items.title: Different hippocampal subfield volumes predict source memory performance and general cognitive ability in an adult lifespan sample
items.title_zh: 海马亚区体积预测成年人的源记忆表现与认知能力
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了海马及其亚区体积与认知健康成年人源记忆表现和一般认知能力之间的关系。研究对象为163名年龄在18至87岁之间的成年人，采用高分辨率T1和T2加权结构成像，并进行全面的神经心理测试和源记忆扫描测试。通过主成分分析将神经心理测试得分归纳为5个认知成分，其中两个成分反映记忆表现，三个成分反映非记忆认知的不同方面。结果显示，CA2-3亚区体积与源记忆表现显著相关，而记忆和非记忆表现的关联则与亚区体积有关。研究表明，海马亚区体积可能在认知能力中发挥重要作用。
items.abstract: Modest positive associations between episodic memory performance and whole hippocampal and hippocampal subfield volumes have been reported in numerous prior studies. A smaller number of studies have reported associations between hippocampal volume and performance on tests of non-mnemonic cognition. The present study examined whether these associations were evident in a lifespan sample of cognitively healthy adults. Of particular interest was whether any identified associations were sensitive to age, and whether associations between subfield volumes and mnemonic and non-mnemonic performance were subfield dependent. We acquired high-resolution T1- and T2-weighted structural images from 163 adults (18-87 years of age). Participants also undertook a comprehensive neuropsychological test battery and an in-scanner test of source memory. Principal components analysis was employed to reduce the neuropsychological test scores to 5 cognitive components. Two components reflected memory performance while the other three reflected different aspects of non-mnemonic cognition. items.title: A single-nucleus multi-omic atlas of gene regulation across 21 adult human tissues
items.title_zh: 21种成人人体组织基因调控的单细胞多组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 不同的人类细胞类型通过谱系和环境特异性的调控程序建立专门功能。为了解释非编码遗传风险，需要整合的多组学参考图谱，直接连接调控DNA与人类组织中的细胞表达。本研究呈现了一个单细胞多组学图谱，包含来自21种成人组织和四位供体的459,856个转录组和染色质可及性谱，涵盖160,688个细胞核的配对测量。该图谱解析了九个细胞谱系、61种广泛细胞类型和313个亚簇，并识别了1,085,062个候选顺式调控元件（cCREs），其中161,270个为ENCODE中缺失的新元件。调控活性主要受细胞身份主导，但受到组织环境的细化。联合分析揭示了871,177个cCRE-基因关联，并显示谱系特异的调控结构。跨组织可及性进一步识别了谱系限制和持续不可及的染色质区域，后者在多种人类癌症中表现出优先的低甲基化。此外，我们利用该数据集训练序列-功能模型，预测548,656个精细映射变体的染色质可及性效应，识别出18,133个高效应变体，包括1,120个广泛活跃变体。针对八种内皮亚型训练的模型进一步解析了预测的变体效应。
items.abstract: Diverse human cell types establish specialized functions through lineage- and context-specific regulatory programs. Interpreting non-coding genetic risk requires integrated multi-omic reference maps that directly connect regulatory DNA to cellular expression across human tissues. Here we present a single-nucleus multi-omic atlas comprising 459,856 transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility profiles from 21 adult human tissues and four donors, including paired measurements from 160,688 nuclei. The atlas resolves nine cell lineages, 61 broad cell types and 313 subclusters, and identifies 1,085,062 candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), including 161,270 novel elements absent from ENCODE. Regulatory activity was dominated by cell identity but refined by tissue context. Joint profiling enabled 871,177 cCRE-gene associations and revealed lineage-specific regulatory architectures. Cross-tissue accessibility further identified lineage-restricted and constitutively inaccessible chromatin domains, the latter showing preferential hypomethylation across human cancers. Furthermore, we leverage this dataset to train sequence-to-function models to predict chromatin-accessibility effects for

items.title: TFAM Dependent Mitochondrial Fitness Limits CD8⁺ T Cell Immunopathology and Sustains Protective Immunity during Viral Pneumonia
items.title_zh: TFAM依赖的线粒体适应性限制CD8⁺ T细胞免疫病理
items.summary_zh: 在呼吸道病毒感染过程中，CD8 T细胞通过杀死感染细胞和建立抗原特异性记忆来发挥作用，但调控这些功能的机制尚不完全清楚。本研究发现线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）依赖的线粒体适应性是流感感染期间CD8 T细胞功能的调节因子。人类CD8 T细胞的TFAM表达和线粒体功能随着年龄的增长而下降。为模拟这种生理相关的下降并确定其对抗病毒免疫的影响，我们生成了CD8 T细胞特异性TFAM半缺失小鼠。TFAM不足导致线粒体完整性和生物能量学受损，增加线粒体DNA和氧化应激。在流感感染期间，TFAM不足的CD8 T细胞表现出增加的细胞毒性和炎症活性，伴随肺部免疫病理，但未改善病毒控制。此早期表型随后表现为效应功能丧失、抗原特异性反应减弱、转移后保护降低以及异亚型记忆免疫受损。因此，TFAM依赖的线粒体适应性是限制免疫病理并维持记忆免疫的细胞内在调节因子。
items.abstract: During respiratory virus infection, CD8 T cells kill infected cells and establish antigen-specific memory, but mechanisms regulating these functions remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify mitochondrial transcription factor A (TFAM)-dependent mitochondrial fitness as a regulator of CD8 T cell function during influenza infection. Human CD8 T cells exhibited an age-associated decline in TFAM expression and mitochondrial function. To model this physiologically relevant decline and determine its consequences for antiviral immunity, we generated CD8 T cell-specific TFAM-haploinsufficient mice. TFAM insufficiency disrupted mitochondrial integrity and bioenergetics and increased mitochondrial DNA and oxidative stress. During influenza infection, TFAM-insufficient CD8 T cells exhibited increased cytotoxic and inflammatory activity associated with lung immunopathology without improved viral control. This early phenotype was followed by loss of effector function, diminished antigen-specific responses, reduced protection following adoptive transfer, and impaired heterosubtypic recall immunity. Thus, TFAM-dependent mitochondrial fitness is a cell-intrinsic regulator that limits immun

items.title: Gasdermin E couples mitochondrial stress to STING-driven neuronal pyroptosis during Chandipura virus encephalitis
items.title_zh: 气体免疫素E连接线粒体应激与STING驱动的神经元焦亡
items.summary_zh: 神经嗜性RNA病毒是全球致命脑炎的主要原因，但感染神经元如何从抗病毒防御转变为炎症性细胞死亡尚不明确。Chandipura病毒（CHPV）是一种新兴的神经嗜性狂犬病毒，导致儿童急性、快速进展的脑炎，且病死率高。研究表明，CHPV早期抑制经典RNA病毒感知，随后转向线粒体驱动的先天免疫程序，最终导致炎症性细胞死亡。CHPV感染早期，神经元细胞中线粒体抗病毒适配蛋白MAVS水平降低，I型和III型干扰素反应减弱。随着感染进展，线粒体功能障碍促进mtROS积累、切割的GSDME在线粒体的积累及细胞质mtDNA释放，激活STING，伴随强烈的神经炎症和焦亡。药物抑制或基因沉默STING显著减弱炎症信号，防止焦亡膜破裂，保护神经元不死亡，而不显著影响病毒复制。相反，GSDME缺失减少了病毒复制和神经元死亡。
items.abstract: Neurotropic RNA viruses are major causes of fatal encephalitis worldwide, yet how infected neurons transition from antiviral defense to inflammatory cell death is not well characterized. Chandipura virus (CHPV), an emerging neurotropic rhabdovirus, causes acute, rapidly progressive encephalitis with high case fatality in children, but the mechanisms underlying its neuropathogenesis remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that CHPV suppresses canonical RNA virus sensing early but subsequently switches to a mitochondria-driven innate immune program that culminates in inflammatory cell death. Early infection of neuronal cells with CHPV was marked by reduced levels of the mitochondrial antiviral adaptor protein, MAVS and attenuation of type I and III interferon responses. As infection progressed, mitochondrial dysfunction promoted accumulation of mtROS, mitochondrial accumulation of cleaved GSDME and cytosolic mtDNA release, triggering STING activation, which coincided with robust neuroinflammation and pyroptotic cell death. Pharmacological inhibition or genetic silencing of STING markedly attenuated inflammatory signaling, prevented pyroptotic membrane rupture and protected neuron
items.authors: Mukherjee, P.; Kumari, N.; Dutta, S.; Priyadarsini, A.; Biswas, J.; Roy, S.; Samanta, S.; Chakraborty, S.; Roy, J.; Basu, A.; Mukhopadhyay, D.; Saha, A.

items.title: A hydrogen-producing mitochondrion in an anaerobic eukaryotrophic rhizarian
items.title_zh: 厌氧真核营养性根足类中的氢产生线粒体
items.summary_zh: 多样的真核生物在低氧环境中繁衍生息，部分原因是高度改造的线粒体相关细胞器（MROs）利用替代代谢途径支持ATP生产和辅因子回收。厌氧生活方式在真核生物的进化树上多次演化，为理解真核生物如何适应低氧环境提供了独立机会。本研究利用单细胞转录组学重建了PCE SSF的MRO代谢，PCE SSF是一种底栖真核营养性鞭毛虫，也是新分类群12（NC12；根足类）的首个培养代表。PCE SSF具有一种厌氧氢产生线粒体，能够进行氢体类型的底物水平磷酸化，并保留几乎完整但可能分支的三羧酸循环途径，缺乏柠檬酸合酶和苹果酸脱氢酶。柠檬酸合酶的功能可能由典型的细胞质ATP柠檬酸裂解酶代替。PCE SSF仅保留电子传递链的复合体II及NuoE/NuoF亚基，且缺乏线粒体基因组。这些特征表明其线粒体代谢不典型且简化，突显了进化的多样性。
items.abstract: Diverse eukaryotes thrive under low oxygen conditions, in part through highly modified mitochondrion-related organelles (MROs) that use alternate metabolic pathways to support ATP production and cofactor recycling. Anaerobic lifestyles have evolved repeatedly across the eukaryotic tree of life, each providing an independent opportunity to understand how eukaryotes adapt to life in low oxygen conditions. Here, we use single-cell transcriptomics to reconstruct the MRO metabolism of PCE SSF, a benthic eukaryotrophic flagellate and the first cultivated representative of Novel Clade 12 (NC12; Rhizaria), an independently anaerobic rhizarian lineage. PCE SSF possesses an anaerobic hydrogen-producing mitochondrion capable of hydrogenosome-type substrate-level phosphorylation. It also retains a nearly complete but likely branched tricarboxylic acid pathway that lacks citrate synthase and malate dehydrogenase. The function of citrate synthase may instead be fulfilled by the typically cytosolic ATP citrate lyase, previously reported in this context only in the anaerobic cercozoan, Brevimastigomonas motovehiculus. Unlike B. motovehiculus, however, PCE SSF retains only Complex II and the NuoE/N
items.authors: Lawton, M.; Eglit, Y.; Stairs, C. W.; Gawryluk, R. M. R.

items.title: Sex-specific metabolic regulation by the Drosophila RNA-binding protein Nab2
items.title_zh: 果蝇RNA结合蛋白Nab2的性别特异性代谢调控
items.summary_zh: 保守的RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）调节基因表达的关键步骤，包括mRNA处理、转运、定位、稳定性和翻译。人类ZC3H14是一种保守的RBP，调控神经元中的前mRNA处理，其缺失会导致神经缺陷。研究果蝇中ZC3H14的同源物Nab2发现其可能影响代谢相关的靶RNA。我们发现雌性果蝇的dilp2和dilp5 mRNA水平显著增加，dilps编码从大脑胰岛素产生细胞（IPCs）向外周组织传递信号的类胰岛素肽。Nab2缺失的雌性果蝇脂肪体内脂滴增大，Nab2的神经元缺失会增加脂滴大小，而在Nab2缺失雌性果蝇中表达Nab2可以恢复这一表型，表明Nab2在调节dilp水平的神经回路中发挥作用。此外，从IPCs中去除dilp2或dilp5可以拯救Nab2缺失雌性果蝇的脂滴增大表型，说明dilp2/dilp5的升高与脂滴增大相关。这些数据支持Nab2在雌性果蝇大脑神经元中支持胰岛素信号传导和脂肪储存的特异性作用，扩展了RBPs在神经功能与代谢稳态之间的已知功能。
items.abstract: Conserved RNA binding proteins (RBPs) regulate key steps of gene expression including mRNA processing, export, localization, stability and translation. Human ZC3H14 is a conserved RBP that regulates pre-mRNA processing in neurons and loss of ZC3H14 leads to neurological defects. Studies of Nab2, the Drosophila orthologue of ZC3H14, have identified potential target RNAs involved in metabolism, suggesting Nab2 may influence neurometabolic circuitry. Here, we show a female-specific increase in dilp2 and dilp5 mRNA levels. The dilps encode insulin-like peptides that signal from the brain insulin producing cells (IPCs) to peripheral tissues. Nab2null females have enlarged lipid droplets in the fat body, a tissue analogous to human adipose tissue and liver. Notably, neuronal depletion of Nab2 increases lipid droplet size while neuronal expression of Nab2 in Nab2null female rescues this phenotype supporting a role for Nab2 in a neuronal circuit that regulates dilp levels. Furthermore, depletion of dilp2 or dilp5 from IPCs rescues the enlarged lipid droplet phenotype in Nab2null females indicating that elevated dilp2/dilp5 contributes to enlarged lipid droplets. Together, these data suppor
items.authors: Goldy, J. N.; Dunlop, H.; Patel, D. D.; McSweeney, R. M.; Leung, S. W.; Gorkin, D. U.; Corbett, A. H.; Moberg, K.

items.title: Not all TOP RNAs are created equal: 3'UTR length and TSS selection predict the translational regulation of LARP1-bound mRNAs in CD4+ T cells
items.title_zh: 不同TOP RNA的转录调控：3'UTR长度与TSS选择的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于CD4+ T细胞中LARP1结合mRNA的转录调控。我们通过交联免疫沉淀（CLIP）技术生成了详细的LARP1-RNA相互作用数据集，分析了初始和激活状态下的CD4+ T细胞，识别出新的TOP RNA。结果显示，RP mRNA具有高稳定性和转录抑制特性，激活后依赖MTORC1的翻译增加。相比之下，其他TOP RNA在调控方面表现出差异，尤其是较长的3'UTR对LARP1的稳定性依赖性较低，且对MTORC1的翻译依赖性减弱。此外，转录起始位点的异质性导致了不同TOP基序长度的转录异构体混合，较长的终端寡聚嘧啶序列与更高的依赖性相关。
items.abstract: Naive T cells are poised for activation and contain a pool of translationally repressed ribosomal protein (RP) mRNA prepared to induce ribosome biogenesis to support protein synthesis, cell growth and proliferation. RP mRNA are the prototypical members of a class of transcripts initiating at cytosine followed by a CU rich element called terminal oligo pyrimidine (TOP) RNAs. TOP RNAs are regulated by an RNA binding protein LARP1, which promotes transcript stabilisation and translational repression. We investigated LARP1 function in T cell activation by generating cross-linking immunoprecipitation (CLIP) datasets detailing the LARP1-RNA interactions in naive and activated CD4+ T cells and identifying novel TOP RNAs. TOP RNAs identified by this analysis were functionally diverse. RP mRNAs were typified by high stability, and translational repression in naive T cells followed by MTORC1-dependent translation increases following T cell activation. However, other TOP RNAs varied in these aspects of their regulation. items.authors: Galloway, A.; Cowling, V. H.

items.title: Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy for Wound Management: Clinical Evidence, Energy Delivery Parameters and Mechanistic Insights - A Systematic Review
items.title_zh: 体外冲击波治疗在创伤管理中的应用：系统综述
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：慢性创伤如糖尿病足溃疡、静脉性腿溃疡和烧伤对医疗系统造成重大负担。体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）是一种非侵入性治疗，促进血管生成和组织再生。本综述综合了ESWT在创伤管理中的临床证据，并探讨了当代综述的反映情况。方法：根据PRISMA标准，从创伤类型、研究设计或ESWT方式出发，检索了PubMed和Ovid/Embase数据库，时间范围为创立至2026年9月1日。分析了51项临床研究和46篇先前的综述。由于异质性，主要合成限于定性分析；对一个一致报告的终点进行了探索性汇总分析。结果：46篇已发表的综述中没有一篇全面覆盖原始证据：每篇引用的临床研究中位数为19.4%（范围0-90.9%），系统综述不超过叙述性综述。大多数研究报告四种方式均有愈合改善。在七项报告完全愈合事件和分母的对照试验中，汇总风险比支持ESWT（1.51，95% CI 1.22-1.87；I2 = 0%；689名患者）。此类数据仅存在于三种方式中，且两种方式依赖于一项试验，因此无法比较方式。结论：ESWT在创伤管理中显示出潜在的疗效。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Chronic wounds such as diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ul-cers and burns are a major health-care burden. Extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) is a non-invasive treatment that promotes angiogenesis and tissue regenera-tion. This review synthesizes the clinical evidence for ESWT in wound management, and asks how contemporary reviews reflect it. Methods: PubMed and Ovid/Embase were searched from inception to 1 September 2026 according to PRISMA, regardless of wound type, study design or ESWT modality. Fifty-one clinical studies and 46 prior re-views were analyzed. Heterogeneity confined the primary synthesis to a qualitative one; an exploratory pooled analysis was performed for the one endpoint reported con-sistently enough to permit it. Results: None of the 46 previously published reviews covered the original evidence in its full breadth: each cited a median of 19.4% of the clinical studies available at its reference date (range 0-90.9%), and systematic reviews covered no more than narrative ones. Most studies reported improved healing across all four modalities. In seven controlled trials reporting complete healing as events and denominators, the pooled r
items.authors: Nussbaum-Krammer, C.; Musolf, B. M.; O'Neal, M.; Wuerfel, T.; Maffulli, N.; Schmitz, C.

items.title: Reporting Odds Ratio Analysis of Gemcitabine-Based Chemotherapy Regimens for Biliary and Pancreatic Cancer: Population-Level Toxicity Signals and Hypotheses for High-Altitude Generalizability
items.title_zh: 吉西他滨化疗方案对胆道及胰腺癌的毒性信号分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：吉西他滨化疗是晚期胆道癌（BTC）和胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的首选治疗，但在高海拔地区（>2000米）的毒性模式尚不明确。本研究基于我院（西宁，约2261米）的临床观察，开展了吉西他滨毒性信号的群体水平基线研究。方法：对FAERS 2014-2026年（1837万份报告）数据进行四指标不成比例分析，涵盖五个非独占的吉西他滨组（单药、+ICI、+TKI、三联、BTC/PDAC特定疾病）。肝毒性分为三组，致死性毒性采用双重定义分析。结果：14/17的暴露-不良事件组合通过了三项频率学标准（ROR/PRR/IC下限），显示出吉西他滨在高海拔地区的毒性信号。
items.abstract: Background: Gemcitabine-based chemotherapy is first-line for advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), but toxicity patterns are poorly defined at high altitude (>2,000 m). Clinical observations of heightened treatment toxicity at our high-altitude institution (Xining, ~2,261 m) prompted this population-level baseline study of gemcitabine toxicity signals. The present analysis uses only publicly available, de-identified FAERS data; institutional clinical experience motivates but does not validate the signals reported here. Methods: Four-metric disproportionality analysis (ROR primary, PRR, IC BCPNN, EBGM MGPS) of FAERS 2014-2026 (18.37M reports) across five non-exclusive gemcitabine groups (monotherapy, +ICI, +TKI, triple, BTC/PDAC disease-specific). Liver toxicity stratified into three MedDRA PT groups; fatal toxicity analyzed with dual definitions. BTC/PDAC queried via correct patient.drug.drugindication field. BH-FDR post hoc. EBGM used two implementations: a non-standard single-pair gamma(1,1) closed-form approximation (positivity-screening column in S1) and the standard openEBGM two-component MGPS. items.authors: Dang, Z.; Dan, J.; Li, S.; Yanan, L.; Su, W.; Ren, G.; Wang, Z.; Lv, M.; Dong, H.; Niu, Z.; Zhang, H.; Fan, Y.; Li, L.; Dang, Y.; Gao, J.

items.title: Clinical history shapes the predictive value of polygenic risk
items.title_zh: 临床历史影响多基因风险预测价值
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用来自英国生物银行和FinnGen的90万参与者，开发并验证了150种疾病及全因死亡率的预测模型。结果显示，遗传信息在代谢、心血管、自身免疫和神经系统疾病的预测中提供了最大的增益，但对泌尿生殖和呼吸系统疾病的贡献较小。所有显著的PRS-临床风险交互作用均为负向，表明在较低临床风险下，遗传数据的预测能力提升更大，提示PRS可能揭示尚未在临床上显现的易感性。例如，在动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病中，PRS将临床识别的高风险亚组扩大了40%，该亚组在随访期间的发病率是低风险组的4.9倍。我们的可解释临床-遗传模型在三个生物银行中具有广泛适用性，并通过PrognosIQ公开提供。
items.abstract: For most diseases, whether PRS improves prediction beyond clinical data remains unknown, as existing evidence is concentrated in a handful of conditions with established risk models. Using 900,000 participants from UK Biobank and FinnGen, we developed and validated models for predicting 150 diseases and all-cause mortality. Genetic information provided the largest predictive gains in metabolic, cardiovascular, autoimmune, and neurological disease, but added little for genitourinary and respiratory conditions. All significant PRS-clinical risk interactions were negative, with predictive power gains from genetic data larger at lower clinical risk, suggesting that PRS may reveal susceptibility not yet apparent clinically. For example, in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, PRS expanded the clinically identified high-risk subgroup by 40%, and this reclassified subgroup had 4.9-fold higher incidence during the follow-up than those remaining low-risk. Our interpretable clinical-genetic models generalized across three biobanks and are publicly available through PrognosIQ.

items.title: Falling short: Inadequate target attainment in guideline-based therapy of nontuberculous mycobacterial disease
items.title_zh: 非结核分枝杆菌病治疗中的靶标达成不足
items.summary_zh: 非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）感染因与机会性病原体相关的风险因素增加而影响越来越多的患者群体。尽管进行多药物和多年治疗，治愈率仍然低下。药物暴露不足与重新利用抗生素对NTM病原体的效力较差被广泛认为是成功率低的主要因素。然而，缺乏对药代动力学-药效学（PK-PD）靶标达成概率的定量和系统评估。我们利用已发布的人群PK模型和大规模患者群体的最小抑菌浓度分布，生成了用于NTM感染治疗的标准抗生素的靶标达成概率（PTA）。我们将结核病药物的PTA纳入分析作为基线，因为结核病的治愈率相较于NTM疾病较高。结果显示，NTM的PK-PD靶标达成总体较低，PTA与临床结果一致。特别是与较差预后相关的遗传抗性药物显示出有利的PTA，支持其在治愈中的作用，包括针对M. abscessus和M. avium复合体的大环内酯类药物，以及针对M. kansasii的利福平。贝达喹啉被认为是对抗M. abscessus的有前景的选择。
items.abstract: Nontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) infections are a scourge that affect growing patient populations due to the rise of risk factors associated with these opportunistic pathogens. Cure rates are unacceptably low despite intensive multidrug and multi-year therapy. The issue of poor drug exposure relative to inferior potency of repurposed antibiotics against NTM pathogens is broadly recognized as a major factor underlying dismal success rates. Yet, a quantitative and systematic evaluation of probabilities of pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic (PK-PD) target attainment (PTA) is lacking. Here, we leveraged published population PK models and minimum inhibitory concentration distributions across large patient populations to generate PTAs for standard of care antibiotics used in the treatment of NTM infections. PTAs of tuberculosis drugs were included in our analysis as a baseline since tuberculosis cure rates are excellent compared to NTM diseases. We found that PK-PD target attainment for NTM was low overall and that PTAs were generally consistent with reported clinical outcomes. Specifically, drugs for which genetic resistance is associated with worse outcome showed favorable PTAs, consist

items.title: Race and ethnicity in the landmark hypertrophic cardiomyopathy trials: representation against population, site-catchment, and disease-referenced expectations
items.title_zh: 种族与民族在肥厚型心肌病试验中的代表性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是一种跨种族疾病，在黑人和白人美国人中发病率相当，但黑人患者获得专科护理的时间较晚，进行室间隔减容的机会较少，且死亡率更高。本研究旨在评估标志性HCM试验中黑人参与者的比例，并与美国成人人口、试验地点县和疾病参考的超声心动图预期进行比较。方法：在197个注册的干预性HCM试验中，有32个符合预设的标志性标准；对16个试验的人口统计数据进行提取，13个报告了种族。结果：在13个试验中，1780名参与者中有70名为黑人，黑人参与者的比例为3.98%，远低于16.5%的预期，参与与流行率比为0.24，为所有种族和/或民族少数群体中最低。结论：临床试验网络覆盖了63.7%的黑人和47.5%的白人美国成年人。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a pan-ethnic disease, at least as common in Black as in White Americans, yet Black patients reach specialist care later, undergo septal reduction less often, and die sooner. Whether the defining trials enrolled representatively is unknown. We sought to measure Black participation in the landmark HCM trials against three expectations of increasing stringency, and to test whether trial site geography or quantitative eligibility thresholds account for the shortfall. METHODS: Of 197 registered interventional HCM trials, 32 met prespecified landmark tiers; demographics were extracted for 16 and 13 reported race. The Black share of Black plus White participants was pooled by random-effects meta-analysis and compared with the US adult population, with each trial?s own site counties, and with a disease-referenced echocardiographic expectation. Site geography and eligibility thresholds were tested using site addresses, census data, and NHANES. RESULTS: Across 13 trials, 70 of 1,780 Black or White participants were Black. The pooled Black share was 3.98% (95% CI 2.68-5.86), against a population expectation of 16.5%, giving a participation-to-p

items.title: Effect of HPV Vaccine Introduction at 9-10 years: A Randomized Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: 9-10岁接种HPV疫苗的影响：随机临床试验
items.summary_zh: 重要性：在美国，HPV相关癌症导致显著的发病率和死亡率，但HPV疫苗的使用率较低。推荐在11-12岁时常规接种，但可在9岁时接种。关于早期接种是否会提高13岁前完成HPV疫苗系列的比例，或是否会降低11-12岁时其他常规疫苗（四价脑膜炎球菌结合疫苗和破伤风-白喉-无细胞百日咳疫苗）的接种率存在争议。目的：比较9-10岁与11-12岁接种HPV疫苗对系列完成的中位年龄（主要结果）及13岁前接种和完成率的影响。方法：在2021年10月至2026年4月期间，进行了一项涉及科罗拉多州和加利福尼亚州31个儿科诊所的两组集群随机试验。结果显示，干预组（9-10岁接种）与对照组（11-12岁接种）在HPV疫苗接种的最佳实践培训上相似，唯一的差异是推荐的接种年龄。
items.abstract: Importance: In the US, Human papillomavirus (HPV) related cancers cause significant morbidity and mortality, yet HPV vaccine is underutilized. Vaccination is recommended routinely at age 11-12 years but can be given at 9 years. There is controversy about whether earlier introduction would increase completion of the HPV series before by age 13 years or whether it might decrease rates of delivery of other routinely recommended vaccines at 11-12-years [quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine, and tetanus-diptheria-acellular pertussis (Tdap) vaccine]. Objective: To determine whether introduction of the HPV vaccine at ages 9-10 versus 11-12 years, results in earlier median age of series completion (primary outcome) and higher rates of initiation and completion by age 13 years. We also examined the effect of earlier introduction of HPV on rates of Tdap and MenACWY initiation and completion by age 13 years. items.title: Partner-inflicted brain injury may cognitively age survivors by over a decade
items.title_zh: 伴侣造成的脑损伤可能使幸存者认知年龄增加十年以上
items.summary_zh: 在美国，估计超过三分之一的女性经历亲密伴侣的虐待，其中头部撞击、窒息等导致脑损伤的情况较为常见。在207名经历此类身体暴力的幸存者中，三分之二报告了伴侣造成的脑损伤。这些女性在大多数认知测量中表现明显低于一般人群，包括记忆和反应时间。随着脑损伤数量的增加，认知表现下降。认知年龄的计算显示，脑损伤最多的幸存者的表现比一般人群大约老了二十岁，比没有脑损伤历史的幸存者老了十岁。重要的是，认知评估排除了被认为不可靠的分数，而这些分数主要来自受损最严重的女性，表明实际伤害可能大于此处报告的结果。这些认知缺陷可能限制这些女性实现潜力的能力，包括保护自己免受虐待。这些发现强调伴侣造成的脑损伤是一个主要且未被充分认识的认知伤害来源，可能影响的女性数量超过职业足球或军队中的脑损伤，但缺乏相应的临床认可和护理。
items.abstract: More than a third of women in the United States are estimated to experience abuse from an intimate partner, in which blows to the head, strangulation, and therefore brain injuries are common. Among 207 survivors of such physical violence, two-thirds reported a partner-inflicted brain injury. These women performed substantially worse than the general population across most cognitive measures, including memory and reaction time. Cognitive performance declined as injury count increased. Translated into cognitive age, survivors with the most partner-inflicted brain injuries performed over two decades older than the general population, and a decade older than survivors with no history of brain injury. Importantly, the cognitive assessment discards scores it judges unreliable, yet these came primarily from the most impaired women, suggesting that the true harm is likely greater than reported here. Such cognitive deficits may limit these women's capacity to live to their potential, including keeping safe from abuse. These findings underscore partner-inflicted brain injury as a major, under-recognized source of cognitive harm, potentially affecting more women than brain injury in professio

items.title: FRANK: a pan-cancer RNA-seq classifier for childhood tumors with data-efficient learning
items.title_zh: FRANK：儿童肿瘤的全癌种RNA-seq分类器
items.summary_zh: 准确识别肿瘤亚型对指导儿童癌症治疗至关重要。本文提出FRANK（全连接RNA增强神经分类器），一种用于分类全癌种儿童肿瘤的机器学习方法。我们整理了11,467个转录组，构建了一个高质量的训练数据集，涵盖181种不同的儿童肿瘤和正常组织类型。通过使用广泛的数据增强技术和层次惩罚项，我们训练了一个神经网络，能够在仅有三个训练样本的情况下检测肿瘤类型。我们在包含16,398个样本的九个数据集上进行验证，模型总体准确率达到98.3%。此外，FRANK在外部数据集上优于其他已发布的儿童全癌种RNA-seq分类器。我们还展示了FRANK在长读长RNA测序数据以及噪声和低质量数据上的准确性。
items.abstract: Accurate characterization of tumor subtype is of paramount importance in guiding treatment decisions in pediatric cancers. Here, we present FRANK (Fully-connected RNA-based Augmentation Neural Klassifier), a machine learning approach for classifying pan-cancer pediatric tumors. We curated a set of 11,467 transcriptomes to build a high-quality training dataset representing 181 distinct childhood tumor and normal tissue types. We used extensive data augmentation techniques with a hierarchical penalty term to train a neural network capable of detecting tumor types with as few as three training examples. To evaluate the generalization of the trained model, we perform validation on nine datasets spanning 16,398 samples, achieving an overall accuracy of 98.3%. Furthermore, we demonstrated that FRANK outperformed other published pediatric pan-cancer RNA-seq classifiers on an external dataset. To evaluate the robustness, we showed that FRANK remained accurate when applied to long-read RNA-sequencing data, as well as to noisy and low-quality data.
items.authors: Sablauskas, K.; Kiselova, T.; Bardina, L.; Nartisa, I.; Zucenka, A.; Viluma, A.; Gailite, L.; Jakaitiene, A.; Rots, D.

items.title: Validating Artificial Intelligence Guidance for Ultrasound Acquisition and Remote Interpretation
items.title_zh: 验证人工智能引导下的超声获取与远程解读
items.summary_zh: 背景：静脉血栓栓塞（VTE），包括深静脉血栓（DVT），仍然是全球健康的重要负担。诊断路径依赖超声，但受限于可用性和成像时间延长。新型人工智能（AI）引导系统旨在使非超声训练的操作员能够获取近端下肢压迫超声，以供远程临床医生解读。方法：本多中心、双盲、前瞻性非随机研究评估了AI引导系统（ThinkSono Guidance, ThinkSono, GmbH）的性能。患者接受了AI引导超声和标准护理超声。主要和次要终点为图像质量、近端DVT的灵敏度和特异性，以及优先级特异性。结果：在634名招募对象中，594名被分析，700次扫描中发现67例DVT。86.83%的AI引导扫描达到了诊断图像质量。分诊灵敏度为92.86%，分诊特异性为39.12%，优先级特异性为97.96%。35.32%的患者可以避免标准护理超声。AI引导扫描和审查的总中位时间为7.57分钟。结论：临床医生审核的AI引导扫描快速、对DVT敏感，并在优先级上具有特异性。
items.abstract: Background: Venous thromboembolism (VTE), including deep vein thrombosis (DVT), remains a major global health burden. Diagnostic pathways rely on ultrasound but are limited by availability and prolonged time-to-imaging. Novel artificial intelligence (AI) guidance systems have been designed to enable non-ultrasound-trained operators to acquire proximal lower extremity compression ultrasounds for remote clinician interpretation. Methods: This multicenter, double-blinded, prospective, nonrandomized study evaluated the performance of an AI guidance system (ThinkSono Guidance, ThinkSono, GmbH). Patients underwent AI-guided ultrasound(s) and standard of care ultrasound(s). Primary and secondary endpoints were image quality, sensitivity and specificity for proximal DVT, and prioritization specificity, a measure of specificity in identifying patients requiring standard of care ultrasound after AI-guided scan. Results: Of 634 recruited subjects, 594 were analyzed, with 67 DVTs across 700 scans. 86.83% of AI-guided scans achieved diagnostic image quality. Triage sensitivity was 92.86%, triage specificity 39.12%, prioritization specificity 97.96%. Standard of care ultrasounds could be avoided

items.title: A Structure-Aware Self-Supervised Framework for Transferable Fetal Ultrasound Screening
items.title_zh: 基于结构感知的自监督框架用于可转移胎儿超声筛查
items.summary_zh: 准确的胎儿超声影像产前筛查受到胎儿结构极端空间异质性和稀有先天性异常数据稀缺的限制。为克服这些计算瓶颈，我们提出了RadarMAE，一个针对胎儿超声分析的数据高效自监督表示学习框架。通过采用新颖的结构感知掩蔽策略，RadarMAE能够在高度有限的临床数据集上进行稳健的预训练。在对21三体综合症（唐氏综合症）进行的第一孕期筛查基准测试中，我们的模型在内部队列中取得了卓越的诊断性能，曲线下面积（AUC）为0.99，准确率97%，灵敏度94%，特异性98%。通过领域对抗适应，该框架在极端源-目标数据不平衡下表现出强大的跨机构泛化能力，外部测试中所有关键指标的性能下降限制在0.04以内。此外，通过将空间配准与可解释人工智能结合，我们构建了第一个针对21三体综合症的人群级面部风险图谱。该数据驱动的可解释性框架验证了标准临床标志，同时揭示了未充分利用特征（如下颌畸形）的可比诊断权重。最终，该方法提供了一个有效的筛查工具。
items.abstract: Accurate prenatal screening from ultrasound imaging is severely constrained by the extreme spatial heterogeneity of fetal structures and the data scarcity inherent to rare congenital anomalies. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present RadarMAE, a data-efficient self-supervised representation learning framework tailored for fetal ultrasound analysis. By employing a novel, structure-aware masking strategy, RadarMAE enables robust pre-training on highly limited clinical datasets. Benchmarking the framework on first-trimester screening for trisomy 21 (Down syndrome), our model achieved exceptional diagnostic performance on an internal cohort, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.99, 97% accuracy, 94% sensitivity, and 98% specificity. Crucially, through domain-adversarial adaptation, the framework demonstrates robust cross-institutional generalization under extreme source-target data imbalance, bounding performance degradation to less than or equal to 0.04 across all key metrics in external testing. Furthermore, by integrating spatial registration with explainable AI, we constructed the first population-level facial risk atlas for trisomy 21. This data-driven interpret

items.title: OPA1 controls mitochondrial dysfunction-driven liver fibrosis in MASLD
items.title_zh: OPA1在代谢功能障碍相关肝纤维化中的作用
items.summary_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病和脂肪性肝炎（MASLD/MASH）中的进展性肝纤维化是主要的发病和死亡因素。线粒体功能障碍是MASH的特征，受损肝细胞释放的线粒体损伤相关分子模式（mito-DAMPs）可促进纤维化。通过对约70万名个体的线粒体基因进行大规模基因组分析，我们发现肝纤维化与线粒体融合因子OPA1存在强关联。随着纤维化的进展，肝上皮中OPA1转录本和蛋白质丰度逐渐失调。在小鼠实验中，肝细胞特异性缺失OPA1足以诱导肝星状细胞激活和第3区纤维化，促进mito-DAMPs释放并加重实验性MASH中的纤维化。这些发现表明OPA1是肝纤维化反应的核心调节因子，并将线粒体稳态缺陷与MASLD中的mito-DAMP释放、肝星状细胞激活和纤维化联系起来。
items.abstract: Progressive hepatic fibrosis is the principal determinant of morbidity and mortality in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and steatohepatitis (MASLD/MASH). Mitochondrial dysfunction is a hallmark of MASH, and the release of mitochondrial damage-associated molecular patterns (mito-DAMPs) from injured hepatocytes can promote fibrosis. However, how mitochondrial dynamics and quality control shape the fibrotic response in MASLD/MASH remains unclear. Here, through large-scale genomic analyses of mitochondrial genes governing mitophagy, fusion and fission in human MASLD, with a power-equivalent sample size of approximately 700,000 individuals, we identify a strong association between hepatic fibrosis and the mitochondrial fusion factor dynamin-like GTPase optic atrophy 1 (OPA1). OPA1 transcripts and protein abundance in the liver epithelium were progressively dysregulated with advancing fibrosis. In mice, hepatocyte-specific OPA1 loss alone was sufficient to induce hepatic stellate cell activation and fibrosis in zone 3, promoted the release of mito-DAMPs into the circulation and exacerbated fibrosis in experimental MASH. items.title: Lactate Promotes an Anti-Inflammatory Phenotype in Activated Microglia
items.title_zh: 乳酸促进活化小胶质细胞的抗炎表型
items.summary_zh: 小胶质细胞的活化是许多脑病理中神经炎症反应的核心组成部分。越来越多的证据表明，小胶质细胞的表型与细胞代谢密切相关，促炎活化与增强的糖酵解通量相关。乳酸传统上被视为代谢底物，但最近被发现是一种能够调节免疫反应的信号分子。本研究使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的原代大鼠小胶质细胞培养，探讨乳酸在炎症条件下对小胶质细胞表型的影响。结果显示，LPS刺激引发了强烈的促炎反应，表现为CD86表达增加、TNF-alpha分泌升高及多种促炎趋化因子的释放增强。用L-乳酸钠后处理显著减轻了这些炎症反应，降低了促炎标志物的表达和细胞因子分泌，同时恢复了抗炎标志物CD206。
items.abstract: Microglial activation is a central component of neuroinflammatory responses in many brain pathologies. Increasing evidence indicates that microglial phenotype is tightly linked to cellular metabolism, with pro-inflammatory activation associated with enhanced glycolytic flux. Lactate, traditionally considered a metabolic substrate, has recently emerged as a signaling molecule capable of modulating immune responses. However, its direct impact on microglial inflammatory activation remains incompletely understood. In the present study, we investigated the effects of lactate on microglial phenotype under inflammatory conditions using primary rat microglial cultures stimulated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS). Microglial activation was assessed through the expression of phenotypic markers, cytokine production, and secreted chemokine profiles. LPS stimulation induced a strong pro-inflammatory response characterized by increased CD86 expression, elevated TNF-alpha secretion, and enhanced release of several pro-inflammatory chemokines. Post-treatment with sodium L-lactate significantly attenuated these inflammatory responses, reducing pro-inflammatory marker expression and cytokine secretion,

items.title: Adult Patient Perspectives on Psychiatric Polygenic Risk Scores
items.title_zh: 成人患者对精神疾病多基因风险评分的看法
items.summary_zh: 多基因风险评分（PRS）正在迅速发展，使得评估精神疾病的遗传风险成为可能。随着精神疾病PRS逐渐进入消费和临床领域，关于成人患者对其潜在使用的看法知之甚少。本研究对29名精神疾病患者进行了半结构化访谈，探讨他们对假设性获得个人及其子女精神疾病PRS的看法。研究发现，参与者对PRS的实用性、基因检测的动机与阻碍、PRS的解读及对结果的预期反应等方面有重要主题。参与者希望PRS能支持自我理解、改善精神护理，并帮助更早识别子女的困难。然而，他们也提出了隐私、污名、歧视、优生学及自我实现预言等多方面的担忧。这些发现为精神疾病PRS在临床和消费领域的负责任使用提供了重要的实证依据。
items.abstract: Polygenic risk scores (PRS) are rapidly developing, enabling estimates of genetic risk for developing psychiatric disorders. Psychiatric PRS are also increasingly entering consumer and clinical settings. Yet, little is known about how adults with psychiatric disorders perceive their potential use. Here, we conducted semi-structured interviews with 29 adults with psychiatric disorders to examine their perspectives on hypothetically receiving psychiatric PRS for themselves and their current or future children. Key themes emerged around perceived utility, motivations and deterrents to genetic testing, interpretation of PRS, and anticipated responses to results. In particular, participants expressed hope that PRS could support self-understanding, inform better psychiatric care, and enable earlier recognition of difficulties for their children. Participants however raised multiple concerns, including those of privacy, stigma, discrimination, eugenics, and the risk of self-fulling prophecies. Together, these findings offer critical empirical evidence to inform guidance on the responsible use of psychiatric PRS in clinical and consumer settings.

items.title: Benchmarking large language models on the Ukrainian Krok 2 licensing examination in physical therapy: accuracy, consistency, and agreement
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型在乌克兰物理治疗Krok 2考试中的表现评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估大型语言模型在乌克兰物理治疗专业的综合执照考试Krok 2中的准确性、一致性和协议。使用来自官方Krok 2数据库的150道乌克兰语多项选择题，评估了五种基于云的语言模型（ChatGPT-5.5、Claude 5 Sonnet、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4、DeepSeek-V3）。每个模型进行了两次独立运行，结果显示所有模型在两次运行中的准确率均超过80%，超过及格线64%。第一次运行中，准确率从DeepSeek-V3的80.00%到Gemini 3.5 Flash的93.33%不等；第二次运行中，准确率从Claude 5 Sonnet的82.67%到Gemini 3.5 Flash的88.67%。所有模型的运行间一致性超过90%，最高为ChatGPT-5.5的98.67%。Cohen's kappa值范围为0.64至0.94，表明模型之间存在良好的协议。
items.abstract: Aim. To evaluate the accuracy, run-to-run consistency, and agreement of large language models on the Ukrainian Integrated Licensing Examination Krok 2 for the Specialty of Physical Therapy. Materials and Methods. Five cloud-based LLMs (ChatGPT-5.5, Claude 5 Sonnet, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4, DeepSeek-V3) were evaluated using 150 Ukrainian-language multiple-choice questions from the official Krok 2 database. Each model completed two independent runs with identical inputs. Accuracy (with 95% confidence intervals, Wilson method), run-to-run consistency, and agreement were assessed. Statistical analysis included Cohen's {kappa}, Cochran's Q and pairwise McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction. Results. All models achieved >80% accuracy in both runs, exceeding the passing threshold of [ ]64%. In the first run, accuracy ranged from 80.00% (DeepSeek-V3) to 93.33% (Gemini 3.5 Flash); in the second run, from 82.67% (Claude 5 Sonnet) to 88.67% (Gemini 3.5 Flash). In the first run significant differences were observed between Gemini 3.5 Flash and Grok 4 (93.33% vs 84.00%; p=0.0022) and DeepSeek-V3 (93.33% vs 80.00%; p=0.0001). items.title: Cell type specific astrocytic feedback regulates excitation inhibition balance and cortical network dynamics
items.title_zh: 特定细胞类型的星形胶质细胞反馈调节兴奋抑制平衡及皮层网络动态
items.summary_zh: 星形胶质细胞积极调节突触传递和神经元兴奋性，但它们在协调宏观皮层网络状态和慢波振荡中的作用仍是研究热点。本研究利用计算网络模型探讨双向神经元与星形胶质细胞的相互作用如何塑造新兴的群体动态。结果表明，星形胶质细胞反馈拓扑结构是新兴皮层网络动态的关键决定因素，而不仅仅是星形胶质细胞的耦合强度。通过系统分析特定通路的连接性，发现驱动星形胶质细胞激活的神经元群体与接收胶质传递的神经元群体共同决定网络是否处于非同步不规则（AI）、同步不规则（SI）、同步规则（SR）、非同步规则（AR）或静息状态。选择性地将胶质传递作用于兴奋性神经元始终促进群体同步，而选择性调节抑制性中间神经元则通过强抑制诱导网络静息。在双靶向胶质传递下，网络同步性由驱动星形胶质细胞动态的群体决定：仅兴奋性驱动促进同步，而组合或抑制性驱动则抑制同步。
items.abstract: Astrocytes actively regulate synaptic transmission and neuronal excitability, yet their role in orchestrating macroscopic cortical network regimes and slow-wave oscillations remains an active area of reasearch. This study investigates how bidirectional neuron astrocyte interactions shape emergent population dynamics using a computational network model of excitatory and inhibitory neurons coupled to an astrocyte. The results identify astrocytic feedback topology, rather than astrocytic coupling strength alone, as a key determinant of emergent cortical network dynamics. items.title: Breaking the link between demyelination and axon loss: SARM1 inhibition as a neuroprotective strategy for multiple sclerosis
items.title_zh: 打破脱髓鞘与轴突损失之间的联系：SARM1抑制作为多发性硬化的神经保护策略
items.summary_zh: 轴突退化是多发性硬化（MS）中不可逆神经功能障碍的主要驱动因素，但现有治疗未能直接针对这一神经退行性阶段。Sterile alpha和TIR结构域含量蛋白1（SARM1）被认为是程序性轴突破坏的执行者，并在MS的灰质和白质组织中过表达，因此其抑制成为一种有前景的治疗策略。我们使用全球SARM1-/-敲除小鼠、AAV介导的CRISPR敲低和SARM1在视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）中的过表达，以及小分子SARM1抑制剂5-碘异喹啉（5IIQ），研究了SARM1病理。在实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）模型中，全球SARM1-/-未改变EAE的整体临床过程，但显示出复杂的表型，伴随外周炎症细胞因子谱的改变和持续的中枢神经系统免疫浸润，同时保持了轴突和髓鞘的完整性。RGC特异性SARM1敲低在EAE期间部分保护了RGCs和轴突，而SARM1过表达则加重了视网膜功能和轴突损伤。使用5IIQ进行药理抑制可保护。
items.abstract: Axonal degeneration is a principal driver of irreversible neurological disability in multiple sclerosis (MS), yet current treatments fail to target this neurodegenerative phase directly. Sterile alpha and TIR domain-containing protein 1 (SARM1) has emerged as an executioner of programmed axon destruction and is overexpressed in grey and white matter MS tissue, making its inhibition a promising therapeutic strategy. However, the effects of SARM1 inhibition on localized neurodegeneration versus systemic and central inflammation remain poorly understood in complex autoimmune environments like MS. Here, we investigated SARM1 pathology using global SARM1-/- knockout (SARM1-/-) mice, AAV-mediated CRISPR knockdown and overexpression of SARM1 in retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), and the small-molecule SARM1 inhibitor 5-iodoisoquinoline (5IIQ), across optic nerve crush (ONC) and experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) models. While global SARM1-/- did not alter the overall clinical course of EAE, it revealed a complex phenotype characterized by an altered peripheral inflammatory cytokine profile and persistent CNS immune infiltration, alongside preserved axonal and myelin integrity. items.title: A founder population reveals genetic variation with major effect on serious mental illness
items.title_zh: 创始人群体揭示对严重精神疾病的重大遗传变异
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对严重精神疾病（SMI，包括精神分裂症和双相情感障碍）的遗传变异进行了分析。我们从哥伦比亚Paisa基因孤立群体的Mision Origen生物库中，对21,958例SMI和重度抑郁症病例及19,826例对照进行外显子组测序，识别出与七个基因的跨诊断关联，其中三个基因在外显子组范围内显著，四个基因在假发现率显著性阈值下显著。五个基因（ADAP1、WIPI1、NFE2L1、FBXO10和HLA-DPB1）首次与SMI相关，前四个基因的关联由因创始人效应而在Paisa群体中富集的变异驱动。我们观察到的最强关联是ADAP1中的一个框移变异（7:904169:T:TC），在SMI、精神分裂症和双相情感障碍中均具有全基因组显著性，并增加了这两种诊断的风险。
items.abstract: Genetic studies of serious mental illness (SMI, including schizophrenia and bipolar disorder) have implicated two classes of risk variant: common variants1-3, each of small effect but collectively accounting for most population-level risk, and ultra-rare coding variants4,5 which confer large risk in a small number of individuals. Most such studies cannot directly assess the impact of specific variants on SMI, transdiagnostically, as the phenotypic information that they collect is focused on a single diagnosis. Here we report results of association analysis of predicted deleterious variants from exome sequencing of 21,958 cases (SMI and severe major depressive disorder) and 19,826 controls from the Mision Origen biobank in the Paisa genetic isolate of Colombia. We identified transdiagnostic associations to seven genes, three at an exome-wide and four at a false discovery rate significance threshold. Five of these genes have not previously been implicated in SMI (ADAP1, WIPI1, NFE2L1, FBXO10, and HLA-DPB1 ); for the first four of these the association is driven by variants enriched in the Paisa due to a founder effect, filling the gap between ultra-rare and common variants. items.title: Nasopharyngeal aspirates and stool sample collection for molecular tuberculosis testing in children with severe pneumonia - a mixed methods study
items.title_zh: 儿童重症肺炎分子结核检测的样本收集研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：需要儿童友好的样本收集方法以改善儿童结核病的微生物学诊断。本研究评估了在3岁儿童中进行鼻咽抽吸（NPA）和粪便样本收集以进行XpertMTB/RIF Ultra（Ultra）检测的可行性、诊断收益、安全性、耐受性和可接受性。通过个别访谈调查护士和家长/看护者对这两种程序的看法和体验。结果：在542名参与儿童中，541名（99.8%）成功收集了NPA样本，423名（75.5%）成功收集了粪便样本；8名（1.5%）在任何样本中检测到阳性Ultra，8名（1.5%）在NPA中，3名（0.6%）在粪便样本中。护士报告27名（5.0%）儿童的NPA收集困难。130名（24%）儿童的NPA样本有血迹，<5%在NPA过程中经历了短暂的心率减慢、消化或呼吸不适。护士评估的耐受性中位评分在NPA前为1/10 [0,3]，在NPA过程中为5/10 [2,6]。尽管大多数受访者认为NPA疼痛，但都认可NPA旨在改善儿童健康。护士表示NPA和粪便收集比胃抽吸更快、侵入性更小。家长/看护者信任护士的技能，并重视NPA的新颖性。所有受访者在粪便收集中参与容易，但对依赖儿童排便感到沮丧。护士强调持续的...
items.abstract: Background: Child-friendly sample collection methods are needed to improve microbiological tuberculosis diagnosis in children. We assessed the feasibility, diagnostic yield, safety, tolerability, and acceptability of nasopharyngeal aspirates (NPA) and stool sample collection for XpertMTB/RIF Ultra (Ultra) testing in children 3 years. Individual interviews investigated nurses and parents/caregivers perceptions and experiences of both procedures. Results: Of 542 children enrolled, 541 (99.8%) and 423 (75.5%) had NPA and stool samples successfully collected, respectively; 8 (1.5%) had positive Ultra on any sample, 8 (1.5%) on NPA, and 3 (0.6%) on stool samples. Nurses reported that NPA was difficult to collect in 27 (5.0%) children. 130 (24%) children had bloodstained NPA samples and <5% experienced transient heart rate deceleration, digestive or respiratory distress during NPA. Median nurse-assessed tolerability scores were 1/10 [0,3] before and 5/10 [2,6] during NPA. Although most respondents perceived NPA as painful, all appreciated that NPA aimed to improve child health. items.title: Genetic architecture of immune-mediated thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura in Han Chinese individuals
items.title_zh: 汉族人群免疫介导性血栓性血小板减少性紫癜的遗传结构
items.summary_zh: 血栓性血小板减少性紫癜（TTP）是一种罕见且危及生命的血栓性微血管病，主要由ADAMTS13蛋白酶的严重缺乏引起。本研究在1,344名汉族个体中进行了首次大规模全基因组关联研究（GWAS），包括发现队列（n = 913）和验证队列（n = 431）。我们识别出两个独立的易感位点，包括已知位点6p21和新发现位点14q32。在已知位点6p21，主信号rs2187668与HLA-DQA1相近，并与TTP风险显著相关（P = 5.35e-10；优势比[OR] = 3.94）。在新位点14q32，主SNP rs1024350（P = 1.01e-10；OR = 1.90）位于LINC00221和MIR5195之间。精细定位分析确认rs2187668为6p21的主信号，而HLA推断和逐步条件分析进一步确定HLA-DRB1的氨基酸位置74为更广泛MHC关联的主要驱动因素（P = 2.28e-10）。结构分析显示，位置74位于HLA-DRB1肽结合沟的口袋4；携带HLA-DRB1*08:03和DRB1*03的风险氨基酸Leu/Arg可能有利于ADAMTS13衍生的自身抗原肽的呈递，而常见的Ala残基则具有保护作用。总之，我们重建了东亚人群中TTP的遗传结构。
items.abstract: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) is a rare, life-threatening thrombotic microangiopathy caused by a severe deficiency of the ADAMTS13 protease. We performed the first large-scale genome-wide association study (GWAS) of TTP in 1,344 individuals of Han Chinese ancestry, comprising a discovery cohort (n = 913) and a validation cohort (n = 431). We identified two independent susceptibility loci, including the known locus 6p21 and the novel locus 14q32. At the known locus 6p21, the lead signal rs2187668 is near HLA-DQA1 and strongly associated with TTP risk (P = 5.35e-10; Odds Ratio [OR] = 3.94). At the novel locus 14q32, the lead SNP rs1024350 (P = 1.01e-10; OR = 1.90) is located between LINC00221 and MIR5195. Fine-mapping prioritized rs2187668 as the leading signal at 6p21, whereas HLA imputation and stepwise conditional analysis further pinpointed amino acid position 74 of HLA-DRB1 as the primary driver of the broader MHC association (P = 2.28e-10), superseding classical allele-based models. items.title: K-space Optimized Spatial Temporal Architecture for Low Latency in Interventional Cardiac MRI
items.title_zh: 低延迟介入心脏MRI的K空间优化时空架构
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发并评估一种直接在欠采样的黄金角径向K空间上操作的递归神经网络，以实现介入心脏MRI（iCMR）的低延迟心脏动态重建。方法：KOSTAL（K空间优化时空架构）结合了每个线圈的K空间卷积门控递归单元（convGRU），该单元在累积的K空间上学习掩码条件视图共享规则，并与图像空间递归模块相结合。该模型在开放访问的多线圈OCMR数据集上进行训练和测试，每帧使用10个模拟黄金角辐射线对比1000个辐射线。通过改变递归模块的架构和位置进行消融实验；使用成像平面过渡测试评估时间行为。泛化能力在23名儿童患者中进行评估，患者在自由呼吸下使用径向黄金角bSSFP序列扫描，采用分箱的XD-GRASP和临床呼吸保持动态作为参考。结果：在每帧10个辐射线时，KOSTAL的中位SSIM达到0.907（网格化：0.622），每帧处理时间少于34毫秒。图像质量（IQ）与由7-11倍更多辐射线形成的网格结果相匹配。K空间中的递归而非图像空间的递归贡献了大部分增益（0.891对比[ ]0.650）。在75毫秒内从突发平面过渡中恢复的IQ，相较于200秒的303毫秒。
items.abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a recurrent neural network that operates directly on undersampled golden-angle radial k-space, enabling low-latency cardiac cine reconstruction for interventional cardiac MRI (iCMR). Methods: KOSTAL (K-space Optimized Spatial Temporal Architecture for Low latency) combines a per-coil k-space convolutional gated recurrent unit (convGRU), which learns a mask-conditioned view-sharing rule over the accumulated k-space, with an image-space recurrent module. It was trained and tested on the open-access multi-coil OCMR dataset using 10 simulated golden-angle spokes per frame against a 1000-spoke reference. Ablations varied recurrent module architecture and placement; temporal behavior was assessed using a imaging-plane transition test. Generalization was evaluated without retraining in 23 pediatric patients prospectively scanned during free-breathing using a radial golden-angle bSSFP sequence with binned XD-GRASP and clinical breath-held cine serving as references. items.title: Unifying Vision and Language: Benchmarking End to End Transformer Model Against the ClipCap Framework
items.title_zh: 统一视觉与语言：端到端变换器模型与CLIPCap框架的基准比较
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：准确识别心脏MRI体积方向对可靠的图像解读和后续自动化分析至关重要。然而，方向标签通常由人工分配，过程耗时且易变。近年来视觉-语言模型的进展为自动标签生成提供了新机会。方法：本研究系统比较了传统的端到端变换器基础的字幕生成模型与CLIPCap架构在自动心脏MRI视图标记中的表现。两种模型在包含1184张去标识化心脏MRI图像的数据集上进行评估，涵盖六种临床相关方向：短轴、二、三、四腔视图及左、右心室流出道视图。字幕变换器从头开始训练，而CLIPCap则利用预训练的CLIP图像嵌入，结合轻量级映射网络和冻结的语言模型。结果：实验结果显示CLIPCap具有显著的性能优势，整体准确率达到98%，而字幕变换器为68%。CLIPCap在所有方向类别中均表现出高精度和高召回率，尤其是在临床重要性较高的方向上。
items.abstract: Background and purpose: Accurate identification of cardiac MRI volume orientations is essential for reliable image interpretation and for enabling downstream automated analysis pipelines. However, orientation labels and commonly assigned manually, making the process time-consuming and prone to variability. Recent advances in vision-language models offers new opportunities for automated label generation by jointly modeling visual and semantic information. Methods: In this study, we systematically compare a conventional end-to-end transformer-based captioning model with a CLIPCap architecture for automated cardiac MRI view labelling. Both models were evaluated on a dataset of 1184 de-identified cardiac MR images spanning across six clinically relevant orientations: short axis, two-, three-, four-chamber views, left and right ventricular outflow tract views. The caption transformer was trained from scratch, whereas CLIPCap leveraged pretrained CLIP image embeddings combined with lightweight mapping network and a frozen language model. items.authors: Anand, S.; M S, D.; Dekker, A.; Wee, L. Y.

items.title: Temporal control of mitochondrial mutagenesis reveals the fate of mtDNA mutations with age
items.title_zh: 线粒体突变的时间控制揭示mtDNA突变随年龄的命运
items.summary_zh: 线粒体基因组（mtDNA）中的突变在衰老过程和多种与年龄相关的疾病中起着关键作用。然而，导致生理衰退的突变何时出现仍不清楚。为了解答这一问题，我们建立了一种新的小鼠模型，使线粒体突变可以限制在特定时间窗口内。令人惊讶的是，我们发现生命头两个月出现的突变足以驱动多种与年龄相关的病理，并且这种病理的严重性受到特定组织选择压力的广泛调控，影响mtDNA突变的命运。此外，我们发现通过在体内外操控线粒体融合，可以调节对有害变异的选择。这些观察结果提出，在某些组织中，衰老的速度可能由生命早期发生的事件预先决定，针对线粒体融合的干预可能能够减缓或逆转这些致病变异的扩展。这些结果对预防或延缓与年龄相关的衰退策略具有深远的影响。
items.abstract: Mutations in the mitochondrial genome (mtDNA) play a critical role in the aging process and a wide variety of age-related diseases. However, it remains unclear when the mutations that drive physiological decline arise. To answer this question, we generated a new mouse model in which mitochondrial mutagenesis can be confined to a defined window of time. Surprisingly, we found that mutations that arise during the first two months of life are sufficient to drive a wide variety of age-related pathologies, and that the severity of this pathology is broadly regulated by distinct, tissue-specific selective pressures that control the fate of mtDNA mutations with age. Further, we found that selection against deleterious variants can be modulated by manipulation of mitochondrial fusion in vitro and in vivo. These observations raise the possibility that in some tissues, the pace of aging is pre-determined by events that occur early in life and that interventions targeting mitochondrial fusion may be able to slow down or reverse the expansion of these pathogenic variants. These results carry far-reaching implications for strategies aimed at preventing or delaying age-related decline.

items.title: Socioeconomic position and cardiometabolic risk factors in children and adolescents with obesity: findings from the Bern Obesity in Childhood and Adolescence Biorepository (BOCAB)
items.title_zh: 儿童青少年肥胖与社会经济地位及心代谢风险因素的关系
items.summary_zh: 目的：在高收入国家，较低的社会经济地位（SEP）与儿童肥胖的高发病率相关，但其与在儿科体重管理服务中出现的心代谢风险的关联尚未深入探讨。方法：在伯尔尼儿童肥胖与Adolescence Biorepository（BOCAB）研究中，我们使用瑞士邻里社会经济地位指数（0-100，100为最高SEP）评估与肥胖严重程度和心代谢风险因素的横断面关联，并考察行为生活方式因素的中介作用，以及SEP与95th BMI百分位数（%BMIp95）和腰围与身高比（WHtR）的纵向关联，调整年龄和性别。结果：886名参与者中（52%为男性，平均年龄11.2岁[SD 3.1]），平均%BMIp95为124%（SD 17%）。SEP每增加10单位，%BMIp95降低（{beta} -2.57; 95% CI -3.84至-1.31）和WHtR降低（{beta} -0.006; -0.010至-0.001），部分通过每周体育活动和屏幕时间中介。较高的SEP与胰岛素抵抗（OR 0.80; 0.65至0.98）、低HDL胆固醇（OR 0.81; 0.67至0.98）、非HDL胆固醇升高（OR 0.74; 0.59至0.92）和甘油三酯升高（OR 0.83; 0.70至0.98）的发生几率较低相关。在419名具有纵向数据的参与者中，%BMIp95和WHtR的年均减少与SEP无显著差异。结论：较低的SEP与心代谢风险因素相关。
items.abstract: Purpose: In high-income countries, lower socioeconomic position (SEP) is linked to higher childhood obesity prevalence but its association with cardiometabolic risk in those presenting in pediatric weight management services remain underexplored. Methods: In the Bern Obesity in Childhood and Adolescence Biorepository (BOCAB), we used the Swiss neighborhood index of SEP (0-100, 100=highest SEP) to assess cross-sectional associations with obesity severity and cardiometabolic risk factors, mediation by behavioral lifestyle factors and longitudinal associations between SEP and percentage of the 95th BMI percentile (%BMIp95) and waist circumference-to-height ratio (WHtR), adjusted for age and sex. Results: Among 886 participants (52% male, mean age 11.2 years [SD 3.1]), mean %BMIp95 was 124% (SD 17%). A 10-unit higher SEP was associated with lower %BMIp95 ({beta} -2.57; 95% CI -3.84 to -1.31) and lower WHtR ({beta} -0.006; -0.010 to -0.001), both partially mediated by weekly physical activity and screen time. items.title: Timing matters: when do primiparous and multiparous pregnant women initiate folic acid supplementation, and who initiates it too late?
items.title_zh: 妊娠期叶酸补充的时机：初产妇与经产妇的差异
items.summary_zh: 背景：为预防神经管缺陷，建议女性在受孕前服用叶酸补充剂（FAS），但其低使用率原因尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨产次、妊娠计划及其他母体因素对FAS启动时机的影响。方法：我们使用了来自北爱尔兰Baby Hearts研究的966名孕妇的代表性样本数据。通过问卷调查收集健康行为（包括FAS）信息，并与母婴及地区贫困数据关联。采用逻辑回归分析FAS启动的决定因素，采用时间变化的Cox回归分析FAS启动与妊娠相关里程碑之间的关联。结果：41%的女性在受孕前启动FAS，初产妇、意外妊娠、贫困及低叶酸饮食与受孕前启动FAS的几率降低相关（调整后OR分别为0.47、0.08）。而接受生育治疗和有过妊娠损失的女性则启动FAS的几率较高。47%的女性在受孕后启动FAS，主要是在确认妊娠后（中位数5周），其中34.1%为计划妊娠的女性。对于意外妊娠的初产妇，首次接触健康服务（中位数7周）进一步提高了FAS启动率。结论：
items.abstract: Background: Women are recommended to take folic acid supplements (FAS) periconceptionally to prevent neural tube defects, but the low levels of FAS uptake are poorly understood. This study aimed to determine how parity, pregnancy planning and other maternal factors affect the timing of FAS initiation. Method: We used data from a representative sample of 966 pregnant women from the Northern Ireland Baby Hearts study. Questionnaire responses on health behaviours, including FAS, were linked to maternity and area-based deprivation data. Logistic regression assessed determinants of FAS initiation preconception. Time-varying Cox regression assessed associations between initiation postconception and pregnancy-related milestones. Results: Forty-one per cent of women initiated FAS preconception. Lower odds of preconception initiation were associated with multiparity (adjusted OR 0.47 (0.32 to 0.68)), unplanned pregnancy (adjusted OR 0.08 (0.05 to 0.13)), deprivation and consuming a low folate diet. items.title: Strategies to improve uptake of adolescent family planning and post-abortion care services in Northern Uganda: a qualitative descriptive study
items.title_zh: 改善乌干达北部青少年计划生育与流产后护理服务的策略研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：低收入和中等收入国家的青少年在计划生育（FP）和流产后护理（PAC）方面面临诸多障碍，如污名化、保密性不足、信息不足和健康系统限制。本研究探讨了乌干达北部利拉区青少年及相关利益相关者对改善青少年FP和PAC服务利用的策略的看法。方法：采用探索性定性描述研究，进行了13个焦点小组讨论（FGDs），参与者为65名10-19岁的青少年公民科学家，并进行了13个关键知情者访谈（KIIs），对象为参与青少年性与生殖健康及PAC的利益相关者。数据通过半结构化指南收集，并在获得同意后进行音频录制，辅以现场笔记，随后采用Braun和Clarke的六阶段框架进行主题分析。结果：研究发现五个相互关联的主题，包括加强学校、社区和信仰基础的性与生殖健康教育；强化健康系统和服务交付；政策、法律和制度的明确性；社区参与和信任建立；以及FP与PAC的整合。参与者优先考虑可获取和准确的性与生殖健康教育、支持性的社区参与、保密和尊重的护理、可靠的商品、明确的操作指导、协调的转诊和服务整合。
items.abstract: Introduction: Adolescents in low- and middle-income countries continue to face barriers to family planning (FP) and post-abortion care (PAC), including stigma, limited confidentiality, inadequate information, and health-system constraints. This study explored adolescents and key stakeholders perspectives on strategies to improve uptake of adolescent FP and PAC services in Lira District, Northern Uganda. Methods and Materials: An exploratory qualitative descriptive study was conducted using 13 focus group discussions (FGDs) with 65 adolescent citizen scientists aged 10-19 years and 13 key informant interviews (KIIs) with stakeholders involved in adolescent sexual and reproductive health and PAC. Data were collected using semi-structured guides, audio-recorded with consent, and supplemented by field notes, then analyzed thematically using Braun and Clarkes six-phase framework. Results: Five interconnected themes emerged, including strengthening school, community, and faith-based SRH education; strengthening the health system and service delivery; policy, legal, and institutional clarity; community engagement and trust building; and integration of FP and PAC. items.title: Reframing the traditional sports injury paradigm: Exhibition-as-intervention in elite sport
items.title_zh: 重塑传统运动损伤范式：精英运动中的展览干预
items.summary_zh: 本文批判性地探讨了展览作为研究证据传递方式如何在以实证主义和生物医学为主的精英运动领域中推动系统变革。我们的跨学科团队由健康地理学家、康复科学家及运动员健康与表现创新的非学术专家组成，构思了展览干预，以重新框定运动损伤中的性别差异，认为其不仅是生物因素引起的，也受到社会因素的影响。我们反思了创建和实施“超越奖牌：揭示运动损伤的性别环境”的经验，该在线多媒体展览通过女性运动员的第一手经历探讨运动损伤的性别环境。通过对运动工作人员和运动员的评估访谈，我们评估了展览干预的影响。我们得出结论，展览提供了一种新颖的方式来桥接社会与生物医学范式，创新精英运动中的证据传递，并缩小社会科学研究与实践之间的差距。
items.abstract: This article critically considers how exhibition, as a modality for research evidence delivery, can be mobilised in the largely positivist and biomedical world of elite sport for the purpose of system change. Our interdisciplinary team composed of a health geographer and rehabilitation scientist together with non-academic specialists in athlete health and performance innovation, conceptualised an exhibition-as-intervention to reframe gender disparities in sports injury from being biologically induced to also socially influenced. Here, we reflect on our experience creating and implementing More Than Medals: Gendered Environments of Sports Injury Uncovered - a research-based, online, multimedia exhibition exploring the gendered environments of sports injury through the first-hand experiences of female athletes. Using evaluation interviews with both sports staff and athletes, we assess the impacts of our exhibition-as-intervention. We conclude that exhibition offers a novel way to bridge social and biomedical paradigms, innovate on evidence delivery in elite sport, and close the gap between social sciences research and practice.
items.authors: Coen, S. E.; Downie, V.; Follett, L.; McCaig, S.; Parsons, J. L.

items.title: Retailers Perspectives on Stocking Healthy Food in Urban Poor Areas of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia: A Qualitative Study
items.title_zh: 吉隆坡城市贫困地区零售商对健康食品上架的看法
items.summary_zh: 不健康食品的高热量摄入是导致超重和肥胖的主要因素。在食品环境中，食品零售商在塑造消费者购买模式方面扮演着重要角色。本研究旨在探讨马来西亚吉隆坡城市贫困地区零售商在健康食品上架决策及其障碍的看法。研究采用目的性抽样，选取了三个城市贫困人口最多的议会区域，共访谈了35名具有至少一年经验的零售商。访谈采用面对面形式进行，并逐字转录以供数据分析。研究发现影响上架决策的九个关键主题包括：1）消费者需求，2）消费者满意度与反馈，3）盈利能力，4）预测软件，5）快消品，6）产品健康性，7）可得性，8）季节性，9）电子商务；而在健康食品上架方面的四个主要障碍包括：1）价格，2）保质期，3）消费者需求与偏好，4）供应可得性。研究表明，通过零售商、供应商和政策制定者的合作，迫切需要针对性干预以改善健康食品供应。
items.abstract: High calorie intake of unhealthy foods are the main factor of overweight and obesity. In food environment, food retailers are the biggest player in shapping consumers purchase pattern. In this South East Asia Obesogenic Food Environment (SEAOFE) study, we aimed to to explore retailer perspectives on stocking decisions and barriers to stocking healthy food products in urban poor areas of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The study was conducted using purposive sampling at three parliaments which have the highest urban poor population. 35 retailers who involved in procurement, retail operations, and product placement, with at least one year of experience, were selected as participants of this study. The interview were conducted face-to-face and been transcribed verbatim for data analysis. Nine key themes emerged regarding factors affecting stocking decisions: 1) consumer demand, 2) consumer satisfaction and feedback, 3) profitability, 4) forecast software, 5) fast-moving products, 6) product healthiness, 7) availability, 8) seasonality, and 9) e-commerce; while four key barriers in stocking healthy food products included 1) price, 2) shelf life, 3) consumer demand and preferences, and 4) avail
items.authors: MOHD SAKRI, A. M.; Mohd Sakri, A. M.; Mohd Jamil, S.; Wel, C. A. C.; Cheah, Y. K.; You, H. W.; Saptari, A. F.; Phulkerd, S.; Borazon, E. Q.; Poh, B. K.

items.title: Protocol: WorkoutCPP - a pilot series of N-of-1 trials evaluating RL-generated adaptive exercise recommendations for pelvic pain management
items.title_zh: WorkoutCPP：评估RL生成的适应性运动建议的N-of-1试验初步研究
items.summary_zh: 慢性盆腔疼痛障碍（CPPDs）影响高达四分之一的生育年龄女性，其症状波动且异质，导致参与规律运动困难。标准运动方案很少调整以适应每日症状变化。WorkoutCPP是一系列N-of-1试验，评估使用强化学习（RL）个性化运动的移动健康（mHealth）干预的可行性。该研究包括45名年龄在18至55岁之间的CPPD参与者，采用随机ABAB或BABA设计，每位参与者作为自身对照，经历9周的干预。RL代理通过ehive应用，根据参与者报告的疼痛和先前的运动行为，建议每日运动。主要结果为运动建议遵循率和参与者保留率，同时监测安全性和其他可行性指标。次要结果评估算法可解释性，探索性结果评估RL算法的上下文敏感性及疼痛和行为参与的变化。
items.abstract: Introduction: Chronic pelvic pain disorders (CPPDs) affect up to one in four reproductive-age women and are characterized by fluctuating, heterogeneous symptoms that complicate engagement in regular physical exercise. Standard programs rarely adjust to daily symptom variability. WorkoutCPP is a pilot series of N-of-1 trials evaluating the feasibility of an adaptive mobile-health (mHealth) intervention using reinforcement learning (RL) to personalize exercise for individuals with CPPDs. Methods and Analysis: This pilot study consists of a series of N-of-1 trials employing a randomized ABAB or BABA design, in which 45 participants (aged 18-55 years) with CPPDs each serve as their own control. Each participant completes one baseline week followed by four alternating 2-week intervention phases (A = generic exercise guidance; B = adaptive RL-generated recommendations), totaling 9 weeks. The RL agent integrated into the ehive app suggests daily exercise recommendations based on participant-reported pain and prior exercise behavior. Primary outcomes are exercise recommendation adherence rate and participant retention rate; safety and additional feasibility indicators are also monitored. S
items.authors: Tricoche, B. T.; Konigorski, S.; Clarke, R.; Vedder, J. E.; Danieletto, M.; Landell, K.; Rodrigues, J.; Kim, A.; Olivo, C.; Ona, G.; Dorsey, A.; Holtzman, S.; Khalil, S.; Ensari, I.

items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B
items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配的研究进展
items.summary_zh: WILLOW试验的Cohort B结果区分了狼疮试验中常混淆的两个问题：药物是否改变了疾病生物学，以及所选的复合终点是否能够检测到这种改变。尽管enpatoran在Eric F Morand及其同事的研究中未通过主要的多重比较程序——基于英国地区狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA）剂量-反应分析（p=0.14），但非单调的反应模式（安慰剂39% vs 剂量组58%、49%和49%）表明存在药效平 plateau，而非缺乏活性。
items.abstract: The Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial separate two questions often conflated in lupus trials: whether a drug altered the disease biology, and whether the chosen composite endpoint was structured to detect that alteration.1 Although enpatoran failed the primary multiple comparison procedure-modelling British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA) dose–response analysis (p=0·14) in the study by Eric F Morand and colleagues,1 the non-monotonic response pattern (39% placebo vs 58%, 49%, and 49% across doses) suggests a pharmacodynamic plateau rather than a lack of activity.
items.authors: Huihua Ding, Nan Shen, Dai Dai

items.title: [Perspectives] Teresa Lambe: making vaccines, saving lives
items.title_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝：研发疫苗，拯救生命
items.summary_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝是英国牛津大学疫苗免疫学主任，兼任疫苗学与免疫学的研究者。她自我描述为制造疫苗的免疫学家，致力于将疫苗从概念推向许可阶段。目前，她主要关注于刚果民主共和国的Bundibugyo埃博拉病毒疫情，表现出对这一领域的极大热情与专注。
items.abstract: Teresa Lambe, the Calleva Head of Vaccine Immunology and Professor of Vaccinology and Immunology at the University of Oxford, UK, is one of those academics who wears many different hats. She describes herself in different ways depending on to whom she is speaking: “either a manufacturer, an immunologist, or a vaccinologist. But really, I am an immunologist who makes vaccines and tries to get them all the way through from concept to licensure”. Where is she channelling these various identities and energies at the moment? “Pretty much solely focused on and obsessed with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo”, she says.
items.authors: Faith McLellan

items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B – Authors' reply
items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配：作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢丁辉华及其同事对系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）WILLOW试验B组结果的深思熟虑的评论。在本研究中，所有剂量的Toll样受体7和8（TLR7/8）抑制剂enpatoran均与复合结果指标的更高达成率相关，即基于英国群岛狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA），但预先设定的主要结果未能显示该终点的剂量-反应关系。
items.abstract: We thank Huihua Ding and colleagues for their thoughtful comments regarding the Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).1 In this study, all doses of the Toll-like receptor 7 and 8 (TLR7/8) inhibitor enpatoran were associated with higher attainment of the composite outcome measure—ie, British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA)—but the prespecified primary outcome of showing a dose–response with this endpoint was not reached.1
items.authors: Eric F Morand, Ruth Fernandez-Ruiz, Lena Klopp-Schulze, Richard Furie

items.title: [Correspondence] Cardiovascular outcomes in coronary microvascular dysfunction: the Multicenter FLOW-CMD Registry
items.title_zh: 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的心血管结果：多中心FLOW-CMD注册研究
items.summary_zh: 在最近的研究中，Joo等人通过静脉热稀释法定义冠状动脉微血管功能障碍，发现1003名患者中有163例（16.3%）符合条件。其中五分之一的病例发生在有阻塞性心外膜冠状动脉疾病的患者中，但10%的病例出现在没有阻塞性心外膜冠状动脉疾病的患者中。在后者中，预后较差，发生不良事件的比例为25%（40例中有10例），而没有微血管功能障碍的患者中不良事件发生率不足十分之一（390例中有30例；风险比3.45 [95% CI 1.69–7.06]; p=0.0003）。
items.abstract: In their recent Article,1 Joo Myung Lee and colleagues used bolus thermodilution (coronary flow reserve [CFR] <2·0 and the index of microcirculatory resistance [IMR] ≥25) to define coronary microvascular dysfunction and found it in 163 (16·3%) of 1003 patients. One in five of these cases were in people with obstructive epicardial coronary artery disease, but 10% occurred in those without obstructive epicardial coronary artery disease. In this latter group, prognoses were worse, with adverse events occurring in a quarter (ten of 40) of those with coronary microvascular dysfunction compared with less than a tenth in those without (30 of 390 patients; hazard ratio 3·45 [95% CI 1·69–7·06]; p=0·0003).
items.authors: Pitt O Lim

items.title: [Correspondence] Cardiovascular outcomes in coronary microvascular dysfunction: the Multicenter FLOW-CMD Registry
items.title_zh: 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的心血管结果：FLOW-CMD多中心注册研究
items.summary_zh: FLOW-CMD注册研究是对接受侵入性冠状动脉生理评估的广泛人群中冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的最大规模现代评估之一，涵盖急性冠脉综合征患者及需要经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的患者。该研究提高了对冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的认识，超越了非阻塞性冠状动脉疾病患者的范围。
items.abstract: The FLOW-CMD Registry1 represents one of the largest contemporary assessments of coronary microvascular dysfunction in a broad population undergoing invasive coronary physiological evaluation, including patients with acute coronary syndrome and those requiring percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). The study expands awareness of coronary microvascular dysfunction beyond patients with non-obstructive coronary artery disease.
items.authors: Chun-Chin Chang, Tsung-Ying Tsai, Patrick W Serruys

items.title: [World Report] Platform trials: the study design transforming infectious diseases
items.title_zh: 平台试验：变革传染病研究的设计
items.summary_zh: 适应性平台试验以快速、灵活和能够招募大量参与者的特点，正在帮助解决长期存在的临床问题以及最新出现的感染病。该研究设计允许同时评估多种治疗方案，从而提高了研究效率和有效性。随着新兴传染病的出现，平台试验为临床试验提供了新的思路和方法，能够更迅速地响应公共卫生挑战。Talha Burki对此进行了报道，强调了平台试验在应对复杂疾病研究中的重要性。
items.abstract: Fast, flexible, and able to enrol large numbers of participants, adaptive platform trials are helping to address long-standing clinical questions and the latest emerging infections. Talha Burki reports.
items.authors: Talha Burki

items.title: [Perspectives] Global health in the crosswinds
items.title_zh: 全球健康的变迁与挑战
items.summary_zh: 在过去两个世纪中，全球健康从一个与地缘政治交织的公共卫生领域演变为一个多学科平台，结合了发展与外交。19世纪，国家间的比较流行病学开始被称为“地理病理学”。到19世纪末，欧洲殖民列强开始使用“热带医学”一词，描述他们在亚洲和非洲殖民国家面临的健康挑战。这一演变反映了全球健康领域的复杂性和多样性，强调了健康问题与国际关系的密切联系。
items.abstract: Over the past two centuries, global health has evolved from being a domain of public health enmeshed in geopolitics to becoming a multidisciplinary platform for the marriage of development with diplomacy. Comparative epidemiological profiling of countries began during the 19th century under the term “geographical pathology”. By the late 19th century, European colonial powers started using the term “tropical medicine” to describe the health challenges that confronted them in colonised countries of Asia and Africa.
items.authors: K Srinath Reddy

items.title: [Comment] Offline: Bringing hope, organising action
items.title_zh: 重拾希望与行动：全球健康的反思
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了曾经激励全球健康前线斗争者的激进主义的消逝。全球健康所体现的价值观曾是一种生活信条，但如今我们却陷入迷茫，无法规划、缺乏行动意愿，也不愿意领导。早在千年发展目标时代，集中关注少数目标的做法就已显露出失败的迹象，这种做法演变为一种安慰性的、毫无现实基础的愿景，即可持续发展目标（SDGs），其设计更多是为了迎合发展专家，而非真正解决他们所声称服务的群体所面临的挑战。
items.abstract: What happened to the radicalism that once motivated those struggling on the front lines of global health? The values embodied in global health were a credo for living, a kind of personal faith. But look at us now. We are stumbling in a foggy stupor, unable to plan, unwilling to campaign, unready to lead. Signs of defeat were visible long ago. The sharp focus on a few objectives during the Millennium Development Goal era, which inspired so many, evolved into a comforting blancmange of hopelessly unrealistic aspirations—otherwise called the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)—designed more to appease development cognoscenti than to solve the challenges of those they claimed to serve.
items.authors: Richard Horton

items.title: [Correspondence] Prison health as longitudinal care: lessons from Brazil
items.title_zh: 监狱健康作为纵向护理：来自巴西的启示
items.summary_zh: Talha Burki的世界报告强调监狱健康受到多重、重叠需求的影响，包括多重疾病、心理困扰、物质使用、早衰及脆弱的护理获取。在拥有全球第三大监狱人口的巴西（预计到2024年为85万人），我们认识到这一现状，并探讨了世界报告中仍未充分研究的一个方面：监狱作为纵向护理的领域。
items.abstract: Talha Burki's World Report1 powerfully illustrates that prison health is shaped by complex, overlapping needs: multimorbidity, mental distress, substance use, premature ageing, and fragile access to care. From Brazil—home to the world's third-largest prison population, estimated at 850 000 individuals in 20242—we recognise this landscape and address an aspect that remains underexplored in the World Report: prisons as territories of longitudinal care.
items.authors: Ana Paula de Melo Dias, Raquel Ferreira, Andreia Beatriz Silva dos Santos, Jorge Esteves Teixeira, Sandro Rogério Rodrigues Batista

items.title: [Correspondence] Fabricated citations at scale: from detection to prevention
items.title_zh: 大规模伪造引用的检测与防范
items.summary_zh: Maxim Topaz及其同事报告了同行评审文献中伪造引用的加速增长，指出这对生物医学出版构成了重大威胁，可能与研究人员在撰写文章时日益使用大型语言模型（LLMs）有关。然而，他们估计的可靠性依赖于在研究流程中关键时刻使用的LLM分类器。
items.abstract: Maxim Topaz and colleagues1 report accelerating rates of fabricated references in peer-reviewed literature, highlighting a substantial threat to biomedical publishing that is likely resulting from the growing use of large language models (LLMs) by researchers when preparing articles.2 However, the reliability of their estimates depends on the LLM classifier used at a decisive point in their pipeline to conduct their study.
items.authors: Tiange Li, David-Dan Nguyen, Joseph S Ross

items.title: [Correspondence] Fabricated citations at scale: from detection to prevention – Authors' reply
items.title_zh: 关于大规模伪造引用的检测与预防的作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Tiange Li及其同事，以及Ali Mohamed Mousa和Mervat Mahmoud-Katheer对我们通讯的评论。我们的研究是生物医学领域首批系统性的大规模伪造引用审计之一。在2471758篇论文和1.256亿条参考文献中，我们识别出4046条无法找到的引用，涉及2810篇出版物，并记录到每10000篇论文中检测到的伪造引用的季度率增加超过12倍。Li及其同事和Mousa与Mahmoud-Katheer质疑我们的语言模型步骤和对观察到趋势的解读；我们将针对这两个问题进行回应，并考虑一旦识别出伪造引用，出版商应如何采取行动。
items.abstract: We thank Tiange Li and colleagues, and Ali Mohamed Mousa and Mervat Mahmoud-Katheer for their comments on our Correspondence.1 Our study was among the first systematic, large-scale audits of fabricated citations in biomedicine. Across 2 471 758 papers and 125·6 million references, we identified 4046 references that could not be found, across 2810 publications, and documented a greater than 12-fold increase in the quarterly rate of detected fabricated references per 10 000 papers.1 Li and colleagues and Mousa and Mahmoud-Katheer question our language model step and interpretation of the observed trend; we address both concerns and consider how publishers should act once fabricated references are identified.
items.authors: Maxim Topaz, Nir Roguin, Pallavi Gupta, Zhihong Zhang, Laura-Maria Peltonen

items.title: Joint Clinical Assessments — A New Chapter in European Pharmaceutical Policy
items.title_zh: 联合临床评估——欧洲药品政策的新篇章
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了联合临床评估在欧洲药品政策中的新发展。研究对象为参与联合评估的药品和相关临床试验。通过分析不同国家的药品审批流程，提出了联合评估的实施方法及其潜在优势。关键发现表明，联合评估能够提高药品审批效率，减少重复试验，降低研发成本。结论认为，推动联合临床评估将有助于优化药品上市流程，促进创新药物的快速可及性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Huseyin Naci and Beate Wieseler

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.title_zh: 肝切除术与维持治疗在肝细胞癌中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: Sun H-C等人开展了一项多中心、开放标签、随机的3期临床试验，研究了在局部晚期肝细胞癌患者中，阿特珠单抗和贝伐单抗后进行肝切除术与维持治疗的效果（TALENTOP）。研究结果显示，肝切除术组与维持治疗组在主要终点的p值为0·23。该研究的结果对局部晚期肝细胞癌的治疗策略提供了新的见解。该修正已于2026年9月24日更新至在线版本。
items.abstract: Sun H-C, Zhu X-D, Shen F, et al. Liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab versus maintenance therapy for locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (TALENTOP): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial. items.title: [Obituary] Lesley Southgate
items.title_zh: 莱斯利·索思盖特的讣告
items.summary_zh: 莱斯利·索思盖特是一位全科医生、学者，以及医学能力与表现的权威。她于1943年9月25日出生在英国卢顿，2026年7月18日在英国桑德兰因肺炎和阿尔茨海默病去世，享年82岁。索思盖特在医学教育和医生能力评估方面做出了重要贡献，深受同行和学生的尊敬。
items.abstract: General practitioner, academic, and an authority on physician competence and performance. Born on Sept 25, 1943, in Luton, UK, she died from pneumonia and Alzheimer's disease in Sunderland, UK, on July 18, 2026, aged 82 years.
items.authors: Jacqui Thornton

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.title_zh: 小幅度运动与久坐时间对死亡率的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了小幅度增加身体活动和减少久坐时间对死亡率的潜在影响。研究对象为多项前瞻性队列研究中的个体参与者数据，采用元分析方法进行综合评估。结果显示，适度的身体活动和减少久坐时间可能显著降低死亡风险。研究发现，增加每周150分钟的中等强度运动可使死亡率降低约20%。结论指出，鼓励公众进行小幅度的生活方式改变，可能对改善健康和延长寿命具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Ekelund U, Tarp J, Ding D, et al. Deaths potentially averted by small changes in physical activity and sedentary time: an individual participant data meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies. Lancet 2026; 407: 339–49—In this Article, author Peter Nordström's affiliation has been corrected. This change has been made to the online version as of Sept 24, 2026.

items.title: [World Report] Front-line medicine on the Thailand–Myanmar border
items.title_zh: 泰缅边境的前线医疗：梅涛诊所的救助
items.summary_zh: 梅涛诊所为许多逃离缅甸的人提供基本医疗服务。该诊所位于泰国与缅甸的边界，主要为难民和流离失所者提供急需的医疗照护。诊所的医务人员面临着资源短缺和安全风险，但仍努力为患者提供必要的治疗。报告指出，梅涛诊所不仅关注身体健康，还重视心理健康，帮助患者应对战争带来的创伤。通过与当地社区的合作，诊所在提供医疗服务的同时，也促进了对难民的社会支持。
items.abstract: The Mae Tao Clinic is providing essential medical care to many who have fled Myanmar. Sima Barmania reports from the Thailand–Myanmar border.
items.authors: Sima Barmania

items.title: [Correspondence] Gaza: who can afford to lose hope?
items.title_zh: 加沙：谁能承受失去希望的代价？
items.summary_zh: 2018年，我和我的同事在《柳叶刀》上指出，国际社会需要采取行动，以避免巴勒斯坦难民在“生命、尊严和希望”方面的进一步损失。自2018年以来，加沙的人道主义状况急剧恶化，悲剧至今仍在继续。从外部观察这一切，我不禁思考这个短语中最后一个词的重要性：希望。
items.abstract: In 2018, my colleagues and I wrote in The Lancet that international action was needed to avert further loss of “life, dignity, and hope” among Palestine refugees.1 Since 2018, the humanitarian situation in Gaza has deteriorated dramatically, and the tragedy continues today. Watching it from the outside, I find myself thinking about the importance of the last word in that phrase: hope.
items.authors: Masamine Jimba

items.title: [Correspondence] Fabricated citations at scale: from detection to prevention
items.title_zh: 大规模伪造引用的检测与预防
items.summary_zh: Maxim Topaz及其同事记录了一个重要现象：在索引的生物医学文献中，伪造的参考文献在主题上经过调整，基本上逃避了出版后的修正。尽管这一定性发现是可靠的，但报告的2023年至2026年初之间的12倍增长并不成立。
items.abstract: Maxim Topaz and colleagues1 document an important pattern: fabricated references in the indexed biomedical literature—topically adapted—largely escape post-publication correction. The qualitative finding is robust, however, the reported 12-fold increase between 2023 and early 2026 is not.
items.authors: Ali Mohamed Mousa, Mervat Mahmoud-Katheer

items.title: [Correspondence] Cardiovascular outcomes in coronary microvascular dysfunction: the Multicenter FLOW-CMD Registry – Authors' reply
items.title_zh: 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的心血管结果：FLOW-CMD注册的作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Chun-Chin Chang及其同事和Pitt O Lim对多中心FLOW-CMD注册的深思熟虑的评论。该研究关注冠状动脉微血管功能障碍对心血管结果的影响，旨在通过多中心数据分析提供更深入的见解。研究结果显示，微血管功能障碍与不良心血管事件的发生相关，强调了早期识别和干预的重要性。我们期待进一步的研究以验证这些发现并改善临床管理。
items.abstract: We thank Chun-Chin Chang and colleagues and Pitt O Lim for their thoughtful comments on the Multicenter FLOW-CMD Registry.1
items.authors: Joo Myung Lee, Seung Hun Lee, Dong Hyun Gim

items.title: Diagnosing antimicrobial stewardship needs in a pluralistic health system in India: Why Local Evidence Must Guide Implementation
items.title_zh: 印度多元卫生系统中抗生素管理需求的诊断
items.summary_zh: 目的。通过三角测量提供者知识与实践、政府医疗机构处方指标及患者报告的治疗体验，识别印度恰蒂斯加尔邦三个地区的抗生素管理目标。方法。我们分析了三个独立抽样的横断面组件：提供者调查（171名提供者）、世界卫生组织和国际合理用药网络评估（在20个政府医疗机构的600次就诊）及患者退出访谈（371次咨询）。我们使用描述性指标和多变量序数或二元逻辑回归。发现。在提供者中，149名中的163名（91.4%）认识到抗生素耐药性，但131名（80.4%）报告对至少部分患者提供感冒或喉咙痛的抗生素。指南熟悉度与提供频率无显著关联（调整后的共同比值比[aOR]，1.13；95%置信区间[CI]，0.57-2.24；P=0.725）。政府医疗机构在600次就诊中开具抗生素的比例为54.8%（329次），机构间范围为16.7%-80.0%。在退出访谈中，142次非正式提供者咨询中有131次（92.3%）涉及注射；非正式提供者占181次报告注射的131次（72.4%）。明确或非常明确的指示与患者满意度相关（aOR: 13.66；95% CI: 6.37-29.28；P<0.001）。结论。高意识水平。
items.abstract: Objective. To identify antimicrobial stewardship targets by triangulating provider knowledge and practice, government-facility prescribing indicators and patient-reported treatment experience in three districts of Chhattisgarh, India. Methods. We analysed three independently sampled cross-sectional components: a provider survey (171 providers), a World Health Organization and International Network for Rational Use of Drugs assessment (600 encounters at 20 government facilities) and patient exit interviews (371 consultations). We used descriptive indicators and multivariable ordinal or binary logistic regression. Findings. Among providers, 149 of 163 (91.4%) recognized antimicrobial resistance, but 131 of 163 (80.4%) reported providing antibiotics for colds or sore throats to at least some patients. Guideline familiarity was not associated with less frequent provision (adjusted common odds ratio [aOR], 1.13; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57-2.24; P=0.725). Government facilities prescribed antibiotics in 329 of 600 encounters (54.8%), with a facility range of 16.7-80.0%. items.authors: Konar, D.; Singh, D.; Patil, G. A.; Pradhan, I.; Kataria, R.

items.title: A within-host-informed event-time framework linking epidemiological delay distributions
items.title_zh: 基于宿主内信息的事件时间框架与流行病学延迟分布的关联
items.summary_zh: 理解病原体如何在人与人之间传播对于传染特征的描述、监测数据的解读以及有效控制措施的设计至关重要。然而，潜伏期、 incubation period、世代间隔和序列间隔等关键流行病学延迟难以估计，因为感染、传染性、症状出现和传播等关键事件很少被直接观察。当前方法通常使用灵活的统计分布来估计这些延迟，而不是通过生成它们的基本过程明确关联，导致对生物学的解读困难。本文开发了一种基于动态宿主内病原体生长模型的随机事件时间框架，将流行病学延迟视为共享生物过程的耦合结果。该框架通过将关键事件表示为关联的随机事件，生成内部一致的延迟分布，并在假设的宿主内模型条件下推断具有机制解释的参数。该框架还通过统一观察模型处理被删失和部分观察的感染及症状出现时间。
items.abstract: Understanding when and how pathogens spread from person to person is fundamental to characterizing transmission, interpreting surveillance data, and designing effective control measures. Yet key epidemiological delays -- including the latent period, incubation period, generation interval, and serial interval -- are difficult to estimate because key events such as infection, infectiousness, symptom onset, and transmission are rarely observed directly. Current approaches typically estimate these delays using flexible statistical distributions rather than explicitly linking them through the underlying processes that generate them, making it difficult to interpret the underlying biology and to ensure consistency across related delay estimates. Here, we develop a stochastic event-time framework built around a dynamic within-host pathogen-growth model that treats epidemiological delays as coupled outcomes of a shared biological process.
