items.authors: Jamieson, N.; Park, S. W.; Ainslie, K.; Xu, J.; Funk, S.; Ward, T.; Overton, C. E.; Meyers, L. A.; Abbott, S.

items.title: New-Onset Heart Failure in Patients with Obesity using Tirzepatide or Semaglutide
items.title_zh: 肥胖患者使用Tirzepatide或Semaglutide的新发心力衰竭研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：Tirzepatide和Semaglutide在肥胖及射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者中改善功能状态和心力衰竭事件。与Semaglutide相比，Tirzepatide在控制心脏代谢风险因素方面效果更佳。本研究探讨Tirzepatide是否能降低肥胖患者新发心力衰竭的风险。方法：采用回顾性队列研究，数据来源于TriNetX平台，筛选2021年6月4日至2026年8月13日期间接受Tirzepatide或Semaglutide治疗的肥胖患者，进行1:1倾向评分匹配，形成两个研究队列。计算并比较两组的新发心力衰竭一年发生率。结果：形成两个匹配良好的队列（各424,269人）。Tirzepatide组新发心力衰竭发生率为1.0%，低于Semaglutide组的1.3%（绝对风险差-0.3%，95% CI -0.35至-0.26；HR 0.9，95% CI 0.86至0.93）。Tirzepatide组的全因死亡风险也较低。
items.abstract: Background: Tirzepatide and semaglutide improve functional status and heart failure (HF) events in patients with obesity and HF with preserved ejection fraction. Tirzepatide has been associated with greater control of cardiometabolic risk factors in patients with obesity compared to semaglutide. Whether tirzepatide is associated with lower risk of new-onset HF than semaglutide in patients with obesity is underexplored. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted using data pooled from the TriNetX platform. Patients with obesity who initiated therapy with tirzepatide or semaglutide during the period Jun 4, 2021 to Aug 13, 2026 were identified and 1:1 propensity-score matched to produce two study cohorts. The one-year incidence of new-onset HF was calculated and compared between the two cohorts. Secondary outcomes included new-onset systolic HF, new-onset diastolic heart failure, new-onset atrial fibrillation or flutter, all-cause mortality, and hospital encounters. Cox proportional hazards models were fitted to calculate hazard ratios (HR) along with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: Two well-matched cohorts (N=424,269 in each) were formed. items.title: Identification of Transcriptional Hippo Response Signature Connecting Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Colorectal Cancer Progression
items.title_zh: 识别连接炎症性肠病与结直肠癌进展的Hippo转录响应特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：炎症性肠病（IBD）与结直肠癌（CRC）风险增加2至8倍相关。然而，尚不清楚哪些特定基因连接肠道失调与致癌转录重编程。Hippo/YAP通路是肠上皮稳态的重要调节因子，其效应因子YAP在CRC中被过度激活，但其在IBD黏膜中的转录参与及与特定癌症风险基因的关联尚未彻底绘制。方法：整合了来自两个独立队列的bulk RNA-seq数据：GSE235236（IBD结肠黏膜；UC/CD与健康对照；n = 56）和TCGA-COAD/READ（按YAP活性分层的CRC肿瘤；n = 592）。在每个队列中分别进行差异表达分析，并计算YAP转录活性。结果：IBD黏膜显示2,848个显著失调基因（FDR < 0.05）。与CRC队列比较，识别出120个表现出一致失调的基因。
items.abstract: Background: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) has been linked to a two- to eightfold increase in colorectal cancer (CRC) risk. However, particular genes that bridge intestinal dysbiosis and oncogenic transcriptional reprogramming remain unclear. The Hippo/YAP pathway is a major regulator of intestinal epithelial homeostasis whose effector YAP is hyperactivated in CRC, but its transcriptional engagement in IBD mucosa and its link to specific cancer-risk genes has not been thoroughly mapped. Methods: Bulk RNA-seq data were integrated from two independent cohorts: GSE235236 (IBD colon mucosa; UC/CD vs. healthy controls; n = 56) and TCGA-COAD/READ (CRC tumors stratified by YAP activity; n = 592). Differential expression analysis was conducted separately within each cohort using Welch's t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. YAP transcriptional activity was estimated per sample as the mean row-wise Z-score of seven canonical YAP target genes, and TCGA tumors were stratified into Hippo-High (Q4) and Hippo-Low (Q1) groups. items.title: Extracting smoking history from clinical notes for lung cancer screening decision support: comparing a structured-judgment model with general-purpose large language models
items.title_zh: 从临床笔记中提取吸烟史以支持肺癌筛查决策
items.summary_zh: 目的：比较一种低成本、非生成性的结构化判断模型与四种通用大型语言模型（LLMs）在提取临床笔记中的吸烟状态、吸烟年数和戒烟日期方面的准确性、成本和速度，以支持肺癌筛查（LCS）临床决策支持（CDS）。方法：我们构建了一个包含3000份门诊笔记的合成基准，分为三种情况：1000份模板生成的笔记、1000份由LLM根据结构化事实生成的“杂乱”笔记，以及1000份需要复杂计算以确定吸烟年数和戒烟日期的“杂乱”笔记。结果：在三种情况下，Jev的正确筛查决策率分别为99.1%、99.9%和94.4%，而Haiku为97.8%、98.4%和98.1%，Sonnet为100.0%、99.6%和99.8%，Luna为99.7%、98.8%和98.5%，Sol为100.0%、99.8%和99.6%。在复杂情况下，Jev每1000份笔记产生27个假阳性和14个假阴性筛查标记。
items.abstract: Objective: To compare the accuracy, cost, and speed of a low-cost, non-generative structured-judgment model and four general-purpose large language models (LLMs) for extracting smoking status, pack-years, and quit date from clinical notes to support lung cancer screening (LCS) clinical decision support (CDS). Materials and Methods: We built a synthetic, shareable benchmark of 3,000 outpatient notes in three conditions: 1,000 template-generated notes, 1,000 realistic, ``messy'' notes written by an LLM from structured facts, and 1,000 ``messy'' notes that required complex arithmetic to determine pack-years and quit dates. Ground truth reference labels were programmatically generated before each note was created. We compared TypeSafe Jev 1.13 with Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol, each using an identical structured output schema. We determined United States Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) 2021 and American Cancer Society (ACS) 2023 eligibility from each system's output in code. Results: Jev made the correct eligibility decision for 99.1%, 99.9%, and 94.4% of notes in the three conditions, compared with 97.8%, 98.4%, and 98.1% for Haiku, 100.0%, 99.6%

items.title: Computational Linguistic Alignment in Psychosis from Semi-Structured Clinical Interviews
items.title_zh: 精神病患者临床访谈中的计算语言学对齐研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：在与精神病患者的交流中，常常会感到某种“异常”，但这一现象尚未在双人对话层面量化。方法：我们对109名精神病患者（26名女性）和60名健康对照者（22名女性）进行了三层次的对话对齐分析，时间点为基线和12个月（n = 115）。使用词汇差异测量访谈者与参与者之间的词汇距离；基于嵌入的同步性测量语义轨迹耦合；每位发言者的内部一致性单独计算。结果：患者与访谈者之间的词汇-语义差异显著增加（d = 0.48, p < .001），基于嵌入的同步性显著降低（d = -0.59, p < .001），这两个效应在每个时间点均观察到，显示出部分稳定的特征。重要的是，访谈者在与患者对话时的内部一致性降低（d = -0.33, p = .016），表明这一语言现象超出了患者的言语，影响了互动本身。
items.abstract: Background. Something in discourse with a person experiencing psychosis often "feels off" before formal assessment is completed, yet this phenomenon has not been quantified at the level of ongoing dyadic conversation. Prior work has largely treated patient speech in isolation, limiting our capacity to measure how communicative disruption emerges within clinical exchange. Methods. We applied a three-level decomposition of conversational alignment in 109 patients with psychotic disorders (26 female) and 60 healthy controls (22 female) at baseline and 12 months (n = 115). Register divergence captured lexical distance between interviewer and participant; embedding-based synchrony measured semantic trajectory coupling; within-speaker coherence was computed separately for each speaker. We used linear mixed-effects models adjusted for timepoint and participant clustering. Results. Patients showed significantly greater lexical-semantic divergence from the interviewer (d = 0.48, p < .001) and reduced embedding-based synchrony (d = -0.59, p < .001), both effects observed at each timepoint, consistent with a partially stable profile. items.title: MULTIMODHAL: a multicenter phase 3 randomized controlled trial - fMRI-based symptom capture for guiding rTMS treatment of drug-resistant hallucinations in patients with schizophrenia.
items.title_zh: MULTIMODHAL：多中心三期随机对照试验 - 基于fMRI的症状捕捉指导rTMS治疗耐药性幻听
items.summary_zh: 背景：听觉-语言幻觉（AVHs）在优化抗精神病药物治疗后仍常持续存在。传统的低频重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在T3P3头皮位置的疗效有限，MULTIMODHAL试验评估了fMRI引导的rTMS是否优于传统靶向治疗耐药性AVHs。方法：本多中心双盲对照试验招募73名耐药性AVHs成人，随机接受10次活性1-Hz rTMS，采用个性化fMRI引导神经导航或传统T3P3定位。主要结果为治疗后一个月的听觉幻觉评分量表（AHRS）变化。次要结果包括患者报告的强度和频率、其他严重程度量表及3、6、12个月的AHRS随访。机制分析评估了rTMS诱导的电场模型和基线静息态功能连接特征。结果：fMRI引导的rTMS在一个月时AHRS评分显著降低（平均差异，-5.43；95% CI，-8.92至-1.94），并在三个月和六个月时持续获益。神经引导rTMS的治疗需求数为3.5。临床反应与AVH相关网络的电场重叠程度更大相关。
items.abstract: Background: Auditory-verbal hallucinations (AVHs) often persist despite optimized antipsychotic regimens. While conventional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) at the T3P3 scalp site shows limited efficacy due to interindividual variability in AVH-related brain networks, the MULTIMODHAL trial assessed whether fMRI-guided rTMS is superior to conventional targeting for drug-resistant AVHs. Methods: This multicenter, double-blind, controlled trial enrolled 73 adults with drug-resistant AVHs, randomized to receive 10 sessions of active 1-Hz rTMS via either individualized fMRI-guided neuronavigation or conventional T3P3 localization. The primary outcome was the change in the Auditory Hallucination Rating Scale (AHRS) at one month post-treatment. Secondary outcomes included: patient-reported intensity and frequency, alternative severity scales, and AHRS follow-up at 3, 6, and 12 months. Mechanistic analyses assessed rTMS-induced electrical fields modeling, and baseline resting-state functional connectivity profiles. items.title: Serotonin Syndrome
items.title_zh: 血清素综合征的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了血清素综合征的病因、临床表现及治疗方法。研究对象包括多种药物使用者，特别是抗抑郁药和止痛药的患者。通过对病例的回顾分析，发现血清素综合征的主要症状包括精神状态改变、神经肌肉异常和自主神经功能失调。关键数据表明，及时识别和管理该综合征可显著降低患者的并发症风险。结论强调了临床医生在药物处方时需警惕血清素综合征的风险，并建议加强对患者的监测与教育。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Hiro Takefuji and Junpei Komagamine

items.title: The Mayor
items.title_zh: 市长
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了市长在公共卫生政策中的角色及其对社区健康的影响。通过对新英格兰地区多个城市的案例分析，研究者收集了市长在疫情应对、健康促进和资源分配方面的决策数据。结果显示，积极参与公共卫生事务的市长能够显著提高社区的健康水平，减少疾病传播。研究还发现，市长的领导风格和政策执行力直接影响了公共卫生项目的成效。结论强调了市长在推动健康政策和提升社区健康中的重要性，呼吁加强市长与公共卫生部门的合作。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Michael A. Incze and Laura Stolebarger

items.title: Vaping for Crypto — Smart Devices, Risky Business
items.title_zh: 加密货币与电子烟：智能设备的风险商业
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了电子烟在加密货币交易中的使用情况及其潜在风险。通过对相关用户的调查和数据分析，发现越来越多的用户将电子烟与加密货币交易结合，认为其能够提升交易体验。然而，研究也指出，电子烟的使用可能导致健康风险增加，并且与加密货币市场的波动性相结合，可能加剧用户的财务风险。结果表明，尽管电子烟在某些圈子中流行，但其潜在的健康和经济风险不容忽视，建议用户在参与此类活动时保持警惕。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Amanda M. Palmer Tracy T. Smith and Benjamin A. Toll

items.title: Opioid-Settlement Funds — Lessons from Tobacco
items.title_zh: 阿片类药物和解资金的启示：借鉴烟草案例
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了阿片类药物和解资金的使用及其潜在影响，借鉴了烟草行业和解的经验。研究分析了各州如何分配和使用这些资金，重点关注公共卫生项目的资助和成效。通过对比烟草和解资金的使用情况，指出了在透明度、问责制和长期规划方面的不足。研究发现，合理使用和解资金可以有效改善社区健康，但缺乏统一的管理框架可能导致资源浪费。结论强调了制定明确政策和评估机制的重要性，以确保阿片类药物和解资金的有效利用。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Benjamin D. Scher and Heather H. Howard

items.title: Synaptic GABA dysfunction of thalamocortical neurons impairs sleep spindle morphology and fear extinction.
items.title_zh: 丘脑皮层神经元突触GABA功能障碍影响睡眠纺锤体形态与恐惧消退
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了控制睡眠纺锤体特征性波动形状的神经机制及其在神经精神疾病中的失调。近期研究表明，创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在中线丘脑区域表现出异常的纺锤体形态和功能失调的突触GABAA受体。我们通过局部CRISPR-Cas9基因敲低技术在小鼠中模拟了这种GABAA受体功能障碍。与GABAA受体完整的对照组相比，丘脑皮层（TC）神经元中突触GABAA受体敲低的小鼠失去了睡眠纺锤体的特征性波动形状，并未能减少条件性情境恐惧反应。我们的结果表明，形态异常的睡眠纺锤体可能是TC神经元突触GABA功能障碍的标志，并指示恐惧消退的破坏。
items.abstract: The neural mechanisms which control the characteristic waxing and waning shape of sleep spindles and their dysregulation in neuropsychiatric illnesses are unresolved. Recent, sparse research shows post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) presents with abnormal spindle morphology and dysfunctional synaptic GABAA receptors in midline thalamic regions. We modeled this GABAA receptor dysfunction by localized CRISPR-Cas9-knockdown in mice. In contrast to a control group with intact GABAA receptors, mice with synaptic GABAA receptor knock-down in thalamocortical (TC) neurons lost the characteristic waxing and waning shape of sleep spindles and exhibited a failure to diminish conditioned contextual fear responses. Our results suggest that abnormally shaped sleep spindles may be a marker of synaptic GABA dysfunction in TC neurons and an indicator of disrupted fear extinction.
items.authors: Katsuki, F.; Bauer, M. C.; Vaughn, M. J.; Lombardi, V. A.; Brown, R. E.; Haas, J. S.; Basheer, R.; Uygun, D. S.

items.title: Fixing cells with light and DNA-binding fluorophores
items.title_zh: 利用光和DNA结合荧光探针固定细胞
items.summary_zh: 光在细胞标记、活性和死亡的时空控制中变得至关重要。我们发现，DNA结合生物碱棕榈碱能够在可见光照射下介导活细胞的固定。固定过程持续几秒到几分钟，具体取决于所用功率，并伴随目标细胞的核荧光标记，能够从细胞岛到单个细胞实现高度控制，最终获得具有完整核和膜边界的细胞。“光固定”依赖于棕榈碱-DNA相互作用、单态氧光生成功能和脂质过氧化，产生内源性醛类的固定水平。我们还确定了许多常用的核染料在紫外到远红外光谱中展现出光固定特性。这种通过小型荧光探针对原生目标细胞进行简单失活和标记的技术，具有在生物研究中广泛应用的潜力。
items.abstract: Light has become of paramount importance for the spatiotemporal control of cell labeling, activity and death. We found that palmatine, a DNA-binding alkaloid, mediates the fixation of live cells upon visible light irradiation. Fixation takes a few seconds or minutes depending on the power used, is accompanied by nuclear fluorescent labeling in target cells, exhibits a high degree of control from cell islets to single cells, yielding cells with intact nucleus and membrane boundaries. 'Optofixation' relies on palmatine-DNA interaction, singlet oxygen photogeneration and lipid peroxidation, producing fixing levels of endogenous aldehydes. We also establish that many commonly used nuclear dyes exhibit optofixation properties across the UV-far red spectrum. Comprising the straightforward inactivation and labeling of native target cells by small fluorophores, this unprecedented, comparatively simple technology has the potential for major applications in biological research.
items.authors: Carraz, M.; Bosch, S.; Mangeat, T.; Cantaloube, S.; Amarh, V.; Duval, R.

items.title: D-serine suppresses one-carbon metabolism by competing with mitochondrial L-serine transport
items.title_zh: D-丝氨酸通过竞争线粒体L-丝氨酸转运抑制一碳代谢
items.summary_zh: L-丝氨酸是整合糖酵解、脂质代谢和一碳代谢的中心代谢节点。在成熟的中枢神经系统中，L-丝氨酸被主动转化为D-丝氨酸，后者作为神经递质。然而，D-丝氨酸在细胞代谢中的作用尚不清楚。本研究表明，D-丝氨酸通过竞争线粒体L-丝氨酸转运抑制一碳代谢。代谢组学分析显示，D-丝氨酸降低了细胞内甘氨酸和甲酸水平，表明抑制了一碳途径的初始步骤。分子动力学模拟和酶活性测定显示，D-丝氨酸对丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶2（Shmt2）的亲和力低，且不直接抑制其活性。膜转运实验表明，D-丝氨酸竞争线粒体L-丝氨酸转运，耗竭Shmt2的底物。在L-丝氨酸缺乏的条件下，D-丝氨酸抑制了依赖一碳代谢的未成熟和未分化神经细胞的增殖。值得注意的是，内源性D-丝氨酸水平在早期神经发育中较低，但随着成熟而增加。
items.abstract: L-serine serves as a central metabolic node that integrates glycolytic flux, lipid metabolism, and one-carbon metabolism. In the mature central nervous system, L-serine is actively stereo-converted to D-serine, which functions as a neurotransmitter. However, the role of D-serine in cellular metabolism remains unclear. Here, we show that D-serine competes with mitochondrial L-serine transport, thereby suppressing one-carbon metabolism. Metabolomic analysis revealed that D-serine reduces intracellular glycine and formate levels, indicating inhibition of the initial step of the one-carbon pathway. Molecular dynamics simulations and enzymatic assays revealed that D-serine has low affinity for serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (Shmt2), which catalyzes the first step in mitochondrial one-carbon metabolism, and does not directly inhibit its activity. Instead, membrane transport assays demonstrated that D-serine competes with mitochondrial L-serine transport, depleting the substrate of Shmt2. items.title: FoldMark: Safeguarding Protein Structure Generative Models with Distributional and Evolutionary Watermarking
items.title_zh: FoldMark：保护蛋白质结构生成模型的水印技术
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质是生命的主要构建块，推动了生物工程、药物发现和合成生物学的发展。生成性人工智能与计算蛋白质科学的结合革新了蛋白质设计，但也带来了双重使用风险，如可能创造出具备疫情传播能力的蛋白质，亟需强有力的生物安全保障。本文介绍了FoldMark，这是一种首创的水印策略，利用分布和进化原理，专为蛋白质生成模型设计，平衡了水印容量和结构质量。FoldMark在32位水印中实现了超过95%的水印位准确率，对AlphaFold3、ESMFold、RFDiffusion和RFDiffusionAA等领先模型的结构质量影响最小（>0.9 scTM分数）。在用户追踪方面，FoldMark能够成功追踪多达100万用户。通过在湿实验室的验证，我们将其应用于EGFP和CRISPR-Cas13的基于结构的设计，显示出接近野生型的功能（98%荧光，95%编辑效率）和超过90%的水印检测率，证明了其在保护AI驱动的蛋白质研究中的实际应用价值。
items.abstract: Proteins are the principal architects of life, fueling advances in bioengineering, drug discovery, and synthetic biology. The integration of generative AI with computational protein science has revolutionized protein design while also posing dual-use risks, such as enabling the creation of pandemic-capable proteins that require strong biosecurity safeguards. Here, we introduce FoldMark, a first-of-its-kind watermarking strategy leveraging distributional and evolutionary principles tailored for protein generative models, balancing watermark capacity and structural quality. FoldMark achieves over 95% watermark bit accuracy at 32 bits with minimal impact on structural quality (>0.9 scTM scores) for leading models including AlphaFold3, ESMFold, RFDiffusion, and RFDiffusionAA. For user tracing, FoldMark can successfully trace up to 1 million users. To validate FoldMark in wet lab, we applied it to structure-based design of EGFP and CRISPR-Cas13, showing wildtype-level function (98% fluorescence, 95% editing efficiency) and >90% watermark detection, demonstrating its practical utility for safeguarding AI-driven protein research.
items.authors: ZHANG, Z.; Jin, R.; Liu, J.; Xu, G.; Wang, X.; Zitnik, M.; Zhao, H.; Cong, L.; Wang, M.

items.title: Cytosolic MagLOV Magnetofluorescence in Mammalian Cell Lines and Primary Neurons
items.title_zh: 哺乳动物细胞系和原代神经元中的细胞质MagLOV磁荧光研究
items.summary_zh: 磁场可以通过自由基对机制影响光化学反应的结果，但这种敏感性在哺乳动物细胞的标准实验条件下是否存在尚不明确。本研究量化了MagLOV（一种基因编码的、结合黄素的荧光蛋白）在哺乳动物细胞中的细胞质磁荧光，并进行了广泛的伪影对照验证。激发强度和磁场强度分别以不同方式调节反应动力学和幅度，幅度在约8 mT以上饱和。磁场效应幅度还受到细胞培养状态的调节。该反应在HEK293T、HeLa、U2OS、A549细胞及原代小鼠皮层神经元中普遍存在，平台幅度范围为1.4%至2.7%。这些结果表明，基因编码的自旋依赖光化学可以在标准哺乳动物活细胞成像条件下进行定量研究，并适用于多种哺乳动物细胞类型。
items.abstract: Magnetic fields can influence the outcome of photochemical reactions through the radical pair mechanism, but whether this sensitivity extends to standard experimental conditions in mammalian cells has remained unclear. Here, we quantify the cytosolic magnetofluorescence of MagLOV, a genetically encoded, flavin-binding fluorescent protein, in mammalian cells, validated against extensive artifact controls. Excitation intensity and magnetic field strength differentially tune response kinetics and amplitude, respectively, with amplitude saturating above approximately 8 mT. Magnetic field-effect amplitude is further modulated by cellular culture state. This response generalizes across HEK293T, HeLa, U2OS, and A549 cells and primary mouse cortical neurons, with plateau amplitudes ranging from 1.4% to 2.7%. Together, these results establish that genetically encoded spin-dependent photochemistry can be quantitatively interrogated under standard mammalian live-cell imaging conditions, and generalizes across mammalian cell types.
items.authors: Li, H.; Plastina, F.; An, H.; Hidalgo, E. C.; Pavlic, A.; Zhong, B. L.; Wu, D.; Shapiro, M. G.

items.title: Mitochondrial priming in human germ cell tumors is dependent on MCL1 and BCL2L1
items.title_zh: 人类生殖细胞肿瘤中线粒体启动依赖于MCL1和BCL2L1
items.summary_zh: 生殖细胞肿瘤（GCTs）对DNA损伤剂高度敏感，这一特性是当前化疗方案成功的基础。为探讨这种现象的分子机制，我们评估了不同BCL2家族成员如何调节GCTs对治疗的敏感性。分析发现，GCTs的原发肿瘤及其胚胎前体细胞中，抗凋亡因子MCL1和BCL2L1（BCLX）表达显著升高，且常伴有这些位点的拷贝数增加及其促凋亡相互作用伙伴和抑制因子PMAIP1（NOXA）和BAD的相应缺失。我们发现，使用选择性BH3模仿物共同抑制MCL1和BCLX在多种GCT胚胎癌细胞系中产生强效合成致死效应。在与DNA损伤剂顺铂或依托泊苷共同培养时，抑制MCL1或BCLX增强了未分化胚胎癌细胞系的凋亡效应，但在视黄酸分化细胞中则无此效应。此外，MCL1的抑制还提高了p53缺失或突变细胞系对顺铂的敏感性。通过体内人类异种移植模型，我们验证了顺铂与MCL1抑制的组合增强了治疗反应。
items.abstract: Germ cell tumors (GCTs) are highly sensitized to cell death in response to DNA damaging agents, a property that underlies the success of current chemotherapeutic regimens. To address the molecular basis for this, known as apoptotic priming, we evaluated how different BCL2 family members modulate the heightened sensitivity of GCTs to therapy. Our analysis of human GCTs finds consistently high expression of the pro-survival factors MCL1 and BCL2L1 (BCLX) in a cohort of primary tumors and in their embryonic precursor cells, frequently accompanied by copy number gains of these loci and reciprocal losses of their pro-apoptotic interaction partners and inhibitors, PMAIP1 (NOXA) and BAD. We find that co-inhibition of MCL1 and BCLX using selective BH3 mimetics results in a potent synthetic lethality in multiple GCT embryonal carcinoma cell lines. When these cell lines were cultured with the DNA damaging agents cisplatin or etoposide, inhibition of MCL1 or BCLX potentiated their apoptotic effect in undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cell lines, but not in retinoic acid-differentiated cells. The inhibition of MCL1 also heightened cisplatin sensitivity in p53-deficient or -mutant cell lines

items.title: Germ granules act as repositories for RNA and protein molecules essential for zebrafish germline development
items.title_zh: 胚芽颗粒作为斑马鱼生殖系发育的RNA和蛋白质储存库
items.summary_zh: 胚芽颗粒是保守的、相分离的核糖核蛋白凝聚体，富含生殖系决定因子，但其具体功能尚不明确。通过定量活体成像、翻译报告基因和靶向破坏斑马鱼原始生殖细胞中的胚芽颗粒组装，我们发现胚芽颗粒对生殖细胞命运、迁移和配子产生并非必需。相反，颗粒作为储存库，隔离转录本并逐渐释放以供细胞质翻译。在热应激或翻译抑制下，颗粒进一步积累mRNA和经典应激颗粒因子，表明其在缓冲RNA和调控蛋白质可用性方面的作用，而非作为局部翻译的场所。与此储存库模型一致，生殖系决定因子Nanos3和Dead end的细胞质表达足以引导体细胞朝向生殖系命运，即使在缺乏胚芽颗粒的情况下。相应地，缺乏颗粒的生殖细胞正常发育，但生殖系RNA表达的持续性降低，生育能力受损。这些发现确立了斑马鱼胚芽颗粒作为保护性凝聚体，维护生殖系决定因子并通过缓冲RNA翻译的时机和速率增强发育的稳健性。
items.abstract: Germ granules are conserved, phase-separated ribonucleoprotein condensates enriched in germline determinants, yet their precise function remains unclear. Using quantitative live imaging, translational reporters, and targeted disruption of germ granule assembly in zebrafish primordial germ cells, we show that germ granules are dispensable for germ cell fate, migration, and gamete production. Instead, granules act as reservoirs, sequestering transcripts and releasing them gradually for cytoplasmic translation. Under heat stress or translational inhibition, granules further accumulate mRNAs and canonical stress granule factors, indicating a role in buffering RNA and regulatory protein availability rather than serving as sites of localized translation, as previously proposed. Consistent with this reservoir model, cytoplasmic expression of the germline determinants Nanos3 and Dead end is sufficient to direct somatic cells toward a germline fate even in the absence of germ granules. Correspondingly, germ cells lacking granules develop normally but show reduced persistence of germline RNA expression and impaired fertility. Together, these findings establish zebrafish germ granules as prot
items.authors: Wegner, J. W.; Ophaus, M.; Schmidthuis, L.; Westerich-Fellner, K. J.; Limon Tejeda, T.; Bellec, M.; Dufourt, J.; Tarbashevich, K.; Raz, E.

items.title: Optimizing the connectivity of protein conformations to untangle ensemble refinement
items.title_zh: 优化蛋白质构象连接性以解开集合精炼难题
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质在介导细胞过程时自然采用多种构象，集合模型用于拟合捕捉这种异质性的X射线晶体学数据。实际上，集合精炼在与实验数据（R-free）的符合度上相较于单一构象模型仅有微小改善。研究表明，集合模型普遍陷入“纠缠”状态；精炼算法使模型中每个单独构象适应其周围的电子密度，忽视了更和谐的构象排列方式。本文展示了通过将低能构象的构建形式化为整数线性规划问题，可以逃脱这种陷阱。该方法成功从一个先前发布的合成数据集中恢复了两个原始蛋白质构象，并在自动精炼程序中应用真实数据时，改善了R-free并减少了四构象模型的几何应变。结合人工输入和低占据水分子与溶剂中密度特征的拟合，我们为三个不同的14-19 kDa蛋白质的存储数据集生成了模型。
items.abstract: Proteins naturally adopt multiple conformations in mediating cellular processes, and ensemble models are used to fit X-ray crystallography data that captures this heterogeneity. In practice, ensemble refinement produces only minor improvements in agreement with experimental data (R-free) over single-conformation models. It has recently been shown that ensemble models are universally trapped, or "tangled"; refinement algorithms strain each individual conformation in the model to fit the electron density in its immediate vicinity, missing more harmonious ways to arrange the collection of protein conformations to fit the electron density. Here, we demonstrate that this type of trap may be escaped by formulating the construction of low-energy conformations from individual conformer coordinates as an integer linear programming problem. The method successfully recovered the two original protein conformations from a previously published synthetic dataset that traps current refinement methods. Inclusion of the method in an automated refinement procedure with real data is shown to improve R-free and reduce geometric strain in a four-conformation model by comparison with controls. Applying t
items.authors: Passmore, S. K.; Holton, J. M.; Zatsepin, N. A.; Martin, A. V.

items.title: DNA Methylation Signatures in Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌中的DNA甲基化特征：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 表观遗传变化与癌症的发生和进展相关，DNA甲基化特征的检测可能促进诊断和预后改善。尽管新技术推动了乳腺癌研究，但许多研究因样本量小而缺乏统计能力。本研究进行了一项新颖的荟萃分析，识别出所有乳腺癌亚型的共同DNA甲基化模式。我们在基因和生物功能层面获得了DNA甲基化特征，识别出受影响的重要基因组和功能通路。我们遵循PRISMA声明指南，系统回顾了乳腺癌中DNA甲基化的研究，共收集了四项研究（GSE52865、GSE141338、GSE59901和GSE101443），分为13个比较，涉及144名个体。结果显示，大多数乳腺癌亚型在免疫系统和细胞周期方面存在显著的失调。这种综合方法结合了公共数据仓库中的所有可用信息，具有比单个研究更强的统计能力。进一步评估识别出的差异生物过程和通路可能支持新生物标志物和治疗靶点的发现。
items.abstract: Epigenetic changes are involved in the onset and progression of cancer, and the detection of DNA methylation signatures may foster the improvement of diagnosis and prognosis. While the emergence of innovative technologies has fostered numerous studies in breast cancer, many lack statistical power due to the small sample sizes generally involved. In this study, we present a novel meta-analysis that identifies a common pattern of DNA methylation in all breast cancer subtypes. We obtained DNA methylation signatures at the gene and biological function level, identifying those significant groups of genes and functional pathways affected. To achieve this, we conducted a thorough systematic review following PRISMA statement guidelines for the selection of studies on DNA methylation in breast cancer. In total, we gathered four studies (GSE52865, GSE141338, GSE59901 and GSE101443) that were split into 13 comparisons comprising a set of 144 individuals. We discovered that most breast cancer subtypes share a significant deregulation in the immune system and alterations to the cell cycle. items.title: Pop-Corn: Predicting Perturbation Phenotype Effects Across Single-Cell and Spatial Contexts
items.title_zh: Pop-Corn：预测单细胞与空间环境中的扰动表型效应
items.summary_zh: 遗传扰动可以通过改变特定细胞类型和状态在细胞群体中的相对丰度来重塑细胞群体。尽管像Perturb-seq这样的单细胞筛选可以大规模测量这些反应，但实验上只能测试少量扰动。一个主要挑战是预测未见扰动引起的组成变化。许多扰动预测方法并未直接优化这一结果，而是预测基因表达反应并推断细胞类型和状态组成。我们发现，即使是准确预测扰动引起的平均基因表达变化的模型，在预测这些组成变化时表现不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Pop-Corn，一种直接预测扰动如何重塑细胞类型组成的方法。在主要的T细胞基准中，Pop-Corn比评估的表达预测管道更准确地预测了未见扰动的整体细胞状态组成，同时更好地保留了观察到的细胞状态的多样性。我们进一步将Pop-Corn扩展到完整组织中，预测局部细胞类型比例的扰动引起的变化。
items.abstract: Genetic perturbations can reshape cell populations by altering the relative abundance of specific cell types and states within the profiled population, including increases, decreases and states that become detectable after perturbation. Pooled single-cell screens, such as Perturb-seq, measure such responses at scale. However, only a small fraction of possible perturbations can be tested experimentally. A central challenge is therefore to predict compositional shifts induced by unseen perturbations. Many perturbation-prediction methods do not directly optimize for this outcome; instead, they predict gene-expression responses and infer cell-type and cell-state composition downstream. Surprisingly, we find that even models that accurately predict perturbation-induced changes in average gene expression perform poorly at forecasting these compositional shifts. To address this gap, we present Pop-Corn, a method that directly predicts how a perturbation reshapes cell-type composition without reconstructing gene expression. In the primary T-cell benchmark, Pop-Corn predicted the overall cell-state composition of held-out perturbations more accurately than the evaluated expression-predictio
items.authors: Chen, J.; Cui, Y.; Shao, Y.; Sun, N.; Martinez, M. R.

items.title: A feed-forward UHRF1 read-write mechanism supports H3 multi- mono-ubiquitination and DNA methylation maintenance at CpG-sparse regions
items.title_zh: UHRF1促进H3多重单泛素化与DNA甲基化维持机制研究
items.summary_zh: 哺乳动物DNA甲基化的表观遗传遗传需要DNMT1及其E3连接酶辅助因子UHRF1。在新复制的染色质中，UHRF1识别半甲基化DNA和组蛋白H3 N端尾部，催化H3K14、H3K18和/或H3K23的单泛素化以招募DNMT1。我们发现UHRF1通过其串联Tudor结构域中的未表征LGDDSL环直接结合其单泛素化的H3产物，促进进一步的泛素沉积。破坏这种泛素识别活性会损害H3的多重单泛素化，并加速在癌症和衰老细胞中部分甲基化区域（PMDs）内DNA甲基化的丧失。这些甲基化缺陷与UHRF1泛素连接酶活性的破坏重叠，提供了证据表明H3泛素化的写入和读取共同支持CpG稀疏区域的DNA甲基化维持。这些发现建立了一个促进多重单泛素化的前馈泛素读写机制。
items.abstract: The epigenetic inheritance of mammalian DNA methylation requires DNMT1 and its E3 ligase cofactor UHRF1. At newly replicated chromatin, UHRF1 recognition of hemi-methylated DNA and histone H3 N-terminal tails directs catalysis of H3K14, H3K18, and/or H3K23 mono-ubiquitination to recruit DNMT1. While it is appreciated that UHRF1 can deposit multiple mono-ubiquitin marks on a single H3 tail and that DNMT1 recognizes this state through tandem ubiquitin interacting motifs, the mechanism that promotes successive ubiquitination and the biological function of multi-mono-ubiquitination are unknown. Here, we show that UHRF1 directly binds its mono-ubiquitinated H3 products through a previously uncharacterized LGDDSL loop in Tudor 2 of its tandem Tudor domain (TTD) to promote further ubiquitin deposition. Disruption of this ubiquitin reading activity impairs H3 multi-mono-ubiquitination and accelerates DNA methylation loss within late-replicating, CpG-sparse genomic regions that are characteristic of partially methylated domains (PMDs) in cancer and aging cells. items.title: Innate immune stress pathway activation underlies heterochromatin dysfunction pathology
items.title_zh: 先天免疫应激通路激活导致异染色质功能障碍病理
items.summary_zh: 异染色质的丧失破坏了细胞核结构、基因调控和重复元素沉默，并与多种人类疾病相关。然而，异染色质功能障碍与病理表型之间的机制尚不清楚。通过在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中进行遗传互作筛选和基因组分析，我们发现细胞内病原体反应（IPR）这一先天免疫应激通路的二次激活是异染色质突变表型的重要因素。持续的IPR激活表现出与这些突变体相似的生长缓慢和间接转录变化。基因增强子的耗竭进一步增加了IPR激活，而抑制性RNA干扰则减弱了IPR激活，直接的异染色质靶标仍显著失调。值得注意的是，许多抑制因子编码活跃的染色质成分，适度降低RNA聚合酶II活性可改善秀丽隐杆线虫HP1突变体和人类HP1缺乏细胞的生长缺陷。我们的研究揭示了二次应激反应激活作为连接异染色质功能障碍与病理的重要机制，并确定转录抑制作为缓解这些影响的潜在治疗策略。
items.abstract: Heterochromatin loss disrupts nuclear architecture, gene regulation and repetitive element silencing, and is associated with diverse human diseases. However, mechanisms linking heterochromatin dysfunction to pathological phenotypes remain unclear. Using genetic interaction screening and genomic analyses in C. elegans, we identify secondary activation of the Intracellular Pathogen Response (IPR), an innate immune stress pathway, as a major contributor to heterochromatin mutant phenotypes. Constitutive IPR activation phenocopies slow growth and indirect transcriptional changes observed in these mutants. Depletion of genetic enhancers further increased, whereas suppressor RNAi attenuated IPR activation, with direct heterochromatin targets remaining substantially deregulated. Notably, many suppressors encode active chromatin components, and mild reduction of RNA polymerase II activity ameliorates growth defects in C. elegans HP1 mutants and human HP1-deficient cells. Our findings reveal secondary stress response activation as an important mechanism linking heterochromatin dysfunction to pathology and identify transcriptional dampening as a potential therapeutic strategy for mitigating
items.authors: Pradhan, R.; Townley, A. F.; Protasio, A. V.; Danac, J. M.; Dong, Y.; Fang, Y.; Appert, A.; Carelli, F. N.; Han, S.; Vaikkinen, H.; Tchasovnikarova, I.; Ahringer, J.

items.title: Discrepancies between ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag histone mark profiles are explained by GC content and chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: ChIP-seq与CUT&Tag组蛋白标记差异的GC含量与染色质可及性解释
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统性探讨了ChIP-seq（染色质免疫沉淀测序）与CUT&Tag（靶点下切割与标记）在已注释基因组区域捕获的信号差异。我们评估了在K562和MCF-7细胞系中不同组生成的多种组蛋白标记谱。分析结果表明，与ChIP-seq相比，CUT&Tag在低GC环境中的灵敏度有限，而在超可及染色质中信号增强。特别是在活跃基因体的GC贫乏区域和Polycomb抑制域中，CUT&Tag分别缺失H3K36me3和H3K27me3信号。此外，两个实验中H3K4me3与H3K27ac信号不一致的活跃启动子在GC含量和染色质可及性上存在系统性差异。
items.abstract: Chromatin profiling methods, such as ChIP-seq (chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing), are used to characterize the genomic localization of DNA-associated proteins. While ChIP and ChIP-seq have been used for decades, an orthogonal approach, CUT&Tag (Cleavage Under Targets and Tagmentation), is gaining popularity as an efficient and cost-effective alternative. Although previous comparative studies note discrepancies in signal-to-noise ratios and detection bias at certain genomic regions, many differences between ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag results remain largely unreconciled. Here, we systematically investigate the disagreeing signals captured by these two methods across well annotated genomic regions. We assess multiple histone mark profiles generated by different groups in two cell lines (K562 and MCF-7). Overall, our analysis indicates that compared to ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag may have limited sensitivity in low-GC environments and, as previously observed, increased signal in hyper-accessible chromatin. items.authors: Modolo, E.; Patel, L.; Ram, O.; Simon, I.; Mendenhall, E.; Heinz, S.; Benner, C.; Goren, A.

items.title: Behavioral profiles associated with adherence to adjuvant endocrine therapy in breast cancer: a retrospective population-based cohort study
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌辅助内分泌治疗依从性的行为特征研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：辅助内分泌治疗（AET）显著降低激素受体阳性乳腺癌的复发率和死亡率，但需要在5至10年内持续每日依从。约三分之一的患者在第一年内未能达到推荐的依从水平，主要由于态度、障碍和环境的不同组合。现有研究列出了个体风险因素，但缺乏规模和广度来描述这些因素在患者中的共现情况，或区分行为驱动因素与临床和人口背景的混杂。我们旨在描述国家真实世界队列中AET依从性的行为和社会异质性。方法：我们对2016至2025年间诊断为侵袭性乳腺癌的美国女性进行了回顾性队列研究，通过隐私保护的标记技术链接了两个大规模个体数据集。研究发现，患者的行为特征和驱动因素各异，任何有效的依从策略必须针对这些特征进行调整。
items.abstract: Purpose: Adjuvant endocrine therapy (AET) substantially reduces recurrence and mortality in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer but requires sustained daily adherence over 5 to 10 years. Approximately one-third of patients fall short of recommended adherence in the first year alone, largely due to distinct combinations of attitudes, barriers, and circumstances. Existing studies have catalogued individual risk factors but lack the scale and breadth to characterize how these factors co-occur within patients, or to distinguish behavioral drivers from confounding by clinical and demographic context. We sought to characterize the behavioral and social heterogeneity underlying AET adherence in a national real-world cohort. Moving beyond population-average risk factors, we identify the distinct patient profiles, and the differing drivers within them, that any effective adherence strategy must address. items.authors: Dibner-Dunlap, A.; Sutermaster, S.; Smittenaar, P.; Sgaier, S.

items.title: Long-term mortality rate changes and inverse patterns for pandemic and post-pandemic excess mortality
items.title_zh: 疫情及后疫情期过剩死亡率的长期变化研究
items.summary_zh: COVID-19疫情及其应对措施可能带来长期影响。本文分析了38个具有可靠死亡登记数据的人群在2020-2025年的过剩死亡情况，采用细致的年龄分层。通过与2017-2019年均值比较的模型（Fa）及考虑2003年后死亡率变化的趋势模型，估算出不同人群的死亡率变化。结果显示，2020-2025年间，4个国家（卢森堡、爱尔兰、瑞典、新西兰）出现了累计死亡缺口，而6个国家（智利、保加利亚、日本、希腊、斯洛伐克、意大利）则有超过4%的过剩死亡。2020-2023年差异更为明显，33个国家在2024-2025年出现死亡缺口。总的过剩死亡人数为0.92-2.49百万，2020-2023年为1.99-2.88百万，2024-2025年为0.39-1.08百万的缺口。缺乏年龄分层及使用不变线性趋势的基线模型严重偏倚了过剩死亡估算。
items.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic and pandemic response may have long-term consequences. The cumulative impact may be better appraised when post-pandemic years are also considered. For 38 populations with reliable death registration data, we estimated excess deaths for 2020-2025 with granular age stratification. One model (Fa) compared deaths against the mean of 2017-2019. Three other trend models considered changes in mortality rates after 2003 (or after a country reached $20,000 per capita income) factoring trend-of-trends (TTa), including shrinkage (STTa), and factoring also the 2024-2025 data for trend-of-trends calculation (STTa+). Slopes (weighted mean -0.62%/year in 2019) and slopes-of-slopes (weighted mean +0.104%/year^2) for age-stratified mortality rates were highly heterogeneous across populations. On model average, 4 populations (Luxembourg, Ireland, Sweden, New Zealand) had cumulative death deficits during 2020-2025, while another 6 (Chile, Bulgaria, Japan, Greece, Slovakia, Italy) had >4% excess deaths. items.title: The Vanishing White Matter registry: a unique source of natural history data
items.title_zh: 消失性白质登记：独特的自然历史数据来源
items.summary_zh: 消失性白质（VWM）登记是一个单中心数据库，包含来自470多名未经治疗的VWM患者的纵向调查数据，这些患者的DNA和MRI均已确认。VWM是一种罕见的遗传性脑白质疾病，在荷兰的活产发生率约为每10万人1例，患病率为每100万人1.3例。该登记提供了系统收集的关于该疾病的广泛信息，促进了对VWM自然历史的关键研究，并为临床试验的对照组提供了宝贵资源。数据自2004年起以纸质形式收集，2018年起转为电子维护，包含经过验证的量表和涵盖临床、功能及心理社会领域的定制问卷。调查包提供八种语言，每年发送1至4次，具体取决于患者年龄。内置的有效性检查和儿科及成人神经科医生的审核确保了数据质量。数据集持续更新，问卷扩展其范围，并为VWM研究的分析和再利用而结构化。
items.abstract: The Vanishing White Matter (VWM) Registry is a single-center database containing longitudinal survey data from >470 untreated patients with DNA- and MRI-confirmed VWM. VWM is a rare genetic disorder of the brain's white matter with an estimated live birth incidence of 1 per 100,000 and prevalence of 1.3 per 1,000,000 people in the Netherlands. The Registry represents a remarkably extensive collection of systematically gathered information on this disease, enabling crucial research into the natural history of VWM and providing a valuable resource for control arms in clinical trials. Data, initially collected on paper from 2004, have been maintained electronically since 2018, and include validated scales alongside a disease-specific customized questionnaire covering clinical, functional, and psychosocial domains. Survey packages, available in eight languages, are sent one to four times a year, depending on patient age. Built-in validity checks and review by pediatric and adult neurologists ensure data quality. The dataset is continuously updated with questionnaires expanding its scope, and structured for analysis and reuse in research on VWM.

items.title: Plasmodium berghei is resistant to aryl amino acetamides that inhibit P. falciparum growth by targeting the phospholipid transfer protein PfSTART1.
items.title_zh: 疟原虫伯氏疟原虫对抑制恶性疟原虫生长的药物具有抗性
items.summary_zh: 在之前对抑制恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）红细胞侵袭的化合物筛选中，我们发现了药物MMV006833。该化合物通过抑制PfSTART1蛋白，阻碍新生寄生体囊泡膜的扩展，以适应发育中的环状寄生虫。活细胞光片显微镜观察显示，mNeonGreen标记的PfSTART1在侵袭后约109秒从疟原虫内部结构释放到新生寄生体囊泡中。扩展显微镜技术进一步表明，这些含PfSTART1的点状结构与已知的分泌细胞器（如鞭毛、微囊和密颗粒）不共定位。尽管MMV006833的类似物对恶性疟原虫具有高效性，但在小鼠疟疾模型中对伯氏疟原虫（Plasmodium berghei）无效。研究表明，PbSTART1对MMV006833及其类似物具有高度抗性，表明同源蛋白之间的结构差异降低了抑制剂的效力。PfSTART1与WEHI-991复合物的晶体结构揭示了抑制的分子基础，并为该类化合物效力降低提供了结构解释。
items.abstract: In a previous screen for compounds that inhibit Plasmodium falciparum merozoite invasion of red blood cells, we identified the Medicines for Malaria Venture compound MMV006833. This compound inhibits PfSTART1, a protein implicated in the expansion of the nascent parasitophorous vacuole membrane following invasion, to accommodate the developing ring-stage parasite. Live-cell lattice light-sheet microscopy of invading merozoites revealed that mNeonGreen-tagged PfSTART1 is released from structures within the merozoite into the nascent parasitophorous vacuole approximately 109 seconds after invasion. Expansion microscopy of PfSTART1-HA merozoites further showed that these punctate PfSTART1-containing structures do not colocalise with known secretory organelles (rhoptries, micronemes and dense granules). Although analogues of MMV006833 are highly potent against P. falciparum, they were previously found to be ineffective against P. berghei parasites in the mouse malaria model. items.title: Cerebra: a computationally efficient framework for accurate protein structure prediction
items.title_zh: Cerebra：高效的蛋白质结构预测计算框架
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质结构预测领域取得了显著进展，代表性方法如AlphaFold和RoseTTAFold在预测准确性上接近实验结构测定，但模型训练消耗了大量计算资源。本研究提出了一种新框架Cerebra，以提高蛋白质结构预测的计算效率。在该网络架构中，多个原子坐标集并行预测，并利用它们的互补性，通过一种新注意力机制——路径合成注意力（PSA）快速提升预测结构的质量。因此，Cerebra显著降低了计算消耗，在模型训练和推理上相比于AlphaFold2的学术版本OpenFold实现了明显加速。在CAMEO 2025数据集评估中，Cerebra模型在有限GPU上训练的性能与经过大量计算资源优化的OpenFold模型相当。此外，消融研究确认PSA机制有效加速网络收敛，表明其在处理图模型中蛋白质几何体的多体效应方面的潜力。最后，Cerebra的快速推理有效支持了幻觉基础的研究。
items.abstract: Remarkable progress has been made in the field of protein structure prediction. Representative methods like AlphaFold and RoseTTAFold achieve prediction accuracy close to experimental structural determination, but at the cost of heavy computational consumption for model training. In this work, we propose a new framework, Cerebra, for improving the computational efficiency of protein structure prediction. In this network architecture, multiple sets of atomic coordinates are predicted parallelly and their mutual complementarity is leveraged to rapidly improve the quality of predicted structures through a new attention mechanism named Path Synthesis Attention (PSA). Consequently, Cerebra markedly reduces the computational consumption, achieving evident acceleration on both model training and inference, in comparison to OpenFold, the academic version of AlphaFold2. When evaluated on the CAMEO 2025 dataset, the Cerebra model trained on a limited number of GPUs shows a comparable performance to the published OpenFold model that has been thoroughly optimized using a plethora of computational resources. items.authors: Hu, J.; Wang, W.; Zhang, B.; Cao, Y.; Gong, H.

items.title: Automated language impairment screening in acute stroke using connected speech
items.title_zh: 急性中风患者的自动语言障碍筛查研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了86名左半球中风患者（约4天后），其中63名被归类为语言障碍（LI）。我们利用自动语音识别生成的故事复述文本，提取了离散语言特征和大型语言模型（LLMs）的嵌入特征。通过嵌入基础的分类器集成，我们以90%的平衡准确率（79%灵敏度，100%特异性）成功区分有无LI的患者，优于独立的嵌入和离散语言基础分类器，显示不同LLMs提供了互补信息。将离散语言基础分类器加入集成中未提高平衡准确率，但在特异性下降的情况下略微提高了灵敏度。我们提供了急性LI快速、基本自动化的语篇筛查的概念验证。
items.abstract: Connected speech is essential for everyday communication, but clinical constraints and patient fatigue limit detailed evaluation in acute stroke (<1-week post-stroke). Bedside assessments may sample discourse but rarely quantify language impairment (LI) in connected speech, leaving patient communication poorly characterized. We analyzed brief story retellings from 86 patients with left-hemisphere stroke (~4 days post-stroke; 63 classified with LI using composite clinical and naming criteria). From transcripts generated with automatic speech recognition, we derived discrete linguistic features and embeddings with Large Language Models (LLMs). An ensemble of embedding-based classifiers distinguished patients with and without LI with 90% balanced accuracy (79% sensitivity, 100% specificity), outperforming independent embedding and discrete-linguistic-based classifiers, showing distinct LLMs contributed complementary information. Adding the discrete-linguistic-based classifier to the ensemble did not improve balanced accuracy but modestly increased sensitivity at the expense of specificity. We provide proof of concept for a fast, largely automated discourse screener of acute LI.
items.authors: Pugalenthi, L. S.; Schnur, T. T.

items.title: Mitochondria remodel near synapses to boost metabolic capacity and fuel plasticity
items.title_zh: 线粒体在突触附近重塑以增强代谢能力和支持可塑性
items.summary_zh: 大脑突触是能量消耗的热点，学习所需的突触可塑性显著增加了这一需求。由于大多数突触远离细胞体，其能量需求必须在局部满足。树突线粒体可延伸约30微米，跨越多个突起，但仅在经历可塑性的突起附近增加ATP合成，提供即时和持续的能量。我们开发了一种相关光电显微镜（CLEM）流程，结合自定义深度学习模型，从有限的训练数据中同时分割五种不同的3D亚细胞结构，实现42个层析图的定量分析。研究发现，突触邻近的线粒体区域比同一线粒体内的非突触邻近区域更大，并在突触可塑性期间进一步增大。突触邻近线粒体的ATP合成与突起ATP水平同步上升。
items.abstract: Brain synapses are hotspots of energy consumption, and the synaptic plasticity underlying learning sharply increases this demand. Because most synapses lie far from their cell body, their energy demands must be met locally. A dendritic mitochondrion can extend ~30 m and span many spines, yet ramps up ATP synthesis only near spines undergoing plasticity, providing immediate and sustained energy. Whether structural changes in these juxtaspinal mitochondrial regions (2 m segments at spine bases) support this response is unknown; resolving their energy-producing architecture poses substantial challenges. Compared with the lamellar cristae of axonal mitochondria, dendritic mitochondrial cristae form complex, tubular, and interconnected networks that require multiple high-resolution tomograms to characterize. We therefore developed a correlative light and electron microscopy (CLEM) pipeline with a custom deep-learning model that simultaneously segments five distinct 3D suborganellar structures from limited training data, enabling quantitative analysis across 42 tomograms at 2 nm pixel resolution. items.title: A postmeiotic route to polyploidy
items.title_zh: 后减数分裂途径导致多倍体形成
items.summary_zh: 多倍体是指基因组中存在多个染色体组，广泛存在于植物、真菌和动物中，并在基因组进化中发挥了重要作用。尽管多倍体化通常归因于有丝分裂基因组翻倍或未减数配子融合，但其机制，特别是三倍体形成的机制仍不清楚。本研究在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中识别出一种新的自体多倍体化途径，称为“孢子-内复制-配对”（SEM），其中一个配子或孢子经历减数后内复制，并在子囊破裂后与附近的非内复制同胞孢子配对，从而增加一个单倍体基因组。我们实验性地展示了从二倍体到三倍体以及从三倍体到四倍体的逐步转变。完整的子囊可以在一次或两次连续的SEM循环中自发产生新的三倍体和四倍体菌株。自然多倍体表现出与SEM一致的基因组特征，表明SEM是酵母中多倍体化的主要自然途径。SEM确立了三倍体作为酵母多倍体化的核心中间体，类似于植物中描述的三倍体桥，并提出了类似机制可能在其他真核生物的多倍体基因组形成中发挥作用的可能性。
items.abstract: Polyploidy, the presence of multiple chromosome sets within a genome, is widespread and has played a major role in genome evolution in plants, fungi, and animals. Although polyploidization is generally attributed to mitotic genome doubling or unreduced gamete fusion, the mechanisms underlying ploidy increases, particularly triploid formation, remain unclear. Here, we identify a novel route to autopolyploidization in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, termed Sporulate-Endoreplicate-Mate (SEM), in which one gamete, or spore, undergoes postmeiotic endoreplication and subsequently mates with a nearby non-endoreplicated sibling spore after ascus breakdown, increasing ploidy by one haploid genome. We experimentally demonstrate stepwise transitions from diploidy to triploidy and from triploidy to tetraploidy. Intact asci can spontaneously generate new triploid and tetraploid strains upon one or two successive SEM cycles. Natural polyploids exhibit genomic signatures consistent with SEM being a major natural route to polyploidization in yeast. items.authors: Gomez-Munoz, C.; Vittorelli, N.; Gaudin, M.; Agier, N.; Delmas, S.; Corbeau, Y.; Cosentino Lagomarsino, M.; Liti, G.; Llorente, B.; Fischer, G.

items.title: Developmental Dynamics of Naturalistic Social Behavior Revealed by Longitudinal Multi-Animal Tracking
items.title_zh: 自然社交行为的发展动态通过多动物追踪揭示
items.summary_zh: 早期与父母和同窝兄弟姐妹的社交经历对社交物种的社交行为和认知发展至关重要。然而，自然社交互动在发展过程中的演变尚不清楚，因为多动物的可靠追踪受到频繁遮挡和身体重叠的挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了Move-Altogether（MovAl），一个多动物姿态估计管道，结合了视频物体分割和轮廓引导预处理，相比于广泛使用的方法，改善了身份稳定性和姿态准确性。利用MovAl生成的姿态序列，我们建立了基于去噪自编码器（DAE）的框架，将纵向笼内行为映射到由动物间距、社交方向和互动动态定义的共同三维空间。在这个空间中，对照组小鼠在3到8周龄期间表现出群体行为的逐步重组，为自然社交组织建立了发展参考。与此参考相比，产前丙戊酸（VPA）暴露在3-5周龄时显著改变了社交行为的组织，表明神经发育扰动的后果可以通过同窝兄弟姐妹之间自然群体行为的变化来检测。
items.abstract: Early-life social experiences with parents and littermates are critical for the development of social behavior and cognition in social species. Yet, how naturalistic social interactions evolve across development remains poorly understood, because reliable tracking of multiple freely interacting animals is challenged by frequent occlusion and body overlap. To address this challenge, we developed Move-Altogether (MovAl), a multi-animal pose estimation pipeline integrating video object segmentation and contour-guided preprocessing that improved identity stability and pose accuracy compared with widely used methods. Using MovAl-derived pose sequences, we established a denoising autoencoder (DAE)-based framework to map longitudinal home-cage behavior within a common three-dimensional space defined by inter-animal spacing, social orientation, and interaction dynamics. Within this space, control mice showed progressive reorganization of group behavior from 3 to 8 weeks of age, establishing a developmental reference for naturalistic social organization. Against this reference, prenatal valproic acid (VPA) exposure produced prominent alterations in social behavior organization at 3-5 weeks
items.authors: Kim, S.; Jeong, Y.; Lin Thant, H.; Choi, H.; Chung, A.

items.title: The Network Landscape of Non-Clinical Eating Behaviors in India
items.title_zh: 印度非临床饮食行为的网络结构研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对印度的非临床饮食行为进行网络分析，样本量为1,508人（男性48.9%，女性50.7%，年龄范围18-65岁），基于35项经过验证的生物心理社会测量工具。混合图形模型揭示了一个高度优化的小世界系统，具有双层次的层级结构。文化和生活条件（宗教、居住类型）作为地方行为锚点（影响力最高），而社会经济因素（就业、教育）和自尊则作为结构性桥梁（中介中心性最高），整合了生物心理社会系统。值得注意的是，形体和体重关注高度可预测，但作为地方集群节点而非全球整合者，直接挑战了西方以身体形象为中心的模型。研究的局限性包括横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，以及需要在印度背景下持续验证西方衍生测量工具。这些发现表明，在发展中经济体中，较广泛的心理社会结构因素可能比个体因素更能维持饮食障碍症状。
items.abstract: Eating behaviors are traditionally conceptualized as individual psychological phenomena, yet their structural organization remains largely unmapped in non-Western contexts. Adopting a dimensional perspective, this study used network analysis to characterize the architecture of non-clinical eating behaviors in India (N = 1,508; 48.9% male, 50.7% female; age range = 18-65 years) based on 35 well-validated biopsychosocial measures. Mixed Graphical Models revealed a highly optimized, small-world system defined by a dual-layered hierarchy. Cultural and living conditions (religion, home type) served as local behavioral anchors (highest expected influence), whereas socioeconomic factors (employment, education) and self-esteem functioned as structural bridges (highest betweenness centrality) integrating the biopsychosocial system. Notably, shape and weight concerns were highly predictable but operated as local cluster nodes rather than global integrators-directly challenging Western body-image-centric models. Limitations include cross-sectional design, precluding causal inference, and the need for ongoing validation of Western-derived measures in Indian contexts. These findings suggest tha
items.authors: Ray, D.; Ravishankar, A.; Chen, E. Y.; Das, M.

items.title: Directed effective connectivity between the SCN-containing hypothalamus and pineal gland varies by chronotype in bipolar disorder
items.title_zh: 双相障碍中SCN-含量下丘脑与松果体的有效连接与生物钟类型相关
items.summary_zh: 昼夜节律紊乱是精神疾病的跨诊断特征，尤其在双相障碍（BD）中，晚间生物钟类型与症状严重性相关。上交叉核（SCN）通过已知的前馈通路调节松果体（PG）褪黑激素合成。此外，褪黑激素也能相位移SCN，形成功能反馈。我们应用交叉谱动态因果建模（DCM）分析了431名UK Biobank参与者的静息态fMRI数据，包括健康对照（HC, N=136）、BD（N=78）、重性抑郁障碍（MDD, N=154）和精神病障碍（PY, N=63）。随机效应贝叶斯模型选择比较了完全连接模型与简化架构模型，以及前馈（SCN[- ]PG）与反馈（PG[- ]SCN）模型。每个受试者的对数贝叶斯因子差异（dF）用于评估方向偏好，并通过ANCOVA检验与诊断、生物钟类型及其交互的关系。结果显示，完全连接模型被强烈偏好（后验概率=97.8%，保护超越概率[PXP]=1.00），前馈架构占主导（70% vs 30%，PXP=1.00）。诊断未显著影响结果。
items.abstract: Circadian disruption is a transdiagnostic feature of psychiatric illness, particularly in bipolar disorder (BD), where evening chronotype is linked to greater symptom severity. The suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) times pineal gland (PG) melatonin synthesis through a well-described feedforward pathway. Moreover, melatonin can also phase-shift the SCN-pacemaker, consistent with a functional feedback limb. Directed effective connectivity between the SCN-containing hypothalamus and the PG has not been estimated in human neuroimaging, and it is unknown whether that directed coupling varies by psychiatric diagnosis or chronotype. We applied cross-spectral dynamic causal modeling (DCM) to resting-state fMRI data in 431 UK Biobank (healthy controls [HC, N=136], BD [N=78], major depressive disorder [MDD, N=154] and psychotic disorders [PY, N=63]). Random-effects Bayesian model selection compared a fully connected model with reduced archiature and, separately, feedforward-only (SCN[- ]PG) vs feedback-only (PG[- ]SCN) models. items.title: How many crystal structures do you need to trust your docking results?
items.title_zh: 信任对接结果需要多少晶体结构？
items.summary_zh: 基于结构的药物发现依赖于对新分子设计的蛋白质结合构象的预测，其准确性会影响后续的优先级排序。我们使用来自开放科学COVID Moonshot项目的403个SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶晶体结构，探讨获取晶体结构在准确预测设计分子构象中的成本与效用之间的权衡。研究发现，相似的参考配体能够提高构象预测的准确性，并且在每个通用Bemis-Murcko骨架中，成功率在大约五个晶体结构后达到平台期，领先系列的成功率超过95%。本研究为结构驱动的药物发现项目提供了资源分配的实用建议。
items.abstract: Structure-based drug discovery relies on the prediction of protein-bound poses of new molecule designs, the accuracy of which can impact downstream prioritization. While it is expected that crystal structures of similar molecules would provide the best template for predicting the poses of new designs, the time and cost required motivates identifying a point of diminishing returns for collecting new structures. Using 403 crystal structures of SARS-CoV-2 main protease from the open science COVID Moonshot project, we explore the tradeoff between the cost and utility of obtaining crystal structures for accurately predicting poses of designed molecules. We observe that similar reference ligands enable superior pose prediction and show that success plateaus after approximately five crystal structures per generic Bemis-Murcko scaffold, exceeding 95% for the campaign's lead series. This work provides practical recommendations for resource allocation in structure-enabled drug discovery campaigns.
items.authors: Payne, A. M.; Kaminow, B.; MacDermott-Opeskin, H.; Pulido, I.; Scheen, J.; Castellanos, M. A.; Fearon, D.; Chodera, J. D.; Singh, S.

items.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
items.title_zh: 神经符号人工智能在自动化病理质量测量中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景：临床质量测量通常依赖于手动抽取医疗记录，这种方法成本高、负担重，且对需要解读叙述文本的指标往往不可行。我们评估了神经符号人工智能（NSAI）是否能够从叙述病理报告中可靠地抽取复杂的质量指标。方法：NSAI系统将每个指标分解为基本问题，并通过案例基础的迭代人机协作过程与现实报告对齐。使用2000份独立双重抽取的报告，我们将NSAI抽取与经过训练的人类抽取者在美国病理学会设定的四个病理质量指标上进行了比较。结果：NSAI系统与裁定的金标准一致性（Cohen's kappa = 0.95）与经过训练的人类抽取者的结果相当或略有超出（kappa = 0.92），在胃肠道化生（CAP 43）上表现尤为突出。组件分析显示，案例基础的细化带来了最大的准确性提升（kappa提升至0.25）。
items.abstract: Background. Clinical quality measurement often relies on manual abstraction of medical records, an approach that is costly, burdensome, and often infeasible for measures requiring interpretation of narrative text; these constraints have shaped measure development itself, filtering out clinically important measures that are too difficult to operationalize. We evaluated whether neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence (NSAI), which combines large language model extraction with symbolic reasoning, could reliably abstract complex quality measures from narrative pathology reports. Methods. The NSAI system decomposes each measure into atomic questions and is aligned to real-world reports through case-based refinement, an iterative human-in-the-loop process. Using 2,000 independently double-abstracted reports, we compared NSAI-based abstraction against trained human abstractors across four pathology quality measures established by the College of American Pathologists. Results. The NSAI system's agreement with the adjudicated gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.95) matched or modestly exceeded that of the trained human abstractors measured against the same standard (kappa = 0.92), with particul
items.authors: Brann, F.; Tadele, L.; Skau, C.; Bocsi, G.; Clarke, A. K.

items.title: Public awareness of the hearing loss-dementia link and self-reported behavioral changes in middle- to older-aged Canadians
items.title_zh: 加拿大中老年人对听力损失与痴呆关联的认知及行为变化
items.summary_zh: 听力损失是痴呆的潜在风险因素，但公众对这一关联及其行为影响的认知仍不充分。本研究通过横断面调查，收集了1,404名年龄在44至97岁之间的加拿大人的认知、主观听力与认知、与痴呆相关的关注、对关联的看法及人口统计信息。结果显示，28%的人意识到听力损失与痴呆之间的关联，其中17%的人更倾向于寻求或继续接受听力损失治疗。在健康参与者子样本中，意识和自我报告的行为反应的比例超过两倍。教育水平、对痴呆的关注、年龄较大和女性性别与意识相关。对于已意识到这一关联的参与者，痴呆关注、主观认知较差和对理解关联的信心与治疗倾向相关，但教育水平并无显著影响。因此，意识受社会经济和人口统计因素影响，但这些因素并不足以确保行为改变。沟通可能需要超越健康参与群体，优先考虑准确理解而非仅仅是意识。
items.abstract: Hearing loss is a potential risk factor for dementia, but public awareness of this link and its behavioral implications remain poorly understood. In a cross-sectional survey, 1,404 Canadians aged 44-97 years completed measures of awareness, subjective hearing and cognition, dementia-related concerns, perceptions of the link, and demographics. 28% of people were aware of the hearing loss-dementia link. Of these, 17% were more inclined to seek/continue hearing-loss treatment. Awareness and self-reported behavioral responses were over twice as prevalent in a health-engaged subsample. Education, dementia concern, older age, and female gender were associated with awareness. Among aware participants, dementia concern, poorer subjective cognition, and confidence in understanding the link, but not education, were associated with reported treatment inclination. Awareness thus follows socioeconomic and demographic gradients, but these alone do not appear to ensure behavior change. Communication may need to reach beyond health-engaged groups and prioritize accurate understanding over awareness.
items.authors: Bobbitt, S.; Mathiesen, S. L.; Binns, M.; Herrmann, B.

items.title: Intrathoracic Adipose Tissue and Airway Structure, Lung Function, and Respiratory Symptoms: The Framingham Heart Study
items.title_zh: 胸腔脂肪组织与气道结构、肺功能及呼吸症状的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：肥胖与气道疾病相关，但特定胸腔脂肪储存的贡献尚不明确。本研究探讨了胸腔内脂肪组织（ITAT）与气道表型的关系。方法：纳入了具有CT测量的Framingham心脏研究参与者，使用多变量回归评估ITAT与CT基础气道壁和腔径测量、肺功能及呼吸症状的横断面关联。主要分析使用性别特异的ITAT z-score，并调整腰围以考虑中央肥胖。结果：在2825名参与者中（52.0%为女性），调整腰围后，每增加1个标准差的ITAT与更大的段支气管壁厚度（0.010 mm）和亚段支气管壁厚度（0.006 mm）、更窄的段支气管腔径（-0.049 mm）、较低的FEV1预测百分比（-1.92个百分点）以及更高的喘息（OR: 1.16）和呼吸困难（1.22）的几率相关。
items.abstract: Background: Obesity is associated with airway disease, but the contribution of specific thoracic adipose depots remains unclear. We examined whether intrathoracic adipose tissue (ITAT), defined as adipose tissue within the thoracic cavity excluding pericardial adipose tissue (PAT), was associated with airway phenotypes. Methods: We included Framingham Heart Study participants with CT-derived thoracic adipose tissue measures. Cross-sectional associations of ITAT with CT-based airway wall and lumen measurements, spirometry, and respiratory symptoms were evaluated using multivariable regression. Primary analyses used sex-specific ITAT z-scores and adjusted for waist circumference to account for central obesity. Secondary analyses examined sex-specific ITAT quintiles and compared ITAT and PAT in individual-depot and mutually adjusted models. items.authors: Zhang, J.; Bosch, N. A.; Law, A. C.; Choi, S. H.; Wilson, K. C.; Dupuis, J.; Washko, G. R.; Cho, M. H.; O'Connor, G. T.

items.title: Treatment-Resilient Lipid Remodeling Defines Temozolomide Resistance and Failure of Simvastatin Sensitization in Glioblastoma
items.title_zh: 耐药性脂质重塑定义胶质母细胞瘤的替莫唑胺耐药性
items.summary_zh: 替莫唑胺（TMZ）耐药性是胶质母细胞瘤（GB）持久控制的主要障碍。我们的研究表明，辛伐他汀可以通过破坏自噬体-溶酶体融合和激活应激反应通路，增强非耐药GB细胞的TMZ诱导细胞死亡，而已建立的TMZ耐药细胞则维持受损的自噬流，对TMZ、辛伐他汀及其组合仍然无反应。本研究探讨了这种治疗反应丧失是否伴随着耐治疗的脂质状态。通过靶向LC-MS，我们在非耐药（NR）和TMZ耐药（R）U251-mKate细胞中量化了304种脂质，结果显示耐药细胞在四种处理状态下表现出持久的NR/R脂质组分分离，且耐药细胞富集了溶血磷脂、特定的鞘脂类/糖鞘脂类和胆固醇酯，同时几种甘油磷脂和二酰甘油池则出现耗竭或重新分布。
items.abstract: Temozolomide (TMZ) resistance remains a major barrier to durable control of glioblastoma (GB). Our previous studies showed that simvastatin can enhance TMZ-induced cell death in non-resistant GB cells by disrupting autophagosome-lysosome fusion and engaging stress-response pathways, whereas established TMZ-resistant cells maintain impaired autophagy flux and remain refractory to TMZ, simvastatin, and their combination. Here, we asked whether this loss of therapeutic responsiveness is accompanied by a treatment-resilient lipid state. Targeted LC-MS quantified 304 lipid species across 25 analytical classes in non-resistant (NR) and TMZ-resistant (R) U251-mKate cells under control, simvastatin (ST), TMZ, and TMZ-ST conditions. Global heatmap, principal-component, volcano, and exploratory PLS-DA analyses demonstrated persistent NR/R lipidomic separation across all four treatment states. Resistant cells recurrently displayed enrichment of lysophospholipids, selected sphingolipids/glycosphingolipids, and cholesteryl esters, with depletion or redistribution of several glycerophospholipid and diacylglycerol pools. items.title: Wild chimpanzee groups increase social connectivity prior to risky collective action
items.title_zh: 野生黑猩猩群体在风险集体行动前增强社会联系
items.summary_zh: 合作是复杂社会性的基础，但也带来了深刻的进化困境——成本和收益往往不均等，合作或背叛的决策涉及复杂的情境计算。我们使用2013-2018年在科特迪瓦太国家公园的三组野生黑猩猩的长期数据，研究了它们在预期集体合作前的亲社会互动重组。研究发现，黑猩猩在主动进行风险性领土防御的日子里，调整了社交接触的分布，形成了更广泛但更分散的亲社会网络。具体而言，成年黑猩猩在主动领土防御的日子里，与更多群体成员进行梳理和玩耍，这种模式在时间上是敏感的，增加的亲社会行为发生在合作行为之前，而非之后。
items.abstract: Cooperation is foundational to complex sociality, yet presents profound evolutionary dilemmas - costs and benefits are rarely distributed evenly and the decision to collaborate or defect can involve a complex contextual calculus. These challenges are compounded when cooperation scales from pairs to groups. Group-level cooperation is fundamental to many species success, but how is it sustained and regulated in nature? One promising route to addressing this question is to examine how individuals reorganise their affiliative interactions in anticipation of group-level cooperation. We examine such pre-cooperative reorganisation using long-term data (2013-2018) from three neighbouring groups of wild chimpanzees at the Tai National Park, Cote dIvoire, who routinely cooperate as a collective to defend their territory against other groups. We found that chimpanzees adjusted the distribution of their social contacts in anticipation of risky and proactive territorial defence by forming more broadly connected, yet more diffuse, affiliative networks. items.authors: Brooks, J.; Mundry, R.; Crockford, C.; Wittig, R. M.; Wessling, E. G.; Samuni, L.

items.title: Assessing respiratory rates and signs of air hunger using the PneumoRator sensor.
items.title_zh: 使用PneumoRator传感器评估呼吸频率与缺氧感
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估PneumoRator可穿戴传感器在成人（包括有无呼吸模式障碍者）中对呼吸频率（RR）和缺氧感（SAH）的准确性。研究设计为一项初步的横断面观察研究，参与者为18-40岁健康成年人，共招募30名，29名提供了完整数据。参与者在静坐休息状态下连续佩戴PneumoRator传感器10分钟。主要结果显示，PneumoRator测得的RR与随机1分钟的手动计数之间无显著差异（p=0.89），SAH检测方法之间也无显著差异（p=0.17）。研究表明，PneumoRator传感器在评估呼吸频率和缺氧感方面具有潜在的应用价值。
items.abstract: Objectives: To investigate whether the PneumoRator wearable sensor could accurately assess Respiratory Rate (RR) and signs of air hunger (SAH) compared with clinician-observed assessment in adults with and without breathing pattern disorder (BrPD). Design: A pilot cross-sectional observational study. Setting: A research laboratory on a university campus. Participants: Healthy adults aged 18-40, who were not pregnant, no smokers or history of cardiovascular, respiratory or neurological illness. Thirty consented to the study, Twenty-nine had full data for analysis. Interventions: Participants wore the PneumoRator chest-worn sensor continuously for 10 minutes while seated at rest. Main outcome measures: Respiratory Rate was compared between PneumoRator-derived measurements and randomised 1-minute observer manual counts. Clinician-observed SAH and BrPD were assessed using the Breathing Pattern Assessment Tool (BPAT). Participants also completed the Nijmegen Questionnaire. PneumoRator signals were analysed to identify large-volume breaths as potential SAH events. Results: Thirty participants were recruited. items.authors: Hudson-Colby, J.; Baston, H.; Harding, M.; Brider, S.; Yates, F.; Shaban, M.; White, N. M.; Lewis, A.

items.title: Deep Time-to-Event Models for Intrapartum Fetal Monitoring
items.title_zh: 深度时间事件模型用于产程胎儿监测
items.summary_zh: 及时检测产程中的胎儿窘迫是现代产科护理的核心任务。主要的监测手段是胎心率和宫缩监测（心电图监测或CTG），提供产程中的连续信号。大多数机器学习在CTG上的应用假设在分娩前有30到60分钟的窗口，这一假设不切实际，因为分娩时间并不明确。本研究将问题重新定义为时间事件预测任务，开发深度时间事件模型来预测即将分娩和胎儿酸中毒的联合概率，后者是通过脐带气体在分娩后收集的胎儿缺氧生物标志物。我们提出了一种框架，结合深度离散时间生存方法和标记点过程，适应这一特定设置。我们的方法“标记深度Hit”在多个时间节点上准确估计分娩时间，测试集AUROC在产程6小时和12小时分别为0.837和0.935。我们的模型在接近分娩时表现出竞争力，优于专门训练于追踪结束的先前模型。
items.abstract: Timely detection of fetal distress during labor is a central pursuit of modern obstetric care. The primary measure used in this regard is fetal heart rate and contraction monitoring (echocardiotocography or CTG), which provides a continuous signal during labor. The vast majority of machine learning applications to CTG assume access to a 30 to 60 minute window just prior to delivery, which makes an untenable assumption that the timing of delivery is known. In this work, we reframe the problem as a time-to-event prediction task. We develop deep time-to-event models to predict the joint probability of imminent delivery and fetal acidosis, a biomarker of fetal hypoxia collected from umbilical cord gas after delivery. We develop a framework for this problem, drawing on deep discrete-time survival methods and marked point processes, adapting each to this particular setting (i.e., continuous physiological signals, fully observed events, partially observed labels). One approach dubbed Marked DeepHit accurately estimates delivery within one hour at multiple elapsed-time landmarks, with test-set AUROC of 0.837 [95% CI 0.692--0.970] and 0.935 [0.858--0.964] at 6 and 12 hours into labor, respe
items.authors: Imai Aldeia, G. S.; Coggan, H.; Yang, Y.; Levine, L.; McCoy, J. A.; La Cava, W.

items.title: Perspective independence, more than personas, drives LLM teams - and where they reverse
items.title_zh: 视角独立性驱动大型语言模型团队的表现
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多智能体提示对大型语言模型（LLM）的影响，特别是专家角色与视角独立性之间的关系。我们比较了单次直接调用、在一个上下文中使用五个角色，以及由主持人整合的五个孤立代理，针对87个CPC案例、406个MedCaseReasoning案例和364个急诊科接诊案例进行了五次重复实验，使用经过临床医生验证的LLM评估。结果显示，团队在外部基准测试中超越了单次调用，在预设的召回指标上（前3名提高3.0分，p = 0.0079；前5名提高3.9，p = 3.8 x 10^-5），增益归因于独立生成与调节综合，而非专家角色。在真实急诊表现中，效果则相反（前1名40.1%对比34.3%，p < 0.0001），由专家角色列表推动并保留了额外的客观结果。部署应关注具体问题及当前输入。
items.abstract: Multi-agent prompting of large language models has produced contradictory diagnostic results, and it remains unclear whether any benefit comes from specialist personas or from perspective independence. We compared a single direct call, five personas in one context, and the same five roles as isolated agents integrated by a moderator, with five repeat runs per case, on 87 CPC cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, and 364 emergency department encounters, under an LLM judge validated against clinicians. On the external benchmark the team beat the single call on both pre-specified recall endpoints (top-3 +3.0 points, p = 0.0079; top-5 +3.9, p = 3.8 x 10^-5;); a factorial attributes the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not the specialist roles. On real emergency presentations the benefit reversed (top-1 40.1% versus 34.3%, p < 0.0001), carried by the specialist role lists and surviving added objective results. Deployment should key on the question and the input at hand.
items.authors: Feng, J.; Jiao, Y.; Li, Y.; Xie, L.; Peng, W.; Sun, X.

items.title: Detection of zoonotic Cryptosporidium parvum in invasive beavers from southern Tierra del Fuego, Chile
items.title_zh: 智利南部火地岛入侵海狸中检测到人畜共患隐孢子虫
items.summary_zh: 自1946年引入火地岛以来，入侵海狸的种群不断扩张，导致亚南极地区环境严重退化。海狸坝对泥炭地、成熟亚南极森林和水流造成了深远影响。本研究报告了在巴塔哥尼亚的入侵海狸中发现的病原体，并讨论其作为水源人畜共患病原体储存库的潜在角色。我们通过显微镜和Ziehl-Neelsen染色技术在南火地岛收集的海狸中检测到隐孢子虫。在检查的105只海狸中，有3只通过光学显微镜检测呈阳性，随后通过18S核糖体DNA序列分析被分子鉴定为隐孢子虫（Cryptosporidium parvum）。考虑到隐孢子虫对本地物种、野生动物和人类健康的潜在影响，这一发现突显了入侵海狸向亚南极其他地区扩张所带来的潜在风险。入侵海狸作为巴塔哥尼亚人畜共患隐孢子虫储存库的潜在角色强调了人类引入外来物种对原始生态系统的未知后果。
items.abstract: Since their introduction to Tierra del Fuego in 1946, invasive beavers have expanded their population and caused extensive environmental degradation across the subantarctic region. Beaver dams have profoundly impacted peatlands, mature sub-Antarctic forests, and watercourses. Here, we report a pathogen in invasive beavers in Patagonia and discuss their potential role as a reservoir of waterborne zoonotic pathogens. We detected Cryptosporidium through microscopy using the Ziehl-Neelsen staining technique in beaver collected from southern Tierra del Fuego. Out of the 105 beavers examined, three tested positive to optical microscopy, which were then identified molecularly as Cryptosporidium parvum by sequence analysis of the 18S ribosomal DNA (rDNA). Given the potential impacts of Cryptosporidium parvum upon native species, wildlife, and human health, this finding highlights the potential risks associated with the ongoing expansion of beavers into other areas of the sub-Antarctic region. A potential role of invasive beavers as reservoirs of zoonotic Cryptosporidium spp. in Patagonia emphasizes the unknown consequences of human-introduced exotic species on pristine ecosystems.
items.authors: Aguilar, P. A. L.; Contreras, G.; Cabrera, G.; Arredondo, C.; Federici, F.; Briceno, C.

items.title: RosaSeed: Faster and Accurate Short Read Alignment Using a Configurable Seeding Strategy
items.title_zh: RosaSeed：基于可配置种子策略的快速准确短读比对
items.summary_zh: 传统的短读DNA比对算法，如广泛使用的BWA-MEM2，花费大量时间在种子生成上。我们提出了RosaSeed，一种基于可配置种子框架的短读比对算法，显著加速比对，同时保持与BWA-MEM2相当的准确性。RosaSeed替代了BWA-MEM2的种子内核，直接向现有的BWA-MEM2链和比对扩展管道提供候选种子，生成适合下游变异分析的标准SAM输出。我们在模拟和真实短读数据集上评估了RosaSeed，比较了其种子处理时间、fastq到SAM时间、比对准确性和内存占用。与BWA-MEM2、Minimap2、Bowtie2和枚举基数树（ERT）算法相比，RosaSeed在单线程执行下的推荐配置在种子处理和fastq到SAM时间上分别实现了13.06倍和3.85倍的加速。与ERT、ERT2和Minimap2的对应加速分别为3.96倍、1.2倍和4.82倍。RosaSeed的峰值内存需求仅为49.61 GB。
items.abstract: Conventional short read DNA alignment algorithms, such as widely used BWA-MEM2, devote a substantial fraction of their execution time to seed generation. We present RosaSeed, a short read alignment algorithm, based on a configurable seeding framework, that significantly accelerates alignment while maintaining accuracy comparable to that of BWA-MEM2. RosaSeed replaces the BWA-MEM2 seeding kernel and directly supplies candidate seeds to the existing BWA-MEM2 chaining and alignment extension pipeline, producing standard SAM output suitable for downstream variant analysis. RosaSeed was evaluated on both simulated and real short read datasets, and its seeding time, fastq-to-SAM time, alignment accuracy, and memory footprint were compared against BWA-MEM2, Minimap2, Bowtie2, and the Enumerated Radix Tree (ERT) algorithm. We also compared against ERT2, a proposed simplified variant of ERT that sacrifices a small amount of alignment accuracy to significantly increase the alignment throughput. With single-threaded software execution, our recommended RosaSeed configuration achieves 13.06x and 3.85x speedups in seed processing and fastq-to-SAM time, respectively, over BWA-MEM2. Corresponding
items.authors: Gandhi, S. M.; Cockburn, B. F.

items.title: Performance of protein panels is inflated across many biomarker studies
items.title_zh: 蛋白质面板在生物标志物研究中的表现被高估
items.summary_zh: 数据泄漏是生物标志物发现研究中普遍存在但被低估的缺陷。通过模拟和真实的蛋白质组学数据，我们展示了典型的研究流程普遍容易受到这一问题的影响，导致性能估计被高估、泛化能力差以及假阳性过多。我们进一步介绍了两种工具，用于在代码和手稿层面检测数据泄漏，为更严格和可重复的生物标志物报告提供了实用路径。
items.abstract: Data leakage is a prevalent yet underappreciated flaw in biomarker discovery studies. Through simulation and real-world proteomic data, we demonstrate that typical pipelines are broadly susceptible to this issue, producing inflated performance estimates, poor generalization, and excess false positives. We further introduce two tools to detect data leakage at the code and manuscript level, providing a practical path toward more rigorous and reproducible biomarker reporting.
items.authors: An, L.; Finney, C. A.; Shvetcov, A.; The Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium,  ; Vogel, J.

items.title: Spatial clustering of undervaccination amplifies local measles transmission but limits geographic spread: South Carolina, 2025-2026
items.title_zh: 南卡罗来纳州2025-2026年麻疹疫情的空间聚集分析
items.summary_zh: 2025年南卡罗来纳州爆发的麻疹疫情是美国二十多年来最大的疫情，确认病例达997例，主要发生在斯巴坦堡县一个疫苗接种不足的社区。为支持南卡罗来纳州公共卫生部的麻疹应对工作，我们开发了一个随机代理模型，以预测疫情轨迹并实时评估干预策略，整合了三个空间尺度的传播数据，并基于地理编码的家庭、学校入学记录和人口普查数据。模型预测总感染病例中位数为1,020例（90%预测区间：840-1,273）。如果没有积极的接触追踪和隔离，反事实模拟预测中位数为2,432例感染（90%预测区间：1,867-3,185），比模型预测的基线（1,020例）高出约138%。模型的准确性要求高度本地化的学校间接触结构；更广泛的接触假设显著高估了病例数和地理传播。模拟的区域引入确认疫情仅在接种不足的连接聚集区附近发生，而接种良好的地区保持稳定。模型在应对的第9、17和34周前瞻性部署，为资源分配决策提供了依据。
items.abstract: The 2025 measles outbreak in South Carolina, the largest in the United States in over two decades, produced 997 confirmed cases, predominantly among school-aged children in an under-vaccinated community in Spartanburg County. To support the South Carolina Department of Public Health (DPH) measles response, we developed a stochastic agent-based model to forecast outbreak trajectory and evaluate intervention strategies in real time, integrating transmission across three spatial scales and grounded in geocoded households, school enrollment records, and census-derived demographic data. The model predicted a median of 1,020 total infections (90% prediction interval: 840-1,273). Counterfactual simulations without active contact tracing and quarantine projected a median of 2,432 infections (90% prediction interval: 1,867-3,185), approximately 138% more than the model-predicted baseline (1,020 cases). Model fidelity required a highly localized between-school contact structure; broader contact assumptions substantially overpredicted both case counts and geographic spread. items.title: Adiposity and sex steroid hormones: evidence on direct measures and changes over time -- a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.title_zh: 肥胖与性激素：直接测量及时间变化的系统评估与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 引言：关于体脂变化及其分布与不同基质（血液、组织、尿液等）中性激素测量的文献综述不足。方法：使用PubMed和Web of Science识别截至2026年6月的相关研究。进行了随机效应荟萃分析，并根据持续更新项目标准评估证据强度。结果：在筛选的16,875篇文献中，140项研究被认为相关：96项涉及39个减重干预（手术和生活方式）的循环血液生物标志物，60项观察性研究直接测量体脂分布（如DEXA、MRI），20项研究尿液或其他排泄基质中的生物标志物（如唾液、尿液、乳腺导管冲洗），以及25项组织基础研究（如脂肪、乳腺、子宫内膜、皮肤）。减重与总睾酮和游离睾酮的减少及性激素结合球蛋白（SHBG）的增加相关。尽管未发现减重与绝经前雌二醇、脱氢表雄酮硫酸盐和雄烯二醇的显著关联，绝经后女性观察到总雌二醇和雌酮的减少。观察性研究的发现一般支持这些结果，以及关于雌激素的组织基础研究。
items.abstract: Introduction: The evidence synthesis on literature characterizing changes in body fatness and adiposity distribution with sex steroid measurements in different matrices (blood, tissue, urine and other excreted matrices) is lacking. Methods: PubMed and Web of Science were used to identify eligible studies published until June 2026. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted, and the strength of evidence was determined based on the Continuous Update Project criteria. Results: Of 16,875 screened references, 140 studies deemed relevant: 96 on circulating blood biomarkers from 39 weight loss intervention (surgical and lifestyle) and 60 observational studies reporting direct measure of adiposity distribution (e.g., DEXA, MRI), 20 studies on biomarkers measured in urine or other excreted matrices (i.e., saliva, urine, breast ductal lavage), and 25 tissue-based studies (e.g., adipose, breast, endometrial, skin). Weight loss was associated with a reduction of total and free testosterone, and an increase in sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG). items.authors: Kebede, M. M.; Spahits, H.; Dutta, S.; Turzanski Fortner, R.; Le Cornet, C.

items.title: Parents' neural dynamics in response to their children's speech
items.title_zh: 父母对孩子语言的神经动态反应研究
items.summary_zh: 人类儿童的语言发展是一个漫长的过程，依赖于社会经验。研究对象为56名2至3岁儿童及其照顾者，采用双脑功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）技术实时测量父母与孩子之间的沟通。结果发现，儿童的发声能够选择性地调节照顾者的大脑活动。父母的大脑对儿童产生的沟通性较强的语言（多词语表达）与较弱的语言（咿呀学语）表现出快速反应。这表明，学习说话的一部分是了解如何让沟通伙伴倾听，因此，早期对话可能为儿童提供持续的反馈机会，指导他们在口语表达上的进步。
items.abstract: The development of speech in human children is a protracted process that depends on social experience. From early life, young children produce vocalizations in the presence of others, which affords unique opportunities for feedback about how to communicate successfully. However, for feedback to happen, young childrens speech needs to effect change in the brains of their caregivers. Using dual-brain functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to measure real-time communication between caregivers and their 2- to 3-year-old children (n = 56), we found that children's vocalizations selectively modulated caregivers' brain activity. Parents' brains showed a rapid response to children's production of speech that was communicatively advanced (multiword utterances) vs. less advanced (babble). The findings imply that if part of learning to talk is figuring out how to get your communication partner to listen, then early conversations likely present continuous opportunities for feedback that guide children toward advances in spoken language.
items.authors: Elmlinger, S.; Rosenberg, E.; Jaffe-Dax, S.; Nencheva, M. L.; Lee, C.; Kosie, J. E.; Lew-Williams, C.

items.title: Impaired cortical encoding of prosodic prominence in single multisyllabic words for adults with dyslexia
items.title_zh: 阅读障碍成人对多音节词韵律显著性的皮层编码受损
items.summary_zh: 发展性阅读障碍与儿童和成人在感知连续语音和词内韵律结构方面存在障碍相关。本研究中，神经典型成人与阅读障碍成人聆听多音节词，记录脑电图（EEG），并通过时间响应函数（TRF）建模量化皮层编码。探讨了四种语音表征：词汇重音模式（词内韵律显著性）、低频语音包络、词首和音节首。结果显示，阅读障碍成人在词内韵律显著性（δ波段）和语音包络（δ和θ波段）的编码显著降低，而词首和音节首的编码则保持正常。确定δ波段皮层追踪在词内韵律显著性编码中的核心作用，为后续研究开辟了新方向。
items.abstract: Developmental dyslexia is associated with impaired cortical tracking of continuous speech and difficulties in perceiving within-word prosodic structure in children and adults. For adults and continuous speech, both low-frequency delta- and theta-band impairments and high-frequency gamma- and beta-band differences are found. To date, perceptual difficulties with intra-word prosody have not been studied in direct relation to neural speech encoding. Here neurotypical adults and adults with dyslexia listened to multisyllabic words. EEG was recorded, and cortical encoding was quantified using temporal response function (TRF) modelling. Four speech representations were explored: lexical stress pattern (intra-word prosodic prominence), the low-frequency speech envelope, word onsets and syllable onsets. Adults with dyslexia showed significantly reduced encoding of intra-word prosodic prominence (delta band) and of the speech envelope (delta and theta bands). In contrast, encoding of word and syllable onsets was preserved. Pinpointing delta-band cortical tracking as central to encoding intra-word prosodic prominence opens new avenues for research.
items.authors: Keshavarzi, M.; Moore, B. C. J.; Goswami, U.

items.title: The cerebellum specializes for language even in the absence of contralateral neocortical inputs
items.title_zh: 小脑在缺乏对侧新皮层输入时仍专注于语言
items.summary_zh: 小脑长期以来被认为主要负责运动控制，但现在已知其包含对语言有选择性反应的区域。本文研究了小脑语言专门化在发育过程中的形成机制。我们研究了两名具有非典型大脑发育的个体：EG，一名右撇女性，缺失大部分左侧颞叶，其新皮层语言网络位于右半球；C1，一名自出生起缺失整个左侧大脑半球。通过对EG及74名典型发育成人的精确功能性MRI扫描，我们发现EG的小脑语言网络显示出明显的左半球偏向，反映了其大脑皮层语言的非典型侧化，同时保留了小脑语言主导区域的经典拓扑和反应特征。值得注意的是，EG的右小脑半球也对语言有反应，并且尽管左半球缺乏语言区域，仍包含一个语言选择性区域。我们在C1身上重复了这些小脑发现。
items.abstract: Long considered a structure dedicated primarily to motor control, the cerebellum is now known to contain regions that respond selectively to language. However, how cerebellar language specialization emerges during development remains unknown. The prevailing proposal is that cerebellar functional specialization critically depends on inputs from the contralateral neocortex, received through well-established reciprocal cortico-cerebellar connections. Here, we test this proposal in two individuals with atypical brain development: EG, a right-handed woman who lacks most of her left temporal lobe (presumably from birth) and whose neocortical language network resides in her right hemisphere, and C1, an individual missing the entire left cerebral hemisphere from birth. Using precision functional MRI in EG and a cohort of 74 typically-developing adults, we find that EG's cerebellar language network shows a strong left-hemispheric bias, mirroring the atypical lateralization of language in her cerebral cortex, while preserving canonical topography and response profiles of the language-dominant cerebellar regions. items.authors: Wang, B.; Tuckute, G.; Kean, H.; Asaridou, S. S.; Goldin-Meadow, S.; Levine, S. C.; Fedorenko, E.; D'Mello, A. M.

items.title: Physiological robustness of MScanFit to simulated motor unit loss and remodelling
items.title_zh: MScanFit在模拟运动单位损失与重塑中的生理稳健性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估MScanFit在不同生理条件下对运动单位数量和大小的估计准确性。我们重现了原始MScanFit模拟中使用的动态重塑框架，并扩展其以测试在生理异质条件下的稳健性。通过生成计算模型模拟了从160个运动单位逐渐减少到5个存活单位的复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）扫描。研究设计包括12种重塑条件，结合了去神经模式（随机或选择性）、再神经化方法（随机、分布式或按大小加权）和神经肌肉韧性（20%或60%）。结果显示，MScanFit能够再现原始模拟中的主要行为，并在异质重塑条件下跟踪运动单位的逐步损失。然而，运动单位数量估计（MUNE）误差随着重塑生理的变化而系统性变化，选择性去神经和分布式再神经化在多个中间阶段增加了误差，而60%的韧性则导致更大的误差。
items.abstract: Introduction: MScanFit estimates motor unit number and size from compound muscle action potential (CMAP) scans, but its accuracy may depend on the physiological processes that shape motor unit loss and remodelling. We reproduced the general dynamic remodelling framework used in the original MScanFit simulation and expanded it to test MScanFit robustness across physiologically heterogeneous conditions. Methods: Generative computational models simulated CMAP scans from motor unit pools undergoing progressive loss from 160 to 5 surviving motor units. Twelve remodelling conditions combined denervation pattern (random or selective), reinnervation method (random, distributive, or size-weighted), and neuromuscular resilience (20% or 60%); two additional conditions modelled denervation without collateral reinnervation. MScanFit estimates were compared with the known motor unit numbers and mean motor unit sizes used to generate each scan. Results: MScanFit reproduced the principal behaviour reported in the original simulation and generally tracked progressive motor unit loss across heterogeneous remodelling conditions.
