items.title: Gaps in archaeological metadata reporting: a meta-analysis of human paleogenomic studies in Western Eurasia
items.title_zh: 考古元数据报告中的缺口：西欧亚人类古基因组研究的元分析
items.summary_zh: 古基因组研究显著提升了我们对过去人口和适应过程的理解，但也因遗传学家与其他研究者之间的脱节而受到批评。为了促进跨学科研究，古基因组样本的上下文元数据应在同一出版物中可获取。本研究对2013至2024年间发表的30篇同行评审的人类古基因组研究进行了初步分析，涉及3911名主要来自西欧亚的古人类的基因序列。结果显示，考古数据的报告在各研究中存在不一致性，并探讨了其驱动因素。总体而言，未发现强有力的解释变量，但某些元数据字段（如地理位置）随着时间的推移在完整性上有所改善。这些不一致性意味着，仅凭已发布数据，元数据报告往往不足以直接研究文化和遗传变化模式之间的关系。我们建议制定最低信息清单，作为未来收集和报告考古数据的最佳实践指南。
items.abstract: Paleogenomic research has dramatically increased our understanding of past demographic and adaptive processes, but has also been criticized for a perceived disconnect between geneticists and other parties involved in the study of the past. For interdisciplinary research to be productive, contextual metadata associated with paleogenomic samples should be accessible in the same publication. Here, we conduct a pilot study examining the extent of archaeological metadata reporting in 30 peer-reviewed human paleogenomic studies, based on genetic sequences from 3911 ancient humans predominately from Western Eurasia, published between 2013 and 2024. We show inconsistent reporting of archaeological data across studies, and have sought to identify the driving factors. Overall, we found no strong explanatory variables, though some metadata fields - like Geolocation - have improved in completeness over time. These inconsistencies mean that metadata reporting is often insufficient to directly investigate the relationship between patterns of cultural and genetic change on the basis of published data alone. items.title: Torsion in motion: the visual system as a three-axis gimbal
items.title_zh: 运动中的扭转：视觉系统作为三轴云台
items.summary_zh: 准确追踪眼睛和头部在空间中的行为对于构建到达视网膜的刺激的真实模型至关重要。视网膜流的运动结构是由眼睛相对于世界的相对运动所产生的。为了表征这一刺激，需要追踪眼睛在头部的三个自由度以及头部在世界中的六个自由度。尽管在注视稳定的背景下，眼睛的垂直和水平旋转已被描述，但视线方向周围的扭转成分仍然难以量化，三种旋转成分如何共同影响自我运动中的视网膜流仍然未被充分探索。我们利用头戴技术估计了十名受试者在向远处目标行走时的眼部扭转。具体而言，我们结合了自动特征跟踪与注视约束的眼部旋转和相机投影的模拟，从图像数据中恢复扭转。我们在两种情境下估计了头部和视网膜中心框架中的光流场的旋度：一种是基于我们的数据估计的扭转，另一种是没有扭转。结果表明，眼睛的扭转成分补偿了头部角位移的滚转成分。
items.abstract: Rigorously tracking eye and head behavior in space is key to building realistic models of the stimulus that reaches our retina. The motion structure of this stimulus or retinal flow - the substrate for self-motion processing - is created by the relative movement of the eyes with respect to the world. Characterizing this stimulus requires tracking the eye's three degrees of freedom in the head and the head's six degrees of freedom in the world. While vertical and horizontal eye rotations have been described during locomotion in the context of gaze stabilization, the component around the line of sight - torsion - has remained difficult to quantify, and how all three rotational components jointly contribute to retinal flow during self-motion remains largely unexplored. Here, we leveraged head-mounted technology to estimate eye torsion in ten subjects as they walked towards a distant target (from 14 to 4 meters away from the target). More specifically, we combined automatic feature tracking with gaze-constrained simulations of eye rotations and camera projection to recover torsion from image data. items.title: Spatial Accessibility to Hospital Capacity and the Concentration of Health-System Contributions in New Jersey
items.title_zh: 新泽西医院容量的空间可达性与健康系统贡献集中度
items.summary_zh: 背景：医院整合使多个医院在共同系统控制下运作，但空间可达性估计并不能表明这种可达性是分布在多个健康系统中还是集中在少数系统内。方法：我们使用增强的两步浮动捕捉区（E2SFCA）方法，估算可在30分钟车程内到达的普通医院的工作人员床位的区域级空间可达性。对于E2SFCA得分为正的区域，我们按健康系统汇总医院贡献，并计算每个系统在区域总E2SFCA得分中的份额的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）。我们使用斯皮尔曼等级相关分析考察与区域社会人口特征的关联。结果：在163家可达医院中，有94家位于新泽西州外，占这些医院工作人员床位的62.7%。在2172个区域中，平均和中位E2SFCA得分分别为每千人口1.98和1.99个工作人员床位。在2161个正E2SFCA得分的区域中，平均和中位HHI值分别为0.36和0.31。根据E2SFCA的2.0和HHI的0.18作为描述性参考值，934个区域的E2SFCA < 2.0且HHI < 0.18，而655个区域的E2SFCA ≥ 2.0且HHI ≥ 0.18。在八个社会人口特征中，有七个的E2SFCA和HHI的相关性方向相反。
items.abstract: Background: Hospital consolidation increasingly places multiple hospitals under common system control. However, spatial accessibility estimates alone do not indicate whether that accessibility is distributed across many health systems or concentrated within a few. Methods: We used the enhanced two-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) method to estimate tract-level spatial accessibility to staffed beds at general hospitals reachable within 30 minutes by car. For tracts with positive E2SFCA scores, we aggregated hospital contributions by health system and calculated a Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) from each system's share of the tract's total E2SFCA score. We used Spearman rank correlations to examine associations with tract-level sociodemographic characteristics. Results: Of 163 reachable hospitals, 94 were outside New Jersey and accounted for 62.7% of staffed beds among these hospitals. Across 2,172 tracts, mean and median E2SFCA scores were 1.98 and 1.99 staffed hospital beds per 1,000 population, respectively. items.title: Anthropic’s AI biolab finds ‘CRISPR-like’ DNA in viruses. What’s next?
items.title_zh: Anthropic的AI生物实验室发现病毒中的“CRISPR-like” DNA
items.summary_zh: 本研究由Anthropic的AI生物实验室进行，重点在于检测病毒中的“CRISPR-like” DNA。研究团队动用了约950个AI代理，花费超过21小时对DNA序列数据库进行深入分析。通过这一检测努力，研究人员发现了与CRISPR技术相似的DNA序列，这可能为基因编辑和病毒研究提供新的视角和工具。研究结果的潜在影响尚待进一步探讨，但这一发现为理解病毒基因组的复杂性和进化提供了重要线索。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03039-6 The detection effort enlisted roughly 950 AI agents that spent more than 21 hours combing through DNA sequence databases.
items.authors: Heidi Ledford

items.title: New space telescope will reopen astronomers’ view of the far-infrared
items.title_zh: 新空间望远镜将重新开启天文学家对远红外的视野
items.summary_zh: NASA投资12亿美元的PRIMA望远镜将研究星系的演化及行星如何从气体和尘埃盘中形成。该望远镜将通过观测远红外波段，提供对星系形成和演化过程的新见解，帮助科学家理解行星系统的起源。PRIMA的观测能力将使天文学家能够深入探讨宇宙中最冷、最暗的区域，揭示隐藏在尘埃中的天体和化学过程。通过这些研究，PRIMA有望推动我们对宇宙结构和演化的理解。
items.abstract: NASA’s $1.2 billion PRIMA will explore how galaxies evolve and how planets emerge from disks of gas and dust
items.authors: Daniel Clery

items.title: Immunomodulatory Potential of KSTM in Activating Natural Killer Cells for Cancer Cell Elimination
items.title_zh: KSTM在激活自然杀伤细胞消除癌细胞中的免疫调节潜力
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：癌症仍是全球主要死亡原因，治疗抵抗限制了治疗成功率。提高癌细胞对免疫介导杀伤的敏感性，特别是自然杀伤（NK）细胞的作用，可能改善治疗效果。本研究旨在确定天然产物是否能使非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）细胞对NK细胞介导的细胞毒性敏感。方法：通过细胞活力测定评估天然产物对NCI-H1975细胞的细胞毒性。采用共培养系统评估NK细胞介导的杀伤。通过流式细胞术分析MICA/B、Fas和TRAIL受体（DR4和DR5）的表达。结果：天然产物与NK细胞联合处理显著增强了癌细胞毒性。机制上，KS显著增加了NCI-H1975细胞上TRAIL死亡受体的表达。62.5 μg/mL的KS处理使DR4阳性细胞比例从13.4%增加到56.7%，DR5阳性细胞比例从99.0%增加到99.9%。结论：研究表明，天然产物通过上调TRAIL受体表达和促进细胞凋亡，增加癌细胞对NK细胞介导杀伤的敏感性。这种敏感化作用可能为提高癌症免疫治疗的疗效提供有效策略。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cancer remains a major cause of mortality worldwide, and resistance to therapy continues to limit treatment success. Improving the susceptibility of cancer cells to immune-mediated killing, particularly by natural killer (NK) cells, may enhance therapeutic outcomes. This study aimed to determine whether natural products can sensitize non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells to NK cell-mediated cytotoxicity. Methods: The cytotoxic effects of natural products on NCI-H1975 cells were assessed using a cell viability assay. NK cell-mediated killing was evaluated in a co-culture system. The expression of MICA/B, Fas, and TRAIL receptors (DR4 and DR5) was analyzed by flow cytometry. Results: Treatment with a natural product and NK cells significantly enhanced cancer cell toxicity compared with either treatment alone. Mechanistically, KS markedly increased the expression of TRAIL death receptors on NCI-H1975 cells. Treatment with KS at 62.5 μg/mL increased the proportion of DR4-positive cells from 13.4% to 56.7% and DR5-positive cells from 99.0% to 99.9%. items.title: A Fractional Hodgkin–Huxley–Lotka–Volterra Model of Neuronal Synchronized Electromechanics
items.title_zh: 分数霍奇金-赫克斯利-洛特卡-沃尔泰拉神经元同步电机械模型
items.summary_zh: 神经元同步在多种健康与疾病的脑过程中的作用至关重要。神经元的功能与同步、机械行为以及与共享微环境的电机械相互作用密切相关。神经元功能对体积变化非常敏感。现有的数学模型主要关注单个神经元的功能-体积动态或神经元的功能同步，忽略了神经元的电机械特性。本文提出了一种新颖的数学模型，连接两个功能同步且体积耦合的数学神经元，属于相邻突触路径。一个数学神经元的电机械行为由广义霍奇金-赫克斯利模型描述，其中离子通道机械行为类似于分数麦克斯韦线性粘弹性材料。两个数学神经元共享相同的微环境、电气特性、初始条件和形状，但其离子通道具有不同的粘弹性记忆。该模型为单向耦合，假设电活动与体积变化独立。
items.abstract: Several health and disease brain processes rely on neuronal synchronization. The functions and synchronization of neurons, mechanical behavior of neurons, and electromechanical interactions of neurons with their shared microenvironment are intricately connected. Notably, neuronal functions are very sensitive to neuronal volumetric variations. Interactions of neurons with the extracellular fluid govern the Regulatory Volume Decrease or Increase (RVD/I) mechanisms preserving neuronal volumes. Published mathematical models focus either on function–volume dynamics of one neuron or on functional synchronization of neurons. These models ignore neuronal electromechanics. This paper presents a novel, proof-of-concept, mathematical model linking two functionally synchronized and volumetrically coupled mathematical neurons belonging to nearby synaptic paths. The electromechanics of one mathematical neuron is described by a generalized Hodgkin–Huxley model in which ion channels behave mechanically as fractional Maxwell linear viscoelastic materials. items.title: Perampanel Attenuates Cognitive and Behavioral Deficits and Modulates Hippocampal Tachykinin Expression in Experimental Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
items.title_zh: 帕莫酸减轻实验性颞叶癫痫的认知和行为缺陷
items.summary_zh: 背景：癫痫是最常见的神经系统疾病之一，常伴随多种共病。本研究旨在评估抗癫痫药物帕莫酸（PRM）对天真大鼠及实验性颞叶癫痫（TLE）模型大鼠的认知功能、抑郁样行为及海马中物质P（SP）和神经激肽B（NKB）表达的影响。方法：在锂-匹罗卡品诱导的癫痫持续状态后3小时给予PRM（3 mg/kg，口服），并持续11周。结果：长期PRM治疗改善了TLE慢性阶段的大鼠的被动和主动学习及记忆，以及空间工作记忆，具体通过阶梯下降、穿梭箱回避测试和T迷宫测试评估。此外，药物减轻了糖偏好测试中的抑郁样行为和活动笼测试中的多动。在非癫痫动物中，PRM未显著改变行为参数。我们发现TLE动物的SP和NKB免疫反应性水平最高，而PRM治疗在不同海马区域对这些升高有不同程度的减轻。
items.abstract: Background: Epilepsy is one of the most prevalent neurological disorders, often presenting alongside many comorbidities. The present study aimed to evaluate the impact of the antiepileptic drug perampanel (PRM) on cognitive function, depressive-like behavior and the expression of substance P (SP) and neurokinin B (NKB) in the hippocampus of naïve rats and rats with an experimental model of temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). Methods: Vehicle/PRM (3 mg/kg p. os) was administered 3 h after the induction of status epilepticus by lithium–pilocarpine and continued for the next eleven weeks in Wistar rats. Matched naïve rats were treated with the same doses. Results: Long-term treatment with PRM during the chronic phase of TLE improved passive and active learning and memory, as well as spatial working memory, as measured by the Step-down, Shuttle-box avoidance tests and T-maze test. Additionally, the drug alleviated depressive-like behavior in the sugar preference test and hyperactivity in the Activity cage test. In non-epileptic animals, perampanel did not produce significant alterations in the behavioural parameters assessed. Furthermore, we found that TLE animals exhibited the highest level
items.authors: Michaela Shishmanova-Doseva, Darina Barbutska, Yvetta Koeva

items.title: The Role of Telomerase in Cellular Stress Response—Therapeutic Potential of Telomerase Inhibitors
items.title_zh: 端粒酶在细胞应激反应中的作用及其抑制剂的治疗潜力
items.summary_zh: 癌症是复杂的疾病，全球面临重大挑战。现有治疗策略常因副作用严重和选择性不足而失败，因此需要寻找新的特异性靶点和个性化治疗方法。端粒酶可能是这样的靶点。虽然端粒酶主要因其在端粒维护和细胞不朽中的作用而被研究，但其在癌症生物学中的更广泛作用仍不清楚。许多针对端粒酶表达和活性的研究集中在恢复端粒的主要功能上。然而，研究表明端粒酶的催化亚单位（TERT）具有独立于端粒恢复的额外功能，这些非典型功能支持癌细胞存活、增强对细胞毒性应激的耐受性，并使肿瘤细胞适应不利的微环境条件。非典型TERT在细胞应激反应中的机制尚不明确，其治疗相关性也未完全理解。本文讨论了非典型端粒酶功能在癌细胞应激反应中的作用，并强调了抑制TERT/端粒酶的治疗潜力。
items.abstract: Cancer remains one of the most complex diseases and a major global problem. Current therapeutic strategies often fail because of severe side effects and insufficient selectivity. Thus, there is a need to identify novel, specific targets and personalized therapeutic approaches. Telomerase may be such a target. Although it has been studied primarily for its role in telomere maintenance and cellular immortality, its broader roles in cancer biology remain poorly understood. Many approaches targeting telomerase expression and activity focus on its primary function of restoring telomeres. However, studies show that the catalytic subunit of telomerase (TERT) shows additional functions that are independent of telomere restoration. These non-canonical functions support cancer cell survival, increased tolerance to cytotoxic stress, and enable tumor cells to adapt to adverse microenvironmental conditions. The mechanism by which non-canonical TERT functions in cellular stress responses (also due to therapeutic agents’ effects) remains unclear, and its therapeutic relevance is not yet fully understood. items.authors: Sandra Pawlak, Magdalena Kostrzewa, Natalia Lisiak, Blazej Rubis

items.title: Dynamic Changes in Serum Neutrophil Gelatinase-Associated Lipocalin for Discrimination of Creatinine-Defined Acute Kidney Injury After Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy: A Prospective Observational Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 腹腔镜袖状胃切除术后急性肾损伤的NGAL动态变化研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：腹腔镜袖状胃切除术（LSG）后可能发生急性肾损伤（AKI），与肥胖相关的肾脆弱性、气腹引起的肾灌注变化及围手术期血流动力学压力有关。本研究旨在评估血清中性粒细胞明胶酶相关脂质运载蛋白（NGAL）及其动态变化（ΔNGAL）在区分LSG术后有无AKI患者的诊断性能。方法：本前瞻性观察队列研究纳入60名重度肥胖患者，术前及术后第1天和第3天测量血清NGAL、肌酐、血尿素氮及估计肾小球滤过率。AKI根据肌酐基础的全球肾病改善标准定义。结果：6名患者（10%）发生AKI，术后第1天AKI患者的NGAL水平显著高于未发生AKI患者。ΔNGAL及肾功能参数变化进行了分析，采用受试者工作特征曲线分析评估诊断性能。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Acute kidney injury (AKI) may occur after laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG) as a result of obesity-related renal vulnerability, pneumoperitoneum-induced changes in renal perfusion, and perioperative hemodynamic stress. Serum creatinine remains the standard diagnostic marker for AKI; however, it may not fully reflect perioperative renal stress. This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of serum neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL), particularly dynamic changes in NGAL (ΔNGAL), for discriminating between patients with and without postoperative AKI after LSG. Methods: This prospective observational cohort study included 60 patients with severe obesity who underwent LSG at a tertiary referral center. Serum NGAL, serum creatinine, blood urea nitrogen, and estimated glomerular filtration rate were measured preoperatively and on postoperative days 1 and 3. AKI was defined according to creatinine-based Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes criteria. Patients were compared according to postoperative AKI status. items.authors: Remzi Can Çakır, Zinet Asuman Arslan Onuk, Sibel Kulaksızoğlu, Halit Özgül, Arif Aslaner, Erhan Aydemir

items.title: Cytomegalovirus Retinitis Across the Immunosuppression Spectrum: A Contemporary Framework for Risk Stratification, Diagnosis, and Vision-Preserving Therapy
items.title_zh: 免疫抑制谱中的巨细胞病毒性视网膜炎：风险分层与治疗框架
items.summary_zh: 巨细胞病毒性视网膜炎（CMVR）在严重细胞免疫缺陷患者中导致不可逆的视力丧失。对于人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）感染者，风险在CD4+ T细胞显著减少且缺乏或无效抗逆转录病毒治疗时最高。其他易感人群包括移植受者、接受恶性肿瘤治疗或靶向免疫抑制的患者，以及有先天免疫缺陷的儿童。本文综述了风险评估、诊断、抗病毒药物选择和随访。扩张眼底检查和连续影像学检查用于评估病变活动性和视力威胁。眼内液体聚合酶链反应（PCR）可支持不确定的诊断，但结果需结合视网膜发现和既往治疗进行解读。抗病毒药物选择需同时评估病变位置、诊断确定性、肾功能、骨髓储备及全身CMV病。系统性使用valganciclovir或ganciclovir作为治疗基础；对视力威胁的病变可能需要辅助的玻璃体内治疗。耐药或毒性可能需要替代方案，而新药的证据仍有限。维持治疗的持续时间取决于视网膜的非活动性和免疫恢复的持续性，HIV以外的停止标准则不太明确。监测应关注复发风险。
items.abstract: Cytomegalovirus retinitis (CMVR) causes irreversible visual loss in patients with severe cellular immunodeficiency. Among people living with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), risk is the highest with profound CD4+ T-cell depletion and absent or ineffective antiretroviral therapy. Other susceptible groups include transplant recipients, patients receiving treatment for malignancy or targeted immunosuppression, and children with inborn errors of immunity. This narrative review connects risk assessment, diagnosis, antiviral selection, and follow-up. Dilated retinal examination and serial imaging establish lesion activity and vision threat. Ocular-fluid polymerase chain reaction supports uncertain diagnoses, but results require interpretation alongside retinal findings and prior treatment. Antiviral selection requires concurrent assessment of lesion location, diagnostic certainty, renal function, marrow reserve, and systemic cytomegalovirus (CMV) disease. Systemic valganciclovir or ganciclovir provides the treatment backbone when feasible; immediately sight-threatening lesions may require adjunctive intravitreal therapy. items.authors: Shuai Su, Yulin Yang, Jiaying Wu, Yi Xiao

items.title: Choriocapillaris Dysfunction in Retinal Diseases: Multimodal Imaging Biomarkers, Pathophysiological Insights, and Emerging Clinical Applications
items.title_zh: 视网膜疾病中的脉络膜毛细血管功能障碍研究
items.summary_zh: 脉络膜毛细血管是维持视网膜色素上皮（RPE）和外层视网膜的终末毛细血管床，其完整性与RPE-布鲁赫膜复合体密不可分。历史病理学研究表明，脉络膜毛细血管密度随年龄下降，并在疾病中进一步降低。光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA），尤其是采用扫频源仪器，信号补偿和验证阈值的技术，使得脉络膜毛细血管流量缺损能够被可靠量化并随时间跟踪。流量缺损是信号级别的测量，并不能单独确立解剖学上的毛细血管损失。本文回顾了脉络膜毛细血管的解剖结构、其通过极化血管内皮生长因子分泌与RPE的功能耦合，以及导致其功能失常的机制，包括补体介导的内皮损伤、布鲁赫膜增厚、氧化应激和静脉超负荷。
items.abstract: The choriocapillaris is the terminal capillary bed that sustains the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and the outer retina, and its integrity is inseparable from that of the RPE–Bruch’s membrane complex it supplies. Histopathological work established decades ago that choriocapillaris density declines with age and falls further in disease, but for most of that period, the layer could not be assessed reliably in living eyes. Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), particularly with swept-source instrumentation, signal compensation and validated thresholding, has changed this: choriocapillaris flow deficits can now be quantified reproducibly and followed over time. A flow deficit is, however, a signal-level measurement that does not by itself establish anatomical capillary loss, and this distinction is maintained throughout. This review examines what that capability has revealed. items.authors: Feliciana Menna, Alessandro Meduri, Laura De Luca, Antonio Baldascino, Stefano Lupo, Enzo Maria Vingolo

items.title: The Pretherapy Endothelial Activation and Stress Index (EASIX) in Patients with Newly Diagnosed Acute Myeloid Leukemia: A Pilot Study
items.title_zh: 新诊断急性髓性白血病患者的内皮激活与应激指数研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：内皮激活与应激指数（EASIX；血清肌酐乘以乳酸脱氢酶除以外周血血小板计数）似乎反映了内皮细胞的激活/功能障碍。内皮细胞支持急性髓性白血病（AML）细胞的增殖和存活，且高骨髓微血管密度与人类AML的不良预后相关。方法：我们在160名AML患者（不包括前髓细胞变异型）中研究了治疗前EASIX评分，时间为诊断时，开始强效阿糖胞苷抗AML治疗之前。结果：我们发现治疗前EASIX评分与单核细胞型AML细胞表型之间存在显著关联（Fisher检验，p = 0.0007）。治疗前EASIX评分高与C反应蛋白水平之间的关联较弱（Spearman检验，p = 0.017）。在比较EASIX评分低于与高于中位数的患者子集时，5年总体生存率未见显著差异（Kaplan-Meier检验，p = 0.84），而两组的上四分位数和下四分位数的总体生存率也无显著差异（p = 0.88）。此外，接受异体移植的患者（n = 58）在治疗前的生存率也未见差异。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The endothelial activation and stress index (EASIX; serum creatinine times lactate dehydrogenase/peripheral blood platelet count) seems to reflect endothelial cell activation/dysfunction. Furthermore, endothelial cells support acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cell proliferation and survival, and high bone marrow microvascular density is associated with adverse prognosis in human AML. Methods: We investigated the pretreatment EASIX score in 160 AML patients (promyelocytic variants excluded) at the time of diagnosis before initiation of intensive cytarabine-based anti-AML therapy. Results: We detected a significant association between the pretreatment EASIX score and the monocytic AML cell phenotype (Fisher’s test, p = 0.0007). A weaker association was observed between a high pretreatment EASIX score and C-reactive protein levels (Spearman’s test, p = 0.017). items.authors: Øystein Bruserud, Guido Smits, Silje Johansen, Espen Talseth Skar, Øystein Wendelbo, Håkon Reikvam

items.title: Cross-Dataset Genomic Proximity and Functional Association of FOXA1 and TET2 at Hypomethylated Regulatory Regions in Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: FOXA1与TET2在结直肠癌低甲基化调控区的基因组接近性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：异常的DNA甲基化在结直肠癌（CRC）的发生和发展中起着关键作用。本研究探讨了先锋转录因子FOXA1与DNA去甲基化酶TET2之间的功能关系，以及它们在CRC中的表观遗传特征和恶性表型的关联。方法：整合公共DNA甲基化、ChIP-seq和转录组数据集，进行全基因组接近性分析。通过共免疫沉淀评估FOXA1与TET2的关联。在HCT116和SW480细胞中分别或同时去除FOXA1和TET2，随后进行增殖和侵袭实验。此外，从对照组、FOXA1-KD、TET2-KD和双重KD HCT116细胞生成RNA-seq数据以表征转录变化。结果：CRC相关的低甲基化区域显示出FOXA1和TET2的ChIP-seq信号富集。在500 bp的峰值阈值下，FOXA1与TET2的基因组接近性比预期高出30.7倍（经验p = 0.000999）。FOXA1/TET2相关位点也显示出显著的富集。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Aberrant DNA methylation plays a critical role in the development and progression of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, how pioneer transcription factors are associated with DNA demethylases at cis-regulatory elements and influence tumor-associated transcriptional programs remains poorly understood. This study investigated the functional relationship between FOXA1 and TET2, an enzyme that converts 5-methylcytosine (5mC) to 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), and its association with epigenetic features and malignant phenotypes in CRC. Methods: Public DNA methylation, ChIP-seq, and transcriptomic datasets were integrated with genome-wide genomic-proximity analyses. The association between FOXA1 and TET2 was evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation. FOXA1 and TET2 were individually or simultaneously depleted in HCT116 and SW480 cells, followed by proliferation and invasion assays. In addition, RNA-seq profiles were generated from control, FOXA1-KD, TET2-KD, and Double-KD HCT116 cells to characterize the resulting transcriptional changes. items.authors: Donglu Lyu, Beile Lyu, Qingqing Qin, Chengtian Gao, Jie Hu, Fengyang Cao

items.title: Tissue Transglutaminase (TG2) as a Candidate Biomarker and Potential Therapeutic Target in Endometriosis: Functional Evidence from shRNA-Mediated Downregulation of TG2 in Endometrial Mesenchymal Stem Cells
items.title_zh: 组织转谷氨酰胺酶TG2在子宫内膜异位症中的作用研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：子宫内膜异位症是指子宫内膜组织在子宫外的存在。由于内膜细胞的迁移对病变发展至关重要，组织转谷氨酰胺酶（TG2）可能发挥重要作用。本研究旨在探讨TG2在健康个体和子宫内膜异位症患者来源的内膜间充质干细胞（eMSCs）迁移和侵袭特征中的作用。方法：从健康对照（heMSCs）和子宫内膜异位症患者（peMSCs）中分离eMSCs，评估TG2蛋白表达和酶活性。通过共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）实验分析TG2与ITGβ-1和SDC-4的相互作用。此外，利用shRNA技术在peMSCs中沉默TG2，分析其对细胞增殖、迁移、侵袭及基质金属蛋白酶（MMP-2和-9）活性的影响。结果：与heMSCs相比，peMSCs表现出更高的TG2蛋白表达但酶活性较低。Co-IP分析显示，peMSCs中TG2与ITGβ-1和SDC-4的结合增强，促进了细胞存活、迁移和侵袭能力。通过shRNA沉默TG2消除了peMSCs的增殖、迁移和侵袭能力。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Endometriosis involves the presence of endometrial tissue outside the uterus. Since the migration of endometrial cells is pivotal to lesion development, tissue transglutaminase (TG2)—known for its roles in cell adhesion, migration, and stemness—may play a significant role. This study aimed to investigate the involvement of TG2 in the migratory and invasive characteristics of endometrial mesenchymal stem cells (eMSCs) derived from healthy individuals and endometriosis patients. Methods: eMSCs were isolated from healthy controls (heMSCs) and endometriosis patients (peMSCs). TG2 protein expression and enzyme activity were evaluated. Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) experiments were performed to assess TG2 associations with ITGβ-1 and SDC-4 in membrane fractions. Additionally, shRNA technology was utilized to silence TG2 in peMSCs to analyze its effects on cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP-2 and -9) activities. Results: peMSCs exhibited higher TG2 protein expression but lower enzyme activity compared to heMSCs. items.title: Plasma Neurofilament Light Chain as a Complementary Biomarker for Alzheimer’s Disease and Mild Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 血浆神经丝轻链作为阿尔茨海默病的补充生物标志物
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种以认知下降和记忆丧失为特征的神经退行性疾病。由于现有治疗在早期阶段最为有效，因此需要可靠的血液生物标志物用于早期诊断和疾病监测。本研究系统评估了血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）与已建立的淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）和tau蛋白标志物的关系。纳入了14项符合特定标准的研究，结果显示，血浆NfL和p-tau217在疾病各阶段均有所增加，而AD/MCI组的Aβ42和Aβ42/Aβ40比对照组更低，Aβ40在各组间相似。血浆NfL可靠反映了神经轴突损伤和AD的疾病严重程度，结合p-tau217/Aβ检测可提供更全面的评估。需要进一步研究以验证其预后价值。
items.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline and memory loss, ultimately leading to a loss of independence and reduced quality of life. As current treatments are most effective in the early stages, reliable blood-based biomarkers are required for early diagnosis, therapeutic monitoring, and disease staging. Plasma neurofilament light chain (NfL), a marker of neuroaxonal injury, is a candidate biomarker; its value relative to established amyloid- and tau-based biomarkers is unclear. A systematic review and meta-analysis comparing plasma NfL with Aβ42, Aβ40, the Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio, and p-tau217 across cognitively normal (control, Con), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD groups was conducted. Fourteen studies that met specific criteria were included. Plasma NfL and p-tau217 increased across disease stages. Aβ42 and Aβ42/Aβ40 were lower in AD/MCI than in Con; Aβ40 was similar across groups. Heterogeneity (I2 99%) was observed across biomarkers. Plasma NfL reliably reflected neuroaxonal injury and disease severity from the earliest clinically detectable stage of AD. Plasma NfL may be most valuable when combined with p-tau217/Aβ-based assa
items.authors: Ka Young Kim, Ki Young Shin, Keun-A Chang

items.title: Disruption of Energy Metabolism, Locomotion, and Stress Tolerance by BxPDHB Silencing in Bursaphelenchus xylophilus: Implications for RNAi-Based Control of Pine Wilt Disease
items.title_zh: BxPDHB沉默对松材线虫能量代谢和运动能力的影响
items.summary_zh: 松材线虫（Bursaphelenchus xylophilus）具备强大的运动能力和高抗逆性，这两种特性共同促进其全球扩散。本文聚焦于JIII扩散阶段幼虫，这一阶段需要高运动输出和强抗逆性。通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）、基因集富集分析（GSEA）和随机森林机器学习，我们系统筛选出可能共同调控运动和抗逆性的核心基因，并通过RNA干扰（RNAi）进行功能验证。结果发现，编码丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体β亚基（PDHB）的基因是核心候选靶点，位于连接糖酵解与三羧酸循环的代谢中心。沉默BxPDHB显著增加丙酮酸含量（约4.61倍），ATP水平显著降低（约16.30%），头部摆动频率大幅减少（约50.00%），活性氧（ROS）水平显著升高（约4.26倍），生存率降低（约26.02%），导致底物积累、能量缺乏、运动能力受损和氧化应激加剧。
items.abstract: Bursaphelenchus xylophilus combines strong locomotory capacity with high stress tolerance, and the coordinated action of these two traits underpins its global invasion and dispersal. Yet the molecular mechanisms coupling locomotion to stress tolerance remain poorly understood. Here, we focused on the JIII dispersal-stage juveniles, a life-history stage that simultaneously demands high locomotory output and robust stress resistance. Using weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), and random forest machine learning, we systematically screened for hub genes that may jointly regulate locomotion and stress tolerance, and then functionally validated the candidate target by RNA interference (RNAi). The gene encoding the β subunit of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (PDHB) was identified as the core candidate target, positioned at the metabolic hub linking glycolysis to the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. items.title: Treatment Sequencing in ARPI-Pre-Exposed Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: Radioligand Therapy, PARP Inhibitors, and Antibody–Drug Conjugates
items.title_zh: ARPI预暴露转移性去势抵抗前列腺癌的治疗顺序研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：在转移性激素敏感前列腺癌中，雄激素受体通路抑制剂（ARPI）的强化改变了转移性去势抵抗前列腺癌（mCRPC）患者的群体，后续治疗的最佳顺序尚不确定。方法：本研究对截至2026年6月的II/III期临床试验进行了叙述性综述，重点关注mCRPC的影像学无进展生存期（rPFS）或总生存期（OS），并根据五级证据等级进行评估。结果：尚未报告前瞻性治疗顺序试验。CARD试验（卡巴他赛与ARPI切换的比较；OS HR 0.64）提供了最清晰的治疗顺序数据。PARP抑制剂在PROfound A队列（HR 0.69）和TALAPRO-2全人群（HR 0.80）中显示出OS获益；BRCA特异性估计较大，TRITON3中BRCA的OS未见改善（HR 0.91）。177Lu-PSMA-617在PSMAfore中改善了rPFS，但意向治疗OS未见差异（HR 0.91），且存在60%的交叉；没有税烯类药物对照试验显示OS优势，初步PLUDO数据中OS倾向于先用多西他赛（HR 1.64），该差异可能受到不对称交叉的影响。结论：我们提出了一个基于同源重组修复状态和PSMA的四轨框架，以生成假设。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) intensification in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer has changed the population reaching metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC), and the optimal sequence of subsequent therapies is uncertain. Methods: The study presents a narrative review of phase II/III trials reporting radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS) or overall survival (OS) in mCRPC, including congress data, to June 2026, graded on a five-level evidence hierarchy. Results: No prospective sequencing trial has been reported. CARD (cabazitaxel versus an ARPI switch after docetaxel; OS HR 0.64) remains the clearest sequencing dataset. items.title: Glymphatic Dysfunction Across Neurological disorders: Links to Neurodegeneration, Inflammaging, Gut–Brain Signaling, and Physiological Modulators
items.title_zh: 神经疾病中的胶淋巴功能障碍：与神经退行性变、炎症衰老等的关联
items.summary_zh: 胶淋巴系统是一个遍布全脑的血管周围网络，促进脑脊液与间质液的交换及代谢废物的清除。越来越多的实验和临床证据表明，胶淋巴功能障碍可能是与衰老、神经炎症和神经退行性变相关的共同病理特征。本文综述了人类成像、临床和转化研究证据，揭示胶淋巴功能障碍在主要神经退行性疾病中的作用，并将这些发现与支持其在与衰老相关的慢性低度炎症（“炎症衰老”）中的角色的新兴数据相结合。我们还讨论了肠道微环境的变化如何通过肠脑轴远程影响胶淋巴功能并促进神经退行性变。尽管有大量的前临床证据，越来越多的人类研究显示多种神经退行性疾病中胶淋巴功能受损，主要通过血管周围空间的扩散张量成像（DTI-ALPS）指数进行评估。胶淋巴功能障碍与认知下降、运动障碍和疾病进展相关。
items.abstract: The glymphatic system is a brain-wide perivascular network that facilitates cerebrospinal-fluid–interstitial-fluid exchange and the clearance of metabolic waste. Growing experimental and clinical evidence suggests that glymphatic dysfunction may represent a convergent pathophysiological feature associated with aging, neuroinflammation, and neurodegeneration, although its causal position within these processes remains unresolved. In this narrative review, we synthesize human imaging, clinical, and translational evidence implicating glymphatic dysfunction across major neurodegenerative diseases and integrate these findings with emerging data supporting its role in chronic low-grade inflammation associated with aging (“inflammaging”). We further discuss how alterations in the gut microenvironment may remotely influence glymphatic function and contribute to neurodegeneration through the gut–brain axis. Although supported by extensive preclinical evidence, studies in humans increasingly demonstrate impaired glymphatic function in several neurodegenerative disorders, most assessed using diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index. items.authors: Konstantinos I. Voumvourakis, Nikolaos S. Thomaidis, Eleni Sideri, Georgios N. Papadimitropoulos, Chrysa Liadinioti, Georgios Tsivgoulis

items.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Early Disease Detection Across Modalities: A Comprehensive Review of Methods, Applications, and Clinical Translation
items.title_zh: 机器学习与深度学习在早期疾病检测中的应用综述
items.summary_zh: 早期疾病检测不仅仅是一个分类问题，它包括人群筛查、无症状风险评估、早期病理变化识别及疾病的早期检测。机器学习和深度学习系统通过医学影像、生理信号、长期健康记录、分子测量、可穿戴传感器及多模态组合来实现这些目标。本文综述了与临床目标、数据生成过程、预处理、表示、模型、验证设计、报告性能、方法限制及临床转化水平相关的证据。分析区分了早期检测与普通诊断、预后及进展预测，强调合并这些任务可能导致临床结果误导。深度学习在需要从大规模代表性数据中学习空间、时间或跨模态表示时最为有效，而传统机器学习在样本量适中、可用临床相关变量或需要透明特征推理时仍具竞争力。证据表明，患者级别的分离、队列构建、流行率、标签定义等因素对性能有显著影响。
items.abstract: Early disease detection is not a single classification problem. It includes population screening, presymptomatic risk estimation, identification of early pathological change, and detection of disease before conventional clinical recognition. Machine learning and deep learning systems approach these targets through medical images, physiological signals, longitudinal health records, molecular measurements, wearable sensors, and multimodal combinations. This survey organizes the evidence around the complete decision pathway linking the clinical target, data generation process, preprocessing, representation, model, validation design, reported performance, methodological limitation, and level of clinical translation. The analysis distinguishes early detection from ordinary diagnosis, prognosis, and progression prediction, as merging these tasks can make apparently strong results clinically misleading. Across modalities, deep learning is most useful when spatial, temporal, or cross-modal representations must be learned from sufficiently large and representative data. items.authors: Ahlem Aziz, Seydi Kacmaz, Azam Isam Abdulkareem Aladwani

items.title: Comparison Between Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Patients with and Without Family History of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus—A Single-Center Retrospective Study
items.title_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮患者家族史的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的阳性家族史反映了遗传对疾病易感性的显著贡献，但患者是否表现出不同的临床表型尚不明确。方法：本研究为单中心回顾性研究，纳入2012至2022年在波兰克拉科夫大学医院接受治疗的符合2019 EULAR/ACR分类标准的成人SLE患者。提取了人口学、临床、实验室、合并症和治疗数据，以及死亡率数据。比较有无SLE家族史的患者，并根据受影响亲属的亲属关系程度进一步分层。结果：在723名SLE患者中，47名（6.5%）报告有SLE家族史。家族史阳性的患者在整体人口学和临床特征上与无家族史患者相似。关节痛在有家族史患者中略为常见（97.8% vs. 88%）。
items.abstract: Background: A positive family history of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) reflects the substantial genetic contribution to disease susceptibility; however, it remains unclear whether patients with a family history of SLE represent a distinct clinical phenotype. Methods: A retrospective single-center study was conducted in adult patients fulfilling the 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria for SLE who were treated at the University Hospital in Kraków, Poland, between 2012 and 2022. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, comorbidity, and treatment data, as well as mortality data, were extracted from medical records. Patients with and without a documented/reported family history of SLE were compared, and those with positive family history of SLE were further stratified according to the degree of kinship of the affected relative. Patients with SLE for whom data on a family history of SLE were unavailable were not included in the analysis. Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate correction was applied across the primary comparisons, while the kinship analysis was corrected separately. items.title: Mutual Enhancement: Human–AI Collaboration and Corporate Carbon Emission Performance
items.title_zh: 人机协作与企业碳排放绩效的相互促进研究
items.summary_zh: 有效的人机协作已成为提升企业碳排放绩效的重要组织基础。基于社会技术系统理论，我们研究了2011至2023年中国A股上市公司的人机协作对碳排放绩效的影响及其调节效应。结果表明，人机协作与企业碳排放绩效呈正相关，表明人工智能能力与人类管理判断的结合有助于提高排放效率。高管的绿色意识对这一关系具有正向调节作用，而数字化转型则削弱了这一关系。此外，该正向效应在非国有企业、高科技企业及竞争较弱市场中的企业中更为显著。从社会技术协调的视角来看，本研究扩展了人机协作对环境绩效影响的研究，推动了碳约束市场中资源协调的战略研究，并为企业在数字与绿色转型中提供了理论基础和实践指导。
items.abstract: Effective collaboration between artificial intelligence and human capital has become an important organizational foundation for improving corporate carbon emissions. Drawing on socio-technical systems theory, we examine the effect of human–AI collaboration on carbon emissions performance and its moderating effects using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2011 to 2023. The results show that human–AI collaboration is positively associated with corporate carbon emissions performance, suggesting that the combination of artificial intelligence capabilities and human managerial judgment is related to improved emissions efficiency. Executives’ green awareness positively moderates the relationship, whereas digital transformation weakens this relationship. In addition, the positive effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned firms, high-tech firms, and firms operating in less competitive markets. items.title: The Rationale for Tissue Biopsy in the Era of Precision Hepatocellular Carcinoma Management
items.title_zh: 精准管理下肝细胞癌组织活检的必要性
items.summary_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的肝癌，通常发生在肝硬化背景下。早期准确的诊断有助于进行潜在的治愈性干预。对高风险患者（如肝硬化、慢性乙型肝炎感染及既往HCC诊断者）进行HCC监测，能够实现早期发现和改善生存率。在这些患者中，当影像学LI-RADS标准满足时，可以非侵入性地确诊。对于没有肝硬化或其他HCC风险因素的患者，组织活检是确诊的必要手段，尤其是在影像学特征不明确时。本文讨论了组织活检在确诊之外的作用，包括提供重要的预后信息和精确的组织病理分类。差分差、微血管侵犯及肿瘤簇周围血管模式等特征与较差的预后相关。HCC具有异质性，不同的组织学亚型与不同的临床、影像学特征及生物学特性相关。分子特征分析和免疫微环境研究的新数据为进一步分类提供了可能。
items.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the most common liver cancer and usually develops on a background of cirrhotic liver. Early and accurate diagnosis enables potentially curative interventions. HCC surveillance, usually offered to patients at risk for HCC, such as those with cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B infection, and previous diagnosis of HCC, is associated with earlier detection and improved survival. In these patients, the diagnosis can be established non-invasively without histological confirmation when the imaging-based LI-RADS criteria are met. Tissue biopsy is mandatory for establishing diagnosis in patients without cirrhosis or other risk factors for HCC, differentiating HCC from other malignant and non-malignant entities, especially when imaging features are not conclusive. In this review, we discuss the evolving role of tissue biopsy beyond establishing the diagnosis, in providing important prognostic information and enabling precise histopathological classification. Features such as poor differentiation, microvascular invasion, and a pattern of vessels encapsulating tumor clusters are linked to worse prognosis. items.title: Altered Inflammatory Protein Release by Vascular Smooth Muscle Cells in 3D-Culture
items.title_zh: 三维培养中血管平滑肌细胞炎症蛋白释放的变化
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对主动脉平滑肌细胞（AoSMCs）在二维（2D）与三维（3D）培养条件下的炎症生物标志物差异进行探讨。通过Olink蛋白组学/酶联免疫吸附测定和定量实时聚合酶链反应，测量了经过炎症处理后的细胞蛋白释放和基因表达。结果显示，2D培养的细胞释放的炎症蛋白（如C-C基序趋化因子20（CCL20）、转化生长因子α（TGF-α）和肿瘤坏死因子超家族成员12（TWEAK））普遍高于3D模型。而3D培养的细胞则释放了更多的基质金属蛋白酶-10（MMP-10）和白介素-8（IL-8）。此外，2D条件下观察到白介素-1β的释放增加及炎症小体组分的转录激活。结论是，炎症蛋白的释放因细胞培养模型而异，2D培养的AoSMCs释放的炎症蛋白更高。
items.abstract: Aortic smooth muscle cells (AoSMCs) are widely used in cardiovascular research for studies on inflammatory processes in atherosclerotic lesions. Usually, AoSMCs are cultured in two-dimensional (2D) cell culture models, although limitations exist compared to the three-dimensional (3D) environment, and differences between 2D and 3D conditions on inflammatory markers have not been explored. This study aims to elucidate differences in inflammatory biomarkers in 2D versus 3D cultured AoSMCs. After inflammatory treatment of 2D and 3D cultured cells, protein release and gene expression were measured by Olink proteomics/enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, respectively. The 2D cultured cells showed generally higher release of inflammatory proteins, such as C-C motif chemokine 20 (CCL20), transforming growth factor alpha (TGF-α) and TNF superfamily member 12 (TWEAK), compared to the 3D model. In contrast, more matrix metallopeptidase-10 (MMP-10) and interleukin-8 (IL-8) were released from 3D cultured cells compared to 2D cultured cells. items.authors: Karin Fransén, Enna Lokmic, Liisa Vasemägi, Madelene Lindkvist

items.title: Early Renal Effects After Radioactive Iodine Therapy in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer: A Prospective Observational Study
items.title_zh: 放射性碘治疗分化型甲状腺癌的早期肾脏影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：放射性碘（RAI）治疗在甲状腺切除后广泛应用于分化型甲状腺癌，但早期肾小管变化可能无法通过常规肾功能参数反映。我们前瞻性评估了三种RAI剂量下的尿液小管生物标志物变化。方法：纳入120名患者，每组40人（1.11、3.70和5.55 GBq）。在基线和第7天采集血液，在基线、第1天和第7天采集尿液。通过酶联免疫吸附测定法测量尿液肾损伤分子-1、网蛋白-1、半胱氨酸蛋白酶抑制剂C和β2-微球蛋白；同时评估常规肾参数。结果：所有四种生物标志物在所有剂量组中从基线到第1天显著增加。尽管高剂量组的百分比增加更大，但基线调整的混合效应分析未显示显著的剂量组效应或剂量组×时间交互作用。到第7天，绝对生物标志物水平部分下降，但仍高于基线，而尿液肌酐标准化的生物标志物比率显著升高。结论：早期变化一致，提示RAI治疗可能对肾脏产生影响。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Radioactive iodine (RAI) therapy is widely used after thyroidectomy for differentiated thyroid cancer, but early renal tubular changes may not be reflected by conventional renal function parameters. We prospectively evaluated urinary tubular biomarker changes across three administered RAI activities. Methods: We included 120 patients, with 40 in each activity group (1.11, 3.70, and 5.55 GBq). Blood was collected at baseline and day 7, and urine at baseline, day 1, and day 7. Urinary kidney injury molecule-1, netrin-1, cystatin C, and β2-microglobulin were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay; conventional renal parameters were also assessed. Results: All four biomarkers increased significantly from baseline to Day 1 in all activity groups. Percentage increases were numerically greater at higher administered activities; however, baseline-adjusted mixed-effects analysis showed no significant activity-group effect or activity group × time interaction. Absolute biomarker levels partially declined by Day 7 and remained numerically above baseline, whereas urinary creatinine-normalized biomarker ratios remained significantly elevated. items.title: Synthesis-Dependent Phase Evolution and Catalytic Behavior of Unsupported Iron Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation to C2-C4=
items.title_zh: 无载体铁催化剂在CO2氢化中的相演变与催化行为研究
items.summary_zh: 铁基催化剂因其低成本和丰富性在CO2氢化制轻烯烃方面受到广泛关注。本研究合成了不同形态、成分和结构特征的无载体Fe纳米颗粒，并进行了CO预处理，评估其在CO2氢化制C2-C4=中的催化性能。通过分析其纹理、结构、氧化还原和表面特性，探讨了合成引起的差异与相演变及催化性能之间的关系。CO预处理在所有样品中形成了铁碳化物相，但催化行为的显著差异表明，活性状态不能仅通过体相组成来描述。铁氧化物纳米多面体（Fe-NP）实现了41.6%的CO2转化率，C2-C4=选择性最高为27.7%，轻烯烃产率最高为11.5%。表面分析显示，碳化物和氧化物Fe物种的相对贡献存在显著差异，表明性能依赖于激活和反应过程中建立的表面相分布。Fe3O4和FexCy物种的共存似乎促进了RWGS及后续的费托合成路径。
items.abstract: Iron-based catalysts are widely investigated for CO2 hydrogenation to light olefins due to their low cost, abundance, and ability to form oxidic and carbidic phases involved in the RWGS-FTS pathway. However, supports and promoters can obscure the intrinsic role of iron phase evolution. Here, unsupported Fe nanoparticles with distinct morphological, compositional and structural characteristics were synthesized, CO-pretreated, and evaluated for CO2 hydrogenation toward C2-C4=. Their textural, structural, redox, and surface properties were examined to relate synthesis-induced differences to phase evolution and catalytic performance. CO pretreatment formed iron carbide phases in all samples, yet marked differences in catalytic behavior showed that the active state cannot be described solely by bulk phase composition. Iron oxide nanopolyhedra (Fe-NP) achieved 41.6% CO2 conversion, the highest C2-C4= selectivity of 27.7%, and the highest light-olefin yield of 11.5%. Surface analysis revealed notable differences in the relative contributions of carbidic and oxidic Fe species, suggesting that performance depends on the surface phase distribution established during activation and reaction.
items.authors: Evridiki Mandela, Eirini Marousiadou, Maria Lykaki, Agapi Orfanoudaki, Vassileios Kyriakou, George E. Marnellos

items.title: Feasibility and Clinical Outcomes of a 6-Month Home-Based Telerehabilitation Program in Patients with Peripheral Arterial Disease: A Prospective Single-Arm Study
items.title_zh: 外周动脉疾病患者6个月居家远程康复的可行性与临床结果
items.summary_zh: 背景：外周动脉疾病（PAD）与显著的心血管发病率和功能障碍相关。本研究评估了为期6个月的居家远程康复（TR）项目的可行性和依从性，以及功能能力、健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）和选定心代谢参数的纵向变化。方法：本前瞻性单臂研究招募了42名PAD患者。使用小米智能手环8监测每日步行，参与者每周接受电话咨询。评估在基线、3个月和6个月时进行。结果：中位每日步数从5868步增加至6905步（p < 0.001），而逐步增加的每周目标达成率从58.33%降至16.66%（p < 0.001）。6分钟步行测试（6MWT）距离在6个月时从390米增加至445米，增加55米（p = 0.001）。HRQoL、收缩压、体重指数和总胆固醇显示出显著的纵向变化，而静息踝臂指数和选定的心肺运动测试参数相对稳定（p > 0.05）。结论：该TR项目可行，伴随活动增加和步行能力改善。绝对活动与目标达成之间的差异支持多维度依从性评估。
items.abstract: (1) Background: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) is associated with substantial cardiovascular morbidity and functional impairment. This study evaluated the feasibility and adherence of a 6-month home-based telerehabilitation (TR) program and longitudinal changes in functional capacity, health-related quality of life (HRQoL), and selected cardiometabolic parameters. (2) Methods: This prospective, single-arm study enrolled 42 patients with PAD. Daily ambulation was monitored using a Xiaomi Smart Band 8, and participants received weekly telephone counseling. Assessments were performed at baseline, 3 months, and 6 months. (3) Results: Median daily step count increased from 5868 to 6905 steps/day (p 0.001), whereas attainment of progressively increasing weekly targets decreased from 58.33% to 16.66% (p 0.001). Median 6 min walk test (6MWT) distance increased from 390 m to 445 m at 6 months, a 55 m increase (p = 0.001). HRQoL, systolic blood pressure, body mass index, and total cholesterol showed significant longitudinal changes, while resting ankle–brachial index and selected cardiopulmonary exercise testing parameters remained relatively stable (p 0.05). (4) Conclusions: The TR progr

items.title: Prediction of Postoperative Ambulatory Function Using Nomogram in Patients with Metastatic Epidural Spinal Cord Compression
items.title_zh: 利用列线图预测转移性脊髓压迫患者术后行走功能
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：本研究旨在开发并内部验证一个列线图，以预测接受减压手术的转移性硬膜外脊髓压迫（MESCC）患者的术后行走功能。方法：在2014至2021年间，在单一三级中心接受转移性脊柱癌手术的352名患者中，纳入97名MESCC患者（Bilsky分级2-3）及术前神经功能缺损（ASIA分级D或更差）的回顾性研究。采用二元逻辑回归识别3个月术后行走状态的候选预测因子（单变量分析p值<0.10），并将其纳入多变量逻辑回归模型，利用R中的rms包构建列线图。模型的区分度和校准度通过Harrell的自助法进行内部验证，重抽样1000次。结果：24名患者（24.7%）恢复了术后行走功能。四个变量满足列线图纳入的预设阈值（p<0.10）：术前运动分级（OR 2.48；95% CI 1.41–4.34；p=0.002）、症状出现至手术间隔（OR 0.81；95% CI 0.62–1.04；p=0.098）、术前KPS（OR 1.04；95% CI 1.00–1.07；p=0.070）和年龄（OR 0.97；95% CI 0.93–1.01；p=0.087）；在多变量模型中，仅术前运动分级为显著预测因子。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study was conducted to develop and internally validate a nomogram that predicts postoperative ambulatory function in patients with metastatic epidural spinal cord compression (MESCC) undergoing decompressive surgery. Methods: Of 352 patients who underwent surgery for metastatic spinal cancer at a single tertiary center between 2014 and 2021, 97 with MESCC (Bilsky grade 2–3) and preoperative neurological deficits (ASIA grade D or worse) were included in this retrospective study. Binary logistic regression was used to identify candidate predictors of 3-month postoperative ambulatory status in the full cohort (p 0.10 in univariable analysis), which were then entered into a multivariable logistic regression model and incorporated into a nomogram using the rms package in R. Model discrimination and calibration were internally validated using Harrell’s bootstrap optimism-correction method with 1000 resamples. Results: Postoperative ambulation was regained in 24 patients (24.7%). Four variables met the prespecified threshold (p 0.10) for inclusion in the nomogram: preoperative motor grade (OR 2.48; 95% CI 1.41–4.34; p = 0.002), symptom onset–to–operation interv
items.authors: Ibrahim S. Alayed, Sehan Park, Dong-Ho Lee, Chang Ju Hwang, Sung Tan Cho, Jae Hwan Cho

items.title: Methylation-driven Cancer Genes and Methylation Profiling in Glioma: A Comparative Study between East Asian and non-Hispanic White Populations
items.title_zh: 甲基化驱动的癌基因及胶质瘤甲基化特征比较研究
items.summary_zh: 胶质瘤的全球发病率和预后因地区而异，但该疾病的研究仍缺乏多样性。本研究分析了来自中国和美国的胶质瘤亚型的表观遗传模式。我们回顾性分析了中国胶质瘤基因组图谱（CGGA）和癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据集，依据2021年世界卫生组织（WHO）中枢神经系统肿瘤分类重新分类胶质瘤亚型。通过DNA甲基化和转录组数据，我们识别了CGGA队列中的甲基化驱动癌基因，并评估其预后价值，与TCGA数据库中的非西班牙裔白人队列进行比较。结果显示，CGGA胶质母细胞瘤的甲基化特征更接近TCGA高等级星形胶质细胞瘤：36.7%的CGGA胶质母细胞瘤（n=49）被识别为高等级星形胶质细胞瘤。生存分析表明，CGGA胶质母细胞瘤患者的生存率显著高于非西班牙裔白人胶质母细胞瘤患者（p = 0.037）。在CGGA胶质母细胞瘤样本中识别出四个关键甲基化驱动基因：GLDN、PRKDC、S100A1和NCAPH。
items.abstract: Global incidence and outcomes of glioma have been found to vary significantly by region, however research into the disease continues to lack diversity. Here we investigated epigenetic patterns in glioma subtypes from cohorts collected from China and the USA. We retrospectively analysed the Chinese Glioma Genome Atlas (CGGA) and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) datasets following reclassification of glioma subtypes based on the WHO 2021 central nervous system (CNS) tumour classification. We used DNA methylation and transcriptomics data to identify methylation-driven cancer genes in the CGGA cohort, assessed their prognostic value and compared against the non-Hispanic White cohort in the TCGA database to consider ethnic influence. Furthermore, we used machine learning classification and clustering techniques to identify methylation patterns in glioma subgroups. Here, we showed that DNA methylation profiles of CGGA glioblastomas have a methylation signature more similar to TCGA high-grade astrocytomas: 36.7% of CGGA glioblastomas (n=49) were identified as high-grade astrocytomas using classification modelling. Assessment of survival revealed that CGGA glioblastoma patients had a signifi
items.authors: Newman, L.; Dunne, N.; Cheng, V. W.; Sharma-Oates, A.

items.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
items.title_zh: BaseCamp——自动化DNA测序数据管道的智能AI框架
items.summary_zh: DNA测序管道涵盖质量控制、比对、变异调用和注释，目前由工作流管理系统可靠执行。然而，执行过程中的决策层仍需人工介入，包括选择适合样本和平台的质量阈值、裁定边界变异调用、诊断异常及确定需专家审查的发现。这些决策重复性高、判断密集且不一致。本文介绍了BaseCamp，一个新颖的智能AI框架，旨在自动化DNA测序管道的决策层。该框架将管道分解为六个专门的AI代理，涵盖样本接收与质量控制、比对、变异调用、注释、跨阶段监控和报告。BaseCamp代理不进行序列分析，而是选择、配置现有工具，解释输出并决定后续步骤，从而确保了可靠性和可重复性。代理推理由一组经过微调的领域专用大型语言模型支持。
items.abstract: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable
items.authors: Eranga Bandara, Xueping Liang, Asanga Gunaratna, Tharaka Hewa, Abdul Rahman, Peter Foytik, Safdar H. Bouk, Sachini Rajapakse, Isurunima Kularathna, Pramoda Karunarathna, Chalani Rajapakse, Ng Wee Keon

items.title: Human-AI-Powered Hypothesis Testing: Cost-Aware Selective AI Scoring and Sequential Human Escalation
items.title_zh: 人机协作假设检验：成本意识的选择性AI评分与人类逐步升级
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作低成本的评判者，以评估输出、标记数据并判断系统是否符合预期质量标准。然而，将AI判断用于正式统计推断与将其视为真实标签有根本区别：AI评估可能存在偏差或噪声，严格的假设检验需要明确控制I型和II型错误。我们研究如何结合AI判断和选择性人类验证，以最低成本进行有效的假设检验。考虑到具有隐藏二元标签的项目群体，决策者可以选择性地查询AI、直接发送项目给人类、在观察AI报告后将AI评分项目升级给人类，或在积累足够证据后停止。我们推导出一个信息论下界，捕捉实现规定检验错误的最低成本，并通过报告依赖的信息前沿表征AI信息和人类验证的价值。基于这一表征，我们开发了SCALE，一个将选择性AI评分与自适应人类升级相结合的顺序成本意识策略。SCALE在有限样本量下有效，并在目标错误概率消失时与下界一阶匹配。我们进一步扩展了该框架。
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as inexpensive judges to evaluate outputs, label data, and assess whether a system meets a desired quality standard. Yet using AI judgments for formal statistical inference is fundamentally different from simply treating them as ground-truth labels: AI evaluations can be biased or noisy, and rigorous hypothesis testing requires explicit control of type-I and type-II errors. We study how to use AI judgments, together with selective human verification, to conduct a valid hypothesis test at minimum cost. We consider a population of items with hidden binary labels. After choosing a fixed pool of items, the decision maker can selectively query AI, send an item directly to a human, escalate an AI-scored item to a human after observing the AI report, or stop once sufficient evidence has accumulated. We derive an information-theoretic lower bound that captures the minimum cost of achieving prescribed testing errors and characterizes the value of AI information and human verification through a report-dependent information frontier. Motivated by this characterization, we develop SCALE, a sequential cost-aware policy that combines selective AI scori
items.authors: Dae Woong (David), Ham, Xuejun Zhao, Stefanus Jasin, Fenghua Yang

items.title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
items.title_zh: CRISS：辅助癌症登记员的检索增强型AI聊天机器人
items.summary_zh: 癌症登记员，包括肿瘤数据专家（ODS），需解读复杂且经常更新的编码和分期标准。我们开发了CRISS（癌症登记智能支持系统），这是一种检索增强生成（RAG）对话助手，能够快速提供有引用支持的登记指导。研究评估了CRISS是否能够（1）支持准确且有引用支持的回答，（2）改善相关指导的获取和解读，以及（3）在保留人类监督的情况下支持培训/帮助台使用。我们从国家癌症登记标准构建了特定领域的知识库，将其分段并标记元数据，作为密集嵌入进行索引。通过大型语言模型（LLM）生成基于引用的回答。RAG配置在简单、中等和困难的登记问题上始终优于非RAG方法，尤其是在问题难度增加时。RAG的平均基础分数在简单/中等/困难层级分别为0.62/0.56/0.59，而非RAG为0.29/0.26/0.29。RAG模型在整体语义相似性分数上也表现更高。
items.abstract: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.5
items.authors: Vani Seth, Mohammad Beheshti, Anirudh Kambhampati, Vishwa Bhayani, Lucinda Ham, Prasad Calyam, Iris Zachary

items.title: Right Choice of Classification Algorithms Based on Reinforcement Learning for Prediction of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的非酒精性脂肪肝分类算法选择研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对非酒精性脂肪肝的预测，提出了一种自动选择分类算法的强化学习方法。研究中引入了一种名为平方学习（SL）的评分方法，以实现学习的自动化。通过灵感来源于四个分类算法的评估指标，提出了第四度学习的新型强化学习方法。实验结果显示，该方法将分类算法的准确率从63%提升至98%。此研究的创新之处在于通过自动化学习提高分类算法的选择效率，为疾病预测提供了新的思路。
items.abstract: There are many complex issues in the world of artificial intelligence. Some of these problems are solved using other artificial intelligence methods, which are called artificial intelligence for artificial intelligence. Finding an appropriate classifier algorithm is a time-consuming task. For this reason, an algorithm that can automatically learn the choice of classification algorithms is very important. Classification algorithms are useful in predicting various diseases. Also, Primary Biliary Cirrhosis is one of the most well-known diseases that have been predicted by classification algorithms. This research's most significant achievement and novelty is the automatic increase in learning through a scoring method of reinforcement learning is called square learning (SL). In this research, an algorithm is presented that learns to automatically select the appropriate classification algorithm to predict Primary Biliary Cirrhosis. In this article, with inspiration from four evaluation metrics in classification algorithms, a new reinforcement learning method by the name of Fourth Degree Learning has been presented. In this research, we increased the performance of the classification algo
items.authors: Hasan Samadbin, Arman Daliri

items.title: Towards An LLM-Driven Unified Conversion Framework for BT and FSM in Autonomous Intelligent Systems
items.title_zh: 面向自主智能系统的LLM驱动统一转换框架
items.summary_zh: 有限状态机（FSM）和行为树（BT）是自主智能系统中广泛采用的行为建模范式。尽管在功能上等价且原则上可互转，但现有的FSM与BT之间的转换方法在保持行为完整性和避免模型复杂性爆炸方面面临重大挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种LLM驱动的统一转换框架，实现FSM与BT之间的自动、高效和语义一致的转换。具体而言，设计了一种新颖的循环执行BT结构，使LLM能够准确捕捉FSM中的循环结构，从而保持行为完整性。为缓解BT转FSM中的状态爆炸问题，引入了深度压缩策略，通过LLM提示消除冗余控制节点，并辅以差异化的分层转换规则，整体减少所需的子FSM数量。在多个自主决策场景中的仿真实验表明，该框架实现了FSM与BT之间的准确自动双向转换，并显著提升了生成模型的可扩展性和可维护性，为消费级自主智能系统中的行为模型转换提供了实用解决方案。
items.abstract: Finite state machine (FSM) and behavior trees (BT) are widely adopted behavioral modeling paradigms for autonomous intelligent systems. While functionally equivalent and inter-convertible in principle, existing transformation methods between FSM and BT face major challenges in preserving behavioral completeness and avoiding model complexity explosion. To overcome these issues, we propose an LLM-driven unified conversion framework that enables automatic, efficient, and semantically consistent transformation between FSM and BT. Specifically, a novel loop execution BT structure is designed for LLM to accurately capture the loop structure in FSM, thereby preserving behavioral completeness. To mitigate the state explosion problem in BT-to-FSM conversion, a depth compression strategy is introduced with LLM prompt to eliminate redundant control nodes, complemented by differentiated hierarchical conversion rules that collectively reduce the number of required sub-FSM. Simulation experiments in multiple autonomous decision-making scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework enables an accurate and automated bidirectional conversion between FSM and BT. Furthermore, it significantly enha
items.authors: Zhang Qi, Yang Shuo, Zhu Zhengqiu, Zhou Peng, Jiao Peng

items.title: Beyond Simple Input-Output Assessment Tasks: Leveraging Automated Programming Assessment for Non-Trivial Courses
items.title_zh: 超越简单输入输出评估任务：利用自动编程评估非平凡课程
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）的公众关注度迅速上升，其在各领域的应用产生了积极影响。AI和机器学习基础课程对于理解其在现代社会中的角色和潜力至关重要。因此，在AI课程中，通过理论与实践的紧密结合理解基本概念和初级算法显得尤为重要。本文报告了我们为编程的自动评估工具设计机器学习练习的经验。我们并未开发一种新型的自动评分系统，而是提出了一种将机器学习问题框定为输入输出评估任务的视角。从这一视角出发，每个练习都有唯一且确定的答案，使得自动编程评估工具（如VPL for Moodle、Codeforces和MOJ）能够有效支持AI教育。我们相信，本文可以鼓励教师通过采用更动态和互动的方法来促进AI课程的教育创新。重要的是，本文并未在教育中引入AI的创新，而是提出了一种改进AI学习，特别是机器学习的创新方法。
items.abstract: The public visibility of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, driven by the positive impact of its applications across diverse fields of knowledge. In this new chapter, courses that cover the foundations of AI and machine learning become essential for understanding their role and potential in contemporary society. Therefore, understanding fundamental concepts and elementary algorithms through the close integration of theory with practice is essential in AI courses. In this essay, we report our experience designing machine learning exercises for automated assessment tools in programming. It is worth mentioning that we are not developing a novel form of automated grading system. Instead, we propose a perspective that frames machine learning problems as input-output assessment tasks. From this perspective, each exercise admits a unique and deterministic answer and enables automated programming assessment tools (e.g., VPL for Moodle, Codeforces, and MOJ) to effectively support AI education. We believe this essay can encourage instructors to foster educational innovation by adopting more dynamic and interactive approaches to AI courses that integrate theory and practice. Imp
items.authors: Artur Jordao

items.title: Hallucination Neurons and Where to Find Them: An Investigation into the existence of Hallucination Neurons
items.title_zh: 幻觉神经元及其发现：对幻觉神经元存在性的研究
items.summary_zh: 可解释的机器学习在大型语言模型（LLMs）中越来越依赖稀疏探测方法，这些方法识别出小规模神经元集合，声称能够检测和因果影响诸如事实回忆、安全对齐和幻觉等行为。这些主张对模型审计和行为引导具有重要意义，但很少针对已知的$L_1$正则化探测在相关高维特征空间中的失效模式进行测试。我们提出了一种五步诊断协议，涵盖特征相关性、引导稳定性、稀疏与密集排名不一致、干预基线和跨数据集评估，作为稀疏神经元定位主张的最低标准。我们使用所提方法调查了先前的研究，特别是在TriviaQA、BioASQ和NQ-Open数据集上对H-神经元的分析。结果显示，在不同模型和数据集上均能重复检测，并超越了TriviaQA和BioASQ数据集原报告的AUROC差距。Gemma 3 4B在匹配数据集上始终优于MedGemma 4B，TriviaQA的AUROC差距为+0.311对+0.235，BioASQ为+0.474对+0.455，NQ-Open为+0.128对+0.112。使用500个样本和五个随机种子的因果验证显示超出随机同层基线的统计显著性效果。
items.abstract: Interpretable machine learning for Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse probing methods that identify small sets of neurons claimed to detect and causally influence behaviors such as factuality recall, safety alignment, and hallucination. These claims have important implications for model auditing and behavioral steering, yet they are rarely tested against known failure modes of $L_1$-regularized probing in correlated, high-dimensional feature spaces. We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol covering feature correlation, bootstrap stability, sparse versus dense ranking disagreement, intervention baselines, and cross-dataset evaluation as a minimum standard for sparse-neuron localization claims. We investigate prior work using our proposed approach, specifically on H-neurons using open-source LLMs across TriviaQA, BioASQ, and NQ-Open datasets. Our results demonstrate detection replicates across both models and datasets, and exceeds the original reported AUROC gaps for TriviaQA and BioASQ datasets. Gemma 3 4B consistently outperforms MedGemma 4B on matched datasets, with AUROC gaps of +0.311 versus +0.235 on TriviaQA, +0.474 versus +0.455 on BioASQ, and +0.128
items.authors: Huseyin Cavus, Sebin Sabu, Joshua Spear, Jaskaran Singh Kawatra, Pavithra Rajendran

items.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
items.title_zh: Qwen-Planner-Agent：面向现实世界的闭环AI规划代理框架
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的快速发展使人工智能从被动内容生成转向工程和科学发现的主动工作流程。本文探讨了人工智能能否同时作为开发对象和下一代AI系统的积极参与者。我们在一个闭环AI-for-AI框架内构建了Qwen-Planner-Agent，以实现可扩展开发和迭代改进。移动规划为此方法提供了严峻的测试：复杂的长期任务挑战代理的可靠性，而真实设备交互的高成本限制了开发的可扩展性。该框架通过共享的行动-反馈-验证协议连接数据生产、模型训练和部署。我们提出了人机协作的数据生成机制、结合监督学习和在线强化学习的训练方法，以及通过执行证据驱动的循环促进模型与工具的共同进化。
items.abstract: The rapid progression of large language models is extending AI from passive content generation into the active workflows of engineering and scientific discovery. This shift raises a compelling question: can AI be both the object of development and an active participant in building next-generation AI systems? We explore this question by building Qwen-Planner-Agent within a closed-loop AI-for-AI framework for scalable development and iterative improvement. Mobile planning offers a demanding test of this approach: complex, long-horizon tasks challenge agent reliability, while costly real-device interaction limits development scalability. The framework connects data production, model training, and deployment through a shared action-feedback-verification contract. (i) AI for Data builds a human-gated agentic data flywheel in which specialized agents construct tasks, collect interaction trajectories, curate and balance training data, and use training feedback to guide subsequent data generation. (ii) AI for Training combines a supervised planning cold start with hybrid-environment online agentic reinforcement learning, where we introduce Competence-Aware Reward-and-Advantage Engineering
items.authors: Tingyu Qu, Weigao Sun, Yuecheng Liu, Yucheng Zhao, Yi Zhu, Yifeng Ding, Qiyi Wang, Sihan Cao, Pengkun Jiao, Hanlei Xie, Xiongwei Wu, Qichao Wang, Haodong Zhang, Jiajun Liu, Yuhao Wang, Yuqing Xie, Jun

items.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
items.title_zh: NNV3：扩展神经网络验证至新架构与领域
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了NNV3，这是神经网络验证（NNV）工具的最新版本，旨在对深度学习模型和学习驱动的网络物理系统进行形式验证。NNV3在NNV 1.0（前馈神经网络、卷积神经网络、神经网络控制系统）和NNV 2.0（递归神经网络、状态空间神经网络、神经常微分方程）的基础上，引入了新的Star集族成员：ModelStar用于在权重扰动下验证网络，VolumeStar用于视频和3D体积输入，GraphStar用于图神经网络。基于符合推断的概率可达性模式补充了在确定性验证不可行的问题上的可靠分析，而FairNNV则认证连续输入区域的反事实和个体公平性属性。NNV3还引入了针对恶意软件检测、基于图的电力系统模型、医学成像、可变长度时间序列数据和动作识别的新基准。NNV3还通过统一文档网站整合了教程和开发者指南。本文详细介绍了这些主要更新，展示了NNV作为一个全面、稳健且易于访问的验证工具的成熟。
items.abstract: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.
items.authors: Anne M. Tumlin, Samuel Sasaki, Ben Wooding, Diego Manzanas Lopez, Muhammad Usama Zubair, Navid Hashemi, Hongchao Zhang, Waseem Abbas, Ipek Oguz, Meiyi Ma, Taylor T. Johnson

items.title: NumericJev: Jev-like LLM Numerical Decoding with Multiway Decision Trees
items.title_zh: NUMERICJEV：基于多向决策树的Jev类LLM数值解码
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型能够理解自然语言，但做出稳健决策仍然具有挑战性。Jev类模型展示了结构化选择，但这些接口并未直接提供所需精度的数值。我们提出了NUMERICJEV，这是一种无训练的数值解码算法，能够从任何具有Jev类结构选择接口的LLM中生成数值输出。令人惊讶的是，在我们的算术基准测试中，其表现比直接从包含正确答案的候选列表中选择高出2.93个百分点。我们的动机源于观察到数值范围选择本身就是一个决策问题，Jev类LLM可以解决。NUMERICJEV通过多向决策树递归地细化范围，同时保留原始问题的上下文，无需参数更新或隐藏状态访问。在100值网格上，十向树仅需两轮决策。范围归一化的平均绝对误差为1.84%，而直接选择为5.18%。一项独立的三日期历史指数研究显示，当提供值时，平均相对召回误差为4.58%，读出误差为0%。代码可在https://github.com/Bring-AI/jev-numeric获取。
items.abstract: Large language models can interpret natural lan- guage, yet robust decisions remain challenging. Jev-like models expose structured choices, but these interfaces do not directly provide numeri- cal values at a requested precision. We propose NUMERICJEV, a training-free numerical decod- ing algorithm that enables numerical output from any LLM with a Jev-like structured-choice in- terface. Surprisingly, on our arithmetic bench- mark, it outperforms direct selection from a can- didate list containing the correct answer by 2.93 percentage points (Figure 1). Our motivation comes from the observation that numerical range selection is itself a decision problem that Jev- like LLMs can address. NUMERICJEV recur- sively refines a range through a multiway deci- sion tree while retaining the original question in context, without parameter updates or hidden- state access. On a 100-value grid, a ten-way tree requires only two decision rounds. Range- normalized MAE is 1.84% versus 5.18% for di- rect choice. A separate three-date historical- index study yields 4.58% mean relative recall er- ror and 0% readout error when the value is sup- plied. Code is available at https://github. com/Bring-AI/jev-
items.authors: Weiwei Ye, Hangchen Liu, Renhe Jiang

items.title: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
items.title_zh: 超越静态图世界模型：学习演变拓扑下的随机潜在动态
items.summary_zh: 图基世界模型最近作为学习关系状态表示转变的一种手段而出现。然而，现有方法主要局限于固定拓扑图或确定性、完全可观察的环境。我们提出了图动态模型（GDM），该模型旨在处理随机和部分可观察环境中演变拓扑的更一般设置。GDM使用稀疏递归邻接矩阵来建模拓扑更新并执行信息传递，同时结合递归状态空间架构来建模随机转变。此外，我们识别出图基世界模型评估中的一个空白，因为现有方法未能提供比较联合图状态（包括相互依赖的拓扑、节点特征和图特征）上预测和真实分布的手段。因此，我们引入了图分布距离（GDD）度量，利用图核的最大均值差异来全面比较联合下一个状态分布。我们在多个环境中评估了GDM，包括随机和部分可观察设置，结果表明GDM优于基线模型，并在大图上展示了零-shot泛化能力。
items.abstract: Graph-based world models have recently emerged as a means of learning transitions over relational state representations. However, existing approaches are largely limited to fixed-topology graphs or deterministic, fully observable environments. We propose the Graph Dynamics Model (GDM), a world model for graph-structured observations that is designed to handle the more general setting of evolving topologies in stochastic and partially observable environments. The GDM uses a sparse recurrent adjacency matrix to model topology updates and perform message passing, together with a recurrent state-space architecture for modelling stochastic transitions. Furthermore, we identify a gap in the evaluation of graph-based world models, as existing methods do not provide a means of comparing predicted and true distributions over the joint graph state comprising the interdependent topology, node features, and graph features. We therefore introduce the Graph Distribution Distance (GDD) metric, which uses maximum mean discrepancy with a graph kernel to comprehensively compare joint next-state distributions.
