items.authors: Alex Schutz, Nick Hawes, Victor-Alexandru Darvariu

items.title: Blockchain-Enabled Artificial Intelligence and AI Agents for Secure Data Sharing and Cybersecurity Applications
items.title_zh: 区块链驱动的人工智能及其在数据共享与网络安全中的应用
items.summary_zh: 区块链与人工智能（AI）正融合为一个基础层，以确保分布式系统中的数据共享、安全模型和自主决策。本文通过四项研究的元综合，探讨了对抗性机器学习、云环境中的AI驱动异常检测、多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）管道的自动漏洞修补，以及AI系统生命周期安全的广泛领域。每项研究针对现代AI驱动安全操作中的不同失效点：训练数据和模型行为的完整性、实时监控的可靠性，以及自动代码修复的可信度。我们认为，区块链的不可篡改性、去中心化共识和可验证来源直接解决了这些问题的共同缺口，即在没有中央权威的情况下建立对数据、模型和自主智能体的信任。基于区块链安全数据共享、联邦学习和多智能体协调的实证研究，我们提出了一种分层参考架构，将对抗性强化模型、区块链锚定的数据来源结合起来。
items.abstract: Blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) are converging into a single infrastructural layer for securing data sharing, model integrity, and autonomous decision-making across distributed systems. This paper presents a meta-synthesis that draws together four constituent studies covering adversarial machine learning, AI-powered anomaly detection in cloud environments, automated vulnerability patching by multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines, and the broader landscape of securing AI systems across their lifecycle and situates their findings within the emerging literature on blockchain-enabled AI and autonomous AI agents. Each constituent study addresses a distinct point of failure in modern AI-driven security operations: the integrity of training data and model behavior, the reliability of real-time monitoring, and the trustworthiness of automated code remediation. We argue that blockchain's properties of immutability, decentralized consensus, and verifiable provenance directly address a gap common to all three: the difficulty of establishing trust in data, models, and autonomous agents that operate without a central authority. Building on real-world research on blockchai
items.authors: Harsh Verma

items.title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
items.title_zh: 基于LLM链式任务规划的通用服务机器人设计与评估
items.summary_zh: 通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务要求机器人在真实家庭环境中解读多样的自然语言指令并生成多步骤的行动序列。传统的单提示（SP）方法存在上下文膨胀和“中途迷失”现象，导致任务规划不可靠。我们提出了一种LLM链式架构，将指令分类和行动生成分为两个专门阶段，减少每次推理的提示长度约45%，同时提高规划一致性。我们使用100个随机生成的GPSR指令在三种语言模型上评估了该方法，结果显示在所有模型上，规划性能均优于SP，局部模型的提升幅度高达37个百分点。此外，在丰田人类支持机器人（HSR）上的实际执行实验表明，仅有规划成功并不能保证任务完成，10个任务中有6个成功完成，执行层的失败被识别为主要瓶颈。
items.abstract: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.
items.authors: Lucas Da Mota Bruno, Jiahao Sim, Yoshinobu Hagiwara

items.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
items.title_zh: HarnessPAI：一种进化的物理人工智能框架
items.summary_zh: 物理人工智能旨在构建能够感知、理解和推理的具身智能体，并决定如何行动。然而，该领域主要集中于将观察映射到低级控制的动作模型。现有的训练方法可能削弱感知和推理能力，使得即使是强大的动作模型也容易受到场景扰动和长时间任务的影响。我们提出了HarnessPAI，这是一个与模型和具身性无关的物理人工智能框架，将代码视为可执行和可进化的接口，组织底层动作原语。该框架分离了两个时间尺度：在一次执行中，它在程序级别以开环方式执行，固定程序指导和检查执行；在多次执行中，它以闭环方式进化，利用执行反馈修订程序并提炼失败为可重用技能。在桌面机器人臂、家用机器人、扫地机器人和步态机器人中，HarnessPAI在不重新训练底层模型的情况下，提升了纯动作模型和代码作为策略基线的性能：在LIBERO-PRO上相较于$\pi_{0.5}$提升61.6分，在RoboCasa原子任务上相较于WorldDreamer提升27.2分。一旦选择了程序，执行不再需要在线高层次LLM的深思。
items.abstract: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks. We introduce HarnessPAI, a model- and embodiment-agnostic Harness framework for Physical AI that treats code as the executable and evolvable interface that organizes the underlying action primitive. The framework separates two timescales: within a rollout, it executes open-loop at the program level, with a fixed program guiding and checking execution; across rollouts, it evolves closed-loop, using execution feedback to revise the program and distill failures into reusable skills. Across desktop robot arms, household robots, a robot vacuum, and a legged walking agent, HarnessPAI improves on both pure action models and code-as-policy baselines without retraining the underlying model: a 61.6-point gain over $\pi_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-PRO and a 27.2-po
items.authors: Xin Wang, Wenhao Wu, Menghao Zhang, Zhi Wang, Kun Shao, Jian Luan, Yang Li, Qing Li, Shangding Gu, Huichi Zhou, Shuqing Shi, Fei Ni, Shuo Lu, Weicheng Meng, Kang Li, Jin Wu, Kang Zhao, Shangmin Guo, G

items.title: From Policy Documents to Structured Survey Responses: Evaluating Large Language Models for Policy Monitoring
items.title_zh: 从政策文件到结构化调查响应：评估大型语言模型在政策监测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 科学、技术和创新政策对竞争力至关重要，但其多样性和规模使得一致的映射和监测变得困难。现有方法主要依赖人工调查，成本高且难以在各国推广。大型语言模型（LLMs）为从长篇非结构化政策文件中提取和结构化信息提供了新可能。本文展示了将LLMs作为“AI响应者”的应用，生成来自政策文本的结构化调查响应。我们开发了一种基于长上下文学习的数据提取管道，将公共网络来源的信息映射到预定义的调查类别中，包括政策工具、目标群体和主题领域。该管道集成了使用次级LLM的验证步骤，以评估相关性和证据，并与人类提供的响应进行比较。通过多国数据集，我们评估了LLM生成输出与人类生成输出之间的一致性，结果显示LLMs在结构化指标上达成高一致性（84-95%），而在自由文本字段中存在差异，模型倾向于提供更详细的程序描述。这些发现突显了人机混合工作流程在政策监测中的潜力，提高了效率和可扩展性。
items.abstract: Science, technology, and innovation policies are crucial for competitiveness, yet their diversity and scale make them difficult to map and monitor consistently. Existing approaches rely heavily on manual survey efforts, which are costly and challenging to scale across countries. Large language models (LLMs) enable new possibilities for extracting and structuring information from long and unstructured policy documents. This paper presents an application of LLMs as "AI respondents" for generating structured survey responses from policy texts. We develop a data extraction pipeline based on long-context in-context learning to map information from public web sources into predefined survey categories, including policy instruments, target groups, and thematic areas. The pipeline integrates a validation step using a secondary LLM to assess relevance and evidence, alongside comparisons with human-provided responses. Using a multi-country dataset, we evaluate the alignment between LLM-generated and human-generated outputs through overlap measures and cross-validation. Results show that LLMs achieve high agreement for structured indicators (84-95%), while differences remain in free-text field
items.authors: Carolyn Cole, Matthias Deschryvere, Toqeer Ehsan, Arash Hajikhani

items.title: Detecting Glaucoma Across Multi-ethnic Myopic and Non-Myopic Populations Using an Uncertainty-Aware Vision Transformer: A Multicentre Model Development and Validation Study
items.title_zh: 基于不确定性感知的视觉变换器检测多种族青光眼研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：基于人工智能的青光眼检测通过彩色眼底照片提供可扩展筛查，但在外部数据集上的表现可能因真实标签定义、种群及共存条件（如高度近视）而下降。本研究开发并验证了一种基于视觉变换器的深度学习模型，用于检测多种族群体中的青光眼，包括有无高度近视的患者。方法：使用56,483张彩色眼底照片（57.1%为近视；14.4%为高度近视）开发了ViT-B/16模型，并进行了预测不确定性估计。青光眼标签通过临床、影像和视野检查数据标准化。模型在三个大洲的16个独立数据集上进行了验证，包括四个具有明确高度近视标签的数据集。发现：内部AUROC为98.7%（95% CI 98.2-99.1%），敏感性为94.5%，特异性为97.3%。在来自八个国家的16个外部数据集中，AUROC范围为86.4%至99.6%。在高度近视眼中，内部AUROC为97.8%（95% CI 96.1-99.2%），敏感性为94.8%，特异性为93.7%。外部高度近视AUROC在北京眼科研究中为86.5%，在台湾、泰国和韩国的医院数据集中分别为93.3%、91.8%和85.5%。在探索性高度近视临床评估中，该模型的彩色眼底照片诊断准确率高于眼科医生和训练评估者（92.0%对70.0%；p=0.008）。
items.abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based glaucoma detection from colour fundus photographs (CFP) offers scalable screening, but performance may decline on external datasets because of differences in ground-truth definitions, populations, and coexisting conditions such as high myopia (HM). We developed and validated a Vision Transformer-based deep learning (DL) model for glaucoma detection across multi-ethnic cohorts with and without HM. Methods: A ViT-B/16 model with predictive uncertainty estimation was developed using 56,483 CFPs (57.1% with myopia; 14.4% with HM). Glaucoma labels were standardised using clinical, imaging, and perimetry data. The model was validated on 16 independent datasets across three continents, including four datasets with explicit HM labels. Findings: Internal AUROC was 98.7% (95% CI 98.2-99.1%), with sensitivity 94.5% and specificity 97.3%. Across 16 external datasets from eight countries, AUROCs ranged from 86.4% to 99.6%. In HM eyes, internal AUROC was 97.8% (95% CI 96.1-99.2%), with sensitivity 94.8% and specificity 93.7%. External HM AUROCs were 86.5% in the Beijing Eye Study and 93.3%, 91.8%, and 85.5% in hospital-based datasets from Taiwan, Th
items.authors: Raghavan Lavanya, Yangqin Feng, Ten Cheer Quek, Quan V. Hoang, Linda Yi-Chieh Poon, Jost B. Jonas, Ya Xing Wang, Vinay Nangia, Jin Wook Jeoung, Sehie Park, SoYeon Kim, Benjamin Y Xu, Sreenidhi Iyengar

items.title: RoboLDA: A Probabilistic Generative Model for Uncovering Embodied Hierarchical Structures in Voxel-based Soft Robots
items.title_zh: RoboLDA：揭示体积基础软机器人层次结构的生成模型
items.summary_zh: 近年来，机器人技术的进展突显了机器人形态的层次配置，其中多个功能子结构协同作用以促进智能行为。尽管这种层次视角对体积基础软机器人（VSRs）在设计和控制复杂性上具有优势，但其对领域专业知识的高度依赖限制了应用。本研究提出RoboLDA，一个贝叶斯概率模型，将VSR形态生成分解为“任务-机器人-器官-体素”四级层次，并通过变分推断进行训练。通过对模拟VSR的广泛实验，我们验证了高性能VSR设计背后存在一致且直观的层次模式，并展示了RoboLDA提取和利用这些层次先验进行零-shot机器人设计的能力。生成的设计在没有进一步优化的情况下，平均达到了进化算法优化性能的106.4%。此外，RoboLDA推断的器官结构作为有效的功能子结构，与模块化控制策略结合时显著增强了协同运动控制。
items.abstract: Recent advances in robotics highlight hierarchical configurations of robot morphology, where multiple levels of functional substructures synergize to facilitate intelligent behaviors. This hierarchical perspective, while particularly advantageous for voxel-based soft robots (VSRs) to ease design and control complexities, is hindered by its heavy reliance on domain expertise. In this work, we address the following question: can we derive such hierarchical design principles solely from existing successful designs? We answer affirmatively by presenting RoboLDA, a Bayesian probabilistic model that decomposes VSR morphology generation into a four-level hierarchy: "task-robot-organ-voxel", and is trained via variational inference. Through extensive experiments on simulated VSRs, we verify the presence of consistent, intuitive hierarchical patterns underlying high-performing VSR designs and showcase RoboLDA's proficiency to extract and leverage these hierarchical priors for zero-shot robot design in unseen tasks. The generated designs, even without further optimization, achieve on average 106.4% of the optimized performance produced by evolutionary algorithms. Additionally, the organ stru
items.authors: Junru Song, Yang Yang, Jingdan Shi, Guozhen Li, Weien Zhou, Ying Wen, Feifei Wang, Wen Yao, Tingsong Jiang

items.title: MorphIK: Morphology-Conditioned Neural Inverse Kinematics for Unknown Robots
items.title_zh: MorphIK：未知机器人形态条件下的神经逆运动学
items.summary_zh: 神经模型能够从数据中学习生成逆运动学问题的多种解决方案，但通常仅限于单一机器人。我们提出了MorphIK，这是一种流匹配模型，能够解决在训练中未见过的基于旋转关节的运动链的逆运动学问题。该模型使用变换器架构对机器人的形态和目标姿态进行编码，这种编码随后为生成噪声姿态的流匹配头提供条件。模型在纯合成数据上训练，针对未见过的真实世界机器人（具有6到9个自由度），达到了约5厘米的精度。为了更高的精度，该模型可作为进一步优化算法的优良先验，在经过一次阻尼最小二乘优化后将误差降低到1厘米以下，在大多数情况下经过三次步骤后误差降至亚毫米级。MorphIK利用流匹配的生成能力高效采样机器人的零空间，为同一姿态提供多种配置，从而实现对已知和未知机器人的神经逆运动学的学习与泛化。
items.abstract: Neural models can learn to generate various solutions to the inverse kinematics problem from data, but are usually limited to a single robot. We present MorphIK, a flow-matching model that solves inverse kinematics for revolute-joint-based kinematic chains it has never seen during training. The model uses a transformer architecture to encode the robot's morphology along with the target pose. This encoding then conditions a flow-matching head that generates poses from noise. Trained on purely synthetic data from procedurally generated robots, the model reaches a precision of about 5 cm on unseen real-world robots with 6 to 9 Degrees of Freedom. For higher precision, the model serves as an excellent Prior for further optimization algorithms, reducing error to less than 1 cm after a single step of Damped Least Squares optimization and to sub-1 mm error after 3 steps in most cases. Building on flow matching's generative capabilities to produce highly diverse outputs, our model can efficiently sample the robot's null space, providing a wide variety of configurations for the same pose. Thus, overall, MorphIK allows learning and generalizing neural inverse kinematics for a multitude of kn
items.authors: Lennart Clasmeier, Jan Gerrit Habekost, Cornelius Weber, Stefan Wermter

items.title: Guardrails or Roadblocks? Effects of Pedagogical Style and Context Awareness in AI Teaching Assistants for Programming
items.title_zh: AI教学助手的教学风格与情境意识对编程学习的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于大型语言模型的AI教学助手（AI TAs）在编程课程中的应用，重点分析了教学风格和情境意识对学生学习体验的影响。我们在一门入门编程课程中对132名学生进行了随机对照试验，学生完成了与代码编写和调试相关的三项任务，并随机分配到四种不同的AI TAs，分别在教学指导风格（苏格拉底式与直接指导）和情境意识（无情境与完整情境）两个维度上进行变化。结果显示，具有完整情境的苏格拉底式AI TA获得的学生评价最低，学生报告的任务完成支持感显著较低。此外，该条件下观察到的互动压力最高，外部大型语言模型使用率最高，且任务后解释中完全理解的比例最低。
items.abstract: AI teaching assistants (AI TAs) backed by large language models (LLMs) and pedagogical guardrails are increasingly being integrated into programming courses, providing students with scalable access to hints, conceptual explanations, and code-level feedback. However, guardrails may also create friction. If students feel that the support provided is overly restrictive or poorly contextualized to their current progress, they may bypass approved tools for general-purpose LLMs. To investigate how AI TA design affects students' learning experiences, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 132 students in an introductory programming course. Students completed three tasks related to code-writing and debugging and were randomly assigned to one of four AI TAs varied across two dimensions: pedagogical guidance style (Socratic vs. Direct instruction) and context awareness (no context vs. full context of the problem and student solution). We examined students' perceptions, interaction behaviors, and evidence of post-task comprehension. Students rated the Socratic AI TA with full context least favorably, reporting significantly lower perceived support for task completion. Descriptively,
items.authors: Madeleine Eastwood, Harshith Narne, Joseph Hilby, Paul Denny, Ashish Aggarwal, Amanpreet Kapoor

items.title: Generating Interesting Scientific Ideas using Knowledge Graphs and LLMs: Evaluations with 100 Research Group Leaders
items.title_zh: 利用知识图谱和大型语言模型生成有趣的科学创意
items.summary_zh: 随着科学文献的快速增长，研究人员在跨学科领域识别新颖且有影响力的创意变得愈加困难。现代人工智能系统为科学创意提供了新机遇，但AI生成的创意有多吸引人？我们介绍了SciMuse，它利用5800万篇论文的知识图谱和大型语言模型生成个性化研究创意。我们对100多位研究组领导进行了大规模评估，评估了超过4400个个性化创意的兴趣水平。专家评分整体较低（平均2.40分，5分制中最常见评分为1），但24.9%的创意获得了4或5分。研究发现，使用知识图谱选择的概念对创意的专家兴趣评分没有显著提升，且高引用预测的概念对比随机概念的兴趣评分甚至略低。尽管如此，图谱特征可以用于控制创意属性，并且我们展示了基于图谱特征的监督神经网络可以预测创意的兴趣。
items.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes it increasingly challenging for researchers to identify novel and impactful ideas, especially across disciplines. Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems offer new opportunities for scientific ideation, but how compelling are AI-generated ideas, and how can their quality be improved? Here, we introduce SciMuse, which generates personalized research ideas using a knowledge graph of 58 million papers and a large language model (LLM). A central focus of this work is to understand how interesting these ideas are. Therefore, we conducted a large-scale evaluation in which more than 100 research group leaders -- spanning the natural sciences to the humanities -- rated over 4,400 personalized ideas according to their level of interest. Overall, expert ratings were modest (mean 2.40 on a 5-point scale, most common rating 1), while 24.9% of ideas were rated 4 or 5. We find that supplying concept pairs selected using the knowledge graph does not improve expert-rated interest over a titles-only GPT baseline. High-citation-predicted pairs even showed a weak tendency (1.94$\sigma$) toward lower interest than random pairs. Nevertheless, graph fe
items.authors: Xuemei Gu, Mario Krenn

items.title: Unraveling the cognitive patterns of Large Language Models through module communities
items.title_zh: 通过模块社区揭示大型语言模型的认知模式
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学、工程和社会领域带来了显著进展，应用范围涵盖科学发现、医学诊断和聊天机器人等。尽管LLMs广泛应用，其内部机制仍隐藏在数十亿个参数和复杂结构中，理解其内在架构和认知过程面临挑战。本文采用生物学中新兴认知的理解方法，开发了一个基于网络的框架，将认知技能、LLM架构和数据集联系起来，推动基础模型分析的范式转变。模块社区中的技能分布表明，尽管LLMs与特定生物系统的专门化不完全相同，但它们展现出独特的模块社区，其新兴技能模式部分反映了鸟类和小型哺乳动物大脑中分布式但相互连接的认知组织。我们的数值结果强调了LLMs与生物系统的关键差异，技能获取显著受益于动态的跨区域互动和神经可塑性。通过将认知科学原理与机器学习相结合，我们的框架为LLM的可解释性提供了新见解。
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have reshaped our world with significant advancements in science, engineering, and society through applications ranging from scientific discoveries and medical diagnostics to Chatbots. Despite their ubiquity and utility, the underlying mechanisms of LLM remain concealed within billions of parameters and complex structures, making their inner architecture and cognitive processes challenging to comprehend. We address this gap by adopting approaches to understanding emerging cognition in biology and developing a network-based framework that links cognitive skills, LLM architectures, and datasets, ushering in a paradigm shift in foundation model analysis. The skill distribution in the module communities demonstrates that while LLMs do not strictly parallel the focalized specialization observed in specific biological systems, they exhibit unique communities of modules whose emergent skill patterns partially mirror the distributed yet interconnected cognitive organization seen in avian and small mammalian brains. Our numerical results highlight a key divergence from biological systems to LLMs, where skill acquisition benefits substantially from dynamic, cross
items.authors: Kushal Raj Bhandari, Pin-Yu Chen, Jianxi Gao

items.title: Multimodal AI predicts clinical outcomes of drug combinations from preclinical data
items.title_zh: 多模态人工智能预测药物组合的临床结果
items.summary_zh: 从前临床数据预测临床结果对于选择安全有效的药物组合和减少后期失败至关重要。本文介绍了Madrigal，一个多模态人工智能模型，能够从结构、通路、细胞活力和转录组数据中学习。Madrigal将21842种化合物的这些模态对齐到一个共享的潜在空间，并能够预测即使在仅有部分数据模态中观察到的药物组合结果。经过158个专家策划和795个患者报告的组合结果训练，Madrigal的表现优于单模态和现有的多模态方法。消融实验表明，模态对齐和多模态输入均提高了预测性能。Madrigal预测共享膜转运蛋白的组合具有较高风险。在比较两个组合臂的头对头试验中，观察到中性粒细胞减少症、贫血、脱发或低血糖发生率较高的臂在28次比较中有25次获得更高的预测风险。在MASH中，Madrigal将resmetirom与2型糖尿病药物配对时列为具有良好预测安全性的候选药物。Madrigal还改善了在纵向患者队列和独立肿瘤患者中的不良事件预测。
items.abstract: Predicting clinical outcomes from preclinical data is essential for selecting safe and effective drug combinations and for reducing late-stage failures. AI models use molecular structure and target annotations, and do not leverage the perturbation readouts that report how a compound acts in a cellular context. Here we introduce Madrigal, a multimodal AI model that learns from structural, pathway, cell-viability, and transcriptomic data. Madrigal aligns these modalities across 21,842 compounds into a shared latent space and predicts combination outcomes even for drugs observed in only a subset of the data modalities. Trained on 158 expert-curated and 795 patient-reported combination outcomes, Madrigal outperforms single-modality and state-of-the-art multimodal methods. Ablations show that modality alignment and multimodal input each improve predictive performance. Madrigal predicts elevated risk for combinations that share membrane transporters. In head-to-head trials that compare two combination arms,the arm with the higher observed incidence of neutropenia, anemia, alopecia, or hypoglycemia receives the higher predicted risk in 25 of 28 comparisons. In MASH, Madrigal ranks resmeti
items.authors: Yepeng Huang, Xiaorui Su, Varun Ullanat, Intae Moon, Ivy Liang, Lindsay Clegg, Damilola Olabode, Ruthie Johnson, Nicholas Ho, Megan Gibbs, Alexander Gusev, Bino John, Marinka Zitnik

items.title: SPARQL-LLM: Real-Time SPARQL Query Generation from Natural Language Questions
items.title_zh: SPARQL-LLM：实时从自然语言生成SPARQL查询
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的出现推动了新方法的发展，这些方法旨在更好地将自然语言生成结构化查询，如SPARQL查询。然而，这些新方法主要关注响应准确性，忽视了运行时间和生成成本等其他评估标准。因此，它们往往不适合生产环境或难以在真实知识图谱上高效部署。为了解决这些问题，本文描述并系统评估了SPARQL-LLM，这是一种开源且与三元组存储无关的方法，利用轻量级元数据从自然语言文本生成SPARQL查询。我们首先描述其架构，包括元数据索引、提示构建和查询生成与执行的专用组件。然后，我们基于多语言问题的挑战和生物信息学领域三大主流知识图谱的问题集合进行评估。结果显示，F1分数相比第二名系统提高了59%，并且能够适应英语、西班牙语和德语等高资源语言，具备形成复杂生物信息学查询的能力。
items.abstract: The advent of large language models is contributing to the emergence of novel approaches that promise to better tackle the challenge of generating structured queries, such as SPARQL queries, from natural language. However, these new approaches mostly focus on response accuracy while ignoring other evaluation criteria, such as runtime and cost to generate SPARQL queries. Consequently, they are often not production-ready or easy to deploy over real-world knowledge graphs with good accuracy. To mitigate these issues, in this paper, we describe and systematically evaluate SPARQL-LLM, an open-source and triplestore-agnostic approach, powered by lightweight metadata, that generates SPARQL queries from natural language text. First, we describe its architecture, which consists of dedicated components for metadata indexing, prompt building, and query generation and execution. Then, we evaluate it based on a state-of-the-art challenge with multilingual questions, and a collection of questions from three of the most prevalent knowledge graphs within the field of bioinformatics. Our results demonstrate a substantial improvement of up to 59% in F1 score over the second-best system participating
items.authors: Panayiotis Smeros, Vincent Emonet, Ruijie Wang, Ana-Claudia Sima, Tarcisio Mendes de Farias

items.title: Novelty Adaptation Through Hybrid Large Language Model (LLM)-Symbolic Planning and LLM-guided Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 通过混合大语言模型与符号规划的创新适应研究
items.summary_zh: 在动态开放世界环境中，自主智能体常常面临新奇事物，这影响其制定实现目标的计划能力。传统的符号规划器在规划领域缺乏与新奇对象适当互动的操作符时，无法生成有效计划。我们提出了一种神经符号架构，整合了符号规划、强化学习和大语言模型（LLM），以学习如何处理新奇对象。具体而言，我们利用LLM的常识推理能力识别缺失的操作符，使用符号AI规划器生成计划，并编写奖励函数以指导强化学习智能体学习新识别操作符的控制策略。我们的研究在操作符发现和连续机器人领域的操作符学习方面优于现有最先进方法。
items.abstract: In dynamic open-world environments, autonomous agents often encounter novelties that hinder their ability to find plans to achieve their goals. Specifically, traditional symbolic planners fail to generate plans when the robot's planning domain lacks the operators that enable it to interact appropriately with novel objects in the environment. We propose a neuro-symbolic architecture that integrates symbolic planning, reinforcement learning, and a large language model (LLM) to learn how to handle novel objects. In particular, we leverage the common sense reasoning capability of the LLM to identify missing operators, generate plans with the symbolic AI planner, and write reward functions to guide the reinforcement learning agent in learning control policies for newly identified operators. Our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in operator discovery as well as operator learning in continuous robotic domains.Our webpage and code can be access here: helenlu66.github.io/hybridLLMguided/
items.authors: Hong Lu, Pierrick Lorang, Timothy R. Duggan, Jivko Sinapov, Matthias Scheutz

items.title: Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation
items.title_zh: 前沿滞后：学术AI评估中的能力误表征文献计量审计
items.summary_zh: 应用领域的大型语言模型（LLM）评估往往反映的是在发表时已被超越的模型。我们观察到一种出版引发差距：学术论文中报告结果的AI系统与当前读者合理假设的被引用AI系统之间的距离。我们系统性地分析了2022年1月1日至2026年4月1日的OpenAlex数据（n = 112,303 LLM关键词匹配），并识别出被评估的模型（n = 18,574可接受记录）。根据Epoch AI能力指数（ECI），我们对每个评估的LLM进行排名。评估时，论文中模型的中位数能力落后于前沿LLM，能力差距中位数为+10.85 ECI（H1；n = 12,312），且这一差距以每年+5.53 ECI的速度增长（H2，名义95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]）。在评估日期明确且模型可解析为ECI分数的论文中（n = 728），H1的中位差距为+5.01 ECI。只有18.4%的全文论文中明确说明了评估日期。在我们的审计中，52.5%（95% CI: [48.2, 56.9]）的摘要结论是在类别层面（“AI”）而非模型层面表述的。
items.abstract: LLM evaluations in applied domains tend to reflect models that were already outclassed at time of publication. We observe a publication elicitation gap: the distance between the AI systems generating the results reported in an academic paper and the AI systems that a current reader of that paper would reasonably assume are being referenced. We systematically sweep OpenAlex from 2022-01-01 to 2026-04-01 (n = 112,303 LLM keyword matches). Then, we identify what models were evaluated (n = 18,574 admissible records). We then rank each evaluated LLM against a frontier LLM based on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), an aggregate LLM capability score. At time of evaluation, the median paper is evaluating models that are behind frontier LLMs in capability, with a median gap of +10.85 ECI (H1; n = 12,312). This gap is growing, increasing at a rate of +5.53 ECI per year (H2, nominal 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). The sign holds even in the absence of any imputation for evaluation date. In papers (n = 728) where the date of evaluation is explicit and the model in question can be resolved to an ECI score, the median gap for H1 is +5.01 ECI. An explicitly stated evaluation date can be found in onl
items.authors: David Gringras, Misha Salahshoor

items.title: When Search Becomes Memory: Accelerating Robot Design Discovery with Self-Evolving Skills
items.title_zh: 搜索变为记忆：自我进化技能加速机器人设计发现
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在进化机器人设计中被广泛用作提案生成器，但大多数循环仍然是无记忆的：模拟器结果影响下一代，但未被保存为可重用的设计知识。我们提出了Auto-Robotist，一个自我进化的LLM代理，它将形态搜索轨迹提炼为明确的自然语言技能库。每个技能存储结构原型、基于证据的正负规则及支持它们的评估设计，使设计记忆可检查而非隐含于种群中。在搜索过程中，代理检索技能以调节精英体的LLM编辑，同时保留遗传算法（GA）变异路径以进行探索；评估后，通过添加、诊断和合并更新库。在涵盖运动、穿越和物体交互的七个EvoGym任务中，Auto-Robotist提高了冷启动5x5搜索，并将学习到的技能转移到10x10设计空间，其中参考条件转移在每个任务上均优于GA。这些结果表明，LLM代理可以将昂贵的物理评估转化为可重用、可审计的设计原则。我们的代码已公开发布在 https://github.com/wangyf9/Auto-Robotist 。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proposal generators for evolutionary robot design, yet most loops remain memoryless: simulator results shape the next population but are not preserved as reusable design knowledge. We present Auto-Robotist, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library. Each skill stores a structural archetype, evidence-grounded positive and negative rules, and the evaluated designs that support them, making design memory inspectable rather than implicit in a population. During search, the agent retrieves skills to condition LLM edits of elite bodies while retaining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) mutation path for exploration; after evaluation, it updates the library through Add, Diagnose, and Merge. Across seven EvoGym tasks spanning locomotion, traversal, and object interaction, Auto-Robotist improves cold-start 5x5 search and transfers learned skills to 10x10 design spaces, where reference-conditioned transfer outperforms GA on every task. These results suggest that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles. Our code is publicly
items.authors: Yunfei Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Yang Li, Xiaonan Huang

items.title: A Human-AI Theorem Connecting Spontaneous and Field-Induced Mechanisms of Collective Behavior in One Dimension
items.title_zh: 连接自发与场诱导集体行为的一维人机定理
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨人工智能（AI）是否能够生成超出人类合作者主动假设空间（AHS）的科学假设，并组织人机研究以促进此类突破。我们证明了一个定理，连接统计物理的两种基本组织机制：在零场中因竞争相互作用产生的集体行为与外部场诱导或控制的行为。我们发现，任意不均匀的最近邻和次最近邻相互作用函数的零场$O(n)$-向量开放链在哈密顿量层面上通过温度无关的映射，微观上等价于一个更简单的$O(n)$开放链。该定理解决了1990年提出的$n=3$的长期挑战，证明过程使用了AI合成的递归Householder移动框架，并通过人类识别的隐性互惠关系得以理解。
items.abstract: Can an artificial intelligence (AI) generate a scientific hypothesis outside a human collaborator's active hypothesis space (AHS), and can human-AI research be organized to make such breakthroughs more likely? We document such a case while proving a theorem that connects two basic organizing mechanisms of statistical physics: collective behavior arising in zero field from competing interactions and that induced or controlled by an external field. A zero-field $O(n)$-vector open chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interaction functions $U_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+1})$ and $V_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+2})$ is microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level, equivalent to a simpler $O(n)$ open chain with nearest-neighbor interaction $V_i(\boldsymbol\sigma_i\cdot\boldsymbol\sigma_{i+1})$ and axial single-spin potential $U_i(\sigma_i^z)$ for every integer $n\ge1$ and every system size $L\ge1$. The homogeneous linear specialization maps the foundational frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ model onto the canonical $J$-$h$ field model---with $n=1,2,3$ being the Ising, XY, and Heisenberg classical spin models, respectively; the theorem resolved a longstan
items.authors: Weiguo Yin

items.title: LabFactory: Building and Evaluating Executable AI Labs
items.title_zh: LabFactory：构建与评估可执行的AI实验室
items.summary_zh: 科学任务指定了期望的能力，但实现这一能力通常需要构建一个针对特定任务的计算系统，包括数据获取、表示设计、模型训练、工具实现及推理使用决策。我们提出了LabFactory，一个框架使AI构建者能够将科学简报转化为可执行的AI实验室：一个集成模型、知识资源、工具和控制器的任务特定求解器，具有固定接口。构建者在一个计量工作空间中开发和打包实验室；然后，独立的主机在保留的输入上执行交付的工件，并在求解器的输入接口外保留参考标签，依据任务协议对输出进行评分。这使得交付的系统成为评估的对象，而非构建者对其进展的描述。我们记录了七个科学任务类别中28个选定构建，涵盖从分子和基因组预测到生理信号、临床决策支持和生物医学文本的任务，所有交付的实验室在主机执行下均超出了其配置的参考值。十个包含在构建过程中拟合的预测模型，其他则围绕固定平台LLM组装检索系统、可执行分析环境和工具驱动的工作流。整体表明，AI代理能够进行科学研究。
items.abstract: Scientific tasks specify a desired capability, but realizing it often requires building a computational system tailored to the task---acquiring data, designing representations, training models, implementing tools, and deciding how they are used at inference. We present LabFactory, a framework in which an AI builder turns a scientific brief into an executable AI lab: a task-specific solver that integrates models, knowledge resources, tools, and a controller behind a fixed interface. The builder develops and packages the lab in a metered workspace; a separate host then executes the delivered artifact on held-out inputs, with reference labels kept outside the solver's input interface, and scores its outputs under the task's protocol. This makes the delivered system, rather than the builder's account of its progress, the object of evaluation. We document 28 selected constructions across seven scientific task categories---from molecular and genomic prediction to physiological signals, clinical decision support, and biomedical text---whose delivered labs exceeded their configured reference values on all 33 subtests under host-side execution. Ten contain predictive models fitted during co
items.authors: Jinge Wu, Hongjian Zhou, Mingde Zeng, Jiayuan Zhu, Junde Wu, Jiazhen Pan, Lei Clifton, Andrew Liu, David A. Clifton

items.title: EvoTreeNAD: Genealogy-Guided Evolution for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Discovery
items.title_zh: EvoTreeNAD：基于谱系引导的LLM驱动神经架构发现
items.summary_zh: AI驱动的科学发现通过自主开发解决方案和设计加速研究。大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过迭代生成和评估支持这一过程。然而，仅靠这些迭代无法确保累积进展或确定下一步的方向。神经架构发现将这些挑战结合在一起，结合开放式设计与资源密集型实验。我们提出EvoTreeNAD，一种谱系引导的进化算法，能够在没有提供种子或手动指定搜索空间的情况下构建可训练架构。从空根开始，它在每个新节点上生长出一个持久的谱系，每个节点代表一个完整的架构。通过计算每个节点及其后代的顶尖值来指导谱系选择。使用选定的设计历史，Idea Agent提出变体，Code Agent实现之。每个评估的变体成为子节点，扩展谱系并为后续谱系选择提供证据。我们的理论分析建立了谱系增长时存在静态变异机制的条件。在特定变异假设下，持续的顶尖家族值量化了在这些机制中生成高奖励架构的概率。EvoTreeNAD发现了架构的演变。
items.abstract: AI-driven scientific discovery accelerates research by autonomously developing solutions and designs. Large language model (LLM) agents support this process through iterative generation and evaluation. Yet these iterations alone do not ensure cumulative progress or establish which directions to pursue next. Costly evaluation further constrains the scope of exploration. Neural architecture discovery brings these challenges together, coupling open-ended design with resource-intensive experimentation. We introduce EvoTreeNAD, a genealogy-guided evolutionary algorithm that constructs trainable architectures without a supplied seed or a hand-specified search space. Starting from an empty root, it grows a persistent genealogy in which each new node represents a complete architecture. Top-percentile values computed from each node and its descendants guide lineage selection. Using the selected design history, an Idea Agent proposes a variant and a Code Agent implements it. Each evaluated variant becomes a child node, expanding the genealogy while providing evidence for subsequent lineage selection. Our theoretical analysis establishes the existence of stationary variation regimes as the ge
items.authors: Lishan Yu, Derek Jiu, Qizhen Lan, Xiaoqian Jiang

items.title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
items.title_zh: DGM与PINN算法在非线性PDE求解中的全局收敛性研究
items.summary_zh: 深度Galerkin方法（DGM）和物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已成为解决偏微分方程（PDE）的广泛应用方法。在这些方法中，通过使用（随机）梯度下降法训练神经网络，以最小化神经网络的PDE残差。然而，由于PDE残差目标函数的非凸性，训练后的神经网络原则上可能仅收敛于目标函数的局部极小值，而非PDE的解。因此，关于这些算法的数学基础长期存在疑问。本研究考虑一类具有解及其一阶导数非线性的半线性PDE，证明了使用梯度下降法训练的神经网络在网络宽度和训练时间趋向无穷大时，将收敛于PDE解。
items.abstract: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific machine learning. In these methods, a neural network is trained to approximate the PDE solution by using (stochastic) gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual of the neural network. Due to the non-convexity of the PDE residual objective function, the trained neural network may, in principle, only converge to a local minimizer of the objective function (which would not be a solution of the PDE). Therefore, there is a longstanding question regarding the mathematical foundations of these algorithms, and it is highly valuable to establish that the trained neural network will converge to the PDE solution. In this paper, we consider a class of semilinear PDEs with nonlinearities in the solution and its first derivative. For this class of PDEs, we prove that neural networks trained with gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual objective function will converge to the PDE solution as the network width and training time $\rightarrow \infty$.
items.authors: Justin Sirignano, Konstantinos Spiliopoulos, Samuel Cohen

items.title: MultiwayPAM: Multiway Partitioning Around Medoids for LLM-as-a-Judge Score Analysis
items.title_zh: 多维PAM：用于LLM评估分数分析的多维聚类方法
items.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge是一个灵活的文本评估框架，通过改变提示模板，可以从不同角度获得文本质量评分。使用LLM-as-a-Judge面临的主要挑战是大语言模型（LLM）推理的计算成本，尤其是在评估大量实例时，以及LLM评估者的固有偏见。为了解决这些问题并揭示LLM评估者造成的评分偏见结构，我们提出将张量聚类方法应用于LLM-as-a-Judge评分张量，该张量的条目为不同问题、回答者和评估者组合的评分。具体而言，我们开发了一种新的张量聚类方法MultiwayPAM，可以同时估计给定数据张量每个模式的聚类成员资格和中心点。通过观察MultiwayPAM获得的中心点，我们可以了解每个问题/回答者/评估者聚类的成员资格。我们通过将MultiwayPAM应用于两个实际数据集的评分张量，实验性地展示了其有效性。
items.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge is a flexible framework for text evaluation, which allows us to obtain scores for the quality of a given text from various perspectives by changing the prompt template. Two main challenges in using LLM-as-a-Judge are computational cost of inference using a large language model (LLM), especially when evaluating a large number of instances, and inherent bias of an LLM evaluator. To address these issues and reveal the structure of score bias caused by an LLM evaluator, we propose to apply a tensor clustering method to a given LLM-as-a-Judge score tensor, whose entries are the scores for different combinations of questions, answerers, and evaluators. Specifically, we develop a new tensor clustering method MultiwayPAM, with which we can simultaneously estimate the cluster membership and the medoids for each mode of a given data tensor. By observing the medoids obtained by MultiwayPAM, we can gain knowledge about the membership of each question/answerer/evaluator cluster. We experimentally show the effectiveness of MultiwayPAM by applying it to the score tensors for two practical datasets.
items.authors: Chihiro Watanabe, Jingyu Sun

items.title: A Comprehensive Review of Large Language Models for Nanophotonics: From Surrogate Modeling to Autonomous Design
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型在纳米光子学中的应用综述
items.summary_zh: 超表面通过实现前所未有的光操控精度，彻底改变了光子器件的开发。然而，其设计过程常受到计算昂贵的模拟和复杂高维设计空间的限制。尽管深度学习作为替代模型加速了设计过程，但仍受限于特定任务的架构，缺乏通用推理能力。本文综述了大型语言模型（LLMs）如何为现有的数值纳米光子学工作流程增添语义接口、代码生成和工具协调。我们首先概述了从经典神经网络到基于变换器模型的发展及其在纳米光子学设计中的应用。接着，回顾了LLM相关方法在纳米光子学中的出现，并将其分为两种操作模式：将结构-光谱映射视为语言任务的替代模型，以及能够生成代码、协调选定模拟步骤并支持闭环优化的智能系统。此外，我们简要探讨了LLMs在材料科学和无线通信等研究领域的应用，以识别未来的跨学科机会。最后，展望了具有物理感知能力的下一代多模态基础模型。
items.abstract: Metasurfaces have revolutionized the development of photonic devices by enabling unprecedented precision in light manipulation. However, their design processes are often constrained by computationally expensive simulations and complex high-dimensional design spaces. Although deep learning has accelerated the design process by serving as a surrogate model, it remains constrained by task-specific architectures and lacks universal reasoning capabilities. This review surveys how Large Language Models (LLMs) are adding semantic interfaces, code generation, and tool orchestration to established numerical nanophotonic workflows. We first outline the development from classical neural networks to transformer-based models and their applications in nanophotonic design. We then review the emergence of LLM-related methods in nanophotonics and organize them into two operational modes: surrogate models that treat structure-spectrum mapping as a language task, and agentic systems that have been demonstrated to generate code, orchestrate selected simulation steps, and support closed-loop optimization. Furthermore, to identify future cross-disciplinary opportunities, we briefly explore applications
items.authors: Huanshu Zhang, Kegeng Tang, Lei Kang, Sawyer D. Campbell, Zihao Wang, Douglas H. Werner

items.title: Grammatical "grandmother neurons" are rare in LLMs
items.title_zh: 大语言模型中的语法“祖母神经元”稀少
items.summary_zh: 理解大语言模型（LLMs）如何编码语言结构仍然是可解释性研究中的一个基本挑战。尽管诊断分类器（或“探针”）被广泛用于此任务，但它们面临显著的 методологические批评：训练辅助分类器引入了容量混淆和校准问题，常常使得难以区分模型的内在表示与探针学习任务的能力。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了一种无探针框架，以在单个神经元级别定位语言选择性。通过利用语言最小对的受控对比，我们提出了神经元可分离性指数（NSI），该指标直接量化单个神经元在不更新参数的情况下，如何可靠地区分语法与非语法结构。对68个语言范式和七个检查点应用NSI揭示了三个主要模式：1）在形态和句法区分上，原始可分离性较早达到接近峰值；2）经过置换归一化后，单元选择性稀疏、弱且调谐狭窄；3）整体向量线性可分离性和单神经元选择性。
items.abstract: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) encode linguistic structures remains a fundamental challenge in interpretability research. While diagnostic classifiers (or "probes") are widely used for this task, they face significant methodological criticism: training auxiliary classifiers introduces capacity confounds and calibration issues, often making it difficult to distinguish the model's intrinsic representations from the probe's ability to learn the task. To address these limitations, we introduce a probe-free framework for localizing linguistic selectivity at the individual neuron level. Leveraging the controlled contrasts of linguistic minimal pairs, we propose a Neuron Separability Index (NSI), a metric that directly quantifies how reliably single neurons differentiate grammatical from ungrammatical constructions without parameter updates. items.authors: Linyang He, Nima Mesgarani

items.title: Large Language Models for Programming: Actually Fixing or Reimplementing Incorrect Code?
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型在编程中的应用：修复错误代码还是重新实现？
items.summary_zh: 近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）能够有效解决各种编程环境中的问题和修复错误，包括竞赛编程。现有方法主要独立评估LLM在问题解决或错误修复方面的表现，但未探讨这两种能力之间的关系。本研究旨在确定LLM在修复错误时与人类修复相比的偏差程度，以及是否倾向于生成全新解决方案。我们构建了一个包含约3000个提交的数据库，并将每个有缺陷的提交与其对应的人类修复匹配。通过比较有缺陷的解决方案与人类修复的相似性，我们评估了3个OpenAI GPT模型（gpt-5-nano、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1）生成的错误修复质量。研究发现，LLM倾向于修改比人类修复更多的代码行，并在某些情况下生成全新解决方案。此外，当允许LLM从头生成解决方案时，其正确解决问题的能力优于修补有缺陷的提交。
items.abstract: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models can effectively solve problems and fix bugs in diverse programming environments, including competitive programming. Existing approaches primarily evaluate LLM performance in problem solving or bug fixing independently, but do not explore the relationship between these two capabilities. This work focuses on determining how much the LLM deviates from a buggy solution to fix the bug compared to a human-written patch, and if there is a bias towards generating entirely new solutions. We construct a dataset with all the submissions ($\sim$ 3000) from a couple of users from Codeforces, and we match each buggy submission with its corresponding human fix. By using the similarity between the buggy solution and the human fix as a baseline, we evaluate the quality of LLM-generated bug fixes on 3 OpenAI GPT models (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1). We check if the generated solutions solve the problem by using the Codeforces-R1 dataset, an openly available dataset that has tests generated with the DeepSeek-R1 model. items.authors: Alexandru Stefan Stoica, Traian Rebedea, Marian Cristian Mihaescu

items.title: LLMersion: A Local-First AI Agent Framework for Low-Cost Home Language Learning toward Educational Equity
items.title_zh: LLMersion：低成本家庭语言学习的本地优先AI代理框架
items.summary_zh: 人工智能在教育中最能帮助那些因成本而缺乏基本资源的学习者。对于语言学习者而言，这一资源是教师的声音，它将听、读、说、写四项技能结合为一个整体。研究显示，全球教师短缺达4400万，加之家庭辅导费用高昂，导致大多数学习者缺乏这种资源。尽管计算机辅助语言学习有效，但应用程序依赖的网络连接有26亿人无法获得，且“每个孩子一台电脑”的随机评估发现，缺乏有效软件的硬件无法提供教学。我们总结了八个困难和四个约束，认为小型开放权重模型可以解决最后一个约束：完整的四项技能堆栈现在可以在200美元级别的笔记本电脑上运行，并且在社区测量中以与语音消费相同的速度生成，每学习小时电费约为1美分。因此，我们提出LLMersion，一个完全在家庭环境中运行的教育AI方案，基于学习者自己的文档，具有可定制的AI编写、理解和更新的代码库；并发布了LLMersion-1的开源原型（https://github.com/QM378/LLMersion）；同时勾勒出私人学习代理的愿景。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence helps education most where an essential provision has been rationed by cost. For language learners that provision is a teacher's voice, which binds listening, reading, speaking, and writing into one act. Published evidence shows why most learners lack it, from a global shortage of 44 million teachers to heavy household tutoring bills, and why technology has not substituted for it: computer-assisted language learning proved effective but narrow, applications presuppose connectivity 2.6 billion people lack, and One Laptop per Child's randomized evaluation found that hardware without capable software teaches nothing. We distill eight difficulties and four binding constraints, and argue that small open-weight models dissolve the last: a complete four-skill stack now fits a \$200-class laptop and, on community measurements, generates at the pace speech is consumed, for about one US cent of electricity per study hour. We therefore propose LLMersion, a scheme for AI for education that runs entirely at home, over the learner's own documents, with an AI-written, AI-understood, AI-updated codebase anyone can customize; present LLMersion-1, a released open-source proto
items.authors: Qiming Guo, Jinwen Tang, Xingran Huang, Hung-Yu Lin, Yafu Zhong, Xiatian Zhuang

items.title: The Domestic Unprotected Zone: Algorithmic Governance and the Reproduction of Perpetrator Discourse in Conversational AI
items.title_zh: 家庭无保护区：对话式AI中的算法治理与施害者话语再生产
items.summary_zh: 对话式AI日益介入亲密伴侣沟通，而推拒逻辑在推理层面上成为性别伤害的治理门槛。本文探讨这些系统是否再生产与亲密暴力私有化历史相关的话语形式。通过对六个广泛使用的对话式AI系统进行三阶段审计，比较每个系统中1,600个交叉提示的推拒行为，隔离300对匹配提示的关系框架，并对比新会话中的提交前框架与输出后的批评。结果显示，四个系统对少于1%的提示进行了推拒。ChatGPT 5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5拒绝了大多数请求，但在亲密框架下仍有残余泄漏。将非亲密描述切换为亲密伴侣描述使非推拒增加了4.4倍和10.8倍。输出后的批评在会话中产生了认可，但未能在新会话中延续，96-100%的泄漏提示再次泄漏。本文将这一模式称为家庭无保护区，作为推理层面的私有化门槛。
items.abstract: Conversational AI increasingly mediates intimate-partner communication, and refusal logic at the inference layer now functions as a governance threshold for gendered harm. This article asks whether such systems reproduce discursive forms historically tied to the privatization of intimate violence. A three-stage audit of six widely accessible conversational AI systems compares refusal behaviour across 1,600 crossed prompts per system, isolates relational framing through 300 matched prompt pairs, and contrasts pre-submission framing with post-output critique across fresh sessions. Four systems refused fewer than 1% of prompts. ChatGPT 5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 refused most requests, but residual leakage clustered under intimate framing. Switching from a non-intimate to an intimate-partner descriptor amplified non-refusal 4.4-fold and 10.8-fold. Post-output critique produced in-session acknowledgement that did not carry across fresh sessions, with 96-100% of leaked prompts re-leaking. The article names this pattern the Domestic Unprotected Zone, a privatization-like threshold at the inference layer.
items.authors: Lyu Chang, S\`onia Estrad\'e Albiol, N\'uria Verg\'es Bosch

items.title: MultiViewDx: Evidence-Linked Multi-View Clinical Diagnosis
items.title_zh: MultiViewDx：证据关联的多视角临床诊断
items.summary_zh: 医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在现有的医学视觉问答（MedVQA）基准上表现良好，但其训练数据往往与临床诊断不匹配。大多数监督围绕孤立图像或短QA对组织，导致证据如何引导决策以及同一病例的视图、系列、模态和患者背景之间的关联不明确。我们提出了MultiViewDx，这是一个部分经过医生验证的多模态指令数据集，用于证据关联的多视角医学影像诊断。MultiViewDx以临床案例作为监督单位，将影像研究与患者背景关联，规范异构报告为证据关联工作流，并使用统一的图像-文本检索器限制指令合成为源支持的证据。在四个MedVQA基准上，MultiViewDx-8B-AN的平均准确率达到79.0%，优于HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B（66.7%）和Claude3-Opus（55.7%）。在JAMA临床挑战案例中，其整体评分也表现最佳。
items.abstract: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform well on existing medical visual question answering (MedVQA) benchmarks, but their training data often does not match clinical diagnosis. Most supervision is organized around isolated images or short QA pairs, leaving two structures weakly specified: how evidence leads to a decision, and how views, series, modalities, and patient context from the same case are linked. We introduce MultiViewDx, a partly physician-validated multimodal instruction dataset for evidence-linked multi-view medical imaging diagnosis. MultiViewDx uses the clinical case as the supervision unit. It links imaging studies with patient context, normalizes heterogeneous reports into an evidence-linked workflow (evidence -> findings -> differential discussion -> diagnosis), and uses a unified image-text retriever to constrain instruction synthesis to source-supported evidence. It covers X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, histopathology, and other clinical visual sources. We fine-tune MultiViewDx-8B-AN and evaluate it on both existing MedVQA benchmarks and real-world case-based diagnostic reasoning. Across four MedVQA benchmarks, it achieves the best average accu
items.authors: Junda Wang, Zonghai Yao, Yujan Ting, Eric Z. Chen, Hieu Tran, Hong Yu, Weijing Huang, Terrence Chen

items.title: High-z galaxies with the JWST and the ELT: Toward Ever-finer Detail
items.title_zh: JWST与ELT探测高红移星系：迈向更精细的细节
items.summary_zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）正在改变对早期宇宙的探索，提供前所未有的红外波长角分辨率，并开启了K波段（2微米）以红的独特窗口。借助NIRCam、NIRISS、NIRSpec和MIRI等仪器，新的源类在运营的头几年中相继出现。宇宙时间的前半个十亿年现在已被常规探测，揭示了大量的蓝/红星系和作为“红点”的活动星系核（AGN），以及在再电离和后再电离时期的源的近红外/光学视图。到2030年代和2040年代，极端自适应光学（AO）设施将在（8-10米）望远镜（如VLT多联适应光学辅助可见成像仪和光谱仪MAVIS）和39米的超大型望远镜（如ELT的多联适应光学中继MORFEO）上部署，角分辨率将继续发挥关键作用。这些设施在衍射极限下运行，将提高JWST的分辨率，ELT的点扩散函数（PSF）将达到约6倍更小，近红外的ELT衍射极限PSF（全宽半最大值FWHM约8-12毫角秒）将解析小于100秒差距的空间尺度。
items.abstract: The exploration of the early Universe is being transformed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), which delivers unprecedented angular resolution at infrared wavelengths and opens a unique window redward of the K band (2um). Thanks to NIRCam, NIRISS, NIRSpec, and MIRI instruments, which provide both imaging and spectroscopy with exquisite efficiency, new classes of sources have emerged within the first years of operations. The first half-Gyr of cosmic time is now routinely probed, revealing massive blue/red galaxies and a population of Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) appearing as "little red dots" together with a rest-frame near-infrared/optical view of sources across the reionization and post-reionization epochs. Angular resolution will remain pivotal in the 2030s - 2040s, when extreme adaptive optics (AO) facilities will be deployed on both (8 - 10)m (e.g., the VLT Multi-Conjugate-Adaptive-Optics (MCAO) - Assisted Visible Imager and Spectrograph, MAVIS) and on extremely large telescopes, like the 39m ELT (e.g., Multi-conjugate adaptive Optics Relay For ELT Observation, MORFEO). Operating at the diffraction limit, these facilities will improve JWST's resolution, with ELT achieving
items.authors: Eros Vanzella

items.title: Stellar Collisions from Self-consistent Stellar Dynamics Around Growing Supermassive black Holes
items.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞周围恒星碰撞的自洽动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 银河中心是恒星环境最密集的区域，巨型黑洞（MBH）使恒星加速到极高速度，导致直接碰撞，从而产生引力波源、千新星和超新星类瞬态等高能现象。这些碰撞可以重塑星团的密度分布，并释放气体供MBH后续吸积。然而，围绕质量增长的MBH的自洽动力学所导致的现象演变速率尚未得到充分研究。本文通过GNC蒙特卡洛代码模拟了不同质量和密度分布的核星团（NSCs），发现恒星碰撞在$\sim 0.1-1$ Gyr内使内层区域的密度尖峰变平。尽管在陡峭尖峰中初始碰撞率迅速下降，但碰撞与MBH增长之间的相互作用在大质量NSCs中（$M_\star \sim 10^9 M_\odot$）显得重要。随着MBH的增长，恒星速度增加使得破坏性碰撞的相对速度可达$\gtrsim 2500 {\rm \,km\,s^{-1}}$，因此，现今大质量星团中的破坏性碰撞率仍然较高（$10^{-4}\sim 10^{-3}{\rm yr}^{-1}$）。
items.abstract: The centers of galaxies harbor the densest stellar environments, where a massive black hole (MBH) accelerates stars to such high velocities that direct collisions can result in high-energetic phenomena, such as gravitational wave sources, kilonovae, and supernova-like transients. These collisions can reshape the cluster's density profile and release gas that can be subsequently accreted by the MBH. However, the evolving rates of such phenomena from self-consistent dynamics around mass-growing MBHs remain largely unexplored. In this work, we simulate nuclear star clusters (NSCs) across a range of masses and density profiles by employing the GNC Monte Carlo code, that self-consistently models stellar dynamics and the subsequent accretion of released gas. We find that stellar collisions flatten the density cusp in the innermost regions ($r \lesssim 10^{-3}-10^{-2}$ pc) within $\sim 0.1-1$ Gyr. While high initial collision rates in steep cusps quickly decline due to stellar depletion, the interplay between collisions and MBH growth is important only in massive NSCs ($M_\star \sim 10^9 M_\odot$). As MBH grows, increased stellar velocities shift the balance toward destructive collisions
items.authors: Fupeng Zhang, Pau Amaro Seoane

items.title: A Census of Stellar-mass Black Holes in the Milky Way with POPKIN. I. Isolated Black Holes
items.title_zh: 银河系中孤立黑洞的普查与POPKIN框架
items.summary_zh: 引力波观测揭示了数百个恒星质量黑洞，但在银河系中已知的仅约二十个，几乎全为双星系统。我们提出了POPKIN，一个将单星和双星演化与银河轨道动力学相结合的Python框架，以追踪黑洞前身从零年龄主序星到现今孤立黑洞（IBH）群体。在十个模型中，超新星（SN）处方、质量转移效率和共同包层喷射效率的变化主要控制IBH的丰度。我们的基准模型预测银河中约有$4\times10^7$个IBH，其中约$8\times10^4$个位于距离太阳$1\,\rm{kpc}$内；其他SN处方预测约有$(1-2)\times10^8$个IBH。基准模型显示双峰质量分布，峰值分别在$9\,M_{\odot}$和$20\,M_{\odot}$，在$13-17\,M_{\odot}$区间存在缺失。未受击的IBH在银河平面附近沿近圆形轨道运动，典型速度为$20-30\,\rm{km\,s^{-1}}$，而受击系统经历更强的径向迁移，速度范围更广。我们估计约有$5\times10^3$个吸积IBH。
items.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations have revealed hundreds of stellar-mass black holes, yet only about two dozen are known in the Milky Way, almost all in binaries. We present POPKIN, a Python framework that couples single- and binary-star evolution with Galactic orbital dynamics to trace black-hole progenitors from the zero-age main sequence to the present-day isolated black-hole (IBH) population. Across ten models varying the supernova (SN) prescription, mass-transfer efficiency, and common-envelope ejection efficiency, the total IBH abundance is controlled primarily by the SN prescription. Our fiducial model, with a recently proposed metallicity- and stripping-history-dependent SN prescription, predicts $\sim4\times10^7$ IBHs in the Galaxy, including $\sim8\times10^4$ within $1\,\rm{kpc}$ of the Sun; alternative SN prescriptions predict $\sim(1-2)\times10^8$ IBHs. The fiducial model yields a bimodal mass distribution, peaking near $9\,M_{\odot}$ and $20\,M_{\odot}$, with a deficit at $13-17\,M_{\odot}$. This distinguishes it from alternative prescriptions, some of which populate the $2-5\,M_{\odot}$ mass-gap region. Non-kicked IBHs follow nearly circular orbits near the Galactic pla
items.authors: Jian-Guo He, Yong Shao, Yu-Dong Nie, Gui-Yu Wang, Xiao-Tian Xu, Chen Wang, Xiao-Jie Xu, Xiang-Dong Li

items.title: Probing binary supermassive black hole in quasars tough spectropolarimetry
items.title_zh: 探测类星体中的双超大质量黑洞的光谱极化研究
items.summary_zh: 几乎所有星系中心都被认为存在超大质量黑洞（SMBH）。在星系合并的背景下，来自母星系的SMBH预计会形成一个绑定的双体系统。由于宇宙时间内此类合并的高频率，双SMBH在活跃星系核（AGN）中应相对常见。然而，它们的直接探测仍然是一个主要的观测挑战，大多数候选者仅通过间接特征推断而来。类星体Markarian 231展现出独特的紫外-光学特性，包括在2500 Å附近总通量的异常下降和强烈的波长依赖极化。本文探讨了光谱极化作为探测和表征AGN中SMBH双体的工具的潜力。我们构建了一个简单的解析模型，以重现Markarian 231的光谱能量分布（SED），并计算了相应的总通量和极化通量。我们的目标是测试两个不同源的存在是否能重现Markarian 231观察到的独特紫外-光学特性。这项研究支持未来高灵敏度紫外光谱极化仪的必要性，以探测类星体的内部结构。
items.abstract: Nearly all galaxies are believed to host a supermassive black hole at their center. In the context of galaxy mergers, the SMBHs from the progenitor galaxies are expected to form a bound binary system. Given the high frequency of such mergers throughout cosmic time, binary SMBHs should be relatively common in active galactic nuclei (AGNs). Yet, their direct detection remains a major observational challenge, with most candidates inferred only through indirect signatures. The quasar Markarian 231 presents unique ultraviolet-optical properties, including an atypical drop in the total flux around 2500 A and a strong wavelength-dependent polarization. In this work, we explore the potential of spectropolarimetry as a tool to detect and characterize SMBH binaries in AGNs. We construct a simple analytical model in order to reproduce the spectral energy distribution (SED) of Mrk 231 taking into account a binary SMBHs scenario and we compute the resulting total and polarized flux. Our goal is to test if the presence of two distinct sources can reproduce the unique ultraviolet-optical properties observed in Markarian 231. Such investigations support the case for future high-sensitivity UV spec
items.authors: J. Biedermann, F. Marin

items.title: Potential binary supermassive black holes in Markarian 231 as a scientific case for the spectropolarimeter POLLUX
items.title_zh: Markarian 231中潜在的双超大质量黑洞及其对POLLUX的科学意义
items.summary_zh: 几乎所有星系的核心都被认为存在超大质量黑洞（SMBH）。在星系合并的背景下，来自每个系统的中心SMBH应形成一个引力绑定的双体系统。由于星系合并的频繁发生，活跃星系核中可能存在这样的双SMBH。然而，观测识别它们仍然非常具有挑战性。大多数候选者依赖间接证据而非明确检测。类星体Markarian 231（Mrk 231）因其独特的紫外到光学特性而突出，包括强烈的波长依赖性偏振和在2500Å处的不寻常光通量下降。本研究探讨了光谱偏振法作为识别和表征活跃星系核中SMBH双体的强大工具的潜力。我们开发了一个简化的解析模型，以假设双SMBH几何形状来重现Mrk 231的光谱能量分布，并计算其总和偏振发射。主要目的是测试两个独立发射源是否能解释Mrk 231独特的紫外到光学特征。这项研究强调了未来高灵敏度紫外光谱偏振仪器的重要性。
items.abstract: It is now widely accepted that a supermassive black hole (SMBH) resides in the core of nearly every galaxy. Within the context of mergers of galaxies, the central SMBHs from each system should form a gravitationally bound binary system. Given the frequency of galaxy mergers throughout cosmic time, the existence of such binary SMBHs is likely to occur within active galactic nuclei. However, identifying them observationally remains highly challenging. The majority of reported candidates rely on indirect evidence rather than unambiguous detection. The quasar Markarian 231 (Mrk 231) stands out because of its distinctive ultraviolet to optical properties, which includes a strong wavelength dependent polarization and an unusual flux decrease at 2500A. In this work, we investigate the potential of spectropolarimetry as a powerful tool for identifying and characterizing SMBH binaries in AGNs. We have developed a simplified analytical model to reproduce the spectral energy distribution of the quasar Mrk 231 assuming a binary SMBH geometry, and we compute both its total and polarized emission. The main aim is to test whether two separate emitting sources could explain the unique UV to optica
items.authors: Biedermann. J, Marin. F, Neiner. C, Bouret. Jean-Claude

items.title: Galaxy And Mass Assembly (GAMA): The Most Isolated GAMA Galaxies
items.title_zh: 银河与质量组装（GAMA）：最孤立的GAMA星系
items.summary_zh: 尽管星系通常生活在星系团和小组中，某些星系却显得相对“孤立”，即缺乏近邻。本文利用GAMA调查和客观的孤立度测量，探讨了最孤立的星系，并确定它们是否具有特定的物理特征。研究发现，孤立星系主要是蓝色、盘状和正在形成恒星的类型，而分组星系则分为红色、球状和静止类型。然而，孤立星系与分组星系在恒星形成和恒星种群方面没有显著差异，尤其是在质量控制后。考虑到孤立样本缺乏显著的相互作用，这表明当今所有环境中（至少在富集星系团外）正在形成恒星的星系的演化主要受内部过程主导。
items.abstract: While galaxies generally live in clusters and groups, particularly small groups, or other structures such as walls or filaments, some galaxies appear relatively `isolated', i.e. lacking in close neighbours. Here we use the GAMA survey, and an objective measure of isolation, to explore the most isolated galaxies. We then determine whether these have particular physical characteristics. We find that, as expected, while grouped galaxies split between blue, disk-like and star forming and red, spheroidal and quiescent, isolated galaxies are preferentially the former. However, there is a broad overlap in properties, with some isolated galaxies sharing the latter characteristics. Considering only the star-forming galaxies, when controlled by mass we find no differences between the grouped and isolated galaxies in terms of their star formation and stellar populations. Given the lack of significant interactions for the isolated sample, this implies that the evolution of present-day star-forming galaxies in all environments (at least outside rich clusters) has been, and remains, dominated by internal processes.
items.authors: Steven Phillipps, Roberto De Propris, Malcolm N. Bremer, Phil A. James, Andrew M. Hopkins

items.title: Probing the Metallicity Dependence of Fast Radio Burst Progenitors with CHIME/FRB Outrigger Dwarf Host Galaxies
items.title_zh: 探究快速射电暴宿主星系的金属丰度依赖性
items.summary_zh: 本文利用CHIME/FRB Outriggers在2025年2月至10月间定位的快速射电暴（FRBs），系统搜索矮星系宿主。我们识别并表征了一个重复FRB和七个明显非重复FRB的八个宿主星系，新增将五个宿主分类为矮星系，恒星质量为$\log(M_\ast/M_\odot) \approx 8.1-9.1$。我们测量了它们的气相金属丰度，并与文献中的宿主结合，发现重复和非重复FRB的金属丰度分布在统计上显著不同。非重复FRB栖息于相对金属丰富的环境中（$12 + \rm log( O/H) \gtrsim 8.35$），而重复FRB则显著偏好金属贫乏的矮星系（$12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.35$）。几乎所有与持久射电源（PRS）相关的重复FRB都位于金属丰度$12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.15$的矮星系中，暗示了金属贫乏矮星系中重复FRB与PRS形成之间的联系。我们还计算了54个、37个和24个FRB的宿主色散测量（$\mathrm{DM}_{\rm host}$）、法拉第旋转测量（$\mathrm{RM}_{\rm host}$）和散射时间尺度（$\tau_{\rm host,1~GHz}$）。我们未发现宿主金属丰度与$\mathrm{DM}_{\rm host}$之间存在显著相关性（$>3\sigma$）。
items.abstract: Using the fast radio bursts (FRBs) localized with the CHIME/FRB Outriggers between February and October 2025, we conduct a systematic search for dwarf host galaxies. We identify and characterize eight host galaxies for one repeating and seven apparently non-repeating FRBs, newly classifying five hosts as dwarfs with stellar masses of $\log(M_\ast/M_\odot) \approx 8.1-9.1$. We measure their gas-phase metallicities and, when combined with hosts from the literature, finding that repeating and non-repeating FRBs have statistically distinct metallicity distributions. Non-repeating FRBs inhabit relatively metal-rich environments ($12 + \rm log( O/H) \gtrsim 8.35$) across the full observed mass range, while repeating FRBs have significant preference for dwarf galaxies with $12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.35$. Almost all repeaters associated with persistent radio sources (PRSs) are in dwarfs with $12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.15$, suggesting a connection between repeaters in metal-poor dwarf environments and PRS formation. items.title: AGN winds and outflows: from accretion-disc scales to the host galaxy
items.title_zh: 活动星系核风与喷流：从吸积盘到宿主星系
items.summary_zh: 超快喷流（UFOs）是从活动星系核（AGN）内吸积盘发射的，可能是驱动宿主星系AGN反馈的主要候选者。确定其物理特性和能量学对评估其对星系演化的影响至关重要。本文回顾了近期的观测进展，特别强调了高分辨率X射线光谱学带来的突破性见解。首次的X射线成像和光谱任务（XRISM）/Resolve对AGN风的观测显示，最内层的UFO在运动学上是结构化和不均匀的。在典型类星体PDS 456中，这些观测显著提高了推断的质量喷流率、动量通量和动能。补充的紫外、光学、红外和毫米波观测追踪了从秒差距到星系尺度的AGN驱动喷流的电离、原子和分子相。然而，吸积盘风与星系喷流之间的物理耦合仍然是AGN反馈中的主要未解问题之一。基于XRISM的开创性结果，新阿尔法（NewAthena）的X射线积分场单元（X-IFU）将以前所未有的精度表征吸积盘风的物理特性和能量学。
items.abstract: Ultra-fast outflows (UFOs), launched from the inner accretion disc in active galactic nuclei (AGN), are among the prime candidates for driving AGN feedback in their host galaxies. Determining their physical properties and energetics is therefore essential for assessing their impact on galaxy evolution. This review highlights recent observational progress, with particular emphasis on the groundbreaking insights enabled by high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy. The first X-Ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission (XRISM)/Resolve observations of AGN winds have revealed that the innermost UFOs are kinematically structured and inhomogeneous. In the archetypal quasar PDS 456, these observations have led to a substantial upward revision of the inferred mass outflow rate, momentum flux and kinetic power. Complementary UV, optical, IR and mm observations trace the ionised, atomic and molecular phases of AGN-driven outflows from parsec to galactic scales. However, the physical coupling between the accretion-disc wind and the galactic outflows remains one of the major unresolved questions in AGN feedback. items.authors: Delphine Porquet (Aix Marseille Univ, CNRS, CNES, LAM, Marseille, France)

items.title: Dark matter haloes from dwarf to massive galaxies: no systematic inner-density tension with {\Lambda}CDM hydrodynamical simulations
items.title_zh: 从矮星系到大质量星系的暗物质晕：与{\Lambda}CDM水动力模拟无系统内密度张力
items.summary_zh: 冷暗物质（CDM）范式面临的两个主要小尺度挑战是尖峰-核心问题和旋转曲线多样性问题。前者涉及许多星系推断出的浅内暗物质密度分布与无碰撞CDM预测的尖峰之间的差异，后者则关注观测到的内暗物质密度和旋转曲线形状的广泛变化。我们分析了一组气体贫乏的卫星星系的内暗物质分布，覆盖了6个数量级的星体质量$M_\ast$。结果发现，暗物质核心大小和核心程度存在显著散布，尖峰和核心晕在广泛的$M_\ast$范围内均有出现。核心的能量与恒星反馈一致，要求超新星能量耦合效率在0.1-1\%的范围内。与NIHAO、FIRE-2和EDGE模拟的比较显示，观测和模拟星系的内暗物质密度及对数斜率广泛一致，主要差异在于一些大质量模拟星系的陡峭斜率和SHMR的差异。
items.abstract: Two of the most prominent small-scale challenges to the cold dark matter (CDM) paradigm are the cusp-core and diversity-of-rotation-curves problems. The former concerns the shallow inner DM density profiles inferred for many galaxies compared with the cusps predicted by collisionless CDM, while the latter concerns the wider range of inner DM densities and rotation curve shapes inferred observationally than hydrodynamical simulations traditionally reproduce. Robust observational constraints on DM core sizes and halo densities are therefore essential for testing both the nature of DM and the impact of galaxy formation processes. We analyse the inner DM distribution of a curated sample of 48 gas-rich galaxies and 8 Milky Way gas-poor satellites, spanning 6 orders of magnitude in $M_\ast$. We find substantial scatter in DM core sizes and degrees of coreness, with both cuspy and cored haloes occurring over a broad $M_\ast$ range. The cores are energetically consistent with stellar feedback, requiring modest supernova energy coupling efficiencies of order $0.1-1\%$. Comparisons with the NIHAO, FIRE-2, and EDGE simulations reveal broad agreement in the inner DM densities and logarithmic s

items.title: Accretion Disks in Schwarzschild-MOG and Kerr-MOG Backgrounds: MOG Parameter in terms of Observational Quantities
items.title_zh: 施瓦茨希尔德-MOG与克尔-MOG背景下的吸积盘研究
items.summary_zh: 我们在标量-张量-矢量引力（MOG）框架下研究静态和旋转黑洞解。结果得出施瓦茨希尔德-MOG黑洞的质量$M$、MOG耦合参数$\alpha$和距离$D$与吸积盘的可测量元素（总频移、望远镜孔径角和红移迅度）之间的精确解析关系。这些表达式适用于接近中线和视线的粒子，其中红移迅度被视为相对不变量，编码了频移相对于发射者固有时间的演化。我们进一步扩展到旋转的克尔-MOG几何，获得相应关系以联合确定旋转参数$a$、$M$、$\alpha$和$D$。在旋转背景下，引入红移加速度（广义相对论中的加速度）以解开时空参数。关键在于这些公式中$\alpha$的显式出现，使得该参数的直接经验估计成为可能，从而提供了检验标准广义相对论偏离的手段。当前研究集中于围绕施瓦茨希尔德黑洞旋转的重测试粒子的测地线运动。
items.abstract: We apply a general relativistic framework to static and rotating black hole solutions in Scalar-Tensor-Vector Gravity or modified gravity (MOG). Our results yield exact analytic, closed-form relations expressing the mass $M$, the MOG coupling parameter $\alpha$, and the distance $D$ of a Schwarzschild-MOG black hole in terms of a minimal set of directly measurable elements of the accretion disk: the total frequency shift, the telescope aperture angle, and the redshift rapidity. The resulting expressions are derived for particles close to the midline and line of sight, where the redshift rapidity is treated as a relativistic invariant encoding the evolution of the frequency shift with respect to the emitter's proper time in MOG spacetime. We further extend the formalism to the rotating Kerr-MOG geometry and obtain corresponding relations that determine the rotation parameter $a$ jointly with $M$, $\alpha$, and $D$ on the midline. In the rotating background, we introduced the redshift acceleration (general-relativistic version of jerk) to disentangle the spacetime parameters. Crucially, the explicit appearance of $\alpha$ in these formulas enables direct empirical estimation of this

items.title: The non-equilibrium condensate-like state in multi-mode driven dissipative superconducting quantum circuit
items.title_zh: 多模驱动耗散超导量子电路中的非平衡凝聚态
items.summary_zh: 传统单模开放量子系统模型的有效衰减率无法准确描述模间交换与环境引起的耗散，因此无法清晰观察目标模的占据路径或辅助模的瞬时参与。同时，也无法解决电路设计导致的选择性耗散路径。为了解决上述问题，我们采用基于fluxonium-transmon-transmon (FTT)的三模模型来描述超导量子电路中耗散谱的动态特性。通过周期性磁通调制，我们发现目标fluxonium从高占据的非平衡凝聚态转变为低占据的平衡玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态（BEC）的模间占据转移和环境释放路径。在调整辅助模的过程中，我们进一步获得了额外的选择性环境耗散路径，而不增加目标模的内在损耗。我们的模型为可控耗散超导量子电路中的非平衡态恢复提供了新的设计视角。
items.abstract: The effective decay rate of traditional single mode model for an open quantum system can't accurately described the exchange between intermodes and dissipation caused by the environment,therefore we can not clearly see the occupation pathway of target mode or the transient participation of auxiliary modes.At the same time,we also can't address the selective dissipation pathways resulting from the circuit design.In order to solving above problem,we adopt fluxonium-transmon-transmon (FTT)-based three mode model to describe dynamical characteristics of dissipation spectrum in superconducting quantum circuits.In terms of periodic flux modulation,we find out the pathways of intermode occupation transfer and environmental release for the target fluxonium changes from a high occupation nonequilibrium condensate-like state to low occupation equilibrium Bose-Einstein condensation(BEC)state.Without increasing the intrinsic loss of the target mode in the process of adjusting the auxiliary mode,we furthermore obtain additional selectively engaged environmental dissipative pathway.Our model can provides a new design perspective for non-equilibrium state recovery in a controllable dissipation su

items.title: Observation of Universal Quantum Chaos at Shallow Depths
items.title_zh: 浅层深度下的普遍量子混沌观察
items.summary_zh: 普遍统计规律是量子混沌的标志，通常与空间结构的丧失相关。本文理论和实验表明，在混沌量子电路中，普遍性在浅层深度就已出现。我们推导了输出概率波动的普遍分布，并在可编程超导处理器上进行了测试。二维晶格、开放的一维链和周期环展现出不同的普遍性类别，保留几何和边界拓扑的特征，直到完全随机矩阵行为出现。在每个类别中，分布仅依赖于两个参数：有效的多体Thouless长度和累积的无相干误差数量。直接从测量的比特串频率中提取这些参数，可以获取混乱程度、目标态的纠缠增长和全局保真度，而无需重建或经典模拟已实现的电路。我们还识别了一个噪声驱动的转变，区分保留系统范围量子关联的输出统计和可由独立小块重现的统计。我们的结果确立了有限深度普遍性作为探测量子处理器深层性质的实用工具。
items.abstract: Universal statistical laws are a hallmark of quantum chaos, usually associated with the loss of spatial structure. Here we show, theoretically and experimentally, that universality emerges already at shallow depths in chaotic quantum circuits. We derive universal distributions of output-probability fluctuations and test them on a programmable superconducting processor. Two-dimensional lattices, open one-dimensional chains, and periodic rings exhibit distinct universality classes, retaining signatures of geometry and boundary topology before full random-matrix behavior emerges. Within each class, the distributions depend on only two parameters: an effective many-body Thouless length and the accumulated number of incoherent errors. Extracting these directly from measured bitstring frequencies provides access to scrambling, entanglement growth of the target state, and global fidelity, without reconstructing or classically simulating the implemented circuit. We also identify a noise-driven transition between output statistics retaining system-wide quantum correlations and those reproducible by independent small patches. Our results establish finite-depth universality as a practical too
items.authors: Arman Sauliere, Guglielmo Lami, Hugo L\'oio, Thomas J. Maldonado, Shashwat Kumar, Pedram Roushan, Andrea De Luca, Jacopo De Nardis

items.title: Quantum computational advantage in random-circuit sampling on IBM superconducting quantum computers
items.title_zh: IBM超导量子计算机中的随机电路采样量子计算优势
items.summary_zh: 我们在120量子比特的Nighthawk r2超导处理器（\textit{ibm\_phoenix}）上进行了前向随机电路采样（RCS），使用61个量子比特、原生CZ门和标准云执行堆栈，未进行特定基准校准。两个独立的保真度估计器——镜像基准测试和三、四补丁交叉熵基准测试（XEB）——在每个测量深度上相互一致，镜像在4到40个周期之间，补丁估计器在20到40个周期之间，保真度衰减超过两个数量级，并且在固定深度上超过第一代Nighthawk r1设备一个数量级。36周期电路处于张量网络收缩成本饱和的深度：与已发布的Sycamore和Zuchongzhi网络验证的收缩成本估计器显示单幅度成本约为$\sim$$10^{22}$个复数操作。在有利的记忆假设下，$F_{\mathrm{XEB}}(36)=2.3\times10^{-3}$意味着在有界保真度拒绝采样模型中需要$1.2\times10^{27}$个机器操作——相当于在Frontier超级计算机上运行一个多世纪——以收集$10^{6}$样本集，而在Nighthawk r2上仅需19秒。我们认为这是在普通随机电路采样中首次展示量子优势。
items.abstract: We report forward random-circuit sampling (RCS) on the 120-qubit Nighthawk r2 superconducting processor (\textit{ibm\_phoenix}) with square-lattice connectivity, using 61 qubits, native CZ gates, and the standard cloud execution stack with no benchmark-specific calibration. Two independent fidelity estimators---mirror benchmarking and three- and four-patch cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB)---agree with each other at every measured depth, the mirror from 4 to 40 cycles and the patched estimators from 20 to 40 cycles, across more than two orders of magnitude of fidelity decay, and exceed the first-generation Nighthawk r1 device by more than an order of magnitude at fixed depth. The 36-cycle circuits sit at the depth where tensor-network contraction cost saturates at system size: a contraction-cost estimator validated against the published Sycamore and Zuchongzhi networks places the single-amplitude cost at $\sim$$10^{22}$ complex operations. At $F_{\mathrm{XEB}}(36)=2.3\times10^{-3}$ under favorable memory assumptions this implies $1.2\times10^{27}$ machine operations within the bounded-fidelity rejection-sampling model --- more than a century of runtime on the Frontier supercomputer
items.authors: Tigran Sedrakyan, Yuxuan Zhang, Hovnatan Karapetyan, Joshua D. Baktay, Hrant Gharibyan, Hayk Tepanyan

items.title: Fundamental Physics at the Frontier of Noisy Quantum Computation
items.title_zh: 噪声量子计算前沿的基础物理研究
items.summary_zh: 量子计算为基础物理研究提供了一种新的方向，超越了经典数值方法和传统可观测量。实现这一潜力需要直接应对当前量子计算机的噪声限制。本文展示了在量子模拟和量子信息应用于基础物理研究中的几项进展。首先，利用量子计算机模拟量子场论中的碰撞，采用新的波包准备、时间演化和误差缓解技术，实现了迄今为止最大有效电路体积的模拟，首次提供了非弹性粒子产生的数值证据。其次，研究量子信息理论量在物理过程中的作用，纠缠和魔法量被证明能够探测散射和强子化动力学中的相互作用。最后，精确研究需要全面量化算法和硬件的不确定性，这是量子模拟成熟的重要目标。
items.abstract: Quantum computing offers a new, orthogonal direction for investigating fundamental physics, extending beyond classical numerical methods and conventional observables. Realizing this potential requires directly confronting the noise limiting currently available quantum computers. Progress rests on advancing algorithms, interpreting their results, and managing their errors together. This thesis presents several advancements in the use of quantum simulation and quantum information to probe fundamental physics. The first is in the use of quantum computers to simulate collisions in quantum field theories. Central to these simulations are new wavepacket preparation, time evolution, and error mitigation techniques, which allow for simulations with some of the largest effective circuit volumes to date. These methods enable the first quantum simulation providing numerical evidence for inelastic particle production, a key process in fundamental physics. The second advancement centers on the role quantum-information-theoretic quantities play in physical processes. Beyond mere correlations with the physics of the process, entanglement and magic are shown to probe the interactions present in sc

items.title: Reconfigurable bus-based quantum router for modular superconducting processors
items.title_zh: 可重构的基于总线的量子路由器用于模块化超导处理器
items.summary_zh: 扩展超导量子处理器需要提供非局部连接性和并行纠缠操作的互连。最近邻耦合要求远程交互通过SWAP网络路由，增加了本征两量子比特门的数量，并可能延长电路的临界路径。本文提出了一种基于总线的可重构量子路由器，用于模块化超导处理器。可调通量SQUID耦合器选择性地将接口量子比特连接到两个共享总线，允许破坏性干涉抑制闲置交互，同时支持两个不相交的受控-$Z$（CZ）门并行操作。全系统哈密顿量模拟显示并行门误差达到$10^{-3}$，开放系统分析确定了高保真操作的相干性要求。针对36量子比特的量子傅里叶变换（QFT）、QAOA-MaxCut和随机配对电路，路由器相较于匹配的二维网格将中位数SWAP计数减少了最多$34\%$，本征CZ计数减少了最多$20\%$。端到端深度的减少依赖于电路，对于QAOA-MaxCut达到$20\%$，而对于QFT则保持在微不足道的水平。结果表明，增强的连接性和可调度的并行性具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Scaling superconducting quantum processors requires interconnects that provide both non-local connectivity and parallel entangling operations. Nearest-neighbour couplings require distant interactions to be routed through SWAP networks, increasing the native two-qubit-gate count and potentially extending the circuit critical path. Here we introduce a bus-based reconfigurable quantum router for modular superconducting processors. Flux-tunable SQUID couplers selectively connect interface qubits to two shared buses, allowing destructive interference to suppress idle interactions while supporting two disjoint controlled-$Z$ (CZ) gates in parallel. Full-system Hamiltonian simulations yield parallel-gate errors at the level of $10^{-3}$, and open-system analysis identifies the coherence requirements for high-fidelity operation. We further assess the circuit-level consequences using hardware-aware compilation and resource-constrained scheduling. For 36-qubit quantum Fourier transform (QFT), QAOA-MaxCut and random-pairing circuits, the router reduces the median SWAP count by up to $34\%$ and the native CZ count by up to $20\%$ relative to a matched two-dimensional grid.
