items.title: 100 million photons per second from a single organic molecule
items.title_zh: 每秒从单个有机分子发射1亿个光子
items.summary_zh: 在低温条件下，有机单光子源（SPSs）具有傅里叶极限发射、几乎无限的光稳定性以及可通过分子设计选择的发射波长，因而在量子计量、安全通信和光子量子信息处理方面具有吸引力。然而，它们与光子微结构的高效集成仍然面临挑战，限制了在低温操作下从单个有机发射体收集光子。本文展示了一种低温平面金属-介电天线，能够高效地将单个二苯并四氮杂烯（DBT）分子的发射引导至收集光学系统。该装置的收集效率达到97%，每秒向第一透镜输送1亿个光子。在强连续波（CW）和脉冲激励下，我们测得傅里叶极限跃迁的光子不可区分性为91.2%，同时保持97.7%的高单光子纯度。这些结果确立了有机分子作为单光子生成的高性能平台，并为可扩展的有机量子光子技术迈出了重要一步。
items.abstract: At cryogenic temperatures, organic single-photon sources (SPSs) offer Fourier-limited emission, virtually unlimited photostability, and emission wavelengths selectable by molecular design, making them attractive for quantum metrology, secure communication, and photonic quantum information processing. However, their efficient integration with photonic microstructures has remained challenging, limiting photon collection from single organic emitters under cryogenic operation. Here, we demonstrate a cryogenic planar metallo-dielectric antenna that efficiently directs the emission of a single dibenzoterrylene (DBT) molecule towards the collection optics. The device reaches a collection efficiency of 97% and delivers 100 million photons per second into the first lens. We measure a photon indistinguishability for the Fourier-limited transition of 91.2% while maintaining a high single-photon purity of 97.7% under strong continuous-wave (CW) and pulsed excitation. These results establish organic molecules as a high-performance platform for single-photon generation and represent an important step towards scalable organic quantum photonic technologies.
items.authors: Siwei Luo, Tim Hebenstreit, Alexey Shkarin, Jan Renger, Tobias Utikal, Stephan Goetzinger

items.title: Loan Portfolio Optimization with Variational Quantum Algorithms
items.title_zh: 变分量子算法下的贷款组合优化研究
items.summary_zh: 贷款组合优化（LPO）旨在寻找在满足实际选择约束的同时最小化信用风险的投资组合。考虑到组合层面的风险，需要建模预期损失、损失变异性和借款人违约相关性，这导致了一个规模庞大的组合优化问题，其复杂性随着组合规模的增加而迅速增长。本文将LPO形式化为一个二次约束二进制优化（QCBO）问题，联合捕捉预期和意外损失，并将其转化为适合变分量子优化的二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型。为应对当前量子硬件的量子比特资源限制，我们采用保利相关编码（PCE），使大量组合选择变量能够用相对较少的量子比特表示。我们在包含2012名借款人的真实微型金融数据集上评估了该框架。对于最多包含1000个组合选择变量的问题实例，我们在匹配时间预算下，将变分量子算法（VQA）的经典模拟与Google OR-Tools进行了基准测试，获得了目标值差距约为40%的可行组合。我们进一步在超导量子硬件上实现了该框架，处理了最多包含1500个变量的实例。
items.abstract: Loan portfolio optimization (LPO) seeks portfolios that minimize credit risk while satisfying practical selection constraints. Accounting for portfolio-level risk requires modeling not only expected losses but also loss variability and borrower-default correlations, leading to a large-scale combinatorial optimization problem whose complexity grows rapidly with portfolio size. In this work, we formulate LPO as a Quadratic Constrained Binary Optimization (QCBO) problem that jointly captures expected and unexpected losses and transform the resulting formulation into a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) model suitable for variational quantum optimization. To address the limited qubit resources of current quantum hardware, we employ Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE), which enables a large number of portfolio-selection variables to be represented using comparatively few qubits. The proposed framework is evaluated on a real-world microfinance dataset comprising 2012 borrowers. For problem instances with up to 1000 portfolio-selection variables, we benchmark classical simulations of a variational quantum algorithm (VQA) against Google OR-Tools under matched time budgets, obt
items.authors: Balaganchi A. Bhargava, Kamlesh Kumar, Gouranga Dinda, Aniruddha Biswas, Vijay S. Rao, Debarag Banerjee, Arun Sehrawat

items.title: Characterization and Active Control of Position-Dependent Timing Dynamics in Superconducting Strip Detectors
items.title_zh: 超导条形探测器中位置依赖时序动态的表征与主动控制
items.summary_zh: 超导条形单光子探测器（SSPDs）作为传统纳米线探测器的可扩展宽条变体，展现出改善的光学填充因子和增强的信噪比等实际优势。然而，支配这些微尺度几何形状的基本探测物理仍然未被充分探索。本文研究了一种20微米宽的钨硅化物SSPD的光响应，展示了在532纳米时的时序抖动为13.2皮秒，在1550纳米时为20.5皮秒，同时在1550纳米下内部检测效率达到饱和。通过聚焦自由空间光学扫描，我们揭示了探测器时序抖动受边缘与中心吸收事件之间空间依赖的斜率强烈影响。为减轻这一影响，我们采用并行超导轨道架构主动重新分配超电流。这种原位调节最小化了延迟不匹配，并减轻了热激活的内在暗计数，扩展了设备在更高温度下的工作能力。最后，将这些动态与时间依赖的金兹堡-兰道（TDGL）模型进行比较，阐明了位置依赖光响应的物理起源，强调了超导轨道或专用读出电子学如何减轻对时序抖动的负面影响。
items.abstract: Superconducting strip single-photon detectors (SSPDs) have emerged as scalable, wide-strip variants of traditional nanowire counterparts. Despite practical advantages including improved optical fill factors and enhanced signal-to-noise ratios the fundamental detection physics governing these micro-scale geometries remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the underlying photoresponse of a 20 um-wide tungsten silicide SSPD, demonstrating a slew-rate-corrected timing jitter of 13.2 ps at 532 nm and 20.5 ps at 1550 nm, alongside saturated internal detection efficiency up to 1550 nm. Using focused free-space optical scanning, we reveal that detector timing jitter is strongly influenced by a spatially dependent slew rate between edge and center absorption events. To mitigate this impact, we utilize a parallel superconducting rail architecture to actively redistribute supercurrent. This in-situ tuning minimizes the latency mismatch and mitigates thermally activated intrinsic dark counts, extending the device's ability to operate at higher temperatures. Finally, comparing these dynamics with time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau (TDGL) modeling elucidates the physical origins of the posit
items.authors: Sahil R. Patel, Kristen M. Parzuchowski, Eli Mueller, Boris Korzh, Emanuel Knehr, Adam N. McCaughan, Martin J. Stevens, Matthew D. Shaw, Jason P. Allmaras

items.title: Classical Sufficiency in Quantum Statistical Experiments
items.title_zh: 量子统计实验中的经典充分性
items.summary_zh: 量子测量将量子统计实验转化为经典实验，但不同的测量通常会产生不同的统计信息。我们引入量子到经典的充分性：相对于指定的测量类，如果某一测量所诱导的经典实验在统计上优于该类中其他所有测量，则该测量是充分的。这一方法将量子推断的两个组成部分分开：通过对称性或决策理论论证减少测量类，以及通过实验级充分性条件识别简约类中的典型测量。我们建立了一个因子分解标准，其中参数仅通过正交块分解的权重进入群体平均实验。块标签测量相对于所有不变测量是充分的。对于单位共轭下的张量积模型，这识别出弱Schur采样作为谱推断的充分测量。结合风险保持的对称化，它将所有测量的不变贝叶斯和最小最大问题精确简化为基于Young图的经典决策问题。我们推导出平滑谱泛函的尖锐一阶渐近贝叶斯和最小最大风险。我们为连续变量中的非紧群作用建立了类似的简化。
items.abstract: A quantum measurement transforms a quantum statistical experiment into a classical one, but different measurements generally yield experiments with different statistical information. We introduce quantum-to-classical sufficiency: relative to a prescribed measurement class, a measurement is sufficient if its induced classical experiment Blackwell-dominates those from every other measurement in the class. This separates two components of quantum inference: reducing the measurement class through symmetry or decision-theoretic arguments, and identifying a canonical measurement in the reduced class by an experiment-level sufficiency condition. We establish a factorization criterion where the parameter enters the group-averaged experiment only through weights of an orthogonal block decomposition. The block-label measurement is then sufficient relative to all invariant measurements. For tensor-product models under unitary conjugation, this identifies weak Schur sampling as the sufficient measurement for spectral inference. Combined with risk-preserving symmetrization, it reduces invariant Bayes and minimax problems over all measurements exactly to classical decision problems based on Youn
items.authors: Samriddha Lahiry

items.title: Twisted Superconducting Quantum Diodes for High Fidelity Anharmonic Qubits
items.title_zh: 扭曲超导量子二极管用于高保真非谐量子比特
items.summary_zh: 在超导电路中，双向信号传播可能导致回反射和回馈，将环境噪声耦合回相干元件，从而降低保真度。非互易超导二极管提供了一种在电路层面抑制此类回散的内在途径。然而，它们的二极管效率和量子集成仍然有限。本文在扭曲的NbSe2中实现了一种量子二极管，研究了其在面内和面外磁场下的表现。仅1度的扭曲就使效率较原始设备提高，达到了27.6%。量子模拟表明，这一中等效率虽然远低于100%的理想值，但在实验上是可行的，并且对于保持量子比特的非谐性和稳定两能级系统是最优的。这些发现表明，最大整流并不总对量子信息有利，为设计扭曲超导体的基本特性以实现低功耗、高保真量子电路建立了新原则。
items.abstract: In superconducting circuits, bidirectional signal propagation can cause back-reflections and back-action that couple environmental noise back to coherent elements, degrading fidelity. Nonreciprocal superconducting diodes provide an intrinsic route to suppress such backscattering at the circuit level. However, their diode efficiency and quantum integration remain limited. Here, we realize a quantum diode in twisted NbSe2 under in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields. A mere 1 degree twist yields an efficiency enhancement over pristine devices, reaching 27.6 percent. Quantum simulations reveal that this intermediate efficiency, well below 100 percent ideal, is both experimentally practical and optimal for preserving qubit anharmonicity and stabilizing two-level systems. These findings show that maximal rectification is not always beneficial for quantum information, establishing a new principle for designing the fundamental properties of twisted superconductors towards low-power, high-fidelity quantum circuits.
items.authors: Han Zhong, Denis Kochan, Igor Zutic, Yingying Wu

items.title: Does fermionic entanglement always outperform bosonic entanglement in dilaton black hole?
items.title_zh: 在引力场中费米子纠缠是否优于玻色子纠缠？
items.summary_zh: 传统上认为，在相对论框架下，费米子纠缠通常优于玻色子纠缠，而玻色子纠缠在极端引力环境中会经历突然消亡。本研究分析了玻色子和费米子GHZ态的真实N体纠缠，采用负性作为测量指标，重点关注与由Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger（GHS）引力子黑洞产生的霍金辐射相互作用的$m$个（$m<N$）成分的情境。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在引力子时空中，玻色场的非引力模式与引力模式之间的量子纠缠强于费米场的相应模式。然而，在引力子黑洞存在下，引力模式与结合的引力和非引力模式之间的量子纠缠对于玻色场而言弱于费米场。最后，玻色场和费米场的全局N体纠缠之间的关系受到引力场强度的影响。本研究揭示了曲率时空中玻色场与费米场量子纠缠的内在关系。
items.abstract: It has traditionally been believed that fermionic entanglement generally outperforms bosonic entanglement in relativistic frameworks, and that bosonic entanglement experiences sudden death in extreme gravitational environments. In this study, we analyze the genuine N-partite entanglement, measured by negativity, of bosonic and fermionic GHZ states, focusing on scenarios where a subset of $m$ ($m<N$) constituents interacts with Hawking radiation generated by a Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GHS) dilaton black hole. Surprisingly, we find that quantum entanglement between the non-gravitational and gravitational modes for the bosonic field is stronger than that in the same modes for the fermionic field within dilaton spacetime. This study challenges the traditional belief that ``fermionic entanglement always outperforms bosonic entanglement" in the relativistic framework. However, quantum entanglement between the gravitational modes and the combined gravitational and non-gravitational modes is weaker for the bosonic field than for the fermionic field in the presence of a dilaton black hole. items.title: Extreme-ultraviolet spectroscopy using quantum logic: a feasibility study for the 1S-2S transition in singly-ionized helium
items.title_zh: 量子逻辑极紫外光谱学：单电离氦1S-2S跃迁的可行性研究
items.summary_zh: 极紫外（XUV）光谱学在精密物理学中代表了一种重要的新方向，具有从基本常数计量到超越标准模型的物理测试等潜在应用。然而，在XUV范围内应用量子控制方法进行精密光谱学仍然是一个开放的挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的量子逻辑（QL）光谱学方法，用于弱XUV跃迁的精密光谱学，并数值验证了其在单电离氦（He$^{+}$）中40.81 eV的1S-2S跃迁的可行性。我们提出了一种基于保罗阱中共捕获的单个He$^{+}$离子和Be$^{+}$离子的方案，通过高次谐波生成（HHG）将频率梳（FC）激光脉冲上转换到XUV。我们研究了一种非破坏性的QL方案来检测1S-2S激发，并将其性能与基于状态选择性电离的破坏性读出进行了比较。我们对XUV光的相位相干性进行了建模，并使用光学腔在HHG之前过滤FC脉冲。我们对捕获离子的运动激发动力学进行了建模，并数值验证了我们在文献中提出的方案，以通过同步离子的经典周期与两个激发脉冲之间的时间延迟来消除第一阶多普勒展宽和反冲位移。
items.abstract: Extreme-ultraviolet (XUV) spectroscopy represents an important new direction in precision physics, with potential applications ranging from the metrology of fundamental constants to tests of physics beyond the Standard Model. However, the application of quantum control methods for precision spectroscopy remains an open challenge in the XUV range. Here we present a novel quantum logic (QL) spectroscopy method for precision spectroscopy of weak XUV transitions, and numerically validate its feasibility for the $1S-2S$ transition at 40.81\,eV in singly-ionized helium (He$^{+}$). We propose a scheme based on a single He$^{+}$ ion co-trapped with a Be$^{+}$ ion in a Paul trap, and He$^{+}$ excitation with pairs of frequency-comb (FC) laser pulses upconverted to the XUV via High-Harmonic Generation (HHG). We investigate a nondestructive QL scheme to detect $1S-2S$ excitation, and compare its performance with a destructive readout based on state-selective ionization. Phase coherence of the XUV light is modelled and an optical cavity is used to filter the FC pulses prior to HHG. items.title: A Spiking Neural Network Model of Elementary Self-Consciousness via Endogenous Default Mode Network Dynamics
items.title_zh: 基于内源性默认模式网络动态的初级自我意识脉冲神经网络模型
items.summary_zh: 理解自我相关认知和基线自我意识的神经生物机制是计算神经科学中的一项基本挑战。本研究提出了一个大规模计算模型，包含一个基于Izhikevich动态的10,000神经元脉冲神经网络（SNN）。该网络分为两个相互作用的子系统：一个感知处理层（5,000个规则脉冲皮层神经元）和一个内源性默认模式网络（DMN）起搏子系统（5,000个内源性爆发神经元）。DMN层通过反映上行脑干神经调节的持续性电流进行调制，维持独立于外部感官输入的内在自律生物电节律。为了表示自上而下的认知调制，突触权重以层级结构设置，使得DMN到网络的投影超过感官层连接。通过使用改进的两步Euler积分方案进行数值模拟，我们展示了内源性起搏器活动如何与瞬态外部感官扰动相互作用，为“自我”的持久自我维持神经表征的出现提供了基本数学框架。
items.abstract: Understanding the neurobiological mechanisms underlying self-referential cognition and baseline self-consciousness remains a fundamental challenge in computational neuroscience. In this work, we propose a large-scale computational model incorporating a 10,000-neuron spiking neural network (SNN) based on Izhikevich dynamics. The network is structured into two interacting subsystems: a sensory processing layer (5,000 regular-spiking cortical neurons) and an endogenous Default Mode Network (DMN) pacemaker subsystem (5,000 intrinsically bursting neurons). The DMN layer is modulated by continuous tonic currents reflecting ascending brainstem neuromodulation, maintaining intrinsic, autonomous bioelectric rhythms independent of external sensory input. To represent top-down cognitive modulation, synaptic weights are hierarchically structured such that DMN-to-network projections exceed sensory-level connections. items.authors: R. Lahoz-Beltra

items.title: Persistent Memory Through Triple-Loop Consolidation Under Stochastic Unit Turnover
items.title_zh: 随机单元更替下的三重循环巩固持久记忆
items.summary_zh: 耗散性认知架构通过持续的能量消耗维持计算，其中耗尽能量的单元会随机替换为新的随机状态。这带来了一个基本挑战：在所有可学习状态周期性被摧毁的情况下，如何保持持久的、特定上下文的记忆？现有的记忆机制如弹性权重巩固、突触智能和基于惊讶的门控依赖于梯度计算，无法应用于不执行梯度计算的系统。我们提出了深度记忆（DM），一种无反向传播的持久记忆机制，通过三重循环巩固周期操作：记录专家特定内容质心、用存储表示初始化替换单元，以及通过持续再进入实现稳定。在测试的范围内，需要通过混合专家（MoE）门控进行离散专家路由，以防止质心收敛导致存储记忆相同。我们推导了完整三重循环的Foster-Lyapunov漂移界限，表明初始化重新调整了更替噪声底线。在对13个区块进行的1007次模拟中：（i）去除稳定的上下文-专家绑定会消除专业化（$\mathrm{MI}=1.10$ vs. $0.001$；$n=91$）；（ii）DM在无记忆情况下实现$R=0.984$ vs. $0.385$（$n=16$）；（iii）持续初始化重建了记忆。
items.abstract: Dissipative cognitive architectures maintain computation through continuous energy expenditure, where units that exhaust their energy are stochastically replaced with fresh random state. This creates a fundamental challenge: how can persistent, context-specific memory survive when all learnable state is periodically destroyed? Existing memory mechanisms -- including elastic weight consolidation, synaptic intelligence, and surprise-driven gating -- rely on gradient computation and are inapplicable to systems that do not perform it. We introduce Deep Memory (DM), a backpropagation-free persistent memory mechanism operating through a triple-loop consolidation cycle: (1) recording of expert-specific content centroids, (2) seeding of replaced units with stored representations, and (3) stabilization through continuous re-entry. Discrete expert routing via Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) gating is required, in the regimes tested, to prevent the centroid convergence that would render stored memories identical. items.title: Central Limit Theorem for Stochastic Nonlinear Heat Equation with Pure-Jump L\'evy White Noise
items.title_zh: 带纯跳跃Lévy白噪声的随机非线性热方程中心极限定理
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了一维随机非线性热方程，该方程由Lévy时空白噪声驱动。我们证明了在某些条件下（$m_1+m_{2p}<\infty$，$p\in(1,\frac{3}{2})$），解的空间平均满足定量和函数中心极限定理。这些结果将抛物安德森模型的高斯波动理论扩展到非线性情形。主要的新特征是由于非线性系数引起的第二Malliavin导数估计中的最小型项。
items.abstract: In this article, we consider the stochastic nonlinear heat equation driven by L\'evy space-time white noise in dimension one. For the spatial average of the solution, we prove quantitative and functional central limit theorems under $m_1+m_{2p}<\infty$ for some $p\in(1,\frac{3}{2})$. These results extend the Gaussian fluctuation theory for the parabolic Anderson model to the nonlinear setting. The main new feature is a minimum-type term in the second Malliavin derivative estimate caused by the nonlinear coefficient.
items.authors: Matis Le Gall, Jinxin Wang

items.title: Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation with L\'evy noise in the Meyer--Zheng topology
items.title_zh: 含Lévy噪声的Smoluchowski-Kramers近似研究
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在有界区域内，受$Q$-维纳过程和具有有限二阶矩的Lévy过程驱动的状态依赖阻尼随机波动方程的Smoluchowski-Kramers近似。当$\varepsilon\to0$时，我们证明$u^\varepsilon$在Meyer-Zheng拓扑下收敛于一个唯一的弱解，该解为超阻尼随机抛物方程。证明依赖于与阻尼系数相关的非线性变换、均匀能量估计和伪路径拓扑下的紧性论证。我们识别出极限方程，该方程包含由状态依赖阻尼引起的经典高斯噪声诱导的漂移，以及由Lévy噪声生成的显式跳跃修正。后者与由非线性阻尼变换引起的典型跳跃流相关的Marcus-to-Itô修正完全一致。
items.abstract: We study the Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation for a stochastic wave equation with state-dependent damping on a bounded domain, driven by both a $Q$-Wiener process and a L\'evy process with finite second moment. As $\varepsilon\to0$, we prove that $u^\varepsilon$ converges in distribution, in the Meyer-Zheng topology, to the unique weak solution of an overdamped stochastic parabolic equation. The proof relies on a nonlinear transformation associated with the damping coefficient, uniform energy estimates, and compactness arguments in the pseudo-path topology. We identify the limiting equation, which contains both the classical Gaussian noise-induced drift caused by state-dependent damping and an explicit jump correction generated by the L\'evy noise. We show that the latter coincides exactly with the Marcus-to-It\^o correction associated with the canonical jump flow induced by the nonlinear damping transformation.
items.authors: Xueru Liu, Qianqian Jiang, Wei Wang

items.title: Boolean threshold functions, neuron capacity, and memory retrieval
items.title_zh: 布尔阈值函数、神经元容量与记忆检索
items.summary_zh: 单个神经元能记住多少信息？神经网络能在不产生错误记忆的情况下检索多少记忆？这些问题与布尔阈值函数的数量有关。本文证明，$n$维布尔阈值函数的数量$T_n$为\[ T_n=2\binom{2^n-1}{n}\bigl(1+O(n^{-99})\bigr)。 \] 单个阈值神经元的容量为$n^2-\log_2(n!)+1+O(n^{-99})$比Kahn--Komlós--Szemerédi的结果中的$O(n)$误差项有所改进。我们还证明，对于随机选择的$v_1,\ldots,v_r$，有\[ \mathbb P\!\left\{ \langle v_1,\ldots,v_r\rangle\cap\{-1,1\}^n =\{\pm v_1,\ldots,\pm v_r\} \right\} =1-O(n^{-99})。 \] 这表明$r=n-1$是一个明显的阈值，几乎所有$r$个记忆的集合中，唯一的基态是这些记忆及其负值，确认了Kalai--Linial--Odlyzko猜想的一个弱形式。
items.abstract: How much information can a single neuron remember? How many memories can neural networks retrieve without creating false memories? These questions are related to a basic question: how many Boolean threshold functions $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(a_0+\langle a,x\rangle)$, $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, are there? In this paper, we show that the number $T_n$ of distinct Boolean threshold functions is \[ T_n=2\binom{2^n-1}{n}\bigl(1+O(n^{-99})\bigr). \] Equivalently, the capacity of a single threshold neuron is $n^2-\log_2(n!)+1+O(n^{-99})$ bits, improving the $O(n)$ error term in the result of Kahn--Koml\'os--Szemer\'edi to $O(n^{-99})$. To prove this, we show that, for $1\le r\le n-1$, and $v_1,\ldots,v_r$ are chosen at random from $\{-1,1\}^n$, \[ \mathbb P\!\left\{ \langle v_1,\ldots,v_r\rangle\cap\{-1,1\}^n =\{\pm v_1,\ldots,\pm v_r\} \right\} =1-O(n^{-99}). \] In the context of the Kanter--Sompolinsky Hamiltonian for memory retrieval, this identifies $r=n-1$ as a sharp threshold, at which, for almost every collection of $r$ memories, the only ground states are these memories and their negatives, confirming a weaker form of the Kalai--Linial--Odlyzko conjecture. items.title: Copula Geometry and Second-Order Calibration of Heavily Right Aggregation
items.title_zh: 重聚合的Copula几何与二阶校准研究
items.summary_zh: 在未知依赖性下，重尾$p$-值组合检验因其零假设尾部在缺乏确切依赖分布时仍具一阶鲁棒性而受到关注。然而，这种鲁棒性并未解决校准问题：$\Pr\{T>q(\alpha)\}=\alpha+o(\alpha)$既无法量化剩余的大小误差，也无法确定其符号。我们为正半柯西和倒数（或调和均值）聚合发展了二阶校准理论。经过精确的边际标准化，极值依赖性通过坐标面格上的指数-1测度表示。其支持区分了轴向、全内、适当面和混合几何。Möbius分解展示了非紧加权半空间如何探测每个面，而定量面极限则决定了校正是否可积、临界放大或不可积。通过共同因子反演和尾部到校准的映射，该理论的工具可应用于超越单个参数copula家族。研究结果包括可积隐藏面转移定理、明确的高面控制的尖锐固定维局部角定理、共同重因子定理，以及相对于独立性的大小和临界值扩展。高斯、标准多元$t$、正克莱顿和最大线性配对冲击模型展现出不同的幂、对数和径向特性。
items.abstract: Heavy-tailed $p$-value combination tests are attractive under unknown dependence because their null tails can be first-order robust even when the exact dependent null distribution is unavailable. That robustness does not resolve calibration: $\Pr\{T>q(\alpha)\}=\alpha+o(\alpha)$ neither quantifies the remaining size error nor determines its sign. We develop a second-order calibration theory for positive Half-Cauchy and reciprocal, or harmonic-mean, aggregation. After exact marginal standardization, extremal dependence is represented by an index-one exponent measure on the coordinate-face lattice. Its support separates axial, full-interior, proper-face, and mixed geometries. A M\"obius decomposition shows how the noncompact weighted half-space probes every face, while quantitative face limits determine whether the correction is integrable, critically amplified, or nonintegrable. With common-factor inversion and a tail-to-calibration map, this yields machinery applicable beyond individual parametric copula families. The results include an integrable hidden-face transfer theorem, a sharp fixed-dimensional local-corner theorem with explicit higher-face control, a common-heavy-factor th
items.authors: Tianle Liu

items.title: Refinements of Peck's theorem on simultaneous approximation to algebraic numbers
items.title_zh: 对Peck定理在代数数同时逼近中的改进
items.summary_zh:
设$n$为整数且$n\ge2$，$E$为一个度数为$n+1$的实代数数域。设$\alpha_1, \ldots , \alpha_n$为$E$中的实数，使得$(1,\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$是$E$在${\mathbb Q}$上的线性基。定义满足条件的实数$
u_1, \ldots, 
u_{n-1}$，并建立了存在仅依赖于$\alpha_1, \ldots , \alpha_n$的实数$C$和无穷多个整数$Q \ge 2$，使得$$Q^{1/n}\Vert Q\alpha_i\Vert \le C (\log Q)^{-
u_i}, \quad 1\le i\le n-1, \quad Q^{1/n}\Vert Q\alpha_n\Vert\le C.$$ 该结果部分回答了Peck的猜想，Peck在1961年证明了当$
u_1 = \ldots = 
u_{n-1} = 1/ (n-1)$时的特殊情况。同时，我们改进了de Mathan和Teulié在2004年关于非阿基米德值的同时丢番图逼近问题的结果。
items.abstract:
Let $n$ be an integer with $n\ge2$, and let $E$ be a real algebraic number field of degree $n+1$ over ${\mathbb Q}$. Let $\alpha_1, \ldots , \alpha_n$ be real numbers in $E$ such that $(1,\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ is a linear basis of $E$ over ${\mathbb Q}$. Let $
u_1, \ldots, 
u_{n-1}$ be real numbers satisfying $$0<\max_{1\le i\le n-1}
u_i\le2\min_{1\le i\le n-1}
u_i,\quad 
u_1+ \ldots +
u_{n-1}=1. $$ We establish that there exist a real number $C$, depending only on $\alpha_1, \ldots , \alpha_n$, and infinitely many integers $Q \ge 2$ satisfying the inequalities $$Q^{1/n}\Vert Q\alpha_i\Vert \le C (\log Q)^{-
u_i}, \quad 1\le i\le n-1, \quad Q^{1/n}\Vert Q\alpha_n\Vert\le C.$$ This answers partially a conjecture of Peck, who proved in 1961 this statement in the particular case where $
u_1 = \ldots = 
u_{n-1} = 1/ (n-1)$. We also improve a result from 2004 of de Mathan and Teuli'e on a question of simultaneous Diophantine approximation involving a non-Archimedean valuation.
items.authors: Yann Bugeaud, Bernard de Mathan

items.title: A geometric proof of Peck's theorem
items.title_zh: Peck定理的几何证明
items.summary_zh: 假设$d\ge 2$，且$1,\alpha_1,\ldots ,\alpha_d$是一个实代数数域的基。Peck在1961年的定理表明，\[\liminf_{n\rightarrow\infty}n\log n\,\|n\alpha_1\|\cdots\|n\alpha_d\|\ < \infty.\] 本文旨在将Peck的证明重新构建在一个直观的几何框架中，通过一次应用Minkowski凸体定理来得出结果。我们还将解释如何对这种方法进行简单修改，从而立即得到de Mathan、Teulié和Bugeaud关于代数数的$d$-元$p$-adic Littlewood猜想的新证明。最后，通过改变凸体的形状，我们在Peck同一论文中提出的关于不均匀分配对数节省的猜想上取得进展。我们证明了该猜想在每个具有自然基的实双二次域中成立，并在涉及的因子大小相当时，对任意数域也成立。
items.abstract: Suppose that $d\ge 2$ and that $1,\alpha_1,\ldots ,\alpha_d$ is a basis for a real algebraic number field. A theorem of Peck from 1961 establishes that \[ \liminf_{n\rightarrow\infty}n\log n\,\|n\alpha_1\|\cdots\|n\alpha_d\|\ < \infty.\] The goal of this paper is to recast Peck's proof in an intuitive geometric framework, where the result follows from a single application of the Minkowski convex body theorem. We will also explain how a simple modification of this approach leads immediately to new proofs of results of de Mathan, Teuli\'{e}, and Bugeaud regarding the $p$-adic Littlewood conjecture for $d$-tuples of algebraic numbers. Finally, changing the shape of the convex body allows us to make progress on a conjecture raised by Peck in the same paper, about distributing the logarithmic savings unequally among the coordinates. We prove the conjecture for every real biquadratic field with its natural basis, and for an arbitrary number field when the factors involved are of comparable size.
items.authors: Kavita Dhanda, Josh Flynn, Alan Haynes

items.title: Proof of the positive trace gap conjecture
items.title_zh: 正迹间隙猜想的证明
items.summary_zh: 我们证明了在 $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ 或 $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ 中的一个格 $\Gamma$ 具有正迹间隙，即其迹是均匀分离的，当且仅当它源自一个可接受的四元数代数。对于紧可压的福克斯群，这证明了 Geninska 和 Leuzinger 在 2008 年归于 Sarnak 的正迹间隙猜想。如果迹的差集不是稠密的，则四元数代数的同样特征依然成立。我们的方法还为每个 $d \ge 3$ 的 $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$ 中的格提供了类似结果：一个格 $\Gamma < \mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$ 具有正迹间隙，当且仅当其所有迹都是整数。等价地，在共轭后，它在一个中心简单代数的单位范数群中具有有限指数，该代数的次数为 $d$，并且在 $\mathbb{R}$ 上分裂。我们还讨论了结果和技术的谱学后果及其他应用。
items.abstract: We prove that a lattice $\Gamma$ in $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ or $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb C)$ has positive trace gap, meaning that its traces are uniformly separated, if and only if it is derived from an admissible quaternion algebra. For cocompact Fuchsian groups, this proves the positive trace gap conjecture attributed to Sarnak by Geninska and Leuzinger in 2008. The same characterization by quaternion algebras holds if the difference set of traces is not dense. Our method also gives a similar result for lattices in $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb R)$, for every $d\ge3$: a lattice $\Gamma<\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb R)$ has positive trace gap if and only if all its traces are integers. Equivalently, after conjugation, it has finite index in the norm-one group of an order in a central simple algebra of degree $d$ over $\mathbb Q$ that splits over $\mathbb R$. We also discuss spectral consequences and other applications of the results and techniques.
items.authors: Nikolay Bogachev

items.title: Shrinking-Tube Concentration for Adaptive Markovian Stochastic Approximation
items.title_zh: 自适应马尔可夫随机逼近的收缩管浓度研究
items.summary_zh: 自适应算法在决策过程中不断重塑生成未来数据的动态。本文建立了由自适应马尔可夫链驱动的投影随机逼近的收缩管浓度界限。该界限高概率地保证在选定时间后的每次迭代都保持在目标周围的容忍度内，并且该容忍度随时间收紧。选定时间后任何退出的概率具有多项式衰减的上界，而相应的下界表明在有限二阶矩下，其多项式指数一般无法改进。因此，该结果揭示了容忍度收缩速度与未来退出概率下降速度之间的明确权衡。我们还将分析扩展到具有额外马尔可夫差异噪声和可预测偏差的递归中，展示马尔可夫差异噪声尺度的增长如何减缓退出概率界限的衰减，而可预测偏差则限制了可接受的管道收缩。证明结合了反向核替换、有限时间均方误差界限和分块最大首次退出论证。我们将理论应用于依赖缺货需求的库存学习，并量化数值梯度精度对结果政策的未来可靠性的影响。
items.abstract: Adaptive algorithms increasingly make decisions while reshaping the dynamics that generate their future data. We establish a shrinking-tube concentration bound for projected stochastic approximation driven by an adaptive Markov chain. The bound guarantees, with high probability, that every iterate after a chosen time remains within a tolerance around the target that tightens over time. The probability of any exit after the chosen time admits a polynomially decaying upper bound, and a matching lower bound shows that its polynomial exponent cannot be improved in general under finite second moments. The result therefore identifies a sharp tradeoff between how quickly the tolerance shrinks and how rapidly the probability of any future exit decreases. We also extend the analysis to recursions with additional martingale-difference noise and predictable bias, showing how growth in the martingale-difference noise scale slows the decay of the exit-probability bound while predictable bias restricts the admissible tube shrinkage. The proof combines backward kernel replacement, a finite-time mean-squared-error bound, and a blockwise maximal first-exit argument. We apply the theory to inventory
items.authors: Jin Li, Ye Luo, Xiaowei Zhang

items.title: AI-guided high-throughput discovery of iridium- and ruthenium-free palladium-oxide catalysts for durable acidic oxygen evolution
items.title_zh: AI引导的无铱铑钯氧化物催化剂高通量发现研究
items.summary_zh: 在质子交换膜水电解（PEMWE）阳极催化酸性氧气演化几乎完全依赖于铱或铑，这限制了千兆瓦级的部署。我们报告了一种人工智能（AI）引导的人类监督闭环平台（>90%自动化），整合了组合溅射合成、高通量筛选、机器学习成分-性质模型、自适应多目标优化和上下文感知的大语言模型推理。该平台在1 M H2SO4中以10 mA cm-2对催化剂进行了长期验证，评估了2,942种催化剂在53种材料体系和26种元素中的活性-稳定性权衡，发现了如InMnPdOx和NiTaPdOx等无铱铑复杂氧化物，这些是传统设计逻辑和现成语言模型无法预测的。在长期测试中，NiTaPdOx的过电位低于PdOx，但两者最终均超过0.5 V：PdOx约在200小时，NiTaPdOx约在470小时。InMnPdOx显示出类似的过电位改善，并显著提高了操作稳定性。
items.abstract: Catalyzing acidic oxygen evolution at the proton-exchange-membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) anode relies almost entirely on iridium or ruthenium, drawn from concentrated supply chains that constrain gigawatt-scale deployment. We report an artificial intelligence (AI)-guided, human-supervised closed-loop platform (>90% automation) integrating combinatorial sputter synthesis, high-throughput screening, machine-learning composition-property models, adaptive multi-objective optimization, and context-aware large-language-model reasoning, where lead catalysts advanced to long-term validation in 1 M H2SO4 at 10 mA cm-2. Navigating a combinatorial metal oxide space, the platform iteratively evaluated the activity-stability trade-off of 2,942 catalysts across 53 material systems and 26 elements, surfacing Ir- and Ru-free complex oxides such as InMnPdOx and NiTaPdOx that conventional design logic, and off-the-shelf language models, would not predict. In retrospective benchmarking, our sequential learning agent advanced the activity-stability frontier faster than fixed-policy Bayesian optimization or in-context language-model selection. items.authors: Ken J. Jenewein, Faezeh Habib Zadeh, Xiaoxiao Wang, Gustavo Malkomes, Huafan Zhang, Natalie Page, Jae Jin Bang, Peter J. Santiago, Karla V. Contreras, Katherine K. Li, Allison Perna, Lorena M. Britton

items.title: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of AgTaO3
items.title_zh: 银钽氧化物AgTaO3单晶薄膜的分子束外延生长
items.summary_zh: 我们首次利用分子束外延（MBE）合成了单晶AgTaO3薄膜。在臭氧/氧气气氛（80% O3 + 20% O2）下，通过顺序沉积原子银和TaO2层，在(001)和(111)取向的SrTiO3衬底上生长了高质量的外延AgTaO3薄膜。X射线衍射和倒易空间映射表明，薄膜与SrTiO3衬底之间存在一致的应变，且摇摆曲线锋利，显示出高结构完美性。高角环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（HAADF-STEM）确认了(001)pc取向薄膜的低缺陷一致生长。对于(111)pc取向薄膜，初始一致生长可持续到10 nm，然后转变为富Ta的表面区域。能量色散X射线光谱（EDX）显示两种取向的衬底界面处存在狭窄的阳离子混合区域。本研究展示了单晶AgTaO3薄膜的有效合成途径，为研究银基钽酸盐中的应变工程和新兴界面特性提供了平台。
items.abstract: We report the first synthesis of single-crystal AgTaO3 thin films using molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE). High-quality epitaxial AgTaO3 films were grown on both (001)- and (111)-oriented SrTiO3 substrates using sequential deposition of atomic silver and TaO2 layers under an ozone/oxygen atmosphere (80 % O3 + 20 % O2). X-ray diffrac- tion and reciprocal space mapping demonstrate that the films are coherently strained to the SrTiO3 substrates with sharp rocking curves comparable to the substrates, indicating high structural perfection. High-angle annular dark-field scanning trans- mission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) confirms coherent, low defect growth for (001)pc-oriented films. For (111)pc-oriented films, initial coherent growth proceeds up to 10 nm before transitioning into a Ta-rich surface region. Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) reveals a narrow cation intermixing region at the sub- strate interface for both orientations. This work demonstrates an effective synthesis route for single-crystal AgTaO3 thin films, providing a platform to investigate strain engineering and emergent interfacial properties in silver-based tantalates.
items.authors: Tobias Schwaigert, Joshua Maile, Olivia Peek, Eric Biedke, Paul T. Malinowski, Kyle M. Shen, Salva Salmani-Rezaie, Darrell G. Schlom, Kaveh Ahadi

items.title: Microscopic origin of the Baumg\"artel-Schausberger-Winter Relaxation Spectrum in Polymer Melts and Particle Rafts
items.title_zh: 聚合物熔体与颗粒筏中BSW松弛谱的微观起源
items.summary_zh: 纠缠聚合物熔体表现出稳健的双支Baumgärtel-Schausberger-Winter (BSW)松弛谱，相关谱在非聚合物单分散无序系统中也存在。尽管BSW已成功应用于多种材料，但缺乏其分子推导。我们构建了一种分子理论，其中链段相对于一个屏蔽的、动态响应的多链环境移动。高斯链预平均给出$M_{\rm seg}(\Delta m)\sim(\Delta m)^{-1/2}$，因此$\lambda_p\sim p^{3/2}$，经过应力投影后，$H(\tau)\sim\tau^{-2/3}$。独立的纵向原始路径扩散给出轮廓长度波动，$H(\tau)\sim\tau^{1/4}$。在不拟合谱指数或单个模态权重的情况下，分子量约束的实现同时与四种单分散聚丁二烯(PBD)熔体的实验$G'(\omega)$和$G''(\omega)$数据进行测试。结果显示BSW谱从快速协作到慢速约束更新级联的连续转移，最终到达有限链终端边界。一个共同的双区笼子动力学将聚合物与颗粒筏连接起来，而不假设相同的微观机制。
items.abstract: Entangled polymer melts exhibit the robust two-branch Baumg\"artel-Schausberger-Winter (BSW) relaxation spectrum, while related spectra occur in nonpolymeric monodisperse disordered systems. In spite of the successful application of BSW to many different materials, a molecular derivation of these spectra is lacking. We construct a molecular theory in which a chain segment moves relative to a screened, dynamically responding multichain environment. Gaussian-chain preaveraging gives $M_{\rm seg}(\Delta m)\sim(\Delta m)^{-1/2}$, hence $\lambda_p\sim p^{3/2}$ and, after stress projection, $H(\tau)\sim\tau^{-2/3}$. Independently, longitudinal primitive-path diffusion gives contour-length fluctuations with $H(\tau)\sim\tau^{1/4}$. A molecular-weight-constrained implementation is tested simultaneously against experimental $G'(\omega)$ and $G''(\omega)$ data for four monodisperse polybutadiene (PBD) melts, without fitting spectral exponents or individual modal weights. The resulting BSW spectrum exhibits a continuous transfer from the fast cooperative to the slow constraint-renewal cascade before a finite-chain terminal edge. items.authors: Dario Nichetti, H. Henning Winter, Alessio Zaccone

items.title: Molecular Design and Interface Engineering of Self-Assembled Monolayers for Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells: A Data-Driven Review of Efficiency, Stability and Scalability
items.title_zh: 自组装单层在反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中的分子设计与界面工程
items.summary_zh: 自组装单层（SAMs）已成为反向钙钛矿太阳能电池中不可或缺的空穴传输层，使单结器件的光电转换效率（PCE）超过27%，而串联器件的效率超过32%。本综述提出了八个假设，包括双磷酸酸SAMs在热稳定性方面优于单磷酸酸SAMs，乙二醇醚侧链将改善PCE和稳定性，以及机器学习能够识别出PCE达到27%且在1000小时内保持90%效率的新SAMs。研究表明，以咔唑为基础的SAMs（如Me-4PACz和MeO-2PACz）在该领域占主导地位。共SAM策略通过氢键添加剂持续提高PCE（绝对提高1-3%），而双磷酸酸锚定基团正在成为改善热稳定性和潮湿热稳定性的一种方式。优化的SAM系统在最大功率点跟踪下的操作稳定性现已超过1000小时，尽管ISOS协议的采用仍不一致。
items.abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) have become indispensable hole-transport layers in inverted perovskite solar cells which enables power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) above 27% in single-junction devices and above 32% in tandems where the tandem devices benefit disproportionately from SAM engineering with certified efficiencies exceeding 31%. In the review eight hypotheses have been proposed including the prediction that bisphosphonic acid SAMs will outperform monophosphonic acid SAMs in thermal stability, glycol ether side chains will improve both PCE and stability and machine learning can identify new SAMs with 27% PCE and 90% retention at 1000 h , the studied researches shows that carbazole-based SAMs with phosphonic acid anchoring groups dominate the field with Me-4PACz and MeO-2PACz . Co-SAM strategies that have hydrogen-bonding additives consistently improve PCE by (1–3)% absolute over single-component SAMs and that bisphosphonic acid anchoring groups are emerging as a way to improve thermal and damp heat stability. Operational stability under maximum power point tracking now exceeds 1000 h for optimized SAM systems though ISOS protocol adoption remains inconsistent.
items.authors: Soumyabir Guha

items.title: Topologically-constrained toehold-mediated strand displacement
items.title_zh: 拓扑约束下的踏脚石介导链置换研究
items.summary_zh: 踏脚石介导链置换（TMSD）是合成核酸纳米系统动态驱动的最简单机制，广泛应用于生物传感、分子计算、数据存储与检索及合成生物学。本文研究了一种简单的生理相关配置，其中踏脚石域位于DNA“气泡”中，即两条链在此区域脱配。研究表明，这种拓扑约束使TMSD的速率降低了约1-3个数量级，原因在于TMSD自由能景观的变化。此外，短DNA链与目标复合物的杂交（远离踏脚石域）加速了TMSD，提供了反应速率的变构调节途径。结果强调了拓扑约束对TMSD的显著影响，这些影响在动态纳米结构和分子反应网络的优化设计中必须考虑，同时为精细调节和调控提供了便利策略。
items.abstract: Toehold-mediated strand displacement (TMSD) is regarded as the simplest mechanism through which synthetic nucleicacid nanosystems can be dynamically actuated and is central to applications in biosensing, molecular computing, data storage and retrieval, and synthetic biology. In these implementations, TMSD often occurs in topologically-confined configurations, with the toehold domain being linked to other elements that restrict its conformational freedom. However, the effect of topological confinement on the biophysics of TMSD remains largely unexplored. Here, we study TMSD in a simple, physiologically-encountered configuration in which the toehold domain is located in a DNA ‘bubble’, a region where the two strands of an otherwise continuous DNA duplex are dehybridised. We show that this topological confinement reduces the rate of TMSD by ∼1–3 orders of magnitude as a result of alterations to the TMSD free-energy landscape. We further demonstrate that hybridisation of a short DNA strand to the target complex–away from the toehold domain–speeds up TMSD, hence providing a route for allosteric modulation of the reaction rate. Our results highlight the substantial effect of topological
items.authors: Andrew Stannard, Aditya Sengar, Alexander H. Clowsley, Christian Soeller, Thomas E. Ouldridge, Lorenzo Di Michele

items.title: A Unified Theory for Generalized Step-Growth Polymerization: From Flory’s Equal‑Reactivity to Kinetic Symmetry‑Breaking
items.title_zh: 统一理论揭示广义步增长聚合反应的动力学特征
items.summary_zh: 近九十年来，Flory的等反应性假设一直是步增长聚合统计的基础。然而，现代刚性融合环结构或催化成键机制的单体常常违反这一核心假设，导致分子量异常被错误归因于副反应或杂质。本文通过将AA + BB聚缩合推广到包含动力学增强参数（𝛼）的严格分析框架，解决了这一理论盲点。我们精确求解了无限耦合的动力学网络，推导出化学计量（𝑟）和动力学（𝛼）整个参数空间的封闭形式表达式，揭示了三个宏观规律：首先，在A缺乏侧（𝑟 < 1），反应经历“动力学冻结”；其次，在等摩尔临界点（𝑟 = 1），分散度表现出深刻的奇异性；最后，链长在固定转化率下随喂料比单调增长，最优化学计量关系显现出动态特征。
items.abstract: For nearly nine decades, Flory’s equal-reactivity hypothesis has universally underpinned the statistics of step-growth polymerization. However, modern monomers featuring rigid fused-ring architectures or catalytic bond-forming mechanisms routinely violate this core assumption. Consequently, the resulting molecular-weight anomalies have long been erroneously misattributed to side reactions or impurities, obscuring the underlying kinetic reality. Here, we resolve this theoretical blind spot by generalizing the AA + BB polycondensation into a strict analytical framework encompassing a kinetic enhancement parameter (𝛼). By exactly solving the infinitely coupled kinetic network, we derive closed-form expressions for the entire parameter space of stoichiometry (𝑟) and kinetics (𝛼), unveiling three macroscopic laws. First, a Terminal Dichotomy: on the A-deficient side (𝑟 1), the reaction undergoes "kinetic freezing," permanently archiving the kinetic 𝛼 -fingerprint within the end-cap inventory; conversely, on the A-excess side (𝑟 1 ), the system exhibits "𝛼 -amnesia," where terminal states are dictated solely by stoichiometry. items.title: Bridging the Training–Application Gap in Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian Learning through Dual-Space Supervision
items.title_zh: 通过双空间监督缩小Kohn–Sham哈密顿量学习的训练-应用差距
items.summary_zh: 利用机器学习预测密度泛函理论（DFT）中的Kohn–Sham哈密顿量为高效电子结构建模提供了有前景的途径。现有模型通常通过直接最小化哈密顿矩阵的元素误差进行训练，但在哈密顿空间损失与衍生电子性质误差之间存在显著的训练-应用差距，限制了其在实际应用中的效用。该差距源于哈密顿空间与其诱导状态空间的误差度量不一致。基于Lieb的DFT凸性公式，我们引入双空间损失（DSLoss）来缩小这一差距。DSLoss利用两个空间中的误差度量，使哈密顿优化能够考虑预测算符及其诱导状态的误差。在分子基准测试中，DSLoss在多种衍生性质上始终优于传统的元素级监督。在具有挑战性的∇2DFT基准测试中，电子密度和总能量的表现得到了显著改善。
items.abstract: Predicting the Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian in density functional theory (DFT) via machine learning offers a promising pathway toward efficient electronic structure modeling. Existing models are typically trained by directly minimizing element-wise Hamiltonian matrix errors, yet a significant trainingapplication gap has been observed between Hamiltonian-space loss and errors in derived electronic properties, limiting their utility in practical applications. Noting that these properties are functions on the state space obtained by solving the Hamiltonian eigenvalue problem, this gap can be traced to a misalignment of the error metrics on the Hamiltonian space and its induced state space. The operator-tostate mapping is highly anisotropic, such that Hamiltonian errors of comparable numerical magnitude can induce markedly different downstream property errors. Motivated by the Hamiltonian–state variational duality rooted in Lieb’s convex formulation of DFT, we introduce Dual-Space Loss (DSLoss) to bridge this training–application gap. By leveraging error metrics in both spaces, DSLoss allows Hamiltonian optimization to account for errors in both the predicted operator and its induced state. A
items.authors: Yifei Wang, He Zhang, Xinran Wei, Jingwen Fu, Yongqiang Ma, Miao Kang

items.title: Influence of exchange–correlation functional on machine-learnt interatomic potentials accuracy: a systematic study in borosilicate glasses
items.title_zh: 交换-关联泛函对机器学习原子势准确性的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 机器学习原子势（MLIP）作为加速分子模拟的一种策略，能够在接近经典力场的成本下提供量子化学的准确性。通常，MLIP是在密度泛函理论（DFT）水平获得的参考数据上训练的，但选择交换-关联泛函对相互作用描述的准确性有重要影响，且这一问题在过去的研究中鲜有系统评估。为此，我们选择了多种成分的硼硅酸盐玻璃作为复杂化学系统进行测试，生成了九种不同化学成分的硼硅酸盐玻璃的参考数据集，并使用五种不同的交换-关联泛函（GGA、meta-GGA和混合型）进行研究。我们训练了所有这些玻璃的MLIP，进行熔融淬火制备，并比较了其物理性质。
items.abstract: Machine-learnt interatomic potential (MLIP) has emerged as a strategy to accelerate molecular simulations, offering the promise of quantum chemical accuracy at a cost close to that of classical force fields. They are commonly trained on reference data obtained at the DFT level, which is itself a sufficiently affordable method to generate thousands of configurations and associated energies and atomic forces. However, this approach suffers from an elephant in the room, which is rarely addressed: the choice of exchange–correlation functional. Although it is understood to have a crucial impact on the accuracy of the description of interactions and therefore on the results of the molecular simulations, it has not been systematically evaluated in the past. To go beyond simple benchmarks on selected configurations, we set out to understand the influence of exchange–correlation (XC) functional on the training of MLIPs, and more importantly on the physical properties of the resulting condensed matter systems. items.authors: Fengming Shi, Luca Brugnoli, François-Xavier Coudert

items.title: (N-Hydroxy)amide-Mediated Ligation of Peptides in Chemical Protein Synthesis
items.title_zh: (N-羟基)酰胺介导的肽类连接在化学蛋白质合成中的应用
items.summary_zh: 化学蛋白质合成能够生产结构精确控制的合成蛋白。本文开发了一种高效的化学选择性连接方法，适用于C-末端(N-甲氧基)氨基酰肼与N-末端氨基酰(N-羟基)肽在水相中的连接。该方法包括在pH 3.0、-15°C下对C-末端(N-甲氧基)氨基酰肼进行亚硝酸盐氧化，生成相应的(N-甲氧基)氨基酰叠氮化物；在pH 8.0室温下与N-末端氨基酰(N-羟基)肽进行分子间N,O交换，生成O-酰肽；随后通过六元环内的O,N-酰转移反应得到连接的N-甲氧基(N'-羟基)肽。该方法为化学蛋白质合成提供了新的选择性连接策略。
items.abstract: Chemical protein synthesis enables the production of synthetic proteins with precisely controlled structures. Some chemoselective methods for ligation of peptides in water have been developed thus far, and a variety of target proteins were successfully prepared, in which some specific amino acids such as N-terminal Cys, Ser/Thr or surrogates containing different auxiliaries are usually required at the ligation sites. Therefore, it is highly desirable to develop a chemoselective peptide ligation that is not limited by the specific amino acids at the ligation sites for chemical protein synthesis. In this paper, we have developed an efficient chemoselective ligation between C-terminal peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl hydrazides and N-terminal aminoacyl (N-hydroxy)peptides in water. In this protocol, nitrite oxidation of our prepared C-terminal peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl hydrazides at pH 3.0 at-15 oC afforded the corresponding peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl azides, intermolecular N,O-exchange of the in-situ formed peptide (N-methoxy)aminoacyl azides with N-terminal aminoacyl (N-hydroxy)peptides at pH 8.0 at room temperature afforded O-acyl peptides, and intramolecular O,N-acyl transfer
items.authors: Weifeng Wang, Yue Zhang, Haijun Yang, Hua Fu

items.title: Tweaking the Water Rigidity at Noble Metal Interfaces for Enhanced Alkaline Hydrogen Production via myo-Inositol Coating - A Bioinspired Approach
items.title_zh: 通过肌醇涂层调节贵金属界面的水刚性以增强碱性氢气生产
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种绝缘糖分子肌醇（MI）在水电解中的应用。通过在无氧化物的贵金属表面修饰MI，显著提高了碱性介质中电催化氢气演化反应（HER）的效率。该非永久性表面涂层使铂在碱性介质中的HER活性与酸性介质相当。此外，MI在金电极上的HER增强效应也得到了验证。通过石英晶体微天平研究确认了MI在金和铂上的单层吸附。MI的存在通过破坏氢键网络，在电极-电解质界面引入了弱氢键结合的水分子，操作中的表面增强红外光谱研究证实了这一点。这一方法突显了MI在HER中的独特作用，有效缓解了碱性水电解的动力学限制。
items.abstract: Can an insulating sugar molecule help in water electrolysis? A unique cyclic polyhydroxy sugar myo-Inositol (MI) is used here to modify the oxide-free noble metal surfaces leading to enhanced electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) efficacy in alkaline medium. This non-permanent surface coating approach makes the HER activity of platinum in alkaline medium on par with that in acidic medium. This HER enhancement effect of MI is also demonstrated on another metal electrode, gold. A monolayer adsorption of MI on Au and Pt is verified with quartz crystal microbalance assisted studies. The presence of MI at the metal surface introduces weakly hydrogen bonded water molecules at the electrode-electrolyte interface by disrupting the hydrogen bonding network, as proven by the operando surface enhanced infrared spectroscopy studies. This approach highlights the unique role of MI in HER and effectively mitigates the kinetic limitations of alkaline water electrolysis.
items.authors: Nandita Mohandas, Alex Joseph, Anusha P. P., Rashmi S. Jha, KM. Archana Yadav, Ritesh Haldar

items.title: Collective vibrational strong coupling triggers dissociation reaction by overcoming energy threshold
items.title_zh: 集体振动强耦合克服能量阈值触发解离反应
items.summary_zh: 在振动强耦合（VSC）下的基态反应已成为极化子化学的核心议题之一，但集体VSC下的能量重分配如何转化为化学反应性仍然是一个未解之谜。本文研究了与光学腔耦合的稀水三聚体的振动预解离，采用全维腔准经典轨迹（cav-QCT）模拟，结合从头算质量的势能和偶极矩面。我们证明，集体VSC直接诱导水三聚体的解离，尽管该过程在能量上是禁止的，且通过腔介导的分子间能量转移（VET）实现。值得注意的是，尽管有效的单分子光-物质耦合强度降低，反应性增强在增大集合体规模时仍然可观察到。轨迹分析表明，集体能量转移是微观机制，并揭示了反应产物的量子态分布大致一致。这些发现建立了集体极化子能量传输与化学反应性之间的微观联系，并建议集体VSC作为同时操控反应性和保持产物状态选择性的一种途径。
items.abstract: Ground-state reactions under vibrational strong coupling (VSC) have emerged as one of the central topics in polariton chemistry, yet how the energy redistribution under collective VSC translates into chemical reactivity remains an open question. Here we investigate vibrational predissociation in dilute ensembles of water trimers coupled to an optical cavity using full-dimensional cavity quasi-classical trajectory (cav-QCT) simulations with ab initio-quality potential-energy and dipole-moment surfaces. We demonstrate that collective VSC directly induces an otherwise energetically forbidden dissociation of the water trimer through cavity-mediated intermolecular VET. Remarkably, the enhancement of reactivity remains observable with increasing ensemble size despite reduced effective single-molecule light–matter coupling strength. Trajectory analyses identify collective energy transfer as the microscopic mechanism and reveal largely consistent quantum-state distributions of the reaction products. These findings establish a microscopic link between collective polaritonic energy transport and chemical reactivity, and suggest collective VSC as a route toward simultaneously manipulating rea
items.authors: Mingliang Ding, Ruitao Ma, Dianfang Chen, Yongchang Han, Dong H. Zhang, Qi Yu

items.title: A Congener-Substitution Strategy for Docking Heavy Metal Protein-Ligand Complexes with AutoDock Vina
items.title_zh: 重金属蛋白-配体复合物的对照替代策略
items.summary_zh: 分子对接广泛用于预测配体-蛋白质相互作用，但在过渡金属复合物，尤其是包含第二和第三周期元素的复合物中，其应用受到常用程序（如AutoDock Vina）缺乏明确金属参数化的限制。本文提出了一种简单实用的重金属复合物对接策略：在对接前用其第一周期同类元素替代金属中心（如Ru替换为Fe；Ir替换为Co）。我们将该方法应用于约60个晶体学表征的蛋白-配体复合物数据集，重点验证了从蛋白质数据银行获取的18个晶体学表征的streptavidin/avidin-biotin复合物（4个Ru，14个Ir）。在全数据集（刚性对接）中，实验观察到的结合构象在66%的案例中得以重现，而在streptavidin/avidin-biotin系统（柔性对接）中，晶体学构象在60%的案例中完全或部分重现（Ru系统为3/4，Ir系统为8/14）。尽管结果存在异质性，金属中心的配位几何和更广泛的蛋白-配体相互作用指纹在对接复合物中得到了良好保持。
items.abstract: Molecular docking is widely used to predict ligand-protein interactions, but its application to transition metal complexes, particularly those containing second- and third-row elements, remains limited by the lack of explicit metal parameterization in commonly used programs such as AutoDock Vina. Here, we present a simple, practical strategy for docking heavy transition metal complexes without reparameterization: substituting the metal center with its first-row congener (e.g. Ru → Fe; Ir → Co) prior to docking. We applied this approach to a dataset of approximately 60 crystallographically characterized protein-ligand complexes containing Re, Ru, Os, Rh, Ir, Pt and Pd, and then focused on a streptavidin/avidin-biotin validation set of 18 crystallographically characterized protein-ligand complexes (4 Ru, 14 Ir) retrieved from the Protein Data Bank. The experimentally observed binding pose on the full set (rigid docking) was reproduced in 66% of cases, while for the streptavidin/avidin-biotin systems (flexible docking) the crystallography pose was fully or partially reproduced in 60% of cases (3/4 for the Ru systems and 8/14 for the Ir systems). items.title: Transcriptomic Identification and Functional Assessment of Candidate Host Factors Affecting Akabane Virus Replication
items.title_zh: 转录组学识别与功能评估影响阿卡巴病毒复制的宿主因子
items.summary_zh: 阿卡巴病毒（AKAV）会导致反刍动物的流产、死胎和先天畸形，但马丁-达比牛肾（MDBK）细胞的转录响应及感染相关宿主基因在AKAV复制中的作用尚未完全阐明。本研究通过RNA测序分析了12小时和24小时后感染AKAV的MDBK细胞与时间匹配的假感染细胞。我们识别了在12小时后有119个差异表达基因（DEGs，82个上调和37个下调）和在24小时后有149个DEGs（85个上调和64个下调）。这些DEGs与抗病毒防御、干扰素反应、模式识别受体信号传导、DNA复制、细胞周期调控、染色体组织和代谢相关。RT-qPCR结果与RNA-seq趋势一致。OAS2和ZBP1在12小时后显著上调，ZBP1在24小时后仍显著升高。过表达这两个基因均与AKAV Gc蛋白丰度、病毒RNA水平和感染滴度的降低相关。这些结果定义了AKAV感染MDBK细胞的转录变化。
items.abstract: Akabane virus (AKAV) causes abortion, stillbirth, and congenital malformations in ruminants, yet the transcriptional response of Madin–Darby bovine kidney (MDBK) cells and the roles of infection-responsive host genes in AKAV replication remain incompletely characterized. We profiled AKAV-infected and time-matched mock-infected MDBK cells by RNA sequencing at 12 and 24 h post-infection (hpi). Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were examined using Gene Ontology functional classification and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway enrichment analysis, six DEGs were evaluated by RT-qPCR, and OAS2 and ZBP1 were assessed by overexpression in BHK-21 cells. We identified 119 DEGs at 12 hpi (82 upregulated and 37 downregulated) and 149 at 24 hpi (85 upregulated and 64 downregulated). The DEG sets were associated with antiviral defense, interferon responses, pattern recognition receptor signaling, DNA replication, cell cycle regulation, chromosome organization, and metabolism. RT-qPCR measurements were consistent with the RNA-seq trends. items.authors: Xiangxiang Tan, Miaomiao Zhang, Canyuan Li, Yuanhang Zhang, Ping Li, Han Gao

items.title: Proteomic Analysis Reveals Altitude-Associated Changes in Immune-Related Bioactive Substances in Yak Colostrum
items.title_zh: 牦牛初乳中免疫相关生物活性物质的高原变化蛋白组学分析
items.summary_zh: 牦牛初乳对新生小牛适应青藏高原恶劣环境至关重要。本研究评估了在低（LAT）、中（MAT）和高（HAT）海拔收集的牦牛初乳中的生物活性成分，包括免疫因子、免疫球蛋白、生长因子和抗氧化酶活性。采用定量蛋白组学分析鉴定了与海拔相关的差异表达蛋白（DEPs）及候选通路。结果显示，随着海拔升高，总固体、脂肪、抗氧化酶（SOD、GSH-Px和CAT）、β-Lg、IL-2和IL-6的水平显著增加（p < 0.05），而IL-4、免疫球蛋白（IgG、IgA和IgM）及生长因子（IGF-1和TGF-β）的浓度显著下降（p < 0.05）。在三组比较中，分别鉴定出489、625和246个DEPs，合并后得到1120个独特DEPs。KEGG富集分析显示，LAT与MAT组之间的DEPs主要富集于补体和凝血级联通路（FDR ≤ 0.05）。
items.abstract: Yak colostrum is crucial for the adaptation of newborn calves to the harsh environment of the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. However, the modulation of its bioactive components along altitudinal gradients and the molecular basis remains incompletely understood. This study evaluated the bioactive components including immune factors, immunoglobulins, growth factors, and antioxidant enzyme activities of yak colostrum collected at low (LAT), medium (MAT), and high altitudes (HAT). Furthermore, quantitative proteomic analysis was used to identify differentially expressed proteins and candidate pathways associated with altitude-related variation. The results showed that along the altitudinal gradient, the levels of total solids, fat, antioxidant enzymes (SOD, GSH-Px, and CAT), β-Lg, IL-2, and IL-6 increased significantly (p 0.05). Conversely, the concentrations of IL-4, immunoglobulins (IgG, IgA, and IgM), and growth factors (IGF-1, and TGF-β) exhibited a significant decline (p 0.05). items.authors: Rongfu Song, Mei Du, Shengrong Chen, Linsheng Gui, Chao Yang

items.title: Targeting a Moving Threshold: Antigen Density as a Design Constraint for Particulate Drug Delivery in HER2-Low and HER2-Ultralow Breast Cancer—A Narrative Review
items.title_zh: 靶向移动阈值：抗原密度在HER2低表达乳腺癌药物递送中的设计约束
items.summary_zh: 曲妥珠单抗德鲁克单抗使得HER2表达极低的乳腺肿瘤具有了治疗潜力，HER2低和HER2超低的定义在监管上具有重要意义。这些定义主要基于免疫组化标准和临床试验资格，而非经过校准的测量。对于受体导向的颗粒载体，关键问题在于是否存在足够的表面可接触受体，以支持多价结合、聚集、内化和药物转移。本文探讨了在HER2过表达模型、非HER2受体系统及合成界面中建立的原则是否可以合理地推广到HER2低表达的情境。抗原密度在递送级联的多个阶段发挥作用，而不仅仅是结合，同时与载体设计和肿瘤运输相关。文献中未发现可跨平台推广的接触阈值，唯一测得的值来自于一个体外研究的脂质体系统。人类成像数据集中，病灶级载体沉积差异显著。
items.abstract: Trastuzumab deruxtecan has made breast tumours with minimal HER2 expression therapeutically actionable, and the descriptors HER2-low and HER2-ultralow now carry regulatory weight. Both were defined by immunohistochemical convention and trial eligibility rather than by calibrated measurement. For a receptor-directed particulate carrier the operative question is not whether HER2 is detectable, but whether enough surface-accessible receptor is present, and suitably distributed, to sustain multivalent attachment, clustering, internalisation and payload transfer. This narrative review asks whether principles established in HER2-overexpressing models, in non-HER2 receptor systems and on synthetic interfaces can defensibly be extrapolated to the HER2-low setting, keeping those evidence classes distinct. Antigen density acts at several stages of the delivery cascade rather than at binding alone, jointly with carrier design and tumour transport. An analytical constraint compounds this: fixed-tissue methods report tissue HER2 abundance but do not selectively quantify the accessible receptor pool a carrier can engage. items.authors: Vasile Adrian Sescu, Alexandru Filipescu, Iustina Petra Solomon Condriuc, Mihaela Burac, Ioana Sadiye Scripcariu, Demetra Socolov

items.title: NOD2 Variants and Duration of Hospitalization After Endoscopic Treatment of Biliary Strictures Following Liver Transplantation: A Cutoff-Dependent Association
items.title_zh: NOD2变异与肝移植后胆道狭窄内镜治疗住院时间的关系
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：核苷酸结合寡聚化域2（NOD2）变异是影响肝病患者疾病进程的重要遗传风险因素。本研究探讨了NOD2变异对接受活体肝移植后胆道狭窄内镜治疗患者住院时间的影响。方法：记录了200名患者的年龄、性别、肝移植后进行内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）的时间、ERCP结果及住院时间。将患者分为两组：第1组在ERCP后24小时内出院，第2组在ERCP后24小时后出院。比较两组的三种NOD2变异频率。结果：第2组无法通过内镜干预的患者比例显著高于第1组（34% vs. 0%，p 0.0001）。此外，第2组的p.R702W和1007fs突变频率显著高于第1组（分别为10% vs. 0%，p = 0.002；14% vs. 3%，p = 0.011）。结论：NOD2变异与肝移植后胆道狭窄患者的住院时间存在显著关联。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 (NOD2) variants are an important genetic risk factor that can affect the course of a disease via interaction between the gut and liver in patients with liver diseases. In this study, we investigated the effects of NOD2 variants on the hospital stay time in patients who underwent endoscopic treatment for biliary strictures after living donor liver transplantation (LDLT). Methods: Age; gender; time to endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) after transplantation; ERCP findings; and hospitalization time of patients who underwent ERCP for biliary strictures after LDLT were recorded. The two hundred patients included in the study were divided into two groups: Group 1, discharged during the first 24 h after ERCP, and Group 2, discharged after the first 24 h following ERCP. The frequency of three NOD2 variants was investigated for the two groups. Results: The number of patients whose strictures could not be passed with endoscopic intervention in Group 2 was significantly higher than the other group (34% vs. 0%, p 0.0001). items.authors: Muhammed Yalçın, Nevra Yalçın, Muhsin Murat Muhip Harputluoglu, Baris Otlu

items.title: The Therapist from Within: A Psychodynamic–Phenomenological Comparison of the Therapist’s Lived Experience in Two Anxiety-Laden Psychotherapeutic Encounters
items.title_zh: 内心的治疗师：焦虑心理治疗中治疗师体验的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 尽管治疗师的体验对临床理解和治疗决策至关重要，但在心理治疗研究中仍相对缺乏关注。本研究采用心理动力学-现象学视角，通过比较分析两个匿名心理治疗案例，探讨治疗师的体验如何成为临床知识的来源。这两例心理治疗均在心理动力学框架下进行，后续分析则运用现象学反思治疗师在治疗中的身体、情感和关系参与。尽管两位患者均表现出显著的焦虑，伴随控制、完美主义和抑制，但产生了截然不同的治疗场域。第一个案例围绕自恋脆弱和羞耻展开，治疗师体验到脆弱的亲近感、微妙的沮丧和情感接触的反复缺失；第二个案例则围绕内疚、严厉的超我功能和对批评的恐惧，治疗师的体验则表现为警觉、谨慎的节奏和在不加剧自我攻击的情况下控制情感。这些对比的体验配置揭示了不同的移情-反移情组织。
items.abstract: The therapist’s lived experience remains comparatively underrepresented in psychotherapy research despite its importance for clinical understanding and therapeutic decision-making. Drawing on a psychodynamic–phenomenological perspective, this qualitative study examines how the therapist’s experience can function as a source of clinical knowledge through the comparative analysis of two anonymized psychotherapeutic cases. The psychotherapies were conducted within a psychodynamic framework, while their subsequent analysis employed phenomenological reflection on the therapist’s embodied, affective, and relational participation in the therapeutic encounter. Although both patients presented with prominent anxiety accompanied by control, perfectionism, and inhibition, they generated markedly different therapeutic fields. In the first case, organized predominantly around narcissistic vulnerability and shame, the therapist experienced fragile proximity, subtle discouragement, and recurrent loss of emotional contact. items.title: Advanced Echocardiography and Myocardial Work in Idiopathic Carpal Tunnel Syndrome with Presumptive Concurrent Cardiac Amyloidosis: An Exploratory Cross-Sectional Study
items.title_zh: 特发性腕管综合症与心脏淀粉样变的超声心动图研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：特发性腕管综合症（CTS）常常在临床诊断转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变（ATTR-CA）之前出现。本研究旨在全面描述在筛查人群中，CTS患者的标准及高级超声心动图表型。方法：33名特发性CTS患者接受了全面的标准和高级超声心动图检查。通过99mTc-DPD闪烁成像评估ATTR-CA的存在，将患者分为淀粉样变组和非淀粉样变对照组进行比较分析。结果：根据闪烁成像，8名患者（24.2%）被诊断为推测性ATTR-CA，25名为闪烁成像阴性对照。标准超声心动图显示，闪烁成像阳性组的心壁厚度增加和舒张功能下降（p < 0.001）。高级成像显示左心室机械功能严重受损，全球纵向应变显著降低（p < 0.001），且顶端保留现象高发（p < 0.001）。非侵入性心肌工作分析显示，闪烁成像阳性患者的全球构建工作（p = 0.005）和全球工作指数（p = 0.017）显著降低。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Idiopathic carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) can frequently precede the clinical diagnosis of transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CA). This study aimed to comprehensively characterize the standard and advanced echocardiographic phenotype in a screening cohort of patients with CTS assessed for concurrent ATTR-CA. Methods: Thirty-three patients with idiopathic CTS underwent comprehensive standard and advanced echocardiography. The presence of concurrent ATTR-CA was assessed using 99mTc-DPD scintigraphy, allowing the stratification of the cohort into an amyloidosis group and a non-amyloidosis control group for comparative analysis. Results: Based on scintigraphy, 8 patients (24.2%) were diagnosed with presumptive ATTR-CA, acknowledging that AL amyloidosis was not systematically excluded, while 25 served as scintigraphy-negative controls. Standard echocardiography revealed greater wall thickness and worse diastolic function (p 0.001) in the scintigraphy-positive group. Advanced imaging demonstrated profound left ventricular (LV) mechanical dysfunction, with severely reduced global longitudinal strain (p 0.001) and a high prevalence of apical sparing (p 0.001). Non

items.title: BMP-7 Enhances the Angiogenic Potential of Wharton’s Jelly Mesenchymal Stem Cells Seeded in Decellularized Human Dental Pulp
items.title_zh: BMP-7增强人牙髓去细胞化基质中Wharton胶脐间充质干细胞的血管生成潜力
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了BMP-7对Wharton胶脐间充质干细胞（WJMSCs）在去细胞化人牙髓（DHDP）中的血管生成潜力的影响。将WJMSCs接种于处理过BMP-7（50 ng/mL）和未处理的DHDP中，评估了DHDP样本的降解率、膨胀比和孔径。通过苏木精-伊红染色和场发射扫描电子显微镜对DHDP及其再植样本进行评估。使用MTT法评估DHDP、BMP-7及DHDP+BMP-7对WJMSCs的生物相容性。WJMSCs的活性在第7、14和21天通过重氮蓝法进行评估。通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应和免疫组化测定血管内皮生长因子-A（VEGFA）基因及蛋白表达。在21天时，DHDP的降解率为40.19%，膨胀率为77.22 ± 0.59%，平均孔径显著大于HDP（p = 0.039）。组织学上，DHDP显示完全去核，WJMSCs良好整合于DHDP基质中。DHDP、BMP-7及DHDP+BMP-7对WJMSCs无细胞毒性。
items.abstract: Regeneration of a pulp–dentin complex requires coordinated angiogenesis. This study investigated the angiogenic potential of Wharton’s jelly mesenchymal stem cells (WJMSCs) in decellularized human dental pulp (DHDP) treated with bone morphogenetic protein-7 (BMP-7). Decellularized human dental pulp tissues were repopulated with WJMSCs, with or without BMP-7 (50 ng/mL). Degradation rate, swelling ratio, and pore size of DHDP samples were assessed. DHDP and repopulated DHDP were evaluated through hematoxylin and eosin and 4′, 6-diamidino-2-phenylindole staining, and field-emission scanning electron microscopy. Biocompatibility of DHDP, BMP-7, and DHDP+BMP-7 on WJMSCs was assessed using the MTT assay. WJMSCs’ viability was evaluated using a resazurin-based assay on days 7, 14, and 21. Angiogenic potential was assessed by measuring vascular endothelial growth factor-A (VEGFA) gene expression via quantitative reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction and VEGF-A protein expression via immunohistochemistry. items.authors: Wei Ying Peh, Dalia Abdullah, Sook Luan Ng, Eason Soo, Nurul Inaas Mahamad Apandi, Nur Azurah Abdul Ghani

items.title: Direct Pan-Cancer Multi-Omic Analysis of Radiotherapy Response Reveals Coding and Regulatory Genomic Variation, and Extracellular Adaptive Programs Underlying Radioresistance
items.title_zh: 放疗反应的全癌种多组学分析揭示放射抗性机制
items.summary_zh: 放射抗性是有效放疗的主要障碍，其分子决定因素尚不完全明确。本研究分析了1,445名接受放疗的患者的基因组、转录组、免疫和临床特征，涵盖15种癌症类型，并记录了放疗结果。癌症类型特异的体细胞关联分析识别出132个显著候选变异，涉及六种癌症类型，包括TCF20、PTPN14和CADM1的三个未注释编码变异。功能注释显示，放射抗性肿瘤富含细胞质、蛋白质相关和代谢功能，而放射敏感肿瘤则富含核调控程序。转录组分析发现8种癌症类型中有107个差异表达基因，富含细胞外信号、分泌程序和肿瘤微环境相互作用。基因组和转录组分析揭示了有限的基因重叠，但在细胞适应和生存方面趋于一致。研究结果表明，放射抗性特征由互补的适应过程构成。
items.abstract: Radioresistance remains a major barrier to effective radiotherapy, yet its molecular determinants remain incompletely understood. Most radiogenomic studies infer radioresistance using surrogate endpoints rather than from clinically annotated treatment response data. Here, we analysed genomic, transcriptomic, immune and clinical features of 1,445 radiotherapy-treated patients across 15 cancer types represented in The Cancer Genome Atlas with documented radiotherapy outcomes. Cancer-type-specific somatic association analyses identified 132 significant candidate variant associations across six cancer types, including three previously unannotated coding variants in TCF20, PTPN14, and CADM1. Functional annotation showed that radioresistant tumours were enriched for cytoplasmic, protein-associated, and metabolic functions, whereas radiosensitive tumours were enriched for nuclear regulatory programs. Through transcriptomic analysis, we identified 107 differentially expressed genes across 8 cancer types, enriched for extracellular signalling, secretory programs, and tumour microenvironment interactions. items.authors: Raman, K.; Yadla, S. C.; Ravi, P.; Kamaraj, V.

items.title: Maternal immune gene expression trajectories and dynamic genetic regulation throughout pregnancy
items.title_zh: 妊娠期间母体免疫基因表达轨迹及动态遗传调控
items.summary_zh: 妊娠期间，母体免疫系统经历显著变化，以同时容忍胎儿并保护母婴免受感染。本文研究了1,305名初产妇在妊娠12、20、28和36周的全血转录组（共3,776个样本），揭示母体免疫系统在早期妊娠（12至20周）经历了最显著的重塑。共表达基因模块显示，早期阶段免疫主导程序高度活跃，随后向细胞和代谢活动增加转变，反映了母体对生理需求增加的适应。通过顺式表达数量性状基因组（cis-eQTL）映射发现，随着妊娠进展，遗传调控效应逐渐偏离非妊娠状态。与全基因组关联研究（GWAS）共定位的结果揭示了与妊娠并发症遗传易感性相关的潜在机制，其中58%的共定位结果可被检测到。
items.abstract: Pregnancy involves profound changes to maternal immunity throughout gestation to simultaneously tolerate the fetus and protect both mother and baby from infection. Dysregulation of this process can lead to pregnancy complications and adverse outcomes. However, how the maternal peripheral immune system adapts throughout an uncomplicated pregnancy remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to identify and interpret alterations associated with pregnancy complications. Here, we longitudinally profiled maternal whole-blood transcriptomes of 1,305 nulliparous women at 12, 20, 28 and 36 weeks of gestation (n=3,776 samples) from the Pregnancy Outcome Prediction Study 2 (POPs2). Differential expression analysis revealed that the maternal immune system underwent its most pronounced remodeling in early pregnancy (between 12 and 20 weeks gestation). Co-expressed gene modules demonstrated immune-dominant programs were highly active in early stages, shifting towards increased cellular and metabolic activity in later pregnancy, reflecting maternal adaptation to increasing physiological demands. items.authors: Hoffman, S.; Burnham, K. L.; Cook, E.; Cohen, C. E.; Sovio, U.; Charnock-Jones, D. S.; Smith, G. C. S.; Davenport, E. E.

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of a package to ensure safe prescription of 7-day high-dose primaquine for the radical cure of Plasmodium vivax in Indonesia
items.title_zh: 印尼高剂量青蒿素安全处方的成本效益分析
items.summary_zh: 根治恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium vivax）需治疗潜伏的肝脏阶段，使用青蒿素或他芬喹，但在葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶（G6PD）缺乏患者中存在严重溶血风险。为支持印尼安全根治，设计了新青蒿素治疗（NPT）方案，包括G6PD筛查、高剂量青蒿素治疗和早期临床评估。构建了决策树模型，基于个体数据，按照G6PD活性对患者进行7mg/kg青蒿素治疗：正常G6PD个体7天，G6PD中度缺乏者14天，严重缺乏者8周。模型考虑了成本、不良事件及P. vivax复发情况，时间范围为六个月。与印尼历史P. vivax复发数据比较，主要结果为避免的残疾调整生命年（DALYs）。从卫生系统和社会角度分析成本，并与印尼健康技术评估推荐的支付意愿阈值进行比较。
items.abstract: The radical cure of Plasmodium vivax requires treatment of the dormant liver stages with either primaquine or tafenoquine but is constrained by the risk of severe hemolysis in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency. A revised case-management package, New Primaquine Treatment (NPT), was designed to support safe radical cure in Indonesia, and included G6PD screening, targeting high dose primaquine and early clinical review. A decision-tree model was constructed using individual-level data from a study, that treated patients with 7mg/kg primaquine according to their G6PD activity: primaquine administered over 7 days (G6PD normal individuals), 14 days (individuals with intermediate G6PD deficiency), or 8 weeks (if severely G6PD deficient). The model incorporated costs, adverse events, and P. vivax recurrence over a six-month time horizon. A business-as-usual comparator was created using historical P. vivax recurrence data for Indonesia overall and the three provinces separately. items.title: The Potential Public Health Benefit of mRNA-1010 for Influenza Among Older Adults >=65 Years in the United States
items.title_zh: mRNA-1010在65岁及以上老年人流感中的潜在公共卫生益处
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：老年人面临流感相关重症和并发症的高风险。当前推荐的高剂量灭活疫苗（HD-IIV）为基于鸡蛋的疫苗，可能受到鸡蛋适应性突变的影响。mRNA-1010是一种已获美国食品药品监督管理局批准的流感mRNA疫苗。本文分析了mRNA-1010与HD-IIV在65岁及以上人群中的临床影响。方法：本研究使用决策分析模型预测每种疫苗在一年内的流感负担。疫苗覆盖率、HD-IIV疫苗有效性（VE）及流感流行病学数据基于疾病控制与预防中心的数据。mRNA-1010与HD-IIV的相对有效性（rVE）基于临床试验和文献数据进行建模。结果：基线分析表明，与HD-IIV相比，mRNA-1010可能额外预防232,200例流感症状感染、130,000例门诊病例、21,100例流感相关住院和2,200例流感相关死亡。预防一例住院所需接种人数为514（mRNA-1010对比无疫苗）和404（HD-IIV对比无疫苗）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Older adults are at high risk of influenza-related severe disease and complications. HD-IIV, currently recommended for adults [ ]65 years, is egg-based and may be subject to egg-adapted mutations. An mRNA-based vaccine for influenza, mRNA-1010, has been approved by the Food and Drug Administration. Given the clinical benefits observed in mRNA-1010 clinical trials and potential to avoid egg-adapted mutations, this analysis explores the clinical impact of mRNA-1010 compared to HD-IIV in those [ ]65 years in the United States. Methods: This study used a decision-analytic model of influenza infection and downstream outcomes to project influenza burden with each vaccine over a one-year timeframe. Vaccine coverage, HD-IIV vaccine effectiveness (VE) and influenza epidemiology was estimated based upon Centers for Disease Control and Prevention data. The relative VE (rVE) for mRNA-1010 vs. HD-IIV was modelled based on data from the clinical trial and published literature on the impact of egg adaptation. items.authors: Fust, K.; Beck, E.; Kohli, M.; Cartier, S.; Weinstein, M. C.; Van de Velde, N.; Joshi, K.

items.title: Validity Gates Expose Limits of Longitudinal Multimodal Parkinson Disease Prediction
items.title_zh: 有效性门限揭示纵向多模态帕金森病预测的局限性
items.summary_zh: 多模态帕金森病模型可以在内部改进，但掩盖了患者差异的原因及其可部署性。我们分析了1,058名帕金森进展标志倡议参与者的临床轨迹、生物来源、观察过程以及相对年龄加权的多种证据，包括多巴胺能、损伤/胶质、认知共病和溶酶体负担，共计5,404个切点。DaT-SPECT和MoCA历史产生了小幅的12个月运动变化增益（Delta R^2=0.015；delta MAE=-0.060），未满足预设的幅度和严格日历标准。连续证据保留了重叠支持，但未显示超出原始来源的可检测预测增量。源感知区间实现了90.6%的参与者覆盖率，但未能进行选择性预测，结果为ABSTAIN。在8,000个半合成实验中，该门限将无效推广限制在0.35%，检测到泄漏并阻止了94.75%的日历反转；PDBP临床转运和多模态资格未能实现。该框架揭示了状态支持、过时或缺失的证据，以及不合理的预后、不确定性或转运主张。
items.abstract: Multimodal Parkinson disease models can improve internally while obscuring why patients differ and whether a gain is deployable. We separated clinical trajectories, dated biological sources, observation process and cohort-relative, age-weighted evidence for dopaminergic, injury/glial, cognitive co-pathology and lysosomal burden across 5,404 cutoffs in 1,058 Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative participants. DaT-SPECT and MoCA history produced a small 12-month motor-change gain (Delta R^2=0.015; delta MAE=-0.060) that failed prespecified magnitude and strict-calendar criteria. Continuous evidence retained overlapping support but showed no detectable predictive increment beyond raw sources. Source-aware intervals achieved 90.6% simultaneous participant coverage yet failed selective prediction, yielding ABSTAIN. In 8,000 semisynthetic experiments, the gate limited null promotion to 0.35%, detected leakage and blocked 94.75% of calendar reversals; PDBP clinical transport and multimodal eligibility failed. The framework reveals state support, stale or missing evidence, and unjustified prognostic, uncertainty or transport claims.
items.authors: Tirhekar, H.; Yadav, P.; bajaj, C. L.

items.title: Nepal’s floods expose issues with climate-disaster funding — firmer policies are needed fast
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔洪灾揭示气候灾害资金问题 亟需更严格政策
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了联合国气候损失与损害基金在应对气候灾害时面临的挑战，特别是在资金分配的公平性和效率方面。研究指出，低资源国家在获取资金时常常处于不利地位，亟需制定更为明确和有效的政策，以确保资金能够迅速且公正地分配给受灾地区。文章强调，改善决策过程对于支持脆弱国家应对气候变化带来的影响至关重要。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03016-z The UN’s climate loss and damage fund needs to consider how to make decisions about finance fairly and quickly, without disadvantaging low-resource nations.
items.authors: Uttam Babu Shrestha

items.title: Little-known arm of immune system could be key to better vaccines, cancer therapies
items.title_zh: 免疫系统鲜为人知的部分或可改善疫苗和癌症疗法
items.summary_zh: CD1系统主要对脂质而非蛋白质作出反应，参与对蜜蜂蜇伤、细菌感染及可能的毒藤反应。研究表明，CD1分子在调节免疫反应中起着重要作用，能够识别和呈递特定脂质给T细胞，从而激活免疫反应。这一发现为开发新型疫苗和癌症治疗方法提供了新的思路，尤其是在针对脂质相关疾病的免疫疗法方面。通过进一步研究CD1系统的机制，科学家们希望能够设计出更有效的免疫治疗策略。
items.abstract: The CD1 system responds to lipids, not proteins, driving reactions to bee stings, bacteria, and possibly poison ivy
items.authors: Mitch Leslie

items.title: IARC Perspective on Lung Cancer Screening
items.title_zh: IARC对肺癌筛查的观点
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了国际癌症研究机构（IARC）对肺癌筛查的看法。研究对象包括高风险人群，采用低剂量螺旋CT（LDCT）进行筛查。关键发现表明，LDCT筛查能够显著降低肺癌死亡率，尤其是在吸烟者和曾吸烟者中。IARC强调，尽管筛查带来益处，但也需关注假阳性结果和随之而来的不必要检查。结论指出，肺癌筛查应在高风险人群中推广，同时需建立有效的随访和管理机制，以最大化其公共卫生效益。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Luciana Neamtiu Matthew E.J. Callister Philip Crosbie Stephen Lam Vivienne Milch Daniela Mariosa Xiaoshuang Feng Roya Dolatkhah Ali Saeed Al-Zahrani Zhandos Amankulov Jean-Luc Bulliard Wendy A. Cooper

items.title: Cellular basis of accelerated whole-tooth regeneration
items.title_zh: 加速全牙再生的细胞基础研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究以马拉维湖的慈鲷鱼为对象，探讨牙齿再生的节奏和细胞基础。慈鲷鱼具有不同的牙齿形态和数量，但具备一对一的牙齿替换能力。我们首先观察到，具有不同牙齿结构的慈鲷鱼在拔除牙齿后，替换速度在下颌的拔除半部加快了3倍。随后，采用单核RNA测序技术，分析了拔牙后第一周内细胞和分子变化，推断出牙齿再生过程中牙龈上皮和间充质的细胞轨迹。研究发现，在加速牙齿替换的四个时间点上，存在明显的基因表达谱和细胞间相互作用，涉及上皮、间充质和免疫细胞类型的不同参与。
items.abstract: Teeth are ectodermal organs that have, throughout their long evolutionary history, retained the capacity for full regeneration and replacement, even in adult stages. Yet, because most mammals (e.g., humans, mice) lack lifelong dental replacement, we do not fully understand its tempo and mode, and we do not have a clear picture of the cell populations and signals that contribute to the process. Here, we used cichlid fishes from Lake Malawi, species that differ in tooth formula (tooth shape and number) but share one-for-one tooth replacement, to (i) explore the tempo of dental replacement after plucking and then (ii) identify the cell populations, gene expression signatures, and interactions between cell populations that change in this plucking paradigm. We observed that cichlid species with divergent dentitions accelerated tooth replacement 3× on the plucked half of the jaw. Then, we used single-nucleus RNA-seq to profile cellular and molecular changes across the first week of post-plucking tooth replacement. items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Neurovascular Surgery: Emerging Applications in Intracranial Aneurysm Management
items.title_zh: 人工智能在神经血管外科中的应用：颅内动脉瘤管理的新兴技术
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：人工智能（AI）在颅内动脉瘤（IA）护理中展现出作为辅助工具的潜力，应用于诊断、破裂风险评估、治疗规划和预后预测。本文综述了当前AI在IA管理和预后评估中的应用。方法：对2001年1月至2026年4月14日间发表的英文研究进行了结构化检索，评估了机器学习（ML）、深度学习和大型语言模型（LLM）在IA诊断、治疗或预后中的应用。经过筛选和全文审查，共纳入45项研究。结果：AI模型在动脉瘤护理的多个领域显示出实用性。深度学习方法支持动脉瘤检测和形态分割，而传统ML模型应用于破裂状态分类、动脉瘤稳定性、治疗选择、闭塞预测和治疗后结果。新兴的LLM在治疗推荐和预后评估中显示出早期潜力，但证据仍然有限。结论：AI可能通过整合临床、影像学、程序和血流动力学数据，改善个体化的动脉瘤管理，从初始诊断到长期结果预测，超越传统评分系统。然而，当前模型仍存在局限性。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising adjunct in intracranial aneurysm (IA) care, with potential applications in diagnosis, rupture risk assessment, treatment planning, and outcome prediction. This review summarizes current AI-based approaches in the management and prognostication of IAs. Methods: A structured search of PubMed, Embase, and Scopus was conducted for English-language studies published from January 2001 to 14 April 2026, evaluating machine learning (ML), deep learning, or large language model (LLM) applications in IA diagnosis, treatment, or prognosis. After screening and full-text review, 45 studies were included. Results: AI models demonstrated utility across several domains of aneurysm care. Deep learning approaches supported aneurysm detection and morphological segmentation, while traditional ML models were applied to rupture status classification, aneurysm stability, treatment selection, occlusion prediction, and post-treatment outcomes. items.title: Dexamethasone Modulates Global DNA Methylation and Oxidative DNA Damage in Glioblastoma Cell Lines
items.title_zh: 地塞米松调节胶质母细胞瘤细胞的全局DNA甲基化与氧化DNA损伤
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤是一种极具侵袭性的原发性脑肿瘤，具有快速进展、治疗抵抗和预后不良的特点。地塞米松常用于减轻肿瘤周围水肿和改善神经症状，但其对肿瘤细胞生物学和治疗反应的广泛分子影响尚不完全清楚。本研究探讨了地塞米松单独及与替莫唑胺、丙戊酸或二甲双胍联合使用对胶质母细胞瘤细胞活力、实时增殖、衰老相关β-半乳糖苷酶活性、细胞周期分布、全局DNA甲基化和氧化DNA损伤的影响。结果显示，地塞米松在胶质瘤细胞中引起浓度和时间依赖性的全局DNA甲基化变化。T98G细胞中，短时间暴露增加了5-甲基胞嘧啶，而较长时间或特定联合处理则降低了甲基化，提示动态表观遗传重塑。低浓度地塞米松与5-甲基胞嘧啶含量增加相关，而高浓度则降低全局甲基化，且该效应依赖于细胞系。在SW1783细胞中，高剂量地塞米松导致5-甲基胞嘧啶减少及8-氧代-2′-脱氧鸟苷水平增加。
items.abstract: Glioblastoma remains one of the most aggressive primary brain tumors, characterized by rapid progression, therapeutic resistance, and poor prognosis. Dexamethasone is routinely administered to patients with glioblastoma to reduce peritumoral edema and improve neurological symptoms. However, its broader molecular effects on tumor-cell biology and treatment response remain incompletely understood. This study examined the effects of dexamethasone alone and in combination with temozolomide, valproic acid, or metformin on glioblastoma cell viability, real-time proliferation, senescence-associated β-galactosidase activity, cell-cycle distribution, global DNA methylation, and oxidative DNA damage. Dexamethasone induced concentration- and time-dependent changes in global DNA methylation in glioma cells. In T98G cells, shorter exposure increased 5-methylcytosine, whereas longer incubation or selected combined treatment conditions reduced methylation, suggesting dynamic epigenetic remodeling. Low dexamethasone concentrations were associated with increased 5-methylcytosine content, also in temozolomide-containing conditions. items.title: The Role of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETosis) in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: Molecular Mechanisms, Pathogenic Roles, Diagnostic Biomarkers, and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies
items.title_zh: 中性粒细胞外陷阱在系统性红斑狼疮中的作用
items.summary_zh: 中性粒细胞外陷阱（NETs）是由染色质支架和细胞毒性颗粒蛋白组成的网状结构，形成于一种特殊的中性粒细胞死亡方式——NETosis。尽管NETs在抗微生物防御中发挥重要作用，但其失调显著促进了系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的发病机制。在SLE患者中，促炎低密度粒细胞（LDGs）过度形成NET以及由于DNase1/DNase1L3活性降低或获得性缺失导致的NET清除障碍，形成了加剧自身免疫激活的致病循环。NETs不仅是自身抗原的来源，还作为免疫放大器，驱动I型干扰素反应、补体激活、B细胞自身免疫、内皮功能障碍和血栓形成。近期研究发现，循环生物标志物如游离DNA（cfDNA）、髓过氧化物酶-DNA复合物和瓜氨酸化组蛋白H3与SLE疾病活动和脏器受累相关。针对NETosis通路的新兴治疗策略，如肽基精氨酸去亚胺酶4（PAD4）抑制剂、重组DNase治疗和补体调节剂，在临床前研究和早期临床试验中显示出希望。
items.abstract: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are web-like structures comprising chromatin scaffolds decorated with cytotoxic granule proteins released during a specialized form of neutrophil cell death termed NETosis. Although NETs function as a critical antimicrobial defense mechanism, their dysregulation contributes significantly to the pathogenesis of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). In SLE patients, both excessive NET formation by proinflammatory low-density granulocytes (LDGs) and impaired NET clearance due to reduced or acquired DNase1/DNase1L3 activity create a pathogenic cycle that amplifies autoimmune activation. NETs serve as both a source of autoantigens and an immunological amplifier, driving Type I interferon responses, complement activation, B cell autoimmunity, endothelial dysfunction, and thrombosis. Recent advances have identified circulating biomarkers of NETosis, including cell-free DNA (cfDNA), myeloperoxidase-DNA complexes, and citrullinated histone H3, that correlate with SLE disease activity and organ involvement. items.title: Perioperative Outcomes of Multivessel Minimally Invasive Coronary Revascularization at a Specialized Center: A Retrospective Cohort of Complete Surgical and Planned Hybrid Strategies
items.title_zh: 多血管微创冠脉再灌注术的围手术期结果分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：多血管微创冠脉再灌注术结合了左侧小切口心肌再灌注和在特定患者中计划的混合经皮成分。现有的单中心研究证据有限。方法：我们回顾性分析了2021年12月至2025年2月在波恩大学医院心脏外科接受多血管微创策略治疗的180名心脏团队选择的患者。该队列包括完全外科再灌注和计划的混合策略。结果：121名患者（67.2%）接受了完全外科再灌注，59名患者（32.8%）接受了计划的混合再灌注。无住院死亡（0.0%；95% CI，0.0–2.0%）。发生中风2例（1.1%），因出血再开胸3例（1.7%），伤口感染3例（1.7%），急性肾损伤8例（4.4%）。3名患者接受了术后透析；其中2名术前依赖透析，1名术后需新开始肾替代治疗（0.6%）。术后心房颤动发生在7名患者中（3.9%）。出院后随访信息可用于140名患者（77.8%），记录到3例死亡。结论：该队列表明，心脏团队驱动的多血管微创冠脉再灌注术具有良好的围手术期结果。
items.abstract: Background: Multivessel minimally invasive coronary revascularization combines surgical myocardial revascularization through a left mini-thoracotomy with, in selected patients, a planned hybrid percutaneous component. Evidence from contemporary single-center cohorts remains limited. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 180 Heart Team-selected patients treated with a multivessel minimally invasive strategy at the Department of Cardiac Surgery, University Hospital Bonn, between December 2021 and February 2025. The cohort comprised complete surgical revascularization and planned hybrid strategies. Results: Complete surgical revascularization was documented in 121/180 patients (67.2%), while 59/180 (32.8%) underwent planned hybrid revascularization. No in-hospital deaths occurred (0.0%; exact 95% CI, 0.0–2.0%). Stroke occurred in 2/180 (1.1%), re-thoracotomy for bleeding in 3/180 (1.7%), wound infection in 3/180 (1.7%), and AKI in 8/180 (4.4%). Three patients received postoperative dialysis; two were dialysis-dependent before surgery and one required new postoperative renal replacement therapy (0.6%).
