items.title: Targeting Endothelial Dysfunction in Wound Repair: Mechanisms and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies
items.title_zh: 靶向内皮功能障碍促进创伤修复的机制与新兴治疗策略
items.summary_zh: 血管内皮在创伤修复过程中动态调节止血、炎症、血管生成、组织灌注和重塑。在糖尿病、肥胖、慢性肾病和外周血管病等慢性疾病中，内皮功能障碍通过降低一氧化氮生物利用度、氧化应激、持续的炎症激活、机械转导改变、血管内皮生长因子信号失调和内皮-间充质转化等机制导致愈合受损。尽管这些疾病产生不同的内皮表型，但它们在损害屏障完整性、微血管灌注和血管生成能力方面存在共同机制。本文综述了内皮细胞在正常创伤愈合中的生理作用，描述了特定疾病和共同的内皮功能障碍途径，并评估了恢复内皮功能的新兴策略，包括生长因子递送、内皮祖细胞治疗、细胞外囊泡、基因干预、天然生物活性化合物和生物材料辅助递送系统。尽管许多策略在临床前研究中显示出良好效果，但临床转化仍受限于内皮异质性和创伤微环境的变异性。
items.abstract: The vascular endothelium is a dynamic regulator of hemostasis, inflammation, angiogenesis, tissue perfusion, and remodeling throughout wound repair. In chronic diseases such as diabetes mellitus, obesity, chronic kidney disease, and peripheral vascular disease, endothelial dysfunction contributes to impaired healing through reduced nitric oxide bioavailability, oxidative stress, persistent inflammatory activation, altered mechanotransduction, dysregulated vascular endothelial growth factor signaling, and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition. Although these conditions produce distinct endothelial phenotypes, they also converge on shared mechanisms that impair barrier integrity, microvascular perfusion, and angiogenic capacity. This narrative review examines the physiological roles of endothelial cells during normal wound healing, describes disease-specific and common pathways of endothelial dysfunction, and evaluates emerging strategies to restore endothelial function. Therapeutic approaches include growth factor delivery, endothelial progenitor cell therapy, extracellular vesicles, gene-based interventions, natural bioactive compounds, and biomaterial-assisted delivery systems. items.title: Psoriasis and Bullous Pemphigoid: An Updated Review of Clinical Association, Targeted Therapy Exposures and Therapeutic Implications
items.title_zh: 银屑病与大疱性类天疱疮的临床关联及治疗影响综述
items.summary_zh: 银屑病是一种慢性免疫介导的炎症性皮肤病，主要由白细胞介素-23-辅助T细胞17轴的失调引起。大疱性类天疱疮是一种独特的自身免疫性皮下水疱性疾病，特征为在真皮-表皮交界处的自身抗体介导损伤及以T辅助细胞2为主的嗜酸性粒细胞丰富的炎症反应。尽管两者在临床和免疫病理上存在显著差异，越来越多的流行病学证据表明银屑病与大疱性类天疱疮的共存可能并非偶然。治疗暴露也可能对这种关联产生影响。用于治疗银屑病的生物制剂在某些情况下与新发的大疱性类天疱疮有时间上的关联。这些观察提出了一个假设，即治疗相关的不同效应可能部分反映了不同的免疫环境，而非特定药物类别的统一特性。本文总结了银屑病与大疱性类天疱疮之间的临床关联的现有证据，批判性地审视了靶向治疗的暴露及其不同的临床背景，并讨论了可能导致银屑病患者发展大疱性类天疱疮的免疫病理机制。特别关注这些发现的临床意义。
items.abstract: Psoriasis is a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory dermatosis driven predominantly by dysregulation of the interleukin-23–T helper 17 axis. Bullous pemphigoid is a distinct autoimmune subepidermal blistering disorder characterized by autoantibody-mediated injury at the dermal–epidermal junction and a T helper 2-polarized, eosinophil-rich inflammatory response. Despite their marked clinical and immunopathological differences, accumulating epidemiological evidence suggests that the coexistence of psoriasis and bullous pemphigoid is unlikely to be incidental. Therapeutic exposure may also contribute to this association. Biologic agents used to treat psoriasis, and in selected cases bullous pemphigoid, have occasionally been reported in temporal association with new-onset bullous pemphigoid. These observations raise the hypothesis that divergent treatment-related effects may partly reflect differences in the prevailing immune milieu rather than a uniform property of a specific drug class. items.title: The Vaginal Microbiome Across the Continuum from HPV Infection to Cervical Cancer: A Narrative Review
items.title_zh: HPV感染与宫颈癌之间的阴道微生物组研究综述
items.summary_zh: 持续的高风险人乳头瘤病毒（HR-HPV）感染是宫颈上皮内瘤变（CIN）和侵袭性宫颈癌的核心前提。研究表明，以保护性乳酸杆菌为主的阴道微生态平衡在HR-HPV感染的发生、持续和自发清除中起着关键作用，而乳酸杆菌减少和厌氧病原体过度生长的微生物失调则形成促炎和免疫抑制的黏膜环境，加速病毒滞留和宫颈恶性转化。我们对2021年1月至2026年4月间发表的相关研究进行了叙述性综述，重点关注阴道微生物组、HR-HPV感染、CIN、宫颈癌及其机制等关键词的文献。综述系统阐明了阴道微生物群与HR-HPV之间的双向调节作用。
items.abstract: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection serves as the core prerequisite for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) and invasive cervical cancer. Accumulated translational evidence confirms that vaginal microecological homeostasis dominated by protective Lactobacillus strains fundamentally governs the initiation, persistence, and spontaneous clearance of HR-HPV infection, while microbial dysbiosis featuring depleted lactobacilli and overgrown anaerobic pathogens creates a pro-inflammatory, immune-suppressive mucosal niche that accelerates viral retention and cervical malignant transformation. We conducted a narrative review of studies published primarily between January 2021 and April 2026. PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP were searched using terms related to the vaginal microbiome, HR-HPV infection, CIN, cervical cancer, underlying mechanisms, microbial biomarkers, and microbiome-modulating interventions. Relevant peer-reviewed epidemiological, mechanistic, and clinical studies were prioritized, and the manuscript was prepared with reference to the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA). items.authors: Xiaodie Zhou, Jiaqi Hu, Ruoyu Zhou, Yi Lu, Xuan Du, Yipei Chen

items.title: A Digital Twin Framework for Per-Fraction Prediction of Normal Tissue Toxicity in Radiotherapy of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.title_zh: 放射治疗中非小细胞肺癌正常组织毒性预测的数字双胞胎框架
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：立体定向体部放射治疗（SBRT）是一种对早期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的有效治疗方法。生物引导放射治疗（BGRT）能够在每个分次中获取患者特定的代谢、解剖和剂量信息。以往模型主要关注静态的群体水平辐射毒性预测，缺乏对个体患者在放疗过程中正常组织反应的纵向特征描述。我们假设基于人工智能的模型可以量化这些纵向数据中的时间毒性模式，从而帮助临床医生平衡肿瘤控制与正常组织并发症，以指导个性化治疗计划。方法：在这项概念验证研究中，我们开发了COMPASS（综合个性化评估系统），这是一个数字双胞胎框架，能够生成每分次的风险评估，为NSCLC的未来适应性决策提供信息。研究纳入了8名接受BGRT的NSCLC患者，共计99个器官-分次观察，涵盖3个风险器官的24个患者-器官纵向轨迹。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT), often delivered in 3–5 fractions, is a highly effective treatment strategy for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in medically inoperable patients. Biology-guided radiotherapy (BGRT), a PET-guided SBRT, enables acquisition of patient-specific metabolic, anatomical, and dose information at each fraction. While prior models have focused on static, population-level prediction of radiation-induced toxicity, there remains a lack of approaches to characterize how normal tissue response evolves longitudinally within individual patients over the course of radiation treatment. We therefore hypothesize that AI-based models can quantify temporal toxicity patterns in such longitudinal data, allowing clinicians to balance tumor control against normal tissue complications to guide individualized treatment planning. Methods: In this proof-of-concept study, we developed COMPASS (COMprehensive Personalized Assessment System), a digital twin framework that generates per-fraction risk estimates that could inform future adaptive decision-making in NSCLC. items.title: Ultra-Short ECG Indices in Patients Presenting with Epigastric Pain—An Orientation Tool for Diagnosis in the Emergency Department
items.title_zh: 急诊科上腹痛患者超短心电图指标的诊断工具研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：上腹痛是急诊科就诊的主要原因之一，可能由多种病因引起，包括轻微的胃炎和反流病到危及生命的急腹症和急性心肌梗死。上腹痛常与压力、炎症和内脏信号相关，这些过程由自主神经系统（ANS）介导。本研究旨在评估心率变异性（HRV）在急诊科上腹痛患者中的预后意义。方法：对2014年在Rambam健康护理中心急诊科诊断为上腹痛的患者进行回顾性分析，从10秒的急诊心电图中计算超短心率变异性（usHRV）指标，并与死亡率、疾病严重程度和病因进行相关性分析。结果：本研究纳入300名患者，因短期死亡率极低，无法可靠评估usHRV与该结果的关系。随访期间死亡率为17.4%，中位随访时间为8.4年。未发现长期死亡率与标准差之间存在显著关联。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Abdominal pain, particularly epigastric pain, is a leading cause of emergency department (ED) visits and encompasses a wide differential diagnosis, ranging from mild conditions such as gastritis and reflux disease to life-threatening etiologies such as acute abdomen and acute myocardial infarction (MI). Epigastric pain is often associated with stress, inflammation, and visceral signaling, processes mediated by the autonomic nervous system (ANS). Changes in ANS activity can be captured by heart rate variability (HRV), a non-invasive measure derived from cardiac rhythm. In this study, we conducted retrospective research to evaluate the prognostic significance of HRV in ED patients presenting with epigastric pain. Materials and Methods: Retrospective analysis of patients diagnosed with epigastric pain in the ED at Rambam Health Care Campus in 2014. Ultra-short heart rate variability (usHRV) indices were calculated from a 10 s ED electrocardiogram and correlated with mortality, disease severity, and disease origin. Results: 300 patients were included in this study. Due to a very low short-term mortality rate, usHRV could not be reliably assessed for this outc
items.authors: Niv Izhaki, Shay Perek, Shiraz Safadi, Ayelet Raz-Pasteur

items.title: Personality Traits and Illness Acceptance in Patients with Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease: A Cross-Sectional Study from Poland
items.title_zh: 癌症与心血管疾病患者的人格特征与疾病接受度研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：疾病接受度是影响慢性病适应的重要心理因素，而人格特征是其已知相关因素之一。本研究探讨了五大人格特征（NEO-FFI）与疾病接受度（AIS）在癌症和心血管疾病患者中的关联，并检验诊断是否调节这些关联。方法：本研究为横断面研究，样本包括631名患者，其中316名癌症患者和315名心血管疾病患者。使用NEO五因素量表（NEO-FFI）测量人格特征，使用疾病接受度量表（AIS）测量疾病接受度。采用未调整的调节多元回归分析，诊断（0=癌症，1=心血管疾病）作为调节变量，疾病接受度为结果变量。分析在R（版本4.2.2）和RStudio（版本2022.12.0）中进行。
items.abstract: Background: Illness acceptance is a key psychological factor shaping adjustment to chronic disease, and personality traits are among its established correlates. Whether the diagnostic context—oncological versus cardiovascular disease—moderates the relationship between personality and illness acceptance remains insufficiently studied. This study examined associations between the Big Five personality traits (NEO-FFI) and illness acceptance (AIS) in patients with cancer and cardiovascular disease, and tested whether diagnosis moderates these associations. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between January 2024 and May 2026 at the Oncology Centre of the Lublin Region, University Hospital No. 4, Lublin, and University Hospital No. 1, Lublin. The sample comprised 631 patients: 316 with a cancer diagnosis and 315 with cardiovascular disease. Personality traits were measured with the NEO Five-Factor Inventory (NEO-FFI) and illness acceptance with the Acceptance of Illness Scale (AIS). An unadjusted moderated multiple regression was used, with personality traits as predictors, diagnosis (0 = cancer, 1 = cardiovascular disease) as the moderator, and illness acceptance as the outc
items.authors: Robert Jan Łuczyk, Marta Łuczyk, Dorota Weber, Kamil Sikora, Anna Charuta

items.title: Recurrent Mesonephric-like Adenocarcinoma of the Ovary with Bladder and Vaginal Recurrences: A Diagnostic Challenge
items.title_zh: 卵巢复发性中肾样腺癌伴膀胱和阴道复发的诊断挑战
items.summary_zh: 背景与临床意义：卵巢中肾样腺癌（MLA）是一种非常罕见的肿瘤，近期被世界卫生组织（WHO）认定为独特亚型，具有较强的复发倾向。本病例报告旨在强调MLA的诊断挑战及免疫组化和分子检测的重要性。病例介绍：我们报告了一例59岁女性，因左侧卵巢肿瘤就诊。组织病理学检查初步诊断为低级别浆液性癌，患者接受相应治疗。五年后，肿瘤在膀胱壁复发，最初被解读为尿路上皮癌。一年后，在阴道穹隆发现进一步复发。对原卵巢肿瘤及复发病灶的综合评估，结合免疫组化和分子检测结果，支持卵巢MLA伴膀胱和阴道复发的诊断。结论：卵巢MLA极为罕见，可能模拟更常见的卵巢癌亚型。了解其形态学和免疫组化特征对于避免误诊至关重要。即使复发发生在不同部位，具有中肾形态/免疫表型的复发性妇科肿瘤也应考虑MLA。
items.abstract: Background and Clinical Significance: Mesonephric-like adenocarcinoma (MLA) of the ovary is a very rare entity that has only recently been recognized as a distinct subtype in the World Health Organization (WHO) classification. It is an aggressive tumor with a propensity for recurrence. The aim of this case report was to highlight the diagnostic challenges associated with MLA and the importance of immunohistochemical and molecular testing. Case Presentation: We report the case of a 59-year-old woman who presented with a left ovarian tumor. Histopathological examination led to an initial diagnosis of low-grade serous carcinoma, and the patient was treated accordingly. Five years later, the tumor recurred in the bladder wall and was initially interpreted as urothelial carcinoma. One year later, a further recurrence was identified at the vaginal cuff. Integrated review of the original ovarian tumor and recurrent lesions, together with immunohistochemical and molecular findings, supported the diagnosis of ovarian MLA with bladder and vaginal recurrences. Conclusions: Ovarian MLA is extremely rare and can mimic more common ovarian carcinoma subtypes. Awareness of its morphological and im
items.authors: Anca Evsei-Seceleanu, Tudor Turcu, Aurelian Mihai Ghita, Sandu-Dumitru Ramboiu, Alexandru Ciobanu, Patricia Visan

items.title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation in Centers Without Cardiac Surgery: A Preliminary Medico-Legal Discussion in Italy
items.title_zh: 意大利无心脏外科中心的经导管主动脉瓣植入初步法律讨论
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：微创和经导管方法的扩展逐渐模糊了医学与外科之间的界限。主动脉瓣疾病是这一转变的典型例子，经导管主动脉瓣植入（TAVI）越来越多地取代传统心脏手术。当前指南建议在具备现场心脏外科的中心进行这些程序，以确保对时间依赖性并发症的管理。尽管重大并发症的发生率较低，但缺乏即时外科救助可能导致治疗机会的实际损失。方法：作者讨论了在无现场心脏外科的中心进行TAVI的法医学影响。结果：患者安全是健康权的一个重要组成部分，强调风险最小化。结构或后勤上无法管理可预见并发症，或在选择性治疗中安全机制的限制，可能构成对这一权利的损害。在此背景下，必须考虑多个方面，包括意大利医疗和外科专业的培训与能力、并发症管理时机及相关死亡率的数据缺乏。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The expansion of minimally invasive and transcatheter approaches has progressively blurred boundaries between medical and surgical disciplines. Valvular heart diseases, especially aortic ones, exemplify this translational shift, with transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) increasingly replacing conventional cardiac surgery. Current guidelines recommend the performance of these procedures in centers equipped with on-site cardiac surgery, ensuring management of time-dependent complications. In fact, even if the incidence of major complications is low, the absence of immediate surgical bailout may translate into a concrete loss of therapeutic opportunity. Methods: The authors discuss the forensic implications of performing TAVI in centers without on-site cardiac surgery. Results: Patient safety is an integral component of the right to health, emphasizing risks minimization. Structural or logistical inability to manage foreseeable complications, or safety mechanisms constraint in elective treatments may therefore constitute a harm of this right. In this context, several aspects must be considered in light of guideline evidence and available data, includin
items.authors: Livio Pietro Tronconi, Vittorio Bolcato, Giuseppe Basile

items.title: Prognostic Value of a Seven-Factor Risk Stratification System in T3N0 Colon Cancer: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
items.title_zh: T3N0结肠癌七因素风险分层系统的预后价值研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：本研究旨在验证临床病理风险因素的预后价值，并评估基于指南的七因素风险分层系统在T3N0结肠癌中的区分能力。方法：回顾性分析174例于2015至2025年接受根治性切除并被诊断为病理T3N0M0（IIA期）结肠腺癌的患者，排除T4病变、直肠肿瘤、同步恶性肿瘤、术前治疗及错配修复缺陷（dMMR/MSI-H）患者。定义七个高风险因素：淋巴血管侵犯（LVI）、神经周围侵犯（PNI）、肠梗阻、穿孔、淋巴结取样不足（<12个淋巴结）、分化差（3级和4级）及高等级肿瘤芽生（BD3，≥10芽）。主要终点为无复发生存期（RFS），次要终点为无病生存期（DFS）和总生存期（OS）。结果：中位数数据待补充。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: This study aimed to validate the prognostic value of clinicopathologic risk factors and assess the discriminatory performance of a guideline-based seven-factor risk stratification system in T3N0 colon cancer. Secondary objectives included examining the independent prognostic role of mucinous histology and analyzing current adjuvant chemotherapy decision-making patterns. Materials and Methods: A total of 174 patients who underwent curative resection between 2015 and 2025 and were diagnosed with pathologic T3N0M0 (stage IIA) colon adenocarcinoma were retrospectively reviewed. Patients with T4 disease, rectal tumors, synchronous malignancies, neoadjuvant therapy and mismatch repair deficiency (dMMR/MSI-H) were excluded. Seven high-risk factors were defined: lymphovascular invasion (LVI), perineural invasion (PNI), intestinal obstruction, perforation, inadequate lymph node sampling ( 12 lymph nodes), poor differentiation (Grade 3 and 4), and high-grade tumor budding (BD3, ≥10 buds according to ITBCC criteria). Mucinous histology was evaluated as a separate subgroup analysis. The primary endpoint was recurrence-free survival (RFS); secondary endpoints were dis
items.authors: Abdussamet Çelebi, Eren Meral, Fırat Akagündüz, Ahmet Demirel, Mustafa Alperen Tunç, Burak Paçacı

items.title: The Sex Paradox in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma: Higher Incidence in Women, Poorer Outcomes in Men, and an Emerging Non-Coding RNA Layer
items.title_zh: 乳头状甲状腺癌的性别悖论：女性发病率高，男性预后差
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：乳头状甲状腺癌（PTC）表现出显著的性别差异：女性的诊断率约为男性的三倍，但男性一旦确诊后，复发、疾病进展和疾病特异性死亡的独立风险因素。我们综合了流行病学、激素、遗传、免疫和临床文献，评估了非编码RNA作为潜在机制桥梁。方法：对超过100篇相关文献进行了结构化叙述综合，并结合了18名患者的肿瘤临床外显子组测序数据（13名女性，5名男性）及TCGA甲状腺癌队列的独立验证。结果：2022年全球标准化发病率为女性每10万人13.60，男性为4.60。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) shows a striking sex disparity: women are diagnosed roughly three times more often than men, yet male sex is an independent risk factor for recurrence, disease progression, and disease-specific mortality once PTC is established. This “female incidence–male mortality paradox” has hormonal, genetic, immunological, and clinical explanations, none individually sufficient, and clinical risk-stratification has only recently begun incorporating sex-relevant molecular variables. We synthesized this evidence and evaluated an underexplored regulatory layer, non-coding RNA, as a candidate mechanistic bridge across the pathways implicated. Methods: We conducted a structured narrative synthesis of epidemiological, hormonal, genetic, immunological, and clinical literature on sex differences in PTC (over 100 candidate papers), integrated with institutional pilot data (native-classification reanalysis of tumor-only clinical exome sequencing; 18 patients, 13 female, 5 male), an independent validation query of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) thyroid carcinoma (THCA) cohort (n = 564) for two immune- and stroma-related transcripts, and a targeted

items.title: DNA Barcoding and Untargeted Metabolomics Reveal Phylogenetic and Chemotaxonomic Relationships Among 11 Ferula Species from Xinjiang, China
items.title_zh: DNA条形码与代谢组学揭示新疆11种Ferula的系统发育关系
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：Ferula物种在形态上相似，尤其在营养生长期，导致叶材的可靠鉴定困难。本研究探讨了新疆11种Ferula的系统发育关系与叶片化学分类模式的对应情况。方法：结合四个DNA条形码位点（ITS2、trnH–psbA、rps11和atpA–trnR）进行分子鉴定和系统发育分析。采用响应面法优化超声辅助提取条件，建立标准化样品制备，随后对33个叶样本进行LC–MS基础的非靶向代谢组学分析。结果：结合的DNA条形码数据集支持大多数样本的鉴定，并揭示了四个广泛的系统发育组，尽管一些近缘样本的分辨率有限。非靶向代谢组学分析显示了与分类相关的代谢模式和化学分类关系。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Morphological similarity among Ferula species, particularly during the vegetative stage, complicates the reliable authentication of leaf materials. The correspondence between phylogenetic relationships and leaf chemotaxonomic patterns among wild and cultivated Ferula resources remains insufficiently characterized. This study addressed three questions in 11 Ferula species from Xinjiang, China: whether combined DNA barcodes support species authentication and broad phylogenetic grouping; whether leaf metabolic profiles reveal taxon-associated differentiation; and to what extent phylogenetic and metabolic groupings correspond. Methods: Four DNA barcode loci, ITS2, trnH–psbA, rps11, and atpA–trnR, were combined for molecular authentication and phylogenetic analysis. Ultrasound-assisted extraction conditions were optimized using response surface methodology to establish standardized sample preparation, followed by LC–MS-based untargeted metabolomic profiling of 33 leaf samples representing 11 species. Multivariate analyses were used to characterize taxon-associated metabolic patterns and chemotaxonomic relationships. Results: The combined DNA barcode dataset genera
items.authors: Shuak Halimubek, Pengyan Yan, Lei Chen, Jingjing Chen, Xiaoqing Zhang, Siyu Chen

items.title: Brain Aging and Cellular Senescence Trigger Neuroimmunological Dysregulation and Neurodegeneration
items.title_zh: 大脑衰老与细胞衰老引发神经免疫失调与神经退行性变
items.summary_zh: 大脑衰老过程中的细胞衰老是一种复杂的生物现象，由与年龄相关的因素和外部因素引发，导致表观遗传和遗传改变，损害细胞复制，造成线粒体功能障碍，并激活衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。这种激活启动促炎信号级联反应，损害炎症消退机制，促进免疫衰老细胞和促炎介质的积累，推动被称为“炎症衰老”的慢性、与年龄相关的炎症。尽管免疫衰老和炎症衰老是不同的机制，但它们并非独立存在，均可通过维持慢性全身性促炎状态，促进神经退行性疾病的发展与进展。此外，免疫系统与中枢神经系统之间的双向通信通路功能障碍，加剧了神经炎症和神经退行性变。
items.abstract: Cellular senescence during brain aging is a complex biological phenomenon triggered by age-related and external factors, leading to epigenetic and genetic alterations that impair cellular replication, cause mitochondrial dysfunction, and activate the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). This activation initiates proinflammatory signaling cascades and impairs inflammation-resolution mechanisms, facilitating the accumulation of immunosenescent cells and proinflammatory mediators and promoting the chronic, age-associated inflammation known as “inflammaging.” Although immunosenescence and inflammaging are distinct mechanisms, they are not independent. Both can contribute to the development and progression of neurodegenerative disorders by maintaining a chronic systemic proinflammatory state mediated by dysfunction of signaling pathways involved in lipid metabolism and inflammation resolution, as well as by disrupting the blood–brain barrier, which facilitates neuroinflammation within the brain parenchyma. items.title: Role of the Gut Microbiome in Natural and Synthetic Drug Efficacy and Safety: A Narrative Review
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物组在药物疗效与安全性中的作用综述
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物组已成为许多治疗药物代谢、疗效和安全性的重要决定因素，拓展了传统的以宿主为中心的药理学观点。直接的微生物生物转化对口服给药的化合物尤为相关，而肠道微生物组也可以通过免疫、炎症、屏障和肝脏途径间接影响系统给药的疗法。除了在营养代谢、免疫调节和上皮稳态维持中的已知作用外，微生物组作为一个代谢活跃的器官，能够通过丰富的微生物酶和代谢物转化内源性分子、膳食化合物、外源物质和治疗药物。这些相互作用通过改变药物的药代动力学、药效学、生物利用度、治疗效果和毒性，影响药物处置的几乎每个阶段。本文综述了肠道微生物组的组成和功能多样性的当前知识，并探讨了宿主-微生物-药物相互作用的分子机制。
items.abstract: The gut microbiome has emerged as an important determinant of the metabolism, efficacy, and safety of many therapeutic agents, expanding the traditional host-centered view of pharmacology. Direct microbial biotransformation is particularly relevant to orally administered compounds, whereas the gut microbiome can also influence systemically administered therapies indirectly through immune, inflammatory, barrier, and hepatic pathways. Beyond its established roles in nutrient metabolism, immune regulation, and maintenance of epithelial homeostasis, the microbiome functions as a metabolically active organ capable of transforming endogenous molecules, dietary compounds, xenobiotics, and therapeutic agents through an extensive repertoire of microbial enzymes and metabolites. These interactions influence virtually every stage of drug disposition by modifying pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, bioavailability, therapeutic efficacy, and toxicity. This narrative review summarizes current knowledge of the composition and functional diversity of the gut microbiome and examines the molecular mechanisms underlying host–microbe–drug interactions, including direct microbial biotransformation, reg
items.authors: Ricardo Villoch-Rosado, Dijanneliz Acosta, Lorelein Morales-Santiago, Isabel M. González-Tardí, Omaira Medina-Rodríguez, Karoline Ríos-Rodríguez

items.title: Gut Microbiome-Mediated Neuroprotective Effect of the Mediterranean Diet: A Narrative Review of Cognitive Aging, Alzheimer’s Disease, and Parkinson’s Disease
items.title_zh: 地中海饮食对神经保护的肠道微生物组影响综述
items.summary_zh: 背景：阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）是主要的神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法有限。越来越多的证据表明，饮食通过肠道微生物组、免疫系统和大脑之间的相互作用影响神经退行性疾病的风险。地中海饮食（MD）与认知健康改善相关，但其潜在神经保护机制尚不完全清楚。目的：本综述综合了MD与神经保护相关的微生物介导机制的证据，并评估了地中海饮食成分如何影响微生物生态、代谢物、免疫调节和神经炎症。方法：回顾了实验、观察和临床研究的证据，重点关注微生物代谢物、肠道屏障完整性、免疫调节和炎症通路。讨论：地中海饮食成分如纤维、多酚、全谷物、豆类、坚果、特级初榨橄榄油和Omega-3脂肪酸可能促进有益微生物群落和代谢物的产生。短链脂肪酸、次级胆汁酸、吲哚衍生物和酚类代谢物可能增强肠道和血脑屏障，调节免疫反应。
items.abstract: Background: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and Parkinson’s disease (PD) are major neurodegenerative disorders for which disease-modifying therapies are limited. Increasingly, evidence suggests that diet influences neurodegenerative risk through interactions among the gut microbiome, immune system, and brain. The Mediterranean diet (MD) is associated with improved cognitive health, but the mechanisms underlying its potential neuroprotective effects remain incompletely understood. Objective: In this narrative review, evidence on microbiome-mediated mechanisms linking MD adherence to neuroprotection was synthesized, and how Mediterranean dietary components influence microbial ecology, metabolites, immune regulation, and neuroinflammation relevant to cognitive aging, AD, and PD was evaluated. Methods: Evidence from experimental, observational, and clinical studies was reviewed, focusing on microbial metabolites, intestinal barrier integrity, immune regulation, and inflammatory pathways. Discussion: Mediterranean dietary components, including fiber, polyphenols, whole grains, legumes, nuts, extra-virgin olive oil, and omega-3 fatty acids, may promote beneficial microbial communities and metab
items.authors: Kundun Kamalakar, Christa Akerele, Ezequiel Lafont, Lauren R. Koralnik, Caitlin Gilman, Jose Clemente Litran

items.title: Developmental synchrony of retinal waves, apoptosis, and angiogenesis in postnatal retina
items.title_zh: 后天视网膜发育中视网膜波、凋亡与血管生成的同步性
items.summary_zh: 后天小鼠视网膜发育是一个多方面的过程，涉及自发神经活动（视网膜波）、血管丛生长和程序性细胞死亡的协调互动。尽管这些过程在粗略层面上已知相互作用，但具体的整合机制仍不明确。通过大规模宽场钙成像、高密度多电极阵列记录、单细胞RNA测序和免疫组化，我们描述了视网膜发育过程中紧密对齐的离心扩展模式。该模式与II期视网膜波的出现、血管发育、表达Heme氧合酶-1（Hmox1）的小胶质细胞、凋亡细胞标记物及本研究中识别的新型自发荧光簇复合物（ACCs）相关。已知凋亡细胞上调功能性pannexin-1（PANX-1）半通道，这些电压门控通道释放的嘌呤分子作为“吃我”信号吸引邻近的小胶质细胞。用药物丙磺舒阻断PANX-1半通道会显著降低自发波的频率和强度，表明视网膜波确实由这些凋亡细胞触发。我们的观察表明，自发波最初是在未血管化的视网膜区域由过度活跃的凋亡视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）触发。
items.abstract: Postnatal mouse retinal development is a multi-faceted process involving the coordinated interaction of spontaneous neural activity as retinal waves, vascular plexus growth, and programmed cell death. While these processes are known to interact at a coarse scale, the specific mechanisms integrating them have remained elusive. Using large-scale, wide-field calcium imaging, high-density multielectrode array recordings, single-cell RNA sequencing, and immunohistochemistry, we characterise a tightly aligned centrifugal expansion pattern during retinal development. This pattern is common to stage II retinal wave onsets, vascular development, Heme oxygenase-1 (Hmox1) expressing microglia, apoptotic cell markers, and a novel set of auto-fluorescent cluster complexes (ACCs) identified in this study. Apoptotic cells are known to upregulate functional pannexin-1 (PANX-1) hemichannels. These voltage-gated channels release purinergic molecules which act as ‘eat me’ signals to neighbouring microglia. PANX-1 hemichannel blockade with the drug probenecid results in a profound decrease in spontaneous wave frequency and strength, suggesting that retinal waves are indeed triggered by these apoptotic

items.title: Investigation of Word Recognition Methods for Japanese Fingerspelling Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的日语手指拼写识别方法研究
items.summary_zh: 自动手指拼写识别系统的开发对聋人和听力障碍者的无缝沟通至关重要。传统的识别技术依赖于可穿戴传感器，如数据手套和惯性测量单元（IMU），虽然提供了稳定的运动数据，但硬件成本高且用户不适。非侵入式视觉传感技术的出现消除了可穿戴设备的负担，但面临严重的物理瓶颈：高速运动不可避免地引入运动模糊和自遮挡，显著降低跟踪精度。为了解决这些视觉传感限制，我们研究了一种视觉-语言集成框架，将来自单个RGB视频流的动态视觉表示与大语言模型（LLM）的词汇知识结合，使语言模型能够补偿视觉表示中的不确定性或错误。我们的方法采用了一个强大的视觉编码器，包括时间卷积网络（TCN）和变换器，从3D骨骼坐标中提取和整合动态过渡特征。此研究重点在于如何将视觉信息有效地表示和传递给LLM。
items.abstract: The development of automatic fingerspelling recognition systems is critical for facilitating seamless communication for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. Historically, recognition technologies relied on wearable sensors, such as data gloves, inertial measurement units (IMUs), and surface electromyography (sEMG), which provided stable kinematic data but suffered from high hardware costs and user discomfort. Non-invasive vision-based sensing has emerged to eliminate wearable overhead but is subject to severe physical bottlenecks: continuous high-speed movements inevitably introduce motion blur and self-occlusion, drastically degrading tracking accuracy. To address these visual sensing constraints, we investigate a visual-language integration framework that combines dynamic visual representations derived from a single RGB video stream with the lexical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), allowing the language model to compensate for uncertainty or errors in the visual representation. Our approach employs a robust visual encoder—comprising a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) and a Transformer—to extract and integrate dynamic transition features from 3D skeletal coordinat
items.authors: Yousun Kang, Renta Kuzuyama, Naoto Tsuta, Ryota Murai, Duk Shin

items.title: Methionine Aminopeptidase 2 (METAP2) in Prader-Willi Syndrome Using In Silico Network Analysis of Translation and Metabolic Pathways that Could Impact Treatment: Initial Observations
items.title_zh: 利用网络分析探讨Prader-Willi综合征中的METAP2
items.summary_zh: Prader-Willi综合征（PWS）是一种印记疾病，表现为严重的肌肉无力、吸吮困难、发育不良及性腺发育不良，伴随早期儿童期的暴食症、严重肥胖和代谢失调。使用Beloranib（一种fumagillin类似物）抑制甲硫氨酸氨肽酶2（METAP2）可抑制血管生成，并在临床试验中与减少脂肪、降低食欲和体重相关。然而，由于出现血栓栓塞事件和死亡报告，Beloranib的临床试验被中止。为更好地表征METAP2及相关METAP1的生物机制，我们进行了全面的生物信息学分析，利用STRING、Pathway Commons和BioGRID等数据库比较基因和蛋白质交互网络。研究发现，METAP2在调控细胞质翻译、核糖体生物合成、翻译后蛋白质成熟、泛素介导的蛋白质稳态及脂质生物学的网络中占据中心位置，并与核糖体蛋白、去泛素化酶及鞘脂类有强关联。
items.abstract: Prader–Willi syndrome (PWS) is an imprinting disorder characterized by severe hypotonia, poor suck, failure to thrive and hypogonadism\hypogenitalism noted during infancy with hyperphagia, severe obesity, and metabolic dysregulation onset in early childhood. Inhibition of methionine aminopeptidase 2 (METAP2) using Beloranib, a fumagillin analog inhibits angiogenesis and associated with decreased adiposity, reduced appetite and body weight in clinical trials of obese individuals with and without PWS. However, clinical trials using Beloranib were discontinued following reports of thromboembolic events and deaths. To better characterize the biological mechanisms underlying METAP2 and related METAP1, we performed a comprehensive silico analysis of genetic and curated protein interactive networks with initial observations from STRING and compared with Pathway Commons and BioGRID interactive gene and protein web-based programs. The studies revealed that METAP2 is centrally embedded within networks governing cytoplasmic translation, ribosomal biogenesis, post-translational protein maturation, ubiquitin-mediated proteostasis, and lipid biology. items.authors: Lucas Francis, Magd Boutany, David Abdelnour, Merlin G. Butler

items.title: Return to a Mid-Piacenzian Climate (Formerly Called the Middle Pliocene) Will Increasingly Spread Pathogens and Accelerate a Higher Severity of Pathogen Virulence by Immunogenomic Editing
items.title_zh: 中皮奥岑气候回归对病原体传播的影响
items.summary_zh: 中皮奥岑时期气候回归正在进行，尤其在高纬度地区产生了负面影响。这一气候变化显著扩大了媒介的地理范围，并增加了病原体感染。这将加速病原体与媒介及宿主亚群体免疫系统之间的多种进化机制。免疫基因组编辑被定义为病原体基因组或媒介或宿主亚群体免疫系统基因组的演变。免疫编辑是免疫基因组编辑的一种分类，最初是针对癌症基因组的研究。随后又识别出针对病原体和人类的其他两种免疫基因组编辑分类。免疫基因组编辑至少有七种潜在分类，其中五种具有应用，包括分析媒介和宿主亚群体对病原体的反应。还可能促进对亚群体对致命病原体流行病脆弱性差异的分析。对病原体传播链的快速分析需求日益增加。
items.abstract: A climate return to the Mid-Piacenzian period (formerly called the Middle Pliocene) is progressing with detrimental consequences, especially in the higher latitudes. This climatic shift is substantially increasing vector ranges geographically and increasing pathogen infections. This will additionally accelerate several evolutionary mechanisms that exist between pathogens, and the immune systems of subpopulations of vectors and hosts. Immunogenomic editing is defined as the evolution of pathogen genomes or the vector or host subpopulation immune system genomes. One immunogenomic editing classification, called immunoediting, was first recognized regarding cancer genomes. Two other immunogenomic editing classifications were subsequently recognized for pathogens and humans. However, these classifications of editing are only examples of much broader immunogenomic editing processes, and other potential classifications of immunogenomic editing were only recently recognized. Immunogenomic editing has at least seven potential classifications, and five immunogenomic editing classifications have applications including analysis of vector and host subpopulation pathogen responses. items.authors: Kevin Roe

items.title: Neuroendocrine Tumors (NETs) of the Larynx
items.title_zh: 喉部神经内分泌肿瘤的现状与诊断
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了喉部神经内分泌肿瘤（NETs）的现状，重点关注其流行病学、病因病理、临床病理特征、免疫组化特征及鉴别诊断。根据最新的《世界卫生组织头颈肿瘤分类》第五版，喉部NET的诊断标准已被定义，其中新增了G3 NET的分类，但部分标准仍为临时性。喉部最常见的NET为G2 NET，主要影响老年男性，常见于喉上部。确诊需通过细胞角蛋白和神经内分泌标志物（如嗜铬粒蛋白、INSM1、突触素）证明肿瘤的上皮来源和神经内分泌分化。不同NET类型的鉴别基于有丝分裂活性和Ki-67增殖指数，以及坏死的存在与否。喉部NET通常表现为野生型p53表达，并保留Rb1和生长抑素受体2的表达，有助于与神经内分泌癌（NEC）的鉴别。由于喉部NET常表达降钙素，需与髓样甲状腺癌（MTC）进行区分。
items.abstract: To review the current state of knowledge regarding neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) of the larynx, with a particular focus on their epidemiology, etiopathogenesis, clinico-pathological features, immunohistochemical profile, and differential diagnostics. Narrative review. Diagnostic criteria for laryngeal NETs were recently defined in the 5th edition of the WHO Classification of Head and Neck Tumors, which newly introduces the entity of NET, grade 3 (G3 NET). However, some of these criteria are still considered provisional. The most common NET of the larynx is the G2 NET. These tumors typically affect older men, with the supraglottic region being the most frequent localization. For a definitive diagnosis, it is essential to demonstrate the epithelial origin and neuroendocrine differentiation of these tumors using cytokeratins and neuroendocrine markers (e.g., chromogranin, INSM1, synaptophysin). The differentiation between individual NET types is based on mitotic activity and/or Ki-67 proliferation index, as well as the presence or absence of necrosis. items.title: House Dust Mite Induces Distinct Cellular and Extracellular Vesicle-Associated miRNA Signatures in BEAS-2B Cells: Targeted Analysis of IL-4 Responses
items.title_zh: 尘螨诱导BEAS-2B细胞特异性miRNA特征及IL-4反应分析
items.summary_zh: 气道上皮细胞通过过敏原感知、2型细胞因子反应和细胞外囊泡（EV）介导的细胞间通信积极调节过敏性哮喘。本研究探讨了尘螨（HDM）暴露对BEAS-2B支气管上皮细胞及其EV富集部分的miRNA反应，并在白细胞介素-4（IL-4）刺激后分析了选定的HDM反应性miRNA。BEAS-2B细胞暴露于HDM提取物或IL-4 72小时后，从条件培养基中分离EV富集制剂，并通过透射电子显微镜、纳米颗粒追踪分析、EV相关标记物的免疫印迹和摄取实验进行表征。使用NanoString nCounter Human v3 miRNA检测对对照组和HDM处理样本进行全球细胞和EV相关miRNA分析，并通过qRT-PCR验证选定候选者。HDM反应性miRNA随后在IL-4处理的细胞及相应的EV相关RNA中通过靶向qRT-PCR进行评估。差异表达的miRNA进行了通路富集分析。HDM暴露显著诱导了重塑反应。
items.abstract: Airway epithelial cells actively regulate allergic asthma through allergen sensing, type 2 cytokine responses, and extracellular vesicle (EV)-mediated intercellular communication. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are important post-transcriptional regulators of epithelial inflammation and remodeling; however, the extent to which allergen exposure differentially alters cellular and EV-associated miRNA profiles remains incompletely understood. This study characterized miRNA responses to house dust mite (HDM) exposure in BEAS-2B bronchial epithelial cells and their EV-enriched fractions and subsequently examined selected HDM-responsive miRNAs following interleukin-4 (IL-4) stimulation. BEAS-2B cells were exposed to HDM extract or IL-4 for 72 h. EV-enriched preparations were isolated from conditioned media and characterized by transmission electron microscopy, nanoparticle tracking analysis, immunoblotting of EV-associated markers, and uptake assays. Global cellular and EV-associated miRNA profiling was performed in control and HDM-treated samples using the NanoString nCounter Human v3 miRNA assay, followed by qRT-PCR validation of selected candidates. items.title: Tunnell's Theorem, #P-Completeness, and the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
items.title_zh: Tunnell定理、#P完全性与Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer猜想
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在\(\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}\)但\(\#\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{FP}\)的复杂性理论情境下，Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer猜想（BSD）对同余数曲线\(E_n: y^2 = x^3 - n^2x\)的影响。我们通过Tunnell定理，利用三次形式\(8x^2 + 2y^2 + 64z^2\)和\(8x^2 + 2y^2 + 16z^2\)的表示计数\(C_n\)和\(D_n\)来建立联系。我们证明了四个无条件结果：首先，对于平方自由的\(n \equiv 2 \pmod 8\)，有\(D_n = 2h(-4n)\)；而对于平方自由的\(n \equiv 6 \pmod 8\)，则\(D_n = C_n = 0\)。其次，虚二次数的类数在\(\mathrm{FP}^{\Sigma_2^{\mathrm{P}}}\)中可计算，因此在\(\mathrm{FP}\)中如果\(\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}\)。第三，\(C_n - h(-4n)\)是Tunnell权重为\(3/2\)的尖点形式的\(n/2\)阶傅里叶系数。最后，任何从\(\#\mathrm{SAT}\)到\(D_n\)的精确计数归约将导致...
items.abstract: We explore the complexity-theoretic scenario in which \(\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}\) but \(\#\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{FP}\), and ask what it would imply for the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture (BSD) for the congruent number curves \(E_n: y^2 = x^3 - n^2x\). We prove four unconditional results. First, for square-free \(n \equiv 2 \pmod 8\) one has \(D_n = 2h(-4n)\), where \(h(-4n)\) is the class number of \(\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-n})\), while \(D_n = C_n = 0\) for square-free \(n \equiv 6 \pmod 8\). items.title: Gut Microbiome, Blood–Brain Barrier, and Psychiatric Disease: A Translational Review of Microbial Control of Neurovascular Function
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物组、血脑屏障与精神疾病的关系综述
items.summary_zh: 背景：肠道微生物通过代谢物、免疫和神经信号调节大脑功能，血脑屏障（BBB）作为神经血管单元的守门人，成为这一影响的主要靶点。BBB的破坏在主要精神疾病中日益受到关注，提示微生物驱动的神经血管变化可能促进抑郁症和精神分裂症中的神经炎症。目的：综合证据表明肠道微生物及其代谢物调节BBB的结构和功能，并将这些机制与精神病理生理联系起来，评估通过神经血管轴作用的微生物群靶向干预。方法：对包括无菌和抗生素耗竭模型、体外BBB模型、病例对照微生物组研究、屏障功能障碍生物标志物以及益生菌和粪便微生物移植（FMT）随机试验的前临床、机制和临床文献进行叙述性综述。结果：无菌小鼠显示BBB通透性增加，伴随occludin和claudin-5减少，通过细菌定植和短链脂肪酸（如丁酸和丙酸）可逆转；而三甲胺-N-氧化物和内毒素则促进屏障损失。
items.abstract: Background: The gut microbiota regulates brain function through metabolite, immune, and neural signaling, and emerging evidence identifies the blood–brain barrier (BBB), gatekeeper of the neurovascular unit, as a principal target of this influence. BBB disruption is increasingly recognized in major psychiatric disorders, suggesting microbiota-driven neurovascular change contributes to neuroinflammation in depression and schizophrenia. Objective: To synthesize evidence that gut microorganisms and metabolites regulate BBB structure and function, link these mechanisms to psychiatric pathophysiology, and evaluate microbiota-targeted interventions acting through the neurovascular axis. Methods: Narrative review of preclinical, mechanistic, and clinical literature, including germ-free and antibiotic-depletion models, in vitro BBB models, case-control microbiome studies, barrier-dysfunction biomarkers, and randomized trials of probiotics and fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). Results: Germ-free mice show increased BBB permeability with reduced occludin and claudin-5, reversible by bacterial colonization and short-chain fatty acids such as butyrate and propionate, acting via G-protein
items.authors: Sushil Kumar Sompur Vasanthkumar

items.title: Video-Based Quantitative Assessment of Facial Expressivity in the Follow-up of Parkinson’s Disease
items.title_zh: 基于视频的帕金森病面部表情定量评估研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了帕金森病（PD）患者的面部表情特征，重点关注特征症状——面部表情减退（hypomimia），该症状表现为自发面部运动和情感表达的减少或丧失。研究对象为九名确诊为PD的墨西哥患者，采用纵向研究设计，在基线和八周临床随访后进行评估。参与者在两次会话中模仿八种特定面部表情，使用高清摄像机记录面部。通过MediaPipe FaceMesh框架提取视频中的动态特征（欧几里得距离），对关键标志点进行量化。结果显示，基线评估的标准化标志点距离偏移量更高（代表静息基线），且峰间幅度更宽，相较于八周随访，表明面部表情显著减少。
items.abstract: Facial expressivity analysis in Parkinson’s disease (PD) has received considerable attention due to the characteristic symptom of hypomimia, which is defined as the reduction or loss of spontaneous facial movements and emotional facial expressions. Hypomimia has been linked to a detrimental impact on close relationships and psychological well-being. This investigation presents the preliminary findings of a quantitative analysis of facial expressivity in a longitudinal pilot cohort of nine Mexican subjects diagnosed with PD, evaluated during two sessions: at baseline and following eight weeks of clinical follow-up under stable medication conditions. In each session, participants were instructed to mimic eight specific facial expressions while their faces were recorded with a high-definition camera. Facial expressivity was quantified by extracting dynamic features (Euclidean distances) between key landmarks from video recordings using the MediaPipe FaceMesh framework (utilizing 468 3D landmarks, excluding the iris). items.title: Integrated respirometry and metabolomics unveil circadian metabolic dynamics in Drosophila
items.title_zh: 综合呼吸测量与代谢组学揭示果蝇昼夜代谢动态
items.summary_zh: 睡眠和昼夜节律影响生物体的能量模式，但其与氧气使用和二氧化碳产生的关系尚不完全清楚。本研究结合高分辨率呼吸测量与液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）基础的代谢组学，表征了果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）的呼吸动态和代谢状态，解析了睡眠干扰和昼夜调节的基因型特异性影响。在光暗周期下的野生型果蝇（WT-LD）显示出反映线粒体能量代谢、氨基酸周转和氧化还原循环的节律性呼吸模式。短睡眠突变体（fmn，sss）表现出代谢率升高，燃料偏好向脂质和氨基酸分解代谢转变，线粒体呼吸发生改变。时钟突变体（per 01）和在持续黑暗下的果蝇（WT-DD）显示出广泛的代谢失调和氧化还原稳态受损。这些发现表明，睡眠和昼夜系统共同作用于代谢底物选择与能量需求的协调，为行为状态干扰如何影响代谢健康提供了机制性见解。
items.abstract: Sleep and circadian rhythms shape organismal energy patterns, but how this timing connects to oxygen use and carbon dioxide production remains incompletely understood. We combined high-resolution respirometry with liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based metabolomics to characterize respiratory dynamics and metabolic states in Drosophila melanogaster , resolving genotype-specific impacts of sleep disruption and circadian regulation. Wild-type flies under light-dark cycles (WT-LD) showed rhythmic respiratory patterns reflective of anticipatory coordination of mitochondrial energy metabolism, amino acid turnover, and redox cycling. Short-sleep mutants ( fmn , sss ) exhibited elevated metabolic rates, with reactive shifts of fuel preferences toward lipid and amino acid catabolism, and altered mitochondrial respiration. The clock mutant ( per 01 ) and flies under constant darkness (WT-DD) showed reactive and widespread metabolic dysregulation and impaired redox homeostasis. items.title: Immunoregenerative Microenvironment Modulation in Tendon–Ligament Regeneration: Evolution of Chitosan-Based Composite Biomaterials
items.title_zh: 肌腱-韧带再生中的免疫再生微环境调节：壳聚糖基复合生物材料的演变
items.summary_zh: 肌腱和韧带损伤的治疗仍然具有挑战性，因为愈合可能导致纤维化、不完全的肌腱-骨整合、受损的生物力学特性和再损伤。本文综述了壳聚糖基复合生物材料在肌腱-韧带再生中的前临床证据，重点关注其从结构支架向多功能免疫再生平台的演变。评估了免疫调节、炎症信号、血管生成、祖细胞活性、细胞外基质重塑、纤维软骨形成、附着点再生、肌腱-骨愈合和生物力学恢复等方面的证据，同时区分了与壳聚糖直接相关的证据与来自更广泛生物材料系统的背景证据。壳聚糖基平台通过结构引导、生物粘附、活性成分的局部递送和配方依赖的免疫调节活性支持多个再生领域。然而，壳聚糖的物理化学性质、复合配方、实验模型和结果测量的异质性限制了直接比较，并阻碍了将多组分效应明确归因于壳聚糖。我们提出了免疫再生级联理论和免疫再生肌腱-韧带单元，作为组织时间和空间的互补假设生成框架。
items.abstract: Tendon and ligament injuries remain challenging to treat because healing may result in fibrosis, incomplete tendon–bone integration, impaired biomechanical properties, and reinjury. This review critically synthesizes preclinical evidence on chitosan-based composite biomaterials for tendon–ligament regeneration, focusing on their evolution from structural scaffolds toward multifunctional immunoregenerative platforms. Evidence across immune regulation, inflammatory signaling, angiogenesis, progenitor-cell activity, extracellular matrix remodeling, fibrocartilage formation, enthesis regeneration, tendon–bone healing, and biomechanical recovery was evaluated, while distinguishing direct chitosan-related evidence from contextual evidence derived from broader biomaterial systems. Chitosan-based platforms may support multiple regenerative domains through structural guidance, bioadhesion, localized delivery of bioactive components, and formulation-dependent immunomodulatory activity. items.authors: Muhammad Wibowo Ariyanto, Zairin Noor, Dwikora Novembri Utomo, Oski Illiandri

items.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Expression Profiling of the GATA Gene Family Reveals Candidate Genes Associated with GA3-Induced Shoot Elongation in Citrus grandis ‘Wanbai’
items.title_zh: 柚子‘万白’GATA基因家族的全基因组鉴定与表达分析
items.summary_zh: 植物GATA转录因子是参与信号转导、生长和发育的锌指蛋白。本研究对柚子（Citrus grandis）‘万白’的CgGATA基因家族进行了全基因组鉴定，分析了其物理化学性质、染色体分布、系统发育关系、基因结构、保守基序、共线性及预测的顺式作用元件。采用RT-qPCR技术检测了不同组织的表达谱，以及在GA3处理下‘万白’柚子芽尖的表达变化和高矮柚子基因型的表达模式。共鉴定出23个CgGATA基因，分为四个系统发育亚家族。相同亚家族的成员通常具有相似的基因结构和保守基序。比较共线性分析显示，柚子与甜橙之间的GATA基因对比柚子与拟南芥之间更多。预测的上游调控区域包含与光、植物激素、生长和应激反应相关的元件。基因在不同组织中表现出明显的表达谱。
items.abstract: Plant GATA transcription factors are zinc-finger proteins involved in signal transduction, growth and development. However, their potential involvement in plant height and gibberellin-associated shoot growth in pummelo insufficiently characterised. In this study, members of the CgGATA gene family were identified genome-wide and characterised through analyses of physicochemical properties, chromosomal distribution, phylogenetic relationships, gene structures, conserved motifs, collinearity and predicted cis-acting elements in putative upstream regulatory regions. RT-qPCR was used to examine expression profiles across sampled tissues, and expression changes associated with prolonged gibberellin (GA3) treatment in ‘Wanbai Pummelo’ shoot tips, and expression patterns in tall and dwarf pummelo genotypes. A total of 23 CgGATA genes were identified and classified into four phylogenetic subfamilies. Members of the same subfamily generally shared similar gene structures and conserved-motif compositions. items.title: Ubiquitin Proteasome System BTB-Adaptor Protein Insomniac Modifies Seizure Severity and Response to the Ketogenic Diet in a Drosophila Model of Mitochondrial Encephalomyopathy
items.title_zh: 泛素-蛋白酶体系统适配蛋白Insomniac影响果蝇癫痫和生酮饮食反应
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）在神经健康中发挥重要作用，包括神经代谢、突触可塑性和分子昼夜节律。UPS的调控确保健康蛋白质与需降解蛋白质的平衡，失调可导致神经退行性疾病等。BTB超家族的适配蛋白在此系统中连接底物与蛋白酶体复合物。我们研究了果蝇中BTB家族成员Insomniac对神经兴奋性疾病表型的影响。方法：采用遗传学方法探讨线粒体脑肌病（ME）中的神经行为功能障碍及饮食疗法的调节能力。结果：我们发现，干扰Insomniac基因在ATP61 ME模型中以神经元亚型特异性方式改变癫痫样行为，在GABA能或多巴胺能神经元中降低癫痫严重性。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The ubiquitin proteasome system (UPS) serves critical cellular homeostatic functions that contribute to neurological health, including neuronal metabolism, synaptic plasticity, and the molecular circadian clock. The UPS is tightly regulated to ensure the correct balance of healthy proteins and those targeted for degradation and recycling; malfunction in this quality control process can contribute to disease states such as neurodegeneration and cancer. Target specificity in this system is due in part to ubiquitin ligase adaptor proteins, such as those of the BTB superfamily of proteins, which connect substrates to the larger proteasomal complex. In Drosophila, the BTB family member insomniac (human orthologs KTCD2, 5, and 17) has been shown to regulate sleep, arousal, and synaptic plasticity, but has not been examined for a role in neuronal excitability disease phenotypes. Methods: We utilized a genetic approach to interrogate neurobehavioral dysfunction in mitochondrial encephalomyopathy (ME) and the ability of dietary therapy to modulate this dysfunction. items.authors: Keri J. Fogle, Brynn Urban, Dana M. Mumford, Michael J. Palladino

items.title: Preoperative Zinc Deficiency as a Novel Prognostic Predictor for Postoperative Recurrence in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 术前锌缺乏作为肝细胞癌术后复发的新预后指标
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：术前锌（Zn）状态对肝细胞癌（HCC）患者在肝切除术后生存和复发的影响尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨术前锌缺乏是否影响接受初次治愈性肝切除术的HCC患者的预后。方法：我们回顾性分析了2011年至2018年在我院接受初次治愈性肝切除术的105例HCC患者。术前锌缺乏定义为血清锌低于70 µg/dL。比较锌缺乏组与正常锌组的临床和肿瘤参数。采用Kaplan-Meier法评估无病生存期和总体生存期，并通过单变量和多变量Cox比例风险分析识别预后因素。结果：105例患者中，46例（43.8%）为锌缺乏组，59例（56.2%）为正常锌组。锌缺乏组的血红蛋白、凝血酶原活性、血清白蛋白显著低于正常锌组，肿瘤大小也较小（均p < 0.05）。锌缺乏组的无病生存期显著较差（p = 0.015），但总体生存期无显著差异（p = 0.63）。多变量分析显示，锌缺乏是独立预后因素（风险比[HR] 1.83，p = 0.040）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The impact of preoperative zinc (Zn) status on the survival and recurrence of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) after hepatectomy remains unclear. This study aimed to clarify whether preoperative Zn deficiency affects the prognosis of patients with HCC undergoing initial curative hepatectomy. Methods: We retrospectively reviewed 105 patients who underwent initial curative hepatectomy for HCC at our institution (2011–2018). Preoperative Zn deficiency was defined as serum Zn 70 µg/dL. Clinical and tumor parameters were compared between patients with and without Zn deficiency. Disease-free and overall survival were evaluated using the Kaplan–Meier method, and prognostic factors were identified via univariate and multivariate Cox proportional hazards analyses. Subgroup analyses were conducted based on age, gender, and etiology. Results: Among 105 patients, 46 (43.8%) showed Zn deficiency (Zn deficiency group), whereas 59 (56.2%) showed normal Zn (normal Zn group). items.authors: Yuki Adachi, Shingo Shimada, Shoichiro Mizukami, Tomoki Takizawa, Katsuro Enomoto, Kai Makino

items.title: The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis
items.title_zh: AI神经科学家：神经影像分析的交互式智能界面
items.summary_zh: 分析神经影像数据需要专业的编码和统计知识，这限制了没有计算背景的研究人员的可及性。我们提出了AI神经科学家，一个用于交互式数据探索的语言代理。该系统将大型语言模型（LLM）与神经影像工具集结合，执行质量控制、建模和可视化。这使研究人员能够直接用自然语言查询数据质量并指定分析参数，为小规模数据探索提供了一种透明且互动的替代方案。我们使用功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）数据展示了这些功能，并在自定义的fNIRS基准测试套件上评估了该代理，与具有代码沙箱的一般用途LLM代理进行比较。未来的扩展将使架构适用于其他模态，包括功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据，并将基准测试套件扩展到更多fNIRS任务。
items.abstract: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to conventional scripted pipelines for small-scale data exploration. We demonstrate these capabilities using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, and evaluate the agent on a custom fNIRS benchmarking suite against general-purpose LLM agents with code sandboxes. Future extensions will generalize the architecture to additional modalities, including functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, and expand the benchmarking suite to additional fNIRS tasks.
items.authors: Aakash Patel, Panos Ketonis, Shreya Saxena, Smita Krishnaswamy, David van Dijk

items.title: Potential for Enhanced Learning in Machine Learning Classes by Using Wiki LLM Indexing
items.title_zh: 利用Wiki LLM索引提升机器学习课程学习效果的潜力
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为特定课程的辅导工具，但其有效性依赖于经过审查的教学材料，这些材料常常在学期中进行修订。我们之前的研究建立了一个基于真实机器学习课程（机器学习基础）的多模态检索增强生成（RAG）系统，发现检索提高了上下文基础，但固定的检索策略并不理想。本文探讨了语料库在导入时的结构是否比查询时的检索量更为重要。我们对两种知识表示形式进行了对比：一种是向量RAG，另一种是基于LLM编译的维基（Karpathy框架），后者在导入时将语料库合成成具有明确交叉引用和来源材料的链接概念页面。我们评估了59个问题，涵盖单一事实回忆、跨单元概念链接、综合与解释，以及课程大纲修订后的时效性。结果显示，两种表示在单一事实问题上的表现相近（9.33 vs. 9.96），但在需要跨课程单元链接的问题上表现差异显著。编译的维基保持了准确性。
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as course-specific tutors, but their usefulness depends on grounding in vetted instructional materials that are often revised mid-semester. Our prior work built a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over an authentic machine learning course corpus (Foundations of Machine Learning) and found that retrieval improved contextual grounding, but that fixed retrieval strategies were suboptimal. That motivates a different question: whether how a corpus is structured at ingest time matters more than how much is retrieved at query time. We present a controlled head-to-head comparison of two knowledge representations over an identical classroom corpus: (A) vector RAG, replicating the best-performing configuration from our prior study, and (B) an LLM-compiled wiki (Karpathy framework), in which the corpus is synthesized at ingest into linked concept pages with explicit cross-references and citations back to source materials. We evaluate 59 questions spanning single-fact recall, cross-unit concept linking, synthesis and explanation, and currency after a syllabus revision, scored by an LLM judge against a human-authored rubric. items.authors: Brian Wright

items.title: Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition for OpenXR Using Transformer-Based Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 基于变换器的实时手势识别在OpenXR中的应用
items.summary_zh: 手势识别是人机交互（HCI）的关键组成部分，为游戏、虚拟现实（VR）、机器人等应用提供直观界面。本研究整合了基于变换器的机器学习模型，实现实时手势识别，使用通过OpenXR标准在Unity中捕获的手部追踪数据。我们利用手关节的位置信息和手腕旋转角度来训练定制的手势识别系统。通过利用变换器的序列建模能力，该系统能够捕捉短时间手势窗口内的时间依赖性，并在不同手部方向和大小下稳健地分类手势。结果显示手势分类准确率显著提高。基于此，我们概述了该方法如何扩展到检测运动流动，即手势之间的过渡，作为未来的研究方向。
items.abstract: Hand gesture recognition is a key component in human-computer interaction (HCI), enabling intuitive interfaces for applications in gaming, virtual reality (VR), robotics, and more. This study integrates transformer-based machine-learning models for real-time hand gesture recognition, using hand-tracking data captured through the OpenXR standard in Unity. We leverage positional data of hand joints and wrist rotation angles to train a custom gesture recognition system. By utilizing the sequential modeling capabilities of transformers, the system captures temporal dependencies within short gesture windows and classifies gestures robustly across hand orientations and sizes. The results show a significant improvement in gesture classification accuracy. Building on this, we outline how the approach can be extended toward detecting the flow of movement, i.e., the transitions between gestures, as future work.
items.authors: Salar Rezayani, Russell Butler

items.title: Early Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Using Temporal Deep Learning on DWI
items.title_zh: 基于时间深度学习的早期预测新辅助化疗病理完全缓解
items.summary_zh: 早期识别乳腺癌新辅助化疗（NACT）中的非应答者对及时调整治疗方案至关重要。本研究提出了一种深度学习框架，仅使用基线和第一次NACT周期后的扩散加权磁共振成像（DW-MRI）进行病理完全缓解（pCR）的早期预测。该框架将肿瘤中心裁剪的图像块输入基于EfficientNet的时间模型，直接学习肿瘤形状和局部组织特征，而无需显式的放射组学特征工程。经过10折交叉验证，模型在一次治疗周期后实现了0.90的接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC），提供了可操作的信息，避免了钆剂的使用，并减少了对异质临床数据的依赖。该方法聚焦于基线到第一次周期的窗口，支持NACT的早期升级或降级，并且仅依赖DW-MRI有助于协议标准化、多中心部署和隐私保护的数据共享。
items.abstract: Early identification of non-responders to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) is crucial for timely treatment adaptation in breast cancer. However, many existing predictive models rely on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), late treatment time points, or extensive clinical data, which limits their applicability. This study proposes a deep learning framework for early prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) using only diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) acquired at baseline and after the first NACT cycle. This framework feeds cropped tumor-centered patches to an EfficientNet-based temporal model that directly learns tumor shape and local tissue characteristics without explicit radiomic feature engineering. The model, trained with 10-fold cross-validation, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.90 for pCR prediction after one cycle, providing actionable information after a single treatment cycle while avoiding gadolinium administration and reducing dependence on heterogeneous clinical data. By focusing on the baseline-to-first-cycle window instead of later stages, the approach supports earlier escalation or de-escalation of NACT
items.authors: Pablo Garc\'ia Marcos, Md. Tarequl Islam, Paula Puerta Gonz\'alez, Guillermo Lorenzo, H\'ector G\'omez, Covadonga del Camino, Angel Rio-Alvarez, V\'ictor M. Gonz\'alez

items.title: Toward User-Mediated Self-Repair in Ubiquitous Robots Through Goal-Oriented Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 面向用户自我修复的普适机器人目标导向智能体AI研究
items.summary_zh: 普适机器人系统通常缺乏传统视觉界面，因此需要强大的自然语言交互来完成维护和修理任务。本文提出了一种目标导向的智能体AI架构，旨在通过情境对话使非专业用户能够进行技术修理。该框架采用多层次方法，将高层战略规划与反应性对话执行解耦，将不受限制的人类指令转化为结构化的目标层级。我们对二十名参与者进行了研究，使用物理硬件测试平台评估系统的有效性。该架构实现了95%的任务完成率，参与者在实时指导下报告了积极的自我效能感，指导能够适应对话偏离和语言变化。与在线基线的比较分析显示，转向物理环境显著降低了感知的社会存在感（p=.0005）以及信任和能力感（p=.037），而智能体框架在整个互动过程中保持稳健。这些发现表明，目标导向的智能体AI可以通过赋能用户在普适环境中执行关键维护，支持可穿戴技术的可持续性。
items.abstract: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, necessitating resilient natural language interaction for maintenance and repair tasks. This paper presents a goal oriented agentic AI architecture designed to enable non-expert users to perform technical repairs through situated dialogue. The framework utilizes a multi-layered approach that decouples high-level strategic planning from reactive conversational execution to transform unconstrained human instructions into a structured hierarchy of goals. We conducted a study involving twenty participants to evaluate the system's efficacy using a physical hardware testbed. The architecture achieved a 95\% task completion rate, and participants reported positive self-efficacy following real-time guidance that adapted to conversational diversions and linguistic variations. A comparative analysis with an online baseline revealed that the transition to a physical environment significantly decreased perceived social presence (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while the agentic framework remained robust throughout the interaction. items.authors: Morten Roed Frederiksen

items.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: EADC：大型语言模型合规性评估的新方法
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各行业中得到广泛应用，但确保其遵循复杂法律和监管框架仍然面临巨大挑战。现有评估方法主要依赖静态基准，存在三大局限：一是合规规则未能符合人工智能（AI）法律法规的要求；二是仅处理明显的合规风险，忽视隐性和隐蔽风险；三是无法追踪风险在逻辑依赖链中的系统传播或在复杂的现实场景中评估合规性。为填补这一关键空白，我们提出EADC，一个基于AI合规知识图谱和法律专家的LLM高级评估基准。通过将抽象法律规则映射为结构化的逻辑多关系图，我们的框架使自动化代理能够提炼和合成复杂的对抗场景。该基准由人类AI法律专家全程审查和修正，最终生成的数据集（4,435+问答对）涵盖了偏见与歧视、公平、个人隐私保护等关键监管领域。
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. items.authors: Yan Zhang, Ruien Li, Yaoyao Peng, Wanxin Ren, Yijia Zhang, Wusheng Zhang, Guangwen Yang

items.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
items.title_zh: AI研究代理的递归自我改进
items.summary_zh: AI代理开始在AI领域内自动化研究与开发，从提高训练效率到优化推理。下一步是提升代理自身的研究效率。当AI研究代理的代码成为优化对象时，每次接受的重写都成为下一轮编辑的代理。我们称这种循环为递归自我改进。其重要性在于，研发支出的累积增加通常会带来边际收益递减。持续的自我改进提供了一种应对这一趋势的方法。我们提出了AIDE^2，一个实现这一循环的前沿AI研究代理系统。它提出自身代码的修改建议，在一系列AI研发任务上基准测试修改后的版本，并保留在隐藏评估中表现最佳的改动。在一次为期8天的自主运行中，AIDE^2发现了七个连续的改进，从新的搜索策略到压缩和管理代理不断增长的上下文的记忆机制。这些改进在四个保留基准上具有普适性，涵盖机器学习工程、启发式算法工程和基于物理的天气预报，其中最后一个任务与选择任务不在同一分布上。在所有四个基准上，发现的最强代理匹配或超越了排名靠前的人类工程生产研究代理。
items.abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference. A natural next step is to improve the research efficiency of the agents themselves. When an AI research agent's own code is the object of optimization, each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits. We refer to this loop as recursive self-improvement. Its significance lies in a long-standing trend, in which increased cumulative spending on R&D yields diminishing returns. Sustained self-improvement offers a way to counter this trend. We present AIDE^2, a system that implements this loop for a frontier AI research agent. It proposes changes to its own code, benchmarks modified versions of itself on a suite of AI R&D tasks, and keeps the changes that perform best on hidden evaluations. In an autonomous 8-day run, AIDE^2 discovered seven successive improvements, ranging from a new search policy to memory mechanisms that compress and manage the agent's growing context. These gains generalize to four held-out benchmarks spanning machine learning engineering, heuristic algorithm engineering, and physics-based weather forecasting,
items.authors: Dhruv Srikanth, Bingchen Zhao, Dixing Xu, Yuxiang Wu, Zhengyao Jiang

items.title: Reproducible AI Requires Reproducible Randomness
items.title_zh: 可重复的人工智能需依赖可重复的随机性
items.summary_zh: 伪随机数生成器（PRNG）是多个科学领域中不可或缺的计算工具，包括蒙特卡洛模拟、随机计算和人工智能（AI）。这些应用的可重复性关键依赖于PRNG实现能够在相同内部状态下生成相同序列的能力。本研究考察了完整初始状态是否能确保跨库的PRNG流的保真性和可移植性，重点分析了两种广泛使用的生成器：梅森旋转算法和Philox，并评估了它们在四个主要Python生态系统（Random、NumPy、PyTorch等）中的实现。研究结果表明，仅依赖简单的种子不足以确保不同实现间的一致性，完整的内部状态转移是确保输出一致性的关键。
items.abstract: Pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) constitute indispensable computational tools across multiple scientific domains, including Monte Carlo simulations, stochastic computing, and artificial intelligence (AI). The reproducibility of such applications critically depends on the ability of PRNG implementations to generate identical sequences across software environments when initialized from the same internal state. These algorithms enable the simulation of stochastic processes while providing deterministic and repeatable behaviour, thereby facilitating reproducible experiments. Modern PRNG implementations may be initialized through either a seed or, more accurately, an initial state that exceeds the capacity of a conventional integer seed. However, reliance on a simple seed alone frequently proves insufficient to ensure consistent program execution traces across different implementations. A natural assumption is that transferring the complete internal state of a generator should guarantee identical outputs regardless of the software library used. This study examines the validity of this assumption by investigating whether complete initial states can ensure cross-library fidelity and
items.authors: Anthony Bertrand (UCA, LIMOS), Tom Schmitt (UCA), Engelbert Mephu Nguifo (LIMOS, UCA), David Hill (INP Clermont Auvergne, ISIMA, LIMOS, UCA)

items.title: AIBuildAI-2.5: Efficient Autonomous AI Model Development Through LLM-Guided Tree Search
items.title_zh: AIBuildAI-2.5：通过LLM引导树搜索实现高效自主AI模型开发
items.summary_zh: 自主代理能够自动构建人工智能（AI）模型，有助于扩大科学和工程领域的AI应用。现有的代理将模型构建视为代码搜索问题，通过树搜索解决，然而在效率上存在三大不足。首先，受限于预算，执行的候选程序数量有限，导致基于执行奖励的搜索规则效果不佳。其次，缺乏资源感知策略，影响硬件利用率和训练效率。最后，所有代理调用依赖单一强大模型，增加推理成本。为此，我们提出AIBuildAI-2.5，采用LLM代理进行树搜索，解决上述问题。该系统引入了一种新颖的LLM引导树搜索方法，通过评估候选程序的预期改进、基础和可行性，进行有效的候选程序评分和排序。
items.abstract: Autonomous agents that automatically build artificial intelligence (AI) models could broaden access to AI across science and engineering. A popular line of such agents frames model building as a code search problem and solves it by tree search, in which each node is a candidate program and the tree grows by generating a child program from a parent, and these agents now approach the capability of experienced AI engineers on realistic benchmarks. However, these agents have three weaknesses in efficiency that have not been fully addressed. First, only a small number of candidates can be executed within a realistic budget, so search rules that rank nodes by executed rewards, such as Monte Carlo-style tree search, rely on few and noisy scores and select the next node to explore less effectively. Second, no resource-aware strategy is used to schedule training jobs, which can lower hardware utilization and training efficiency. Third, every agent call is served by a single powerful model, which inflates inference cost. Here we introduce AIBuildAI-2.5, an agentic system that carries out the tree search with LLM agents and addresses each of the three issues. AIBuildAI-2.5 proposes a novel LL
items.authors: Peijia Qin, Ruiyi Zhang, Qi Cao, Han Guo, Li Zhang, Pengtao Xie

items.title: LLM-Driven Training-free Location-Attribute Synergic Fusion: A Closed-Loop Paradigm for Dual-source Encrypted POIs and LULC Mapping
items.title_zh: 无训练LLM驱动的双源加密POI与LULC映射融合方法
items.summary_zh: 双源加密兴趣点（DSEP）面临位置与属性的不确定性，影响土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）映射。本文首次提出一种无训练的LLM驱动位置-属性协同闭环优化范式用于DSEP融合。该范式通过迭代反馈共同优化位置变换和属性对应。属性协同位置融合利用LLM驱动的属性匹配方法，将匹配复杂度从O(N^2)降低至O(N)，并在ISODATA聚类的局部子区域内使用改进的粒子群优化算法优化变换系数。位置协同属性融合则通过LLM模糊方法重新评估属性置信度。优化后的对应关系反馈至位置优化，形成双向闭环。样本净化和自适应半径收缩使得收敛在两次迭代内实现。此外，我们提出了一种无训练的LULC映射方法，通过位置融合从加密地图继承土地利用类别，生成矢量-栅格集成的LULC地图。
items.abstract: Dual-source encrypted points of interest (DSEP), POIs from two encrypted coordinate systems, suffer from intertwined location and attribute uncertainties, including nonlinear systematic misalignment and naming inconsistency, hindering land-use/land-cover (LULC) mapping. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first to propose an LLM-driven, training-free location-attribute synergic closed-loop optimization paradigm for DSEP fusion. The paradigm jointly refines location transformation and attribute correspondences through iterative feedback. Attribute-synergic location fusion uses an LLM-driven attribute matching method to establish DSEP correspondences, reducing matching complexity from O(N^2) to O(N), and refines transformation coefficients using an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm within ISODATA-clustered local subregions. Location-synergic attribute fusion then reassesses attribute confidence from updated geometric residuals through an LLM-fuzzy method. The refined correspondences feed back into location optimization, forming a bidirectional closed loop. Sample purification and adaptive radius contraction enable convergence in essentially two iterations. We
items.authors: Chang Li, Xingtao Peng, Yongjun Zhang, Yinfei He, Cairun Huang

items.title: WILSON - a pathology foundation model framework for patient-level analysis and diagnostic text generation
items.title_zh: WILSON：用于患者级分析和诊断文本生成的病理基础模型框架
items.summary_zh: 病理学家在不同放大倍数和患者病例的切片之间整合形态学信息，而病理基础模型则对单个切片的数千个图块进行编码并聚合其特征。我们提出了WILSON，这是一种视觉-语言基础模型，将全切片图像和多切片病例表示为单一的多放大倍数复合图像，训练数据来自梅奥诊所的约189,000张切片，涵盖42个器官和829个诊断实体，并以病理报告作为监督。WILSON在所有内部队列中超越了专用的病例级模型（宏F1 0.52对比0.38），并在计算资源上比最大9.4倍的切片级模型低272到2155倍。对508例三阴性乳腺癌病例的端到端微调提高了组织学亚型分类和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞评分，宏F1分别提升0.16和0.11。WILSON在75.6%的召回率下检索到匹配的诊断文本（PRISM为58.1%），并在内部队列及大多数外部比较中生成的标题更接近于报告衍生的参考。复合图像因此提供了一个紧凑且与临床对齐的病理计算单元。
items.abstract: Pathologists integrate morphology across magnifications and across the slides of a patient case, whereas pathology foundation models encode thousands of tiles from single slides and aggregate their features. Here we present WILSON, a vision--language foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as single multi-magnification composite images, trained on approximately 189k slides from Mayo Clinic spanning 42 organs and 829 diagnostic entities using pathology reports as supervision. Without task-specific training, WILSON exceeded a dedicated case-level model on all internal cohorts (macro-F1 0.52 versus 0.38) and matched slide-level models up to 9.4 times larger at 272- to 2,155-fold lower compute. End-to-end fine-tuning on 508 triple-negative breast cancer cases improved histologic subtyping and stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte grading by 0.16 and 0.11 macro-F1. WILSON retrieved matching diagnostic text at 75.6% recall@1 (PRISM, 58.1%) and generated captions closer to report-derived references than PRISM and PRISM2 on the internal cohort and on most external comparisons. Composite images thus offer a compact, clinically aligned computational unit for

items.title: West-WRF AI 2-km: High-Resolution Prediction of Integrated Vapor Transport and Precipitation
items.title_zh: West-WRF AI 2公里：高分辨率综合水汽输送与降水预测
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种在美国西部及部分东北太平洋地区具有2公里分辨率的人工智能（AI）天气预报模型West-WRF AI 2-km，全球其他地区约为31公里分辨率。由于复杂的地形和大气河流（AR）对地形降水的强烈影响，西部地区的预报面临挑战。该模型基于预训练的全球模型，使用40年欧洲中期天气预报中心再分析v5（ERA5）数据集，并通过西部天气与水极端中心（CW3E）2公里区域再分析进行微调，以生成自回归的6小时降水和综合水汽输送（IVT）预报。2020-2023年冬季的预报通过网格化降水观测、雨量计和AR侦察探空仪进行评估，并与粗分辨率AI预报及区域和全球数值天气预报（NWP）系统进行基准对比。West-WRF AI 2-km能够再现观测到的降水强度分布，保持细尺度谱变异性，并生成更清晰的狭窄沿海降水带和局部地形敏感极端天气。其广域性能与粗分辨率配置相当，同时在保持大尺度技能的情况下实现更高分辨率。探空仪验证显示其误差较低。
items.abstract: We introduce a stretched-grid artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasting model with 2-km resolution over the western United States and part of the Northeast Pacific and approximately 31-km resolution elsewhere globally. Forecasting over the western U.S. is challenging because complex topography and atmospheric rivers (ARs) strongly influence orographic precipitation. West-WRF AI 2-km builds on a global model pretrained with a 40-year European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts Reanalysis v5 (ERA5) dataset and is fine-tuned with the Center for Western Weather and Water Extremes (CW3E) 2-km regional reanalysis to produce autoregressive 6-hourly forecasts of precipitation and integrated vapor transport (IVT). Forecasts are evaluated over winters 2020-2023 using gridded precipitation observations, rain gauges, and AR Reconnaissance dropsondes and are benchmarked against coarser-resolution AI forecasts and regional and global numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems. West-WRF AI 2-km reproduces observed precipitation-intensity distributions, retains fine-scale spectral variability, and produces sharper narrow coastal precipitation bands and localized, terrain-sensitive ex

items.title: Deflecting the Value Compass: Interacting with Large Language Models Temporarily Shifts Human Value Priorities Toward Personal Focus
items.title_zh: 与大型语言模型互动暂时改变人类价值优先级
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨与大型语言模型（LLMs）互动是否会改变用户的价值优先级。研究对象为200名美国成年人，他们与ChatGPT、Claude或Gemini作为思维伙伴进行互动，或阅读固定的AI生成的考虑。研究要求LLMs支持推理而不推荐决策，并未提及具体价值。参与者为面临真实困境的人提供建议，并在互动前、互动后立即及一项任务后填写平行的PVQ-RR表格。结果显示，每种LLM条件相较于对照组，暂时将价值优先级向个人关注转移（d=0.37-0.51），主要通过增强自我提升。参与者的建议保留了与LLMs交流的词汇和意义。因此，简短的LLM互动可以在判断过程中重新定向活跃的价值，而不会在价值方向或建议上产生可检测的趋同。
items.abstract: Large language models increasingly support decisions where values are in tension, yet little is known about whether interacting with them changes which values users prioritize. In a preregistered study, 200 U.S. adults interacted with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini as a thinking partner or read fixed AI-generated considerations. The prompt asked LLMs to support reasoning without recommending a decision and named no values. Participants advised people facing real dilemmas and completed parallel PVQ-RR forms before, immediately after, and one task later. Each LLM condition temporarily shifted value priorities toward personal focus relative to the control (d=0.37-0.51), primarily through increased Self-Enhancement. Participants' advice retained words and meaning from their exchanges. Thus, a brief LLM interaction that neither targets values nor seeks to persuade can reorient values active during judgment without detectable convergence in value directions or advice.
items.authors: Hasibur Rahman, Malak Sadek, Smit Desai

items.title: When Quantum Meets AI: Quantum Methods for Machine Learning and Machine Learning Methods for Quantum Systems
items.title_zh: 量子与人工智能的交汇：量子机器学习与机器学习在量子系统中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本论文研究量子计算与人工智能的交叉领域，主要包括量子机器学习方法和机器学习在量子系统中的应用。在量子机器学习方面，神经量子嵌入通过学习数据表示，增加嵌入类集之间的迹距离，从而降低依赖嵌入的经验风险界限，并改善在噪声量子硬件上的分类性能。基于Hilbert-Schmidt内积的训练目标将该方法扩展到具有单量子比特的确定性量子计算（DQC1），并在NMR量子处理器上进行了验证。边际基的泛化分析将量子神经网络的性能与量子态区分联系起来，结果表明边际分布在泛化预测上比参数计数指标更可靠。对于量子系统，基于Mamba的神经解码器在表面码的记忆实验中与重现的Transformer基线相匹配，同时将推理成本的扩展从四次方降低到二次方。在显式解码器诱导噪声模型下，该解码器实现了更低的逻辑错误率和更高的有效阈值。对于神经量子态，随机重构被解释为切空间岭回归，其对角线偏移控制有限模型下的偏差-方差权衡。
items.abstract: This thesis studies the intersection of quantum computing and artificial intelligence in two directions: quantum methods for machine learning and machine learning methods for quantum systems. For quantum machine learning, Neural Quantum Embedding learns data representations that increase the trace distance between embedded class ensembles, lowering an embedding-dependent bound on empirical risk and improving classification on noisy quantum hardware. A training objective based on the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product extends this approach to deterministic quantum computation with one qubit (DQC1) and is demonstrated on an NMR quantum processor. A margin-based generalization analysis then connects quantum neural network performance to quantum state discrimination. In the studied benchmarks, margin distributions predict generalization more reliably than parameter-count metrics. For quantum systems, a Mamba-based neural decoder for surface codes matches a reproduced Transformer baseline in memory experiments while reducing inference-cost scaling from quartic to quadratic in code distance. items.title: Toward Responsible AI-Augmented Cyber Defense: Pattern Recognition, Defense-in-Depth, and the Case for Human-AI Collaboration
items.title_zh: 迈向负责任的AI增强网络防御：模式识别、深度防御与人机协作案例
items.summary_zh: 网络安全文献广泛记录了人工智能（AI）在威胁检测、事件响应和预防中的操作优势，同时提出了关于过度自动化、算法偏见和分析师技能下降的定性担忧。本文建立了一个正式的、可证伪的模型，将深度防御理论、人工智能模式识别理论和安全操作中的人机协作三者联系起来。我们将分层防御形式化为一个伯努利检测级联，其中AI增强在各层之间以乘法方式进入；将每层的模式识别行为形式化为具有导出闭式最优阈值的Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian检测器；并将人机分诊形式化为一个容量受限的级联，明确量化检测概率与误报（“警报疲劳”）率之间的权衡。蒙特卡洛/分析模拟评估显示，AI增强在防御层中复合，最大边际收益恰好出现在传统分层饱和的地方，而对AI标记警报的全面人工审核并非最优：将分析师能力提升至100%覆盖率可将误报减少约20倍。
items.abstract: Cybersecurity literature has extensively documented the operational benefits of artificial intelligence (AI) for threat detection, incident response, and prevention, while raising qualitative concerns about over-automation, algorithmic bias, and analyst-skill erosion. What remains largely absent is a formal, falsifiable model connecting three constructs that recur across this literature: Defense-in-Depth Theory, the Artificial Intelligence Theory of Pattern Recognition, and human-AI collaboration in security operations. This paper develops such a model. We formalize layered defense as a Bernoulli detection cascade in which AI augmentation enters multiplicatively across layers; we formalize each layer's pattern-recognition behavior as a Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian detector with a derived closed-form optimal threshold; and we formalize human-AI triage as a capacity-constrained cascade with an explicit, quantifiable trade-off between detection probability and false-alarm ("alert fatigue") rate. items.authors: Mustafa S. Aljumaily, Hayder Kareem Abed, Nawar S. Alseelawi

items.title: Reciprocal Collaboration: how lessons from convergence in GLAMs can enhance interdisciplinary AI research
items.title_zh: 互惠合作：GLAM领域的经验如何提升跨学科AI研究
items.summary_zh: 研究资助机构越来越重视不同研究领域之间的合作，尤其是在人工智能（AI）及相关技术革命的背景下。AI在各领域的潜在影响引发了广泛关注，包括其方法论和新知识的进展。然而，关于AI技术基础及跨学科研究方法的担忧也在增加。当前的合作往往是一条单向街，领域合作伙伴仅充当信息提供者。为此，我们提出一种互惠的合作方式，双方共同理解、合作并识别重要影响。本文探讨了文化遗产机构（GLAMs）、人文社会科学（AHSS）研究与技术驱动的AI研究之间的关系，特别是当前AI技术进步的影响。
items.abstract: The need for collaboration between diverse fields of research is increasingly recognised as important by research funding agencies. A significant driver of this need is the current revolution in artificial intelligence (AI) and related technologies. There is a growing interest in the potential impact of AI in different fields including the methodologies they use and the resulting advances in new knowledge, new access and enhanced productivity. However, there is also a corresponding increase in concern about the fundamentals of AI technologies and the way in which trans and/or interdisciplinary research is approached. The resulting collaboration too often ends up as a one-way street where the domain partner acts only as an information provider. For example, the contribution of the AHSS partner might be limited to providing insight about ethics and/or the technology partner may only provide a service to build applied AI-based solutions. In response to this problem, we propose a reciprocal approach to collaboration where both partners seek to understand, cooperate and identify jointly significant impacts. items.authors: Amber L. Cushing, Suzanne Little, Giulia Osti

items.title: StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots
items.title_zh: StepTrigger：基于接触状态的后门攻击在VLM驱动的四足机器人上应用
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型和视觉语言模型越来越多地作为机器人系统中的高级规划者，利用任务目标和传感器摘要选择导航或操作动作。这为后门攻击提供了新的切入点：被攻击的规划者在大多数情况下表现正常，但在隐藏触发器存在时会改变目标选择。本文提出了StepTrigger，一种针对VLM驱动四足机器人的接触状态触发后门攻击。该触发器不是提示令牌或可见标记，而是由Unitree Go1四足机器人在密集地形上行走时产生的压力和脚地接触模式。与传统的视觉或文本触发器不同，接触信号本质上是噪声，并且在正常运动中也可能出现。为避免将每个压力异常视为触发器，StepTrigger从多模态机器人状态中学习选择性后门策略，使用偶发压力事件作为良性示例，密集地块接触作为有毒示例。在分层离线评估中，训练后的规划者实现了98.75%的良性行为保留率、92.50%的假触发拒绝率、76.25%的真实触发激活率和89.17%的整体解析行为准确率。
items.abstract: Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch. Unlike conventional visual or textual triggers, contact signals are inherently noisy and may also arise during benign locomotion. To avoid treating every pressure anomaly as a trigger, StepTrigger learns a selective backdoor policy from multimodal robot state, using incidental pressure events as benign examples and dense-patch contacts as poisoned examples. items.authors: Jiageng Zhang, Doniyorkhon Obidov, Kaichen Yang

items.title: Silent Sabotage: Internal State Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Powered Robotic Systems
items.title_zh: 内部状态触发的后门攻击对LLM驱动机器人系统的影响
items.summary_zh: 将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到机器人控制系统中，推动了新一代自主代理的发展，具备复杂推理和规划能力。然而，这一范式转变也带来了尚未充分探讨的新型安全风险。现有研究主要集中于外部刺激触发的LLM后门攻击，而忽视了内部逻辑触发的潜在脆弱性。本文首次全面研究了基于历史的后门攻击，展示攻击者可以通过操控指令在LLM驱动的机器人控制器中嵌入隐蔽后门。该后门由机器人自身过去动作的特定稀有序列触发，正常操作时保持潜伏，但可激活恶意行为，如完全停止或碰撞。我们的实验在多种机器人和LLM的模拟环境中进行，结果表明该历史攻击极为有效，攻击成功率接近完美，且极难被检测。这些发现揭示了重要的安全隐患。
items.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotic control systems is enabling a new generation of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and planning. While this paradigm shift accelerates progress, it also introduces novel security risks that remain largely unexplored. Current research into LLM backdoors has focused on attacks triggered by external stimuli, such as specific words, visual objects, or environmental states. These attacks, while potent, overlook a more insidious class of vulnerability where the trigger is internal to the agent's own operational logic. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of history-based backdoor attacks on LLM-powered robotic systems. We demonstrate that an attacker can embed a stealthy backdoor into an LLM-based robot controller by manipulating its instructions. This backdoor is triggered not by an external cue, but by a specific, rare sequence of the robot's own past actions. It remains dormant during normal operation, preserving the robot's utility, but can be activated to induce a malicious behavior, such as a complete stop or a collision.
