items.authors: Doniyorkhon Obidov, Shivayogi Akki, Tan Chen, Kaichen Yang

items.title: The Ethics of Artificial Intelligence in Military Operations
items.title_zh: 军事行动中人工智能的伦理问题
items.summary_zh: 深度学习系统如今在军事决策中介入使用武力，但其内部逻辑难以检视，评估实践易被操控，且责任在分散的利益相关者之间难以界定。这些系统所带来的伦理挑战本质上是认识论性的：不仅是自主武器是否应被允许杀戮的问题，更是当关键功能委托给不透明算法时，负责任的人类判断的条件是否能够维持。研究表明，这一认识论条件导致了具体的责任缺口：设计者、操作员和政策制定者之间的责任模糊，而国际人道法假设当前AI系统缺乏的判断能力。为解决这一缺口，提出了一种治理框架，通过明确的责任角色、使用未公开基准的对抗性审计、分级部署阈值以及建议的北约评估标准来程序化伦理约束。对八个记录案例（1988-2025）的反事实分析显示，每种治理机制针对特定的失败类别，但单一的保障措施不足以独立应对：有效治理军事AI不仅需要技术约束，还需保持人类判断意义的制度基础设施。
items.abstract: Deep learning systems now mediate military decisions to use force, yet their internal logic resists inspection, their evaluation practices are gameable, and their deployment fractures accountability across dispersed stakeholders. The ethical challenge posed by these systems is fundamentally epistemic: not just whether autonomous weapons should be permitted to kill, but whether the conditions for responsible human judgment can survive when critical functions are delegated to opaque algorithms. We show that this epistemic condition produces a concrete accountability gap: responsibility diffuses across designers, operators, and policymakers while International Humanitarian Law presupposes capacities for judgment that current AI systems lack. To address this gap, we propose a governance framework that proceduralizes ethical constraints through named accountability roles, adversarial auditing with undisclosed benchmarks, tiered deployment thresholds, and a proposed NATO evaluation standard. Counterfactual analysis of eight documented cases (1988-2025) shows that each governance mechanism addresses a documented class of failure, but no single safeguard suffices in isolation: effective go
items.authors: Nicolas Drapier, Florian Mauberger, Aladine Chetouani, Aurelien Chateigner

items.title: Small Language Models are the Future of Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 小型语言模型是代理人工智能的未来
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）因其在多种任务上接近人类的表现而受到赞誉，但代理人工智能系统的兴起使得语言模型在少数专业任务中重复执行的应用增多。我们认为小型语言模型（SLMs）在能力上足够强大，更适合且经济性更高，因此是代理人工智能的未来。我们的论点基于SLMs当前的能力水平、代理系统的常见架构以及语言模型部署的经济性。此外，在需要通用对话能力的情况下，异构代理系统（即调用多种不同模型的代理）是自然选择。我们讨论了SLMs在代理系统中采用的潜在障碍，并概述了一种通用的LLM到SLM的代理转换算法。我们的立场强调，从LLMs到SLMs的部分转变对人工智能代理行业的运营和经济影响的重要性。我们希望激发关于有效利用人工智能资源的讨论，并推动降低成本的努力。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often praised for exhibiting near-human performance on a wide range of tasks and valued for their ability to hold a general conversation. The rise of agentic AI systems is, however, ushering in a mass of applications in which language models perform a small number of specialized tasks repetitively and with little variation. Here we lay out the position that small language models (SLMs) are sufficiently powerful, inherently more suitable, and necessarily more economical for many invocations in agentic systems, and are therefore the future of agentic AI. Our argumentation is grounded in the current level of capabilities exhibited by SLMs, the common architectures of agentic systems, and the economy of LM deployment. We further argue that in situations where general-purpose conversational abilities are essential, heterogeneous agentic systems (i.e., agents invoking multiple different models) are the natural choice. We discuss the potential barriers for the adoption of SLMs in agentic systems and outline a general LLM-to-SLM agent conversion algorithm. Our position, formulated as a value statement, highlights the significance of the operational and econ
items.authors: Peter Belcak, Greg Heinrich, Shizhe Diao, Yonggan Fu, Xin Dong, Saurav Muralidharan, Yingyan Celine Lin, Pavlo Molchanov

items.title: Glucose-ML: A collection of longitudinal diabetes datasets for development of robust AI solutions
items.title_zh: Glucose-ML：用于开发稳健AI解决方案的糖尿病纵向数据集集合
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）算法是糖尿病管理数字健康技术的关键组成部分。然而，获取大型高质量数据集的困难阻碍了稳健AI解决方案的发展。为加速透明、可重复和稳健AI解决方案的开发，我们推出了Glucose-ML，这是一个包含10个公开可用的糖尿病数据集的集合，数据集发布于过去7年（即2018-2025年）。Glucose-ML集合包含超过30万个连续血糖监测（CGM）数据天数，共收集了来自4个国家2500多人的3800万血糖样本。参与者包括1型糖尿病、2型糖尿病、前驱糖尿病和无糖尿病的人群。我们还进行了血糖预测的案例研究，提供了在Glucose-ML集合中所有10个公开糖尿病数据集上的短期血糖预测基准，结果显示同一算法在不同数据集上的预测结果可能存在显著差异。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are a critical part of state-of-the-art digital health technology for diabetes management. Yet, access to large high-quality datasets is creating barriers that impede development of robust AI solutions. To accelerate development of transparent, reproducible, and robust AI solutions, we present Glucose-ML, a collection of 10 publicly available diabetes datasets, released within the last 7 years (i.e., 2018 - 2025). The Glucose-ML collection comprises over 300,000 days of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) data with a total of 38 million glucose samples collected from 2500+ people across 4 countries. Participants include persons living with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and no diabetes. To support researchers and innovators with using this rich collection of diabetes datasets, we present a comparative analysis to guide algorithm developers with data selection. Additionally, we conduct a case study for the task of blood glucose prediction - one of the most common AI tasks within the field. items.authors: Temiloluwa Prioleau, Baiying Lu, Yanjun Cui

items.title: Ultra Strong Machine Learning: LLM-Generated Explanations Do Not Yet Suffice for Teaching Humans Active Learning Strategy
items.title_zh: 超强机器学习：LLM生成的解释尚不足以教人主动学习策略
items.summary_zh: 主动学习是人工和人类学习者共享的一种学习机制。AI是否能够教授人类跨领域转移的策略仍是一个未解之谜。超强机器学习（USML）系统通过量化解释提高人类的样本外表现，能够回答这一问题。以往的USML研究依赖于手工制作的解释模板，无法扩展。我们开发了一种结合归纳逻辑编程（ILP）与大型语言模型（LLMs）的解释生成与评分管道。我们在三种相关领域的人类试验中测试这些解释是否实现USML。探索性结果显示，简洁的专家撰写解释对初始表现较高的学习者有益，而管道生成的解释尽管在LLM评估中被认为质量更高，但对自我学习没有优势。该案例研究揭示了LLM质量指标无法预测人类学习结果的系统性差距。我们的发现指出，解释复杂性与任务难度的相对关系是关键因素，并呼吁基于人类认知限制而非LLM偏好的解释方法和评估标准。
items.abstract: Active learning is a general learning mechanism shared by artificial and human learners. Whether AI can teach humans such a strategy that transfers across domains is an open question. Ultra Strong Machine Learning (USML), a system whose explanations quantifiably improve human out-of-sample performance compared to self-learning, is uniquely positioned to answer this question. Prior USML work relied on hand-crafted explanation templates that require expert effort for each new domain and do not scale. We developed an explanation pipeline combining Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) with large language models (LLMs) to automate explanation generation and scoring. We tested whether these explanations achieve USML in a human trial teaching active learning strategies across three related domains. Our exploratory results show that concise, expert-written explanations benefit learners with higher initial performance, while pipeline-generated explanations provide no advantage over self-learning despite being rated as higher quality from an LLM-as-judge evaluation. This case study reveals a systematic gap that LLM quality metrics do not predict human learning outcomes. Our findings point to ex
items.authors: Lun Ai, Johannes Langer, Ute Schmid, Stephen Muggleton

items.title: SPINE: Bridging the Cyber-Physical Gap with Agentic AI
items.title_zh: SPINE：用自主AI弥合网络物理鸿沟
items.summary_zh: 基础模型赋予机器人强大的高层次推理能力，但将这种智能转化为可靠的物理行动仍然困难。机器人技术人员必须为每个平台对设备驱动程序、网络接口、传感器、控制器和安全约束进行对齐。我们提出SPINE（可扩展物理集成与自主专业知识），这是一个系统调试和部署双手机器人进行远程操作的框架。SPINE集中于两个子代理驱动的工作流程：一个编译机器人特定上下文的配置生成器和一个利用该上下文进行诊断、修复和验证的调试器。在两个双手机器人平台和12个调试场景中，使用SPINE的初学者比使用Claude Code的人类操作员实现了更完整和高效的恢复。在DOBOT X-Trainer上，SPINE的成功率从76%提高到100%，平均远程操作时间减少30%；在AgileX PiPER上，SPINE同样实现了100%的成功率，平均远程操作时间减少38%。这些结果表明，结构化的自主调试可以解决现实世界机器人部署中的关键网络物理集成瓶颈。
items.abstract: Foundation models give robots powerful high-level reasoning, yet turning that intelligence into reliable physical action remains difficult: roboticists must still align device drivers, network interfaces, sensors, controllers, and safety constraints for each platform. This often-overlooked integration layer acts as the robot's spinal cord, translating high-level intent into coordinated physical behavior, and remains a primary bottleneck for scalable Embodied AI. Hence, we propose SPINE (Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise), an agentic framework for systematically debugging and deploying bimanual robots for teleoperation. SPINE centers on two subagent-driven workflows: a profile builder that compiles robot-specific context and a debugger that uses that context to iterate through diagnosis, repair, and validation until teleoperation succeeds. Across two bimanual robot platforms and 12 debugging scenarios, novice-operated SPINE achieved more complete and efficient recovery than human operators using Claude Code. On DOBOT X-Trainer, SPINE improved success from 76% to 100% and reduced mean time-to-teleoperation by 30\%; on AgileX PiPER, SPINE also achieved 100\% success
items.authors: Minkyu Ham, Dongho Kim, Chan Lee, Min Jun Kim, Yixi Zhang, Jiayi Wang, Han Liu

items.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
items.title_zh: BixBench3：在计算生物学任务中评估AI代理性能
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）有望通过自动化计算分析来加速生物研究。然而，AI代理在完整研究规模的计算生物学任务中的执行能力尚未得到系统评估。本文介绍了BixBench3，一个评估AI代理处理原始生物数据到科学结果能力的基准。BixBench3任务模拟科学家向代理委派工作的过程：科学家选择研究问题和高层次方法，然后将所有分析的实施委托给代理。在每个任务中，代理接收研究目标、方法指导和来自已发表科学研究的原始数据，并必须执行一系列分析以实现研究目标。分析结果的数据工件，如峰值调用矩阵或差异表达表，按照原研究中生成和报告的相应工件进行程序化评分。在涵盖138个独特工件的20个BixBench3任务中，我们发现13个前沿模型的得分范围从Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite的0.00到GPT 5.6 Sol的0.48。代理在处理较大原始数据集（100 GB任务得分为0.36）和需要更多顺序步骤的分析（1-2步骤得分为0.36）时表现较差。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to accelerate biological research by automating computational analyses. Yet the ability of AI agents to execute on computational biology at the scale of complete research studies has not been systematically evaluated. Here we introduce BixBench3, a benchmark that measures the capacity of AI agents to process raw biological data through to scientific results. We designed BixBench3 tasks to mirror the delegation of work from a scientist to an agent: the scientist chooses the research question and high-level methods, then delegates implementation of all analyses to the agent. In each task, an agent receives a research objective, methodological guidance, and raw data derived from a published scientific study, and must execute a sequence of analyses to achieve the research objective. The data artifacts resulting from these analyses, such as peak call matrices or differential expression tables, are programmatically graded against the corresponding artifacts generated and reported in the original study. Across 20 BixBench3 tasks encompassing the generation of 138 unique artifacts, we find that 13 frontier models achieve scores ranging from 0.00 for Ge
items.authors: Zane Koch, Asmamaw T. Wassie, Javier Valdes-Aleman, Jason Lee, Michaela M. Hinks, Samuel G. Rodriques, Andrew D. White, Jon M. Laurent

items.title: Towards Synergistic Teacher-AI Interactions with Generative Artificial Intelligence
items.title_zh: 生成性人工智能与教师协作的协同互动研究
items.summary_zh: 生成性人工智能（GenAI）在教育领域的应用日益增多，给教师适应这些变化带来了重大挑战。GenAI为教育任务提供了前所未有的可及性、可扩展性和生产力机会。然而，通过GenAI自动化教学任务引发了教师自主性降低、潜在认知退化以及教学职业化降低的担忧。本文基于先前关于教育中人工智能的文献，结合最近的系统文献综述，提出了教师与AI协作的五个层次：交易型、情境型、操作型、实践型和协同型。该框架旨在捕捉教师与GenAI互动的细微动态，可能导致教师能力和专业实践的替代、互补或增强。讨论了支持协作所需的GenAI技术能力及相关实证研究。我们描绘了一个未来愿景，超越个体教师的自主性，朝向教师与AI之间的协作决策，双方通过协商、建设性挑战和共同推理来增强彼此的能力，实现独立无法实现的成果。
items.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in education, posing significant challenges for teachers adapting to these changes. GenAI offers unprecedented opportunities for accessibility, scalability and productivity in educational tasks. However, the automation of teaching tasks through GenAI raises concerns about reduced teacher agency, potential cognitive atrophy, and the broader deprofessionalisation of teaching. Drawing findings from prior literature on AI in Education, and refining through a recent systematic literature review, this chapter presents a conceptualisation of five levels of teacher-AI teaming: transactional, situational, operational, praxical and synergistic teaming. The framework aims to capture the nuanced dynamics of teacher-AI interactions, particularly with GenAI, that may lead to the replacement, complementarity, or augmentation of teachers' competences and professional practice. GenAI technological affordances required in supporting teaming, along with empirical studies, are discussed. Drawing on empirical observations, we outline a future vision that moves beyond individual teacher agency toward collaborative decision-making between te
items.authors: Mutlu Cukurova, Wannapon Suraworachet, Qi Zhou, Sahan Bulathwela

items.title: Mechanism Design Is Not Enough: Prosocial Agents for Cooperative AI
items.title_zh: 机制设计不足：合作AI中的亲社会代理
items.summary_zh: 确保AI代理在与其他方互动时安全且有益已成为现代AI安全的核心挑战之一。机制设计作为一种理论，旨在设计规则以对齐个人与集体目标，能够激励合作行为，但是否足以最大化大型语言模型（LLM）代理的社会福利仍是一个未解的问题。本研究证明答案是否定的：基于不完全合同理论，我们正式表明，当合同无法区分所有相关的未来情境时，存在无法通过任何现实机制消除的严格正的福利损失。我们展示了亲社会代理在权衡他人福利与自身福利时，可以弥补这一差距，实现社会上更优且个体上有利的结果。实验表明，在多代理资源分配环境和经典社会困境中，亲社会性是有益的。对AI安全的启示是：为了实现大规模的合作互动，仅仅设计足够的机制是不够的；代理必须具备内在的亲社会特性。
items.abstract: Ensuring that AI agents behave safely and beneficially when interacting with other parties has emerged as one of the central challenges of modern AI safety. While mechanism design, as the theory of designing rules to align individual and collective objectives, can incentivize cooperative behavior, it is still an open question whether it alone is sufficient to maximize LLM agents' social welfare. This work proves that the answer is negative: drawing from incomplete contract theory, we formally show that when contracts cannot distinguish all relevant future contingencies, there is a strictly positive welfare loss that no realistic mechanism can eliminate. We show that prosocial agents, who weigh others' welfare alongside their own, can close this gap and achieve outcomes that are socially superior and individually beneficial. Experimentally, we show that in multi-agent resource-allocation environments and canonical social dilemmas where agents are powered by large language models, prosociality is beneficial. The implication for AI safety is clear: to enable cooperative interactions at scale, designing adequate mechanisms is not sufficient; agents must be built to be intrinsically pro
items.authors: Xuanqiang Angelo Huang, Charlie Tharas, Samuele Marro, Van Q. Truong, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Emanuele La Malfa, Zhijing Jin

items.title: FinRED: An Expert-Guided Benchmark Generation and Evaluation Framework for Financial LLM Red-Teaming
items.title_zh: FinRED：金融LLM安全评估的专家指导基准生成框架
items.summary_zh: 现有安全基准主要针对一般对抗场景，未能涵盖金融特有风险。金融LLM面临合规违规、欺诈助长和系统性信任侵蚀等问题，需进行针对性评估。我们提出FinRED，这是一个由金融专家开发的专家指导的红队框架，用于金融LLM安全评估。FinRED采用新颖的两级分类法，将全球标准（如FATF和EU DORA）映射到从合规规避到复杂欺诈的威胁，并结合可扩展的管道，通过专家定义的模式将真实金融文档转化为丰富上下文的红队行为提示（种子）。严格的专家验证确认了种子的合理性和真实性，以便进行有意义的LLM安全评估。此外，我们提供了一个经过专家验证的金融特定评分标准，超越了免责声明检查，更贴近人类专家，显著减少了关键假阴性，从28降至12。FinRED与国际认可的风险管理和信息安全标准（如ISO/IEC 27001）对齐，并在韩国金融安全研究所（FSI）的监管沙箱中部署，用于真实金融服务中的生成AI安全评估。为减轻双重用途风险，数据集、生成管道、提示模板和评估框架均设有访问限制。
items.abstract: Existing safety benchmarks target general adversarial scenarios but miss finance-specific risks. Financial LLMs face regulatory compliance violations, fraud facilitation, and systemic trust erosion that require targeted evaluation. We introduce FinRED, an expert-guided red-teaming framework for financial LLM safety evaluation developed with financial experts. FinRED uses a novel two-level taxonomy mapping global standards (e.g., FATF and EU DORA) to threats ranging from regulatory evasion to complex fraud, integrated with a scalable pipeline that converts real financial documents into context-rich red-teaming Behavioral Prompts (seeds) through an expert-defined schema. Rigorous expert validation confirms seed plausibility and realism for meaningful LLM safety evaluation. We also provide an expert-validated, finance-specific rubric that goes beyond disclaimer checks, aligns more closely with human experts than static one-size-fits-all rubrics, and reduces critical false negatives from 28 to 12. Aligned with internationally adopted risk-management and information-security standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001), FinRED is deployed in South Korea's Financial Security Institute (FSI) regulator
items.authors: Chaeyun Kim, Daeyoung Park, Junghwan Kim, Jinyoung Jeong, Eunji Song, Yongtaek Lim, Minwoo Kim

items.title: From Plausible to Actionable: A Position on LLM Self-Explanations
items.title_zh: 从可信到可行动：关于大型语言模型自我解释的观点
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成自然语言解释，以合理化其决策，这一现象被称为自我解释。自我解释作为可解释人工智能（XAI）的一个有前景的方向，尤其在解释LLM行为方面表现突出。然而，尽管自我解释通常看起来可信，但它们是否真实反映模型的推理过程仍然是一个未解的问题。本文认为，自我解释可以高度可信、可疑地忠实，但仍然具有高度的可行动性。从传统XAI的角度，我们识别了标准评估协议在LLM生成自我解释中的局限性，并提出了评估其可信性和忠实性的实用指南。此外，我们主张评估应超越这些标准，关注可行动性，强调LLM合理化能力在支持知情决策和适当行动方面的应用。
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate natural language explanations that rationalize their own decisions, a phenomenon commonly referred to as self-explanations. Such explanations have emerged as a promising direction for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), particularly for interpreting LLM behavior. However, while self-explanations often appear plausible, whether they faithfully reflect a model's underlying reasoning process remains an open question. In this opinion paper, we argue that self-explanations can be highly plausible, questionably faithful, and yet highly actionable. From a traditional XAI perspective, we identify the limitations of standard evaluation protocols for LLM-generated self-explanations and propose practical guidelines for assessing their plausibility and faithfulness. Moreover, we argue that evaluation should extend beyond these criteria to actionability, highlighting applications of LLM rationalization capabilities that support informed decision-making and appropriate action across diverse stakeholders.
items.authors: Elize Herrewijnen, Benedetta Muscato, Gizem Gezici, Fosca Giannotti

items.title: Semi-Automated Detection of Gaps in LLM Security Knowledge
items.title_zh: 半自动化检测大型语言模型安全知识的缺口
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件、硬件和以人为中心的安全任务中越来越多地被使用。因此，LLM在安全任务上的表现成为一个活跃的测量和研究领域，重点在于识别LLM安全“知识”的不足之处。现有的识别LLM安全知识缺口的策略通常需要大量的手动工作和安全专业知识。我们提出了一种部分自动化的方法来评估LLM在特定安全领域的知识。该方法利用消费者保护机构（CPAs）的权威信息，识别LLM响应中的不稳定性，这可能表明知识缺口。我们在身份盗窃和冒充诈骗两个安全主题上演示了该方法，使用来自6个CPAs的公开信息，评估了两个领先LLM家族中的5个模型，Gemini和GPT。该方法能够区分具有足够知识和缺乏知识的模型，以准确识别文本叙述中的安全主题。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for a range of software, hardware and human-centered security tasks. Consequently, LLM performance on security tasks is an active area of measurement and research, often with a focus on identifying areas in which LLM security "knowledge" may be insufficient. Popular strategies for identifying LLM security knowledge gaps include building corpora of challenge questions or task benchmarks, strategies that require substantial manual work and security expertise to design and execute. We introduce a partially-automated method for assessing LLM knowledge of a security area. The method uses authoritative information from Consumer Protection Agencies (CPAs) to identify instability in LLM responses that can be indicative of knowledge gaps. We demonstrate the method for 2 security topics, identity theft and impostor scams, and 5 LLMs in 2 leading LLM families, Gemini and GPT, using publicly available information about identity theft and impostor scams from 6 CPAs. The method distinguishes between models that have and don't have sufficient knowledge to accurately identify the security topics in text narratives.
items.authors: Shufan Chai, Liangliang Sun, Jessica Staddon

items.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: AffordanceWAM：面向机器人操作的可供性感知联合世界-动作建模
items.summary_zh: 通用机器人操作需要预测场景演变、识别可交互区域并确定行动方式。动作标记的机器人视频直接监督控制，但成本高且多样性有限；而自我中心的人类视频捕捉了多样的交互，但缺乏机器人动作且在体现和外观上存在差异。我们提出了AffordanceWAM，这是一种可供性感知的生成世界动作模型，通过标量可供性和Affordance Heatmap在生成的未来世界中表示以物体为中心的时空可供性。该表示将视觉预测与任务相关的对象和交互区域结合，为动作生成提供基础，并在人工和机器人视频之间提供共享的交互目标。基于预训练的视频扩散Transformer，AffordanceWAM使用分别参数化的世界和动作专家，通过掩蔽联合自注意力进行耦合，共同预测未来的RGB观测、标量可供性场、可供性热图和连续的机器人动作。人类视频监督所有三个未来世界流，而机器人轨迹则提供额外的动作监督，支持在没有人类动作标签或重新定向的情况下进行迁移。在RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D和现实世界操作的实验中，显示出一致的性能提升。
items.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. items.title: ActGov: Governing LLM Agent Actions via Policy-Constrained Validation
items.title_zh: ActGov：通过政策约束验证管理LLM代理行为
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地通过外部工具执行长期工作流程，这使得不可信的输出可能影响后续行动并超出用户授权。现有防御措施通过隔离注入内容或使用预定义计划和静态政策来限制执行，但在动态工作流程下这些方法脆弱且在可扩展工具生态系统中扩展性差。本文提出了ActGov，一个运行时强制框架，在每个LLM提议的工具行动造成外部影响之前进行验证。ActGov-Policy组件基于授权、行动、运行时上下文和安全约束的统一语义模型，迭代构建政策集，并通过基于SMT的反例检查验证每次更新。在运行时，ActGov-Runtime将每个工具调用抽象为有限的政策记录，仅在其保持在任务范围内的授权边界并满足所有适用政策时允许执行。该逐行动强制机制在长期、动态分支工作流程中保持授权。我们在AgentDojo和AgentDyn基准上评估了ActGov，结果表明ActGov在保持任务效用的同时，持续降低了间接提示注入攻击的成功率。
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute long-horizon workflows through external tools, allowing untrusted outputs to influence subsequent actions and exceed user authorization. Existing defenses isolate injected content or constrain execution with predefined plans and static policies, but these approaches are brittle under dynamic workflows and scale poorly across extensible tool ecosystems. In this work, we present ActGov, a runtime enforcement framework that validates each LLM-proposed tool action before it causes external effects. Built on a unified semantic model of authorization, actions, runtime context, and security constraints, the ActGov-Policy component iteratively constructs a policy set from tool specifications, benign tasks, and observed failure traces, with each update verified through SMT-based counterexample checking. At runtime, ActGov-Runtime abstracts each tool call into finite policy records and permits it only if it remains within the task-scoped authorization boundary and satisfies all applicable policies. This per-action enforcement preserves authorization throughout long-horizon, dynamically branching workflows. We evaluate ActGov on the Agent
items.authors: Kaiyuan Zhang, Yuke Peng, Ke Jiang, Yinqian Zhang

items.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
items.title_zh: 天王星：构建下一代具身人工智能模拟基础设施
items.summary_zh: 可扩展的模拟对于机器人数据生成、策略训练、评估和安全迭代至关重要，但现实世界的交互成本高昂，传统模拟器的构建需要大量人力。我们提出了Uranus，一个基于联合轨迹条件自回归扩散模型的数据驱动机器人模拟器。Uranus具备三大关键能力：(1) 流式开放式展开，在线接收未来的关节位置轨迹，并自回归生成每一步的潜在帧，对应四个RGB帧，无固定时间范围；(2) 低延迟生成，经过推理优化后实现24帧每秒；(3) 可扩展的机器人控制，提供统一接口以实现多视角生成，适用于多种机器人形态和相机配置。我们对Uranus进行了全面的定量和定性评估，涵盖了分布内和分布外的数据，客观评估其性能并明确指出当前的局限性。我们发布了代码和模型权重，以支持社区获得实用工具和见解。
items.abstract: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.
items.authors: Wenkang Qin, Yukun Zhou, Noah Shen, Jisong Cai, Dongxiao Mao, Baicheng Li, Yue Zhang, Wei Sui

items.title: Data-driven discrete-time deep recurrent neural network-based modeling for dissipative systems
items.title_zh: 基于数据驱动的离散时间深度递归神经网络建模耗散系统
items.summary_zh: 物理人工智能在理解、预测和控制现实世界动态方面受到越来越多的关注。实现这一目标需要不仅具备高预测精度的AI模型，还需保留动态系统的基本物理特性。本文提出了一种深度离散时间耗散递归神经网络（DissipNet），通过结构权重约束和专门的训练算法显式地强制执行耗散性这一与稳定性和能量耗散相关的关键特性。所提网络能够在学习耗散动态的同时保持其固有的稳定性，利用Lyapunov理论进行了形式化分析。与物理信息神经网络（PINNs）不同，后者将控制方程纳入训练损失但不保证内部分析特性如耗散性或无源性的保留，我们的方法在模型层面提供了稳定性的明确保证。通过多个建模应用展示了该方法的有效性，并与简单递归神经网络（RNN）和基于PINN的模型进行了性能比较。
items.abstract: Physical AI has gained increasing attention for its role in developing AI systems that better understand, predict, and control real-world dynamics. Achieving this requires AI models that not only achieve high prediction accuracy but also preserve fundamental physical properties of dynamical systems. In this paper, we propose a deep discrete-time dissipative recurrent neural network (DissipNet) that explicitly enforces dissipativity, a key property related to stability and energy dissipation, through structural weight constraints and a dedicated training algorithm. By construction, the proposed network is capable of learning dissipative dynamics while preserving their inherent stability, which is formally analyzed using Lyapunov theory. In contrast to Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), which incorporate governing equations into the training loss but do not guarantee preservation of internal analytical properties such as dissipativity or passivity, our approach provides explicit guarantees on stability at the model level. items.authors: Tuan Luong, Hyungpil Moon

items.title: KITE: KV-Invariant Transformer Expansion for Efficient Agentic LLM Scaling
items.title_zh: KITE：高效代理LLM扩展的KV不变变换器扩展
items.summary_zh: 扩展语言模型不仅关乎最终质量，架构选择决定了训练、提示处理和自回归解码所需的计算量。理想的模型架构应降低这些计算成本，以便于扩展到更大模型，同时确保更大模型确实优于较小基线。我们提出了KV不变变换器扩展（KITE），这一扩展范式实现了这一目标。它通过将模型从小规模训练到大规模（即通过再利用节省训练成本），并将新添加的参数放置在不影响注意力KV的区域。因此，在推理过程中，预填充KV仅依赖于模型的小部分，从而节省推理成本。作为具体实例，我们展示了步骤扩展变换器（SST），一种双塔解码器，其中一塔生成KV，另一塔读取它们。在相当的累计训练计算下，SST作为67B MoE模型，每个解码令牌有2.15B活跃体参数，其训练损失低于47B和63B MoE变换器（分别为1.48B和2.02B活跃体参数），同时推理成本估计降低了6.7%和31.6%。
items.abstract: Scaling a language model is not only a question of final quality: the architectural choice determines how much computation is spent during training, prompt processing, and autoregressive decoding to achieve certain model quality. An ideal model architecture should lower all above computation costs to facilitate scaling to a larger model, while ensure the larger model indeed outperforms smaller baselines. We introduce KV-Invariant Transformer Expansion (KITE), a scaling paradigm that achieves this goal. It trains the model from a smaller size to a larger size (i.e., saving training costs via upcycling), while places newly added parameters in regions that do not affect attention KV. Consequently, during inference, prefilling KV only relies on the smaller part of the model, so the inference costs are saved. As a concrete instantiation, we present Step Scale Transformer (SST), a two-tower decoder in which one tower produces KV and the other reads them. At comparable cumulative training compute, SST, a 67B MoE model with 2.15B active body parameters per decode token, achieves lower training loss than 47B and 63B MoE Transformers with 1.48B and 2.02B active body parameters, respectively,
items.authors: Zhiheng Hu, Yixun Wei, Jian Zhou, Yizhuang Zhou, Ji Li, Xing Chen, Yang Li, Bojun Wang, Yibo Zhu, Xiangyu Zhang, Daxin Jiang

items.title: TNLearn: An Open Source Python Package for Task-based Neurons
items.title_zh: TNLearn：用于任务导向神经元的开源Python包
items.summary_zh: 大脑并不依赖单一类型的神经元来执行各种任务，而是为不同任务设计不同的神经元。任务导向神经元的概念相比于基于任务的架构代表了一种范式转变。该概念认为，解决特定问题需要定制的神经元，因为任务导向神经元能够从与任务相关的数据中捕获有用的先验知识。为促进任务导向神经元在科学研究和工业应用中的使用，我们推出了TNLearn，一个开源Python包，提供任务导向神经元和网络的自动构建，支持任务导向网络的顺利训练。全面的文档，包括技术说明、API参考和示例，已在线提供。TNLearn已在https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn开源，并成为PyTorch生态系统项目。
items.abstract: The brain does not rely on a single type of neuron to perform all kinds of tasks; instead, it designs different neurons for different tasks. The concept of task-based neurons represents a paradigm shift compared to task-based architectures. It argues that solving a specific problem requires customized neurons, as task-based neurons capture useful prior knowledge from task-related data. To facilitate the use of task-based neurons in scientific research and industrial applications, we introduce TNLearn, an open-source Python package that provides automated construction of task-based neurons and networks, enabling smooth training of task-based networks. Comprehensive documentation, including technical exposition, API reference, and representative examples, is available online. TNLearn is open-sourced at https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn and has become a PyTorch ecosystem project.
items.authors: Meng Wang, Tieyun Li, Juntong Fan, Hanyu Pei, Jing-Xiao Liao, Yaodong Yang, Jianwei Ma, Fenglei Fan

items.title: Experts Rise Where LLMs Disagree: Using Cross-Model Disagreement to Target Expert Effort in LLM Codebook Revision for Large-Scale Annotation
items.title_zh: 利用LLM不一致性优化专家参与大规模文本标注
items.summary_zh: 大规模文本标注通过代码书为数百万文档提供专家见解，但开发稳健的代码书通常需要数月时间。大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过应用早期代码书并识别LLM之间强烈不一致的案例，从而加速这一过程，并引导专家反馈以解决这些问题。我们研究了专家为LLM代码书修订提供反馈的三种方式：（i）编辑基于跨LLM不一致的LLM生成修订（代码书验证），（ii）回答关于LLM不一致的问题（问答），以及（iii）用理由标注不一致案例（理由标注）。在数千个辅导会话记录的实验中，理由标注的LLM标注准确率最高（64.9%），优于专家修订的代码书（57.8%），最佳问答设置也超越了该水平（60.5%）。我们的研究表明，LLMs可以战略性地引导专家关注，从而将代码书修订的时间从数月缩短至数天，同时不牺牲标注性能。
items.abstract: Large-scale text annotation brings expert insight to millions of documents, often through a codebook that AI annotators follow. Developing a robust codebook, however, takes months. Large language models (LLMs) could speed this process by applying an early codebook to the data, surfacing cases with strong LLM disagreement, and eliciting expert feedback to address them. We examined three ways experts can provide feedback for LLM codebook revision: (i) editing LLM-generated revisions driven by cross-LLM disagreement (Codebook Verifying), (ii) answering questions about LLM disagreements (Question Answering), and (iii) labeling disagreement cases with rationales (Rationale Labeling). Experiments on thousands of tutoring-session transcripts show that Rationale Labeling yielded the highest LLM-labeling accuracy (64.9%) against expert labels, outperforming the expert-revised codebook (57.8%). The best Question Answering setting also outperformed it (60.5%). Our work shows that LLMs can be used to strategically target expert attention, shortening months of codebook revision to days without sacrificing labeling performance.
items.authors: Zeyu He, Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Rene F. Kizilcec, Ting-Hao 'Kenneth' Huang

items.title: The Computational Value of Sensory-Aligned Receptive Fields Depends on Neuronal Expressivity
items.title_zh: 感官对齐的感受野的计算价值依赖于神经元的表现力
items.summary_zh: 生物感官神经元具有沿着有意义的刺激坐标（如频率、运动方向或视网膜位置）组织的选择性感受野。此结构可能源于高效编码及生物活动、连接和布线的限制。本文探讨了结构化感受野是否在资源效率之外提供计算优势，以及当单个神经元表现力较高时，这种优势是否仍然存在。我们在表达性泄漏记忆神经元的递归网络中独立变化神经元复杂性和前馈感受野的组织。研究发现，在听觉和基于事件的视觉分类任务中，与任务相关的感官坐标对齐的感受野相较于预算匹配的随机感受野提高了测试准确性。当感官坐标被打乱或感受野遵循与任务无关的坐标时，这种优势消失，表明这种益处来自于与任务几何形状的对齐，而非仅仅是受限的连接性。增加神经元复杂性会降低结构化感受野的性能优势。最后，通用突触稀疏正则化诱导输入选择性并部分恢复性能。
items.abstract: Biological sensory neurons have selective receptive fields organized along meaningful stimulus coordinates, such as frequency, motion direction, or retinotopic position. Such structure may arise from efficient coding and biological constraints on activity, connectivity, and wiring, as computational studies of simple neurons have shown across modalities. This raises a question: do structured receptive fields confer a computational advantage beyond resource efficiency itself, and does this advantage persist when individual neurons are highly expressive? We address this question in recurrent networks of Expressive Leaky Memory neurons, where we can independently vary neuronal complexity and the organization of feed-forward receptive fields. Across auditory and event-based visual classification tasks, receptive fields aligned with a task-relevant sensory coordinate improve test accuracy relative to budget-matched random receptive fields. This advantage disappears when sensory coordinates are scrambled, or when receptive fields follow task-irrelevant coordinates, showing that the benefit comes from alignment with task geometry rather than restricted connectivity alone. items.authors: Agnese Adorante, Aaron Spieler, Anna Levina

items.title: Quantifying the Occult: A Comparative Study of Hindu and Buddhist Deities Using Machine Learning Methods
items.title_zh: 量化隐秘：基于机器学习的印度教与佛教神祇比较研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究引入双矩阵计算架构，数学量化196位印度教和金刚乘佛教的隐秘神祇在形态和神学上的差异。通过改进的“基数加权”算法，利用离散Gower距离矩阵评估物理形态，同时通过大型语言模型（LLM）生成的密集向量嵌入映射神学功能，以减轻循环推理的影响。多模态拓扑投影验证了“图像伪装”，展示了不同视觉形式如何在结构上掩盖共享的跨传统功能。此外，我还计算建模了“阿廷效应”，作为顺序认知偏见的心理观察和机器学习基准，表明高基数的隐秘锚（如维纳琴或 severed head）如何超越系统性神学差异，数学聚类正统与密宗实体。跨传统空间分析表明，印度教的Chinnamasta与佛教的Chinnamunda等最高隐秘表现，在视觉（$D_G = 0.288$）和语义（$D_C = 0.068$）边界上共享几乎相同的数学坐标，指示出1:1的隐秘转移。
items.abstract: This study introduces a dual-matrix computational architecture to mathematically quantify the morphological and theological divergence of 196 Hindu and Vajrayana Buddhist esoteric deities. Physical morphology is evaluated via a discrete Gower distance matrix enhanced by a novel "Cardinality Weighting" algorithm, while theological function is mapped via dense vector embeddings generated from Large Language Model (LLM) semantic expansions, explicitly utilized as a synthetic proxy to mitigate circular reasoning. The multi-modal topological projections provide algorithmic validation of "iconographic camouflage", demonstrating how distinct visual forms structurally obscure shared cross-tradition functions. Furthermore, I computationally model the "Atin Effect" - serving simultaneously as a psychological observation of sequential cognitive bias and a machine learning benchmark - demonstrating how high-cardinality esoteric anchors (e.g., a veena or a severed head) override systemic theological disparities to mathematically cluster orthodox and Tantric entities. items.authors: Ankit Bhattacharjee

items.title: Artificial intelligence surrogates for treatment effect estimation with before-and-after data
items.title_zh: 人工智能替代模型用于治疗效果估计的研究
items.summary_zh: 在临床重要结果测量成本高或需要长时间随访的情况下，估计医疗治疗的因果效应变得困难。短期或低成本的替代结果提供了一种潜在的替代方案，但替代生物标志物可能不可用或难以识别。人工智能（AI）的进步使得从低成本、高维度测量中更准确地预测临床结果成为可能，从而为将AI预测作为替代提供了机会。我们开发了一个框架，用于估计每个接受治疗个体在治疗前后的配对测量所获得的治疗效果。通过预训练的AI模型对这些测量进行分析，我们的估计器比较了结果预测。我们界定了在何种技术假设下，这种个体内对比能够识别接受治疗者的平均治疗效应，即使临床结果从未被观察到。对于无法证明的假设，我们利用预测驱动的推断，通过少量观察到的临床结果来校正偏差，获得有效推断。合成和真实世界的心脏肿瘤学实验验证了该方法的有效性和准确性。
items.abstract: Estimating the causal effects of medical treatments is difficult when clinically important outcomes are costly to measure or require long follow-up. Short-term or inexpensive surrogate outcomes offer a potential alternative, but surrogate biomarkers may be unavailable or difficult to identify. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled increasingly accurate prediction of clinical outcomes from inexpensive, high-dimensional measurements, which creates an opportunity to use AI predictions themselves as surrogates. To this end, we develop a framework for estimating treatment effects from paired measurements obtained before and after treatment for each treated individual. A pretrained AI model is applied to the before and after measurements, and our estimator compares the resulting outcome predictions. We characterize the technical assumptions under which this within-person contrast identifies the average treatment effect on the treated, even when clinical outcomes are never observed for treated individuals. items.authors: Frances Dean, Anna Neufeld, Joshua Barrios, Geoffrey H Tison, Ahmed Alaa

items.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
items.title_zh: 预训练模型在AI辅助教育问题评估中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 随着AI辅助教育材料生成的快速发展，我们在验证其教学质量方面的能力滞后。使用Bloom分类器模型进行自动评估是一种有前景的方法，但在新生成的超出分布（OOD）数据集上应用时，性能可能下降。为识别在数据集转变下的稳健分类器，我们评估了传统机器学习（ML）、变换器和大型语言模型在Bloom级别分类任务上的表现。研究发现，TFPOS-IDF ML模型在OOD上的表现较差（宏F1分数0.48），而BERT和LLMs分别为0.55和0.79。文本拼接提高了ML和BERT模型的宏F1分数（分别为0.59和0.62）。将学习目标与输入结合使用提升了特定数据集上的模型性能。模型重训练在各模型和数据集间提供了最大的改进。这些发现强调了在使用预训练模型处理新生成的AI辅助教育问题时的权衡。
items.abstract: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). items.authors: Michael Lawrence Castanares, Princess Ventures, Allan Tan

items.title: Path Regularization: A Near-Complete and Optimal Nonasymptotic Generalization Theory for Multilayer Neural Networks and Double Descent Phenomenon
items.title_zh: 路径正则化：多层神经网络的非渐近泛化理论
items.summary_zh: 路径正则化被证明是一种有效的神经网络训练正则化方法，优于常见的正则化方法如权重衰减。本文提出了一种针对多层神经网络的近乎完整的非渐近泛化理论，适用于一般学习问题，特别是无需假设损失函数有界。该理论超越了偏差-方差权衡，并与深度学习中常见现象相一致，显著不同于现有的非渐近泛化误差界限。我们为具有$\sigma(0)=0$和足够广泛的Lipschitz损失函数的多层神经网络提出了明确的泛化误差上界，无需神经网络的宽度、深度或其他超参数趋向无穷大，也不依赖特定的网络架构或损失函数有界性，同时考虑了近似误差。此外，我们解决了Weinan E等人在2020年提出的关于广义Barron空间的近似率的开放问题，并展示了该理论在ReLU激活的回归问题中的近最优性。
items.abstract: Path regularization has shown to be a very effective regularization to train neural networks, leading to a better generalization property than common regularizations i.e. weight decay, etc. We propose a first near-complete (as will be made explicit in the main text) nonasymptotic generalization theory for multilayer neural networks with path regularizations for general learning problems. In particular, it does not require the boundedness of the loss function, as is commonly assumed in the literature. Our theory goes beyond the bias-variance tradeoff and aligns with phenomena typically encountered in deep learning. It is therefore sharply different from other existing nonasymptotic generalization error bounds. More explicitly, we propose an explicit generalization error upper bound for multilayer neural networks with $\sigma(0)=0$ and sufficiently broad Lipschitz loss functions, without requiring the width, depth, or other hyperparameters of the neural network to approach infinity, a specific neural network architecture (e.g., sparsity), or boundedness of the loss function, while also taking approximation error into consideration. In particular, we solve an open problem proposed by
items.authors: Hao Yu

items.title: Learning to Approximate Uniform Facility Location via Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 通过图神经网络学习均匀设施选址的近似解
items.summary_zh: 神经网络，特别是消息传递神经网络（MPNNs），越来越多地被用作解决困难组合优化问题的启发式方法。然而，许多基于学习的方法依赖于监督、强化学习或梯度估计，导致高计算成本、不稳定的训练或有限的保证。经典的近似算法提供了最坏情况保证，但不可微分且无法适应自然输入分布中的结构。我们通过均匀设施选址（UniFL）问题研究这一权衡，该问题在聚类、摘要、物流和供应链中有应用。我们提出了一种完全可微的MPNN，结合了近似算法原则，无需求解器监督或离散松弛。该模型具有可证明的近似保证，并在实证上优于标准近似算法，缩小了与整数线性规划之间的差距。
items.abstract: Neural networks, particularly message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), are increasingly used as heuristics for hard combinatorial optimization problems. Yet many learning-based methods rely on supervision, reinforcement learning, or gradient estimators, causing high computational cost, unstable training, or limited guarantees. Classical approximation algorithms provide worst-case guarantees but are non-differentiable and cannot adapt to structure in natural input distributions. We study this tradeoff through Uniform Facility Location (UniFL), a problem with applications in clustering, summarization, logistics, and supply chains. We propose a fully differentiable MPNN that incorporates approximation-algorithmic principles without solver supervision or discrete relaxations. The model has provable approximation guarantees and empirically improves on standard approximation algorithms, narrowing the gap to integer linear programming.
items.authors: Chendi Qian, Christopher Morris, Stefanie Jegelka, Christian Sohler

items.title: TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Study Selection in Systematic Reviews
items.title_zh: TiAb Review插件：基于浏览器的AI辅助系统评价文献筛选工具
items.summary_zh: 服务器端筛选工具需支付订阅费用，而开源替代品则要求具备编码技能，全文筛选仍未纳入无代码开源工具的范围。我们开发了TiAb Review插件，这是一款开源的Chrome浏览器扩展，提供无代码、无服务器的人工智能（AI）辅助文献筛选，涵盖标题和摘要（T&A）筛选及全文筛选。该插件使用Google Sheets作为共享数据库，Google Drive作为PDF存储，用户需提供自己的大型语言模型（LLM）API密钥。T&A筛选提供手动审核、LLM批量筛选和机器学习（ML）主动学习。全文筛选从PubMed Central、Europe PMC、Unpaywall、OpenAlex及出版商页面获取开放获取PDF，支持盲审双重审核，提供结构化排除理由和裁决，选项上获取带页面锚定证据的LLM判断，并计算PRISMA 2020流程计数。我们在TypeScript中重新实现了默认的ASReview算法，并与Python原版进行了比较。
items.abstract: Server-based screening tools impose subscription costs, while open-source alternatives require coding skills, and full-text screening has remained outside the scope of no-code open-source tools. We developed TiAb Review Plugin, an open-source Chrome browser extension that provides no-code, serverless artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted study selection covering both title and abstract (T&A) screening and full-text screening. It uses Google Sheets as a shared database and Google Drive as a PDF store, and users supply their own large language model (LLM) API key. For T&A screening, it offers manual review, LLM batch screening, and machine learning (ML) active learning. For full-text screening, it retrieves open-access PDFs from PubMed Central, Europe PMC, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and publisher pages, supports blinded dual review with structured exclusion reasons and adjudication, optionally obtains an LLM judgment with page-anchored evidence, and computes PRISMA 2020 flow counts. We re-implemented the default ASReview algorithm (TF-IDF with Naive Bayes) in TypeScript and compared it with the Python original using 10-fold cross-validation on six datasets. items.title: RideSkill: A Hierarchical Algorithm for Generalized Ride Sharing with LLM-Driven Automatic Evolution
items.title_zh: RideSkill：基于层次算法的通用拼车自动演化方法
items.summary_zh: 拼车允许多个乘客共享一辆车，但由于不同的起止点（OD）对的存在，这一操作面临挑战。尽管多智能体强化学习（MARL）在此领域表现良好，但其在适应不同环境和平台目标方面存在局限，且在大规模系统中训练困难。近期，随着大语言模型（LLM）的发展，部分研究将LLM应用于打车系统，但均未支持车辆共享，导致状态和动作空间指数级扩展。此外，大多数方法在推理时需频繁调用LLM，限制了实时部署的可行性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RideSkill，一种利用LLM辅助自动算法设计的层次拼车方法。RideSkill通过从学习的技能库中为每辆车分配适当的技能，提升了拼车效率。
items.abstract: Ride-sharing, which allows multiple passengers with different origin-destination (OD) pairs to share a single vehicle, is a challenging operational problem, as it requires orders with different OD pairs to be efficiently bundled and assigned to vehicles under uncertain and varying scenarios. Although multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) solutions have achieved promising performance, they suffer from limited generalization (adapting to different environmental scenarios), low transferability (adapting to different platform objectives), and training difficulties in large-scale systems, such as the curse of dimensionality. Recently, motivated by the scaling of large language models (LLMs), several works have incorporated LLMs into ride-hailing systems, either by employing LLMs directly as decision-making agents or using them for automatic algorithm design. However, none of these approaches support vehicle sharing, which complicates the problem by expanding both the state and action spaces exponentially. Moreover, most of them require frequent LLM calls at inference time, making them infeasible for real-time deployment. To address these issues, we propose RideSkill, a hierarchical
items.authors: Zijian Zhao, Sen Li, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan

items.title: "AI Is Turning Too Human": How Teenagers Experience and Negotiate AI in Everyday Life
items.title_zh: 青少年如何体验与协商日常生活中的人工智能
items.summary_zh: 生成性人工智能迅速融入青少年的日常生活，影响其认知、社交和情感发展。本文分析了2023年1月至2026年7月期间r/teenagers上的AI相关讨论，采用关键词检索和人机协作的主题分析方法。研究发现，AI相关讨论显著增加，分析编码的11,083条帖子揭示了八个相互关联的体验领域。其中，日常和社交使用最为普遍（占36.8%），讨论逐渐转向真实性、个人控制、安全性和未来人类角色等议题。青少年质疑AI何时应支持或替代人类思维与创造力，交互式AI如何改变关系与自主感，什么仍可视为真实，谁控制个人信息与表现，以及哪些机会与角色应保留给人类。这些发现表明，青少年对AI的使用不仅是技术采纳，更是对AI在日常生活中地位与界限的协商。
items.abstract: Generative AI is rapidly entering adolescents' everyday lives during a critical period of cognitive, social and emotional development. Yet its adoption is outpacing evidence on how adolescents themselves experience, understand and negotiate its expanding role in their lives. We examined AI-related discourse on r/teenagers from January 2023 to July 2026 using validated keyword-based retrieval and a human-in-the-loop, LLM-assisted thematic analysis. AI-related discussion increased substantially over time, and 11,083 analytically coded posts revealed eight interconnected domains of experience. Everyday and social use was most prevalent (36.8 percent), while discourse increasingly shifted toward authenticity, personal control and safety, and future human roles. Across domains, adolescents questioned when AI should support or substitute for human thinking and creativity, how conversational AI changes relationships and perceptions of agency, what can still be considered authentic, who controls personal information and representation, and what opportunities and roles should remain human. These findings position adolescent AI use not simply as technology adoption, but as an emerging negoti
items.authors: Jianfeng Zhu

items.title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
items.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型生成的写作反馈的聚焦与适应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的反馈是否反映了专家教师在反馈聚焦和适应性方面的教学实践。以往的评估主要关注反馈特征、对学习的影响及其目标，而反馈的聚焦和适应性尚未得到充分重视。为填补这一空白，我们采用并改进了Narciss的分类法，将反馈聚焦类型细分为七类，并对三门大学写作课程中的教师和LLM生成的反馈进行标注。我们发布了FeedType基准，包含来自六个LLM在三种提示策略下的标注反馈。研究评估了反馈聚焦类型的覆盖率和分布，并考察LLMs是否像专家教师一样根据草稿阶段和学生表现水平调整反馈。结果显示，尽管大多数LLMs覆盖了大部分反馈聚焦类型，但未能反映教师反馈的分布，且适应性水平各异，均未匹配教师的适应行为。我们相信FeedType将支持未来在LLM反馈生成中的教学一致性研究。
items.abstract: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.
items.authors: Norah Almousa, Shayan Peyghambari Oskoui, Raquel Coelho, Gayle Rogers, Xiang Lorraine Li, Diane Litman

items.title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
items.title_zh: 超越诗歌：大型语言模型能生成经典阿拉伯Maqamat吗？
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在创意文本生成方面表现出色，但其生成具有文化基础和风格约束的文学形式的能力仍未得到充分探索。以往研究主要集中在现代语言和诗歌上，而经典散文传统如Maqama则鲜有研究。Maqama是一种经典文学体裁，特点是押韵散文（saj）、密集的修辞装饰和情节结构，使其成为评估LLMs是否能超越表面流畅性、达到更深层次文学能力的挑战性测试平台。本文首次对LLMs生成Maqama进行了控制评估研究，比较了五种模型在零样本、少样本和基于规则的提示下的表现，并通过人类注释和LLM作为评判者的框架评估输出的修辞丰富性、saj密度、结构连贯性和风格真实性等维度。结果表明，提示策略对风格质量有显著影响：少样本提示最一致地提高了saj密度，而对修辞和连贯性的影响因模型而异，最强模型（GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini）在这些维度上最受益于基于规则的提示，尽管零样本提示在所有五个模型中产生了最高的综合得分。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. items.title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
items.title_zh: 激活记忆与参数记忆在少样本学习中的互补作用
items.summary_zh: 在测试阶段，大型语言模型（LLMs）能够通过激活记忆（即KV缓存）和参数记忆（即更新参数）编码历史信息。激活记忆通常被认为在事实回忆方面有效，而参数记忆则用于学习新任务，但二者的相互作用尚不明确。本研究通过控制实验系统地探讨了记忆在少样本学习中的作用。结果发现，激活记忆在回忆事实方面表现优越，而参数记忆在任务学习中并不总是优于激活记忆。此外，实验表明复合任务“条件算术”需要两种记忆类型的协同作用。通过神经元级分析，我们发现模型在通过激活记忆与参数记忆访问相同历史信息时激活了不同的神经元集合。当两种记忆类型结合时，模型从两个集合中招募神经元，这对解决条件算术至关重要。这些发现表明，单一的记忆机制不足以完成该复合任务，强调了它们协作的重要性。
items.abstract: At test time, large language models (LLMs) can encode historical information in activation memory (i.e., KV caches) and parametric memory (i.e., updated parameters). While activation memory is generally considered effective for factual recall and parametric memory for learning new tasks, their interplay remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of memory in few-shot learning through controlled experiments. We find that activation memory is superior for recalling facts, whereas parametric memory does not consistently outperform activation memory in task learning. Moreover, our experiments show that the composite task, Conditional Arithmetic, requires the synergy of both memory types. Through neuron-level analysis, we find that the model activates distinct sets of neurons when accessing the same historical information through activation versus parametric memory. When both memory types are combined, the model recruits neurons from both sets, which is crucial for solving Conditional Arithmetic. These findings suggest that neither memory mechanism alone is sufficient for this composite task, highlighting the importance of their collaboration.
items.authors: Miaohe Niu, Runsong Zhao, Xinyu Liu, Bo Jin, Yucheng Qiao, Chunliang Zhang, Jingbo Zhu, Tong Xiao

items.title: Toward Measuring Structural Drift in LLM Communication Loops
items.title_zh: 测量大型语言模型通信环路中的结构漂移
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地在有状态的管道中运行，这些管道通过检索、记忆、工具和其他代理组装每个提示。这些管道会发生漂移：本应影响下一个响应的信息被丢弃、压缩或错误路由，而每个组件仍报告成功。现有诊断方法未能捕捉这一点，因为它们评估的是孤立的提示、响应或任务得分，而真正解耦的是提示与其引出的响应之间的关系。我们展示了将提示到响应再到下一个提示的链视为分析的基本单元，使这些关系可测量。我们引入了结构通信一致性，通过两个指标量化：通信闭合性和标准化条件行动贡献。在2171个人与人、58个人与LLM和8个LLM与LLM的对话中，这些指标揭示了方向性互动结构；关键是，当响应被替换为来自另一个回合的响应时，测量的贡献下降了87%到92%，而周围的提示保持不变。由于该方法不需要标签、健康的参考数据或预定义规则，仅通过操作流量直接定义和测量原始提示和响应的漂移。
items.abstract: Large language models increasingly run in stateful pipelines that assemble each prompt from retrieval, memory, tools, and other agents. Such pipelines drift: information that should shape the next response is dropped, compressed, or misrouted while every component still reports success. Existing diagnostics miss this because they evaluate isolated prompts, responses, or task scores, whereas what decouples is the relation between a prompt and the response it draws. Here we show that treating the prompt to response to next prompt chain as the fundamental unit of analysis makes these relations measurable. We introduce structural communication coherence, quantified by two metrics: communication closure, which asks if what the pipeline returns at one turn matches what it faces next, and normalized conditional action contribution, which measures how much a sent message resolves the subsequent reply. Across 2,171 human to human, 58 human to LLM, and 8 LLM to LLM dialogues, these metrics reveal directional interaction structures; crucially, the measured contribution drops by 87 to 92% when a response is swapped for one from another turn, leaving surrounding prompts untouched. items.title: Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass
items.title_zh: 双宇宙与双度量引力：从萨哈罗夫的宇宙对称到负质量的现代推测
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了双宇宙模型的概念和理论现状，涵盖了萨哈罗夫早期关于重子生成、CPT对称性及时间反向箭头的思想，以及近期涉及对偶创建纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学场景。特别关注萨哈罗夫类型的宇宙对称性、现代双度量引力理论与负质量领域的推测模型之间的区别。总结了双度量引力面临的主要一致性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼态、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒定律及正负质量领域的禁入结果。接着探讨了Janus宇宙模型及相关黑洞替代方案，强调启发式双宇宙叙述与完全规范的相对论场论之间的差异。我们认为，尽管双宇宙思想为时间箭头、物质-反物质不对称性及宇宙的量子起源等问题提供了肥沃的框架，但结合双度量引力、负质量、暗领域现象学及Kerr黑洞替代方案的模型面临着重大的数学和观测证明负担。
items.abstract: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observ
items.authors: Jean-Pierre Luminet

items.title: The lifetimes and properties of Little Red Dots in the AMBRA simulation
items.title_zh: AMBRA模拟中小红点的寿命与性质研究
items.summary_zh: 我们在AMBRA宇宙学水动力学模拟中识别并分析了小红点（LRDs），通过模拟红移为5到8之间的星系和活动星系核（AGN）的观测。我们使用标准AGN发射模型和“气体包裹”模型生成这些模拟观测，发现气体包裹的AGN对再现暗淡LRDs（F444W星等$>$ 26.0）至关重要。我们发现AMBRA中LRD密度在$z=5$到$z=8$之间的下降比观测结果更陡峭，导致在$z\sim6$之后LRDs的相对不足。加入未解析的AGN变异性后，红移的下降趋于平缓，AMBRA中的LRD红移演化与其他理论数据集大致一致，并更接近观测结果。我们发现AMBRA中的LRDs是预先存在的黑洞-星系系统，正经历LRD阶段，主要通过AGN相对于宿主的亮度进行选择。虽然由于AGN环境的未解析特性，无法确定这些LRD阶段的确切持续时间，但我们利用现有的时间序列数据对AMBRA中LRDs的寿命进行了限制，发现大多数LRDs的寿命在$\sim3$到$\sim 300$百万年之间，且LRD寿命随着黑洞和其他因素的增加而延长。
items.abstract: We identify and analyze the little red dots (LRDs) in the AMBRA cosmological hydrodynamic simulation, by producing mock observations of the galaxies and active galactic nuclei (AGN) between redshifts 5 and 8. We produce these mock observations with both a standard AGN emission model, and a ``gas-enshrouded'' model, and find that the presence of a gas-enshrouded AGN is instrumental to the reproduction of dim LRDs (F444W magnitude $>$ 26.0). We find a steeper decrease in LRD density between $z=5$ and $z=8$ within AMBRA than seen in observations, resulting in a relative underproduction of LRDs beyond $z\sim6$ in AMBRA. With the addition of unresolved AGN variability, the decline with redshift flattens, and the LRD redshift evolution in AMBRA becomes broadly consistent with other theoretical datasets, and closer to that seen in observations. We find that the LRDs in AMBRA are pre-existing black hole--galaxy systems that are undergoing an LRD phase, selected primarily by the brightness of the AGN relative to its host. While the exact duration of these LRD phases is not possible to determine due to the unresolved nature of the AGN environment, we use the available time-series data to pla
items.authors: Patrick LaChance, Yihao Zhou, Aklant Kumar Bhowmick, Rupert A. C. Croft, Tiziana Di Matteo, Laura Blecha, Fabio Pacucci, Paul Torrey, Simeon Bird

items.title: The galactic HI-to-halo mass relation from isolated galaxies to cosmological hydrodynamic simulations
items.title_zh: 孤立星系的HI与暗物质晕质量关系研究
items.summary_zh: HI与暗物质（DM）晕质量之间的关系为气体吸积和星系形成调节提供了重要见解。本研究基于SPARC和LITTLE THINGS样本，发现附近盘状星系中HI质量与DM晕质量的比率在恒星质量范围内大致保持不变（$\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$，$1\sigma$散布为0.37 dex）。本研究进一步引入来自孤立星系间介质分析（AMIGA）样本和Gassendi HAlpha螺旋星系调查（GHASP）的星系，构建高分辨率旋转曲线和红外光度学的质量模型，推导DM晕参数。结果确认HI与DM晕质量之间的比例关系，并在近五个数量级的恒星质量范围内发现几乎恒定的HI质量与晕质量比率（$\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$，$1\sigma$散布为0.36 dex）。AMIGA和GHASP样本与之前SPARC和LITTLE THINGS样本的关系统计一致，表明该关系在不同星系中具有稳健性。
items.abstract: The relation between HI and dark matter (DM) halo masses provides key insights into gas accretion and the regulation of galaxy formation. In a previous study based on SPARC and LITTLE THINGS samples, we showed that the ratio between HI mass and DM halo mass remains approximately constant with stellar mass for nearby disc galaxies ($\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$ with a $1\sigma$ scatter of 0.37 dex). In this work, we extend that analysis by incorporating galaxies from the Analysis of the interstellar Medium in Isolated GAlaxies (AMIGA) sample and from the Gassendi HAlpha survey of SPirals (GHASP). The AMIGA sample provides the most rigorously selected sample of isolated galaxies in the local Universe, well-suited for testing whether the relation found in the previous samples holds in interaction-free galaxies. We construct mass models from high-resolution rotation curves and infrared photometry, and derive DM halo parameters. We confirm the proportionality between HI and DM halo masses and find a nearly constant HI-mass-to-halo-mass ratio of $\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$ over nearly five orders of magnitude in stellar mass ($7\leq\log(M_{\star}/M_\odot)\leq 11.5$), with a $1\sigma$ sca

items.title: Ubiquitous nuclear disks and bars embedded in massive galaxies in the cosmic morning
items.title_zh: 宇宙早期大质量星系中的普遍核盘和棒结构
items.summary_zh: 高红移星系中心区域的形态尚未得到充分研究，近期案例研究表明，巨型盘可以在未形成显著中心球体的情况下出现。本文研究了TNG50模拟中45个质量完整的$z=3$大质量星系的内部结构。通过双S\'ersic剖面分解、等密度椭圆拟合、内在三维形状测量和恒星动力学分析，我们发现这些中心结构普遍扁平且由旋转支撑，S\'ersic指数较低（$n \lesssim 1$）。这表明中心区域主要是核盘和棒，而非隆起。我们追踪其演化，发现这些核盘和棒在富含气体的压缩过程中形成，并在$z \lesssim 1$之前未转变为球形和弥散主导系统，此前已发展出扩展的恒星盘。我们的结果表明，大质量盘可以围绕旋转支撑的中心组装，而缺乏隆起的大质量星系可能是星系演化的常见结果。
items.abstract: The morphology of the central regions of high-redshift galaxies remains relatively unexplored, while recent case studies suggest that giant disks can emerge without first developing a prominent central spheroid. Here, we investigate the inner structures of a mass-complete sample of 45 massive galaxies at $z=3$ in the TNG50 simulation. Through double-S\'ersic profile decomposition, isodensity ellipse fitting, intrinsic three-dimensional shape measurements, and stellar kinematics, we find that these central structures are ubiquitously flattened and rotation-supported with low S\'ersic indices ($n \lesssim 1$). This indicates that the central regions are predominantly nuclear disks and bars rather than bulges. Tracking their evolution, we show that these nuclear disks and bars emerge during gas-rich compaction and do not transform into spheroidal and dispersion-dominated systems until $z \lesssim 1$, before which extended stellar disks have already developed. Our results suggest that massive disks can assemble around rotation-supported centers and bulge-deficient massive galaxies may be a common outcome of galaxy evolution.
items.authors: Jianyuan Luo, Fangzhou Jiang, Jinning Liang, Boris S. Kalita, Pinsong Zhao, Jinyi Shangguan, Bingcheng Jin, Zeyu Gao, Weichen Wang, Luis C. Ho, Yingjie Peng

items.title: Investigating the ionization mechanisms powering the extreme emission lines in metal-poor galaxies
items.title_zh: 探讨金属贫乏星系中极端发射线的电离机制
items.summary_zh: 极端发射金属贫乏星系（EEMPGs）是理解早期宇宙中极端物理条件和电离辐射场的优秀实验室。然而，导致其高电离发射线的确切来源仍存在争议，包括中等质量黑洞（IMBHs）、超亮X射线源（ULXs）或辐射冲击波。我们对金属贫乏EEMPGs的基本特性和电离辐射场进行了表征，旨在识别驱动这些发射线的高电离光子的主要来源。我们选择了11个EEMPG样本，这些星系是迄今为止已知的最金属贫乏星系（12+log(O/H) < 54 eV）。我们的样本涵盖了多种特性，适合研究早期星系。低电离线和高电离线的通量比表明，恒星辐射可能是主要的电离源，IMBH的贡献较小（4-8%）。纯冲击波无法解释观察到的发射线比率和电离光子预算。
items.abstract: Extreme emission metal-poor galaxies (EEMPGs) are excellent local laboratories for understanding the extreme physical conditions and ionizing radiation fields in the early Universe. However, the exact source of high-ionization emission lines in them, whether from intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs), ultra-luminous X-ray sources (ULXs), or radiative shocks, remains debated. We characterize the fundamental properties and ionizing radiation field on metal-poor EEMPGs, aiming to identify the dominant sources of the highly ionizing photons that drive these lines. We selected a sample of 11 EEMPGs, among the most metal-poor galaxies with JWST/MIRI observations known so far (12+log(O/H) 54 eV). Our EEMPG sample, covering various properties, is ideal for studying the first galaxies. Their flux ratios of low- and high-ionization lines suggest stellar radiation as the likely ionization source, with a small contribution from an IMBH (4-8%). Pure shocks fail to explain the observed emission line ratios and ionizing photon budget.
items.authors: C. Daoutis, V. Lebouteiller, D. Schaerer, I. Morel, O. Bait, S. Satyapal, S. Doan, B. Trahin, A. Gurpide, Y. Izotov, N. Guseva, L. Ramambason, A. Verhamme, SpeXion Team

items.title: A sub-100 pc view at z~5 of a Multiply-Imaged Massive Quiescent Galaxy
items.title_zh: z~5的多重成像大质量静止星系研究
items.summary_zh: 近期詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的光谱调查揭示了在宇宙早期十亿年内快速形成的早期星系。宇宙学模拟难以重现这一人群，因为模型要求在早期宇宙中快速、高效地将重子转化为恒星，并随后迅速停止恒星形成（称为熄灭）。高红移场星系的紧凑性和未解析性使得测试这些理论模型变得困难。我们在此介绍VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1，这是一颗位于$z=5.18\pm0.15$的巨大后星暴星系，过去30百万年内推测其恒星形成水平较低。前景星团CL J0152.7-1357将该系统引力透镜成三个图像，平均放大率为$\mu \sim$ 7, 11和0.6。这种几何形状提供了约70 pc的物理分辨率，比JWST/NIRCam的基本模糊极限提高了约7倍。我们的二维映射显示其半光半径是预期的两倍，中心恒星质量表面密度比场类星系低半个数量级，并且存在偏心的电离气体发射。这些特征表明VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1在没有明显驱动因素的情况下突然停止了恒星形成。
items.abstract: Recent James Webb Space Telescope spectroscopic surveys reveal an abundance of rapidly assembled early galaxies in the first billion years. Cosmological simulations struggle to reproduce this population because models require a rapid, highly efficient conversion of baryons into stars followed by an abrupt cessation of star-formation, known as quenching, in the early Universe. Testing these theoretical models remains difficult because high-redshift field galaxies appear compact and unresolved. This lack of resolution makes it impossible to distinguish compaction-driven quenching from secular evolution. Here we present VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1, a massive post-starburst galaxy at $z=5.18\pm0.15$, with inferred low-levels of star-formation in the last 30 Myr. The foreground cluster CL J0152.7-1357 gravitationally lenses the system into three images with median magnifications of $\mu \sim$ 7, 11, and 0.6. This geometry yields a physical resolution of $\sim 70$ pc, a factor of $\sim 7$ better than the JWST/NIRCam fundamental blurring limit (full-width half-maximum of $\sim$0.48 kpc at $z\sim5$). items.title: The universe as a superconductor: How to search for a photon mass
items.title_zh: 宇宙作为超导体：光子质量的搜索方法
items.summary_zh: 我们重新审视了光子质量的限制条件，特别是在阿贝尔希格斯机制下，而非普罗卡项。由于希格斯粒子必然是微电荷且轻的，理论的相位（迈斯纳相、涡旋相或对称恢复相）依赖于环境磁场，因此实验测得的光子质量取决于实验环境。我们根据相位对现有实验进行了分类，类比于I型和II型超导体。对于I型光子质量，星系和星际介质中的磁场可以在各处恢复对称性，允许真空光子质量高达$0.3 \,{\rm MeV}$。宇宙中可能存在高达$10^{-5}\, {\rm eV}$的光子质量区域，频率依赖的光学深度测量可能揭示这些区域。对于II型光子质量，我们表明最强的约束主要来自于银河动力学生成观测到的磁场的要求，这一要求是通过将磁流体动力学推广到非零光子质量而得出的。由于地球磁场在大部分剩余参数空间中恢复对称性，因此在大型磁屏蔽体内或太空中的实验可以探测到地球上任何实验无法观察到的光子质量。
items.abstract: We revisit the bounds on the photon mass when it arises from an Abelian Higgs mechanism rather than a Proca term. Because the higgs is necessarily millicharged and light, the phase of the theory (Meissner, vortex, or symmetry-restored) depends on the ambient magnetic field, so the photon mass an experiment measures depends on the environment it is performed in. We classify existing experiments by the phases in which they apply, in analogy with Type I and Type II superconductors. For Type I photon masses, magnetic fields in galaxies and the intergalactic medium can restore the symmetry everywhere, allowing a vacuum photon mass as large as $0.3 \,{\rm MeV}$. Regions of photon mass as large as $10^{-5}\, {\rm eV}$ could be present in the Universe, and measurement of frequency dependent optical depth can potentially reveal these regions. For Type II photon masses, we show that the strongest constraints mainly arise from the requirement that the galactic dynamo generates the observed magnetic fields, which we derive by generalizing magnetohydrodynamics to a nonzero photon mass. items.title: Disk truncation triggers relativistic jet launching of a highly accreting supermassive black hole
items.title_zh: 盘面截断触发超大质量黑洞的相对论喷流发射
items.summary_zh: 相对论喷流是宇宙中最具能量的现象之一，通过能量反馈影响星系演化，但吸积流与喷流发射之间的物理联系尚未解决。喷流的产生通常归因于Blandford-Znajek机制，该机制通过吸积流维持的大规模磁场提取黑洞的旋转能量。尽管这一机制在热的、几何厚的吸积流中得到了观测支持，但在强喷流的高吸积环境中却存在悖论，因为这些环境通常由冷的、几何薄的盘主导，无法维持大规模磁场。我们报告了通过X射线成像与光谱任务（XRISM）获得的协调X射线微量热计光谱和全球毫米波干涉阵（GMVA）、超长基线阵（VLBA）及东亚VLBI网络（EAVN）对宽线射电星系3C120的毫米波/射电干涉观测。高分辨率X射线光谱揭示了一个相对论扩展的Fe-K$\alpha$线，表明冷的、几何薄的盘在$\sim 20~R_{\rm g}$处被截断，内部区域被热的、几何厚的流替代。同时，射电成像表明喷流轮廓向黑洞视界的外推结果。
items.abstract: Relativistic jets are among the most energetic phenomena in the Universe and influence galaxy evolution through energetic feedback, yet the physical connection between accretion flows and jet launching remains unresolved. Jet production is widely attributed to the Blandford-Znajek mechanism, which extracts black hole rotational energy via large-scale magnetic fields sustained by an accretion flow. Although this mechanism is observationally well supported for hot, geometrically-thick accretion flows, highly accreting environments with strong jets present a paradox, as they are typically dominated by cold, geometrically-thin disks incapable of sustaining large-scale magnetic fields. Here, we report coordinated X-ray microcalorimeter spectroscopy achieved by X-ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission (XRISM) and millimeter/radio interferometric observations by Global Millimeter VLBI Array (GMVA), Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA), and East Asian VLBI Network (EAVN) on the broad-line radio galaxy 3C120. items.title: A Search For Stellar-mass Black Holes Via Astrometric Microlensing II: 2012-2015 Keck Candidates
items.title_zh: 通过天文测微透镜寻找恒星质量黑洞 II：2012-2015年Keck候选者
items.summary_zh: 银河系预计拥有约10^8个恒星质量黑洞，但其双星比例尚不确定。探测孤立恒星质量黑洞的唯一有效方法是引力微透镜。本文报告了通过光度测量和天文测量进行的黑洞微透镜搜索结果。我们结合了来自OGLE和MOA的10年受限视场光度数据与W.~M.~Keck天文台自适应光学成像仪的衍射极限光度和天文测量数据，限制了OGLE-2012-BLG-0169、OGLE-2014-BLG-0613/MOA-2015-BLG-041、OGLE-2015-BLG-0029/MOA-2015-BLG-170和OGLE-2015-BLG-0211的透镜质量。在监测的四个长时间微透镜事件中，我们排除了3个事件中的黑洞透镜，可能存在恒星或白矮星透镜。OGLE-2015-BLG-0211仍为黑洞候选者，其透镜质量限制不明确，1σ上限为3.2M⊙，3σ上限为21.6M⊙。该事件受限于不良观测条件和显著的天文参考框架不确定性，但其分析可能受益于即将发布的Gaia数据第4版的额外天文数据。在本研究及之前研究的六个长时间尺度（t_E>100天）微透镜事件中，已确认一个黑洞，另一个尚未排除。我们简要检查了银河模型模拟。
items.abstract: The Milky Way is expected to host $\sim$10$^8$ stellar-mass black holes with an uncertain binary fraction. The only proven method to detect isolated stellar mass black holes is gravitational microlensing. Here we report the results of a microlensing search for black holes with photometry and astrometry. By combining 10 years of seeing-limited photometry from OGLE and MOA with diffraction-limited photometry and astrometry from adaptive optics imagers at the W.~M.~Keck Observatory, we constrain lens masses for OGLE-2012-BLG-0169, OGLE-2014-BLG-0613/MOA-2015-BLG-041, OGLE-2015-BLG-0029/MOA-2015-BLG-170, and OGLE-2015-BLG-0211. Of the four long-duration microlensing events monitored, we ruled out black hole lenses in 3 events, which likely have stellar or white dwarf lenses. OGLE-2015-BLG-0211 remains a black hole candidate with a poorly constrained lens mass with a 1$\sigma$ upper mass limit of 3.2$M_\odot$ and a 3$\sigma$ upper mass limit of 21.6$M_\odot$. This event suffered from poor observing conditions and significant astrometric reference frame uncertainties, but its analysis may benefit from additional astrometric data in the upcoming Gaia Data Release 4. items.title: Differentiable astrophysics at scale: solving and differentiating ODE ensembles on the GPU
items.title_zh: 大规模可微天体物理：在GPU上求解和微分ODE集合
items.summary_zh: 天文学家越来越多地使用基于梯度的方法来拟合模型，如哈密顿蒙特卡洛，这需要模型相对于参数的导数。在许多分析中，预测需要为成千上万到百万个参数集求解一小组常微分方程（ODE），而这种集成的成本通常决定了分析的开销。我们向天文学界介绍了GRADSOLVE，这是一个将计算移至图形处理单元（GPU）的JAX库：它在每个GPU线程中集成集合的每个成员，并在同一次计算中返回相对于参数的导数。在三个不同天文学领域的示例中，我们测量了其加速效果，包括银河势场中的恒星轨道、暗能量宇宙学的膨胀历史和双黑洞的自旋进动。对于一百万条轨迹，GRADSOLVE的运行速度比在CPU的128个核心上运行的串行代码快8.5到1500倍，比单核心快几个数量级。在同一GPU上，它在所有三个示例中也比JAX中的最先进ODE库DIFFRAX快11到15倍。使用GRADSOLVE，一百万次这样的积分在一台GPU上只需几秒钟或更少。
items.abstract: Astronomers increasingly fit their models with gradient-based methods, such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, which need the derivatives of the model with respect to its parameters. In many analyses a prediction requires solving a small system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for thousands to millions of parameter sets, and this ensemble of integrations often sets the cost of the analysis. We introduce to the astronomical community GRADSOLVE, a JAX library that moves this computation to graphics processing units (GPUs): it integrates each member of the ensemble in its own GPU thread with its own step size and returns the derivatives with respect to the parameters in the same pass. We measure the speed-up it provides in three examples from different fields of astronomy, stellar orbits in the Galactic potential, the expansion history of a dark-energy cosmology and the spin precession of binary black holes, with every code held to the same accuracy requirement. For a million trajectories GRADSOLVE runs 8.5 to 1500 times faster than the serial CPU code of each example running on all 128 cores of a CPU, and several orders of magnitude faster than on one core. items.title: The Entangling of Supernova Feedback Impacts with Coarsening Simulation Resolution
items.title_zh: 超新星反馈影响与粗分辨率模拟的纠缠
items.summary_zh: 超新星（SN）反馈在星系中被认为调节星形成（SF）和产生气体外流。然而，针对超新星对星际介质（ISM）小尺度影响的详细研究表明，SF抑制和外流生成的宏观过程是通过不同的渠道进行的。我们在两个独立的高数值分辨率（m_gas ~ Msun）孤立矮星系模拟LYRA和RIGEL中展示了这一发现。结果表明，超新星对星系的宏观影响最好由其局部密度预测。外流在稀疏区域由超新星驱动，扩展到其冷却半径，尺度达到大约千秒差距（~kpc），而密集的SF区域则以局部方式（~pc）被破坏。然而，这些反馈渠道仅在能够跟踪质量尺度小于等于100太阳质量的高分辨率下可区分。在较粗的尺度上平均时，ISM密度被严重低估，不同SF和受超新星影响区域之间的变化被严重抹平。因此，无法仅凭粗分辨率信息自洽地确定（1）超新星是否倾向于促进外流或直接抑制SF，以及（2）特定区域的SF速率。
items.abstract: It is often understood that supernova (SN) feedback in galaxies is responsible for regulating star formation (SF) and generating gaseous outflows. However, a detailed look at the small-scale effects of SNe on the interstellar medium (ISM) in simulations shows that the macroscopic processes of SF suppression and outflow generation proceed in distinct channels. We demonstrate this finding in two independent simulations of isolated dwarf galaxies with very high (m_gas ~ Msun) numerical resolution, LYRA and RIGEL. Our findings suggest that the macroscopic effect of a given SN on the galaxy is best predicted by its local density. Outflows are driven by SNe in diffuse regions expanding to their cooling radii on large (~kpc) scales, while dense SF regions are disrupted in a localized (~pc) manner. However, these separate feedback channels are only distinguishable at very high resolutions capable of following mass scales \lesssim 10^2 \msun. When averaging on coarser scales, ISM densities are greatly mis-estimated, and variations between different SF and SNe-affected regions are severely washed out. It therefore cannot be __self-consistently__ determined, from coarse-resolution information

items.title: Black Hole Occupation Fraction: Dependence on Black Hole Mass Threshold, Environment, Resolution and Redshift
items.title_zh: 黑洞占据分数：对黑洞质量阈值、环境、分辨率和红移的依赖性
items.summary_zh: 我们利用最先进的半解析模型\texttt{FEGA25}，基于三种仅含暗物质的宇宙模拟提取的合并树，研究黑洞（BH）占据分数$f_{\rm BH,occ}$与星系恒星质量之间的关系，考虑黑洞质量阈值、星系类型、模拟体积、数值分辨率、采样星系群体和红移等因素。\texttt{FEGA25}改进了活动星系核反馈的处理，并不强加预先存在的黑洞种子群体：黑洞通过类星体和射电模式自然生长。我们的分析表明，$f_{\rm BH,occ}$随恒星质量增加而增加，但其归一化和形状强烈依赖于所采用的黑洞质量阈值及中心星系与卫星星系的相对贡献。中心星系和卫星星系的相对行为依赖于模拟盒和黑洞质量阈值，而整体关系应视为加权量。此外，我们发现显著的盒间变化，反映了数值分辨率、模拟体积和采样星系群体的综合影响。红移演化并非普遍适用。
items.abstract: We take advantage of the state-of-the-art semi-analytic model \texttt{FEGA25} \citep{contini2025}, run on merger trees extracted from three dark matter-only cosmological simulations, to study the relation between the black hole (BH) occupation fraction, $f_{\rm BH,occ}$, and galaxy stellar mass as a function of BH mass threshold, galaxy type, simulated volume, numerical resolution, sampled galaxy population, and redshift. \texttt{FEGA25} includes an improved treatment of active galactic nucleus feedback and does not impose a pre-existing BH seed population: BHs grow naturally through quasar and radio modes. Starting from the prerequisite that \texttt{FEGA25} reproduces the observed BH mass function from at least $z=2$ to the present day, our analysis leads to several results. We find that $f_{\rm BH,occ}$ increases with stellar mass, but that its normalization and shape depend strongly on the adopted BH mass threshold and on the relative contribution of central and satellite galaxies. The relative behavior of central and satellite galaxies depends on the simulation box and BH mass threshold, while the global relation should be interpreted as a population-weighted quantity. We also
items.authors: Emanuele Contini, J. K. Jang, Jinsu Rhee, Changjo Seo, Sukyoung K. Yi

items.title: Deterministic photon waveform adaptation for quantum connectivity
items.title_zh: 量子连接的确定性光子波形适应技术
items.summary_zh: 量子技术的可扩展性依赖于通过光子通道互联独立量子系统的能力。然而，异构量子平台发射和吸收的光子具有显著不同的特性，严重限制了节点间的干涉和模块化连接。本文展示了一种冷原子光学量子存储器，能够同时实现接近单位的存储和检索效率，以及在任意可编程输入和输出脉冲波形之间对单光子的确定性时间适应。该系统在高光学深度和完全集成的架构下运行，能够存储持续时间跨越三个数量级的光子，并在不影响效率的情况下任意重塑，兼容多种当前平台。通过将量子存储器的角色从被动存储元件提升为主动可编程光子接口，我们的研究为可扩展的基于纠缠的量子网络和模块化量子计算架构奠定了关键基础。
items.abstract: The scalability of quantum technologies will depend on the ability to interconnect independent quantum systems through photonic channels. However, heterogeneous quantum platforms emit and absorb photons with widely differing properties, severely limiting inter-node interference and modular connectivity. Here we demonstrate a cold-atom optical quantum memory that simultaneously achieves near-unity storage-and-retrieval efficiency and deterministic temporal adaptation of single photons between arbitrary and programmable input and output pulse waveforms. Operating at high optical depth and within a fully integrated architecture, the system can store photons with durations spanning over three orders of magnitude and reshape them arbitrarily without compromising efficiency, achieving compatibility with many current platforms. By augmenting the role of a quantum memory from a passive storage element to an active programmable photonic interface, our results establish a key building block for scalable entanglement-based quantum networks and modular quantum computing architectures.
items.authors: Jeffrey Mohan, J\'er\'emy Berroir, Filippo Borselli, David Libault, Ferhat Loubar, Kilian M\"uller, Jed Rowland, F\'elix Hoffet, Eleni Diamanti, Tom Darras, Tommaso Mazzoni, Julien Laurat

items.title: Soft decoding for quantum LDPC codes with experimental validation
items.title_zh: 量子LDPC码的软解码及实验验证
items.summary_zh: 解码器是容错量子计算机的关键组件，根据计算过程中进行的奇偶校验测量计算纠错。软解码器通过置信度评分增强输出，结合后选择可显著提高逻辑性能。我们提出了一种用于量子低密度奇偶校验码的软束搜索解码器，利用内部解码器数据作为置信度指标，消除了额外计算的需求。我们对五种与超导和捕获离子架构相关的量子LDPC码进行了电路级仿真，使用我们的全局软解码器，在物理误差率为$10^{-3}$时实现了高达$580\times$的逻辑错误抑制，仅拒绝$0.1\%$的实验。随后，我们模拟了行走猫架构的核心逻辑操作——错误检测测量，使用流式软束解码器，实现了高达$210\times$的错误抑制，同时拒绝概率仅增加$0.5$个百分点。最后，我们回顾了在捕获离子上进行的量子LDPC码记忆实验，证明我们的软解码器使逻辑量子比特的寿命翻倍，平均拒绝率为$2.6\%$至$5.6\%$，将所有五种代码带入超越盈亏平衡的状态。
items.abstract: The decoder is a critical component of a fault-tolerant quantum computer, computing corrections based on parity-check measurements performed throughout the computation. A soft decoder supplements its output with a confidence score which, when used alongside post-selection, can substantially improve logical performance. We introduce a soft beam search decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that uses internal decoder data as a confidence metric, removing the need for extra computation. We perform circuit-level simulations of five quantum LDPC codes relevant for superconducting and trapped ion architectures equipped with our global soft decoder and we obtain up to $580\times$ logical-error suppression at a physical error rate of $10^{-3}$ while rejecting only $0.1\%$ of shots. Then, we simulate an error detected measurement, which is a core logical operation of the walking cat architecture, using a streaming version of soft beam decoder and we achieve up to $210\times$ error suppression while increasing the rejection probability by only $0.5$ percentage points.
