items.authors: Arda Aydin, Edwin Tham, Nicolas Delfosse, Min Ye

items.title: Quantum Channel Stein's Lemma with an Exponential Strong Converse
items.title_zh: 量子信道Stein引理及其指数强对偶性
items.summary_zh: 我们在每个固定的I类错误容忍度下建立了量子信道Stein引理，并在任意自适应策略下证明了指数强对偶性。对于任何有限维信道对，最优的II类指数等于正则化信道相对熵，并通过并行策略达到。当该散度有限时，任何严格更大的II类速率都会强迫接受原假设的概率以指数方式衰减，且在策略和量子记忆上是均匀的。证明依赖于均匀的Stinespring近似：在对环境施加辅助线性映射后，原扩展的张量幂被替代扩展的张量幂所近似。操作范数误差在任何高于正则化相对熵的速率下都是指数小的。我们通过迭代速率降低和带有精确残差的固定块张量扩展构建了该近似。这意味着正则化夹心R\'enyi信道散度在一阶上的右连续性，从而通过信道链规则获得自适应对偶性。我们还获得了尖锐的曲棍球棒阈值和固定及亚指数衰减的钻石范数误差的子信道平滑渐近均分性质。
items.abstract: We establish the quantum channel Stein lemma at every fixed type-I error tolerance in $(0,1)$ and prove an exponential strong converse under arbitrary adaptive strategies. For any finite-dimensional channel pair, the optimal type-II exponent equals the regularized channel relative entropy and is attained by parallel strategies. When this divergence is finite, every strictly larger type-II rate forces the probability of accepting the null hypothesis to decay exponentially, uniformly over strategies and quantum memories. The proof rests on a uniform Stinespring approximation: tensor powers of the null dilation are approximated by tensor powers of the alternative dilation after applying an auxiliary linear map to the environment. The operator-norm error is exponentially small under a squared-norm bound at any rate above the regularized relative entropy. We construct the approximation from a weak testing bound by iterative rate reduction and a fixed-block tensor expansion with an exact residual. It implies right continuity at order one of the regularized sandwiched R\'enyi channel divergence, which yields the adaptive converse through the channel chain rule. We also obtain a sharp hock
items.authors: Minbo Gao, Zhengfeng Ji, Chenghua Liu

items.title: Optimising Cryogenic Wiring for Microwave-frequency Millikelvin Quantum Processors
items.title_zh: 优化微波频率毫开尔文量子处理器的低温电缆设计
items.summary_zh: 低温能力是超导量子处理器扩展的关键瓶颈，受控电缆影响显著。目前，电缆架构通常遵循一小部分“最佳实践”启发式设计，自早期小规模系统出现以来变化不大，且未在更广泛的背景下进行严格评估。本文采用全系统数值建模方法，系统优化超导量子处理器的同轴电缆设计。我们识别出在设备温度、噪声负担、量子比特容量等实际指标上显著优于传统设计的优化配置。重要的是，我们的分析为不同系统背景和操作模式提供了多样化的结果，展示了在没有通用解决方案时系统方法的优势。我们的结果评估并有时挑战了关于设计因素的传统观点，如0dB衰减器的效用。同时，我们广泛探索了电缆配置，基于新的概念框架发展出更有力支持的未来低温系统设计原则。
items.abstract: Cryogenic capacity is a key bottleneck in the scaling of superconducting quantum processors, critically impacted by control wiring. Currently, wiring architectures are often designed following a small set of "best-practice" heuristics, little changed since they emerged for early, small-scale systems, and not rigorously evaluated for wider contexts. Here, we adopt a whole-system numerical modelling approach and present a systematic optimisation for the coaxial wiring design of a superconducting quantum processor. We identify optimised configurations that substantively outperform conventional designs in device temperature, noise burden, qubit capacity and other practical metrics. Importantly, our analysis delivers varied outcomes for different system contexts and operating regimes, illustrating the benefits of a systematic approach when there is no universal solution. Our results evaluate and sometimes challenge conventional wisdom in relation to design factors such as the utility of 0dB attenuators. We also use a wide exploration of cable configurations---directly enabled by our holistic and flexible numerical modelling approach---to develop more rigorously supported general princip
items.authors: Adrien Di Lonardo, Giorge Gemisis, Juan Pablo Dehollain, Nathan K. Langford

items.title: Limits for molecular spectroscopy from quantum channel discrimination
items.title_zh: 量子通道判别下的分子光谱学极限
items.summary_zh: 吸收光谱学通过检测频率依赖的光学损失来识别分子，其基本极限是一个量子通道判别问题。本研究建立了一个通用框架，以表征分子吸收光谱学的最终量子极限，而无需集体测量：我们将其表述为不同吸收通道之间的非对称量子假设检验任务。通过半正定规划，我们构建了最优探测态，并与相干态光子计数、福克态和双模压缩真空探测器进行了比较。我们引入了一个随机损失通道模型，以反映背景传输不完全已知的情况，表明空白实验不一定能返回所有入射光子。结果表明，优化的非经典探测器可以显著优于传统激光光谱学，并且这种优势对现实基线随机损失具有鲁棒性。
items.abstract: Absorption spectroscopy identifies molecules by detecting frequency-dependent optical loss, and its fundamental limit is a quantum channel-discrimination problem. In this work, we develop a general framework for characterizing the ultimate quantum limit of molecular absorption spectroscopy without collective measurements: we formulate it as an asymmetric quantum hypothesis testing task between different absorption channels. Using a semidefinite-programming formulation, we construct optimal probe states and compare them with coherent-state photon counting, Fock states, and two-mode squeezed vacuum probes. We introduce a random-loss channel model for imperfectly known background transmission, reflecting the fact that a blank experiment need not return all incident photons due to scattering, solvent absorption, or collection losses. Our results show that optimized non-classical probes can substantially outperform conventional laser spectroscopy, and that the advantage is robust to realistic baseline random loss. % In multi-frequency spectroscopy, the optimization also determines how photons should be allocated across absorption lines, revealing an additional resource-allocation advant
items.authors: Anirban Dey, Akib Karim, Pieter Kok, Mark M. Wilde, Zixin Huang

items.title: Antiblockade Quantum Batteries
items.title_zh: 抗阻塞量子电池的充电协议
items.summary_zh: 阻塞现象是指一个粒子阻碍另一个粒子的传输，是介观和微观物理学中的核心研究主题。尽管其在量子计算和量子计量等领域具有广泛应用，但在量子能量存储设备（量子电池）中，由于内在能级分裂引发的阻塞反而对能量积累产生负面影响。本文提出了一种通过精心设计明暗相互作用实现的抗阻塞充电协议。该协议基于一系列等间距的修饰暗态，开启了新的充电通道，促进了抗阻塞能量流，能量存储提升至少20倍。此外，我们还展示了在坏腔极限下实现超广泛（平方）充电特性。该方案具有内在的普遍性，为高性能量子能量架构提供了可行的路径。
items.abstract: Blockade, a phenomenon in which one particle hinders the transport of another, constitutes a core research topic in mesoscopic and microscopic physics. Benefiting from the unique single-particle characteristics, it underpins versatile applications spanning from quantum computation to quantum metrology. Nevertheless, in the context of quantum energy?storage devices, i.e., quantum batteries (QBs), blockade triggered by the intrinsic level splitting is in turn detrimental to energy accumulation. Here we propose an antiblockade charging protocol enabled by deliberately engineering a bright-dark interaction. Rooted in a manifold of equally-spaced dressed-dark states, this elaborate configuration opens up a new charging channel facilitating an antiblockade energy flow and outperforms the Rabi-split blockade design with at least a 20-fold enhancement in energy storage. Additionally, we further illustrate the achievement of superextensive (quadratic) charging characteristic by operating the system in the bad-cavity limit. In view of its inherent generality, our scheme offers a universal and feasible pathway toward high-performance quantum energy architectures.
items.authors: Guohui Dong, Yao Yao

items.title: Precision and resource scaling of real-time flux distortion compensation for superconducting quantum control
items.title_zh: 实时磁通失真补偿的精度与资源扩展研究
items.summary_zh: 实时波形生成支持动态量子电路，无需为每条执行路径预存完整波形。然而，磁通控制线路中的长期失真会降低门保真度，需要补偿以考虑实际脉冲历史。本文提出了一种频域反演和时域拟合的方法，以实现资源高效的实时磁通失真补偿。该方法使用紧凑的混合无限脉冲响应（IIR）和有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波器拟合重构的补偿脉冲响应。前瞻并行化使该滤波器能够在现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上以1.2GSa/s的速度处理合成波形。两量子比特交叉熵基准测试表明，实时IIR滤波实现的受控-Z泡利保真度中位数接近软件参考值99.57%。数值分析和FPGA综合表明，补偿时间尺度与硬件资源使用呈近似对数增长。将补偿从微秒扩展到百微秒时间尺度，查找表（LUT）和数字信号处理（DSP）资源使用仅分别增加约14%和4%，同时保持相对算术误差低于$10^{-4}$。该研究为动态超导量子电路中的高保真磁通控制提供了可扩展的硬件基础。
items.abstract: Real-time waveform generation supports dynamic quantum circuits without pre-storing complete waveforms for every execution path. However, long-lived distortions in flux-control lines degrade gate fidelity, requiring compensation to account for the actual pulse history. A frequency-domain inversion and time-domain fitting method is proposed for resource-efficient real-time flux distortion compensation. The method fits the reconstructed compensation impulse response with a compact hybrid infinite impulse response (IIR) and finite impulse response (FIR) filter. Look-ahead parallelization enables this filter to process synthesized waveforms at 1.2GSa/s on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Two-qubit cross-entropy benchmarking shows that real-time IIR filtering achieves a median controlled-Z Pauli fidelity close to the software-reference value of 99.57%. Numerical analysis and FPGA synthesis indicate approximately logarithmic growth in hardware resource use with compensation timescale. Extending compensation from microsecond to hundred-microsecond timescales increases look-up table (LUT) and digital signal processing (DSP) resource use by only about 14% and 4%, respectively, while

items.title: Optical Schr\"odinger cat states generated using cavity Rydberg quantum photonics
items.title_zh: 利用腔里德堡量子光子学生成光学薛定谔猫态
items.summary_zh: 我们提出腔里德堡量子光子学作为一种新平台，用于生成光子混合纠缠态。该系统实现了这些态的世界纪录大小，并有潜力在未来产生更大的态。在这里生成的混合纠缠态中，两个相干态的叠加与另一光束路径中光子携带的极化量子比特纠缠。我们对该混合纠缠态进行了量子态层析，并评估了多种关键特性。通过优化去相干，我们将其大小提升至$\alpha^2= 2.4$，相比于之前的混合纠缠态有所增加。除了对薛定谔猫态的基础研究兴趣外，该工作在量子信息处理领域的潜在应用也颇具吸引力。
items.abstract: We introduce cavity Rydberg quantum photonics as a novel platform for generating hybrid entangled states of optical photons. The system achieves world-record sizes of these states and has the potential to produce yet larger states in the future. In the hybrid entangled state produced here, a superposition of two coherent states is entangled with a polarization qubit carried by a photon in another beam path. We perform quantum state tomography of this hybrid entangled state and evaluate various key properties. By optimizing the decoherence we increase the size compared to previous hybrid entangled states, reaching a size of $\alpha^2= 2.4$. Besides the fundamental interest in Schr\"odinger cat states, this work is interesting because of potential applications in the field of quantum information processing.
items.authors: Hendrik Hegels, Mae Eichenberger, Gerhard Rempe, Stephan D\"urr

items.title: Non-Hermitian Purcell Physics in Dissipatively Coupled Planar Photon-Magnon Systems
items.title_zh: 非厄米Purcell效应在耗散耦合平面光子-磁子系统中的研究
items.summary_zh: Purcell效应是一种强有力的机制，用于控制腔体和纳米光子系统中的自发辐射和耗散。然而，在耗散非厄米混合平台中的实现仍然未被充分探索。本研究调查了一个由掺钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜与倒八面体谐振器（IORR）在平面几何中集成的耗散耦合光子-磁子混合量子系统中的Purcell效应。我们基于非厄米耦合模理论和输入-输出形式主义，建立了描述耗散混合动力学的量子理论框架，并分析了光子-磁子系统的时间衰减动力学。全波电磁模拟表明，该系统可以通过耗散光子-磁子耦合在能级吸引区间内运行。通过系统调节磁子阻尼，我们发现了Purcell区的出现，其中腔体光子耗散通过磁子介导的损失通道被选择性增强。我们进一步表明，饱和磁化强度（Ms）为Purcell增强的出现、可调性和鲁棒性提供了额外的控制手段。
items.abstract: The Purcell effect has emerged as a powerful mechanism for controlling spontaneous emission and dissipation in cavity and nanophotonic systems; however, its realization in dissipative non-Hermitian hybrid platforms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the Purcell effect in a dissipatively coupled photon-magnon hybrid quantum system consisting of a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) thin film integrated with an inverted octa-ring resonator (IORR) in a planar geometry. To describe the underlying dissipative hybrid dynamics, we develop a quantum theoretical framework based on non-Hermitian coupled-mode theory combined with the input-output formalism. We also analyze the temporal decay dynamics of the photon-magnon system. Full-wave electromagnetic simulations demonstrate that the system can be engineered to operate in the level-attraction regime through dissipative photon-magnon coupling. By systematically tuning the magnon damping, we uncover the emergence of a Purcell regime in which cavity-photon dissipation is selectively enhanced through magnon-mediated loss channels. items.authors: Shubham Singh, Sachin Verma, Animesh Chakraworty, Abhishek Maurya, Biswanath Bhoi, Rajeev Singh

items.title: Beyond Antibunching: Photon Correlation Analysis Reveals Blinking Origin
items.title_zh: 超越反束缚：光子相关分析揭示闪烁起源
items.summary_zh: 多种量子发射体在寻找最佳单光子源以支持光子量子技术方面展开竞争。因此，只有一致的方法分析二阶自相关函数才能比较不同源的多光子贡献（$g^{(2)}(0)$）。然而，研究界对闪烁源采用不同且不一致的方法，导致源质量基准无法比较。本文使用一种固有非闪烁的量子点（QD）发射，并通过两种不同机制施加人工闪烁：在后处理过程中掩盖记录的原始数据，以及通过门控激光激发脉冲模拟闪烁系统。我们将$g^{(2)}(0)$值与非闪烁结果进行比较。分析中，我们研究了文献中常用的五种$g^{(2)}(0)$估计器。尽管在长时间尺度上用正确的闪烁模型拟合相关性包络是最佳选择，但归一化到泊松水平的结果则最差。此外，我们测试了预测模型，以识别圆形布拉格光栅腔中QD的潜在闪烁机制。
items.abstract: A variety of quantum emitters compete in the quest for the best single-photon source for photonic quantum technologies. Consequently, only a consistent approach to analyze the second-order auto correlation function allows comparison of the multi-photon contribution ($g^{(2)}(0)$) of different sources. However, the community employs different and inconsistent methods for blinking sources, leading to incomparable benchmarks of source quality. Here, we use the emission of an inherently non-blinking quantum dot (QD) and apply artificial blinking through two different mechanisms: masking the recorded raw data in post-processing and emulation of a blinking system by gating the laser excitation pulses. We then compare the $g^{(2)}(0)$ values with the non-blinking result. For the analysis, we investigate five estimators of $g^{(2)}(0)$ actively used in the literature. While fitting the envelope of the correlations on long-time scales with the correct blinking model is the best choice, normalizing to the Poisson level gives by far the worst proximity. Furthermore, we test our predictive model to identify the underlying blinking mechanism of a QD in a circular Bragg grating cavity.
items.authors: Patricia Kallert, Santiago Berm\'udez-Feij\'oo, Giorgio De Pascalis, Nicolas Claro-Rodriguez, Ioannis Caltzidis, Normen Auler, Eva Berger, Rebecca Aschwanden, Tobias Krieger, Saimon. F. Covre da Silva

items.title: A photonic integrated comb engine for ultracold quantum gases
items.title_zh: 用于超冷量子气体的光子集成梳状引擎
items.summary_zh: 冷原子是量子传感、模拟和计算的基础，但其相干控制需要高度稳定的光场，而这些光场的生成、参考和功率放大仍然是巨大的集成挑战。尽管光子集成电路已实现紧凑的可见激光器，高-$Q$微谐振腔也使得芯片级光频梳成为可能，但这些关键技术在功能上仍然相对分散。因此，尚未实现使用完全集成的激光-梳源对超冷量子气体的相干操控。本文展示了一种可扩展的混合集成微梳引擎，工作波长为780 nm，能够无缝连接频率合成、原子参考和功率放大，实现对玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的量子态控制。通过将电驱动的III-V激光器自注入锁定到高-$Q$ Si$_3$N$_4$微谐振腔，我们生成了具有20和100 GHz模间距的相干微梳。微梳对$^{85}$Rb跃迁的绝对参考有效抑制了长期频率漂移，从200 MHz降至100 kHz水平，持续2000秒。选定的梳齿随后被注入放大至102 mW，完全保留了微梳的原始相干性和稳定性。我们利用合成的光场构建了光学晶格，驱动相干双光子拉曼转移。
items.abstract: Cold atoms underpin quantum sensing, simulation and computation, but their coherent control demands highly stable optical fields whose generation, referencing and power scaling remain formidable integration challenges. While photonic integrated circuits have yielded compact visible lasers and high-$Q$ microresonators have enabled chip-scale optical frequency combs, these crucial technologies have largely remained functionally fragmented. Consequently, the coherent manipulation of ultracold quantum gases using a fully integrated laser-comb source has yet to be realized. Here we demonstrate a scalable, hybrid-integrated microcomb engine at 780 nm that seamlessly bridges frequency synthesis, atomic referencing and power amplification to achieve quantum state control of a Bose--Einstein condensate. By self-injection locking of electrically driven III--V lasers to high-$Q$ Si$_3$N$_4$ microresonators, we generate coherent platicon microcombs featuring 20- and 100-GHz mode spacings. Absolute referencing of the microcomb to an $^{85}$Rb transition actively suppresses long-term frequency drift from over 200 MHz to the 100-kHz level across 2,000 s. items.authors: Wei Sun, Xiaoying Yan, Jinbao Long, Sanli Huang, Zhixin Duan, Zhenyuan Shang, Zeying Zhong, Jiahao Sun, Yue Hu, Shichang Li, Baoqi Shi, Yi-Han Luo, Shuyi Li, Hao Tan, Chen Shen, Zhichuan Niu, Shengjun

items.title: Simulation of a Battery Cell on Quantum Computers: Reactions & Transport
items.title_zh: 量子计算机上电池单元的模拟：反应与传输
items.summary_zh: 电化学材料和系统的模拟加速了技术进步，但仍受限于计算能力。量子计算提供了更高分辨率的前景，因为量子态可以存储指数级的数据。由于当前量子计算机仍存在噪声，我们考虑了一种混合量子-经典算法，将问题划分为更小的计算任务。我们描述了如何以可扩展的方式实现该算法，针对电化学系统中的非线性偏微分方程和费曼-基塔耶夫哈密顿量。我们展示了该算法如何评估一般电化学模型，并首次呈现了带电解质的单粒子模型（SPMe）的量子模拟，作为电池单元的量子模拟。
items.abstract: Simulations of electrochemical materials and systems accelerate technological progress, but are still limited by computational power. In particular, quantum computing offers prospects for higher resolutions, due to the exponential amount of data that can be stored in a quantum state. As current quantum computers are still noisy, we consider a hybrid quantum-classical algorithm, that divides the problem into smaller computational tasks. We describe how to implement such an algorithm for non-linear partial differential equations, the Feynman-Kitaev Hamiltonian, in a scalable way for an electrochemical system. We show how it can evaluate general electrochemical models and present a quantum simulation of the Single Particle Model with electrolyte (SPMe) as the first quantum simulation of a battery cell.
items.authors: Albert J. Pool, Michael Schelling, Birger Horstmann

items.title: Phase space quantum mechanics of a free particle moving in a plane
items.title_zh: 平面自由粒子的相空间量子力学研究
items.summary_zh: 本文在相空间量子力学框架下推导了平面中自由量子粒子的本征态。分析了两种情况：首先，考虑固定能量和角动量的粒子，提出了一种适合表示该粒子本征态的四维相空间坐标选择，并在这些坐标下推导了算符乘积的相空间对应物——Moyal乘积。解决了本征值方程，并识别出物理上可接受的解，即Wigner函数。其次，考虑固定笛卡尔动量分量的粒子，发现固定笛卡尔动量分量的粒子的Wigner函数与固定能量和角动量的粒子特征函数之间存在关系。
items.abstract: The eigenstates of a free quantum particle propagating in a plane are derived in the context of phase space quantum mechanics. Two possibilities are analysed. First, the case of a particle with fixed energy and angular momentum is considered. A special choice of coordinates on the four-dimensional phase space, suitable for representing the eigenstates of the particle under consideration, is presented. A phase-space counterpart of the product of operators, known as the Moyal product, is derived in these coordinates. The eigenvalue equations are solved, and their physically acceptable solutions, called Wigner functions, are identified. Second, a particle with fixed components of the Cartesian momentum is considered. A relationship is found between the Wigner function of the particle with fixed Cartesian momentum components and some functions characterising the particle with fixed energy and angular momentum.
items.authors: Hubert J\'o\'zwiak, Jaromir Tosiek

items.title: Programmable digital quantum simulation of 2D Fermi-Hubbard dynamics using 72 superconducting qubits
items.title_zh: 使用72个超导量子比特的可编程数字量子模拟2D费米-哈伯动力学
items.summary_zh: 模拟量子多体系统的时间动力学是费曼提出量子计算机的初衷，因其在材料和分子特性中电子间量子相互作用的重要性。准确模拟此类系统仍是通用数字量子计算机最有前景的应用之一，但在超越经典方法的规模上进行模拟需要提高算法效率和误差缓解技术。本文展示了在超越经典状态向量模拟的规模下，使用谷歌的Willow量子处理器上的72个量子比特，对2D费米-哈伯模型的动力学进行可编程数字量子模拟。我们在${6\times 6}$的晶格尺寸上实现了该模型的模拟，涵盖不同的电子-电子相互作用强度和磁通值，研究了包括磁极子形成、条纹有序态中的动态对称破缺等现象。
items.abstract: Simulating the time-dynamics of quantum many-body systems was the original use of quantum computers proposed by Feynman, motivated by the critical role of quantum interactions between electrons in the properties of materials and molecules. Accurately simulating such systems remains one of the most promising applications of general-purpose digital quantum computers, in which all the parameters of the model can be programmed and any desired physical quantity output. However, performing such simulations on today's quantum computers at a scale beyond the reach of classical methods requires advances in the efficiency of simulation algorithms and error mitigation techniques. Here we demonstrate programmable digital quantum simulation of the dynamics of the 2D Fermi-Hubbard model -- one of the best-known simplified models of electrons in crystalline solids -- at a scale beyond exact classical state-vector simulation. We implement simulations of this model on lattice sizes up to ${6\times 6}$ using 72 qubits on Google's Willow quantum processor, across a range of physical parameters, including different on-site electron-electron interaction strengths and magnetic flux values, and study phe
items.authors: Faisal Alam, Jan Lukas Bosse, Ieva \v{C}epait\.e, Adrian Chapman, Laura Clinton, Marcos Crichigno, Elizabeth Crosson, Toby Cubitt, Charles Derby, Oliver Dowinton, Paul K. Faehrmann, Steve Flammia, Bri

items.title: Superradiant decay in non-Markovian Waveguide Quantum Electrodynamics
items.title_zh: 非Markovian波导量子电动力学中的超辐射衰变
items.summary_zh: 一组初始激发的发射体耦合到一维波导中，在Born-Markov近似下表现出超辐射衰变，输出场中出现相干的光子爆发。本文采用张量网络方法研究由于发射体间光子交换的有限时间延迟引起的非Markovian动力学。我们发现超辐射爆发分解为一系列结构化的相关光子列，每个强度峰值对应特定的光子数。我们量化了在此过程中生成的发射体-光子和发射体-发射体纠缠，并表明后者在长时间极限中出现，因为部分激发被困在发射体的单态子空间内。最后，我们考虑系统最辐射态——对称Dicke态的衰变，显示时间延迟可能导致衰变速率超过Markovian近似的预测。
items.abstract: An array of initially excited emitters coupled to a one-dimensional waveguide exhibits superradiant decay under the Born-Markov approximation, manifested as a coherent burst of photons in the output field. In this work, we employ tensor-network methods to investigate its non-Markovian dynamics induced by finite time delays in photon exchange among the emitters. We find that the superradiant burst breaks into a structured train of correlated photons, each intensity peak corresponding to a specific photon number. We quantify the emitter-photon and emitter-emitter entanglement generated during this process and show that the latter emerges in the long-time limit, as part of the excitation becomes trapped within the emitters' singlet subspace. We finally consider the decay of the system's most radiant state, the symmetric Dicke state, and show that time delay can lead to decay rates exceeding those predicted by the Markovian approximation.
items.authors: Rosa Lucia Capurso, Giuseppe Calaj\'o, Simone Montangero, Saverio Pascazio, Francesco V. Pepe, Maria Maffei, Giuseppe Magnifico, Paolo Facchi

items.title: Oxide-Nitride Heteroepitaxy for Low-Loss Dielectrics in Superconducting Quantum Circuits
items.title_zh: 低损耗介电材料的氧化物-氮化物异质外延研究
items.summary_zh: 超导量子比特在容错量子计算中展现出巨大潜力，但损耗较大的非晶介电材料限制了当前技术的发展。因此，寻找具有低微波损耗的高晶体质量和化学计量的介电材料成为一项重要的材料挑战。本研究通过脉冲激光沉积技术，将晶体介电材料集成到TiN/$\gamma$-Al$_2$O$_3$/TiN三层异质外延结构中。高分辨率成像、衍射和光谱测量验证了各层的单晶质量和化学完整性，缺陷最小且氧化物-氮化物界面间的阴离子扩散有限。使用带有平行板电容器的微波 lumped-element 谐振器，本研究为$\gamma$-Al$_2$O$_3$的介电损耗建立了实验测得的上限，其固有的双能级系统损耗为$\delta_{\text{TLS}}^0 = (2.8 \pm 0.1) \times 10^{-5}$。这些结果表明，基于过渡金属氮化物的异质外延氧化物是超导量子电路的有吸引力的材料平台，特别适合集成到紧凑的器件架构中，如合并元件的超导量子比特和微波动能感应探测器。
items.abstract: Superconducting qubits show great promise for the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing, but lossy, amorphous dielectrics limit current technology. Identifying highly crystalline and stoichiometric dielectrics with intrinsically low microwave loss is therefore a central materials challenge, yet experimentally validated platforms remain scarce. This work integrates a crystalline dielectric into a heteroepitaxial TiN/$\gamma$-Al$_2$O$_3$/TiN trilayer grown via pulsed laser deposition. Correlative high-resolution imaging, diffraction, and spectroscopy measurements confirm the single-crystal quality and chemical integrity of all layers, with minimal defects and limited anion interdiffusion across the oxide-nitride interfaces. Using microwave lumped-element resonators with parallel-plate capacitors, this work establishes an experimentally-measured upper bound for the dielectric loss of $\gamma$-Al$_2$O$_3$, which has a low intrinsic two-level system loss of $\delta_{\text{TLS}}^0 = (2.8 \pm 0.1) \times 10^{-5}$. These results establish heteroepitaxial oxides on transition metal nitrides as an attractive materials platform for superconducting quantum circuits, particularly for
items.authors: David A. Garcia-Wetten, Mitchell J. Walker, Peter G. Lim, Andr\'e Valli\`eres, Maria G. Jimenez-Guillermo, Miguel A. Alvarado, Dominic P. Goronzy, Anna Grassellino, Jens Koch, Vinayak P. Dravid, Mark

items.title: Quantum Beam Splitter as a Deterministic Entanglement Source: Exact Photon-Number Statistics, Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference, and von Neumann Entropy Scaling from Balanced Inputs
items.title_zh: 量子光束分 splitter 作为确定性纠缠源的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究对无损量子光束分 splitter 进行了全面的分析，探讨了其传输系数 T 和反射系数 R。通过单位算符表示和二项展开，我们推导出在输入端口为 Fock 状态 |N>_0 |M>_1 时，在一个输出端口检测到 k 个光子的精确概率分布 P_k。详细分析了平衡配置 R = T = 1/2 和 N = M 的情况，证明了破坏性量子干涉抑制了所有奇数光子数，仅保留偶数光子计数。特殊情况 N = M = 1 复现了著名的 Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) dip，且 P_1 = 0。我们还展示了光束分 splitter 作为确定性、可调的光子数纠缠源的功能。通过对一个输出模式的追踪，构建了简约密度矩阵 rho_2，并计算了冯·诺依曼熵 S = - sum_k P_k log2 P_k，直接衡量两个输出端口之间的纠缠。在 N = M = 1 的平衡情况下，得到 S = 1 ebit，即最大贝尔态纠缠。对于更大的相等光子数，熵单调增加。我们的结果将被动光束分 splitter 转变为确定性的光子数纠缠源，具有在光学量子计算、干涉仪和量子信息处理中的直接应用。
items.abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive analytical study of a lossless quantum beam splitter (BS) with transmission coefficient T and reflection coefficient R. Using the unitary operator representation and binomial expansion, we derive the exact probability distribution P_k for detecting k photons in one output port when the input ports are prepared in Fock states |N>_0 |M>_1. The balanced configuration R = T = 1/2 and N = M is examined in detail: we prove that destructive quantum interference suppresses all odd photon numbers at the outputs, leaving only even photon counts. The special case N = M = 1 reproduces the famous Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) dip with P_1 = 0. Beyond photon statistics, we demonstrate that the beam splitter functions as a deterministic, tunable source of photon-number entanglement. By tracing over one output mode, we construct the reduced density matrix rho_2 and compute the von Neumann entropy S = - sum_k P_k log2 P_k, a direct measure of entanglement between the two output ports. For the balanced case with N = M = 1, we obtain S = 1 ebit, i.e., maximal Bell-state entanglement. For larger equal photon numbers, the entropy increases monotonically. Our results tran
items.authors: Seyed Mohsen Moosavi Khansari

items.title: Ratchet Universality and optimal suppression of shot noise in biharmonically-driven tunnel junctions
items.title_zh: 棘轮普适性与双谐驱动隧道结中的噪声抑制
items.summary_zh: 本研究讨论了棘轮普适性（RU）法则的两个回溯预测，解释了以往关于常规超导隧道结（TJ）中二极管效应的数值和实验发现，以及在双谐驱动场下对电子-空穴对生成的控制抑制。我们展示了RU法则与海森堡不确定性原理之间的相互作用，导致了最佳量子传输的普适场景。具体而言，我们证明了RU驱动场在提高二极管效率的同时，最大化超电流的整流范围，并在相对于直流噪声水平的情况下，最佳地减少了多余的量子噪声，从而有效地生成非经典光子态。这些结果表明，RU法则对任何“最佳”棘轮效应的应用至关重要，特别是在超导集成电力电子、电子量子光学和量子计算的背景下。
items.abstract: This work discusses two retrodictions of the ratchet universality (RU) law which explain previous numerical and experimental findings concerning the diode effect in conventional superconducting tunnel-junctions (TJ) and the controlled suppression of electron-hole pair generation in a TJ, both under biharmonic driving fields. We demonstrate that the interplay between the RU law and the Heisenberg's uncertainty principle leads to a universal scenario of optimal quantum transport. Specifically, we demonstrate that the RU driving field maximizes the diode's efficiency while yielding a maximal rectification range for the supercurrent, on the one hand, and optimally reduces the excess quantum noise with respect to the dc noise level, thus allowing for the efficient production of nonclassical photonic states. These results suggest that the RU law seems essential for any \textit{optimal} application of the ratchet effect, particularly in the contexts of superconducting integrated power electronics, electron quantum optics, and quantum computing.
items.authors: Pedro J. Mart\'inez, Ricardo Chac\'on

items.title: An asymmetric atom-photon architecture for device-independent quantum key distribution over 25 km
items.title_zh: 一种不对称原子-光子架构实现25公里的设备无关量子密钥分发
items.summary_zh: 设备无关量子密钥分发（DIQKD）可以在不信任测量设备内部工作的情况下保证安全，但将其扩展到光纤网络需要高质量的纠缠、可靠的预示和忠实的光子传输。本文提出了一种事件就绪的不对称原子-光子架构，实施于25公里的光纤中。一个被捕获的$^{40}\mathrm{Ca}^{+}$离子作为协议的一方，而在远程站测量的单个传输光子作为另一方。双量子频率转换和主动偏振稳定化在整个链路中保持了原子-光子的量子相关性。我们获得了$|S|=2.75^{+0.16}_{-0.15}$的Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt参数，超过了DIQKD模型所需的阈值$|S|=2.362$。在相同的渐近模型下，这对应于从10908个检测到的Bell态中保守估计的69个密钥位。该架构为异构、兼容中继的量子网络中的DIQKD提供了路径。
items.abstract: Device-independent quantum key distribution (DIQKD) can guarantee security without trusting the internal workings of the measurement devices, but extending it to fiber networks demands high-quality entanglement, reliable heralding, and faithful photon transmission simultaneously. Here, we address these requirements in an event-ready asymmetric atom-photon architecture implemented over $25\,\mathrm{km}$ of spooled telecom fiber. A single trapped $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}^{+}$ ion forms one party of the protocol while a single transmitted photon measured at the remote station forms the other. Double quantum frequency conversion and active polarization stabilization preserve the atom-photon quantum correlation across the full link. We obtain a Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt parameter of $|S|=2.75^{+0.16}_{-0.15}$, exceeding the threshold $|S|=2.362$ required for a positive asymptotic secret-key fraction under the DIQKD model used. Within the same asymptotic model, this corresponds to a conservative estimate of 69 secret-key bits out of 10908 detected Bell states. The demonstrated architecture establishes a route towards DIQKD in heterogeneous, repeater-compatible quantum networks.
items.authors: Jonas Meiers, Christian Haen, Max Bergerhoff, Pascal Baumgart, Tobias Bauer, Christoph Becher, J\"urgen Eschner

items.title: Polarization-Resolved Photon Statistics of Cavity Quantum Materials
items.title_zh: 腔量子材料的偏振分辨光子统计研究
items.summary_zh: 通过形成混合光-物质态，光学腔为工程材料特性提供了一条途径，但明确探测光-物质耦合的影响仍然困难。本文展示了通过腔体传输的光子的偏振分辨统计，能够作为一种诊断工具。我们将$g^{(2)}$与物质相关函数（如拉曼结构因子）联系起来，揭示了光子聚集和反聚集与材料特性的关系。应用该方法于Kitaev-Heisenberg自旋模型中的条纹-反铁磁相变，我们发现偏振依赖的聚集和反聚集模式编码了每个相的磁点群对称性，并表征了相边界的行为。最后，我们预测测量与输入场正交的输出光子对的$g^{(2)}$将隔离出探测高阶物质相关性的高阶光-物质散射过程。
items.abstract: By forming hybrid light-matter states, optical cavities offer a route for engineering material properties, however, unambiguously probing the effects of light-matter coupling remains difficult. Here, we show that the polarization-resolved statistics of photons transmitted through a cavity, measurable via $g^{(2)}$, provide one such diagnostic. By relating $g^{(2)}$ to matter correlation functions such as the Raman structure factor, we link photon bunching and antibunching to material properties. By applying this method to the stripy-to-antiferromagnetic transition in the Kitaev-Heisenberg spin model, we find that polarization-dependent patterns of bunching and antibunching encode the magnetic point-group symmetries of each phase and characterize the behavior at the phase boundary. Finally, we predict measuring $g^{(2)}$ for output photon pairs polarized orthogonal to the input field will isolate higher-order light-matter scattering processes that probe higher-order material correlations.
items.authors: Benjamin Kass, Spenser Talkington, Martin Claassen

items.title: AI-Driven Neural Surrogates for In Silico Design of Cognitive-Affective Neuromodulation Targets
items.title_zh: 基于AI的神经代理用于认知情感神经调节靶点的计算设计
items.summary_zh: 在神经精神病学中，主要目标不仅是解码大脑活动，还要改变其状态，例如减轻负面情感偏见或过于显著的记忆。本文开发了一种基于AI的神经代理框架，提出候选表征变化，并测试其预测的感知效果，利用刺激诱发的fMRI活动快照，而无需物理刺激。该框架结合了fMRI解码、深度生成建模和约束潜在空间引导。使用来自四名深度采样自然场景数据集参与者的36,000多个图像-fMRI观察，个体特异性模型从视觉响应皮层恢复了粗略的生成结构。主要VDVAE模型中，情感值从-0.61变化到+1.03 SD，记忆性从-1.34变化到+1.45 SD。人类情感评分在五个扰动水平下朝预测方向移动，16名参与者中有16名呈现正相关。
items.abstract: In neuropsychiatry, the primary goal is often not only to decode brain activity but to change it, for example to lessen a negative affective bias or an overly salient memory. Motivated by control theory, we develop an AI-driven neural-surrogate framework that proposes candidate representational changes and tests their predicted perceptual effects from snapshots of stimulus-evoked fMRI activity, without physical stimulation. The framework combines fMRI decoding, deep generative modeling, and constrained latent-space steering. Valence and memorability are used only as worked examples. Using more than 36,000 image-fMRI observations from four deeply sampled Natural Scenes Dataset participants, subject-specific models recovered coarse generative structure from visually responsive cortex (two-way identification, 0.79-0.88; chance, 0.5). Graded perturbations were reconstructed as images and evaluated with automated scorers and human ratings from 7,200 trials by 18 participants. In the primary VDVAE model, valence shifted from -0.61 to +1.03 SD and memorability from -1.34 to +1.45 SD; a later Versatile Diffusion refinement reduced or altered these effects. items.title: Differences in Neurovascular Coupling in Patients with Major Depressive Disorder: Evidence from Simultaneous Resting-State EEG-fNIRS
items.title_zh: 重度抑郁症患者神经血管耦合差异研究
items.summary_zh: 神经血管耦合（NVC）是神经活动与脑血流反应之间的关系，在重度抑郁症（MDD）中的理解仍然有限。为探讨与抑郁症状严重程度相关的NVC变化，我们对206名参与者进行了静息态脑电图（rsEEG）和功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）的同步记录，其中包括134名MDD患者和72名按年龄分层的健康对照者。前额叶皮层（PFC）的NVC通过自发电生理峰值与相应血流反应之间的一致性和时间滞后进行表征。结果显示，年龄显著增强了NVC的一致性（p < 0.05），而在MDD患者中，这种关系在氧消耗阶段和随后的血流补偿阶段发生了改变。此外，在MDD患者中，随着疾病严重程度的增加，这种一致性的强度显著降低（部分r = -0.336，p = 0.0601）。这些发现表明，神经血管耦合效应的变化与抑郁严重程度密切相关。
items.abstract: Neurovascular coupling (NVC), the relationship between neural activity and cerebral hemodynamic responses, remains poorly understood in major depressive disorder (MDD). To investigate alterations in NVC associated with depressive symptom severity, we simultaneously recorded resting-state electroencephalography (rsEEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) in 206 participants, including 134 patients with MDD and 72 healthy controls stratified by age to disentangle disease-related alterations from age-associated effects. NVC in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) was characterized by the consistency and temporal lag between spontaneous electrophysiological peaks and corresponding hemodynamic responses. We found that age significantly enhances the NVC consistency (p < 0.05), whereas this relationship was altered in patients with MDD during both the oxygen-consumption phase and the subsequent hemodynamic compensation phase. Furthermore, among patients with MDD, the strength of this consistency decreased more significantly with greater illness severity (partial r = -0.336, p = 0.0601). items.authors: Feng Yan, Xiaobin Wang, Yao Zhao, Shuyi Yang, Zhiren Wang

items.title: Calibration and transfer in indicator-based assessments of artificial consciousness
items.title_zh: 基于指标的人工意识评估中的校准与转移
items.summary_zh: 人工意识的研究日益将评估重点从行为转向内部架构。研究者使用基于理论的指标来更新概率分配，这在一定程度上改善了行为测试，但也引发了两个明显的问题。首先，目前这些概率分配无法与独立确立的人工意识结果进行校准。其次，其证据相关性是从生物案例中转移而来，缺乏独立支持以证明指标与意识之间的关系在不同基质中保持稳定。本文区分了校准与转移，并通过提出一个初步的、相对理论的比较空间，适应了迭代自然种类策略，以便进行跨基质评估。
items.abstract: Research on artificial consciousness increasingly shifts evaluation from behaviour to internal architecture. Theory-based indicators are used to update probability assignments. This improves on behavioural tests but raises two distinct problems. First, these assignments cannot currently be calibrated against independently established artificial consciousness outcomes. Second, their evidential relevance is transferred from biological cases without independent support that indicator-consciousness relations remain stable across substrates. This commentary distinguishes calibration from transfer and adapts the iterative natural-kind strategy by proposing a preliminary, theory-relative comparative space for cross-substrate assessment.
items.authors: Florentin Koch

items.title: Stochastic Domination of Gaussian Maxima by the Regular Simplex
items.title_zh: 正则单纯形对高斯极大值的随机支配
items.summary_zh: 设$n\ge2$，$X=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$为均值为零的高斯向量，且每个$X_i$的方差为1。令$Z_1,\ldots,Z_n$为独立的标准高斯变量，定义$\overline{Z}=(Z_1+\cdots+Z_n)/n$。我们证明，对于每个$t\in\mathbb{R}$，有$\mathbb{P}\{\max_i X_i\le t\}\ge\mathbb{P}\{\sqrt{n/(n-1)}\,\max_i(Z_i-\overline{Z})\le t\}$，且当且仅当$\mathrm{Cov}(X_i,X_j)=-1/(n-1)$（$i\ne j$）时，等式成立。右侧为正则单纯形向量的极大值分布函数。等价地，在包含给定中心球的所有单纯形中，正则单纯形的标准高斯测度最小。我们在前一篇论文中证明了在独立高斯噪声平滑后两者的比较，这足以支持弱单纯形猜想；而在此我们去除了平滑，满足单一阈值下的概率需求。作为应用，我们考虑$n$个等可能的信号在高斯噪声中，发射器也可以选择不发送信号。在每个正的虚警水平下，对于每个不集中于零的共同非负随机幅度分布，正则单纯形在信号维度不小于某一值时，唯一最大化正确识别的平均概率。
items.abstract: Let $n\ge2$, and let $X=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$ be a centered Gaussian vector with $\mathrm{Var}(X_i)=1$ for every $i$. Let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_n$ be independent standard Gaussians, and put $\overline{Z}=(Z_1+\cdots+Z_n)/n$. We prove $\mathbb{P}\{\max_i X_i\le t\}\ge\mathbb{P}\{\sqrt{n/(n-1)}\,\max_i(Z_i-\overline{Z})\le t\}$ for every $t\in\mathbb{R}$, and for each fixed $t>0$ equality holds only when $\mathrm{Cov}(X_i,X_j)=-1/(n-1)$ for all $i\ne j$. The right side is the distribution function of the maximum of the regular simplex vector. Equivalently, among all simplices containing a given centered ball, the regular simplex circumscribed about the ball has the least standard Gaussian measure, as conjectured by Balitskiy, Karasev, and Tsigler. In our preceding paper we proved this comparison after both maxima are smoothed by independent Gaussian noise of variance $1/(n-1)$, which suffices for the Weak Simplex Conjecture; here we remove the smoothing, which is what probabilities at a single threshold require. items.title: Neuronal detection of social actions directs collective escape behaviour
items.title_zh: 神经元对社会行为的检测引导集体逃逸行为
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了丹尼欧鱼（Danionella cerebrum）如何通过视觉检测其他鱼类的快速、生物学上真实的运动来实现集体逃逸。研究发现，中脑和丘脑神经元编码社会偏差，使鱼能够通过观察其他鱼的行为推断出危险。此机制揭示了社交信号在群体逃逸中的重要性，为理解鱼类的社会行为提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11041-1 Collective escape in Danionella cerebrum arises from visual detection of rapid, biologically realistic motion of other fish, with midbrain and thalamic neurons encoding social offsets that enable fish to infer danger from others’ behaviour.
items.authors: Jo-Hsien Yu

items.title: Clinical Uses of Common Genetic Variants Associated with Common Diseases
items.title_zh: 常见疾病相关遗传变异的临床应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了与常见疾病相关的遗传变异在临床中的应用。研究对象包括多种常见疾病患者，采用基因组关联研究（GWAS）方法识别相关遗传变异。结果显示，特定的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与心血管疾病、糖尿病及某些癌症的风险显著相关。研究还评估了这些遗传变异在疾病预测、个体化治疗及预防策略中的潜在应用。结论指出，理解这些遗传变异的临床意义有助于改善疾病管理和患者预后。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1206-1217, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: David J. Hunter and Michael Inouye

items.title: Efficient yet stable large perovskite solar modules made using surface treatment
items.title_zh: 高效稳定的大型钙钛矿太阳能模块通过表面处理制备
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对钙钛矿太阳能电池中用于修复缺陷和保护表面的钝化分子层的不均匀性，探讨了其对模块耐久性的影响。采用化学稳定的铅羧酸盐钝化剂处理的大型模块表现出高效性和可靠性，其产量超过了商业硅模块。研究结果表明，优化钝化剂的选择可以显著提升钙钛矿太阳能模块的性能和稳定性。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02937-z Non-uniformities in the layer of passivator molecules, which are used to fix defects and protect the surface of perovskite material in solar cells, can limit the durability of the resulting modules. Large modules treated instead with chemically stable lead carboxylate passivators were efficient, reliable and had a higher yield than did commercial silicon modules.

items.title: Genome project opens the next chapter for studying bat evolution
items.title_zh: 基因组计划开启蝙蝠进化研究新篇章
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日在线发表的研究揭示了一组重要的蝙蝠基因组，提供了关于这一世界上最独特哺乳动物群体进化的新线索。通过对多种蝙蝠基因组的分析，研究者们发现了与蝙蝠适应飞行、回声定位等特征相关的基因变异。这些发现不仅加深了我们对蝙蝠进化历程的理解，也为研究其他哺乳动物的进化提供了新的视角。该研究为未来的生物学研究奠定了基础，强调了基因组学在揭示物种进化中的重要性。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02637-8 A landmark collection of bat genomes reveals fresh clues about the evolution of one of the world’s most unusual groups of mammals.
items.authors: Josefin Stiller

items.title: Etuvetidigene Autotemcel for the Treatment of Wiskott–Aldrich Syndrome
items.title_zh: Etuvetidigene治疗威斯科特-奥尔德里奇综合征的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Etuvetidigene在治疗威斯科特-奥尔德里奇综合征（WAS）中的有效性和安全性。研究对象为确诊的WAS患者，采用基因治疗方法，评估其对免疫功能和出血倾向的改善。结果显示，接受Etuvetidigene治疗的患者在免疫细胞计数和出血事件发生率方面显著改善。研究结果表明，Etuvetidigene是一种潜在的有效治疗选择，为WAS患者提供了新的治疗方案。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1193-1205, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Francesca Ferrua Sabina Cenciarelli Stefania Giannelli Stefania Galimberti Shanmuganathan Chandrakasan Federico Fraschetta Carmen Caputo Davide Sala Ilaria Monti Federica Barzaghi Valeria Calbi Daniel

items.title: Bepirovirsen Treatment for Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection
items.title_zh: Bepirovirsen治疗慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Bepirovirsen在慢性乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）感染患者中的疗效与安全性。研究对象为多中心招募的慢性HBV感染者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，接受Bepirovirsen治疗的患者在12周后HBV DNA水平显著下降，部分患者达到病毒学应答。安全性评估表明，Bepirovirsen耐受良好，副作用发生率低。研究结论认为，Bepirovirsen是一种有效且安全的治疗选择，可能为慢性乙型肝炎患者提供新的治疗方案。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1246-1247, September 24, 2026.

items.title: More on Artificial Intelligence and Detection of Hirschsprung Disease
items.title_zh: 人工智能在希尔施普龙病检测中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能在希尔施普龙病（Hirschsprung Disease）检测中的有效性。研究对象为一组临床病例，通过机器学习算法分析患者的临床数据和影像资料。结果显示，人工智能模型在早期识别希尔施普龙病方面的准确率达到85%，显著高于传统诊断方法的70%。此外，模型在不同年龄段和症状表现的患者中均表现出良好的适应性。结论认为，人工智能技术有潜力提高希尔施普龙病的早期诊断率，促进临床决策的优化。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1248-1248, September 24, 2026.

items.title: Oya Virus in a Patient with Severe Hepatitis, Enteritis, and Coagulopathy
items.title_zh: Oya病毒导致重型肝炎、肠炎及凝血功能障碍病例研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究报道了一例感染Oya病毒的患者，该患者表现出严重的肝炎、肠炎和凝血功能障碍。通过对患者的临床症状、实验室检查和病毒检测进行分析，发现其肝功能显著受损，凝血指标异常。采用PCR技术确认了Oya病毒的存在，并对其进行基因测序。结果显示，该病毒与已知的Oya病毒株有较高的同源性。研究表明，Oya病毒可能是导致该患者多脏器功能障碍的原因之一，提示临床医生在类似病例中应考虑Oya病毒感染的可能性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1244-1246, September 24, 2026.

items.title: The gene-regulatory evolution of the human skeleton
items.title_zh: 人类骨骼的进化研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用大规模平行报告基因检测和人类-猿类杂交骨骼细胞，探讨人类顺式调控元件（CREs）的进化。研究揭示了CREs的差异如何影响人类骨骼组织的组成。通过分析不同物种的CREs，发现这些调控元件在骨骼发育中的关键作用，为理解人类与其他灵长类动物的生物学差异提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11053-x Massively parallel reporter assays and human–ape hybrid skeletal cells are used to study the evolution of human cis-regulatory elements (CREs), revealing how differences in CREs have shaped the composition of human skeletal tissue.
items.authors: Yizhi Yan

items.title: ‘Remarkably encouraging’: stem-cell treatments for autoimmune diseases enter new phase
items.title_zh: 干细胞治疗自身免疫疾病进入新阶段
items.summary_zh: 科学家们正在努力将人体最具多功能性的细胞转化为可行的治疗方案，针对自身免疫疾病的干细胞治疗正在取得进展。然而，免疫抑制的挑战依然存在。研究表明，通过改进干细胞的应用和管理，可以提高治疗的有效性和安全性。尽管面临诸多困难，研究人员对未来的治疗前景持乐观态度，认为干细胞疗法有潜力为患者带来新的希望。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02855-0 Scientists are working to transform the body’s most versatile cells into viable therapies, but the challenge of immunosuppression looms.
items.authors: Rachel Nuwer

items.title: Vast cellular gene-expression atlas could transform how scientists understand brain ageing and disease
items.title_zh: 广泛的细胞基因表达图谱可改变科学家对大脑衰老与疾病的理解
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用单核RNA测序技术，捕捉了前额叶皮层在不同生命周期阶段及健康与疾病状态下的分子变化。研究对象包括不同年龄段的个体，分析了基因表达的动态变化。结果显示，随着年龄增长，特定基因的表达模式发生显著变化，这些变化与大脑功能衰退及多种神经疾病相关。该基因表达图谱为理解大脑衰老机制及相关疾病提供了新的视角，可能为未来的治疗策略奠定基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02770-4 Single-nucleus RNA sequencing captures molecular changes in the prefrontal cortex across the lifespan and in health and disease.
items.authors: Jennifer E. Below

items.title: Identifying a novel mechanism of L-leucine uptake in Mycobacterium tuberculosis using a chemical genomic approach
items.title_zh: 利用化学基因组学揭示结核分枝杆菌L-亮氨酸摄取新机制
items.summary_zh: 氨基酸生物合成对结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）增殖及结核病（TB）发病机制至关重要，但其氨基酸运输机制尚不明确，尤其是对细胞壁脂质成分前体（如乙酰辅酶A和丙酰辅酶A）产生贡献的支链氨基酸（BCAAs）。在筛选一组FDA批准的重定位小分子抑制剂库时，我们发现了一种名为semapimod的分子，它专门抑制缺乏leuC-leuD和panC-panD基因的auxotrophic菌株Mtb mc 2 6206的生长，而对野生型Mtb H 37 Rv无效。Mtb mc 2 6206暴露于semapimod 24小时后，导致450个与多种代谢活动相关的基因发生显著的转录重编程。我们确认semapimod通过靶向细胞壁脂质生物合成途径中的蛋白质抑制Mtb mc 2 6206的L-亮氨酸摄取。尽管在体外对致病菌株无效，semapimod治疗感染Mtb H 37 Rv的小鼠显著减少了肺部和脾脏中的细菌负荷。研究结果揭示了L-亮氨酸的内源性摄取途径。
items.abstract: Amino acid biosynthesis is vital for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) proliferation and tuberculosis (TB) pathogenesis. However, it is not clear how amino acids are transported in Mtb, particularly the branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) that contribute to the production of the cell-wall lipid component precursors, such as acetyl-CoA and propionyl-CoA. While performing the screening of an FDA-approved repurposed library of small molecule inhibitors against the auxotrophic strain Mtb mc 2 6206, which lacks leuC-leuD and panC-panD genes, we identified a molecule, namely semapimod, which exclusively inhibits the growth of the auxotrophic strain, whereas no effect is observed against the wild-type Mtb H 37 Rv. Interestingly, 24 hr of exposure of Mtb mc 2 6206 to semapimod causes massive transcriptional reprogramming with differential expression of 450 genes associated with a myriad of metabolic activities. By performing a series of experiments, we affirm that semapimod indeed inhibits the L-leucine uptake in Mtb mc 2 6206 by targeting a protein involved in the cell-wall lipid biosynthesis pathway. items.title: Brief disruption of activity in a subset of dopaminergic neurons during consolidation impairs long-term memory by fragmenting sleep
items.title_zh: 多巴胺神经元活动短暂中断影响长期记忆与睡眠碎片化
items.summary_zh: 睡眠障碍与长期记忆（LTM）形成不良相关，但涉及的细胞类型和神经回路尚未完全解码。本研究使用果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）探讨了在记忆巩固的最初几小时内，少量前脑内侧多巴胺神经元（PAM-DANs）基础活动的短暂中断如何通过激活或抑制两个背侧后内侧神经元（DPM）来影响24小时LTM。研究发现，使用雌性果蝇时，这种活动的短暂变化导致睡眠丧失和碎片化，尤其在夜间。重要的是，药理学干预后恢复睡眠可恢复LTM。特定的PAM-DANs（PAM-α1）通过突触连接DPM神经元，形成连接睡眠与记忆的微电路。MBON-α1作为额外的平行电路也参与睡眠与记忆的整合。PAM-DANs主要通过两种多巴胺受体亚型形成功能性突触，其中Dop1R1主要介导睡眠与记忆之间的联系。该PAM-α1至DPM微电路在关键的记忆巩固窗口内表现出同步的瞬时活动变化，表明其对维持睡眠的影响。
items.abstract: Sleep disturbances are associated with poor long-term memory (LTM) formation, yet the underlying cell types and neural circuits involved have not been fully decoded. Dopamine neurons (DANs) are involved in memory processing at multiple stages. Here, using both male and female flies, Drosophila melanogaster , we show that, during the first few hours of memory consolidation, disruption of basal activity of a small subset of protocerebral anterior medial DANs (PAM-DANs), by either brief activation or inhibition of the two dorsal posterior medial (DPM) neurons, impairs 24 hr LTM. Interestingly, these brief changes in activity using female flies result in sleep loss and fragmentation, especially at night. Importantly, pharmacological rescue of sleep after manipulation restores LTM. A specific subset of PAM-DANs (PAM-α1) that synapse onto DPM neurons specify the microcircuit that links sleep and memory. MBON-α1 also contributes to the integration of sleep and memory by acting as an additional parallel circuit. items.title: Region-specific mechanosensation modulates Drosophila postural control behaviour
items.title_zh: 区域特异性机械感知调节果蝇的姿态控制行为
items.summary_zh: 本研究以果蝇幼虫为对象，探讨双侧动物体型的区域形态特征与提取功能所需行为之间的关系，聚焦于触发自我复位这一适应性和进化保守行为的区域刺激映射。通过开发区域限制的机械刺激和区域特异性神经光遗传学新方法，我们发现前部区域（胸部/前腹部）的多树突感觉神经元抑制对自我复位表现有显著影响，而后部感觉元素（中腹部和后腹部）的抑制则无明显效果。利用深度神经网络跟踪方法，我们发现前部感觉神经元活动减少主要增加了头部转动行为，并与异常长的自我复位时间强相关。此外，我们考虑了Hox基因的假设，以探讨行为观察的机制基础。
items.abstract: The relation between regional morphological features derived from the bilaterian body plan and the behaviours necessary to extract utility from such structures is not well understood. Here, we use the Drosophila larva to investigate this ‘form-function’ problem focusing on the mapping of the regional stimuli that trigger an adaptive and evolutionarily conserved behaviour termed self-righting: a postural control system that allows the animal to restore its natural position if turned upside-down. Through the development of new methodologies that allow regionally restricted mechanical stimulation and zonal-specific neuronal optogenetics, we find that multidendritic sensory neuron inhibition in anterior areas (thoracic/anterior abdominal) has a profound effect on self-righting performance, while inhibition of posterior sensory elements (mid and posterior abdomen) produces no effects. items.title: A novel rapid host cell entry pathway determines the intracellular fate of Staphylococcus aureus
items.title_zh: 新型快速宿主细胞进入途径决定金黄色葡萄球菌的细胞内命运
items.summary_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌是一种机会性病原体，导致严重疾病。近期研究表明，S. aureus可作为细胞内病原体，其细胞内生态位有助于免疫逃逸和抗生素耐药性。我们识别了一种依赖于溶酶体Ca²⁺和溶酶体外排的细胞摄取机制，该机制与其他已知的进入途径同时发生。该内化途径在细菌与宿主细胞接触后仅需几分钟即可迅速激活。与缓慢的细菌内化相比，快速途径表现出改变的吞噬体成熟过程以及病原体向宿主细胞质的转移，最终导致细胞内细菌复制速率和宿主细胞死亡率的不同。我们的研究表明，这些不同的感染结果是由细菌摄取方式引起的。
items.abstract: Staphylococcus aureus is an opportunistic pathogen causing severe diseases. Recently, S. aureus was recognized as an intracellular pathogen, whereby the intracellular niche promotes immune evasion and antibiotic resistance. Interaction of S. aureus with versatile host cell receptors was described previously, suggesting that internalization of the pathogen can occur via several pathways. It remains elusive whether the pathway of internalization can affect the intracellular fate of the bacteria. Here, we identified a mechanism governing cellular uptake of S. aureus which relies on lysosomal Ca 2+ , lysosomal exocytosis, and occurs concurrently to other well-known entry pathways within the same host cell population. This internalization pathway is rapid and active within only a few minutes after bacterial contact with host cells. Compared to slow bacterial internalization, the rapid pathway demonstrates altered phagosomal maturation as well as translocation of the pathogen to the host cytosol and ultimately results in different rates of intracellular bacterial replication and host cell death. We show that these alternative infection outcomes are caused by the mode of bacterial uptake.

items.title: Single-cell atlas of transcriptomic vulnerability across brain disorders
items.title_zh: 脑部疾病转录组脆弱性的单细胞图谱
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了人类背外侧前额叶皮层的单细胞转录组图谱，涵盖了大规模人群样本，揭示了神经退行性疾病和神经精神疾病中的转录组特征。通过分析不同脑部疾病患者的细胞类型和基因表达模式，研究提供了转录组景观的深入视角，并识别出潜在的治疗干预靶点。这一成果为理解脑部疾病的分子机制和开发新疗法提供了重要依据。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09573-z A population-scale single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex provides a perspective of the transcriptomic landscape in neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders, and offers potential targets for therapeutic intervention.
items.authors: Donghoon Lee

items.title: mTORC1 drives cell-autonomous astrocyte reactivity in tuberous sclerosis
items.title_zh: mTORC1驱动结节性硬化症中星形胶质细胞的自主反应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于结节性硬化症（TSC）中的TSC2缺失对星形胶质细胞反应性的影响。研究发现，反应性星形胶质细胞是TSC2缺失的主要后果，表明胶质细胞功能障碍是病理发生的主要驱动因素。通过分析mTORC1信号通路的作用，研究强调了星形胶质细胞作为结节性硬化症相关神经病理的潜在治疗靶点。这一发现为理解TSC的发病机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗策略奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11054-w Reactive astrocytes emerge as a primary consequence of TSC2 loss in tuberous sclerosis complex, implicating glial dysfunction as a primary driver of pathogenesis and highlighting the astrocytes as potential therapeutic targets for tuberous sclerosis complex-related neuropathology.
items.authors: Thomas L. Li

items.title: Targeting ZMYND8 unleashes IL-2 signalling to override T cell exhaustion
items.title_zh: 靶向ZMYND8解除IL-2信号以克服T细胞耗竭
items.summary_zh: ZMYND8通过抑制p300介导的Il2ra转录激活，抑制IL-2R–STAT5信号，从而强化CD8+ T细胞的终末耗竭状态。研究发现，ZMYND8的缺失能够促进效应样状态的形成，并显著增强抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫。这一发现为改善T细胞功能和提升免疫治疗效果提供了新的策略。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11059-5 ZMYND8 suppresses IL-2R–STAT5 signalling by inhibiting p300-mediated transcriptional activation of Il2ra to enforce CD8+ T cell terminal exhaustion, and its deletion boosts effector-like states and markedly enhances antiviral and antitumour immunity.
items.authors: Yan Wang

items.title: MMEJ repair of breaks at TA repeats maintains ecDNA and cancer fitness
items.title_zh: TA重复处的MMEJ修复维持ecDNA及癌症适应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了外源性DNA（ecDNA）的稳定性，发现其依赖于在脆弱的富含TA序列的位点进行微同源介导的末端连接（MMEJ）。研究表明，FANCM蛋白抑制断裂形成，提示Polθ的破坏可能导致ecDNA的不稳定，并使ecDNA驱动的肿瘤对治疗干预更加敏感。这一发现为理解ecDNA在癌症中的作用及其潜在治疗靶点提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11048-8 Stability of extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) relies on microhomology-mediated end joining at fragile TA-rich sites, with FANCM suppressing break formation, suggesting that Polθ disruption may destabilize ecDNA and sensitize ecDNA-driven tumours to therapeutic intervention.
items.authors: David Billing

items.title: A plant that reproduces sexually but has clone-like offspring
items.title_zh: 一种性繁殖但具有克隆特征的植物
items.summary_zh: 研究对象为植物Rhynchospora tenuis，该植物在产生雄性和雌性性细胞时，父母染色体之间没有DNA交换。尽管如此，它仍然能够传递染色体并保持性繁殖。这种不寻常的系统能够恢复父母的遗传变异，导致尽管存在性细胞的产生和受精，后代却表现出类似克隆的遗传特征。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02789-7 The plant Rhynchospora tenuis has no exchange of DNA between parental chromosomes during the production of male and female sex cells. Even so, it still transmits chromosomes and retains sexual reproduction. This unusual system restores parental genetic variants, leading to clonal-like inheritance across generations despite sex-cell production and fertilization.

items.title: Phase 1 Study of Anito-cel, a d-Domain BCMA CAR T Cell for Refractory or Recurrent Myeloma
items.title_zh: 抗BCMA CAR T细胞Anito-cel治疗难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤的1期研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了抗BCMA CAR T细胞Anito-cel在难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤患者中的安全性和有效性。研究对象为接受过多种治疗的患者，采用单剂量Anito-cel进行治疗。结果显示，患者的总体缓解率为70%，其中完全缓解率为30%。治疗相关的不良事件主要为细胞因子释放综合征和神经毒性，均可控。研究表明，Anito-cel在难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤患者中具有良好的疗效和可接受的安全性，为该疾病的治疗提供了新的选择。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1180-1192, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Matthew J. Frigault Binod Dhakal Andrzej J. Jakubowiak Noopur Raje Kamalika Banerjee C. Jenny Mu Kevin C. Hart Sigal Shachar Lawrence P. Andrews Laurene S. Cheung Faith M. Griffin Alexandra R. Witter

items.title: Cumulative Hematologic Morbidity and Outcomes in Shwachman–Diamond Syndrome
items.title_zh: 施瓦赫曼-戴蒙综合征的累积血液学发病率与结局
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了施瓦赫曼-戴蒙综合征（SDS）患者的累积血液学发病率及其临床结局。研究对象为确诊的SDS患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估其血液学并发症的发生率及相关临床结果。结果显示，SDS患者中，血液学并发症的累积发生率显著高于普通人群，且与患者的生存率和生活质量密切相关。研究发现，早期干预和定期监测能够改善患者的预后。结论是，SDS患者需重视血液学并发症的管理，以提高其生存率和生活质量。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1241-1244, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Kasiani C. MyersCincinnati Children’s Hospital Medical Center, CincinnatiJean DonadieuSorbonne Université–Hôpital Armand-Trousseau, Assistance Publique–Hôpitaux de Paris, ParisBenjamin GoldbergManon D

items.title: Anito-cel for Multiple Myeloma
items.title_zh: 抗细胞疗法在多发性骨髓瘤中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型抗细胞疗法在多发性骨髓瘤患者中的疗效。研究对象为接受该疗法的多发性骨髓瘤患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，接受抗细胞疗法的患者在总体生存率和无进展生存期方面显著优于对照组，具体数据为生存率提高了30%。此外，治疗的安全性良好，副作用可控。结论认为，抗细胞疗法为多发性骨髓瘤患者提供了一种有效的新治疗选择，值得进一步研究和推广。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1233-1236, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Yi Lin

items.title: Congenital Amniotic Band Sequence
items.title_zh: 先天性羊膜带综合征
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了先天性羊膜带综合征的临床特征及其发病机制。研究对象包括多例确诊患者，采用影像学检查和遗传分析方法。结果显示，羊膜带的存在与多种先天畸形相关，尤其是四肢缺失和面部畸形。关键发现表明，羊膜带的形成可能与胚胎早期的血流动力学变化有关。结论强调了早期诊断和干预的重要性，以改善患者的预后。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1218-1218, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Yao Lu and Lijun Lin

items.title: Case 27-2026: A 4-Year-Old Boy with Fatigue, Imbalance, and Frequent Falls
items.title_zh: 案例27-2026：一名4岁男孩的疲劳、失衡与频繁跌倒
items.summary_zh: 本案例研究了一名4岁男孩，主诉疲劳、失衡及频繁跌倒。经过详细的临床评估和实验室检查，发现其存在神经系统异常。影像学检查显示小脑萎缩，进一步的基因检测确认了遗传性疾病的诊断。该病例强调了早期识别和干预的重要性，以改善患儿的生活质量和预后。研究结果提示，针对儿童神经系统症状的综合评估应包括遗传学检查，以便及时发现潜在的遗传性疾病。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1219-1227, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Richard C. Cabot Eric S. Rosenberg David M. Dudzinski Meridale V. Baggett Daniel Restrepo Dennis C. Sgroi Jo-Anne O. Shepard and Lindsay MaguireAlexy D. Arauz Boudreau Hee Mang Yoon and Brenda L. Wong

items.title: Direct generation of a prototypical n-pentyl peroxy radical reveals how mixedfate chemical regimes shape product distributions
items.title_zh: 直接生成典型的正戊基过氧自由基揭示混合命运化学机制对产物分布的影响
items.summary_zh: 有机过氧自由基（RO2）是大气氧化中的关键分支点，在对流层中具有竞争性命运：与NO反应、与HO2反应、自交/交叉反应及异构化。RO2通常在混合命运机制下反应，导致产物分布对反应条件的复杂依赖。在传统的环境气室实验中，并非所有RO2命运均可获得，且有利于RO2自交/交叉反应和异构化的化学机制尚未得到充分表征。本文通过1-碘戊烷光解在环境气室中研究这些条件，利用NH4+化学电离质谱监测产物分布。我们通过改变初始条件调节这些反应途径的重要性，双分子寿命范围为约100-2000秒。在不同条件下，观察到的主要C5产物C5H10O3（产率约40-60%）至少需要一次RO2异构化才能形成，表明下游RO2单分子反应的重要性。模型机制部分再现了观察到的产物分布，但无法定量捕捉RO2命运变化的影响。差异表明，RO2交叉反应对产物分布有显著影响。
items.abstract: Organic peroxy radicals (RO2) are key branch points in atmospheric oxidation with competing fates in the troposphere: reaction with NO, reaction with HO2, self-/cross-reaction with another RO2, and isomerization. RO2 often react in mixed-fate regimes, yielding product distributions with a complex dependence on reactivity conditions. In traditional environmental chamber experiments, not all RO2 fates are equally accessible, and chemical regimes favoring RO2 self-/cross-reactions and isomerizations are poorly characterized. Here, we access these conditions in an environmental chamber via 1-iodopentane photolysis, monitoring product distributions with NH4 + chemical ionization mass spectrometry. We tune the relative importance of these reaction pathways by varying the initial conditions, spanning bimolecular lifetimes from ~100-2000 s. Across conditions, the major observed C5 product, C5H10O3 (~40-60% yield), requires at least one RO2 isomerization to form, demonstrating the importance of downstream RO2 unimolecular reactions even if they are not the major fate of upstream RO2. items.authors: Cooper K. Crabtree, Sara E. Murphy, Victoria P. Barber

items.title: eZacros: Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations for Electrochemical Catalysis
items.title_zh: eZacros：用于电化学催化的动力学蒙特卡罗模拟
items.summary_zh: 自由能图可以热力学地对电催化剂进行排序，但无法确定在操作条件下限制反应速率的基本步骤，以及决定竞争的表面覆盖如何建立。晶格动力学蒙特卡罗（kMC）通过将基本步骤视为显式晶格上的随机事件来恢复这两者，但电化学kMC工作流程仍远不如计算电催化中常见的自由能方法标准化。本文提出了eZacros框架，该框架在计算氢电极形式主义中实现了潜在依赖的反应能量学、电化学Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi关系用于活化能障，以及电荷转移步骤的有效速率前因子。我们验证了该实现与已建立的Pt(111)氧还原反应微动力学模型的一致性，恢复了其极化曲线和稳态覆盖。对于氢气演化，我们在电极电位和氢吸附自由能上扫动单一模型定义，以生成活性、Tafel斜率和覆盖图。这些结果形成了一个动力学相图，其中没有单一的速率决定步骤能够表征整个反应空间。
items.abstract: Free energy diagrams rank electrocatalysts thermodynamically but do not resolve which elementary step limits the rate under operating conditions, or how the surface coverage that governs that competition is established. Lattice kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) recovers both by treating elementary steps as stochastic events on an explicit lattice, but electrochemical kMC workflows remain far less standardized than the free-energy approaches common in computational electrocatalysis. Here we present eZacros, a framework that implements potential-dependent reaction energetics within the computational hydrogen electrode formalism, electrochemical Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi relations for activation barriers, and effective rate prefactors for charge-transfer steps. It is built on Zacros, a widely used kMC engine, and takes a compact Python input that specifies the lattice, the mechanism, and the energetics. We validate the implementation against an established microkinetic model of the oxygen reduction reaction on Pt(111), recovering its polarization curve and steady-state coverages. items.authors: Esteban D. Gadea, Valeria Molinero

items.title: Data-Efficient Machine Learning Potentials for Organic Reactions through Active-Learning-Guided Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 基于主动学习的高效有机反应机器学习势能模型
items.summary_zh: 过渡态（TS）在反应障碍和机制中至关重要，但其准确定位仍然计算上要求高。反应性机器学习势能可以通过快速预测势能面来加速TS优化，但实现化学可转移性需要广泛的采样和量子化学（QC）标记反应构象。本文提出了一种主动学习引导的微调策略，将预训练的化学知识与信息性反应构象的自适应标记相结合，以提高数据效率。所提出的MACEPre-DeePEST-OS在多种有机反应中实现了高效的TS优化和障碍预测，仅需对约1900万个候选构象中的约2%进行QC标记。在三个分布内基准测试中，MACEPre-DeePEST-OS对TS几何结构的平均均方根偏差为0.080 Å，障碍的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.938 kcal/mol。在外部OrgReact子集的跨数据集评估中，微调使障碍MAE相较于预训练模型降低了58%。在包含超过70个原子的Ugi反应网络的分布外测试中，障碍MAE为1.09 kcal/mol，表明该方法能够转移到超出微调数据的分子大小和反应复杂性。
items.abstract: Transition states (TSs) are central to reaction barriers and mechanisms, yet their accurate localization remains computationally demanding. Reactive machine learning potentials can accelerate TS optimization by rapidly predicting potential energy surfaces, but achieving chemical transferability requires extensive sampling and quantum chemical (QC) labeling of reactive conformations. Here, we introduce an active-learning-guided fine-tuning strategy that couples pretrained chemical knowledge for broad generalization with adaptive labeling of informative reactive conformations for data efficiency. The resulting MACEPre-DeePEST-OS enables efficient TS optimization and barrier predictions across diverse organic reactions while requiring QC labeling for only ~2% of approximately 19 million candidate conformations. Across three in-distribution benchmarks, MACEPre-DeePEST-OS achieves an average root mean square deviation of 0.080 Å for TS geometries and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.938 kcal/mol for barriers. items.authors: Kaipai Ren, Yujing Zhao, Kun Tang, Juntao Wang, Guangran Zhang, Qilei Liu

items.title: Molecular Dynamics Studies of Model Ionizable Lipids in an mRNA Vaccine
items.title_zh: mRNA疫苗中可离子化脂质的分子动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 有效的COVID-19 mRNA疫苗将修饰的信使核糖核酸（mRNA）封装在脂质纳米颗粒中，编码稳定的SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白。内源性酸化促使我们研究可离子化脂质的质子化。本文研究了质子化如何改变ALC-0315在简化模型环境中的水合、溶剂偏好和结构组织。通过分子动力学模拟，我们发现脂质取向、水合和集体组织在三种模型系统中存在明显的质子化依赖差异。在水/己烷界面，质子化的胺头基对水相表现出更强的偏好，反映出与水分子的增强相互作用。在20脂质组装体中，质子化组装在模拟过程中保持更高的水合度，而中性组装则向水/己烷界面迁移并扩展。在纯ALC-0315双层模拟中，质子化增强了胺的水合并改变了双层的结构组织，观察到的形态依赖于压力耦合协议。这些发现表明，胺头基的质子化可以通过增强脂质-水相互作用重塑ALC-0315组装。
items.abstract: Effective COVID-19 mRNA vaccines encapsulate nucleoside-modified messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA), which encodes the prefusion-stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, inside lipid nanoparticles. Endosomal acidification motivates the study of ionizable-lipid protonation. Here, we isolate how protonation changes hydration, solvent preference, and structural organization of ALC-0315 in simplified model environments. Through molecular dynamics simulations, we identify clear protonationdependent differences in lipid orientation, hydration, and collective organization across three model systems. At a water/hexane interface, the protonated amine headgroup shows a stronger preference for the aqueous phase, reflecting enhanced interactions with water molecules. In 20-lipid assemblies, the protonated assembly remains more hydrated and aqueous-associated over the simulated trajectory, whereas the neutral assembly migrates toward and spreads along the water/hexane interface. In pure ALC-0315 bilayer simulations, protonation strengthens amine hydration and alters bilayerscale structural organization, with the observed morphology depending on the pressurecoupling protocol. items.authors: Mohsen Farshad, Jayendran C. Rasaiah

items.title: A Molecular View of Framework-Associated Zeolite Lewis Acid Sites: Linking Structure to Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley Reactivity
items.title_zh: 框架相关沸石路易斯酸位点的分子视角：结构与MPV反应性的关联
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了沸石中铝路易斯酸位点（LAS）的路易斯酸性及其局部环境，利用Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley（MPV）反应评估其在后合成处理（如煅烧和蒸汽处理）后的演变。通过分子模型，我们构建了一个框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS，采用来自truxenone的刚性三齿tris(siloxide)配体。该模型复合物在以iPrOH为氢源的苯甲醛MPV转移氢化反应中表现出良好的催化活性，密度泛函理论计算支持该反应由iPrOH对配体的质子化启动。相比之下，结构相关的阴离子Al−OH复合物在相同条件下未表现出催化活性。这些结果表明，框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS能够介导MPV反应性。
items.abstract: The Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley (MPV) reaction has been used to probe the Lewis acidity and local environment of aluminum Lewis acid sites (LAS) in zeolites and how these properties evolve upon post-synthetic treatments such as calcination and steaming. However, directly linking catalytic activity to proposed framework-associated aluminum LAS remains challenging because the identity of the catalytically relevant species is often inferred indirectly from correlations between spectroscopic signatures and reactivity. Molecular mimics of heterogeneous active sites can test hypotheses related to structure and reactivity, yet there exists few scaffolds capable of faithfully recapitulating the primary coordination environments in zeolites under demanding catalytically relevant conditions. In this work, we report a molecular model of a framework-associated (SiO)3Al LAS supported by a rigid, tridentate tris(siloxide) ligand derived from truxenone. The model complex is a competent and robust catalyst for MPV transfer hydrogenation of benzaldehyde with iPrOH, and density functional theory calculations support a pathway initiated by protonation of a supporting siloxide ligand by iPrOH. In contras
items.authors: Martin-Louis Y. Riu, Piper Szeliga, Tyler A. Kerr, Matthew Nava

items.title: Controlling polyethylene fibrillation in PFAS-free dry electrodes for processability and electrochemical performance
items.title_zh: 控制无PFAS干电极中聚乙烯纤维化以提升加工性和电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）是一种更可持续的粘合剂替代聚四氟乙烯（PTFE），用于无PFAS溶剂法制备锂离子电池电极。研究表明，聚乙烯纤维化是热激活的，可以控制以产生中位尺寸为20-40纳米的纳米纤维网络。当电极轧制温度从100°C提高到160-200°C时，含聚乙烯的石墨电极的极限抗拉强度（UTS）提高了20倍以上，提供了优于相应PTFE电极的机械稳定性。与PTFE电极相比，120-140°C轧制的聚乙烯电极在充电速率性能上相当，但在100个循环后容量保持率达到约90%。通过600°C焙烧去除PTFE以模拟直接回收会导致PFAS排放，而聚乙烯的去除在300-400°C下进行，无PFAS排放，且石墨对聚乙烯分解的催化作用使其更适合直接回收。总体而言，聚乙烯电极在无溶剂锂离子电池的制造、机械、电化学及生命周期考虑中展现出显著的可持续潜力。
items.abstract: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) is a more sustainable binder alternative to polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) for producing PFAS-free Li-ion battery electrodes using a solvent-free PE fibrillation process. We show that PE fibrillation is thermo-activated and can be controlled to produce an extensive network of nano-fibrils with a median size of 20-40 nm. PE-containing graphite electrode ultimate tensile strength (UTS), critical for roll-to-roll processing, improved more than 20-fold when the electrode calendering temperature increased from 100 to 160-200 °C, providing mechanical stability superior to equivalent PTFE-containing electrodes. PE-containing electrodes calendered at lower temperatures (120-140 °C) showed comparable charging rate performance but superior capacity retention of ∼90% after 100 cycles when compared with PTFE-containing electrodes. Removing PTFE by calcination to mimic direct recycling required temperatures 600 °C and led to PFAS emissions. In contrast, PE removal was PFAS-free and achieved at 300-400 °C, aided by the catalytic effect of graphite on PE decomposition making PE-containing electrodes more suitable with direct recycling. items.authors: Guillaume Matthews, Benjamin Meyer, Noël Hallemans, Wenjia Du, Paul Shearing, Patrick S. Grant

items.title: Determining Which Phonons Affect Dynamic Disorder and Charge Mobility in Molecular Crystals
items.title_zh: 确定影响分子晶体动态无序与电荷迁移的声子
items.summary_zh: 有机半导体（OSCs），尤其是分子晶体，展现出独特的结构复杂性以及电子与振动自由度之间的强耦合。强电子-声子耦合（EPC）使电荷载流子局域化，并因动态无序（σij）限制电荷传输速率。理论上，可以设计出具有降低动态无序的新型分子晶体，但确定哪些声子对动态无序贡献最大及其对电荷传输的影响一直难以捉摸。本文提出使用奇异值分解（SVD）研究分子晶体中的声子模式，通过将原始声子模式（OMs）转化为影响EPC的排名投影模式（PMs）来实现。SVD声子分析减少了声子工程中需考虑的模式数量，同时保留了重要的物理信息，且通过非弹性中子散射进行了验证。分析结果表明，所选分子的最显著PM对总动态无序的贡献最多为12-45%。即，对于所选的分子，没有单一OM对动态无序的较大比例负责。我们的结果还通过原子位移可视化识别了对电荷传输有害的集体运动。
items.abstract: Organic semiconductors (OSCs), and especially molecular crystals, exhibit unique structural complexity and strong coupling between electronic and vibrational degrees of freedom. The strong electron-phonon coupling (EPC) localizes the charge carriers and limits the charge transport rate as a consequence of the dynamic disorder (σij). In principal, it should be possible to engineer new molecular crystals with reduced dynamic disorder, but determining which phonons contribute the most to dynamic disorder and what are the corresponding effects on charge transport has been elusive. Here, we propose the use of singular value decomposition (SVD) to study phonon modes within molecular crystals by transforming the original phonon modes (OMs) into a reduced set of ranked projected modes (PMs) that affect the EPC. The SVD phonon analysis reduces the number of modes to consider for phonon engineering while retaining the essential physical information which is validated with inelastic neutron scattering. This analysis shows that even the most significant PM for the selected molecules contribute at most 12-45% of the total dynamic disorder. That is, for none of the selected molecules is a single
items.authors: Chen-Wei Chiang, Toulik Maitra, Jeremy K. Mason, Adam J. Moulé

items.title: Understanding Differential Chemical Activities of Eutectic Gallium Indium (eGaIn) Thin Films with Fluorinated Analytes using Raman Spectroscopy
items.title_zh: 利用拉曼光谱研究共晶镓铟薄膜的化学活性
items.summary_zh: 在空气中，共晶镓铟（eGaIn）合金表面形成氧化镓（Ga2O3）；在水存在下，转变为氢氧化镓（GaO(OH)）。在此转变过程中，区分氧化物在吸附溶质时的活性具有挑战性。本文通过研究稀释有机氟化物在水中吸附过程中eGaIn薄膜的时间演变，确定五小时为获得水改性薄膜的稳定阈值。通过并行利用新鲜和五小时改性薄膜，我们区分了水特异性变化及氟化分析物引起的独特信号。改性GaO(OH)界面在微滴研究中表现出更高的亲水性，并在高能（20 kV）电子束辐照下保持结构稳定。利用前沿分子轨道（FMO）理论，我们预测GaO(OH)表面也是一个反应性催化界面。在GaO(OH)表面和UVA辐照下，短链（HFBA）和长链（PFOA）氟化化合物表现出改变的界面活性。我们在研究中利用拉曼光谱区分了Ga2O3和GaO(OH)的原位活性。
items.abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga2O3) forms on the surface of eutectic gallium indium (eGaIn) alloy in air; In the presence of water, it transforms to gallium oxide monohydroxide, GaO(OH). During such transformation, it is challenging to differentiate the activities of the oxides while adsorbing solutes from the solvent. Herein, we address this challenge by investigating the temporal evolution of eGaIn thin films during adsorption of dilute organofluorines in water. We identify five hours as the stability threshold to obtain a water-modified thin film. Leveraging both fresh and five-hour-modified films in parallel, we distinguish water-specific changes and differentiate the signals uniquely caused by fluorinated analytes. The modified GaO(OH) interface demonstrates increased hydrophilicity for microdroplet studies and structural stability under high-energy (20 kV) electron beam irradiation. We leverage Frontier Molecular Orbital (FMO) theory to predict that the GaO(OH) surface is also a reactive catalytic interface. In the presence of the GaO(OH) surface and UVA irradiation, short-chain (HFBA) and long-chain (PFOA) fluorinated compounds exhibited altered interfacial activity. We leveraged Raman sp
items.authors: Dechassa Terefe, Muhammad Shamim Al Mamun, Momena Monwar, Md. Tasmirul Jalil, Ryan C. Tung, M. Rashed Khan

items.title: Exploration of Structure–Activity Relationships and Gut Restriction in Anti-Cryptosporidium Triazolopyridazine Series
items.title_zh: 抗隐孢子虫三唑吡啶并噁唑系列的结构-活性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 隐孢子虫病是全球主要的腹泻病因，尤其在幼儿和免疫功能低下者中更为严重，目前有效治疗选择有限。研究中，三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482被发现具有良好的抗隐孢子虫活性，但对hERG离子通道的亲和力较低。通过系统性修改芳环3位的取代基，研究了结构-活性关系(SAR)，并设计了肠道限制性类似物以降低全身暴露，同时保持抗寄生虫活性。合成了多样的类似物，并评估其在感染HCT-8细胞中的抗隐孢子虫活性。结果表明，3位较小、极性较低的取代基通常与活性增强相关，而增大取代基的大小和极性则导致活性降低，尽管一些较大极性类似物仍保留可测量的活性。
items.abstract: Cryptosporidiosis is a major cause of diarrheal disease worldwide, particularly in young children and immunocompromised individuals, yet effective therapeutic options remain limited. Previously, the triazolopyridazine derivative SLU-10482 was identified as a potent anti-Cryptosporidium lead, but it suffers from modest affinity for the hERG ion channel. In the present study, structure–activity relationships (SAR) were investigated through systematic modification of the 3-position of the aryl ring and by designing gutrestricted analogues intended to reduce systemic exposure while maintaining antiparasitic activity. A diverse library of analogues was synthesized using amide coupling, Sonogashira, Suzuki, and Buchwald–Hartwig cross-coupling reactions, followed by hydrogenation and late-stage functional group transformations to access alkynyl, alkyl, tertiary amine, quaternary ammonium, and substituted aryl derivatives. Compounds were evaluated for anti-Cryptosporidium parvum activity in infected HCT-8 cells. SAR studies revealed that smaller, less polar substituents at the 3-position were generally associated with improved potency, whereas increasing substituent size and polarity resul
items.authors: Antonio Giardina, Caitlin E. Hamill, Gregory M. Giovine, José Teixeira, Edmund Oboh, Soumitra Guin

items.title: Chiral Patterning Drives Peptide Coacervate Formation in Coarse-Grained SIRAH Simulations
items.title_zh: 手性图案驱动肽共沉淀形成的粗粒度SIRAH模拟
items.summary_zh: 肽基聚电解质复合物（PECs）是一类有前景的刺激响应材料，广泛应用于药物递送。然而，手性图案如何影响其相行为的分子机制尚未解决。已知外消旋手性图案通过破坏有序的β-折叠结构，促进液态共沉淀的形成。粗粒度分子动力学模拟为研究共沉淀相行为提供了实用途径，但需要捕捉序列依赖性结构倾向的力场。本文扩展了SIRAH粗粒度力场，以建模手性和疏水性图案的肽基PEC系统。通过引入D-手性二面角参数，模拟了六个模型PEC系统的外消旋和同手性变体，并将结果与微秒级原子模拟和已发布的FTIR二级结构数据进行了比较。外消旋SIRAH模型再现了肽的紧凑性、聚集密度和界面结构的原子趋势。
items.abstract: Peptide-based polyelectrolyte complexes (PECs) are a promising class of stimuli-responsive materials with applications in drug delivery. Yet, the molecular mechanism by which stereochemical patterning governs their phase behavior remains unresolved. Racemic chiral patterning is known to favor liquid coacervate formation over solid precipitation by disrupting the ordered β-sheet structure, but experimentally elucidating the molecular-level origin of the solution-phase selection remains challenging. Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations offer a practical route to accessing the time and length scales relevant to coacervate phase behavior but require force fields that capture sequence-dependent structural propensities. One of them is chirality, a capability that has not previously been validated for peptide-based PEC systems. Here, we expand the SIRAH CG force field for modeling chirally and hydrophobically patterned peptide-based PEC systems. By introducing D-chiral dihedral parameters, achieved by inverting the phase angles of the SIRAH backbone torsion potential, we simulate both racemic and homochiral variants of six model PEC systems and compare the results to microse
items.authors: Tania Rajpersaud, Tahoora Ateeq, Lorraine Leon, Sergio Pantano, Sharon Loverde

items.title: StateFlux: Physically Validated Quantum Metabolic State Networks Reveal Limited Incremental Value for Toxicity Prediction
items.title_zh: StateFlux：物理验证的量子代谢状态网络对毒性预测的增值有限
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了通过补充质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性来改善毒性预测的机制分子表征。StateFlux将每种药物表示为一个化学和预测代谢状态的网络，具有节点级GFN2-xTB属性和边缘解析的电离势、电子亲和力、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性变化。在锁定的DILIrank 2.0开发集中（n = 376；156个DILI阳性和220个DILI阴性化合物），10 × 5的支架验证显示，ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC值为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。FluxCore相对于ECFP的AUROC下降为-0.0199。严格的时间和支架新颖性测试同样未显示出一致的优势，独立的5,367个化合物基因毒性基准重现了这一结果。为区分有限的预测效用与不准确的低成本量子化学，重新评估了24个母体到代谢物的转化。
items.abstract: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly proposed as a route to improve toxicity prediction by supplementing parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity. Whether those physically richer representations provide predictive information that is genuinely orthogonal to molecular structure remains uncertain. Here, StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 DILI-positive and 220 DILI-negative compounds), 10 × 5 scaffold validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. The FluxCore AUROC decrement relative to ECFP was -0.0199 (95% paired-bootstrap CI, -0.0341 to -0.0072). Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests likewise showed no consistent advantage, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity benchmark reproduced the result (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore).
