items.authors: Aris Tsai

items.title: A Convenient Crystalline Acyl Silane for the Colorimetric Titration of Diisobutylaluminum Hydride (DIBAL)
items.title_zh: 一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷用于二异丁基铝氢化物的比色滴定
items.summary_zh: 由于酰基硅烷的强烈颜色及其与二异丁基铝氢化物（DIBAL）快速反应生成无色醇的特性，本文开发了一种DIBAL的比色滴定方法。研究中鉴定出一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，可在克级规模上制备，无需通过色谱纯化，直接结晶反应产物。该材料可用于DIBAL和n-BuLi的比色滴定。还测试了多种其他氢化物和有机金属试剂，但其终点不理想。该研究由美国化学学会Project SEED的学生在一名高级研究生的指导下进行，适合应用于与反应性氢化物试剂滴定相关的高级本科实验室。
items.abstract: Due to the intense color associated with acyl silanes and their fast reaction with DIBAL to generate colorless alcohols, these properties were utilized to develop a colorimetric titration of DIBAL. A convenient crystalline acyl silane was identified that can be prepared on gram scale without the need for chromatographic purification by direct crystallization of the reaction products. Use of this material for the colorimetric titration of DIBAL and n-BuLi was possible. A variety of other 2 hydride and organometallic reagents were also tested and showed unsatisfactory endpoints. This work was performed by an American Chemical Society Project SEED student during their summer fellowship under the direction of a senior graduate student. The work disclosed could be suitable for application to an advanced undergraduate level laboratory related to the titration of reactive hydride reagents including the significance of atom effects on the physical and chemical properties or organic compounds.
items.authors: Stephen Collins, Colby Basnett, Joshua D. Sieber

items.title: Computer Vision for Predicting Electrochemical Reaction Performance from Electroanalytical Data
items.title_zh: 基于计算机视觉预测电化学反应性能的研究
items.summary_zh: 电合成作为现代合成中的关键方法，促进了更可持续的化学转化并减少了化学废物。准确预测电合成性能对于加速反应的发现和设计至关重要。尽管已有显著进展，但基于描述符的预测在表征电合成的高维参数空间时仍显不足。循环伏安图通常用于机制分析，内含丰富的电化学过程信息。本文应用计算机视觉技术建立了循环伏安图像数据库，并直接在这些图像数据上训练了神经网络。所得到的模型在预测电合成结果方面表现可靠，展示了基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的潜力。
items.abstract: Electrosynthesis has surfaced as a key approach in modern synthesis, enabling more sustainable chemical transformations with reduced chemical waste. The accurate prediction of electrosynthesis performance is crucial for accelerating the discovery and design of reactions. Despite indisputable advances, the descriptor-based predictions fall short in representing the full reaction regime due to the high‑dimensional parameter space of electrosynthesis. Cyclic voltammograms, which are typically employed for mechanistic analysis, inherently contain rich information about electrochemical processes. Herein, we applied computer vision techniques to collect a cyclic voltammogram image database and trained a neural network directly on these image data. The resulting models achieved reliable performance in predicting electrosynthesis outcomes, demonstrating the potential of image-based deep learning for electrochemical reaction evaluation and data-driven electrosynthesis studies.
items.authors: Xinran Chen, Sven Erik Peters, Lutz Ackermann

items.title: Framework Connectivity Tunes the Nuclear Spin Bath and Extends Coherence in Cu(II) Metal–Organic Framework Qubit Lattices
items.title_zh: 框架连接性调节核自旋浴并延长Cu(II)金属有机框架量子比特的相干性
items.summary_zh: 设计能够在高自旋密度下保持长相干时间的固态自旋量子比特阵列是量子信息材料中的一个核心挑战。在分子量子比特中，这一挑战源于局部配位环境和晶格结构不仅定义了自旋阵列，还控制了主要的去相干通道，尤其是核自旋谱扩散和与低频声子的耦合。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其结合了密集的晶体自旋阵列与可化学编程的配位环境、框架连接性和超分子堆积而特别有吸引力，但对特定结构变化如何转化为可预测的弛豫行为的基本理解仍然不够成熟。本文比较了两个密切相关的氧配位Cu(II)框架Cu-TPTC和Cu-TPTriC，前者由一维Cu–O链组成，后者形成二维Cu–O–Cu片层。连续波电子顺磁共振（CW-EPR）光谱显示，两种晶格的线宽相对较窄。
items.abstract: Designing solid-state spin-qubit arrays that retain long coherence at high spin density remains a central challenge in quantum information materials. In molecular qubits, this challenge arises because the same local coordination environment and lattice architecture that define the spin array also control the dominant decoherence channels, most notably nuclear-spin spectral diffusion and coupling to low-frequency phonons. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are therefore especially attractive because they combine dense, crystalline spin arrays with chemically programmable control over the coordination environment, framework connectivity, and supramolecular packing, yet a fundamental understanding of how specific structural changes translate into predictable relaxation behavior remains underdeveloped. Here we compare two closely related oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) frameworks, Cu-TPTC and Cu-TPTriC, that preserve the same first-sphere donor set while changing connectivity and supramolecular packing. Cu-TPTC comprises one-dimensional Cu–O chains assembled into hydrogen-bonded rods, whereas Cu-TPTriC forms coordination-connected Cu–O–Cu two-dimensional sheets that stack through interlayer aro
items.authors: Kavish Saini, Sisheed Sivaraman, Prashanna Poudel, Bonaventure A. Odeke, Gajadhar Joshi, Manny de Jesus Lopez

items.title: Differentiable mass transfer modeling enables wet lab validated inverse analysis of liquid chromatography
items.title_zh: 可微分质量传输建模实现液相色谱逆向分析的实验验证
items.summary_zh: 液相色谱（LC）在有机合成和新兴自驱动实验室中至关重要，但其方法开发仍然成本高昂且依赖专家直觉。机制性色谱模型为可转移和数据高效的方法开发提供了途径，但逆向建模的计算成本和从实验色谱图中参数估计的病态性限制了其实际应用。本文报告了一种经过湿实验验证的可微分物理框架用于LC逆向建模。该框架将机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习（PIML）相结合，实现了从梯度洗脱色谱图中高效的正向模拟和基于梯度的逆向估计。主要的PINN代理在无量纲浓度上重现机制性参考，均方根误差为10−3。为解决逆向问题的病态性，我们引入了一种可观测性引导的实验设计策略，量化参数可识别性，并将此信息纳入逆向目标，以促进向真实参数的收敛。在300个干实验室模拟参数组合中，该策略在88.3%的情况下以相对误差≤10%恢复了真实参数。
items.abstract: Liquid chromatography (LC) is essential to organic synthesis and emerging selfdriving laboratories (SDLs), yet LC method development remains cost-intensive and dependent on expert intuition. Mechanistic chromatographic models offer a route to transferable and data-efficient method development, but their practical use is limited by the computational cost of inverse modeling and by the ill-posedness of parameter estimation from experimental chromatograms. Here we report a wet-lab-validated differentiable physics framework for LC inverse modeling. The framework integrates mechanistic column modeling with physics-informed machine learning (PIML) to enable efficient forward simulation and gradient-based inverse estimation of molecular transport and adsorption parameters from gradient-elution chromatograms. The primary PINN surrogate reproduces the mechanistic reference with a root-mean-square error of 10−3 in dimensionless concentration. To address the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem, we introduce an observability-guided experimental-design strategy that quantifies parameter identifiability and incorporates this information into the inverse objective to promote convergence towar
items.authors: Baochen Li, Zihan Zhou, Yanqing Yu, Sen Lin, Peng Wang, Tianshu Yu

items.title: Gas-Phase Fragmentation in Mass Spectrometry Informs the Shape and Topology of Thiolated Metal Nanoclusters
items.title_zh: 气相碎裂质谱分析揭示硫醇化金属纳米簇的形状与拓扑
items.summary_zh: 硫醇化金属纳米簇（NCs）由金属核心和外层保护结构组成，因其在催化、生物传感和生物医学中的应用前景而受到广泛关注。尽管质谱（MS）常用于通过完整质量测量确定金属NCs的化学组成，但其在气相碎裂方面的深入结构分析潜力尚未得到充分探索，主要集中在气体碰撞诱导解离（CID）技术上。本文系统比较了CID与另一种方法——表面诱导解离（SID）之间的碎裂路径，使用了具有不同对称性和结构特征的模型金纳米簇。结果表明，CID和SID的气相碎片在整体上表现出相似的碎裂行为，但在键断裂位置上存在不同偏好。此外，SID在具有三聚体结构的椭球形金纳米簇中显示出特征性的金损失；CID和SID的碎裂效率则根据纳米簇的形状有所不同。基于这些发现，我们将该方法应用于研究具有异质化学计量的不可结晶化金银纳米簇，SID碎裂数据有助于定位金和银原子，为合成提供了宝贵的见解。
items.abstract: Thiolated metal nanoclusters (NCs), comprising a metal core protected by outer-layer staple motifs, have attracted widespread interest due to their promising applications in catalysis, biosensing, and biomedicine. While mass spectrometry (MS) is widely used to determine the chemical composition of metal NCs via intact mass measurement, its potential for in-depth structural analysis via gas-phase fragmentation in tandem MS (MS/MS) has been relatively underexplored and mostly focused on the collision induced dissociation (CID) technique involving gas collisions. Herein, we systematically compared the fragmentation pathways between CID and an alternative method, surface induced dissociation (SID), using model Au NCs featuring distinct symmetries and structural motifs. We show that gas-phase fragments in CID and SID overall shared the common fragmentation behavior of breaking the outer staples of Au NCs, but with different preferences in the location of bond cleavages. In addition, SID showed characteristic Au losses in ellipsoidal Au NCs with trimeric staples; and fragmentation efficiency in CID and SID varied differentially according to the shape of the NCs. Building on these finding
items.authors: Long Shi, Luoming Zhang, Zebo Li, Zijie Chen, Yuqing Yao, Ruikang Tang

items.title: Docking, Molecular Dynamics, QSAR, and Machine Learning in Alzheimer's Small-Molecule Drug Discovery: Current Utility, Key Limitations, and Reproducibility Challenges
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中的计算方法综述
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）因其多因素病理、复杂靶点生物学及中枢神经系统药物开发要求，成为小分子药物发现中最具挑战性的领域之一。计算方法在化合物优先级排序、假设生成和结构-活性解释中变得愈发重要。本文重点评估分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟、定量结构-活性关系（QSAR）建模和机器学习（ML）在AD小分子发现中的实际应用，分析其主要优点、局限性及当前在验证、可解释性、可重复性和实验转化方面的挑战。分子对接在结构基础假设生成和结合位点分析中仍然有用，但常常被过度解读。MD模拟为研究蛋白-配体稳定性提供了补充框架。
items.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) remains one of the most challenging therapeutic areas for small-molecule drug discovery because of its multifactorial pathology, complex target biology, and demanding central nervous system drug-development requirements. In this context, computational methods have become increasingly important for compound prioritization, hypothesis generation, and structure–activity interpretation. Among these, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) modeling, and machine learning (ML) are widely used in AD-oriented medicinal chemistry, particularly in studies involving targets such as β-secretase 1 (BACE1) and tau. This review critically examines the practical roles of these four approaches in AD small-molecule discovery. Rather than presenting them as universally predictive solutions, the review evaluates their principal strengths, major limitations, and current challenges related to validation, interpretability, reproducibility, and experimental translation. Molecular docking remains useful for structure-based hypothesis generation and binding-pose analysis, especially for structurally characterized tar
items.authors: Poulami Saha, Anuja Chouhan

items.title: Accelerating Lead Optimization away from Anti-Targets: Navigating the Structural Complexity of Promiscuous ADMET Proteins
items.title_zh: 加速优化小分子药物，规避抗靶点的结构复杂性
items.summary_zh: 小分子药物的开发不仅需要优化与靶标蛋白的结合，还需减少与多种已知的抗靶点蛋白的结合，这些抗靶点通常被称为ADMET蛋白，具有大且高度灵活的结合位点，导致小分子的多重结合。本文展示了诱导适配对接和自由能扰动相结合的方法，结构性地优化了几种常见的抗靶点：细胞色素P450同种型3A4和2D6、hERG离子通道及PXR。通过在同系系列中强制执行共识结合模式，有效探索了广泛的受体构象空间。结果展示了公共回顾性数据集和在活跃药物发现项目中的前瞻性应用。
items.abstract: The development of a small-molecule suitable for clinical use involves optimization of ligand binding to an identified target protein but also frequently the reduction of binding to a variety of anti-target proteins known to pose translational risk. These anti-targets, often referred to as ADMET proteins, often contain large, highly flexible binding sites leading to promiscuous binding of small molecules. This property often frustrates efforts to execute structure-based design against these anti-targets. Here we demonstrate the application of a combination of induced fit docking and free energy perturbation to structurally enable several of the most common anti-targets: cytochrome P450 isoforms 3A4 and 2D6, the hERG ion channel, and PXR. Crucially, the enforcement of a consensus binding mode across a congeneric series allowed for the efficient exploration of a wide range of receptor conformation space. Results are presented for both public retrospective datasets and prospective application in active drug discovery programs.
items.authors: Howook Hwang, Mee Shelley, Andrew Placzek, Kevin Demarco, Steven Albanese, Andreas Verras

items.title: Computationally Accelerated Discovery of Efficient Dual Component White Light Emitters
items.title_zh: 计算加速高效双组分白光发射体的发现
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种计算指导的方法，以形成一系列氢键结合的铱发光体和互补的氢键结合荧光体的白光发射。我们计算性地研究了三十种新型Ir(III)配合物，这些配合物均包含一种先前研究过的富氢键的大尿素功能化配体。基于TD-DFT峰值发射数据及文献中已建立的寿命和量子效率数据的计算筛选结果，确定了七种适合合成和进一步研究的Ir(III)候选物。在这七种Ir(III)配合物中，四种因其合成可行性和适合进一步研究的参数被选中。对这四种候选物与我们的深蓝色发射体进行的光物理研究显示，四种配合物中有三种在适当比例的互补氢键结合荧光体中可实现近乎理想的白光，而所有四种宿主-客体组合在聚合物(PMMA)薄膜中均显示出良好的白光效果。
items.abstract: This work presents a computationally guided approach to formulating white light emission from a series of Hbonded iridium phosphors and a complementary H-bonding fluorophore. We computationally investigated thirty new Ir(III) complexes that all incorporate a previously studied H-bond rich biguanide functionalised ligand. The results of the computational screening, based on TD-DFT peak emission data and established lifetime and quantum efficiency data in the literature, identified seven Ir(III) candidates suitable for synthesis and further investigation. Of the seven Ir(III) complexes, four were chosen based on their synthetic feasibility and their suitability to further study based on the parameters of the screen. Photophysical investigations of these four candidates with our deep blue emitter showed how three of the four complexes could achieve near ideal white light in the appropriate ratio of the complementary H-bonding fluorophore, while all four hostguest-complements show promising white-light results in polymer (PMMA) films.
items.authors: T.H. Jones, R.S. Horne, D.J. Graham, B.A. Blight, Barry Blight

items.title: Bidirectional Refractive-Index Programming via Three-Stage Sequential Thiol-Click Chemistry for High-Performance Holographic Recording
items.title_zh: 基于三阶段硫醇点击化学的双向折射率编程用于高性能全息记录
items.summary_zh: 传统全息光聚合物（HPs）主要依赖聚合-扩散机制记录体积全息光栅（VHGs），导致光敏性、折射率调制（Δn）、光学清晰度和VHG稳定性之间的权衡。为了解决这些权衡，我们提出了一种基于三步序列硫醇点击反应的双向折射率编程（BRIP）策略。第一阶段采用碱催化的硫醇-丙烯酸酯迈克尔加成形成富硫醇的基体。在全息曝光下，第二阶段触发光诱导的硫醇-乙烯加成，将高折射率记录单体引入亮区，生成初始VHG Δn，同时在暗区保留残余硫醇位点。曝光后，第三阶段利用热激活的硫醇-环氧加成将低折射率增强单体引入这些互补的暗区，进一步增加Δn。通过开发代表性的BRIP HP配方验证了该策略。得益于BRIP设计，该材料仅需1.1-1.9 mJ/cm²的曝光剂量即可在第二阶段生成初始Δn值为0.0103-0.0232的VHG，第三阶段后增加至0.0193-0.0394，同时在200至-197°C之间的十个热循环后保持95%的可见光透过率、0.02%的雾度和4%的Δn变化。此研究建立了一种新的分子设计范式。
items.abstract: Conventional holographic photopolymers (HPs) mainly rely on a polymerization–diffusion mechanism to record volume holographic gratings (VHGs), resulting in trade-offs among photosensitivity, refractive-index (RI) modulation (Δn), optical clarity, and VHG stability. To address these trade-offs, we propose a bidirectional refractive-index programming (BRIP) strategy based on three sequential thiol-click reactions. Stage I employs a base-catalyzed thiol–acrylate Michael addition to form a thiol-rich host matrix. Under holographic exposure, Stage II triggers photoinduced thiol–vinyl addition to incorporate a high-RI recording monomer into the bright regions, generating the initial VHG Δn while preserving residual thiol sites in the dark regions. After exposure, Stage III uses thermally activated thiol–epoxy addition to incorporate a low-RI enhancing monomer into these complementary dark regions, further increasing Δn. A representative BRIP HP formulation is developed to validate the strategy. Benefiting from the BRIP design, the material requires only 1.1–1.9 mJ/cm2 exposure dose to generate VHGs with initial Δn values of 0.0103–0.0232 after Stage II, which increase to 0.0193–0.0394 af
items.authors: Haoqiang Gao, Mingxuan Wang, Diqin Zhang, Yunlong Zhang, Qixin Zhou, Yong Bi

items.title: Language-model-derived training data for polymer glass transition prediction: a controlled benchmark
items.title_zh: 基于语言模型的聚合物玻璃转变预测训练数据：受控基准测试
items.summary_zh: 实验聚合物性质数据稀缺且成本高昂，而大型语言模型（LLMs）已吸收大量化学文献，并可按每个聚合物几分之一美分的成本进行查询。我们探讨了LLM生成的数据是否可以替代或补充实验数据以预测玻璃转变温度（Tg）。在Claude Sonnet 5的指导下，我们构建了两个合成数据集，分别为7912个聚合物的生成集和9925个假设PI1M聚合物的标记集。数据经过RDKit清洗、去重，并剔除持出测试集和验证集中的聚合物。经过训练的MoLFormer学生在合成数据和真实数据上进行比较，结果显示仅用合成数据训练的学生达到了36.8°C（生成）和38.5°C（标记）的平均绝对误差（MAE），接近教师的37.3°C，但远高于仅用真实数据训练的学生的25.2°C。合成数据的帮助仅在真实数据缺乏时显现。
items.abstract: Experimental polymer property data are scarce and costly, whereas large language models (LLMs) have absorbed much of the chemical literature and can be queried for a fraction of a cent per polymer. We ask whether LLM-produced data can replace or supplement experimental data for predicting the glass transition temperature (Tg). With Claude Sonnet 5 as the teacher we built two synthetic datasets for USD 10.28: a generated set of 7,912 polymers whose structures and Tg values were both written by the LLM, and a labeled set of 9,925 hypothetical PI1M polymers whose Tg the LLM predicted. Both were cleaned with RDKit, deduplicated with a cut-invariant polymer key, and purged of every polymer of a held-out test set (1,471 polymers) and validation set (589) drawn from a curated experimental collection. A fine-tuned MoLFormer student was trained along a learning curve of 250 to 5,297 real polymers, with and without a preceding stage on synthetic data, and compared with a fingerprint random forest, two controls (self-training pseudo-labels and shuffled labels) and the teacher’s own zero-shot predictions, over 5 seeds. Trained on synthetic data alone, the student reached a mean absolute error
items.authors: Rostislav Rusev

items.title: One network to link them all: an untargeted multi-metabolomics-methods network
items.title_zh: 一个网络连接所有：无靶向多代谢组学方法网络
items.summary_zh: 代谢组学旨在覆盖从极性代谢物到疏水性脂质的广泛代谢物。因此，结合多种色谱方法（如反相液相色谱RPLC和亲水性相互作用色谱HILIC）以提供全面的概述。生成的表格需要合并进行数据分析，但多个方法可能检测到相同的代谢物。目前，仅能处理已识别代谢物的多个条目，急需超越简单拼接的数据显示融合策略。网络已被证明是代谢组学数据分析的强大工具。我们开发了一个跨多种采集方法的分子网络，以提供更全面的数据组合和代谢物识别。比较不同LC方法数据集之间的MS/MS谱以合并特征，使用基于预定义加合物的离子模式匹配识别代谢物，并在单一离子化模式下基于GNPS质量偏移余弦相似度匹配谱。最终构建了一个包含4,862个节点和401,387条边的大型网络。
items.abstract: Metabolomics aims to cover a large range of metabolites from polar metabolites to hydrophobic lipids. Therefore, multiple chromatographic methods – such as reversed-phase liquid chromatography (RPLC) or hydrophilic interaction chromatography (HILIC) – are combined to provide a comprehensive overview. The resulting tables need to be combined afterward for data analysis, but several metabolites might be detected across multiple methods. Currently, it is only possible to deal with such multiple entries for identified metabolites. There is a strong requirement for data fusion strategies beyond the simple concatenation of individual peak tables. Networks have been shown to represent a powerful tool for metabolomics data analysis. Feature-based molecular networking, or ion identity networking, is a modern tool for reconstructing biochemical knowledge from metabolomics data. Here, we developed a molecular network across multiple acquisition methods to provide a more comprehensive combination of data and metabolite identification. items.authors: Pauline Couacault, Sandra Costa González, Clément Frainay, Fabien Jourdan, Michael Witting

items.title: Integrative Physics and Machine Learning-Based Optimal Binding Pose Generator for Protein-Ligand Complexes
items.title_zh: 基于物理与机器学习的蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点生成器
items.summary_zh: 准确识别蛋白质-配体最佳结合位点对可靠的结合亲和力预测至关重要，但目前尚无高效的预测方法。我们评估了三种基于人工智能的软件解决方案（AlphaFold3、Boltz和RoseTTAFold All-Atom），并展示了它们在此方面的显著不足。本文提出了一种结合物理和机器学习的方法，能够在蛋白质-配体的放松状态下预测最佳结合位点，从而快速、经济地估算结合亲和力。我们将该方法应用于两个靶点：tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) 和 3C样蛋白酶 (3CLPro)，每个系统使用10,000个分子的数据库。对约3,000个分子的外部验证集的评估表明，该方法能够推广到未见过的数据集，符合高通量药物发现流程的实际需求。我们的方法显著减少了对昂贵计算的需求，通过有效过滤不太可能产生有利结合亲和力的位点。
items.abstract: Accurately identifying the optimal protein–ligand binding pose is crucial for reliable binding affinity prediction, as molecular dynamics–based approaches are highly sensitive to the initial structure. However, there is currently no efficient way to predict such poses. Indeed, we assess the capabilities of three proposed AI-based software solutions (AlphaFold3, Boltz and RoseTTAFold All-Atom) and demonstrate their substantial shortcomings in this context. Here, we present a combined physics-and machine-learning-based method that predicts optimal protein-ligand poses in their relaxed states, enabling rapid and cost-effective downstream estimation of binding affinities. We apply our approach to two targets, tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) and the 3C-like protease (3CLPro), using datasets of 10,000 molecules for each system. Evaluation on an external validation set of approximately 3,000 molecules demonstrates the method’s ability to generalize to previously unseen datasets, aligning with the practical needs of high-throughput drug discovery pipelines that iteratively evaluate new molecules. items.authors: Agastya P Bhati, Jinyu Dong, Sean Black, Shunzhou Wan, Vineeth Gutta, Xibei Zhang

items.title: Interlayer Mismatch and Solvated Intermediates Control Spacer Mixing in 2D Perovskites
items.title_zh: 层间不匹配与溶剂中间体控制二维钙钛矿的间隔体混合
items.summary_zh: 有机间隔体混合是一种调节二维层状卤化钙钛矿（2DLHPs）结构和性质的多功能策略，但影响混合配置的因素仍不清楚。本文研究了烷基单铵Ruddlesden–Popper（RP）和烷基双铵Dion–Jacobson（DJ）2DLHP的混合物，识别出三种结构结果：合金化、相分离和超晶格形成。在二十种间隔体组合中，母体钙钛矿之间的层间间距不匹配在很大程度上决定了结果，小的不匹配有利于合金化，而大的不匹配则有利于相分离。超晶格相的周期超过任一母体，仅在大不匹配且仅对含有1,4-丁二胺（DC4）的混合物形成。原位吸收光谱和单晶结构测定显示，超晶格形成通过含有二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的中间体进行，其中DC4和正戊基铵（C5）占据不同的桥接和插层晶体学位置，产生有序前驱体，经过退火转变为超晶格。结构不匹配和中间相化学共同决定了混合间隔体2DLHPs中的合金化、相分离和超晶格形成。
items.abstract: Organic spacer mixing is a versatile strategy for tuning the structure and properties of two-dimensional layered halide perovskites (2DLHPs), yet the factors that govern the resulting mixing configuration remain poorly understood. Here we investigate mixtures of alkyl monoammonium Ruddlesden–Popper (RP) and alkyl diammonium Dion–Jacobson (DJ) 2DLHPs and identify three structural outcomes: alloying, phase separation, and superlattice formation. Across twenty spacer combinations, the interlayer-spacing mismatch between the parent perovskites largely determines the outcome, with small mismatch favoring alloys and large mismatch favoring phase separation. A superlattice phase with a period exceeding either parent, consistent with alternating RP and DJ layers, forms only at large mismatch and only for blends containing 1,4-butanediammonium (DC4). In situ absorption spectroscopy and single-crystal structure determination reveal that superlattice formation proceeds through a dimethylformamide (DMF)-containing intermediate in which DC4 and n-pentylammonium (C5) occupy distinct bridging and intercalated crystallographic sites, producing an ordered precursor that converts to the superlattice
items.authors: Yunhao Wei, Perry W. Martin, Rae A. Hunter, Bobby G. Duersch, Ryan T. VanderLinden, Connor G. Bischak

items.title: Steric Repulsion Driven Formation of a 3D Covalent Organic Framework Polymorph with Exceptionally High Surface Area
items.title_zh: 立体排斥驱动的高比表面积三维共价有机框架多晶型形成
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种基于三苯基四醛连接体的亚胺连接共价有机框架（COF）的维度多晶型。该连接体功能化了两个笨基苯甲酸甲酯基团，能够采用平面或伪四面体构象。研究发现，在广泛的条件下，该系统形成了2D-kgm COF，而在精确控制少量水的情况下，获得了第二种高度结晶且多孔的3D-dia COF。该相在超临界二氧化碳激活后得以保留，而2D-kgm COF在有无超临界二氧化碳下均可保留，强调了激活在寻找3D相中的重要性。立体拥挤限制了相互渗透的程度，使得3D-dia相的BET比表面积高达3883 m²/g，且在273 K和19.5 bar下的高压CO2吸附量为31.9 mmol/g，相比之下，2D-kgm相的性能显著较低。
items.abstract: Dimensional polymorphism, in which the same molecular building blocks form frameworks of different dimensionality, offers a direct route to distinct pore architectures in covalent organic frameworks (COFs). True 2D/3D polymorphism remains rare, since linkers capable of forming both 2D and 3D COFs tend to favor 2D structures. Accessing 3D polymorphs remains a challenge. We investigated the dimensional polymorphism in an imine-linked COF based on a terphenyl tetraaldehyde linker core, which is functionalized with two bulky methyl benzoate groups, and p-phenylenediamine. The tetraaldehyde linker can adopt planar or pseudo-tetrahedral conformations, while the methyl benzoate groups introduce steric crowding within the framework. Under a wide range of conditions, the system forms a 2D-kgm COF, whereas precise control over small amounts of water gives access to a second highly crystalline and highly porous 3D-dia COF. This phase is retained only after supercritical CO2 activation, while the 2D-kgm COF is retained with and without scCO2, highlighting the importance of activation in the search for 3D phases. items.authors: Alena Winter, Simona Bassoli, Emma Regincós Martí, David J. Ashworth, Farzad Hamdi, Alaa Shaikhqasem

items.title: Optimizing Affinity and Pharmacokinetics of a Cysteine-sulfoxide Derivative as Potential Inhibitor of BACE-1 using Fragment Growing and Molecular Dynamics
items.title_zh: 优化半胱氨酸亚砜衍生物作为BACE-1抑制剂的亲和力与药代动力学
items.summary_zh: 本研究以大蒜素（S-(2-丙烯基)-L-半胱氨酸亚砜）为基础，探索其作为BACE-1潜在抑制剂的可能性，尽管其药代动力学表现较差。我们通过在活性位点的亚口袋中扩展配体，优化药代动力学参数并提高亲和力。采用Schrodinger的配体设计模块进行片段生长，将2-丙烯基-大蒜素从两端扩展，并以多参数优化（MPO）评分为指导。经过500ns的分子动力学模拟，选定的配体C37、C47和C57的MPO评分均超过0.9，LogP显著提高至1.129至2.147，分子量从358g/mol提升至384g/mol。所有衍生物在模拟过程中与天冬氨酸二聚体保持稳定的电荷接触，C47和C57则通过吡啶侧链与Phe112形成π-π相互作用。计算的结合自由能（BFE）显示C47和C57的值分别为-52.29 ± 5.56 kcal/mol和-59.40 ± 4.66，明显高于2-丙烯基-大蒜素。
items.abstract: Alliin (S-(2-propenyl)-L-cysteine sulfoxide) was initially identified as a potential inhibitor of BACE-1, with the ability to chelate the catalytic dyad, but with very poor pharmacokinetics. We aimed to optimize these pharmacokinetic parameters, with a possible gain in affinity by growing the ligand towards the sub-pocket of the active site under the flaps. We employed fragment growing, implemented in the ligand designer module of Schrodinger, to extend 2-propenyl-alliin (a derivative of alliin) from both ends, with the multiparameter optimization (MPO) score as a guide. Select hits were further validated using molecular dynamics simulations for 500ns in explicit water. Ligands C37, C47, and C57 showed MPO scores above 0.9 with great improvements in LogP ranging from 1.129 to 2.147 and MW from 358g/mol to 384g/mol compared to -0.421 and 225.35g/mol in 2-propenyl-alliin, respectively. All the derivatives maintained an iron-clad charged contacts with the aspartic dyad throughout the simulation; while C47 and C57 made π-π interactions with Phe112 under the flap, using their pyridine side chains. items.title: A Solid-Phase Platform for Site-Specific Thiolation and Thioether Functionalization of DNA Oligonucleotides
items.title_zh: 固相平台用于DNA寡核苷酸的位点特异性硫化和硫醚功能化
items.summary_zh: 硫核苷基因具有独特的氢键、电子和光化学特性，但其在DNA中的位点特异性引入通常需要专门的含硫磷酰胺和多步单体合成。本文建立了一种统一的协议，使用氢硫酸钠（NaSH）和1,8-二氮杂双环[5.4.0]十一烯（DBU），实现了8-溴-2′-脱氧腺苷（Br 8 dA）向8-硫-2′-脱氧腺苷（s 8 dA）的直接转化、C8硫醚的多样化以及在单一DNA链中同时转化Br 8 dA和4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶。通过标准固相合成引入电亲核前体核苷，并在寡核苷酸保持支撑结合的状态下进行转化。首次使用2-(三甲基硅基)乙硫醇演示了Br 8 dA向s 8 dA的转化，随后直接使用NaSH·xH2O实现，省去了单独的氟介导去保护步骤。C8位的取代与混合序列、多重修饰及多种脂肪族和芳香族硫醇兼容，支持多样化含硫功能的后期安装。相同的支撑结合协议应用于4-三唑基胸腺嘧啶，获得了含有一个或多个4-硫胸腺嘧啶（s 4 T）残基的DNA，并且两种硫核苷基因可以在同一链中生成。
items.abstract: Thionucleobases provide distinctive hydrogen-bonding, electronic, and photochemical properties, but their site-specific incorporation into DNA often requires specialized sulfurcontaining phosphoramidites and multistep monomer synthesis. Here, we establish a unified protocol using sodium hydrosulfide (NaSH) and 1,8-diazabicyclo[5.4.0]undec-7-ene (DBU) for direct on-support conversion of 8-bromo-2′-deoxyadenosine (Br 8 dA) to 8-thio-2′deoxyadenosine (s 8 dA), late-stage C8 thioether diversification, and concurrent conversion of Br 8 dA and 4-triazolylthymidine within a single DNA strand. Electrophilic precursor nucleosides were incorporated by standard solid-phase synthesis and subsequently converted while the oligonucleotide remained support-bound. Conversion of Br 8 dA to s 8 dA was first demonstrated using 2-(trimethylsilyl)ethanethiol and subsequently achieved directly with NaSH·xH2O, eliminating the need for a separate fluoride-mediated deprotection step. Substitution at the C8 was compatible with mixed sequences, multiple modifications, and a range of aliphatic and aromatic thiols, enabling late-stage installation of diverse sulfurcontaining functionalities. items.title: A Dinucleating β-Thio-δ-Diiminate Ligand Enables Metal-Dependent CO2 Reactivity in Homo- and Heterobimetallic Zn and Cu Complexes
items.title_zh: 一种双核β-硫-δ-二亚胺配体促进金属依赖的CO2反应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了β-硫-δ-二亚胺（BTDDI）配体，作为已建立的BODDI框架的含硫类似物，应用于单金属和双金属Cu(I)及Zn(II)化学。通过顺序金属化实现选择性构建同金属和异金属复合物，包括首个结构表征的Cu/Zn衍生物。中心氧供体被硫替换，扩展了双核框架，显著增加了金属间距。这些复合物对CO2的反应性强烈依赖于金属种类和核数：单金属Cu(I)和Zn(II)复合物及同金属Cu(I)类似物不反应，而Cu/Zn和二Zn复合物则能激活CO2。二Zn复合物在配体主链的γ位选择性形成C–C键，生成一种可逆形成的含羧酸盐的产物，具有不寻常的三足[N,S,O]供体结构。各类实验和DFT计算表明，二金属复合物的γ-C插入能量障碍显著降低，Zn(II)通过Zn–O相互作用和后续二聚化对羧酸盐的稳定化起关键作用。
items.abstract: Herein, we investigate the β-thio-δ-diimine (BTDDI) ligand, recently reported as a sulfur containing analogue of the established BODDI framework, as a platform for mono- and bimetallic Cu(I) and Zn(II) chemistry. Sequential metalation enables selective access to homo- and heterobimetallic complexes, including the first structurally characterised Cu/Zn derivative of this ligand class. Replacement of the central oxygen donor by sulfur expands the dinuclear framework, resulting in significantly increased metal–metal separations. The reactivity of these complexes towards CO 2 is strongly dependent on both metal identity and nuclearity: monometallic Cu(I) and Zn(II) complexes and the homobimetallic Cu(I) analogue are unreactive, whereas the Cu/Zn and di-Zn complexes undergo CO 2 activation. The di-Zn complex undergoes selective C–C bond formation at the γ-position of the ligand backbone to give a reversibly formed carboxylate-containing product featuring an unusual tripodal [N,S,O] donor motif. Isotopic labelling, spectroscopic and structural studies establish incorporation of CO 2 into the ligand framework, while DFT calculations reveal substantially lower barriers to γ-C insertion for
items.authors: Jamie Allen, Diney S. Shanfrezan, Grace E. Linford-Wood, Tobias Krämer, Alexander F. R. Kilpatrick

items.title: μ-Oxo-Bridged Iodine(III) Reagents Enable Catalyst- and Light-Free Fluoro(halo)methyl Radical Generation
items.title_zh: μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂实现无催化剂和光照的氟(卤)甲基自由基生成
items.summary_zh: 传统的自由基氟烷基化通常需要外源催化剂或光激活以克服显著的动力学障碍。本文报道了稳定的μ-氧桥接碘(III)试剂，在加热条件下无需外部催化剂、添加剂或光照即可释放氟(卤)甲基自由基。这些自由基能够引发甲基丙烯酰胺和甲基丙烯酰肼的级联环化反应，生成氟化的氧吲哚、吡唑酮及相关杂环化合物。通过改变碘(III)试剂框架内的氟化羧酸盐配体，可以控制转移的C1片段的种类，从而从相同的试剂结构中获得氯氟甲基、溴氟甲基、二氟甲基和单氟甲基产物。该转化适用于结构多样的天然产物衍生底物，并在放大时高效进行。通过将所需的键松弛性直接编码到碘(III)框架中，该策略为无催化剂、添加剂和光照的氟化C1自由基生成及其在复杂分子框架中的引入建立了通用平台。
items.abstract: While conventional radical fluoroalkylation typically requires exogenous catalysts or photoactivation to overcome significant kinetic barriers, here we report bench-stable μ-oxo-bridged iodine(III) reagents that release fluoro(halo)methyl radicals upon heating without an external catalyst, additive, or light. The resulting radicals initiate cascade cyclizations of methacrylamides and methacrylohydrazides to afford fluorinated oxindoles, pyrazolones, and related heterocycles. Variation of the fluorinated carboxylate ligand within the iodine(III) reagent framework controls the identity of the transferred C1 fragment, thereby providing chlorofluoromethyl, bromofluoromethyl, difluoromethyl, and monofluoromethyl products from a common reagent architecture. The transformation is compatible with structurally diverse and natural-product-derived substrates and proceeds efficiently upon scale-up. By encoding the required bond lability directly into the iodine(III) framework, this strategy establishes a general platform for the catalyst-, additive-, and light-free generation and incorporation of fluorinated C1 radicals into complex molecular frameworks.
items.authors: Anupam Das, Nagarajan Ramkumar, Artis Kinēns, Sergey Belyakov, Andris Antuzevičs, Janis Veliks

items.title: Machine learning-enabled prediction of dynamic vertical triplet energies underscores the role of vibrational anharmonicity in energy transfer
items.title_zh: 机器学习预测动态垂直三重态能量及其振动非谐性的作用
items.summary_zh: 三重态能量的概念长期以来是光化学中能量转移反应性的预测指标，但对于许多有机系统，其可靠的计算确定仍然具有挑战性。最近提出的动态垂直三重态能量（DvTE）框架将三重态能量重新定义为从分子动力学轨迹中采样的瞬时垂直能隙的统计集，平均绝对误差为1.7 kcal/mol，然而其计算成本限制了更广泛的应用。本文引入DvTE-ML，扩展了机器学习的原子间势能到动态的、基于集体的激发态性质预测。DvTE-ML通过微调MACE-OMOL基础模型，结合路径积分分子动力学显式捕捉核量子效应，并采用迭代过滤工作流程解决开放壳层训练数据固有的状态误差污染风险。应用于52种有机分子，包括以前在理论参考水平上难以处理的生物相关系统，DvTE-ML的准确性与原始DvTE框架相匹配。更高分辨率的采样揭示能隙分布可能偏离先前假设的正态形式，振动非谐性导致分布偏斜。
items.abstract: The concept of triplet energy has long served as the operative predictor of energy transfer reactivity in photochemistry, yet its reliable computational determination remains challenging for many organic systems. The recently introduced dynamic vertical triplet energy (DvTE) framework recasts triplet energy as a statistical ensemble of instantaneous vertical gaps sampled from molecular dynamics trajectories, achieving mean absolute errors of 1.7 kcal/mol against experimental data, but at a computational cost that limits its broader application. Here, DvTE-ML is introduced, which extends machine-learned interatomic potentials to dynamic, ensemble-based prediction of excited-state properties. Built by fine-tuning the MACE-OMOL foundation model, DvTE-ML incorporates path integral molecular dynamics to capture nuclear quantum effects explicitly, alongside an iterative filtering workflow that addresses a state-error contamination risk intrinsic to open-shell training data. Applied to a diverse set of 52 organic molecules, including biologically relevant systems previously intractable at the reference level of theory, DvTE-ML matches the accuracy of the original DvTE framework. items.title: Residue-Conditioned In-Pocket Design for Paralogue Selectivity
items.title_zh: 基于残基条件的选择性设计方法研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种基于结构的生成模型，用于在蛋白质活性位点内探索化学空间，优先考虑候选分子。我们评估了设计结果在目标蛋白与其近亲同源蛋白之间的选择性，并结合了残基水平的条件和共价结合位点的设计。设计循环中，每轮引入一个化学基团，针对在选择的反目标中标记为不同的口袋残基，同时保持结构连续性。反目标口袋通过仅突变目标结构中的不同位点构建，从而确保两者在这些残基上存在差异。通过17个设计实验，最终选定的骨架在每个最终候选中均得以保留。与文献中针对12个受体对的44个参考化合物比较，19次比较中保持了已建立的识别化学，且无关活性诱饵率为12.6%。生成的候选分子与已知抑制剂的结构关系良好，包括与伊马替尼共享78%的核心结构，以及与厄洛替尼共享59%的核心，同时引入了替代化学策略。
items.abstract: Structure based generative model explore chemical spaces inside the protein active site , typically prioritizing candidates through empirical scoring functions.Few evaluate wthether the results is selective for the intended protein over a close paralogue , and none of them combines that evaluation with residue level conditioning and covalent bounds placement . In this paper we describe a design loop in which each rounds installs one chemical group aimed at one named pocket residue that a pairwise alignment marks as divergent in a chosen anti target , subject while enforcing structural continuity by requiring each successive molecule to retain its predecessor as a substructure. The anti target pocket is built by mutating only the divergent position within the target's own structure , so the two differ at those residues and nowhere else . Across 17 design campaigns the selected scaffold was retained in every final lead . items.title: A Pan-YTHDF Probe Enables Chemical Modulation and Dissection of RNA m6A Reader Programs
items.title_zh: 一种全能YTHDF化学探针用于调控RNA m6A识别程序
items.summary_zh: RNA修饰结合蛋白（读者）的功能通常通过基因干扰来定义，但基因敲除方法无法区分依赖于修饰的读者活性与其他蛋白相关功能。小分子提供了一种正交策略，通过直接干扰读者蛋白与RNA的识别事件，同时保留读者蛋白。我们开发了DF142，这是一种通过m6A锚定设计策略获得的细胞活性全能YTHDF化学探针。结构导向优化获得了高亲和力配体，能够结合内源性YTHDF蛋白，阻断YTHDF与m6A RNA的识别，并显示出良好的选择性。在小鼠B细胞中，DF142的转录效应与Ythdf1/2基因缺失相似，但在Ythdf1/2缺失细胞中仅产生最小影响，区分了m6A依赖和假定的m6A独立程序。在急性髓性白血病细胞中，DF142的应用揭示了与YTHDF–m6A相互作用相关的白血病相关RNA程序。这些发现确立了DF142作为解析m6A依赖YTHDF生物学的化学探针的价值。
items.abstract: Genetic perturbation has been central to defining the functions of RNA modification binding proteins (readers), but knockout approaches remove the entire protein and cannot readily distinguish modification-dependent reader activity from other protein-associated functions. Small molecules provide an orthogonal strategy by directly perturbing the reader protein–RNA recognition event while preserving the reader protein. Here we report DF142, a cell-active pan-YTHDF chemical probe developed through an m6A-anchored design strategy. Structure-guided optimization yielded a high-affinity ligand that engages endogenous YTHDF proteins, blocks YTHDF–m6A RNA recognition, and displays a favorable selectivity profile. In mouse B cells, DF142 closely recapitulated the transcriptional effects of genetic Ythdf1/2 loss but induced minimal effects in Ythdf1/2-deficient cells at the applied dose range, distinguishing m6A-dependent from putative m6A-independent programs. In AML cells, application of DF142 revealed a leukemia-relevant RNA program associated with YTHDF–m6A interactions. Its activity in cancer cells and mouse models further demonstrates the utility of DF142 for interrogating YTHDF functio
items.authors: Wenlong Li, Linda Zhang, Zhong Zheng, Pingluan Wang, Yutao Zhao, Yanming Chen

items.title: The Chemistry of the Golgi-Cox Stain
items.title_zh: 高尔基-考克斯染色的化学机制研究
items.summary_zh: 本综述对高尔基-考克斯染色进行了理论讨论和实验研究。尽管该方法在组织学中已使用数百年且操作相对简单，但其化学机制仍存在显著不确定性。我们提出高尔基-考克斯染色并非简单的染料扩散过程，而是组织结构、固定、铬介导的氧化还原化学、汞结合、pH值和细胞成分之间相互作用的结果。膜和脂质的完整性影响染色，而铬依赖的pH和氧化还原状态变化则创造了后续汞反应所需的化学条件，只有少数神经元适合这一“恰到好处”的区域，从而成功染色。基于我们的综述和实验研究，我们提出了高尔基-考克斯染色的首个综合机制。我们的文献调查和实验数据为新手和经验丰富的组织学从业者提供了参考资源。
items.abstract: Our review provides both a theoretical discussion and experimental investigation of the Golgi–Cox stain. While this procedure has been a mainstay in the histologist’s toolkit for centuries and is implemented quite straightforwardly, there is still significant uncertainty around the chemistry. As such, it remains unclear how the stain works and, therefore, how it can be improved to be safer, faster, more reliable and work for larger specimens. Here, we provide technical and chemical considerations supplemented with original experimental observation on tissue clearing methods. Our findings suggest that Golgi–Cox staining cannot be understood as a simple process of stain diffusion, but rather as the outcome of interactions between tissue structure, fixation, chromate-mediated redox chemistry, mercury binding, pH, and cellular composition. Membrane and lipid integrity influence impregnation, while chromate-dependent changes in pH and redox state create the chemical conditions necessary for subsequent mercury reactions whereby only a few neurons fit within this goldilocks zone and are thus successfully stained. items.authors: Brooklyn Rose Wright, Karen Hakobyan, George Paxinos, Mustafa S. Kassem

items.title: Fully Atomistic Vibrational Free Energy of Molecular Crystals Using Distributed Multipole Moments
items.title_zh: 分布多极矩法下分子晶体的全原子振动自由能研究
items.summary_zh: 预测给定温度和压力下分子的最稳定晶体结构仍然具有挑战性。现有的晶体结构预测方法主要集中在0 K下识别最低晶格能的结构，但越来越多的研究认识到，准确的预测需要在感兴趣的温度下评估振动自由能。当前的工作流程通常在少数假设结构上进行计算密集型的原子电子结构计算，或在更多结构上使用成本较低但精度较差的力场方法。为此，我们首次提出了允许全原子处理分子灵活性的晶格动力学表达式，并在常用的晶体结构预测力场中应用分布多极矩模型。我们在CrystalDynamics算法中实现了这些表达式，以计算色散曲线、声子态密度和振动自由能。我们展示了CrystalDynamics在三种不同大小和灵活性的分子晶体中的应用。
items.abstract: Predicting the most stable crystal structure of a given molecule at given temperature and pressure remains challenging. While many crystal structure prediction (CSP) methods focus on identifying the structures with the lowest lattice energy at 0 K, there is growing recognition that accurate predictions require evaluating the vibrational free energy at the temperature(s) of interest. In current workflows, such evaluation is either carried out on a few putative structures using computationally demanding atomistic electronic structure calculations or on a larger number of structures using less expensive and less accurate force field approaches under the rigid-body approximation. There is thus a need for methods that offer a better compromise between accuracy and computational cost. We present, for the first time, lattice dynamics expressions that allow for a fully atomistic treatment of molecular flexibility with a force field commonly used in CSP, where electrostatic interactions are modelled with distributed multipole moments. items.authors: Stefanos Konstantinopoulos, Claire S. Adjiman

items.title: Photophysics and Triplet Sensitization of the Molecular Lanthanide YbQ3
items.title_zh: 分子镱化合物YbQ3的光物理特性与三重态敏化研究
items.summary_zh: 有机配体与基于镧系元素的近红外发射体（如镱离子Yb3+）之间的能量转移机制具有重要的光物理意义。近年来，镧系元素因其在多种应用中的上转换和下转换能力而受到关注。本文研究了在镱三(8-羟基喹啉)（YbQ3）分子中，配体到Yb3+的分子内三重态能量转移，以及通过二价钯八乙基卟啉（PdOEP）对Yb3+的分子间敏化。研究发现，分子内敏化使Yb3+的光致发光量子产率（PLQY）达到(9.7 ± 1.0)%，而局部配体环境导致镧系发射寿命相对较短，为12.1 ± 0.1 µs。在YbQ3/PdOEP混合物中的分子间能量转移机制由PdOEP的磷光动态猝灭主导，尽管能量转移的碰撞概率相对较弱，但在选择性激发PdOEP时，Yb3+的PLQY为(4.5 ± 0.7)%。这些结果表明，三重态可以有效地作为近红外镧系元素的敏化剂。
items.abstract: The energy transfer mechanism between organic ligands and lanthanide-based near-infrared emitters, such as ytterbium ions (Yb3+), is of great photophysical interest. In recent years, lanthanides have attracted attention for their capacity for both up-and down-conversion for a range of applications. While lanthanides generally have extremely small absorption cross-sections, their light-matter interaction can be complemented by an appropriate choice of chromophore ligand. Here, we investigate intramolecular ligand-to-Yb3+ triplet energy transfer in ytterbium tris(8-hydroxyquinoline) (YbQ3) molecule as well as the intermolecular sensitization of Yb3+ by palladium(II) octaethylporphyrin (PdOEP). We find that the intramolecular sensitization leads to a Yb3+ photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of (9.7 ± 1.0)% and and that the local ligand environment results in a relatively short lanthanide emission lifetime of 12.1 ± 0.1 µs. As for the intermolecular energy transfer mechanism in the YbQ3/PdOEP mixture, this is governed by a dynamic quenching of the phosphorescence from PdOEP. items.title: Embedded Morgan Fingerprints for more efficient molecular property predictions with machine learning
items.title_zh: 嵌入式摩根指纹提升分子性质预测效率
items.summary_zh: 高维分子指纹已成为化学机器学习的瓶颈，数据集中的位碰撞和计算成本上升限制了模型的发现。本研究提出了嵌入式摩根指纹（eMFP），一种后处理方案，将标准摩根指纹压缩为连续值的低维表示，受压缩因子q控制。应用于三个逐渐增大的分子数据集（RedDB、非富勒烯受体和QM9），在考虑骨架的嵌套交叉验证下，eMFP在适度压缩（q≤32）时保持了树基方法的预测能力，同时在其他情况下表现出更依赖模型和设置的行为。其连续输出与傅里叶特征神经网络配合良好，能更自然地与正弦特征映射交互，并持续缩短每次试验的训练时间。这些结果使eMFP成为一种简单的、可扩展的分子表示方法，能够保持准确性，同时减轻模型开发的计算负担。
items.abstract: High-dimensional molecular fingerprints have become a quiet bottleneck for chemical machine learning, where bit collisions in large, chemically diverse datasets and escalating computational costs constrain model discovery. This work introduces the embedded Morgan Fingerprint (eMFP), a post-processing scheme that compresses standard Morgan Fingerprints into continuously valued, lower-dimensional representations governed by a compression factor q. Applied to three molecular datasets of increasing size (RedDB, Non-Fullerene Acceptors and QM9), five regression models and four encoding configurations under scaffold-aware nested cross-validation, eMFP maintains the predictive power of full-length fingerprints for tree-based methods at moderate compression (q≤32), while exhibiting more model- and setting-dependent behaviour elsewhere. Its continuous outputs pair favourably with Fourier Feature Neural Networks, where they interact more naturally with sinusoidal feature mappings than the original binary fingerprints, and consistently shorten training times per trial. Together, these results position eMFP as a simple, drop-in route to more scalable molecular representations that retain accur
items.authors: Emilio Nuñez-Andrade, Isaac Vidal-Daza, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli, James W. Ryan, Francisco J. Martin-Martinez

items.title: Chemically Neutral, Electrokinetically Charged: Ligand Shell Thickness Governs the Zeta Potential and In Vivo Fate of Ultrasmall HfO2 Nanoparticles
items.title_zh: 化学中性、电动带电：配体壳厚度影响超小HfO2纳米粒子的电位与体内命运
items.summary_zh: 纳米粒子在生物领域广泛研究，其核心成分决定特定功能，而表面化学则影响与生物环境的相互作用。本研究以超小（直径5纳米）氧化铪纳米粒子为模型，因其生物相容性及在对比增强X射线计算机断层扫描和外束放疗中的应用。我们系统比较了三种表面配体，均具有相同的高亲和力硝基儿茶酚锚定基团，但末端基团不同：短链乙二醇（EG）寡聚物、2 kDa聚乙二醇（PEG）聚合物和短链两性离子（ZW）链。尽管所有配体尾部均为中性，只有长链PEG产生了接近中性的电位。短链配体的纳米粒子电位显著负值（-30 mV），是其胶体稳定性的重要因素。用短链EG或ZW配体稳定的纳米粒子在体外被THP-1巨噬细胞摄取增强，在斑马鱼幼体中循环时间短，尽管ZW纳米粒子抑制了蛋白冠形成。ZW纳米粒子表现出抗污但非隐形行为，而长链PEG稳定的纳米粒子则大部分逃避了吞噬细胞系统的检测。
items.abstract: Nanoparticles are extensively explored in biological contexts, and while their core composition determines their specific functionality, surface chemistry governs their interactions with the biological environment. In this work, we used ultrasmall (d 5 nm) hafnium oxide nanoparticles as a model system, given their biocompatibility and established use in contrast-enhanced X-ray computed tomography and external-beam radiotherapy. We systematically compared three surface ligands featuring the same high-affinity nitrocatechol anchoring group but different terminal moieties: a short ethylene glycol (EG) oligomer, a 2 kDa polyethylene glycol (PEG) polymer, and a short zwitterionic (ZW) chain. Despite the neutral character of all ligand tails, only the long PEG chains yielded nanoparticles with a near-neutral zeta potential. The short ligands produced nanoparticles with significantly negative zeta potentials (-30 mV), which was found to be an essential component of their colloidal stability. NPs stabilized with short EG or ZW ligands exhibited enhanced uptake by THP-1 macrophages in vitro and short circulation times in vivo in zebrafish larvae, despite suppressed protein corona formation
items.authors: Elizaveta Maksimova, David Wang, Megan Stierli, Nikolina Veljancic, Oya Tagit, Jörg Huwyler

items.title: A Catalyst Discovery Workflow Coupling MLIP with MOBO for Nitrite-to-Hydroxylamine Electroreduction
items.title_zh: 结合机器学习与多目标优化的亚硝酸盐电还原催化剂发现工作流程
items.summary_zh: 亚硝酸盐电还原为羟胺的选择性受多步耦合反应的影响，无法仅通过单一吸附描述符的火山关系来表征。为解决这一局限，本文开发了一种将机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）与多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）相结合的催化剂发现工作流程。通过一小组物理描述符，将离散的氧化物-掺杂剂候选者映射到低维连续表示，同时四个热力学目标描述了NH2OH形成中的竞争步骤。MLIP为氧化物候选者提供统一、低成本的结构和能量评估。高斯过程代理模型结合期望超体积改进，依次从离散池中选择候选者，并在固定评估预算内更新帕累托前沿。该工作流程整合了化学目标、能量评估和顺序决策，适用于氧化物体系的催化剂筛选。
items.abstract: The selectivity of electrocatalytic nitrite reduction to hydroxylamine is governed by multiple coupled steps within the multi-electron nitrogen–oxygen reduction network, which cannot be represented simultaneously by a volcano relation based on a single adsorption descriptor. To address this limitation, a catalyst discovery workflow coupling machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is developed. A small set of physical descriptors maps discrete oxide–dopant candidates onto a low-dimensional continuous representation, while four thermodynamic objectives describe the competing steps in NH2OH formation. The MLIP provides unified, low-cost structural and energy evaluation for oxide candidates. A Gaussian process surrogate model together with expected hypervolume improvement sequentially selects candidates from the discrete pool and updates the Pareto front within a fixed evaluation budget. The workflow integrates chemical objectives, energy evaluation, and sequential decision-making for catalyst screening in oxide systems.
items.authors: Zhiyi Yu, Huaiwen Zhang, Weiming Zhao

items.title: CuBr-Catalyzed Enantioselective Synthesis of Decahydroquinoxaline-Based
items.title_zh: CuBr催化的对映选择性合成十氢喹啉基化合物
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种CuBr催化的一锅法合成十氢喹啉基双(丙炔胺)的方法，反应原料为易得的末端炔烃、芳香醛和C2对称手性二胺。三组分耦合反应在120°C下进行12小时，产物收率为58-93%，其非对映体比高达99:1。通过ZnI2介导的转化示例，展示了代表性双(丙炔胺)(7a)转化为相应的轴手性烯烃(8a)，其对映体过量为90%。该方法实现了双(丙炔胺)的立体选择性构建，并展示了其作为轴手性烯烃前体的应用潜力。
items.abstract: A CuBr-catalyzed one-pot protocol provides access to decahydroquinoxaline-based bis(propargylamines) from readily available terminal alkynes, aromatic aldehydes, and a C2symmetric chiral diamine. The three-component coupling proceeds at 120 °C within 12 h, affording the products in 58–93% yields with diastereomeric ratios of up to 99:1. The synthetic utility of the protocol is illustrated by the ZnI2-mediated conversion of a representative bis(propargylamine) (7a) into the corresponding axially chiral allene (8a) with 90% ee. This approach enables the stereoselective construction of bis(propargylamines) and demonstrates their application as precursors to axially chiral allenes.
items.authors: Alakonda, Mariappan Periasamy

items.title: Localizing and quantifying the dynamic interfacial proton population in alkaline electrocatalysis
items.title_zh: 局部化与定量分析碱性电催化中的动态界面质子群体
items.summary_zh: 在碱性电催化中，静电理论预测并实验确认界面酸度偏离体相pHb。电双层（EDL）内质子群体的位置和大小及其随催化转化的演变尚未解决，成为质子耦合电催化机制解释的关键空白。本文通过在金（Au）上进行碱性（pHb 13）氢气演化的示范，结合电化学荧光显微镜与静电模型，展示了电极表面1 nm内的界面pH反转超过八个单位，位于外海尔姆霍兹平面以下。该EDL质子群体是动态的。在氢气演化开始时，反应可以从中提取质子。随着电催化转化的增加，H+的消耗速度超过其静电补充，促进了基于水的反应路径。局部化和定量分析这一动态质子群体填补了碱性氢气演化机制解释中的关键空白，质子可用性框架可能与广泛的碱性电催化和电合成相关。
items.abstract: In alkaline electrocatalysis, electrostatic theory predicts, and experiments confirm, interfacial acidity that deviates from bulk pHb. The location and magnitude of the proton population within the electric double layer (EDL) and its evolution with catalytic turnover have remained unresolved, leaving a critical gap for mechanistic interpretation across proton-coupled electrocatalysis. Here, using showcase alkaline (pHb 13) hydrogen evolution on Au, electrochemical fluorescence microscopy combined with electrostatic modelling demonstrates an apparent interfacial pH inversion of more than eight units within 1 nm of 1 the electrode, below the outer Helmholtz plane. This EDL proton population is dynamic. At hydrogen-evolution onset, the reaction can draw from it. As electrocatalytic turnover increases, H+ consumption outpaces its electrostatic replenishment, favouring a water-based reaction pathway. Localizing and quantifying this dynamic proton population closes a key gap in the mechanistic interpretation of alkaline hydrogen evolution with a proton-availability framework likely relevant to alkaline electrocatalysis and electrosynthesis at large.
items.authors: Xinwei Zhu, Daniel Ohm, Qiqi Yang, Adrian Heinritz, Paramaconi Rodriguez, Xiaomin Liu

items.title: Highly Luminescent Alkyl- and Alkoxy-Terminated Silicon Quantum Dots via Aging Following Single-Step Plasma Synthesis and Functionalization
items.title_zh: 通过老化提升硅量子点光致发光量子产率的研究
items.summary_zh: 非热等离子体合成技术能够在单一流动反应器中连续生产并即时表面功能化硅量子点（Si QDs）。然而，所得到的纳米晶体通常由于表面缺陷而导致光致发光量子产率（PLQY）较低。在本研究中，我们证明了通过在特定溶剂中老化Si QDs的简单后处理，可以将PLQY提升至约50%，接近更复杂溶液相方法的性能。表面配体和溶剂的选择至关重要：己醇终止的Si QDs表现出显著高于十烯终止颗粒的初始和最终PLQY，可能是由于醇类与气相中电亲和表面位点的反应更快。在所研究的溶剂中，氯仿始终提供最高的PLQY。此外，我们还发现400 nm和633 nm的光照射显著加速Si QD的老化过程，将老化时间从数百小时缩短至20小时以内。这一“合成后即忘”的策略为优化高PLQY Si QDs在光电和生物成像应用中的使用提供了高效途径。
items.abstract: Nonthermal plasma synthesis enables the continuous production and immediate surface functionalization of silicon quantum dots (Si QDs) in a single, flow-through reactor. While this process occurs on a millisecond timescale, the resulting nanocrystals are often limited by low photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQY) due to persistent surface defects. In this work, we demonstrate that a minimal post-treatment, aging the Si QDs in specific solvents, can enhance the PLQY to ~50%, approaching the performance of much more complex solution-phase methods. We find that the choice of the surface ligand and solvent is critical: hexanol-terminated Si QDs exhibit significantly higher initial and final PLQYs than decene-terminated particles, likely due to the faster reaction of alcohols with electrophilic surface sites in the gas phase. Among the solvents investigated, chloroform consistently yields the highest PLQY. Furthermore, we show that light irradiation at 400 nm and 633 nm drastically accelerates the Si QD aging process, reducing the aging time from hundreds of hours to under 20 hours. This practical “synthesize and forget” strategy offers an efficient pathway for optimizing high-PLQY Si
items.authors: Masoumeh Amirifard, Zhaohan Li, Uwe Kortshagen

items.title: Cobalt(III)-Catalyzed Synthesis of Aminoisoquinolones and Amino-2-Pyridones via C–H Functionalization with Ynamides: A Combined Experimental and Computational Study
items.title_zh: 钴(III)催化的氨基异喹啉和氨基-2-吡啶酮合成研究
items.summary_zh: 碳-氢（C–H）功能化方法通常依赖于电子贫乏的π-体系，而电子丰富的体系应用仍不成熟。本研究首次报道了钴催化的O-苯基羟肟酸与电子丰富的炔胺进行位点和区域选择性的C–H功能化，合成氨基异喹啉和2-吡啶酮。结合实验和计算的机理研究揭示了一个由Curtin–Hammett动力学主导的反应路径，特点是可逆的金属化去质子化、不可逆的选择性决定性迁移插入和限制转化的C–N还原消除。该转化通过不同的路径进行，主要的4-氨基异喹啉通过Co(III)循环生成，而次要的3-氨基异喹啉则经历Co(III)/Co(I)氧化还原过程。此外，常被提及的高价Co(V)氮烯中间体被排除在催化中。
items.abstract: Carbon–hydrogen (C–H) functionalization methodologies typically rely on electron-poor π-systems, whereas the engagement of electron-rich counterparts remains underdeveloped. Herein, we report the first cobalt-catalyzed, site- and regioselective C–H functionalization of O-phenyl hydroxamic acids with electron-rich ynamides to afford aminoisoquinolones and 2-pyridones. Combined experimental and computational mechanistic studies reveal a pathway governed by Curtin–Hammett kinetics, featuring reversible concerted metalation deprotonation, irreversible selectivitydetermining migratory insertion, and turnover-limiting C–N reductive elimination. The transformation proceeds via divergent pathways, wherein the major 4-aminoisoquinolone is generated through a Co(III) cycle and the minor 3aminoisoquinolone transits a Co(III)/Co(I) redox manifold. Furthermore, high-valent Co(V) nitrenoids, which are frequently invoked in related reactions, are ruled out as catalytic intermediates.
items.authors: Yujie Cao, Justin D. DeBow, Elise Mach, Melody Wu, Veronica Carta, Kevin G. M. Kou

items.title: Resolving Active Sites in Cu/ZnO Methanol Synthesis via Coupled Modelling of Surface Reconstruction and Coverage-dependent Kinetics
items.title_zh: 通过耦合建模解析Cu/ZnO甲醇合成的活性位点
items.summary_zh: 在异相催化中，识别活性位点对理解和设计催化剂至关重要，但在操作条件下，表面结构、吸附物覆盖率和反应动力学的共同演化使这一过程变得复杂。以ZnO/Cu催化剂的甲醇合成活性位点争议为例，我们结合全球结构探索、广义正则采样、反应性CuZnCHO机器学习势能和覆盖率一致的微动力学，建立了条件依赖的活性表面图景。研究表明，Zn-Cu合金、ZnO类覆盖层和部分还原的Zn物种并非互斥的活性位点模型，而是在同一动态结构景观中的不同状态。在中间热力学窗口内，Cu-Zn/Cu-Cu双功能集合体在台阶边缘附近形成，从而最大化活性。这些发现调和了看似矛盾的活性位点分配，并为理解复杂系统中的活性建立了通用框架。我们的研究方法为识别催化系统中的活性-结构关系提供了范例。
items.abstract: Identifying active sites in heterogeneous catalysis is central to fundamental understanding and designing catalysts, yet it becomes challenging when surface structures, adsorbate coverages and reaction kinetics co-evolve under operating conditions. This challenge is exemplified by the enduring controversy over the active site for methanol synthesis over ZnO/Cu catalysts. Here we combine global structure exploration, grand-canonical sampling, a reactive CuZnCHO machine-learning potential and coverage-consistent microkinetics to establish a condition-dependent picture of the active surface. We show that Zn-Cu alloys, ZnO-like overlayers and partially reduced Zn species are not mutually exclusive active-site models, but distinct states within the same dynamic structural landscape. Activity is maximized within an intermediate thermodynamic window, where a Cu-Zn/Cu-Cu bifunctional ensemble forms near a step rim. These findings reconcile seemingly conflicting active-site assignments and establish a general framework for understanding activity in complicated systems. More broadly, our approach provides a paradigm for identifying activity-structure relationships in catalytic systems.
items.authors: Zhening Fang, Chenyu Wu, Changxi Yang, Wenbo Xie, Zhi Liu, Peijun Hu

items.title: Hydrophobic Interaction as the Result of Interfacial Frustration
items.title_zh: 界面挫折导致的疏水相互作用
items.summary_zh: 疏水效应是分子生物学中最重要的组织原则之一，为蛋白质折叠、分子识别、膜自组装和别构通信等概念的解释奠定了基础。传统上，疏水结合被视为非极性表面周围水分子有序排列导致的熵释放驱动。然而，随着结构、动态和热量测定数据的积累，这一框架在某些方面显得不够完整。本文提出将疏水效应重新框定为界面挫折，即液态水的氢键需求与非极性表面之间的几何敏感不兼容。本文认为，疏水结合是对这种挫折的解决，而不仅仅是受限溶剂的排斥。这一重新框定为经典理论无法单独解释的现象提供了统一的机制性解释。
items.abstract: The hydrophobic effect is one of the most consequential organizing principles in molecular biology, laying the foundation for explanation of concepts like protein folding, molecular recognition, membrane self-assembly and allosteric communication. Its conceptual description remains dependent primarily on a framework established in the mid-twentieth century, as per which, hydrophobic association is driven primarily by the entropic release of water molecules ordered around non-polar surfaces. The framework, while thermodynamically correct, is incomplete in some ways that have become increasingly consequential as structural, dynamic and calorimetric data have been accumulated over the years. In this paper, I propose a reframing of the hydrophobic effect in terms of interfacial frustration- a continuous, geometry sensitive incompatibility between the hydrogen bond requirements of liquid water and non-polar surfaces it is forced to accommodate. This paper argues that hydrophobic association represents the resolution of this frustration, rather than the mere expulsion of constrained solvent. This reframing provides a unified mechanistic account of phenomena that the classical picture can
items.authors: Prithwish Mukherjee

items.title: DNA-Encoded Chemical Diversification of mRNA Display Libraries
items.title_zh: DNA编码的mRNA展示库化学多样性研究
items.summary_zh: mRNA展示技术能够筛选大量肽库，但其化学多样性受限于翻译过程。DNA编码库通过分裂-池化化学引入合成多样性，但缺乏翻译提供的肽支架和进化框架。本研究将这两种方法结合，在mRNA展示的肽上直接进行DNA编码的化学多样化。通过连续的DNA条形码步骤与半胱氨酸烷基化和赖氨酸酰化相结合，记录每个化学操作，同时保持肽与编码核酸之间的连接。对五肽库的应用生成了约2000万个名义化学结构。针对碳酸酐酶IX的筛选优先富集了编码羧基苯磺酰胺修饰的库成员，包括一个含赖氨酸的肽，其独立合成后显示与CAIX的结合常数Kd为26 nM。这些结果建立了从编码化学多样化、筛选到命中识别、重合成和结合验证的完整进程，为发现化学修饰的肽配体提供了实用框架。
items.abstract: mRNA display can survey vast peptide populations, but the chemical diversity available to selection remains largely constrained by translation. DNA-encoded libraries possess the complementary advantage: synthetic diversity can be introduced through split-and-pool chemistry, although without the peptide scaffolds and evolutionary framework provided by translation. Here, we combine these approaches by performing DNA-encoded chemical diversification directly on mRNAdisplayed peptides. Successive DNA-barcoding steps were coupled to cysteine alkylation and lysine acylation, allowing each chemical operation to be recorded while preserving the linkage between peptide and encoding nucleic acid. Application of this workflow to a five-residue peptide library generated approximately 20 million nominal chemical structures. Selection against carbonic anhydrase IX preferentially enriched library members encoded for a carboxybenzene sulfonamide modification, including a lysine-containing peptide that was independently resynthesized and shown to bind CAIX with a Kd of 26 nM. These results establish a complete progression from encoded chemical diversification and selection to hit identification, re
items.authors: Emily Anacleto, Emilyn B. Aucoin, Kirsten Monroe, Ryan Hili

items.title: Pt(II)-Flavin Complexes As Anticancer And Antibacterial Agents
items.title_zh: Pt(II)-黄素复合物作为抗癌和抗菌剂的研究
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一种新型的螯合吡啶-亚胺配体，该配体具有源自核黄素的侧链及其Pt(II)复合物1和2，旨在设计为顺铂和奥沙利铂类衍生物。两种复合物均与DNA和组蛋白衍生肽发生反应，其中复合物1显示出显著更高的共价反应性。然而，这一趋势在生物活性中并未体现。复合物2表现出微摩尔级的抗增殖效果和显著的抗菌活性，特别是对枯草芽孢杆菌，而复合物1在测试模型中无活性。细胞积累研究排除了增强的铂摄取作为差异的来源。对大肠杆菌和枯草芽孢杆菌进行的荧光显微镜观察表明，复合物2影响细菌DNA和膜电位，符合双重抗菌机制。与奥沙利铂和游离黄素配体的比较显示，Pt-草酸盐片段和含核黄素的配体均是活性所必需的。
items.abstract: We report a new chelating pyridyl–imine ligand bearing a riboflavin-derived pendant group and its Pt(II) complexes 1 and 2, designed as cisplatin- and oxaliplatin-like derivatives. Both complexes reacted with DNA and a histone-derived peptide, with 1 showing markedly higher covalent reactivity. However, this trend was not reflected in biological activity. Complex 2 displayed micromolar antiproliferative effects and pronounced antibacterial activity, particularly against Bacillus subtilis, whereas 1 was inactive in the tested models. Cellular accumulation studies excluded enhanced Pt uptake as the origin of this difference. Fluorescence microscopy performed on Escherichia Coli and Bacillus subtilis indicated that 2 affects bacterial DNA and membrane potential, consistent with a dual antibacterial mechanism. Comparison with oxaliplatin and the free flavin ligands showed that both the Pt–oxalate fragment and the riboflavin-containing ligand are required for activity.
items.authors: Maria Jesus Moran Plata, Igor V. Esarev, Nitin Kumar, Laura Marretta, Leo Pontfort, Ana Cristina Carrasco

items.title: Fundamental Investigations into the Activity and Stability of Iron-Based Bimetallic Catalysts for the Oxygen Evolution Reaction
items.title_zh: 铁基双金属催化剂在氧气演化反应中的活性与稳定性研究
items.summary_zh: 在碱性介质中，增强电催化剂抵抗降解的能力是开发稳定、丰富的氧气演化反应（OER）阳极的主要挑战。本文结合酸碱滴定和X射线荧光技术，定量分析了在1.66–2.11 VRHE下沉积在铁箔上的一系列双金属FexMy（氧）氢氧化物（My = Sn, Hf, Mn, Se）的铁溶解情况，发现表面稳定的电流密度和循环伏安法可能掩盖显著的电极降解。在初始重构后（约2小时），阳极的稳态溶解速率为0.15–0.67 mgFe cm⁻² h⁻¹，接近OER起始点（约1.75 VRHE）。不同合金的溶解速率与Fe–My的电负性差异相关，电负性低于Fe的合金溶解速率最高，XPS分析显示表面更还原，羟基配体浓度较高。DFT+U计算表明，Sn能还原邻近的Fe原子，降低OER的形成自由能，但可能加速Fe-O键的延长和溶解。我们建议，FeOOH表面的溶解抗性可能通过合金驱动的质子化状态调节来控制。
items.abstract: Engineering electrocatalyst resistance to degradation in alkaline media remains a major challenge for developing stable, earth-abundant oxygen evolution reaction (OER) anodes. Here, we combined acid–base titration and X-ray fluorescence to quantify Fe dissolution from a series of bimettalic FexMy (oxy)hydroxides deposited on Fe foils (My = Sn, Hf, Mn, Se) at 1.66–2.11 VRHE, showing that apparently stable current densities and cycle voltametery alone can mask significant electrode degradation. After initial restructuring (~2 h), end-of-life anodes showed steady-state dissolution rates of 0.15–0.67 mgFe cm⁻² h⁻¹ near OER onset (~1.75 VRHE). Across alloys, dissolution rates and OER overpotentials correlated with the Fe–My electronegativity difference. Dissolution rates were highest for those alloys where My was less electronegative than Fe, and XPS revealed a more reduced surface with higher concentrations of hydroxoligands. Spin-polarized DFT+U shows Sn reduces neighboring Fe atoms, shifting the potential-limiting OER step to Fe–O* formation, lowering its formation free energy (consistent with a reduced OER overpotential); but elongating Fe-O bonds (perhaps accelerating dissolution).
items.authors: Shayan Hoseini, Foroogh Khezeli, Ashley Head, Craig Plaisance, Theodore Walker

items.title: Predicting the Thermodynamic Stability of Ce/Ti Nanoclusters under Synthetic Conditions
items.title_zh: 预测合成条件下Ce/Ti纳米簇的热力学稳定性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在不同合成条件下形成的两种六核Ce/Ti簇：在温和条件下获得的黄色Ce IV 4 Ti 2簇和首次提出的红色Ce III 2 Ti 4簇，该簇需要更高的温度、更长的反应时间和增加的Ti前驱体浓度。为确定红色簇是热力学上不稳定还是动力学受阻，我们结合了显式溶剂的构型采样和基于密度泛函理论的吉布斯自由能计算。模拟退火法识别出能量比直接松弛晶体结构获得的构型低约1 eV的构型。尽管需要更强的合成条件，预测显示Ce III 2 Ti 4比Ce IV 4 Ti 2稳定4.48 eV。与假设的Ce IV 2 Ti 4簇的比较将这一差异分解为与Ce III氧化态相关的2.86 eV的稳定化。
items.abstract: Predicting which molecular species will form under a given set of synthetic conditions requires determining their thermodynamic stability relative to precursors and competing products. For complex molecular systems in solution, this requires both accurate electronic-structure calculations and sufficient configurational sampling. Here, we investigate two hexanuclear Ce/Ti clusters that form under different synthetic conditions: a yellow Ce IV 4 Ti 2 cluster obtained under mild conditions and a red Ce III 2 Ti 4 cluster, presented here for the first time, that requires higher temperature, longer reaction times, and increased Ti precursor concentration. To determine whether the red cluster is thermodynamically less stable or instead kinetically hindered, we combine explicit-solvent configurational sampling using a fine-tuned foundation machine-learned interatomic potential with density functional theory calculations of the Gibbs free energies of formation. Simulated annealing identifies configurations approximately 1 eV lower in energy than those obtained by direct relaxation of the crystallographic structures. items.authors: Liping Liu, Haley Wellman, Zi-Ming Ye, Andrea Darù, Ria Zaman, Kent O. Kirlikovali

items.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Eight Ru-based catalytic hydrogenolysis configurations for the upcycling of waste polyolefins
items.title_zh: 八种基于钌的催化氢解配置的生命周期评估
items.summary_zh: 近年来，全球塑料需求超过每年4亿吨。聚烯烃（如聚乙烯）因其机械和化学抗性及低成本，占全球塑料生产的50%以上，导致塑料废物的产生和积累。传统废物管理技术（如填埋和焚烧）会产生温室气体排放并可能造成有价值碳源的损失，而机械回收策略通常导致材料降解和机械性能损失。因此，化学回收技术作为低影响策略逐渐兴起。评估化学回收替代方案的潜在影响对支持开发者确保环境竞争力至关重要。为此，我们提出了对八种基于钌的聚乙烯催化氢解为有价值润滑剂和燃料的潜在替代方案的比较生命周期评估（LCA）。评估的配置采用不同的驱动方式：热能、机械能和热辅助机械化学配置。结果表明，能耗最高的配置承担了最高的环境负担，而热辅助机械化学过程则产生最低的影响。
items.abstract: In recent years, plastics demand has exceeded 400 million tons annually worldwide. Due to their mechanical and chemical resistance and low cost, polyolefins, including polyethylene (PE), represent beyond 50% of global plastic production, contributing to the generation and accumulation of plastic waste. Traditional waste management technologies, including landfilling and incineration, result into greenhouse gases emissions and potential loss of valuable carbon sources, whereas mechanical recycling strategies generally imply materials degradation and loss of mechanical properties. Hence, chemical recycling technologies are emerging as low-impact strategies to valorize plastic waste. Assessing the potential impacts of chemical recycling alternatives is crucial to support developers in ensuring environmental competitiveness at higher scales. To this end, we propose a comparative Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) of eight potential alternatives for ruthenium-based catalytic hydrogenolysis of PE into valuable lubricants and fuels. Assessed configurations adopt different driving forces to power the reaction: thermal energy, mechanical energy and thermally assisted mechanochemical configurations
items.authors: Antonio Cosimo Pio Trimboli, Francesco Brenda, Francesco Arfelli, Riccardo Pellegrini, Elena Groppo, Lars Borchardt

items.title: Polymer Informatics in the Era of Foundation Models: From Representation to Autonomous Design
items.title_zh: 基础模型时代的聚合物信息学：从表征到自主设计
items.summary_zh: 基础模型通过在广泛数据集上预训练并适应多种任务，为聚合物性质预测和逆向设计提供了重用化学知识的途径。实现这一机会需要将学习到的表征与材料连接起来，这些材料的性质还依赖于分子群体、配方、加工和测量条件。本文回顾了聚合物基础模型的进展，以及支持其在材料设计中应用的数据、表征和实验工作流程。我们围绕聚合物材料状态进行组织，该描述将化学身份与分子分布、结构、形态和与目标性质相关的制备历史联系起来。我们比较了学习目标和适应方法，考察了聚合物化学和状态的表征，并跟踪从候选生成到合成、加工和验证的逆向设计。预训练模型现在支持跨多个性质的预测和针对特定目标的生成，部分聚合物候选材料已达到合成和热特性表征。
items.abstract: Foundation models, pretrained on broad datasets and adapted to multiple tasks, offer a way to reuse chemical knowledge across polymer property prediction and inverse design. Realizing this opportunity requires connecting learned representations to materials whose properties also depend on molecular populations, formulation, processing, and measurement conditions. Here, we review advances in polymer foundation models and the data, representations, and experimental workflows that support their use in materials design. We organize these developments around the polymer material state, a description linking chemical identity to molecular distributions, architecture, morphology, and preparation history relevant to a target property. This organization connects data resources and pretraining strategies to questions about what models learn, how that knowledge transfers, and which experimental choices it can support. We compare learning objectives and adaptation methods, examine representations of polymer chemistry and state, and follow inverse design from candidate generation through synthesis and processing to validation. Pretrained models now support prediction across multiple properties
items.authors: Jianxin He, Ying Li

items.title: Making inferences with incomplete epidemiological data: a proof-of-concept estimating measles vaccine coverage across Canada
items.title_zh: 利用不完整流行病学数据推断：估算加拿大麻疹疫苗覆盖率
items.summary_zh: 背景与研究目的：全球麻疹疫情的爆发凸显了某些疫苗可预防疾病（VPD）免疫状况的变化。2026年1月至6月，加拿大报告了约1,100例麻疹病例，远超每年平均不足200例的水平。这一重大疫情强调了了解加拿大当前麻疹群体免疫状态的必要性，这是疫情应对模型的重要输入参数。大部分群体免疫来源于常规儿童疫苗接种，但疫苗覆盖数据在全国范围内不均匀，通常是横断面收集，以监测人群对免疫接种计划的遵循，而非评估人群易感性。本研究开发了统计方法，将现有的麻疹疫苗覆盖率估算转化为按年龄和省/地区（PT）更完整的当前免疫估算。方法与结果：首先，从现有的公开数据集中整理了按PT划分的疫苗覆盖标准化数据集。发现按PT、剂量和年份缺失的疫苗覆盖估算数量显著。我们使用高斯过程模型对至少接种一剂麻疹疫苗的当前覆盖率进行插补，以创建完整的估算。
items.abstract: Background & aims of study: Current measles outbreaks around the world have highlighted the evolving immunity landscape of some vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs). In Canada, there have been approximately 1,100 reported measles cases between January and June 2026 alone. This far exceeds the previous average annual case count of <200. This significant outbreak has underscored the need to better understand the present state of population immunity to measles in Canada, an essential input parameter for outbreak response models. Most population immunity in this setting is derived from routine childhood vaccination, but vaccine coverage data is available heterogeneously across the country and is typically collected cross-sectionally to monitor population adherence to immunization schedules rather than to inform population-level susceptibility. This study developed statistical methods to adapt available measles vaccine coverage estimates into more complete estimates of present-day immunity in Canada by age and province/territory (PT). Methods & results: First, a standardized dataset for vaccine coverage by PT was curated from existing publicly-available datasets and reports. A significan
items.authors: Hadley, L.; Milwid, R.; Hongoh, V.; Wasfi, R.; Kissler, S. M.; Papst, I.

items.title: Auditing the Human LLM Autonomy Gap in Clinical Ethics: Development and Application of the Autonomy Index Across 50 Clinical Ethics Vignettes
items.title_zh: 临床伦理中人类自主性差距的审计：自主性指数的开发与应用
items.summary_zh: 背景：尊重自主性是生物医学伦理的核心，但很少通过结构化、可重复的测量工具进行评估。随着患者、家庭和临床医生越来越多地使用通用语言模型来处理健康相关问题，这一差距显得尤为重要。我们开发了自主性指数（AIx），以表征临床伦理情境中的自主代理，并将训练有素的人类评审者的评分与当前语言模型的评分进行了比较。方法：我们审查了十种决策能力工具，并根据目标构念将其分类为同意能力、决策能力和功能自主性，识别出现有工具测量最差的自主代理区域（价值观、审议和实施）。最终形成的十三项工具在五点有序量表上评分四个领域：价值观意识、事实理解、理性审议和意图行动。九个模型对89个临床情境进行了评分。我们根据模型评分层级和模型间不一致性选择了50个情境，并在2026年7月获得了30名临床和生物伦理知情评审者的173个评分，以及来自八个模型的3431个有效评分。预设比较总结了每个来源在情境中的表现，并估计了人类与模型评分的差异。
items.abstract: Background. Respect for autonomy is central to biomedical ethics but is rarely assessed with a structured, reproducible measure. This gap matters as patients, families, and clinicians increasingly use general-purpose language models for health-related questions. We developed the Autonomy Index (AIx) to characterize autonomous agency in clinical-ethics vignettes and compared ratings from trained human reviewers with ratings from current language models. Methods. We reviewed ten decisional-capacity instruments and classified them by target construct into consent capacity, decision capacity, and functional autonomy, identifying a region of autonomous agency (values, deliberation, and enactment) that existing instruments measure least well. The resulting thirteen-item instrument scores four domains: Values Awareness, Factual Understanding, Rational Deliberation, and Intentional Action, on a five-point ordinal scale with an explicit not-applicable option; the External Constraint Index and Support Provided Index are reported separately. items.authors: Dutta Roy, T.; Brendel, R. W.

items.title: Dietary Patterns and Cardiovascular Risk in Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer: Findings From the SCCSS-Nutrition Study
items.title_zh: 儿童癌症幸存者的饮食模式与心血管风险研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：识别成年儿童癌症幸存者（CCSs）的饮食模式，探讨其决定因素，并评估其与心血管疾病（CVD）风险特征的差异。方法：研究对象为1976-2005年间在21岁前确诊并生存超过5年的瑞士儿童癌症幸存者，2017年时年龄≥18岁，完成了饮食频率问卷（SCCSS-Nutrition）。通过对52种食物组进行因子和层次聚类分析，识别饮食模式。CCSs根据是否患有CVD、CVD风险因素（肥胖、高血压、糖尿病、高胆固醇）或无CVD风险进行分类。采用多项逻辑回归分析饮食模式与CVD风险特征之间的关联。结果：在802名CCSs中（中位年龄：35岁；IQR：29-41；50%为男性），识别出五种饮食模式：地中海饮食（22%）、西方放纵饮食（38%）、西方甜腻饮食（26%）、克制放纵饮食（9%）、植物性与酒精丰富饮食（6%）。男性、年轻、德语区、吸烟及与他人同住与西方放纵、甜腻及克制放纵饮食相关；较高的瑞士社会经济地位和教育水平以及无子女与植物性与酒精丰富饮食相关，较高的瑞士社会经济地位也与西方放纵饮食相关。
items.abstract: Purpose: To identify dietary patterns among adult childhood cancer survivors (CCSs), examine their determinants, and assess whether they differ according to cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk profiles. Methods: CCSs from the Swiss Childhood Cancer Survivor Study diagnosed before age 21 years (1976-2005), surviving [ ]5 years and aged [ ]18 years in 2017, completed a food frequency questionnaire (SCCSS-Nutrition). Factor and hierarchical cluster analyses of 52 food groups identified dietary patterns. We categorised CCSs as having CVD, CVD risk factors (obesity, hypertension, diabetes, high cholesterol), or being CVD risk-free. Multinomial logistic regression assessed associations between dietary patterns and CVD risk profiles. Results: Among 802 CCSs (median age: 35 years; IQR: 29-41; 50% male), we identified five dietary patterns: Mediterranean-inspired diet (22%), Western indulgence diet (38%), Western sweet & fatty diet (26%), restrained indulgence diet (9%), plant-based & alcohol-rich diet (6%). items.authors: Li, R.; Revuelta Iniesta, R.; Barker, A. R.; Chatelan, A.; Leuenberger, L. M.; Shoman, Y.; Spycher, B. D.; Belle, F. N.

items.title: Evaluation of an AI-Powered Patient Education Application in Bariatric Surgery: A Prospective Mixed-Methods Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 人工智能辅助的肥胖手术患者教育应用评估研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：患者教育对安全有效的肥胖手术后护理至关重要。大型语言模型（LLMs）可能改善个性化患者教育的获取，但在临床环境中直接使用的证据仍然有限。我们评估了BariBot，这是一款为接受肥胖手术的患者提供教育的LLM驱动应用。方法：我们在一家三级学术医疗中心进行了一项前瞻性单臂混合方法可行性研究，时间从2024年5月至2025年5月。成年肥胖手术患者在术后第1天独立使用BariBot。该应用提供对话式术后教育，并根据参与者的教育水平调整语言复杂性。结果包括可行性、可用性、可接受性、感知可信度和预期未来使用。可用性通过系统可用性量表（SUS）评估。参与者在使用BariBot后完成了半结构化的定性访谈。结果：16名参与者完成了BariBot使用、SUS评估和干预后访谈。没有技术故障影响应用使用，且没有参与者要求提前停止。中位SUS评分为91.3（IQR，81.3-98）。
items.abstract: Background Patient education is critical to safe and effective postoperative bariatric surgery care. Large language models (LLMs) may improve access to personalized patient education but evidence regarding direct patient use in clinical settings remains limited. We evaluated BariBot, an LLM-powered educational application for patients undergoing bariatric surgery. Methods We conducted a prospective, single-arm mixed-methods feasibility study at a tertiary academic medical center from May 2024 to May 2025. Adult patients undergoing bariatric surgery used BariBot independently on postoperative day 1. The application provided conversational postoperative education and adapted language complexity to participants' educational attainment. Outcomes included feasibility, usability, acceptability, perceived trustworthiness, and anticipated future use. Usability was assessed using the System Usability Scale (SUS). Immediately after BariBot use, participants completed a semi-structured qualitative interview assessing acceptability, perceived trustworthiness, and anticipated future use. items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Macitentan Across Pulmonary Hypertension Phenotypes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.title_zh: Macitentan在不同肺动脉高压表型中的疗效与安全性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：Macitentan是一种双重内皮素受体拮抗剂，主要用于肺动脉高压（PAH），也研究了其他形式的肺动脉高压（PH）。本研究旨在评估Macitentan在不同PH表型中的疗效与安全性，并探讨治疗效果是否因PH分类而异。方法：通过PubMed、Embase和Cochrane数据库检索至2026年6月，纳入接受Macitentan治疗的PH患者的随机和非随机比较研究。预设疗效指标包括6分钟步行距离（6MWD）、肺血管阻力（PVR）、平均肺动脉压（mPAP）和心脏指数；安全性指标包括死亡率和不良事件。结果：共纳入14项研究。Macitentan显著降低PVR（MD，-134.50 dyn.s.cm；95% CI，-226.10至-42.86）并增加心脏指数（MD，0.44 L/min/m²；95% CI，0.22至0.67）。6MWD（MD，5.04 m；95% CI，-15.06至25.14）和mPAP（MD，-2.70 mmHg）未显示统计学显著差异。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Macitentan is a dual endothelin receptor antagonist used in pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and has also been studied in other forms of pulmonary hypertension (PH). Evidence across PH phenotypes has been heterogeneous. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of macitentan compared with concurrent control therapies across PH phenotypes and to explore whether treatment effects differ according to PH classification. Methods: PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane database were searched from inception through June 2026. Randomized and non-randomized comparative studies of patients with PH receiving macitentan were eligible. Prespecified efficacy outcomes were 6-minute walk distance (6MWD), pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR), mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP), and cardiac index; prespecified safety outcomes included mortality and adverse events. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using mean differences (MDs) for continuous outcomes and risk ratios (RRs) for dichotomous outcomes. Results: Fourteen studies met the eligibility criteria. Macitentan was associated with a greater reduction in PVR (MD, -134.50 dyn.s.cm; 95% CI, -226.10 to -42.86
items.authors: Gurram, S.; MP, V.; Avula, S. T.; Subramanian, V.; Natarajan, H. A.; Byreddy, H.; Palakodeti, S.

items.title: RNA Splicing of the REST Gene by SRRM4 in Vascular Smooth Muscle Cells Promotes Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Development
items.title_zh: SRRM4在血管平滑肌细胞中调控REST基因剪接促进腹主动脉瘤发展
items.summary_zh: 背景：腹主动脉瘤（AAA）的进展与血管平滑肌细胞（VSMC）的表型转变密切相关。尽管丝氨酸/精氨酸富集剪接因子（SRs）超家族在调节细胞表型中的重要作用日益受到重视，但这些因子对AAA发展的具体贡献尚未深入研究。方法：通过对人类和小鼠AAA组织的全转录组分析，识别出丝氨酸-精氨酸重复基因4（SRRM4）作为调控AAA形成的候选基因。我们使用全身和VSMC特异性SRRM4敲除小鼠构建AAA模型，进一步在体内外模型中研究SRRM4对AAA的影响。结果：在人类和小鼠AAA组织的VSMC中观察到SRRM4 mRNA和蛋白水平升高。靶向沉默VSMC中的SRRM4显著减弱了AngII和CaCl2诱导的小鼠模型中的AAA形成。我们的研究确定了RE1沉默转录因子（REST）作为SRRM4在AAA中的关键靶基因，表明SRRM4通过替代剪接调节VSMC表型。
items.abstract: Background: The progression of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) is closely associated with the phenotypic switch of vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC). While members of the Serine/Arginine-rich splicing factor (SRs) superfamily are increasingly acknowledged for their pivotal role in modulating cell phenotype, the specific contribution of these factors to AAA development has remained underexplored. Methods: Through integrated analyses the whole transcriptome of human and murine AAA tissues derived from clinical samples and animal models, we identified serine-arginine repeat matrix 4 (SRRM4) as a candidate gene regulating AAA formation. To investigate the role of SRRM4 in AAA formation, we used global and VSMC-specific SRRM4-knockout mice to construct AAA mouse models in two different ways. The impact of SRRM4 on AAA was further investigated in in vivo and in vitro models Results: Elevated levels of SRRM4 mRNA and protein were observed in VSMC from both human and murine AAA tissues. Targeted silencing of SRRM4 in VSMC (but not in endothelial or myeloid cells) significantly attenuated AAA formation in both AngII-and CaCl2-induced mouse models. items.authors: Li, Y.; Wang, Y.; Ni, Q.; Yang, S.; Qi, H.; Yao, Y.; Wang, H.; Xu, W.; Yuan, K.; Lv, L.; Guo, X.; Ye, M.; Xue, G.; Tang, W. H.; Pu, J.; Zhang, L.

items.title: Social Isolation and All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality in the UK Biobank: The Modifying Role of Non-Commute Transportation Mode
items.title_zh: 社会孤立与全因及特定原因死亡率的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：社会孤立（SI）是慢性疾病和死亡率的重要风险因素。人们的出行方式可能影响社交互动机会，从而影响SI的影响。本研究评估了SI与死亡率之间在主要非通勤交通方式上的异质性。方法：我们分析了UK Biobank的队列数据，追踪2006年至2022年间40-69岁参与者。基线SI通过三项指标得出并进行二分化。使用Cox模型估计SI与死亡率之间的关联，调整社会经济因素、健康行为和共病情况。通过与SI的交互项评估参与者主要非通勤交通方式的效应修饰。结果：共有490,114名参与者的基线暴露数据完整。SI与全因死亡率（风险比[HR]=1.34，95%置信区间[CI]：1.31-1.38）及心血管死亡率（HR=1.49，CI：1.41-1.57）相关。与仅使用汽车的参与者相比，仅使用公共交通的参与者心血管死亡率的关联更强（交互HR=1.17，CI：1.00-1.37）。相比单独使用汽车，结合使用汽车与主动或公共交通的参与者，SI与死亡率之间的关联减弱。
items.abstract: Background: Social isolation (SI) is an established risk factor for chronic disease and mortality. How people travel, including the modes of transportation they use, may shape opportunities for social interaction and influence the impacts of SI. This study assessed heterogeneity of the association between SI and mortality across primary modes of non-commute transportation. Methods: We analyzed cohort data from the UK Biobank, following participants aged 40-69 years from 2006 to 2022. SI at baseline was derived from three items and dichotomized. Cox models were used to estimate the association between SI and mortality, adjusting for socioeconomic factors, health behaviours, and comorbidities. Effect modification by participants' primary mode of non-commute transportation was assessed using interaction terms with SI. Results: There were 490,114 participants with complete baseline exposure data. SI was associated with increased hazard of all-cause (Hazard Ratio [HR] = 1.34, 95% Confidence Interval [CI]: 1.31-1.38) and cardiovascular mortality (HR = 1.49, CI: 1.41-1.57). The association with cardiovascular mortality was stronger among participants who only used public transport compare
