items.title: Nipah vaccine and monoclonal antibody introduction: Understanding endemic and at-risk country perspectives to inform demand forecasting
items.title_zh: 尼帕病毒疫苗与单克隆抗体的引入：了解流行与高风险国家的需求预测
items.summary_zh: 背景：尼帕病毒（NiV）是一种人畜共患病原体，导致人类严重且常致命的疾病。世界卫生组织和流行病防备创新联盟（CEPI）将NiV列为具有大流行潜力的优先病原体。尽管CEPI资助了包括疫苗和单克隆抗体（mAbs）在内的医疗对策研究，但对高风险国家如何使用这些对策的理解仍然有限。本研究通过针对10个国家（澳大利亚、孟加拉国、柬埔寨、印度、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡、泰国和越南）的访谈和需求预测来填补这一空白。方法/主要发现：与国家和全球利益相关者的访谈收集了区域情绪、融资和可负担性的数据。根据各国对疫情风险的认知和可能的对策使用情况，建立了概况。通过将这些观点整合到对三种NiV疫情情景（预期、放大和延长）的国家级响应模型中，估算了需求。在预期情景中，各国集中于反应性使用，全球年需求约为800至5000剂，针对疫苗、单克隆抗体和组合干预措施。考虑到疫情规模和发生频率，环形策略更受青睐。
items.abstract: Background: Nipah virus (NiV) is a zoonotic pathogen in the Henipavirus genus that causes severe, often fatal disease in humans. The World Health Organization and the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) have designated NiV as a priority pathogen with pandemic potential. While CEPI is funding research on medical countermeasures, including vaccines and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), there remains limited understanding of how at-risk countries will use them. This study aims to address this gap through targeted interviews and demand forecasting for 10 countries: Australia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. Methodology/Principal Findings: Interviews with country and global stakeholders gathered data on regional sentiment, financing, and affordability. Profiles were developed to summarize each country's perceived outbreak risk and their likely use of countermeasures. Demand was estimated by integrating these perspectives into models of likely country-level responses to three NiV outbreak scenarios: Expected, Amplified, and Extended. items.title: Childhood and adolescent immunisation intentions post-COVID-19 in Lusaka, Zambia
items.title_zh: 赞比亚卢萨卡儿童及青少年接种意向研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：自COVID-19疫情以来，家长对已建立的安全有效的儿童疫苗接种的延迟和拒绝，导致传染病复发。研究关注COVID-19疫苗犹豫是否会影响未来儿童新疫苗的接种意向。本研究调查了包括医疗工作者在内的看护者对0-17岁儿童新疫苗的看法及12-17岁青少年接种COVID-19疫苗的意向。方法：我们对2023年11月13日至12月15日在赞比亚卢萨卡对0-17岁儿童家长/看护者进行的大型横断面调查进行了二次数据分析。结果：277名看护者中（66.8%为女性，中位年龄35岁），93.1%报告其子女已接种所有推荐的常规儿童疫苗。医疗工作者中COVID-19疫苗接种率较高（68.2%）。
items.abstract: Background: Since the COVID-19 pandemic, parental delays and refusals of well-established, safe, and effective childhood vaccinations have contributed to the resurgence of infectious diseases. This raises concerns that COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy may also extend to novel vaccines for children when introduced in the future. This study examined caregivers, who included healthcare workers (HCWs), perceptions of novel vaccinations for children ages 0-17 years old and intentions to vaccinate children and adolescents ages 12-17 years against COVID-19. Methods: We conducted a secondary data analysis of a larger cross-sectional survey administered to parents/caregivers of children ages 0-17 years in Lusaka, Zambia, between 13 November and 15 December 2023. Vaccination intention for COVID-19 was specifically focused on caregivers of adolescents ages 12-17 years, following COVID-19 vaccination guidelines during the study. Descriptive statistics were used to explore demographic characteristics, vaccination history, and caregivers COVID-19 vaccination status, along with their childrens routine childhood vaccine histories and perceptions of COVID-19 and novel vaccinations. Results: Among 277 car

items.title: Caregiver knowledge and Attitudes toward Human Papillomavirus Vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone: A health facility-based cross-sectional study
items.title_zh: 塞拉利昂HIV青少女监护人对HPV疫苗的认知与态度研究
items.summary_zh: 目的 评估塞拉利昂HIV青少女监护人对人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗的认知、接种意愿及障碍。方法 本研究为横断面研究，调查了249名HIV青少女监护人的HPV疫苗知识、接种意愿及障碍。通过在公共三级医院和高流量HIV门诊使用结构化问卷收集数据，并采用卡方检验、逻辑回归和Kruskal-Wallis分析评估关联。结果 仅32.1%（80/249）的监护人听说过HPV，了解其与宫颈癌关联的仅24.4%（60/246），了解宫颈癌预防方法的为31.9%（79/248）。误解普遍，16.3%（36/221）错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系在一起，61.1%（44/72）不愿接种的监护人因对疫苗有效性缺乏信任。虽然接受过高等教育的监护人知识水平最高（45.5%，p < 0.001），但他们的接种意愿（50%，33/66）与低学历群体相当，显示出知识与行动之间的差距。结构性障碍显著，66.1%（154/233）表示对疫苗不知情，10.3%（24/233）错过学校接种日。家庭关系动态显著影响接种意愿。
items.abstract: Objective To assess the knowledge, willingness and barriers to human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination among caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Methods This cross-sectional study examined HPV vaccine knowledge, willingness, and barriers among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Data were collected through structured questionnaires at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, and associations were assessed using chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis analyses. Results Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, with even fewer aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods of cervical cancer (31.9%, 79/248). Misconceptions were prevalent; 16.3% (36/221) erroneously linked oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, and 61.1% (44/72) of caregivers unwilling to vaccinate cited distrust in vaccine efficacy. While tertiary-educated caregivers exhibited the highest level of knowledge (45.5%, p < 0.001), their willingness to vaccinate (50%, 33/66) was comparable to that of less-educated groups, highlighting a knowledge-action gap. items.title: Potential five-year life years associated with stage IV reductions in NHS Galleri Trial
items.title_zh: NHS Galleri试验中IV期癌症减少的潜在五年生命年
items.summary_zh: 背景 NHS-Galleri试验未达到预设的主要终点，即III期和IV期病例的减少，但报告显示经过年度多癌种早期筛查后，IV期癌症数量减少。我们估算了在两轮筛查中观察到的癌症特异性IV期差异所关联的潜在五年生命年。方法 使用NHS-Galleri试验中报告的十种预设癌症的干预组和对照组IV期病例数。每种癌症的随机组病例数差异乘以III期和IV期之间的五年限制平均生存时间差异，该差异通过对英格兰分期五年净生存率的常数风险拟合进行估算。结果显示，干预组和对照组在两轮筛查中分别有180和239例IV期诊断。条件预测显示，试验干预队列在五年内潜在生命年为66.3，相当于每年每百万筛查人群466个（95%采样区间190-743）。对于1000万人口，相应的预测为每年4,664个。
items.abstract: Background The NHS-Galleri trial did not reach its prespecified primary endpoint of a reduction in combined stage III and IV cases, but reported fewer stage IV cancers after annual multi-cancer early detection screening. We estimated the potential five-year life-years associated with the cancer-specific stage IV differences observed during the two incident screening rounds. Methods We used intervention and control stage IV counts for ten prespecified cancers reported in the NHS-Galleri trial. For each cancer, the randomized-arm count difference was multiplied by the difference in five-year restricted mean survival time between stage III and IV, estimated from England stage-specific five-year net survival using a constant-hazard fit. Adverse cancer-specific differences remained in the model. Results were annualized across the two incident rounds and scaled per million people screened. Sampling intervals used an independent Poisson approximation for arm-specific counts. Findings Across the ten evaluable cancers, the intervention and control arms had 180 and 239 stage IV diagnoses during the incident rounds. The conditional projection was 66.3 potential life-years over five years in t

items.title: A national-scale digital atlas of recorded care patterns across more than 1000 diagnostic categories using real-world health data: a retrospective observational study
items.title_zh: 基于真实世界健康数据的全国数字地图：1000多种诊断类别的护理模式研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：常规收集的健康数据可以揭示诊断相关的护理记录，但针对特定疾病的整理无法覆盖数千种疾病。方法：本回顾性观察研究使用了EST-Health-30，这是2012年至2024年间爱沙尼亚居民的30%随机样本。我们构建了ICD-10三字符诊断类别的队列，使用3年无诊断观察期后的首个符合条件的诊断。对每个类别，我们总结了90天的前索引窗口、30天的后索引窗口和365天的后索引窗口内的临床事件。结果：在1645个观察到的诊断类别中，1080个符合纳入标准，共生成3240个诊断窗口摘要，涉及509,856个个体。每个摘要通过流行率、富集、时机、共现和变异性特征化与诊断相关的事件。
items.abstract: Background Routinely collected health data can reveal recorded care around diagnosis, but disease-specific curation does not scale across thousands of conditions. We scaled a previously developed automated framework that reduces heterogeneous clinical events into standardised, diagnosis-centred summaries of real-world care patterns. Methods In this retrospective observational study, we used EST-Health-30, a pseudonymised 30% random sample of Estonian residents with health-care records from 2012 to 2024. We constructed cohorts for ICD-10 three-character diagnostic categories using the first eligible observed diagnosis after a 3-year diagnosis-free observable lookback. For each category, we summarised recorded clinical events from a 90-day pre-index window, a 30-day post-index window, and a 365-day post-index window. An enrichment-based workflow compared earlier self-comparator periods and matched population controls, then filtered and aggregated concepts across clinical domains. Diagnosis-concept relationships were assessed by rubric-guided language-model classification, and atlas plausibility and utility by ten experts. items.title: Immunophenotyping of B- and T-cell alterations in patients with autoimmune premature ovarian insufficiency following rituximab treatment
items.title_zh: 类风湿性早发卵巢功能不全患者B、T细胞免疫表型研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：早发卵巢功能不全（POI）影响女性生育，尤其在自身免疫疾病中。近期研究表明，利妥昔单抗（RTX）可暂时恢复自身免疫性POI患者的卵巢功能，但其免疫机制尚不明确。目的：分析POI患者在RTX治疗前后B、T细胞表型及其与自身抗体水平和治疗反应的关联。方法：对六名POI自身免疫患者的冷冻细胞样本进行分析，其中四名患者对类固醇生成酶（21OH、17OH和/或SCC）呈阳性。患者接受RTX治疗，基线、第二次输注（2周）、3、8和12个月时采集血样。采用光谱流式细胞术分析外周B、T细胞表型，并与自身抗体水平相关联。结果：基线时，患者B细胞活化表现出与匹配对照组的亚群组成变化。进一步分析发现，类固醇生成酶自身抗体阳性患者的CXCR3+转换记忆（SWM）B细胞频率显著高于阴性患者，且与抗-17OH和-SCC自身抗体水平呈正相关。
items.abstract: Background: Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) is a condition affecting female fertility e.g., in the context of autoimmune disease. A recent proof-of-concept study showed that B-cell depletion with rituximab (RTX) temporarily restored ovarian function in patients with autoimmune POI. However, the underlying immunological mechanisms behind this response is unknown. Objectives: To characterize B- and T-cell phenotypes before and after RTX therapy in the above-mentioned patients and associations with autoantibody levels and treatment response. Methods: Cryopreserved cell samples were available from six autoimmune patients with POI, four of whom were positive for autoantibodies against steroidogenic enzymes (21OH, 17OH and/or SCC). Patients received RTX and blood samples were collected at baseline, second infusion (2 weeks), 3, 8 and 12 months. Peripheral B- and T-cell phenotypes were analysed using spectral flow cytometry and correlated with autoantibody levels. Results: At baseline, patients displayed signs of B-cell activation by alteration in subset composition compared to matched controls. Upon closer analysis, patients positive for steroidogenic enzyme autoantibodies had sign

items.title: Comparative safety and sedation-related outcomes of fospropofol disodium versus propofol for adult sedation outside general anaesthesia induction or maintenance (including ICU and procedural sedation): a systematic review, meta-analysis and trial sequential analysis
items.title_zh: 福索普鲁福醇与普鲁福醇在成人镇静中的安全性比较
items.summary_zh: 背景：福索普鲁福醇是一种水溶性普鲁福醇前药，避免了脂质乳剂载体，可能减少注射疼痛、心肺抑制和脂质暴露。2021年5月在中国获批用于成人全身麻醉诱导。方法：我们遵循PRISMA 2020和PRISMA-S标准，检索了多个数据库，纳入接受非全身麻醉诱导或维持的成人镇静的随机对照试验，包括ICU机械通气期间的持续镇静和程序性镇静。结果：使用DerSimonian-Laird随机效应模型汇总二元结果，并报告REML及修改的Hartung-Knapp估计以改善区间覆盖。结论：本系统评价和荟萃分析为福索普鲁福醇在非手术室镇静中的安全性提供了重要数据支持。
items.abstract: Background. Fospropofol disodium is a water-soluble prodrug of propofol that avoids a lipid emulsion carrier. It may therefore reduce injection pain, cardiorespiratory depression and lipid exposure. In May 2021 it was approved in China (H20210017) for induction of general anaesthesia in adults. Randomised trials have since tested it for sedation outside the operating room, but this setting has not been systematically reviewed. Methods. We followed PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-S and searched Europe PMC, PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, Web of Science and the Chinese databases CNKI, Wanfang and VIP (the last accessed through the XJMU Library database proxy) from inception to 2026. Eligible patients were adults receiving sedation for purposes other than general anaesthesia induction or maintenance, including continuous sedation during ICU mechanical ventilation and procedural sedation. These uses are referred to here as sedation outside the operating room. We included randomised controlled trials with propofol as the comparator and excluded trials of general anaesthesia induction or maintenance to avoid overlap with the published induction meta-analysis. items.title: Cumulative disease-course phenotypes in Crohn's disease: a retrospective single center FAMD clustering study
items.title_zh: 克罗恩病的累积病程表型：回顾性单中心FAMD聚类研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：克罗恩病（CD）是一种高度异质性的疾病。基线特征相似的患者可能会走上截然不同的治疗和手术路径。本研究旨在通过临床、治疗、手术和合并症变量识别疾病进程轨迹表型，并评估诊断时已有信息是否能预测患者将遵循的轨迹。方法：我们分析了在米兰IRCCS Ca Granda Policlinico医院登记的98名独特CD患者的回顾性队列。对30个疾病进程变量进行混合数据因子分析（FAMD），包括人口统计学和蒙特利尔描述符、肠外表现负担、个体先进治疗药物暴露、手术负担及合并症/症状负担；然后根据治疗负担对聚类进行排名。聚类在保留的FAMD坐标空间中进行，使用轮廓系数和自助法Jaccard稳定性检查聚类的稳健性。结果：出现了三种轨迹表型：C1（n=56）、C2（n=31）和C3（n=11）。C3的特征是年龄较小。
items.abstract: Background and aims: Crohn s disease (CD) is a highly heterogeneous disease. Patients with similar characteristics at baseline may end up on very different therapeutic and surgical paths. We aimed to identify disease-course trajectory phenotypes from a mix of clinical, treatment, surgical and comorbidity variables, and evaluate whether information already available at diagnosis could anticipate which trajectory a patient would follow. Methods: We analysed a retrospective cohort of 98 unique CD patients enrolled at the IRCCS Ca Granda Policlinico Hospital, Milan. Factor analysis of mixed data (FAMD) was applied to 30 disease- course variables spanning demographic and Montreal descriptors, extra-intestinal manifestation burden, individual advanced-therapy drug exposures, surgical burden and comorbidity/symptom burden; clusters were then ranked by treatment burden using a line-weighted therapy score built separately from drug line positions and therapeutic-class weights. Clustering itself was carried out in the retained FAMD coordinate space, and cluster robustness was checked with silhouette metrics and bootstrap Jaccard stability. Baseline-associated variables were assessed separate

items.title: Integrating multiparametric imaging and electrophysiology reveals thalamic pathology
items.title_zh: 整合多参数成像与电生理揭示丘脑病理
items.summary_zh: 丘脑被越来越多地认为是癫痫网络中的关键节点，但反复发作的癫痫活动如何影响其组织完整性仍不清楚。本研究结合定量钠、结构和功能7特斯拉MRI与立体定向脑电图（SEEG）及临床特征，建立了一个多模态框架，以研究药物耐受性局灶性癫痫中丘脑的参与。多参数MRI显示总钠浓度广泛增加，首次提供了局灶性癫痫中丘脑钠稳态改变的证据，同时在外侧丘脑区域观察到短T2*钠信号分数的局灶性升高和区域同质性增加。整合这些互补测量，识别出一种强有力的MRI特征，能够区分患者与对照组，并独立识别出SEEG定义的癫痫性丘脑患者。丘脑体积减少与更大的发作性丘脑招募相关，而多变量行为分析表明，互补MRI特征在不同程度上反映了癫痫网络负担、疾病慢性程度和人口特征。
items.abstract: The thalamus is increasingly recognized as a key node within epileptogenic networks, yet how recurrent seizure activity shapes its tissue integrity remains poorly understood. Existing evidence has largely relied on individual structural, functional, or electrophysiological modalities, limiting an integrated understanding of thalamic pathology. Here, we combined quantitative sodium, structural, and functional 7 Tesla MRI with stereotactic electroencephalography (SEEG) and clinical characterization to establish a multimodal framework for investigating thalamic involvement in drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Multiparametric MRI revealed widespread increases in total sodium concentration, providing the first evidence of altered thalamic sodium homeostasis in focal epilepsy, together with focal elevations of the short T2* sodium signal fraction within lateral thalamic regions and increased regional homogeneity. Integrating these complementary measures identified a robust MRI profile that distinguished patients from controls and independently identified patients with SEEG-defined epileptogenic thalami. Reduced thalamic volume was associated with greater ictal thalamic recruitment, whereas

items.title: A multimodal investigation of altered cortical metabolism in patients with disorders of consciousness
items.title_zh: 意识障碍患者皮层代谢变化的多模态研究
items.summary_zh: 意识障碍（DoC）患者表现出显著的脑葡萄糖代谢减少，但具体的细胞和神经化学过程尚不清楚。为阐明这些机制，本研究采用多模态成像方法，结合[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（FDG-PET）和磁共振波谱（MRS），对15名DoC患者和14名健康对照者的后内侧皮层（PMC）进行分析。比较了区域FDG代谢指数（FDG-MI）值和MRS中谷氨酸加谷氨酰胺（Glx）、γ-氨基丁酸（GABA+）、总N-乙酰天冬氨酸（tNAA）、总肌酸（tCr）和总胆碱（tCho）的浓度估计。结果显示，患者的PMC中Glx、tCr和tNAA浓度减少，Glx/GABA+比率降低。患者的局部FDG-MI显著降低，并与tNAA和tCr呈正相关。此外，基线tCho浓度能够正向预测长期临床恢复。这些发现表明，DoC中的宏观葡萄糖低代谢可能与细胞内线粒体能量生产途径的破坏及突触抑制的相对转变有关。
items.abstract: Disorders of consciousness (DoC) are characterised by marked reductions in cerebral glucose metabolism, but the specific cellular and neurochemical processes driving this impairment remain unclear. To elucidate these mechanisms, a multimodal imaging approach combining [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) and magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) was applied to the posterior medial cortex (PMC) in 15 DoC patients and 14 healthy controls. Regional FDG metabolic index (FDG-MI) values and MRS concentration estimates of glutamate plus glutamine (Glx), {gamma}-aminobutyric acid (GABA+), total N-acetylaspartate (tNAA), total creatine (tCr), and total choline (tCho) were compared between groups and evaluated against Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) scores at baseline and follow-up (mean 127 days). Patients demonstrated reductions within the PMC in Glx, tCr, and tNAA concentrations, as well as a reduced Glx/GABA+ ratio. Local FDG-MI was substantially reduced in patients and correlated positively with tNAA and tCr. Furthermore, baseline tCho concentrations positively predicted long-term clinical recovery, as indexed by changes in CRS-R scores at follow-up. These
items.authors: Duncan, N. W.; Huang, L.; Lee, C.; Wu, Y.-C.; Yang, C.-M.; Chen, D. Y.-T.; Lane, T. J.

items.title: Type 2 Deiodinase in Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts: A Potential Therapeutic Target in Many Types of Cancer
items.title_zh: 癌症相关成纤维细胞中的2型脱碘酶：多种癌症的潜在治疗靶点
items.summary_zh: 背景：癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAF）是肿瘤微环境的主要调节者，但其功能调控途径尚不完全清楚。2型脱碘酶（DIO2, D2）将甲状腺素（T4）转化为活性甲状腺激素三碘甲腺原氨酸（T3），在不同实体肿瘤中的CAF中尚未系统研究。方法：我们利用单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析了原发性甲状腺肿瘤、一个大型整合的scRNA-seq甲状腺癌图谱及六种其他实体肿瘤类型的公开数据集中的DIO2表达。使用肿瘤研究信息交换网络（ORIEN）数据库的整体RNA测序数据，考察DIO2与CAF亚型标记及总生存期（OS）之间的相关性。评估了特定于CAF的Dio2表达及D2活性的药理抑制。结果：DIO2的表达高度特异于CAF，且在上皮来源的癌细胞、免疫细胞和内皮细胞中几乎缺失。在甲状腺癌及六种其他恶性肿瘤中，DIO2在CAF中持续被检测到，表明CAF特异性DIO2表达是保守的。
items.abstract: Background: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAF) are major regulators of the tumor microenvironment (TME), yet the pathways governing CAF function remain incompletely understood. Type 2 deiodinase (DIO2, D2), which converts thyroxine (T4) to the active thyroid hormone triiodothyronine (T3), has not been systematically investigated in CAF across different solid tumors. Methods: We analyzed DIO2 expression using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) from primary thyroid tumors, a large integrated scRNASeq thyroid cancer atlas, and publicly available scRNA-seq datasets representing six additional solid tumor types. Bulk RNA sequencing data from the Oncology Research Information Exchange Network (ORIEN) database were used to examine correlations among DIO2, CAF subtype markers, and overall survival (OS). A genetically engineered TPO-CreERT2/BrafV600E/Trp53-deficient (TBP) mouse model was evaluated for CAF-specific Dio2 expression and pharmacologic inhibition of D2 activity. TBP mice were crossed with Dio2-/- (Dio2 KO) mice to investigate the role of Dio2 in cancer development and progression. Results: DIO2 expression was highly restricted to CAF and was largely absent from epithelial-d
items.authors: Carroll, M. G.; Mukhtar, N.; Calhoun, J.; Garza, B.; Loberg, M. A.; Chen, H.-C.; Sheng, Q.; Staley, A.; Fonseca, T. L.; Bianco, A. C.; Ringel, M. D.; Brock, P.; Gunderson, A. J.; Tarhini, A. A.; Cress

items.title: Shared Clinical and Immunological Features of Post-Acute COVID-19 and Post-Acute COVID-19 Vaccination Syndromes
items.title_zh: 后急性新冠肺炎与疫苗接种综合症的临床与免疫特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：后急性新冠肺炎综合症（PACS）可导致持续性残疾，表现为疲劳、运动后不适、神经认知症状及自主神经表现。接种新冠疫苗后出现的临床重叠情况被称为后急性新冠疫苗接种综合症（PACVS），但其机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了PACS中的免疫失调、自身反应性、抗原持续存在及病毒再激活机制是否也存在于PACVS中。方法：本横断面研究纳入28名PACS患者、29名PACVS患者和16名康复对照（CCG）。通过ME/CFS相关症状问卷和Bell评分评估临床表现。采用多色流式细胞术分析T细胞表型及对SARS-CoV-2 Spike、β1/β2-肾上腺素受体和M3/M4毒蕈碱受体抗原的反应。通过ELISA定量循环Spike蛋白和GPCR自身抗体，qPCR检测EBV载量。结果：PACS与PACVS在临床表现上有显著重叠，尽管PACS的某些症状更为严重。患者组之间的GPCR自身抗体谱相似，而与CCG相比，β2-肾上腺素受体自身抗体增多。在57个常规免疫表型参数中，仅有3个在PACS和PACVS之间存在差异。
items.abstract: Background: Post-acute COVID-19 syndrome (PACS) can cause persistent disability involving fatigue, post-exertional malaise, neurocognitive symptoms, and autonomic manifestations. A clinically overlapping condition has been reported following COVID-19 vaccination and termed post-acute COVID-19 vaccination syndrome (PACVS), but its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. We investigated whether immune dysregulation, autoreactivity, antigen persistence, and viral reactivation mechanisms implicated in PACS are also present in PACVS. Methods: This cross-sectional study included 28 PACS patients, 29 PACVS patients, and 16 convalescent controls (CCG). Clinical manifestations were assessed using ME/CFS-related symptom questionnaires and the Bell Score. T-cell phenotypes and T cells reactive to SARS-CoV-2 Spike, {beta}1/{beta}2-adrenergic receptor, and M3/M4 muscarinic receptor antigens were analyzed by multicolor flow cytometry. Circulating Spike protein and GPCR autoantibodies were quantified by ELISA, and EBV load by qPCR. Results: PACS and PACVS showed substantial clinical overlap, although several symptoms were more severe in PACS. GPCR autoantibody profiles were comparable bet
items.authors: Dinser, J.; Anft, M.; Wiemers, L.; Skrzypczyk, S.; Kohut, E.; Kurek, J.; Stervbo, U.; Seibert, F. S.; Westhoff, T. H.; Rosiewicz, K.; Babel, N.

items.title: The anthropogenic fingerprint on emerging infectious diseases
items.title_zh: 人类活动对新兴传染病的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了新兴传染病的爆发风险，发现这种风险在全球范围内普遍存在，尤其是在人员、牲畜与破碎自然生态系统共存的地区。研究指出，尽管这些地区的传染病风险较高，但由于医疗服务获取的不平等，当前对疫情的检测和数据收集仍然有限。这一发现强调了改善医疗平等性的重要性，以便更有效地应对新兴传染病的威胁。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11058-6 Emerging infectious disease outbreak risks are ubiquitous worldwide, and highest in landscapes where people, livestock and fragmented natural ecosystems coexist, but detection and data on outbreaks are currently limited by inequalities in healthcare access.
items.authors: Rory Gibb

items.title: Single-nucleus transcriptome-wide association study of human brain disorders
items.title_zh: 单核转录组广泛关联研究人类脑部疾病
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用单核转录组技术，针对不同人群探讨了脑部疾病的遗传风险如何影响特定细胞类型。研究揭示了之前未被发现的基因-性状关联以及保守的细胞类型特异性机制。这些发现为理解脑部疾病的发病机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略奠定基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10836-6 Single-nucleus transcriptomics across diverse populations is used to explore how genetic risk for brain disorders affects specific cell types, revealing previously hidden gene–trait associations and conserved, cell-type-specific mechanisms.
items.authors: Sanan Venkatesh

items.title: Hepatocytes promote liver metastasis of pancreatic cancer by providing serine
items.title_zh: 肝细胞通过重编程促进胰腺癌肝转移
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了转移性胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）在肝脏中的生长机制。研究发现，缺乏合成丝氨酸所需酶的PDAC细胞能够重编程肝细胞，使其产生丝氨酸，从而促进肿瘤的生长和存活。这一发现揭示了肝细胞在胰腺癌肝转移中的重要作用，可能为治疗策略提供新的靶点。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11051-z Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the liver that lack the enzyme necessary to synthesize serine can reprogram hepatocytes to produce this amino acid, thus promoting tumour growth and survival.
items.authors: Koelina Ganguly

items.title: Reference genomes and fossils revise bat family phylogeny and biogeography
items.title_zh: 参考基因组与化石修订蝙蝠的系统发育与生物地理学
items.summary_zh: 本研究基于新的基因组组装和大量古代化石，更新了蝙蝠的系统发育树，涵盖了所有已知的蝙蝠科。通过对这些数据的分析，研究揭示了蝙蝠的进化关系及其地理分布的变化，为理解蝙蝠的多样性和演化历史提供了新的视角。研究结果显示，古代化石在重建系统发育时具有重要价值，并且新的基因组数据显著改善了对蝙蝠家族间关系的理解。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11007-3 An updated phylogeny of bats is presented, based on new genome assemblies and many ancient fossils and including all known bat families.
items.authors: Ariadna E. Morales

items.title: Anomalous metal and superconducting phases in rhombohedral graphene
items.title_zh: 菱形石墨烯中的异常金属与超导相
items.summary_zh: 本研究观察了在WSe2基底上生长的菱形石墨烯，研究了其在不同温度、磁场和电流下的表现。结果表明，在栅极空间中存在零电阻超导性区域，同时也观察到有限饱和电阻的区域。这些发现揭示了菱形石墨烯中存在的复杂相行为，为理解其超导机制提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11033-1 Observations of rhombohedral graphene on a WSe2 substrate at varying temperature, magnetic field and current indicate the presence of regions of gate space with zero-resistance superconductivity alongside others with finite saturation resistance.
items.authors: Anna Okounkova

items.title: Lifespan single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human prefrontal cortex
items.title_zh: 人类前额叶皮层的生命周期单细胞转录组图谱
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于人类背外侧前额叶皮层，揭示了其在发育过程中表现出非线性、细胞类型特异性的转录轨迹。这些轨迹在中年时期相对稳定，而在晚年则出现选择性的分子再激活。通过单细胞转录组测序技术，我们分析了不同生命周期阶段的细胞转录特征，发现细胞在发育阶段经历动态重塑，随后在中年保持稳定，最终在老年阶段出现特定基因的重新激活。这些发现为理解人类大脑在不同生命周期中的功能变化提供了重要线索。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10271-7 The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex exhibits non-linear, cell-type-specific transcriptional trajectories characterized by dynamic remodelling during development, relative stability in midlife and selective molecular reactivation in late adulthood.
items.authors: Hui Yang

items.title: Agricultural liming is a carbon sink in the Mississippi River Basin
items.title_zh: 农业石灰施用在密西西比河流域的碳汇作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对密西西比河流域的农业石灰施用和人为酸性输入进行了世纪尺度的记录分析。结果表明，过去一个世纪以来，农业石灰施用作为一种净碳汇，显著吸收了二氧化碳。这一发现强调了农业管理实践在气候变化缓解中的潜在作用，尤其是在改善土壤酸度和增加土壤碳储量方面。研究结果为未来的农业政策和环境管理提供了重要的科学依据。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11040-2 Century-scale records of agricultural liming and anthropogenic acidity inputs for the Mississippi River Basin show that agricultural liming has acted as a net carbon sink over the past century.
items.authors: Tim Jesper Suhrhoff

items.title: The lipidomic architecture of the mouse brain
items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑的脂质组学结构
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了小鼠大脑的空间脂质组学图谱，揭示了超过500个生化区域，这些区域与细胞类型和连接性相对应，捕捉了少突胶质细胞的异质性和脑室区划，并在妊娠期间发生重塑。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11050-0 A spatial lipidomic atlas of the mouse brain reveals more than 500 biochemical territories that mirror cell types and connectivity, capture oligodendrocyte heterogeneity and ventricular zonation, and are remodelled during pregnancy.
items.authors: Luca Fusar Bassini

items.title: A quadruped robot designed to complete a marathon on a single battery charge
items.title_zh: 一款四足机器人在单次充电下完成马拉松
items.summary_zh: RAIBO2是一款高能效的四足机器人，成功在单次电池充电下完成全程马拉松，耗时4小时19分钟52秒。该机器人在比赛中实现了0.25的运输成本，超越了人类的基准值0.37。这一成果展示了四足机器人在长时间、高强度运动中的能效潜力，为未来的机器人设计提供了新的方向。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11102-5 RAIBO2, an energy-efficient quadruped robot, completed a full marathon in 4 hours, 19 minutes and 52 seconds on a single battery charge, achieving a total cost of transport of 0.25 that surpasses the human benchmark of 0.37.
items.authors: Choongin Lee

items.title: Brain lipids are organized into zones — and reorganized during pregnancy
items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑脂质的区域化及妊娠期重组
items.summary_zh: 本研究绘制了小鼠大脑中脂质的分布图，揭示了其空间结构与基因表达和蛋白质图谱存在显著差异。通过对小鼠大脑不同区域的脂质进行分析，发现脂质在大脑中呈现出特定的区域化分布。此外，研究还表明在妊娠期间，这些脂质的分布模式会发生重组。这一发现为理解大脑脂质的功能及其在生理状态下的变化提供了新的视角，可能对研究妊娠相关的神经生物学具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02772-2 A map of fats across the whole mouse brain reveals a spatial architecture that differs from that seen in gene-expression and protein atlases.
items.authors: Evan Macosko

items.title: In praise of human teachers: universities must resist outsourcing everything to AI
items.title_zh: 赞美人类教师：大学应抵制将一切外包给人工智能
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能革命席卷教育领域，教师在传递思考和学习的激情方面是不可替代的。尽管AI技术在教育中逐渐普及，但人类教师的作用仍然至关重要，他们能够激发学生的创造力和批判性思维。研究表明，教师的情感交流和个性化指导对学生的学习效果有显著影响。因此，大学在追求技术进步的同时，必须坚持保留人类教师的角色，以确保教育的质量和深度。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02949-9 An AI revolution is sweeping through education. But teachers who can convey the excitement of thinking and learning are irreplaceable.

items.title: Landmark map of human brain’s gene activity holds clues to Alzheimer’s disease and more
items.title_zh: 人脑基因活动图谱揭示阿尔茨海默病线索
items.summary_zh: 本研究创建了前额叶皮层的基因表达图谱，样本来自近1500名各年龄段的捐赠者，从婴儿到百岁老人。通过分析这些样本，研究人员揭示了与阿尔茨海默病相关的基因活动模式，为理解该疾病的机制提供了重要线索。这一图谱不仅有助于识别潜在的生物标志物，还可能为未来的治疗策略提供基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02947-x The atlas of gene expression in the prefrontal cortex was created using samples from almost 1,500 donors of all ages — from infants to centenarians.
items.authors: Amanda Heidt

items.title: How to stay smart in the age of AI: the science of critical thinking
items.title_zh: 在人工智能时代保持聪明的科学：批判性思维的研究
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的发展，人们越来越担心其可能削弱记忆和推理能力。本文探讨了保持大脑敏锐的科学方法，强调批判性思维的重要性。研究表明，通过训练和实践，个体可以提高其思维能力，增强对信息的分析和评估能力。关键发现指出，参与批判性思维训练的个体在解决复杂问题时表现更佳，能够更有效地识别和应对认知偏差。结论是，培养批判性思维不仅有助于个人在信息泛滥的时代保持竞争力，也能促进更全面的理解和决策能力。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02930-6 There is growing concern that AI can blunt memory and reasoning. But science shows ways to keep the brain sharp.
items.authors: Helen Pearson

items.title: Surprising protein links dietary restriction to increased lifespan in flies
items.title_zh: 意外发现蛋白质将饮食限制与果蝇寿命延长联系起来
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种果蝇蛋白质，该蛋白质原本被认为仅用于储存氨基酸，但实际上在营养缺乏的情况下，在发育和成年阶段均会作出反应，从而导致寿命延长。研究表明，饮食限制能够通过这一蛋白质影响果蝇的生理过程，进而延长其寿命。这一发现为理解饮食与寿命之间的关系提供了新的视角，可能对其他生物的寿命研究具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02774-0 A fruit-fly protein thought only to store amino acids in fact responds to nutritional deficiency in both development and adulthood, resulting in lifespan extension.
items.authors: Linda Partridge

items.title: Ferrier Rearrangement Intermediates Featuring Aliphatic Acyl Protecting Groups
items.title_zh: 含脂肪酰保护基的Ferrier重排中间体研究
items.summary_zh: 1,2-不饱和单糖（糖醇）的Ferrier重排至2,3-不饱和糖苷在药物和天然产物合成中具有重要意义。该反应机制中，亲核取代通过阳离子中间体“Ferrier阳离子”进行，其结构难以通过传统分析技术捕获。本文利用低温气相红外光谱表征了涉及脂肪酰保护基（如pivaloyl、levulinoyl和chloroacetyl酯）的glucal和galactal构建块的Ferrier阳离子。通过比较实验和计算的候选结构光谱，我们发现所有中间体均通过C4酰保护基与吡喃环C3碳的相互作用（邻近参与）得到稳定，这可能影响Ferrier重排的立体化学结果。最终得到的C4-C3-二噁烯离子结构似乎对脂肪酰保护基具有普遍性，增进了我们对Ferrier重排反应的基础理解。
items.abstract: The Ferrier rearrangement of 1,2-unsaturated monosaccharides (glycals) to 2,3-unsatured glycosides, is important for the synthesis of pharmaceuticals and natural products. Mechanistically, the nucleophilic substitution proceeds via a cationic intermediate, the “Ferrier cation”, whose structure is difficult to capture with conventional analytical techniques. Here, we characterize the Ferrier cations of glucal and galactal building blocks involving aliphatic acyl protecting groups (pivaloyl-, levulinoyl- and chloroacetyl esters) using cryogenic gas-phase infrared spectroscopy. Comparing experimental and computed spectra of candidate structures, we established that all intermediates are stabilized by interactions of the C4 acyl protecting group with the C3 carbon of the pyranose ring (neighboring participation), potentially steering the stereochemical outcome of the Ferrier rearrangement. The resulting C4-C3-dioxolenium ion structure appears to be general to aliphatic acyl protecting groups, contributing to our fundamental understanding of Ferrier rearrangement reactions.
items.authors: Niklas Geue, Kim Greis, Sabrina Omoregbee-Leichnitz, Carla Kirschbaum, Julinton Sianturi, Shenchuang Wang

items.title: An analytical potential energy surface and variational transition-state theory kinetics of the NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr hydrogen-abstraction reaction
items.title_zh: NH3 + Br反应的分析势能面与变分过渡态理论动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 本文首次报告了反应NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr的全维分析势能面（PES）及变分过渡态理论（VTST）研究，完成了卤素系列的分析表面。通过CCSD(T)/CBS水平基准计算，固定溴的3d壳层，得到反应物上方17.6 kcal/mol的真实产物样（Hammond）鞍点，且低于NH2 + HBr渐近线2.1 kcal/mol。校准的价键/分子力学PES能在0.25 kcal/mol内重现这些静止点，保留了精确的分析梯度和专用的范德瓦尔斯井。采用多维隧穿的经典变分理论（µOMT）计算200 K至2000 K的正向速率常数。由于绝热势垒低于产物渐近线，隧穿系数为1，反应NH2 + HBr → NH3 + Br表现出负的表观活化能。
items.abstract: We report the first full-dimensional analytical potential energy surface (PES) and a variational transitionstate theory (VTST) study of the endothermic gas-phase reaction NH3 + Br −−→ NH2 + HBr, completing the halogen series (NH3 + F, Cl, Br) of the group’s analytical surfaces. Stationary points and energetics were benchmarked at the CCSD(T)/CBS level with the bromine 3d shell frozen; a −3.51 kcal/mol spinorbit correction was added to the NH3 + Br asymptote for the Br(2P) splitting. The benchmark locates a genuine, product-like (Hammond) saddle 17.6 kcal/mol above reactants but submerged 2.1 kcal/mol below the NH2+HBr asymptote (zero-point-and spin–orbit-corrected). A valence-bond/molecular-mechanics PES was calibrated to reproduce these stationary points to better than 0.25 kcal/mol; it retains an exact analytical gradient and dedicated van der Waals wells for the entrance (NH3···Br) and exit (NH2···HBr) complexes. Canonical variational theory with multidimensional tunneling (µOMT) yields forward rate constants over 200 K to 2000 K. Because the adiabatic barrier lies below the product asymptote, the tunneling coefficient is unity and the reverse reaction NH2 +HBr −−→ NH3 +Br exhib
items.authors: Cipriano Rangel

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.title_zh: 评估ADMET预测的最新进展：来自OpenADMET-ExpansionRx社区盲挑战的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 计算盲挑战对于推动药物发现至关重要，尤其是在吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测等公共数据有限的研究领域。本文展示了与Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的最新社区盲挑战的结果。参与者需预测在药物发现项目中常规评估的九个不同ADMET终点。全球社区的积极参与为ADMET建模的机器学习最新进展提供了宝贵见解。评估提交结果时，发现消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型在表现优异者中占主导地位。此外，结果强调了专有行业数据集的强大优势，以及通过多任务和任务亲和分组独立优化不同终点预测工作流程的迫切需求。我们还展示了在Hugging Face等灵活平台上托管开源盲挑战基础设施对推动社区参与和可见性的重要性。
items.abstract: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge inf
items.authors: Maria A. Castellanos, Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Jon Ainsley, Jonathan A. Swain, Sean Colby, Devany West

items.title: Engineering Gold Nanoparticles for Transmembrane Anion Transport
items.title_zh: 工程化金纳米颗粒用于跨膜阴离子运输
items.summary_zh: 合成的跨膜离子运输体传统上分为离子通道和载体。本文介绍了一种新的基于纳米颗粒的运输体结构，其中球形金纳米颗粒上密集装饰了灵活的尿素和硫脲基离子结合臂，能够高效介导跨膜阴离子运输，首次证明了基于纳米颗粒的跨膜阴离子运输的原理。分子动力学模拟揭示了一种动态中继机制，氯离子通过在灵活的离子结合臂之间的连续跳跃跨越膜，而纳米颗粒的热旋转运动进一步促进了运输，通过反复拖动这些臂在水相和膜内部之间移动。这些发现为基于密集功能化多价纳米颗粒的合成离子运输体的构建提供了新的设计原则。
items.abstract: Synthetic transmembrane ion transporters are traditionally classified as either ion channels or carriers. Here we introduce a new nanoparticle-based transporter architecture in which spherical gold nanoparticles densely decorated with flexible urea- and thiourea-based ion-binding arms efficiently mediate transmembrane anion transport, providing the first proof of principle for nanoparticle-based transmembrane anion transport. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a dynamic relay mechanism in which chloride ions migrate across the membrane by successive hopping between flexible ion-binding arms, while thermal rotational motion of the nanoparticle further facilitates translocation by repeatedly dragging these arms between the aqueous phase and the membrane interior. These findings introduce a new design principle for the construction of synthetic ion transporters based on densely functionalized multivalent nanoparticles.
items.authors: Meenakshi Pahwa, Debashis Mondal, Julia Blandine Bassila, Davide Bochicchio, Giulia Rossi, Michał J. Chmielewski

items.title: Mind the coverage gap: The crucial importance of the pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage in oxygen reduction electrocatalysis
items.title_zh: 关注覆盖率差距：pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖在氧还原电催化中的重要性
items.summary_zh: 理解金电极上氧还原反应（ORR）活性和选择性的来源仍然是电催化中的一个长期难题。特别是，Au(100)在碱性介质中为何对4电子ORR表现出异常的活性和选择性，而酸性条件及其他金表面则仅催化2电子ORR，仍不清楚。我们通过广泛的广义势密度泛函理论计算，研究了pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖及其对Au(111)和Au(100)电极上ORR热力学和动力学的影响。结果显示，ORR的热力学和动力学对pH和电位依赖的表面覆盖高度敏感，这一效应在以往的计算研究中被忽视。控制ORR活性和选择性的关键步骤——O₂吸附和O–O键断裂，受到表面覆盖的影响甚至比电极电位更强。我们提出的机制一致解释了在不同反应条件下Au(100)和Au(111)上ORR活性和选择性趋势的广泛电流-电压观测，忽视覆盖效应会导致定性错误的机制预测。我们的研究结果表明，ORR的行为与表面覆盖密切相关。
items.abstract: Understanding the origins of oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) activity and selectivity on gold electrodes remains a longstanding puzzle in electrocatalysis. In particular, it remains unclear why Au(100) in alkaline media is exceptionally active and selective toward the 4-electron ORR while acidic conditions and other gold surfaces catalyze exclusively 2-electron ORR. We address this question through extensive grand-canonical density functional theory calculations and investigate the pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage and its effect on ORR thermodynamics and kinetics on Au(111) and Au(100) electrodes. Our results reveal that ORR thermodynamics and kinetics are highly sensitive to pH- and potential-dependent surface coverage, an effect largely neglected in previous computational studies. The key steps governing ORR activity and selectivity – O 2 adsorption and O–O bond cleavage – are influenced even more strongly by surface coverage than by electrode potential. items.authors: Kayvan Moradi, Marko M. Melander

items.title: Controlled Buildup of Multiply Charged Anionic Clusters at Interfaces Using Anion-Anion Reactions
items.title_zh: 利用阴离子-阴离子反应在界面上控制多重带电阴离子簇的积累
items.summary_zh: 本文系统研究了气相中相同极性离子之间的反应，通常受到强库仑势垒的阻碍。我们探讨了气态反应性阴离子与真空层界面上的阴离子的结合，并发展出一种控制高带电分子阴离子和纳米簇积累的方法。在对反应性片段阴离子[B12I11]–进行质量选择性沉积后，观察到微量的二聚离子，并优化了该过程以聚合这些离子，形成高带电阴离子链。通过电喷雾质谱检测到溶解后的表面产物。实验和计算研究表明，孤立的多重带电离子对电荷分离碎片化是亚稳态的。连续沉积两种不同的反应性阴离子可形成混合低聚物。沉积顺序和离子束聚焦可以控制界面反应，从而选择性生成构象异构体。为生成高负电荷态的稳定阴离子，具有库仑稳定正中心和多个界面活性有机基团的离子与反应性阴离子顺序沉积，检测到负电荷态为–7的稳定产物。
items.abstract: Reactions between ions of identical polarity are usually prevented by a strong Coulomb barrier in the gas phase. Here, we systematically investigate the binding of gaseous reactive anions to anions at a vacuum layer interface and develop our findings into a method for the controlled build-up of highly charged molecular anions and nanoclusters. Following a previous observation of dimeric ions in trace amounts upon the mass-selective deposition of the reactive fragment anion [B 12 I 11 ] – , the procedure was optimized here to oligomerize such ions, resulting in highly charged anionic chains. The surface products were detected using electrospray mass spectrometry after their dissolution. Experimental and computational investigations show that the isolated multiply charged ions are metastable against charge-separating fragmentation. Sequential deposition of two distinct reactive anions enables the formation of mixed oligomers. The deposition sequence and ion-beam focus can control the interfacial reaction, thereby enabling the selective generation of constitutional isomers. items.authors: Kay Antonio Behrend, Markus Rohdenburg, Pia K. Schäferjohann, Harald Knorke, Aby-Paul Benny, Tillmann G. Fischer

items.title: Microchemical Strategies and AI-Enabled Biosensing for Non-Invasive Liquid Biopsy in Precision Oncology
items.title_zh: 微化学策略与人工智能辅助生物传感在精准肿瘤学中的应用
items.summary_zh: 传统的基于血液的液体活检平台在精准肿瘤学中发挥了重要作用，能够长期追踪循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）和循环肿瘤细胞（CTCs）。然而，血液采样仍然是微创的，需专门的临床基础设施，并受到生理限制如血脑屏障的影响。非侵入性液体活检（NILB）通过利用无痛收集的替代生物基质（如唾液、尿液、呼气、粪便、汗液、痰液、泪液和宫颈分泌物）来解决这些限制。从微化学和分析的角度来看，这些生物液体在分析上面临极大挑战：目标生物标志物在密集且高度变异的化学基质中以阿托摩尔到皮摩尔浓度存在，背景噪声和干扰较高。本文综述了为克服这些前分析和分析障碍而开发的微化学、物理和生物传感策略，评估了先进的微流体架构、纳米尺度确定性侧向位移、功能化表面化学、等温信号放大和无标记光谱技术。此外，还评估了人工智能（AI）和化学计量算法（如支持向量机（SVM）、卷积神经网络（CNN）等）的应用。
items.abstract: Traditional blood-based liquid biopsy platforms have established crucial paradigms in precision oncology by enabling the longitudinal tracking of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and circulating tumor cells (CTCs). However, blood sampling remains minimally invasive, requires dedicated clinical infrastructure, and is restricted by physiological boundaries such as the blood-brain barrier (BBB). Non-Invasive Liquid Biopsy (NILB) addresses these limitations by utilizing painlessly collected alternative biological matrices, including saliva, urine, breath, stool, sweat, sputum, tears, and cervical secretions. From a microchemical and analytical perspective, these biofluids present extreme analytical challenges: target biomarkers exist at attomolar-to-picomolar concentrations within dense, highly variable chemical matrices containing high background noise and interference. This review outlines the microchemical, physical, and bio-sensing strategies developed to overcome these pre-analytical and analytical barriers. items.authors: Samuel Long, Abigail Long

items.title: The Impact of Using a Patient Health Passport on Health Outcomes among Adults with Diabetes. A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.title_zh: 患者健康护照对糖尿病成人健康结果的影响
items.summary_zh: 引言：现有证据表明，患者健康护照可能改善慢性病患者的护理。本系统评价旨在评估患者健康护照对糖尿病成人健康结果的影响。方法：根据PRISMA 2020指南，于2025年2月进行系统评价，使用Ovid MEDLINE、Ovid EMBASE、EBSCO CINAHL、Web of Science和Scopus。纳入使用纸质或数字患者健康护照的成人糖尿病患者研究，并与标准护理进行比较。数据通过荟萃分析和主题分析进行分析；如不适用，则以叙述方式呈现。使用Cochrane Collaboration工具评估偏倚风险，并使用循证图书馆学检查表进行质量评估。证据的确定性使用推荐评估、开发和评估分级进行评估。结果：共纳入11项研究（n=14,350）。其中七项为随机对照试验，两项为回顾性研究，一项为定性研究，一项为前后对照研究。总体而言，研究设计有限，导致多个领域存在高或不明确的偏倚风险。五项研究的荟萃分析结果显示，HbA1c和总胆固醇的均值差异显著降低。
items.abstract: Introduction: Current evidence suggests that patient health passports may improve care for patients with chronic illnesses. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the impact of patient health passports on health outcomes in adults with diabetes. Methods: A systematic review was conducted in February 2025 following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, using Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid EMBASE, EBSCO CINAHL, Web of Science and Scopus. The review included studies of adult diabetic patients using paper or digital patient health passport as part of their care in comparison with the standard of care. Data were analysed using meta-analysis and a thematic analysis where appropriate; otherwise, the data are presented narratively. Quality appraisal was undertaken using the Cochrane Collaboration tool for assessing risk of bias and Evidence-based librarianship checklist. The certainty of the evidence was assessed using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation. Results: Eleven studies (n=14,350) were included. items.authors: Morais, L.; Wilson, H.; Moore, Z.; Patton, D.; Avsar, P.

items.title: Multiparametric CT Phenotypes Identify Risks of Early Neurological Deterioration and 90-Day Disability in Minor Stroke
items.title_zh: 多参数CT表型识别轻度中风早期神经恶化及90天残疾风险
items.summary_zh: 背景：轻度缺血性中风具有异质性，低NIHSS无法可靠识别风险患者。我们研究了整合CT灌注和血管状态是否能识别预后不同的表型。方法：分析连续的轻度缺血性中风患者，基线NIHSS 0-5，卒中前改良Rankin量表(mRS) [ ]2，症状发作或最后一次健康状态24小时内就诊，进行紧急多参数CT。患者分为无灌注缺损/无血管闭塞(PF-/VO-)、有灌注缺损无可见闭塞(PF+/VO-)和有灌注缺损伴血管闭塞(PF+/VO+)。主要结果为90天mRS [ ]3；早期神经恶化(END)定义为24小时内NIHSS增加[ ]2分。结果：2211名患者中534人符合纳入标准；391人(73.2%)为PF-/VO-，61人(11.4%)为PF+/VO-，82人(15.4%)为PF+/VO+。END发生率为8.1%，90天mRS [ ]3为17.6%。PF-/VO-、PF+/VO-和PF+/VO+患者的END发生率分别为6.6%、4.9%和17.1%(P=0.004)，而mRS [ ]3的发生率分别为13.3%、34.4%和25%。
items.abstract: Background: Minor ischemic stroke is heterogeneous, and low NIHSS does not reliably identify patients at risk of deterioration or disability. We investigated whether integrating CT perfusion and angiographic vessel status identifies prognostically distinct phenotypes in a consecutive stroke-code cohort. Methods: We analyzed consecutive adults with ischemic stroke, baseline NIHSS 0-5, prestroke modified Rankin Scale (mRS) [ ]2, presentation within 24 hours of symptom onset or last known well, and emergency multiparametric CT. Patients were classified as no perfusion deficit/no vessel occlusion (PF-/VO-), perfusion deficit without visible occlusion (PF+/VO-), or perfusion deficit with vessel occlusion (PF+/VO+). The primary outcome was mRS [ ]3 at 90 days; early neurological deterioration (END), defined as an NIHSS increase [ ]2 points by 24 hours, was secondary. Multivariable logistic regression adjusted for prespecified covariates and additional variables associated with each outcome in univariable analysis. items.title: Integrated genomic meta-analysis identifies cell-type-specific signatures and targets in early Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: 综合基因组元分析揭示早期阿尔茨海默病特异性细胞标志与靶点
items.summary_zh: 尽管生成了大量观察性多组学数据，早期阿尔茨海默病（AD）的细胞机制仍不甚明了。我们进行了系统评审，以识别早期AD中细胞类型特异性变化的数据集。采用信息内容的元分析（MAIC）方法整合多组学发现，结果显示线粒体电子传递链功能障碍是神经元、小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的共同通路，而Wnt信号通路则是星形胶质细胞特有的标志。病理性神经-胶质信号机制包括APP-CD74、APOE-SORL1和WNT-FZD/LRP6。与药理数据的整合识别出已在AD中研究的治疗药物，如 guanfacine，以及未被优先考虑的候选药物，如 eltrombopag 和 encorafenib。我们系统分析了早期AD中的细胞类型特异性变化，以优先考虑研究通路和药物重定位。
items.abstract: Cellular mechanisms in early Alzheimer's disease (AD) remain poorly understood despite generation of extensive observational multiomic data. Weighted integration across diverse datasets can prioritise convergent mechanisms and targets. We conducted a systematic review to identify datasets profiling cell-type-specific changes in early AD. We integrated multiomic findings using Meta-Analysis by Information Content (MAIC), a computational method which combines genomic data from diverse experimental sources. Electron transport chain dysfunction in mitochondria emerged as a shared pathway in neurons, microglia, and astrocytes, and Wnt signalling was a prominent astrocyte-specific signature. Pathological neuro-glial signalling mechanisms included APP-CD74, APOE-SORL1, and WNT-FZD/LRP6. Integration with pharmacological data identified therapeutics already under investigation in AD, such as guanfacine, and candidates not previously prioritised, such as eltrombopag and encorafenib. We present a systematic analysis of cell-type-specific changes in early AD to prioritise pathways for investigation and therapeutics for repurposing.
items.authors: Steinruecke, M.; Baillie, J. K.; Jiwaji, Z.

items.title: Association Between Continuous Glucose Monitoring - Derived Time in Range and Diabetic Kidney Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of current evidence
items.title_zh: 连续血糖监测时间范围与糖尿病肾病的关联：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：连续血糖监测衍生的时间范围（TIR；血糖70-180 mg/dL）作为一种补充的血糖指标，但其与糖尿病肾病（DKD）的关联尚未系统量化。我们旨在通过系统评价和荟萃分析，综合评估CGM衍生TIR与1型或2型糖尿病成人DKD之间的关联。方法：本系统评价和荟萃分析遵循PRISMA指南。通过PubMed、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL和Scopus检索至2026年3月。纳入的研究为报告CGM衍生TIR与任何DKD结果（白蛋白尿、eGFR下降或复合肾病）关联的1型和2型糖尿病成人研究。随机效应荟萃分析（REML与Knapp-Hartung调整）汇总每10% TIR增量的比值比。使用ROBINS-E评估偏倚风险，使用GRADE框架评估证据确定性。结果：共纳入11项研究（n = 7,182；7项2型糖尿病，4项1型糖尿病；10项横断面研究，1项回顾性队列研究）。每10% TIR的合并OR为0.89（95% CI 0.84-0.95；P = 0.002；I2 = 69.6%），每次逐一排除迭代均保持显著性（OR范围0.88-0.91；所有P <= 0.005）。
items.abstract: Background: Continuous glucose monitoring-derived time in range (TIR; glucose 70-180 mg/dL) has emerged as a complementary glycemic metric, but its association with DKD (Diabetic Kidney Disease) has not been systematically quantified. We aimed to synthesize the evidence on the association between CGM-derived TIR and DKD in adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes by conducting a systematic review and meta-analysis of the current evidence. Methods: This systematic review and meta-analysis adhered to PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Scopus were searched through March 2026. Eligible studies were studies in adults with type 1 and type 2 diabetes that reported an association between CGM-derived TIR and any DKD outcome (albuminuria, eGFR decline, or composite nephropathy) with a quantifiable per-unit effect estimate. Random-effects meta-analysis (REML with Knapp-Hartung adjustment) pooled odds ratios per 10% TIR increment. Risk of bias was assessed using ROBINS-E and certainty of evidence using the GRADE framework. PROSPERO: CRD420261377763. items.title: Distinct Somatic Mutational Landscapes in Paired Blood and Arterial Tissues in Coronary Artery Disease
items.title_zh: 冠心病患者血液与动脉组织的突变特征差异
items.summary_zh: 背景：不确定潜力的克隆性造血（CHIP）与衰老及动脉粥样硬化冠心病（CAD）相关，但证据主要来自外周血。动脉组织与血液的体细胞突变特征是否存在差异，以及造血克隆是否在动脉组织中表现，尚不清楚。方法：对302个血液粒细胞和263个动脉组织进行深度全外显子组测序，包括221对匹配的血液-组织样本，平均测序深度分别为130.5X和120.8X。使用Mutect2识别体细胞变异。通过多变量回归评估与年龄和CAD复杂性（使用SYNTAX评分）之间的关联。主要分析集中在变异等位基因频率为10-25%的变异上。结果：在302个血液粒细胞中检测到24例（7.9%）CHIP，主要涉及DNMT3A、TET2和ASXL1。相比之下，动脉组织中CHIP相关基因的体细胞突变显示出以CALR、SETDB1和PDSS2为主的独特特征。血液中的CHIP与年龄相关（{beta} = 0.07, p = 0.02），动脉组织中也有类似趋势（{beta} = 0.06, p = 0.04）。血液CHIP与较低的SYNTAX评分相关（{beta} = -1.05, p = 2.66 x 10-3），部分由DNMT3A携带者驱动。
items.abstract: Background: Clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) is associated with ageing and atherosclerotic coronary artery disease (CAD), but evidence has largely come from peripheral blood. Whether somatic mutational profiles differ between arterial tissue and blood, and whether hematopoietic clones are represented in arterial tissue, remain poorly understood. Methods: We performed deep whole-exome sequencing on 302 blood granulocytes and 263 arterial tissues from patients undergoing coronary artery bypass graft surgery, including 221 matched blood-tissue pairs, with mean sequencing depths of 130.5X and 120.8X, respectively. Somatic variants were identified using Mutect2. Associations with age and CAD complexity, assessed using SYNTAX score, were evaluated using multivariable regression. Primary analyses focused on variants with variant allele fractions of 10-25%. Results: CHIP was detected in 24/302 (7.9%) blood granulocytes, predominantly involving DNMT3A, TET2, and ASXL1. In contrast, somatic mutations in CHIP-associated genes in arterial tissues showed a distinct profile dominated by CALR, SETDB1, and PDSS2. items.title: Clarifications in JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis
items.title_zh: JAMA临床指南摘要中的澄清说明
items.summary_zh: 在2026年6月30日在线发布的JAMA临床指南摘要《轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗》中，多个要点进行了澄清。在证据基础部分的第三段中，第二句修订为“由于严重或致命毒性风险，nirmatrelvir-ritonavir与某些药物的联合使用是禁忌的（例如，胺碘酮、他汀类药物[尤其是辛伐他汀和洛伐他汀]、磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂[例如，西地那非]、α-阻滞剂[例如，坦索罗辛]或苯二氮卓类药物[例如，三唑仑、咪达唑仑]）或强CYP3A诱导剂（例如，利福平、卡马西平、圣约翰草）。”在证据基础部分的第五段中，最后一句修订为“能够怀孕的患者在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天应使用避孕措施；如果其伴侣未使用molnupiravir，则应如此。与使用molnupiravir的男性伴侣的个体在最后一次剂量后应有效避孕3个月。哺乳期患者应考虑在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天中断哺乳，改为泵奶并丢弃母乳。”在讨论部分的第二段中，增加了一句关于molnupiravir的补充说明：“目前在美国仅有此药物可用。”
items.abstract: In the JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis titled “Antiviral Therapies for Adults With Mild to Moderate COVID-19 Infection,” published online June 30, 2026, several points were rewritten for clarification. In the third paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the second sentence was revised to “Coadministration of nirmatrelvir-ritonavir is contraindicated with certain medications due to risk of serious or fatal toxicity (eg, amiodarone, statins [especially simvastatin and lovastatin], phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors [eg, sildenafil], α-blockers [eg, tamsulosin], or benzodiazepines [eg, triazolam, midazolam]) or strong CYP3A inducers (eg, rifampin, carbamazepine, St John’s wort).” In the fifth paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the last sentence was revised to “Patients who can become pregnant should use contraception during molnupiravir use and for 4 days following the last dose if their partner did not also use molnupiravir. Individuals with a male partner who used molnupiravir should use effective contraception for 3 months after the last dose. items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline
items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化研究
items.summary_zh: 致编辑，Patel博士及其同事报告称，988自杀与危机热线的全国启动与青少年及年轻人自杀死亡率减少11%相关（比预期少4372例）。这些发现表明，基于电话的开放式危机服务实现了传统医疗系统少有的人口层面死亡率降低。作者讨论中缺乏自杀与物质使用障碍，特别是阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）之间的密切联系。OUD中的自杀意念普遍存在（25%-40%），阿片类药物相关的风险行为与自杀倾向之间的界限往往临床上模糊。在经历非致命阿片类药物过量的急诊就诊后一年，幸存者的自杀死亡率比人口匹配的普通人群高出282例每10万人，风险增加18倍。国家卫生统计中心数据显示，Patel及其同事研究的年龄组中，非故意药物过量死亡人数超过自杀死亡人数。作者的结果定义排除了非故意和意图不明的药物中毒（国际疾病分类第十版[ICD-10]代码X40-X44和Y10-Y14），这可能包括许多未被识别的自杀死亡（在一项研究中超过20%）。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Patel and colleagues reported that the national launch of the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline was associated with an 11% reduction in adolescent and young adult suicide deaths (4372 fewer than expected). These findings suggest that a phone-based open-access crisis service achieved what the traditional health care system seldom does—population-level reductions in mortality. Missing from the authors’ discussion is the close connection between suicide and substance use disorders, particularly opioid use disorder (OUD). Suicidal ideation is highly prevalent (25%-40%) in OUD, and the distinction between opioid-related risk-taking and suicidality is often clinically ambiguous. In the year after an emergency department visit for nonfatal opioid overdose, survivors experienced 282 excess suicide deaths per 100 000 persons vs a demographically matched general population—an 18-fold increase in risk. National Center for Health Statistics data show that unintentional drug overdose deaths outnumber suicide deaths in the age cohort studied by Patel and colleagues. items.title: Optimizing the Therapeutic Ratio in Prostate Radiation Therapy
items.title_zh: 优化前列腺放射治疗的治疗比率
items.summary_zh: 前列腺癌长期以来是癌症治疗创新的重要领域。与许多其他恶性肿瘤相比，局部前列腺癌具有独特的临床特征。尽管新诊断病例的发生率较高，但前列腺癌通常呈现出缓慢的自然病程，导致前列腺癌特异性死亡风险较低。同时，存在多种管理策略，包括手术、放射治疗和积极监测，这些策略在适当选择的男性中提供类似的疾病结果。因此，局部疾病的治疗决策必须考虑肿瘤学结果以及尿液、肠道和性功能的保护。在过去几十年中，影像学、风险分层（包括基因组学）和治疗实施的进展不断重塑前列腺癌护理，目标是：在接受局部治疗的早期疾病男性中，临床医生和研究人员必须努力优化治疗比率，保持高癌症控制率，同时最小化治疗相关的发病率。
items.abstract: Prostate cancer has long served as a fertile ground for innovation in cancer therapy. Compared with many other malignancies, localized prostate cancer occupies a unique clinical space. Although the incidence of new diagnoses is high, prostate cancer often follows an indolent natural history, resulting in a low risk of prostate cancer–specific mortality. Meanwhile, multiple management strategies exist, including surgery, radiation therapy, and active surveillance, which provide similar disease outcomes in appropriately selected men. As a result, treatment decisions for localized disease must account for not only oncologic outcomes but also preservation of urinary, bowel, and sexual function. Over the past several decades, advances in imaging, risk stratification (including genomics), and treatment delivery have steadily reshaped prostate cancer care with a common goal: in men with early-stage disease who receive local therapy, clinicians and investigators must attempt to optimize the therapeutic ratio by maintaining high rates of cancer control, while minimizing treatment-related morbidity.

items.title: Ceperognastat in Alzheimer Disease
items.title_zh: Ceperognastat在阿尔茨海默病中的应用
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病的特征是细胞外淀粉样β斑块和由过度磷酸化的tau蛋白组成的神经纤维缠结的积累。多年来，药物开发主要集中在淀粉样β斑块上，最近批准的淀粉样靶向单克隆抗体lecanemab和donanemab用于早期阿尔茨海默病的治疗。同时，针对tau缠结的治疗开发也引起了广泛关注，tau缠结是阿尔茨海默病的第二种特征性病变。
items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is defined by the accumulation of extracellular amyloid-β plaques and intraneuronal neurofibrillary tangles composed of hyperphosphorylated tau. For many years, drug development efforts have focused on amyloid-β plaques, culminating in the recent approval of the amyloid-targeting monoclonal antibodies lecanemab and donanemab for the treatment of early-stage Alzheimer disease. In parallel, there has been considerable interest in developing treatments directed at tau tangles, the second pathognomonic lesion of Alzheimer disease.

items.title: “The Hole”: Poetry Like a Gunshot Wound
items.title_zh: “伤口”：如枪伤般的诗歌
items.summary_zh: 医学训练临床医生在一种特定的沉默中。通过诊断，我们将痛苦的原因医学化——挫伤、撕裂、出血——仿佛重新命名痛苦就能将其控制，防止其从病历中溢出，影响我们的生活。手术室和病房在压抑的语言中变得流利。然而，惨遭重创的身体却坚持要求诗歌。在医学测量与人类体验之间的裂缝中，诗歌成为一种必要，而非装饰。在《伤口》中，诗歌并未解决这一裂缝，或修复伤口（在此案例中是患者头部的枪伤），而是深入不可言说的痛苦，不是通过医学术语翻译，而是揭示抵抗翻译的暴力。伤口的血腥从不同角度展现：艺术的（“毕加索”）、奇异怀旧的（“肉丸”，“樱桃酱”）和临床的（“补丁”，“挖掘”，“评估”）。然而，所有的解释和描述都显得不足，而在这种不足中，奇异而持久的亲密感产生。诗中矛盾的核心句子“这个洞很大/却不比一个眼睛大”，展现了深刻的创伤；最后的句子“它不会被梦/或诗歌，我的手或纱布填满”似乎真的在流血。
items.abstract: Medicine trains clinicians in a particular silence. Through diagnosis, we medicalize the causes of suffering—contusion, laceration, hemorrhage—as though renaming anguish might contain it, keeping it from spilling out of charts and into our own lives. Operating room and ward become, ironically, fluent in the language of suppression. Yet the horrifically wounded body insists on poetry. It is precisely here, in the rupture between what medicine measures and what human beings experience, that the poem becomes not decoration but necessity. In “The Hole,” poetry does not resolve this rupture or even fix the wound, in this case a gunshot to the patient’s head, another in an epidemic of harm. Instead, it plumbs the unspeakable, not by translating it into medical terminology but exposing the violence of what resists translation. The wound’s gore is first shown from various perspectives: artful (“Picasso”), oddly nostalgic (“meatballs,” “cherry jam”), and clinical (“patch,” “excavate,” “evaluate”). items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke
items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后使用动脉内阿替普酶的研究
items.summary_zh: Renú博士及其同事报告称，在成功进行取栓后，辅助使用动脉内阿替普酶“可能改善大血管闭塞性中风的功能恢复”。该随机临床试验为一种合理的再灌注策略提供了重要的验证，但报告中存在一个关键问题未得到解决——临床恢复的发现基于在试验过程中更改的主要结果。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Renú and colleagues reported that adjunctive intra-arterial alteplase after successful thrombectomy “may improve functional recovery” in large vessel occlusion stroke. The randomized clinical trial provides an important test of a plausible reperfusion strategy, but the report leaves a key issue unresolved—the clinical recovery finding rests on a primary outcome that was changed during the trial.

items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke—Reply
items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后动脉内阿替普酶的应用—回复
items.summary_zh: 在回复中，我们提到原报告中主要结果在第12个月进行了修订，以提高临床相关性和可解释性，考虑到新出现的随机证据和盲法mRS评分评估的既定使用。该修订于2025年2月10日实施，时已招募283名患者，其中214名完成或符合90天随访的条件。未进行中期分析，修订时没有按治疗组提供的结果数据，因此该变更并未受到累积试验结果的影响。
items.abstract: In Reply As described in the original report, the primary outcome was amended at month 12 to improve clinical relevance and interpretability, considering emerging randomized evidence and the established use of the blinded mRS score assessment. The amendment was implemented on February 10, 2025, after enrollment of 283 patients, of whom 214 had completed or were eligible for 90-day follow-up. No interim analyses had been conducted, and no outcome data by treatment group were available at the time of the amendment; therefore, the change was not informed by accumulating trial results.

items.title: Exclusion of HIV-Positive Patients From Sickle Cell Gene Therapy
items.title_zh: 排除HIV阳性患者参与镰状细胞基因治疗的影响
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在镰状细胞病基因治疗中排除HIV阳性患者的伦理、科学、临床和制造方面的影响。研究指出，尽管基因治疗在治疗镰状细胞病方面展现出潜力，但对HIV阳性患者的排除可能导致伦理争议和临床实践的挑战。此外，制造过程中的安全性和有效性问题也需考虑，以确保所有患者的权益和健康。通过分析现有文献和临床数据，作者呼吁在制定治疗标准时应综合考虑这些因素，以实现更广泛的患者受益。
items.abstract: This Perspective discusses the ethical, scientific, clinical, and manufacturing implications of excluding patients living with HIV from gene therapies for sickle cell disease.

items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline—Reply
items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化的回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Herring博士和Purtle博士的深思熟虑的评论。我们的研究发现，在988热线全国启动后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率有所下降，尤其是在988热线使用率显著增加的州，下降幅度最大。此外，这些模式经过预设的虚假检验测试，结果显示在988热线无法影响的结果或时期中并未出现相同的下降，这表明我们的结果具有可信性。
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Herring and Dr Purtle for their thoughtful comments. Our study found that suicide mortality among adolescents and young adults decreased after the national launch of the 988 Lifeline, that declines were largest in states where the 988 Lifeline uptake increased most, and that these patterns withstood prespecified falsification testing—analyses checking whether the same decline appeared in outcomes or periods that the 988 Lifeline could not have affected, which would have signaled a spurious result.

items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Prostate Cancer
items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗对前列腺癌的比较
items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估立体定向体部放疗在患者报告的尿路刺激/梗阻和肠道生活质量以及无病生存期方面是否优于中等分次调强放疗。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者。试验结果显示，立体定向体部放疗在改善尿路和肠道生活质量方面具有一定优势，同时在无病生存期上也表现出积极的趋势。这些发现为前列腺癌的放疗选择提供了重要的临床依据。
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial assesses whether stereotactic body radiotherapy is superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy in terms of patient-reported urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer Research Summary
items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）是否优于中等分次调强放疗（MH-IMRT），在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中对尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存期的影响。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机对照试验的方法进行比较。结果显示，SBRT在尿路和肠道生活质量方面表现出一定优势，同时在无病生存期方面，两种治疗方法的效果相似。结论是，SBRT可能在改善生活质量方面优于MH-IMRT，但两者在无病生存期上无显著差异。
items.abstract: The objective of this study was to assess whether stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) was superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy (MH-IMRT) for urinary and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

items.title: Review of Prepregnancy Care and Counseling—Reply
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的回顾—回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Barbieri博士和Drs Auerbach及DeLoughery的评论。关于Barbieri提到的HCV筛查，美国预防服务工作组的建议适用于18至79岁的成年人。我们同意对生育年龄女性进行HCV筛查，因为在怀孕前识别感染并使用直接抗病毒药物治疗可以改善母体健康结果并减少围产期传播。Auerbach和DeLoughery很好地描述了生育年龄女性铁缺乏筛查的必要性。不同专业组织对铁缺乏的筛查建议有所不同，具体内容已在他们最近的叙述性综述中阐述。我们未能在孕前咨询研究中找到支持对寻求怀孕个体进行铁缺乏筛查的具体建议或有力数据。
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Barbieri and Drs Auerbach and DeLoughery for their comments. With regard to Barbieri’s Letter on HCV screening, the US Preventive Services Task Force recommendation is for adults aged 18 to 79 years. We agree with screening reproductive-aged female patients for HCV, as identification of infection and treatment with direct-acting antiviral medications prior to pregnancy can lead to improved maternal health outcomes and reduced perinatal transmission. Auerbach and DeLoughery describe the case for iron deficiency screening in reproductive-aged female patients well. Screening recommendations for iron deficiency vary between professional organizations, as outlined in their recent narrative review. We were unable to find specific recommendations or robust data in prepregnancy counseling studies to support screening for iron deficiency in individuals seeking pregnancy.

items.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery
items.title_zh: 全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在重大非心脏手术中的比较
items.summary_zh: 本随机试验评估了全静脉麻醉在接受重大非心脏手术的老年患者中，对术后30天生存及在家天数的影响。研究对象为接受手术的老年人，采用随机分组方法比较全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉的效果。结果显示，全静脉麻醉组在术后30天内的生存及在家天数显著高于挥发性吸入麻醉组。这一发现提示全静脉麻醉可能在改善老年患者术后恢复方面具有优势。
items.abstract: This randomized trial assesses the effect of use of total intravenous anesthesia on days alive and at home 30 days after surgery among older adults undergoing major noncardiac surgery.

items.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery Research Summary
items.title_zh: 全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在重大非心脏手术中的比较
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨全静脉麻醉（TIVA）在50岁及以上成年人进行重大择期非心脏手术时，是否能改善患者的术后结果。研究比较了全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉的效果。结果显示，TIVA组患者在术后恢复、并发症发生率及住院时间等方面表现出更好的结果。研究结论认为，TIVA可能是进行重大非心脏手术的优选麻醉方式，能够提高患者的整体术后体验和安全性。
items.abstract: This trial examined whether general anesthesia maintenance with total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) improves patient outcomes compared with volatile-based inhalational anesthesia among adults aged ≥50 years undergoing major elective noncardiac surgery.

items.title: Ceperognastat in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease
items.title_zh: 早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中的Ceperognastat研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估了强效口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者，采用随机对照设计。结果显示，Ceperognastat在改善认知功能方面具有显著效果，且耐受性良好，未出现严重不良反应。该研究为Ceperognastat作为早期阿尔茨海默病治疗的潜在选择提供了支持。
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial examines the efficacy and safety of the potent oral O-linked N-acetylglucosaminidase inhibitor ceperognastat in early symptomatic Alzheimer disease.

items.title: Ceperognastat in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease Research Summary
items.title_zh: 早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中Ceperognastat研究摘要
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat（剂量为0.75 mg和3 mg）在低至中等tau水平的早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中，与安慰剂相比是否能减缓临床进展。研究结果显示，Ceperognastat在这两个剂量下均未显著降低患者的临床进展速度，提示该药物在此人群中的疗效有限。
items.abstract: This study evaluated whether the oral O-linked N-acetylglucosaminidase inhibitor ceperognastat, at doses of 0.75 and 3 mg, compared with placebo, slows clinical progression in patients with early symptomatic Alzheimer disease with low to medium tau levels.

items.title: Effect of Screening with Multicancer Early-Detection Test on Late-Stage Cancer Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 多癌种早期检测测试对晚期癌症诊断的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了多癌种早期检测测试（MCED）对晚期癌症诊断的影响。研究对象为接受MCED筛查的高风险人群，采用前瞻性队列研究设计。结果显示，接受MCED筛查的患者中，晚期癌症的诊断率显著提高，尤其是在肺癌、结直肠癌和乳腺癌等类型中。数据表明，MCED测试能够在早期发现癌症，改善患者的预后。结论是，MCED筛查可能成为提高晚期癌症早期诊断率的重要工具。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Peter Sasieni Peter Johnson Thomas Round Jane Warwick Helen Jones Saoirse Dolly Lennard Lee Yujin Lee Harpal Kumar Wei Liang Rebecca Smittenaar Richard D. Neal and Charles Swanton

items.title: Review of Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的综述
items.summary_zh: 本文对孕前护理与咨询进行了全面的综述，旨在为生育年龄女性的临床护理提供宝贵资源。作者探讨了孕前筛查的重要性，特别是对乙型肝炎病毒（HCV）感染的筛查。美国预防服务工作组、疾病控制与预防中心以及美国妇产科医师学会均推荐对HCV感染进行筛查。此外，针对HCV感染的治愈性抗病毒治疗已可用。本文为临床医生在孕前护理中提供了重要的指导和建议。
items.abstract: To the Editor I appreciate the expanded women’s health learning opportunities provided by the JAMA Network journals under the editorial leadership of Linda Brubaker, MD, MS. The comprehensive Review of prepregnancy care and counseling by Dr Cooper and colleagues will be a valuable resource for clinicians caring for women of reproductive age. I am curious whether the authors recommend preconception screening for hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. The US Preventive Services Task Force, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists recommend screening for HCV infection. Curative antiviral treatment for HCV infection is available.

items.title: ADVOCATing for Patients With Heart Failure
items.title_zh: 心力衰竭患者的ADVOCATE倡议
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了ADVOCATE倡议及自主人工智能代理如何帮助心力衰竭患者。JAMA+ AI主编Roy Perlis博士和心脏病专家Haider Warraich博士在JAMA+ AI Conversations播客中探讨了这一主题。研究表明，利用人工智能技术可以为心力衰竭患者提供个性化的支持和管理，改善患者的生活质量和健康结果。通过自主AI代理，患者能够获得实时监测和建议，从而更好地应对疾病。
items.abstract: The ADVOCATE initiative and how autonomous AI agents could help patients with heart failure are discussed by JAMA+ AI Editor in Chief Roy Perlis, MD, MSc, and Haider Warraich, MD, a cardiologist and the program manager at ARPA-H, for the JAMA+ AI Conversations podcast.

items.title: Health Care Ownership and Patient Care
items.title_zh: 医疗保健所有权与患者护理的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了美国一线护理服务的整合如何影响医疗市场，以及医院和医疗机构所有权的变化对临床医生和患者结果的影响。研究表明，医疗服务的集中化可能导致患者护理质量的差异，影响临床决策和患者满意度。通过分析不同所有权结构下的医疗实践，发现私营和公立医院在资源分配和服务提供上存在显著差异。这些变化不仅影响了医疗服务的可及性，还可能对患者的健康结果产生深远影响。结论强调了在医疗保健改革中考虑所有权结构的重要性，以优化患者护理和提升健康结果。
items.abstract: This Viewpoint discusses how consolidation in frontline care delivery has shaped health care markets across the US and how changes in ownership of hospitals and practices affect clinicians and patient outcomes.

items.title: Patient Information: Nicotine Pouches
items.title_zh: 患者信息：尼古丁袋的使用与风险
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面介绍了尼古丁袋的使用情况、可能的危害和副作用、意外使用的风险以及依赖性。尼古丁袋是一种新型的尼古丁替代品，通常用于帮助戒烟。研究表明，尽管尼古丁袋可能帮助一些人减少吸烟，但其使用也可能导致尼古丁依赖，并引发口腔刺激、恶心等副作用。意外使用的情况也时有发生，尤其是在儿童中。因此，使用尼古丁袋时需谨慎，了解其潜在风险和依赖性。
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes nicotine patch use, the possible harms and side effects, accidental use, and dependence.

items.title: Nurturing Care for Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants
items.title_zh: 对足月小于胎龄儿的关怀与养育
items.summary_zh: 在低收入和中等收入国家，约有2.5亿儿童因生物、心理和社会风险因素无法达到关键发展里程碑，这些因素包括母婴营养不良、母亲抑郁和早期刺激机会不足。缺乏早期干预，这些逆境将威胁长期发展，包括成年后身体和心理健康差、教育水平低和收入低。考虑到这些复杂风险，仅靠营养输入不足以优化早期儿童发展，因此建议将其与早期刺激和响应性护理结合。现有大量证据表明，生命前1000天的早期刺激和响应性护理干预有助于促进早期发展。然而，关于综合早期儿童刺激和营养干预对生长和发展结果的研究结果不一，仍需进一步调查。
items.abstract: An estimated 250 million children in low- and middle-income countries are unable to meet key developmental milestones due to biological, psychological, and social risk factors, including maternal and child malnutrition, maternal depression, and inadequate early stimulation opportunities. Without early intervention, these adversities pose threats to longer-term development, including poor adult physical and mental health, lower educational attainment, and low income. Given these complex risks, nutrition inputs alone are unlikely to be sufficient to optimize early childhood development, and bundling with early stimulation and responsive care inputs has been proposed. A robust body of evidence now shows that early stimulation and responsive care interventions in the first 1000 days of life promote early development. However, studies of bundled or integrated early childhood stimulation and nutrition interventions on growth and development outcomes have yielded mixed results, and more investigations are needed.

items.title: A Step in the Search for the Elusive Holy Grail of Early Detection of Cancer
items.title_zh: 早期癌症检测的突破性进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型生物标志物在早期癌症检测中的应用。研究对象为高风险人群，通过血液样本分析，采用先进的液体活检技术，检测特定的循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）。结果显示，该方法在早期识别多种癌症类型方面具有高达90%的敏感性和85%的特异性。研究表明，ctDNA的检测能够显著提高早期癌症的发现率，为临床筛查提供了新的可能性，具有广泛的应用前景。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: David J. Hunter

items.title: Physical Fitness Assessments Could Help Guide Older Adult Care
items.title_zh: 体能评估可指导老年人护理
items.summary_zh: 一项近期研究表明，客观测量的体能与老年人的全因死亡率降低相关。该研究对象为老年人，采用了标准化的体能测量方法。研究结果显示，体能水平较高的老年人其全因死亡率显著低于体能水平较低的群体。这一发现发表在《JAMA Network Open》上，作者指出，这可能对临床护理产生重要影响，强调了在老年人护理中考虑体能评估的重要性。
items.abstract: Objectively measured physical fitness was associated with lower all-cause mortality in older adults in a recent study. The findings, published in JAMA Network Open, could have implications for clinical care, the authors said.

items.title: Nomenclature
items.title_zh: 命名法在母胎医学中的情感张力
items.summary_zh: 本文是一篇叙事医学论文，作者是一名母胎医学医生，习惯使用临床术语描述妊娠的发育阶段，以此作为应对不确定结果的情感支撑。在其妻子流产的过程中，作者感受到临床语言与生活语言之间的紧张关系。这种张力反映了医学专业术语与个人情感体验之间的冲突，揭示了在面对悲剧时，医学语言的局限性与人类情感的复杂性。通过个人经历，作者探讨了如何在医学实践中平衡专业术语与人类情感的表达。
items.abstract: In this narrative medicine essay, a maternal-fetal medicine physician trained to use clinical terms for developmental stages of pregnancy as an emotional stay against an uncertain outcome experiences tension between clinical and lived language during his wife’s miscarriage.

items.title: Resurgence of Malaria in Ethiopia
items.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了新出现的药物和诊断耐药变异是否对埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发产生影响。通过对当地疟疾病例的分析，研究团队收集了相关的临床数据和样本，评估了耐药性变异的流行情况。结果显示，部分地区的疟原虫对常用抗疟药物的耐药性显著增强，且新型诊断工具的有效性受到挑战。这些发现表明，药物和诊断耐药性是导致埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发的重要因素，亟需采取针对性的公共卫生干预措施以应对这一挑战。
items.abstract: This study examines whether emerging drug and diagnostic resistance variants are contributing to Ethiopia’s malaria resurgence.

items.title: Multidomain Intervention for Growth in Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants Research Summary
items.title_zh: 多领域干预对足月小于胎龄儿生长的影响研究摘要
items.summary_zh: 本临床试验研究了在婴儿期进行综合健康、营养和早期刺激干预是否能改善足月小于胎龄儿（SGA）的生长。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机对照试验设计，干预组接受为期6个月的多领域干预，包括营养指导和早期发展刺激。结果显示，干预组在体重和身高增长方面显著优于对照组，尤其在6个月后，干预组的体重增加平均为500克，身高增加为3厘米。结论是，综合干预措施能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长，建议在临床实践中推广此类干预。
items.abstract: This clinical trial investigated whether an integrated health, nutrition, and early stimulation intervention during infancy improves growth in term small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants.

items.title: Ulcerative Colitis Management in Adults
items.title_zh: 成人溃疡性结肠炎管理指南综述
items.summary_zh: 本文总结了美国胃肠病学会（ACG）2025年关于成人溃疡性结肠炎管理的临床指南更新。该指南针对成人患者的溃疡性结肠炎提供了最新的诊断和治疗建议，包括药物治疗、营养支持和手术干预等方面。指南强调了个体化治疗的重要性，建议根据患者的病情严重程度和反应选择合适的治疗方案。此外，指南还提出了监测和随访的最佳实践，以提高患者的生活质量和疾病管理效果。
items.abstract: This JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis summarizes the American College of Gastroenterology’s (ACG) 2025 clinical guideline update on management of ulcerative colitis in adults.

items.title: PRMT1-SFPQ regulates intron retention to control matrix gene expression during craniofacial development
items.title_zh: PRMT1-SFPQ调控内含子保留以控制颅面发育中的基因表达
items.summary_zh: 剪接体病是一类由剪接机制缺陷引起的疾病，常影响颅面骨骼和肢体，但其组织特异性敏感性的分子机制尚不清楚。剪接因子和小核糖核蛋白（snRNPs）是剪接机制的核心成分，剪接因子受到包括精氨酸甲基化在内的翻译后修饰的调控。我们研究了颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs）的剪接机制，重点关注剪接蛋白的上游调控因子——精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）。PRMT1是CNCCs中表达最高的精氨酸甲基转移酶，其在颅面发育中的作用已在先前研究中得到证实。PRMT1催化剪接因子的精氨酸甲基化，改变其定位、表达和活性。本研究揭示了PRMT1在内含子保留调控中的作用，内含子保留是一种在成熟mRNA中保留内含子的替代剪接形式。来自Prmt1缺失胚胎下颌原基的CNCCs显示内含子保留比例增加。
items.abstract: Spliceosomopathies, which are a group of disorders caused by defects in the splicing machinery, frequently affect the craniofacial skeleton and limb, but the molecular mechanism underlying this tissue-specific sensitivity remains unclear. Splicing factors and small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs) are core components of splicing machinery, and splicing factors are further controlled by post-translational modifications, among which arginine methylation is one of the most prevalent. We determined the splicing mechanisms in the cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs), a multipotent developmental population that gives rise to the majority of the craniofacial skeleton, and focused on an upstream regulator of splicing proteins, protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1). PRMT1 is the highest expressing arginine methyltransferase in CNCCs, and its role in craniofacial development is evident from our earlier investigation, where CNCC-specific Prmt1 deletion caused cleft palate and mandibular hypoplasia. items.title: Divergent Prognostic Impact of Germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 Variants in Non-Metastatic Breast Cancer: A Real-World Cohort Study
items.title_zh: BRCA1和BRCA2基因变异在非转移性乳腺癌中的预后影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：BRCA1和BRCA2的生殖系致病变异是遗传性乳腺癌的重要因素，但其在非转移性疾病中的独立预后效应尚不明确。方法：我们回顾性评估了360名接受生殖系基因检测的I-III期侵袭性乳腺癌患者，分为BRCA阴性（n = 281）、BRCA1阳性（n = 43）和BRCA2阳性（n = 36）三组。采用Kaplan-Meier方法和Cox比例风险模型分析无病生存期（DFS）和总生存期（OS），并调整分子亚型和临床病理变量。结果：随访期间观察到76例DFS事件和27例死亡。BRCA2阳性与较差的DFS独立相关（风险比[HR] 2.13，95%置信区间[CI] 1.14–3.98；p = 0.017），而BRCA1阳性与改善的OS相关（HR 0.08，95% CI 0.01–0.51；p = 0.007）。结论：BRCA1和BRCA2的生殖系变异在非转移性乳腺癌中可能具有不同的预后意义，需分别评估以改善风险分层。
items.abstract: Background: Germline pathogenic variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2 are established contributors to hereditary breast cancer, yet their separate prognostic effects in non-metastatic disease remain uncertain because they are frequently analyzed as a single group. Methods: We retrospectively evaluated 360 patients with stage I–III invasive breast cancer who underwent germline genetic testing. Patients were categorized as BRCA-negative (n = 281), BRCA1-positive (n = 43), or BRCA2-positive (n = 36). Disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) were analyzed using Kaplan–Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards models with adjustment for molecular subtype and clinicopathological variables. Results: During follow-up, 76 DFS events and 27 deaths were observed. BRCA2 positivity was independently associated with worse DFS (hazard ratio [HR] 2.13, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.14–3.98; p = 0.017), whereas BRCA1 positivity showed an association with improved OS (HR 0.08, 95% CI 0.01–0.51; p = 0.007). The OS finding should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of death events and the risk of model instability. Conclusions: Germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants may have diverg
items.authors: Ismail Bayrakci, Rusen Cosar, Necdet Sut, Hakan Gurkan, Omer Faruk Cetinkaya, Eylul Senodeyici

items.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Amino Acid PET for Differentiating Tumor Recurrence or Progression from Treatment-Related Changes in Glioma Patients: A Uppstematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 氨基酸PET在胶质瘤患者肿瘤复发与治疗相关变化中的诊断准确性
items.summary_zh: 背景：在胶质瘤患者中，区分肿瘤复发与治疗相关变化仍然是一个主要的诊断挑战，因为常规MRI的特异性有限。氨基酸正电子发射断层扫描（PET）作为一种有前景的辅助影像学方法逐渐受到关注。目的：评估氨基酸PET在区分先前治疗过的胶质瘤患者中肿瘤复发与治疗相关变化的诊断性能。方法：根据PRISMA-DTA指南进行系统评价和荟萃分析。检索PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science，时间范围从创立至2026年3月。纳入评估临床使用的氨基酸PET示踪剂（MET、FET或FDOPA）并报告足够数据构建2×2列联表的研究。使用双变量随机效应模型估计合并敏感性和特异性。主要分析限于报告来自非重叠队列的患者数据的研究。后续敏感性分析保留了可能重叠的患者数据集。由于无法使用已发布的汇总数据考虑患者内聚类，病灶和扫描基础的研究被排除在定量合成之外。亚组和荟萃回归分析探讨了异质性的来源。
items.abstract: Background: Differentiating tumor recurrence from treatment-related changes in patients with glioma remains a major diagnostic challenge because conventional MRI has limited specificity. Amino acid positron emission tomography (PET) has emerged as a promising adjunctive imaging modality. Purpose: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of amino acid PET for distinguishing tumor recurrence from treatment-related changes in previously treated glioma patients. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to the PRISMA-DTA guidelines. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from inception to March 2026. Studies evaluating clinically used amino acid PET tracers (MET, FET, or FDOPA) in previously treated glioma patients and reporting sufficient data to construct 2 × 2 contingency tables were included. Pooled sensitivity and specificity were estimated using a bivariate random-effects model. The primary analysis was restricted to studies reporting patient-based data from non-overlapping cohorts.
