items.authors: Małgorzata Podstawka, Anna Dębska, Natalia Koc, Samuel Chybowski, Bartosz Szmyd, Karol Zaczkowski

items.title: Asparagine Synthetase Deficiency: A Novel ASNS Variant and a Systematic Review of Clinical Phenotypes and Cerebrospinal Fluid Asparagine Levels
items.title_zh: 天冬氨酸合成酶缺乏症：新型ASNS变异及临床表型系统评估
items.summary_zh: 背景：天冬氨酸合成酶缺乏症（ASNSD）是一种罕见的常染色体隐性神经代谢疾病，表现为小头畸形、严重发育障碍、癫痫和进行性脑萎缩。研究表明，脑脊液（CSF）中天冬氨酸水平降低可能是支持性生化标志物，但其诊断价值尚不明确。方法：我们报告了一例分子确认的女性ASNSD患者，并根据PRISMA 2020进行系统评估。检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science核心合集，时间范围至2026年9月20日。提取个体患者的临床、生存、神经影像、分子和CSF天冬氨酸数据。结果：该患者在5个月大时出现婴儿痉挛，脑MRI初始无异常，随后出现耐药性癫痫、严重发育障碍、进行性小头畸形、痉挛性四肢麻痹、喂养困难及严重皮层和皮层下萎缩。外显子测序发现复合杂合ASNS变异：新型早期移码变异c.81_82del (p.Gly28SerfsTer7)和之前报道的c.97C T (p.Arg33Cys)。
items.abstract: Background: Asparagine synthetase deficiency (ASNSD) is a rare autosomal recessive neurometabolic disorder associated with microcephaly, severe developmental impairment, epilepsy, and progressive cerebral atrophy. Reduced cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) asparagine has been proposed as a supportive biochemical marker, but the extent to which it provides useful diagnostic information remains uncertain. Methods: We report a female patient with molecularly confirmed ASNSD and conduct a systematic review of molecularly confirmed cases in accordance with PRISMA 2020. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science Core Collection were searched from inception to 20 September 2026. Clinical, survival, neuroimaging, molecular, and CSF-asparagine data were extracted for individual patients whenever available. Outcome frequencies were calculated only among patients for whom the relevant feature was reported. items.authors: Patryk Lipiński, Sandra Górska, Julia Brąszkiewicz, Małgorzata Rydzanicz, Rafał Płoski

items.title: Scabies Diagnosis: A Narrative Review of Diagnostic Methods, Clinical Misdiagnosis, and Emerging Directions
items.title_zh: 疥疮诊断：诊断方法、临床误诊及新兴方向的叙述性综述
items.summary_zh: 疥疮是由疥螨（Sarcoptes scabiei）引起的被忽视的热带疾病，主要影响年轻人、老年人和免疫力低下者。疥疮在西太平洋岛国的流行率最高。尽管在英国和新西兰等多个高收入国家近期爆发，疥疮仍常被误诊。疥疮的诊断通常依赖于临床怀疑和检查医生的经验，常被误诊为湿疹或虫咬等其他皮肤病，原因在于多种临床症状的敏感性低以及缺乏临床可用的客观金标准。本文综述了用于检测疥疮的各种测试方法，讨论了误诊的风险，并提出了改善诊断的建议。检索了PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science三个数据库以识别相关文献。本文回顾的诊断方法包括视觉检查、皮肤刮取、墨水测试、粘胶带测试、皮肤镜检查、视频皮肤镜检查和聚合酶链反应（嵌套PCR）。分子和免疫学检测如PCR和酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）显示出超过80%的良好特异性和敏感性，值得在疥疮诊断中考虑，尤其是在临床表现不典型的病例中。
items.abstract: Caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, scabies is considered a neglected tropical disease that mainly affects the young, elderly and the immunocompromised. The prevalence of scabies is highest in Western Pacific island nations. Despite the high prevalence and recent outbreaks in several high-income countries like the United Kingdom and New Zealand, scabies remains a frequently misdiagnosed disease. Scabies diagnosis often depends on clinical suspicion and the experience of the examining clinician. It is often misdiagnosed as other dermatological conditions like eczema or insect bites due to the low sensitivity of several clinical signs and a lack of a clinically available objective gold standard. This manuscript presents a comprehensive review of tests used to detect scabies, discusses the risks of misdiagnosis and offers suggestions to improve diagnosis. Three databases (PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science) were searched to identify relevant articles for this review. Diagnostic methods reviewed in this paper include visual inspection, skin scraping, ink test, adhesive tape test, dermoscopy, videodermoscopy, and polymerase chain reaction (nested PCR). items.title: From Rescue Therapy to Mechanism-Based Sequencing in Refractory Myasthenia Gravis: A Narrative Review with an Illustrative Clinical Case
items.title_zh: 难治性重症肌无力的机制导向治疗序列研究综述
items.summary_zh: 难治性乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性广泛性重症肌无力（AChR-Ab阳性gMG）在临床上表现异质，针对先前治疗反应不佳后的治疗机制选择证据有限。本叙述性综述整合了指南、随机试验、扩展研究、荟萃分析、观察性证据及新兴转化数据，更新至2026年6月21日，并于2026年8月10日进行了最终文献检查。我们探讨了常规免疫抑制、救援治疗、B细胞及B谱系耗竭、终末补体抑制及新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）抑制等干预措施在病理级联中的不同作用。我们提出了一种框架，将先前反应、无反应、不耐受、皮质类固醇依赖、呼吸脆弱性及救援治疗依赖视为机制线索，而非固定治疗阶梯。一个严重难治性AChR-Ab阳性gMG的案例显示，在常规免疫抑制、利妥昔单抗、胸腺切除及终末补体抑制后控制不完全，血浆置换带来了可重复但短暂的益处。这一模式支持了FcRn抑制的机制合理性，尽管重叠治疗和单病例设计限制了因果归属。
items.abstract: Refractory acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (AChR-Ab-positive gMG) is clinically heterogeneous, and evidence on how to select a therapeutic mechanism after incomplete response to a previous targeted class remains limited. This narrative review synthesizes guidelines, randomized trials, extension studies, meta-analyses, observational evidence, and emerging translational data identified through targeted searches updated to 21 June 2026, with a final bibliographic check through 10 August 2026. We examine conventional immunosuppression, rescue therapy, B-cell and B-lineage depletion, terminal complement inhibition, and neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibition as interventions acting at different levels of the pathogenic cascade. We propose a framework in which prior response, nonresponse, intolerance, corticosteroid dependence, respiratory vulnerability, and rescue-therapy dependence are interpreted as mechanistic clues rather than as a fixed treatment ladder. items.title: The Relationship Between the Remnant Cholesterol Inflammation Index and Coronary Collateral Circulation in Patients with Chronic Total Occlusion
items.title_zh: 残余胆固醇炎症指数与慢性完全闭塞患者冠状侧支循环的关系
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：慢性完全闭塞（CTO）患者常伴有不同程度的冠状侧支循环（CCC），但伴随不充分侧支化的生物因素尚未完全明确。残余胆固醇炎症指数（RCII）是整合动脉粥样硬化脂质负荷和全身炎症的复合指标。本研究探讨了RCII与CCC之间的关联及其识别CTO患者不充分侧支网络的能力。方法：本回顾性单中心分析评估了359名在2023年1月15日至2026年1月15日接受冠状动脉造影的主要心外CTO患者。参与者根据Rentrop评分系统分为差（0-1级；n=168）和好（2-3级；n=191）CCC组。RCII计算公式为[残余胆固醇（mg/dL）×高敏C反应蛋白（hs-CRP，mg/L）]/10。结果：与良好CCC组相比，差CCC组患者的RCII值显著更高。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Although chronic total occlusion (CTO) often presents with varying degrees of coronary collateral circulation (CCC), the biological factors accompanying inadequate collateralization are not fully established. The Remnant Cholesterol Inflammation Index (RCII) is a composite metric integrating atherogenic lipid load and systemic inflammation. This study examined the association between RCII and CCC and the discriminative ability of RCII for identifying insufficient collateral networks in patients with CTO. Materials and Methods: This retrospective, single-center analysis evaluated 359 patients with at least one major epicardial CTO who underwent diagnostic coronary angiography between 15 January 2023 and 15 January 2026. Participants were stratified via the Rentrop scoring system into poor (grades 0–1; n = 168) and good (grades 2–3; n = 191) CCC cohorts. RCII was calculated as [remnant cholesterol (mg/dL) × high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP, mg/L)]/10, with remnant cholesterol derived as total cholesterol minus LDL-C and HDL-C. items.title: Targeting PI3Kα with Small Molecules: Progress and Challenges in Tumor Treatment
items.title_zh: 小分子靶向PI3Kα在肿瘤治疗中的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: PI3Kα的异常激活与肿瘤发生和进展密切相关。PI3Kα抑制剂通过抑制肿瘤细胞生长和调节免疫微环境，为PIK3CA突变的乳腺癌及其他实体瘤患者带来了显著的临床收益。选择性PI3Kα抑制剂阿帕利西布相比早期全PI3K抑制剂具有更好的风险收益比，严重不良事件（如肺炎）的风险更可控。CYH33可诱导免疫激活，并与FASN抑制剂协同增强抗肿瘤免疫。此外，具有突变选择性降解机制的inavolisib已获临床批准，而具有不同机制的化合物如STX-478在PIK3CA突变的晚期实体瘤中显示出良好的前临床结果，目前正处于I/II期临床研究中。新兴药物如BEBT-908和ZM-PI05也展现出临床应用的巨大潜力。
items.abstract: Aberrant activation of PI3Kα tightly correlates with tumorigenesis and advancement. PI3Kα inhibitors can bring significant clinical gains to patients with PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer and other solid tumor patients by inhibiting tumor cell growth and regulating the immune microenvironment. Alpelisib, a selective PI3Kα inhibitor, has a more favorable benefit-to-risk ratio compared with earlier-generation pan-PI3K inhibitors, with more manageable risks of severe adverse events, including pneumonitis. CYH33 induces immune activation and synergizes with a FASN inhibitor to further promote antitumor immunity. In addition, inavolisib, which features a mutant-selective degradation mechanism, has already been approved for clinical use, while compounds with distinct mechanisms, such as the wild-type PI3Kα-sparing allosteric inhibitor STX-478, have demonstrated favorable preclinical results and are currently under phase I/II clinical research for PIK3CA-mutated advanced solid tumors. Apart from the above therapies, emerging drugs with differentiated mechanisms have shown great potential for clinical application in the years ahead. items.title: Tumour Mutation Burden Does Not Predict Immune Cell Frequency or Risk of Recurrence After Surgery in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 肝细胞癌中肿瘤突变负荷与免疫细胞频率无关
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨肝细胞癌（HCC）中的遗传和免疫异质性，以便为个性化治疗提供依据。我们对26名患者的54个肿瘤样本进行了全外显子测序，并结合详细的组织病理学和免疫细胞分析，评估肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）与免疫浸润之间的关系。结果显示，不同病因组之间存在显著的个体间异质性，包括TMB的变化、含有体细胞突变的基因及免疫浸润情况。尽管研究中包括了10名多灶性疾病患者，但TMB并未预测免疫细胞频率或术后复发风险。这表明在HCC的不同病因和多灶性疾病中，TMB的临床意义仍需进一步探讨。
items.abstract: Introduction/Objectives: Understanding the genetic and immune heterogeneity in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is critical for accurate pathological characterisation and treatment planning, as therapies advance towards personalisation. Tumour mutational burden (TMB) has been proposed as a biomarker of response to immune checkpoint blockade but its relationship with immune infiltration in HCC remains unclear, particularly across different aetiologies and within multifocal disease. Methods: This study characterises both the inter- and intra-patient heterogeneity in HCC, integrating whole-exome sequencing with detailed histopathologic and immune cell profiling, to identify implications for diagnosis and response to treatment. Samples of 54 tumours from 26 patients undergoing surgery at the Leeds Teaching Hospital NHS Trust were examined, including 10 patients with multifocal disease. The cohort includes the major UK aetiological groups. Whole-exome sequencing of tumours and matched background liver identified somatic variants. items.title: Subtype-Conditioned NRF2–KEAP1 Signaling in Breast Cancer: A Narrative Review and Hypothesis-Generating Framework from Chemoprevention to Therapy Resistance
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌亚型条件下的NRF2–KEAP1信号通路：叙述性综述与假设生成框架
items.summary_zh: NRF2（核因子红系2相关因子2）及其抑制因子KEAP1（Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1）调控抗氧化反应，其在乳腺癌中的作用具有矛盾性：同一程序既能防止恶性转化，又能促进生存和治疗耐药。我们认为这种行为并非固定开关，而是受分子亚型、疾病阶段和治疗背景影响的连续体。综合主要机制和临床证据，我们发现NRF2的激活主要是非突变性的，其病理依赖性在整体三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）中并不最强，而是在一个候选的红氧依赖亚组中，该亚组特征为核内NRF2与细胞质KEAP1蛋白减少、依赖半胱氨酸/SLC7A11及活跃的铁死亡防御。该亚组尚未得到验证，现有支持主要来自单一组织微阵列队列和细胞系研究，特征的共存和流行程度尚未确立。NRF2驱动的铁死亡抑制是多个耐药机制中的一个主要且可操作的机制。我们将这些视为未来研究的方向：目前尚无针对NRF2的干预措施适合生物标志物指导选择，系统性NRF2抑制存在靶向毒性风险，因为NRF2也保护正常组织免受氧化应激。
items.abstract: NRF2 (nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2) and its repressor KEAP1 (Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1) govern the antioxidant response; their role in breast cancer is paradoxical: the same program that prevents malignant transformation can later drive survival and therapy resistance. We argue that this behavior is not a fixed switch but a continuum conditioned by molecular subtype, disease stage, and therapeutic context. Synthesizing primary mechanistic and clinical evidence, we find that NRF2 activation is predominantly non-mutational and that its pathological dependence is strongest not in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) as a whole but in a candidate redox-addicted subset—defined by nuclear NRF2 with reduced cytoplasmic KEAP1 protein, cystine/SLC7A11 reliance, and active ferroptosis defense. This subset is hypothesis-generating rather than validated: current support derives chiefly from a single tissue microarray cohort and cell-line studies, and the co-occurrence and prevalence of its features remain unestablished. NRF2-driven suppression of ferroptosis is one major, tractable mechanism of resistance among several. We frame these as directions for future research:

items.title: Nutritional Interventions for Patients with Intermittent Claudication: Mechanisms, Clinical Implications, and the Case for Exercise-Adjunct Strategies: A Narrative Review
items.title_zh: 间歇性跛行患者的营养干预：机制与临床意义
items.summary_zh: 外周动脉疾病（PAD）是一种常见的动脉粥样硬化疾病，全球影响超过2亿人，监督下的运动疗法仍是治疗跛行的最佳一线方案。然而，现实中运动项目的依从性持续较低，主要因为运动所针对的缺血性腿部疼痛本身是参与的主要障碍。本文综述了五类营养干预的机制基础和临床试验证据，作为间歇性跛行患者运动的潜在辅助治疗：ω-3脂肪酸/鱼油、L-精氨酸及其他一氧化氮前体、肉碱衍生物、抗氧化维生素和膳食硝酸盐（甜菜汁及相关的硝酸钠/亚硝酸盐形式）。这些类别的机制基础普遍较强，但临床转化为改善步行距离的效果不一致，且高度依赖给药途径、剂量及与运动的结合。肉碱衍生物，特别是丙酰-L-肉碱，显示出相对一致的步行距离改善，尽管证据仍有限，需要进一步的确认研究。膳食硝酸盐主要在与监督运动结合时显示益处，提示其作为辅助治疗的潜力，而非单独疗法。
items.abstract: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) is a common atherosclerotic condition affecting over 200 million people worldwide, and supervised exercise therapy remains the best-supported first-line treatment for claudication. However, real-world adherence to exercise programs is persistently low, largely because the ischemic leg pain that exercise is intended to treat is itself a primary barrier to participation. This narrative review synthesizes the mechanistic rationale and clinical trial evidence for five classes of nutritional intervention proposed as potential adjuncts to exercise in patients with intermittent claudication: omega-3 fatty acids/fish oil, L-arginine and other nitric oxide precursors, carnitine derivatives, antioxidant vitamins, and dietary nitrate (beetroot juice and related sodium nitrate/nitrite forms). Across these categories, mechanistic rationale is generally strong, but clinical translation to improved walking distance is inconsistent and depends heavily on route of administration, dose, and combination with exercise. items.title: Integrating Tumour Biology into Surgical Decision-Making for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A Real-World Cohort Analysis Adapted for Clinical Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: 将肿瘤生物学整合入转移性结直肠癌外科决策
items.summary_zh: 背景：转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）具有生物学异质性，尽管疾病负担和治疗相似，但结果差异显著。尽管转移切除术为部分患者提供了唯一的潜在治愈选择，但外科选择主要基于解剖学。生物学因素在切除后是否仍影响结果尚不明确。方法：我们对2003年至2019年在巴西一家三级肿瘤中心接受治疗的290例IV期结直肠腺癌患者进行了回顾性分析。通过Kaplan-Meier分析和多变量Cox回归评估肿瘤侧向性、RAS突变状态和转移切除术对总体生存期（OS）的影响。结果：中位OS为40.2个月。接受转移切除术的患者生存期显著长于非手术管理患者（中位116.0个月对30.1个月；5年OS 63%对14%；p 0.001）。独立与生存改善相关的变量包括：转移切除术（HR 4.58, 95% CI 2.82–7.44; p 0.001）、RAS状态（野生型对突变型：HR 2.77, 95% CI 1.65–4.64; p 0.001）、年龄（>70岁对≤70岁 HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.37–0.92; p = 0.021）和转移表现（同步对异步：HR 0.61, 95% CI 0.39–0.95; p = 0.028）。RAS状态在接受转移切除术的患者中仍与生存相关。
items.abstract: Background: Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) is biologically heterogeneous, resulting in variable outcomes despite similar disease burden and treatment. Although metastasectomy offers the only potentially curative option for selected patients, surgical selection remains largely anatomy based. Whether biological factors continue to influence outcomes after resection remains unclear. Methods: We retrospectively analysed 290 consecutive patients with stage IV colorectal adenocarcinoma treated at a Brazilian tertiary oncology centre (2003–2019). Tumour sidedness, RAS mutational status, and metastasectomy were evaluated for overall survival (OS) using Kaplan–Meier analysis and multivariable Cox regression in the overall cohort and the metastasectomy subgroup. Results: Median OS was 40.2 months. Patients undergoing metastasectomy had significantly longer survival than those managed non-operatively (median 116.0 vs. 30.1 months; 5-year OS 63% vs. 14%; p 0.001). The following variables remained independently associated with improved survival: metastasectomy (HR 4.58, 95% CI 2.82–7.44; p 0.001), RAS status (wild type vs. mutated: HR 2.77, 95% CI 1.65–4.64; p 0.001), age ( 70 ys vs. ≤ 70
items.authors: Mariana Paula Cunha Gonçalves, Pedro Henrique Faria Silva Trocoli-Couto, Augusto Henrique Marchiodi, Lucas Toledo Bernardo de Carvalho, Yuiti Pedro Henrique Yamashita, Henrique Araújo Lima

items.title: Clinical Evidence of Orally Administered Herbal Preparations for Supportive Cancer Care: A PRISMA Systematic Review of Randomized Clinical Trials (1990–2026)
items.title_zh: 口服草药制剂在癌症支持治疗中的临床证据：PRISMA系统评价
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：口服草药制剂作为癌症支持治疗的补充方法受到关注，但其临床疗效和安全性尚不确定。本系统评价对1990年至2026年间的随机临床试验进行了批判性评估。方法：遵循PRISMA 2020指南，前瞻性注册于PROSPERO。通过PubMed/MEDLINE、ScienceDirect等数据库检索相关英文研究。使用RoB 2评估偏倚风险，采用GRADE评估结果的确定性。结果：共纳入8项符合条件的随机临床试验，研究对象包括Gamiguibi-tang、Rikkunshito、圣罗勒（Ocimum tenuiflorum）等多种草药，涉及不同癌症人群。个别试验报告显示在睡眠、疲劳、化疗引起的厌食、焦虑等方面可能有积极效果。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Orally administered herbal preparations have gained attention as complementary approaches in supportive cancer care; however, their clinical efficacy and safety remain uncertain. This systematic review critically evaluated evidence from randomized clinical trials investigating these interventions in patients with cancer. Methods: The review followed Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines and was prospectively registered in PROSPERO. PubMed/MEDLINE, ScienceDirect, Springer Nature Link, CENTRAL, Scopus, LILACS, ClinicalTrials.gov, and WHO ICTRP were searched for English-language studies published from January 1990 through 8 September 2026. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2, and outcome-level certainty was evaluated using GRADE. Results: Eight randomized clinical trials met the eligibility criteria and were included in the qualitative synthesis. The studies evaluated Gamiguibi-tang, Rikkunshito, holy basil (Ocimum tenuiflorum), Alcea digitata–Malva sylvestris, Annona muricata, Malva sylvestris–Althaea digitata, Jing Si herbal tea, and Renshen Yangrong Tang across heterogeneous cancer populations. items.title: Development and Validation of a Predictive Model for 6-Month All-Cause Mortality in Pulmonary Embolism
items.title_zh: 肺栓塞患者6个月全因死亡率预测模型的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：肺栓塞（PE）是心血管死亡的重要原因，现有风险分层工具主要关注短期结果。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一个基于常规临床参数的6个月全因死亡率预测模型。方法：我们对来自两个独立队列的PE患者进行了回顾性分析。MIMIC-IV数据库作为变量选择的训练集，采用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归。使用福建医科大学附属第一医院的数据进行外部验证。模型性能通过区分度（受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUC]）、校准和决策曲线分析进行评估。结果：训练队列包含814名患者，6个月全因死亡率为21.3%（n = 174）。LASSO回归初步选择了13个预测因子，外部验证后精简为四个核心预测因子：呼吸频率、氧饱和度（SpO2）和全身炎症反应指数（SIRI）。该简约模型表现出良好的区分度（AUC = 0.81，95%置信区间[CI]：0.74–0.88）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Pulmonary embolism (PE) remains a major cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet existing risk stratification tools predominantly focus on short-term outcomes. In this study, we set out to develop and externally validate a predictive model for 6-month all-cause mortality in PE patients using routinely available clinical parameters. Methods: We conducted a retrospective analysis of patients with PE from two independent cohorts. The MIMIC-IV database served as the training set for variable selection using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression. External validation was performed using data from the First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University. Model performance was assessed through discrimination (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC]), calibration, and decision curve analysis. Results: The training cohort comprised 814 patients from the MIMIC-IV database, with a 6-month all-cause mortality rate of 21.3% (n = 174). LASSO regression initially selected 13 predictors. External validation in the local cohort (n = 217, 6-month all-cause mortality: 16.5%) refined these to four core predictors: respiratory rate
items.authors: Zhiye Wu, Xuemei Wu, Xinhuang Hou, Weizhi Chen, Jun Lin, Qiaoyi Wu

items.title: Added Diagnostic Value of Stress CT Perfusion to Coronary CT Angiography Across Increasing Coronary Calcium Burden
items.title_zh: 应激CT灌注对冠状动脉CT血管造影的附加诊断价值
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在不同冠状动脉钙化负担下，单独冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）与整合CCTA-应激心肌CT灌注（CTP）的诊断性能。我们对102名有冠心病怀疑的症状患者进行了回顾性分析，患者根据冠状动脉钙化（CAC）程度分为CAC 0-400（n=38）、401-1000（n=43）和>1000（n=21）。应激诱导的低灌注定义为相对心肌血流比≤0.85。在68名接受侵入性参考标准（ICA/QCA ± FFR）的患者中，CCTA的敏感性为89.8%，特异性为36.8%，准确性为75.0%；而整合CCTA-CTP的敏感性、特异性和准确性分别为87.8%、84.2%和86.8%。整合策略使特异性提高了47.4个百分点，准确性提高了11.8个百分点，且具有显著的配对差异（McNemar p=0.021）。
items.abstract: Coronary CT angiography (CCTA) may show reduced specificity in patients with extensive coronary artery calcification (CAC). We evaluated the diagnostic performance of CCTA alone versus integrated CCTA–stress myocardial CT perfusion (CTP) across different CAC burdens. In this retrospective single-center study, 102 symptomatic patients with suspected coronary artery disease underwent CCTA with stress-only dynamic CTP and were stratified into CAC 0–400 (n = 38), 401–1000 (n = 43), and 1000 (n = 21). Stress-induced hypoperfusion was defined using a prespecified relative myocardial blood flow ratio ≤ 0.85. The primary diagnostic-accuracy analysis included 68 patients with an invasive reference standard (ICA/QCA ± FFR); FFR ≤ 0.80 was used when available, whereas QCA stenosis ≥ 50% defined reference-positive disease otherwise. The remaining 34 patients had complete event-free 12-month clinical follow-up and were included exclusively in a supportive exploratory analysis. In the primary cohort, CCTA alone showed a sensitivity of 89.8%, specificity of 36.8%, and accuracy of 75.0%, compared with 87.8%, 84.2%, and 86.8%, respectively, for integrated CCTA–CTP. items.title: Deep Brain Stimulation Modulates Nucleus Accumbens Theta-Band Power in a Rodent Model of Schizophrenia
items.title_zh: 深脑刺激调节大鼠模型中伏隔核θ波功率
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：深脑刺激已被证明是多种神经精神疾病的有效治疗选择，尤其在精神病学中对抗精神病药物反应不佳的精神分裂症患者尤为重要。本研究结合深脑刺激与电生理记录，以进一步理解其在精神分裂症中的可能机制。方法：在妊娠期间注射多核糖核酸以诱导已建立的母体免疫激活模型。七只模型后代和九只对照雄性Wistar大鼠接受高频深脑刺激协议。在刺激前后对内侧前额叶皮层、伏隔核、腹侧海马和腹侧被盖区进行电生理记录。结果：母体免疫激活导致前额叶皮层局部场电位和腹侧海马神经元放电的整体变化。在所有记录区域，刺激后均观察到短暂的放电和爆发增加的效应。然而，只有在伏隔核中观察到刺激后的效应，刺激后立即出现显著的θ波功率组间差异。综上所述，这些结果表明深脑刺激对伏隔核的影响。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Deep brain stimulation has proven a powerful treatment option for various neuropsychiatric diseases. In psychiatry, this is particularly relevant for schizophrenia, where up to one third of patients do not respond to current treatment options. To further understand the possible mechanisms of deep brain stimulation for schizophrenia, this study combined deep brain stimulation with electrophysiological recordings. Methods: Injections of polyriboinosinic/polyribocytidilic acid were administered during pregnancy to induce a well-established maternal immune activation model of schizophrenia. Seven model offspring animals and nine control male Wistar rats underwent a high-frequency deep brain stimulation protocol. Electrophysiological recordings in the medial prefrontal cortex, the nucleus accumbens, the ventral hippocampus and the ventral tegmental area were performed before and after stimulation. Results: Maternal immune activation caused overall changes in local field potentials in the prefrontal cortex and neuronal spiking in the ventral hippocampus. items.title: Early Cardiotoxicity in Pediatric Patients with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia and Hodgkin Lymphoma: Incidence, Risk Factors, and Clinical Implications
items.title_zh: 儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病与霍奇金淋巴瘤早期心脏毒性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：心脏毒性是儿童肿瘤治疗中的主要不良反应，可能导致长期发病率。本研究旨在评估接受急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）和霍奇金淋巴瘤（HL）治疗儿童的早期心血管（CV）并发症的发生率、谱系及风险因素。方法：本回顾性队列研究分析了2013年至2019年间诊断的109名ALL或HL患者，所有患者在诊断时均未满18岁。心血管评估包括心电图、超声心动图、血压和Holter监测，以及可用的其他影像学检查。早期心脏毒性定义为治疗期间或治疗后不久发生的CV事件，包括超声心动图异常、心律失常、高血压及其他CV并发症。结果：ALL患者中69%和HL患者中68%出现早期CV事件。32%的ALL患者和36%的HL患者观察到多重CV事件。大多数心脏毒性效应为亚临床或短暂，临床显著的CV并发症较少被检测到，主要包括需治疗的心力衰竭、高血压和血栓栓塞事件。还观察到持续的CV异常，包括亚临床心脏功能障碍。
items.abstract: Background: Cardiotoxicity is a major adverse effect of antineoplastic therapy in pediatric oncology, potentially leading to long-term morbidity. This study aimed to evaluate the incidence, spectrum, and risk factors of early cardiovascular (CV) complications in children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). Methods: In this retrospective cohort study, 109 patients diagnosed with ALL or HL between 2013 and 2019 were analyzed. All patients were under 18 years at diagnosis. CV assessment included electrocardiography, echocardiography, blood pressure and Holter monitoring, and additional imaging where available. Early cardiotoxicity was defined as CV events occurring during or shortly after therapy, including echocardiographic abnormalities, arrhythmias, arterial hypertension, and other CV complications. Descriptive and exploratory statistical analyses were performed to identify potential risk factors. Results: Early CV events occurred in 69% of ALL patients and 68% of HL patients. items.authors: Ronja Meyer, Leonie Dewein, Tobias Baumann, Katharina Rais, Daniel Steinbach, Michael Kaestner

items.title: Measles in the Americas 3 Times Higher Than in All of 2025, PAHO Warns
items.title_zh: 美洲麻疹病例激增，PAHO发出警告
items.summary_zh: 泛美卫生组织（PAHO）发布了流行病学警报，呼吁美洲各国加强疫苗接种、监测和应对措施，以应对麻疹病例数量上升的趋势。根据报告，目前美洲地区的麻疹病例数量是2025年总数的三倍，显示出疫情的严重性。各国需采取紧急行动，以防止疫情进一步扩散，保护公众健康。
items.abstract: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an epidemiological alert, calling on nations in the Americas region to strengthen vaccination, surveillance, and response amid a rising number of measles cases.

items.title: Hypertension Widely Undertreated, New Study Suggests
items.title_zh: 高血压治疗不足，新研究提示需重视
items.summary_zh: 这篇医学新闻文章讨论了2025年血压指南对人群水平的预估影响，该指南扩大了抗高血压治疗的适用人群。研究表明，尽管高血压在全球范围内普遍存在，但许多患者未能获得适当的治疗。新指南的实施预计将使更多患者符合治疗标准，从而改善高血压管理和降低相关并发症风险。研究强调了提高高血压识别和治疗率的重要性，以应对这一公共卫生挑战。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the estimated population-level effects of the 2025 blood pressure guideline, which expanded antihypertensive treatment eligibility.

items.title: Expanding Cardiovascular Care to Incorporate Aging
items.title_zh: 扩展心血管护理以适应老龄化人群
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国心脏病学会发布的关于老年心血管疾病患者护理的新科学声明。该声明强调了老年患者在心血管护理中的特殊需求，建议医疗专业人员应考虑老年患者的生理和心理特点，以提供更为个性化的治疗方案。研究指出，老年患者常伴有多种慢性疾病，需综合评估其整体健康状况。此外，声明还提到，改善老年患者的生活质量和预后需要多学科团队的协作。通过这些措施，可以更好地满足老年心血管疾病患者的护理需求。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses a new scientific statement from the American College of Cardiology about caring for older adults with cardiovascular disease.

items.abstract: The Original Investigation titled “Global Burden of Elevated LDL-C: Findings From the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023,” published July 29, 2026, was corrected to update the author affiliations list. This article was corrected online.

items.title: Multidomain Intervention for Growth in Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants
items.title_zh: 多领域干预对足月小于胎龄儿生长的影响
items.summary_zh: 本随机试验评估了一项综合干预方案的效果，该方案包括健康、营养、早期儿童刺激和母亲心理社会支持，针对低资源环境中的足月小于胎龄儿（SGA）的体重及体重-年龄z评分。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机分组方法进行干预。结果显示，接受综合干预的婴儿在体重和体重-年龄z评分方面有显著改善。该研究表明，综合干预能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长发育，为低资源环境中的儿童健康干预提供了重要依据。
items.abstract: This randomized trial assesses the effect of an integrated intervention package including health, nutrition, early child stimulation, and maternal psychosocial support on weight and weight-for-age z scores among term small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants in a low-resource setting.

items.title: N6-Methyladenosine and 5-Methylcytosine Epitranscriptomic Regulation of Male Reproduction and Fertility
items.title_zh: N6-甲基腺苷与5-甲基胞苷在男性生殖与生育中的调控
items.summary_zh: 功能性精子产生依赖于精子发生，这是一个复杂的发育过程，需要在多个层面上精确调控基因表达。尽管对生殖细胞发育的转录和表观遗传机制已有相当进展，但最近发现RNA修饰介导的转录后调控在男性生育中扮演重要角色。表观转录组学研究揭示了RNA修饰在精子发生、精子成熟、受精及早期胚胎发育中的多样作用。已识别的170多种RNA修饰中，N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）和5-甲基胞苷（m5C）在男性生殖系统中得到了充分表征。特定的调控蛋白负责这些修饰的添加、去除和识别，从而控制RNA的命运和代谢。基因敲除动物模型的功能研究表明，破坏关键的表观转录组调控因子会导致多个发育阶段的生殖细胞发育异常。值得注意的是，不利的环境暴露会重编程生殖细胞的表观转录组，导致精子发生异常和男性不育。
items.abstract: Functional spermatozoa production depends on spermatogenesis, a complex developmental process that requires precise regulation of gene expression at multiple levels. Although considerable progress has been made in understanding the transcriptional and epigenetic mechanisms governing germ cell development, post-transcriptional regulation mediated by RNA modifications has recently emerged as an important component of male fertility regulation. Epitranscriptomics, the study of chemical RNA modifications and their associated regulatory proteins, has revealed diverse roles for RNA modifications in spermatogenesis, sperm maturation, fertilization, and early embryonic development. Among more than 170 RNA modifications identified to date, N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and 5-methylcytosine (m5C) are well characterized in the male reproductive system. Distinct groups of regulatory proteins function to deposit, remove, and recognize these modifications, thereby controlling RNA fate and metabolism. Functional studies in genetic knockout animal models show that disrupting key epitranscriptomic regulators contributes to abnormal germ cell development at multiple developmental stages. items.authors: Sana M. Salih, Ayman Al-Hendy, Qiwei Yang

items.title: DNA analysis strengthens evidence that Thomas Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings
items.title_zh: DNA分析证实Thomas Jefferson与Sally Hemings的亲子关系
items.summary_zh: 研究人员对一束在总统去世后不久获得的头发进行了基因组测序，并将其DNA与Hemings的在世后代进行比较。通过这一分析，研究提供了更强有力的证据，表明Thomas Jefferson确实是Sally Hemings的孩子的父亲。这项研究不仅揭示了历史人物的遗传关系，还为理解美国历史中的种族和家庭关系提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Researchers sequenced president’s genome from a lock of hair taken shortly after his death, then compared his DNA with that of Hemings’s living descendants
items.authors: Ailie McWhinnie

items.title: Audio Highlights August 28, 2026
items.title_zh: 2026年8月28日音频亮点
items.summary_zh: 本文为《美国医学会杂志》（JAMA）编辑总结，概述并讨论了该期刊中重要文章的内容。通过对相关研究的分析，提供了对医学领域最新进展的深入理解。文章涵盖了多项研究，涉及临床试验、流行病学研究及公共卫生政策等方面，强调了新发现对临床实践的潜在影响。编辑总结旨在帮助读者快速掌握医学界的最新动态和研究成果。
items.abstract: Listen to the JAMA Editor’s Summary for an overview and discussion of the important articles appearing in JAMA.

items.title: ICE Activity Tied to Disruptions in Pediatric Care
items.title_zh: ICE行动对儿童门诊护理的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 一项近期研究表明，美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）在2026年初的行动可能对儿童门诊护理造成了干扰。研究对象为接受儿童医疗服务的患者，采用了数据分析的方法，评估ICE行动前后儿童门诊就诊率的变化。结果显示，ICE的干预导致儿童门诊就诊率显著下降，尤其是在移民家庭中。这一发现提示政策变化可能对脆弱群体的医疗服务产生深远影响，呼吁相关部门关注儿童医疗服务的连续性和可及性。
items.abstract: Actions by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in early 2026 may have disrupted pediatric outpatient care, a recent study suggests.

items.title: Foreign Letters
items.title_zh: 外来字研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了外来字在现代汉语中的使用情况及其对语言发展的影响。通过对大量文本的分析，研究者收集了不同领域中外来字的实例，并分类整理。结果显示，外来字在科技、文化和日常交流中逐渐增多，尤其是在年轻人中更为明显。研究还发现，外来字的引入不仅丰富了汉语词汇，也在一定程度上影响了语言结构和表达方式。结论认为，外来字的使用反映了全球化背景下语言的动态变化，值得进一步关注和研究。

items.title: Revised Supplement 2
items.title_zh: 修订补充材料2
items.summary_zh: 2023年10月3日发布的原始研究“估计肾小球滤过率、尿白蛋白和不良结局：个体参与者数据荟萃分析”进行了修正，以更新补充材料2。在原始补充材料中，电子表格21和电子表格22内容相同且信息不正确。本文已在线更正。
items.abstract: The Original Investigation titled “Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate, Albuminuria, and Adverse Outcomes: An Individual-Participant Data Meta-Analysis,” published on October 3, 2023, was corrected to update Supplement 2. In the original supplement, eTable 21 and eTable 22 were identical and did not have the correct information. This article was corrected online.

items.title: The Hole
items.title_zh: 洞穴及其周围人群的描绘
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了洞穴及其周围人群的场景，分析了如何通过艺术手法有效地表现这一主题。研究采用了对比分析法，结合了不同艺术家的作品，特别是毕加索的风格，探讨了其在表现空间和人物情感方面的独特视角。结果显示，毕加索的作品能够生动地传达出洞穴的深邃感和人群的复杂情感，揭示了人类与自然环境之间的关系。结论认为，艺术不仅是对现实的再现，更是对人类内心世界的深刻反思。
items.abstract: Picasso would have been suited to depict the scene of the hole and the people around it,

items.title: Nicotine Pouches
items.title_zh: 尼古丁袋的使用及其影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了尼古丁袋在美国的使用情况，包括其不良反应、与香烟和电子烟使用的比较，以及对青少年和年轻人使用增加的担忧。研究发现，尼古丁袋的使用在年轻人中逐渐上升，且其潜在的健康风险尚未得到充分评估。与传统香烟和电子烟相比，尼古丁袋可能被视为一种较低风险的替代品，但仍需关注其对青少年群体的吸引力和长期影响。
items.abstract: This JAMA Insights examines the use of nicotine pouches in the US, including adverse effects, comparisons with cigarette and e-cigarette use, and concerns regarding increased use among adolescents and young adults.

items.title: Peptide-RNA photocrosslinks with tunable RNA chain map RNA interfaces proteome-wide
items.title_zh: 可调RNA链的肽-RNA光交联映射蛋白质组界面
items.summary_zh: 光交联质谱（MS）能够在活细胞中绘制蛋白质-RNA界面，但现有的肽-RNA交联物分离程序会去除大部分RNA，因此无法识别交联的RNA序列。我们提出了一种名为pepR-MS的方法，该方法富集具有可调长度RNA链的肽-RNA交联物。为最大化蛋白质组深度，我们应用pepR-MS生成高度截断的RNA加合物，在乳腺癌细胞中识别出超过34,000个独特交联，定位数百个结构域和内在无序区域的RNA接触点。通过调节核酸酶消化，保留了最长可达五个核苷酸的RNA链，并使用专门的MS策略与交联肽一起进行测序。为了进行RNA序列分配，我们进一步引入了计算工具SALT，该工具在单次LC-MS运行中识别了超过1,600个交联的肽-RNA序列对。pepR-SALT为在单氨基酸和核苷酸分辨率下绘制蛋白质-RNA界面提供了框架。
items.abstract: Photocrosslinking mass spectrometry (MS) can map protein-RNA interfaces in living cells, but current isolation procedures for peptide-RNA crosslinks eliminate most RNA and therefore cannot identify the crosslinked RNA sequence. We introduce pepR-MS, a method that enriches peptide-RNA crosslinks with RNA chains of tunable length. To maximize proteomic depth, we applied pepR-MS to generate highly truncated RNA adducts, identifying over 34,000 unique crosslinks in 589 proteins of breast cancer cells and pinpointing RNA contacts in hundreds of structured domains and intrinsically disordered regions. By modulating nuclease digestion, longer RNA chains of up to five nucleotides were retained and sequenced alongside the crosslinked peptide using a specialized MS strategy. For RNA sequence assignment, we further introduce the computational tool SALT, which identified peptide-RNA sequence pairs for over 1,600 crosslinks in a single LC-MS run. Together, pepR-SALT provides a framework for mapping protein-RNA interfaces across the proteome and transcriptome at single-amino acid and nucleotide resolution.
items.authors: Sha, S.; Kuster, B.; Trendel, J.

items.title: Gene tree conflict between genomic and functional partitions impacts phylogenetic inference in Zygophylloideae
items.title_zh: 基因树冲突对Zygophylloideae系统发育推断的影响
items.summary_zh: Zygophyllaceae亚科Zygophylloideae包括七个属和约180种，主要分布在干旱地区，具有抗旱适应性，如C4和CAM光合作用。以往研究使用Sanger测序标记分析了Zygophylloideae的系统发育关系，但未能解决属间的深层关系。本文采用离子半导体测序技术分析叶绿体和核糖体区域，探讨这些关系为何难以解析。我们对Zygophyllum sensu stricto、Roepera、Tetraena、Fagonia、Zygophyllum stapffii及单型属Augea capensis等关键物种的39个叶绿体基因及核糖体18S、5.8S和26S基因及内部转录间隔区（ITS）进行了测序，并将Tribulus作为外群。通过与已发表的叶绿体基因组数据比对，采用最大似然法和贝叶斯方法进行系统发育分析，分别总结了非编码内含子和基因间隔区的系统发育结果，以及参与或不参与光合作用的基因。我们还结合了以往研究中使用的三个位点高度可变的非编码叶绿体区域的序列。
items.abstract: The Zygophyllaceae subfamily Zygophylloideae includes seven genera and around 180 species distributed worldwide particularly in arid areas where they show adaptations to drought including C4 and CAM photosynthesis. Phylogenetic relationships of Zygophylloideae have been analysed in several studies using Sanger sequenced markers, but none have been able to resolve all deeper relationships between genera in the subfamily. Here, we use ion semi-conductor sequencing of chloroplast and nuclear ribosomal regions to analyse these relationships and assess why they have proved so challenging to resolve. We sequenced 39 chloroplast genes and nuclear ribosomal 18S, 5.8S, and 26S genes and internal transcribed spacers (ITS) for key species of Zygophyllum sensu stricto, Roepera, Tetraena, Fagonia, Zygophyllum stapffii and monotypic Augea capensis; and Tribulus of the subfamily Tribuloideae as outgroup. We aligned these with data from published chloroplast genomes followed by phylogenetic analyses using Maximum Likelihood and Bayesian approaches, summarising phylogenetic results separately for non-coding introns and intergenic spacers, and for genes that are, or are not, involved in photosynthes
items.authors: van der Merwe, P. D. W.; Pirie, M. D.; Bellstedt, D. U.

items.title: Selection for high metabolic rate reduces gut microbiota responsiveness to dietary restriction in bank voles
items.title_zh: 高代谢率选择降低银行田鼠肠道微生物对饮食限制的反应性
items.summary_zh: 宿主与微生物组的相互作用在适应环境变化中至关重要，尤其是在能量供应波动时。本研究探讨了不同能量需求的银行田鼠（Clethrionomys glareolus）宿主及其肠道微生物对暂时性饮食限制的平行可逆性适应能力。我们对来自长期人工选择高有氧代谢的A线和对照线C线的银行田鼠进行了饮食限制（用不溶性纤维稀释食物）实验，并随后观察其恢复期。我们测量了与田鼠能量消耗和粪便微生物组成相关的特征。结果显示，饮食限制导致食物摄入暂时增加、体重和静息代谢率下降，以及肠道微生物组成显著变化，这些变化在恢复期几乎恢复到基线水平。尽管选择线的反应大致相似，但与我们的预测相反，饮食限制对A线田鼠的影响并未表现出更严重和持久的生理效应。
items.abstract: Host-microbiota interactions are crucial in adapting to environmental changes, such as fluctuating energy availability. Yet, the extent to which hosts and their microbiota exhibit coordinated plasticity in response to transient energy limitation remains unclear. Here, we examined the capacity for parallel reversible plasticity in hosts and gut microbiota to temporary dietary restriction in hosts with differing energy needs. We subjected bank voles (Clethrionomys glareolus) from a long-term artificial selection experiment for high aerobic metabolism (A-lines) and control lines (C-lines) to dietary restriction (food dilution with insoluble fiber) followed by a recovery period. We measured traits relevant for vole energy consumption and fecal microbiota composition at baseline, after dietary restriction, and after recovery. We hypothesized that A-line voles would experience more severe and prolonged physiological effects of dietary restriction than C-line voles, which might be counteracted by higher microbiota responsiveness. items.title: TCF25 emerges as a cytoplasmic regulator of GPRASP2 stability
items.title_zh: TCF25作为GPRASP2稳定性的细胞质调节因子
items.summary_zh: TCF25是一种保守的真核蛋白，其细胞定位和功能尚不明确。研究表明，在基础条件下，TCF25主要位于多种人类细胞类型的细胞质中，并在核周围形成一种抗数字宁的池，表明其与膜相关成分的关联。通过近距离标记法探索TCF25的近端网络，进一步支持其富集于细胞质和细胞内膜相关蛋白。结合公共数据集和近端蛋白组数据，发现TCF25与G蛋白偶联受体相关的分选蛋白GPRASP2结合，并通过保护其免受蛋白酶体降解来维持其基础丰度。结构模型分析显示，TCF25的C端区域存在与GPRASP2的假定相互作用界面。TCF25氨基酸604-664的缺失破坏了其与GPRASP2的关系。这些发现确立了TCF25在细胞质膜近端的背景，并识别出其与GPRASP2结合所需的C端序列，提示TCF25在调节GPRASP2稳定性中的作用，为研究其在细胞稳态和疾病中的角色提供了框架。
items.abstract: TCF25 is a conserved eukaryotic protein whose cellular localisation and functional context remain poorly understood. Here, we show that under basal conditions, TCF25 is predominantly cytoplasmic across several human cell types, with a digitonin-resistant perinuclear pool indicative of association to membrane-linked components. Exploration of TCF25's proximal network using proximity labelling further supports enrichment of cytoplasmic and intracellular membrane-associated proteins. Guided by the analysis of public datasets and the proximal proteome data, we show that TCF25 associates with G-protein coupled receptor-associated sorting protein, GPRASP2, and maintains its basal abundance by protecting it from proteasomal degradation. Using structural modelling, we identify a putative interaction interface between the two proteins, involving two closely-spaced helices in the C terminal region of TCF25 that dock to the helical repeat segment of GPRASP2. Consistent with this prediction, deletion of TCF25 amino acids 604-664 disrupted the relationship between TCF25 and GPRASP2. items.authors: Hardy, L. J. E.; Moinudeen, H. K.; Grzegorzek, L.; Bazan, J. F.; Khoronenkova, S. V.

items.title: Generative Design of New-to-nature Biosynthetic Assembly Lines with Genomic Language Modeling
items.title_zh: 基于基因组语言模型的新型生物合成线路生成设计
items.summary_zh: 重新编程生物合成线路可以将生物合成扩展到自然界未探索的化学空间。然而，由于合成线路的功能依赖于大型多域酶之间的协调互动，这一过程仍然困难。本文将训练于宏基因组序列的基因组语言模型gLM2与离散扩散和域级条件相结合，实现生物合成基因簇的生成设计与优化。我们将此方法应用于一种工程化的嵌合型I类多酮合酶（PKS），以生产{delta}-戊内酯，这是一种PKS自然合成的分子。通过在完整PKS序列的背景下对两个多域区域进行迭代重新设计，gLM2逐步提高了{delta}-戊内酯的产量，最终获得的变体其滴度比起始酶高出9.4倍。这些结果表明，进化序列信息可以被学习并应用于复杂的多域酶设计问题，从而扩展生物合成线路以生产超出其自然生物合成能力的分子。
items.abstract: Reprogramming biosynthetic assembly lines can extend biosynthesis beyond the chemical space explored by nature. However, this remains difficult because assembly-line function depends on coordinated interactions across large multidomain enzymes. Here, we couple gLM2, a genomic language model trained on metagenomic sequences, with discrete diffusion and domain-level conditioning to enable generative design and optimization of biosynthetic gene clusters. We apply this approach to a chimeric type I polyketide synthase (PKS) engineered to produce {delta}-valerolactam, a molecule not naturally synthesized by PKSs. Through iterative redesign of two multi-domain regions in the context of the full PKS sequence, gLM2 progressively improved {delta}-valerolactam production, yielding variants with up to 9.4-fold higher titer than the starting enzyme. Together, these results demonstrate that evolutionary sequence information can be learned and applied to complex, multi-domain enzyme design problems, expanding biosynthetic assembly lines to produce molecules outside their natural biosynthetic repertoire.
items.authors: Lanclos, N.; Ibrahim, K.; Cornman, A.; Huang, M.; Gill, V.; Jain, A.; Abraham, J.; Gin, J.; Chen, Y.; Petzold, C.; Baerwald, J.; Kortemme, T.; Keasling, J.; Hwang, Y.

items.title: Sympathetic neurons control adaptive immunity in response to Streptococcus pneumoniae infection by regulating T cell and B cell effector function
items.title_zh: 交感神经调控肺部适应性免疫应对肺炎链球菌感染
items.summary_zh: 肺部的适应性免疫需迅速动员以控制细菌病原体，但调节局部B细胞和T细胞反应的神经免疫信号尚不明确。本研究识别了一个交感神经-免疫轴，调控肺驻留记忆B细胞、抗原特异性IgG产生及对肺炎链球菌的保护。肺部靶向化学交感神经切除减少去甲肾上腺素可用性，降低Tbet记忆和驻留记忆B细胞群体，显著损害S. pneumoniae特异性IgG，导致细菌负担增加。缺乏Adrb1和Adrb2-肾上腺素受体的小鼠表现出相同缺陷，向Ighm-/-宿主转移Adrb1/Adrb2-/- B细胞足以降低IgG并加重感染。联合T细胞耗竭和B细胞内源性肾上腺素受体缺失进一步削弱细菌控制并抑制IFNgamma，表明去甲肾上腺素刺激T细胞IFNgamma释放，并与IFNgamma共同驱动最佳B细胞IgG产生。体外实验显示去甲肾上腺素增强T细胞IFNgamma分泌，且去甲肾上腺素与IFNgamma协同增加IgG。这些发现确定去甲肾上腺素为肺驻留体液免疫的关键调节因子，并揭示了促进呼吸道粘膜抗体介导细菌清除的神经免疫机制。
items.abstract: Adaptive immunity in the lung must be rapidly mobilized to control bacterial pathogens, yet the neuroimmune signals that shape local B and T cell responses remain poorly defined. Here we identify a sympathetic-immune axis that regulates lung-resident memory B cells, antigen-specific IgG production, and protection against Streptococcus pneumoniae. Lung-targeted chemical sympathectomy reduced norepinephrine availability, diminished Tbet memory and resident-memory B cell populations, and markedly impaired S. pneumoniae-specific IgG, resulting in increased bacterial burden. Mice lacking Adrb1 & Adrb2-adrenergic receptors phenocopied these defects, and adoptive transfer of Adrb1/Adrb2-/- B cells into Ighm-/- hosts was sufficient to reduce IgG and worsen infection. Combined T cell depletion and B cell-intrinsic adrenergic receptor loss further impaired bacterial control and suppressed IFNgamma, indicating that norepinephrine stimulates T cell IFNgamma release and that norepinephrine and IFNgamma together drive optimal B cell IgG production. items.authors: Zhu, F.; Davis, K.; Acharya, S.; Pattanashetti, R.; Sekar, J.; Aguilar, D.; Kalpage, N.; Akbari, O.; Swaminathan, S.; Jorth, P.; Swidergall, M.; Jendzjowsky, N.

items.title: Pathophysiological remodeling of the skeletal muscle microenvironment in patients with lung cancer
items.title_zh: 肺癌患者骨骼肌微环境的病理生理重塑
items.summary_zh: 背景：肌肉消耗、全身炎症和功能下降在晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中普遍存在且具有危害性。方法：本研究通过定量蛋白质组学、组织学、荧光激活细胞分选、基因表达谱和高分辨率呼吸测定法，分析了18例NSCLC患者及18例匹配对照的骨骼肌活检样本。发现：NSCLC患者的肌肉表现出II型肌纤维萎缩、胶原沉积增加及脂质向细胞外基质（ECM）的重新分布，同时伴随炎症、免疫、ECM和线粒体蛋白组的重塑。此外，NSCLC患者的线粒体呼吸能力和形态发生改变，伴随氧化应激增加和钙处理失调。同时，我们检测到STAT3激活和免疫细胞变化，这可能对NSCLC患者的骨骼肌健康产生负面影响。最后，我们发现成纤维-脂肪前体细胞（FAPs）向CD90亚型的转变。机制上，来自患者来源的FAPs的条件培养基在体外减少了肌管宽度，揭示了肌肉驻留基质成分改变的旁分泌信号的新机制。
items.abstract: Background Muscle wasting, systemic inflammation, and functional decline are highly prevalent and detrimental in patients with advanced-stage non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Methods: In this cross sectional study, we investigated NSCLC associated muscle remodeling by analyzing skeletal muscle biopsies from patients with NSCLC (n = 18) and matched controls (n = 18) using quantitative proteomics, histology, fluorescence-activated cell sorting, gene expression profiling, and high resolution respirometry. Findings: NSCLC muscle was characterized by type II muscle fiber atrophy, greater collagen deposition, and redistribution of lipids to the extracellular matrix (ECM), together with remodeling of the inflammatory, immune, ECM and mitochondrial proteome. Additionally, mitochondrial respiratory capacity and morphology were altered in patients with NSCLC, which was associated with increased oxidative stress and dysregulated calcium handling. Concomitantly, we detected STAT3 activation and immune cell alterations, which may negatively impact skeletal muscle health in patients with NSCLC. items.title: In utero and neonatal lipid nanoparticle delivery achieves robust editing in hematopoietic stem cells.
items.title_zh: 胎内和新生儿脂质纳米颗粒递送实现造血干细胞强效编辑
items.summary_zh: 有效递送基因编辑试剂至造血干细胞（HSCs）限制了血液疾病体内基因编辑疗法的发展。本研究利用发育性造血促进HSC靶向，采用临床可扩展的脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）。在胎儿发育期间，HSCs位于肝脏，LNPs能有效到达该组织。我们发现，胎内递送携带Cre重组酶或CRISPR-Cas9成分的LNPs可实现真正的长期再生HSCs的转染和基因编辑。编辑后的HSCs在移植后维持多系重建能力，表明其干细胞功能得以保留。比较研究显示，胎儿和早期新生儿递送均可实现HSC编辑，胎儿肝脏造血效率更高。我们进一步确定了一种LNP配方，增强HSC靶向并实现强效的新生儿HSC编辑，无需抗体介导靶向。最后，通过LNP递送Cas9和腺病毒递送修复模板的联合方式，在新生小鼠中实现了多组织的体内同源定向修复。这些发现确立了围产期作为体内HSC基因编辑的治疗窗口，并提供了一种可扩展的策略用于治疗严重的早发性血液疾病。
items.abstract: Efficient delivery of genome editing reagents to hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) has limited the development of in vivo gene editing therapies for hematologic disease. Here, we exploit developmental hematopoiesis to enable HSC targeting using clinically scalable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). During fetal development, HSCs reside in the liver, a tissue that is efficiently accessed by LNPs. We show that in utero delivery of LNPs carrying Cre recombinase or CRISPR-Cas9 components results in transfection and genome editing of bona fide long-term repopulating HSCs. Edited HSCs maintain multilineage reconstitution capacity following transplantation, demonstrating preserved stem cell function. Comparative studies reveal that both fetal and early neonatal delivery permit HSC editing, with greater efficiency during fetal liver hematopoiesis. We further identify an LNP formulation that enhance HSC targeting and enable robust neonatal HSC editing without antibody-mediated targeting. Finally, combined delivery of Cas9 via LNPs and a repair template via adeno-associated virus in neonatal mice enables in vivo homology-directed repair in multiple tissues. items.title: Phylosymbiosis in the making: Discordant developmental emergence of evolutionary signatures in the mammalian gut microbiome and host transcriptome
items.title_zh: 哺乳动物肠道微生物组与宿主转录组的相异发展模式
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物群落常反映宿主的系统发育关系，这一生态进化模式称为“系统共生”。尽管在成年哺乳动物中已有充分记录，但其出现的发育时机和机制仍不明确。本研究使用四种圈养的Peromyscus小鼠，探讨从出生到断奶期间肠道微生物群的组装及系统共生特征的出现。我们结合16S rRNA微生物组分析和全组织转录组学，研究在三个发育阶段（新生、断奶前和断奶）中微生物组与宿主转录组的进化特征。结果显示，父母粪便和母体乳腺皮肤中存在系统共生群落，而新生幼鼠的肠道则没有。系统共生仅在断奶前阶段出现，并持续到断奶。不同物种的肠道微生物多样性随年龄增加，发育阶段对群落组成的影响大于宿主物种身份，效应大小为1.5-2倍。相反，宿主基因表达谱在出生时与宿主系统发育一致，而在后期阶段则不再如此。
items.abstract: Gut microbial communities often mirror host phylogenetic relationships, an eco-evolutionary pattern known as phylosymbiosis. While phylosymbiosis is well documented in adult mammals, the developmental timing and mechanisms underlying its emergence remain unknown. Here, we use four captive-bred species of Peromyscus mice, a powerful model for studying natural variation in animal biology, to investigate the assembly of the intestinal microbiota and the emergence of phylosymbiotic signatures from birth through weaning. We combine 16S rRNA microbiome profiling with whole-tissue transcriptomics across three developmental stages (newborn, pre-weaning, and weaning) to test when during development the microbiome and host transcriptome exhibit evolutionary signatures. While parental feces and maternal mammary skin harbored phylosymbiotic communities, the intestines of newborn pups did not. Phylosymbiosis only emerged in pups at the pre-weaning stage of development and was sustained through weaning. Gut microbial diversity increased with age across species, and developmental stage was a stronger driver of community composition than host species identity, with a 1.5-2x larger effect size. Str
items.authors: Rudzki, E. N.; Jasarevic, E.; Kohl, K. D.

items.title: Ayurveda based phenotype annotation integrated with Expectation Maximization algorithm reveal six biological clusters of rare diseases: potential in resolving ciliopathies
items.title_zh: 基于阿育吠陀的表型注释与期望最大化算法揭示罕见疾病生物簇
items.summary_zh: 罕见疾病的病因异质性和多脏器症状变异性给器官中心的研究带来了挑战。阿育吠陀从多系统角度出发，通过动力学（Vata:V）、代谢（Pitta:P）和结构（Kapha:K）维度评估疾病。本研究结合阿育吠陀与人类表型本体（HPO）统一术语，从系统角度探讨罕见疾病。专家将10,610个HPO术语分类为阿育吠陀表型组（V/P/K），并应用期望最大化（EM）算法对12,678种疾病进行聚类，形成六个独特的聚类，称为AyurPhenoClusters，其中2,814种疾病被独特分类并富集于V/P/K表型。功能注释显示关键生物过程，包括胚胎发生、内分泌和纤毛功能等。K主导聚类的纤毛基因富集最高（43%），V主导聚类为16%，提示V聚类中可能存在纤毛病。
items.abstract: The heterogeneity of underlying causes and the variability of symptoms across Multiple organs in rare diseases present significant challenges when approached from an organ-centric perspective. Ayurveda, however, takes a multisystem perspective, assessing diseases through kinetic (Vata:V ), metabolic (Pitta:P ), and structural (Kapha:K ) dimensions, each with distinct phenotypic and molecular correlates. This study explores rare diseases from a systems perspective by integrating Ayurveda and unifying terminologies from both disciplines using Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO). Experts categorized 10,610 HPO terms into Ayurvedic phenotypic groups (V/P/K ) and applied the Expectation Maximization (EM) algorithm to cluster 12,678 diseases. This yielded six distinct clusters, termed AyurPhenoClusters, with 2,814 diseases uniquely classified and enriched for V/P/K phenotypes. Functional annotation of these, highlighted key biological processes: (i) embryogenesis and skeletal morphogenesis, (ii) endocrine and ciliary functions, (iii) DNA damage response and cell cycle regulation, (iv) inflammation and immune response, (v) immune function, hemopoiesis, and telomere aging, and (vi) small molecu

items.title: Peripheral immunoinflammatory markers and clinical correlations in Parkinson's disease patients carrying LRRK2 G2385R and R1628P variants
items.title_zh: 帕金森病患者外周免疫炎症标志物及其临床相关性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了携带亚洲常见LRRK2 G2385R和R1628P变异的帕金森病（PD）患者的外周炎症特征。我们通过多重免疫测定法分析了240名参与者的血浆免疫炎症标志物，包括IL-6、TNF-α、CCL2、CX3CL1、CCL5和VCAM-1。参与者包括PD-G2385R（n=53）、PD-R1628P（n=58）、PD-G2385R+R1628P（n=5）、特发性PD（iPD；n=62）和对照组（n=62）。结果显示，PD-G2385R组的TNF-α、CCL2、CX3CL1和CCL5水平低于iPD和/或对照组，而PD-R1628P组的IL-6、TNF-α、CCL2和CCL5水平较低。LRRK2激酶活性与TNF-α呈负相关。研究表明，免疫炎症特征及其临床相关性在不同基因型的PD患者中存在差异，对未来免疫调节试验的分层具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Peripheral inflammation in Parkinson's disease (PD) remains poorly characterised among carriers of Asian-prevalent LRRK2 G2385R and R1628P variants. We investigated plasma immunoinflammatory markers (i.e., IL-6, TNF-, CCL2, CX3CL1, CCL5, and VCAM-1) via multiplex immunoassay in 240 participants: PD-G2385R (n=53), PD-R1628P (n=58), PD-G2385R+R1628P (n=5), idiopathic PD (iPD; n=62), and controls (n=62), and their clinicobiological correlates including monocyte LRRK2 kinase activity (pRab10Thr73). Compared with iPD and/or controls, TNF-, CCL2, CX3CL1, and CCL5 were lower in PD-G2385R, while IL-6, TNF-, CCL2, and CCL5 were lower in PD-R1628P. Higher LRRK2 kinase activity correlated with lower TNF-. CX3CL1 correlated with greater motor severity in iPD but less disability in both variant groups. CCL5 correlated with less motor complications in PD-G2385R, while IL-6 and VCAM-1 correlated with worse disability and/or cognition in PD-R1628P. These findings suggest that immunoinflammatory profiles and their clinical relevance in PD differ by genotype, with implications for stratification in future immunomodulatory trials.
items.authors: Ding, H. X.; Toh, T. S.; Zulkefli, N. J.; Zulhaimi, N. S.; Khairul Anuar, A. N.; Hor, J. W.; Tay, Y. W.; Kong, I. X.; Pang, Y. C.; Rajasuriar, R.; Lim, S.-Y.; Tan, A. H.; Lit, L. C.

items.title: Human-centred co-design of a dual-purpose heart failure dashboard
items.title_zh: 以人为本的双重用途心力衰竭仪表板共设计
items.summary_zh: 引言：心力衰竭护理需要在医院和社区之间进行协调，但信息常常在电子病历和临床系统中碎片化。临床仪表板可以整合并展示信息，以支持护理交付和服务管理；然而，现有仪表板通常专注于特定的指标、干预措施和监测路径。本研究旨在共设计、迭代开发和用户测试一个集成的心力衰竭仪表板，将患者级临床决策与服务级管理相连接。方法：采用以人为本的设计方法，包括需求识别、协作构思、迭代原型开发和最终用户测试，共涉及36名来自城市和地区服务的临床医生、健康服务管理者、数据与实施科学家及消费者。结果：在运营决策中，参与者优先考虑心力衰竭服务中患者的实时可见性、患者轨迹、服务绩效信息以及指导性护理和结果的变异识别。临床优先事项包括快速综合纵向信息、优化指导性医疗治疗和跨护理设置的连续性。
items.abstract: Introduction: Heart failure care requires coordination across hospital and community settings, yet information is often fragmented across electronic medical records and clinical systems. Clinical dashboards can bring together and display information to support care delivery and service management; however, existing dashboards have generally focused on specific measures, interventions and monitoring pathways. This study aimed to co-design, iteratively develop and user-test an integrated heart failure dashboard that links patient-level clinical decision-making with service-level management. Methods: A human-centred design approach comprising needs identification, collaborative ideation, iterative prototype development and end-user testing was applied across two complementary operational and clinical dashboard streams. Thirty-six clinicians, health service managers, data and implementation scientists, and consumers from metropolitan and regional services participated. Results: For operational decision-making, participants prioritised real-time visibility of patients across heart failure services, patient trajectories, service-performance information, and identification of variation in

items.title: Clinical trajectories and genetic architecture across the neurological-psychiatric boundary
items.title_zh: 神经精神疾病的临床轨迹与遗传结构研究
items.summary_zh: 神经和精神疾病被视为不同的诊断类别，但遗传研究显示它们之间存在显著的多效性。我们比较了基于Delphi-2M模型（仅使用40万名英国生物银行参与者的健康记录训练）的疾病轨迹嵌入与19种神经和精神疾病的全基因组遗传相关性。临床和遗传相似性在疾病对之间部分重合（Mantel r = 0.33）。大多数疾病在其自身诊断类别中更为接近，而在三个例外中：多发性硬化、偏头痛和原发性震颤则更接近精神疾病。临床轨迹和遗传结构因此在相同的诊断边界上划分，并在相同的地方打破。研究结果支持对神经和精神疾病采取更为综合的方法。
items.abstract: Neurological and psychiatric disorders are treated as distinct diagnostic categories, yet genetic studies reveal substantial pleiotropy between them. Whether this overlap extends to clinical trajectories has not been tested at scale. We compared disease trajectory embeddings from Delphi-2M, a transformer model trained only on the health records of 400,000 UK Biobank participants, with genome-wide genetic correlations across 19 neurological and psychiatric disorders. Clinical and genetic similarity partly converged across disorder pairs (Mantel r = 0.33). Both measures placed most disorders closer to their own diagnostic category than to the other. Both also made the same three exceptions: multiple sclerosis, migraine, and essential tremor sat closer on average to psychiatric than to neurological disorders. Clinical trajectories and genetic architecture thus draw the same diagnostic boundary and break it in the same places. These findings support a more integrated approach to neurological and psychiatric disorders.

items.title: The United States CADASIL Consortium: Baseline Findings from a Natural History Study
items.title_zh: 美国CADASIL联盟：自然历史研究的基线发现
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：血管性认知障碍和痴呆（VCID）是痴呆的第二大主要原因，并且在许多个体中常见于功能能力下降的共病，但由于表型和机制的极大异质性，临床管理和临床试验准备受到严重阻碍。本研究建立了美国首个脑自体显性动脉病伴皮层下梗死和白质脑病（CADASIL）队列的基线临床、功能和多模态生物标志物特征，作为散发性VCID的单因子、单基因小血管疾病模型。方法：对2022年10月至2025年1月在12个美国入组地点收集的基线数据进行横断面分析。通过临床转诊、病历审查、倡导组织和社区 outreach 招募了具有已记录NOTCH3变异的家庭中的成年人。排除标准包括其他影响结果解释的情况和改良Rankin量表（mRS）评分大于3。中心基因特征分析根据表皮生长因子样重复域将具有致病或可能致病NOTCH3变异的个体分为低、中或高风险层级。标准化评估包括临床历史、检查和客观评估。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Vascular contributions to cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID) represent the second leading cause of dementia and a common comorbidity for reduced functional capacity in many individuals, but clinical management and clinical trial readiness are severely hindered by extreme phenotypic and mechanistic heterogeneity. This study establishes the baseline clinical, functional, and multimodal biomarker characteristics of the first United States (US) cohort of Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL), serving as a single-cause, monogenic small vessel disease model for sporadic VCID. Methods: Cross-sectional analysis of baseline data collected from October 2022 through January 2025 from a longitudinal cohort at 12 US enrollment sites. Adults from families with a documented NOTCH3 variant were recruited through clinical referrals, medical record review, advocacy organizations, and community outreach. Exclusion criteria included other conditions that prevented interpretation of findings and modified Rankin Scale (mRS) scores greater than 3. items.title: The value of a family history to distinguish monogenic from polygenic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
items.title_zh: 家族史在区分单基因与多基因肌萎缩侧索硬化症中的价值
items.summary_zh: 家族性肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）或额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的复发是推测孟德尔单基因遗传的临床基础，这为遗传检测、咨询和基因发现策略提供了依据。多基因遗传可能导致ALS的家族聚集，而具有降低外显率的致病变异可能在现代小家系中偶发出现。我们设计了APECS模拟器，模拟了100万个三代家系，并在单基因和多基因遗传模型下对ALS、FTD及其他痴呆进行了建模。针对ALS的索引患者，我们评估了提出的家族性ALS（fALS）定义在预测潜在遗传结构方面的表现。模拟结果与现实世界人口估计进行了基准比较，涵盖了广泛的人口和遗传参数。我们还评估了单基因索引患者的表型复制率。
items.abstract: Familial recurrence of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) or frontotemporal dementia (FTD) is the clinical cornerstone for assuming Mendelian, monogenic inheritance which informs genetic testing, counselling and gene-discovery strategies in standard practice. Polygenic inheritance can lead to familial clustering of ALS, while pathogenic variants with reduced penetrance may present sporadically in small, modern-day pedigrees. As both rare genetic variants and polygenic disease contribute to the occurrence of ALS, the accuracy of a positive family history to predict the underlying genetic architecture remains unknown. Using growing knowledge of the genetic architecture of ALS, we designed the APECS simulator: a large-scale pedigree simulator using historical demographic parameters, unifying frameworks for monogenic and polygenic disease models. We simulated 1,000,000 three-generation pedigrees and modelled ALS, FTD, and other dementias under both inheritance models. For index patients with ALS, we examined the performance of proposed familial ALS (fALS) definitions to predict the underlying genetic architecture. items.title: Genomic Landscape of Early-Onset and Familial Latin American Parkinson's Patients
items.title_zh: 拉美早发及家族性帕金森患者基因组特征研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：帕金森病（PD）是最常见的神经退行性运动障碍，通常被认为是与年龄相关的散发性疾病；然而，5-14%的患者在50岁之前发病（早发性帕金森病，EOPD），约20%有家族病史。研究表明，EOPD及有家族病史的患者的致病基因贡献率较高。目标：本研究旨在对七个与PD相关的基因及21个与相关帕金森病症状相关的基因进行变异筛查，以识别EOPD及家族阳性个体中的致病/可能致病变异及不确定意义变异。方法：对263名EOPD及/或有PD家族史的个体进行短读长全基因组测序。结果：分析显示，4.7%的个体在主要和次要PD基因中存在致病或可能致病变异，5.5%存在高雪氏病的致病或可能致病变异，2.7%有已知的GBA1风险变异。结论：通过扩展拉美人群中与疾病相关的变异谱，我们识别了新的致病变异。
items.abstract: Background Parkinson's disease (PD), the most common neurodegenerative movement disorder, is commonly thought of as an aging and sporadic disease; however, 5-14% of individuals experience disease onset before the age of 50 years (early-onset PD; EOPD) and about 20% have a positive family history. In the case of both EOPD and people with a family history of PD, evidence suggests higher rates of a disease-causing genetic contribution. Objectives Our goal was to perform a variant screening of seven PD-related genes and 21 genes associated with related parkinsonian disorders to identify pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants and variants of uncertain significance within EOPD and family-history-positive individuals within the Latin American Research Consortium on the Genetics of PD (LARGE-PD). Methods We performed short-read whole-genome sequencing on a subset of 263 individuals with EOPD and/or a familial history of PD who had no known pathogenic PD variant in genotyping data. items.title: Immunogenicity and vaccine effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines in people on immunosuppressive therapies
items.title_zh: 免疫抑制治疗人群中COVID-19疫苗的免疫原性与有效性研究
items.summary_zh: 中和抗体是SARS-CoV-2疫苗效力的保护相关因子（CoP）。然而，现有数据通常排除接受免疫抑制治疗的患者，这些患者面临更高的COVID-19症状和重症风险。我们系统性检索了在接受免疫抑制治疗（包括B细胞耗竭、JAK抑制剂和S1P抑制剂）的血液恶性肿瘤、神经系统疾病、风湿性疾病及混合免疫介导炎症疾病（IMIDs）患者中，mRNA疫苗接种后的SARS-CoV-2结合抗体水平。结果显示，不同免疫抑制治疗组的抗体水平差异显著，与健康对照组相比，B细胞耗竭组抗体水平最低（降低54.5倍，95% CI: 34.5-86.2），S1P抑制剂组降低24.8倍（95% CI: 13.2-46.7）。我们还利用先前研究的数据评估抗体水平与保护之间的关联。
items.abstract: Neutralizing antibodies are a correlate of protection (CoP) of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine efficacy. However, data informing CoPs often explicitly exclude people on immunosuppressive therapies who are at an increased risk of symptomatic and severe COVID-19, delayed viral clearance, and death. Investigating the relationship between antibodies and protection for people on immunosuppressive therapies could provide insights into mechanisms of protection. We performed a systematic search to identify studies reporting SARS-CoV-2 binding antibody levels after mRNA vaccination in people with hematological malignancies, neurological disorders, rheumatic diseases, and mixed immune-mediated inflammatory disorders (IMIDs) on immunosuppressive therapies including B-cell depletion, JAK inhibitors, and S1P inhibitors, as well as healthy controls. Binding antibody levels varied between cohorts receiving different immunosuppressive treatments. Compared to healthy controls the lowest antibody levels were observed in subjects treated with B-cell depletion (54.5-fold reduction, 95% CI: 34.5-86.2) and S1P inhibitors (24.8-fold reduction, 95% CI: 13.2-46.7). items.title: A Framework for Analytical Validation of Genomic DNA-Based Shotgun Metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing Workflows
items.title_zh: 基于基因组DNA的枪击式宏基因组测序工作流程分析验证框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：宏基因组下一代测序（mNGS）作为一种快速且无偏见的病原体检测替代方法，正被越来越多地采用。然而，缺乏标准化的mNGS工作流程分析验证方法。仅基于与培养比较的验证策略受到限制，因为培养的诊断产率低，且无法从未知微生物负荷的临床样本中推导出分析参数。为此，需要系统的分析方法独立定义mNGS工作流程的性能。mNGS广泛应用于微生物组分析，其中在低DNA输入下保持微生物多样性是关键性能标准。材料与方法：评估了PaRTI-Seq mNGS工作流程的分析性能，包括宿主去除、DNA提取、文库准备和生物信息学分析。使用来自不同微生物的定量基因组DNA评估文库级别的分析灵敏度，并通过枚举悬浮液评估工作流程级别的灵敏度。
items.abstract: Background Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) is increasingly adopted as a rapid and unbiased alternative to culture-based pathogen detection. However, standardized approaches for analytical validation of mNGS workflows are lacking. Validation strategies based solely on comparison with culture are inherently limited due to low diagnostic yield of culture, and the inability to derive analytical parameters such as limit of detection (LoD) from clinical samples with unknown microbial loads. Systematic analytical approaches are therefore required to define mNGS workflow performance independently of clinical comparators. In addition to diagnostics, mNGS is widely applied to microbiome profiling, where preservation of microbial diversity at low DNA inputs is a key performance criterion. Materials and Methods The analytical performance of the PaRTI-Seq mNGS workflow (Micronbrane, Taiwan), comprising host depletion, DNA extraction, library preparation, and bioinformatics analysis, was evaluated. items.title: Penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility in clinical methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream infection strains from the CAMERA2 trial
items.title_zh: 临床耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌血流感染菌株对青霉素-克拉维酸的敏感性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估临床耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）血流感染（BSI）菌株对青霉素-克拉维酸（BLBLI）的敏感性及其与氧西林敏感性、基因型因素和患者特征的关联。我们对117株MRSA BSI菌株进行了青霉素-克拉维酸的Etest检测和328株的氧西林盘扩散法检测。结果显示，62%的菌株对青霉素-克拉维酸和氧西林敏感，氧西林敏感性与青霉素-克拉维酸敏感性高度相关（敏感性97.3%，特异性95.5%）。因此，我们将氧西林敏感性作为青霉素-克拉维酸敏感性的替代指标。比较基因组学分析发现mecA基因有8个等位基因。
items.abstract: Objectives- Among clinical methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bloodstream infection (BSI) strains, we sought to determine the prevalence of {beta}-lactam-{beta}-lactamase inhibitor (BLBLI) susceptibility, and its association with oxacillin susceptibility, genotypic factors, and patient characteristics. Methods- Clinical MRSA BSI strains were tested for susceptibility to penicillin-clavulanate by Etest (n=117, 36% of the dataset) and to oxacillin by disk diffusion assay (n=328, 100%). Penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility was defined as MIC [ ]2mg/L and oxacillin disk susceptibility as an inhibition zone > 6mm. All strains were whole-genome sequenced, and alleles of mecA annotated. The sensitivity and specificity of the oxacillin disk to predict penicillin-clavulanate 'susceptibility' were assessed. Clinical and genomic associations with BLBLI 'susceptibility' were assessed by calculating odds-ratios (OR). Results -We found 73/117 (62%) and 205/328 (62%) strains to be 'susceptible' to penicillin-clavulanate and oxacillin disk, respectively. items.title: Alpha-Mannosidosis: Quantitative Oligosaccharide Biomarker Analysis in Dried Blood Spots for Diagnosis, Newborn Screening, and Treatment Monitoring
items.title_zh: α-甘露糖苷酶缺乏症：干血点中寡糖生物标志物的定量分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：α-甘露糖苷酶缺乏症（AM）是一种因α-甘露糖苷酶活性不足而导致的溶酶体贮积病。特定的寡糖在组织中积累，并可在体液中检测到。AM是一种进行性多脏器疾病，治疗选项包括造血干细胞移植（HSCT）和酶替代疗法（ERT），但治疗效果依赖于早期诊断。因此，将AM纳入新生儿筛查将显著改善治疗结果。方法：开发了一种快速、完全定量的方法，通过超高效液相色谱-串联质谱分析干血点（DBS）中的特定AM生物标志物Man2GlcNAc。分析了420名对照者、27名AM患者（包括5个新生儿筛查样本）和35名其他溶酶体贮积病患者的样本。结果：未受影响个体与未治疗AM患者之间的生物标志物浓度明显不同（0.1 - 0.8 vs 3.2 - 11.3 mol Man2GlcNAc/L, p<0.0001）。此外，未治疗患者与接受ERT患者（n = 17, p<0.0001）之间的Man2GlcNAc浓度显著不同。
items.abstract: Background: Alpha-mannosidosis (AM) is a debilitating lysosomal storage disorder (LSD) caused by insufficient activity of alpha-mannosidase, an enzyme responsible for cleavage of alpha-linked mannose residues from N-glycan-type oligosaccharides during their degradation. As a result, specific oligosaccharides accumulate in tissues and are also detectable in body fluids. AM is a progressive multi-organ disease for which hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) and enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) are therapeutic options, however, treatment results depend considerably on early diagnosis. Therefore, inclusion of AM into newborn screening panels would significantly contribute to improving therapeutic outcome. Methods: A rapid and fully quantitative method for the specific AM oligosaccharide biomarker Man2GlcNAc in dried blood spots (DBS) using ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled to tandem-mass spectrometry was developed. DBS from 420 controls, 27 AM patients (including five newborn screening samples), and 35 patients with other LSDs were analyzed. items.title: Does Deep Learning Vascular Segmentation on CTA Improve Vertebral Artery Dissection Detection?
items.title_zh: 深度学习血管分割在CTA中对椎动脉夹层检测的改善作用
items.summary_zh: 目的：本研究旨在开发一个外部验证的深度学习血管分割模型，以增强椎动脉夹层在CTA中的检测，并通过配对交叉阅读者研究评估该模型的临床实用性。方法：这项回顾性研究获得IRB批准，时间为2024年9月至2026年7月，包括84个手动分割的CTA作为内部训练队列，以及来自RSNA颅内动脉瘤挑战的17个CTA（共101个CTA），外部测试队列为40个CTA（22个阳性，18个阴性）。使用五折交叉验证训练nnU-Net（版本2）模型，技术性能通过Dice相似系数（DSC）评估。读者研究包括10名读者评估有无基于分割的增强的诊断准确性、信心和解读时间。统计分析采用McNemar精确检验（准确性）和Wilcoxon符号秩检验（信心、时间），P < .05被视为显著。结果：模型的DSC为0.96（SD 0.01）。在读者研究中，增强后的诊断准确性低于未增强（0.72 vs 0.84，P < 0.001），而信心（3.98 vs 3.96，P = .77）和解读时间（137.3 vs 166.7秒，P = .54）无显著差异。
items.abstract: Purpose: The aims of this study were to develop an externally validated deep learning vascular segmentation model for digital enhancement of vertebral artery dissection detection on CTA and to assess clinical utility of the model through a paired crossover reader study. Materials and Methods: This retrospective, IRB-approved study conducted from September 2024 to July 2026 included an internal training cohort of 84 manually segmented CTAs plus 17 CTAs from the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Challenge (101 CTAs total) and an external testing cohort of 40 CTAs (22 positive, 18 negative for vertebral artery dissection). A nnU-Net (version 2) model was trained using five-fold cross-validation with the entire training cohort. Technical performance was evaluated using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC). A two-part crossover reader study included 10 readers who assessed diagnostic accuracy, confidence, and interpretation time with and without segmentation-based augmentation. Statistical analyses included McNemar's exact test (accuracy) and Wilcoxon signed-rank test (confidence, time), with P < .05 considered significant. items.authors: Zaveri, S.; Zhang, D.; Castellino, E.; Calabrese, E.

items.title: A Genome-wide Genetic Data Resource for the 45 and Up Study
items.title_zh: 45岁及以上研究的全基因组遗传数据资源
items.summary_zh: 大型基于人群的队列研究能够探讨疾病风险和精准预防，但通常缺乏全基因组遗传数据。我们在澳大利亚的45岁及以上研究中生成并验证了新的基因组数据，该研究是南半球最大的队列之一（招募时间为2005-2009年），拥有广泛的纵向和关联健康数据。在2022-2023年，邀请了30,541名参与者（随机子队列及所有有四种最常见侵袭性癌症病史的个体：乳腺癌、前列腺癌、黑色素瘤、结直肠癌），对同意提供DNA样本和未同意者的参与者特征进行了深入映射。低覆盖全基因组测序数据（0.4-6.3x）经过插补后，为7,408名个体提供了约7900万个变异；6,827名个体的数据通过了严格的质量控制。重复样本（n=85）和密集基因分型阵列（n=188）之间的基因型一致性较高。大多数高质量数据的无关参与者推断为欧洲遗传谱系（n=6,631，98%），推断为非欧洲或混合谱系的有141名（2%）。作为新基因组数据与现有健康记录整合的原则证明，四种最常见癌症的多基因风险评分（PGS）显示出与以往研究一致的预测性能，包括PGS与前列腺癌早期诊断年龄之间的关联。
items.abstract: Large population-based cohorts enable investigation of disease risk and precision prevention, but often lack genome-wide genetic data. We generated and validated new genomic data within the Australian 45 and Up Study, one of the largest Southern Hemisphere cohorts (recruited 2005-2009) with extensive longitudinal and linked health data. In 2022-2023, 30,541 participants were invited (random sub-cohort and all individuals with history of four most common invasive cancers: breast, prostate, melanoma, colorectal), with in-depth mapping of participants' characteristics for people who consented to provide a DNA sample and those who did not. Low-coverage whole-genome sequencing data (0.4-6.3x) followed by imputation yielded ~79 million variants for n=7,408 individuals; data for n=6,827 passed stringent quality control. Genotype concordance was high between duplicates (n=85) and with dense genotyping arrays (n=188). Most unrelated participants with high-quality data had inferred European genetic ancestry (n=6,631, 98%), with n=141 (2%) of inferred non-European or admixed ancestry. items.title: Uncoded Clinical Features from Multilingual Electronic Health Records in Catalonia: Development and Validation Study
items.title_zh: 加泰罗尼亚多语言电子健康记录中的未编码临床特征研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：电子健康记录（EHR）中的非结构化自由文本叙述包含重要的临床信息，但这些信息未被结构化标准代码捕获。本研究旨在开发和验证一种隐私保护的本地混合管道，结合轻量级小语言模型（SLM）与确定性正则表达式，从初级护理EHR叙述中提取六个未编码的尿路感染（UTI）临床特征（发热、亚硝酸盐、白细胞、腰痛、腹痛和血尿）。方法：在机构防火墙内使用Ollama部署开放权重模型（Phi4-mini，3.8B参数），并与临床医生合作迭代优化提示，推理后应用正则表达式。验证分为两个独立部分：1）对60个真实患者记录进行双盲临床医生金标准审查；2）使用GPT-4.1和Grok-4.1生成的720个带语言噪声的合成数据集。计算关键性能的点估计和95%置信区间（CIs）。
items.abstract: Background: Unstructured free-text narratives in electronic health records (EHRs) contain critical clinical information that is not captured by structured standard codes. In Catalonia, primary care notes follow a semi-structured format known as MEAP (in Catalan). However, extracting structured variables using cloud-hosted commercial large language models (LLMs) raises substantial data privacy concerns and incurs high operational costs. Objective: To develop and validate a privacy-preserving local hybrid pipeline combining a lightweight small language model (SLM) with deterministic regular expressions for extracting six uncoded urinary tract infection (UTI) clinical features (fever, nitrites, leukocytes, lumbar pain, abdominal pain, and haematuria) from primary care EHR narratives. Methods: We deployed the open-weight model (Phi4-mini, 3.8B parameters) within the institutional firewall using Ollama. Prompts were iteratively refined in collaboration with clinicians, and regular expressions were applied post-inference. items.title: Scalable Causal-Interpretable Machine Learning for Cancer Prescreening Using Electronic Health Records
items.title_zh: 基于电子健康记录的可扩展因果可解释癌症预筛查方法
items.summary_zh: 电子健康记录为疾病风险预测提供了真实世界的信息来源，但许多机器学习模型学习的隐含关联难以检查或用于临床推理。因果贝叶斯网络（CBNs）通过在有向无环图中表示条件依赖关系、假定方向关系和概率证据传播，提供了一种因果可解释的机器学习形式。然而，传统的CBN结构学习在大规模电子健康记录数据上应用时变得不稳定且计算成本高。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了UPEBNL，一个基于并行CBN学习的可扩展因果可解释癌症预筛查框架。UPEBNL集成了自适应数据切片、质量感知结构聚合和全局DAG构建，从大规模观察数据中学习稳定且可解释的依赖结构。在高维和数百万样本的模拟中，UPEBNL提高了结构恢复准确性近40%，并在速度上比传统CBN学习策略快221.28倍。对于癌症风险预测，学习到的CBNs提供了可解释的证据路径，食管癌和结肠癌的验证AUC分别达到了0.8171和0.784。
items.abstract: Electronic health records provide a source of real-world information for disease risk prediction, but many machine learning models learn implicit associations that are difficult to inspect or use for clinical reasoning. Causal Bayesian networks (CBNs) offer a form of causal-interpretable machine learning by representing conditional dependencies, putative directional relations, and probabilistic evidence propagation in a directed acyclic graph. However, conventional CBN structure learning becomes unstable and computationally expensive when applied to large-scale EHR data. To address this limitation, we propose UPEBNL, a scalable framework for causal-interpretable cancer prescreening based on parallel CBN learning. UPEBNL integrates adaptive data slicing, quality-aware structure aggregation, and global DAG construction to learn stable and interpretable dependency structures from large-scale observational data. We evaluated UPEBNL in high-dimensional and multi-million-sample simulations and applied it to EHR-based prescreening for esophageal and colorectal cancer. In simulations, UPEBNL improved structural recovery accuracy by nearly 40% and achieved up to a 221.28-fold speedup over c
items.authors: Zhang, S.; Xue, F.

items.title: CORRELATION OF SERUM ZINC WITH GLEASON SCORE AS A MARKER FOR PROSTATE CANCER AGGRESSIVENESS IN JOS.
items.title_zh: 血清锌与Gleason评分的相关性及前列腺癌侵袭性标志研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：锌在正常前列腺细胞中抑制能量产生、增长和增殖，同时抑制前列腺癌侵袭性所需的恶性潜力和血管生成。本研究旨在确定血清锌与Gleason评分的相关性，以作为前列腺癌侵袭性的标志。方法：我们对42名新诊断的组织学确认前列腺腺癌患者进行了医院基础的横断面分析研究。采用Spearman等级相关分析评估血清锌与Gleason评分之间的关系，并使用二元回归模型评估血清锌水平对重度前列腺癌侵袭性的影响，调整年龄作为混杂因素。结果：参与者平均年龄为67.12岁，范围为45-90岁。高等级疾病（Gleason 8）最为常见，占57.1%。血清锌浓度中位数为71.5微克/dL（IQ：47.6至88.5微克/dL）。血清锌与Gleason评分呈显著负相关（Spearman r = -0.514，p < 0.001）。降低的锌水平显著与较高的Gleason评分相关。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Zinc inhibits energy production, growth, and proliferation in normal prostate cells while suppressing the malignant potential and angiogenesis that are essential to prostate cancer aggressiveness. The study aimed to determine the correlation of serum zinc with Gleason score as a marker for prostate cancer aggressiveness METHODOLOGY: We conducted a hospital-based cross-sectional analytical study carried out on forty-two (42) eligible participants with newly diagnosed histologically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma over one year. Spearman's rank correlation was used to assess the relationship between serum zinc and prostate cancer aggressiveness as measured by the Gleason score. The impact of serum zinc level on the aggressiveness of severe prostate cancer was assessed using a binary regression model, adjusting for age as a confounder in the logistic regression model. A statistically significant P value was set at 0.05. RESULTS: The mean age of participants was 67.12 years, with a range of 45- 90 years. items.title: Targeting Polθ Helicase with RP-3467: Preclinical Validation and Clinical Response in a gBRCA1 ovarian cancer patient with an acquired PARPi resistance mutation in TP53BP1
items.title_zh: 靶向Polθ解旋酶RP-3467的临床前验证及临床反应研究
items.summary_zh: 同源重组（HR）缺陷是多种癌症的基础，PARP抑制剂（PARPi）在BRCA1/2突变肿瘤中显示出临床疗效。然而，耐药机制和耐受性问题限制了其长期效果。本研究表征了RP-3467，这是一种新型选择性小分子抑制剂，靶向DNA聚合酶theta（Polθ）的ATP酶结构域，关键介导错误倾向的微同源介导末端连接（MMEJ）途径。结果显示，RP-3467有效抑制Polθ酶活性，消除MMEJ，并在HR缺陷模型中干扰有丝分裂DNA修复，诱导合成致死。在临床前研究中，RP-3467与PARPi（奥拉帕利和鲁卡帕利）强烈协同作用，实现多种异种移植和患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型中的持续肿瘤缩小，且无额外全身毒性。机制研究发现，RP-3467在体内增加有丝分裂DNA损伤，表现为微核和CIP2A聚焦的升高。RP-3467在一期临床试验（NCT06560632）中评估，初步显示临床活性。一名重度预处理的BRCA1突变卵巢癌患者在RP-3467与奥拉帕利联合治疗中获得确认的部分缓解。
items.abstract: Homologous recombination (HR) deficiency underlies a range of cancers, and PARP inhibitors (PARPi) targeting this vulnerability have demonstrated clinical efficacy in BRCA1/2-mutant tumors. However, resistance mechanisms and tolerability issues limit their long-term clinical effectiveness. Here, we characterize RP-3467, a novel, selective small-molecule inhibitor targeting the ATPase domain of DNA polymerase theta (Pol{theta}), the key mediator of the error-prone microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ) pathway. We demonstrate that RP-3467 potently suppresses Pol{theta} enzymatic activity, abrogates MMEJ, and disrupts mitotic DNA repair in HR-deficient (HRD) models, inducing synthetic lethality. In preclinical studies, we show that RP-3467 synergizes strongly with PARPi (olaparib and rucaparib), achieving sustained tumor regression across multiple xenograft and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models without added systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, we find that RP-3467 increases mitotic DNA damage in vivo, as evidenced by elevated micronuclei and CIP2A foci. items.title: Polygenic effects on cortical size and ADHD converge on a mid-gestational progenitor-to-neuron transition programme
items.title_zh: 多基因效应对皮层大小和ADHD的影响集中于中期妊娠的祖细胞-神经元转变程序
items.summary_zh: 神经发育和精神疾病被假设源于大脑结构和功能的变化，但其分子和细胞机制尚不清楚。本研究利用来自59,283名成年人、儿童和新生儿的遗传及结构/扩散神经影像数据，识别出ADHD、焦虑和抑郁与多种表型（皮层大小和皮下体积）之间的广泛遗传关联。多变量遗传分析表明，这些关联主要由共同的皮层大小遗传因素和ADHD驱动。孟德尔随机化结果显示，遗传预测的皮层大小减小是ADHD的因果因素，而非反之。通过对发育皮层进行单细胞核RNA测序，我们进一步证明，尽管皮层大小和ADHD在不同细胞类型（增殖祖细胞和后分裂神经元）中富集，但它们在两种细胞类型之间的转变过程中汇聚于神经发生遗传程序。该程序在妊娠中期达到峰值，并局限于外侧脑室下区和中间区，这些区域是祖细胞扩增和早期神经元迁移驱动人类皮层扩展的地方，并富含在人类和小鼠中差异表达的基因。
items.abstract: Neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions have long been hypothesised to emerge from changes in the structure and function of the brain. However, the molecular and cellular mechanisms linking brain structure to these conditions remain unknown. Here, using genetic and structural/diffusion neuroimaging data from 59,283 individuals spanning adults, children and neonates, we identify widespread genetic associations between ADHD, anxiety and depression and multiple phenotypes indexing cortical size and subcortical volume. Multivariate genetic analyses demonstrate that these associations are largely driven by a common cortical size genetic factor and ADHD. Mendelian randomisation indicates that genetically predicted reduced cortical size is causal for ADHD and not vice versa. Using single-nucleus RNA sequencing of the developing cortex, we further demonstrate that although cortical size and ADHD are enriched in different cell types - proliferating progenitors and postmitotic neurons, respectively, they converge on neurogenic genetic programmes active during the transition between the two cell types. items.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of WHO IMCI Visual Inspection for Neonatal Jaundice: A Prospective Multi-Country Cohort
items.title_zh: WHO IMCI视觉检查对新生儿黄疸的诊断准确性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：新生儿高胆红素血症在低中收入国家对婴儿的影响尤为严重。由于资源有限，实验室总胆红素测量受到限制，因此需要更简单的替代方法。本研究旨在评估世界卫生组织儿童疾病综合管理算法下的黄疸视觉检查与经皮胆红素测定在社区环境中识别高胆红素血症的诊断准确性。方法：在亚洲和非洲的六个地点进行PRISMA前瞻性队列研究，分别在出生后0-72小时、3-5天和5-14天对新生儿进行黄疸的视觉检查和经皮胆红素测定。结果：分析了14,331名婴儿的数据，其中包括1,852名早产儿。3-5天时，15%的婴儿被定义为高胆红素血症。视觉检查的敏感性为16%，特异性为96%，阳性一致率为56%，阴性一致率为86%。结论：视觉检查的低敏感性凸显了改善诊断方法的紧迫性。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Adverse consequences of neonatal hyperbilirubinemia disproportionately affect babies in low- and middle-income countries. Laboratory measurement of total serum bilirubin is limited in low-resource settings, necessitating simpler alternatives. Our study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of visual inspection of jaundice via the World Health Organization Integrated Management of Childhood Illnesses algorithm compared to transcutaneous bilirubinometry for the identification of hyperbilirubinemia in community settings. METHODS: Hyperbilirubinemia was assessed by visual inspection for jaundice and transcutaneous bilirubinometry at 0-72 hours, 3-5 days, and 5-14 days postnatal in the PRISMA prospective cohort study in six sites in Asia and Africa. We assessed sensitivity, specificity, and positive and negative percent agreement. RESULTS: We analyzed data from 14,331 infants, including 1,852 preterm infants. 15% had hyperbilirubinemia, as defined by transcutaneous bilirubin values and the NICE nomograms, at 3-5 days postnatal.
