items.title: TARGet: Topology-Aware Fusion-based Radio Frequency Circuit Functional Modeling using Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: TARGet：基于拓扑感知融合的射频电路功能建模
items.summary_zh: 自动合成模拟和射频（RF）电路是一个新兴领域，亟需高效的电路建模方法。近年来，机器学习（ML）解决方案在这方面展现出良好前景。然而，许多现有的ML方法需要针对每种电路拓扑单独训练数据，且忽视电路拓扑信息，限制了其捕捉复杂组件交互的能力。此外，它们依赖于全连接神经网络，特征表示平坦，需大量训练数据。本文提出了一种开源的拓扑感知RF电路建模方法TARGet。该模型在子电路和整体电路拓扑两个层面考虑电路，利用S参数表示捕捉子电路行为，并明确将电路拓扑信息纳入模型，从而实现跨多种拓扑的学习。TARGet引入了一种新颖的融合架构，整合了图神经网络（GNN）和子电路连接感知神经网络，以提高数据效率。
items.abstract: Automatic synthesis of analog and Radio Frequency (RF) circuits is an emerging area that requires an efficient circuit modeling method. In recent years, Machine Learning (ML) solutions have played a promising role in this regard. However, many existing ML approaches require separate training data for each circuit topology, even when a single circuit component is added or removed. In addition, they overlook circuit topology information, which limits their ability to capture complex component interactions. Furthermore, they rely on fully connected neural networks with flat feature representations, which require substantial amounts of training data. In this work, we propose an open-source topology-aware RF circuit modeling method, TARGet. Our model considers the circuit at two levels: sub-circuits and the overall circuit topology. At the sub-circuit level, TARGet leverages S-parameter representations to capture sub-circuit behavior rather than relying on individual circuit components, providing a reusable behavioral abstraction for RF building blocks. Moreover, TARGet explicitly incorporates circuit topology information into the model, enabling it to learn across multiple topologies.
items.authors: Soroosh Noorzad, Sebastian Bodero, Morteza Fayazi

items.title: CNA: An AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment for Healthy Status and Application to Optimize RRT Strategies by Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: CNA：一种面向AI的综合健康状态评估及其在RRT策略优化中的应用
items.summary_zh: 全球有数百万患者需要进行肾脏替代治疗（RRT），这对生存至关重要。然而，由于患者动态异质性、数据缺失以及缺乏面向AI的健康评估标准，优化RRT策略面临挑战。我们提出了一种面向AI的综合标准化评估（CNA）用于健康状态评估，并应用于通过离线强化学习（RL）优化RRT策略。CNA的关键思想是将生命体征分布转化为标准正态空间，从而生成统一的数据驱动健康状态评分，基于参考区间的偏差进行定义，并为评估策略质量提供了AI导向的标准，支持RL终止。我们设计了一个结构化的23维状态表示，整合了19个指标和4个RRT描述符，并采用矩阵分解重构缺失的生命体征，提高数据完整性。这些组件被纳入多个离线RL算法，并通过系统性消融研究验证。在与医生观察的治疗相比，最佳学习策略将死亡率从13.2%降低至5.0%（降低62.24%），并将平均住院时间从308.5小时缩短至250.1小时（降低18.93%），展示了方法创新及CNA指导的RL的潜力。
items.abstract: Millions worldwide require Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT) as a treatment essential for survival. However, optimizing RRT strategies via AI is challenging due to heterogeneous patient dynamics, missing data, and the absence of an AI-oriented health assessment criterion. We propose an AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment (CNA) for healthy status and apply it to optimize RRT strategies by using offline reinforcement learning (RL). The key idea of CNA is transforming vital-sign distributions into a standard normal space, enabling a unified, data-driven health-status score defined by deviations from referent intervals, which also provides an AI-oriented criterion to assess strategy quality and supports RL termination. We further design a structured 23-dimensional state representation that integrates 19 indicators with 4 RRT descriptors, and employ matrix decomposition to reconstruct missing vital signs, improving data completeness for learning. These components are incorporated into multiple offline RL algorithms and validated via systematic ablation studies on RRT feature subsets. items.authors: Jiang Liu, Chan Zhou, Yujie Li, Di Wu, Yihao Xie, Peiwei Li, Xin Shu, Jiaqi Zhu, Chunyong Yang, Yuwen Chen, Bin Yi

items.title: Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting
items.title_zh: 多时间尺度喀斯特含水层预测的机器学习方法研究
items.summary_zh: 喀斯特含水层动态预测困难，因为补给响应是非线性、事件驱动且受强异质流动路径影响。本研究开发并评估了一个部署感知框架，用于预测德克萨斯州爱德华兹含水层的泉水流量和地下水位，预测范围为1至12周，基于约79年的水文气候观测数据。比较了五种模型家族：极端梯度提升、极端随机树、长短期记忆网络、卷积神经网络和变换器。评估指标包括决定系数、Kling-Gupta效率、均方根误差及与干旱阈值的一致性。结果显示，极端梯度提升模型在1-4周、5-8周和9-12周的R²分别达到0.97、0.96和0.94，并在所有时间范围内的前三个干旱阶段中达成90%以上的一致性。深度模型在短期内表现竞争，但在较长预测期内逐渐退化并出现孤立失败。我们将这一对比归因于树分割与低维、轴对齐的水文气候预测因子的对齐，以及神经模型平滑不规则极值的倾向。经过验证的模型嵌入了一个五代理的操作框架中。
items.abstract: Forecasting karst aquifer dynamics is difficult because recharge responses are nonlinear, event-driven, and governed by strongly heterogeneous flow paths. This study develops and evaluates a deployment-aware framework for 1-12-week-ahead prediction of spring discharge and groundwater level using approximately 79 years of hydroclimatic observations from the Edwards Aquifer, Texas. Five model families were compared under a common temporal evaluation design: extreme gradient boosting, extremely randomized trees, long short-term memory, convolutional neural networks, and Transformers. Predictions were evaluated using coefficient of determination, Kling-Gupta efficiency, root-mean-square error, and agreement with operational drought thresholds. Extreme gradient boosting was consistently most reliable, with R2 at least 0.97, 0.96, and 0.94 across 1-4-, 5-8-, and 9-12-week horizons, respectively, and greater than 90% critical-stage agreement at the first three drought stages across all horizons. Deep models were competitive at short horizons but degraded progressively and exhibited isolated failures at longer lead times. We attribute this contrast to an alignment between tree partitioning
items.authors: Pramod Lekhak, Chetan Sharma, Hakan Ba\c{s}a\u{g}ao\u{g}lu, F. Paul Bertetti, Debaditya Chakraborty

items.title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures for Predictive Maintenance in Industry 4.0
items.title_zh: 工业4.0预测性维护的混合深度学习架构基准测试
items.summary_zh: 工业4.0中的预测性维护利用传感器、机器和生产系统的数据来估计设备故障的可能时间，以便在故障发生前进行维护。然而，实验室中的预测模型在实际工厂数据中可能会失效。为了解决这一“可靠性”差距，我们评估了六种深度学习架构，进行了超过700次实验。我们关注了两种主流方法：逐步处理数据的递归神经网络（RNN）和同时查看整个序列的Transformer。研究发现，尽管Transformer在跟踪稳定、缓慢变化的过程方面表现优异，但在面对混乱数据时容易过度反应，将传感器噪声误认为有意义的信号。我们还发现，结合长短期记忆（LSTM）层和Transformer层的混合方法对工厂噪声数据更具韧性，LSTM作为噪声过滤器，平滑数据波动，使Transformer能够专注于全局信息。
items.abstract: Predictive maintenance in Industry 4.0 refers to using data from sensors, machines, and production systems to estimate when equipment is likely to fail, so maintenance can be planned before a breakdown occurs [1]. However, a model that predicts maintenance may work perfectly in the lab but fail unexpectedly when applied to real factory data [2]. To solve this "reliability" gap, we evaluated six deep learning architectures across more than 700 experimental runs. We focused on the two dominant approaches in the field: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), which process data step-by-step, like reading a sentence [3], and Transformers, a recent dominant approach, which look at the entire sequence at once to spot important connections [4]. We examined whether Transformers still outperform recurrent neural networks (RNNs) when the data includes noise [5]. We found that while Transformers excelled at tracking stable, slow-moving processes, they tend to overreact to chaotic data, mistakenly taking sensor noise for meaningful signals [6]. We also found that the hybrid method that combines a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layer with a Transformer layer is more resilient to noisy data from factory
items.authors: Zhengyang (Cissy), Gu, Joseph E. Hernandez, Thomas Cook, John Burtenshaw, Sean Scott, Chris Couch

items.title: CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning
items.title_zh: CTRL：基于控制的时间序列预测与LLM引导的残差学习
items.summary_zh: 时间序列预测在各个领域的关键决策中至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出良好的推理能力，但现有的基于LLM的时间序列预测方法要么将其简化为忽视其优势的数值预测器，要么允许直接生成预测，这在非平稳环境中会导致预测不稳定。我们提出了CTRL，一个将语义推理与定量预测解耦的框架。冻结的主干网络生成基础预测，而专门的LLM代理作为控制器，通过分解的趋势、季节性和不规则成分分析主干预测误差，将推理基于可解释的时间结构。每个代理输出紧凑的控制信号，轻量级残差解码器将其转化为预测修正。CTRL还结合了无标签的测试时适应，能够仅通过输入统计检测分布变化，并通过缓存仅需3-24次LLM调用重新调整控制信号。CTRL明确设计用于提高在非平稳时间动态和分布变化下的鲁棒性，同时在高度平稳的时间序列上保持竞争力。
items.abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3-24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series whe
items.authors: Minkyoung Kim, Daeun Ji, Yohan Lee, Beomsoo Kim, Beakcheol Jang

items.title: Real-time Generalizable Heart Valve Mechanics for Clinical Disease Assessment via a Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator
items.title_zh: 实时通用心脏瓣膜力学用于临床疾病评估的物理条件神经算子
items.summary_zh: 二尖瓣反流是全球最常见的心脏瓣膜疾病，影响超过2%的人口，75岁以上成年人中这一比例上升至至少10%，并导致约15%的瓣膜性心脏病相关死亡。然而，只有少数重症患者接受纠正手术。快速评估瓣膜力学可实现更早、更精确的干预，但传统有限元模拟在临床时间框架和参数扫描中仍然过于缓慢。我们提出了物理条件神经算子（PCNO），这是一种基于变换器的替代模型，能够预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣几何形状下的瓣膜位移、应变和应力场，基于收缩期血压和组织特性进行条件化。PCNO在功能性、反流性和病理性瓣膜（包括系带、P2脱垂和环扩张）上训练，速度比细网格有限元模拟快达15,260倍，且精度相当，能够识别病理类别，并在分布外外推下将诊断指标的误差控制在3.5%以内。
items.abstract: Mitral regurgitation is the most common heart valve disorder worldwide, affecting over 2% of the global population, rising to at least 10% in adults over 75, and causing approximately 15% of valvular heart disease-related deaths. Yet only a minority of patients with severe disease undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but traditional finite element simulations remain too slow for clinical timelines and parameter sweeps. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based surrogate that predicts leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields across mitral and tricuspid geometries, conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. Trained on functional, regurgitated, and pathological valves, including tethering, P2 prolapse, and annular dilation, PCNO achieves up to a 15,260x speedup over fine mesh finite element simulations with comparable accuracy, identifies pathology class, and resolves diagnostic metrics within 3.5% error under out-of-distribution extrapolation.
items.authors: Shawn Koohy, Wensi Wu, Matthew A Jolley, Paris Perdikaris

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Inspired Black-box Adversarial Attacks for Computer Vision
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的黑箱对抗攻击在计算机视觉中的应用
items.summary_zh: 神经网络（包括卷积网络和变换器）是现代计算机视觉系统的核心，但它们对微小扰动高度敏感，这些扰动对人类几乎不可察觉，却能显著改变模型预测。这些对抗攻击被认为对安全关键应用中的神经网络构成重大威胁。大多数攻击采用白箱威胁模型，需完全访问目标模型，实际应用中不够现实。我们提出了一种新方法，在更现实的黑箱威胁模型下，利用强化学习的概念优化扰动。强化学习算法已优化为查询高效，成为设计黑箱对抗攻击的理想起点。通过与Cifar10和ImageNet数据集上最先进攻击的比较，我们展示了基于强化学习的黑箱对抗攻击（RIBA）在仅用少量查询生成对抗扰动方面的成功。RIBA在Cifar10上生成攻击图像所需的中位查询数比ResNet-18少25.4%，在ImageNet上欺骗Vit-B/16模型所需的中位查询数少22.5%。
items.abstract: Neural networks, both convolution or transformer based, are essential for modern computer vision systems. However, they are vulnerable to small perturbations, almost imperceptible to humans, which significantly alter the model's prediction. These adversarial attacks are often considered to be a significant threat to the implementation of neural networks in safety-critical applications. Most attacks utilize the white-box threat model and therefore require full access to the target model, making them unrealistic to use in practice. We propose a novel approach under the more realistic black-box threat model that utilizes concepts from reinforcement learning to optimize perturbations with a non-differentiable target model. Reinforcement learning algorithms have already been optimized to be query efficient, making them an ideal starting point when designing black-box adversarial attacks. We show the success of our reinforcement learning inspired black-box adversarial attack (RIBA) in generating adversarial perturbations using only a small number of queries to the target model, by comparing it to state of the art attacks on different models on the Cifar10 and ImageNet data sets. items.authors: Florian Krone, Elena Hoemann, Sven Hallerbach

items.title: MemCalib: Benchmarking and Optimizing Memory Use in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: MemCalib：大语言模型代理的内存使用基准与优化
items.summary_zh: 代理内存的有效性取决于基础大语言模型（LLM）对上下文中每个记忆的影响程度。为评估这一能力，我们提出了MemCalib，一个基于现实内存系统场景的基准，用于评估内存使用和优化算法。MemCalib测试集的结果显示，前沿的开源和闭源模型在内存使用上存在问题，常常过度或不足使用内存，导致偏见和低质量的响应。通过常见的后训练算法实验，发现训练模型在某一方向上改进而在另一方向上恶化。为此，我们提出了MemCalib-RL，一种有序的双向反事实信用分配算法，能够分离过度和不足使用信号，并通过精确的原子消融将其信用定位到响应标记上。不同模型（Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）显示，MemCalib-RL在整体性能上最佳，同时更好地平衡了过度和不足使用，并在外部基准中获得了广泛的提升。
items.abstract: The effectiveness of agent memory ultimately depends on whether the underlying LLM gives each memory in context an appropriate degree of influence over its response. Yet this capability has remained largely overlooked. To assess this capability, we introduce MemCalib, a benchmark grounded in realistic memory-system scenarios for evaluating memory use and advancing optimization algorithms. Results on the MemCalib test set reveal that frontier open- and closed-source models struggle to use memory appropriately. They frequently over-use or under-use memory rather than matching each proposition's actual use to its target level, leading to biased, low-quality responses. Experiments with common post-training algorithms, including group relative policy optimization and on-policy self-distillation, further reveal a clear directional skew: trained models improve in one direction while deteriorating in the other. We therefore propose MemCalib-RL, an ordered bidirectional counterfactual credit-assignment algorithm that separates over- and under-use signals and localizes their credit to response tokens through exact atom ablation. items.title: RAILS: Retrieval-Augmented Incremental LLM Clustering at Scale
items.title_zh: RAILS：大规模增量LLM聚类的检索增强方法
items.summary_zh: 在生产规模上使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行聚类面临挑战：提示无法涵盖整个标签空间，逐文档串行处理无法满足实际工作负载的吞吐量需求。我们提出了RAILS，一种检索增强的增量LLM聚类器，将聚类转变为对不断增长的标签池的简单循环，并通过有界并发实现文档批处理扩展。在六个公共基准测试中，RAILS的表现超过了以往最强的LLM聚类方法，平均准确率从51.2%提升至59.3%，NMI从67.2%提升至74.8%，ARI从45.4%提升至54.7%。此外，我们还报告了来自SaaS工单主题发现管道的生产部署证据，RAILS取代了传统的HDBSCAN阶段，提供了更高的聚类质量、透明的提示驱动控制和有状态的增量操作。
items.abstract: Using a Large Language Model (LLM) as the clusterer at production scale is hard: prompts cannot hold the entire label space, and per-document serial processing does not deliver the throughput real workloads require. We present RAILS, a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that turns clustering into a simple loop over a growing label pool and scales through document batching with bounded concurrency. On six public benchmarks RAILS exceeds the strongest prior LLM-clustering method on average, lifting accuracy from 51.2% to 59.3%, NMI from 67.2% to 74.8%, and ARI from 45.4% to 54.7%. We further report production-deployment evidence from a SaaS ticket-topic-discovery pipeline, where RAILS has replaced a traditional HDBSCAN stage with higher clustering quality, transparent prompt-driven control, and stateful incremental operation.
items.authors: Armin Oliya, Aleksandra Sawczuk, Rados{\l}aw Bia{\l}obrzeski

items.title: Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations
items.title_zh: 基于角色的LLM模拟增强假设检验方法
items.summary_zh: A/B测试通常需要大样本、长时间和高成本。当机器学习模型提供实验结果的辅助预测时，尽管预测质量不确定，仍无法完全替代人类实验，但这些预测可能包含有用信号。我们提出了一种学习增强的假设检验框架，利用未知质量的预测来减少样本量，同时保持统计有效性。该框架涵盖了不同粒度的预测：对于仅提供处理效应符号的群体级方向性预测，我们使用不对称检验，并在学习增强算法范式下证明了一致性和稳健性界限；对于个体级预测，我们引入了广义PPI++（GPPI），扩展了预测驱动推断以处理非线性预测误差。两种方法在准确预测的基础上，仍对不准确或对抗性预测保持稳健性。我们通过基于角色的LLM模拟验证了该框架，AI代理利用用户角色预测个体行为，成为一种自然的预测来源。
items.abstract: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. items.authors: Ziyad Benomar, Aymen Al Marjani, Paul Missault, Saab Mansour

items.title: A Federated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Optimizing Pancreatic Cancer Treatment - Strategy Update
items.title_zh: 优化胰腺癌治疗的联邦人工智能框架 - 策略更新
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在胰腺癌治疗中应用联邦学习（FL）架构的可行性。尽管集中式方法在数据质量和预测性能上理论上最佳，但在实践中并不总是可行。我们在之前的案例报告中描述了参与站点的前提条件及准备数据、人员和基础设施的必要步骤。此次更新分享了我们在应对挑战中的经验，并展示了实际联邦学习AI管道的初步结果。参与站点需在本地FL中心提取和转换后识别和注释可访问数据。我们应用了一种新开发的FL算法，考虑所有本地特征，包括特定于本地站点的部分重叠特征。理论上，癌症环境中的注释应利用德国肿瘤核心数据集（oBDS），该数据集已用于癌症登记的强制报告。
items.abstract: While a centralized approach involving patient consent to collect and analyze data centrally would theoretically offer the best data quality and predictive performance, it is not always feasible in practice. Federated Learning (FL) architectures have shown to be a very promising approach to use and access distributed disease related resources within the GDPR boundaries. In a previous case report, we described the preconditions at the participating sites and necessary administrative and process related steps to prepare data, people and infrastructure for improving subtype identification and assessing treatment options in pancreatic cancer. We update this report sharing our experience in tackling the challenges and show preliminary results of the actual federated learning AI pipelines. At the participating sites, we have to identify and annotate the data being accessible after extraction and transformation in a local FL hub - in our case a centrally developed and distributively deployed Docker container. items.title: LoRA-generating hypernetworks for efficient on-device LLM generative personalization
items.title_zh: 高效设备端LLM个性化的LoRA生成超网络
items.summary_zh: 设备端的大型语言模型（LLMs），如在手机上运行，适合通过个性化进行改进。移动设备的计算资源有限，限制了模型规模和质量，因此任何可实现的质量提升都具有重要意义。同时，LLM的个人化特性使得其使用模式在时间上趋于相似和可预测。本文提出了一种新方法，通过训练超网络将用户的上下文标记映射到适合该用户的低秩适应（LoRA）。一旦训练好的通用模型部署到用户设备上，每个用户便可利用超网络在设备上合成个性化的LoRA。该方法结合了现有LLM定制方法的优点，避免了它们的缺点，具备计算可行性，仅需前向传播，并通过权重修改目标基础LLM，避免了延长输入序列带来的负面影响。该方法特别适合移动设备。
items.abstract: On-device large language models (`LLMs'), e.g. running on mobile phones, are ripe for improvement via personalization. The limited compute resources of mobile devices impose limits on model scale and thus model quality, making any realizable quality gains highly impactful. At the same time, their personal nature (i.e., the close coupling to a particular user) means that a given on-device LLM tends to be used in similar, predictable patterns over the course of time. This paper presents a novel method for personalizing on-device LLMs. It trains a hypernetwork to map a user's context tokens to a low-rank adaptation (`LoRA') well-suited to that user. Once the trained common artifacts are deployed to users' devices, each user uses the hypernetwork to synthesize (entirely on device) a personalized LoRA. This approach blends the benefits while avoiding the drawbacks of two existing approaches to LLM customization: in-context learning (`ICL') and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (`PEFT'). Like ICL (and unlike PEFT), the on-device phase of our approach is computationally feasible, requiring only forward passes through neural networks. Like PEFT (and unlike ICL), our approach modifies the `ta
items.authors: Sean Augenstein, Li Ding, Jihwan Lee, Keith Rush, Andrey Zhmoginov

items.title: Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 代码的标记特征：比较大型语言模型的编码行为
items.summary_zh: 对大型语言模型（LLMs）在编码任务上的评估主要集中在性能指标如pass@k上。随着LLMs的不断进步，许多模型已达到基准性能要求，单纯依赖性能评估的区分能力降低。然而，一个关键问题仍未得到充分探讨：LLMs在编码行为上有何不同？我们提出了CLIC（代码学习用于识别和比较），一种通过标记频率分析来表征LLM编码行为的可视化分析方法。CLIC将每个代码样本表示为标记频率的特征向量，并训练一个可解释的决策树以区分两个LLM的代码集。除了分类准确性外，我们定义了两个新指标：鲁棒性和集中度，前者衡量在逐步移除最具区分性的标记时两个LLM是否仍可区分，后者衡量差异是由少数主导标记驱动还是分布在多个标记上。通过对多个成对比较的解释，形成一种多尺度、假设驱动的探索任务。我们因此开发了一个交互式可视化分析系统，以导航比较领域，识别感兴趣的对，并深入分析区分性标记及其代码上下文。
items.abstract: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. items.authors: Junpeng Wang, Yuzhong Chen, Menghai Pan, Uday Singh Saini, Yiwei Cai

items.title: Using Composition Operators to Linearize LLM Semantic Transformations
items.title_zh: 利用组合算子线性化大语言模型的语义变换
items.summary_zh: 机器学习学习函数：从提示到响应，从图像到标题。这些函数在数学上仍然难以明确。我们提出了一种使用动力系统技术近似这些变换的方法，这些技术属于库普曼主义的范畴。我们引入了组合算子的使用，它推广了库普曼算子，并且能够在不同空间之间映射，这一观点促使我们认为大语言模型的变换是矩形无限维算子。这一形式化揭示了有用的结构：在对提示和响应分布的自然假设下，大语言模型算子是一个等距算子，而学习表示之间的不对齐表现为其有限部分的谱污染。我们随后概述了一种构建大语言模型算子的有限维近似的方法，并展示了如何利用奇异值谱来比较任务和模型。
items.abstract: Machine learning learns functions: prompt to response, image to caption. What these functions are mathematically remains hard to say. We present a method to approximate these kinds of transformations using techniques from dynamical systems that fall under the umbrella of Koopmanism. We introduce the use of composition operators, which generalize the Koopman operator and, crucially, can map between distinct spaces, motivating the perspective that LLM transformations are rectangular infinite-dimensional operators. This formalism reveals useful structure: under natural assumptions on the prompt and response distributions, the LLM operator is an isometry, and misalignment between learned representations manifests as spectral pollution of its finite sections. We then outline a method of constructing finite-dimensional approximations of an LLM operator, and demonstrate how the singular value spectrum can be used to compare tasks and models.
items.authors: Afjal Chowdhury, James Chen, Alan Edelman

items.title: Fairness Beyond Anonymization? Demographic Leakage in German LLM-Generated Resumes
items.title_zh: 超越匿名化的公平性？德国LLM生成简历中的人口统计信息泄露
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被整合到AI辅助招聘流程中，包括自动生成和筛选简历。在欧盟人工智能法案下，招聘领域被分类为高风险，因此公平性和透明度成为关键要求。本研究对德国语言LLM生成的简历进行了两阶段审计。首先，我们使用ChatGPT（GPT-4o-mini）、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite和多个开放权重的Qwen 3模型（4B、8B和14B）从真实的匿名求职匹配档案生成简历，系统性地改变与性别和种族相关的名字，同时保持资格不变。其次，我们模拟了一个下游简历筛选场景，生成的简历首先被匿名化和性别中立化，然后在结果文本上训练人口统计信息泄露分类器。结果发现，尽管进行了这些干预，分类器仍能可靠地区分使用男性和女性名字生成的简历。这种泄露并非由明显的性别化用词驱动，而是由德语中语义等价、形式上性别中立的术语使用的微妙差异造成。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into AI-assisted hiring pipelines, including automated resume generation and screening. Under the EU AI Act, the hiring domain is classified as high-risk, making fairness and transparency critical requirements. Existing work has primarily focused on explicit hiring decisions, while less attention has been paid to whether generated resumes themselves encode recoverable demographic information. In this work, we conduct a two-stage audit of demographic leakage in German-language LLM-generated resumes. First, we use ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and multiple scales of the open-weight Qwen 3 model family (4B, 8B, and 14B) to generate resumes from real anonymized job-matching profiles, systematically varying gender- and ethnicity-associated names while holding qualifications constant. Second, we simulate a downstream resume screening scenario, where the generated resumes are first anonymized and gender-neutralized, before demographic leakage classifiers are trained on the resulting texts. We find that, despite these interventions, classifiers reliably distinguish between resumes generated with male and female names.
items.authors: Charlotte Leininger, Helena Veit, Matthias A{\ss}enmacher, Andreas Bender

items.title: Clinical Domain Classification from Medical Transcriptions
items.title_zh: 医学转录文本的临床领域分类研究
items.summary_zh: 临床领域分类在组织和分析大量非结构化医学文本中具有重要作用。然而，医学转录数据集通常存在严重的不平衡，这会显著降低分类性能，尤其是对代表性不足的临床专业。本文比较了传统机器学习和基于变换器的方法在医学转录文本中的临床领域分类效果。我们评估了六种传统机器学习分类器——朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机（SVM）、决策树、随机森林、K近邻（KNN）和XGBoost，以及两个预训练的变换器模型BERT和XLNet，以及一种少量示例的大语言模型提示方法。实验数据来自MTSamples，共包含5,013个样本，涵盖40个临床专业。为解决严重的类别不平衡问题，我们探讨了两种平衡策略：基于NLP的同义词替换文本增强和合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）。实验结果表明，数据平衡显著提高了各模型的分类性能，特别是BERT在SMOTE平衡数据集上达到了0.996的最高F1分数，同时训练时间低于XLNet。
items.abstract: Clinical domain classification plays an important role in organizing and analyzing large volumes of unstructured medical text. However, medical transcription datasets are often highly imbalanced, which can substantially degrade classification performance, particularly for underrepresented clinical specialties. In this work, we present a comparative study of machine learning and transformer-based approaches for clinical domain classification from medical transcriptions. We evaluate six traditional machine learning classifiers---Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost---along with two pretrained transformer models, BERT and XLNet, and a few-shot large language model prompting approach. Experiments are conducted on medical transcription data collected from MTSamples, comprising 5,013 samples across 40 clinical specialties. To address severe class imbalance, we investigate two balancing strategies: text augmentation using NLP-based synonym replacement and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Experimental results demonstrate that data balancing substantially improves classification performance across
items.authors: Sravani Pottipati, Lakshmikar R. Polamreddy

items.title: Measured Joules, Learned Routes: Learning to Route for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 测量焦耳与学习路径：为节能高效的LLM服务学习路由
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和自主AI系统随着模型规模的扩大和推理轨迹的延伸，正迅速增加推理能耗。许多查询并不需要最大模型的能力，频繁将这些查询指向高能力模型会导致不必要的计算和能耗。本文探讨了在异构LLM池中自适应路由是否能在不显著影响任务性能的情况下减少能耗。我们设计了一种基于语言模型的路由器，读取每个查询并从固定候选池中选择答案模型。候选模型通过离线比赛进行性能评估，记录其正确性、延迟、功耗和GPU能量。利用这些测量数据，路由器通过监督微调和相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练。结果表明，学习路由能够根据查询上下文选择性地分配昂贵的模型容量，并改善多LLM服务中的准确性与能耗权衡。在七个基准任务中，我们观察到路由器之间的准确性-能耗相位转变，为在保持LLM性能的同时提高能效提供了实用见解。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems are creating rapidly growing inference energy demands as model sizes grow and reasoning trajectories extend. While in practice, many queries do not require the capabilities of the largest available model, and routinely directing such queries to a high-capability model can introduce unnecessary, considerable computation and energy consumption. In this paper, we investigate whether adaptive routing across a heterogeneous pool of LLMs can reduce this energy burden without substantially compromising task performance. We design a language-model-based router that reads in each query and selects an answer model from a fixed candidate pool. The candidate models are first profiled through an offline tournament that records their correctness, latency, power, and GPU energy for each query. Using these measurements, the router is trained through supervised fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with the tailored paradigms. Results demonstrate that learned routing can selectively allocate expensive model capacity based on query context and improve the accuracy-energy tradeoff in multi-LLM serving. Across seven benchm
items.authors: Muhammad Abdur Rab Siddiqui, Daniela Rojas, Chen Yang, Wenqi Cui, Yuanyuan Shi, Yize Chen

items.title: An LLM-Assisted AutoML Framework for Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks
items.title_zh: 基于LLM的自动化机器学习框架用于物联网入侵检测
items.summary_zh: 物联网（IoT）系统在智能家居、交通、能源系统和关键基础设施中得到广泛应用，尽管这种广泛连接提升了服务智能，但也扩大了IoT网络的攻击面。基于机器学习（ML）的入侵检测系统（IDS）被广泛用于识别恶意网络威胁并保护IoT系统，但开发有效的ML模型通常需要人类专家的参与和多次手动决策，包括数据预处理、特征选择、模型选择和超参数调优。自动化机器学习（AutoML）通过优化技术自动化ML流程的步骤，减轻了这一负担，但传统的AutoML方法可能消耗大量优化时间。本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AutoML框架，用于IoT入侵检测。该框架利用LLM作为策略生成器，将数据集配置转化为有界且经过验证的AutoML策略，实现自动数据平衡、特征工程和算法选择与超参数优化（CASH）。在相同的10次试验预算下，所提LLM辅助策略的加权测试F1-score优于传统AutoML方法。
items.abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems are increasingly deployed in smart homes, transportation, energy systems, and critical infrastructure. This broad connectivity improves service intelligence, but also enlarges the attack surface of IoT networks. Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are widely used to identify malicious network threats and protect IoT systems, but developing effective ML-based IDS models often requires human expertise and repeated manual decisions on many procedures, including data pre-processing, feature selection, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) reduces this burden by automating steps of the ML pipeline using optimization techniques, but conventional AutoML methods can consume substantial optimization time because they explore broad candidate model families and large hyperparameter spaces. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted AutoML framework for IoT intrusion detection. The proposed framework uses an LLM as a policy generator that converts dataset profiles into bounded and validated AutoML policies for automated data balancing, automated feature engineering, and Combined
items.authors: Li Yang

items.title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
items.title_zh: UniK：数字与物理AI的通用知识感知
items.summary_zh: 两类变革性的AI系统正在重塑组织运作：\textit{数字AI}，通过企业知识驱动聊天机器人和代理工作流；以及\textit{物理AI}，从视频、游戏和传感器数据中学习控制机器人和自主系统。两者面临相同的基础瓶颈：大规模的原始知识，跨越异构模态，锁定在现有AI基础设施无法可靠或高效访问的私有数据集中。我们提出\textit{通用知识感知（UniK）}作为这两类系统的共同平台，涵盖知识生命周期的各个环节（摄取、丰富、索引、检索和持续评估），支持从丰富文本和视频到分子数据和传感器数据的多种模态。UniK基于多索引融合的Polymath Retrieval构建，无需特定任务的微调。在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域问答、化学、法律视频程序和政府开放数据）中，UniK结合一个开源的700亿参数模型，始终与或超越规模更大的前沿专有LLM的表现：在政府数据上，RAG准确率为76\%，而GPT-5为47\%；医学问答的准确率为77.9\%，且无需微调；在所有开源化学管道中表现最佳。
items.abstract: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are order
items.authors: Nirmit Desai, Kunal Sawarkar, Aditya Mahakali, Dongkon Lee, Kevin Park, Eric Song

items.title: Topographic Training Concentrates Causal Circuits Without Improving Neuron Monosemanticity
items.title_zh: 拓扑训练集中因果电路但不改善神经元单义性
items.summary_zh: 视觉变换器的机制可解释性旨在将模型计算分解为人类可读的单元，但学习到的表示在每个神经元中纠缠了多个概念。特征叠加被广泛视为这一分解的主要障碍，然而大多数缓解措施（稀疏自编码器、字典学习）是事后处理，并未改变底层网络。我们探讨了一种空间局部性训练损失（TopoLoss）是否可以作为轻量级的训练时先验，改善标准机制可解释工具的可解释性。在ImageNet-100上训练ViT，使用不同的TopoLoss权重$\alpha$，通过激活修补测量拓扑聚类的因果充分性，并通过适应同一残差流的稀疏自编码器测量特征几何。在$\alpha=1.0$时，拓扑聚类的因果充分性比随机单元集高2.79倍，且随着$\alpha$的增加而单调增加。SAE L0稀疏性下降11%，而无效特征比例上升19倍，但标准神经元级单义性评分未变化，表明拓扑压力在电路层面作用，将因果质量集中到空间局部结构中，而未解开单个神经元。这一解离表明当前神经元级单义性指标对真实可解释性提升的某类变化不敏感。
items.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights $\alpha$, we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At $\alpha=1.0$, topographic clusters are 2.79$\times$ more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in $\alpha$. SAE L0 sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially l
items.authors: Gautam Ranka, Shubham Santosh Pandere, Aiden Dsouza

items.title: Label Propagation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Physics-Informed Gaussian Processes
items.title_zh: 基于标签传播的物理信息神经网络与高斯过程研究
items.summary_zh: 本文展示了半监督标签传播技术在训练物理信息机器学习方法中的一系列实证结果。研究包括物理信息神经网络和物理信息高斯过程的自我训练，以及通过共同训练将两者整合，从而建立这两类物理信息机器学习的混合模型。通过大量数值实验，我们展示了这些方法如何改善从边界向物理域传播信息的问题，包括在求解刚性时变偏微分方程时从初始条件传播信息的能力，这被认为是物理信息机器学习的常见失败模式。
items.abstract: We present a series of empirical results of the application of semi-supervised label propagation techniques in training physics-informed machine learning methods. This includes self-training of physics-informed neural networks and physics-informed Gaussian processes in isolation, and the integration of the two via co-training, therefore establishing a hybrid between these two main classes of physics-informed machine learning. We demonstrate via extensive numerical experiments how these methods can ameliorate the issue of propagating information from boundaries into the physical domain, including information from initial conditions in the case of solving stiff time-dependent partial differential equations, which is known to be a common failure mode of physics-informed machine learning.
items.authors: Ming Zhong, Dehao Liu, Raymundo Arroyave, Ulisses Braga-Neto

items.title: Memento No More: Coaching AI Agents to Master Multiple Tasks via Hints Internalization
items.title_zh: 不再是记忆：通过提示内化训练AI代理掌握多任务
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）代理的通用能力不断发展，如何通过经验学习掌握多项复杂任务仍然是一个关键挑战。目前的语言模型（LLM）代理，尤其是基于专有语言模型的，通常依赖提示来整合目标任务的知识。这种方法无法让代理内化信息，反而需要不断扩展提示以维持其在多样场景中的功能。本文提出了一种新方法，训练AI代理在无需繁琐的笔记系统或高质量示范数据的情况下，整合多任务的知识和技能。我们的方法采用迭代过程，代理收集新经验，接受人类以提示形式的纠正反馈，并通过上下文蒸馏训练程序将反馈整合到权重中。我们在基于Llama-3的代理中实施该方法，结果显示在仅经过几轮反馈后，其在信息检索、工具使用和问答等任务集中的表现超过了先进模型GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3。
items.abstract: As the general capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) agents continue to evolve, their ability to learn to master multiple complex tasks through experience remains a key challenge. Current LLM agents, particularly those based on proprietary language models, typically rely on prompts to incorporate knowledge about the target tasks. This approach does not allow the agent to internalize this information and instead relies on ever-expanding prompts to sustain its functionality in diverse scenarios. This resembles a system of notes used by a person affected by anterograde amnesia, the inability to form new memories. In this paper, we propose a novel method to train AI agents to incorporate knowledge and skills for multiple tasks without the need for either cumbersome note systems or prior high-quality demonstration data. Our approach employs an iterative process where the agent collects new experiences, receives corrective feedback from humans in the form of hints, and integrates this feedback into its weights via a context distillation training procedure. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach by implementing it in a Llama-3-based agent that, after only a few rounds of feedb
items.authors: Minttu Alakuijala, Ya Gao, Georgy Ananov, Samuel Kaski, Pekka Marttinen, Alexander Ilin, Harri Valpola

items.title: Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning
items.title_zh: 分形盆地几何与深度学习中的可预测性与可重复性限制
items.summary_zh: 可预测性的基本限制是我们理解许多物理和计算系统的核心。在深度学习中，训练结果的可预测性和可重复性极其困难，但其机制尚不明确。本文提出分形、孔洞盆地几何作为统一的动力系统机制：每个导致某一解决方案的初始化都与导致不同解决方案的初始化非常接近，形成一个在任意细尺度上具有结构的肥厚分形。通过一个最小神经网络模型，我们分析性地建立了经典的孔洞机制，并推导出接近零的不确定性指数：即使初始化精度显著提高，结果的可预测性也仅有微小提升。在深度网络中，交织的训练目标和接近零的参数空间指数提供了与孔洞现象一致的强有力特征，适用于不同架构、优化器和训练协议。我们进一步引入功能不确定性指数，将这些对规模无关的不可重复性的诊断从参数空间扩展到学习的函数本身。我们的结果支持分形盆地几何作为深度学习中不可重复性的潜在组织原则。
items.abstract: Fundamental limits to predictability are central to our understanding of many physical and computational systems. In deep learning, training outcomes are notoriously difficult to predict and reproduce, yet the mechanism underlying these difficulties has remained unclear. Here we propose fractal, riddled basin geometry as a unifying dynamical-systems mechanism: every initialization leading to one solution lies arbitrarily close to initializations leading to different solutions, forming a fat fractal with structure at arbitrarily fine scales. Using a minimal neural network model, we analytically establish the classical route to riddling and derive a near-zero uncertainty exponent: even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome predictability. In deep networks, intertwined training destinations and near-zero parameter-space exponents provide robust signatures consistent with riddling across tested architectures, optimizers and training protocols, offering a common dynamical account of otherwise disparate empirical observations. We further introduce functional uncertainty exponents, which extend these diagnostics of scale-insensitive irreproducibi
items.authors: Andrew Ly, Pulin Gong

items.title: Towards Training-free Automatic Proxy Discovery via Large Language Models for Mixed Precision Quantization
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的无训练自动代理发现用于混合精度量化
items.summary_zh: 混合精度量化（MPQ）使深度神经网络（DNN）摆脱了内存瓶颈，受到越来越多的研究关注。传统方法依赖于昂贵的可微优化搜索，效率低且灵活性差，或需人工设计代理（如HAWQ），劳动强度大且需广泛的专家知识。本文提出了一种新颖的大语言模型（LLM）驱动的无训练自动代理发现框架（称为TAP），旨在无需人类专家或训练即可设计代理。该框架利用LLM和进化搜索策略自动寻找适合MPQ的优越TAP。此外，我们引入了一种轻量级的基于直接偏好优化（DPO）的策略控制器，根据适应信号动态调整三种提示模板的选择概率，形成任务感知的反馈循环，提升代理生成效果。大量实验表明，TAP在主流基准上达到了最先进的性能。
items.abstract: Mixed-Precision Quantization (MPQ) liberates Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) from the Out-Of-Memory (OOM) bottleneck and has garnered increasing research attention. However, conventional methods either rely on costly differentiable optimization search, which is neither efficient nor flexible, or learn a quantized DNN from a proxy (e.g., HAWQ) manually designed by human experts, which is labor-intensive and requires extensive expert knowledge. Can we design a proxy without involving any human experts or training? In this paper, we provide an affirmative answer by proposing a novel Large Language Model (LLM)-driven Training-free Automatic Proxy (dubbed TAP) discovery framework. It reforms the design paradigm of MPQ by utilizing LLMs and evolutionary search strategies to automatically find superior TAP tailored for MPQ. In addition, to bridge the gap between black-box LLMs and the challenging MPQ task, we introduce a lightweight Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-based strategy controller that dynamically reweights the selection probabilities of the three prompt templates for evolutionary search strategies according to fitness signals, without fine-tuning the LLM. This forms a task-awar
items.authors: Haidong Kang, Jun Du, Guo Yu

items.title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Simulating Context-Aware Disease Trajectories
items.title_zh: CLARITY：基于医学世界模型的治疗决策指导
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤学中的临床决策需要预测疾病在治疗下的演变，但大多数人工智能系统仍是静态预测器，无法模拟长期、治疗条件下的进展。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CLARITY，一个医学世界模型，能够进行治疗条件下疾病轨迹的反事实模拟。CLARITY通过联合编码影像衍生的潜在状态、捕捉不规则随访的时间间隔以及患者特定的临床背景，学习疾病进展的平滑和可解释表示，从而模拟替代治疗如何重塑未来的疾病动态。此外，我们提出了一种熵正则化的高效长远预测决策框架，规划治疗策略并通过生存感知反馈迭代优化治疗建议，形成闭环模拟到决策的过程。
items.abstract: Clinical decision-making in oncology requires forecasting how disease evolves under treatment, yet most AI systems remain static predictors that cannot model longitudinal, treatment-conditioned progression. Although generative and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in general domains, their adaptation to medicine remains limited and insufficient for capturing complex, treatment-induced physiological dynamics across temporal scales. To address these gaps, we introduce CLARITY, a medical world model that enables counterfactual simulation of treatment-conditioned disease trajectories for clinical decision-making. By jointly encoding imaging-derived latent states, temporal intervals that capture irregular follow-ups, and patient-specific clinical context, CLARITY learns smooth and interpretable representations of disease progression, allowing the model to simulate how alternative treatments reshape future disease dynamics. Because treatment optimization is inherently sequential and uncertain, requiring evaluation of long-term outcomes across multiple possible interventions, we further propose an entropy-regularized, computationally efficient long-horizon prediction-to-d
items.authors: Tianxingjian Ding, Yuanhao Zou, Chen Chen, Mubarak Shah, Yu Tian

items.title: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 连接点滴：通过强化学习训练长生命周期代理的LLM
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种训练大型语言模型（LLMs）以实现“连接点滴”（CoD）能力的通用框架，该能力是长生命周期代理所需的元能力。LLM基础的AI代理在环境中部署后，能够解决一系列长期任务，同时不断探索环境，从自身经验中学习，并迭代更新其环境上下文，从而在未来任务中基于更新的上下文实现更好的表现。CoD框架的主要组成部分包括：1）针对长回合序列的端到端强化学习（RL）算法设计与基础设施；2）在训练过程中激励和引导LLMs获得目标元能力的任务与环境，以及在评估中准确测量进展的工具。我们展示了CoD框架的概念验证实现，包括具有细粒度信用分配的GRPO风格RL算法，以及针对目标元能力定制的任务与环境。Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.6-27B的实证结果验证了CoD设置中端到端RL训练的有效性，并展示了跨领域泛化的潜力。
items.abstract: This work presents a general framework for training large language models (LLMs) to "Connect the Dots" (CoD), a meta-capability required by long-lifecycle agents: as an LLM-based AI agent gets deployed in an environment, it solves a long sequence of tasks while continuously exploring the environment, learning from its own experiences, and iteratively self-updating its context about the environment, thereby achieving progressively better performance on future tasks conditioned on the updated context. Major components of the CoD framework include: (1) algorithm design and infrastructure for end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) with long rollout sequences interleaving solve-task and update-context episodes; (2) tasks and environments for incentivizing and eliciting the targeted meta-capability in LLMs during training, as well as for faithfully measuring progress during evaluation. We present proof-of-concept implementations of the CoD framework, including a GRPO-style RL algorithm with fine-grained credit assignment, as well as tasks and environments tailored to the targeted meta-capability (rather than domain-specific LLM capabilities or standard task-by-task RL). items.authors: Yanxi Chen, Weijie Shi, Boyi Hu, Zeyue Zhang, Zhiwei Wang, Yuexiang Xie, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou

items.title: D-TAIA: Domain-Aware LLM Adaptation for Multi-Task Predictive Process Monitoring
items.title_zh: D-TAIA：面向领域的LLM适应性多任务预测过程监控
items.summary_zh: 预测过程监控（PPM）使组织能够预测未来的过程行为，如下一活动和剩余时间。然而，数据稀缺、高过程熵和分布变化等三种条件导致现有方法性能下降。尽管基础模型（FMs），尤其是大型语言模型（LLMs），通过广泛的序列推理提供了新的范式，但在这些条件下将其适应于多任务PPM仍然是一个挑战。现有基于FM的方法要么缺乏处理分布变化的机制，要么依赖于与连续时间预测任务结构不匹配的直接回归头。本文提出了D-TAIA（面向领域的训练和基于注意力的推理架构），通过对FM骨干网进行参数高效的微调，实现下一活动和剩余时间的联合预测任务。我们的方法结合了领域感知三元组损失（DATL）预训练与基于FAISS的最近邻检索，并采用TAIA推理策略以保持微调过程中的预训练序列推理能力。在四个真实事件日志上的评估中，D-TAIA始终展现出与微调的LLM和递归神经网络基线相当或更优的性能。
items.abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) enables organizations to forecast future process behavior, such as the next activity and remaining time of ongoing cases. In practice, three conditions cause existing methods to degrade, namely data scarcity, high process entropy and distributional shift. While Foundation Models (FMs), especially Large Language Models (LLMs), offer a new paradigm through broad sequential reasoning, adapting them to multi-task PPM under these conditions remains an open challenge. Existing FM-based approaches either lack mechanisms for handling distributional shift or rely on direct regression heads that can be structurally misaligned with continuous time prediction tasks. This paper introduces D-TAIA (Domain-aware Training and Attention-based Inference Architecture), a framework for a joint next activity and remaining time prediction task via parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an FM backbone. Our approach combines domain-aware triplet loss (DATL) pre-training with FAISS-based nearest neighbor retrieval for remaining time prediction, and adopts the TAIA inference strategy to preserve pre-trained sequential reasoning during fine-tuning. items.authors: Sjoerd van Straten, Christine Jacob, Marwan Hassani

items.title: HumanAgencyBench: Scalable Evaluation of Human Agency Support in AI Assistants
items.title_zh: 人类代理基准：可扩展的AI助手人类代理支持评估
items.summary_zh: 随着人类将更多任务和决策委托给人工智能（AI），我们面临失去对个人和集体未来控制的风险。本文通过将哲学和科学的代理理论与AI辅助评估方法相结合，提出了人类代理的概念：利用大型语言模型（LLMs）模拟和验证用户查询，并评估AI响应。我们开发了人类代理基准（HAB），这是一个可扩展的诊断工具，评估与人类代理相关的六种行为。HAB测量AI助手在提出澄清问题、避免价值操控、纠正错误信息、推迟重要决策、鼓励学习和维护社会边界方面的倾向。我们发现当代基于LLM的助手在人类代理支持方面表现低至中等，且在系统开发者和行为之间存在显著差异。例如，尽管Anthropic LLM总体上最支持人类代理，但在避免价值操控方面却是支持最少的LLM。这些行为似乎并不总是源于LLM能力或遵循指令的提升（如RLHF）；我们鼓励进一步研究这些行为。
items.abstract: As humans delegate more tasks and decisions to artificial intelligence (AI), we risk losing control of our individual and collective futures. Relatively simple algorithmic systems already steer human decision-making, such as social media feed algorithms that lead people to unintentionally and absent-mindedly scroll through engagement-optimized content. In this paper, we develop the idea of human agency by integrating philosophical and scientific theories of agency with AI-assisted evaluation methods: using large language models (LLMs) to simulate and validate user queries and to evaluate AI responses. We develop HumanAgencyBench (HAB), a scalable and adaptive diagnostic tool for six behaviors related to human agency. HAB measures the tendency of an AI assistant to Ask Clarifying Questions, Avoid Value Manipulation, Correct Misinformation, Defer Important Decisions, Encourage Learning, and Maintain Social Boundaries. We find low-to-moderate agency support in contemporary LLM-based assistants, with substantial variation across system developers and behaviors. items.authors: Benjamin Sturgeon, Daniel Samuelson, Jacob Haimes, Jacy Reese Anthis

items.title: Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 想象力源于幻觉吗？大型语言模型中的跨分类评估
items.summary_zh: 想象力作为大型语言模型（LLMs）的高级功能，决定了其创造未见或创意内容的潜力。现有研究虽然建立了丰富的创造力基准，但仅测量输出与常见答案的偏离程度，未检查这种偏离是否得到提示的许可。此外，幻觉作为想象力的近邻，通常在不同生成的独立流程中进行测量，因此想象力与幻觉源于相同生成机制的影响性主张从未得到直接验证。本文提出了Whiteboard，这是首个LLM想象力评估基准。其设计遵循用于测量人类想象力的权威认知工具：七种机制基础的想象子类型与十种支持边界的幻觉子类型交叉，并在同一生成中共同评分。与以往的创造力或幻觉基准不同，Whiteboard通过明确的支持检查对每个想象分数进行限制，并通过可审计的原子矩阵确定两个轴的计算，主要路径上没有LLM评判。完整的Whiteboard题库包含1660个提示；在共享的80个锚点集上，我们评估了79个最先进的LLMs并进行了验证。
items.abstract: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. items.authors: Zixuan Tang, Hongzong Li, Shuxin Zhuang, Dapeng Wu, Zi Liang

items.title: The Role of AI in Online Reviews
items.title_zh: 人工智能在在线评论中的作用
items.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速应用，在线平台的内容生成出现了新的机遇，但也可能带来有害的操控形式，影响平台的有效性和动态。由于AI生成内容难以直接观察，我们引入了一种实证方法，利用LLM供给冲击（模型价格和能力的突变），对比验证与非验证评论，以识别与生成AI供给改善相关的平台活动变化。我们分析了来自Trustpilot的1300多万条评论。研究发现，LLM供给冲击后，未验证评论的负面性增加：1星评论增多，5星评论减少，评分降低，主要受新模型发布的驱动，且集中在评论量最低和最高的公司。这表明战略性AI使用可能重塑平台竞争动态。此外，LLM供给冲击还引发了短期集中评论活动。这些发现表明，生成AI已经在改变在线平台上的声誉和竞争运作方式。
items.abstract: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities for strategic content generation on online platforms, including potentially harmful forms of manipulation that may undermine platform effectiveness and reshape platform dynamics. However, measuring such activity is difficult because AI-generated content is rarely directly observable. We introduce an empirical approach that leverages discrete LLM supply shocks - abrupt changes in model prices and capabilities, and contrasts verified with non-verified reviews to identify changes in platform activity associated with generative AI supply improvements. We apply this approach to more than 13 million reviews from Trustpilot, one of the leading online platforms for business reviews. A robust finding is that following LLM supply shocks, unverified reviews shift toward greater negativity: more 1-stars, fewer 5-stars, and lower ratings, with effects driven primarily by new model releases and concentrated among firms with the lowest and highest review volumes, suggesting that strategic AI use may reshape platform competition dynamics. We further find that LLM supply shocks trigger short, concentrated bursts of review
items.authors: Valeria Lerman, Oren Rigbi, Yaniv Dover

items.title: Team DArgk at the 2026 ELOQUENT lab for evaluating generative language model quality: Residuals of Humanity: AI Detection Evasion via GRPO Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 2026 ELOQUENT实验室团队DArgk的生成语言模型质量评估研究
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成流畅且连贯的文本，越来越难以与人类写作区分，这促使自动AI生成文本检测器的发展。然而，这些检测器在对抗生成下的鲁棒性仍不确定。本文提出SHADE（通过对抗检测器规避的随机人类样本生成），一个将检测器规避视为策略优化问题的强化学习框架。SHADE通过基于PAN 2025 mdok系统的替代检测器反馈，使用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）对指令调优的LLaMA模型进行微调。实验表明，使用小的KL正则化惩罚进行全面微调时，替代规避率达到98.5%，而基础模型仅为1.5%；而基于LoRA的适应在正则化下效果显著较差。语言分析显示，成功规避与输出文本较短、简单且词汇多样性较低相关，表明高检测器规避并不一定对应于更人类化的写作。在官方Voight-Kampff竞赛中，我们的提交排名第六和第七，表明针对单一替代检测器的优化仅部分转移到未见评估中。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing.
items.authors: Antonela Tommasel, Juan Manuel Rodriguez

items.title: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation
items.title_zh: 知识图谱增强的环境人工智能用于临床笔记生成
items.summary_zh: 环境人工智能在医疗领域越来越多地被应用于自动生成患者与临床医生对话的临床笔记，旨在显著减轻临床医生的文档负担。然而，生成的笔记可能会遗漏在就诊过程中讨论的临床相关信息，从而造成信息缺口，影响后续护理。通过从就诊记录中构建的知识图谱（KG）可以提供讨论内容的结构化表示，并系统性地识别生成笔记中缺失的关键信息。本研究提出了覆盖导向修订（CDR）框架，该框架从就诊记录构建KG，识别初始生成笔记中缺失的医学概念，并指导大型语言模型（LLMs）恢复缺失信息，而无需修改基础的笔记生成系统。我们在两个数据集上评估了CDR：1）Pitt-Bench，本地康复会话数据集；2）ACI-Bench，临床笔记生成基准的公共数据集。测试结果表明，CDR在所有评估条件下均能持续提高内容回忆率。本研究为改善环境人工智能生成的临床文档的完整性提供了实用方法。
items.abstract: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results
items.authors: Jakir Hossain, Yi-Fei Zhao, Hongjian Wang, Minmei Shih, Katie Leigh Mullen, Ahmad P. Tafti, Leming Zhou, Manoj Purohit, William Hogan, Jay Zeng, Elizabeth Skidmore, Yanshan Wang

items.title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
items.title_zh: CoSLR：人机协作系统中的信任校准研究
items.summary_zh: 系统性文献综述（SLRs）对基于证据的研究至关重要，但过程耗时，需管理大量文献。大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成流畅且结构良好的综述文本，使得难以区分经过研究者验证的合成与仅看似权威的合成。这增加了未经验证的AI生成合成进入学术记录的风险。我们提出了CoSLR，一个支持SLR工作流程的人机协作多智能体系统，采用模块化的三阶段管道，结合大型语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG），并在生成输出与接受之间设置明确的强制性人类检查点。在对63名参与者的调查研究中，系统获得积极反馈：63名参与者中有27人（42.9%）高度评价其可用性，表明强制性检查点未影响界面的可用性。然而，检查点仅在研究者使用时才能保障综述的安全：63名参与者中有22人（34.9%）表示在与系统短暂互动后会信任AI生成的摘要和报告，而无需额外的人类检查。
items.abstract: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. items.authors: MD Aidul Islam, Malik Abdul Sami, Muhammad Waseem, Zeeshan Rasheed, Kai-kristian Kemell, Zheying Zhang, Pekka Abrahamsson

items.title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
items.title_zh: 审计大型语言模型助手的政治对齐：参与、立场与用户身份
items.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的人工智能系统为数亿人回答政治问题。当前的审计主要测量它们对普通用户的回应，但其行为是动态的。本文认为，它们的政治行为是一系列政策，包括回答对象、内容以及是否参与，具体取决于话题和系统对用户的了解。这些政策被称为系统的言论制度，反映了开发者在回答、迎合用户与拒绝之间的权衡。通过参与度和立场两个维度，我推导出五种言论制度。在一项预注册实验中，我测试了六个AI系统（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek），进行7500次多轮对话，随机分配用户的政治身份，涵盖五个话题：堕胎、加泰罗尼亚独立、气候变化、纳粹主义和一个零风险控制话题（比萨上的菠萝）。来自不同开发者的两位LLM评审对每个回答进行评分，并与人工编码进行验证，拒绝被视为结果而非缺失数据。所有系统在控制话题上迎合用户，表明政治克制是一项政策。在有争议的话题上，各系统表现出不同的制度：在堕胎问题上，GPT与每位用户互动并反映其观点，而Gemma拒绝所有人，Claude则对强保守用户的回答率为35%。
items.abstract: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restr
items.authors: Joan C. Timoneda

items.title: Predicting the Unpredictable: Development and External Validation of the GO SOAR Surgical Risk Calculator for Data-Driven Predictions of Surgical Complications in Gynaecological Oncology Surgery
items.title_zh: GO SOAR外科风险计算器在妇科肿瘤手术中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：现有的外科风险计算器未经过验证，且对接受妇科肿瘤手术的女性术后并发症和死亡率的预测效果较差。本研究旨在开发并外部验证GO SOAR外科风险计算器，以预测妇科肿瘤手术后30天的并发症和死亡率。方法：使用GO SOAR1训练队列（n = 1811）开发新的逻辑回归模型，并在独立前瞻性队列（n = 416）中进行外部验证，评估30天术后死亡率和并发症（Clavien–Dindo I–V）。结果：GO SOAR全模型的AUROC为0.752（95% CI 0.570–0.935），GO SOAR简化模型为0.795（95% CI 0.660–0.930），在90%特异性下的灵敏度分别为57.1%。结论：GO SOAR计算器在预测妇科肿瘤手术的术后风险方面表现优于现有的通用外科风险计算器。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Universal surgical risk calculators are not validated for use and poorly predict postoperative morbidity and mortality for women undergoing gynaecological oncology surgery. This adversely affects communication of risk resulting in poorly informed decisions and missed opportunities for medical optimization to mitigate risk preoperatively. We present the development and external validation of our novel GO SOAR surgical risk calculator for use to preoperatively predict postoperative thirty-day surgical morbidity and mortality in relation to gynaecological oncology surgeries. Methods: New logistic regression models were developed using the GO SOAR1 training cohort (n = 1811) and externally validated in an independent prospective cohort (n = 416) for two outcomes: thirty-day postoperative mortality (alive versus dead) and thirty-day postoperative morbidity (any complication (Clavien–Dindo I–V) versus none). Performance of the GO SOAR models was compared against established all-purpose surgical risk calculators (SORT/POSSUM/P-POSSUM/NSQIP). items.authors: Faiza Gaba, Oleg Blyuss, Janna G. Oganezova, Giulia Pellecchia, Stefano Restaino, Cristian Dell’Acqua

items.title: Treatment Strategies for Advanced Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Following Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Failure: A Systematic Review of the Literature and Ongoing Trials
items.title_zh: 抗PD-1免疫治疗失败后晚期皮肤鳞状细胞癌的治疗策略综述
items.summary_zh: 背景：尽管抗PD-1免疫治疗显著改善了晚期皮肤鳞状细胞癌（cSCC）的预后，但超过一半的患者未能响应，且尚无确立的二线治疗方案，存在明显的未满足需求。方法：本研究系统回顾了相关文献和正在进行的临床试验，以评估当前治疗策略的证据。经过全面检索和质量控制评估，我们最终纳入了20项研究：11篇已发表论文、1个会议海报和8项正在进行的临床试验。结果：尽管样本量小且多采用联合治疗而非单药治疗，证据显示含表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）抑制剂的治疗策略是最常报告的救援方法，并在抗PD-1失败后的晚期cSCC中显示出初步的治疗活性。结论：H
items.abstract: Background: While anti-PD-1 immunotherapy has led to significant improvements in the outcome of advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), over half of patients fail to respond, and there remains no established second-line therapy, representing a clear unmet need. Aim/Methods: Here, we present a systematic review of the literature and ongoing clinical trials to evaluate current evidence on treatment strategies in this setting. Following a comprehensive search, and quality control assessment of each paper, we identified 20 studies that were included in the final review: 11 published papers, 1 conference poster and 8 ongoing clinical trials. Data from the 12 reported studies were presented in a study-by-study format. Outcomes were reported descriptively and included the overall response rate (ORR), complete response (CR), partial response (PR), stable disease (SD) and progressive disease (PD), progression-free survival (PFS) and, where available, overall survival (OS). items.authors: Hamish Thomson, Embiye Adala, Anirban Mandal, Christopher Jones, Joseph J. Sacco

items.title: Sjögren’s Disease-Associated Parotid MALT Lymphoma: Diagnostic Pitfall of Ultrasound-Guided Core Needle Biopsy
items.title_zh: 干燥综合征相关的腮腺MALT淋巴瘤：超声引导下穿刺活检的诊断陷阱
items.summary_zh: 干燥综合征（SD）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，增加了粘膜相关淋巴组织（MALT淋巴瘤）外周边缘区淋巴瘤的风险，尤其是在腮腺中。本文报告了一名老年女性，表现为双侧腮腺肿胀伴干口症和干眼症。血清学检测显示抗SSA和抗SSB抗体阳性，伴有高γ球蛋白血症和低补体血症，提示干燥综合征。颈部超声显示双侧腮腺内多个低回声结节。超声引导下核心针活检（US-CNB）结果为淋巴上皮性腮腺炎，混合淋巴细胞浸润提示SD。后续CT显示右侧咽旁间隙有坏死性淋巴结肿大，因此进行了右腮腺肿瘤的外科切除，组织病理学确认为外周边缘区B细胞淋巴瘤（MALT淋巴瘤）。分期PET-CT显示多部位受累。化疗后实现完全代谢反应，患者在30个月的随访中保持缓解。由于淋巴瘤风险增加，SD患者需进行仔细监测。
items.abstract: Sjögren’s disease (SD) is a chronic autoimmune disease associated with an increased risk of extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma), particularly in the parotid glands. However, distinguishing benign SD-associated sialadenitis from early lymphoma remains a diagnostic challenge, especially when biopsy samples are limited. We report an elderly woman presenting with progressive bilateral parotid swelling accompanied by xerostomia and xerophthalmia. Serological testing revealed positive anti-SSA and anti-SSB antibodies, hypergammaglobulinemia, and hypocomplementemia, suggesting Sjögren syndrome. Neck ultrasound demonstrated multiple hypoechoic nodules in both parotid glands. Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy (US-CNB) revealed lymphoepithelial sialadenitis with mixed lymphocytic infiltration suggestive of SD. Subsequent computed tomography demonstrated necrotic lymphadenopathy in the right parapharyngeal space. Surgical excision of the right parotid tumor was therefore performed, and histopathology confirmed extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma (MALT lymphoma). items.title: Silymarin and Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles Attenuate Experimental Colon Cancer in Rats Through Crosstalk of miR-192 and β-Catenin Pathways
items.title_zh: 水飞蓟素与氧化锌纳米颗粒减轻大肠癌的实验研究
items.summary_zh: 大肠癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。尽管化疗仍是主要治疗手段，但其毒性和耐药性促使寻找替代治疗策略。本研究评估了水飞蓟素（Sily）和氧化锌纳米颗粒（ZnO-NPs）对DMH诱导的大肠癌的疗效。将30只雄性斯普拉格-道利大鼠分为五组：对照组、大肠癌组（DMH 20 mg/kg/16周皮下注射）及三组每日接受水飞蓟素（40 mg/kg口服）、氧化锌纳米颗粒（10 mg/kg腹腔注射）或其联合治疗，持续4周。结果显示，与大肠癌组相比，水飞蓟素或氧化锌纳米颗粒显著降低了癌胚抗原（CEA）水平，恢复了粘蛋白合成，并改善了结肠组织学，联合治疗效果最为显著。治疗减轻了氧化应激，水飞蓟素恢复了超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平，而氧化锌纳米颗粒主要降低了脂质过氧化，表现为丙二醛（MDA）水平下降。机制上，联合治疗降低了抑制性GSK-3β磷酸化和β-连环蛋白表达，恢复了GSK-3β介导的β-连环蛋白抑制作用。同时，联合治疗恢复了PKCα和miR-192的表达，并降低了与增殖和转移相关的标志物MMP-9、c-Myc和Cyclin-D1的表达。
items.abstract: Colon cancer (CC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality globally. Although chemotherapy remains the primary treatment, its toxicity and drug resistance highlight the need for alternative therapeutic strategies. Silymarin (Sily), a natural compound, and zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO-NPs) have shown potential antitumor activity. This study evaluated Sily and/or ZnO-NPs against DMH-induced CC in rats. Thirty male Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into five groups (n = 6): control, CC (DMH 20 mg/kg/16-week S.C.), and three groups receiving Sily (40 mg/kg orally), ZnO-NPs (10 mg/kg IP), or their combination daily for 4 weeks. In comparison to the CC group, Sily or ZnO-NPs significantly decreased CEA levels, restored mucin synthesis, and improved colonic histology, with the combination treatment producing the most pronounced antitumor effects. Treatments attenuated oxidative stress, with Sily restoring SOD and GSH levels, whereas ZnO-NPs primarily reduced lipid peroxidation, as reflected by decreased MDA levels. items.authors: Eman H. Yousef, Aya Megahed, Alaa Samy, Amgad E. Salem, Jawaher Abdullah Alamoudi, Ahmed Abbas

items.title: Engineering Functional Biomaterials for Targeted and Localized Cancer Drug Delivery: A Structure–Property–Performance Design Perspective
items.title_zh: 针对性局部癌症药物递送的功能性生物材料设计
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：癌症治疗受到肿瘤选择性差、全身毒性、生物运输障碍、快速清除、耐药性和术后复发等限制。功能性生物材料通过针对性、局部、可控和刺激响应的药物递送系统来解决这些问题。现有综述通常根据载体类型、治疗剂或癌症应用对这些系统进行分类，较少强调生物材料的结构和物理化学性质如何影响治疗效果。本综述采用结构-性质-性能（SPP）框架，理性设计功能性生物材料以实现针对性局部癌症药物递送。方法：本综述批判性地考察了粒子大小和形态、表面化学和电荷、靶向功能化、刺激响应性、孔隙率和内部结构、机械稳定性及降解等设计参数，并将其与药物负载和释放、全身运输、肿瘤积累和渗透、细胞摄取和局部保留相关联。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cancer therapy remains limited by poor tumor selectivity, systemic toxicity, biological barriers to drug transport, rapid clearance, treatment resistance, and postoperative recurrence. Functional biomaterials offer engineered systems to address these limitations through targeted, localized, controlled, and stimuli-responsive drug delivery. However, existing reviews commonly classify these systems according to carrier type, therapeutic agent, or cancer application, with less emphasis on how biomaterial structure and physicochemical properties determine therapeutic performance. This review addresses this gap using a structure–property–performance (SPP) framework to rationally engineer functional biomaterials for targeted, localized cancer drug delivery. Methods: The review critically examines particle size and morphology, surface chemistry and charge, targeting functionalization, stimulus responsiveness, porosity and internal architecture, mechanical stability, and degradation, and relates these design parameters to drug loading and release, systemic transport, tumor accumulation and penetration, cellular uptake, and local retention. items.authors: Precious Etinosa, Yusuf Olatunji Waidi, Sarah Osafo, Yiporo Danyuo, Stanley Eluu, Chukwudi Ezeala

items.title: Safety and Feasibility of Endoscopic-Assisted Electrochemotherapy in Addition to Neoadjuvant Treatment of Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: An Exploratory Randomised Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: 内镜辅助电化学疗法联合新辅助治疗局部晚期直肠癌的安全性与可行性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：局部晚期直肠癌（LARC）在接受新辅助化放疗（CRT）后，尽管进行积极的多模式治疗，复发率仍然较高。电化学疗法（ECT）结合了电穿孔与化疗，在其他恶性肿瘤中显示出安全性和可行性，但其作为直肠癌新辅助治疗的附加作用尚未探索。方法：本研究为平行组随机安全性和可行性试验，纳入经过组织学确认的LARC患者，随机分为接受手术前单次ECT治疗（n=8）或标准治疗（n=8）。主要结果为安全性。结果：所有接受ECT的患者均成功完成治疗，平均操作时间为23.5分钟。所有ECT患者均出现不良事件，主要为直肠疼痛（86%），其中一名患者因疼痛管理住院。未观察到与操作相关的并发症。两名ECT患者因术中穿孔接受R1切除。肿瘤反应不均匀：两名患者达到完全反应（TRG1）。
items.abstract: Background: Locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) has high recurrence rates despite aggressive multimodal treatment with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (CRT) followed by surgery. Electrochemotherapy (ECT), combining electroporation with chemotherapy, has shown safety and feasibility in other malignancies, but its role as an additive neoadjuvant treatment in rectal cancer remains unexplored. Methods: In this parallel-group, randomised safety and feasibility trial, patients with histologically verified LARC who completed neoadjuvant CRT were randomised 1:1 to a single ECT treatment with bleomycin before surgery (n = 8) or standard therapy (n = 8). The primary outcome was safety (amended from the protocol-specified efficacy endpoint after early study termination). Follow-up was scheduled before surgery and at 6 and 12 weeks post-surgery, including adverse events, clinical examination, and patient-reported quality of life, bowel, urinary, and sexual function. Results: ECT was successfully delivered in all treated patients. Median procedure time was 23.5 min. Adverse events occurred in all ECT patients, predominantly rectal pain (86%), with one patient hospitalised for pain management. N
items.authors: Loan Ngo-Stuyt, Rasmus Peuliche Vogelsang, Mustafa Bulut, Helle Hjorth Johannesen, Annika Loft, Malene Broholm

items.title: Measurement-Dependent Asymmetry in Chinese Urban Carbon-Emission Inventories: Reference States, Scale Sensitivity, and Cross-Inventory Concordance
items.title_zh: 城市碳排放清单的测量依赖性不对称性研究
items.summary_zh: 城市碳排放清单的结论因会计构建和分析尺度的不同而异，但这两种变异来源在共同框架下的评估较少。我们将不对称性定义为相对于明确参考状态的测量依赖性偏离，而非不平等、时间变异或空间聚集的同义词。利用2001-2019年CEADs城市年清单、2019-2021年Carbon Monitor Cities日估计和统一城市几何形状，我们考察了分布、时间和局部空间维度，并评估了跨清单一致性。结果表明，长期不平等趋势对样本组成敏感；季节性对比显著大于工作日与周末的差异；而弱全球空间依赖性可与持续的局部尾部组织共存。尽管绝对排放量存在显著差异，跨清单城市排名相对稳健，而细粒度的局部空间分类对清单构建更为敏感。这些发现表明，城市碳排放的不对称性是由所选参考状态、样本、时间分辨率、空间定义和会计边界共同决定的测量属性。
items.abstract: Urban carbon-emission inventories can yield different conclusions depending on accounting construction and analytical scale, yet these two sources of variation are rarely evaluated within a common framework. We define asymmetry as a measurement-dependent departure from an explicit reference state, rather than as a synonym for inequality, temporal variability, or spatial clustering. Using CEADs annual city inventories for 2001–2019, Carbon Monitor Cities daily estimates for 2019–2021, and harmonized city geometries, we examine distributional, temporal, and local spatial dimensions and assess cross-inventory concordance. The results show that long-term inequality trends are sensitive to sample composition; seasonal contrasts are substantially larger than weekday–weekend differences; and weak global spatial dependence can coexist with persistent local tail organization. Cross-inventory city rankings are comparatively robust despite material differences in absolute emission magnitudes, whereas fine-grained local spatial classifications are more sensitive to inventory construction. items.authors: Ningze Xia, Junjie Bian, Chengfang Wang, Mu-Jiang-Shan Wang

items.title: Clinical Subtype Stratification Reveals Gut Microbial Alterations, Candidate Markers, and Co-Occurrence Network Remodeling in Coronary Artery Disease
items.title_zh: 冠状动脉疾病的临床亚型分层揭示肠道微生物变化
items.summary_zh: 尽管肠道微生物失调与冠状动脉疾病（CAD）相关，但其在不同临床阶段的动态变化尚未得到充分研究。本研究旨在识别CAD谱系中阶段特异性的微生物生物标志物。我们分析了306名受试者的16S rRNA测序数据，包括非CAD对照组及轻度冠状动脉狭窄（MCS）、稳定型心绞痛（SA）、不稳定型心绞痛（UA）和急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者。通过多样性分析、机器学习和SPIEC-EASI网络建模评估微生物群落变化并识别核心诊断标志物。观察到肠道微生物群的显著结构重塑，尤其是在AMI阶段。Veillonella、Intestinimonas和Streptococcus分别被确定为MCS、SA和UA/AMI阶段的核心生物标志物。从MCS到UA阶段，生态网络连通性持续下降，突显出关键屏障的脆弱性，随后在AMI阶段转变为以对抗为主导的网络。机器学习模型有效区分了不同疾病阶段，关键微生物标志物在调整主要临床混杂因素后仍保持统计学稳健性。肠道微生物群在CAD进展过程中表现出动态的阶段特异性失调，为非侵入性生物标志物提供了有希望的依据。
items.abstract: Although gut microbiota dysbiosis is associated with coronary artery disease (CAD), its dynamic alterations across distinct clinical stages remain largely unexplored. This study aimed to identify stage-specific microbial biomarkers across the CAD spectrum. We analyzed 16S rRNA sequencing data from 306 subjects, including non-CAD controls and patients with mild coronary stenosis (MCS), stable angina (SA), unstable angina (UA), and acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Diversity analyses, machine learning, and SPIEC-EASI network modeling were applied to evaluate microbial community shifts and identify core diagnostic markers. Significant structural remodeling of the gut microbiota was observed, particularly during the AMI stage. Veillonella, Intestinimonas, and Streptococcus were identified as the core biomarkers for the MCS, SA, and UA/AMI stages, respectively. From the MCS to the UA stage, ecological network connectivity continuously declined, highlighting critical barrier vulnerability, before transitioning into an antagonism-dominated network in the AMI stage. Machine learning models effectively discriminated among the various disease stages, and key microbial markers remained stati
items.authors: Peiqi Yan, Chen Tian, Lei Zhu, Zhigang Zhang

items.title: A Registry-Informed Framework for Earlier Detection of Esophageal Adenocarcinoma in Thailand: Evidence from a 16-Year Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 泰国食管腺癌早期检测的登记信息框架研究
items.summary_zh: 食管癌常在晚期被诊断，限制了治愈性治疗的机会并导致不良临床结果。本研究旨在识别晚期表现的临床病理预测因子，并利用这些发现为泰国食管腺癌的早期检测提供登记信息框架。我们使用Siriraj癌症登记处进行了一项回顾性队列研究。2009年至2024年间，1451名食管癌患者中，有591名患者的临床和/或病理信息足以进行分期。结果显示，77.5%的患者为晚期疾病。与鳞状细胞癌相比，腺癌组织学独立与晚期表现相关（调整后的比值比4.16，95%置信区间1.21–14.30；p = 0.024）。与2009–2016年相比，2017–2024年早期诊断趋势有所改善（调整后的比值比0.66，95%置信区间0.43–1.00；p = 0.052）。这些发现为进一步研究提供了假设基础。
items.abstract: Esophageal cancer is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage, limiting opportunities for curative treatment and contributing to poor clinical outcomes. We aimed to identify clinicopathological predictors of advanced-stage presentation and use these findings to inform a registry-informed framework for earlier detection of esophageal adenocarcinoma (AC) in Thailand. A retrospective cohort study was conducted using the Siriraj Cancer Registry. Among 1451 patients diagnosed with esophageal cancer between 2009 and 2024, 591 patients with sufficient clinical and/or pathological information for stage assignment were included. Patients were classified as having early-stage (Stage I–II) or advanced-stage (Stage III–IV) disease. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify independent predictors of advanced-stage presentation. Among patients with sufficient information for reliable stage assignment, 77.5% presented with advanced-stage disease. AC histology was independently associated with increased odds of advanced-stage presentation compared with squamous cell carcinoma (adjusted odds ratio 4.16, 95% confidence interval 1.21–14.30; p = 0.024). items.authors: Thanawat Suwatthanarak, Kullanist Thanormjit, Onchira Acharayothin, Patcharipa Chanaturakarnnon, Sripatch Sri-arporn, Tippawan Gerdsuriwong

items.title: Mortality Predictors and Retrospective Concordance with ICU Admission Prioritization Guidelines in Patients with Cancer: A Single-Center Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 癌症患者ICU死亡预测因素及与入院优先级指南的回顾性一致性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：随着癌症治疗的进展和人口老龄化，癌症患者的ICU入院率增加，但死亡率仍然较高且ICU资源有限。本研究旨在识别入院时可用的死亡预测因素及ICU期间出现的因素，并评估与ICU入院优先级指南的回顾性一致性。方法：本回顾性单中心队列研究纳入2024年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间在波兰卢布林一家肿瘤ICU入院的287名活跃恶性肿瘤患者。两名独立评审员在不知结果的情况下，根据波兰麻醉学与重症治疗学会的指南回顾性分配ICU入院优先级。使用单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析识别与ICU死亡相关的因素。结果：ICU总体死亡率为41.1%（118/287）。在调整后的入院时间模型中，APACHE II评分（每分1.15的比值比）、ECOG 4（比值比6.37）和术后入院（比值比0.29）与死亡相关（受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.84）。在探索性ICU病程模型中，机械通气48小时或在机械通气期间48小时内死亡（比值比6.79）及使用血管加压药48小时或在使用血管加压药期间48小时内死亡（比值比4.33）也与死亡相关。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Advances in cancer treatment and an aging population have increased ICU admissions among patients with cancer, while mortality remains high and ICU resources are limited. We aimed to identify mortality predictors available at admission and factors arising during the ICU stay and to evaluate retrospective concordance with ICU admission-prioritization guidelines. Methods: This retrospective single-center cohort included 287 patients with an active malignancy admitted to an oncology ICU in Lublin, Poland, from 1 January 2024 through 31 December 2025. Two independent reviewers, blinded to outcomes, retrospectively assigned ICU admission priorities according to Polish Society of Anaesthesiology and Intensive Therapy guidelines. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were used to identify factors associated with ICU mortality. Results: Overall ICU mortality was 41.1% (118/287). In the adjusted admission-time model, APACHE II score (odds ratio (OR), 1.15 per point), ECOG 4 (OR, 6.37), and postoperative admission (OR, 0.29) were associated with mortality (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), 0.84). items.authors: Katarzyna Kosz, Justyna Wasiewicz, Amelia Bień, Maksymilian Skwirut, Paweł Piwowarczyk, Michał Borys

items.title: Accelerated Pancreatic Volume Loss as a Potential Pre-Diagnostic Imaging Biomarker for Pancreatic Cancer Risk Enrichment: An AI-Assisted Volumetric Study
items.title_zh: 加速胰腺体积丧失作为胰腺癌风险的影像学生物标志物
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的治疗依赖于早期检测，但大多数患者在不可手术阶段就已出现。局灶性胰腺实质萎缩（FPPA）是一种缺乏客观量化的前驱影像特征。本研究评估了纵向AI测量的胰腺体积（PV）变化是否与后续PDAC相关。方法：在这项回顾性病例对照研究中，我们分析了40名PDAC患者和61名对照的纵向CT影像，均具有≥5年的前期影像。通过AI分割测量PV，并比较个体特定的变化率，采用多变量、混合效应和敏感性分析评估稳健性。结果：PDAC患者的PV下降速度明显快于匹配对照（5年减少9.71 vs. 1.23 mL; p = 0.013），在排除糖尿病和调整后仍然存在。混合效应模型确认了更快的下降速度，且在截断窗口中一致，但在接近诊断时缺失。将该标志物添加到基本协变量模型中，曲线下面积（AUC）从0.679提高至0.823。对微切除FPPA的探索性转录组分析识别出131个在PanIN和侵袭性PDAC邻近比较中一致改变的基因，且在非侵袭性PanIN邻近存在免疫相关信号，在侵袭性PDAC邻近则更为显著。结论：后期发展为PDAC的患者表现出明显的胰腺体积加速丧失。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Treatment for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) depends on early detection, yet most present at an inoperable stage. Focal pancreatic parenchymal atrophy (FPPA) is a prodromal imaging feature lacking objective quantification. We evaluated whether longitudinal, AI-measured pancreatic volume (PV) change is associated with subsequent PDAC. Methods: In this retrospective case–control study, we analyzed longitudinal CT from 40 PDAC patients and 61 controls, each with ≥5 years of pre-index imaging. PV was measured by AI segmentation and compared as a subject-specific rate of change, with robustness assessed via multivariable, mixed-effects, and sensitivity analyses. Results: PDAC patients showed more rapid PV decline than matched controls (5-year reduction 9.71 vs. 1.23 mL; p = 0.013), persisting after excluding diabetes and adjustment. A mixed-effects model confirmed faster decline, consistent across truncation windows but absent near diagnosis. Adding the marker to a basic covariate model raised the area under the curve (AUC) from 0.679 to 0.823.
