items.authors: Jun Nakahodo, Wataru Ujita, Daichi Sadato, Yuki Fukumura, Yuji Aoki, Masataka Kikuyama

items.title: Engineering a Redox-Responsive Bimolecular Prodrug for Targeted Gastric Cancer Combination Therapy: Design, Synthesis, and In Vivo Evaluation
items.title_zh: 靶向胃癌的红氧还原响应双分子前药设计与评估
items.summary_zh: 组合化疗常面临药代动力学不同步和非靶向毒性问题。为此，我们设计了一种新型的红氧还原响应双分子前药（CA-4-Gefitinib），通过工程化二硫键作为可裂解连接子，将微管抑制剂康布雷塔斯汀A-4（CA-4）与EGFR抑制剂吉非替尼共价结合。该前药在高谷胱甘肽环境中实现肿瘤选择性药物激活，表现出增强的细胞摄取和对SGC-7901胃癌细胞的强效抗增殖活性，安全指数为98，显著优于正常细胞。机制上，该前药干扰微管聚合，诱导G2/M期停滞，抑制ERK信号通路并促进细胞凋亡。在小鼠异种移植模型中，该前药显示出优越的抗肿瘤效果，并显著降低系统性毒性。我们的研究提出了一种合理的前药设计策略，提供了一个有前景的平台用于先进的靶向治疗。
items.abstract: Combination chemotherapy often suffers from asynchronous pharmacokinetics and off-target toxicity. To address this, we designed a novel, unreported engineered prodrug—a redox-responsive bimolecular prodrug (CA-4-Gefitinib)—by engineering a disulfide bond as a cleavable linker to covalently conjugate the tubulin inhibitor combretastatin A-4 (CA-4) and the EGFR inhibitor Gefitinib. This molecular-level prodrug design enables tumor-selective drug activation in high-glutathione environments. This prodrug exhibited enhanced cellular uptake and potent antiproliferative activity against SGC-7901 gastric cancer cells, with significantly improved selectivity over normal cells (safety index of 98). Mechanistically, this engineered prodrug disrupted microtubule polymerization, induced G2/M arrest, suppressed ERK signaling, and promoted apoptosis. The prodrug’s pharmacokinetic profile showed prolonged circulation and reduced systemic exposure to free CA-4, indicating favorable biodistribution. In a murine xenograft model, this prodrug demonstrated superior antitumor efficacy and markedly reduced systemic toxicity compared to the combination of free drugs. items.authors: Chao Wang, Yutao Xiu, Yujing Zhang, Jiazhen Xu, Yanhong Wang, Dongming Xing

items.title: Colorectal Cancer in Younger and Elderly Patients: A Real-World Analysis from the Modena Cancer Center
items.title_zh: 年轻与老年患者结直肠癌的真实世界分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：早发结直肠癌已成为全球健康挑战。尽管年轻患者与老年患者之间存在差异，但对极端年龄组的直接比较可能进一步揭示其临床和治疗特征。方法：本研究为回顾性单中心观察研究，比较1990-2025年间年轻患者（A组：≤50岁，n=153）与老年患者（B组：≥75岁，n=533）。结果：A组IV期表现率更高（66.9% vs. 47.1%，p<0.001），T4肿瘤、N2淋巴结受累、远端肿瘤定位及同步转移（87.5% vs. 70.6%，p=0.001），主要涉及肝脏和腹膜。年轻患者接受了更为密集的辅助和转移性系统治疗。A组的中位生存期为52.8个月，B组为26.4个月（HR 2.29，95% CI 1.57–3.54，p<0.001），A组的无病生存期更长（28.6 vs. 19.1个月；HR 2.26，95% CI 1.55–3.29，p<0.001）。两组在一线或二线无进展生存期方面未观察到显著差异。结论：早发结直肠癌表现出更不利的临床病理特征。年轻患者在本研究中显示出更长的总体生存期和无病生存期，但需谨慎解读这些结果，考虑治疗差异的潜在影响。
items.abstract: Background: Early-onset colorectal cancer represents a growing global health challenge. Although differences between young and elderly patients are recognized, direct comparison of extreme age groups may further characterize their distinct clinical and therapeutic profiles. Methods: This is a retrospective, single-centre, observational study, comparing young patients (Group A: ≤50 years, n = 153) with elderly patients (Group B: ≥75 years, n = 533) during the period 1990–2025. Results: Group A presented higher rates of stage IV presentation (66.9% vs. 47.1%, p 0.001), T4 tumors, N2 nodal involvement, distal tumor localization and synchronous metastasis (87.5% vs. 70.6%, p = 0.001), predominantly involving the liver and peritoneum. Younger patients received more intensive adjuvant and metastatic systemic treatment. The mOS was 52.8 months for Group A compared to 26.4 months for Group B (HR 2.29, 95% CI 1.57–3.54, p 0.001) and DFS was longer in Group A (28.6 vs. 19.1 months; HR 2.26, 95% CI 1.55–3.29, p 0.001). No statistically significant differences were observed in first- or second-line PFS between the cohorts. Conclusions: Early-onset colorectal cancer exhibits a more adverse clin
items.authors: Bianca Medici, Andrea Spallanzani, Annalisa Fontana, Massimiliano Salati, Salvatore Natalizio, Alberto Bertolotti

items.title: Virotherapy for Spinal and Spinal Cord Tumors: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives
items.title_zh: 脊柱及脊髓肿瘤的病毒治疗：现状与未来展望
items.summary_zh: 脊柱和脊髓肿瘤，包括原发性和转移性椎体肿瘤、髓内胶质瘤及难治性硬膜内病变，因周围神经组织的复杂性和不可再生性而难以治疗。溶瘤病毒治疗可能提供一种合理的替代方案，通过肿瘤选择性溶解与诱导全身抗肿瘤免疫相结合，同时保护正常神经细胞。本文综述了在脊柱及脊髓肿瘤背景下的溶瘤病毒，包括腺病毒、单纯疱疹病毒、轮状病毒等。尽管脊柱领域的临床数据仍然稀缺，但基于肉瘤及其他肿瘤的组织学证据、广泛的胶质瘤经验（包括弥漫性内在桥脑胶质瘤）以及神经鞘瘤和脑膜瘤模型的前临床活动，支持了这一理论。我们讨论了端粒酶特异性溶瘤腺病毒OBP-301及其衍生物，其hTERT驱动的复制提供了组织学无关的肿瘤选择性，但对通过替代延长端粒（ALT）途径维持端粒的肿瘤（如许多骨肉瘤和某些脊髓星形胶质瘤）活性有限。我们还讨论了在受限脊柱内的递送和安全性问题。
items.abstract: Tumors of the spine and spinal cord, including primary and metastatic vertebral tumors, intramedullary gliomas, and refractory intradural lesions, are challenging to treat because curative local therapy is limited by the eloquent, nonregenerating neural tissue surrounding them. Oncolytic virotherapy may offer a rational alternative by combining tumor-selective oncolysis with the induction of systemic antitumor immunity, while sparing normal neural cells. This review summarizes the current field of oncolytic viruses, including adenovirus, herpes simplex virus, reovirus, and others, in the context of spinal and spinal cord tumors. Clinical data in the spine remain scarce; however, the rationale is based on histological evidence from sarcomas and other tumors, extensive glioma experience, including diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, and preclinical activity in nerve sheath and meningioma models. We discuss the telomerase-specific oncolytic adenovirus OBP-301 and its derivatives, whose hTERT-driven replication provides histology-agnostic tumor selectivity, while sparing the telomerase-silent spinal cord. This telomerase dependence, however, limits activity against tumors that maintain t
items.authors: Koji Uotani, Tomohiro Fujiwara, Ryo Takatori, Kazutaka Yamashita, Kenzaburo Matsumoto, Yoshiaki Oda

items.title: Targeting the Gut Microbiome in Cardiovascular Disease: Current Therapeutic Strategies and Future Perspectives
items.title_zh: 靶向肠道微生物组在心血管疾病中的应用与前景
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物群被越来越多地认为是心血管健康的重要调节因子，其与饮食、代谢、免疫学和宿主生理之间存在复杂的相互作用。研究表明，肠道微生物组的组成和功能变化可能通过微生物代谢物、肠道屏障功能障碍、炎症和代谢失调等机制，促进动脉粥样硬化、高血压、心力衰竭、血栓形成等心血管疾病的发生。本综述的关键问题是：调节肠道微生物组及其代谢功能在心血管疾病的预防和治疗中能发挥多大临床意义，以及目前可用的微生物组靶向方法中，哪些具有足够的机制和临床证据支持其在心血管实践中的应用？我们回顾了肠道微生物组与主要心血管表型（如动脉粥样硬化、高血压、心力衰竭、血栓形成和心房颤动）之间的证据，重点关注微生物代谢物、肠道屏障功能障碍、炎症和代谢失调如何影响心血管风险的机制，并审视当前及新兴的微生物组调节策略。
items.abstract: The gut microbiota is increasingly recognized as an important modulator of cardiovascular health, demonstrating complicated interactions among diet, metabolism, immunology and host physiology. Evidence is accumulating that changes in the composition and function of the gut microbiome may contribute to the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis, hypertension, heart failure, thrombosis and other cardiovascular phenotypes through mechanisms involving microbial metabolites, intestinal barrier dysfunction, inflammation and metabolic dysregulation. In this context, the key question of this narrative review is: how far can modulation of the gut microbiome and its metabolic functions be a clinically meaningful approach in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease, and which of the currently available microbiome-targeted approaches have sufficient mechanistic and clinical evidence to justify translation into cardiovascular practice? To answer this question, we review the evidence linking the gut microbiome to major cardiovascular phenotypes, such as atherosclerosis, hypertension, heart failure, thrombosis and atrial fibrillation, with particular focus on the mechanisms through which m
items.authors: Diana Elena David, Cringuta Mariana Paraschiv, Laura Elisabeta Checherita, Stefan Andrei Chiriac, Gabriela Raluca Grigorasi, Vasile Valeriu Lupu

items.title: Speech Perception in Noise: A Narrative Review of Cognitive Contribution and Hearing-Aid Signal Processing
items.title_zh: 噪声中的语音感知：认知贡献与助听器信号处理的叙述性综述
items.summary_zh: 背景：环境噪声是现代城市中普遍存在的生态健康问题，导致听力损伤、烦恼、睡眠干扰、心血管疾病及交流障碍。对于任何年龄段的听力障碍者，嘈杂环境的主要挑战在于理解背景噪声中的语音，这与认知密切相关。方法：通过对PubMed、Scopus和Google Scholar的文献检索，结合认知、语音感知、噪声中的语音、助听器信号处理、环境健康和衰老等相关术语进行叙述性综述。结果：评估了认知能力在噪声中语音感知中的作用，特别关注人工智能如何支持认知与助听器信号处理在不利环境中的相互作用。根据语言理解的易用性（ELU）模型，本文描述了降级的声学输入如何将处理从快速、隐式的词汇访问转向依赖于显式工作记忆的重构。实际证据表明，工作记忆尤其可以预测在不利条件下的助听语音识别，衰老则使这些过程分离。
items.abstract: Background: Environmental noise is one of the most pervasive ecological health issues in modern urban settings, contributing to the onset of hearing damage but also to the development of annoyance, sleep disturbance, cardiovascular diseases, and impaired communication. For people with hearing impairment of any age, the main challenge posed by noisy environments is not merely detecting sound but understanding speech against a competing background—a task heavily related to cognition. Methods: Narrative review; the literature has been identified through searches of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar, combining terms related to cognition, speech perception, speech in noise, hearing-aid signal processing, environmental health, and aging. Results: The role of cognitive abilities in speech perception in noise has been evaluated, with particular attention to how artificial intelligence supports the interplay between cognition and hearing-aid signal processing in adverse environments. Within the Ease of Language Understanding (ELU) model, this paper describes how degraded acoustic input shifts processing from rapid, implicit lexical access toward explicit working-memory-dependent reconstruc
items.authors: Daniele Monzani, Andrea Bianchino, Andrea Ciorba, Chiara Bianchini, Marianna Manuelli, Andrea Migliorelli

items.title: 'Epigenetic' editing is here: gene-tagging technique banishes hepatitis B virus
items.title_zh: 表观遗传编辑技术消除乙型肝炎病毒
items.summary_zh: 本研究介绍了一种新型的基因标记技术，该技术利用化学标签有效关闭潜伏在宿主基因组中的乙型肝炎病毒DNA。通过这一方法，研究人员能够精准定位并抑制病毒基因的表达，从而阻止病毒的复制和传播。实验结果表明，该技术在体外实验中成功消除了感染细胞中的病毒DNA，显示出良好的应用前景。这一突破为乙型肝炎的治疗提供了新的思路，可能为未来的抗病毒疗法开辟新的方向。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 21 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02981-9 Technique uses chemical tags to shut down viral DNA lurking in host’s genome.
items.authors: Miryam Naddaf

items.title: Computational design of metalloproteases
items.title_zh: 金属蛋白酶的计算设计
items.summary_zh: 尽管在创造能够水解活化酯的去新型金属酶方面取得了显著进展，但酰胺键的断裂仍然是酶设计中的一大挑战。本文报告了使用RoseTTAFold Diffusion 2进行的去新型锌蛋白酶设计，该方法优化了酶和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用设计。在135个计算设计中，36%的实验测试显示出活性，并在预定位点精确断裂。最活跃的设计相较于未催化反应加速了肽键水解超过10^8倍，经过四个点突变后进一步提升至10^10倍。基于这些能力，我们设计了能够特异性切割人类TDP-43、淀粉样β肽和血清淀粉样A的金属蛋白酶，其速率加速高达9.2x10^8倍。我们展示了通过生成被笼罩的细胞因子和受体拮抗剂，利用设计的蛋白酶实现生物正交控制细胞状态的潜力。
items.abstract: Although significant progress has been made in creating de novo metalloenzymes that hydrolyze activated esters, the energetically demanding cleavage of amide bonds has remained a major challenge for enzyme design: amide bonds are significantly more stable than ester bonds, the amine leaving groups in proteins are not activated, and peptide substrates are flexible making them difficult to bind precisely. Here, we report the de novo design of zinc proteases from minimal catalytic motifs using RoseTTAFold Diffusion 2 for Molecular Interfaces, optimized for both enzyme and protein-protein interaction design. Of 135 computational designs experimentally tested, 36% had activity and cleaved precisely at the intended site. The most active design accelerates peptide bond hydrolysis by more than 10^8-fold relative to the uncatalyzed reaction, and by over 10^10-fold following the introduction of four point mutations that enhanced active-site preorganization4. Building on these capabilities, we designed metalloproteases that specifically cleave human TDP-43, the amyloid-{beta} peptide, and serum amyloid A with rate accelerations up to 9.2x10^8-fold over background. items.title: Integrating structural homology with deep learning to achieve highly accurate protein-protein interface prediction for the human interactome
items.title_zh: 结合结构同源性与深度学习的蛋白质相互作用界面预测
items.summary_zh: 许多致病突变发生在蛋白质相互作用界面，但结构解析的多蛋白复合物数量极少。本文提出了一种计算管道PIONEER2，结合三维结构相似性与几何深度学习，准确预测特定蛋白质结合伙伴的界面残基。通过对PDB结构的测试集比较PIONEER2与AlphaFold3的性能，发现二者表现相似。然而，约20%的AlphaFold3在PDB中对蛋白质复合物的预测得分低于0.5，表明模型不确定。对于这些结构，PIONEER2在区分界面与非界面残基方面优于AlphaFold3。此外，约一半的高置信度蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）得分低于0.5，表明PIONEER2在大量无结构的PPIs中提供了更优的界面预测。我们创建了一个涵盖352,124个实验检测的二元人类PPIs的综合三维结构信息互作组，并对每个进行PIONEER2界面预测。我们通过生成1,866个突变并测试其破坏性来实验验证这些预测。
items.abstract: A significant portion of disease-causing mutations occur at protein-protein interfaces however, the number of structurally resolved multi-protein complexes is extremely small. Here we present a computational pipeline, PIONEER2, that integrates 3D structural similarity with geometric deep learning to accurately predict protein binding partner-specific interfacial residues. We compare the performance of PIONEER2 to that of AlphaFold3 and found, using a test set of PDB structures, that their performance is quite similar. However, about 20% of AlphaFold3 predictions for protein-protein complexes in the PDB have AlphaFold3 ranking scores below 0.5, which indicates an uncertain model. For these structures, PIONEER2 outperforms AlphaFold3 at discriminating interfacial from non-interfacial residues. Further, about half of the AlphaFold3 ranking scores on high confidence protein-protein interactions (PPIs) not associated with a PDB structure are below 0.5 indicating that PIONEER2 offers superior interface prediction for a large number of PPIs for which structures are not available. items.title: Elevated CO2 Reshapes the 3D Chromatin Landscape of Arabidopsis thaliana
items.title_zh: 升高CO2重塑拟南芥的三维染色质结构
items.summary_zh: 大气CO2水平迅速上升，但植物在基因组层面的响应尚不清楚。染色质在细胞核中的三维组织是基因表达和环境响应的关键调节因子，染色质结构的变化可以通过表观遗传机制在世代间传递。本研究发现，升高的CO2与拟南芥的广泛三维染色质重组相关，涉及从染色体范围的区室身份到千碱基分辨率的局部染色质域（LCDs）和LCD相关环（LALs）。通过在四种突变背景下进行染色质构象捕获和测序（Hi-C），我们显示这些变化在升高CO2条件下自交后代中表现出世代间的持续性，并且这种持续性对RNA导向的DNA甲基化（RdDM）途径的Pol V分支敏感。我们注释了2,279个LCD，其边界富集了被染色质沉默因子Pol V和LHP1占据的可转位元件位点，约三分之一的LCD边界是LALs。升高的CO2与LAL减弱和H3K27me3标记的LCD边界转录本丰度变化相关，暗示了RdDM和多梳组（PcG）活性在染色质响应中的协调作用。
items.abstract: Atmospheric CO2 levels are rising rapidly, yet how plants respond at the genomic level remains poorly understood. The three-dimensional (3D) organization of chromatin in the nucleus is a key regulator of gene expression and environmental response, and changes in chromatin architecture can be transmitted across generations through epigenetic mechanisms. Here, we report that elevated CO2 is associated with broad 3D chromatin reorganization in Arabidopsis thaliana, spanning scales from chromosome-wide compartment identity to kilobase-resolution Local Chromatin Domains (LCDs) and LCD-Associated Loops (LALs). Using chromatin conformation capture and sequencing (Hi-C) across four mutant backgrounds, we show that these changes exhibit intergenerational persistence in the self-fertilized progeny of plants grown at elevated CO2, and that this persistence is sensitive to the Pol V branch of the RNA-directed DNA Methylation (RdDM) pathway rather than to upstream small RNA biogenesis. At kilobase resolution, we annotated 2,279 LCDs whose borders are enriched for transposable element loci occupied by the chromatin-silencing members Pol V and LHP1, and near a third of LCD borders are LALs. items.title: Early adversity promotes adolescent avoidance behavior by enhancing prefrontal-amygdala communication through CRH+ glutamatergic neurons
items.title_zh: 早期逆境通过CRH+谷氨酸能神经元增强前额叶-杏仁核沟通促进青少年回避行为
items.summary_zh: 早期生活逆境（ELA）对情绪回路功能产生持久影响。早期虐待、忽视或家庭不稳定的经历与威胁评估和反应的持久改变相关，这些改变是情绪和焦虑障碍的特征。我们识别出一种应激敏感的内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）-基底外侧杏仁核通路，该通路共同表达促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素（CRH）和谷氨酸。研究发现，ELA增强了这一通路，并在青少年时期增加了威胁回避行为。光遗传学抑制和发育阶段CRH敲低均能拯救ELA引起的青少年回避行为增加，而在正常饲养的小鼠中广泛降低mPFC CRH表达则模拟了ELA表型。这些操作在成年鼠中未产生行为影响。我们的研究表明，特定细胞类型的CRH信号调节发育回路的可塑性，偏向情绪回路功能，并可能导致精神疾病的脆弱性。
items.abstract: Early life adversity (ELA) has lasting impacts on emotion circuit function1. Exposure to early maltreatment, neglect, or household instability is associated with enduring alterations in threat evaluation and response, hallmarks of mood and anxiety disorders2-4. These alterations often emerge during adolescence and are characterized by excessive avoidance that limits engagement in rewarding experiences5,6. However, the neurodevelopmental mechanisms linking ELA to increased threat responses remain unclear. We identified a stress-sensitive medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC)-basolateral amygdala pathway that co-expresses corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH) and glutamate. We find that ELA strengthens this pathway and increases threat avoidance behavior during adolescence. Optogenetic inhibition and developmental CRH knockdown in this pathway both rescue ELA-induced elevations in adolescent avoidance, whereas broadly reducing mPFC CRH expression in typically reared mice mimics ELA phenotypes. The same manipulations produced no behavioral effects in adults. Together, our findings indicate that cell type-specific CRH signaling regulates developmental circuit plasticity, biasing emotional ci

items.title: Selective abundance of miR-290-295 in the adult Substantia Nigra dopamine neurons is neuroprotective via preservation of protein synthesis
items.title_zh: 成年黑质多巴胺神经元中miR-290-295的选择性丰度及其神经保护作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于成年黑质致密部（SNpc）中的多巴胺（DA）神经元，发现miR-290-295簇在这些神经元中特异性表达，能够防止运动缺陷并维持多巴胺生物合成相关蛋白（如酪氨酸羟化酶、脱羧酶和多巴胺转运蛋白）的适当表达。研究表明，miR-290-295簇的全局敲除会导致成年小鼠SNDA神经元数量减少。通过体外和体内DA细胞特异性功能缺失模型，我们证实了该簇中最丰富的miR-292a-3p直接靶向PTEN，这是一种对抗神经保护性PI3K-AKT-mTOR信号通路的磷酸酶。
items.abstract: Locomotor, reward and other critical functions of the body are regulated by the ventral midbrain, with the central role played by dopamine (DA) neurons. The function of these cells from the early development to maturity is critically dependent on the orchestrated expression of coding and non-coding genes. For example, in the stem cells the miR-290-295 cluster constitutes the majority of expressed microRNAs and is critical for stemness in rodents. During development towards various terminally differentiated lineages, such as neurons, the cells typically switch off transcription of these stem cell-specific microRNAs. Here we report that within the adult Substantia Nigra pars compacta (SNpc), the miR-290-295 cluster is exclusively expressed in DA neurons (SNDA), preventing the locomotor deficits and maintaining an adequate expression of proteins involved in DA biogenesis, such as tyrosine hydroxylase (TH), dopa decarboxylase (DDC) and DA transporter (DAT). Importantly, a global knock-out of the miR-290-295 cluster leads to decreased numbers of SNDA neurons in adult mice. items.title: Reprogramming mRNA localization by targeted RNA-protein interference reveals roles in oncogenesis
items.title_zh: 靶向RNA-蛋白干扰重编程mRNA定位揭示其在肿瘤发生中的作用
items.summary_zh: RNA结合蛋白（RBP）与RNA在复杂的核糖核蛋白复合物中结合，调控RNA生命周期的各个方面及细胞功能。尽管其重要性显著，阐明特定RNA-RBP结合事件的功能贡献仍然具有挑战性。本文利用CRISPR/dCas13的特异性干扰特定RNA-RBP相互作用，应用于招募RNA结合蛋白CNBP的GA富集mRNA定位元件，作为mRNA运输复合物的组装平台。结果表明，dCas13/gRNA以高度特异的方式结合目标转录本，干扰CNBP招募，导致目标mRNA定位和细胞运动性改变，与靶向mRNA的功能一致。我们描述了该系统稳定实施的优化和注意事项，并进一步显示干扰GA含量的NET1 mRNA定位可降低癌细胞的侵袭性和转移性肺部定植。这些数据揭示了mRNA定位在肿瘤进展中的潜在作用，并展示了该CRISPR系统在体内长期研究RNA-RBP相互作用的应用。
items.abstract: RNA binding proteins (RBPs) associate with RNAs in intricate ribonucleoprotein complexes and regulate various aspects of RNA life cycle and, by extension, cell functions. Despite their significance, elucidating the functional contributions of specific RNA-RBP binding events, particularly in long-term phenotypic assays, remains challenging. Here, we harness the specificity of CRISPR/dCas13 to interfere with specific RNA-RBP interactions. We apply this methodology to GA-rich mRNA localization elements which recruit the RNA-binding protein CNBP and serve as platforms for the assembly of mRNA trabicking complexes. We show that dCas13/gRNA binds to target transcripts in a highly specific manner and interferes with CNBP recruitment leading to altered target mRNA localization and cell motility, consistent with the function of the targeted mRNAs. We describe optimizations and considerations for the stable implementation of this system. We further use it to show that interfering with the localization of the GA-containing NET1 mRNA reduces cancer cell invasiveness and metastatic lung colonization. These data reveal a potential role for mRNA localization in oncogenic progression and illustrat
items.authors: Mason, D.; Bandyopadhyay, D.; Jiwnani, N.; Meyer, B.; Garcia Jimenez, I.; Iglesias-Bartolome, R.; Mili, S.

items.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals cell-type-specific circadian rhythms and their disruption by acute misalignment in mouse aorta
items.title_zh: 小鼠主动脉单细胞转录组揭示细胞特异性昼夜节律及其急性失调
items.summary_zh: 昼夜分子时钟是影响心血管功能的24小时细胞时间计。昼夜时钟因与光暗周期失调而受到干扰，已与心血管疾病发生率增加及心血管风险因素上升相关。然而，失调如何影响血管的细胞类型特异性分子机制尚不清楚。为此，我们对雄性和雌性小鼠在ZT0、ZT6、ZT12和ZT18的主动脉进行了单细胞RNA测序，比较了对齐和急性失调（6小时相位提前）光暗周期下的样本。通过贝叶斯变分推断，我们估计了141,752个细胞的后验波形，并在血管平滑肌细胞和成纤维细胞中识别出数百个循环基因。通路和转录因子富集分析显示胆固醇生物合成、平滑肌收缩和细胞外基质组织中的协调昼夜活动。值得注意的是，参与表型转换的平滑肌细胞基因显示出协调的时间模式，促进转换的基因在黄昏达到峰值，而抑制转换的基因在黎明达到峰值。比较雄性和雌性，我们发现雌性平滑肌细胞的节律性更强，幅度更高，循环基因几乎是雄性的两倍。
items.abstract: The circadian molecular clock is a 24 hour cellular timekeeper that influences many features of cardiovascular function. Disruption of the circadian clock via misalignment with the light dark cycle is associated with a higher incidence of cardiovascular disease and raises cardiovascular risk factors in humans. Nonetheless, the cell type specific molecular basis for how misalignment affects the vasculature remains poorly understood. To address this, we performed single cell RNA sequencing from whole mouse aorta at ZT0, ZT6, ZT12, and ZT18 under aligned and acutely misaligned (6 hour phase advance) light dark cycles in both male and female mice. Leveraging Bayesian variational inference, we estimated posterior waveforms for 141,752 cells across four major cell types and identified hundreds of cycling genes in vascular smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and fibroblasts. Pathway and transcription factor enrichment analyses revealed coordinated circadian activity in cholesterol biosynthesis, smooth muscle contraction, and extracellular matrix organization. items.authors: Auerbach, B. J.; Lordan, R.; Tang, S. Y.; Hennessy, E.; Anderson, S. T.; Das, U. S.; McConnell, R.; Li, M.; FitzGerald, G. A.

items.title: Questioning the G2 phase in the budding yeast cell cycle with a qualitative and possibilistic model
items.title_zh: 质疑酵母细胞周期中的G2期：定性与可能性模型研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对酵母菌S. cerevisiae这一细胞周期研究的基础模型，探讨其复杂的相位组织（G1、S、G2/M）及其由检查点控制的细胞遗传传递的准确性。G2期的存在仍存在争议，有观点认为应为前中期。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了一种离散事件、定性和可能性模型，首次将细胞器级别的组件（复制叉、姐妹染色体、有丝分裂纺锤体、芽）整合在一起，同时保持简洁。与分子中心或过于复杂的全细胞模型不同，该方法在广泛的系统性和细致的机制尺度之间架起了桥梁。结果表明，该模型忠实地再现了细胞周期进程，并支持G2期的可有可无性。该可能性模型借鉴了生态学中的最新应用，支持前中期的必要性。本研究提供了一个统一且灵活的框架，以解决酵母细胞动态中的长期模糊性，同时避免过度复杂性或还原主义的陷阱。
items.abstract: The budding yeast S. cerevisiae, a foundational model for cell cycle studies, exhibits a complex phase organisation (G1, S, G2/M) governed by checkpoints ensuring faithful cellular inheritance. However, the existence of a distinct G2 phase in yeast remains debated, with some advocating for a prometaphase instead. To address this issue, we developed a discrete-event, qualitative, and possibilistic model, the first one to our knowledge, to integrate organelle-level components (replication forks, sister chromatids, mitotic spindle, bud) while remaining parsimonious. Unlike molecular-centred or overly complex whole-cell models, this approach bridges broad systemic and finer mechanistic scales. Our results demonstrate that the model faithfully recapitulates cell cycle progression and supports the dispensable G2 phase. This possibilistic model inspired from recent applications in ecology advocates in favor of the necessity of prometaphase. This study thus provides a unifying and flexible framework to resolve long-standing ambiguities in yeast cell dynamics, while avoiding the pitfalls of excessive complexity or reductionism.
items.authors: Faure, A.; Liakopoulos, D.; Gaucherel, C.

items.title: Presynaptic mechanism of epileptiform activities in forward-programmed human excitatory neuronal networks
items.title_zh: 前向编程人类兴奋性神经网络的癫痫样活动突触前机制
items.summary_zh: 癫痫是最常见的神经系统疾病之一，但控制癫痫发作终止的机制仍不清楚。特别是，节律性尖波放电在停止前减速的原因尚未解释。我们使用通过靶向前向编程分化的人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生的兴奋性神经元，报告了在培养神经网络中观察到的类似减速现象。这些网络表现出谷氨酸依赖的癫痫样“超级爆发”，其节奏从约4 Hz减缓至约2 Hz。通过结合计算机模拟和体外实验，我们将这种活动模式与突触前囊泡池的层次组织相关联。嵌套爆发与回收池（RP）相关，子爆发与随时可释放池（RRP）相关。RP到RRP的囊泡转运减速缩短了超级爆发，表明癫痫样动态在很大程度上依赖于这一转运过程。这些发现将源自前向编程细胞的人类神经网络描绘为癫痫学的模型，揭示了兴奋性网络中节律性放电的突触前框架。
items.abstract: Epilepsy is one of the most common neurological disorders, yet the mechanisms controlling seizure termination remain poorly understood. In particular, why rhythmic spike-wave discharges decelerate before stopping is unexplained. Here, using human iPSC-derived excitatory neurons differentiated via targeted forward-programming, we report a similar deceleration phenomenon in cultured neuronal networks. These networks exhibit glutamate-dependent, epileptiform 'super-bursts' with a slowing rhythm from ~4 Hz to ~2 Hz. Combining in silico simulations and in vitro experiments, we correlate this activity pattern with the hierarchical organization of presynaptic vesicle pools. Nested bursts link to the recycling pool (RP), and sub-bursts associate with the readily releasable pool (RRP). Decelerating RP-to-RRP vesicle translocation shortened the super-bursts, indicating that epileptiform dynamics depend heavily on this translocation process. These findings depict human neuronal networks derived from forward-programmed cells as a model for epileptology, revealing a presynaptic framework for rhythmic discharges in excitatory networks.
items.authors: Wen, J.; Li, J.; Peitz, M.; Bruestle, O.

items.title: Coupling lysosomal polarity and purinergic signaling regulates B cell activation
items.title_zh: 溶酶体极性与嘌呤能信号调控B细胞激活
items.summary_zh: B细胞激活由B细胞受体（BCR）与固定抗原结合引发，进而促使细胞极性变化，建立免疫突触。本文研究了与炎症相关的经典危险信号三磷酸腺苷（ATP）对B细胞功能的影响。研究发现，B细胞释放的ATP及外源性添加的ATP促进了固定抗原的提取和呈递。内源性ATP由招募至免疫突触的线粒体产生，并通过Pannexin 1通道局部释放，以维持免疫突触的嘌呤能信号。我们识别到P2RX4通过Rab6a+转高尔基体网络和VAMP7+/LAMP1+溶酶体转运至质膜是该反应的关键步骤。此外，免疫突触处P2RX4的局部激活触发了B细胞从活动状态向静止状态的迁移转变，表明该受体作为B细胞迁移的负调节因子。这些发现揭示了ATP作为B细胞功能的局部增强因子，以及P2RX4在B细胞激活中的意外分子开关作用。
items.abstract: B cell activation is initiated by engagement of the B cell receptor (BCR) with immobilized antigens, which triggers changes in cell polarity promoting the establishment of an immune synapse that is further shaped by signals from the microenvironment. However, how cell polarity coordinates the sensing of extracellular cues to regulate B cell activation remains unclear. Here, we investigated the impact of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), a conventional danger signal related to inflammation, on B cell function. We found that ATP released by B cells, as well as exogenously added ATP, acts as a promoter of the extraction and presentation of immobilized antigens. Endogenous ATP was produced by mitochondria recruited at the immune synapse and locally released via Pannexin 1 channels to sustain purinergic signaling at the immune synapse. We identified P2RX4 trafficking to the plasma membrane through the Rab6a+ trans-Golgi network and VAMP7+/LAMP1+ lysosomes as a key step in this response. In addition, the local activation of P2RX4 at the immune synapse triggered a migratory switch from motile to sessile, suggesting that this receptor acts as a negative regulator of B cell migration. items.title: Mechanistic Investigation of Reversible Hibernation-Driven Immune Suppression in Thirteen-Lined Ground Squirrels
items.title_zh: 对十三条纹地松鼠可逆冬眠驱动免疫抑制的机制研究
items.summary_zh: 冬眠是哺乳动物的一种状态，尽管其对能量的极大限制，但其对免疫系统的影响尚不清楚。本研究结合单细胞RNA测序和脾脏组织免疫细胞群体的定量图像分析，探讨了自然冬眠者十三条纹地松鼠在冬眠期间的免疫重塑。结果显示，冬眠脾脏的白髓显著收缩，适应性免疫细胞（B细胞和T细胞）富集的区域减少，而先天性髓系细胞相对保存。免疫细胞谱系中出现了一种保守的转录程序，表现为糖酵解、细胞周期进程、RNA加工和翻译的抑制，以及葡萄糖转运蛋白表达的降低和冷休克RNA结合蛋白的诱导。尽管代谢活动普遍低下，免疫细胞仍保持谱系特征，B细胞数量和转录水平下降与滤泡重塑相关，T细胞则进入一种静息、抗压状态而无凋亡富集。先天性细胞群体数量保持丰富，但转录受到限制，符合低能量组织监测而非炎症激活。这些发现表明，冬眠是一种协调的、可逆的免疫抑制状态。
items.abstract: Torpor in mammals imposes extreme energetic constraints, yet how it reshapes the immune system remains poorly understood. Here we combined single-cell RNA sequencing with quantitative image analysis of immune cell populations in splenic tissues to define immune remodeling during torpor in a natural hibernator, 13-lined ground squirrels. The torpid spleen showed a significant contraction of white pulp with a preferential reduction of B cell- and T cell-rich adaptive niches and relative preservation of innate myeloid populations. Across immune cell lineages, a conserved transcriptional program of metabolic downscaling emerged, marked by suppression of glycolysis, cell-cycle progression, RNA processing, and translation, together with reduced glucose transporter expression and induction of cold-shock RNA-binding proteins. Despite this pervasive metabolic quiescence, immune cells maintain lineage identity, with B cells undergoing numerical and transcriptional contraction linked to follicular remodeling and T cells adopting a quiescent, stress-resistant state without apoptotic enrichment. items.title: Differential Associations of Postoperative Plasma and Cerebrospinal Fluid Albumin Changes with Delirium Following Non-Cardiac Surgery
items.title_zh: 术后血浆与脑脊液白蛋白变化与谵妄的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：术后脑脊液（CSF）与血浆白蛋白比率（CPAR）增加与术后谵妄（POD）及住院时间延长相关，但血浆与CSF白蛋白变化的贡献尚不明确。目的：探讨术后24小时内血浆与CSF白蛋白变化是否独立与POD及住院时间相关。方法：在老年非心脏手术患者中，术前及术后24小时测量血浆和CSF白蛋白浓度。采用多变量逻辑回归和负二项回归模型评估白蛋白变化与POD或住院时间的关联，调整年龄、基线认知、手术类型和液体管理。结果：240名患者中，31名（13.3%）出现POD。术前至术后24小时，血浆白蛋白（中位数3.95降至3.43 g/dL，p<0.001）和CSF白蛋白（中位数22.68降至20.43 mg/dL，p<0.001）均下降。血浆白蛋白的显著下降（每0.43 g/dL）独立与POD（OR 2.14, 95% CI 1.28-3.58; p=0.004）及住院时间延长（平均比率1.44, 95% CI 1.26-1.64; p<0.001）相关，而CSF白蛋白变化（每5.8 mg/dL增加）与POD无关（OR 0.97, 95% CI 0.60-1.58; p=0.91），但与住院时间延长有一定关联。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Postoperative increases in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to plasma albumin ratio (CPAR), a blood-brain barrier dysfunction marker, have been associated with postoperative delirium (POD) and prolonged hospital stay. However, the contributions of plasma versus CSF albumin changes remain unclear. AIM: To determine whether 24-hour postoperative changes in plasma and CSF albumin are independently associated with POD and hospital length of stay. METHODS: Plasma and CSF albumin concentrations were measured before and 24-hours postoperatively in older non-cardiac surgery patients. Multivariable logistic and negative binomial regression models evaluated associations between albumin changes and POD or hospital length of stay, adjusting for age, baseline cognition, surgery type, and fluid administration. RESULTS: Of 240 patients, 31 (13.3%) developed POD. From before to 24-hours after surgery, both plasma albumin (median 3.95 to 3.43 g/dL, p<0.001) and CSF albumin decreased (median 22.68 to 20.43 mg/dL, p<0.001). items.title: Boosting vaccination uptake using wastewater surveillance: a county-randomized controlled trial
items.title_zh: 利用废水监测提升疫苗接种率的县级随机对照试验
items.summary_zh: 疫苗犹豫仍然是公共卫生面临的主要挑战，亟需有效策略提升疫苗接种率。本研究开展了一项县级随机试验，评估基于社区废水监测警报的社交媒体活动是否能提高COVID-19和流感疫苗接种率。选取了40个纽约州县进行为期11周的活动，其中20个县为干预组，20个县为对照组。活动共产生超过1660万次展示，点击行动链接超过77,000次，显示出公众参与度显著。在活动期间，干预县每10万人每周接种的COVID-19疫苗剂量显著高于对照县（{beta} = 76.7, P = 0.01），但流感疫苗剂量则显著低于对照县（{beta}= -140.9, P = 0.04）。然而，季节性分析显示两组在COVID-19和流感疫苗接种率上没有显著差异。这些发现突显了社区废水监测警报在促进疫苗接种方面的潜力。
items.abstract: Vaccine hesitancy remains a major public health challenge, highlighting the need for effective strategies to boost vaccine uptake. We conducted a county-randomized trial to evaluate whether a social media campaign grounded in alerts driven by community-level wastewater surveillance could increase COVID-19 and influenza vaccination. Forty New York State counties were selected for an 11-week campaign during fall 2024, with 20 counties assigned to the intervention and 20 serving as controls. The campaign reached more than 16.6 million impressions, with over 77K clicks on the call-to-action link, demonstrating substantial public engagement. During the campaign period, intervention counties administered significantly more COVID-19 vaccine doses ({beta} = 76.7, P = 0.01) but fewer influenza vaccine doses ({beta}= -140.9, P = 0.04) per 100,000 residents per week than control counties. However, season-level analysis showed no significant differences in COVID-19 or influenza vaccination uptake between groups. These findings highlight the potential of alerts from community-level wastewater surveillance to promote vaccination.
items.authors: Blatz, M. N.; Neigel, D.; Larsen, D. A.; Kmush, B. L.

items.title: Evaluating Nursing Performance During Heatwave Simulations: Protocol for a Repeated Measures Cross-Over Study
items.title_zh: 热浪模拟下护理表现评估研究方案
items.summary_zh: 本研究方案结合临床模拟与气候室实验，评估1）热应激对医院护士生理负担、身体和心理疲劳、警觉性及临床表现的影响；2）实用降温干预（如电风扇）在缓解热应激负面影响的有效性。研究对象为在医院工作的英国注册成人护士，采用重复测量交叉设计，进行五个分别为3小时的实验会话，模拟临床工作，地点为南安普敦综合医院气候室。实验会话的环境温度和降温干预分别为：1）对照组（CTR；18℃，相对湿度50%）；2）温暖组（WARM；26℃，50%RH）；3）温暖加电风扇组（WARM+FAN；26℃，50%RH）；4）炎热组（HOT；34℃，50%RH）；5）炎热加电风扇组（HOT+FAN；34℃，50%RH）。本研究已在公开临床试验注册中心注册（ISRCTN45793399）。每个会话中，参与者首先完成标准化疲劳诱导协议，模拟轮班工作（即低强度骑行与认知任务），随后进行模拟医院查房，涉及六名模拟患者和两个模拟心脏骤停场景。
items.abstract: This study protocol combines clinical simulations with climatic chamber experiments, to evaluate 1) the impact of heat stress on hospital nurses physiological strain, physical and mental fatigue, vigilance, and clinical performance; and 2) the efficacy of a practical cooling intervention (i.e. electric fan) in mitigating the negative impact of heat stress. UK-based, registered adult nurses working in hospital settings will be recruited to partake in a repeated-measures cross-over design study, consisting of five separate 3-hour experimental sessions simulating clinical work, and taking place within a climatic chamber at Southampton General Hospital (UK). Sessions will differ by ambient temperature and cooling intervention as follows: 1) control (CTR; 18{degrees}C, 50% relative humidity [RH]); 2) warm (WARM; 26{degrees}C, 50%RH); 3) warm with electric fan (WARM+FAN; 26{degrees}C, 50%RH); 4) hot (HOT; 34{degrees}C, 50%RH); 5) hot with electric fan (HOT+FAN; 34{degrees}C, 50%RH). This study has been registered on a publicly accessible clinical trial registry (ISRCTN45793399). items.title: Urine DNA methylation as a potential diagnostic and surveillance tool in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer in Thailand: A pilot study
items.title_zh: 尿液DNA甲基化在泰国非肌肉侵袭性膀胱癌中的诊断潜力研究
items.summary_zh: 非肌肉侵袭性膀胱癌（NMIBC）复发率高，需频繁进行侵入性监测。本研究旨在探讨泰国患者NMIBC的尿液DNA甲基化模式。纳入5名高分级NMIBC患者和3名健康志愿者，收集经尿道膀胱肿瘤切除术（TUR-BT）前的中段尿液和血液样本。提取尿液游离DNA（cfDNA），并通过细胞游离甲基化DNA免疫沉淀结合高通量测序（cfMeDIP-seq）进行分析。共识别出82个差异甲基化区域（DMRs），其中76个为高甲基化，6个为低甲基化，IRX4、TBX5和MIR124-3为主要高甲基化基因。经过剔除两个异常样本（UC2和UC3）的亚组分析，发现476个显著DMRs（449个高甲基化）。主成分分析（PCA）显示NMIBC与对照组之间有明显的分离，强调了MIR124-3的重要性。
items.abstract: Non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) exhibits high recurrence, necessitating frequent invasive surveillance. Urine DNA methylation profiling represents a promising non-invasive biomarker approach for early detection and monitoring. This pilot study aimed to investigate urine DNA methylation patterns in NMIBC among Thai patients. Five patients with high-grade NMIBC and three healthy volunteers were enrolled, and midstream urine and blood samples were collected prior to transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TUR-BT). Urine cell-free DNA (cfDNA) was extracted, mechanically sheared from an atypical peak of approximately 400 bp to an optimal target length of 150-200 bp, and analyzed using cell-free methylated DNA immunoprecipitation followed by high-throughput sequencing (cfMeDIP-seq). Differentially methylated regions (DMRs) were identified between NMIBC and controls, and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed. A total of 82 DMRs were identified (adjusted P < 0.001), including 76 hypermethylated and 6 hypomethylated regions, with IRX4, TBX5, and MIR124-3 representing the top hypermethylated genes. items.title: Promising prognostic factors in Cutaneous Leishmaniasis in regions of Leishmaniavirus 1 circulation
items.title_zh: 皮肤利什曼病中有前景的预后因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：皮肤利什曼病（CL）由利什曼原虫（Viannia）引起，可能导致寄生虫从主要皮肤病变扩散至临床健康的粘膜部位，这一过程可能与粘膜利什曼病的发展相关。寄生虫负荷和利什曼病毒1（LRV1）被认为是影响寄生虫持续性、扩散及治疗反应的因素。我们研究了皮肤病变中的寄生虫负荷和LRV1检测是否与临床健康的鼻粘膜中的利什曼原虫相关，并在部分患者中评估了其与治疗结果的关系。方法：我们进行了前瞻性观察性队列研究。在巴西亚马逊州隆多尼亚的局限性皮肤利什曼病患者中，通过qPCR评估皮肤病变和临床健康鼻粘膜中的寄生虫负荷和LRV1。样本在治疗前（D0）、治疗结束时（D20）和随访期间（D90-180）进行评估。在178名筛查患者中，113名确诊为CL。LRV1在皮肤病变中检测到的比例为34.51%，在鼻粘膜中为24.13%。在临床健康的鼻粘膜中检测到利什曼DNA的患者占12.38%。皮肤病变中LRV1的检测与鼻粘膜中利什曼原虫的检测相关。较高的寄生虫负荷与LRV1检测呈正相关。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) caused by Leishmania (Viannia) may involve parasite dissemination from the primary skin lesion to clinically healthy mucosal sites, a process potentially relevant to the development of mucosal leishmaniasis. Parasite burden and Leishmania RNA Virus 1 (LRV1) have been proposed as factors influencing parasite persistence, dissemination, and treatment response. We investigated whether parasite load and LRV1 detection in skin lesions were associated with Leishmania in clinically healthy nasal mucosa and, in a subset of patients, with therapeutic outcome. We also assessed the relationship between LRV1 and parasite load. Methodology/Principal findings We conducted a prospective observational cohort study. Parasite load and LRV1 were assessed by qPCR in skin lesions and clinically healthy nasal mucosa from patients with localized cutaneous leishmaniasis in Rondonia, Brazilian Amazon. Samples were evaluated before treatment (D0), at the end of treatment (D20), and during follow-up (D90-180). Among 178 patients screened, CL was confirmed in 113. items.title: Evaluating prescriber preferences for the treatment of indeterminate Chagas disease (EPPIC study): an international survey
items.title_zh: 评估处方医生对不确定型查加斯病治疗的偏好（EPPIC研究）：国际调查
items.summary_zh: 背景：苯达唑（BNZ）和尼夫替莫克斯（NFX）是目前唯一批准的克鲁斯锥虫感染治疗药物，但均伴随频繁的不良药物反应（ADRs）、较长的治疗周期和有限的可及性，导致治疗依从性差和提前停药。本研究旨在识别处方医生定义的疗效阈值及影响其对新抗寄生虫方案偏好的因素。方法：我们于2024年6月至8月在流行病和非流行病国家的医疗提供者、研究人员和公共卫生从业者中进行了一项国际横断面网络调查。结果：50名受邀参与者中有30人完成调查（60%响应率）；大多数为医生或护士（57%），76%具有超过六年的查加斯病经验。
items.abstract: Background: Benznidazole (BNZ) and nifurtimox (NFX) remain the only approved treatments for Trypanosoma cruzi infection, but both are associated with frequent adverse drug reactions (ADRs), long treatment duration, and limited accessibility, resulting in poor treatment adherence and premature discontinuation. Recent clinical trials have evaluated shorter and lower-dose regimens; however, the minimum level of efficacy considered acceptable by healthcare providers - in the context of improved safety and greater accessibility - has not been systematically investigated. This study aimed to identify prescriber-defined efficacy thresholds and the factors influencing prescribing preferences for new antiparasitic regimens for Chagas disease. Methods: We conducted an international, cross-sectional, web-based survey between June and August 2024 among healthcare providers, researchers, and public health practitioners with experience in Chagas disease from endemic and non-endemic countries. items.title: Confounder-Adjusted Plasma Proteomics Identify Robust Protein Signatures in Sepsis Across Two Independent Perioperative Control Cohorts
items.title_zh: 调整混杂因素的血浆蛋白组学在脓毒症中识别稳健蛋白特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：脓毒症是重症监护中主要的死亡原因。个性化医学需要准确理解该综合征，血浆蛋白组学越来越多地用于表征其分子变化。合并症、人口统计学特征和术后无菌炎症使这一任务复杂化，相关蛋白可能被误认为是脓毒症特异性。方法：我们比较了343名脓毒症患者与两个独立的围手术期对照队列（n = 73和n = 75），样本采集于手术前后。通过质谱分析血浆，并使用线性模型调整年龄、性别和特定队列的合并症。采用倾向评分匹配来表征肾脏合并症，并为每个队列和时间点训练Elastic Net分类器。结果：我们发现肾脏合并症对血浆蛋白组有最强影响，影响脓毒症相关蛋白，包括Cystatin-C和Beta-2-microglobulin。11种蛋白与脓毒症稳健相关，其中包括已知的急性期蛋白和较少研究的Beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase 1。特征重要性分析确认了这一核心集合，并识别出在队列和时间点特异性贡献的其他蛋白。分类器表现良好，但在术后第3天对照患者中表现不佳。
items.abstract: Background Sepsis is the primary driver of mortality in intensive care. Personalized medicine requires an accurate understanding of the syndrome, and plasma proteomics is increasingly used to characterize its molecular alterations. Comorbidities, demographics and postoperative sterile inflammation complicate this task, and proteins associated with them may be mistaken as sepsis-specific. Methods We compared 343 sepsis patients with two independent perioperative control cohorts (n = 73 and n = 75) sampled before and after surgery. Plasma was analyzed by mass spectrometry, and analyzed using linear models adjusted for age, sex and cohort-specific comorbidities. Propensity score matching was used to characterize renal comorbidities and Elastic Net classifiers were trained per cohort and time point. Results We show that renal comorbidities had the strongest impact on the plasma proteome and affected sepsis-associated proteins including Cystatin-C and Beta-2-microglobulin. Eleven proteins were robustly associated with sepsis, among them established acute phase proteins and the less well characterized Beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase 1. items.title: PATIENT PROFILING AND OUTCOME OF ANTIHYPERTENSIVE TREATMENT. An Exploratory Analysis of the VALUE Trial.
items.title_zh: 抗高血压治疗的患者特征与结果分析
items.summary_zh: 背景 随机结果试验已显示抗高血压治疗的益处，但针对患者特征的亚组分析通常基于单一因素，而非综合患者特征。我们假设，结合多个个体预测因子能够更好地识别出更可能或不太可能实现血压控制的患者。方法 为验证我们的假设，我们重新分析了双盲VALUE结果试验的数据（n=15,313）。患者群体分为探索性队列（2/3）和验证队列（1/3）。我们通过结合四个已证明的血压控制预测因子（年龄、高血压严重程度、合并症和既往治疗状态）构建了综合患者特征。使用逻辑回归和Cox比例风险模型测试不同特征间的血压控制和心血管事件发生率差异，以及特征分析是否提供了超越单一因素的额外预测信息。结果 不同患者特征间的血压控制率显著不同（似然比检验，p<0.001），探索性队列的结果在验证队列中可重复。特征分析对血压控制的预测显著优于任何单一因素（所有比较p<0.001）。此外，结果显示...
items.abstract: Background Randomized outcome trials have shown the benefit of antihypertensive treatment, but subgroup analyses exploring treatment responses in relation to patient characteristics are usually based on single factors rather than comprehensive patient profiles. We hypothesized that a combination of individual predictors better identifies patients who are more or less likely to achieve blood pressure (BP) control. Methods To test our hypothesis, we reanalysed the data from the double-blinded VALUE-outcome trial (n=15,313). The patient population was divided into an exploratory cohort (2/3) and a validation cohort (1/3). We constructed composite patient profiles by combining four proven predictors of BP control: age, severity of hypertension, comorbidity and previous treatment status. Logistic regression and Cox proportional hazard models were used to test whether BP control and cardiovascular event rates differed among these profiles, and whether profiling conferred additional predictive information beyond the individual factors alone. items.title: Protective effect of influenza vaccine in Brazilian patients hospitalised for severe acute respiratory infection, 2023-2025
items.title_zh: 2023-2025年巴西重症急性呼吸感染患者流感疫苗保护效应
items.summary_zh: 引言：尽管2025年巴西流感负担显著增加，但相关疫苗有效性未涵盖冬季末期。方法：在历年内接种的三价流感疫苗剂量为主要暴露因素，住院死亡率、住院时间、重症监护室（ICU）使用及ICU住院时间为结果指标。分析了2003年1月至2025年10月的次级数据，采用泊松回归法。结果：重症急性呼吸感染（SARI）住院患者的流感疫苗接种率从2023年的约70%下降至2024和2025年的40-50%。接种单剂疫苗的患者与未接种者相比，结果改善10-13%。每年接种两剂显著降低死亡率（32%）、ICU入院率（52%）及ICU住院时间（28%）。结论：每年接种两剂流感疫苗对降低SARI住院流感患者的住院死亡率和住院时间具有中等效果。将50-59岁人群纳入优先接种组可能显著减少与流感相关的不良结果。
items.abstract: Introduction: Despite a significant increase in influenza burden in Brazil in 2025, the associated vaccine effectiveness has not included the key end-of-winter period. Methods: The number of trivalent influenza vaccine doses received within a calendar year was the key exposure. In-hospital mortality and length of stay, use of the intensive care unit (ICU), and ICU stay were outcome measures. Secondary data from January 2003 to October 2025 were retrieved and analysed by Poisson regression. Results: Influenza vaccine uptake among SARI-hospitalised patients dropped from about 70% in 2023 to a 40-50% level in 2024 and 2025. A single vaccine dose reduced outcomes by 10-13% compared to unvaccinated patients. Two doses per year significantly reduced mortality (32%), ICU admissions (52%), and ICU stay (28%). Conclusion: Two doses of influenza vaccine were moderately effective in decreasing in-hospital mortality and stay among SARI-hospitalised influenza patients. Including 50-59-year-olds in a priority vaccination group may significantly reduce influenza-related adverse outcomes.
items.authors: Kupek, E.

items.title: Lessons learned from a trial on integrated and proactive care for patients with complex needs (Hotspotters project): a process evaluation
items.title_zh: 复杂需求患者的综合主动护理试验经验教训
items.summary_zh: 背景：本研究聚焦于因多重生活领域问题而需复杂护理的成年人，及其高急性护理使用率。Hotspotters项目旨在评估综合主动护理对该群体健康结果和医疗成本的影响。我们评估了Hotspotters项目的覆盖率、有效性、采纳、实施和维护（RE-AIM），以识别影响实施和结果的因素。方法：本混合方法研究遵循RE-AIM框架，使用经过验证的问卷、常规护理数据和半结构化访谈。患者和护理提供者的定性数据为定量结果提供了见解。定量数据采用描述性分析（SPSS），访谈记录使用归纳主题内容分析（Atlas.ti）。结果：由于急性护理使用低于预期，符合条件的患者较少（153/1403），后续低入组（n=30）限制了有效性结论。尽管如此，该干预改善了与社会工作的协作，结构化的入院评估被认为有助于了解患者的复杂需求。许多实践将该干预纳入常规护理，尽管纳入过程复杂。护理提供者建议修订目标人群和招募方式，以更好地反映荷兰背景。
items.abstract: Background: This study focused on adults with complex care needs due to problems on multiple life domains and consequent high acute care use. The Hotspotters Project was undertaken to assess the effects of proactive integrated care on health outcomes and healthcare costs in this group. We evaluated the reach, effectiveness, adoption, implementation and maintenance (RE-AIM) of the Hotspotters Project in order to identify factors that influenced implementation and outcomes. Method: This mixed method study followed the RE-AIM-framework, using validated questionnaires, routine care data and semi-structured interviews. Qualitative data from patients and care providers offered insight in the quantitative outcomes. Quantitative data were analyzed descriptively (SPSS), and interview transcripts were analyzed using inductive thematic content analysis (Atlas.ti). Results: As acute care use was lower than expected, few patients were eligible (153/1403) and subsequent low enrollment (n=30) limited conclusions regarding effectiveness. items.title: Evaluation of accelerated whole-body diffusion weighted imaging with deep learning reconstruction in patients with metastatic prostate cancer: assessment of image quality and ADC estimates.
items.title_zh: 加速全身扩散加权成像在转移性前列腺癌患者中的评估
items.summary_zh: 目的：评估使用深度学习重建的加速全身扩散加权MRI（WB-DWI）协议对转移性前列腺癌患者图像质量和表观扩散系数（ADC）量化的影响。方法：本研究为单中心前瞻性研究，涉及两组患者在1.5T下接受标准全身MRI。深度学习WB-DWI采集使用较少的信号平均和更高的并行成像加速，通过基于变分网络的研究应用DL包进行重建。在第一组（n=10）中，由两名盲法放射科医师使用4点Likert量表对四个解剖部位的图像质量进行定性评估。在第二组（n=20）中，评估高细胞性骨转移灶的ADC值，并比较标准与加速DL WB-DWI协议。图像质量评分使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Bonferroni校正）分析，ADC一致性通过Bland-Altman分析评估。结果：加速DL WB-DWI将WB-DWI采集时间缩短37%，且未影响图像质量。放射科医师一致认为两种协议在所有图像质量指标上均为良好至优秀。病灶的中位ADC估计在两种协议间无显著差异。
items.abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the impact of an accelerated whole-body diffusion-weighted MRI (WB-DWI) protocol using deep learning (DL) reconstruction on image quality and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) quantification in patients with metastatic prostate cancer. Methods: This single-centre prospective study involved two patient cohorts undergoing standard-of-care WB-MRI at 1.5T. The DL WB-DWI acquisition used fewer signal averages and higher parallel imaging acceleration, reconstructed with a research application DL package based on a variational network. In Cohort 1 (n = 10), qualitative assessment of image quality was performed across four anatomical stations using a 4-point Likert scale by two radiologists, blinded to the DWI protocol. In Cohort 2 (n = 20), ADC values were evaluated in hypercellular focal bone metastases (as determined by a radiologist) and compared between the standard and accelerated DL WB-DWI protocols. Image quality scores were analysed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (Bonferroni-corrected), and ADC agreement was evaluated via Bland-Altman analysis. Results: Accelerated DL WB-DWI reduced WB-DWI acquisition time by 37% without compromising image quality. Rad

items.title: Longitudinal Drain-Fluid Proteomics Reveals Procedure-Specific Signatures of Postoperative Leakage after Pancreatic and Colorectal Surgery
items.title_zh: 术后漏液的特征：胰腺与结直肠手术的排液蛋白组学研究
items.summary_zh: 吻合口漏是胃肠手术后的主要并发症，早期检测受限于非特异性临床症状和狭窄的生物标志物面板。本研究使用纵向数据独立获取蛋白组学分析了来自33名胰腺手术患者（201个排液样本）和34名结直肠手术患者（143个排液样本）的术后排液。观察窗口最长为术后10天。研究旨在定义特定手术的漏液特征，评估已建立的生物标志物，并识别常规测量蛋白之外的候选标志物。胰腺手术中，已知酶标志物（特别是AMY2A和PNLIP）在漏液与非漏液患者之间表现出强烈的早期区分，而结直肠手术中相同的标志物策略表现不一致。发现分析显示出不同的时间模式，胰腺漏液主要由术后1-3天的酶富集主导，随后是炎症、抗微生物、氧化应激和基质重塑相关蛋白，而结直肠漏液在术后第3天表现出最强的差异，主要由与伤口愈合相关的蛋白丰度降低驱动。
items.abstract: Anastomotic leakage is a major complication after gastrointestinal surgery, yet early detection remains limited by nonspecific clinical signs and narrow biomarker panels. Here, we used longitudinal data-independent acquisition proteomics to profile postoperative drain fluid from two surgical cohorts, comprising 33 pancreatic surgery patients with 201 drain-fluid samples and 34 colorectal surgery patients with 143 drain-fluid samples with an observation window of up to 10 days postoperatively. We aimed to define procedure-specific leakage signatures, evaluate established biomarkers across postoperative time, and identify additional candidate markers beyond routinely measured proteins. In pancreatic surgery, established enzyme markers, particularly AMY2A and PNLIP, showed strong early discrimination between leak and non-leak patients, while in colorectal surgery, the same predefined marker strategy performed less consistently. Discovery analysis revealed divergent temporal patterns. Pancreatic leakage was dominated by early (post-operative day (POD) 1-3) enzyme enrichment followed by inflammatory, antimicrobial, oxidative stress, and matrix-remodeling-associated proteins. items.title: Clinical Meaningfulness of Individual Items of the Brief Ataxia Rating Scale and the Scale for the Assessment and Rating of Ataxia
items.title_zh: 简短共济失调评分量表与共济失调评估量表的临床意义
items.summary_zh: 引言：简短共济失调评分量表（BARS）和共济失调评估量表（SARA）用于量化小脑共济失调的严重程度。本研究调查了临床医生评分与患者功能障碍报告的一致性，患者认为重要的量表项目，以及项目评分的增量变化对患者的意义。方法：30名小脑共济失调患者完成了BARS、SARA、FARS功能分级和日常生活活动重要性问卷。我们研究了BARS和SARA项目评分在患者感知障碍方面的高估或低估情况，并探讨了患者对日常功能相关项目重要性的排名，以及他们对BARS步态和言语0.5分和1分变化的重要性认知。结果：患者认为步态在BARS和SARA中最为重要，其次是眼动（BARS）和站立（SARA）。跟踝测试的重要性最低，两个量表的高估点数相似（BARS为2.65 +/- 2.80，SARA为2.78 +/- 2.78）。60%和46.6%的患者认为BARS步态和言语0.5分变化非常或极其重要，1分变化的比例分别增加至83.3%和70%。结论：步态对小脑共济失调患者最具意义，BARS眼动和SARA站立排名第二。
items.abstract: Introduction The Brief Ataxia Rating Scale (BARS) and Scale for the Assessment and Rating of Ataxia (SARA) are used to quantify cerebellar ataxia severity. We investigated how often clinician ratings match patient reports of functional impairment, which scale items patients consider important, and whether incremental changes in item scores are meaningful to patients. Methods 30 patients with cerebellar ataxia completed BARS, SARA, FARS Functional Staging, and an Importance of Activities of Daily Living questionnaire. We studied BARS and SARA item scores for over- or underestimation in relation to patient perception of impairment. We explored patient rankings of item importance in relation to daily function, and their perception of the likely importance of 0.5- and 1-point changes in BARS gait and speech. Results Patients identified gait as most important on BARS and SARA, followed by oculomotor (BARS) and stance (SARA). Heel-to-shin was least important, with highest overestimation on both scales. items.title: Physiological variability in key Alzheimer's biomarkers in amyloid-positive clinical trial cohorts and the mechanistic basis of biomarker ratios
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病生物标志物的生理变异性及其机制基础
items.summary_zh: 背景：脑脊液（CSF）和血浆中的蛋白质生物标志物已成为神经疾病诊断和监测的重要工具。生理差异（如CSF或血浆体积及清除动力学）也会影响生物标志物的变异性。本研究旨在量化生理因素对个体间生物标志物变异性的贡献，并探讨基于比率的标准化为何能提高生物标志物的表现。方法：利用机制动力学框架和四项III期临床试验（GRADUATE I和II，CREAD和CREAD2）的配对CSF和血浆基线数据，量化常用阿尔茨海默病生物标志物（Aβ40、Aβ42、p-tau181、t-tau）的生理和神经生物学变异性。
items.abstract: Background: Protein biomarkers in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and plasma have established themselves as essential tools for the diagnosis of neurological disorders and for disease monitoring, thanks to their accuracy and clinical validity. Outside their original intended context of use, protein biomarkers are increasingly used in clinical trials to assess the effects of novel therapies on brain biology. Physiological differences across individuals - such as CSF or plasma volume and elimination kinetics - also contribute to biomarker variability. A deeper understanding of these sources of variability is essential to further improve biomarker interpretation, particularly in clinical trials where populations are by design more homogeneous than in real-world diagnostic settings. This study aimed to quantify the contributions of physiological factors to inter-individual biomarker variability, and to identify the mechanistic basis for why ratio-based normalization can lead to enhanced biomarker performance. items.title: Incremental Predictive Value and Representation of Transcriptomic Features for Immunotherapy Response in Advanced Urothelial Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 转录组特征对晚期尿路上皮癌免疫治疗反应的增量预测价值
items.summary_zh: 转录组分析可能改善免疫治疗反应的预测，但其在已建立的临床和肿瘤生物标志物之外的增量价值尚不明确。在IMvigor210试验中，我们对298例晚期尿路上皮癌患者进行了研究，比较了知识引导的肿瘤微环境基因集特征与数据驱动的全转录组基因选择。知识引导特征在仅使用临床变量的基础上，AUPRC提高了0.058，而在加入标准生物标志物（TMB、PD-L1）后仅提高0.011，加入研究丰富的生物标志物（新抗原负担、免疫表型）后提高0.016。数据驱动的基因选择在不同折叠间不稳定（平均Jaccard相似度为0.227），在临床加生物标志物的基线下，AUPRC比知识引导表示低0.150。尽管存在不稳定性，IL-6/JAK/STAT3信号通路是最常见的标志性通路，表明生物学上的通路收敛。外部评估显示类似模式：知识引导特征在临床变量基础上提高AUPRC 0.128，而在临床加生物标志物基础上仅提高0.019。这些发现支持在分子分析中，转录组的生物学信息表示具有增值作用。
items.abstract: Transcriptomic profiling may improve immunotherapy response prediction, but its incremental value beyond established clinical and tumor biomarkers is unclear. In 298 patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma from IMvigor210, an atezolizumab (PD-L1 inhibitor) trial, we compared knowledge-guided tumor microenvironment gene-set features with data-driven transcriptome-wide gene selection. Knowledge-guided features improved AUPRC by 0.058 beyond clinical variables alone, with smaller gains after including standard biomarkers (TMB, PD-L1; +0.011) and research-enriched biomarkers (neoantigen burden, immune phenotype; +0.016). Data-driven gene selection was unstable across folds (mean Jaccard similarity, 0.227) and, under the clinical-plus-biomarker baseline, yielded an AUPRC 0.150 lower than the knowledge-guided representation. Despite this instability, IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling was the most recurrent Hallmark pathway, suggesting pathway-level biological convergence. External evaluation showed a similar pattern: knowledge-guided features improved AUPRC by 0.128 over clinical variables vs. 0.019 over clinical-plus-biomarker baseline. items.title: A Causal Multi-modal AI Model Stratifies Residual Risk and Identifies Candidates for Treatment Escalation in Node-Positive HR+/HER2- Early Breast Cancer
items.title_zh: 因果多模态AI模型评估HR+/HER2-早期乳腺癌残余风险
items.summary_zh: 目的：寻找能够评估标准辅助治疗后残余复发风险的预后生物标志物，以指导进一步治疗升级。本研究使用Ataraxis Breast CTX，一个整合临床变量和组织病理学的因果多模态AI模型，对临床定义的高风险患者进行残余风险分层。方法：CTX结合临床变量与H&E图像特征，生成复发风险（CTX-prognostic）和化疗获益（CTX-benefit）的估计。在III期UNIRAD试验中进行前瞻性-回顾性验证，评估CTX-prognostic在未接受新辅助化疗、已接受辅助化疗且有H&E切片的患者中的表现（n=556）。主要终点为无病生存期（DFS）。结果：CTX-prognostic有效地将患者分为高风险和低风险组，低风险组的5年DFS显著高于高风险组（93%对80%）。
items.abstract: PURPOSE Prognostic biomarkers that estimate residual recurrence risk after standard adjuvant therapy to guide further treatment escalation are an unmet clinical need. This study used Ataraxis Breast CTX, a causal multi-modal AI model integrating clinical variables and histopathology, to stratify residual risk in clinically defined high-risk patients. We aimed to identify patients who have excellent outcomes on standard-of-care chemoendocrine therapy and patients who may benefit from additional therapies such as everolimus or CDK4/6 inhibitors. METHODS CTX combines clinical variables with image features from H&E images to produce estimates of recurrence risk (CTX-prognostic) and chemotherapy benefit (CTX-benefit). Prospective-retrospective validation was performed in the phase III UNIRAD trial to assess CTX-prognostic's performance in the subset of patients who had not received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, who had received adjuvant chemotherapy, and who had H&E slides available (n = 556). The primary endpoint in this study was disease-free survival (DFS). As an exploratory analysis, we evaluated CTX-benefit's ability to predict benefit from adjuvant everolimus. items.title: Chronic intracranial neural dynamics forecast treatment response and therapeutic engagement during deep brain stimulation for OCD
items.title_zh: 慢性颅内神经动态预测强迫症深脑刺激治疗反应
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了24名接受腹侧胶囊/腹侧纹状体深脑刺激治疗难治性强迫症患者的近120,000小时慢性颅内记录。研究发现，在刺激开始前，昼夜节律神经特征能够区分最终的反应者与非反应者。在治疗的前两周内，神经可预测性的降低能够区分最终反应者与非反应者，并与随后症状改善的幅度相关，这一变化发生在稳定临床反应之前的数月。在慢性治疗过程中，神经可预测性能够跟踪临床反应状态。这些发现为深脑刺激治疗过程中的神经生物标志物建立了框架：在刺激前预测治疗反应，在激活后检测早期治疗参与，并纵向监测临床反应。
items.abstract: Clinical improvement following psychiatric neuromodulation often requires weeks to months, creating prolonged uncertainty during treatment optimization. Neural biomarkers could reduce this uncertainty by forecasting treatment outcome, providing early evidence of therapeutic engagement, and objectively tracking clinical response. We analyzed nearly 120,000 patient-hours of chronic intracranial recordings from 24 patients undergoing ventral capsule/ventral striatum deep brain stimulation for treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder. Before stimulation initiation, circadian neural features distinguished eventual responders from non-responders. Within the first two weeks of therapy, reductions in neural predictability differentiated eventual responders from non-responders and correlated with the magnitude of subsequent symptom improvement, months before stable clinical response was achieved. During chronic treatment, neural predictability tracked clinical response state. items.title: Multimodal Prediction of Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma Using Polygenic Risk Scores and Clinical Features in a High-Risk African Ancestry Cohort
items.title_zh: 利用多基因风险评分和临床特征预测高风险非洲血统青光眼
items.summary_zh: 原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）对非洲血统个体的影响尤为显著，但风险预测工具仍然有限。本研究评估了四种多基因风险评分（PGS），包括两种全基因组评分和两种经过整理的评分，均按非洲血统效应大小加权。单独使用时，这些评分的区分能力有限。年龄和性别具有强预测性；添加PGS616后，在训练队列（N = 271）中，交叉验证的AUC达到了0.713，与人口统计模型相当。在宾夕法尼亚医学生物库（N = 9,084）中，该模型的AUC为0.727，接近仅基于年龄和性别的0.729，且在固定特异性下的病例检测相似。在一个可疑队列（N = 1,013）中，预测风险与杯盘比和神经纤维层变薄相关，这种关联可由年龄和性别解释。这些结果为评估与血统匹配的POAG多基因风险评分建立了人口统计基准。
items.abstract: Primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) disproportionately affects individuals of African ancestry, for whom risk prediction tools remain limited. We evaluated four polygenic risk scores (PGS), two genome-wide and two curated, weighted by African ancestry effect sizes. Used alone, the scores showed modest discrimination. Age and sex were strongly predictive; adding PGS616 reached a cross-validated AUC of 0.713 in the training cohort (N = 271), comparable to the demographic model. In the Penn Medicine BioBank (N = 9,084) the model reached AUC = 0.727, similar to 0.729 for age and sex alone, with comparable case detection at fixed specificity. In a suspect cohort (N = 1,013), predicted risk tracked cup-to-disc ratio and nerve fiber layer thinning, an association explained by age and sex. These results establish a demographic benchmark for evaluating ancestry-matched PGS in POAG.

items.title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
items.title_zh: 基于临床医生的AI辅助精神病评估质量保障
items.summary_zh: 在患者使用AI辅助精神病评估系统之前，医疗系统需要有效的方法来定期评估这些工具是否符合临床质量标准。由于临床医生可能采用不同的评估风格，因此该评估必须支持不同访谈方法的比较，减轻临床医生的负担，并测量与健康系统相关的临床表现。我们提出了一个基于临床医生的评估平台，围绕增强记忆的患者模拟器InterviewPlayground构建。通过InterviewPlayground创建了互动患者，并构建了模拟评估平台。初步试验中，6名临床医生在25分钟的评估中与基于GPT的LLM评估者进行比较，LLM识别出更多临床相关项目（88.0% vs. 38.9%），但基于访谈做出的临床推断更多（56.8% vs. 27.8%），且识别安全隐患的频率较低（33.3% vs. 66.7%），为该任务的质量保障奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage
items.authors: King Shi, Amanda Li, Jonathan Ivey, Synthia Qia Wang, Guan Gui, Hyunseo Kim, Peter Zandi, Jason Straub, Jacob Taylor, Ananya Joshi

items.title: Offline Multimodal Large Language Models for Decision Support in Air Operations
items.title_zh: 离线多模态大语言模型在空中行动决策支持中的应用
items.summary_zh: 空中行动依赖复杂规则、既定程序和在有限连接及严格安全约束下的时间敏感分析。本文研究了离线大语言模型作为决策支持工具，在隔离和受限环境中为分析师提供可追溯的教义知识。我们描述了一种适合无互联网连接操作的模块化检索增强架构，支持来自技术手册的文本和图像输入。作为评估该架构的第一步，我们报告了与巴西空军四名图像分析师的初步研究，结合了基于电子目标识别教义的知识评估和在无AI辅助下手动生成侦察目标报告的认知负荷测量。结果显示，该手动任务要求高，尤其在心理需求（6.0/7）和努力程度（5.0/7）方面，而所提系统的表现与人类得分相当（8/10），评估完成时间为7.1分钟。
items.abstract: Air operations rely on complex rules, established procedures, and time-critical analysis under limited connectivity and strict security constraints. In such environments, analysts must combine written doctrine with images, often without access to external computing resources. This paper studies offline large language models as decision support tools, deployed in isolated and restricted environments to give analysts access to doctrinal knowledge that remains traceable to its original sources through natural language interaction. We describe a modular retrieval-augmented architecture suitable for operation without Internet connectivity, supporting both text and image input from technical manuals. As a first step toward evaluating this architecture, we report a pilot study with four image analysts of the Brazilian Air Force, combining (i) a doctrinal knowledge assessment based on their electronic-target identification doctrine, comparing human and proposed system performance on the same test, and (ii) a measurement of the cognitive workload involved in manually producing a reconnaissance target report (Relat\'orio de Miss\~ao de Reconhecimento - REMIR) without AI assistance. items.authors: Joao P. A. Dantas, Jelton A. Cunha, Gabriel Dietzsch

items.title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
items.title_zh: 学习优化：AI原生网络的缺失架构层
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正成为未来AI原生通信网络的基本设计原则，支持自主资源管理、自适应控制和零接触网络操作。当前的AI原生架构在网络功能中嵌入智能，但对如何系统性地生成、转移和利用优化知识提供的指导有限。本文认为，学习优化（L2O）是优化与AI原生智能之间缺失的架构层。该范式将优化算法重新定义为离线知识生成器，为神经代理模型提供高质量的监督信息。所生成的模型继承了优化专业知识，同时支持适合动态网络环境的低延迟运行推理。提出了一个通用的四阶段L2O工作流程，包括优化、知识生成、代理学习和运行推理。与现有的学习优化方法主要关注算法加速不同，所提框架将L2O确立为适用于异构通信和计算系统的架构抽象。
items.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration,
items.authors: Giambattista Amati, Federica Mangiatordi, Pierpaolo Salvo, Emiliano Pallotti, Simone Angelini

items.title: The Stochastic Shift: A New Evaluation Paradigm for Text-to-SQL with AI Operators
items.title_zh: 随机偏移：文本到SQL的新评估范式
items.summary_zh: SQL通过AI运算符得到了增强，使现代数据分析平台能够从结构化和非结构化数据中提取洞察。尽管当前的文本到SQL系统能够成功生成这些增强查询，但可靠评估其正确性仍然是一个重要挑战。现有的评估指标依赖于精确的查询结果和确定性执行，系统性地无法应对AI运算符的灵活和非确定性输出。本文形式化了这些独特的评估失败模式，并引入了一个多层次评估框架，将确定性数据库逻辑与灵活的AI语义解耦。我们在行业（BigQuery）和学术（ThalamusDB）系统上测试了该方法，结果显示传统执行准确率严重惩罚有效查询，正确翻译的检测率低至25%。此外，最先进的基于LLM的自动评分器因同时判断关系和AI组件的复杂性，错误拒绝了32%的准确查询。通过分别验证标准关系逻辑和AI操作，我们的框架在两个平台上实现了最高97.2%的整体准确率，为基于AI的SQL生成器提供了可靠的基准标准。
items.abstract: SQL has been augmented with AI operators, enabling modern data analytics platforms to derive insights from both structured and unstructured data. We observe that while current Text-to-SQL systems can successfully generate these AI-augmented queries, reliably evaluating their correctness remains a critical open challenge. Current metrics, which rely on exact query results and deterministic execution, systematically fail against the flexible, non-deterministic outputs of AI operators. In this paper, we formalize these unique evaluation failure modes and introduce a Multilayered Evaluation Framework that decouples deterministic database logic from flexible AI semantics. We test our approach across both industry (BigQuery) and academic (ThalamusDB) systems. We demonstrate that traditional Execution Accuracy severely penalizes valid queries, achieving as low as a 25% detection rate for correct translations. Furthermore, even a state-of-the-art LLM-based autorater falsely rejects 32% of accurate queries due to the complexity of judging both relational and AI components simultaneously. By validating the standard relational logic and the AI operations separately, our framework achieves sta
items.authors: Tarfah Alrashed, Fatma Ozcan, Per Jacobsson, Tal Neiman, Xianshun Chen

items.title: CESBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Cryptographic Engineering Security for IoT Devices
items.title_zh: CESBench：物联网设备密码工程安全的大型语言模型基准测试
items.summary_zh: 对于物联网（IoT）设备，仅有安全算法不足以保障安全，攻击者可直接攻击实现，且一旦部署，缺陷难以修复。大型语言模型（LLMs）现被用于构建和分析此类实现。现有的LLM基准测试涵盖了密码学和一般网络安全，但缺乏密码工程的评估。本文提出CESBench，包含380个专家编写的项目，涵盖六个子领域：侧信道、故障注入、实现、对策、评估和集成。四种任务类型针对不同能力：209个选择题测试记忆，67个判断题要求安全裁决及其理由，63个场景题需工程诊断，41个代码任务通过572个测试用例评分。11个开放权重和专有LLM对每个项目进行回答，选择题和代码响应自动评分，判断和场景响应由LLM评审，分数与其他模型家族的第二评审和人工重评分进行核对。综合得分范围为54.4%至83.6%。各任务类型的最高分为选择题98.6%、代码95.1%和场景诊断88.4%，但判断题仅为58.8%。在模型间，88.5%的裁决是正确的。
items.abstract: For Internet of Things (IoT) devices, a secure algorithm alone is not enough: an attacker with physical access can attack the implementation directly, and its flaws are hard to fix once deployed. Large language models (LLMs) are now used to build and analyze such implementations. LLM benchmarks exist for cryptography and general cybersecurity, but none covers cryptographic engineering. In this paper, we present CESBench, 380 expert-written items across six sub-domains of cryptographic engineering security for IoT devices: side-channel, fault injection, implementation, countermeasures, evaluation, and integration. Four task types target different competences: 209 multiple-choice items test recall, 67 judgment items require a security verdict and its justification, 63 scenario items require an engineering diagnosis, and 41 code tasks are graded by 572 test cases. To validate the benchmark, 11 open-weight and proprietary LLMs answer every item. Multiple-choice and code responses are scored automatically, and judgment and scenario responses by an LLM judge, whose scores are checked against a second judge from another model family and human re-scoring. Composite scores range from 54.4%
items.authors: Wenquan Zhou, An Wang, Jing Liang, Peien Feng, Jingqi Zhang, Yaoling Ding, Liehuang Zhu

items.title: The MAMA-MIA Challenge: Advancing Generalizability and Fairness in Breast MRI Tumor Segmentation and Treatment Response Prediction
items.title_zh: MAMA-MIA挑战：提升乳腺MRI肿瘤分割与治疗反应预测的普适性与公平性
items.summary_zh: 乳腺癌是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，也是癌症相关死亡的主要原因。动态对比增强磁共振成像在肿瘤特征描述和治疗监测中发挥着重要作用，尤其是在接受新辅助化疗的患者中。然而，现有的乳腺MRI人工智能模型通常使用异质数据集、研究人群和评估协议进行开发和评估，导致直接比较困难，限制了对模型在不同机构和临床相关患者亚组中的稳健性的理解。MAMA-MIA挑战旨在通过提供一个标准化基准，解决这些问题，专注于仅使用治疗前的磁共振成像进行原发肿瘤分割和病理完全反应预测的联合评估。训练队列包括来自美国多个机构的1,506名患者，评估则在来自三个独立欧洲中心的574名患者的外部测试集上进行，以评估跨洲和跨机构的普适性。统一的评分框架结合了预测性能与年龄、绝经状态和乳腺密度等亚组的一致性。最终评估阶段有26个国际团队参与。
items.abstract: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy among women worldwide and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging plays a central role in tumor characterization and treatment monitoring, particularly in patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy. However, existing artificial intelligence models for breast magnetic resonance imaging are typically developed and evaluated using heterogeneous datasets, study populations, and assessment protocols, making direct comparison difficult and limiting understanding of model robustness across institutions and clinically relevant patient subgroups. The MAMA-MIA Challenge was designed to address these challenges by providing a standardized benchmark for the joint evaluation of primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathologic complete response using pre-treatment magnetic resonance imaging only. The training cohort comprised 1,506 patients from multiple institutions in the United States, while evaluation was conducted on an external test set of 574 patients from three independent European centers to assess cross-continental and cross-institutional generalization.
