items.title: When AI Reviews Train AI Reviewers: Scientific-Judgment Collapse and Mitigation
items.title_zh: 当AI评审训练AI评审者：科学判断崩溃及其缓解
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学评估中越来越多地参与，既作为自动评审者，也作为人类评审者的助手。随着模型生成的评审进入公共数据和未来训练语料库，AI同行评审可能变得递归：后续评审者从早期模型产生的判断中学习。我们在受控环境中研究了这一反馈循环的一步。以Llama 3.1 8B为起点，我们首先在2018-2023年官方ICLR评审上微调评审者，然后在ICLR 2024数据上训练四个后续模型，系统性地混合官方和模型生成的评审。研究表明，引入合成评审压缩了评分分布，减少了同论文和语料库层面的语义多样性。我们称这种现象为“科学判断崩溃”。为缓解这一失败模式，我们引入了“TrustReviewer”，一个基于LLM的开源系统，用于生成AI和机器学习论文的同行评审。TrustReviewer在两个互补阶段进行干预。训练阶段通过在精心策划的语料库上训练核心评审者，以减少低质量和语义退化的监督；测试阶段通过配对激活引导进一步缓解崩溃判断的残余倾向。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, both as automated reviewers and as assistants to human reviewers. As model-generated reviews enter public data and future training corpora, AI peer review can become recursive: later reviewers learn from judgments produced by earlier models. We study one step of this feedback loop in a controlled setting. Starting from Llama 3.1 8B, we first fine-tune a reviewer on official ICLR reviews from 2018--2023 and then train four successor models on ICLR 2024 data with systematically varied mixtures of official and model-generated reviews. Our study shows that introducing synthetic reviews compresses rating distributions and reduces both same-paper and corpus-level semantic diversity. We call this pattern $\textbf{scientific-judgment collapse}$. To mitigate this failure mode, we introduce $\textbf{TrustReviewer}$, an open-source LLM-based system for generating peer reviews of AI and machine learning papers. TrustReviewer intervenes at two complementary stages. For training-time prevention, we train the core reviewer in a single stage on a curated corpus designed to reduce low-quality and semantically degenerate
items.authors: Sy-Tuyen Ho, Minghui Liu, Furong Huang

items.title: M2G-LLM: Enhancing Clinical Prediction via Multimodal Graph Reasoning and LLM Context Injection
items.title_zh: M2G-LLM：通过多模态图推理与LLM上下文注入提升临床预测
items.summary_zh: 整合临床笔记、实验室结果和医学影像等多种数据模态对于推动临床决策至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理非结构化临床文本方面表现出色，但其在整合非文本模态方面的能力有限，制约了其在医疗应用中的广泛使用。本文提出了M2G-LLM（多模态MedGraph-LLM），一个通过图神经网络（GNNs）增强LLMs的多模态整合与对齐的新框架。该方法建模患者就诊之间的时间关系，跨临床相似患者传播信息，并对齐异构数据源以构建丰富的多模态上下文向量。这些向量被注入LLM的中间层，使得对文本和非文本模态进行联合推理成为可能。我们在MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR数据集上评估了M2G-LLM，结果显示其在临床预测任务上优于强基线模型，突显了将LLMs的语言理解与GNNs的关系推理能力结合用于全面多模态医疗分析的潜力。
items.abstract: Integrating diverse data modalities --- such as clinical notes, laboratory results, and medical imaging --- is essential for advancing clinical decision-making. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in processing unstructured clinical text, their limited capacity to incorporate non-text modalities hinders their broader utility in healthcare applications. Here, we introduce M2G-LLM (Multimodal MedGraph-LLM), a novel framework that enhances LLMs with multimodal integration and alignment via Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Our approach models temporal relationships between patient visits, propagates information across clinically similar patients, and aligns heterogeneous data sources to construct enriched multimodal context vectors. These vectors are injected into the intermediate layers of the LLM, enabling joint reasoning over textual and non-textual modalities. We evaluate M2G-LLM on the MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR datasets, demonstrating improvements in clinical prediction tasks over strong baseline models. Our results highlight the promise of combining the language understanding of LLMs with the relational reasoning capabilities of GNNs for comprehensive,
items.authors: Inyoung Choi, Sukwon Yun, Jiayi Xin, Jie Peng, Tianlong Chen, Qi Long

items.title: An Introduction to Compression-Based Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 基于压缩的机器学习简介
items.summary_zh: 任何无损压缩算法（如gzip）都可以通过归一化压缩距离或最小描述长度原则转化为机器学习方法。任何自回归模型也可以通过熵编码转化为无损压缩方法。这种看似循环的依赖在现代人工智能和机器学习中具有未被实现的潜力。我们调查并形式化了利用压缩进行机器学习的各种策略。我们引入并实证验证了一种基于压缩的机器学习设计框架，发现基于压缩的方法在与传统基线的比较中具有竞争力，且在恶意软件检测上表现更强。我们发现，调整这些设计选择可实现高达0.62的准确率提升。
items.abstract: Any lossless compression algorithm (like gzip) may be converted into a machine learning method, via either Normalized Compression Distance or the Minimum Description Length principle. Any auto-regressive model may be converted into a lossless compression method via entropy coding. This seemingly circular dependence has unrealized potential in modern artificial intelligence and machine learning, and we survey and formalize the various strategies that have been used to leverage compression for machine learning. We introduce and empirically validate a design framework for compression-based ML, finding compression-based methods competitive with conventional baselines and decisively stronger on malware. We find that varying these design choices yields accuracy gains of up to 0.62.
items.authors: John Hurwitz, Edward Raff, Charles K. Nicholas

items.title: Intervention Granularity Matters: Coherent Treatment Bundles in Counterfactual Simulation with Clinical World Models
items.title_zh: 干预粒度的重要性：临床世界模型中的一致性治疗组合
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在临床世界模型中进行反事实模拟时，干预粒度对模型响应的影响。通过分析MIMIC-IV数据库中945,707小时的患者数据，发现干预通常以组合形式记录，某些组件总是共同出现。我们假设干预的编辑粒度会改变世界模型的响应，并使用Clin-JEPA模型进行测试。在1,019例侵入性通气的记录中，我们保持患者历史和其他治疗不变，比较编辑单一通气设置与编辑完整配置的效果。结果显示，完整组合的预测状态变化幅度大于任何单一设置，且这一差异在考虑每次编辑对模型输入的影响后依然存在。因此，干预粒度显著影响临床世界模型的响应，单一组件的编辑可能低估治疗敏感性。
items.abstract: Counterfactual simulation with a clinical world model means fixing a patient's history, changing the treatment, and reading off the predicted response. Doing so requires deciding what counts as one intervention. In clinical settings, interventions are documented as bundles: a co-occurrence audit of 945,707 patient-hours from MIMIC-IV shows groups of components, such as every parameter of a dialysis circuit, that never appear apart, so an edit that changes one component on its own describes an hour that never occurs in the data. We hypothesize that the granularity at which an intervention is edited changes how a world model responds, and test this with Clin-JEPA, a latent world model of patient trajectories conditioned on hourly treatment text. At 1,019 documented onsets of invasive ventilation, we keep the patient's history and other treatments fixed and compare editing one ventilator setting with editing the complete configuration recorded for a real patient with the most similar recent trajectory. The complete bundle moves the predicted next state further than any single setting, consistently across all five settings, and the difference remains after accounting for how much each
items.authors: Fangzhou Wang, Yixuan Yang, Camilla Balzarotti, Rishikesan Kamaleswaran

items.title: HERMES: Contrast-Aware Knowledge Graph Reasoning from Clinical Notes for Patient Outcome Prediction
items.title_zh: HERMES：基于对比感知的临床笔记知识图推理用于患者结果预测
items.summary_zh: 临床预测模型通常依赖于结构化电子健康记录数据，如时间序列和程序代码。尽管近期研究开始利用非结构化临床笔记，但通常将其编码为平面序列，可能会丧失临床叙述中显式的关系和时间结构。为此，我们提出了HERMES，一个专注于临床文本的图形框架，保留临床关系。该方法基于两个关键思想：首先，通过大型语言模型引导的提取构建个性化知识图（KG），并采用对比逻辑建模，明确捕捉时间动态、治疗失败及结果变化；其次，图注意力网络通过基于图的学习合成患者表示。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上进行的院内死亡率和30天再入院预测实验表明，HERMES始终优于强大的文本基线。我们的研究结果表明，采用对比逻辑建模的显式关系建模显著提升了预测性能。
items.abstract: Clinical predictive models often rely on structured Electronic Health Record data, such as time-series and procedure codes. While recent approaches have begun leveraging unstructured clinical notes, they typically encode them as flat sequences, which may lose explicit relational and temporal structure present in clinical narratives. In response, we propose HERMES, a graph-based framework that operates exclusively on clinical text while preserving clinical relationships. This approach builds on two key ideas. First, personalized Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are constructed through Large-Language-Model-guided extraction from clinical notes with Contrastive Logic Modeling that explicitly captures temporal dynamics and treatment failures and changes in outcomes. Second, a Graph Attention Network synthesizes patient representations through graph-based learning over the KGs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality and 30-day readmission prediction show that HERMES consistently outperforms strong text-only baselines. Our findings demonstrate that explicit relational modeling with Contrastive Logic Modeling significantly advances predictive performance.
items.authors: Gia-Bach Nguyen, Hoang-Ha Nguyen, Tuan-Cuong Vuong, Trang Mai Xuan, Duy Quoc Ngo, Tien-Cuong Nguyen, Huan Vu, Thien Van Luong

items.title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
items.title_zh: TrialAtlas：临床试验设计与优化的多智能体研究组织
items.summary_zh: 尽管投入数十亿美元，近90%的药物在临床开发中最终失败。制药公司依赖临床开发规划（CDP）和技术及监管成功概率评估来预测开发风险，但这些决策仍然劳动密集且主观，需要临床科学、统计学、监管事务和竞争情报等领域的专家共同获取、综合和推理异构证据。本文介绍了TrialAtlas，一种增强记忆的多智能体研究组织，协调专门代理进行文献综合、竞争试验情报、监管先例分析及试验设计和开发风险的综合推理。TrialAtlas还从历史临床试验和监管结果中学习，以积累的开发经验为基础做出决策。为评估其在真实监管环境中的能力，我们引入了TrialAtlasBench，基于291份FDA完整回复信，涵盖检测试验设计缺陷、推荐可行设计改进和预测技术及监管成功等三项实际任务。TrialAtlas在缺陷检测任务中实现了50.0%的F1分数。
items.abstract: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three
items.authors: Jiacheng Lin, Zifeng Wang, Zheng Chen, Erick Scott, Ziwei Yang, Fanyang Yu, Sheng Zhong, Jimeng Sun

items.title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
items.title_zh: 利用数字语义评分测量数字劳动市场转型：荷兰劳动市场的AI方法论
items.summary_zh: 荷兰劳动市场的数字化转型正在重塑职业语言、职业路径和与工作相关的技能。为应对这些变化，本文开发了一种基于AI的方法论，利用覆盖数百万荷兰职位档案的数据分析数字化。该方法结合了基于嵌入的相似性搜索和大型语言模型分类，将非结构化职位信息映射到统一的ESCO职业。我们还引入了数字语义评分，衡量职位名称和技能与数字概念的关联程度。通过使用嵌入和余弦相似度，该指标超越了基于关键词的方法，捕捉了职业语言和工人技能档案中的更广泛数字含义。研究发现，数字化在劳动市场中的分布不均，数字职位语言在管理、专业和ICT相关职业中最为显著，但在混合商业、市场营销和自动化相关角色中也日益明显。职业转型分析表明，向数字工作的转变依赖于路径，而技能分析则显示出不同的趋势。
items.abstract: The digital transformation of the Dutch labour market is reshaping occupational language, career pathways, and job-related skills. Addressing these changes requires granular labour market intelligence. This paper develops an AI-based methodology to analyse digitalisation using data covering millions of Dutch job profiles. The methodology combines embedding-based similarity search and large language model classification to map unstructured job information to harmonised ESCO occupations. We also introduce a Digital Semantic Score that measures how strongly job titles and skills are associated with digital concepts relative to a non-digital reference. Using embeddings and cosine similarity to transparent digital and non-digital anchor groups, this indicator moves beyond keyword-based approaches by capturing broader digital meanings in occupational language and worker skill profiles. It enables analysis across occupations, career transitions, emerging job-title vocabulary, and skill digitality. The findings reveal that digitalisation is unevenly distributed across the labour market. Digital job-title language is most prominent among managerial, professional and ICT-related occupations,
items.authors: Sadegh Shahmohammadi, Xavier Pinho, Mairi Bowdler, Suhendan Adiguzel-van Zoelen, Joost van Genabeek

items.title: Towards a picture of the natural world derived from relativity and quantum theory
items.title_zh: 基于相对论和量子理论的自然世界图景探讨
items.summary_zh: 本文主张物理学应提供一个连贯的现实解释，而不仅仅是有效的经验结果预测算法。文章展示了基于现代物理理论的现实图景，特别是通过Weyl-Wigner表示法将玻色量子场解释为纯波场。最重要的结果是存在一个随机真空场，对应于场论标准规范形式中的量子真空波动。该场为电磁场中粒子（光子）的行为提供了解释。此外，文章还对实际粒子（如原子）的干涉实验提供了现实解释。经典广义相对论的解释是标准的，但强调了等效原理。文章略微触及时空奇点（黑洞）和贝尔不等式的经验违反等问题。除了这些问题，文章的主要不完整之处在于缺乏对费米场的现实解释。
items.abstract: I contend that physics should provide a coherent account of reality, in addition to be an efficient algorithm for the prediction of empirical results. This article offers pictures of reality derived from theories of modern physics. In particular it is shown that Bose quantum fields may be interpreted as pure wave fields via the Weyl-Wigner representation. The most relevant result being the existence of a stochastic vacuum field, corresponding to the quantum vacuum fluctuations of the standard, canonical, formulation of field theory. That field provides explanations for the particle (photons) behaviour of the electromagnetic field. Also a realistic interpretation is offered for the interference experiments with actual particles, like atoms. The interpretation of classical general relativity is standard but emphasis is made on the principle of equivalence. Problems like the spacetime singularities (black holes) and the empirical violation of Bell inequalities are touched but slightly. Asides from these problems the main incompleteness of the article is the absence of a realistic interpretation of Fermi fields.
items.authors: Emilio Santos

items.title: Quiescent Galaxies at $z > 2$ from CAPERS spectroscopy and their Number densities
items.title_zh: 高红移（$z > 2$）静止星系的光谱研究及其数量密度
items.summary_zh: 近期JWST观测揭示了高红移区静止星系的过量存在。常用的光度法（如光度衍生的特定星形成率、$UVJ$颜色和合成$ugi_s$颜色）用于识别静止星系，但其完整性和纯度尚不明确。本文展示了来自再电离时期调查（CAPERS）的19个光谱选择的静止星系样本，红移范围为$2 \leq z \leq 4$，选择标准为$M_\ast > 10^{9.5} M_\odot$且特定星形成率低于宇宙年龄的20%。这些星系在$z \sim 3.0$--4.6时形成了50%的星体质量，并在约0.1--0.2 Gyr的时间尺度上迅速熄灭。与其他高红移静止星系相比，这些熄灭时间尺度较短。通过光谱样本评估常用的光度静止星系选择方法，发现其完整性为63--89%，纯度仅为40--63%，强发射线星系是主要污染源。应用光谱样本校准的完整性和纯度修正，我们测量了$2 \leq z \leq 5$区间静止星系的数量密度，结果超过了大多数当前星系形成模拟的预测。
items.abstract: Recent JWST observations have revealed an overabundance of quiescent galaxies at high redshift. Photometric methods, such as photometry-derived sSFRs, $UVJ$ colors, and synthetic $ugi_s$ colors, are commonly used to identify quiescent galaxies, but their completeness and purity remain poorly constrained. Here we present a spectroscopically selected sample of 19 quiescent galaxies at $2 \leq z \leq 4$ from the CANDELS-Area Prism Epoch of Reionization Survey (CAPERS). They are selected with $M_\ast > 10^{9.5} M_\odot$ and a specific star formation rate below 20% of the inverse cosmic age. These galaxies formed 50% of their stellar mass at $z \sim 3.0$--4.6 and quenched rapidly on timescales of $\sim0.1$--0.2 Gyr. These quenching timescales are comparable to those of other high-redshift QGs but shorter than those at lower redshift. Using the spectroscopic sample as a benchmark, we assess commonly adopted photometric QG selection methods. We find completeness of 63--89% and purities of only 40--63%, with strong emission-line galaxies constituting the dominant source of contamination. Applying completeness and purity corrections calibrated from the spectroscopic sample, we measure the n
items.authors: Lu Shen, Weida Hu, Casey Papovich, Justin Cole, Mark Dickinson, Pablo Arrabal Haro, Anthony J. Taylor, Adam C. Carnall, \'Angel Chandro-G\'omez, Yingjie Cheng, Nikko J. Cleri, James S. Dunlop, Carter

items.title: From Observation to Ground Truth: Reconstruction Losses of Galaxy Imaging Under Heteroscedastic Noise
items.title_zh: 从观测到真实值：在异方差噪声下的星系成像重建损失
items.summary_zh: 深度学习广泛应用于星系图像分析，重建损失决定了模型在训练过程中优先考虑的图像特征。均方误差（MSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）分别对应于同方差高斯和拉普拉斯似然，而逆方差加权的$\chi^2$损失则考虑了异方差天文噪声的空间变化不确定性。为了比较这些目标恢复底层信号的效果，我们生成了无噪声的星系图像，并通过点扩散函数（PSF）定义真实值（GT），构建了带噪声的模拟观测。我们训练了三个使用不同重建损失的变分自编码器（VAEs），并将其输出与GT进行评估。在大多数信噪比（SNR）范围内，$\chi^2$训练的模型相较于MSE和MAE训练的模型具有更低的相对重建误差，表明逆方差加权在此异方差噪声下改善了星系图像的重建效果。
items.abstract: Deep learning is widely used to analyze galaxy images, and the reconstruction loss determines which image features a model prioritizes during training. Mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) correspond to homoscedastic Gaussian and Laplace likelihoods, respectively, whereas the inverse-variance-weighted $\chi^2$ loss accounts for the spatially varying uncertainties of heteroscedastic astronomical noise. Comparing how closely these objectives recover the underlying signal requires a ground truth (GT), which real observations cannot provide. We therefore generate noise-free galaxy images with IllustrisTNG, SKIRT, and \textsc{GalaxyGenius}, convolve them with a point-spread function (PSF) to define the GT, and construct noisy simulated observations. We train otherwise identical variational autoencoders (VAEs) with the three reconstruction losses and evaluate their outputs against the GT. Over most of the evaluated signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range, the $\chi^2$-trained model yields lower relative reconstruction errors than the MSE- and MAE-trained models, indicating that inverse-variance weighting improves galaxy-image reconstruction under the heteroscedastic noise con
items.authors: Renhao Ye, Shiyin Shen, Quanfeng Xu

items.title: Fountain pattern of baryon cycle revealed in galaxy ecosystems
items.title_zh: 星系生态系统中重子循环的喷泉模式揭示
items.summary_zh: 在星系生态系统中，重子被认为经历持续的流入和流出循环，形成喷泉状模式，编码了星系如何从环境中获取物质及其反馈响应的关键信息。尽管已有观测证据推测存在这样的重子循环，但由于个别星系生态系统的多样性和动态性，具体理解仍然困难。本文介绍了一种堆叠方法，通过结合多个个体星系生态系统的重子场，抑制不规则性并揭示潜在模式。该方法应用于宇宙学水动力学模拟，揭示了星系生态系统中气体特性的显著规律性模式，与观测推断结果高度一致。这一方法易于实施，使得在结构形成范式内充分理解气体循环模式的过程成为可能，并为将模拟星系生态系统与观测数据联系起来构建了坚实框架。
items.abstract: Baryons in galaxy ecosystems are believed to undergo continuous cycles of inflow and outflow, forming fountain-like patterns that encode key information about how galaxies acquire matter from their environments and respond through feedback. The presence of such baryon cycles has been inferred from pieces of observational evidence, but a concrete understanding remains elusive because individual galaxy ecosystems are diverse and dynamic. Here we introduce a stacking method that combines baryonic fields across ensembles of individual galaxy ecosystems to suppress irregularities and reveal the underlying pattern. Applied to a cosmological hydrodynamic simulation, this approach unveils strikingly regular patterns in gas properties across the full spatial extent of galaxy ecosystems, in close agreement with those inferred from observations. This method is straightforward to implement, allowing the processes shaping the gas-cycling pattern to be fully understood within the structure-formation paradigm, and a solid framework to be constructed for linking simulated galaxy ecosystems with observations.
items.authors: Chengyu Ma, Yangyao Chen, Enci Wang, Houjun Mo, Huiyuan Wang, Tao Wang, Qirong Yuan, Min Du, Zhaozhou Li, Kai Wang, Cheqiu Lyu, Haoran Yu, Zeyu Chen, Xiaoxuan Chen

items.title: Supernova origin of galactic turbulence revealed by superbubbles
items.title_zh: 超新星起源的星系湍流通过超级气泡揭示
items.summary_zh: 超新星（SNe）是驱动星系尺度湍流的主要候选者之一。超新星驱动扩展的中性原子氢（HI）壳层，称为超级气泡。由于缺乏敏感且动态完整的星系范围普查，超级气泡未被用于量化星系尺度的湍流能量预算。本文结合五百米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）和詹斯基甚大阵列的HI调查，对邻近的巨型螺旋星系仙女座星系（M31）进行了高灵敏度和动态覆盖的研究。我们在M31的整个盘面上识别出118个超级气泡，动态年龄可达40百万年，与星团中超新星活动的预期持续时间一致。根据这些超级气泡推断的超新星动能注入率（$10^{49}$--$10^{51.5}$ erg kpc$^{-3}$ Myr$^{-1}$）与从相同数据独立得出的湍流耗散率在幅度和空间分布上高度一致。这些结果表明，聚集的超新星反馈足以维持星系尺度的湍流，进而塑造盘面结构并影响星系演化。
items.abstract: Supernovae (SNe) are among the leading candidates for powering galactic-scale turbulence. SNe drive expanding shells of neutral atomic hydrogen (HI) known as superbubbles. Due to the lack of a sensitive, dynamically complete, galaxy-wide census, superbubbles have not been used to quantify the galactic-scale turbulent energy budget. Here we present a combined Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST) and Jansky Very Large Array HI survey of the Andromeda galaxy (M31), the nearest giant spiral, with superior sensitivity and dynamical coverage. We identify 118 superbubbles across the entire disk of M31 with dynamical ages up to 40 Myr, consistent with the expected duration of SN activity in a star cluster and extending the age coverage well beyond previous surveys. Inferred from these superbubbles, the kinetic energy injection rates ($10^{49}$--$10^{51.5}$ erg kpc$^{-3}$ Myr$^{-1}$) from SNe closely match the turbulence dissipation rates derived independently from the same data, in both magnitude and spatial distribution. These results demonstrate that clustered SN feedback is sufficient to sustain galactic-scale turbulence, which shapes disk structure and influence
items.authors: Fanyi Meng, Chao-Wei Tsai, Jingwen Wu, Sihan Jiao, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Zhi-Yu Zhang, Am\'elie Saintonge, Hui Li, Zongnan Li, Jie Wang, Lile Wang, Haitao Xu, Yanbin Yang, Kai Zhang, Rouyu Li, Di Li

items.title: The JWST Ultramassive Galaxy Sample -- I. Overview, Photometry, and Stellar Kinematics: Selecting Optimal Template Subsets via Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
items.title_zh: JWST超大质量星系样本概述及其光度学与恒星动力学
items.summary_zh: 我们介绍了JWST超大质量星系样本，包含8个极端早期型星系（$M_\star \gtrsim 2\times10^{12}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$），作为全面全天文普查中100多个此类天体的代表子集。本项目旨在动态测量其中心超大质量黑洞（BH），以探讨BH与星系的尺度关系的极高质量端，这是BH生长和宿主星系共同演化的物理机制可能根本改变的关键领域。本文呈现了基础数据产品：详细的光度模型和空间分辨的核恒星动力学。我们结合JWST/NIRCam成像与广域DESI遗产调查数据，使用多高斯展开（MGE）参数化表面亮度，准确映射BH影响范围内到扩展晕的恒星质量分布。通过JWST/NIRSpec积分场观测，采用惩罚像素拟合（pPXF）方法提取恒星动力学。为充分利用连续的$1.66-3.17\,\mu\mathrm{m}$波长覆盖，我们引入近可分离的非负矩阵分解（NMF）算法。
items.abstract: We introduce the JWST Ultramassive Galaxy Sample, comprising 8 extreme early-type galaxies ($M_\star \gtrsim 2\times10^{12}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$) drawn as a representative subset from a comprehensive full-sky census of over 100 such objects. This program aims to dynamically measure their central supermassive black holes (BHs) to probe the extreme high-mass end of BH--galaxy scaling relations, a critical regime where the physical mechanisms governing BH growth and host-galaxy co-evolution are expected to fundamentally change. In this first paper, we present the foundational data products: detailed photometric models and spatially resolved nuclear stellar kinematics. To accurately map the stellar mass distribution from the BH sphere of influence out to the extended halo, we combine diffraction-limited JWST/NIRCam imaging with wide-field DESI Legacy Surveys data, parametrizing the surface brightness using Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE). We extract stellar kinematics from JWST/NIRSpec integral-field observations using the penalized pixel-fitting (\textsc{pPXF}) method. To fully exploit the continuous $1.66-3.17\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ wavelength coverage---avoiding the telluric gaps of ground-ba
items.authors: Michele Cappellari, Dieu D. Nguyen, Susan A. Kassin

items.title: The JWST Ultramassive Galaxy Sample -- II. Supermassive Black Hole Masses for 8 Extreme Early-Type Galaxies via Jeans Anisotropic Modelling of High-Resolution Integral-Field NIRSpec Stellar Kinematics
items.title_zh: JWST超大质量星系样本研究：8个极端早型星系的超大质量黑洞质量测量
items.summary_zh: 我们对JWST超大质量星系样本中的8个星系进行了中心超大质量黑洞（BH）质量测量，这些星系是从附近宇宙中最大早型星系的完整样本中选出的（$M_\star \gtrsim 2\times10^{12} M_\odot$）。基于第一篇论文中的MGE光度分布和JWST/NIRSpec恒星动力学，我们采用Jeans各向异性建模（JAM）框架重建核动力学。通过贝叶斯MCMC分析，我们测试了扁球形和长球形的内在几何形状，并通过边际化经典动力学简并性（包括轨道速度各向异性、质量-光度比和倾角）提取出稳健的BH质量。结果表明，JWST的卓越分辨率使得仅凭核动力学就能严格约束中心势能。值得注意的是，并非所有超大质量星系都拥有超大质量BH：虽然大多数星系显示出经典的中心速度色散峰，但也有明显例外，包括一个星系中中心色散的明显下降和另一个星系中色散峰的减弱。这些动力学差异导致不同的BH质量，表明在极端质量尺度下，BH的增长具有高度随机性。
items.abstract: We present central supermassive black hole (BH) mass measurements for the JWST Ultramassive Galaxy Sample, comprising 8 galaxies selected from a complete sample of the most massive early-type galaxies in the nearby Universe ($M_\star \gtrsim 2\times10^{12} M_\odot$). Building on the MGE photometric profiles and JWST/NIRSpec stellar kinematics from Paper I, we use the Jeans Anisotropic Modelling (JAM) framework to reconstruct the nuclear dynamics. Given the unique structural properties of these dry-merger-dominated systems, our Bayesian MCMC analysis explicitly tests both oblate and prolate intrinsic geometries. By marginalizing over classical dynamical degeneracies (including orbital velocity anisotropy, mass-to-light ratios, and inclination), we extract robust BH masses. We demonstrate that JWST's exceptional resolution allows JAM to tightly constrain the central potential using nuclear kinematics alone. Crucially, not all ultramassive galaxies host ultramassive BHs: while most display a classic central velocity dispersion peak, notable exceptions emerge, including a clear central dispersion drop in one galaxy and a subdued peak in another. These kinematic differences yield distin
items.authors: Michele Cappellari, Dieu D. Nguyen, Susan A. Kassin

items.title: Stochastic black hole growth tracks stellar mass in ultramassive galaxies
items.title_zh: 随机黑洞增长与超大质量星系的恒星质量关系
items.summary_zh: 过去三十年，研究表明星系椭球体中存在超大质量黑洞（BH），其质量与宿主星系的特性紧密相关。最具预测性的关系是BH质量与恒星速度扩散（$M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$关系），以及与核球光度或恒星质量（$M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$关系）。理论模型预测，对于最重的星系，其后期增长主要通过缺气的“干”合并进行，$M_\star$应成为BH质量的更好预测因子。然而，由于这些星系极为稀有且中心表面亮度低，真正的偏离$M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$关系的现象难以观察。我们报告了James Webb太空望远镜（JWST）对八个超大质量星系中心BH的测量，发现最大的$M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$关系偏离，且大多数BH质量超过$10^{10}$太阳质量。在这一极端质量范围内，星系紧密遵循$M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$关系，散布极小，成功验证了理论预测。此外，我们观察到显著的随机性：对于一个超大质量星系，中心速度扩散下降而非上升，未显示出中心质量的证据。
items.abstract: Over the past three decades, it has been established that galaxy spheroids contain supermassive black holes (BHs) whose masses correlate tightly with the properties of their host galaxies. The most predictive of these correlations is between BH mass and stellar velocity dispersion (the $M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$ relation), alongside a relation with bulge luminosity or stellar mass (the $M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$ relation). Theoretical models of galaxy evolution predict that for the most massive galaxies, whose late-time growth proceeds mainly via gas-poor `dry' mergers, $M_\star$ should become a better predictor of BH mass than $\sigma$. However, genuine deviations from the $M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$ relation have remained difficult to observe due to the extreme rarity and low central surface brightness of such galaxies. Here we report James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) measurements of central BHs in a sample of eight ultramassive galaxies. We find the largest deviations from the $M_{\rm BH}-\sigma$ relation ever reported, with most BH masses exceeding $10^{10}$ solar masses. In this extreme mass regime, the galaxies tightly follow the $M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$ relation with minimal scatter, successfully co
items.authors: Michele Cappellari, Dieu D. Nguyen, Susan A. Kassin

items.title: Discovery, Characterization, and Potential Origins of a Stream in the Stellar Halo of Nearby LMC-Mass Galaxy NGC 55
items.title_zh: 发现并表征近邻LMC质量星系NGC 55的星际流
items.summary_zh: 我们在LMC质量矮星系NGC 55（2 Mpc）的星际晕中发现了一条之前未被探测的星际流，这是DECam本地体积探索（DELVE）调查中对LMC/SMC质量矮星系星际晕进行表征的持续努力的一部分。该结构与通过H$\alpha$发射追踪的气体流出、一个中性氢的突起和云团，以及超稀疏且可能正在破坏的卫星星系NGC 55-dw1对齐。我们通过局部光度-金属丰度关系和一组包含气体、恒星和暗物质成分的玩具动力学模型，研究了该星际流的可能外源祖先场景。如果该星际流是先前合并的产物，则其祖先星系的绝对星等$M_V \leq -7.2$，恒星质量$M_* \geq 10^5 M_{\odot}$。如果它是来自超稀疏卫星的破坏物质，则它们共享的祖先的绝对星等$M_V \leq -8.3$，恒星质量$M_* \geq 10^{5.2} M_{\odot}$。我们将我们的星际流和祖先场景与NGC 300进行比较，后者是一颗恒星质量与NGC 55相似且已知在其星际晕中存在多个结构的星系。我们的结果表明，即使是相对孤立的LMC质量星系也可以具有复杂的吸积历史，为层次化星系形成提供了新的检验。
items.abstract: We present a previously undetected stellar stream in the halo of the LMC-mass dwarf galaxy NGC 55 (2 Mpc), as part of an ongoing effort to characterize the stellar halos of LMC/SMC-mass dwarfs in the DEEP component of the DECam Local Volume Exploration (DELVE) survey. This structure is aligned with an outflow traced by H$\alpha$ emission, a spur and cloud of neutral hydrogen, and the ultra-diffuse and possibly disrupting satellite galaxy NGC 55-dw1. We investigate possible ex-situ progenitor scenarios for this stream through the local luminosity-metallicity relation and a set of toy dynamical models that include gaseous, stellar, and dark matter components. If the stream is a product of a previous merger, the progenitor galaxy had an absolute magnitude $M_V \leq -7.2$ and a stellar mass $M_* \geq 10^5 M_{\odot}$ based on extrapolations of the detected stellar populations. If it is disrupted material from the ultra-diffuse satellite, their shared progenitor had an absolute magnitude $M_V \leq -8.3$ and a stellar mass $M_* \geq 10^{5.2} M_{\odot}$. items.title: A Gamma-ray Emitting Head-Tail Radio Galaxy Swimming Through the Hot Medium of the Merging Cluster Abell 3627
items.title_zh: 在合并星团Abell 3627中游动的伽马射线头尾型射电星系
items.summary_zh: 头尾型射电源是穿越星系团稠密星际介质的喷流活跃星系核（AGN），在伽马射线天空中极为稀有，可能因其通常在大视角下观测。我们首次报告了位于合并星团Abell 3627边缘的头尾型射电星系ESO~0137-G007（z=0.016）与伽马射线源FL16Y~J1615.5$-$6034的关联。该星系在稠密星团环境中的运动及随后的冲击压力和/或星际介质湍流导致形成了超过500 kpc长的喷流，展现出扭曲、波动的射电形态。通过4.1米SOAR望远镜获得的光谱显示其缺乏发射线，表明其基础吸积活动辐射效率低。根据测得的视线方向恒星速度色散，我们估计中心超大质量黑洞的质量为$(3.36\pm1.32)\times10^9$ \Msun。我们简要讨论了几种辐射模型，以解释ESO~0137$-$G007的宽带光谱能量分布。我们认为对这一独特伽马射线发射头尾型射电星系进行更深入的多波长观测是必要的。
items.abstract: Head-tail radio sources are jetted active galactic nuclei (AGN) moving through the dense intracluster medium of galaxy clusters. They are extremely rare in the gamma-ray sky, likely because they are usually observed at large viewing angles. Therefore, every new gamma-ray detection of head-tail radio galaxies allows us to probe the origin of the high-energy emission in this unique class of AGN. Here we report, for the first time, the association of ESO~0137-G007 (z=0.016), a head-tail radio galaxy located at the outskirts of the merging cluster Abell 3627, with the gamma-ray source FL16Y~J1615.5$-$6034. The motion of the galaxy through the dense cluster environment and subsequent ram pressure and/or intracluster medium turbulence have led to the formation of a $>$500 kpc-long jet exhibiting a twisted, wiggly radio morphology. Its optical spectrum, obtained with the 4.1 m SOAR telescope, is devoid of emission lines, indicating that the underlying accretion activity is radiatively inefficient. From the measured line-of-sight stellar velocity dispersion, we estimate the mass of the central supermassive black hole to be $(3.36\pm1.32)\times10^9$ \Msun. We briefly discuss several radiati
items.authors: Vaidehi S. Paliya, M. B\"ottcher, Swayamtrupta Panda, Kiran Wani, D. J. Saikia, Mahadev Pandge, C. S. Stalin

items.title: Lens Modeling and Cosmological Inference from an Impure Sample of Galaxy-Galaxy Strong Lenses
items.title_zh: 从不纯样本中进行强引力透镜的模型化与宇宙学推断
items.summary_zh: 随着遗产空间与时间调查的开始，强引力透镜科学进入新纪元，预计识别的强透镜数量将增加至$\mathcal{O}(10^5)$。本文利用神经网络确定透镜参数的测量精度，使用现实模拟的LSST透镜系统。结果显示，爱因斯坦半径的平均测量精度为$3.7\%$，校准的不确定性准确反映了相应的测量误差。考虑到当前强透镜分类器的表现，预计约有$100,000$个可检测的强透镜伴随相似或更多的假阳性（非透镜）。为此，我们引入了一个名为‘COSMIC-BEAMS’的形式化方法，以推断宇宙学参数，同时考虑假阳性的污染。作为概念验证，使用模拟的LSST测量结果，我们发现对于$w$CDM宇宙学，宇宙学参数$\Omega_m$、$\Omega_\Lambda$和$w$的测量精度分别为$0.1$、$0.03$和$0.15$，即使在$50\%$假阳性污染的强透镜样本中也能推断出无偏的宇宙学参数。
items.abstract: The start of the Legacy Survey of Space and Time marks a new era for strong lensing science, where the number of strong lenses identified is expected to increase to $\mathcal{O}(10^5)$. In this paper we use a neural network to determine the precision with which lens parameters can be determined, using realistic simulated LSST lensed systems. We find that the Einstein radius can be measured with a mean precision of $3.7\%$ with calibrated uncertainties accurately reflecting the corresponding measurement error. Based on the performance of current strong lens classifiers, the $\sim 100,000$ detectable strong lenses are expected to be accompanied by a similar or larger number of false positives (non-lenses). In readiness for this we introduce a formalism, termed `COSMIC-BEAMS', to infer cosmological parameters while accounting for contamination by false positives. items.authors: Philip Holloway, Aprajita Verma, Philip J. Marshall, Padmavathi Venkatraman, Sydney Erickson, Tian Li, Simon Birrer, Steven Dillmann, Thomas E. Collett, the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration

items.title: Core-collapse supernovae 2022prr, 2023ucy, and 2024ljc in the luminous infrared galaxy NGC 6745
items.title_zh: NGC 6745中核心塌缩超新星2022prr、2023ucy和2024ljc研究
items.summary_zh: 核心塌缩超新星（CCSNe）2022prr、2023ucy和2024ljc在邻近的发光红外星系NGC 6745的中心区域爆发。我们展示了后续观测数据，旨在表征这些超新星的光谱光度演化，确定其宿主星系的消光，并定义其物理特性。所呈现的光谱光度数据集覆盖了三颗超新星的光学和近红外区域。通过宽带光度测量，推导出每个目标的宿主星系消光值Av。构建了宿主星系的光谱能量分布（SED），并拟合不同的星系成分以估计CCSN的内在率和NGC 6745的星爆年龄。2022prr是类似SN2009ip的事件，其光曲线演化包含两个连续的亮事件A和B，峰值亮度分别为Mr = -14.8和-18.3等。接近最大光度时，V和R波段的高极化度（P=2.8%）表明与高度非球形的星周物质相互作用。超新星的光谱演化以窄的巴尔默发射线为主，且随时间呈现复杂演变。2022prr加入了越来越多的类似SN2009ip的事件，显示出早期“闪电电离”特征。
items.abstract: The core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) 2022prr, 2023ucy, and 2024ljc exploded within the central regions of the nearby luminous infrared galaxy (LIRG) NGC6745. We present our follow-up data with the aim to characterise the spectrophotometric evolution of these CCSNe, determine their host-galaxy extinction, and to define their physical nature. The presented spectrophotometric data set covers the optical and near-infrared region for our three supernovae (SNe). The data are analysed and compared to other hydrogen-rich CCSNe, and a host-galaxy extinction value Av is derived based on broadband photometry for each of the targets. A spectral energy distribution (SED) for the host galaxy is constructed, and a combination of different galactic components are fitted to the SED to estimate the intrinsic CCSN rate and the age of the starburst of NGC6745. 2022prr is a SN2009ip-like event, whose light curve evolution consists of two consecutive luminous events A and B with peak magnitudes of Mr = -14.8 and -18.3 mag, respectively. items.title: Euclid: Quick Data Release (Q1) -- Optical hotspots in powerful radio galaxies
items.title_zh: Euclid：快速数据发布（Q1）——强大射电星系的光学热点
items.summary_zh: 强大射电星系的热点是高能粒子加速的场所，但射电观测对其产生的电子能量分布信息有限，影响了我们对其物理和能量学的整体理解。光学同步辐射对应物已知多年，但仅在少数亮射电星系中研究。通过结合低频阵列（LOFAR）观测与Euclid Q1数据发布，我们识别出77个具有热点的强大射电星系，并显示其中7-15%的星系可能检测到其热点的红外和光学对应物。在我们最清晰的案例中，热点的光谱能量分布与粒子加速至1 TeV的假设一致，而未检测到的热点则可能未达到如此高的电子能量或具有不同的电子能量谱。两个新的光学热点候选者被清晰检测到，与高分辨率LOFAR数据匹配，其中一个是迄今为止已知的最高红移光学热点（$z \approx 1.6$）。
items.abstract: The hotspots of powerful radio galaxies are the sites of high-energy particle acceleration, but radio observations give us limited information on the electron energy distributions that they generate, which affects our overall understanding of their physics and energetics. Optical synchrotron counterparts to radio galaxy hotspots, which probe high electron energies, have been known for many years, but have only been studied in a small number of objects selected as being very bright in the radio. By combining Low-Frequency Array (LOFAR) observations with the Euclid Q1 data release in the Euclid Deep Field North, we identify 77 powerful radio galaxies with hotspots and show that a small but significant fraction of them, 7--15\%, may have detected infrared and optical counterparts to their hotspots. The hotspot spectral energy distributions in our clearest cases are consistent with particle acceleration up to (but not beyond) 1\,TeV in energy on the assumption of field strengths close to equipartition, whereas non-detected hotspots either do not reach such high electron energies or would have to have very different electron energy spectra or significantly sub-equipartition magnetic fie
items.authors: M. J. Hardcastle (Department of Physics, Astronomy and Mathematics, University of Hertfordshire, College Lane, Hatfield AL10 9AB, UK), L. Bisigello (INAF-Osservatorio Astronomico di Padova, Via dell'O

items.title: Prevention is better than cure? Feedback from high specific energy winds in cosmological simulations with Arkenstone
items.title_zh: 高比能风在宇宙模拟中的反馈机制研究
items.summary_zh: 我们首次在宇宙模拟中应用新的Arkenstone星系风模型，能够有效解析高比能风的演化及其影响。在一个(25 $h^{-1}$ Mpc)$^3$的计算盒中，我们进行了多组数值实验，系统性地改变风的质量和能量负载，发现能量含量是控制恒星与暗物质质量比的关键参数。固定能量下增加质量负载反而导致轻微增强的恒星形成，这与传统观点相悖，原因在于风变得更冷。我们测试的简单参数化中，能量负载与晕质量成反比的模型最符合广泛观测，并且所需的质量负载远低于大多数以往的宇宙模拟。在这种情况下，星际介质中喷射的物质显著减少，风加热了星系周围的气体，减缓了对星系的降落，同时驱动冲击波超出虚拟半径，降低了晕尺度的增积率。此外，预防性星系调节所需的超新星能量比例远低于如IllustrisTNG等喷射风反馈模型。此研究为“学习宇宙”合作出版。
items.abstract: We deploy the new Arkenstone galactic wind model in cosmological simulations for the first time, allowing us to robustly resolve the evolution and impact of high specific energy winds. In a (25 $h^{-1}$ Mpc)$^3$ box we perform a set of numerical experiments that systematically vary the mass and energy loadings of such winds, finding that their energy content is the key parameter controlling the stellar to dark matter mass ratio. Increasing the mass loading, at fixed energy, actually results in mildly enhanced star formation, counter to prevailing wisdom, due to the wind becoming cooler. Of the simple parametrisations that we test, we find that an energy loading that scales inversely with halo mass best matches a wide range of observations and can do so with mass loadings drastically lower than those in most previous cosmological simulations. In this scenario, much less material is ejected from the interstellar medium. Instead, winds both heat gas in the circumgalactic medium, slowing infall onto the galaxy, and also drive shocks beyond the virial radius, decreasing the halo-scale accretion rate. items.authors: Jake S. Bennett, Matthew C. Smith, Drummond B. Fielding, Greg L. Bryan, Chang-Goo Kim, Volker Springel, Lars Hernquist, Rachel S. Somerville, Laura Sommovigo

items.title: Overmassive black holes and little red dots naturally form in simulations
items.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞与小红点在模拟中自然形成
items.summary_zh: 超大质量黑洞（SMBHs）的起源一直是天体物理学中的一个长期问题。最近的JWST观测揭示了在$z>4$-$6$的超大质量黑洞意外丰富的群体，其黑洞质量远高于当地的标度关系，并未被当前的宇宙学模型所再现。我们展示了完全宇宙学的辐射-流体动力学模拟，自洽地跟踪了SMBHs在原始星团环境中的诞生、早期增长及其可观测特征。我们发现约$10^{6}\,M_\odot$的重种子自然形成，超出典型理论预期一个数量级。这些种子迅速发展出致密、光学厚的盘，其强电子散射产生的宽H$\alpha$发射与小红点（LRDs）相当。持续的超爱丁顿吸积驱动其快速增长至$\sim3\times10^{7}\,M_\odot$，在$z\simeq 8$时达到。这是首次证明LRDs与重种子形成的短暂、被包裹的阶段统一，后者自然演化为JWST探测到的超大质量类星体，最终成为今天SMBHs的祖先。
items.abstract: The origin of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) remains a long-standing problem in astrophysics. Recent JWST observations reveal an unexpectedly abundant population of overmassive black holes at $z>4$--$6$, where the BH masses lie far above local scaling relations and are not reproduced by current cosmological models. How such overmassive black holes form and rapidly grow within young galaxies has remained unclear. Here we present fully cosmological radiation-hydrodynamic simulations that self-consistently follow the birth, early growth, and emergent observable signatures of SMBHs in proto-cluster environments. We find that heavy seeds of order $10^{6}\,M_\odot$ naturally form, exceeding typical theoretical expectations by an order of magnitude. These seeds rapidly develop dense, optically thick disks whose strong electron scattering produces broad H$\alpha$ emission comparable to that seen in little red dots (LRDs). Sustained super-Eddington accretion then drives fast growth to $\sim3\times10^{7}\,M_\odot$ by $z\simeq 8$. This is the first demonstration that unifies LRDs to a short-lived, enshrouded phase of heavy-seed formation, which naturally evolve into the overmassive quasars
items.authors: Sunmyon Chon, Shingo Hirano, Tomoaki Ishiyama, Seok-Jun Chang, Volker Springel

items.title: Predicting Supermassive Black Hole-Host Mass Offsets from Broadband Photometry Across Cosmological Simulations with Forecasts for LSST
items.title_zh: 基于宽波段光度学预测超大质量黑洞-宿主质量偏差
items.summary_zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜发现的“红点”暗示超大质量黑洞（SMBH）可能过于庞大，这可能不利于轻型超大质量黑洞种子的存在。然而，何为“重型”种子的质量范围仍然相对不明确。维拉·C·鲁宾天文台的遗产时间与空间调查将通过光度学特征化星系，而无需直接测量黑洞质量。我们将SIMBA、IllustrisTNG和EAGLE宇宙学模拟的结果转化为LSST的光度带，以训练一个集成机器学习分类器。我们的框架在SIMBA和IllustrisTNG中实现了91%-94%的准确率，能够在LSST的亮度限制下区分超大质量和不足质量的SMBH生长模式。跨模拟转移实验的准确率为83%-89%。信号分解显示，我们的分类主要受宿主星系颜色和吸积状态的光谱能量分布形状驱动。
items.abstract: The possibility of over-massive black holes suggested by James Webb Space Telescope photometric discoveries of 'little red dots', may disfavor light supermassive black hole (SMBH) seeds. However, what should constitute the mass (range) of 'heavy' seeds remains relatively unconstrained. Moreover, Vera C Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time will photometrically characterize galaxies without direct black hole mass measurements. We forward-model the SIMBA, IllustrisTNG, and EAGLE cosmological simulations into the photometric bands of LSST to train an ensemble machine learning classifier. Our framework achieves $91\%$--$94\%$ accuracy across SIMBA and IllustrisTNG in distinguishing between over-massive and under-massive SMBH growth regimes under LSST magnitude limits, using only broadband photometry. Furthermore, cross-simulation transfer experiments (training on one cosmological simulation and evaluating on another using rank-normalized features) achieve $83\%$--$89\%$ accuracy. items.title: Nonlocal Magic Spreading in Many-body Quantum Dynamics: From Chaotic Evolution to Quasi-particle Picture in Integrable Models
items.title_zh: 多体量子动力学中的非局域魔法传播研究
items.summary_zh: 纠缠和魔法是揭示量子多体系统互补特性的资源。非局域魔法是指在任意局部基变换下仍然存在的魔法。本文将非局域魔法与纠缠容量联系起来，后者是衡量纠缠哈密顿量波动的可处理量。通过大规模数值模拟，我们在混沌和可积系统中分析了这一联系。在混沌系统中，非局域魔法表现出瞬态积累，时间上呈对数增长后衰减至与系统大小无关的值。而在可积系统中，我们发展了量子粒子图景，与数值结果定量一致，显示初始增长最终在与子系统大小对数相关的值上饱和。这些对比行为对纠缠盗用具有操作性影响：最强的扰动器仅能瞬态盗用，而自由费米动力学则能在稳态中维持普遍盗用。
items.abstract: Entanglement and magic are resources that reveal complementary aspects of quantum many-body systems. Their interplay is captured by nonlocal magic, the magic that survives arbitrary local changes of basis. Yet their markedly different dynamical behavior leaves open how this irreducible component of magic spreads. Here we connect nonlocal magic to the capacity of entanglement, a tractable quantity measuring fluctuations of the entanglement Hamiltonian. This connection enables analytically controlled predictions across a wide range of many-body dynamics, from chaotic to integrable systems, which we investigate also using large-scale numerical simulations. In chaotic systems, nonlocal magic exhibits a transient buildup, with logarithmic growth in time followed by decay to a size-independent value. For integrable systems, we develop a quasiparticle picture in quantitative agreement with numerics, showing that the same initial growth instead leads to saturation at a value logarithmic in subsystem size. items.authors: Sreemayee Aditya, Piotr Sierant, Xhek Turkeshi

items.title: Hybrid quantum-classical attention for histopathology-based molecular profiling in data-limited cancers
items.title_zh: 基于组织病理学的分子特征混合量子-经典注意力研究
items.summary_zh: 在常规组织病理学中进行分子特征分析可以在缺乏测序、组织有限或训练样本小的情况下扩展精准肿瘤学的应用。我们开发了一种混合量子-经典策略，用量子导出的双随机矩阵（QDSM）替代变换器中的softmax注意力进行基于组织病理学的基因表达预测。在来自癌症基因组图谱的29个癌症队列及临床蛋白质组肿瘤分析联盟的独立胰腺癌队列中，QDSM注意力在小型数据有限队列中产生了显著的增益，尤其是在肾上腺皮质癌和葡萄膜黑色素瘤中。QDSM并未均匀提高转录组整体表现，而是重新分配了基因和通路的预测准确性，在某些肿瘤背景下改善了生物学相关目标。
items.abstract: Molecular profiling from routine histopathology could expand access to precision oncology when sequencing is unavailable, tissue is limited, or training cohorts are small. We developed a hybrid quantum-classical strategy that replaces softmax attention in a transformer for histopathology-based gene expression prediction with a quantum-derived doubly stochastic matrix (QDSM). Across 29 cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas and an independent pancreatic cancer cohort from the Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium, QDSM attention produced selective gains, with the largest relative improvements in smaller, data-limited cohorts, including adrenocortical carcinoma and uveal melanoma. Rather than improving transcriptome-wide performance uniformly, QDSM redistributed predictive accuracy across genes and pathways, improving biologically relevant targets in some tumor contexts while worsening others. In adrenocortical carcinoma, preferentially improved genes were enriched for adverse overall-survival associations, linking enhanced molecular inference to prognostically relevant biology. In pancreatic cancer transfer experiments, QDSM improved selected metabolic and lineage-associ

items.title: Polariton Bell Node for Quantum Repeaters
items.title_zh: 量子中继的极化子贝尔节点
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于平面半导体微腔的贝尔测量节点，该微腔在强耦合状态下工作。腔光子与量子阱激子混合形成极化子，结合了光子和物质准粒子的特性。加载到一个极化子模式中的控制光子会改变随后入射的目标光子的偏振响应。这种条件旋转由自诱导的拉莫尔进动和横电模式与横磁模式的分裂引起的偏振拍动共同决定。我们确定了实验条件，使得能够实现受控-Z门，并在理想极限下区分所有四个贝尔态。单侧散射方案在相同假设下提供了比标量克尔参考更低的相互作用阈值。在选定的工作点，带宽引起的识别误差在窄带极限下按脉冲带宽的四次方缩放。额外的固定输入旋转进一步减少了这一误差。我们描述了远程记忆之间的纠缠交换，并确定了获得纠缠输出所需的基本链路的最低质量。
items.abstract: We propose a Bell-measurement node for quantum repeaters based on a planar semiconductor microcavity operating in the strong-coupling regime. Cavity photons hybridize with quantum-well excitons to form polaritons combining properties of photons and matter quasiparticles. A control photon loaded into one polariton mode changes the polarization response seen by a subsequently incident target photon. This conditional rotation is governed by the interplay of self-induced Larmor precession triggered by spin-dependent exciton-exciton interactions and the polarization beats caused by the splitting of transverse-electric and transverse-magnetic cavity modes. We identify conditions of the experiment that enable implementation of a controlled-Z gate and allow to distinguish all four Bell states in the ideal limit. The one-sided scattering scheme provides a lower interaction threshold than a scalar Kerr reference under the same assumptions. At a selected operating point, the bandwidth-induced identification error scales as the fourth power of the pulse bandwidth in the narrow-band limit. An additional fixed input rotation reduces this error even further. We describe the entanglement swapping
items.authors: Junhui Cao, Alexey Kavokin

items.title: Parameter-Decoupled Quantum Superresolution without Multiparameter Estimation
items.title_zh: 无多参数估计的参数解耦量子超分辨率
items.summary_zh: 量子超分辨率能够超越衍射极限分辨紧密间隔的源，但现有方法通常依赖理想化的源特性或需要同时估计多个耦合参数。本文提出了一种参数解耦测量方法，可以在不估计未知亮度不平衡、相干性或相对相位的情况下，确定真实被动源的间隔。通过完整的四参数量子费舍尔信息分析，识别出在存在这些干扰参数时仍可获取的间隔信息。我们构建了一个直接可测量的对数概率不变量，其条件统计仅依赖于间隔。广泛的信道对满足解耦条件。对于高斯点扩散函数，最低阶实现能够在亚瑞利赫区间内渐近达到每个入射信号的四参数量子极限。该方法将现实的多参数成像问题转化为操作上单参数的测量，为量子增强被动空间、时间和光谱信号的分辨率提供了实用途径。
items.abstract: Quantum superresolution promises to resolve closely spaced sources beyond the diffraction limit, but existing approaches generally rely on idealized source properties or require simultaneous estimation of multiple coupled parameters of realistic sources. Here we introduce a parameter-decoupled measurement that determines the separation of realistic passive sources without estimating their unknown brightness imbalance, mutual coherence, or relative phase. A complete four-parameter quantum Fisher information analysis identifies the separation information that remains accessible in the presence of these nuisance parameters. We then construct a directly measurable log-probability invariant from projection channels whose conditional statistics depend only on the separation. Broad classes of channel pairs satisfy the resulting decoupling condition. For a Gaussian point-spread function, the lowest-order implementation asymptotically attains the four-parameter quantum limit per incident signal in the sub-Rayleigh regime. This approach converts a realistic multiparameter imaging problem into an operationally single-parameter measurement, providing a practical route toward quantum-enhanced r
items.authors: X. -F. Qian

items.title: Single-atom-based asynchronous photonic interconnect for scalable modular quantum computing
items.title_zh: 基于单原子的异步光子互连实现可扩展模块化量子计算
items.summary_zh: 为了超越单一量子处理单元的计算能力，量子计算需要模块化处理器之间的量子互连。光子是分发纠缠的自然载体。大多数抗损失协议使用基于线性光学的贝尔态测量，导致纠缠速率与每个处理器的低光子传递概率呈平方关系。本文分析了一种记忆辅助的量子互连，利用被困在高品质腔中的单原子实现近确定性、稳健的光子-原子控制-$Z$门。通过检测和测量一个处理器的光子，可以预示该处理器与原子之间的纠缠。该纠缠在与第二个处理器重复过程时得以保持，直到检测到第二个光子。读取原子量子比特完成处理器之间的纠缠。由于纠缠由原子介导，两个处理器的光子不需要完全相同，从而消除了主要的误差来源。此外，通过去除同时光子到达的要求，该协议使得纠缠速率在广泛参数范围内与光子到达概率呈线性关系。我们在现实参数下推导了纠缠速率。
items.abstract: Scaling quantum computation beyond the capacity of a single quantum processing unit requires quantum interconnects between modular processors. Optical photons are natural carriers for distributing entanglement between these processors. Most loss-resilient protocols use photonic Bell-state measurements based on the linear-optics type-II fusion gate. The resulting entanglement rate scales quadratically with each processor's typically low photon-delivery probability. Here we analyze a memory-assisted quantum interconnect using a near-deterministic, robust photon--atom controlled-$Z$ gate via a single atom trapped in a high-finesse cavity. Detecting and measuring a photon from one processor heralds entanglement between that processor and the atom. This entanglement is preserved while the process repeats with the second processor until the second photon is detected and measured. Reading out the atomic qubit finalizes the entanglement between the processors. As the entanglement is mediated by the atom, the photons from both processors do not need to be indistinguishable, removing a major source of infidelity. Furthermore, by removing the simultaneous photon-arrival requirement, the proto
items.authors: J\'er\'emy Raskop, Nadav Kandel, Yaniv Amichy, Yaron Jarach, Tal Kanonich, Andrei Militaru, Johannes Fink, Barak Dayan

items.title: Microwave dielectric properties of LiNbO$_{\mathbf{3}}$ and AlN at millikelvin temperatures and single-photon power
items.title_zh: LiNbO$_{\mathbf{3}}$和AlN在毫开尔文温度下的微波介电特性
items.summary_zh: 高效的双向微波光子转换是将超导量子处理器扩展到分布式网络的关键能力。然而，实现所需的转换效率需要填补对电光材料损耗机制的关键知识空白。本文对单晶块状LiNbO$_3$和AlN的微波特性进行了表征，涵盖了从毫开尔文温度到超过1K的广泛功率范围，直至单光子水平。我们证明这两种材料表现出两能级系统（TLS）行为，同时排除了与压电相关的损耗。结果表明，TLS引起的耗散主要集中在表面，而非内在的块体特性，这一结果得到了室温3D XPS和飞行时间SIMS分析的进一步证实。这些发现为设计集成块状电光晶体与超导腔体的混合架构提供了有用的见解，证明了与高效微波光学转换兼容的微波品质因子是可以实现的。
items.abstract: Efficient bidirectional microwave optical photon conversion is a key capability for scaling superconducting quantum processors into distributed networks. However, achieving the necessary conversion efficiency requires filling a critical knowledge gap in understanding the loss mechanisms of electro optic materials. Here, we characterize the microwave properties of single crystal bulk LiNbO3 and AlN over a broad range of powers, down to single photon levels, and spanning from millikelvin temperatures to above 1K. We demonstrate that both materials exhibit two level systems (TLS) behavior, while piezoelectric related losses are excluded. We show that TLS induced dissipation is predominantly localized on the surface rather than being an intrinsic bulk property, a result further corroborated by room temperature 3D XPS and time of flight SIMS analyses. These findings provide useful insights to engineer hybrid architectures that integrate bulk electro optic crystals within superconducting cavities, proving that microwave quality factors compatible with high efficiency microwave optical transduction are within reach.
items.authors: Alessandro Reineri, Francesco Crisa, Akshay Murthy, Maithlee Shinde, Daniel Bafia, Changqing Wang, Tanay Roy, Alexander Romanenko, John Zasadzinski, Anna Grassellino, Silvia Zorzetti

items.title: Cavity-QED analysis of InAs quantum-dot single photon production
items.title_zh: 腔量子电动力学分析InAs量子点单光子产生
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用腔量子电动力学探讨腔体增强对InAs量子点单光子性能的影响，主要涉及发射速率、纯度及不同温度下的表现。参数研究表明，单光子产生速率与纯度之间存在权衡关系，以及不可区分性与纯度之间的权衡。结果显示量子载流子-光子相关性的重要性，这对均场处理产生显著修正，尤其在光-物质耦合强度较高时，腔体增强效果最为显著。
items.abstract: Cavity quantum electrodynamics is used to study the extent cavity enhancement affects single photon performance of an InAs quantum dot, in terms of emission rate, purity and indistinguishability at different temperatures. Parametric studies show a tradeoff between single photon production rate and purity, as well as between indistinguishability and purity. The results indicate the importance of quantum carrier-photon correlations that yield substantial corrections to mean-field treatments, especially at high light-matter coupling strength, where cavity enhancement is most effective.
items.authors: W. W. Chow, S. Peana, D. I. Herman, K. Y. Lee, A. Cejan, C. Shang, G. Moody, J. E. Bowers, F. Jahnke

items.title: Persistent Quantum-Enhanced Frequency Sensing with T^{-3/2} Scaling
items.title_zh: 持久量子增强频率传感及其T^{-3/2}缩放特性
items.summary_zh: 量子传感利用非经典态提高测量灵敏度，但提供计量增益的态也更快去相干，限制了可用的探测时间，通常使最终灵敏度无法提高。本文通过在量子异频（Qdyne）协议中嵌入Fock态增强，恢复了持久的量子优势，将灵敏度与去相干限制的探测时间{\tau}解耦。我们在短{\tau}下获取测量，量子增强增益最优，同时精度随着总测量时间累积。在捕获的40Ca+离子的运动模式上，观察到的量子增强精度在超越去相干极限的测量时间上持续存在，缩放为T^{-3/2}，且没有饱和迹象。使用n=3 Fock态，我们相对于86MHz载波达到了0.5uHz的频率精度，实现了约6x10^{-15}的分数精度。这代表了相对于n=0态的7.1(10) dB的量子增强增益，符合Fisher信息的预测。这是Qdyne在固态自旋缺陷之外的首次演示。此外，通过使用量子谐振子进行频率混合，我们将操作扩展到超过1GHz，提升了两个数量级。
items.abstract: Quantum sensing uses nonclassical states to improve measurement sensitivity, but the same states that provide metrological gain also decohere more rapidly. This limits the usable interrogation time and, in practice, often precludes improvement in ultimate sensitivity - realized useful quantum advantage has consequently remained rare. Here, we restore persistent quantum advantage by embedding Fock-state enhancement within a quantum heterodyne (Qdyne) protocol, decoupling sensitivity from the decoherence-limited interrogation time {\tau}. Measurements are acquired at short {\tau} where the quantum-enhanced gain is optimal, while precision accumulates with the total measurement time. Demonstrated on the motional mode of a trapped 40Ca+ ion, we observe quantum-enhanced precision that persists to measurement times seven orders of magnitude beyond the dephasing limit, scaling as T^{-3/2} with no indication of saturation. Using the n=3 Fock state, we reach a frequency precision of 0.5uHz relative to an 86MHz carrier, achieving a fractional precision ~6x10^{-15}. This represents a quantum-enhanced gain of 7.1(10) dB over the n=0 state, in agreement with Fisher information predictions. This
items.authors: Clayton Z. C. Ho, Hao Wu, Grant D. Mitts, Joshua A. Rabinowitz, Eric R. Hudson

items.title: Exact DeWitt kernels in Lorentzian quantum cosmology
items.title_zh: 洛伦兹量子宇宙学中的精确DeWitt核
items.summary_zh: 在迷你超空间量子宇宙学中，通过仅对非奇异路径求和，可以在洛伦兹路径积分中实现DeWitt边界条件。我们给出了结果DeWitt核的一般定义，以及构造它们的明确规则，并进行了精确评估。对正半轴的积分得到Wheeler--DeWitt算子的Dirichlet格林函数，而对整个实线的积分则得到Dirichlet群平均核；当任一端点位于奇点时，两者均为零。由于迷你超空间作用至多为二次，所有的积分均以封闭形式完成，无需鞍点近似。我们获得了没有宇宙学常数的闭合宇宙的核，其中整个实线核恒等于零；对于平坦的de Sitter宇宙，以及闭合和开放的de Sitter宇宙，均以Airy函数的形式给出。整个过程中，DeWitt条件作为奇点处的边界条件施加，选择了半线上的自伴约束算子，并唯一确定了核及其归一化。
items.abstract: The DeWitt boundary condition can be implemented in the Lorentzian path integral of minisuperspace quantum cosmology by summing only over non-singular paths. We give a general definition of the resulting DeWitt kernels, together with explicit rules for constructing them, and evaluate them exactly. The lapse integral over the positive half-line yields the Dirichlet Green function of the Wheeler--DeWitt operator, whereas the integral over the whole real line yields the Dirichlet group-averaging kernel; both vanish when either endpoint lies at the singularity. Since the minisuperspace actions are at most quadratic, all lapse integrals are performed in closed form without saddle-point approximations. We obtain the kernels for the closed universe without cosmological constant, where the whole-real-line kernel vanishes identically, for the flat de Sitter universe, and, in terms of Airy functions, for the closed and open de Sitter universes. Throughout, the DeWitt condition is imposed as the boundary condition at the singularity, which selects a self-adjoint constraint operator on the half-line and fixes the kernels uniquely, including their normalization.
items.authors: Hiroki Matsui

items.title: Arrival Time\textemdash Classical Parameter or Quantum Operator?
items.title_zh: 到达时间：经典参数还是量子算符？
items.summary_zh: 到达时间分布在量子力学中的解释和计算问题尚未解决，反映了将时间视为量子可观测量或经典参数之间的长期紧张关系。本文在标准量子力学框架内探讨这一模糊性，并扩展到多粒子系统。以往研究主要集中在远场单粒子案例，结果相似且通常可用半经典分析处理。然而，随着原子光学技术的进步，现在可以在近场条件下实验研究纠缠多粒子系统的到达时间分布，这需要超越半经典近似的深入分析。即使在远场，由于量子非局域性，半经典近似在多粒子系统中也不一定成立。因此，本文扩展了到达时间问题的两种基本方法——时间参数法和时间算符法，并提出了可行的双粒子到达时间实验，数值评估了相应的联合分布。
items.abstract: The question of how to interpret and compute arrival-time distributions in quantum mechanics remains unsettled, reflecting the longstanding tension between treating time as a quantum observable or as a classical parameter. While recent studies have primarily contrasted arrival-time predictions across different interpretations of quantum mechanics, here we investigate this ambiguity within the standard quantum-mechanical framework itself. Moreover, most previous studies have focused on the single-particle case in the far-field regime, where these distinct approaches yield very similar arrival-time distributions and a semi-classical analysis typically suffices. Recent advances in atom-optics technologies now make it possible to experimentally investigate arrival-time distributions for entangled multi-particle systems in the near-field regime, where a deeper analysis beyond semi-classical approximations is required. Even in the far-field regime, due to quantum non-locality, the semi-classical approximation cannot generally hold in multi-particle systems. Therefore, in this work, two fundamental approaches to the arrival-time problem---namely, the time-parameter and time-operator appro
items.authors: MohammadJavad Kazemi, MohammadHossein Barati, Ghadir Jafari, S. Shajidul Haque, Saurya Das

items.title: Fast universal parametric spin control in an acoustically modulated quantum dot
items.title_zh: 声调制量子点中的快速通用参数自旋控制
items.summary_zh: 量子通信、分布式计算和混合架构依赖于能够实现量子比特的相干控制和与传播量子模式耦合的节点。尽管半导体量子点（QD）自旋与微波和光子耦合，但与机械波的弱相互作用限制了单量子点自旋量子比特在声耦合混合系统中的集成。现有的声学量子点自旋控制理论在旋转轴角度范围上有限，导致门原语实现复杂且门时间较长，难以抵御三重态衰变和准静态核自旋噪声引起的去相干。我们提出了一种参数控制方法，利用远离共振的光学耦合到三重态来混合自旋态，并结合声调制光学跃迁能量。我们通过与修饰自旋分裂的共振来参数化地诱导自旋旋转，从而开发出自旋类“摆动”电荷态激发的方案。该方案提供了快速的通用量子比特控制，旋转轴几乎任意。我们的保利-$X$ 门持续时间约为155皮秒，比之前的声光公式快约290倍，比光学法拉第效应快约14倍。
items.abstract: Quantum communication, distributed computing, and hybrid architectures rely on nodes enabling coherent control of qubits and coupling to propagating quantum modes. While semiconductor quantum-dot (QD) spins couple to microwave and optical photons, weak interaction with mechanical waves has limited the integration of single-QD spin qubits into on-chip, acoustically coupled hybrid systems. The existing theory of acoustic QD spin control suffers from a limited range of rotation-axis angles, enforcing complex realizations of gate primitives and long gate times, leaving little margin against decoherence from trion decay and quasi-static nuclear-spin noise. We propose parametric control that overcomes these problems. We use far-detuned optical coupling to a trion state to dress and thus mix spin states, combined with acoustic modulation of the optical transition energy. Instead of relying on direct acoustic resonance with the spin splitting that leads to significant bottlenecks, we induce spin rotations parametrically via resonance with the dressed-spin splitting. We thus develop a spin analog of the ``swing-up'' charge-state excitation. Our scheme provides fast universal qubit control w
items.authors: Mateusz Kuniej, Micha{\l} Gawe{\l}czyk

items.title: From In Silico to In Vitro: A Comprehensive Guide to Validating Bioinformatics Findings
items.title_zh: 从计算到实验：生物信息学发现验证的全面指南
items.summary_zh: 将计算预测转化为实验验证的生物学知识是现代生物信息学面临的主要挑战之一。本文批判性地审视了如何通过实验验证对计算发现进行优先排序、测试和解读。我们围绕三个常见挑战组织验证过程：基因组范围计算预测与单靶实验测定之间的特异性差距；在一个模型系统中验证的结果可能无法推广到另一个系统的可重复性与可转化性紧张关系；高通量候选发现与低通量机制验证之间的规模-深度权衡。我们比较了主要验证方法（如qPCR、RNA-seq、西方印迹、共免疫沉淀、荧光素酶报告实验、CRISPR干扰和功能表型实验）的优缺点及常见失败模式，并提供了基因表达、蛋白质相互作用、非编码RNA、调控元件和通路验证的结构化比较表，以及根据预测类型、生物背景、证据严格性、通量和资源限制指导方法选择的决策框架。
items.abstract: Translating computational predictions into experimentally validated biological knowledge remains one of the central challenges in modern bioinformatics. This review critically examines how in silico findings can be prioritized, tested, and interpreted through experimental validation. We organize the validation process around three recurring challenges: the specificity gap between genome-wide computational predictions and single-target experimental assays; the reproducibility-translatability tension, in which results validated in one model system may not generalize to another; and the scale-depth trade-off between high-throughput candidate discovery and the low-throughput nature of mechanistic validation. Rather than presenting an encyclopedic catalogue of techniques, we compare the strengths, limitations, and common failure modes of major validation approaches, including qPCR, RNA-seq, Western blotting, co-immunoprecipitation, luciferase reporter assays, CRISPR perturbation, and functional phenotypic assays. We also provide structured comparison tables for gene expression, protein-protein interaction, non-coding RNA, regulatory element, and pathway validation, together with decisio

items.title: The Manifold Hypothesis under Unknown Gaussian Noise:Conditional Certificates and Consistent Dimension Estimation
items.title_zh: 未知高斯噪声下的流形假设：条件证书与一致维度估计
items.summary_zh: 我们研究在明确识别和规律性条件下，噪声数据对流形假设的支持。人口残差证书结合了独立视角定位、高斯集中、成员不确定性和人口转移。现有的可整性标准得出覆盖尺度的结果。对于具有正Hölder密度的局部光滑流形，实际球协方差极限将谱交叉与几何维度相识别。我们证明在重复观察下几乎必然最终恢复。重新利用准确的定位平均将充分点样条件从$Nr^{d+4}\gg\log N$改善至$Nr^d\gg\log N$，复制条件为$kr^2\gg\log N$。双质量证书控制在声明类界限下的错误几何维度发射。对于具有未知高斯噪声的单次观察，仿射支持或已知坐标界限限制提供噪声区间和一致的高斯相关维度估计。Ahlfors规律性将该指数与Hausdorff维度及均匀光滑类的几何维度相识别。确切的Cantor计算划定了整数谱计数和相邻半径斜率的极限。我们在具体构造之前引用了已建立的局部PCA、可整性、高度集中、二项推断和去卷积结果。
items.abstract: We study what noisy data can establish about the Manifold Hypothesis under explicit identification and regularity conditions. A population residual certificate combines independent-view localization, Gaussian concentration, membership uncertainty, and population transfer. Existing rectifiability criteria then yield a covered-scale consequence. For a local smooth manifold with positive H\"older density, the actual-ball covariance limit identifies the spectral crossing with geometric dimension. We prove almost-sure eventual recovery under repeated observations. Reusing accurate localization averages improves the sufficient point-sample condition from $Nr^{d+4}\gg\log N$ to $Nr^d\gg\log N$, with replication $kr^2\gg\log N$. A two-mass certificate controls incorrect geometric-dimension emissions under declared class bounds. For single observations with unknown Gaussian noise, affine-support or known coordinate-bound restrictions provide noise intervals and consistent Gaussian correlation-dimension estimators. Ahlfors regularity identifies this exponent with Hausdorff dimension and with the geometric dimension of a homogeneous smooth class. Exact Cantor calculations delineate the limits

items.title: High-Moment Stability and Error Analysis of a Fully Discrete LDG-IMEX Method for High Dimensional Nonlinear Stochastic Convection-Diffusion Equations
items.title_zh: 高维非线性随机对流扩散方程的完全离散LDG-IMEX方法的高矩稳定性与误差分析
items.summary_zh: 本文提出并分析了一种完全离散的局部不连续Galerkin（LDG）方法，该方法结合了隐式-显式（IMEX）欧拉时间离散化，应用于由乘法性$\mathcal Q$-维纳噪声驱动的高维非线性随机对流扩散方程。该模型允许非线性主系数、非线性对流项、耗散源项和梯度依赖噪声。扩散算子通过LDG公式隐式处理，而非线性对流、低阶漂移和随机项则显式计算。主要贡献在于对完全离散方案的高矩稳定性和误差分析。由于非线性项导致的路径增长因子无法在全样本空间上均匀控制，提供稳定性和误差估计的关键在于引入适应于数值解的递归定义嵌套子集。在给定的随机抛物性和细化条件下，证明这些子集的概率收敛于1。在这些子集上，数值解满足高矩稳定性，完全离散误差以空间$r+1$和时间$1/2$的任意接近阶数收敛。我们还通过结合高矩误差界和离散Kolmogorov论证推导出路径误差估计。
items.abstract: A fully discrete local discontinuous Galerkin (LDG) method coupled with an implicit-explicit (IMEX) Euler time discretization is presented and analyzed for a class of high dimensional nonlinear stochastic convection-diffusion equations driven by multiplicative $\mathcal Q$-Wiener noise. The model allows nonlinear leading coefficients, nonlinear convection terms, dissipative source terms, and gradient-dependent noise. The diffusion operator is treated implicitly through the LDG formulation, while the nonlinear convection, lower-order drift, and stochastic terms are evaluated explicitly. The main contribution is a high-moment stability and error analysis for the fully discrete scheme. A central difficulty is that the nonlinear terms lead to pathwise growth factors that cannot be controlled uniformly on the full sample space. To provide the stability and error estimate, we introduce recursively defined nested subsets adapted to the numerical solution. Under the stated stochastic parabolicity and refinement conditions, we prove that these subsets have probabilities converging to one. items.title: Stochastic Optimal Control of Interacting Particle Systems in Hilbert Spaces and Applications
items.title_zh: 希尔伯特空间中相互作用粒子系统的随机最优控制及应用
items.summary_zh: 相互作用粒子在希尔伯特空间中由随机演化方程支配的最优控制是一个开放的研究领域。这类系统自然出现在每个粒子由随机偏微分方程、路径依赖的随机微分方程（如随机延迟微分方程或随机沃尔特拉积分方程）或部分观测的随机系统建模的情形下。本文旨在通过动态规划方法建立粒子数量趋于无穷时的极限理论。我们证明了有限粒子系统的价值函数$u_n$收敛到一个函数$\mathcal{V}$，该函数是对应的均值场哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程在概率测度空间中的唯一$L$-粘性解，并识别其与所谓“提升”极限最优控制问题的价值函数$U$的关系。在适当的附加假设下，我们展示了$U$的$C^{1,1}$正则性，证明了$\mathcal{V}$准确投影到价值函数$u_n$上，并且粒子系统的最优（或最优反馈）控制对应于从相应初始条件出发的提升控制问题的最优（或最优反馈）控制。
items.abstract: Optimal control of interacting particles governed by stochastic evolution equations in Hilbert spaces is an open area of research. Such systems naturally arise in formulations where each particle is modeled by stochastic partial differential equations, path-dependent stochastic differential equations (such as stochastic delay differential equations or stochastic Volterra integral equations), or partially observed stochastic systems. The purpose of this manuscript is to build a limiting theory as the number of particles tends to infinity via the dynamic programming approach. We prove the convergence of the value functions $u_n$ of finite particle systems to a function $\mathcal{V}$, which is the unique $L$-viscosity solution of the corresponding mean-field Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation in the space of probability measures, and we identify its lift with the value function $U$ of the so-called ``lifted'' limit optimal control problem. items.authors: Filippo de Feo, Fausto Gozzi, Andrzej \'Swi\k{e}ch, Lukas Wessels

items.title: Flowing to Normality and the Fate of the Single Ring Theorem
items.title_zh: 流向常态与单环定理的命运
items.summary_zh: 随机非厄米矩阵集在大矩阵尺寸极限下遵循单环定理，该定理指出复平面中均值特征值分布的支撑区域为圆盘或环形区域。相比之下，旋转不变的随机正规矩阵集可以在复平面上有任意数量的同心环形区域的均值特征值密度。本文引入并研究了一种非厄米矩阵模型，通过调节一个惩罚非正规性的参数，使其从遵循单环定理的通用矩阵分布流向正规矩阵分布。我们观察到，随着模型向常态流动，单环定理的破坏，并确定了发生转变的关键参数值。我们还详细研究了这些矩阵在流动过程中的奇异值行为，这些奇异值形成了限制在正半轴上的费米气体。特别地，我们发现，在流动参数较小的情况下，气体中的粒子间距表现出维格纳-戴森排斥，而在流动的正规矩阵终点，流动参数趋于无穷大时，间距统计呈现泊松分布。该流动在这两种类型之间连续插值。
items.abstract: Random non-hermitian matrix ensembles with double-sided rotation invariance obey, in the limit of large matrix size, the Single Ring Theorem, which states that the support of the mean eigenvalue distribution in the complex plane is either a disk or an annulus. In contrast, rotational-invariant random normal matrix ensembles can have mean eigenvalue densities supported over any number of concentric annuli in the complex plane. In this paper we introduce and investigate, both analytically and numerically, a non-hermitian matrix model which flows from a generic matrix distribution obeying the Single Ring Theorem to a distribution of normal matrices by tuning a parameter which penalizes non-normality. We observe numerically breakdown of the Single Ring Theorem as the model flows towards normality, and determine the critical value of the parameter at which the transition occurs. We also study in detail the behavior of the singular values of these matrices under the flow. These singular values form a Fermi gas confined to the positive half-line. items.authors: Joshua Feinberg, Roman Riser, Richard Scalettar, Anthony Zee

items.title: Objective Model Prior Probabilities in Variable Selection
items.title_zh: 变量选择中的客观模型先验概率研究
items.summary_zh: 多年来，在贝叶斯模型不确定性分析中，使用相等的模型先验概率已成为常规。然而，这种做法存在问题，导致在基因组学等领域支持过于庞大的模型。为了解决这一问题，研究者们提出了一种方法：对考虑的总共$k$个变量中包含$d$个变量的所有模型赋予先验概率$1/(k + 1)$，并在该集合中的模型间均分该先验概率。此外，还引入了其他一些强烈限制模型复杂度的先验概率选择。本文首先回顾了使用相等模型先验概率的问题，接着讨论了Jeffreys选择的严重缺陷，最后介绍并研究了多种客观的模型先验概率替代选择，从数值和理论的角度进行分析。
items.abstract: For many years it was routine to use equal model prior probabilities in Bayesian model uncertainty analysis. At least twenty years ago it became clear that this was problematic, leading to support of much too large models in the increasingly huge model spaces being considered in genomics and other fields. A popular replacement was to adopt a suggestion of Harold Jeffreys for the variable selection problem in which a total of $k$ possible variables are being considered for inclusion in the model: give the collection of all models containing $d$ variables ($d = 0, . . . , k$) prior probability $1/(k + 1)$ and then divide this prior probability equally among the models in the collection. Many other choices of model prior probabilities that impose severe parsimony have also been introduced. We begin by reviewing the problems with using equal model prior probabilities and then discuss some serious problems with the Jeffreys choice. Finally, we introduce and study a number of objective alternative choices of model prior probabilities, from both numerical and theoretical perspectives.
items.authors: James Berger, Gonzalo Garc\'ia-Donato, Luis Pericchi

items.title: Material chemical compositon impacts on the band alignments: Preliminary results on the 3D/2D perovskite interfaces
items.title_zh: 材料化学成分对能带对齐的影响：3D/2D钙钛矿界面的初步研究
items.summary_zh: 混合有机-无机卤化物钙钛矿太阳能电池已实现显著的认证效率，但其广泛应用受到光、热和湿气不稳定性的制约。为缓解湿气敏感性等问题，研究将2D钙钛矿沉积在3D薄膜上进行钝化，但其对电池性能的具体影响尚需深入理解。本研究采用基于混合泛函的原子级第一性原理模拟，探讨2D/3D界面的结构和电子特性，重点研究(PEA)2PbI4（PEA = C6H5CH2CH2NH3，作为2D钙钛矿）与复杂3D钙钛矿(Cs0.125MA0.14FA0.735Pb(I0.87Br0.13)3，MA = CH3NH3，FA = CH(NH2)2）的界面。结果表明，功函数（WF）强烈依赖于表面的断裂和化学性质，界面的形成显著影响宏观电势，且能带对齐对终止和化学性质高度敏感。
items.abstract: While hybrid organic-inorganic halide perovskite solar cells have achieved remarkable certified efficiencies, their widespread industrial and societal adoption is hindered by instabilities against light, heat, and moisture. A strategy to mitigate issues, such as moisture sensitivity, involves depositing 2D perovskites on 3D thin films for passivation, but their precise impact on cell performance requires detailed understanding. This work employs atomistic first-principles simulation, based on hybrid functionals, to investigate the structural and electronic properties of 2D/3D interfaces. Specifically, it focuses on interfaces formed by (PEA)2PbI4 (PEA = C6H5CH2CH2NH3, as 2D perovskite) and complex 3D perovskites (Cs0.125MA0.14FA0.735Pb(I0.87Br0.13)3, with MA = CH3NH3 and FA = CH(NH2)2) which are ones of the most used perovskites. The approach is based on optimized hybrid functional methods to consistently determine work function (WF), electron affinity (___), and band offset (EBO) across different layers. items.title: Programmable Strain-Induced Intrinsic Circularly Polarized Emission from All-Inorganic Perovskite Nanocrystal Glass
items.title_zh: 全无机钙钛矿纳米晶玻璃中可编程应变诱导的内源性圆偏振发射
items.summary_zh: 生成圆偏振光（CPL）对手性光子学和高密度光信息存储至关重要。当前在半导体纳米材料中实现CPL的方法通常依赖手性有机分子，这限制了不同手性状态在单一单体基底上的逐像素集成。本文实现了无手性分子的可编程CPL，采用直接激光写入法合成全无机钙钛矿纳米晶。高分辨率透射电子显微镜揭示了层间距的核壳状变化，与扭转晶格畸变一致。密度泛函理论计算进一步表明，扭转晶格畸变提升了带边电子态的自旋简并性。功率依赖的CPL测量显示，从双折射介导的圆偏振过渡到内源性CPL。此外，通过系统调节入射线性偏振角和焦深，我们确定性地编程了CPL的手性和幅度，|glum|约为4 x 10^-3。我们的研究通过直接激光写入展示了对内源性手性光学功能的确定性控制，为单体材料中空间集成的手性发射体建立了策略。
items.abstract: Generating circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) is important for chiral photonics and high-density optical information storage. Current approaches to CPL in semiconductor nanomaterials often employ chiral organic molecules, which hinder pixel-by-pixel integration of different chiral states onto a single monolithic substrate. Here, we realize chiral-molecule-free, programmable CPL from all-inorganic perovskite nanocrystals synthesized by direct laser writing in glass. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy reveals a core-shell-like variation in interplanar spacing, consistent with torsional lattice distortion. Density functional theory calculations further show that torsional lattice distortion lifts the spin degeneracy of the band-edge electronic states. Power-dependent CPL measurements reveal a transition from birefringence-mediated circular polarization to intrinsic CPL. Furthermore, by systematically tuning the incident linear polarization angle and focal depth, we deterministically program both the handedness and magnitude of the CPL, with |glum| of approximately 4 x 10^-3. items.title: Development of a Non-Empirical Exchange-Hole Dipole Moment Dispersion Model
items.title_zh: 非经验交换孔偶极矩色散模型的开发
items.summary_zh: 在密度泛函理论（DFT）中，考虑色散效应对于正确建模非共价相互作用至关重要。过去提出了许多色散泛函。交换孔偶极矩（XDM）模型结合了简化的阻尼成对渐近表达式与基于理论的方法来计算色散系数。XDM被认为是描述分子晶体的最准确的色散修正，但存在两个主要缺陷：一是依赖于实验确定的自由原子极化率，二是由于使用Hirshfeld划分方法，XDM对带有大原子部分电荷的系统（如碱金属阳离子或卤素阴离子）的描述较差。我们提出了neXDM，这是一种非经验的XDM变体，通过使用Kirkwood极化率公式消除了实验参数，使其成为纯粹的meta-GGA色散泛函。此外，基于Bu\v{c}ko等人对类似Tkatchenko--Scheffler（TS）方法的研究，我们用迭代方法替代了Hirshfeld划分。
items.abstract: The inclusion of dispersion effects is important in density-functional theory (DFT) to model non-covalent interactions correctly, a task that is essential in many applications of the theory. Many dispersion functionals have been proposed in the past. The exchange-hole dipole moment (XDM) model combines the simplicity of a damped pairwise asymptotic expression for the dispersion energy with a theory-grounded approach to calculate the dispersion coefficients. XDM is, arguably, the most accurate dispersion correction for the description of molecular crystals and it has been thoroughly tested for other applications across a wide range of chemistries. Here, we address the two main shortcomings of XDM. First, XDM relies on the use of experimentally determined free-atom polarizabilities. Second, because the XDM atom-in-molecule properties (volumes, polarizabilities, exchange-hole dipole moments) use the Hirshfeld partition method, XDM describes systems with large atomic partial charges, like alkali cations or halide anions, poorly. We propose neXDM, a non-empirical variant of XDM that removes the experimental parameters by using the Kirkwood polarizability formula, thereby making neXDM a
items.authors: Alastair J. A. Price, Alberto Otero-de-la-Roza

items.title: Dissecting the Roles of Optimal Tuning, Solvation, and Vibrational Corrections in Excited-State Redox Potential Prediction for Organic Photoredox Catalysts
items.title_zh: 解析有机光氧化催化剂激发态氧化还原电位预测中的关键因素
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于16种结构相关的N-芳基苯并噻唑光催化剂的激发态氧化还原电位预测，采用实验数据在二甲基乙酰胺中进行比较。我们探讨了时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT）中基态氧化还原热化学与激发态能量学的处理方式，特别是范围分离处理的选择。研究发现，默认的范围分离参数在基态氧化电位预测中误差最低，而在溶液相调谐下，使用平衡（PVγT）或非平衡（SVγT）极化连续体模型可将过渡能量的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低至0.10–0.13 eV。结合零点或完全振动修正后，激发态氧化电位的MAE为0.11–0.13 V。
items.abstract: Department of Chemistry, Emory University Abstract Reliable computational prediction of excited-state redox potentials is central to the rational design of photoredox catalysts and requires accurate treatment of both ground-state redox thermochemistry and excited-state energetics. Although time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) provides a practical computational framework, it remains unclear whether these two components should use the same range-separation treatment and how the tuning of 2 range-separated hybrid (RSH) functionals, solvent response, and vibrational corrections affect that choice. We address these questions using a controlled benchmark of 16 structurally related N-aryl phenoxazine photocatalysts with experimental data obtained in dimethylacetamide, comparing default range-separation parameters with gas-phase tuning (GPγT) and two solution-phase tuning schemes based on equilibrium (PVγT) and nonequilibrium (SVγT) polarizable continuum models. The optimal treatment is quantity dependent: default ω values give the lowest errors for ground-state oxidation potentials, whereas solution-phase tuning with PVγT or SVγT reduces the mean absolute errors (MAEs) of tran
items.authors: Ariel Gale, Bushra Alam, Fang Liu

items.title: Pyrrole-Imine Dimer Stabilized Bis(germaamides) with two Ge(E)N(SiMe3)2 moieties (E = S, Se)
items.title_zh: 含两个Ge(E)N(SiMe3)2基团的吡咯-亚胺二聚体稳定的双（锗酰胺）化合物
items.summary_zh: 双（锗酰胺）及其硫和硒的类似物尚未被发现。本研究报道了含有两个Ge(E)NR2基团（E = S, Se; R = SiMe3）的双（锗酰胺）7和8的首次分离和表征。这些化合物通过用元素硫和硒氧化体积较大的吡咯-亚胺二聚体配体稳定的双（氨基锗烯）5获得。本研究还首次展示了体积较大的吡咯-亚胺二聚体配体3在同时稳定两个低价中心（锗烯或锡烯）方面的应用。此外，利用单晶X射线衍射和DFT计算详细研究了硫和硒双（锗酰胺）7和8中的键合情况。
items.abstract: Bis(germaamides) and their thio- and seleno- analogs are unknown. This work reports the isolation and characterization of the first examples of thio- and seleno-analogs of bis(germaamides) 7 and 8 containing two Ge(E)NR2 moieties (E = S, Se; R = SiMe3). These compounds were obtained by oxidizing the bulky pyrrole-imine dimeric ligand-stabilized bis(aminogermylene) 5 with elemental sulfur and selenium. This study also highlights the first-ever application of the bulky pyrrole-imine dimeric ligand 3 to simultaneously stabilize two low-valent centers (germylenes or stannylenes). Furthermore, the bonding in the thio- and seleno-bis(germaamides) 7 and 8 was investigated in detail using single–crystal X-ray diffraction and DFT calculations.
items.authors: Tanya Batra, Prakash Chandra Joshi, Vishal Singh, Hemant Kumar, Subrata Kundu, Selvarajan Nagendran

items.title: Nanoscale stacking disorder and Jahn-Teller distortion in Brochantite, Cu4SO4(OH)6, revealed by 3D electron diffraction
items.title_zh: 纳米级堆叠缺陷与贾恩-泰勒畸变在铜硫酸盐中的研究
items.summary_zh: 功能材料的表征常常忽视结构缺陷的显式建模，然而缺陷对材料性质有显著影响。本研究针对最常见的基本铜硫酸盐之一——铜硫酸盐（Brochantite, Cu4SO4(OH)6）的结构复杂性，采用三维电子衍射（3D ED）结合实验室和同步辐射单晶X射线衍射进行分析。对数十个晶体的测量揭示了纳米级缺陷、新的正交多型体以及广泛的堆叠缺陷概率。结果显示铜硫酸盐的结构异质性明显，并探讨了不同硫酸盐环境和堆叠配置与贾恩-泰勒畸变的大小和方向之间的关系。高压测量进一步表明，这些畸变对层几何和压缩变化有响应。此外，单晶X射线研究显示铜硫酸盐中存在异常的孪生现象，而对纳米晶体收集的3D ED数据提供了在大晶体中被平均化的单个晶体结构。
items.abstract: Characterization of functional materials often neglects explicit modeling of structural disorder because of its complexity and the limitations of conventional experimental methods. Yet disorder can strongly affect material properties, and understanding its role is essential for establishing reliable structure-property relationships. Here, we address the long-standing structural complexity of brochantite, one of the most common basic copper sulfates, using 3D electron diffraction (3D ED) complemented by laboratory and synchrotron single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Measurements on dozens of crystals reveal nanoscale disorder, a new orthorhombic polytype, and a broad range of stacking-fault probabilities. The results demonstrate pronounced structural heterogeneity in brochantite and allow us to examine how different sulfate environments and stacking configurations correlate with the magnitude and orientation of Jahn-Teller distortions. High-pressure measurements further show that these distortions respond to changes in layer geometry and compression.
