items.authors: Piotr Rejnhardt, Wojciech A. Sławiński, Jan Parafiniuk, Roman Gajda, Agnieszka Huć, Tomasz Poręba

items.title: Perovskite Photovoltaics in January-June 2026: The Certified Frontier From Cell to Module
items.title_zh: 2026年上半年钙钛矿光伏技术的最新进展
items.summary_zh: 在为期6个月的评估中，金属卤化物钙钛矿文献增加了3328篇索引出版物。其中884篇被仔细审查，重点关注物理特性、界面机制和不同器件架构的稳定性。在单结器件中，认证的功率转换效率（PCE）上限提高至27.6%。然而，关于低维封顶异质结构的操作机制的研究结果存在分歧。一些研究表明，宽带隙表面封顶层抑制非辐射复合并阻碍卤化物迁移，而竞争性证据则显示无序有机间隔相造成严重的电荷传输障碍。在全钙钛矿串联器件中，性能上限受窄带隙（NBG）混合锡铅子电池的化学脆弱性限制。化学硬度工程和成核控制同步结晶，抑制局部锡富缺陷的分离。关于这一过程在连续操作中是否能阻止二价锡向四价锡氧化的物理证据仍然薄弱且存在争议。与硅或硫族元素底部吸收体配对的单体混合串联器件确立了34.85%的全行业上限。
items.abstract: Over an evaluation period spanning 6 months, the metal halide perovskite literature expanded by 3328 indexed publications. Of these, 884 were examined closely for physical claims, interfacial mechanisms, and stability validation across distinct device architectures. Across single junction devices, the certified power conversion efficiency (PCE) ceiling advanced to 27.6%, yet mechanistic investigations diverged over the operational function of low-dimensional capping heterostructures. Several studies concluded that wide-bandgap surface caps suppress non-radiative recombination and impede halide migration without hindering transport, while competing evidence demonstrated that disordered organic spacer phases create severe charge-transport barriers, accumulate photogenerated carriers under illumination, and penalize fill factor (FF). In all-perovskite tandems, performance ceilings remained governed by the chemical vulnerability of narrow-bandgap (NBG) mixed tin-lead sub-cells. Chemical hardness engineering and nucleation control synchronized crystallization and suppressed localized tin-rich defect segregation. items.authors: Havid Aqoma

items.title: Conformational ensembles of the TDP-43 NTD-RRM1-RRM2 domains interacting with GU-rich RNA determined by MD simulations and SAXS data
items.title_zh: TDP-43 NTD-RRM1-RRM2域与GU富含RNA相互作用的构象研究
items.summary_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）是RNA代谢的重要调节因子，其病理聚集是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、额颞叶痴呆（FTD）和阿尔茨海默病的标志。通过其RNA识别基序（RRM1和RRM2）与GU富含RNA序列结合已知可对抗聚集，但RNA如何调节TDP-43的构象和超分子组织的分子机制仍不清楚。为了解决这一问题，我们对TDP-43 NTD-RRM1-RRM2单体在无GU富含RNA和有GU富含RNA的情况下进行了全原子（AA）和粗粒度（CG）分子动力学（MD）研究。使用AMBER03ws和RNA AMBERχOL3力场进行AA模拟，同时开发了与MARTINI 3兼容的GU富含RNA CG模型，并进行了CG模拟，以获取更长时间尺度的构象动态。结合小角X射线散射（SAXS）数据，进一步优化了AA和CG生成的构象集合。
items.abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a crucial regulator of RNA metabolism whose pathological aggregation is a hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and Alzheimer’s disease. Binding to GU-rich RNA sequences via its RNA recognition motifs (RRM1 and RRM2) is known to antagonize aggregation, yet the molecular mechanisms by which RNA modulates TDP-43 conformational and supramolecular organization remain poorly understood. This limitation arises from the challenges related to the structural resolution of the inter-domain dynamics by experimental methods due to the protein intrinsically disordered regions, notably the linker connecting the N-terminal domain (NTD) to RRM1. To address this gap, we performed a combined all-atom (AA) and coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) investigation of a TDP-43 NTD–RRM1–RRM2 monomer in both the absence and presence of GU-rich RNA. AA simulations were carried out using the protein AMBER03ws and RNA AMBERχOL3 force fields to accurately capture protein–RNA 1 interactions. In parallel, we developed a MARTINI 3–compatible CG model for GU–rich RNA and performed CG simulations to access longer timescale confor
items.authors: Zichen Feng, Cagla Okyay, Aurélien Thureau, David Pastré, Ahmed Bouhss, Liuba Mazzanti

items.title: Large Language Models in Chemistry and Materials Science: A Comprehensive Survey
items.title_zh: 化学与材料科学中的大型语言模型综述
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在通过连接科学知识、异构数据、计算工具和实验工作流程，拓展人工智能在化学和材料科学中的应用。本文全面调查了以LLM为中心的科学系统的基础、表征、方法、应用和评估。我们提出了一种非排他性的表征机制分类法，将文本、分子和晶体结构、光谱、图像及数值属性与模型适应、跨表征基础、外部知识和工具、工作流程协调相联系。在此框架内，我们综合了提示、领域预训练与微调、偏好对齐与验证驱动的强化学习、多模态集成以及基于检索和代理的方法。应用涵盖文献理解、性质预测、分子与材料设计、合成规划、表征、假设生成和闭环发现。通过将方法选择与输入信息、任务定义和验证条件联系起来，框架阐明了哪些报告结果可以比较及其支持的科学主张。我们组织了代表性数据集和基准，并引入了一个评估矩阵，将任务性能与信息保真度、不确定性等联系起来。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding the scope of artificial intelligence in chemistry and materials science by connecting scientific knowledge, heterogeneous data, computational tools, and experimental workflows. This article presents a comprehensive survey of the foundations, representations, methods, applications, and evaluation of LLM-centered scientific systems. We develop a non-exclusive representation-by-mechanism taxonomy linking text, molecular and crystal structures, spectra, images, and numerical properties with model adaptation, cross-representation grounding, external knowledge and tools, and workflow coordination. Within this framework, we synthesize prompting, domain pre-training and fine-tuning, preference alignment and verifier-driven reinforcement learning, multimodal integration, and retrieval- and agent-based approaches. Applications span literature understanding, property prediction, molecular and materials design, synthesis planning, characterization, hypothesis generation, and closed-loop discovery. By linking method choices to input information, task definitions, and validation conditions, the framework clarifies which reported results can be compared
items.authors: JINSHI LI, CHENGCHUN LIU, CHENGRUI WEI, YIMI WANG, BOXUAN ZHAO, ZHIYUAN YAN

items.title: Seedless one-pot synthesis of high aspect ratio chiral gold nanofibers
items.title_zh: 无种子一锅法合成高纵横比手性金纳米纤维
items.summary_zh: 手性是自然界的基本特征，在分子识别、催化和细胞组织中起着决定性作用。本文报道了一种高纵横比手性金纳米纤维的合成方法，这是一类一维手性等离子体材料。采用无种子、软模板、配体辅助的生长方法，以D/L-半胱氨酸作为手性诱导剂。小角X射线衍射和X射线光电子能谱结果支持软模板介导的生长机制假设。所得到的手性金纳米纤维表现出明显的镜像对称圆二色性信号和特征性等离子共振，确认其内在的结构手性。此外，4D扫描透射电子显微镜分析表明，原子以手性方式排列，导致金纳米纤维的表面手性。总之，该研究建立了一种简单且可扩展的途径，以制造具有潜在应用于不对称催化、光学传感和生物指导支架的手性金结构。
items.abstract: Chirality, a fundamental characteristic of nature, plays a decisive role in molecular recognition, catalysis, and cellular organization. Translating this asymmetry into synthetic systems has the potential to unlock new functionalities at the interface of nanoscience and biology. Here, we report the synthesis of high-aspect-ratio chiral gold nanofibers, a class of one-dimensional chiral plasmonic materials, fabricated via a seedless, soft-templated, ligand-assisted growth method using D/L-cysteine as chiral inducers. Small-angle X-ray diffraction and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy results support the hypothesis of a soft template-mediated growth mechanism. The resulting chiral gold nanofibers exhibit pronounced, mirror-symmetric circular dichroism signals and characteristic plasmonic resonances, confirming their intrinsic structural chirality. Further, 4D scanning transmission electron microscopy analysis indicates that the atoms arrange in a chiral fashion, resulting in the observed topographical chirality of the gold nanofibers. Altogether, this effort establishes a simple and scalable route to fabricate chiral gold architectures with potential applications in asymmetric catalys
items.authors: Mathias R. S. Nielsen, Rebekka Klemmt, Espen D. Bøjesen, Marcos López Hernández, Jan Skov Pedersen, Miguel Alexandre Ramos-Docampo

items.title: Performance Self-Blown Non-Isocyanate Polyurethane Foams
items.title_zh: 自发泡非异氰酸酯聚氨酯泡沫的性能研究
items.summary_zh: 刚性泡沫在结构应用中因其刚度与密度的特定平衡而占有一席之地。无异氰酸酯的替代品难以复制这种平衡。水发泡的聚羟基聚氨酯（PHU）泡沫是最有前景的无异氰酸酯替代品，但有毒的碱催化剂和较弱的机械性能限制了其应用。研究表明，布朗斯特酸催化有效，动态平衡的瞬态质子化与热胺再生扩大了水驱动CO2释放的流变窗口，同时实现了网络的完全转化。酸性条件还激活了乙烯醚，将负责潮湿增塑的侧链和邻位羟基转化为缩醛交联。所得到的聚（羟基聚氨酯）-聚缩醛（PHU–PAC）泡沫表现出16倍的橡胶模量、4倍的压缩模量（4 → 18 MPa），以及相较于PHU基准的水吸收量减半。标准化的峰值热释放速率几乎降至商业PU泡沫的八分之一，在特定强度与刚度的Ashby图上，PHU–PAC接近HDPE和PVC。
items.abstract: Rigid foams earn their place in structural applications through a specific balance of stiffness and density. Reproducing that balance without isocyanates has proven far harder than replacing the chemistry itself. Water-blown polyhydroxyurethane (PHU) foams are the most credible isocyanate-free alternatives to conventional polyurethanes, but toxic base catalysts and weak mechanical properties have stalled their adoption. Brønsted acid catalysis, long dismissed on the expectation that amine protonation suppresses urethane formation, proves effective instead: a dynamic equilibrium of transient protonation and thermal amine regeneration widens the rheological window for water-driven CO2 release while carrying the network to full conversion. Acidic conditions additionally activate vinyl ethers, converting the pendant and vicinal hydroxyls responsible for moisture plasticization into acetal crosslinks. The resulting poly(hydroxyurethane)–polyacetal (PHU–PAC) foams show a sixteenfold (16x) higher rubbery modulus, a fourfold higher compressive modulus (4 → 18 MPa), and halved water uptake relative to the PHU benchmark. items.authors: Gabriel Perli, Guillem Seychal, Bruno A. Piscelli, Yi Wang, Maliheh Razavi-Esfali, Lucas Polo Fonseca

items.title: Interfacial Solvent Engineering of Zinc Porphyrin Hydrogen-Bonded Organic Frameworks Enables Aggregation-Enhanced Electrochemiluminescence for Synthetic Cannabinoid Sensing
items.title_zh: 锌卟啉氢键有机框架的界面溶剂工程及其在合成大麻素传感中的应用
items.summary_zh: 锌卟啉氢键有机框架（ZnTCPP HOFs）在固/液界面易发生无序的短程π-π堆叠，导致聚集引起的猝灭（ACQ），从而限制其电化学发光（ECL）效率。当前抑制ACQ的策略主要依赖于共价或配位键，通常合成过程繁琐。本研究从胶体与界面科学的角度出发，提出了一种壳聚糖（CS）-DMF反溶剂沉淀策略。该方法重组氢键网络，促进CS与ZnTCPP HOFs羧基之间的静电结合，从而实现大晶体向微/纳米聚集体的可控转化。这种协同效应抑制了短程π-π堆叠，同时增强了长程聚集诱导发光（AIE），显著提高了ECL效率，无需额外的共反应促进剂。基于此，开发了一种基于适配体的ECL传感器，实现了对5F-EDMB-PINACA的超灵敏检测，检测限为8.61 × 10^-16 g/L，线性范围跨越九个数量级。这些发现强调了胶体-界面调控在ECL传感中的有效性。
items.abstract: Zinc porphyrin hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (ZnTCPP HOFs) are prone to uncontrolled short-range π–π stacking at solid/liquid interfaces, which leads to aggregation-caused quenching (ACQ) and consequently limits their electrochemiluminescence (ECL) efficiency. Current strategies for suppressing ACQ primarily depend on covalent or coordination bonds and often involve laborious synthesis. Addressing this challenge from the perspective of colloid and interface science, this study introduces a chitosan (CS)–DMF counter-solvent precipitation strategy. This approach reorganizes the hydrogen-bond network and fosters electrostatic association between CS and the carboxyl groups of ZnTCPP HOFs, thereby facilitating a controlled transformation of bulk crystals into micro/nano-aggregates. This synergistic effect suppresses short-range π–π stacking while enhancing long-range aggregation-induced emission (AIE), leading to a significant improvement in ECL efficiency without the need for an additional co-reaction promoter. On this basis, an aptamer-based ECL sensor was developed for the ultrasensitive detection of 5F-EDMB-PINACA, achieving a limit of detection of 8.61 × 10 -16 g/L and a linea
items.authors: Yanpei Zhang, Ding Jiang, Bingxue Fan, Mingyang Han, Suran Tian, Haibo Li

items.title: RaX-DT: An Open-Source Platform for Automated Molecular Docking Workflows and Reproducible Pipeline Validation
items.title_zh: RaX-DT：自动化分子对接工作流的开源平台
items.summary_zh: 自动化分子对接工作流常常在配体准备、蛋白质准备、结合位点定义和后处理的接口处失败。我们提出了RaX-DT，这是一个开源的、可通过Docker Compose部署的平台，将这些步骤集成在一个单一的网络应用程序和可选的对话助手中。RaX-DT自动化了3D配体生成、互变异构体/质子化状态处理、蛋白质清理、通过P2Rank、Fpocket或用户指定坐标定义结合位点、基于GNINA的对接和交互式结果可视化。我们在231个来自DUD-E和LIT-PCBA的蛋白质-配体共晶结构上验证了组装的工作流，其中186个结构成功完成；对于65.1%的完成结构，排名最高的构象与晶体构象的偏差在2.0 Å以内，五个最高评分构象中的最佳达到了77.4%。验证还揭示了一个盒子放置缺陷，可能产生看似合理但无效的输出，强调了管道级质量控制的价值。RaX-DT在MIT许可证下发布，旨在提高常规对接工作流的可及性、可重复性和透明性。
items.abstract: Automated molecular docking workflows often fail not at the scoring engine but at the interfaces between ligand preparation, protein preparation, binding-site definition, and post-processing. We present RaX-DT, an open-source, Docker Compose–deployable platform that integrates these steps in a single web application and an optional conversational assistant. RaX-DT automates 3D ligand generation, tautomer/protonation-state handling, protein cleaning, binding-site definition via P2Rank, Fpocket, or user-specified coordinates, GNINA-based docking, and interactive result visualization. Because end-to-end automation can introduce silent failures, we validated the assembled workflow on 231 protein–ligand co-crystal structures from DUD-E and LIT-PCBA rather than treating the docking engine in isolation. Of these, 186 structures completed successfully; the top-ranked pose reproduced the crystallographic pose within 2.0 Å for 65.1% of completed structures, and the best of the five top-scoring poses reached 77.4%. Validation also exposed a box-placement defect that would have produced plausible-looking but invalid output, underscoring the value of pipeline-level quality control. RaX-DT is re
items.authors: Amir Hosein Ghavi, Bita Barazandeh Shirvan, Zohre Ganji, Zahra Jafari, Mojgan Nejabat, Farzin Hadizadeh

items.title: Synthesis and Ambiphilic Reactivity of a Monocoordinate Carbazolyl Gallylene
items.title_zh: 单配位卡巴唑基镓烯的合成与两亲反应性
items.summary_zh: 单配位无路易斯碱的镓(I)配合物因其易于发生不均化和聚合而较为罕见。本研究报道了一种由大体积1,8-bis(3,5-二叔丁基苯基)-3,6-二叔丁基卡巴唑配体稳定的单体单配位镓烯的合成及结构表征。利用侧链芳基取代基提供的显著动力学屏蔽，该化合物可作为无溶剂的单配位主族卡宾体分离。该化合物具有孤对电子和两个空的p轨道，表现出两亲特性，通过与路易斯酸性过渡金属片段（M(CO)5；M = Cr, Mo, W）及强σ供体路易斯碱（如N-杂环卡宾(IPrMe NHC)和4-二甲氨基吡啶(DMAP)）的配位进行了实验探测。此外，Ga(I)配合物显示出对碘化甲基和菲-9,10-二酮的氧化加成。与其他单配位镓烯化合物相反，其碳金属化反应在动力学和热力学上均不利。
items.abstract: Monocoordinate Lewis base-free gallium(I) complexes are rare due to their high propensity for disproportionation and oligomerization. Herein, we report the synthesis and structural characterization of a monomeric, monocoordinate gallylene stabilized by a bulky 1,8-bis(3,5-ditert-butylphenyl)-3,6-di-tert-butylcarbazole ligand. Taking advantage of the substantial kinetic shielding provided by the flanking aryl substituents, the compound can be isolated as a solvent free, one-coordinate main-group carbenoid. With a lone pair and two vacant p-orbitals, this compound features an ambiphilic character which was experimentally probed through coordination to both Lewis-acidic transition-metal fragments (M(CO) 5 ; M = Cr, Mo, W) and strong σ-donor Lewis bases, including the N-heterocyclic carbene ( IPrMe NHC) and 4-dimethylaminopyridine (DMAP). Furthermore, the Ga(I) complex shows oxidative addition of methyl iodide and phenanthrene-9,10-dione. Conversely to other monocoordinate gallylene compounds its carbometallation reactions are kinetically and thermodynamically unfavored.
items.authors: Nasrina Parvin, T. Ilgin Demirer, Dennis Welterlich, Bernd Morgenstern, Alexander Hinz, Diego M. Andrada

items.title: Collaborative Laboratory Edge Networks
items.title_zh: 协作实验室边缘网络中的化学模型训练
items.summary_zh: 化学语言模型能够以有用的准确性预测反应和逆合成路径，但在制药和精细化工实践中，这些模型的假设并不成立。我们提出了ChemFedFusion，这是一个考虑异质性的框架，用于在协作实验室边缘网络上进行联邦化学模型训练和卸载。ChemUCP是一个化学感知的效用-成本预测器，通过预期化学增益、预期延迟和明确的分布外风险来评估任务-节点对。CSAW通过引入支架空间互补性、站点可靠性和减弱体积保护的乘积，替代样本计数聚合，放大稀有化学而抑制噪声站点。ARCO通过共享适应矩阵和事件驱动的异步聚合器将卸载与聚合结合起来，以便成功的卸载能够教会聚合器哪个节点是合格的。
items.abstract: Chemistry language models now predict reactions and retrosynthetic routes with useful accuracy, but they assume that proprietary reaction records can be pooled into a central cluster and that inference runs on abundant accelerators. Neither assumption holds in pharmaceutical and fine-chemical practice, where yield records cannot leave the plant network, the points of use are heterogeneous resource-limited sites, and different laboratories occupy disjoint regions of chemical space. We present ChemFedFusion, a heterogeneity-aware framework for federated chemistry-model training and offloading over collaborative laboratory edge networks. ChemUCP is a chemistry-aware utility–cost predictor that scores a task–node pair by expected chemistry gain, expected latency, and an explicit out-of-distribution risk of emitting unparsable or unreliable chemistry, using a dual-channel tokenizer and a scaffold-coverage encoder that is corrected online from execution feedback. CSAW replaces sample-count aggregation with the product of a scaffold-space complementarity term, a site reliability term, and a weakened volume guard, amplifying rare chemistry while suppressing noisy sites. items.authors: Andre Williams, Shanice Brown, Kevin Thompson, Jamar Campbell, Alicia Morgan

items.title: Alternative synthetic pathways to selected molecular fluorophores present in citric acid-based carbon dots
items.title_zh: 柠檬酸基碳点中分子荧光团的替代合成路径
items.summary_zh: 分子荧光团（MFs）是通过自下而上的方法从小有机分子合成碳点（CDs）时所制备的许多反应混合物的重要组成部分。尽管它们对所制备CDs的发光有显著贡献，但MF的光学性质研究因pH依赖性、互变异构体的形成可能性、低产率和复杂的分离过程而变得复杂。本文总结了在柠檬酸（及各种掺杂剂）制备的CDs中检测到的MF的结构，这些结构包含与5或6元杂环相连的吡啶-2(1H)-酮环。这些化合物与柠檬酸氨基酸（CZA）密切相关。综述的第二部分探讨了环融合2-吡啶酮的替代合成路径，这些路径可用于制备类似化合物，避免直接从CA合成时的缺点（如与MF一起形成碳质基质导致低产率）。通过替代路径制备的MF，去除了聚合和炭化颗粒，可作为标准以更好地理解CDs的光学性质。
items.abstract: Molecular fluorophores (MFs) are an integral part of many raw reaction mixtures prepared during the synthesis of carbon dots (CDs) from small organic molecules by the bottom-up methods. Despite their significant contribution to the luminescence of as-prepared CDs, the investigation of optical properties of MF is complicated by the pH dependence, possibility of formation of tautomers, low yields and complicated isolation. In this review, we summarize the structure of MFs detected in CDs prepared from citric acid (and various dopants), whose structure contains pyridin-2(1 H )-one ring annulated to 5- or 6-membered heterocycles. These compounds are closely related to citrazinic acid (CZA). The second part of the review deals with the alternative synthesis pathways towards ring-fused 2-pyridones, that could be used to prepare analogous compounds without the drawbacks related to the direct synthesis from CA (formation of carbonaceous matrix along with MFs resulting in low yields). MFs prepared by alternative pathways, free from polymerized and carbonized particles, could be used as standards towards better understanding of optical properties of CDs.
items.authors: Alex Sedlařík, Jela Nociarová

items.title: From Automated Beamlines to Autonomous Science
items.title_zh: 从自动化光束线到自主科学的转变
items.summary_zh: 自主实验在材料合成、同步辐射和中子表征、实时分析及科学决策中逐渐兴起。然而，单靠日益强大的人工智能并不能实现自主科学。科学用户设施必须提供可机器操作的实验、可机器读取和互操作的数据与接口、实验生命周期中的持久来源、可跨仪器和设施发现与协调的科学能力，以及与迭代实验活动兼容的访问模型。我们认为这些基础设施需求应视为一个耦合的科学设计问题。其价值不仅限于提高通量：减少观察、解释、决策与下一次测量之间的延迟，可以使亚稳态、竞争相/相共存、降解、失效路径、相边界及其他难以获取的现象在实验中可观察。我们借鉴了自主实验室和先进表征的最新示范，以及2026年先进光源自动化与自主实验室研讨会的讨论，概述了从自动化仪器到分布式自主发现生态系统的实际进展。
items.abstract: Autonomous experimentation is emerging across materials synthesis, synchrotron and neutron characterization, real-time analysis, and scientific decision-making. Yet increasingly capable artificial intelligence does not by itself create autonomous science. Scientific user facilities must also provide machine-operable experiments, machine-readable and interoperable data and interfaces, persistent provenance across the experimental lifecycle, scientific capabilities that can be discovered and orchestrated across instruments and facilities, and access models compatible with iterative experimental campaigns. We argue that these infrastructure requirements should be treated as a coupled scientific design problem. Their value is not limited to higher throughput: reducing the latency between observation, interpretation, decision, and the next measurement can make metastable states, competing phases / phase coexistence, degradation, failure pathways, phase boundaries, and other difficult-to-access phenomena experimentally observable. Drawing on recent demonstrations in autonomous laboratories and advanced characterization, along with discussions from the 2026 Advanced Light Source Automatio
items.authors: Chenhui Zhu, Marcus M. Noack, Wiebke Koepp, Thomas Ferron, Oleg Kostko, Damon English

items.title: Exploration of Low-Crystalline NiPd(CN)4 by Ab Initio Global Structure Search
items.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的低晶体NiPd(CN)4结构探索
items.summary_zh: 对于低晶体无机材料，单靠衍射测量往往难以唯一确定其晶体结构。本研究通过实验与第一性原理计算相结合，确定了新合成的金属氰化物NiPd(CN)4的晶体结构。观察到的粉末X射线衍射图谱无法用任何已报道的类似结构解释，而磁化测量表明基态存在有限的局部磁矩。利用这些实验约束作为线索，我们通过启发式结构建模获得了扭曲的平面正方形配位的放松结构，并通过第一性原理全局结构搜索发现了µ-桥接结构，其中Ni呈现六配位八面体环境。候选结构通过粉末X射线衍射、拉曼散射、XAFS、STEM和紫外-可见光光谱的理论与实验比较得到了全面验证，发现µ-桥接结构能够很好地再现实验结果。基于这些发现，我们得出结论：µ-桥接结构被强烈建议为NiPd(CN)4的实际结构。
items.abstract: For poorly crystalline inorganic materials, it is often difficult to uniquely determine the crystal structure from diffraction measurements alone. In this study, we identified the crystal structure of a newly synthesized metal cyanide NiPd(CN) 4 by combining experiments with ab initio calculations. The observed powder X-ray diffraction pattern could not be explained by any previously reported analogous structures, while magnetization measurements indicated the presence of a finite local magnetic moment in the ground state. Using these experimental constraints as clues, we obtained a relaxed tilt structure with distorted square-planar coordination through heuristic structure modeling, and discovered a µ-bridged structure, in which Ni adopts a six-coordinate octahedral environment, through ab initio global structure search. The candidate structures were comprehensively validated through comparisons between theory and experiment for powder X-ray diffraction, Raman scattering, XAFS, STEM, and UV–vis spectroscopy, and the µ-bridged structure was found to reproduce the experimental results well. items.authors: Ryunosuke Fujimaru, Yuudai Iwai, Haruka Yoshino, Hitoshi Miyasaka, Koji Kimoto, Yusuke Nambu

items.title: Investigating pH Effects on the Photoswitching of Furanyl-Indolinium Heteroarylstilbenes
items.title_zh: 研究pH对呋喃基吲哚鎓异芳烯的光开关效应
items.summary_zh: 阳离子异芳烯，如呋喃基吲哚鎓色素，是一类水溶性、可见光响应的光开关。然而，它们在生理相关pH条件下的光化学行为尚不充分了解。本研究合成了四种衍生物，并系统地研究了它们在三种pH值下的光开关特性，使用磷酸盐缓冲介质。通过紫外可见光谱分析可见光诱导的E/Z光异构化动力学，结果异构体的结构通过核磁共振光谱确认。关键结果是，热Z→E反异构化在磷酸盐缓冲液中表现出明显的pH依赖性，而光诱导的E→Z开关仅受到弱影响。表观热恢复被竞争的暗衰减过程叠加，独立量化以区分实际的热反异构化动力学。衍生物在化学稳定性上存在差异，甲基取代的衍生物相对稳健，而硝基取代的衍生物则表现出明显降解。这些结果表明，仅有水溶性并不能保证在生物相关条件下的稳健光开关，pH依赖的开关动力学和化学稳定性均需考虑。
items.abstract: Cationic heteroarylstilbenes, such as the furanyl-indolinium chromophore, represent a class of watersoluble, visible-light-responsive photoswitches. However, their photochemical behaviour under physiologically relevant pH conditions remains insufficiently understood. In this study, four derivatives were synthesized and systematically investigated, with particular emphasis on their photoswitching properties at three pH values using phosphate-buffered media. The visible-light-induced E/Z photoisomerization kinetics were analysed by UV/Vis spectroscopy, while the structures of the resulting isomers were confirmed by NMR spectroscopy. A key result is the pronounced pH dependence of the thermal Z→E back-isomerization in phosphate buffer, whereas the photoinduced E→Z switching is only weakly affected. The apparent thermal recovery is superimposed by a competing dark-decay process, which was quantified independently to separate concurrent degradation from the actual thermal back-isomerization kinetics. The derivatives differ in their chemical stability. The methyl-substituted derivative is comparatively robust, whereas the nitro-substituted derivative shows pronounced degradation. These r
items.authors: M. Seemann, J. N. Riese, R. Geitner, A. G. Groß, Alexander Gross

items.title: VIBE-QC: an open-source, general-purpose electronic-structure code for molecules and solids developed with generative AI
items.title_zh: VIBE-QC：基于生成式AI的分子与固体电子结构开源代码
items.summary_zh: 我们介绍了VIBE-QC，这是一款针对分子和固体的通用开源电子结构代码，几乎完全通过生成式AI辅助编程（“vibe-coding”）在专家指导下开发。该分子模块提供Hartree-Fock和Kohn-Sham DFT，涵盖完整的LIBXC库，具备解析梯度和Hessian、Møller-Plesset理论及双杂化、局部相关变体的耦合簇、多参考方法、激发态、色散、连续溶剂化、有效核心势和半经验方法。周期性模块处理一维、二维和三维系统，通过三种Fock构建路径实现多𝒌计算。生产结果通过与已建立参考程序的交叉代码比较进行验证，达到纳哈特里级别的平均场方法和3.3 × 10−7 𝐸h的传统CCSD(T)精度；周期性总能量的外部对称性验证仍在进行中，相关进展在公共问题追踪器中记录。VIBE-QC还增加了基于容器的结果存储和可视化格式（QVF）、交互式查看器（VIBEVIEW）和作业队列（VIBE-QUEUE），遵循MPL-2.0许可证。
items.abstract: We present VIBE-QC, a general-purpose open-source electronic-structure code for molecules and solids, developed almost entirely through generative-AI-assisted programming (“vibe-coding”) under expert human direction. The molecular stack provides Hartree–Fock and Kohn–Sham DFT over the full LIBXC library, analytic gradients and Hessians, Møller–Plesset theory and double hybrids, coupled cluster with local-correlation variants, multireference methods, excited states, dispersion, continuum solvation, effective core potentials, and semiempirical methods. The periodic stack treats one-, two-, and three-dimensional systems at multiple 𝒌 through three Fock-build routes. Production claims are validated by out-of-process cross-code comparisons against established reference programs, reaching the nanohartree scale for mean-field methods and 3.3 × 10−7 𝐸h for conventional CCSD(T); external parity for periodic total energies is open work at this release, tracked in the public issue tracker. VIBEQC adds a container-based results-storage and visualization format (QVF), an interactive viewer (VIBEVIEW), and a job queue (VIBE-QUEUE), under the MPL-2.0 license. Graphical TOC summary. items.title: Direct visualization of heterogeneous molecular diffusion and interfacial barriers during condensate ripening
items.title_zh: 直接观察冷凝物成熟过程中的分子扩散与界面障碍
items.summary_zh: 成熟过程在乳液、晶体、合金和生物分子冷凝物等多相系统中普遍存在，显著影响系统形态及其性质。尽管成熟现象已研究数百年，但从分子层面观察这一过程仍未实现，限制了我们对其基本理解。本文采用单分子追踪技术，观察和量化聚-L-赖氨酸（PLL）在快速成熟过程中扩散动力学，ATP液滴冷凝物转变为纤维晶体。我们成功观察到PLL在稀相和冷凝相中向生长晶体的偏好运动，并揭示了界面附近未知的分子动力学。在冷凝物界面，PLL分子遇到能量障碍，限制其运动并阻碍逃离冷凝物。在晶体纤维附近，我们发现分子动力学的明显异质性，可分为布朗运动、限制运动和超扩散运动。模拟和物理模型表明，晶体纤维上形成的水润滑层使PLL分子能够以超扩散运动沿纤维滑动。
items.abstract: Ripening processes are ubiquitous in various multiphase systems, such as emulsions, crystals, alloys, and biomolecular condensates. This phenomenon significantly affects the morphology of a system and its resulting properties through the growth of dispersed domains at the expense of others without direct contact. Though ripening has been studied for centuries, a molecule-level visualization of this process has never been captured, significantly hindering our fundamental understanding. Here, we use single-molecule tracking techniques to visualize and quantify the diffusion dynamics of poly-L-lysine (PLL) during a rapid ripening process, where ATP droplet condensates transform into fibrillar crystals. We successfully observe preferential motion of PLL within both the dilute and condensate phases toward growing crystals and uncover previously unknown molecular dynamics near interfaces. At condensate interfaces, PLL molecules encounter energetic barriers that trap their motions and restrict their escape from condensates. Near crystal fibers, we discover clear heterogeneity in molecular dynamics, which can be classified into Brownian, confined, and superdiffusive motions. To explain thi
items.authors: Feipeng Chen, Arman Moussavi, Christopher Rademacher, Danielle Tullman-Ercek, Sinan Keten, Muzhou Wang

items.title: Enhancing Grignard reactions via anion borrowing in deep eutectic /organic biphasic media
items.title_zh: 通过阴离子借用在深共熔/有机双相介质中增强Grignard反应
items.summary_zh: Grignard反应的合理优化对合成化学家而言仍然是一个重大挑战。研究表明，使用深共熔溶剂（DES）可以提高对不饱和有机分子的亲核加成反应的性能。本研究中，将Grignard在THF中的溶液加入到含有底物的DES中，并进行剧烈搅拌。我们结合从头算分子动力学、量子力学/分子力学模拟和增强采样，使用异丙基氯化镁和乙酰苯作为试剂，THF作为有机溶剂，1:2的氯化胆碱与甘油溶液作为DES，探讨了这一有益效应的根本原因。结果显示，在DES/THF介质中，Grignard反应的优先性增加，抑制了源自异丙基的β-H转移形成副产物的可能性。这种增强的选择性源于在DES界面形成的氯化二镁物种。尽管中性Grignard在大体积THF中动力学上偏向于β-H转移，但DES中的氯富集使得两种反应的动力学更为等效，并显著有利于Grignard产物的热力学偏好，结果是增加了分子内的稳定相互作用。这一结果与实验证据一致，表明选择性提高。
items.abstract: The rational optimization of the Grignard reaction remains a considerable challenge for synthetic chemists. When assessing nucleophilic additions to unsaturated organic molecules, it has been shown that improved performance can be achieved using deep eutectic solvents (DESs). In this case, a solution of the Grignard in THF is added to the DES containing the substrate under vigorous stirring. In this study, we determine the underlying causes for this beneficial effect by combining ab initio molecular dynamics, QM/MM simulations, and enhanced sampling, using i -PrMgCl and acetophenone as reagents, THF as the organic solvent, and a 1:2 solution of choline chloride:glycerol as the DES. Our results show an increased preference for the Grignard reaction over the formation of by-products originating from a β-H transfer from the isopropyl group with the DES/THF media. This enhanced selectivity stems from the formation of chlorinated dimagnesium entities at the DES interface. While the reaction of a neutral Grignard in bulk THF kinetically favours the β-H transfer, the chlorine enrichment originating from the DES is shown to make the two reactions kinetically more equivalent, and to drastic
items.authors: Marco Bortoli, Eva Hevia, Odile Eisenstein, Michele Cascella

items.title: Multimodal Representation Learning for Exploring Natural Product Chemical Space
items.title_zh: 多模态表征学习探索天然产物化学空间
items.summary_zh: 天然产物是重要的治疗分子来源，但其结构多样性和有限的生物注释对计算探索和发现构成了挑战。本文开发了一种多模态分子表征框架，将化学语言、分子指纹、物理化学描述符和分子图整合为统一的潜在空间，以促进天然产物的发现。通过使用结构上不在分布内的分子空间，我们展示了分子表征和采样策略共同决定了化学空间的探索区域。多模态预训练捕捉了化学信息丰富的表征，使得对结构上未见的天然产物的探索成为可能。与单模态表征的比较表明，表征优势取决于发现目标，而非普遍优越。预训练表征在抗炎和抗氧化活性预测中具有可转移性，并与主动学习结合，实现了生物活性分子的高效探索。对结构上未见的天然产物的前瞻性评估进一步将模型引导的探索与实验抗氧化活性联系起来。这些发现确立了分子表征和采样作为化学空间探索的耦合决定因素。
items.abstract: Natural products represent a major source of therapeutic molecules, yet their structural diversity and limited biological annotations pose substantial challenges for computational exploration and discovery. Here, we develop a multimodal molecular representation framework that integrates chemical language, molecular fingerprints, physicochemical descriptors, and molecular graphs into a unified latent space for natural product discovery. Using structurally out-of-distribution molecular spaces, we show that molecular representation and sampling strategy jointly determine which regions of chemical space are explored. Multimodal pretraining captured chemically informative representations that enabled exploration of structurally unseen natural products, while comparisons with singlemodality representations showed that representation advantages depended on the discovery objective rather than being universally superior. The pretrained representation was transferable across anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity predictions, and its integration with active learning enabled data-efficient exploration of biologically active molecules. items.authors: Tarapong Srisongkram, Supreeya Paiboon, Huynh Anh Duy

items.title: Molecule–Metal Nanostructure Interactions in Plasmonic Chemistry
items.title_zh: 分子-金属纳米结构在等离子体化学中的相互作用
items.summary_zh: 等离子体化学通过分子-金属界面的三个相互关联的通道将金属纳米结构转化为光催化剂：增强的近场、非平衡电荷载体和局部热量。本文重点讨论这一界面视角，展示了吸附物和配体不仅仅是附着在纳米颗粒上，它们还会降低等离子体寿命、改变功函数、修改态密度，并影响各种物理过程中的能量和电荷流动。在脉冲激发下的超快热化和连续照明下的稳态条件下，为化学反应开辟了不同的途径。尽管等离子体金属至关重要，但表面结合的分子通过捕获电荷载体积极参与，影响选择性和稳定性，甚至经历化学转化。这些方面对于控制产物分布和利用激发态途径实现新型化学反应至关重要。结合等离子体纳米结构的纳米尺度特性，化学反应可以被限制在由几何形状和极化所塑造的纳米级热点中。这些见解为天线-反应器混合体和新型等离子体材料的实用设计原则的发展提供了指导。
items.abstract: Plasmonic chemistry converts metal nanostructures into photocatalysts via three interconnected channels at the molecule–metal interface: enhanced near fields, non-equilibrium charge carriers, and localized heat. This review focuses on this interfacial perspective. We show how adsorbates and ligands do more than just stick to nanoparticles – they reduce plasmon lifetimes, change work functions, modify the density of states, and impact the energy and charge flow during various physical processes. Ultrafast thermalization under pulsed excitation and steady state conditions under continuous illumination open up different pathways for chemical reactions. Although the plasmonic metal is crucial, surface-bound molecules actively participate by scavenging charge carriers, affecting selectivity and stability, and even undergoing chemical transformations. These aspects are crucial for controlling product distributions and enabling novel chemical pathways by exploiting excited-state pathways inaccessible through thermal energy. Together with the nanoscale properties of plasmonic nanostructures, chemical reactions can be confined to nanoscale hot spots shaped by geometry and polarization. Thes
items.authors: Sergio Kogikoski Junior, Wouter Koopman, Felix Stete, Radwan M. Sarhan, Shashank K.Gahlaut, Evgenii Titov

items.title: Incoherent Transport Signatures in Ferrocene and Ferrocenium-based Molecular Wires
items.title_zh: 铁烯和铁烯阳离子分子导线中的无相干传输特征
items.summary_zh: 包含氧化还原单元的分子导线是单分子电子学的基础，但决定电荷传输主要通过相干量子隧穿还是热激活无相干跳跃的分子设计和环境仍存在争议。通过合成稳定的Fe(III)铁烯阳离子导线（外部氧化）并与电化学调控的Fe(II)类似物（内部氧化）在扫描隧道显微镜断裂接头中比较其分子导电性，我们识别出共存传输机制的不同实验特征。在铁烯和铁烯阳离子系统中，尽管在低偏压下相干隧穿主导，但有利的环境重组能量在高偏压下触发高效的两步序列过程。这些发现解决了金属烯分子电子学中的一个长期机制问题，并强调仅依靠双端测量不足以解决此类模糊性。我们的电化学方法为分子接头中传输现象的更稳健表征提供了途径。
items.abstract: Molecular wires incorporating redox units are foundational to single-molecule electronics, yet the molecular designs and environment which govern whether charge-transport proceeds predominantly via phase-coherent quantum tunnelling or thermally activated incoherent hopping remains debated. By synthesising bench-stable Fe(III) ferrocenium wires ( ex-situ oxidation) and comparing their molecular conductance against electrochemically gated Fe(II) analogues ( in-situ oxidation) within scanning tunnelling microscopy break-junctions, we identify distinct experimental signatures of coexisting transport regimes. For both ferrocene and ferrocenium systems, while phase-coherent tunnelling through frontier molecular orbitals dominates at low bias, favourable environmental reorganisation energetics trigger efficient, two-step sequential processes at high biases. These findings resolve a long-standing mechanistic question in metallocene molecular electronics and highlight how two-terminal measurements alone are insufficient to resolve such ambiguities. Our combined electrochemical approach provides a pathway to more robust characterisation of transport phenomena in molecular junctions.
items.authors: Linlin Hou, Varshini Kumar, Munirah Alsaqer, Amit Sil, James M. F. Morris, Chongguang Liu

items.title: Atomic Orbital Interactions in [CeX6]2– (X = F, Cl, Br): Consequences for X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopic Analysis
items.title_zh: [CeX6]2–（X = F, Cl, Br）中原子轨道相互作用的研究
items.summary_zh: 本文利用密度泛函理论（DFT）和预结合分析研究了[CeX6]2–复合物（X = F, Cl, Br）中的金属-配体键合。分析量化了复合物中原子轨道（AO）能量和重叠，重点关注铈（Ce）4f轨道与卤素𝑛p供体轨道之间的混合。结果表明，从F到Br，Ce-配体AO重叠的减少被AO能量匹配的改善所补偿，导致4f基的配体向金属的捐赠在系列中增加。基于预结合数据的种群分析合理化了近期实验的X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）发现。通过基于Wolfsberg-Helmholtz（WH）关系的简化AO结合模型从XANES数据中提取的有效轨道重叠与预结合重叠直接比较。使用基于电离势（IP）的AO能量在实验数据处理中的影响及模型固有假设也进行了审视。模型中使用一致的预结合AO能量需要WH常数𝐾 ≃ 3，以重现4f基相互作用的计算重叠。将基于IP的AO能量与传统值𝐾 = 2结合，显示出由于误差的抵消而产生可比的重叠。总体而言，预结合分析为连接AO提供了基于第一性原理理论的框架。
items.abstract: Metal–ligand bonding in [CeX 6 ] 2– complexes (X = F, Cl, Br) is investigated using density functional theory (DFT) and pre-bonding analysis. The analysis quantifies atomic orbital (AO) energies and overlaps in the complexes, with a focus on the mixing between Ce 4f AOs with halide 𝑛p donor AOs. Results indicate that decreasing Ce–ligand AO overlap from X = F to Br is compensated by improved AO energy matching, leading to increased 4f-based ligand-to-metal donation across the series. Population analysis derived from pre-bonding data rationalizes recent experimental X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) findings. Effective orbital overlaps extracted from XANES data using a simplified AO bonding model based on the Wolfsberg–Helmholtz (WH) relation are compared directly with pre-bonding overlaps. The consequences of using ionization potential (IP) based AO energies in the experimental data workup and other assumptions inherent in the bonding model are also scrutinized. Using consistent pre-bonding AO energies in the model requires a WH constant of 𝐾 ≃ 3 to reproduce the calculated overlaps for 4f-based interactions. items.authors: Kurtis Stanistreet-Welsh, Jacob A. Branson, Stefan G. Minasian, Jochen Autschbach

items.title: When the lower-barrier pathway yields the minor enantiomer: reversibility and intermediate stability in pyrroloindoline synthesis
items.title_zh: 低能垒路径导致少量对映体的原因研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过计算方法探讨了由亚胺离子催化的吡咯并吲哚类化合物的对映选择性来源。结合构象搜索与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，我们获得了催化能量剖面，显示对映选择性并非由对映决定的C–C键形成步骤的能垒决定。基于该剖面的微动力学模型重现了实验中的对映过量，并确定了选择性的来源：在产品释放前的步骤可逆的条件下，催化剂结合的中间体I9沿S路径优先积累，其稳定性明显高于R对映体。因此，选择性反映的是在非对映体中间体层面上的热力学贡献，而非活化能垒的差异。我们强调，仅从自由能剖面无法获得这一结果：简单检查活化能垒预测了相反的诱导方向，只有显式的动力学处理才能重现实验结果。之前的研究表明，亚胺离子中间体的E/Z比的控制与催化选择性相关；本研究显示立体诱导源于S路径中间体的优势。
items.abstract: In this work, we present a computational study that provides evidence for the origins of selectivity in the enantioselective synthesis of pyrroloindolines catalyzed by iminium ions. Through a conformational search combined with DFT calculations, we obtained the catalytic energy profile, which shows that the enantioselectivity is not determined by the barriers of the enantiodetermining C–C bond-forming step. A microkinetic model built on this profile reproduces the experimental enantiomeric excess and identifies the origin of the selectivity: under conditions in which the steps preceding product release are reversible, the catalyst-bound intermediate I9 accumulates preferentially along the S pathway, where it is markedly more stable than its R counterpart. The selectivity therefore reflects a thermodynamic contribution operating at the level of the diastereomeric on-cycle intermediates rather than a difference in activation barriers. We stress that this outcome is not accessible from the free energy profile alone: a simple inspection of the activation barriers predicts the opposite sense of induction, and only the explicit kinetic treatment reproduces the experimental results. items.authors: Felipe Schoma Cardoso, Bruno Matos Paz, Ataualpa A. C. Braga

items.title: Why Molecular-Scale Occupancy Fluctuations Appear Gaussian without Being Bulk-Like
items.title_zh: 分子尺度占据波动为何呈高斯分布而非体相特征
items.summary_zh: 水和硬球流体中的分子尺度占据分布可以表现出显著的高斯特征。我们使用经典密度泛函理论，结合与占据相关的外场，计算了硬球流体中球形体积的占据累积量，并重现了之前蒙特卡洛模拟中报告的方差和小的振荡三阶矩。这一结果表明，密度泛函捕捉了导致该现象的相关性，并使排斥体积效应得以分离。通过与泊松极限的比较以及改变观察体积和体密度，我们发现排斥体积相关性显著抑制了高阶累积量。最终的偏度和超峰度保持非零且振荡，但随着观察体积的增大而减小。然而，在相同的分子尺度范围内，有限体积方差仍然强烈依赖于尺度，并未达到由体积压缩性设定的广泛标度。因此，近高斯性的早期出现主要受分子堆积的控制，并不表明波动已达到热力学高斯极限，也不支持由体相高斯波动主导的小腔体制。
items.abstract: Molecular-scale occupancy distributions in water and hard-sphere fluids can appear remarkably Gaussian. Using classical density functional theory with an external field conjugate to the occupancy, we calculate occupancy cumulants for spherical volumes in a hard-sphere fluid and reproduce the variance and small, oscillatory third moment reported previously in Monte Carlo simulations. This agreement shows that the density functional captures the correlations responsible for the phenomenon and allows the role of excluded-volume packing to be isolated. By comparison with the Poisson limit and by varying both observation-volume size and bulk density, we show that excluded-volume correlations strongly suppress the higher cumulants. The resulting skewness and excess kurtosis remain nonzero and oscillatory, but they become small as the observation volume increases. However, over the same molecular-scale range, the finite-volume variance remains strongly scale-dependent and does not attain the extensive scaling set by the bulk compressibility. items.title: [The Lancet Commissions] The NUS–Lancet PRIME Commission: transforming pandemic readiness for equity
items.title_zh: 新加坡国立大学-柳叶刀PRIME委员会：提升疫情应对公平性
items.summary_zh: 新加坡国立大学-柳叶刀疫情准备委员会（PRIME）重新定义了疫情准备，并提供了全社会疫情规划和实施的实用蓝图。该委员会借鉴了COVID-19疫情的教训，汇集了来自20个国家的证据，包括对不同社区和群体成员的访谈、未来情景分析和流行病学建模。通过将生活经验与系统分析和前瞻性证据相结合，委员会阐明了政府、机构和社区如何在健康危机的各个阶段，从正式计划转向以人为本的保护措施。
items.abstract: The National University of Singapore (NUS)–Lancet Pandemic Readiness through Institutions, Mobilising Communities, and Equity (PRIME) Commission redefines pandemic readiness and offers a practical blueprint for whole-of-society pandemic planning and implementation. Drawing on the hard lessons of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Commission brings together evidence from 20 countries, including interviews with members of diverse communities and groups, future scenarios, and epidemiological modelling. By integrating lived experience with systems analysis and forward-looking evidence, the Commission sets out how governments, institutions, and communities can move from formal plans to people-centred protection across all stages of a health crisis.
items.authors: Sara Calderón-Larrañaga, Rinad Bakhti, Manal Etemadi, Lina Fakih, Hil Ousland Vandeskog, Pami Shrestha, Shiying He, Alvin Qijia Chua, David Heymann, Viroj Tangcharoensathien, Yodi Mahendradhata, Alex

items.title: [Editorial] Getting ready for the next pandemic
items.title_zh: 为下一个疫情做好准备
items.summary_zh: COVID-19造成的悲惨死亡、残疾和混乱逐渐淡出集体记忆。这场大流行引发了全球健康危机，导致超过700万人报告死亡，估计有2800万额外死亡，并造成深远的健康、经济和社会破坏。它暴露了疫情准备中的关键失误以及社会和健康系统的脆弱性。尽管疫情风险在增加，全球仍未做好应对下一个疫情的准备。2023年9月21日，《柳叶刀》发布了一份新报告，题为《新加坡国立大学-《柳叶刀》疫情准备委员会：通过机构、动员社区和公平》。
items.abstract: The tragic death, disability, and chaos wrought by the COVID-19 are fading from collective memory. The pandemic created a global health crisis that led to more than 7 million reported deaths, an estimated 28 million excess deaths, and profound health, economic, and social disruption. It exposed critical failures in pandemic preparedness and weaknesses in social and health systems. Yet even though the risk of pandemics is growing, the world has failed to be ready for the next one. On Sept 21, a new Lancet Commission report is published, The National University of Singapore (NUS)–Lancet Pandemic Readiness through Institutions, Mobilising Communities, and Equity (PRIME) Commission.
items.authors: The Lancet

items.title: Single neurons in the human substantia nigra encode social learning signals
items.title_zh: 人类黑质单神经元编码社会学习信号
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人类黑质和苍白球中单神经元如何编码社会信号。我们在神经外科参与者进行迭代最后通牒游戏时记录了单神经元的活动，参与者与人类和计算机化身对战。通过行为的计算建模，我们发现黑质中的假定多巴胺能单位追踪规范预测误差的情感值，在与人类化身游戏时编码更为显著。对邻近黑质的苍白球进行类似分析未发现显著效果。我们的结果揭示了黑质在编码社会学习信号中的新角色。
items.abstract: Humans are remarkable at adapting to changing norms, yet we know little about how the human brain encodes these social signals at the single neuron level. Here, we recorded the activity of single neurons in the substantia nigra and globus pallidus in neurosurgical participants as they played an iterative ultimatum game versus human and computer avatars. Using computational modeling of behavior, we found that putative dopaminergic units in the substantia nigra tracked the valence of norm prediction errors, with greater encoding during gameplay with human versus computer avatars. Analogous analyses in the globus pallidus, a nucleus adjacent to the substantia nigra, found no significant effect. Our results identify a novel role for the substantia nigra in encoding social learning signals.
items.authors: Davis, A. N.; Perl, O.; Kopell, B. H.; Heflin, M.; Fu, Q. X.; Qasim, S. E.; Imtiaz, Z.; Kato, A.; Na, S.; Mikail, N.; Mayberg, H. S.; Montague, R.; Saez, I.; Gu, X.

items.title: Local translation couples synaptic activity to mitochondrial adaptation in dendrites
items.title_zh: 局部翻译将突触活动与树突线粒体适应联系起来
items.summary_zh: 神经元依赖局部蛋白质合成快速适应突触功能，但树突翻译如何调节突触可塑性期间的线粒体重塑仍不清楚。本研究表明，神经活动激活了一种空间限制的翻译程序，通过非经典翻译起始因子eIF4G2将局部蛋白质合成与线粒体功能相结合。通过接近标记技术分析树突RNA相互组、翻译组和蛋白质组，我们发现一组核编码的线粒体mRNA在去极化和mGluR激活后被选择性招募进行翻译。该程序驱动线粒体膜电位、线粒体丰度和氧气消耗的活动依赖性增加。缺失eIF4G2会消除这些反应，而特定于树突的救援则恢复线粒体重塑，表明eIF4G2在突触后位点局部发挥作用。机制上，eIF4G2结合活动响应线粒体转录本的5'非翻译区，促进上游开放阅读框和下游编码序列的翻译。使用树突靶向的分裂GFP报告基因，我们进一步表明神经活动诱导局部uORF翻译，生成先前未注释的微肽。
items.abstract: Neurons rely on localized protein synthesis to rapidly adapt synaptic function to activity, yet how dendritic translation regulates mitochondrial remodeling during synaptic plasticity remains poorly understood. Here, we show that neuronal activity engages a spatially restricted translational program that couples local protein synthesis to mitochondrial function through the non-canonical translation initiation factor eIF4G2. Using proximity labeling to profile the dendritic RNA interactome, translatome, and proteome, we identify a cohort of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial mRNAs that are selectively recruited for translation following depolarization and mGluR activation. This program drives activity-dependent increases in mitochondrial membrane potential, mitochondrial abundance, and oxygen consumption. Loss of eIF4G2 abolishes these responses, whereas dendrite-specific, but not soma-restricted, rescue restores mitochondrial remodeling, demonstrating that eIF4G2 functions locally at postsynaptic sites. items.authors: Jones, M. T.; Noble, N.; Darnell, R. B.; Hacisuleyman, E.

items.title: Cellular code for mnemonic pattern separation in the human hippocampus is revealed by false memories
items.title_zh: 人类海马体中记忆模式分离的细胞编码通过虚假记忆揭示
items.summary_zh: 理论模型提出，模式分离是海马体执行的一种计算，帮助我们区分熟悉和新颖的物品。然而，模式分离在人体海马体中的作用仍存在争议，且尚无确立的单细胞相关性。我们记录了97名患者在执行识别记忆任务时，3506个神经元的单细胞活动。任务中，类似于之前见过的图像的新图像导致虚假记忆和相关行为错误。我们识别出两种记忆选择性神经元：一种对虚假识别的新图像和正确识别的熟悉图像的反应不同，符合模式分离；另一种则信号化被试的选择。在群体层面，这些细胞预测了海马体中的记忆真实情况和前补充运动区的决策，展示了从记忆信号到决策的进程。移除模式分离信号细胞消除了海马体中存在的连续记忆强度梯度，表明这些细胞在分离不同强度记忆中的作用。这些结果确立了人类海马体中记忆模式分离的单细胞相关性，并显示其在情景记忆中的行为相关性。
items.abstract: Theoretical models propose that pattern separation, a computation thought to be implemented by the hippocampus, allows us to differentiate between familiar and novel items. However, whether pattern separation operates in the human hippocampus remains contested, with no established single-cell correlate. We recorded the single neuron activity of 3506 neurons in the human brain while 97 patients performed a recognition memory task in which novel images similar to previously seen images led to false memories and associated behavioral errors. We identified two kinds of memory selective neurons distributed across the brain: those responding differently to falsely recognized novel and correctly recognized familiar images in a manner compatible with pattern separation, and the other signaling the subject's choice. At the population level, these cells predicted mnemonic ground truth in the hippocampus and the decision in the pre-supplementary motor area, illustrating the progression from mnemonic signals to decisions. Removing pattern separation-signaling cells abolished the continuous memory strength gradient present in the hippocampus, suggesting a role of these cells in separating memor
items.authors: Kurilenko, N.; Mosher, C.; Cheng, S.; Salimpour, Y.; Daume, J.; Reed, C. M.; Anderson, W. S.; Valiante, T. A.; Mamelak, A. N.; Rutishauser, U.

items.title: A lifespan single-cell atlas of the human developing hippocampus benchmarks familial Alzheimer's disease brain organoids.
items.title_zh: 人类发育海马体单细胞图谱与家族性阿尔茨海默病脑类器官的比较
items.summary_zh: 家族性阿尔茨海默病（fAD）是一种由APP、PSEN1或PSEN2的常染色体显性变异引起的早发性阿尔茨海默病，其中PSEN1占大多数基因定义病例。海马体是阿尔茨海默病中最早且受影响最严重的脑区之一。人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生的脑类器官重现了早期人类脑发育的关键特征，并为研究fAD突变如何干扰神经发育过程提供了模型。我们构建了人类发育海马体图谱（HuDeHA），整合了658,059个细胞，涵盖从受孕后第3周到15.3年的发育阶段，并用于基准比较携带与fAD相关的PSEN1 E280A的iPSC衍生脑类器官。基于参考的映射揭示了PSEN1 E280A样本中细胞组成的改变。
items.abstract: Familial Alzheimer's disease (fAD) is an early-onset form of AD caused by autosomal-dominant variants in APP, PSEN1, or PSEN2, with PSEN1 accounting for most genetically defined cases [1]. The hippocampus is among the earliest and most severely affected brain regions in AD [2,3]. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived brain organoids recapitulate key features of early human brain development and provide a tractable model for studying how fAD mutations perturb neurodevelopmental processes [4]. However, their interpretation is complicated by heterogeneous regional identity, variable maturation state, and cell-type composition across protocols [5,6]. Existing single-cell studies of human hippocampus cover prenatal [7] and postnatal [8-10] stages but do not provide a continuous developmental reference. By elevating the atlas approach in utilizing single-cell RNA-sequencing data, we obtain standardized information on the organoid cell class and type composition and maturation states. Here, we constructed the Human Developing Hippocampus Atlas (HuDeHA), an integrated single-cell reference comprising 658,059 cells spanning post-conceptional week 3 to 15.3 years, and used it to
items.authors: Ivleva, E.; Kruikov, E.; Arboleda-Velasquez, J. F.; Baranov, P.

items.title: Basolateral amygdala neurons await oscillatory recruitment into valence-relevant ensembles
items.title_zh: 基底外侧杏仁核神经元在情感相关集合中的振荡招募
items.summary_zh: 情感处理障碍是精神疾病的核心特征。情感处理是快速评估情境和刺激并判断其正负意义的脑功能，对生存至关重要。基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）在情感处理中的关键作用已被确认，情感集合通过其解剖位置、投射目标和遗传特征等因素进行识别。不同的BLA振荡状态被证明能驱动不同的情感状态。我们展示了BLA主神经元的亚群体会对特定频率的光遗传振荡作出反应，且集合招募是个体神经元对输入频率敏感性的结果，这些频率可由中间神经元驱动的振荡状态引发。此外，我们还证明了中间神经元刺激驱动的振荡可以激活特定投射群体并重新激活与行为相关的集合。
items.abstract: Impaired valence processing is a core feature of psychiatric illnesses. The ability to rapidly evaluate situations and stimuli and determine whether they have positive or negative implications, termed valence processing, is a highly adaptive brain function that is essential for survival. Despite its importance, we still lack a complete understanding of the neural computations involved. The basolateral amygdala (BLA) plays a critical role in valence processing and valence ensembles have been identified by their anatomical location within the BLA, their projection targets, their genetic identity, or some combination of these factors. In parallel, distinct BLA oscillatory states have been shown to drive divergent valence states. Despite abundant evidence separately supporting these processes, we have failed to reconcile these disparate contributions to valence processing. Here, we demonstrate that subpopulations of BLA principal neurons are recruited in response to specific frequencies of optogenetically-driven oscillations. We provide evidence showing ensemble recruitment is a product of individual neuronal sensitivities to input frequencies that can be driven by interneuron-driven o
items.authors: Amaya, K. A.; He, Y.; Weiss, G. L.; Antonoudiou, P.; Maguire, J. L.

items.title: Evolution of new cerebellar nuclei by excitatory progenitor diversification in the early rhombic lip
items.title_zh: 兴奋性祖细胞多样化导致小脑新核的演化
items.summary_zh: 小脑核是小脑的输出区域，通过保守细胞类型的重复复制演化出不同数量的核。本研究利用小鼠和鸡的发育单细胞及空间转录组学时间序列，探讨这一过程的机制。结果表明，新核的形成由早期和晚期菱唇中的特定祖细胞产生的兴奋性神经元主导，而抑制性神经元则融入已建立的核区域。进化上较新的典型小脑核通过早期菱唇的多样化产生，核的身份和空间组织部分依赖于保守祖细胞类型的边界形成程序的共选。相比之下，晚期菱唇生成内侧核的高阶亚核，并形成非典型的橄榄小脑回路。我们的研究表明，新脑区可以通过兴奋性祖细胞的发育多样化和保守姐妹细胞类型的空间分隔演化而成。
items.abstract: The cerebellar nuclei, the output regions of the cerebellum, have evolved via repeated duplication of a conserved cell type set to produce different numbers of nuclei across species. Here, we investigate the mechanism underlying this process using developmental single-cell and spatial transcriptomics time courses in mouse and chicken. We show that new nuclei formation is governed by excitatory neurons born from nucleus-specific progenitors in the early and late rhombic lip (RL), with inhibitory neurons incorporating into established nuclear territories. Evolutionarily newer canonical cerebellar nuclei with increasingly higher-order functions are produced by diversification of the early RL, where nuclear identity and spatial organization are established in part by co-option of border formation programs in conserved progenitor cell types. In contrast, the late RL generates the higher-order subnuclei of the medial nucleus and forms a non-canonical olivocerebellar circuit. Together, our findings suggest that new brain regions can evolve through developmental diversification of excitatory progenitors and spatial segregation of conserved sister cell types with generic inhibitory neurons
items.authors: Anant, M. M.-G.; Zuercher, E. C.; Lowman, M.; Shi, C.; Faltine-Gonzalez, D. Z.; Piacentino, M. L.; Fan, J.; Kebschull, J. M.

items.title: The activation function of CA3 pyramidal neurons is optimal for the stable recall of memory patterns
items.title_zh: CA3锥体神经元的激活函数优化了记忆模式的稳定回忆
items.summary_zh: 海马CA3区被广泛认为是核心记忆功能的中心：检索先前存储在神经元之间递归连接中的分布式神经活动模式。然而，个体神经元的生理特性如何贡献于这一功能仍不清楚。本文对CA3的经典递归神经网络模型进行了数学分析，提出了三项可实验验证的预测。两项预测与先前实验结果一致，强调锥体细胞具有较高的内在兴奋性和以抑制为主的递归连接。我们重点测试第三项预测：神经元激活函数的指数略高于1。通过对行为小鼠CA3区49个锥体神经元进行体内细胞内记录，模型拟合和统计比较显示，平均神经激活指数略高于1，确认了理论预测，且细胞间存在显著异质性。对另外133个细胞的分析提供了神经激活指数的估计。
items.abstract: Hippocampal area CA3 is widely believed to serve a core memory function: retrieving distributed patterns of neural activity that were previously stored in the recurrent connections between neurons. However, it remains unknown how the physiological properties of individual neurons contribute to this function. Here, we present a mathematical analysis of a canonical recurrent neural network model of CA3. Our analysis provides three main, experimentally testable predictions for recurrent circuits performing stable memory recall. Two of these predictions, that pyramidal cells should be characterized by elevated intrinsic excitability and by inhibition-dominated recurrent connections, are consistent with previous experimental findings. We thus focused on testing the third prediction: that neuronal activation functions have an exponent slightly above $1$. For this, we performed \textit{in vivo} intracellular recordings of 49 pyramidal neurons from the CA3 area of behaving mice. items.authors: Cohen, U.; Picher, M. M.; Navas-Olive, A.; Lengyel, M.

items.title: Hierarchical chromatin polyvalency governs robust gene regulation and organogenesis
items.title_zh: 层次化染色质多价性调控基因表达与器官发生
items.summary_zh: 精确的基因表达时间控制对胚胎发育至关重要，但调控转录时序的表观遗传和染色质基础仍不清楚。双价性模型认为H3K4me3和H3K27me3的共存标志着准备激活的状态。然而，H3K27me3去除后缺乏快速基因激活的现象挑战了这一模型，表明H3K27me3并不负责沉默。通过对植入后小鼠胚胎的时间表观基因组分析及蛋白降解标签（dTAG）系统，我们证明H2Aub是主要的抑制因子，而非H3K27me3。我们进一步揭示了一个层次化的抑制结构，其中H2Aub负责转录沉默，而H3K27me3和H3K9me3则强化沉默状态。功能上，破坏这一以H2Aub为中心的层次结构扰乱了多价基因激活的时间控制，导致严重的器官发生缺陷。机制上，H2Aub的急性缺失干扰了视黄酸-FGF信号通路，导致体节发生停滞。我们的研究确立了染色质多价性模型作为一个多层次的、层次化的抑制机制，调控胚胎发育过程中的基因表达时间控制。
items.abstract: Precise temporal control of gene expression is fundamental for embryonic development, yet the epigenetic and chromatin basis governing transcriptional timing remain poorly understood. The bivalency model, characterized by coexistence of H3K4me3 and H3K27me3, has been proposed to mark a poised state ready for activation. However, this model has been challenged by lacking of rapid gene activation in response to H3K27me3 depletion, suggesting that the H3K27me3 mark is not responsible for the silencing. Here, through temporal epigenomic profiling of post-implantation mouse embryos and use of the protein degradation tag (dTAG) system, we demonstrate that H2Aub, but not H3K27me3, functions as the major repressor. We further reveal a hierarchical repression architecture in which H2Aub is responsible for transcriptional silencing, while H3K27me3 and H3K9me3 serve to reinforce the silencing state in post-implantation embryos. Functionally, disruption of this H2Aub-centered hierarchy perturbs temporal control of polyvalent gene activation, leading to severe organogenesis defects. Mechanistically, acute loss of H2Aub disrupts retinoic acid-FGF signaling pathway, causing somitogenesis arrest.
items.authors: Zhou, C.; Wang, M.; Chen, Z.; Zhang, Y.

items.title: Neonatal AAV-SIL1 gene therapy prevents Marinesco-Sjögren syndrome in mice
items.title_zh: 新生儿AAV-SIL1基因治疗可预防Marinesco-Sjogren综合征
items.summary_zh: Marinesco-Sjogren综合征是一种罕见的早发多系统疾病，主要特征为小脑性共济失调和肌病，由SIL1基因功能丧失突变引起。目前没有可用的疾病修正治疗。我们研究了腺相关病毒（AAV）介导的基因治疗是否能在woozy小鼠模型中预防该疾病。新生小鼠接受了AAV-PHP.eB载体的脑室内注射，载体编码SIL1并由普遍或小脑颗粒细胞特异性启动子控制。对照组woozy小鼠出现了与小脑颗粒细胞退化和内质网应激通路激活相关的运动障碍。相比之下，AAV-SIL1治疗预防了共济失调的发生，保护了小脑颗粒细胞，并减轻了应激通路的激活。在小脑颗粒细胞中选择性恢复SIL1表达足以改善运动表现，支持小脑颗粒细胞功能障碍在疾病发病机制中的细胞自主贡献。治疗效果在26周的观察期内持续，伴随肌肉功能改善和肌肉病理减轻。这些发现证明了AAV介导的SIL1基因治疗可以预防疾病的神经和肌肉表现，为Marinesco-Sjogren综合征的可转化基因治疗方法的发展提供了支持。
items.abstract: Marinesco-Sjogren syndrome is a rare early-onset multisystem disorder characterized primarily by cerebellar ataxia and myopathy and caused by loss-of-function mutations in SIL1. No disease-modifying therapy is available. We investigated whether adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy could prevent disease in the woozy mouse model. Neonatal mice received intracerebroventricular injections of AAV-PHP.eB vectors encoding SIL1 under the control of a ubiquitous or a Purkinje cell-specific promoter. Vehicle-treated woozy mice developed motor impairment associated with Purkinje cell degeneration and activation of endoplasmic reticulum stress pathways. In contrast, AAV-SIL1 treatment prevented the onset of ataxia, preserved Purkinje cells, and attenuated stress pathway activation. Selective restoration of SIL1 expression in Purkinje cells was sufficient to rescue motor performance, supporting a cell-autonomous contribution of Purkinje cell dysfunction to disease pathogenesis. Therapeutic efficacy was maintained throughout the 26-week observation period and was accompanied by improved muscle function and attenuation of muscle pathology. items.title: Bacterial secreted products selectively inhibit non-symbiotic fungi in bees
items.title_zh: 细菌分泌产物选择性抑制蜜蜂中的非共生真菌
items.summary_zh: 微生物相互作用在微生物组组装中发挥重要作用，能够限制有害生物的入侵。研究对象为蜜蜂的微生物组，特别是无刺蜜蜂Scaptotrigona depilis中的细菌。研究结合了条件培养基（无细胞上清液）实验与基因组和代谢组分析，探讨细菌分泌产物是否介导这些效应。结果显示，来自常见细菌类群（如Apilactobacillus kunkeei）的分泌产物显著影响真菌生长，尤其是病原真菌青霉菌（Aspergillus）被持续抑制，部分原因是有机酸导致的基质酸化，同时也涉及其他独立于酸度的因素。相比之下，酵母的反应更为多变：非共生的酵母Zygosaccharomyces在接近中性pH下被细菌代谢物抑制，而对幼虫发育必需的共生Zygosaccharomyces在酸性条件下得以维持或促进。
items.abstract: Microbial interactions play an important role in shaping microbiome assembly, such as by limiting invasion by harmful organisms that can directly affect the host or disrupt microbiome-associated benefits. Such interactions have been observed across systems, including in the microbiomes of key pollinators such as stingless bees. In Scaptotrigona depilis, bacteria associated with the larval diet inhibit potentially pathogenic filamentous fungi while allowing beneficial yeast symbionts to persist. The mechanisms underlying these effects, however, remain unclear. Here, we combined conditioned media (cell-free supernatant) assays with genomic and metabolomic analyses to investigate whether bacterial secreted products mediate these effects in the bee microbiome. Our results show that bacterial secreted products, particularly from prevalent bacterial taxa such as Apilactobacillus kunkeei, strongly affect fungal growth. Filamentous fungi, including the pathogen Aspergillus, were consistently inhibited, partly through substrate acidification driven by organic acids, but also through additional acidity-independent factors. items.title: Reduced DPP4 Binding Confers Resistance to Soluble DPP4 While Preserving MERS-CoV Entry into Cells Expressing High Levels of DPP4
items.title_zh: 降低DPP4结合能力使MERS-CoV抵抗可溶性DPP4
items.summary_zh: 中东呼吸综合症冠状病毒（MERS-CoV）利用DPP4/CD26作为细胞进入的受体。可溶性重组DPP4能够在细胞培养和动物模型中阻止MERS-CoV感染，具有潜在的抗病毒前景。我们研究了MERS-CoV如何获得对可溶性DPP4（sDPP4）的抵抗，采用编码MERS-CoV刺突蛋白的囊泡性口炎病毒（VSV-MERS-S）。在sDPP4存在下的VSV-MERS-S传代选择出具有L507I和L507H突变的病毒变体，这些突变降低了sDPP4结合能力，并与高水平DPP4表达的细胞系的强烈进入相兼容，赋予了sDPP4抵抗性。相反，低水平DPP4表达的细胞系的进入能力降低。此外，在患者MERS-CoV序列中检测到的多态性L507F/R/P表现出更明显的表型，其中L507R和L507P完全抵抗sDPP4。我们的结果表明，MERS-CoV刺突蛋白中的自然发生多态性通过降低sDPP4结合能力赋予sDPP4抵抗性，但仍可能与高水平DPP4表达的细胞和组织中的强烈病毒传播相兼容。
items.abstract: The Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus uses DPP4/CD26 as receptor for cell entry. Soluble recombinant DPP4 can block MERS-CoV infection in cell culture and in animal models and might hold promise as antiviral. Furthermore, endogenous soluble DPP4 in plasma might reduce MERS-CoV dissemination in infected individuals. Therefore, we addressed whether and how MERS-CoV can acquire resistance against soluble DPP4 (sDPP4), employing a vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) encoding the MERS-CoV spike (S) protein (VSV-MERS-S). Passaging of VSV-MERS-S in the presence of sDPP4 selected for viral variants with mutations L507I and L507H in the receptor binding domain (RBD) of the S protein. These mutations reduced sDPP4 binding, were compatible with robust entry into cell lines expressing high levels of DPP4 and conferred sDPP4 resistance. In contrast, entry into cell lines expressing low levels of DPP4 was reduced. Furthermore, polymorphisms L507F/R/P, which were detected in MERS-CoV sequences from patients, exhibited an even more pronounced phenotype, with L507R and L507P conferring complete sDPP4 resistance. items.title: The coculture of Fomitopsis betulina with Escherichia coli induces a nutritional stress and triggers secondary metabolism pathways.
items.title_zh: 白桦茸与大肠杆菌共培养诱导营养压力及次级代谢途径
items.summary_zh: 基真菌是具有重要生物技术潜力的特种代谢物的未充分探索来源。本文研究了木腐真菌白桦茸（Fomitopsis betulina）对营养竞争的反应，采用与大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）共培养的方法。在固体培养基上，白桦茸抑制了细菌生长。通过基于质谱的代谢组学方法，我们在抑制区内鉴定出了一种苏米基酸衍生物、双甲酸钙和硫酸，推测这些化合物与培养基酸化有关。在液体培养基中，与大肠杆菌的共培养迅速耗尽了可用的葡萄糖，导致碳饥饿条件的建立和真菌生物量减少44%。转录组分析显示，白桦茸在应对细菌竞争时发生了广泛的代谢重编程，包括碳获取、营养运输、氧化还原稳态和应激适应相关基因的诱导。
items.abstract: Basidiomycete fungi are an underexplored source of specialized metabolites with significant biotechnological potential. However, the environmental cues that activate their biosynthetic pathways remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated the response of the wood-decaying fungus Fomitopsis betulina, to nutritional competition using co-cultures with Escherichia coli. On solid medium, F. betulina inhibited the bacterial growth. Using a mass spectrometry-based metabolomics approach, we identified a Sumikis acid derivative, calcium diformate, and sulfuric acid among the compounds enriched within the inhibition zone and hypothesized that these compounds were associated with the acidification of the medium. Although F. betulina has previously been reported to produce the antibacterial compound piptamine, neither piptamine nor related derivatives were detected under our experimental conditions. In liquid medium, the co-culture with E. coli caused the rapid depletion of the available glucose, resulting in the establishment of carbon-starvation conditions and a 44% reduction in fungal biomass. items.title: SMCHD1's DNA binding activity enables its stable retention on chromatin
items.title_zh: SMCHD1的DNA结合活性促进其在染色质上的稳定保留
items.summary_zh: 染色质蛋白在基因调控中发挥关键作用，但我们常常不完全理解这些蛋白的弱DNA结合亲和力如何影响其特定基因位点的功能。本文研究了SMCHD1，这是一种非典型SMC家族蛋白，参与三维基因组组织和不活跃X染色体及其常染色体靶标的基因抑制。我们用GFP标记的野生型或铰链域DNA结合突变体SMCHD1替代内源性SMCHD1，以明确DNA结合的细胞角色。突变体在女性细胞中在不活跃X染色体上的富集减少，但在大多数常染色体结合位点上保持稳定结合。DNA结合受损削弱了SMCHD1介导的基因抑制和染色质状态调控，产生低表型效应。多种活细胞成像方法表明，DNA结合限制了SMCHD1的运动性，并支持其在间期和有丝分裂期间的染色质结合的维持。因此，SMCHD1的弱且无序列依赖的DNA结合是其在染色质上驻留、定位和功能的关键决定因素。我们的发现为理解SMCHD1及其他具有无序列依赖DNA结合活性的染色质蛋白提供了框架。
items.abstract: Chromatin proteins play critical roles in gene regulation, yet frequently we do not fully understand how weak DNA binding affinity of such proteins contributes to their locus-specific actions. Here, we studied SMCHD1, a non-canonical SMC-family protein involved in three-dimensional genome organization and gene repression of the inactive X chromosome and its autosomal targets. We replaced endogenous SMCHD1 with GFP-tagged wild-type or hinge-domain DNA-binding mutant SMCHD1 to define the cellular role of DNA binding. The mutant showed reduced enrichment at the inactive X chromosome in female cells, while retaining stable binding at most autosomal binding sites. Impaired DNA binding weakens SMCHD1-mediated gene repression and chromatin-state regulation, producing hypomorphic effect. Multiple live-cell imaging methods reveal that DNA binding constrains SMCHD1 mobility and supports maintenance, rather than initial recruitment, of chromatin-bound SMCHD1 both during interphase and mitosis. Thus, SMCHD1's weak and sequence-independent DNA binding is a key determinant of its chromatin residence, localization and function. items.title: CAST as a Tumor-Specific Suppressor in Colorectal Cancer: Discovery Through Integrative Analysis of Unannotated Isoforms, Proteomics, and Epigenetic Regulation
items.title_zh: CAST在结直肠癌中的肿瘤特异性抑制作用研究
items.summary_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，但其肿瘤发生和进展的分子机制尚不完全清楚。本研究通过整合单细胞长读长测序、蛋白质组学和DNA甲基化数据，识别出CRC中未注释的转录本中的肿瘤特异性靶标。对3,262个单细胞的29,429个转录本分析发现3,338个新转录本，其中2779个为新目录（NIC），559个为未在目录中（NNC）。与GTEx的68个正常组织交叉参考，识别出3个在正常结肠中缺失的肿瘤特异性候选基因。其中，CAST（Calpastatin）作为肿瘤特异性抑制因子，其在肿瘤中的表达比正常结肠高63.1倍。通过质谱在100个肿瘤样本中确认CAST蛋白的存在。对100个CRC样本的突变分析发现8个有害突变，支持其肿瘤抑制作用。393个肿瘤样本的启动子甲基化分析显示89.3%为低甲基化，表明去甲基化介导的再激活。此外，CAST表达与启动子甲基化呈负相关，并受到miR-200家族的调控。
items.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, yet the molecular mechanisms driving tumor initiation and progression are incompletely understood. Here, we integrate single-cell long-read sequencing, proteomics, and DNA methylation data to identify tumor-specific targets from unannotated isoforms in CRC. Analysis of 29,429 isoforms across 3,262 single cells revealed 3,338 novel isoforms, comprising 2,779 Novel In Catalog (NIC) and 559 Novel Not in Catalog (NNC). Cross-referencing with 68 normal tissues from GTEx identified 3 tumor-specific candidates absent from normal colon. Among these, CAST (Calpastatin) emerged as a tumor-specific suppressor, with a 63.1-fold higher expression in tumor (2.62) versus normal colon (0.03). CAST protein was confirmed in 100 tumor samples by mass spectrometry (mean expression: 0.22). Mutational analysis of 100 CRC samples revealed 8 deleterious mutations, including 2 nonsense, 2 splice-site, 2 missense, 1 frameshift, and 1 in-frame variant, consistent with a tumor-suppressor role. items.title: Peer-guided movie neurofeedback to facilitate recovery in opioid use disorder
items.title_zh: 同伴引导的电影神经反馈促进阿片类药物使用障碍恢复
items.summary_zh: 实时fMRI神经反馈能够改变临床相关的脑状态，但在成瘾领域，尚未测试同伴之间的脑动态转移。本文介绍了同伴引导的电影神经反馈（PG-MovieNF），该方法训练参与者将其脑活动与更早恢复的同伴在观看同一电影时的治疗相关动态对齐。我们使用了阿片类药物使用障碍患者在接受8周辅助治疗前后观看《猜火车》的纵向fMRI数据，得出了在背外侧和背内侧前额叶皮层的多变量治疗预测信号。随后，一个独立的队列在观看同一电影时接受了真实的PG-MovieNF或配对的假反馈。真实反馈增加了与同伴导向目标信号的对齐，减少了渴求感并改善了情感评分。目标对齐与真实反馈期间共享的眶额皮层动态相关，并预测了渴求感的减少。这些发现为PG-MovieNF在增强成瘾恢复方面提供了概念验证。
items.abstract: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback can modify clinically relevant brain states, but transferring brain dynamics between peers has not been tested, particularly in addiction, where social learning is central to recovery. Here we introduce peer-guided movie neurofeedback (PG-MovieNF), which trains participants to align their brain activity with treatment-related dynamics derived from peers further along in recovery viewing the same movie. Using longitudinal fMRI data from individuals with opioid use disorder watching Trainspotting before and after 8 weeks of adjunctive treatment, we derived a multivariate treatment-predictive signal in dorsolateral and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex. An independent cohort then received real PG-MovieNF or yoked sham feedback during the same film. Real feedback increased alignment with the peer-derived target signal, reduced craving and improved affective ratings. Target alignment was coupled to shared orbitofrontal cortex dynamics during real feedback and predicted craving reduction. Together, these findings establish proof of concept for PG-MovieNF to enhance addiction recovery.
items.authors: Kronberg, G.; McClain, N. E.; Boros, M.; Santhapuram, S.; Drury, K. R.; Hennings, A. C.; Hasson, U.; Alia-Klein, N.; Norman, K. A.; Goldstein, R. Z.

items.title: Long-Term Efficacy and Allograft Loss after Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients with Advanced Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 免疫检查点抑制剂治疗晚期皮肤鳞状细胞癌移植受者的长期疗效与移植物损失
items.summary_zh: 背景：免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）可有效治疗固体器官移植受者（SOTRs）中的晚期皮肤鳞状细胞癌（CSCC），但长期肿瘤学和移植物结果尚不明确。目的：评估SOTRs中晚期CSCC患者接受ICI治疗后的长期疗效和移植物结果。方法：我们对2016-2025年在麻省总医院接受系统性ICI治疗的晚期CSCC SOTRs进行了回顾性队列研究。评估了肿瘤反应、生存率、免疫相关不良事件、免疫抑制调整、排斥率和移植物损失。结果：在36名SOTRs中，客观反应率为44.4%（95% CI，27.9%-61.9%），包括9例完全反应。3年时，无进展生存率、疾病特异性生存率和总体生存率分别为18.6%、65.8%和32.5%。中位随访时间为42.1个月。5名患者经历了移植物损失，均为肾脏移植者；4例经活检确认排斥。3年肾移植物失效的累积发生率为16.7%（95% CI，2.9%-30.5%）。结论：ICI在CSCC控制方面提供了长期效果，且移植物损失率较低。
items.abstract: Background: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) can provide effective treatment for advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) in solid organ transplant recipients (SOTRs), but long-term oncologic and allograft outcomes remain poorly characterized. Objective: To evaluate long-term efficacy and allograft outcomes after ICI therapy in SOTRs with advanced CSCC. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of SOTRs with advanced CSCC treated with systemic ICI at Mass General Brigham from 2016-2025. Tumor response, survival, immune-related adverse events, immunosuppression modifications, rejection rate, and graft loss were assessed. Kidney graft failure was analyzed using competing-risk methods with death as a competing event. Results: Among 36 SOTRs, objective response rate was 44.4% (95% CI, 27.9%-61.9%), including 9 complete responses. At 3 years, progression-free, disease-specific, and overall survival were 18.6%, 65.8%, and 32.5%, respectively. Median follow-up was 42.1 months. items.title: Prospective evaluation of basic life support interventions for foreign body airway obstructions: A pilot population-based cohort study
items.title_zh: 外物气道梗阻基本生命支持干预的前瞻性评估研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：外物气道梗阻（FBAO）是一种危及生命的紧急情况，但旁观者的治疗建议主要依赖于回顾性数据。本研究评估了基于人群的FBAO干预的前瞻性队列研究的可行性。方法：我们在加拿大阿尔伯塔省于2025年11月至2026年4月进行了一项前瞻性观察性试点研究。通过验证的健康记录案例定义，识别出拨打急救电话或前往急诊科的院外FBAO患者。参与者分为成人和儿童（>2岁）及幼儿（<2岁）两组。主要结果为每月纳入病例数，次要结果包括可行性（纳入合格病例的比例、数据完整性）和临床结果（FBAO缓解、急救出院生存率、良好的神经学结果、干预相关伤害）。结果：在筛查的5208例中，识别出147例FBAO病例，其中91例成人和儿童（89.2%）及39例幼儿（86.7%）被纳入。成人和儿童组的平均招募人数为15.2人/月（SD=1.1），超过预设的可行性阈值（13人/月），幼儿组为6.5人/月（SD=1.3），符合黄区标准（6-8人/月）。数据完整性超过90%。
items.abstract: Background: Foreign body airway obstruction (FBAO) is a life-threatening emergency; however, bystander treatment recommendations rely on retrospective data. We evaluated the feasibility of a population-based prospective cohort study of FBAO interventions. Methods: We conducted a prospective observational pilot study in Alberta, Canada, between November 2025 and April 2026. We identified individuals with out-of-hospital FBAO who called emergency medical services or attended an emergency department using a validated health-record case definition. Participants were stratified into adults and children (aged>2 years) and younger children (aged< 2 years) cohorts. The primary outcome was included cases per month, with several secondary feasibility (proportion of eligible cases included, data completeness) and clinical outcomes (FBAO relief, survival to acute care discharge, favourable neurological outcome, intervention-associated injuries). Results: Among 5,208 screened encounters, 147 FBAO cases were identified. Of these, 91 adults and children (89.2%) and 39 young children (86.7%) were enrolled. items.title: A longitudinal study of age-related traits and cognitive function: The Collaborative Amish Aging and Memory Project (CAAMP)
items.title_zh: 阿米什人群认知功能与年龄相关特征的纵向研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：阿米什人群老龄化与记忆项目（CAAMP）是一项正在进行的纵向研究，聚焦于中西部阿米什（俄亥俄州和印第安纳州）社区的认知功能和年龄相关特征。主要关注特征包括阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）、成功老龄化（SA）及其他年龄相关状况。方法：CAAMP结合临床和认知评估、家族史、谱系、基因组、生物样本和生物标志物数据。通过共识裁定分配认知诊断。结果：迄今为止，CAAMP已招募3,978名参与者（平均年龄78.6岁，59.1%为女性，83%受教育水平为八年级），其中2,928人有共识裁定的认知状态。在最近的评估中，66.6%认知正常，9.9%有轻度认知障碍，8.9%患有阿尔茨海默病，4.5%有认知障碍但不属于阿尔茨海默病。剩余的1,050人未在入组时进行详细的认知评估。针对部分参与者提供了纵向认知评估和多种生物样本类型。CAAMP还包括广泛的多代谱系信息、全基因组基因型等数据。
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Collaborative Amish Aging and Memory Project (CAAMP) is an ongoing longitudinal study spanning multiple sites, focused on cognitive function and age-related traits in Midwestern Amish (Ohio and Indiana) communities. The primary traits of interest include Alzheimer Disease and related dementias (ADRD), successful aging (SA), and other age-related conditions. METHODS: CAAMP integrates clinical and cognitive assessments with family history, genealogical, genomic, biospecimen, and biomarker data collected across Amish communities in Ohio and Indiana. Cognitive diagnoses are assigned through consensus adjudication using clinical, cognitive, functional, and informant data. RESULTS: To date, CAAMP has enrolled 3,978 participants (mean age 78.6 (SD = 7.9), 59.1% female, and 83% with an education level at the eighth grade), of whom 2,928 have consensus-adjudicated cognitive status. At the most recent assessment, 66.6% were cognitively unimpaired, 9.9% had mild cognitive impairment, 8.9% had Alzheimer disease, and 4.5% had cognitive impairment, but not Alzheimer disease. items.title: Same-Session Clearance of Small Common Bile Duct Stones After Sphincterotomy Alone or With Adjunctive Extraction: A Single-Center Observational Study
items.title_zh: 内镜下括约肌切开术后胆总管小结石清除研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：小胆总管结石在内镜下括约肌切开术后可能自行排出，但不进行取石则清除情况不确定。方法：本研究为单中心观察性研究，纳入203例胆总管结石（直径≤5mm）患者，比较仅行括约肌切开术与括约肌切开术后进行气囊和/或篮式取石的同-session清除率。结果：平均年龄58.62岁，男性90例（44.3%）。仅行括约肌切开术的患者中，21例（44.7%）成功清除结石，而在进行辅助取石的患者中，130例（83.3%）成功清除（风险比1.87，95%置信区间1.35至2.58；P < 0.001）。结论：辅助取石显著提高了胆总管小结石的同-session清除率。
items.abstract: Background Small common bile duct stones may pass after endoscopic sphincterotomy, but leaving the duct without attempting extraction also leaves clearance uncertain. We compared same-session stone clearance after sphincterotomy alone with clearance after sphincterotomy followed by balloon-based and/or basket extraction. Methods We conducted a single-center observational study of 203 patients with common bile duct stones 5 mm or smaller who underwent therapeutic endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography. The endoscopist chose the treatment during the procedure. Forty-seven patients underwent sphincterotomy alone, and 156 underwent sphincterotomy followed by balloon-based and/or basket extraction. The primary outcome was fluoroscopically confirmed clearance during the same procedure. Intraprocedural bleeding was a secondary outcome. We calculated unadjusted risk ratios and used Fisher's exact test for sparse events. Results The mean age was 58.62 years (standard deviation 20.10), and 90 patients (44.3%) were men. items.title: Varenicline as a Repurposable Drug Candidate for ADRD Prevention
items.title_zh: 瓦伦尼克林作为ADRD预防的可再利用药物候选者
items.summary_zh: 目的：有效的阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）预防策略有限。本研究通过药物广泛关联研究（MWAS+）强调了瓦伦尼克林作为候选药物。方法：利用“我们所有人”研究数据库，识别2006年至2023年间50岁及以上的成年人，这些人有关于烟草使用历史的生活方式调查回应，并开始使用瓦伦尼克林或尼古丁替代疗法（NRT）进行戒烟治疗。我们将队列限制为首次单药治疗用户，并将索引日期设定为首次处方。排除了基线有ADRD或无随访的个体。基线特征包括人口统计学、合并症、BMI和先前药物暴露。结果：队列包含9,584名个体（1,801名瓦伦尼克林用户和7,783名NRT用户）。经过倾向评分匹配后，每组各有1,758名个体，基线特征平衡。使用瓦伦尼克林与ADRD风险降低相关（HR 0.516，95% CI：0.353-0.754）以及ADRD或死亡的复合结果（HR 0.657，95% CI：0.501-0.861）。Kaplan-Meier曲线也显示瓦伦尼克林在研究期间的持续益处。
items.abstract: Objective: Effective strategies to prevent Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) are limited. Implementing our Medication-Wide Association Study (MWAS+), we highlighted varenicline as a candidate. This study evaluated the association between varenicline use and risk of ADRD relative to nicotine replacement therapy (NRT). Methods: Using the All of Us Research Database, we identified adults aged 50 years or older with available lifestyle survey responses regarding tobacco use history who initiated smoking cessation therapy with either varenicline or NRT between 2006 and 2023. We limited our cohort to incident monotherapy users and designated the index date as the first prescription. Individuals with baseline ADRD or no follow-up were excluded. Baseline characteristics included demographics, comorbidities, BMI, and prior medication exposures. Outcomes were incident ADRD and a composite outcome of ADRD or death. Findings: The cohort consisted of 9,584 individuals (1,801 varenicline users and 7,783 NRT users). items.title: Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound of the Amygdala in Depression and Anxiety: A First-in-Human Active-Controlled Trial
items.title_zh: 低强度聚焦超声对抑郁和焦虑的影响：首例人类主动对照试验
items.summary_zh: 背景：低强度聚焦超声（FUS）是一种非侵入性方法，能够以毫米级精度直接调节深层脑结构，可能解决现有非侵入性神经调节方法的主要局限性。杏仁核是情感神经回路中的关键节点，适合用于精神干预。我们进行了一项首例人类主动对照试验（NCT05147142），研究针对重度抑郁症患者的杏仁核FUS，评估其安全性和靶点参与度。方法：十名重度抑郁症参与者完成了一项单盲随机交叉试验，比较针对右侧杏仁核的成像引导FUS与左侧初级躯体感觉皮层作为主动对照的效果。FUS包括在诊断超声安全限度内的两次10分钟应用。主要结果为在超声照射期间通过BOLD fMRI评估的安全性和靶点参与度，超声后动脉自旋标记（ASL）和静息态功能连接。结果：九名参与者完成了两个阶段。未发生严重不良事件；神经学、神经心理学和MRI安全评估均无异常。杏仁核组的不良事件发生频率高于对照组。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Low intensity focused ultrasound (FUS) offers a noninvasive method for directly modulating deep brain structures with millimeter-scale precision, potentially addressing a major limitation of existing noninvasive neuromodulation approaches. The amygdala is a key node in affective neurocircuitry and a compelling target for psychiatric intervention. We conducted a first in human active controlled trial (NCT05147142) of amygdala-targeted FUS in patients with major depressive disorder, examining safety and target engagement. Methods: Ten participants with major depressive disorder completed a single-blind randomized crossover trial with blinded symptom ratings, comparing imaging guided FUS targeting the right amygdala versus left primary somatosensory cortex as an active control. FUS comprised two 10 minute applications within diagnostic ultrasound safety limits. Primary outcomes were safety and target engagement assessed with BOLD fMRI during sonication, post-sonication arterial spin labeling (ASL) and resting state functional connectivity. items.title: Meditation Practice and Long-Term Mortality in US Adults: A Doubly Robust Analysis of Pooled National Health Interview Survey Cohorts with a Trial-Informed Bayesian Subgroup Analysis
items.title_zh: 冥想实践与美国成年人长期死亡率的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估冥想与美国成年人死亡率的关联，特别关注家庭收入的差异。我们汇总了2002至2017年的四个国家健康访谈调查队列，并通过2019年的死亡率跟踪数据进行分析（N=90,041；8,402人（9.3%）在过去12个月内报告过冥想实践）。采用双重稳健的调查加权Cox模型，结合稳定的逆概率权重和协变量调整，计算15年风险并进行概率偏倚分析。结果显示，在818,248人年随访中，共发生10,027例全因死亡和3,040例心血管死亡。全因死亡的双重稳健风险比为1.02（95% CI 0.90, 1.16），心血管死亡的风险比为0.96（95% CI 0.79, 1.16）。在低于联邦贫困线200%的人群中，结果显示冥想的影响值得进一步研究。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Introduction: Trial evidence in older adults with hypertension suggests that meditation may lower mortality, but this association has not been tested in a nationally representative study with linked-mortality data. This study estimated meditation's association with mortality among US adults, examined variation by family income, and synthesized trial and survey evidence for the population matched to the trial evidence base. Methods: We pooled four National Health Interview Survey cohorts (2002 to 2017) with mortality follow-up through 2019 (N=90,041; 8,402 [9.3%] reported meditation practice in the past 12 months). Doubly robust survey-weighted Cox models combined stabilized inverse-probability weights with covariate adjustment, overall and by income stratum; 15 year risks were standardized using g computation, and probabilistic bias analysis addressed exposure misclassification, including a scenario by income strata. For non Hispanic Black adults [ ]55 years with hypertension (n=2,786), Bayesian synthesis combined subgroup estimates with a pooled randomized trial prior.
