items.title: Sleep Quality and Daytime Sleepiness in Patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease in a Tertiary Care Hospital: An Observational Study
items.title_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的睡眠质量与白天嗜睡情况研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：睡眠障碍在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者中被低估，可能影响健康相关的生活质量。本研究旨在确定COPD患者中睡眠质量差和白天嗜睡的流行率。方法：本横断面研究于2025年3月至6月在COPD患者中进行，共招募398名患者。使用标准化问卷评估睡眠质量和白天嗜睡。数据录入Microsoft Excel 2016并使用SPSS 20.0进行分析。结果：398名COPD患者中，有210名（52.78%；95% CI, 47.86%至57.62%）睡眠质量差（PSQI>5），184名（46.23%；95% CI, 41.39%至51.14%）存在过度白天嗜睡（ESS>10）。大多数参与者为中度至重度COPD（77.89%；95% CI, 73.56%至81.69%），平均CAT评分为24.36（±8.16）。63.07%（95% CI, 58.22%至67.66%）的患者出现频繁加重。睡眠潜伏期延长，睡眠时长减少（平均5.55±0.80小时）。
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Sleep disturbance is a under-recognized problem among patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and may affect health-related quality of life. Data regarding sleep quality and daytime sleepiness remain limited. This study aimed to determine prevalence of poor sleep quality and daytime sleepiness among patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. METHODS: This cross-sectional study was conducted in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease from March to June 2025. 398 patients were enrolled. Sleep quality and daytime sleepiness were assessed using standardized questionnaires. Data were entered into Microsoft Excel 2016 and analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences version 20.0. Point estimates at 95% confidence interval were calculated along with frequency and percentage for binary data and mean and standard deviation for continuous data. RESULTS: Among 398 COPD patients, 210 (52.78%; 95% CI, 47.86% to 57.62%) had poor sleep quality (PSQI>5) and 184 (46.23%; 95% CI, 41.39% to 51.14%) had excessive daytime sleepiness (ESS>10). items.title: Effectiveness of Human Cellular Umbilical Tissue Allograft Compared to Acellular Matrix Products in Managing Diabetic Lower Extremity Ulcers in Hospitalized Patients
items.title_zh: 人类脐带组织移植物在糖尿病下肢溃疡治疗中的有效性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：细胞和无细胞基质产品（CAMPs）可促进糖尿病下肢溃疡（DLEU）患者的伤口愈合，但缺乏不同CAMPs之间的比较数据。本研究旨在利用真实世界证据比较接受最小操作人类脐带组织（STRAVIX）或其他无细胞CAMPs治疗的住院DLEU患者的临床和经济结果。方法：本回顾性分析基于Premier PINC AI医疗数据库的数据，分析了接受CAMPs治疗的DLEU患者。每位患者的首次住院就诊被指定为索引入院。分析组包括细胞人类脐带组织移植物（STRAVIX）和四种不同的无细胞CAMPs（aCAMPs）。为平衡基线协变量，应用了逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）。随后，使用IPTW调整的广义线性模型估计医疗相关结果和医院相关费用。结果：共识别出2626名接受STRAVIX治疗的DLEU患者和10002名接受aCAMPs治疗的DLEU患者。与接受aCAMPs治疗的患者相比，接受STRAVIX治疗的患者在感染反应、伤口裂开、轻重度截肢的发生率显著降低。
items.abstract: Background: CAMPs (cellular and acellular matrix products) can facilitate wound closure and improve clinical outcomes in patients with diabetic lower extremity ulcers (DLEU), however, there is a lack of comparative data between different CAMPs. The objective of this study was to use real-world evidence to compare the clinical and economic outcomes of hospital care for DLEU patients treated with a minimally manipulated human umbilical tissue (STRAVIX{lozenge}) or other acellular CAMPs. Methods: This retrospective analysis was conducted on patients with DLEU treated with the CAMPs using data from the Premier PINC AI Healthcare Database. Each patient's earliest inpatient encounter was designated as the index admission. The analysis groups included a cellular human umbilical tissue allograft (STRAVIX) and four different acellular CAMPs (aCAMPs). To balance baseline covariates, inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) was applied. Subsequently, IPTW-adjusted generalized linear models were utilized to estimate healthcare-related outcomes and hospital-related costs. items.title: Myo-inositol as a spectroscopic marker of neuroinflammation in frontotemporal lobar degeneration
items.title_zh: 肌醇作为额叶颞叶变性神经炎症的光谱标志物
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：需要经济有效且具有机制信息的生物标志物以推动痴呆新疗法的发展。本研究聚焦于与额叶颞叶变性（FTLD）相关的神经炎症。常用的检测方法包括正电子发射断层扫描（PET）和外周血标志物，但PET受限于放射性，影响重复测量，而外周标志物则是神经病理的间接指标。本研究探讨质子磁共振光谱（MRS）量化肌醇的潜力，肌醇是一种在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中发现的炎症代谢物。我们测试以下假设：1）FTLD受影响脑区的肌醇水平升高；2）受影响脑区的肌醇与外周免疫标志物相关；3）受影响脑区的肌醇与认知衰退相关。方法：54名FTLD相关疾病患者（29例行为变异型额叶痴呆，25例进行性核上性麻痹）和73名年龄/性别匹配的对照者接受了单体素7特斯拉MRS。2cm各向同性体素放置在右下额回（R IFG，受影响区域）和右枕叶（R OCC，对照区域）。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Cost-effective and mechanistically-informative biomarkers are needed to advance novel therapeutics for dementia. We focus on neuroinflammation in disorders associated with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Commonly used assays include positron emission tomography (PET) imaging and peripheral blood markers. However, PET is limited by radioactivity, which impedes repeated measurements, while peripheral markers are indirect measures of neuropathology. This study investigates the potential of proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) - a non-invasive technique that can be deployed alongside structural imaging sequences - to quantify myo-inositol, an inflammatory metabolite found in astroglial and microglial cells. We test the following hypotheses (1) myo-inositol is elevated in brain regions affected by FTLD disorders; (2) myo-inositol in affected brain regions correlates with peripheral immune markers; and (3) myo-inositol in affected brain regions correlates with cognitive decline. items.title: An AI Model Identifies Chemotherapy Benefit in Node-Negative HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Patients from TAILORx, a Phase 3 Randomized Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: AI模型识别TAILORx试验中HR+/HER2-乳腺癌化疗获益
items.summary_zh: 背景：乳腺癌患者的辅助化疗需权衡生存获益与治疗相关毒性。TAILORx试验显示，对于中等风险患者，单独内分泌治疗平均上不劣于化疗联合内分泌治疗。方法：我们分析了TAILORx试验中的6735名患者，使用Ataraxis Breast CTX模型结合病理图像和复发评分（RS）。CTX模型整合了H&E染色切片的形态特征与临床变量，生成个体化预后（CTX-prognostic）和化疗获益（CTX-benefit）预测。结果：在仅接受内分泌治疗的患者中，CTX-prognostic预测无病生存期（DFI），每标准差增加的风险比为1.651（95% CI, 1.511-1.803, p < 0.001），C-index为0.736（95% CI, 0.697-0.770）。在接受化疗联合内分泌治疗的患者中，表现相似。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND The prescribing of adjuvant chemotherapy for patients with breast cancer must balance the survival benefit against treatment-related toxicities. TAILORx, a phase 3 randomized clinical trial, demonstrated that endocrine therapy alone was, on average, noninferior to chemoendocrine therapy for patients classified as intermediate risk by a 21-gene Recurrence Score (RS) assay. Uncertainty remains about the optimal strategy to identify which intermediate-RS individuals derive benefit from chemotherapy. METHODS We analyzed 6735 patients from the TAILORx trial using Ataraxis Breast CTX with pathology images (H&E slides) and RS available. CTX is an AI model which integrates morphologic features extracted from H&E-stained slides with clinical variables to generate individualized predictions of prognosis (CTX-prognostic) and chemotherapy benefit (CTX-benefit). No data from TAILORx were used to train CTX and CTX was not retrained or recalibrated for this study. Analyses were prespecified in a protocol approved by ECOG-ACRIN. items.title: Impaired regulatory T cell mediated immune tolerance promotes neurodegeneration in glaucoma
items.title_zh: 调节性T细胞介导的免疫耐受失调促进青光眼神经退行性变
items.summary_zh: 神经退行性疾病越来越被认为涉及免疫系统与神经系统之间的有害相互作用，但外周免疫耐受的失效是否主动驱动神经元丧失仍不明确。本研究以原发性开角型青光眼作为慢性神经退行性变的模型，证明了失调的适应性免疫足以促进视网膜神经节细胞的退化。青光眼患者的外周血单核细胞在转移到人源化免疫缺陷小鼠后，导致视网膜神经节细胞丧失，而眼内压未发生变化，显示出免疫反应在患者来源材料中的因果作用。全面的免疫分析进一步揭示了调节性T细胞群体的选择性变化，表明激活减少、抑制表型受损，以及分化和迁移状态改变，尽管整体调节性T细胞丰度保持不变。研究还表明，调节性T细胞的瞬时扩增可以保护视觉功能，减少视神经轴突退化，并限制实验性青光眼模型中的视网膜神经节细胞丧失。这些发现表明调节性T细胞介导的免疫耐受失效是青光眼中神经退行性变的一个机制。
items.abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases are increasingly recognized to involve detrimental interactions between the immune and nervous systems, yet whether failure of peripheral immune tolerance actively drives neuronal loss frequently remains unclear. Here, using primary open-angle glaucoma as a model of chronic neurodegeneration, we demonstrate that dysregulated adaptive immunity is sufficient to promote retinal ganglion cell degeneration. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from glaucoma patients, but not healthy donors, induced retinal ganglion cell loss following transfer into humanized immunodeficient mice without changes to the intraocular pressure, demonstrating a causal role for immune responses in the patient derived material. Comprehensive immune profiling further revealed selective changes in the regulatory T-cell compartment, indicating reduced activation, an impaired suppressive phenotype, and altered differentiation and trafficking states despite preserved overall regulatory T cell abundance. items.title: Allele-Specific MicroRNA-Binding Variants at Colorectal Cancer Risk Loci in a Hispanic/Latino Population: An Integrative GWAS, All of Us, and Epigenomic Analysis
items.title_zh: 西班牙裔人群结直肠癌风险位点的等位基因特异性miRNA结合变异
items.summary_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）对西班牙裔个体的影响显著，但在基因组发现中仍然缺乏代表性。本研究通过与西班牙裔相关的资源，识别了CRC风险位点的等位基因特异性miRNA结合变异。我们从GWAS目录中汇总了与CRC相关的3'非翻译区（3' UTR）变异，并在“All of Us”研究项目的西班牙裔/拉丁裔个体中进行了验证（n = 453）。筛选了38个CRC相关的3' UTR SNPs，发现19个变异影响九个基因的miRNA结合。三个致癌位点DCBLD2（主SNP rs11552978）、GREM1（主SNP rs10318）和SMC1B（rs3747239）符合所有优先标准。风险等位基因破坏了强miRNA结合位点，同时基因的肿瘤表达增加。
items.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) disproportionately affects Hispanic individuals, who remain underrepresented in genomic discovery and lack ancestry-matched functional resources. Many CRC risk variants are non-coding, and those in 3' untranslated regions (3' UTRs) can alter microRNA (miRNA) binding sites and reprogram post-transcriptional gene regulation. Here, we identify allele-specific miRNA-binding variants at CRC risk loci within the Hispanic population using a discovery pipeline anchored to Hispanic-relevant resources. CRC-associated 3' UTR variants were compiled from the GWAS Catalog, further verified in Hispanic/Latino individuals using the All of Us Research Program cohort (n = 453), expanded into proxy sets using Admixed American-specific linkage disequilibrium, annotated against Ensembl transcripts, and evaluated with TargetScan and RNAhybrid. Screening of 38 CRC-associated 3' UTR SNPs identified 19 variants that alter miRNA binding across nine genes, with each gene represented by a variant confirmed in the Hispanic cohort. items.title: Genomic Research as a Critical Pathway to Diagnosis for Individuals with Rare Disease
items.title_zh: 基因组研究为罕见病诊断提供关键路径
items.summary_zh: 许多罕见单基因疾病患者因基因检测获取困难、变异解读模糊及新疾病基因发现与临床应用之间的延迟而未能获得分子诊断。罕见基因组项目（RGP）为罕见病家庭提供远程研究型基因组测序服务，以克服诊断障碍并加深对罕见病遗传基础的理解。通过短读长基因组测序和以家庭为中心的分析，识别主要疾病原因。符合返还标准的变异经过临床确认并反馈给家庭。自2017年以来，RGP招募了来自50个州、华盛顿特区和波多黎各的临床异质、未诊断的罕见病家庭。272个被测序家庭获得了结果，解决率为23.3%，强候选变异返还率为3.5%。特定疾病的返还率在15%至40%之间，许多家庭在面临医疗获取挑战后获得了已知疾病基因的结果。研究干预措施在所有家庭中贡献了16%的结果，包括最近发现或非编码疾病基因的变异、额外功能研究以解决变异不确定性，以及实时数据共享以促进新疾病基因的发现。RGP证明了这一研究模式的有效性。
items.abstract: Many individuals with rare monogenic disease remain molecularly undiagnosed due to challenges accessing genetic testing, ambiguity in interpretation of uncertain variants, and latency between novel disease-gene discovery and adoption into clinical pipelines. The Rare Genomes Project (RGP) provides a remote, research-based genomic sequencing (GS) service for rare disease families to overcome diagnostic barriers while advancing the understanding of the genetic basis of rare disease. Short-read GS and family-centered analysis were performed to identify causes of primary disease. Variants meeting return criteria were clinically confirmed and returned to families. Since 2017, RGP enrolled clinically heterogeneous, undiagnosed rare disease families from all fifty states, Washington DC, and Puerto Rico. Findings were returned to 272 of 1014 sequenced families, resulting in a solve rate of 23.3% and a returned strong candidate rate of 3.5%. Condition-specific return rates ranged from 15% to 40% with many families receiving a result in a known disease gene after healthcare access challenges. items.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Colorectal Cancer Symptom Extraction from MIMIC-IV Clinical Notes
items.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型提取结直肠癌患者出院记录中的症状
items.summary_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）患者的症状负担主要记录在非结构化的出院记录中，手动提取不具可扩展性。尚未严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）是否优于基于规则和命名实体识别（NER）的方法。目的：基准测试基于规则、NER和零样本LLM方法，从CRC出院记录中提取46种癌症相关症状，并与经过裁定的真实数据进行对比。方法：分析了MIMIC-IV中2,704份CRC患者的出院记录，构建了基于纪念症状评估量表和EORTC QLQ-CR29的46种症状目标列表。评估了四种方法——基于字典的规则匹配、预训练的临床NER、零样本Claude Haiku和Gemini 3.5 Flash，以及两种混合变体（LLM输出后处理规则否定过滤），与200份由两名评审裁定的金标准进行比较（合并kappa=0.71，宏kappa=0.49），使用宏/微F1、精确度和召回率。结果：Gemini 3.5 Flash表现最佳（宏F1=0.70，微F1=0.86，宏精确度=0.74），其次是Claude Haiku（宏F1=0.63，宏召回率=0.71）；两者均显著优于基于规则（宏F1=0.44）和NER（宏F1=0.38）的方法。后处理否定过滤反而降低了LLM性能（Gemini+Hybrid宏F1=0.58；Claude+Hybrid宏F1=0.54）。
items.abstract: Background: Much of the symptom burden in colorectal cancer (CRC) patients is documented in unstructured discharge-note narrative, and manual extraction is not scalable. Whether large language models (LLMs) outperform rule-based and named entity recognition (NER) methods has not been rigorously benchmarked. Objective: To benchmark rule-based, NER, and zero-shot LLM methods for extracting 46 cancer-related symptoms from CRC discharge notes against an adjudicated ground truth. Methods: We analyzed 2,704 discharge notes from CRC patients in MIMIC-IV. A 46-symptom target list was built from the Memorial Symptom Assessment Scale and the EORTC QLQ-CR29. Four approaches -- dictionary-based rule matching, pretrained clinical NER, and zero-shot Claude Haiku and Gemini 3.5 Flash -- plus two hybrid variants (LLM output with post-hoc rule-based negation filtering) were evaluated against a 200-note gold standard adjudicated by two raters (pooled kappa=0.71, macro kappa=0.49), using Macro/Micro F1, precision, and recall. items.authors: Lee, Y.; Dinov, I.; Hu, X.; Jiang, Y.

items.title: LLM-enabled Natural History Study Analysis to Support Rare Disease Research
items.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型分析自然历史研究以支持罕见病研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：罕见疾病影响全球约3亿人，但指导诊断和治疗的研究往往分散在多个非结构化文献来源中。自然历史研究（NHS）是重要的证据来源，但手动提取NHS出版物中的结构化信息既繁琐又难以扩展。方法：我们开发了一个信息提取管道的概念验证，测试了三种开源大型语言模型（LLMs）——Athena-v3-AWQ、谷歌的Gemma3-27B和Meta的Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct，从Chan Zuckerberg Initiative疾病研究状态模型语料库中提取关键NHS特征，比较模型的效率、提取完整性和专家评估的准确性。结果：三种模型处理摘要的成功率均超过99%。然而，Gemma表现最佳，专家评估的准确率最高（68.0%输出被评为“好”），且在全语料库上的运行时间最快（约16分钟处理3,547个摘要），尽管Llama在自动Token F1指标上得分更高（0.874 vs. 0.723），显示出自动评估与人工评估之间的差异。Athena的较低表现主要归因于逐字提取的限制。
items.abstract: Background: Rare diseases affect an estimated 300 million people worldwide, yet the research needed to guide diagnosis and treatment is often fragmented across multiple unstructured literature sources. Natural history studies (NHS) are a key source of this evidence, but manually extracting structured information from NHS publications can be tedious and does not scale. Methods: We have developed a proof-of-concept for an information extraction pipeline testing three opensource large-language models (LLMs) -- Athena-v3-AWQ, Google's Gemma3-27B, and Meta's Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, to extract key NHS characteristics from PubMed abstracts curated from a Chan Zuckerberg Initiative disease research state model corpus (302 gold-standard and 8,338 full-corpus abstracts), and compared the models on efficiency, extraction completeness, and expert-rated accuracy. Results: All three models processed abstracts with success rates exceeding 99%. However, Gemma achieved the best overall performance, with the highest expert-rated accuracy (68.0% of outputs rated "good" vs. 36.0% for Llama and 10.0% for Athena) and the fastest runtime on the full corpus (~16 minutes for 3,547 abstracts), despite Llama
items.authors: Li, K.; Sid, E.; Zhu, Q.

items.title: Clinical Trial Components of NIH Career Development Awards: Supporting the Nation's Future Trialists
items.title_zh: NIH职业发展奖的临床试验组成部分：支持未来试验者
items.summary_zh: 到2027年，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）将不再支持与职业发展（K）奖相关的临床试验（CT）费用。NIH对临床试验的定义涵盖了多种研究类型，从早期的试点工作到确凿的研究。我们对NIH RePORTER数据进行了横断面分析，以描述由NIH K01、K08和其他相关资助机会公告（FOA）支持的临床试验的类型和规模。通过规则基础的分类方案，将每个奖项分为五种互斥的试验类型：试点/可行性/概念验证、疗效/有效性、类型不明确的确认试验、其他（机制性、辅助性或I/II期）或未识别特定试验语言。在报告明确、手动验证样本量的摘要中评估试验规模。在1336个独特的奖项中，815个（61.0%）被分类为试点、可行性或概念验证研究，55个（4.1%）为疗效或有效性研究。
items.abstract: In 2027, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) will no longer support costs associated with clinical trials (CT) for career development (K) awards. NIH's CT definition encompasses many types of research, from early-stage pilot work through definitive studies. The types and sizes of trials K awardees conduct have not been described, which could inform ongoing policy changes relevant to the next generation of clinical trialists. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of NIH RePORTER data to characterize the types and sizes of CTs supported by NIH K01, K08, and K23 awards funded in fiscal years 2024-2025 under a CT Required or CT Optional funding opportunity announcement (FOA), with non-missing abstract text. A rule-based classification scheme applied to free-text abstracts categorized each award into 5 mutually exclusive trial types: pilot/feasibility/proof-of-concept, efficacy/effectiveness, trial confirmed with type unclear, other (mechanistic, ancillary, or phase I/II), or no trial-specific language identified. items.title: Microbiome Profiling Reveals Prognostic Heterogeneity in Staphylococcus aureus Pneumonia
items.title_zh: 微生物组分析揭示金黄色葡萄球菌肺炎预后异质性
items.summary_zh: 背景：金黄色葡萄球菌是机械通气患者重症肺炎的主要病因。临床培养可以识别病原体，但可能无法反映下呼吸道微生物生态。我们研究了培养确认的金黄色葡萄球菌肺炎是否存在组成异质性及其预后意义。方法：在前瞻性ICU注册中，我们对机械通气患者的气管插管抽吸样本进行了16S rRNA基因测序和纳米孔宏基因组学分析。我们量化了金黄色葡萄球菌的丰度，评估了其与培养特征和宿主炎症生物标志物的相关性，并使用Kaplan-Meier和Cox风险分析检查了与60天死亡率的关联。结果：在109名患者中，半定量培养生长和耐甲氧西林表现与预后无关联。16S测序（n=54）显示金黄色葡萄球菌相对丰度存在显著异质性（范围0-96.7%），仅33%患者表现出主导地位（>50%）。主导地位与较差的60天生存率相关（50% vs. 80%，p=0.013），在调整年龄、性别和耐甲氧西林后仍然独立预测（调整HR 3.24 [95%CI 1.12-9.36]，p=0.030）。主导患者表现出较高的五聚蛋白-3（p=0.01）和较低的Fractalkine（p=0.02）。
items.abstract: Background: Staphylococcus aureus is a leading cause of severe pneumonia in mechanically ventilated patients. Clinical cultures identify pathogen presence but may not reflect lower respiratory tract microbial ecology. Whether culture-confirmed S. aureus pneumonia encompasses compositional heterogeneity with prognostic implications remains unknown. Methods: We performed 16S rRNA gene sequencing and shotgun nanopore metagenomics on endotracheal aspirate samples from mechanically ventilated patients with culture-confirmed S. aureus pneumonia in a prospective ICU registry. We quantified Staphylococcus abundance, assessed correlations with culture characteristics and host inflammatory biomarkers, and examined associations with 60-day mortality using Kaplan-Meier and Cox hazards analyses. Results: Among 109 patients, semi-quantitative culture growth and methicillin resistance showed no associations with outcomes. 16S sequencing (n=54) revealed marked heterogeneity in Staphylococcus relative abundance (range 0-96.7%), with only 33% demonstrating dominance (>50%). items.title: Predicting parental Human papillomavirus vaccine hesitancy: development and internal validation of machine learning models
items.title_zh: 预测父母人乳头瘤病毒疫苗犹豫的机器学习模型研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：宫颈癌是喀麦隆女性中第二常见的癌症。然而，高父母对人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗的犹豫阻碍了疫苗的推广，且缺乏有效的预测工具。本研究旨在开发并内部验证预测父母HPV疫苗犹豫的机器学习模型，并识别关键预测因素。方法：本次二次分析使用了1,156名9-18岁儿童父母的横断面调查数据。通过自我报告的疫苗接种状态和意图来确定犹豫程度。筛选了26个预测变量组（17个用于逻辑回归，全部26个用于基于树的模型）。数据按80/20分为训练集（n=925）和测试集（n=231）。通过重复交叉验证调整逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型，阈值由Youden's J统计量设定。结果：所有模型的区分度相似（AUC-ROC 0.841-0.870），XGBoost的AUC最高（0.870），逻辑回归的敏感性最高（73.1%），F1-score为74.9%，Brier分数最低（0.1435）。模型的校准斜率均超过1（1.12-1.46）。
items.abstract: Objectives: Cervical cancer is Cameroon's second most common cancer among women. However, high parental Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy impedes elimination, and no validated predictive tool exists. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District and identify key predictors. Methods: This secondary analysis used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9-18 years. Hesitancy was derived from self-reported vaccination status and intention. Twenty-six predictor groups were screened via group LASSO (17 retained for logistic regression; all 26 for tree-based models). Data were split 80/20 into training (n=925) and test (n=231) sets. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were tuned via repeated cross-validation while thresholds were set by Youden's J statistic. Discrimination, calibration, and Brier score were assessed on the test set. Predictions were interpreted using SHAP. Results: All models showed comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841-0.870). items.title: Deciphering Charge-Transfer and Triplet-Multiplet Excited States in Substituted MnIII and CrIII Phthalocyanines: Insights from UV-Vis-NIR, MCD, and Theory
items.title_zh: 解读取代MnIII和CrIII酞菁中的电荷转移及三重态多重态激发态
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了高自旋Pc tBu Cr III Cl、Pc tBu Mn III Cl和Pc OBu Mn III Cl复合物的紫外-可见-近红外（UV-vis-NIR）和磁圆二色性（MCD）光谱中的电荷转移（金属-配体转移MLCT、配体-金属转移LMCT、配体间转移LLCT）及配体内转移（π−π*和三重态多重态）跃迁。通过结合群论、时间依赖密度泛函理论及从头算（CASSCF和NEVPT2(13e,14o)）计算，系统研究了取代基对电子跃迁能量的影响。结果表明，三重态多重态跃迁主导了UV-vis-NIR和MCD光谱的近红外区域，而LMCT带则主导了“酞菁窗口”（350-550 nm）区域。此外，预测了在紫外区域的MLCT跃迁，揭示了d 1 -d 9构型中三重态多重态跃迁的一般趋势。
items.abstract: Charge-transfer (metal-to-ligand, MLCT, ligand-to-metal, LMCT, and interligand, (LLCT) and intraligand (π−π* and triplet-multiplet) transitions observed in the UV-vis-NIR and magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) spectra of high-spin Pc tBu Cr III Cl, Pc tBu Mn III Cl, and Pc OBu Mn III Cl (Pc tBu is the dianion of the 2,9(10),16(17),23(24)-tetra-tert-butyl-phthalocyanine and Pc OBu is the dianion of the 1,4,8,11,15,18,22,25-octa-n-butoxy-phthalocyanine) complexes were analyzed with the help of group theory combined with time-dependent density functional theory and ab initio (CASSCF and NEVPT2(13e,14o)) calculations. The energy shift between tert-butylated and butoxylated Pc rings, the energy shift between Mn and Cr centers, and the change in solvent donicity between dichloromethane/chloroform (DCM / CHCl 3 ) and N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) were used to systematically perturb the energies of electronic transitions. It was demonstrated that the triplet-multiplet transitions dominate the NIR region of the UV-vis-NIR and MCD spectra, while LMCT bands dominate the “phthalocyanine window” (350-550 nm) region of the UV-vis-NIR and MCD spectra. items.title: Methylation-Based ctDNA for Post-Treatment Surveillance of Non-Viral Head and Neck Cancer
items.title_zh: 基于甲基化的ctDNA在非病毒性头颈癌治疗后监测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 重要性：头颈鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）的复发率仍然较高，目前的治疗后监测主要依赖临床检查和影像学，存在已知局限性。循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）在HPV阳性HNSCC的复发检测中显示出潜力，但在非病毒相关疾病中的作用尚不明确。目的：评估基于甲基化的ctDNA检测在非病毒性HNSCC治疗后监测中的诊断性能，并评估其与生存结果的预后关联。设计、设置和参与者：本回顾性单中心队列研究纳入了2024年1月至2025年10月期间接受根治性治疗的非转移性非病毒性HNSCC患者，且至少进行过一次Guardant360 ctDNA检测。主要结果和指标包括灵敏度、特异性、阳性预测值（PPV）、阴性预测值（NPV）和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）。采用Kaplan-Meier法估算无进展生存期（PFS）和总生存期（OS）。
items.abstract: Importance: Recurrence rates in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) remain high, yet current post-treatment surveillance relies primarily on clinical examination and imaging with known limitations. Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) has shown promise for recurrence detection in HPV-positive HNSCC, but less is known about its role in non-virally associated disease. Objective: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of a methylation-based ctDNA assay for detecting recurrence during post-treatment surveillance of non-virally associated HNSCC and to assess its prognostic association with survival outcomes. Design, Setting, and Participants: This retrospective single-institution cohort study included patients with non-metastatic non-virally associated HNSCC who underwent definitive therapy and had at least one Guardant360 ctDNA test during post-treatment surveillance between January 2024 and October 2025. Guardant360 identifies tumor-specific DNA methylation patterns via next-generation sequencing of plasma cell-free DNA. A positive result was defined by a methylation signal of 0.05% or greater. Main Outcomes and Measures: Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), n

items.title: Time-to-Statin Prescription for Primary Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease Prevention in a Lung Cancer Screening Program in Missouri: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 密苏里州肺癌筛查项目中他汀处方时间研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：接受肺癌筛查（LCS）的个体是动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）高风险人群，但在筛查过程中进行心血管预防的机会可能未被充分利用。本研究旨在探讨在LCS后他汀的处方时机。方法：我们使用密苏里州大型学术健康系统的电子健康记录数据，进行了一项回顾性队列研究。纳入对象为2015年1月1日至2023年12月31日之间接受LCS的50-80岁成年人，且为他汀初用者，符合2019年ACC/AHA初级预防标准。主要结果为LCS后他汀启动的时间。结果：在3100名符合他汀处方标准的他汀初用者中，仅27.3%在LCS后一年内被处方他汀。处方率逐渐增加（90天为10.5%；180天为17.8%；270天为23.2%；360天为27.1%）。调整后的模型显示，较早启动他汀与更高的ASCVD风险类别及前一年内的心脏科就诊独立相关。
items.abstract: Background: Individuals undergoing lung cancer screening (LCS) represent a population at high risk for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), yet opportunities for cardiovascular prevention during screening encounters may be underutilized. While prior studies have examined whether statins are prescribed in eligible patients, little is known about the timing of statin initiation following LCS, particularly among statin-naive individuals. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using electronic health record data from a large academic health system in Missouri. Adults aged 50-80 who underwent LCS between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2023, were statin-naive, and met 2019 ACC/AHA criteria for primary prevention were included. The primary outcome was time-to-statin initiation following LCS. Kaplan-Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards models were used to evaluate timing and predictors of statin initiation across demographic, clinical, and socioeconomic subgroups. items.authors: Che Ngang, I.; Zewde, E. K.; Gopalsamy Ramaswamy, S.; Anandarajah, A.; Bowe, B.; Odeny, B.

items.title: Mechanistic regimes for electron transfer at bio–nano interfaces
items.title_zh: 生物-纳米界面电子转移的机制范畴
items.summary_zh: 生物电子医学越来越多地在接近氧化还原分子、电双层和结构化电子态的界面上进行研究。核心问题不在于识别电化学何时变为量子效应，而在于确定哪种物理描述能够解释反应。对于纳米尺度的双极电极，这一挑战尤为明显，因为均匀场模型预测的导体尺度电位可能非常小，尽管存在法拉第和生物活性。局部场集中、双层重叠、离子浓度极化、重组能量变化、随机分子动力学和电子隧穿提供了共存的解释。我们提出了一个可证伪的框架，通过扰动局部电位、场和长度、分子耦合、限制和电子结构，区分连续/器件、界面/细胞、随机/少分子和量子信息范畴。量子电容、双极电化学、隧道结、无激活电子转移和多尺度建模展示了这些测试。尺寸决定了效应何时变得重要；机制必须通过区分行为来确定，而不仅仅依赖于尺寸或最终反应。
items.abstract: Bioelectronic medicine increasingly operates at interfaces whose dimensions approach redox molecules, electrical double layers and structured electronic states. The central problem is therefore not to identify a size at which electrochemistry becomes quantum, but to determine which physical description explains a response. This challenge is acute for nanoscale bipolar electrodes, where conductor-scale potentials predicted from uniform-field models can be extremely small despite faradaic and biological activity. Local field concentration, double-layer overlap, ion-concentration polarisation, altered reorganisation energetics, stochastic molecular dynamics and electron tunnelling offer coexisting explanations. We propose a falsifiable framework that distinguishes continuum/device, interfacial/cellular, stochastic/few-molecule and quantum-informed regimes by perturbing local potential, field and length, molecular coupling, confinement and electronic structure. Quantum capacitance, bipolar electrochemistry, tunnelling junctions, activationless electron transfer and multiscale modelling illustrate these tests. Size determines when effects may become important; mechanism must be assigned
items.authors: Deepan Kumar Neethipathi, Frankie J. Rawson

items.title: Rapid, High-Yielding, and Broad-Scope Silicon-Noded Single-Atom Ligation Platform
items.title_zh: 快速高效的硅节点单原子连接平台
items.summary_zh: 节点-模块逻辑是DNA、RNA和金属有机框架的基础。在小分子合成中，SuFEx和PFEx利用硫或磷作为单原子节点进行模块连接，但主要限于胺和酚模块。基于硅的连接提供了一种可行的替代方案，因为醇和酚均可作为可靠的模块，但缺乏高效可控的平台。在此，我们报告了一种硅节点连接平台，采用双(2,4,6-三甲氧基苯)硅烷（bis(TMP)silanes）作为连接中心，实现了醇和酚模块的快速高效连接，并具有广泛的官能团耐受性。
items.abstract: The node–module logic underpins DNA, RNA, and metal–organic frameworks. In small-molecule synthesis, SuFEx and PFEx exploit sulfur or phosphorus as single‑atom nodes for 10 modular ligations but are largely confined to amine and phenol modules. Silicon‑based ligation would offer a viable alternative, as both alcohols and phenols can serve as reliable modules, yet it has lacked efficient and controllable platforms. Herein, we report a silicon-noded ligation platform using bis(2,4,6-trimethoxyphenyl)silanes (bis(TMP)silanes) as the ligation hubs, enabling rapid, high-yielding ligation of both alcohol and phenol modules with broad functional-group tolerance.
items.authors: Jie Wang, Zhiyou Hu, Youliang Wang

items.title: Synthetic Mutagenesis of Tyrosine into Proline Mimetics Enables Late-Stage Backbone Editing of Peptides
items.title_zh: 合成诱变酪氨酸为脯氨酸类似物实现肽链末期编辑
items.summary_zh: 肽的生物和物理化学性质受到其主链构象的强烈影响。我们报道了一种末期主链编辑方法，将天然氨基酸残基转化为脯氨酸类似物。通过在碱性水相缓冲液中进行酪氨酸选择性腙结合生成的去芳香化中间体，诱导主链酰胺氮的分子内1,4-加成，从而将酪氨酸残基转化为肽链中的环状脯氨酸类似物。该转化在温和的水相条件下高效进行，并适用于多种生物活性肽。多维核磁共振分析确定了产物的结构，而常规分子动力学和REST2模拟表明，所安装的脯氨酸类似物主链降低了肽的局部构象自由度。使用β-发夹模型肽的评估进一步表明，脯氨酸类似物结构增强了对蛋白酶降解的抵抗力。这一方法构成了一种化学诱变策略，直接将天然酪氨酸残基转化为主链构象控制单元，而无需重建母肽序列。
items.abstract: The biological and physicochemical properties of peptides are strongly influenced by their backbone conformations. However, installing conformationally restricting units generally requires peptide redesign and resynthesis using noncanonical amino acids. Here, we report a late-stage backbone-editing method that converts a native amino acid residue into a proline-mimetic structure. Treatment of the dearomatized intermediate generated by tyrosine-selective oxime conjugation in a basic aqueous buffer induced intramolecular 1,4-addition of the backbone amide nitrogen, thereby converting the tyrosine residue into a cyclic proline-mimetic unit within the peptide backbone. This transformation proceeded efficiently under mild aqueous conditions and was applicable to several bioactive peptides. Multidimensional NMR analyses established the structures of the resulting products, while conventional molecular dynamics and REST2 simulations demonstrated that the installed proline-mimetic backbone reduced the local conformational freedom of the peptide. Evaluation using a β-hairpin model peptide further demonstrated that the proline-mimetic structure enhanced resistance to proteolytic degradation.
items.authors: Takaya Togo, Takumi Ueda, Yuko Otani, Yuka Furukawa, Kohei Nogita, Katsuya Maruyama

items.title: An open implementation of MSEVB for reactive force field simulation with simple energy-based coupling
items.title_zh: 开放实现的MSEVB用于简单能量耦合的反应力场模拟
items.summary_zh: 在大系统中对化学反应性建模面临计算和理论挑战；从头算方法成本过高，而经典力场无法处理键的断裂和形成。现有的反应力场解决方案需要丰富的专业知识，机器学习方法通常需要庞大且高质量的数据集进行训练。这些障碍限制了反应化学过程的建模。多态经验价键（MSEVB）理论提供了一种替代方案，通过以受控方式混合常规非反应力场来选择性描述化学反应。然而，现有的MSEVB实现通常是特定于领域的，分发受限或依赖复杂的参数化方案。本研究提出了一种新的开源通用MSEVB实现，旨在使反应建模对非专家更为可及。该实现专注于简单的基于能量的耦合，从而消除了对复杂几何耦合方法的需求，显著降低了反应力场开发的门槛。该通用方法在Y掺杂和未掺杂的BaZrO3、体相水和液态咪唑等系统中成功再现了质子转移行为及其他反应性形式。
items.abstract: Chemical reactivity modelling in large systems over extended timescales is computationally and theoretically challenging; ab initio methods are too expensive, while classical force fields cannot handle bond breaking/formation. Existing solutions like reactive force fields require extensive expertise to develop, and machine-learned approaches often need prohibitively large, high-quality datasets for training. These barriers have hindered the modelling of reactive chemical processes. Multi-state empirical valence bond (MSEVB) theory offers an alternative by enabling conventional unreactive force fields to be mixed in a controlled manner to selectively describe chemical reactions. However, existing MSEVB implementations are often field-specific, have license-restricted distribution, or rely on complex parameterisation schemes. This work presents a new open-source, general MSEVB implementation, designed to make reactive modelling more accessible to non-experts. Specifically, the implementation here focused on simple energy-based coupling, thereby eliminating the need for complex geometry-based coupling approaches, significantly lowering the barrier to entry for reactive force field dev
items.authors: Blake I. Armstrong, Peter R. Spackman, Luc M. LeBlanc, Paolo Raiteri, Julian D. Gale

items.title: Sensitized near-infrared luminescence in sulfur-coordinated lanthanide complexes for machine learning-enhanced thermometry
items.title_zh: 用于机器学习增强温度测量的硫配位镧系金属复合物的近红外发光研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了仅含Ln–S键的镧系金属(Ln 3+ )配位复合物的光学特性，这些特性受到软供体原子的独特调制。我们合成了三种新型均配位复合物，通式为[K(2.2.2-cryptand)][Ln(L)4] (Ln = Nd 3+ (1-Nd)、Gd 3+ (1-Gd)或Yb 3+ (1-Yb); L = 2,6-bis-(4-tert-butylphenyl)phenyldithiocarboxylate)。所有复合物中，Ln 3+ 离子以十二面体方式与八个硫原子配位，导致晶场状态的显著混合。通过温度依赖的光致发光和光学吸收测量，识别了复合物光学特性的电子跃迁和能量转移机制，发现Ln 3+ 发射主要受配体敏化影响。光致发光与温度的校准数据表明1-Nd和1-Yb在温度测量中的潜力。
items.abstract: Lanthanide (Ln 3+ ) coordination complexes featuring only Ln–S bonds have optical properties uniquely modulated by soft donor atoms. Yet, these complexes and their applications are underexplored, due to the stricter environmental control required for their typical preparation relative to complexes containing Ln–O bonds. Herein, we show that Ln-S coordination is ideally suited to generate information-rich near-infrared (NIR) photoluminescence, laying the optimal ground for machine learning-driven optical sensing. We prepared three new homoleptic complexes with general formula [K(2.2.2-cryptand)][Ln( L ) 4 ] (Ln = Nd 3+ ( 1-Nd ), Gd 3+ ( 1-Gd ), or Yb 3+ ( 1-Yb ); L = 2,6-bis-(4- tert -butylphenyl)phenyldithiocarboxylate). In all complexes, the Ln 3+ ion is dodecahedrally coordinated to eight sulfur atoms, generating a crystal field that deviates from the ideal anisotropic case and leads to substantial mixing of the crystal-field states, as revealed by magnetic measurements and ab initio calculations. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence and optical absorption measurements allowed identifying the electronic transitions and energy transfer mechanisms underpinning the complexes’ opt
items.authors: Mikko Rautiainen, Emily Andreato, Essi Barkas, Liyan Ming, Nikita Panov, Hannu Huhtinen

items.title: When Is a Molecule a Duplicate? Identity Policy Determines What a Benchmark Audit Finds
items.title_zh: 分子何时算作重复？身份政策影响基准审计结果
items.summary_zh: 分子机器学习基准中重复或冗余记录的报告通常被视为数据集的属性，实际上并非如此。重复计数是对数据集应用的分子身份操作定义的结果，不同的可辩护定义会从同一文件中返回不同的答案。我们在四级身份层次下审计了七个MoleculeNet基准（52,144条记录），使用标准InChIKey作为正交比较，而非层级，并在声明的适用领域外保留派生身份。每个基准的重复组计数随着层级变化，对于三个基准，审计结果改变了是否包含重复化合物的判断。领域选择同样重要：在每条记录都被认定为身份的情况下，HIV在塔托美尔归一化层级报告330个重复组，而在声明领域则为124个。后续敏感性分析发现，领域未覆盖主族和f区金属相关结构，导致109个结果未影响预设的124个结果。在295个合并事件中，179个仅凭结构可判定，116个依赖于政策；在完整普查中，19个事件（16.4%；41条记录）获得了不同的基准结果。
items.abstract: Reports of duplicate or redundant records in molecular machine-learning benchmarks are routinely presented as properties of the datasets. They are not. A duplicate count is the output of an operational definition of molecular identity applied to a dataset, and different defensible definitions return different answers from the same file. We audited seven MoleculeNet [3] benchmarks (52,144 records) under a four-level identity hierarchy — canonical molecular graph, fragment parent, charge-normalised parent and tautomer-normalised parent — with the Standard InChIKey as an orthogonal comparator rather than a rung, and with derived identity withheld outside a declared domain of applicability. Duplicate-group counts moved with the level in every benchmark, and for three the audit changed its answer to whether the benchmark contains duplicate compounds at all. Domain choice mattered as much: HIV reports 330 duplicate groups at the tautomer-normalised level when identity is asserted for every record, against 124 on the declared domain. items.title: Water Layering and Orientation Modulate Lanthanide Hydration in Carbon Nanotubes
items.title_zh: 水层和取向调节碳纳米管中镧系离子的水合状态
items.summary_zh: 纳米尺度的限制可以重组水分子并改变离子水合状态，为分离化学性质相似的离子提供潜在途径。我们使用分子动力学模拟和MACE-MH-1基础机器学习原子间势，研究了八种三价镧系离子（Ln³⁺：La³⁺、Pr³⁺、Nd³⁺、Gd³⁺、Tb³⁺、Dy³⁺、Tm³⁺和Lu³⁺）在直径为1.09–1.3纳米的碳纳米管（CNTs）中的水合情况。MACE-MH-1的OMOL模型重现了已报道的Ln–O距离和配位数趋势，因此用于CNT模拟。水合因子（测量第一壳层的取向有序性）随CNT直径非单调变化，在CNT(9,9)中达到最小值，同时容纳最多的第一壳层水分子。该最小值与中心水群体的出现相吻合，反映了第一壳层与周围水分子之间的取向差异和氢键耦合的增加。然而，不同的Ln³⁺离子对限制的反应相似，表明CNT限制单独可能对其分离的选择性有限。
items.abstract: Nanoscale confinement can reorganize water molecules and alter ionic hydration, offering a potential route to separating chemically similar ions. We use molecular dynamics simulations with the MACE-MH-1 foundation machine-learning interatomic potential to investigate the hydration of eight trivalent lanthanide ions (Ln 3+ : La 3+ , Pr 3+ , Nd 3+ , Gd 3+ , Tb 3+ , Dy 3+ , Tm 3+ , and Lu 3+ ) in carbon nanotubes (CNTs) with diameters of 1.09–1.49 nm. We first evaluate MACE-MH-1 for Ln 3+ hydration in bulk solution. The OMOL model of MACE-MH-1 reproduces the reported Ln–O distances and coordination-number trends and is therefore used for the CNT simulations. The hydration factor, which measures first-shell orientational order, varies nonmonotonically with CNT diameter and reaches a minimum in CNT(9,9), which also accommodates the most first-shell water molecules. This minimum coincides with the emergence of a central water population and reflects two combined effects: difference in preferred orientation between first-shell and surrounding water molecules and increased hydrogen-bond coupling between them. items.authors: Kailong Zhang, Jian Shi, Qing Shao

items.title: CO2 Electrosorption: Electric Field Effect on the Metal–CO2 Interfacial Dipole
items.title_zh: CO2电吸附：电场对金属-CO2界面偶极子的影响
items.summary_zh: 金属电极上的CO2电吸附是控制后续电化学还原过程的关键步骤，但其物理化学机制仍存在争议。电场诱导的吸附CO2的稳定性——电场效应——通常归因于施加电场与CO2吸附诱导的分子偶极子之间的相互作用。本研究采用密度泛函理论结合施加电场，重新审视这一范式，研究Ag、Au、Cu、Ir、Pb和Pt的(111)表面上的CO2电吸附。我们展示了电场驱动的物理吸附与化学吸附之间的转变。物理吸附保持近线性几何形状，几乎没有电荷转移和弱电场依赖性，而化学吸附则涉及明显的弯曲和大量的电子从金属转移。总体而言，我们证明电场效应源于电场与在电荷转移后形成的金属-CO2界面偶极子之间的相互作用，而非仅仅是分子CO2偶极子，如传统假设。
items.abstract: CO2 electrosorption at metal electrodes is a critical step controlling the subsequent electrochemical reduction process, yet its physicochemical origin remains debated. The field-induced stabilization of adsorbed CO2 – the field effect − is commonly attributed to the interaction between the applied electric field and the adsorption-induced molecular dipole of CO2 . In this study, we employ density functional theory with an applied electric field to re-examine this paradigm by studying CO2 electrosorption on (111) surfaces of Ag, Au, Cu, Ir, Pb, and Pt. We show an electric-field-driven transition between physisorbed and chemisorbed CO2 . Physisorption preserves a near-linear geometry with negligible charge transfer and weak field dependence, whereas chemisorption involves pronounced bending and substantial electron transfer from the metal. Collectively, we demonstrate that the field effect arises from the interaction between the electric field and the interfacial metal–CO2 dipole formed upon charge transfer, rather than the molecular CO2 dipole alone, as conventionally assumed.
items.authors: Anna Stepanova, Ba Long Nguyen, Nadezda Kongi, Vladislav Ivanistsev

items.title: Coordinate bonding, cluster delocalization and topological criticality in a cyclic trimeric beryllium–dinitrogen complex
items.title_zh: 循环三聚体铍-二氮复合物中的配位键、簇去局域化与拓扑临界性
items.summary_zh: 主族簇对分子二氮（N2）的固定与配位提供了非经典多中心键合和轻金属活化途径的基本见解。本文报告了对循环簇Be3(N2)3的结合密度泛函和从头算研究。几何优化和频率分析表明，该三聚体为稳定的闭壳层Cs对称结构，包含一个等腰三角形的Be3金属核心，由三个末端N2配体端对端配位。能量分解分析结合化学价自然轨道（ETS-NOCV）显示，Be3⋯(N2)3相互作用主要由轨道贡献主导（约占吸引力的60%），并辅以静电吸引，共同克服泡利排斥。分子中的原子量子理论（QTAIM）识别出沿顶点-基底Be–Be边缘的两个非核吸引子，而电子局域化函数（ELF）和局域轨道定位器（LOL）分析揭示出一个独特的心形三突触价盆V(Be,Be,Be)，其电子数约为1.8–2.0。这些拓扑特征确立了多中心σ-芳香去局域化作为中心金属环的结构基础，并表明轻碱土元素能够支持非经典的N2配位框架。
items.abstract: Fixation and coordination of molecular dinitrogen (N2) by main-group clusters offer fundamental insight into non-classical multi-centre bonding and light-metal activation pathways. Here we report a combined density-functional and ab initio study of the cyclic cluster Be3(N2)3. Geometry optimization and frequency analysis establish a stable, closed-shell Cs-symmetric trimer containing an isosceles triangular Be3 metal core coordinated end-on by three terminal N2 ligands. Energy decomposition analysis coupled with natural orbitals for chemical valence (ETS-NOCV) shows that the Be3⋯(N2)3 interaction is dominated by orbital contributions (≈60 % of attractive forces), supplemented by electrostatic attraction that together overcome Pauli repulsion. Quantum theory of atoms in molecules (QTAIM) identifies two non-nuclear attractors along the apical–basal Be–Be edges, while electron localization function (ELF) and localized orbital locator (LOL) basin analyses reveal a distinct heart-shaped trisynaptic valence basin V(Be,Be,Be) populated by ≈1.8–2.0 electrons. These topological signatures establish multi-centre σ-aromatic delocalization as the structural foundation of the central metallacyc
items.authors: D K Jha, M Pathak, Dhananjay Kumar Jha

items.title: Sampling Budget as a Confound in Dimensionality-Reduction Analyses of Molecular Simulation
items.title_zh: 采样预算对分子模拟降维分析的干扰
items.summary_zh: 分子模拟中常见的观点是，投影轨迹可以揭示N个亚稳态。这里的N是低维嵌入中选择的高斯混合成分的数量，缺乏动力学模型时应视为表观盆地计数，而非经过验证的亚稳态计数。在两个固定盆地计数的势能和两个独立的100 ns丙氨酸二肽模拟中，BIC选择的成分数量随着采样预算显著增加（Spearman rho = 0.87-0.97），尽管参考景观未发生变化。该趋势在统一稀疏化的共同参考轨迹下持续存在，并在精确的合成潜在坐标下的IID玻尔兹曼采样中保持不变，消除了时间相关性和投影学习。其他标准表现出不同的失效模式：AIC常常受到上限限制或非单调，ICL从未达到测试上限但在方法上依然不准确，轮廓系数和简单肘部诊断则大多不敏感。BIC选择的恢复通常在中等预算时达到峰值，然后下降，即使参考成分计数的恢复保持平稳或改善。一个例外是明确的丙氨酸TICA种子1，在测试范围内没有下降，因为其高恢复交叉发生在预算较高时。
items.abstract: A common claim in molecular simulation is that projecting a trajectory reveals N metastable states. Here N is operationally the number of Gaussian-mixture components selected in a low-dimensional embedding, without a kinetic model it should be read as an apparent-basin count, not a validated metastable-state count. Across two potentials with basin counts fixed by construction and two independent 100 ns alanine-dipeptide simulations, the BIC-selected component count rises strongly with sampling budget (Spearman rho = 0.87-0.97 across systems and methods) although the reference landscape is unchanged. The trend persists under uniform thinning of a common reference trajectory, where coverage is approximately matched, and under IID Boltzmann sampling in the exact synthetic latent coordinates, which removes time correlation and projection learning. Other criteria exhibit different failure modes: AIC is frequently ceiling-censored or non-monotone, ICL never reaches the tested ceiling but remains method-dependently inaccurate, and silhouette and the simple elbow diagnostic are largely insensitive. items.authors: Jaiveer Bassi

items.title: Self-Salting Coacervates: Interfacial Tension Reveals a Critical-Like Self-Suppression of Complex Coacervation
items.title_zh: 自盐析共聚物：界面张力揭示复杂共聚的自抑制特性
items.summary_zh: 复杂共聚是对立电荷聚电解质的关联性液-液相分离，广泛用于生物分子凝聚体的原理研究及封装和水下粘附应用。共聚通常通过添加盐的离子强度进行控制，而聚电解质浓度的作用则较少被关注。本文展示了在无盐的聚（双烯基二甲基铵氯化物）/聚丙烯酸钠体系中，增加聚合物浓度会逐渐抑制复杂共聚。随着聚合物浓度的增加，共聚相膨胀，而其中回收的聚合物比例几乎保持不变，共聚相和上清液的组成及密度逐渐趋同。在400 mM聚合物浓度时，宏观相边界消失，系统达到均匀的自抑制共聚状态。在此范围内，液-液界面张力持续降低至接近零，遵循临界型幂律，指数为1.43±0.03，接近经典均场值3/2。这些结果表明，聚电解质浓度不仅是成分变量，还能驱动共聚向临界型均匀状态发展。
items.abstract: Complex coacervation, the associative liquid\liquid phase separation of oppositely charged polyelectrolytes, is a widely used physicochemical model for the principles underlying biomolecular condensates and for applications in encapsulation and underwater adhesion. Coacervation is typically controlled through the ionic strength of an added salt, while the role of polyelectrolyte concentration itself has received much less attention. Here we show that increasing polymer concentration can itself progressively suppress complex coacervation in a charge-stoichiometric, salt-free poly(diallyldimethylammonium chloride)/sodium polyacrylate system. As the polymer concentration increases, the coacervate phase swells while the fraction of polymer recovered in it stays nearly constant, and the compositions and densities of the coacervate and supernatant phases progressively converge. At a polymer concentration of 400 mM, the macroscopic phase boundary vanishes and the system reaches a homogeneous, self-suppressed coacervation state. Over this range, the liquid\liquid interfacial tension decreases continuously toward zero, following a critical-like power law with an exponent of 1.43±0.03, close
items.authors: Yue Yu, Hongwei Li, Christophe Schatz, Jean-Paul Chapel

items.title: Dynamic Coordination Enables Moisture-Tolerant Organoaluminum Catalysis for Controlled Ring-Opening Polymerization
items.title_zh: 动态协调实现耐湿性有机铝催化剂的可控开环聚合
items.summary_zh: 在高催化活性与空气/湿气稳定性之间取得平衡是开发高效有机金属催化剂用于开环聚合（ROP）的基本挑战。本文提出了一种动态路易斯碱协调策略，调节有机铝催化剂的协调环境，以平衡这些相互竞争的要求。所制备的有机铝催化剂MeAl(BHT)2(THF)具有动态THF配体，易于从商业可得的三甲基铝、2,6-二叔丁基-4-甲基苯酚和四氢呋喃（THF）合成，无需繁琐的纯化。与母体MeAl(BHT)2相比，MeAl(BHT)2(THF)在保持良好催化活性和对多种内酯和乳酸的ROP可控性的同时，显著增强了空气/湿气耐受性。特别是，MeAl(BHT)2(THF)在180°C空气中进行l-乳酸的批量ROP时，达到8400 h-1的高周转频率（TOF）。单晶结构分析和原位NMR实验共同证实了THF配体的动态协调与解离，这解释了高活性与耐湿性的平衡。
items.abstract: Reconciling high catalytic activity with air/moisture stability remains a fundamental challenge in the development of efficient organometallic catalysts for the ring‑opening polymerization (ROP). In this contribution, we present a dynamic Lewis-base coordination strategy that regulates the coordination environment of an organoaluminum catalyst to balance these competing requirements. A structurally simple organoaluminum catalyst featuring a dynamic THF ligand, MeAl(BHT)2(THF) (BHT = 2,6-di-tert-butyl-4-methylphenoxy), is easily prepared from commercially available trimethylaluminum, 2,6-di-tert-butyl-4-methylphenol and tetrahydrofuran (THF) without tedious purification. In contrast to the parent MeAl(BHT)2, MeAl(BHT)2(THF) exhibits substantially enhanced air/moisture tolerance while retaining good catalytic activity and controllability toward the ROP of a diversity of lactones and lactide. Notably, MeAl(BHT)2(THF) enable controlled ROP of commercially as-received monomers without prior drying or purification. In particular, MeAl(BHT)2(THF) achieves a high turnover frequency (TOF) of 8400 h-1 for the bulk ROP of l-lactide conducted at 180 °C in air. The single-crystal structural ana
items.authors: Qin Yan, Pingtao Ge, Shuyi Wang, Yong Shen, Zhibo Li

items.title: Closed-loop optimization in an industrial R D lab
items.title_zh: 工业研发实验室中的闭环优化系统
items.summary_zh: 在工业研发中，自主闭环反应优化器有潜力显著加速流程，但需具备稳健性和灵活性，涵盖硬件和软件组件。本文介绍了一种在工业研发实验室研究单元内开发和部署的多功能系统，旨在解决多种行业相关挑战，而非作为一次性演示工具。与传统系统专注于特定化学过程不同，我们的方法支持多个有机合成研究小组的反应优化。通过三个案例研究，我们展示了该系统在实际应用中的适应性和有效性。通过优先考虑可配置性和可重用性，本研究旨在为工业环境中化学工程实践的可持续和高效方法做出贡献，其中跨学科合作至关重要。
items.abstract: In industrial research and development, autonomous closed-loop reaction optimizers have the potential to significantly accelerate processes, but they must be robust and flexible, encompassing both hardware and software components. This paper presents a versatile system developed and deployed within a research unit of an industrial R D lab, designed to address a variety of industry-relevant challenges rather than functioning as a one-off demonstrator. Unlike traditional systems that may focus on specific chemical processes, our approach facilitates the optimization of reactions across multiple organic synthesis research groups. We illustrate the system’s capabilities through three case studies, showcasing its adaptability and effectiveness in real-world applications. By prioritizing configurability and reusability, this work aims to contribute to a more sustainable and efficient approach to chemical engineering practices in industrial settings where interdisciplinary collaboration is key.
items.authors: Behrang Shafei, Robert Lee, Steffen Hoecker, Matthias Schmalzbauer, Bernd Schaefer

items.title: Tokenising quantum data for label-efficient training of molecular models
items.title_zh: 量子数据标记高效训练分子模型的方法
items.summary_zh: 分子能量模型受限于可获得的参考数据量，因为每个训练样本都是昂贵的计算。我们提出了一种分子的量子特征表示，称为量子标记，模型在使用现有表示的同时也使用该标记。分子在给定轨道基下的能量是其一、二粒子约化密度矩阵的线性泛函，因此计算的对象是这些矩阵而非原子坐标。通过廉价计算可以获得近似值，量子标记是其固定长度的编码。该标记不是语言模型中的符号，而是实数向量，代表一次铸造并被多个下游模型重用的量子信息单位。我们使用普通经典模型在这些特征上进行训练，以预测廉价计算的残差。通过固定学习器、支架不相交分割和训练集大小，仅改变输入特征，添加量子标记使得生产描述符的性能提高了4.4-5.3倍。
items.abstract: A model of molecular energies is limited by how much reference data can be afforded, because every training example is itself an expensive calculation. The practical question is therefore not “how accurate can this get” but “how much accuracy do I get per labelled molecule.” We built a representation of a molecule’s quantum features, which we call a quantum token and which a model consumes alongside whatever representation it already uses. The energy of a molecule in a given orbital basis is a linear functional of its one-and two-particle reduced density matrices, so those matrices, rather than the atomic coordinates, are the object the answer is actually computed from. A cheap calculation already produces an approximate one, and the token is a fixed-length encoding of it. It is not a token in the language-model sense: it is a vector of real numbers, not a discrete symbol drawn from a vocabulary, and the name refers to a unit of quantum information minted once and reused by many downstream models. items.title: Fully bio-based precursor for photocurable networks: synthesis and photopolymerization of furan-vegetable oil derivative
items.title_zh: 全生物基光固化网络前驱体的合成与聚合研究
items.summary_zh: 全生物基光固化树脂的发展为传统石油衍生材料提供了可持续的替代方案。本研究通过两步合成路线合成了新型呋喃基大分子单体。第一步是使用不同催化剂对二甲基2,5-呋喃二羧酸酯（DMFDCA）与二亚油酸二醇（DD）进行转酯化，随后用丙烯酸氯化物进行甲基丙烯酸化，引入末端乙烯基功能团。通过1H NMR和FT-IR光谱确认了中间体和最终大分子单体的化学结构。采用流变学表征评估流动行为和加工性。通过差示扫描量热法（DSC）研究热性质和相行为，发现聚合物具有无定形和柔韧的结构，并在高温下发生热诱导交联。使用光DSC分析了不同类型I光引发剂在受控紫外照射条件下的光聚合动力学，并通过在常温下制备的光固化样品的凝胶分数分析进一步评估了网络形成。此外，还进行了细胞相容性研究，以评估材料在生物医学应用中的潜在适用性。总体而言，这项系统研究为全生物基光固化材料的开发提供了宝贵的见解。
items.abstract: The development of fully bio-based photocurable resins represents a promising sustainable alternative to conventional petroleum-derived materials. In this study, novel furan-based macromonomers were synthesized via a two-step synthetic route. The first step involved the transesterification of dimethyl 2,5-furandicarboxylate (DMFDCA) with dilinoleic diol (DD) using various catalysts, followed by methacrylation with methacryloyl chloride to introduce terminal vinyl functionalities. The chemical structures of the intermediates and final macromonomers were confirmed by 1 H NMR and FT-IR spectroscopy. Rheological characterization was conducted to evaluate flow behavior and processability. Thermal properties and phase behavior were investigated by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), revealing an amorphous and flexible polymer architecture with thermally induced crosslinking at elevated temperatures. Photopolymerization kinetics were analyzed using photo-DSC with different type-I photoinitiators under controlled UV irradiation conditions, while network formation was further evaluated through gel fraction analysis of photocured samples prepared under ambient conditions. items.title: Biosynthetic Plausibility Mapper: Reaction-Aware Prioritization of Plant Metabolite Candidates Using Curated Pathway Context
items.title_zh: 生物合成合理性映射工具：植物代谢物候选的优先排序
items.summary_zh: 未针对性植物代谢组学能够生成大量结构上合理的注释和候选结构，但仅凭结构相似性无法确定化合物是否与检测到的代谢组所代表的生物合成背景一致。因此，将经过整理的生化关系与化学相似性结合，可以为候选物的优先排序提供额外的可解释层次。本文介绍了生物合成合理性映射工具（BPM），这是一个开源的化学信息学应用，能够将用户提供的植物代谢物注释映射到本地构建的PlantCyc衍生知识库，并明确区分检测到的化合物、整理的途径背景和计算优先排序的候选物。在与难结构诱饵的途径基础基准测试中，BPM v3.1实现了1.000的AUROC和AUPRC值，并在所有20次试验中将参考化合物排名第一。在包含生物合成合理替代物的更严格对抗基准中，v3.1将AUROC从0.920提高到0.985，AUPRC从0.574提高到0.837，Top-1准确率从65%提高到90%。
items.abstract: Untargeted plant metabolomics can generate numerous structurally plausible annotations and candidate structures, but structural similarity alone does not establish whether a compound is consistent with the biosynthetic context represented by the detected metabolome. Integrating curated biochemical relationships with chemical similarity could therefore provide an additional, interpretable layer for candidate prioritization. Here, we present Biosynthetic Plausibility Mapper (BPM), an opensource cheminformatics application that maps user-provided plant metabolite annotations onto a locally constructed PlantCyc-derived knowledge base and explicitly distinguishes detected compounds, curated pathway context, and computationally prioritized candidates. BPM integrates chemical-identity reconciliation, curated reaction and pathway relationships, structural similarity, and global-context coherence into a decomposable candidate-ranking framework. In pathway-based benchmarking against hard structural decoys, BPM v3.1 achieved AUROC and AUPRC values of 1.000 and ranked the reference compound first in all 20 trials. items.authors: Lucas Jesus Patrício, Rômulo Pereira de Jesus, Ísis Tavares Vilas Boas, Fernanda Oliveira Chagas, Ricardo Moreira Borges

items.title: SimSJSAlert: A Similarity-Augmented Multi-View Learning Framework with Scaffold Alerts for Drug-Induced Stevens-Johnson Syndrome Risk Assessment
items.title_zh: SimSJSAlert：用于药物诱导Stevens-Johnson综合征风险评估的多视角学习框架
items.summary_zh: Stevens-Johnson综合征（SJS）是一种罕见且危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍然具有挑战性。本研究开发了一种可解释的定量结构-毒性关系（QSTR）框架，用于SJS预测，采用包含21种分子表征的多视角学习框架，包括分子描述符、指纹、基于变换器的嵌入和分子相似性表征。模型开发和评估遵循OECD QSAR验证原则，结合了骨架意识验证、对药物监测负信号化合物的外部评估，以及通过将SHAP与Bemis-Murcko骨架富集分析相结合进行结构解释。该框架在灵敏度和特异性方面表现稳健，分子相似性持续改善了SJS相关化合物的识别。此外，基于共识预测和骨架优先策略，从外部负信号数据集中识别出包括头孢氟噻吩、四环素和奥马西林在内的多种高风险药物，突显其与SJS的潜在关联，值得进一步的药物监测和实验研究。为便于实际应用，该框架已部署为免费访问的网络服务器SimSJSAlert。
items.abstract: Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) is a rare, life-threatening adverse drug reaction for which early identification of high-risk drugs remains challenging. In this study, we developed an explainable quantitative structure-toxicity relationship (QSTR) framework for SJS prediction using a multi-view learning framework with 21 molecular representations, including molecular descriptors, fingerprints, transformer-based embeddings, and a molecular similarity representation. Model development and evaluation were designed in accordance with the OECD principles for QSAR validation, incorporating scaffold-aware validation, external evaluation on pharmacovigilance negative-signal compounds, and structural interpretation by integrating SHAP with Bemis-Murcko scaffold enrichment analysis. The proposed framework achieved robust sensitivity and specificity, with molecular similarity consistently improving the identification of SJS-associated compounds. Furthermore, a consensus prediction and scaffold-based prioritization strategy identified several high-risk drugs from the 1 external negative-signal dataset, including cefprozil, tetracycline, and omadacycline, highlighting their potential association
items.authors: Huynh Anh Duy, Sastiya Kampaengsri, Supreeya Paiboon, Tarapong Srisongkram

items.title: Thermodynamics-Driven Treatability Investigation of Energy-Storage-Related Emerging PFAS
items.title_zh: 热力学驱动的能源存储相关新兴PFAS的可处理性研究
items.summary_zh: 双全氟烷基磺酰亚胺（bis-FASIs）广泛应用于锂离子电池电解液中，逐渐在环境中被检测到，但其转化和可处理性仍不清楚。本文结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与实验，探讨分子结构如何影响bis-FASIs的降解。在电化学氧化（EO）和紫外线/亚硫酸盐（UV/S）处理过程中，降解和去氟化通常随着全氟烷基链长度的增加而增加，其中双（三氟甲基磺酰）亚胺（bis-FMeSI）是最难降解的同系物。尽管这两种过程几乎完全转化了bis-FMeSI，但其氟的去向显著不同。EO几乎定量生成三氟甲烷磺酸盐（TFMS），而UV/S则生成TFMS和三氟甲烷磺酰胺（TfNH2）。Marcus理论计算确定了一电子转移的氧化还原阈值，电子结构分析显示氧化和还原生成不同的状态，遵循不同的键断裂路径。TFMS和TfNH2的进一步转化需要超出水相稳定窗口的氧化还原条件，导致其积累并限制去氟化。为克服这一限制，我们展示了一种跨介质的方法，将bis-FMeSI和TFMS从水中吸附。
items.abstract: Bis-perfluoroalkyl sulfonimides (bis-FASIs), widely used in lithium-ion battery electrolytes, are increasingly detected in the environment, yet their transformation and treatability remain poorly understood. Here, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were integrated with experiments to determine how molecular structure controls bis-FASIs degradation. During electrochemical oxidation (EO) and UV/sulfite (UV/S) treatment, degradation and defluorination generally increased with perfluoroalkyl-chain length, with bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide (bis-FMeSI) being the most recalcitrant homolog. Although both processes nearly completely transformed bis-FMeSI, its fluorine fate differed markedly. EO produced trifluoromethanesulfonate (TFMS) at nearly stoichiometric yield, whereas UV/S generated both TFMS and trifluoromethanesulfonamide (TfNH 2 ). Marcus-theory calculations established the redox thresholds for one-electron transfer, while electronic-structure analysis showed that oxidation and reduction generate distinct states that follow different bond-cleavage pathways. Further transformation of TFMS and TfNH 2 required redox conditions beyond those attainable within the aqueous
items.authors: Xiaotian Xu, Jinyuan Zhu, Yunqiao Guan, Yang Yang

items.title: From Rim to Core: Nitrile Coordination Creates an Electronic Gradient across Cu12 Nanocluster Nodes for CO2-to-Formate Electrosynthesis
items.title_zh: 从边缘到核心：腈配位在Cu12纳米簇节点上形成电子梯度用于CO2还原合成
items.summary_zh: 原子精确的铜纳米簇为在单个金属位置上编程催化提供了机会，但网络化主要用于稳定簇而非电子差异化。本文中，腈配位将Cu12S9纳米簇节点转变为Cu12TPN MOF中的径向极化催化集合体。单晶分析揭示了一种硫醇支持的Cu12结构，其四个对苯二腈连接体选择性地作用于外围铜位点。Bader分析显示，从电子缺乏的腈结合边缘位点（约+0.57 |e|）到电子丰富的Cu–S/Cu内部（约+0.32–0.37 |e|）存在电子梯度。这种配位编码的不对称性直接转化为CO2还原，HCOOH的法拉第效率达到63.32%，且CO生成量极少。密度泛函理论表明，在路径分叉处，O结合的*OCOH相较于*COOH具有0.91 eV的能量优势，而氢吸附仍不利。电解后光谱确认了簇衍生环境的持久性。这些结果确立了网络化作为原子精确纳米簇节点内的电子编程策略。
items.abstract: Atomically precise copper nanoclusters offer an opportunity to program catalysis across individual metal positions, yet reticulation has largely been used to stabilize clusters rather than differentiate them electronically. Here, nitrile coordination converts a Cu12S9 nanocluster node into a radially polarized catalytic ensemble in Cu12TPN MOF. Single-crystal analysis resolves a thiolate-supported Cu12 architecture whose four terephthalonitrile linkers selectively address peripheral Cu sites. Bader analysis reveals an electronic gradient from electron-deficient nitrile-bound rim sites (~+0.57 |e|) to an electron-rich Cu–S/Cu interior (~+0.32–0.37 |e|). This coordination-encoded asymmetry translates directly into CO2 reduction, delivering 63.32% Faradaic efficiency for HCOOH with negligible CO formation. Density functional theory identifies a 0.91 eV energetic separation favoring O-bound *OCOH over *COOH at the pathway bifurcation, while H adsorption remains unfavorable. Post-electrolysis spectroscopy confirms persistence of the cluster-derived environment. These results establish reticulation as an electronic programming strategy within, rather than merely around, atomically precis
items.authors: Sreelakshmi, Tsukasa Irie, Tokuhisa Kawawaki, Milan Kumar Jena, Saikat Das, Yuichi Negishi

items.title: Chemical synthesis of an atomically precise 2.5-MDa protein capsid and its mirror image
items.title_zh: 化学合成原子精确的2.5-MDa蛋白质衣壳及其镜像
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质衣壳在生物功能中发挥广泛作用，并可作为递送载体、纳米反应器、生物传感器和疫苗进行工程化。然而，由于构成这些衣壳的蛋白质构件必须在生物系统中表达，其组成主要限于典型氨基酸，限制了功能性。本文展示了细菌噬菌体Qβ的14.1-kDa外壳蛋白的完整化学合成及其组装成180亚基的2.5-MDa衣壳。我们利用全合成提供的扩展化学工具，生产完全由非天然D-氨基酸组成的镜像衣壳。通过冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）确定L-和D-衣壳的结构，分辨率达到3-Å，并通过冷冻电子断层成像（cryo-ET）验证其立体化学。D-衣壳在小鼠中诱导的抗体滴度比L-衣壳低100倍，且D-衣壳反应以IgM抗体为主。我们展示了使用合成的L-和D-衣壳递送编码荧光素酶的mRNA的功能性体内递送。我们的研究结合生物自组装与化学合成，为生产新型可编程纳米材料开辟了途径。
items.abstract: Protein capsids perform a broad range of biological functions 1–4 and can be engineered 5 as delivery vehicles, 6 nanoreactors, 7 biosensors, 8 and vaccines. 9 However, because the protein building blocks that make up these capsids must be expressed in biological systems, their composition is largely restricted to the canonical amino acids, limiting functionality. Assembling capsids from chemically synthesized proteins could circumvent this limitation but has not been accomplished due to a combination of technical challenges. Here we demonstrate the complete chemical synthesis of the 14.1-kDa coat protein of bacteriophage Qβ and its assembly into 180-subunit 2.5-MDa capsids. We exploit the expanded chemical palette afforded by total synthesis to produce mirror-image capsids composed entirely of unnatural D-amino acids. We determine the structures of the L- and D-capsids to 3-Å resolution by cryo-EM and verify their stereochemistry by cryo-ET. D-capsids elicit antibody titers 100-fold lower than their L-counterparts in mice, with the D-capsid response dominated by IgM antibodies. We demonstrate functional delivery in vivo using synthetic L-and D-capsids loaded with luciferase-encodi
items.authors: Alexander Harjung, Chih-Chin Chi, Chuxuan Ling, Mariusz Matyszewski, Nino Makasarashvili, Lisa Kain

items.title: Nickel-Catalyzed Formal [3+2+2] Cycloadditions of Bis(trimethylsilyl)cyclopropanone withDiynes: A Concise Approach to Functionalized Azulene Derivatives
items.title_zh: 镍催化的双(trimethylsilyl)环丙酮与二炔的[3+2+2]环加成反应研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种新的合成方法，通过正式的[3+2+2]环加成反应，将1,6-二炔与顺式-2,3-双(trimethylsilyl)环丙酮结合，合成功能化的蓝烯衍生物。该反应有效构建了蓝烯框架，并在单一步骤中引入了合成多样的功能团。在转化过程中观察到一种不寻常的重排过程，符合从蓝烯框架C7位到C6位的正式[1,7]-硅迁移。该方法的合成实用性通过将得到的硅化蓝烯衍生物进一步转化为多种功能化蓝烯得以验证。本研究为构建和功能化蓝烯骨架提供了新策略，并为环丙酮衍生中间体的反应性提供了新见解。
items.abstract: consequently, developing efficient methods for their preparation is important. Herein, we report the development of formal [3+2+2] cycloaddition chemistry involving 1,6-diynes and cis-2,3-bis(trimethylsilyl)cyclopropanone as a new synthetic approach to functionalized azulene derivatives. The azulene framework is efficiently constructed using the developed reaction, with synthetically versatile functional groups introduced in a single operation. An unusual rearrangement process consistent with a formal [1,7]-silyl migration from the C7 to C6 position of the azulene framework was observed during the course of the transformation. The synthetic utility of the method was demonstrated by further transforming the resulting silylated azulene derivatives into a variety of 1functionalized azulenes. This study provides a new strategy for constructing and functionalizing azulene skeletons as well as new insight into the reactivities of cyclopropanone-derived intermediates.
items.authors: Yuki Sato, Sayaka Ohrui, Masanori Tayu, Satoshi Yagi, Mutsuki Kato, Kuniyoshi Miki

items.title: The CO₂ Concentration Inversion Effect: *CO Generation Rate and *CO C–C Coupling Efficiency as Dual Kinetic Descriptors for Catalyst-Dependent C₂₊ Selectivity in Dilute CO₂ Electroreduction¹
items.title_zh: CO₂浓度反转效应：*CO生成速率与*CO C-C耦合效率对C₂₊选择性的影响
items.summary_zh: 稀释CO₂（5–33% v/v）电化学还原为多碳（C₂₊）产品提供了一种可持续的直接利用工业废气的途径，避免了能量密集型的CO₂捕集和净化。我们的系统研究显示，在稀释CO₂进料下，铜基催化剂的C₂₊选择性不仅与纯CO₂基线相匹配，甚至可以超越。我们定义了CO₂浓度反转效应：在稀释CO₂进料下，FE(C₂₊)/FE(C₁)比率在相同电位下超过纯CO₂。这种非单调选择性表明，C₂₊的形成受催化剂可调节的*CO供给与耦合动力学之间的平衡控制。我们引入了两个定量动力学描述符：*CO生成速率和*CO的C-C耦合效率，二者共同决定*CO中间体的命运。研究表明，C₂₊选择性由*CO生成速率和*CO C-C耦合效率协同控制。
items.abstract: The electrochemical reduction of dilute CO₂ (5–33% v/v) to multicarbon (C₂₊) products offers a sustainable route to directly utilize industrial exhaust, bypassing energy-intensive CO₂ capture and purification. Our systematic investigations from 2023 to 2026 reveal a counter-intuitive paradigm: under dilute CO2 feed ranging (e.g. from 25% to pure CO2), the C2+ selectivity of copper-based catalysts not only matches but can surpass the pure CO2 baseline. Here, we define the CO₂ Concentration Inversion Effect: a kinetic regime where the FE(C₂₊)/FE(C₁) ratio under dilute CO₂ feed exceeds that under pure CO₂ at identical potentials. This non-monotonic selectivity demonstrates that C₂₊ formation is governed by a catalyst-tunable balance between *CO supply and coupling kinetics. Critically, we introduce two quantitative kinetic descriptors that jointly govern the fate of *CO intermediates: the *CO production rate (the total flux of *CO supplied to the surface) and the C-C coupling efficiency of *CO (the fraction of that *CO consumed by C-C coupling). While the definitions of these descriptors are general, their joint systematic quantification and mechanistic application as a dual-descripto
items.authors: Qing Yu, Ying Zhang, Peng Zhu, Qiankang Zhang

items.title: A substrate-first-enzymology deep-learning framework for transforming new-to-nature chemicals
items.title_zh: 基于底物优先的酶学深度学习框架用于新型化学物质转化
items.summary_zh: 酶活性数据倾向于熟悉的底物和积极结果，导致生存偏差，限制了对新型化学的预测。本文提出底物优先酶学：设计化学多样的底物阵列，以拓宽预定义的合成相关化学空间的覆盖范围，而不依赖于预期活性。系统评估醇脱氢酶（ADHs）与该阵列的相互作用，使用统一的高通量测定。酶-底物矩阵记录活性标签和转化频率（k cat）值；底物解析的特征形成ADH k cat图谱。基于这些数据训练的深度学习模型能够分类活性并预测活跃对的k cat。该模型在匹配的训练和评估条件下优于现有方法，并前瞻性地优先考虑来自代表性不足的化学空间的活性底物。模型的注意机制突出底物反应中心和催化相关残基。通过在测量前设计底物覆盖并保留正负结果，该框架减少了历史采样偏差，并支持超越历史采样化学的可解释k cat预测。
items.abstract: Enzyme activity data favor familiar substrates and positive outcomes, creating survivorship bias that limits predictions for new-to-nature chemistry. Here we introduce substrate-first enzymology: a chemically diverse substrate array is designed to broaden coverage of a predefined, synthetically relevant chemical space, independently of expected activity. Alcohol dehydrogenases (ADHs) are systematically assayed against this array using a unified high-throughput assay. The enzyme–substrate matrix records activity labels and turnover frequency ( k cat ) values; substrate-resolved profiles form an ADH k cat atlas. A deep learning model trained on these data classifies activity and predicts k cat for active pairs. The model outperforms existing approaches under matched training and evaluation conditions and prospectively prioritizes active substrates from underrepresented chemical space. Without binding-pocket annotations, the model’s attention mechanism highlights substrate reactive centers and catalytically relevant residues. By designing substrate coverage before measurement and retaining both positive and negative outcomes, this framework reduces historical sampling bias and support
items.authors: You-Xue Zhao, Hao-Yue Wang, Luo-Bing Meng, Yu-Xin Jia, Xi-Ruo Li, Jia-Ming Yang

items.title: Machine-learning force-field scoring rivals free-energy perturbation for congeneric ligand ranking across public benchmarks
items.title_zh: 机器学习力场评分在同类配体排名中的表现超越自由能扰动法
items.summary_zh: 相对结合自由能（RBFE）方法如自由能扰动（FEP）在基于结构的药物设计中设定了同类配体排名的准确性标准，但其计算成本限制了通量。机器学习力场（MLFF）现已以较低成本接近量子化学的准确性，提出了能否在保持计算效率的同时恢复RBFE排名准确性的问题。我们引入了一种称为taqo的静态评分方法，并对10种跨越6个模型家族（UMA、MACE、Orb、eSEN、AIMNet2、AllScAIP）的MLFF变体进行基准测试，结合经典分子力学力场，在22个基准系统上进行实验对比。结果显示，十种MLFF在样本量下无法相互区分，但均显著优于经典力场参考，单个配体计算时间为几秒。与已发布的OpenFE和FEP+结果相比，taqo在相同系统和配体集上统计上与OpenFE无显著差异，且显著低于FEP+，成本约低三个数量级。在同类JACS子集上，taqo与FEP+统计上无显著差异。在相同基准姿势下，taqo的表现优于经典对接评分，并与深度学习评分统计上无显著差异。
items.abstract: Relative binding free-energy (RBFE) methods such as free-energy perturbation (FEP) set the accuracy standard for ranking congeneric ligands in structurebased drug design, but their computational cost limits throughput. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) now approach quantum-chemical accuracy at a small fraction of that cost, raising the question of whether they can recover much of RBFE’s ranking accuracy while remaining computationally efficient. We introduce a static-score methodology called taqo and benchmark 10 MLFF variants spanning 6 model families (UMA, MACE, Orb, eSEN, AIMNet2, AllScAIP), together with a classical molecular-mechanics force field, on a uniform staticpocket protocol, correlated against experiment across 22 benchmark systems.We find that the ten MLFFs cannot be resolved from one another at this sample size, while every one of them significantly outranks the classical force field reference, at a few seconds per ligand on a single GPU. Against published OpenFE and FEP+ results on the same systems and the same ligand sets, taqo is statistically indistinguishable from OpenFE and significantly below FEP+, at roughly three orders of magnitude lower cost. On the con
items.authors: Kevin Ryczko, Sarah Maier, Amogh Sood, Patrick Rowe, Harish Ramadas, Lorenzo Boninsegna

items.title: E3 ubiquitin ligase SYVN1 mediates K63-linked ubiquitination of DDX3X to activate Macrophage NLRP3 Inflammasome
items.title_zh: E3泛素连接酶SYVN1介导DDX3X的K63连接泛素化以激活巨噬细胞NLRP3炎症小体
items.summary_zh: DDX3X（DEAD框解旋酶3，X连锁）是应激颗粒和NLRP3炎症小体组装及激活的关键组成部分，但驱动DDX3X激活不同细胞通路的上游细胞应激信号尚不明确。我们发现E3泛素连接酶SYVN1（Synoviolin）在DDX3X的上游调控中发挥重要作用，从而控制NLRP3的激活和应激颗粒的组装。SYVN1在巨噬细胞中的沉默阻止了NLRP3驱动的炎症和应激颗粒形成。SYVN1缺失可防止LPS诱导的炎症性肺损伤，并提高小鼠的存活率。SYVN1维持DDX3X基因表达并促进DDX3X的刺激依赖性泛素化。在炎症条件下，SYVN1介导DDX3X的K63连接泛素化，这是NLRP3炎症小体激活的必要条件。相反，应激条件下K63连接的DDX3X泛素化减少，与去泛素化酶OTUB1的活性相关。因此，SYVN1与OTUB1之间的平衡优化了DDX3X的活性及NLRP3或应激颗粒的激活。这些发现表明SYVN1-OTUB1轴在整合细胞应激信号以决定细胞命运中的上游作用，并提示DDX3X的泛素化是潜在的治疗靶点。
items.abstract: DDX3X (DEAD box helicase 3, X linked) is a common and essential component for both stress granules and NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and their activation; however, the upstream cellular stress signals driving DDX3X to activate the contrasting cellular pathway remain unclear. We identified the pivotal role of the E3 ubiquitin ligase SYVN1(Synoviolin) as the upstream regulator of DDX3X and thereby controlling NLRP3 activation and stress granule assembly. We observed SYVN1 silencing in macrophages prevented both NLRP3 driven inflammation and stress granule formation. SYVN1 deficiency prevented LPS induced inflammatory lung injury and increased the survival rate of the mice. SYVN1 sustains DDX3X gene expression and promotes stimulus-dependent ubiquitination of DDX3X. Under inflammatory conditions, SYVN1 mediated 63 linked ubiquitination of DDX3X, a requirement for NLRP3 inflammasome activation. Conversely, stress conditions reduced K63 linked DDX3X ubiquitination in coordination with activity of the deubiquitinase OTUB1 (OTU domain-containing ubiquitin aldehyde-binding protein 1). Thus, the balance between SYVN1 and OTUB1 functioned to optimize DDX3X activity and activation of NLRP3 or s
items.authors: ANAS, M.; Singh, A.; Prasad, N. R.; Thompson, J. W.; Tiruppathi, C.; Malik, A. B.

items.title: Convergent genetic evolution within Burkholderia multivorans chronic infections correlates with lung function decline in cystic fibrosis patients
items.title_zh: Burkholderia multivorans慢性感染的趋同遗传进化与囊性纤维化患者肺功能下降相关
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了从8名囊性纤维化（CF）患者的慢性气道感染中分离出的7种不同的Burkholderia multivorans菌株的进化过程，时间跨度为7至17年。尽管起源不同，各感染群体遵循了相似的系统发育模式，表现为早期多样化后出现主导谱系。这些流行谱系的关键突变影响了相同的全局调控因子，导致临床显著的细菌表型变化。突变基因涉及脂质代谢、免疫逃逸、抗生素耐药、生物膜生成及在缺氧条件下的生存。最重要的是，感染中主导谱系的出现所传递的系统发育信号，与患者肺功能的快速下降密切相关。这些发现强调了结合不同物种慢性感染研究的重要性。
items.abstract: The patterns and pathways of pathogen adaptation during chronic infections can reveal the gateways microbes must unlock to colonize and persist. In chronic lung infections of cystic fibrosis (CF) patients, a longtime goal has been to anticipate disease outcome and to improve treatment. Understanding of these processes for Burkholderia multivorans, the most prevalent CF pathogen of the Burkholderia cepacia complex, is limited. We investigate the evolution of seven different strains recovered from chronic airway infections of eight CF patients over 7-17 years. Despite divergent origins, each infecting population followed similar phylogenetic patterns of early diversification followed by the emergence of a dominant clade. The defining mutations of these prevalent lineages also affected the same set of global regulators, which altered clinically significant bacterial phenotypes in parallel directions. Mutated genes govern lipid metabolism, immune evasion, antibiotic resistance, biofilm production, and survival under oxygen limitation, and unite studies of chronic infections by different species of the B. cepacia complex. items.title: Heritability and rare variant contributions to Alzheimer disease in the Midwestern Amish
items.title_zh: 阿米什人群中阿尔茨海默病的遗传性及稀有变异贡献
items.summary_zh: 背景 阿尔茨海默病的遗传结构尚未完全理解。阿米什等创始人群体为识别影响该疾病的额外遗传变异提供了独特机会。方法 通过使用来自中西部阿米什社区的广泛家系和基因组数据，我们估计了阿尔茨海默病的家系遗传率和SNP基础遗传率。此外，进行了全基因组关联研究和基因基础稀有变异测试。结果 遗传率估计表明，常见变异在APOE-{varepsilon}4携带者中解释了大部分遗传风险，而在非携带者中仍存在未解释的遗传率。GWAS确认APOE-{varepsilon}4是阿米什人中阿尔茨海默病最强的遗传决定因素。稀有变异分析发现RIN3和PILRA与认知障碍风险显著相关，同时也识别出CYP24A1等提示信号。讨论 这些发现强调了常见和稀有变异对阿尔茨海默病的贡献，并建议除了常见变异外，其他因素可能在APOE-{varepsilon}4非携带者中影响疾病易感性。
items.abstract: Background The genetic architecture of Alzheimer disease remains incompletely understood. Founder populations such as the Amish offer a unique opportunity to identify additional genetic variation influencing the disease. Method Using extensive pedigree and genomic data from Midwestern Amish communities, we estimated both pedigree- and SNP- based heritability of AD. In addition, genome-wide association studies and gene-based rare variant tests were performed. Results Heritability estimates suggested that common variants explain much of genetic risk among APOE-{varepsilon}4 carriers, while unexplained heritability remains in non-carriers in the Amish. GWAS confirmed APOE-{varepsilon}4 as the strongest genetic determinant of AD in the Amish. Rare variant analyses identified RIN3 and PILRA as significantly associated with risk of cognitive impairment; suggestive signals including CYP24A1 were also identified. Discussion These findings highlight the contributions of common and rare variants to Alzheimer disease and suggest factors beyond common variants may contribute to disease susceptibility particularly among the APOE-{varepsilon}4 non-carriers.

items.title: Use of Renal Duplex To Detect Renal Artery Stenosis in Fibromuscular Dysplasia
items.title_zh: 利用肾脏双谱超声检测纤维肌肉发育不良患者的肾动脉狭窄
items.summary_zh: 引言：双谱超声广泛用于评估肾动脉狭窄（RAS），但其诊断标准主要来源于动脉粥样硬化性RAS，可能不适用于纤维肌肉发育不良（FMD）。本研究评估了肾脏双谱参数与FMD患者中血流动力学显著的RAS之间的关联。方法：纳入在3个月内接受肾脏双谱超声和肾动脉造影的肾脏FMD患者。比较有无RAS的动脉的双谱参数（Pd/Pa 20 mm Hg或%狭窄>70%）。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估诊断性能。结果：纳入33名患者的55条肾动脉。RAS动脉的峰收缩期速度（PSV）、舒张末期速度（EDV）和加速时间（AT）均较高，阻力指数（RI）较低。肾动脉与主动脉比率（RAR）在组间无显著差异。PSV的最佳截断值为275 cm/sec，敏感性为79%，特异性为78%，曲线下面积（AUC）为0.81。加入其他参数未改善PSV的表现。经过血管成形术后，PSV、EDV和AT下降，RI上升，RAR保持不变。结论：在肾脏FMD中，双谱超声参数，特别是PSV，具有良好的诊断价值。
items.abstract: Introduction: Duplex ultrasonography is widely used to evaluate renal artery stenosis (RAS), but diagnostic criteria are largely derived from atherosclerotic RAS and may not apply to fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD). We evaluated associations between renal duplex parameters and hemodynamically significant RAS in patients with FMD. Methods: Patients with renal FMD who underwent renal duplex followed by renal artery angiography within 3 months were included. Duplex parameters were compared between arteries with and without RAS (Pd/Pa 20 mm Hg, or %stenosis >70%). Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was used to evaluate diagnostic performance. Changes following angioplasty were compared. Results: 55 renal arteries from 33 patients with renal FMD were included. Peak systolic velocity (PSV), end diastolic velocity (EDV), and acceleration time (AT) were higher in arteries with RAS. Resistive index (RI) was lower in RAS. Renal aortic ratio (RAR) did not differ between groups. PSV demonstrated good discrimination with a cut-off of 275 cm/sec yielding 79% sensitivity, 78% specificity, and an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.81. items.title: Clofazimine pharmacokinetics in novel rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis regimens: an analysis of the endTB and endTB-Q trials
items.title_zh: 克洛法齐明在新型利福平耐药结核治疗中的药代动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：利福平耐药结核病在全球构成重大威胁。克洛法齐明被认为对构建有效的个体化多药治疗方案至关重要。我们的目标是描述克洛法齐明在新型联合治疗方案中的药代动力学特征，并识别与药物暴露变化相关的参与者特征。方法：从参与endTB和endTB-Q三期随机对照试验的成人和青少年中获取克洛法齐明药代动力学数据。采用非线性混合效应模型分析血浆浓度，以量化克洛法齐明暴露并探讨相关协变量的影响。结果：来自六个高负担国家的100名参与者提供了药代动力学数据。中位年龄为34岁，32%为女性，18%患有糖尿病，18%感染HIV。克洛法齐明血浆浓度最佳描述为二室药代动力学模型，具有一级吸收特征。与德拉曼尼联合使用及HIV共感染分别导致克洛法齐明生物利用度增加37%和减少20%。糖尿病与克洛法齐明生物利用度降低43%相关。
items.abstract: Introduction Rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis poses a significant threat worldwide. Clofazimine is considered important for the construction of effective individualized multidrug regimens to treat rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis. Our goal was to characterize clofazimine pharmacokinetics in novel combination treatment regimens and to identify participant characteristics associated with variations in drug exposure. Methods Clofazimine pharmacokinetic data were obtained from adults and adolescents enrolled in the PandrTB pharmacokinetic sub-study of the endTB and endTB-Q Phase 3 randomized controlled therapeutic trials for rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis. Plasma concentrations were analyzed using nonlinear mixed-effects modeling to quantify clofazimine exposure and explore the impact of relevant covariates. Results 100 participants from six countries with high burdens of rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis contributed pharmacokinetic data. Their median age was 34 years, 32% were female, 18% were living with diabetes mellitus, and 18% were living with HIV. items.title: TDP-43 dysfunction induces cryptic circular RNAs in ALS/FTD
items.title_zh: TDP-43功能失调诱导ALS/FTD中的隐秘环状RNA
items.summary_zh: TDP-43的核耗竭是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的特征性病理特征，导致广泛的RNA错误处理，包括隐秘外显子的形成。我们在多种人类神经细胞模型中识别出TDP-43作为环状RNA（circRNA）生物发生的调节因子，并显示其功能失调诱导隐秘环状RNA（c-circRNA）的新生形成。对尸检脑转录组数据的分析发现了一组特定于TDP-43病理的c-circRNA。此外，我们开发了基于滚环扩增的高灵敏度circRNA检测方法，能够以0.99的AUC区分人类中枢神经系统组织中的TDP-43病理。我们发现c-circRNA与隐秘线性剪接事件共存，揭示了导致疾病相关蛋白（如RPTOR和EHMT1）丧失的复杂RNA错误处理热点。值得注意的是，其中一个c-circRNA源自UNC13A，其隐秘外显子与ALS/FTD中的主要GWAS命中相关，并作为通过剪接切换ASO进行的治疗靶点。我们显示c-circUNC13A与线性隐秘转录本共同调控，抑制UNC13A隐秘外显子导致培养神经元和体内c-circUNC13A的减少，突显其潜在作用。
items.abstract: Nuclear depletion of TDP-43 is a defining pathological feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), leading to widespread RNA misprocessing, including the formation of cryptic exons. Here, we identified TDP-43 as a regulator of circular RNA (circRNA) biogenesis in multiple human neuronal cell models, and showed that its dysfunction induces the de novo formation of cryptic circular RNAs (c-circRNAs). Analysis of post-mortem brain transcriptomic data identified a subset of c-circRNAs which are specific for ALS and FTD cases with TDP-43 pathology. Further, we developed highly sensitive rolling-circle amplification-based circRNA detection assays that allow to distinguish TDP-43 pathology in human CNS tissues with a 0.99 AUC. We found that c-circRNAs can co-occur with cryptic linear splicing events, uncovering complex RNA misprocessing hotspots that induce loss of disease-relevant proteins, including RPTOR and EHMT1. Notably, one of these c-circRNAs originates from UNC13A, a gene whose cryptic exon has previously been linked to one of the major GWAS hits in ALS/FTD and that is being pursued as a therapeutic target through splice-switching ASOs.
