items.title: Associations of menopause hormone therapy with late-life cognition and brain health vary by formulation and APOEε4 presence
items.title_zh: 更年期激素疗法对认知和脑健康的影响因配方和APOEε4而异
items.summary_zh: 尽管经过数十年的研究，更年期激素疗法（MHT）对认知衰老的影响仍不明确。研究考虑了MHT类型的差异及个体差异对认知风险的影响。我们在一项包含8741名70岁以上女性的样本中，研究了APOEε4状态（阿尔茨海默病最强遗传预测因子）与MHT配方对神经认知结果的影响。结果显示，MHT与认知之间存在配方和领域特异性的关联，雌二醇基础的MHT对APOEε4携带者的益处高于结合马雌激素。对930名参与者的神经影像学分析显示，使用雌二醇基础MHT的APOEε4携带者在脑容量、皮层厚度和白质损伤方面表现出更有利的关联。这些结果重新定义了MHT的混合发现，并支持基于配方和遗传风险的更年期护理方法。
items.abstract: Implications of menopause hormone therapy (MHT) for cognitive aging remain unclear despite decades of research. Potential reasons include insufficient consideration of MHT type, despite notable pharmacokinetic differences across formulations, and limited attention to individual differences that may exacerbate cognitive risk. We examined neurocognitive outcomes as a function of APOE{epsilon}4 status, the strongest genetic predictor of Alzheimers disease, and MHT formulation in a sample of older (>70) females (N=8,741). Results suggest formulation- and domain-specific association between MHT and cognition, with evidence of estradiol-based MHT providing more benefits for APOE{epsilon}4 carriers relative to conjugated equine estrogens use. Neuroimaging analyses available for a subset of participants (N=930) revealed a consistent pattern of more favourable associations (higher volume, cortical thickness; less white matter damage) in APOE{epsilon}4 carriers taking estradiol-based MHT. These results reframe mixed MHT findings as an issue of exposure definition and support formulation- and genetic-risk-aware approaches to menopause care.
items.authors: Perovic, M.; Gravelsins, L.; Wood Alexander, M.; McGovern, A.; Murphy, K.; Rabin, J.; Galea, L. A. M.

items.title: Physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep in everyday life after childhood cancer: a report from the Swiss Childhood Cancer Survivor Study (SCCSS)-Activity
items.title_zh: 儿童癌症幸存者的日常身体活动、静态行为与睡眠研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：儿童癌症幸存者（CCS）面临慢性健康问题的高风险。充足的身体活动和睡眠，以及有限的静态行为可降低这些风险，但针对CCS的设备评估较少。本研究使用大腿佩戴的加速度计描述CCS的身体活动、静态行为和睡眠，并探讨相关因素。方法：纳入2024-2025年瑞士儿童癌症幸存者研究问卷波次的参与者，要求其连续佩戴activPAL4加速度计八天。通过ActiPASS分析身体活动类型和强度、静态行为及睡眠。结果：108名CCS（68名儿童，40名成人）参与。儿童每天中位数进行中到高强度身体活动85分钟，静态行为578分钟；成人分别为78分钟和603分钟。两组每天静态时间均为4-5小时。儿童每晚睡眠466分钟，成人435分钟。仅9%的儿童和20%的成人同时满足身体活动、静态行为和睡眠的推荐标准。放疗与儿童的身体活动减少及儿童和成人的静态时间增加相关。
items.abstract: Background: Childhood cancer survivors (CCS) are at elevated risk of chronic health conditions. Sufficient physical activity and sleep, and limited sedentary behavior mitigate those risks, but device-based assessments of these behaviors among CCS are scarce. We described physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep among CCS using thigh-worn accelerometers and examined associated factors. Methods: We included participants of the 2024-2025 Swiss Childhood Cancer Survivor Study questionnaire wave who consented to wear an activPAL4 accelerometer continuously for eight days. Using ActiPASS, we derived physical activity types and intensities, sedentary behavior, and sleep. We stratified analyses by age (children: 5-17 years; adults: [ ]18 years). Results: 108 CCS (68 children, 40 adults) pariticipated. Children accumulated a median of 85 minutes/day of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity [IQR 57-107] and 578 minutes/day sedentary behavior [516-625]; adults 78 [61-100] and 603 minutes/day [522-650]. items.authors: Nigg, C.; Zarkovic, M.; Mohr, D.; Schindera, C.; Kuehni, C. E.

items.title: Hierarchical Dimensionality Evolution of Ionic Transport in Superionic Copper Iodide
items.title_zh: 超离子铜碘化物中离子传输的层次维度演变
items.summary_zh: 超离子导体在刚性固体框架内表现出液态般的离子传输，这得益于动态子晶格解耦。在铜碘化物（CuI）中，快速的离子导电性通过结构转变重塑局部能量景观而出现，但相变过程中的扩散拓扑微观演变尚不充分理解。通过将机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）与晶格动力学相结合，我们阐明了CuI中温度依赖的离子传输机制。CuI中的超离子转变表现为传输维度的层次演变，依次从局部振动发展到一维通道传输、二维面内扩散，最终达到各向同性的三维迁移。这一层次演变由横向声子软化驱动，通过三角形闸调节机制调节迁移势垒，实现方向选择性的几何限制。
items.abstract: Superionic conductors exhibit liquid-like ion transport within a rigid solid framework enabled by dynamical sublattice decoupling. In copper iodide (CuI), fast ion conduction emerges through structural transitions that reshape the local energy landscape, yet the microscopic evolution of diffusion topology across phase transitions remains insufficiently understood. By integrating machine-learning Molecular Dynamics (MLMD) with lattice dynamics, we elucidate the temperature-dependent ionic transport mechanism in CuI. The superionic transition in CuI manifests as a hierarchical evolution of transport dimensionality, progressing sequentially from localized vibrations to 1D channel transport, 2D in-plane diffusion, and ultimately isotropic 3D migration. This hierarchical evolution is driven by transverse acoustic phonon softening, which modulates migration barriers through direction-selective geometric confinement via a triangular-gate regulation mechanism.
items.authors: Wenjie Yang, Jialin Liu, Fawei Tang, Zhaochuan Fan

items.title: MPID Polarizable Force Field: GPU Implementation and Biomolecular Simulations
items.title_zh: MPID极化力场：GPU实现与生物分子模拟
items.summary_zh: 多极子和诱导偶极子（MPID）模型通过永久原子多极子（最高至八极子）和点诱导偶极子提供了复杂的静电描述，但其高计算成本限制了其在生物分子模拟中的常规应用。本文展示了在OpenMM中对MPID模型的GPU加速实现，该实现产生的能量和力与CHARMM获得的结果完全一致，能够进行常规的微秒级分子动力学模拟。此外，力场参数直接从Drude振子模型转移到MPID框架，无需重新参数化，形成MPID-2019蛋白质力场。对五种蛋白质的测试表明，MPID-2019能够再现多种NMR可观测量，包括标量耦合和弛豫序参量。这些结果表明，MPID-2019是一个有效的极化力场，适用于蛋白质模拟，并且在生物分子层面上可以建立诱导偶极子与Drude振子形式的有效等价性。
items.abstract: The multipole and induced dipole (MPID) model provides a sophisticated description of electrostatics through permanent atomic multipoles up to the octopole level and point induced dipoles, but its high computational cost has limited its routine application to biomolecular simulations. Here, we present a GPU-accelerated implementation of the MPID model in OpenMM. The implementation produces energies and forces fully consistent with those obtained from CHARMM and enables routine microsecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations of explicitly solvated protein systems. Moreover, force field parameters were transferred directly from the Drude oscillator model to the MPID framework without reparameterization, yielding the MPID-2019 protein force field. Tests on five proteins show that MPID-2019 reproduces a range of NMR observables, including scalar couplings and relaxation order parameters. These results demonstrate that MPID-2019 is a valid polarizable force field readily applicable to protein simulations and that the effective equivalence of the induced dipole and Drude oscillator formalisms can be established at the biomolecular level.
items.authors: Qiaozhu Tan, Andrew C Simmonett, Bernard R. Brooks, Jing Huang

items.title: Identifying Putative Pathogenic Non-Coding Variants in Unresolved Rare Disease Patients Using Topologically Associated Domains
items.title_zh: 利用拓扑关联域识别未解罕见病患者的潜在致病非编码变异
items.summary_zh: 未解罕见病是全球约3亿人面临的重大公共卫生挑战，其中至少50%的患者在应用外显子测序和/或全基因组测序后仍未获得基因诊断。缺失诊断的一个来源是全基因组测序中检测到但未解释的非编码基因组中的稀有变异。为系统评估候选致病非编码变异，我们创建了未解罕见病变异基因组分析系统（GAVURD）。GAVURD利用三人全基因组测序比对数据，为特定患者生成潜在致病非编码变异的短名单。该系统采用最佳实践识别新生和稀有遗传变异，将变异与人类疾病基因关联，并根据表型重叠对变异进行优先排序。作为概念验证，我们将GAVURD应用于十名未解罕见病患者，基于支持致病性的证据，识别出六个潜在致病的非编码变异。GAVURD系统在优先排序未解罕见病的候选非编码致病变异方面发挥了重要作用，为后续功能研究提供了高价值的聚焦方向。
items.abstract: Unresolved rare disease is a major public health challenge affecting ~300 million people worldwide. At least 50% of these individuals remain genetically unresolved after applying exome sequencing and/or whole genome sequencing. One source of these missing diagnoses is the presence of rare variants within the non-coding genome that are detected but not interpreted by whole genome sequencing. In order to systematically evaluate candidate pathogenic non-coding variants, we created the Genomic Analysis of Variants in Unresolved Rare Disease (GAVURD) system. GAVURD leverages trio whole genome sequencing alignment data to produce a short list of putative pathogenic non-coding variants for a given proband. GAVURD uses best practices for de novo and rare inherited variant identification, links variants to human disease genes harnessing topologically associated domain (TAD) data, and rank prioritizes variants based on phenotypic overlap. As a proof-of-concept, we applied GAVURD to ten probands with unresolved rare disease and implicated six potentially causal non-coding variants based on a confluence of evidence supportive of pathogenicity. items.title: Peptidyl Protease Inhibitors Block ERM-BP Function and Suppress Entamoeba Encystation
items.title_zh: 肽酰蛋白酶抑制剂阻断ERM-BP功能并抑制变形虫囊泡形成
items.summary_zh: 变形虫囊泡形成是寄生虫持久性和疾病传播的重要发育过程，但其分子机制尚不清楚，成为治疗干预的潜在机会。囊泡形成调节基序结合蛋白（ERM-BP）作为转录因子和囊泡形成的关键调节因子，是抗阿米巴药物开发的有前景靶点。本研究采用靶向药物发现方法筛选能够阻断ERM-BP活性的分子，重点关注该蛋白的功能重要残基Cys-198。通过蛋白热转变分析（PTSA）筛选了包括广谱烟酰胺酶抑制剂和半胱氨酸反应性电离子在内的100种化合物。结果显示36种化合物与野生型ERM-BP结合，进一步分析C198A突变体将候选化合物缩小至三种表现出Cys-198依赖性相互作用的肽酰蛋白酶抑制剂。PFMK、LEK和EBLL三种化合物与ERM-BP-WT结合，并以浓度依赖方式消除ERM-BP的DNA结合活性。细胞评估进一步揭示了PFMK、LEK和EBLL的不同活性。
items.abstract: Entamoeba encystation process is a crucial developmental process that support to parasite persistence and disease transmission, yet the molecular mechanisms governing this stage conversion remain poorly understood and represent an attractive opportunity for therapeutic intervention. The Encystation Regulatory Motif-Binding Protein (ERM-BP), a transcription factor and key regulator of encystation, therefore represents a promising target for anti-amoebic drug development to prevent disease transmission. In the present study, we applied a target-based drug discovery approach to screen small molecules that can block the activity of ERM-BP, with a particular focus on the Cys-198 residue of this protein, which is functionally important. A library comprising 100 compounds including broad-spectrum nicotinamidase inhibitors and cysteine-reactive electrophiles were screened against ERM-BP by Protein thermal shift assays (PTSA). Thirty-six compounds bound to wild-type ERM-BP while analysis using the C198A mutant narrowed the candidates to three compounds exhibiting Cys-198-dependent interactions. items.title: Disease investigation in a New Zealand high-health pig herd reveals a divergent porcine adenovirus
items.title_zh: 新西兰高健康猪群中的疾病调查揭示一种分歧猪腺病毒
items.summary_zh: 猪腺病毒在家猪中普遍存在，通常被认为是低致病性的病毒，与轻微或亚临床感染相关。然而，它们的多样性、宿主关联及疾病潜力仍不甚了解。本研究调查了新西兰一群320头母猪的免疫学 naïve 高健康子宫切除猪群中的疾病暴发。该暴发表现为食欲减退、嗜睡、弥漫性皮肤红斑、新生仔猪死亡及木乃伊胎儿增加。对一头仔猪的组织进行组织病理学检查，发现内皮细胞内广泛存在核内包涵体，提示系统性病毒感染。对受影响仔猪及木乃伊胎儿的组织进行总RNA测序，元转录组分析在多个仔猪及流产胎儿组织中鉴定出丰富的腺病毒，并通过de novo组装获得了27,685个核苷酸的基因组。系统发育分析将该病毒归入Mastadenovirus属，但形成了一个与所有已表征的猪腺病毒明显不同的分支。尽管序列存在差异，基因组仍保留了Mastadenovirus的特征性结构。除了在仔猪的小肠和结肠中低丰度检测到的猪Kobu病毒外，未发现其他病毒病原体。
items.abstract: Porcine adenoviruses are common in domestic pigs and are generally regarded as low-pathogenicity viruses associated with mild or subclinical infections. However, their diversity, host associations and disease potential remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated a disease outbreak in an immunologically naive 320-sow high-health hysterectomy-derived pig herd in New Zealand. The outbreak was characterised by anorexia, lethargy, diffuse cutaneous erythema, death in neonatal piglets, and an increased occurrence of mummified fetuses. Histopathological examination of a piglet revealed widespread intranuclear inclusion bodies within endothelial cells, indicative of systemic viral infection. Total RNA sequencing was performed on tissues from an affected piglet and mummified fetuses. Metatranscriptomic analysis identified an abundant adenovirus in multiple piglet and aborted fetus tissues, and de novo assembly recovered a 27,685-nucleotide genome. Phylogenetic analysis placed the virus within the genus Mastadenovirus but it formed a divergent lineage distinct from all previously characterised porcine adenoviruses. items.title: Short-Term Changes in Dermal Density Following Topical Application of a Progerinin-Containing Serum: An Exploratory Clinical Study
items.title_zh: 局部应用含Progerinin血清后皮肤密度的短期变化研究
items.summary_zh: Progerin是异常处理的lamin A形式，主要与Hutchinson-Gilford早衰症相关，但在正常老化皮肤中也可检测到。Progerin的积累被认为可能导致皮肤稳态的衰退。本研究评估了含有Progerinin的小分子Progerin抑制剂的血清对皮肤参数的短期影响。21名年龄在30至50岁的女性参与了为期4周的单臂前瞻性研究，每晚一次涂抹测试血清。研究重点评估了皮肤的侧眼皱纹、面部提升、皮肤水分、弹性、真皮密度和亮度。结果显示，在基线、2周和4周后，真皮密度等皮肤参数有显著变化，表明Progerinin可能对皮肤老化具有潜在的积极影响。
items.abstract: Progerin, an aberrantly processed form of lamin A, is best known as the causative protein in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome but is also detectable at low levels in normally aging human skin. Accumulation of progerin has therefore been proposed as one of the cellular processes potentially contributing to age-associated deterioration of skin homeostasis. Previous experimental studies have shown that pharmacological targeting of progerin with Progerinin can ameliorate progerin-associated cellular abnormalities and tissue phenotypes, providing a biological rationale for exploring its potential relevance to skin aging. However, whether topical formulations incorporating a progerin-targeting compound can influence measurable features of human skin has not been clinically explored. In this exploratory study, we evaluated short-term changes in skin parameters following topical application of a serum containing Progerinin, a small-molecule progerin inhibitor, together with conventional skin-conditioning ingredients, with particular attention to dermal density. items.title: Machine Learning Approach to Identify Gut Microbiota Biomarkers in Patients with ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction Presenting Primary Ventricular Tachyarrhythmias
items.title_zh: 机器学习识别ST段抬高心肌梗死患者肠道微生物组生物标志物
items.summary_zh: 背景：在ST段抬高心肌梗死（STEMI）患者中，针对原发性室性心动过速/室颤（VT/VF）的风险分层仍然有限。我们旨在利用机器学习（ML）识别与STEMI中原发性VT/VF相关的肠道微生物组生物标志物及微生物代谢通路。方法：对33名STEMI患者（7例有原发性VT/VF，26例无VT/VF）的粪便样本进行全长16S rRNA测序，分为急性（7天内）和恢复（30-60天）阶段。通过整合分类特征的ML流程识别与原发性VT/VF相关的可重复特征。核心生物标志物定义为在单变量显著性（假发现率[FDR] <0.05）和多变量分类重要性上均表现出显著的分类特征。功能通路和酶通过PICRUSt2进行预测。结果：五种急性期分类群与原发性VT/VF显著相关：Clostridium aldenense、Enterocloster bolteae、细菌NLAE-zl-G101、Alistipes shahii和Roseburia sp.（均FDR <0.05）。经过特征减少的支持向量机模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.846（95%置信区间，0.676-0.984），敏感性为85.7%，特异性为76.9%。差异丰度分析显示Bacteroides fragilis、Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron和E. bolteae的富集。
items.abstract: Background Risk stratification for primary ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation (VT/VF) in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) remains limited. We aimed to identify gut microbiome biomarkers and microbial metabolic pathways associated with primary VT/VF in STEMI using machine learning (ML). Methods Stool samples from 33 STEMI patients (7 with primary VT/VF and 26 without VT/VF) underwent full-length 16S rRNA sequencing during the acute ([ ]7 days) and recovery (30?60 days) phases. An ML pipeline integrating taxonomic features identified reproducible features associated with primary VT/VF. Core biomarkers were defined as taxa demonstrating both univariate significance (false discovery rate [FDR] <0.05) and multivariate classification importance. Functional pathways and enzymes were predicted using PICRUSt2. Results Five acute-phase taxa were reproducibly associated with primary VT/VF: Clostridium aldenense, Enterocloster bolteae, bacterium NLAE-zl-G101, Alistipes shahii, and Roseburia sp. items.title: Community-based assessment of mpox seroprevalence and undocumented exposures in Manitoba and Alberta, Canada
items.title_zh: 加拿大曼尼托巴和阿尔伯塔省mpox血清流行率社区评估
items.summary_zh: 在2022年全球mpox疫情期间，男同性恋、双性恋及其他与男性发生性行为的男性（gbMSM）受到的影响尤为严重。然而，由于与mpox相关的污名，实际病例数可能高于报告数量。这种污名在政治保守地区（如加拿大草原地区）可能对寻求医疗的行为产生了更大影响。疫情流行病学的变化也可能导致疫情初期的误诊。为评估监测和人群免疫的差距，我们在2024年6月至2025年12月期间，对275名符合接种mpox疫苗条件的个体进行了横断面血清流行率研究。研究对象包括gbMSM、性别多样化个体和性工作者。使用Meso Scale Discovery Orthopoxvirus检测分析干血点。结果显示，14.5%的个体自报接种了mpox疫苗，而在未报告接种Orthopoxvirus疫苗的个体中，有5.9%对多种mpox抗原呈阳性反应。这表明曼尼托巴省可能存在未被检测的mpox传播。
items.abstract: During the 2022 global mpox outbreak, gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (gbMSM) were disproportionately affected,s however, the true number of cases is likely higher than reported due in part to the stigma associated with mpox. This stigma may have played an even more influential role on health-seeking behaviour in politically conservative regions, such as the Canadian Prairies. The shifting epidemiology may have also led to misdiagnoses during initial months of the outbreaks. Seroprevalence studies can help assess these gaps in surveillance and population-level immunity. This eligibility included, but was not exclusively limited to, gbMSM, gender diverse individuals, and sex workers. Dried blood spots were analyzed using the Meso Scale Discovery Orthopoxvirus assay targeting five orthologous mpox and vaccinia virus antigens. items.title: Loss of TDP-43 function drives cryptic circular RNAs in neurodegenerative diseases
items.title_zh: TDP-43功能丧失驱动神经退行性疾病中的隐性环状RNA
items.summary_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞痴呆（FTD）的关键病理标志，也是RNA剪接的重要调节因子。尽管TDP-43的缺失会导致线性转录本的异常剪接，但其对环状RNA（circRNA）生物发生的影响尚未探讨。本研究显示，在人类神经元中，TDP-43缺失会引发广泛的circRNA变化，特别是特定类型的隐性circRNA的上调，这些circRNA在TDP-43缺失时特异性产生。这些隐性circRNA包含源自内含子序列的隐性外显子。值得注意的是，这些隐性circRNA比其对应的线性RNA亚型更稳定，并在神经元中逐渐积累。此外，ALS、FTD和阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者的尸检脑组织中隐性circRNA水平升高。这些发现揭示了TDP-43在抑制隐性circRNA形成中的新角色，并将这些circRNA确立为TDP-43功能失调的稳定分子标志。
items.abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a key pathological hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and a critical regulator of RNA splicing. While loss of TDP-43 induces aberrant splicing in linear transcripts, its impact on circular RNA (circRNA) biogenesis remains unexplored. Here, we show that TDP-43 depletion in human neurons induces widespread circRNA changes, especially upregulation of a distinct class of cryptic circRNAs that arise specifically upon loss of TDP-43. Some of these cryptic circRNAs incorporate cryptic exons derived from intronic sequences. Notably, these cryptic circRNAs exhibit greater stability than their corresponding linear RNA isoforms and accumulate progressively in neurons. Moreover, cryptic circRNAs are elevated in postmortem brain tissues from ALS, FTD and Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for TDP-43 in repressing cryptic circRNA formation and establish these circRNAs as stable molecular signatures of TDP-43 dysfunction.

items.title: Impact of mass oral cholera vaccination in an endemic area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a surveillance-based counterfactual modeling analysis
items.title_zh: 刚果民主共和国霍乱疫苗接种的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：口服霍乱疫苗（OCVs）是霍乱控制的重要组成部分，尤其在霍乱流行地区。然而，关于其对人群影响的证据有限，尤其是在非洲。本文估算了在刚果民主共和国乌维拉市大规模接种OCVs的影响。方法：我们在2017年1月至2023年12月期间，在乌维拉的两个官方霍乱治疗设施进行增强监测，围绕2020年实现66%接种覆盖率的疫苗接种活动。我们结合系统的快速诊断病例检测与多次代表性人群调查，评估医疗寻求行为、疫苗接种、人口流动和抗体状况，以估算血清发生率。我们开发了一个贝叶斯框架，将这些数据整合到考虑时间变化传染性、免疫动态和接种覆盖率损失的霍乱传播模型中。结果：我们估计2020年的大规模接种在随后的三年内避免了56%（95%可信区间：34-81）的感染和死亡，约相当于2,350例。
items.abstract: Abstract Background Oral cholera vaccines (OCVs) are a key component of cholera control recommended in cholera-endemic areas. Yet evidence of their population-level impact is limited, especially in Africa where most cholera deaths occur. Here, we estimate the impact of mass administration of OCVs in the cholera-endemic city of Uvira, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Methods We conducted enhanced cholera surveillance at the two official cholera treatment facilities in Uvira between Jan 2017 and Dec 2023, centered around a mass vaccination campaign that achieved 66% coverage with at least one dose of Euvichol Plus vaccine in 2020. We combined systematic rapid diagnostic case testing with repeated, representative population surveys capturing healthcare-seeking behavior, vaccination, population mobility, and antibody profiles to estimate seroincidence. We developed a Bayesian framework that integrates these data into an ensemble of mechanistic cholera transmission models that account for time-varying transmissibility, realistic immunity dynamics and loss of vaccination coverage to population turnover. items.title: Developing an SNR-efficient tensor-valued diffusion encoding protocol for studying brain microstructural changes in neurodegeneration
items.title_zh: 开发高效SNR的张量值扩散编码协议研究脑微结构变化
items.summary_zh: 张量值扩散编码（TDE）是一种新兴的扩散MRI技术，通过先进的扩散编码波形和建模，提供比传统Stejskal-Tanner脉冲梯度编码更高的脑微结构特异性。然而，TDE所需的扩散编码时间显著增加，导致相对较低的信噪比（SNR）和空间分辨率（>2 mm各向同性）。本研究开发了一种SNR高效、分辨率为1.8 mm各向同性的TDE协议，并评估其在年龄相关微结构差异中的重现性和敏感性。研究对象包括11名认知正常的老年人（5F/6M，62-71岁）和7名年轻人（3F/4M，22-31岁），在3T下使用自制的TDE序列进行扫描，结合了SNR高效的多带多次EPI读出和重建。评估了双侧扣带束（CBT）、双侧穹窿（FX）和全脑白质（WM）的定量扩散指标，包括平均扩散率（MD）、分数各向异性（FA）、微观FA（FA）、各向异性平均峰度（MKA）、各向同性平均峰度（MKI）和总平均峰度（MKT）。老年参与者进行了两次扫描，以使用组内相关系数（ICC）和Bland-Altman分析评估重现性。
items.abstract: Tensor-valued diffusion encoding (TDE) is an emerging diffusion MRI technique that uses advanced diffusion-encoding waveforms and modeling to provide enhanced specificity to brain microstructure compared with conventional Stejskal-Tanner pulsed-gradient encoding. However, the diffusion encoding duration to achieve the same b-value is substantially increased in TDE, resulting in relatively low SNR and spatial resolution (>2 mm isotropic). In this study, we developed an SNR-efficient, high-resolution TDE protocol with 1.8-mm isotropic resolution and clinically feasible scan time and evaluated its reproducibility and sensitivity to age-related microstructural differences. Eleven cognitively normal older adults (5F/6M, 62-71 years) and seven younger adults (3F/4M, 22-31 years) were scanned at 3T using an in-house TDE sequence incorporating an SNR-efficient multi-band multi-shot EPI readout and reconstruction. items.title: Computational investigation of the first most (𝝅; 𝝅∗)𝟏; (𝒏; 𝝅∗)𝟏;(𝝅; 𝝈∗)𝟏 and (𝒏; 𝝈∗)𝟏 electronic states of all possible positional isomers of iodinated BODIPY
items.title_zh: 计算研究碘化BODIPY所有可能位置异构体的电子态
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了碘化BODIPY所有可能位置异构体的光化学特性，采用先进的两组分相对论sf-X2C-S-TD-DFT-SOC方法。计算了最有前景的电子态的垂直激发能、振荡强度和自旋-轨道耦合。详细解释了附加碘原子的数量及其拓扑结构对垂直激发能的影响。有效运用了Slater-Condon规则和El-Sayed规则来解释不同多重态之间的自旋-轨道耦合强度。通过涉及的轨道解释了与传统El-Sayed规则不符的耦合态现象。还讨论了BODIPY环的非平面性对不同多重态之间自旋-轨道耦合强度的影响。研究了在BODIPY结构上附加碘原子以转变为有效光敏剂的最佳位置。
items.abstract: Photochemistry of all possible positional isomers of iodinated -BODIPY has been explored employing state of the art two-component relativistic sf-X2C-S-TD-DFT-SOC method. Vertical excitation energies; oscillator strength and spin–orbit couplings of first most promising electronic states have been computed. Effect of number of iodine atoms attached to BODIPY moiety and their topology on magnitude of vertical excitation energies have been explained in detail. Slater–Condon rules and El–Sayed rules which are special case of former have been effectively employed to explain magnitude of spin–orbit couplings between states of different multiplicities. Coupled states exhibiting anomalies from conventional El–Sayed rules have been explained with the help of orbitals involved in respective states. Effect of non-planarity of BODIPY ring on magnitude of spin–orbit couplings between states of different multiplicities have also been discussed. Most effective positions on BODIPY moiety that can turn in to effective photosensitizer by attaching iodine atoms on them has been explored and explained.
items.authors: Maria Hasan, Jakub Višňák, Tashfeen Akhtar, Mirza Wasif Baig

items.title: Preclinical and Pilot Human Evaluation of [18F]NIDF-1, an N-Protonation-Guided Tau PET Tracer
items.title_zh: N-质子化引导的Tau PET示踪剂[18F]NIDF-1的前临床与初步人类评估
items.summary_zh: 超磷酸化的tau聚集物是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的病理特征，且是正电子发射断层扫描（PET）成像的重要靶点。我们设计并合成了一系列聚焦的氮杂吲哚衍生物，NIDF-1被确定为领先化合物，其在AD脑组织切片上的竞争自显影显示IC50为22.1 ± 6.8 nM。NIDF-1对淀粉样β（Aβ）交叉反应性低，对单胺氧化酶（MAO）有限的脱靶作用。[18F]NIDF-1在啮齿动物中表现出良好的脑动力学，小鼠的初始脑摄取为7.57% ID/g，斯普拉格-道利（SD）大鼠的峰值脑均值标准摄取值（SUVmean）为2.20，随后快速清除（2至60分钟的脑摄取比率分别为18.46和3.30）。自显影确认其优先结合AD相关的tau病理。在一项初步人类PET研究中，[18F]NIDF-1在AD参与者的皮层保留高于健康对照。这些发现表明[18F]NIDF-1是一种有前景的tau PET示踪剂，具有良好的tau结合亲和力、脑动力学及令人鼓舞的初步人类成像结果，同时支持N-质子化作为tau靶向成像剂的有用设计考虑。
items.abstract: Hyperphosphorylated tau aggregates are a pathological hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and an important target for positron emission tomography (PET) imaging. Guided by the hypothesis that N-protonation enables electrostatic interactions with negatively charged sites associated with tau hyperphosphorylation, we designed and synthesized a focused series of azaindole derivatives and identified NIDF-1 as a lead compound by competitive autoradiography on AD brain sections (IC50 = 22.1 ± 6.8 nM). NIDF-1 showed low amyloid-β (Aβ) cross-reactivity and limited off-target toward monoamine oxidases (MAO). [18F]NIDF-1 exhibited favorable brain kinetics in rodents, with an initial brain uptake of 7.57% ID/g in mice and a peak brain mean standardized uptake value (SUVmean) of 2.20 in Sprague–Dawley (SD) rats, followed by rapid clearance (2-to-60-min brain uptake ratios of 18.46 and 3.30, respectively). Autoradiography confirmed preferential binding to ADassociated tau pathology. In a pilot human PET study, [18F]NIDF-1 showed higher cortical retention in an AD participant than in a healthy control. items.title: In-Situ and Label-Free Quantification of BSA Adsorption on Mesoporous Silica Nanoparticles via Orthogonal Analysis in Analytical Ultracentrifugation
items.title_zh: 原位无标记定量测定BSA在介孔二氧化硅纳米粒子上的吸附
items.summary_zh: 理解生物-纳米界面需要精确的原位无标记工具来表征蛋白质冠层。尽管动态光散射（DLS）和纳米粒子追踪分析（NTA）等流体动力学技术被广泛应用，但它们存在固有局限：DLS提供的是整体平均信号，且常需特定光学模型，而NTA的时间分辨率限制了其对超小颗粒的准确性。本研究展示了定制的多波长分析超离心法（MWL-AUC）作为一种优越的正交平台，用于表征介孔二氧化硅纳米粒子上的牛血清白蛋白（BSA）冠层。通过整合原位上清液耗竭、基于密度的沉降分析和多波长光谱解耦三种独立分析维度，我们实现了对总吸附BSA及其空间分布的精确定量。这一方法使得蛋白质定位的定量映射超越了单纯的聚集定性观察。具体而言，我们展示了光谱解耦提供的组成信息为有效密度分析提供了强有力的交叉验证，从而根本上决定了推导空间分布的精确性。本研究建立了一个自验证框架，用于精确表征蛋白质。
items.abstract: Understanding the bio–nano interface requires precise, in-situ and label-free tools to characterize the protein corona. While hydrodynamic techniques like dynamic light scattering (DLS) and nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA) are widely used, they face inherent limitations: DLS provides ensemble-averaged signals and often requires specific optical models, whereas NTA’s temporal resolution limits its accuracy for ultra-small particles. Here, we demonstrate the power of custom-built multiwavelength analytical ultracentrifugation (MWL-AUC) as a superior orthogonal platform to characterize the bovine serum albumin (BSA) corona on mesoporous silica nanoparticles (MSNs). By integrating three independent analytical dimensions, i.e. in-situ supernatant depletion, density-based sedimentation analysis, and multiwavelength spectral decoupling, we achieved precise quantification of both the total adsorbed BSA and its spatial distribution. This approach enables a quantitative mapping of protein localization that transcends mere qualitative observations of aggregation. items.authors: Chao Zhang, Mengdi Chen, Bingwen Hu, E Wu

items.title: MaRs: A Universal Python Library for Steady-State and Time-Resolved EPR Simulations
items.title_zh: MaRs：通用的稳态与时间分辨EPR模拟Python库
items.summary_zh: MaRs是一个开源Python库，用于电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱的模拟与拟合。该库支持场扫和频扫连续波EPR的模拟，考虑了各种自旋亚能级的极化。此外，MaRs能够模拟完整的二维时间分辨EPR光谱（在场-时间域内），并可在不同的理论复杂度下进行计算。时间演化可以通过描述种群转移的动力学速率方程或全李维尔空间来计算。时间分辨模拟中的弛豫路径可以通过直观的速率参数指定，或使用Bloch-Redfield形式微观推导。为处理复杂的弛豫场景，MaRs提供自动热平衡强制和组合操作，允许从简单构件组装多组分弛豫模型。基于流行的机器学习开发平台PyTorch，MaRs支持CPU和CUDA（GPU）后端的操作。我们展示了MaRs的时间分辨EPR能力及其内置时间域模拟方法的差异与局限性。
items.abstract: MaRs is an open-source Python library for the simulation and fitting of electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectra. MaRs supports simulations of field-swept and frequency-swept continuous-wave EPR, accounting for various spin-sublevel polarizations. Moreover, MaRs is capable of simulating complete 2D time-resolved EPR spectra (in field-time domain). The latter can be computed in different levels of theoretical complexity. First, the time evolution can be computed either with kinetic rate equations, which describe population transfer, or in full Liouville space, which captures coherence dynamics. Second, the relaxation pathways in timeresolved simulations can be specified either through intuitive rate parameters that are automatically expanded into the Lindblad master-equation form, or derived microscopically using the Bloch-Redfield formalism. To handle physically complex relaxation scenarios, MaRs provides automatic thermal-balance enforcement and composition operations that allow multicomponent relaxation models to be assembled from simple building blocks. Built on PyTorch (popular platform for machine learning development), MaRs leverages operations on both CPU and CUDA (GPU)
items.authors: Arkady Samsonenko, Ivan Kurganskii, Alexander Maryasov, Sergey Veber, Matvey Fedin

items.title: Growth and Postsynthetic Modulation of Morphology-Encoded Plasmonic Chirality
items.title_zh: 形态编码的等离子体手性生长与后合成调制研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了纳米颗粒生长过程中形态如何导致等离子体手性，以及其后续结构修饰的响应。通过半胱氨酸引导的金（Au）生长和银（Ag）过生长，我们在单一纳米颗粒平台上研究了这些互补过程。最初的无手性金双锥体演变为不规则的多面体纳米颗粒，表现出强烈的双重圆二色性（CD），L-和D-半胱氨酸产生近似镜像的响应。改变半胱氨酸对映体的相对比例系统地控制了CD响应的符号和幅度，外消旋混合物几乎抵消。时间分辨测量显示，正负CD带以相似的S型Avrami动力学发展，定量捕捉了生长过程中等离子体手性的出现。一旦手性建立，后续的银沉积在没有额外半胱氨酸的情况下，逐渐蓝移等离子体响应并减弱了两个对映体纳米颗粒的CD，但未发生符号反转。这种减弱伴随着不规则金外部形态向更光滑、圆润的富银外形态的转变。
items.abstract: Establishing how nanoscale morphology gives rise to plasmonic chirality requires understanding both its development during nanoparticle growth and its response to subsequent structural modification. Here, we investigate these complementary processes within a single nanoparticle platform through cysteine-directed Au growth followed by Ag overgrowth. Initially achiral Au bipyramids evolve into irregular, faceted nanoparticles displaying strong bisignate circular dichroism (CD), with L- and D-cysteine producing approximately mirror-related responses. Varying the relative proportions of the cysteine enantiomers systematically controls the sign and magnitude of the CD response, with near cancellation for the racemic mixture. Time-resolved measurements reveal that the positive and negative CD bands develop with comparable sigmoidal Avrami-type kinetics, quantitatively capturing the emergence of plasmonic chirality during growth. Once chirality is established, subsequent Ag deposition without additional cysteine progressively blue-shifts the plasmonic response and attenuates the CD of both enantiomeric nanoparticles without sign reversal. items.title: Operational insights from the front lines of OpenADMET: lessons from our blind challenges
items.title_zh: OpenADMET盲测挑战的操作见解与经验教训
items.summary_zh: 药物发现中报告的机器学习（ML）模型性能与实际应用中的体验之间存在显著差距，这成为该领域的一大障碍。为了填补这一空白，OpenADMET举办了一系列盲测挑战，以基准测试和推动吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）的预测建模。本文总结了前四次盲测挑战中的操作、战略和社区层面的经验教训，为生命科学领域的协作机器学习竞赛设计和实施提供了实用蓝图。此外，我们开源了盲测挑战基础设施和数据验证工具，以降低举办严格、社区驱动竞赛的门槛，并促进计算机辅助药物发现中的可持续集体学习框架。
items.abstract: The gap between reported machine learning (ML) model performance in drug discovery and the experience of using these models in live discovery projects remains a major hurdle for the field, because the retrospective nature of most benchmarks makes it difficult to objectively assess progress. To address this gap, OpenADMET has hosted a series of blind challenges to benchmark and advance predictive modeling in absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET). In this Perspective, we distill the operational, strategic, and community-level lessons from our first four blind challenges, providing a practical blueprint for designing and running collaborative machine learning competitions in the life sciences. In addition, we open-source our blind challenge infrastructure and data-validation tools to lower the barrier to entry for hosting rigorous, community-driven competitions and to foster a sustainable framework for collective learning in computer-aided drug discovery.
items.authors: Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Maria Castellanos, Jonathan A. Swain, Jenke Scheen, Sean Colby, Georgia Channing

items.title: Anomalous Hall Conductivity from Berry Curvature at the Dirac Point in AlPd5I2 Monolayer
items.title_zh: AlPd5I2单层材料中Dirac点的异常霍尔电导率研究
items.summary_zh: 异常霍尔效应（AHE）在非磁性材料中是探测Bloch电子Berry曲率（BC）的有效手段，也是下一代自旋电子器件的关键组成部分。本研究对单层AlPd5I2的异常霍尔电导率（AHC）进行了第一性原理研究，该二维材料在费米能级附近具有Dirac型交叉。采用包含自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的密度泛函理论（DFT），使用Quantum ESPRESSO和最大局域Wannier函数（Wannier90）进行计算。电子结构显示在S点存在Dirac点，因SOC分裂为具有大BC的带隙态。费米能级略高于带隙，导致金属态和极高的AHC。AHE直接源于Dirac点处SOC诱导带隙的强BC热点。研究结果表明，AlPd5I2单层材料是研究BC主导的输运和大霍尔响应的有前景系统。
items.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in non-magnetic materials is a powerful transport probe of the Berry curvature (BC) of Bloch electrons and a key component of next-generation spintronic devices. In this work, I present a first-principles study of the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in monolayer AlPd5I2, a two-dimensional material hosting a Dirac-type crossing located close to the Fermi energy. Density functional theory (DFT) with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is performed using Quantum ESPRESSO and maximally localized Wannier functions (Wannier90). The electronic structure reveals a Dirac point at the S point, split by SOC into a gapped state with a large BC. The Fermi level is located slightly above the gap, yielding a metallic state with a very high AHC. The AHE is traced directly to the intense BC hotspots at the SOC-induced gap at the Dirac point. My findings establish the AlPd5I2 monolayer as a promising system for investigating BC dominated transport and large Hall responses.
items.authors: Shubham Sharma

items.title: Historical Side Information and the Reversal of Open-System Dynamics
items.title_zh: 历史侧信息与开放系统动力学的逆转
items.summary_zh: 微观可逆性保证了全球可逆动力系统存在时间反转轨迹，但并不保证后续控制器具备识别和实现该轨迹所需的物理信息。在开放系统中，不同微观历史之间的区别可能会编码在环境相关性中，其物理载体可能会扩散、降解或变得不可获取，尽管相应的信息仍然存在于全局状态中。我们将这一区别表述为控制器的物理可接状态，并引入了一种任务依赖的历史逆转信息度量：实现规定逆转精度所需的额外物理可实现信息。对于连续系统，局部高斯模型提供了一个速率-失真下限基准，其高分辨率行为将几何贡献与动力学放大项分离。对于混沌动力学，后者可以获得与相关正Lyapunov指数成比例的Pesin型形式。我们进一步区分了可接性的实际损失与因果不可接性。当逆转相关信息的载体穿越因果边界时，后续信息回流至控制器被排除。最后，我们考虑有限的物理记忆，并展示了在最小化条件下的相关结果。
items.abstract: Microscopic reversibility guarantees the existence of a time-reversed trajectory for a globally reversible dynamical system, but does not by itself guarantee that a later controller possesses the physical information required to identify and implement that trajectory. For an open system, distinctions between different microscopic histories may become encoded in environmental correlations whose physical carriers disperse, degrade, or become inaccessible, even though the corresponding information remains present in the global state. We formulate this distinction in terms of the physically accessible state of the controller and introduce a task-dependent measure of historical reversal information: the additional physically realizable information required to achieve a prescribed reversal accuracy. For continuous systems, a local Gaussian model yields a rate–distortion lower benchmark whose high-resolution behavior separates a geometrical contribution from a dynamical amplification term. For chaotic dynamics, the latter can acquire a Pesin-type form proportional to the relevant positive Lyapunov exponents. We then distinguish practical loss of accessibility from causal inaccessibility.
items.authors: Paolo Ghigna

items.title: N-Phosphoryl Imines Enable Intermolecular Aza Paternò–Büchi Reactions with Unactivated and Activated Alkenes
items.title_zh: N-磷酰亚胺促进未活化和活化烯烃的间接Aza Paternò–Büchi反应
items.summary_zh: 间接Aza Paternò–Büchi (aPB)反应通过亚胺和烯烃的光环加成为合成氮杂环丁烷提供了一种直接且收敛的方法。然而，涉及未活化烯烃的反应仍然具有挑战性，尤其是对于非环状亚胺，其激发态易于快速非辐射弛豫和竞争性光化学途径。本文报道了N-磷酰亚胺作为可获得且稳定的光反应伙伴，适用于可见光介导的未活化烯烃间接aPB反应。使用硫喹啉作为廉价有机光催化剂的三重态敏化使得在多种烯烃上实现了高效的[2+2]环加成，为间接aPB化学建立了新的试剂平台，扩展了非环状亚胺与未活化烯烃的可及反应性。
items.abstract: Intermolecular aza Paternò–Büchi (aPB) reactions provide a direct and convergent approach to azetidines through the photocycloaddition of imines and alkenes. However, reactions involving unactivated alkenes remain challenging, particularly with acyclic imines, whose excited states are susceptible to rapid nonradiative relaxation and competing photochemical pathways. Here, we report N-phosphinyl imines as readily accessible and stable photoreactive partners for visiblelight-mediated intermolecular aPB reactions with unactivated alkenes. Triplet sensitization using thioxanthone as an inexpensive organic photocatalyst enables productive [2+2]-cycloaddition across a range of alkenes, establishing a new reagent platform for intermolecular aPB chemistry to expand the accessible reactivity of acyclic imines with unactivated alkenes.
items.authors: Scott L. Kim, Lillian J. Carleu, Corinna S. Schindler

items.title: TLQ Method: A Tandem Mixing–Linear Deduction–Quantile Weighted Median Framework for Robust Metabolite Screening and a General Diagnostic Indicator for Measurement Reliability
items.title_zh: TLQ方法：用于稳健代谢物筛选的框架
items.summary_zh: 无靶向代谢组学受到个体间变异、低丰度代谢物检测困难及基质效应的限制。我们提出TLQ方法，包括串联混合、线性推导和分位数加权中位数。串联混合通过对配对样本进行等体积混合，压缩组间基质差异并增强低丰度信号。线性推导去除背景并反向计算处理信号，得出更接近真实处理与对照比的推导倍数变化。第三模块使用带Bootstrap置信区间的加权中位数进行稳健筛选。候选机制在不影响准确性的情况下提高覆盖率。各模块可灵活部署（配对模式、P_R模式或独立第三模块）。我们还提出了一种通用的组水平诊断指标（GDI）框架，GDI比较合并和个体估计，并将其差异标准化为随机期望，使系统性扭曲可量化。GDI独立于平台，并作为TLQ方法中的独立可靠性注释层。
items.abstract: Untargeted metabolomics is constrained by inter-individual variability, difficulty in detecting low-abundance metabolites, and matrix effects. Post-acquisition corrections are limited when biological variation is large, signals approach detection limits, or matrix effects are strong. We propose the TLQ method, consisting of Tandem Mixing, Linear Deduction, and Quantile Quality-Weighted Median. Tandem Mixing compresses between-group matrix differences and enhances low-abundance signals via equal-volume mixing of paired samples. Linear Deduction removes background and back-calculates the treatment signal, yielding a deduced fold change closer to the true treatment-to-control ratio. The third module performs robust screening using a quality-weighted median with Bootstrap confidence intervals. A candidates-of-interest mechanism improves coverage without compromising accuracy. The modules can be deployed flexibly (paired mode, P_R mode, or standalone third module). We also propose a general group-level diagnostic indicator (GDI) framework. items.title: Human-specific retrotransposons encode the regulatory logic of two lineages in a bipotent neural crest and central nervous system precursor
items.title_zh: 人类特有逆转录转座子编码双能神经嵴与中枢神经系统前体的调控逻辑
items.summary_zh: 转座元件是顺式调控创新的来源，最新的家族尤其引人关注，因为只有近期插入的转座子才能解释物种特异性的调控差异。SVAs（亚家族-E, F）、LTR5Hs和L1HS是人类特有的逆转录元件。我们在早期胚胎前体中分析了人类诱导多能干细胞衍生的双能神经外胚层聚集体的染色质可及性和基因表达，发现这些细胞在谱系决定前的阶段仍保留神经嵴和中枢神经系统的能力。转录组分析确认了这种双重能力：神经板边界、神经嵴和前脑程序同时活跃，而明确的神经嵴特征尚未诱导。在约4300个注释的人类特有转座子中，有289个在聚集体中可重复地可及。这些可及元素相较于不可及元素更靠近基因，位于基因密集的邻域，并且邻近转录本的表达水平更高。
items.abstract: Transposable elements are sources of cis-regulatory innovation, and the youngest families are particularly interesting because only recent insertions can account for species-specific regulatory divergence. SVAs (subfamilies -E, F), LTR5Hs and L1HS are human-specific retroelements. They are polymorphic, and in some cases still mobile. Regulatory activity in these families has been surveyed mainly in pluripotent cells and differentiated tissues, leaving the early embryonic precursors in which lineage decisions are made largely unexplored. We profiled chromatin accessibility and gene expression in human iPSC-derived bipotent neuroectodermal aggregates harvested at a stage that precedes lineage commitment and retains competence for both the neural crest and the central nervous system. Transcriptional profiling confirmed this dual competence: neural plate border, neural crest and forebrain programs were concurrently active, and definitive neural crest specifiers not yet induced. Of ~4,300 annotated human-specific transposons, 289 were reproducibly accessible in the aggregates. items.title: Varied influence of curli on Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli O157, O26, O111 biofilm formation and animal cell adherence.
items.title_zh: Curli对志贺毒素产菌大肠杆菌生物膜形成的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 志贺毒素产菌大肠杆菌（STEC）在牛体内持续存在，并能定殖于牛的直肛交界处，成为重要的传播储存库。本研究探讨了curli产生、生物膜形成与O157、O26和O111 STEC分离株对牛直肛交界（RAJ）鳞状上皮（RSE）细胞的附着关系。评估了30个分离株在环境和宿主相关生长条件下的RSE附着、curli相关表型和生物膜形成。结果显示，O157和O111分离株对RSE细胞表现出强聚集附着，而O26分离株则主要表现为较为分散的附着。O111分离株在环境条件下产生最强的生物膜，并显示出相对稳定的curli表型，而O157和O26分离株则变化较大。然而，环境生物膜形成与RSE附着之间并未始终存在一致的相关性。在模拟宿主条件下，生物膜形成显著减少，包括一些产生强环境生物膜的分离株。
items.abstract: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) persist in cattle and can colonize the bovine recto-anal junction, making it an important reservoir for transmission. Curli are extracellular amyloid fibers associated with biofilm formation and environmental persistence, but their contribution to STEC adherence to bovine epithelial cells is unclear. This study examined the relationship between curli production, biofilm formation, and adherence of O157, O26, and O111 STEC isolates to bovine recto-anal junction (RAJ) squamous epithelial (RSE) cells. Thirty isolates were evaluated for RSE adherence, curli-associated phenotypes, and biofilm formation under environmental and host-associated growth conditions. O157 and O111 isolates predominantly exhibited strong aggregative adherence to RSE cells, whereas O26 isolates showed more heterogeneous, primarily diffuse adherence. O111 isolates produced the strongest biofilms under environmental conditions and displayed relatively stable curli phenotypes, while O157 and O26 isolates showed greater variation. items.authors: Kudva, I. T.; Biernbaum, E. N.; Mazon, H.; Drabek, K.

items.title: Genetically Predicted Blood DNA Methylation Reveals Putative Regulatory Signals Associated with ALS Risk
items.title_zh: 基因预测的血液DNA甲基化与ALS风险的潜在调控信号
items.summary_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其遗传结构和分子机制尚不完全清楚，尤其是在散发性疾病中。为探讨基因调控的DNA甲基化是否有助于理解ALS易感性，我们使用PrediXcan框架进行了甲基组广泛关联研究（MWAS）。应用于ALS全基因组关联研究（GWAS）的总结统计数据，涉及27,205例病例和110,881例欧洲血统对照，评估了192,378个独特CpG位点的基因预测甲基化。在名义阈值p < 0.05下，使用ARIES模型发现3,741个CpG与ALS风险相关，使用Understanding Society模型发现13,127个。经过Bonferroni校正后，8个基因组区域中有25个CpG与ALS风险显著相关，包括C9orf72、TBK1、SCFD1和MOB3B等已知ALS基因及位点，以及一个新发现的CpG位点WHAMM（15q25.2）。预测的甲基化在18个CpG位点与ALS风险呈正相关，在7个CpG位点呈负相关。
items.abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder whose genetic architecture and underlying molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood, particularly in sporadic disease. To investigate whether genetically regulated DNA methylation may help interpret ALS susceptibility, we conducted a methylome-wide association study (MWAS) of genetically predicted blood DNA methylation using the PrediXcan framework. CpG-specific prediction models developed in the ARIES and Understanding Society cohorts were applied to ALS genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics from 27,205 cases and 110,881 controls of European ancestry. In total, genetically predicted methylation at 192,378 unique CpG sites was evaluated using S-PrediXcan. At a nominal threshold of p < 0.05, 3,741 CpGs were associated with ALS risk using ARIES models and 13,127 using Understanding Society models. After Bonferroni correction, 25 CpGs across eight genomic regions remained significantly associated with ALS risk. items.title: International trends in clozapine utilisation prevalence in adults, adolescents and older people: An observational study in 42 countries between 2015 and 2024
items.title_zh: 2015至2024年42国氯氮平使用情况国际趋势观察研究
items.summary_zh: 重要性：氯氮平是治疗耐药性精神分裂症（TRS）的唯一循证治疗，但其使用存在显著的国际差异。目的：通过标准化方法评估各国氯氮平的使用情况，并研究使用差异的相关因素。设计、设置和参与者：使用2015至2024年的基于人群的数据进行重复横断面研究。数据来自36个国家和1个特别行政区，并补充了5个国家的氯氮平消费数据。分析分别针对成年人（20-64岁）、青少年（10-19岁）和老年人（65岁及以上）进行。主要结果：按年龄组、性别、国家和年份计算每10万人中的年度门诊氯氮平使用率。还考察了氯氮平使用率与国家级健康系统、人口和社会经济指标之间的关联。结果：我们分析了超过11亿人的数据。2024年，成年人的氯氮平使用率在克罗地亚最高（每10万人415.3），在芬兰为302.0，而在阿曼和埃塞俄比亚最低（分别为0.5）。
items.abstract: Importance: Clozapine is the only evidence-based treatment for treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS), yet substantial international variation in its use has been reported. Objective: To provide a comprehensive and updated assessment of international clozapine utilisation by estimating prevalence across countries using a standardised methodology and examining factors associated with variation in use. Design, Setting, and Participants: Repeated cross-sectional study using population-based data from 2015 to 2024. Individual-level data were obtained from 36 countries and 1 special administrative region, supplemented by national clozapine consumption data from 5 additional countries. Analyses were conducted separately for adults (20-64 years; primary analysis), adolescents (10-19 years), and older adults ([ ]65 years). Main Outcomes and Measures: Annual outpatient clozapine utilisation prevalence per 100,000 population by age group, sex, country and calendar year. Associations between clozapine utilisation prevalence and country-level health system, demographic, and socioeconomic indicators were also examined. items.title: Myocardial Stiffness Tracking & Assessment Toolkit Driven by Artificial Intelligence For Reproducible Benchmarking of Temporal Segmentation and Shear-Wave Velocity Stabilization on Synthetic Data
items.title_zh: 人工智能驱动的心肌刚度追踪与评估工具包
items.summary_zh: 常规超声心动图评估受操作人员差异和耗时后处理的影响，限制了快速定量分析。实时电影超声要求低延迟的自动处理。现有方法缺乏标准化评估框架和可重复性保障。为解决这些问题，我们构建了人工智能驱动的心肌刚度追踪与评估工具包（MyoSTAT.AI）。该工具包提供了一个确定性、完全可重复的流程，能够实时进行分割和剪切波速度估计，完全基于合成数据进行评估。我们评估了四种基于U-Net的架构，包括2D基线、2.5D堆叠帧模型、3D体积模型和ConvLSTM变体，使用包含1200帧合成图像的分割数据集和900个合成速度场案例的剪切波速度数据集进行实验。
items.abstract: Propose: Routine echocardiographic assessment can be affected by operator variability and time-consuming post-processing, which may limit rapid quantitative analysis. Real-time cine ultrasound demands low-latency automated processing for clinical usage. Existing approaches lack standardized evaluation frameworks, verified edge deployment, and structured reproducibility guarantees. To address these limitations, we built Myocardial Stiffness Tracking & Assessment Toolkit driven by Artificial Intelligence (MyoSTAT.AI). We report a deterministic, fully reproducible pipeline that performs real-time segmentation and SWE velocity estimation, evaluated entirely on synthetic data. Approach: Four U-Net-based architectures spanning single-frame and temporal designs were evaluated via systematic ablation: a 2D baseline, a 2.5D stacked-frame model, a 3D volumetric model, and a ConvLSTM variant. Experiments used synthetic reference corpora with split accounting the segmentation corpus contained 1,200 synthetic frames, and the SWE corpus contained 900 synthetic velocity-field cases. The SWE branch used Radon-transform-based propagation-direction estimation, time-domain shear-wave speed estimation

items.title: High-altitude exercise orchestrates a divergent immune landscape: cytotoxic suppression, humoral compensation, and neutrophil functional reprogramming.
items.title_zh: 高海拔运动调控免疫环境：细胞毒性抑制与体液补偿
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了高海拔运动对免疫适应的影响，研究对象为46名健康男性，采用低海拔和高海拔标准化运动进行 plasma 蛋白组学和单细胞 RNA 测序。结果显示，低海拔运动诱导了广泛的免疫激活，而高海拔运动后 CD8 T 细胞、自然杀伤细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞的细胞毒性和先天效应程序则被广泛抑制。相反，体液免疫增强，表现为浆细胞母细胞和 CD4 记忆及增殖 T 细胞的激活。成熟中性粒细胞功能重新编程，向吞噬作用和脱颗粒转变，并伴随活化循环中性粒细胞的扩增。通过 plasma 蛋白组学和小鼠肌肉转录组分析，进一步识别出特定于高海拔的趋化和血管外渗程序。这些适应与 APRIL、MIF 和 Annexin A1 信号增强及 CCL-趋化因子和补体通路减弱相关。总体而言，高海拔运动诱导了以细胞免疫抑制为特征的协调免疫重构。
items.abstract: Physical exertion at high-altitude imposes a dual stress of hypoxia and mechanical load, yet the underlying immune adaptations remain poorly understood. Plasma proteomics and single-cell RNA sequencing were performed in 46 healthy men undergoing standardized exercise at low and high altitudes, and the findings were validated in mice exposed to chronic extreme hypoxia (simulated 5,800 m) combined with exhaustive exercise. Whereas broad immune activation was induced by low-altitude exercise, cytotoxic and innate effector programs in CD8 T cells, natural killer cells, monocytes, and dendritic cells were broadly suppressed following high-altitude exercise. In contrast, humoral immunity was enhanced, as indicated by the activation of plasmablasts and CD4 memory and proliferating T cells. Mature neutrophils were functionally reprogrammed toward phagocytosis and degranulation, accompanied by an expansion of activated circulating neutrophils. A high-altitude-specific program involving chemotaxis and vascular extravasation was further identified by plasma proteomic and murine muscle transcriptomic analyses. These adaptations were associated with enhanced APRIL, MIF, and Annexin A1 signaling

items.title: Bidirectional relationship between Sleep Disturbance and Atrial Fibrillation: a SPRINT-based analysis
items.title_zh: 睡眠障碍与心房颤动的双向关系：基于SPRINT的分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：睡眠障碍与心房颤动（AF）相关，但以往研究多依赖于单一时间点的睡眠评估或特定睡眠障碍的研究。睡眠障碍随时间变化是否预测AF，以及AF是否预测后续睡眠障碍尚不明确。方法：我们对收缩压干预试验（SPRINT）进行了二次分析，纳入无糖尿病的高血压成年人。构建了两个前瞻性分析队列：7,232名无基线AF参与者用于分析睡眠障碍与新发AF，6,079名基线无临床显著睡眠障碍参与者用于互逆分析。使用0-3的患者自报症状评分反复评估睡眠障碍，临床显著睡眠障碍定义为评分≥2。AF通过12导联心电图确认。采用时间依赖的Cox模型评估时间更新的睡眠障碍与新发AF的关系，以及时间更新的AF与新发临床显著睡眠障碍的关系，调整人口统计学、生活方式和心血管风险因素。结果：在中位随访3.3年期间，189例新发AF被记录。
items.abstract: Background: Sleep disturbance has been associated with atrial fibrillation (AF), but prior studies have largely relied on sleep assessed at a single time point or examined specific sleep disorders. Whether changes in sleep disturbance over time predict AF and, conversely, whether AF predicts subsequent sleep disturbance within the same population is not well established. Methods: We conducted a secondary analysis of the Systolic Blood Pressure Intervention Trial (SPRINT), which enrolled adults with hypertension and increased cardiovascular risk without diabetes. Two prospective analytic cohorts were constructed to examine each direction of the association: 7,232 participants without baseline AF for the analysis of sleep disturbance and incident AF, and 6,079 participants without clinically significant sleep disturbance at baseline for the reciprocal analysis. Sleep disturbance was assessed repeatedly using a 0-3 patient-reported symptom score, with clinically significant sleep disturbance defined as a score [ ]2. AF was ascertained from protocol 12-lead ECGs. Time-dependent Cox models evaluated time-updated sleep disturbance in relation to incident AF and time-updated AF in relatio

items.title: Medical Service Use for Dental Problems in Australia: A National Cross-Sectional Study
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚牙科问题的医疗服务使用：全国横断面研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：研究澳大利亚人为何选择医疗而非牙科护理解决牙科问题，并描述医疗环境中的治疗路径和提供的治疗。方法：数据来源于2021年国家牙科电话访谈调查（NDTIS），涵盖5,526名成年人。通过加权分析估算了因牙科问题寻求医疗服务的流行率及社会人口学预测因素。在寻求医疗的受访者中，识别出使用的最高强度路径（全科医疗/其他初级护理、急诊科、住院）并描述了所接受的治疗（包括处方药、非药物干预和转诊），按就诊原因分层。结果：总体上，4.4%的成年人在前一年因牙科问题寻求医疗服务。土著成年人（13.5%）、低收入群体（6.5%）和符合公共牙科护理资格者（8.5%）的比例显著更高。急诊科是主要就诊路径（76.9%），其次是住院（13.6%）和初级护理（9.5%）。牙痛/智齿问题和口腔损伤的抗生素处方率最高，而口腔损伤则以程序性护理为主。其他急性牙科问题的管理方式多样，许多人仅获得建议或症状管理。
items.abstract: Aim: To examine how and why Australians seek medical rather than dental care for dental problems, and to describe the pathways and treatments provided within medical settings. Subjects and Methods: Data were drawn from the National Dental Telephone Interview Survey (NDTIS) 2021, a nationally representative survey of 5,526 adults. Survey-weighted analyses estimated the prevalence and sociodemographic predictors of medical service use for dental problems. Among respondents who sought medical care, we identified the highest-intensity pathway used (general practice/other primary care, emergency department, hospital admission) and described treatment received (including prescription medications, non-pharmaceutical interventions, and referrals) stratified by reason for presentation. Results: Overall, 4.4% of adults sought medical care for a dental problem in the preceding year. Prevalence was substantially higher among Indigenous adults (13.5%), low-income groups (6.5%), and those eligible for public dental care (8.5%). Emergency departments were the dominant pathway (76.9%), followed by hospital admission (13.6%) and primary care (9.5%). Toothache/wisdom-tooth problems and oral injuries
items.authors: Luzzi, L.; McCormick, K. M.; Amarasena, N.; Mejia, G.; Chrisopoulos, S.

items.title: Network-Based Analysis of Fibromyalgia-Associated Genes Identifies Candidate Molecular Targets and Enriched Biological Pathways
items.title_zh: 基于网络分析的纤维肌痛相关基因候选分子靶点及富集通路研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：纤维肌痛（FM）是一种以慢性疼痛和躯体症状为特征的疾病，其机制尚不完全清楚。中枢敏感化是纤维肌痛病理生理学的关键方面。尽管其患病率较高，但有效的治疗选择有限，相关机制仍不明了。本研究旨在识别与纤维肌痛相关的潜在中心基因及其生物通路。方法：初步筛选了GeneCards、DisGeNET、OMIM和PharmGKB四个在线数据库中的纤维肌痛相关基因，利用GeneCards和DisGeNET识别共同基因，并通过STRING数据库生成蛋白质关联网络。使用Cytoscape软件分析网络，并通过CytoHubba插件根据度和中介中心性识别中心基因。采用ShinyGO进行功能富集分析以识别显著富集的KEGG通路。结果：TNF和IL6被识别为具有最高中心度的两个中心基因。
items.abstract: Background Fibromyalgia (FM) is a disorder characterized by chronic pain and somatic symptoms that are not fully understood. Central sensitization, a process by which the central nervous system amplifies pain signals, is a key aspect of the pathophysiology of fibromyalgia. Despite its prevalence, effective treatment options are limited and the underlying pathophysiological mechanisms are not fully understood. Network pharmacology, which analyzes the interactions between diseases, targets, and biological pathways, can be used to identify potential molecular targets and pathways associated with fibromyalgia. In this study, we aimed to identify potential hub genes and the underlying biological pathways involved in fibromyalgia. Methods Four online databases, GeneCards, DisGeNET, OMIM, and PharmGKB, were initially screened for genes associated with fibromyalgia. GeneCards and DisGeNET were subsequently used to identify common genes, which were used to generate a protein association network using the STRING database. Cytoscape software was used to analyze the network, and the CytoHubba plugin was used to identify hub genes based on degree and betweenness centrality. Functional enrichmen
items.authors: Sarkar, S.; Srinivasan, A.

items.title: Active control of crystal nucleation and growth using operando X-ray imaging
items.title_zh: 利用原位X射线成像主动控制晶体成核与生长
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了通过原位X射线成像技术主动控制晶体的成核与生长过程。研究对象为多种晶体材料，采用高分辨率X射线成像实时监测晶体的形成与演变。关键发现表明，外部条件（如温度、浓度）对晶体成核速率和生长速率有显著影响。通过调节这些条件，研究人员能够有效地控制晶体的形态和尺寸。结果为晶体材料的设计与优化提供了新的策略，具有重要的应用潜力。
items.authors: Eslam M. Elbakry, Emma A. Pappas, Joshua C. Gibson, Daniel P. Shoemaker

items.title: Do topological and quantum-inspired molecularrepresentations add value? Evidence from Africannatural-product-inspired antimalarial chemical space
items.title_zh: 拓扑与量子启发分子表征的价值研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了拓扑和量子启发的分子表征在非洲天然产物启发的抗疟化学空间中的价值。通过对比不同分子表征方法，分析其在抗疟药物发现中的有效性。研究结果表明，拓扑和量子特征能够显著提高化合物的筛选效率，尤其是在复杂的化学空间中。关键数据表明，采用这些表征方法的模型在预测活性化合物方面表现优于传统方法。结论是，拓扑和量子启发的分子表征为抗疟药物的开发提供了新的视角和工具，具有重要的应用潜力。
items.authors: Myke Vital Sao Temgoua, Jean-Pierre TCHAPET NJAFA, Serge Guy Nana Engo, Penabei Samafou, Wilfred Fon Mbacham

items.title: Distinct Roles of Working Memory and Inhibitory Control in Speech-in-Noise Perception
items.title_zh: 工作记忆与抑制控制在噪声中语音感知中的不同作用
items.summary_zh: 在寻求听力健康的患者中，噪声中语音感知困难是主要诉求，即使听力阈值未明显下降。当前临床实践主要关注感官功能，忽视了执行功能对日常超阈值听力的影响。语音在噪声中的感知依赖于听觉通路的感官编码精度与支持目标导向听力的高阶认知过程之间的动态互动。我们研究了执行功能的两个子组件——工作记忆和抑制控制，如何在成年生命周期中变化并影响噪声中的语音表现。研究对象为200名年龄在18至73岁之间、听力阈值正常的参与者，使用在线听觉心理物理平台进行测试。工作记忆通过n-back任务评估，抑制控制通过听觉Stroop任务评估。结果显示，年龄显著影响两项任务的表现，老化与抑制控制降低（Stroop成本增加）相关，但未发现显著影响。
items.abstract: Difficulty perceiving speech in noise is the primary complaint of patients seeking hearing healthcare, even absent overt losses in audiometric thresholds. Yet current clinical practice largely focuses on sensory function while ignoring the potentially outsized effects of executive function on everyday suprathreshold listening. Speech perception in noise depends on the dynamic interplay between the fidelity of sensory coding along the auditory pathway and higher-order top-down cognitive processes that support goal-directed listening, both of which can independently change across the lifespan. Here we examined how two subcomponents of executive function, working memory and inhibitory control, vary across the adult lifespan and contribute to speech-in-noise performance. Two hundred participants aged 18 to 73 with normal hearing thresholds were tested on a validated online auditory psychophysics platform. Working memory was assessed with an n-back task and inhibitory control with an auditory Stroop task. Participants then performed two speech-in-noise tasks: a modified rhyme test emphasizing sensory coding through energetic masking at the cochlea, and a matrix sentence task emphasizing

items.title: The Genetic Architecture of Neonatal Deer Mouse Cries Implicates the Cerebellum in the Temporal Control of an Infant Social Behavior
items.title_zh: 新生鹿鼠叫声的遗传结构与小脑在社交行为中的时间控制
items.summary_zh: 声乐沟通是脊椎动物的一种保守社交行为，从出生时婴儿的哭声开始。这些新生儿的声音信号在不同情境下变化，以引发与婴儿需求相匹配的父母关怀，并在不同物种中适应特定的生态和社会系统。我们研究了北美鹿鼠的新生儿叫声，发现其特征存在可遗传的物种间差异。本文重点分析了其中的时间结构特征，发现鹿鼠叫声的时间特征在不同物种间的差异大于频谱特征，并且在回放实验中，叫声持续时间影响幼鼠叫声引发父母接近的能力。我们还关注小脑系统，发现新生小脑和下橄榄体的解剖结构存在物种间差异，并展示了药理干预对小脑功能的影响。
items.abstract: Vocal communication is a conserved vertebrate social behavior that begins at birth with the cries of infants. These neonatal vocal signals vary across contexts to elicit parental care that matches infant needs, and across species to match species-specific ecologies and social systems. This natural variation presents an opportunity to identify proximate mechanisms supporting flexible neonatal vocal behaviors and their evolution. To this end, we recently described neonatal vocalizations in North American deer mice, a model system for behavioral evolution, and identified heritable interspecific differences in features of these vocalizations. Here, we examine one of these features, temporal structure, which in humans and rodents contains information about infant distress. We find that temporal features of neonatal deer mouse cries have diverged more across deer mouse species than spectral features, and that in a playback assay cry duration affects the ability of pup vocalizations to elicit parental approach. To test proximate mechanisms underlying natural variation in cry duration, we first focus on the cerebellar system, a conserved hindbrain region that contributes to the temporal st
items.authors: Jourjine, N.; Woolfolk, M. L.; Hoekstra, H. E.

items.title: BRIDGE-AD reveals Alzheimer's disease effectors through interpretable large-scale omics integration
items.title_zh: BRIDGE-AD通过可解释的大规模组学整合揭示阿尔茨海默病效应因子
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）数据集的不断增加为整合异质证据和系统性发现疾病效应因子提供了机会。我们提出了BRIDGE-AD，这是一个可解释的网络医学框架，将多模态数据转化为统一的、特定于疾病的基因表示，以优先考虑AD效应因子。我们整合了30多个数据集和涵盖组学、功能、遗传及先前疾病知识层的资源。BRIDGE-AD在恢复与AD相关的基因方面优于最近发布的预训练和特定模态的基因嵌入，并生成了候选AD效应因子的全基因组资源。已确立和新优先的效应因子形成了19个功能簇，揭示了AD生物学的全球分子景观。BRIDGE-AD支持以SPP1为中心的跨区假说，并提名了一个特征不明的候选基因SCARB2进行功能验证。SCARB2在小胶质细胞中重塑了溶酶体、脂质处理和自噬程序，而AD中SCARB2糖基化的破坏则影响了SCARB2的加工和功能。附带网站explore-bridgead.com使用户能够追踪整理的证据并生成机制假说。
items.abstract: The growing landscape of Alzheimer's disease (AD) datasets creates opportunities to integrate heterogeneous evidence and systematically discover disease effectors. We present BRIDGE-AD, an interpretable network medicine framework that transforms multimodal data into a unified, disease-specific gene representation for AD effector prioritisation. We integrated more than 30 datasets and curated resources spanning omics, functional, genetic and prior disease knowledge layers. BRIDGE-AD outperformed recently published pretrained and modality-specific gene embeddings in recovering AD-associated genes and produced a genome-wide resource of candidate AD effectors. Established and newly prioritised effectors formed 19 functional clusters, revealing a global molecular landscape of AD biology. BRIDGE-AD supported an SPP1-centred cross-compartment hypothesis and nominated SCARB2, a poorly characterised candidate, for functional validation. SCARB2 rewired lysosomal, lipid-handling and autophagic programmes in microglia, whereas disrupted SCARB2 glycosylation in AD implicated altered SCARB2 processing and function. The accompanying website, explore-bridgead.com, enables users to trace the curate

items.title: Variation in multiple classes of simple sequence repeats can alter drug susceptibility in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.title_zh: 简单序列重复变异影响结核分枝杆菌药物敏感性
items.summary_zh: 简单序列重复（SSRs）中的插入和缺失（INDELs）产生相对高频的可逆遗传变化，促进细菌适应环境变化。对全球结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）分离株的分析表明，许多SSRs受到多样性选择，且某些同聚体（HT）中的INDELs在宿主和抗生素压力下可提高病原体的适应性。然而，大多数可变SSRs的功能影响尚不清楚。本研究结合越南和秘鲁临床Mtb菌株的系统基因组分析与体外实验验证，识别出改变抗生素敏感性的SSR INDELs。结果显示，不同重复组成的多个SSRs中的INDELs高度变异，并与临床抗生素耐药性相关。这些变异包括在ppe13、glpK、Rv2081c和ppsA中的框移HT INDELs，以及在ponA1、ppe53和ppe59中的内框三核苷酸SSR INDELs，后者对蛋白结构产生更微妙的变化。重建这些INDELs的同源背景中识别出四种直接降低药物效力的变异，包括在ppe53中的三核苷酸SSR缺失，赋予异烟肼和利福平的中等耐药性。
items.abstract: Insertions and deletions (INDELs) in simple sequence repeats (SSRs) generate relatively high-frequency reversible genetic changes that facilitate bacterial adaptation to changing environments. Analyses of global Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) isolates indicate that many SSRs are under diversifying selection, and several of the resulting INDELs in homopolymer tracts (HTs) can increase the pathogen's fitness during exposure to host and antibiotic stresses. However, the functional impact of most variable SSRs, particularly those within more complex repeat sequences than HT, remains unclear. Here, we combine phylogenomic analysis of clinical Mtb strains from Vietnam and Peru with in vitro experimental validation of engineered strains to identify SSR INDELs that alter antibiotic susceptibility. Our findings demonstrate that INDELs across multiple SSRs of differing repeat composition are highly variable and correlate with clinical antibiotic resistance. These variants included frameshifting HT INDELs in ppe13, glpK, Rv2081c, and ppsA, and in-frame trinucleotide (triplet) SSR INDELS in ponA1, ppe53, and ppe59 that produce much more subtle changes in protein structure. items.title: Neural Responsivity to Unexpected Stimuli Moderates a Developmental Pathway to Anxiety: A Community-Sample Replication in Early Infancy and Childhood
items.title_zh: 神经对意外刺激的反应调节焦虑发展的路径
items.summary_zh: 背景：气质风险，包括负性反应性（NR）和行为抑制（BI），是焦虑的重要早期路径。神经对意外感官刺激的反应，通过不匹配反应（MMR）进行评估，已被证明可以调节早期气质与后期焦虑之间的关联。本研究旨在检验在社区样本中，4个月时测得的MMR是否调节NR到BI及BI到儿童焦虑的发展路径。方法：参与者为147名来自婴儿气质起源研究的婴儿。4个月时评估NR和脑电图（EEG），EEG在听觉奇异刺激范式下记录。14个月时观察测量BI，30个月及4至6岁时使用儿童行为检查表评估焦虑症状。使用结构方程模型测试MMR对NR到BI及BI到焦虑路径的调节效应。结果：MMR显著调节了这两条路径。4个月时更负的MMR与从高NR到高BI及从高BI到30个月高焦虑的风险路径相关。更积极的MMR水平未观察到显著关联。焦虑症状在30个月至4至6岁期间保持稳定。结论：早期婴儿对意外刺激的神经反应调节焦虑的发展。
items.abstract: Background: Temperamental risk, including negative reactivity (NR) and behavioral inhibition (BI), represents a robust early pathway to anxiety. Neural responsivity to unexpected sensory stimuli, indexed by the mismatch response (MMR), has been shown to moderate associations linking early temperament to later anxiety. This study extends prior work by testing whether MMR measured as early as 4 months, in a community sample, moderate the developmental pathways from NR to BI and from BI to childhood anxiety. Methods: Participants included 147 infants from the Origins of Infant Temperament study. NR and EEG were assessed at 4 months, with EEG recorded during an auditory oddball paradigm. BI was observationally measured at 14 months, and anxiety symptoms were assessed at 30 months and 4 to 6 years using the Child Behavior Checklist. Structural equation modeling with full-information maximum likelihood tested moderation effects of MMR on NR to BI and BI to anxiety pathways. Results: MMR significantly moderated both pathways. More negative MMR at 4 months were associated with the risk pathways from high NR to high BI and from high BI to high anxiety at 30 months. No significant associatio

items.title: Investigating 24-Hour Urine Expected Ranges of Non-Kidney Stone Formers: an EAU Endourology Research Group Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 非肾结石形成者24小时尿液预期范围的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：24小时尿液收集的参考范围存在显著差异，导致诊断不确定性。我们旨在为非肾结石形成者的24小时尿液收集预期范围提供可靠证据。方法：我们对健康成年无肾结石病的个体进行了系统评估（PROSPERO ID: CRD42024590784）。每个成分在R中进行荟萃分析，按年龄、性别和祖先分层，并进行元回归和敏感性分析。通过明确的八分支决策框架选择每个成分的推荐分析。预期范围来源于合并标准差（95%区间）；证据通过GRADE量化。关键发现与局限性：共纳入72篇文章（10,284名参与者）。预期范围（mmol / 24 h，除非另有说明）：尿量1.0-2.5L，钙1.9-6.2，草酸0.2-0.6（男性）/0.2-0.4（女性），尿酸2.0-5.1（男性）/2.3-3.5（女性），pH 5.6-6.3，柠檬酸1.2-4.5，肌酐12.2-16.3（男性）/7.2-12.6（女性），磷19-26，钠98-253，钾28-77，镁3.1-4.8，铵28-46（男性）/20-40（女性），氯84-218，硫酸盐17-26（男性）/7-30（女性），尿素234-445。主要局限性为：研究间异质性高（大多数成分I-squared>95%）及测定/实验室变异。
items.abstract: Background and Objective: There is substantial variation in reference ranges for 24-hour urine collections, leading to diagnostic uncertainty. We aimed to curate robust evidence for expected ranges of 24-hour urine collections in the non-kidney stone forming population. Methods: We performed a systematic review (PROSPERO ID: CRD42024590784) of healthy adults without kidney stone disease undergoing 24-hour urine collections. Each component was meta-analysed in R, stratified by age, sex and ancestry, meta-regression and sensitivity analyses for study design, collection completeness and bias. An explicit eight-branch decision framework selected the recommended analysis per component. Expected ranges were derived from the pooled SD (95% interval); evidence was quantified by GRADE. Key Findings and Limitations: Seventy-two articles were included (10,284 participants). Expected ranges (mmol / 24 h unless stated): volume 1.0-2.5L, calcium 1.9-6.2, oxalate 0.2-0.6 (men) / 0.2-0.4 (women), urate 2.0-5.1(men)/2.3-3.5(women), pH 5.6-6.3, citrate 1.2-4.5, creatinine 12.2-16.3(men)/7.2-12.6(women), phosphate 19-26, sodium 98-253, potassium 28-77, magnesium 3.1-4.8, ammonium 28-46(men)/20-40(wom

items.title: Association of polygenic risk scores with low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels and control: findings from the Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos (HCHS/SOL)
items.title_zh: 多基因风险评分与低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：高胆固醇血症是西班牙裔/拉丁裔人群中常见的心血管疾病风险因素，但该人群的胆固醇意识和治疗率较低。利用与低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL）水平相关的多基因风险评分（PRS）可能有助于识别最能从他汀治疗中受益的人群。方法：本研究基于2008-2011年在美国四个社区招募的16,415名年龄在18-74岁的西班牙裔/拉丁裔成年人。我们评估了20个PRS与11,669名参与者的基线LDL水平及LDL控制的关联。使用多变量线性回归分析得出PRS与基线LDL水平的效应估计。多变量逻辑回归分析用于评估PRS与他汀使用者LDL控制的关联。结果显示，PRS与LDL水平及控制存在显著关联，为高风险人群的筛查提供了依据。
items.abstract: Background: Hypercholesterolemia is a prevalent cardiovascular (CVD) risk factor among Hispanics/Latinos; however, rates of cholesterol awareness and treatment are low in this population. Using a polygenic risk score (PRS) associated with low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL) levels may help identify those who would benefit most from statin therapy. Previous LDL-PRS have been developed but they have not been properly evaluated for use in a highly diverse Hispanic/Latino population. Methods: The Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos (HCHS/SOL) is a prospective study that enrolled 16,415 Hispanic/Latino adults aged 18-74 years from four U.S. communities in 2008-2011. We assessed the association of twenty PRS with baseline LDL levels and LDL control among 11,669 HCHS/SOL participants with complete data and consent to conduct genetic research. Weighted PRS were calculated using effect estimates obtained from the PGS Catalog. Multivariable linear regression analysis was used to derive effect estimates (betas (&beta), 95% confidence intervals (CI)) for the association between each PRS, modeled continuously and by quintiles, with baseline LDL levels. items.title: A self-limiting, TREM2-dependent anabolic program confers microglial resilience in Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: 依赖TREM2的自限性合成程序赋予阿尔茨海默病小胶质细胞韧性
items.summary_zh: 小胶质细胞是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的关键驱动因素，而TREM2是最强的遗传风险因素之一，促进了与病理相关的小胶质细胞（DAM）状态以应对斑块。我们利用蛋白质组学、单细胞转录组学和体内代谢标记，发现斑块相关的小胶质细胞启动了一种依赖TREM2的合成程序，将新生蛋白质合成与线粒体生物发生相结合。该程序标志着具有吞噬能力的小胶质细胞，其丧失与蛋白稳态过载和线粒体功能障碍相关。意外的是，这一合成程序是自限性的，在低淀粉样蛋白负担时达到峰值，随着负担增加而下降。这一下降在人体中也得到了保留：在523名供体中，合成能力与TREM2相关，但在晚期Braak阶段下降，即使DAM特征仍在上升。因此，合成能力而非激活状态标志着AD中小胶质细胞的韧性，持续的抗淀粉样抗体吞噬刺激可能导致生物合成耗竭和自限性效能。
items.abstract: Microglia are key drivers of Alzheimer's disease (AD), and TREM2, one of the strongest genetic risk factors, enables the disease-associated microglia (DAM) state required for plaque engagement. How TREM2 sustains this protection, and why it falters as disease advances, remain unclear. Using proteomics, single-cell transcriptomics, and in vivo metabolic labeling, we show that plaque-associated microglia mount a TREM2-dependent anabolic program coupling nascent protein synthesis to mitochondrial biogenesis. This program, not the DAM signature, marks phagocytically competent microglia; its loss is associated with proteostatic overload and mitochondrial dysfunction. Unexpectedly, this anabolic program is self-limiting, peaking at low amyloid burden and declining as burden rises. This decline is conserved in humans: across 523 donors, anabolic capacity tracks TREM2 but falls at advanced Braak stage even as DAM signature keeps rising. Thus, anabolic capacity, rather than activation state, marks microglial resilience in AD, and sustained stimulation of phagocytosis by anti-amyloid antibodies risks biosynthetic exhaustion and self-limiting efficacy.
items.authors: Lin, D.; Atkinson, J. R.; Wu, W.; Chen, M.; Jayasekara, S.; Segal, B. M.; Ma, A.; Gao, J.

items.title: Large language model linguistic perplexity in childhood onset psychosis: unique features and developmental trends
items.title_zh: 儿童精神病中的语言模型困惑度：独特特征与发展趋势
items.summary_zh: 目的：儿童及青少年精神病（COP）与语言的细微变化相关，这些变化与思维障碍有关，是功能损害的关键因素。大型语言模型（LLM）通过分析句子结构和词汇选择，可以检测语言模式的偏差。研究旨在确定困惑度是否随年龄变化，以及在COP中是否有所改变。方法：本研究比较了COP病例（N = 23，平均年龄12.78岁）与对照组（N = 15，平均年龄11.67岁）的困惑度差异。分析了大量手动转录的访谈数据（对照组：3,829词；病例：6,579词）。结果：来自大型语言模型Meta AI（LLaMA）的困惑度在病例中与年龄呈显著负相关，而在对照组中则没有。来自双向编码器表示的困惑度（BERT）在两组中均未与年龄显著相关。通过广义线性模型评估组间差异，以（伪）困惑度为因变量，病例状态为预测变量，年龄和词数为协变量。
items.abstract: Objective: Child and early adolescent onset psychosis (COP) is associated with subtle changes in language linked to thought disorder, a key contributor to functional impairment. Large language models (LLM) can detect deviations from expected language patterns by jointly analyzing sentence structure and word choice. This integrated information is captured by measures such as (pseudo)-perplexity, which quantify how difficult it is for an LLM to predict individual words given the surrounding linguistic context. The objective was to determine if perplexity measures change with age and whether they are altered in COP. Method: This study tested for a difference in perplexity in COP cases (N = 23) mean age 12.78 years as compared to controls (N = 15) mean age 11.67 years. Extensive manually transcribed interviews were analyzed (controls: 3,829; cases: 6,579 mean words). Results: Perplexity derived from Large Language Model Meta AI (LLaMA) had a significant negative correlation with age in cases but not in controls. Pseudo-perplexity derived from Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) did not have a significant correlation with age in either group. Group differences

items.title: Cardiometabolic and Psychobehavioral Phenotypes Define Cardiovascular Risk Heterogeneity in Rheumatoid Arthritis
items.title_zh: 类风湿关节炎心血管风险异质性的表型研究
items.summary_zh: 心血管疾病（CVD）是类风湿关节炎（RA）患者的主要发病和早亡原因。本研究旨在识别多维度的心脏代谢、炎症、肾脏、行为和心理社会因素是否定义了RA中的不同心血管风险表型。我们分析了来自2005-2018年国家健康与营养调查（NHANES）的3,252名自报RA的成年人。采用无监督的PAM聚类方法识别出不同的心血管风险特征。结果显示，识别出六种临床可解释的心血管风险表型，CVD的患病率各异：重度代谢性糖尿病（40.3%）、老年糖尿病高血压（34.9%）、非糖尿病中间型（20.2%）、轻度代谢型（14.8%）、心脏代谢型（10.4%）和吸烟主导型（19.4%）。与心脏代谢型相比，重度代谢性糖尿病表型的CVD患病风险最高（aOR 4.11, 95%CI:2.56-6.59）。
items.abstract: Abstract Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a major cause of morbidity and premature mortality in people with rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Whether multidimensional cardiometabolic, inflammatory, renal, behavioral, and psychosocial factors define distinct cardiovascular risk phenotypes in RA remains unclear. This study aimed to identify data-driven phenotypes and evaluate their associations with prevalent CVD. We analyzed 3,252 adults aged over 20 years with self-reported RA from the 2005-2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). Unsupervised partitioning around medoids (PAM) clustering using Gower distance identified distinct data-driven cardiovascular-risk profiles. Cluster validity was assessed using silhouette analysis and internal train test validation. Survey-weighted binary logistic regression evaluated associations between phenotype membership and prevalent CVD. Six clinically interpretable data-driven phenotypes were identified with varying CVD prevalence: Severe Metabolic Diabetic (40.3%), Aging Diabetic Hypertensive (34.9%), Non-Diabetic Intermediate (20.2%), Mild Metabolic (14.8%), Cardiometabolic (10.4%), and Smoking-Predominant (19.4%). items.authors: Jahan, S. T.; Akter, A.; Hossain, S.; Reza, M. S.; Rahman, M. M.; Alam, M. M.; Huq, M. M.

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Blood Pressure, Central Adiposity, and Physical Activity Patterns Between Wheelchair Users and Ambulatory Adults in a Rural South African Settings: A Cross-Sectional Study Protocol
items.title_zh: 轮椅使用者与行走成年人血压及身体活动比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：高血压是低中收入国家心血管疾病的重要可改变因素，主要受中心性肥胖和身体不活动影响。轮椅使用者是一个结构性边缘化群体，面临长时间坐姿和身体成分改变的风险。然而，关于南非农村地区不同移动状态的心血管风险特征的流行病学数据仍然稀缺。目的：本研究旨在比较南非林波波省Thulamela市轮椅使用者与行走成年人之间的血压、中心性肥胖（腰围）、身体活动水平和久坐行为，并确定移动状态是否与高血压独立相关。方法：本研究采用分析性社区基础横断面设计，计划招募210名成年人（70名轮椅使用者；140名行走对照），通过目的性和便利抽样策略进行招募。评估将包括坐位血压测量和坐位腰围指标，以标准化数据收集。身体活动和久坐时间将使用脊髓损伤休闲时间身体活动问卷（LTPAQ-SCI）进行量化。
items.abstract: Background Hypertension is a major modifiable driver of cardiovascular disease in low- and middle-income countries, heavily driven by central adiposity and physical inactivity. Wheelchair users represent a structurally marginalized population facing heightened exposure to prolonged sitting and altered body composition. However, context-specific epidemiological data comparing cardiovascular risk profiles by mobility status in rural South Africa remain scarce. Objective This study aims to compare blood pressure profiles, central adiposity (waist circumference), physical activity levels, and sedentary behavior between wheelchair users and ambulatory adults in the Thulamela Municipality, Limpopo Province, and to determine if mobility status is independently associated with hypertension. Methods This study utilizes an analytical, community-based cross-sectional design. A sample of N = 210 adults (n = 70 wheelchair users; n = 140 ambulatory controls) will be recruited using purposive and convenience sampling strategies within rural networks. Assessments will feature seated blood pressure measurements and seated waist circumference metrics to standardize data collection across both groups
items.authors: Nefale, T.; Mathunjwa, M. L. L.; Shaw, B.; Mukoma, G.

items.title: What Transfers Across Brains Is Not What Stays Within Individuals: Evidence from Bilingual Language States
items.title_zh: 跨脑传递与个体内稳定性：双语语言状态的证据
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了双语者的脑活动差异，分析了77名中英双语者的功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据。我们从大脑皮层活动中解码每个人的当前语言状态（中文或英文），并评估参与者对之间的跨人传递。结果显示，存在一个低维度的群体表征，能够支持跨脑传递，其性能几乎与完整的皮层模式相匹配。传递的变化与参与者学习英语的早期时间相关。去除这些维度几乎不影响个体内的准确性，但传递性能逐渐下降直至崩溃。研究结果揭示了两种组织层次：支持跨脑传递的共同成分和在个体内跨会话保持稳定的个体成分。
items.abstract: Cognitive neuroscience often seeks brain activity that is consistent across people. Individual differences in brain organization have received less attention. Bilinguals, in particular, remain understudied at the individual level, as neuroimaging has mostly approached them as a group. We analyzed functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data from 77 Chinese-English bilinguals. We decoded each person's current language state, Chinese or English, from cortex-wide activity and assessed cross-person transfer across participant pairs. We identified a low-dimensional population representation, derived outside each tested pair, that was sufficient to support transfer, with performance nearly matching that of the full cortical pattern. Variation in this transfer tracked how early participants had learned English. Removing these dimensions barely changed within person accuracy, but transfer progressively declined until it collapsed. Our findings reveal two levels of organization: a common component that supports transfer between brains and an individual component that remains reliably stable within a person across sessions.
items.authors: Demirkan, S.; Wassermann, D.; Sagot, B.

items.title: Changes in Neural Dynamics of Brain Activity and Connectivity Independently Predict Post-Stroke Aphasia Recovery
items.title_zh: 脑活动与连接性变化独立预测中风后失语症恢复
items.summary_zh: 中风后的语言恢复涉及左半球语言网络和双侧通用多需求网络的重组。我们使用任务相关活动和连接性评估特定脑区的神经预测因子，研究对象为47名失语症患者，分别在急性、亚急性和慢性阶段进行功能性神经成像，采用句子理解范式。通过控制混杂因素的多变量正则回归与特征消融，测试预测因子是否超越病灶、年龄和失语症严重程度解释语言恢复，并识别最相关的区域特异性预测因子。结果显示，早期恢复由急性和亚急性活动及连接性独立预测，而后期改善仅由活动预测。亚急性阶段多需求到语言区域的连接性预测早期恢复，而急性多需求网络活动则预测长期结果。
items.abstract: Post-stroke language recovery involves reorganization of left-hemisphere language and bilateral domain-general multiple-demand networks. Neuroimaging predictors of recovery are widely used, yet, they are often grouped into broad predictor families, limiting clinical translation and the identification of specific therapeutic targets. Here, we assess brain region-specific neural predictors of recovery using task-related activity and connectivity within a multivariate, cross-validated predictive framework. Forty-seven patients with aphasia were examined longitudinally in the acute, subacute, and chronic phases after ischemic stroke using a sentence comprehension paradigm during functional neuroimaging, with regions of interest spanning language and multiple-demand networks. Confound-controlled multivariate regularized regression with feature ablation tested whether predictor families explained language recovery beyond lesion, age, and aphasia severity, and identified the most relevant region-specific predictors. Early recovery was independently predicted by acute and subacute activity and connectivity, whereas later improvement was predicted by activity alone. Subacute connectivity fr
items.authors: Bruera, A.; Jiang, Z.; Saur, D.; Stockert, A.; Hartwigsen, G.

items.title: PCR Detection and Species Identification of Leishmania in Microscopy-Negative Smears from Suspected Cutaneous Leishmaniasis in Iran
items.title_zh: 伊朗疑似皮肤利什曼病显微镜阴性涂片中利什曼原虫的PCR检测与物种鉴定
items.summary_zh: 背景：直接显微镜检查仍是皮肤利什曼病（CL）的实用一线检测方法，但在寄生虫数量少或病变慢性的情况下可能会漏诊。我们评估了PCR在已报告为显微镜阴性的吉姆萨染色涂片中检测和鉴定利什曼原虫的能力。方法：我们回顾性分析了2013年3月至2015年2月期间，来自伊朗Gonbad-e-Qabus和Torbat-e-Jam的131例临床疑似CL患者的显微镜阴性涂片。通过酚-氯仿-异戊醇提取从染色载玻片中回收DNA，使用kDNA PCR进行分子检测和物种鉴定。结果：在131个显微镜阴性样本中，34个（25.9%）检测到利什曼原虫DNA，其中23个（67.6%）被鉴定为L. major，11个（32.4%）为L. tropica。所有L. major阳性样本均来自Gonbad-e-Qabus，而所有L. tropica阳性样本均来自Torbat-e-Jam。大多数PCR阳性病变（27/34，79.4%）为慢性、继发感染和/或临床上不典型。在小型实验室验证面板中，所有10个显微镜阳性涂片均为PCR阳性，10个非利什曼病皮肤病对照均为PCR阴性。结论：约四分之一的临床疑似病例在显微镜检查阴性情况下仍有利什曼原虫感染。
items.abstract: Background: Direct microscopy remains a practical first-line test for cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL), but it can miss infections when parasite numbers are low or lesions are chronic. We evaluated whether PCR could detect and identify Leishmania in Giemsa-stained smears that had already been reported as microscopy-negative. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 131 microscopy-negative smears from patients with clinically suspected CL who attended health-center laboratories in Gonbad-e-Qabus and Torbat-e-Jam, Iran, between March 2013 and February 2015. DNA was recovered from the stained slides by phenol- chloroform-isoamyl alcohol extraction. kDNA PCR was used for molecular detection and species identification. Results: Leishmania DNA was detected in 34 of 131 microscopy-negative samples (25.9%; exact 95% CI, 18.7%-34.3%). Twenty-three positive samples (67.6%) were identified as L. major and 11 (32.4%) as L. tropica. All L. major-positive samples came from Gonbad-e-Qabus, whereas all L. tropica-positive samples came from Torbat-e-Jam.
