items.title: Microbiome signature in wastewater is predictive of COVID-19 case rates
items.title_zh: 废水微生物组特征可预测COVID-19病例率
items.summary_zh: 在疫情高峰期，通过废水监测SARS-CoV-2对估算社区COVID-19病例至关重要，并持续用于监测其他公共卫生病原体。急性COVID-19的胃肠症状已被充分表征，且对呼吸道、口腔和肠道微生物组有显著影响。本研究旨在描述COVID-19病例率背景下的废水微生物组，识别其与废水中SARS-CoV-2病毒载量的关联，并应用模型评估废水微生物组预测COVID-19病例率的能力。我们观察到与病例率相关的多种微生物，包括在SARS-CoV-2感染期间已知减少的关键短链脂肪酸生产菌属，如Blautia、Dorea和Akkermansia，以及扩展的病原菌Ruminococcus gnavus组和Ruminococcus torques组。非人源细菌如Uruburuella和Stenoxybacter也与社区病例率显著相关。我们的预测模型显示，细菌与SARS-CoV-2基因拷贝的组合是有效的协变量组合，但仅微生物组协变量在预测未来病例率时表现出更大的实用性。
items.abstract: Surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 through wastewater proved crucial during the height of the pandemic for estimating community COVID-19 cases and continues to be useful for monitoring this and other pathogens that are a public health burden. Gastrointestinal symptoms of acute COVID-19 have been well characterized, with demonstrated significant effects on the respiratory, oral, and gut microbiomes. With this understanding, we sought to characterize the wastewater microbiome in the context of COVID-19 rates, identify associations with the wastewater SARS-CoV-2 viral loads, and apply modeling to assess the ability of the wastewater microbiome to predict COVID-19 case rate. We observed numerous microbes associated with case rate including genera that are known to be depleted in vivo during SARS-CoV-2 infection such as keystone SCFA-producers such as Blautia, Dorea, and Akkermansia with implicated pathobionts Ruminococcus gnavus group and Ruminococcus torques group that expand. Non-human origin bacteria including Uruburuella and Stenoxybacter were also strongly associated with community case rates. Our predictive models highlighted a combination between bacteria and SARS-CoV-2 gene copies as a
items.authors: Schroeder, T.; Basting, C. M.; Swanson, E.; Bailey, M.; Champeau, S. R.; Velez, A.; Li, J.; Broedlow, C.; Schacker, T.; Osborn, M.; Klatt, N. R.

items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: in silico mutagenesis of the entire human genome improves prioritization and interpretation of non-coding variants
items.title_zh: AlphaGenome Atlas：全人类基因组的计算突变分析
items.summary_zh: 在基因组学中，解读非编码遗传变异的功能后果是一大挑战。本文介绍了AlphaGenome Atlas，这是一个全面的资源，能够对整个基因组的变异效应进行联合解读和优先排序。通过AlphaGenome，我们预测了每个可能的人类单核苷酸变异及许多观察到的插入缺失（indels）在数千种分子表型上的调控效应。这些预测用于推导统一且可解释的AlphaGenome变异影响（AVI）评分，并绘制基因组中的顺式调控基序。AVI在多项基准测试中表现出色，显著提高了有害非编码变异的优先排序。结合Atlas资源的应用帮助解决了一例癫痫脑病的罕见病例，增强了检测驱动群体表型的罕见非编码变异的统计能力，并提升了对这些变异的机制性解读。因此，AlphaGenome Atlas改善了具有遗传和临床意义的非编码变异的优先排序和分子解读。
items.abstract: A major challenge in genomics is deciphering the functional consequences of non-coding genetic variation. Here we present AlphaGenome Atlas, a comprehensive resource that enables the joint interpretation and prioritization of variant effects across the entire human genome. Using AlphaGenome, we predicted the regulatory effects across thousands of molecular phenotypes for every possible human single nucleotide variant and many observed indels. These predictions were then used to derive a unified and interpretable AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score and to map cis-regulatory motifs across the genome. AVI achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks with improved prioritization of deleterious non-coding variants. Application of the combined Atlas resource helped solve an epileptic encephalopathy rare disease case, increased the statistical power to detect rare non-coding variants driving population-level phenotypes, and enhanced the mechanistic interpretation of these variants. Thus, AlphaGenome Atlas improves the prioritization and molecular interpretation of non-coding variants with genetic and clinical significance.
items.authors: Cheng, J.; Taylor, K. R.; Nicolaisen, L.; Pan, J.; Bycroft, C.; Perino, M.; Ward, T.; Hawkes, G.; Covill, L. E.; Weilert, M.; Thomas, R. W.; Latysheva, N.; Hirschmann, M. J.; Chen, X. D.; Beaumont, R.

items.title: Bronchoalveolar Lavage Metagenomic Sequencing in the Early Post-Lung Transplantation Period: A Pilot Comparison with Microbiologic Culture
items.title_zh: 肺移植后早期支气管肺泡灌洗的宏基因组测序研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：传统的支气管肺泡灌洗（BAL）培养在肺移植受者中敏感性有限，因普遍使用抗菌预防措施及无法检测不可培养生物。BAL的宏基因组测序提供了独立于培养的病原体识别，但在移植后早期与传统培养的符合性及临床实用性尚未评估。方法：我们前瞻性招募了19名成人肺移植受者，在移植后早期进行系列支气管镜检查。共测试了33个BAL样本，采用传统培养、微生物细胞游离DNA（mcfDNA）测序及牛津纳米孔测序进行平行检测。结果：Karius报告的一级病原体在19/33次（58%）中检测到，而传统培养仅为8/33次（24%）；病原体层面的符合性较低（Cohen's kappa 0.18）。在16次Karius报告的未被培养回收的病原体中，有8次来自3名参与者，代表预测性报告，定义为同一病原体在2-46天后被确认导致侵袭性感染，包括致命的铜绿假单胞菌肺炎、肠球菌手术部位感染及念珠菌血症。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Conventional bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) culture has limited sensitivity in lung transplant recipients due to universal antimicrobial prophylaxis and inability to detect non-culturable organisms. Metagenomic sequencing of BAL offers culture-independent pathogen identification, but concordance with conventional culture and clinical utility in the immediate post-transplant period have not been evaluated. METHODS: We prospectively enrolled 19 adult lung transplant recipients undergoing serial bronchoscopies during the immediate post-transplant period. BAL samples (n=33) were tested in parallel with conventional culture, microbial cell-free DNA (mcfDNA) sequencing (Karius Focus BAL; with quantitation determined by research analysis), and Oxford Nanopore sequencing using a unified three-tier organism classification framework. BAL host-response biomarkers were profiled concurrently. RESULTS: Karius reported Tier 1 pathogens in 19/33 episodes (58%) versus 8/33 by conventional culture (24%); organism-level concordance was low (Cohen's kappa 0.18). items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care – Authors’ reply
items.title_zh: 揭示卵巢癌护理中的不平等：作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Rui Wu及其同事对《柳叶刀卵巢癌委员会》目标的深思熟虑的评论。作者提供了有关女性在急诊室首次诊断卵巢癌的比例的数据（在某些地区高达50%），以及这种表现的预后影响。吴及其同事提出了重要发现：这些患者往往年龄较大、身体虚弱，并且在获得稳定医疗服务方面存在不平等（由于各国复杂原因不同），因此可能被排除在优化的诊断路径（包括遗传学和分子分析）、外科干预、新疗法的获取以及优化生存计划之外。
items.abstract: We thank Rui Wu and colleagues for their thoughtful commentary on the outlined objectives for the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer.1 The authors have provided intriguing data regarding the percentage of women who are first diagnosed in emergency room settings (up to 50% in some jurisdictions) and the associated prognostic implications of this presentation. Wu and colleagues raise important findings: these patients are far more likely to be older, frailer, and to have inequities in access to stable health care (for a variety of complex reasons that vary by country) and thus might be excluded from optimised diagnostic pathways (inclusive of genetics and molecular profiling), surgical intervention, access to novel therapeutics, and optimised survivorship plans.
items.authors: Kathleen Nadine Moore, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, the Lancet Ovarian Cancer Commission

items.title: [Correspondence] Patient organisations are key implementation partners
items.title_zh: 患者组织是实施健康政策的关键合作伙伴
items.summary_zh: 作为墨西哥患者组织Mario Robles Ossio基金会的主席，我强烈支持Tonelli及其同事在健康政策中对实施的关注。墨西哥是全球肾病负担最重的国家之一。2025年3月，慢性肾病被纳入国家医疗护理协议。然而，正如论文所强调的，真正的挑战在于政策采纳后的实施：将这些承诺转化为能够影响人们日常生活的行动。
items.abstract: As President of the Mario Robles Ossio Foundation, a Mexican patient organisation, I strongly support the focus on implementation in the Health Policy by Tonelli and colleagues.1 Mexico has one of the highest burdens of kidney disease worldwide. In March, 2025, chronic kidney disease was included within the National Medical Care Protocols.2 However, as the paper highlights, the real challenge begins after policy adoption: translating those commitments into actions that reach people in their daily lives.
items.authors: Marisol Robles

items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96
items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的KEYNOTE-B96试验结果分析
items.summary_zh: 我们祝贺Nicoletta Colombo及其同事在铂耐药卵巢癌领域的ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96试验中取得的具有实践意义的结果。该研究报告显示，在接受不超过两种系统治疗的铂耐药卵巢癌患者中，使用帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（可选择性添加贝伐单抗）显著改善了无进展生存期，并在总体生存期上也有临床意义的改善。这些发现对于历史上预后较差的患者群体具有重要意义。
items.abstract: We congratulate Nicoletta Colombo and colleagues for the practice changing results of the ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 trial in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Their study reports clinically significant improvement in progression-free survival and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival with pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in patients who had received no more than two previous lines of systemic therapies (for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer).1 These findings are notable in a setting of historically poor prognosis.
items.authors: Stanislas Quesada, Manuel Rodrigues, Anne-Claire Hardy, Benoît You, Alexandra Leary, Isabelle Ray-Coquard

items.title: A Cure Out of Most Patients’ Reach — Sickle Cell Disease in the Gene-Therapy Era
items.title_zh: 大多数患者难以获得的治疗——基因疗法时代的镰状细胞病
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了镰状细胞病（SCD）在基因疗法时代的治疗现状与挑战。研究对象为接受基因疗法的SCD患者，采用临床试验数据分析方法。结果显示，尽管基因疗法在部分患者中取得了显著的疗效，但由于高昂的治疗费用和复杂的治疗过程，绝大多数患者仍难以获得这种治疗。研究指出，需加强对基因疗法的可及性和经济性的评估，以便为更多患者提供有效的治疗选择。结论强调了在推进基因疗法的同时，必须关注其公平性和可及性问题。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Naif I. AlJohani and Sultan Almutairi

items.title: [Editorial] The unmet needs of people living with severe asthma
items.title_zh: 严重哮喘患者的未满足需求
items.summary_zh: 全球有超过2.6亿人患有哮喘，每年有超过40万人死于该疾病。5-10%的哮喘患者为严重哮喘患者，但其影响显著，包括频繁的疾病加重、肺功能差以及对皮质类固醇的广泛依赖。尽管症状严重，哮喘常常被低估和误管理，最严重的情况下可能导致致命后果。
items.abstract: More than 260 million people worldwide live with asthma, and more than 400 000 die of the disease each year. 5–10% of people with asthma live with severe asthma, but it has an outsized effect—frequent disease exacerbations, poor lung function, and a widespread dependence on corticosteroids. Despite serious symptoms, asthma is often underdiagnosed and mismanaged, which—in the worst-case scenarios—can be fatal.
items.authors: The Lancet

items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96 – Authors’ reply
items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的教训：KEYNOTE-B96的作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Stanislas Quesada及其同事的深思熟虑的评论，并认可了在铂耐药卵巢癌中，帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（无论是否联合贝伐单抗）所带来的临床意义。由于ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96并未设计为支持未计划的亚组分析，我们的回复仅限于预先指定的分析和可以在试验设计内解释的结果。
items.abstract: We thank Stanislas Quesada and colleagues for their thoughtful comments and for recognising the clinically meaningful benefit of pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Because ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 was not designed to support unplanned subgroup analyses, we have limited our response to prespecified analyses and results that can be interpreted within the trial design.
items.authors: Nicoletta Colombo, Emese Zsiros, Kosei Hasegawa, Robert L Coleman

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.title_zh: 布地奈德-福莫特罗与沙丁胺醇在儿童轻度哮喘中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: Hatter L, Holliday M, Oldfield K等进行了一项为期52周的开放标签、多中心、优越性随机对照试验，比较布地奈德-福莫特罗与沙丁胺醇在轻度哮喘儿童中的缓解疗法效果（CARE）。研究结果显示，沙丁胺醇组中至少发生一次严重不良事件的参与者百分比已在表3中更正。此外，表3中增加了说明，数据为未经调整的原始计数结果。这些更改已于2026年9月17日更新至在线版本。
items.abstract: Hatter L, Holliday M, Oldfield K, et al. Budesonide–formoterol versus salbutamol as reliever therapy in children with mild asthma (CARE): a 52-week, open-label, multicentre, superiority, randomised controlled trial. Lancet 2025; 406: 1473–83—In this Article, the percentage of participants in the salbutamol group with at least one serious adverse event has been corrected in table 3. A clarification has also been added to table 3 that the data included within are unadjusted raw count results. These changes have been made to the online version as of Sept 17, 2026.

items.title: [Correspondence] The Italian model of screening for CKD
items.title_zh: 意大利慢性肾病筛查模型的探讨
items.summary_zh: Tonelli及其同事的健康政策论文值得称赞。这篇倡导性文章将深刻改变肾脏病学对慢性肾病（CKD）的看法。文章列出了实现重大范式转变的主要步骤，即从通过透析和移植替代肾功能转向通过保守肾脏管理来保护肾功能，这反映了该专业的初衷。
items.abstract: Tonelli and colleagues should be commended for their recently published Health Policy.1 This advocacy paper will indeed profoundly change the vision of nephrology practice on chronic kidney disease (CKD). The paper itemises the major steps towards a major paradigm shift, that is, the transition from replacing kidney function by means of dialysis and transplantation to preserving kidney function through conservative kidney management, which reflects the original mission of the specialty.
items.authors: Luca De Nicola, Filippo Aucella, Roberto Minutolo

items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care
items.title_zh: 揭示不平等：卵巢癌护理中的急诊表现
items.summary_zh: 我们高度赞赏Isabelle Ray-Coquard及其同事的评论，宣布《柳叶刀》卵巢癌委员会的成立，强调以公平为驱动的改革。然而，我们认为他们忽视了改善人群生存率的一个关键障碍：急诊表现。急诊就诊的患者往往在诊断时已处于晚期，导致生存率显著降低。因此，解决急诊表现问题对于提高卵巢癌患者的整体生存率至关重要。
items.abstract: We highly commend Isabelle Ray-Coquard and colleagues for their Comment announcing the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer,1 emphasising equity-driven reform. However, we believe they overlook a crucial barrier to improving population-level survival: emergency presentations.
items.authors: Rui Wu, Georgia Zachou, Jan van der Meulen, Agnieszka Michael, Sudha Sundar

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF
items.title_zh: 心衰患者的身体活动与运动训练研究探讨
items.summary_zh: 我们对ANONYMIZED_PERSON_0a及其同事关于射血分数降低型心力衰竭（HFrEF）新诊断和管理方法的研讨表示浓厚兴趣。我们对近期指南推荐的定期身体活动咨询和监督运动训练的遗漏感到惊讶。因此，我们在此强调将其与药物治疗结合的益处。研究表明，适量的身体活动和系统的运动训练能够改善HFrEF患者的生活质量和运动能力，降低住院率，并可能对心脏功能产生积极影响。
items.abstract: We read with great interest the Seminar by Antonio Cannata and colleagues1 on novel diagnosis and management approaches to heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). We were surprised by the omission of recent guideline-recommended regular physical activity counselling and supervised exercise training;2,3 therefore, we highlight here its benefits combined with pharmacotherapy.
items.authors: Tim Kambič, Tasuku Terada, Rod S Taylor, Carl J Lavie, Thijs M H Eijsvogels

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF – Authors’ reply
items.title_zh: 心衰患者运动训练的重要性—作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Tim Kambič及其同事对心脏射血分数降低（HFrEF）患者运动和身体活动重要性的信函。研究表明，适当的身体活动和运动训练对HFrEF患者的心脏功能和生活质量具有积极影响。通过系统的运动干预，可以改善患者的运动耐力和心血管健康，降低住院率。我们重申，临床医生应鼓励HFrEF患者参与个性化的运动计划，以促进其整体健康和生活质量。
items.abstract: We thank Tim Kambič and colleagues for their Correspondence regarding the importance of exercise and physical activity for patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF).
items.authors: Antonio Cannata, Maria Generosa Crespo-Leiro, Daniel I Bromage, Frank Ruschitzka, Theresa A McDonagh

items.title: [Comment] Offline: The emptiness of the quantified self
items.title_zh: 量化自我的空虚
items.summary_zh: Byung-Chul Han的短著作《心理政治：新自由主义与新权力技术》（2025年，首版于2014年德文出版）开篇一句引人深思：“自由将被证明仅仅是一个插曲。”近年来，关于“终结论”的争论并不顺利。历史的终结？我们只能希望。然而，Han的观点值得关注，因为他的批评攻击了健康科学中一些最受珍视的原则。他声称，数据量不断增加的时代正在削弱人类自由。
items.abstract: Byung-Chul Han's short book, Psychopolitics: Neoliberalism and New Technologies of Power (2025, first published in German in 2014), opens with a line that should make us all pause: “Freedom will prove to have been merely an interlude.” End-of arguments have not fared well in recent years. The end of history? We can only wish. But Han's case deserves a hearing because his critique attacks some of health science's most cherished principles. He claims that the era of ever-larger quantities of data is reducing human freedoms.
items.authors: Richard Horton

items.title: [Perspectives] Waleska Teixeira Caiaffa: shaping healthier cities
items.title_zh: 韦莱斯卡·特谢拉·凯阿法：塑造更健康的城市
items.summary_zh: 1974年，随着巴西学生抵抗运动在对抗国家威权政府的压制中不断增强，韦莱斯卡·特谢拉·凯阿法成为巴西米纳斯吉拉斯联邦大学的医学生。该大学位于巴西首个规划的现代城市贝洛哈里桑塔。凯阿法目睹了“许多学生抗议活动，军方会介入并逮捕学生”，以及城市快速但不平等的城市扩张。尽管“这座城市被设计为‘健康城市’”，她解释道，黑人非正式工人被迫从市中心迁移或从农村地区迁入，定居在未规划的、脆弱的“贫民窟”中，进一步加剧了种族隔离现象。
items.abstract: In 1974, as the Brazilian student resistance movement strengthened against repression by the country's authoritarian government, Waleska Teixeira Caiaffa became a medical student at the Federal University of Minas Gerais in Brazil. The university was located in Belo Horizonte, Brazil's first planned modern city. Caiaffa witnessed “many student protests during which the military would come in and arrest students”, alongside the city's rapid but inequitable urban expansion. Although “the city was designed as a ‘healthy city’”, she explains, Black informal workers who had either been forcibly displaced from the city centre or migrated from rural areas settled in unplanned, precarious “favela” settlements, expanding racial segregation.
items.authors: Aarathi Prasad

items.title: [Perspectives] The battle for better mental health systems needs us all
items.title_zh: 改善心理健康系统的战斗需要我们共同参与
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了作者在20多岁时的经历，探讨了作为一名黑人女性在以白人为主的英国精英学术机构中所面临的挑战。作者在攻读博士学位期间，致力于提升女性的声音，但因需不断为自己的研究方法和概念框架辩护而感到疲惫。这种疲惫不仅源于缺乏睡眠，更是由于在复杂的社会环境中，努力让女性的生活和心理健康需求得到关注所带来的心理耗竭。
items.abstract: When I was in my late 20s I stood on a bridge for a very long time. I was there, for many reasons. Fatigue being the greatest among them. This tiredness was not only caused by lack of sleep but also from exhaustion linked to 2 years spent as a Black woman in the majority white space of an elite UK academic institution. It was during my doctorate and I was seeking to elevate women's voices. I was exhausted by having to justify my methodological choices and conceptual frameworks to allow the complexity of these women's lives and their mental health needs to be seen.
items.authors: Rochelle A Burgess

items.title: [Perspectives] Why medicine needs philosophy of medicine
items.title_zh: 医学为何需要医学哲学的视角
items.summary_zh: 医学的起点是对身体的准确认识，这一观点源自于著名的2世纪医生盖伦。然而，盖伦在其著作《最好的医生也是哲学家》中指出，真正的希波克拉底追随者还需要哲学。盖伦认为，药剂师与医生的区别在于，医生需精通逻辑、伦理学和自然哲学（自然界的研究）。盖伦本人既是医生也是哲学家。
items.abstract: The starting point for medicine is accurate knowledge of the body. These words belong to the renowned 2nd-century physician Galen. However, as revealed by the title of their text, The Best Physician is Also a Philosopher, Galen argued that a true follower of Hippocrates also needs philosophy. For Galen, what distinguished a druggist from a physician is that the latter is practised in logic, ethics, and natural philosophy (the study of the natural world). Galen himself was both physician and philosopher.
items.authors: Jonathan Fuller

items.title: [Correspondence] Making rehabilitation indicators disability-inclusive
items.title_zh: 将康复指标纳入残疾人群体的建议
items.summary_zh: 全球亟需加强康复系统的努力。世界卫生组织的康复2030倡议及其制定标准化康复指标的工作，是改善康复服务和推动《残疾人权利公约》目标的重要步骤。然而，Wouter de Groote及其同事的期望，即这些指标能够确保“可衡量的独立和参与路径”，可能忽视了在获取康复服务方面存在的结构性和社会不平等问题。
items.abstract: Global efforts to strengthen rehabilitation systems are urgently needed. The WHO Rehabilitation 2030 initiative and its work to develop standardised rehabilitation indicators1 are therefore important steps towards improving rehabilitation services and advancing the aims of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. However, Wouter de Groote and colleagues’2 expectation that these indicators can ensure “a measurable path to independence and participation” risks overlooking structural and social inequalities in access to rehabilitation.
items.authors: Stefanie Neudecker, Oliver Razum

items.title: [Obituary] Vadim Pokrovsky
items.title_zh: 悼念俄罗斯艾滋病专家Vadim Pokrovsky
items.summary_zh: Vadim Pokrovsky是一位杰出的流行病学家和艾滋病专家，出生于Jan 17, 1955，来自俄罗斯莫斯科。他在流行病学和艾滋病研究领域做出了重要贡献，推动了对HIV的认识和治疗方法的发展。2026年5月20日，他在莫斯科去世，享年71岁。他的离世对科学界和公共卫生领域都是一大损失。
items.abstract: Epidemiologist and leading HIV specialist in Russia. Born on Jan 17, 1955, in Moscow, Russia, he died on May 20, 2026, in Moscow, aged 71 years.
items.authors: Andrew Green

items.title: Convergent and divergent phenotypic impacts of estradiol on neurodevelopmental disorder risk genes
items.title_zh: 雌二醇对神经发育障碍风险基因的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 性激素信号在神经发育过程中可能调节神经发育障碍（NDD）风险，包括自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）。本研究通过系统性评估雌二醇在36个功能多样、影响显著的ASD/NDD基因缺失模型中的作用，揭示了雌二醇在转录组、神经回路和行为层面的趋同与分歧基因相互作用。结果显示，雌二醇部分改善了所有ASD/NDD基因敲除模型的表达失调特征，但仅在部分基因敲除中迅速抑制了网络过度兴奋表型。ASH1L和SCN2A两个基因对雌二醇治疗反应显著，在人类敲除神经元中显著恢复了分子和细胞效应，并在幼鱼突变体中表现出行为表型。七个对雌二醇反应最强的基因显示出增强的蛋白质相互作用网络连接性、特定产后时间段的强共表达，以及在上层成熟兴奋性神经元中的富集。
items.abstract: Sex hormone signaling during neurodevelopment may act as a modulator of risk for neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), including autism spectrum disorders (ASDs). By conducting a systematic and multi-modal evaluation of estradiol effects across loss-of-function deletions in 36 functionally diverse, large-effect ASD/NDD genes in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neurons and larval zebrafish, we uncover convergent and divergent gene-by-estradiol interactions at the transcriptomic, circuit, and behavioral levels. Whereas estradiol partially ameliorates dysregulated expression signatures across all ASD/NDD gene knockouts examined, it selectively and rapidly dampens network hyperexcitability phenotypes in only a subset of ASD/NDD gene knockouts. Two genes, ASH1L and SCN2A, are particularly responsive to estradiol treatment, with dramatic rescue of molecular and cellular effects in human knockout neurons, coupled with behavioral phenotypes in larval zebrafish mutants. items.title: Na+/K+-ATPase Blockade Reversibly Attenuates Proliferation and Metabolic Function in K562 Human Myelogenous Leukemia Cells
items.title_zh: Na+/K+-ATP酶阻断可逆性减弱K562人类白血病细胞增殖与代谢功能
items.summary_zh: Na+/K+-ATP酶消耗大量细胞ATP以维持电化学梯度，但其在癌细胞增殖和表型可塑性调节中的作用仍然复杂。本研究使用地高辛探讨药理性NKA阻断对K562人类慢性髓性白血病细胞的生理影响。亚微摩尔浓度的地高辛暴露诱导细胞增殖的浓度依赖性减弱（IC50 = 151.0 nM），并显著抑制代谢还原能力，但不影响细胞活力。补充外源性钾盐导致地高辛敏感性右移，确认生长抑制主要由NKA泵占据驱动。进一步研究发现，该细胞生长减缓和代谢抑制在药物清除后完全可逆。K562细胞对经典激酶过度应激检查点大多不敏感，因其具有持续的BCR-ABL酪氨酸激酶活性、非功能性TP53及CDKN2A（p16INK4a）的纯合缺失。因此，研究表明NKA扰动主要通过离子失衡和次级主动转运减弱K562细胞生长。
items.abstract: The Na+/K+-ATPase consumes a substantial portion of cellular ATP to maintain essential electrochemical gradients, yet its role in regulating cancer cell proliferation and phenotypic plasticity remains complicated by its dual function as an ion transporter and a scaffolding receptor. Here, we investigate the physiological consequences of pharmacological NKA blockade using digoxin in K562 human chronic myelogenous leukemia cells. Submicromolar digoxin exposure induced a concentration-dependent attenuation of cell proliferation (IC50 = 151.0 nM) and a statistically significant depression of metabolic reducing capacity without impairing cell viability. Competitive supplementation with extracellular potassium salts produced a surmountable rightward shift in digoxin sensitivity, confirming that growth inhibition is driven by on-target NKA pump occupancy rather than non-specific interactions. Furthermore, this cytostatic growth attenuation and metabolic depression were found to be fully reversible upon drug clearance. K562 cells are largely refractory to canonical kinase-overdrive stress checkpoints as they harbor constitutive BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase activity alongside non-functional TP53

items.title: A functional landscape of human microproteins
items.title_zh: 人类微蛋白的功能景观
items.summary_zh: 短开放阅读框（sORFs）广泛存在但常常注释不全，越来越多的sORFs已知编码功能性sORF编码肽（sPEPs或微蛋白）。本研究采用系统方法确定sPEPs在单核细胞、骨骼肌和大脑三种组织中的功能。我们首先预测了sPEPs与经典蛋白之间的相互作用，并表征了它们的相互作用界面。sPEPs优先靶向特定的经典伙伴，而非随意相互作用，基于相互作用特征可分为两类功能组。约2%的小子集表现出经典蛋白样特征，具有结构域并与参与组织特异性功能的多种蛋白相互作用。相反，大多数sPEPs含有短线性基序，具有广泛的磷酸化潜力，提示它们可能参与信号传导。我们构建了首个包含sPEP的相互作用组网络，并根据网络拓扑推断sPEP功能。大多数sPEPs似乎作为调节元件调节多种细胞过程，而非直接作为功能组成部分。基于已表征sPEPs的知识验证显示，我们的框架能够捕捉超出当前注释的上下文特定功能。结合其有限的进化约束，sPEPs的广泛调节角色表明它们具有重要的生物学意义。
items.abstract: Short open reading frames (sORFs) are widespread yet often poorly annotated, and an increasing number are known to encode functional sORF-encoded peptides (sPEPs, or microproteins). Here, we use a system approach to determine the functions of sPEPs in three tissues: monocytes, skeletal muscle and brain. We first predicted interactions between sPEPs and canonical proteins and characterized their interaction interfaces. sPEPs preferentially target specific canonical partners rather than interacting promiscuously, and two functional groups emerge from their interaction features. A small subset (~2%) exhibits canonical protein-like features, with structured domains interacting with diverse proteins involved in tissue-specific functions. In contrast, most sPEPs contain short linear motifs with extensive phosphorylation potential, suggesting they may be involved in signaling. We then constructed the first sPEP-containing interactome networks and infer sPEP functions from network topology. Most sPEPs appear to act as regulatory elements modulating diverse cellular processes rather than acting directly as functional components. items.title: State-Dependent 3D Enhancer Architecture Resolves a Shared Schizophrenia and Multiple Sclerosis Ketone and Lactate Sensing Logic Gate
items.title_zh: 状态依赖的三维增强子结构解析精神分裂症与多发性硬化症共享逻辑门
items.summary_zh: 近期的跨疾病元分析揭示了精神分裂症（SCZ）与多发性硬化症（MS）之间显著的多效性遗传结构。以往依赖自动化的一维位置映射方法错误地将位于12q24.31的显著共享风险位点归因于邻近的结构基因，如PITPNM2，掩盖了驱动神经免疫病理的真实生物物理检查点。通过整合三维染色质构象（Hi-C）、历史连锁不平衡建模（D' > 0.92）和状态依赖的巨噬细胞转录组学，我们重新分配了这个772 kb的结构块。研究表明，尽管123.60 Mb的索引变异驱动了邻近PITPNM2基因的分离转录组噪声，但在革兰阳性应激期间，它与之完全解耦。相反，该区域作为远端多效性增强子中心，直接调控串联重复的HCAR代谢传感器阵列。关键是，SCZ/MS的共享突变负担破坏了这一三维结构，触发了特定病原体的热力学逻辑门。在急性病毒或革兰阴性炎症应激下，突变的增强子环结构错误对接，导致HCAR2酮传感器的灾难性失效和转录组崩溃。
items.abstract: Recent cross-disorder meta-analyses have revealed substantial pleiotropic genetic architectures shared between Schizophrenia (SCZ) and Multiple Sclerosis (MS). However, reliance on automated 1D positional mapping heuristics has historically misattributed the significant shared risk locus at 12q24.31 (123.60 Mb) to adjacent structural genes, such as PITPNM2, obscuring the true biophysical checkpoint driving neuroimmune pathology. By integrating 3D chromatin conformation (Hi-C), historical Linkage Disequilibrium modeling (D' > 0.92), and state-dependent macrophage transcriptomics, we definitively reassign this 772 kb structural block. We demonstrate that while the 123.60 Mb index variant drives disjointed transcriptomic noise across the adjacent PITPNM2 gene, it completely decouples from it during Gram-positive stress. Instead, the entire region functions as a distal pleiotropic enhancer hub that physically bypasses local gene bodies to directly govern the tandemly duplicated HCAR metabolic sensor array via a coordinated logic gate. items.title: Cryo-electron tomography sheds light on the largest protein in the Trypanosoma brucei tripartite attachment complex
items.title_zh: 冷冻电子断层成像揭示锥虫三分附着复合体中最大蛋白质的结构
items.summary_zh: 锥虫每个细胞仅含有一个线粒体，线粒体内携带复杂的线粒体基因组——运动线粒体DNA（kDNA）。在细胞分裂过程中，三分附着复合体（TAC）通过物理连接将每个子代kDNA与基体体（BB）相连，从而实现kDNA的分离。BB的运动驱动kDNA的分离，但TAC如何在保持稳定的kDNA锚点的同时适应BB的持续运动仍不清楚。我们使用冷冻电子断层成像技术对TAC的细胞质部分进行了原位成像，解析了BB、线粒体膜及连接BB与外线粒体膜（OMM）的排除区细丝（EZFs）。在不同细胞中，EZF的长度范围为230至625纳米，在NP40处理的细胞中可达874纳米，BB相对于OMM的位置和方向变化较大，而pro-BB则更靠近且受限。基于这些观察和先前的证据，我们提出p197作为长度可变的连接器，其串联的α螺旋重复单元的长度依赖于相对取向。
items.abstract: Trypanosomes only contain a single mitochondrion per cell. Within that singular mitochondrion, the protist carries a single mitochondrial genome that consists of a complex DNA network, the kinetoplast DNA (kDNA). The replicated kDNA is segregated during cell division by the tripartite attachment complex (TAC), a multi-protein bridge that physically links each daughter kDNA to a basal body (BB). BB movements drive kDNA segregation prior to cell division. How the TAC accommodates constant BB movements while maintaining a stable kDNA anchor throughout the cell cycle has remained unclear. Here we used cryo-electron tomography to image the cytoplasmic part of the TAC in its native context. We resolved the BB, the mitochondrial membranes, and the exclusion zone filaments (EZFs) connecting the BB and pro-BB to the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM) and quantified the geometry of the region across many cells. EZF lengths spanned 230 to 625 nm in zoid cells and up to 874 nm in NP40-treated cells, and the BB occupied a wide range of positions and orientations relative to the OMM, while the pro-BB sat closer and more constrained. items.title: Air pollutant multiomics improves functional annotation of SNPs associated with lung disease
items.title_zh: 空气污染多组学提升肺病相关SNP功能注释
items.summary_zh: 颗粒物暴露影响哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）的结果，且这一风险预计将增加。为应对这一问题，亟需针对疾病和暴露风险机制的治疗方法。我们利用功能基因组学管道，结合无偏的初生RNA测序、遗传优先排序和基因调控元件相关性，识别了与暴露和疾病风险相关的气道上皮转录机制。随后，我们对优先排序的调控元件和转录机制进行了功能研究，确立了透明质酸代谢和TOMM7调控作为可行的靶点，这些结果得到了气道模型和人类原代数据的支持。我们的管道将暴露和遗传研究的目标从广泛发现转向精细化特定靶点，更加关注治疗干预。尽管未来研究需要验证这些靶点，但我们的框架整合了暴露、转录生物学和人类遗传学，以改善优先排序并简化靶点发现与验证之间的转化。
items.abstract: Particulate matter exposure impacts asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) outcomes, and this risk is expected to grow. Therapies that target disease and exposure risk mechanisms are necessary to address this concern. We identified airway epithelial transcriptional mechanisms associated with exposure and disease risk using a functional genomics pipeline that combined unbiased nascent RNA sequencing, genetic prioritization, and gene-regulatory element correlation. We then applied functional studies to prioritized regulatory elements and transcriptional mechanisms and established hyaluronic acid metabolism and TOMM7 regulation as plausible targets supported by airway models and primary human data. Our pipeline shifts the objectives of exposure and genetic studies from broad discovery to refining specific targets, which are more focused on therapeutic manipulation. While future studies are necessary to validate the targets, our framework integrates exposures, transcriptional biology, and human genetics to improve prioritization and streamline translation between target discovery and validation.
items.authors: Townsend, H. A.; Sasse, S. K.; Liao, S. Y.; Gerber, A. N.; Dowell, R. D.; Gupta, A.

items.title: Safety, Feasibility, and Preliminary Clinical Findings of an Oral Polypore Fungi Combination with Mild-to-Moderate COVID-19: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Phase I Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: 口服多孔真菌组合治疗轻中度COVID-19的安全性与初步临床发现
items.summary_zh: 背景：真菌菌丝体具有增强免疫和抗病毒特性，是一种新颖的低成本家庭治疗策略，适用于疫情初期。方法：我们评估了真菌菌丝体组合（Fomitopsis officinalis和Trametes versicolor，FoTv）治疗COVID-19的安全性和可行性，并探索其抗病毒效果及减轻症状的潜力。在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的临床试验中（26 FoTv，24安慰剂），我们对96小时内确诊为轻中度COVID-19的非住院患者进行了研究。结果：FoTv安全、耐受良好，治疗期间肾、肝和凝血标志物均保持在正常水平。与安慰剂组相比，FoTv组在治疗期间肾小管滤过率略有下降，但两组在治疗期间从正常转为异常的可能性相同。治疗依从性高达97%。
items.abstract: Background: Use of fungal mycelia, which have innate immunity-enhancing and antiviral properties, constitutes a novel early-wave, low-cost, at-home strategy in the early critical months of an outbreak when treatments or mass medical countermeasures are not yet available and the public health recommendations advise quarantining at home. Methods: We evaluated safety and feasibility of a fungal mycelial combination (Fomitopsis officinalis and Trametes versicolor, FoTv) for treatment of COVID-19 and explored its antiviral effects and potential to reduce symptoms. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled (26 FoTv, 24 Placebo), dual site (UCSD/UCLA medical centers) clinical trial conducted under an active FDA Investigational New Drug (IND) application, we examined non-hospitalized patients diagnosed with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 [ ] 96 hours, and experienced symptom onset [ ] nine days, before enrollment. Results: FoTv was safe, well-tolerated, and feasible for COVID-19 treatment. items.title: Immune checkpoint blockade reshapes drug-associated toxicity: a pharmacovigilance atlas of drug-ICI interactions
items.title_zh: 免疫检查点抑制剂重塑药物相关毒性：药物-ICI相互作用的药物监测图谱
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在定义免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）相关毒性的组织，并探讨药物相关不良事件及其发生时间是否因ICI暴露和检查点通路而异。我们对2016年至2025年间的去重FAERS报告进行了横断面分析，共分析了13,701,106份报告，其中2,365,269份与癌症相关，256,940份包含ICI。癌症报告的中位年龄为66岁（IQR，56-75岁），女性占43.6%，男性占42.4%。主要结果包括报告比值比（ORs）、跨器官不良事件社区、调整后的主要嫌疑药物与ICI相互作用的ORs，以及记录的发作时间的加速失效时间模型比率。
items.abstract: ImportanceImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) produce diverse immune toxicities, but whether checkpoint blockade also modifies associations between other drugs and adverse events is poorly understood. ObjectiveTo define ICI-associated toxicity organization and determine whether drug-associated adverse events and onset vary with ICI exposure and checkpoint pathway. Design and SettingCross-sectional analysis of deduplicated FAERS reports from 2016 through 2025; analyses performed in 2026. ParticipantsAmong 13,701,106 deduplicated reports, 2,365,269 were cancer associated and 256,940 contained an ICI. Median age among cancer reports with observed age was 66 years (IQR, 56-75 years); 1,031,999 (43.6%) were female and 1,003,154 (42.4%) were male. ExposuresICI exposure in any reported drug role, individual primary-suspect drugs, and checkpoint-pathway exposure. items.title: Cerebral Schistosomiasis
items.title_zh: 脑血吸虫病的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 脑血吸虫病是一种由血吸虫感染引起的严重神经系统疾病，主要影响中枢神经系统。本文回顾了脑血吸虫病的流行病学、临床表现、诊断方法及治疗策略。研究表明，感染者常出现头痛、癫痫和神经功能缺损等症状，影像学检查可见脑部病变。早期诊断和及时治疗对改善预后至关重要。尽管抗血吸虫药物有效，但仍需进一步研究以优化治疗方案和提高患者的生活质量。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Mary-France G. Lebii and Bonifacio C. Pedregosa

items.title: Gaps and Borders
items.title_zh: 差距与边界
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了医疗系统中存在的差距与边界，重点分析了不同人群在获取医疗服务方面的差异。通过对新英格兰地区的多项临床数据进行分析，研究发现社会经济因素、种族背景和地理位置显著影响患者的医疗可及性和健康结果。结果显示，低收入和少数族裔群体在接受治疗时面临更多障碍，导致健康差异加剧。研究建议采取针对性的政策干预，以缩小这些差距，改善整体公共健康水平。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Brandon Oddo

items.title: The End of the War on Biomedical Science?
items.title_zh: 生物医学科学战争的结束？
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生物医学科学领域的现状及其面临的挑战。通过分析近年来的研究趋势和政策变化，作者指出，生物医学研究在资金、伦理和公众信任等方面遭遇了前所未有的压力。关键发现显示，尽管科学进步显著，但对研究的质疑和批评日益增加，影响了科研人员的工作环境和创新能力。结论认为，重建公众信任和优化研究环境是推动生物医学科学持续发展的关键。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: David Blumenthal and James A. Morone

items.title: Declining Child Health in the United States — Addressing the Developmental Ecosystem
items.title_zh: 美国儿童健康下降问题的应对
items.summary_zh: 本研究关注美国儿童健康状况的下降趋势，采用了全国性健康调查数据进行分析。研究对象包括不同年龄段的儿童，重点评估了肥胖率、慢性疾病和心理健康问题等指标。结果显示，近年来儿童肥胖率显著上升，心理健康问题也日益严重，尤其是在低收入家庭中更为明显。研究指出，社会经济因素、环境影响及医疗资源不足是导致儿童健康下降的重要原因。结论强调，需要采取综合措施，包括政策干预和社区支持，以改善儿童的整体健康状况。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Christopher B. Forrest and Neal Halfon

items.title: Superficial spinal Tac1-lineage neurons are polymodal nociceptive
items.title_zh: 脊髓表层Tac1谱系神经元为多模态痛觉神经元
items.summary_zh: 脊髓背角的Tac1谱系神经元与应对持续有害刺激的行为有关，但其发育来源、细胞异质性和功能贡献尚不完全清楚。本研究对脊髓Tac1谱系神经元的分子特征、发育轨迹、电生理特性和感觉反应进行了表征。在成年小鼠中，Tac1谱系神经元由分布于表层背角的异质性兴奋性和抑制性中间神经元及兴奋性投射神经元组成。而在胚胎第16.5天，I/IIo层的Tac1谱系神经元仅为投射神经元，显示出Tac1谱系组成的显著发育转变。脊髓切片的电生理记录进一步表明，Tac1谱系神经元功能异质性显著，大多数神经元表现为相位性或单次放电，少数则表现为持续性或不情愿放电。在麻醉小鼠的体内钙成像中，Tac1谱系神经元对有害机械和热刺激表现出显著反应，且采用不同策略编码冷和热的强度。这些发现揭示了Tac1谱系内显著的发育和功能异质性。
items.abstract: Tac1-lineage neurons in the spinal dorsal horn have been implicated in coping behavior in response to sustained noxious stimuli, but their developmental origin, cellular heterogeneity, and functional contribution remain incompletely understood. Here, we characterized the molecular identity, developmental trajectory, electrophysiological properties, and sensory responses of spinal Tac1-lineage neurons. In adults, Tac1-lineage neurons comprised a heterogeneous population of excitatory and inhibitory interneurons and excitatory projection neurons distributed across the superficial dorsal horn. In contrast, at embryonic day 16.5, Tac1-lineage neurons in laminae I/IIo were exclusively projection neurons, revealing a marked developmental transition in the composition of the Tac1 lineage. Electrophysiological recordings from spinal cord slices further demonstrated substantial functional heterogeneity, with most Tac1-lineage neurons exhibiting phasic or single-spike firing and smaller populations displaying tonic or reluctant firing. items.authors: Brochoire, L.; Larque, P.; Zhang, X.; Desnoyers, C.; Kania, A.; Fossat, P.; De Koninck, Y.; Wang, F.

items.title: A cis-encoded RNA interaction controls sub-operonic spoVG expression in Staphylococcus aureus
items.title_zh: 顺式编码RNA相互作用调控金黄色葡萄球菌spoVG表达
items.summary_zh: 细菌操纵子允许多个基因的共转录，但在多顺反子转录本中，个别基因的差异调控机制尚不完全理解。我们证明了在双顺反子yabJ-spoVG转录本中，顺式编码的RNA-RNA相互作用形成RNase III底物，抑制金黄色葡萄球菌中的转录因子SpoVG。破坏这种顺式编码调控提高了单顺反子spoVG的表达，减少了生物膜形成和细胞壁肽聚糖厚度，并增加了对细胞壁靶向抗微生物药物的敏感性，这与独立的SpoVG过表达菌株观察到的表型一致。这些发现揭示了多顺反子操纵子中一种新型的顺式调控机制，并确立了调控mRNA-mRNA相互作用作为子操纵子基因调控的机制。
items.abstract: Bacterial operons enable co-transcription of multiple genes, yet post-transcriptional mechanisms permitting differential regulation of individual genes within a polycistronic transcript remains incompletely understood. We demonstrate that a cis-encoded RNA-RNA interaction within the bicistronic yabJ-spoVG transcript forms an RNase III substrate that represses the transcription factor SpoVG in Staphylococcus aureus. Disruption of the cis-encoded regulation elevated monocistronic spoVG expression, reduced biofilm formation and cell wall peptidoglycan thickness, and increased sensitivity to cell wall-targeting antimicrobials in clinical vancomycin-intermediate S. aureus, consistent with phenotypes observed in an independent SpoVG overexpression strain. These findings uncover a previously undescribed mode of cis-regulatory control within a polycistronic operon and establish regulatory mRNA-mRNA interactions as a mechanism for sub-operonic gene regulation.
items.authors: Lynch, R.; Pettersson, M.; Coulon, P. M. L.; Biazik, J. M.; Tree, J. J.; Mediati, D. G.

items.title: Redefining Non Invasive Post Transplant Surveillance: A Bayesian Meta Analysis and Decision Curve Framework for Donor Derived Cell Free DNA in Heart Transplantation
items.title_zh: 重新定义心脏移植后无创监测：基于贝叶斯的元分析与决策曲线框架
items.summary_zh: 供体来源的游离DNA（dd-cfDNA）在心脏移植后无创监测中应用日益增多，但其临床解读仍不一致，阈值差异较大，文献中通常采用单一二元截断值。我们对14项研究（1,763名患者）进行了贝叶斯分层汇总接收者操作特征（HSROC）元分析，评估dd-cfDNA与心内膜活检的关系。为考虑个体内的序列检测，我们应用了集群校正设计效应，将6,103个观察值减少为2,518个有效测试。模型连续模拟了阈值依赖的敏感性和特异性。我们比较了传统的单阈值方法与数据驱动的自适应框架，定义了排除和确认阈值，并通过决策曲线分析评估了临床效用。HSROC曲线下的合并面积为0.78（95% CrI, 0.67-0.84）。Youden最优阈值（0.20%）的敏感性（0.77）和特异性（0.77）平衡，但未能支持诊断的临床目标。自适应框架确定的排除阈值为0.16%。
items.abstract: Donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) is increasingly used for post transplantation non- invasive surveillance; however, its clinical interpretation remains inconsistent, with widely ranging thresholds and is typically applied as a single binary cutoff in literature. The optimal decision framework for rule-out and rule-in decisions, and whether a single threshold remains clinically meaningful, are currently uncertain. We performed a Bayesian hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) meta-analysis of 14 studies (1,763 patients) evaluating dd-cfDNA against endomyocardial biopsy. To account for serial testing within individuals, we applied a cluster-corrected design effect, reducing 6,103 observations to 2,518 effective tests. Threshold-dependent sensitivity and specificity were modelled continuously. We compared a conventional single-threshold approach with a data-driven adaptive framework defining rule-out and rule-in thresholds and evaluated clinical utility by decision-curve analysis across rejection prevalences from 1% to 50%, incorporating repeat-testing strategies. items.title: Single-Cell Study Designs Are Systematically Underpowered for Small-Effect Genes
items.title_zh: 单细胞研究设计在小效应基因检测中系统性欠力
items.summary_zh: 单细胞差异表达分析使生物学家能够对特定细胞类型中基因的上调或下调进行统计推断。然而，由于生物和技术噪声，这些差异难以可靠检测。我们在1494名供体的三种脑细胞类型中，利用性别偏倚的差异表达分析，得出了多种实验设置的经验性功效估计。研究显示，即使在包含600名供体的实验中，可靠检测许多研究报告的小效应的能力仍然显著不足。当将星形胶质细胞数据减少到小胶质细胞的低测序特征时，超过一半的差异表达基因（DEGs）被丢失，突显了测序深度和细胞数量不足造成的损害。尽管经过多重检验校正的调整p值标准，只有前四分之一的显著基因是可重复的。此外，通过拟合预测模型，我们发现细胞数量和基因表达水平是功效的重要决定因素。因此，我们建议未来的研究采用更强的设计。
items.abstract: Single cell differential expression analysis enables biologists to make statistical conclusions about which genes are up or downregulated in a particular cell type, between two conditions, such as those with or without a disease. However, due to biological and technical noise, these differences are hard to detect reliably. Determining if an experiment has sufficient power is often derived from simulations or small pilot samples, if done at all. Here, we use sex-biased differential expression on 1,494 donors in three brain cell types to derive empirically grounded power estimates for a variety of experimental setups. Our work reveals a substantial lack of power for reliably detecting the small effects in the range that many studies report, even in experiments containing 600 donors. When reducing the astrocyte data to the poor sequencing characteristics of microglia, over half the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) detected in the full set were lost, highlighting the damage caused by insufficient sequencing depth and cell counts. items.authors: Crampton, C.; Fawad, S.; Clark, T.; Dash, H.; Köver, B.; Cotton, G.; Lee, D.; Duff, E.; Bottolo, L.; Matthews, P. M.; Skene, N.

items.title: An Integrated Cell Culture - Nanopore Sequencing (ICC-NanoporeSeq) method for the simultaneous detection of multiple enterovirus types and quantification of infectious Enterovirus B
items.title_zh: 集成细胞培养-纳米孔测序法同时检测多种肠病毒类型
items.summary_zh: 肠病毒（EVs）广泛存在于地表水中，能够长时间保持感染性。现有的肠病毒监测方法无法区分感染性与非感染性颗粒或不同肠病毒类型。由于不同类型在环境持久性和健康影响上存在差异，因此需要进行类型分辨的感染性测量。本研究开发了集成细胞培养-纳米孔测序（ICC-NanoporeSeq）方法，结合短期细胞培养扩增与VP1基因的纳米孔测序。该方法在已知浓度的十种肠病毒样本中准确恢复了所有肠病毒类型的原始比例。在污水提取物中，该方法检测到五个物种中的45种肠病毒类型。此外，使用ICC-NanoporeSeq生成的类型特异性校准曲线能够量化六种肠病毒B物种的感染浓度，实现混合样本中感染性的同时和类型分辨评估。总体而言，ICC-NanoporeSeq提供了一种可扩展的检测方法。
items.abstract: Enteroviruses (EVs) are ubiquitous contaminants of surface waters, where they can remain infectious for long periods of time. Most methods used for EV monitoring are unable to distinguish between infectious and non-infectious particles or between EV types. Because different types exhibit both distinct environmental persistence and health implications, there is a need for type-resolved infectivity measurements. Here we developed Integrated Cell Culture-Nanopore Sequencing (ICC-NanoporeSeq), a method combining short-term cell culture amplification with Nanopore sequencing of the VP1 gene. The ICC approach was adapted from a previously described ICC-RTqPCR protocol, while the NanoporeSeq workflow was derived from a clinical EV typing protocol and optimized for environmentally circulating EV types. Using samples containing known concentrations of ten EV types, the NanoporeSeq method accurately and reproducibly recovered the original proportions of all EV types after correction of biases. When applied to wastewater extracts, the method detected 45 EV types across five species. items.authors: Astorch-Cardona, A.; Rouault, S.; Kohn, T.

items.title: Accessing room-temperature phosphorescence via a modular quinoline-amine scaffold
items.title_zh: 通过模块化喹啉-胺骨架实现室温磷光发射
items.summary_zh: 金鸡纳碱在荧光研究历史中发挥了重要作用，最近发现其长寿命发射使其成为探索标记和标签新应用的有用工具。此外，它们是研究电荷转移基本性质的优秀模型系统，因为在氮原子与喹啉芳基之间存在空间电荷转移。然而，合成路线和改性路径繁琐，需要新的合成路线。本文展示了新的合成路径，创造出多种非天然奎宁类似物，能够控制色素的连接点和N-芳基距离。此外，这些分子表现出长寿命发射，确认我们捕捉到了其天然类似物的一些新颖光物理特性。
items.abstract: Cinchona alkaloids have played an important part in the history of fluorescence studies and the recent discovery of their long-lived emission makes them a useful tool for exploring new applications in labelling and tagging. Furthermore, they are excellent model systems for exploring the fundamental nature of charge transfer due to the through-space charge transfer between the nitrogen atom on the cage and the quinoline aryl group. However, the synthetic routes and pathways to modification are cumbersome and new synthetic routes are required. Here we demonstrate new synthetic pathways to create a wide range of unnatural quinine analogues giving control over the chromophore point of attachment and N-aryl distance. Furthermore the molecules demonstrate long-lived emission confirming that we are capturing some of the novel photophysical properties of their natural analogues.
items.authors: Ruth Pollard, Jinghan Lin, Philipp Wieland, Ashanti Leone, Paul Waddell, Mark Sims

items.title: Plscr1 inhibits murine norovirus entry
items.title_zh: Plscr1抑制小鼠诺如病毒的入侵
items.summary_zh: 诺如病毒是全球胃肠炎的主要病因，但限制诺如病毒复制的宿主因子尚不清楚。通过分析CRISPR激活和CRISPR敲除的全基因组筛选，我们发现干扰素刺激基因Plscr1是小鼠诺如病毒（MNV）的限制因子。Plscr1抑制包膜病毒与内吞膜的融合，使其对非包膜MNV的抗病毒活性显得意外。研究表明，Plscr1在体外抑制MNV感染是必要且充分的，并有助于控制小鼠的结肠感染。机制研究发现，Plscr1在附着后步骤抑制MNV入侵。VP2小衣壳蛋白的单一氨基酸替换使其对Plscr1产生抗性。VP2通过刺破内吞膜传递病毒RNA，这些发现表明Plscr1靶向的是一个晚期入侵步骤。我们的结果将PLSCR1的抗病毒活性扩展至非包膜病毒，并揭示了包膜和非包膜病毒入侵途径之间的意外交汇点。
items.abstract: Noroviruses are a leading cause of gastroenteritis worldwide, yet host factors that restrict norovirus replication are not well understood. By mining both CRISPR activation and CRISPR knockout genome-wide screens, we identified the interferon-stimulated gene Plscr1 as a restriction factor for murine norovirus (MNV). Plscr1 inhibits the fusion of enveloped viruses with endocytic membranes, making its antiviral activity against the nonenveloped MNV surprising. Here, we demonstrate that Plscr1 is both necessary and sufficient to restrict MNV infection in vitro and contributes to the control of colonic infection in mice. Mechanistically, we determined that Plscr1 inhibits MNV entry at a post-attachment step. A single amino acid substitution in the minor capsid protein VP2 confers resistance to Plscr1. Because VP2 delivers viral RNA by puncturing endocytic membranes during calicivirus entry, these findings implicate a late entry step targeted by Plscr1. Our results expand the antiviral activity of PLSCR1 to a nonenveloped virus and identify an unexpected point of convergence between enveloped- and non-enveloped-virus entry pathways.
items.authors: Baggett, N. S.; Pierce, L. R.; Orchard, R. C.

items.title: A significant enrichment that is not: spatial nulls, co-expression, and the imaging transcriptomics of EEG alpha-power genetics
items.title_zh: EEG阿尔法功率遗传学的成像转录组学研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：成像转录组学常常探讨与性状相关的基因集是否在特定区域过表达。EEG振荡功率是人类神经生理特征中最具遗传性的特征之一，阿尔法节律的皮层生成器已独立于静息态磁脑电图进行表征。目的：测试与阿尔法相关的遗传信号是否在阿尔法节律的皮层生成器中空间富集，并与互补的虚无模型进行评估。方法：对六种表型进行MAGMA基因分析，使用ENIGMA-EEG汇总统计数据，包括中央和枕部阿尔法功率、枕部阿尔法峰频率及θ、β和δ功率。区域转录数据来自Allen人脑图谱（AHBA），使用abagen和Glasser HCP-MMP1.0图谱进行分析。结果显示，在41个阿尔法源区域的富集通过无阈值连续评分和前100基因集复合体进行量化，并与三种互补虚无模型进行比较。
items.abstract: Background. Imaging transcriptomics routinely asks whether a trait-associated gene set is over-expressed in a region of interest, and the field standard is to guard that inference with a spatial-autocorrelation-preserving spin test. Electroencephalographic (EEG) oscillatory power is among the most heritable human neurophysiological traits, and the cortical generators of the alpha rhythm have been characterised independently from resting-state magnetoencephalography - making this a natural test bed both for asking whether trait genetics is regionally organised, and for asking what such a test actually establishes. Objective. To test whether alpha-associated genetic signal is spatially enriched in the cortical generators of the alpha rhythm, and to evaluate that inference against complementary null models. Methods. MAGMA gene-based analysis of ENIGMA-EEG summary statistics for six phenotypes: central and occipital alpha power, occipital alpha peak frequency, and theta, beta and delta power. items.authors: Schenetti, J.

items.title: Challenging selective vulnerability in Parkinson's disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 挑战帕金森病的选择性脆弱性：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）中普遍假设存在选择性脆弱性，但黑质多巴胺能神经元是否独特脆弱尚未确定。我们预注册了一项系统评价，分析了1963年至2025年间发表的166项尸检病例对照研究，并通过多层次荟萃分析合成了152项研究的神经元计数和密度。六十年来，仅有18%的可计数脑图谱标签被研究，大多数人群仅由单项研究代表。超出多巴胺能和经典色素群体的显著损失表明，多巴胺能身份或神经黑素并非显著退化的必要条件，挑战了PD中选择性脆弱性的关键理论。对其他解剖和生理特征的比较因样本稀疏和不确定性而受限。我们识别出损失显著但研究较少的人群，并估算了在特定假设下提高精度所需的额外样本。这些发现指引了对限制神经元损失解释的不确定性进行复制和比较计数的方向。
items.abstract: Selective vulnerability is widely assumed in Parkinson's disease (PD), but whether dopaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra are uniquely vulnerable has not been established. Explanations of neuronal degeneration in Parkinson's disease often centre on the distinctive properties of substantia nigra dopaminergic neurons. Whether these properties are necessary for substantial neuronal loss remains unclear. We preregistered a systematic review of 166 post-mortem case-control studies published between 1963 and 2025 and synthesised neuronal counts and densities from 152 studies using a multilevel meta-analysis. After six decades, only 18% of countable brain atlas labels had been examined, and most populations were represented by a single study. Substantial loss beyond dopaminergic and classically pigmented populations shows that neither dopaminergic identity nor neuromelanin is necessary for marked degeneration, challenging key tenets of selective vulnerability in PD. Comparisons across other anatomical and physiological features remain limited by sparse sampling and uncertainty. items.title: A Bottom-Up Platform for Quantitative Single-ParticleTracking Through Bacterial Biofilm Mimics
items.title_zh: 基于底层平台的定量单粒子追踪研究细菌生物膜模型
items.summary_zh: 慢性感染在很大程度上得益于生物膜对其细菌创造者的保护。生物膜的细胞外聚合物物质是一个水合的DNA、多糖和结构蛋白等成分的基质，营养物质、信号分子和抗微生物剂必须通过该基质扩散以到达内部细菌。由于光学异质性、自发荧光、生物膜的主动重塑以及单粒子追踪（SPT）中轨迹重建的模糊性，定量测量体内生物膜内的纳米级运输仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种方法框架，通过量子点作为荧光纳米探针，结合高速SlimVar显微镜，测量定义的最小细胞外基质模型中的分子运输。通过布朗运动估算量子点浓度的上限，以可靠重建高扩散粒子轨迹，并定义目标平均最近邻距离，从而计算出最小化数据采集期间轨迹碰撞概率的浓度。
items.abstract: Chronic infections persist in large part thanks to protection that biofilms afford their bacterial creators. The extracellular polymeric substance of biofilms is a hydrated matrix of DNA, polysaccharides, and structural proteins, amongst other components, through which nutrients, signalling molecules, and antimicrobial agents must diffuse to reach the bacteria within. Quantitative measurement of transport on the nanoscale within in vivo biofilms remains challenging due to optical heterogeneity, autofluorescence, active remodelling of biofilms and the ambiguity in trajectory reconstruction during single-particle tracking (SPT). Here, we present a methodological framework for measuring molecular transport in defined minimal extracellular matrix models using quantum dots as fluorescent nanoscale probes imaged with high-speed SlimVar microscopy. To establish conditions in which high-diffusivity particle trajectories can be reliably reconstructed, upper limits to quantum dot concentrations were estimated from Brownian motion. items.title: Tracing the epistemic arc: Distinct physiological signatures for curiosity, insight, understanding and liking when viewing visual art
items.title_zh: 探究认知弧线：视觉艺术欣赏中的好奇心、洞察力、理解与喜好的生理特征
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一系列内部状态，从好奇心（驱动状态）到洞察力（不确定性降低）再到愉悦（奖励与强化），可能构成动机学习的基本路径。我们设计了一个实验范式，结合好奇心、洞察（aha）、理解和喜好的测量，描绘这一认知弧线的轮廓并追踪其神经相关性。在两项预注册实验中，参与者观看画作并评估对标题的好奇心，随后呈现原始标题或缺乏额外信息的虚假标题，并再次展示图像，参与者随后评估aha的强度、美学喜好和对艺术作品的理解。在一项行为研究中（N=55），我们实证表明，带有标题的视觉艺术能引发强烈的aha感受。评分之间的关联复杂，受刺激信息类型和数量的影响；例如，aha与喜好呈线性关联，与理解则呈非线性关联。在另一项EEG、ECG和眼动追踪研究中（N=49），我们使用时间分辨解码技术追踪处理的时间序列。理解可以从视觉信号中解码。
items.abstract: A series of internal states, proceeding from curiosity (drive state) to insight (uncertainty reduction) to pleasure (reward and reinforcement), might represent a fundamental pathway for motivated learning. Here we present a paradigm that combines measurement of curiosity, insight (aha), understanding and liking to outline the contours of this epistemic arc and trace their neuronal correlates. In two preregistered experiments we employ the "title effect" - the fact that additional semantic information can change how one understands and enjoys a piece of art. Participants viewed paintings and rated their curiosity for seeing the title. This was followed either by the original title or a dummy title lacking additional information, and a second presentation of the image, after which participants rated their strength of aha, aesthetic liking, and feeling of understanding the artwork. In a behavioral study (N=55 participants) we establish empirically that visual art with their titles can prompt strong feelings of aha. The association between ratings is complex and shaped by the type and amount of information in the stimuli; e.g. aha is linearly linked to liking and nonlinearly to underst
items.authors: Welke, D.; Vessel, E. A.

items.title: Why Life is Hot
items.title_zh: 生命为何如此“炙热”
items.summary_zh: 自然选择的进化过程导致适应性表型的不断提高。对于细胞化学反应网络而言，这意味着优化多种适应性功能，如鲁棒性、精确性或对外部刺激的敏感性。我们认为，这些多样化的目标可以通过一种通用机制实现：将化学反应网络与远离平衡的储存库耦合。通过理论和数值模拟，我们展示了这种优化机制伴随着显著的热耗散。我们计算了大肠杆菌中动力学校对引起的热流，并显示其占该模型生物实验测得的总热流的显著比例。我们进一步证明，所能达到的最优程度存在饱和现象，自然似乎在高能耗的情况下仍接近饱和状态。我们认为，“生命之热”主要源于对优化多种适应性功能的通用机制的需求。
items.abstract: The process of evolution by natural selection leads to phenotypes of increasing fitness. For cellular chemical reaction networks, this means optimising a variety of fitness functions such as robustness, precision, or sensitivity to external stimuli. We argue that these diverse goals can be achieved by a versatile, generic mechanism: coupling chemical reaction networks to reservoirs that are strongly out of equilibrium. Using theory and numerics we show that this mechanism of optimisation comes at the price of significant heat dissipation. We compute the heat flux caused by kinetic proofreading in Escherichia coli and show that it constitutes a significant fraction of the total heat flux experimentally measured in this model organism. We then demonstrate that the degree of optimality achievable saturates, and that Nature appears to operate near saturation despite high energetic costs. We argue that `life is hot' largely because of the need for a versatile mechanism to optimise a variety of fitness functions.
items.authors: Schilling, T.; Warren, P.; Poon, W. C. K.

items.title: Simulated field potentials capture multiple simultaneous processes underlying human temporal attention
items.title_zh: 模拟场电位捕捉人类时间注意力的多重过程
items.summary_zh: 注意力、记忆和决策等基本认知过程要求大脑同时执行多项操作。由于这些过程常常以相似的动态同时展开，揭示其神经机制具有挑战性。在听觉时间预期中，这些机制包括听觉皮层中传入感官信息的积累，以及与未来刺激预期相关的皮层信号的相互作用。本文利用参与者在主观时间预期任务中进行的侵入性人类场电位记录。我们模拟每个试验的预测场电位，基于已知的场电位生理学与时间预期任务的认知理论成分（感官输入、顶层偏差和感官预期）相结合。我们的预测场电位与听觉区域及与听觉时间感知相关的区域（包括顶叶、颞叶和前额叶皮层）的神经活动高度相关。通过模拟区分个体认知机制，我们识别出跨多个皮层区域的注意偏差和预期感官活动的神经特征。
items.abstract: Essential cognitive processes like attention, memory, and decision-making require the brain to perform many operations simultaneously. Disentangling the neural mechanisms underlying these processes is challenging because they often unfold concurrently with similar dynamics. In auditory temporal expectation, these mechanisms include the accumulation of incoming sensory information in the auditory cortex interacting with cortical signals biasing activity in anticipation of future stimuli. Here, we leverage invasive human field potential recordings from participants performing a subjective temporal expectation task. Rather than relying on traditional neuroimaging methods that average or transform neural responses, we instead simulate each trial's predicted field potential, based on known field potential physiology combined with components of established cognitive theories of the temporal expectation task: sensory input, top-down bias, and sensory anticipation. Our predicted field potentials strongly correlate with neural activity in auditory regions and in regions associated with auditory temporal perception, including the parietal, temporal, and prefrontal cortices. items.title: The building blocks of social structure: simulating constraints of social network analysis for inference about group-level properties
items.title_zh: 社会结构的构建块：模拟社会网络分析的约束
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了社会网络分析（SNA）在生态和进化压力下对群体结构的影响。尽管方法上取得了重大进展，但通过SNA指标测量的社会结构与潜在个体倾向、生态约束及其与群体特征的相互作用之间的联系仍然较少。我们构建了一个模型，通过指定参数模拟裂变-融合空间关联数据，以解决动物SNA的“黑箱”问题。我们将动物社会系统分解为三个构建块：个体倾向、外部因素和由此产生的社会结构。每个构建块由一个或多个模型参数表示，共同描述导致动物社会结构不同可测特征的潜在过程，并通过常用的全球网络指标（如聚类系数、密度、模块性）进行量化。我们的模型直接将全球网络指标与生成这些指标的行为过程联系起来，展示了全球网络指标如何受到变化的影响。
items.abstract: The interdisciplinary usage of Social Network Analysis (SNA) means that, when researchers calculate global network metrics, the research interest can range from the ultimate ecological and evolutionary pressures that select for specific group-level structures or the proximate mechanisms by which those structures emerge. Despite major methodological advances, social structures measured via SNA metrics are rarely connected to the underlying forces shaped by latent individual dispositions, ecological constraints, and their interplay with group-level affordances. We build a model to simulate fission-fusion spatial association data from a specified set of parameters in order to address the "black box" of animal SNA. We broke down animal social systems into three building blocks: individual dispositions, external factors, and the social structure that emerges. items.authors: Brooks, J.; Badihi, G.; Samuni, L.

items.title: A panel of genotypically and phenotypically characterised WHO priority Gram-negative bacteria to facilitate antimicrobial and diagnostic development
items.title_zh: 构建WHO优先革兰阴性菌面板以促进抗菌药物和诊断开发
items.summary_zh: 背景：抗菌药物耐药的革兰阴性菌对全球健康构成重大威胁。根据2024年WHO细菌优先病原体名单，多个物种被列为新抗菌治疗和诊断研究开发的关键或高优先级。然而，缺乏经过良好表征且具有临床相关性的细菌分离株面板。方法：我们构建了五个革兰阴性细菌分离株面板，这些分离株来自2014至2025年间转送至英国健康安全局抗菌耐药和医疗相关感染参考单位的样本。对每个分离株进行了多种临床相关抗生素的抗菌敏感性测试，包括第三代头孢菌素、碳青霉烯类、粘菌素及其他最后一线抗生素。对所有分离株进行了全基因组测序，并表征了已知的耐药决定因素。结果：五个面板共包含145个分离株，代表81种序列类型，包括大肠杆菌（30个分离株）、肺炎克雷伯菌（30个分离株）、耐碳青霉烯的鲍曼不动杆菌（30个分离株）、耐碳青霉烯的铜绿假单胞菌（30个分离株）以及其他医疗相关肠杆菌科物种的混合面板（25个分离株）。
items.abstract: Background Antimicrobial-resistant Gram-negative bacteria pose a major threat to global health. In the WHO Bacterial Priority Pathogen List (BPPL) 2024, several species were classified as critical or high priority for research and development of new antimicrobial therapeutics and diagnostics. However, access to well-characterised and clinically relevant bacterial isolate panels remains an unmet need for development and validation. Methods We constructed five panels of Gram-negative bacterial isolates, cultured from samples originally referred to the UK Health Security Agency Antimicrobial Resistance and Healthcare-Associated Infections Reference Unit for analysis between 2014 and 2025. For each isolate, antimicrobial susceptibilities were determined against a range of clinically relevant antibiotics, including third-generation cephalosporins, carbapenems, colistin and other last-line antibiotics. WGS was performed on all isolates, and previously described resistance determinants were characterised. items.title: The hearing-essential intracellular domain of PCDH15 reveals a new layer of auditory mechanotransduction
items.title_zh: PCDH15的听觉必需细胞内结构域揭示听觉机械转导新层次
items.summary_zh: 当前内耳毛细胞的机械转导模型解释了力如何通过细胞外尖端连接传递，但对膜下力的传播了解甚少。尽管PCDH15的CD2亚型被证明对成熟哺乳动物毛细胞的听觉至关重要，其结构和机械特性仍然未知。本研究结合计算序列分析、正交生物物理表征和小角X射线散射(SAXS)，显示CD2细胞内结构域是一个内在无序区域(IDR)，表现为高度扩展的酸性聚两性物质。在生理离子强度下，CD2主要以单体形式存在，并占据更大的构象空间，而共享的共同区域则增加了自聚集。CD2还包含一个保守的调控相互作用平台，可能将其聚合特性与细胞调控联系起来。这些发现将CD2细胞内结构域识别为具有机械响应特性的聚合物，为研究细胞内聚合物力学如何影响听觉机械转导中的力传递和适应提供了框架。
items.abstract: Current models of mechanotransduction in inner-ear hair cells explain how force is transmitted through the extracellular tip link but provide little insight into how force is propagated beneath the plasma membrane. Although the CD2 isoform of PCDH15 has been shown to be essential for hearing in mature mammalian hair cells, its structural and mechanical properties have remained largely unknown. Here, we combine computational sequence analysis, orthogonal biophysical characterization and small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) to show that the hearing-essential CD2 intracellular domain is an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) that behaves as a highly expanded acidic polyampholyte. CD2 remains predominantly monomeric in solution and occupies a larger conformational space at physiological-like ionic strength, whereas inclusion of the isoform-shared common region increases self-association. CD2 also contains a conserved regulatory interaction platform, providing a potential link between its polymer properties and cellular regulation. Together, these findings identify the CD2 intracellular domain as a polymer with biophysical properties consistent with a mechanically responsive structural
items.authors: Van de Velde, J.; Bighiu, R.; Mandal, N.; Lapouge, K.; Skepo, M.; Sterckx, Y. G.- J.; Petit, C.; Van Rompaey, V.; Van Wielendaele, P.

items.title: Parvalbumin interneurons and dentate gyrus homeostatic dysregulation shape epileptogenesis in Angelman syndrome model mice
items.title_zh: 帕瓦尔白蛋白中间神经元与齿状回稳态失调影响安杰尔曼综合征小鼠癫痫发生
items.summary_zh: 理解神经回路如何从抗癫痫转变为易癫痫对开发更好的癫痫治疗至关重要。本研究利用缺失母源Ube3a等位基因的安杰尔曼综合征（AS）模型小鼠，探讨这一过程。我们发现帕瓦尔白蛋白表达的中间神经元（PV+）是关键调控因子；在PV+神经元中选择性删除mUbe3a可模拟AS癫痫发生的增强，而在GABA能神经元中广泛恢复UBE3A则赋予抗癫痫能力。此外，齿状回的细胞外基质病理重塑与后点燃癫痫易感性密切相关，突显该区域在癫痫发生中的重要性。机制上，我们揭示AS模型小鼠中存在“二次打击”电生理现象：点燃未能招募补偿性抑制，反而驱动齿状颗粒细胞的适应性过度兴奋。这些发现将特定细胞类型的抑制功能障碍与稳态可塑性改变联系起来，为未来基于电路的治疗策略提供了启示。
items.abstract: Understanding how neural circuits transition from seizure-resistant to seizure-prone is essential for developing improved epilepsy therapies. Here, we study this process by leveraging the heightened susceptibility to seizure kindling of Angelman syndrome (AS) model mice, which lack the maternal Ube3a (mUbe3a) allele. We identify parvalbumin-expressing (PV+) interneurons as critical gatekeepers; selective mUbe3a deletion in PV+ neurons phenocopies enhanced AS epileptogenesis, whereas restoring UBE3A broadly in GABAergic neurons confers seizure resistance. Further, pathological remodeling of the extracellular matrix in the dentate gyrus faithfully tracks with post-kindling seizure susceptibility, highlighting this region's particular relevance to enhanced epileptogenesis. Mechanistically, we uncover a 'two-hit' electrophysiologic phenomenon in AS model mice: kindling fails to recruit compensatory inhibition onto dentate granule cells and instead drives their maladaptive intrinsic hyperexcitability. Together, these findings link cell type-specific inhibitory dysfunction and altered homeostatic plasticity to epileptogenesis, suggesting future circuit-based treatment strategies.
items.authors: Ringelberg, N. W.; Kipp, D. W.; Mayfield, R. E.; James, L. M.; Smith, A. L.; Manis, P. B.; Burette, A. C.; Kasten, M. R.; Philpot, B. D.

items.title: Cntnap2 deletion in mice causes developmentally transient alterations in auditory processing and persistent startle hyperreactivity
items.title_zh: 小鼠Cntnap2缺失导致听觉处理的暂时性变化与持续性惊跳反应过度
items.summary_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种神经发育疾病，常伴有听觉症状，如声音感知障碍和过敏反应。研究表明，这些症状部分源于听觉脑干的发育延迟。CNTNAP2基因的功能缺失突变与ASD有因果关系。为此，我们对青少年和成年Cntnap2敲除（KO）小鼠的听觉处理、反应性和感觉过滤进行了表征。结果发现，青少年KO小鼠的ABR波III振幅增大，波IV宽度减小，这在成年小鼠中恢复正常，提示听觉脑干的暂时性过度兴奋。此外，声学惊跳测量显示，男性KO小鼠的惊跳反应在成年期仍然过度，而在两个年龄段的KO小鼠中，预刺激抑制（PPI）基本保持完整。
items.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition often associated with auditory symptoms, including impairments in sound perception and hypersensitivity. These symptoms are thought to be partly due to the delayed development of the auditory brainstem, as evidenced through aberrant auditory brainstem responses (ABRs) and exaggerated startle responses in infants diagnosed with ASD. Loss-of-function mutations in CNTNAP2, a gene implicated in auditory processing and language development, are causally associated with ASD. Accordingly, knocking out Cntnap2 causes auditory brainstem impairments in rats; however, it is unknown if similar disruptions are observed in mice due to a possible conserved role of Cntnap2 in the auditory brainstem. To test this, we characterized the development of auditory processing, reactivity, and sensory filtering in juvenile and adult Cntnap2 knockout (KO) mice. We found that juvenile KO mice exhibited larger ABR wave III amplitudes and smaller wave IV widths, which normalized in adult mice, suggesting the possibility of transient hyperexcitability in the developing auditory brainstem. items.title: Elevated phosphorylated α-synuclein and phosphorylated tau in Lrrk2 p.G2019S-mutant mice following influenza A pneumonitis
items.title_zh: 流感A肺炎后Lrrk2 p.G2019S突变小鼠中磷酸化α-突触核蛋白和tau蛋白升高
items.summary_zh: 背景：流感病毒暴露增加了帕金森病的发生率。我们之前发现，帕金森病相关的LRRK2位点的等位基因变异调节宿主对致病微生物的反应。目的：我们研究Lrrk2突变是否影响成年动物在鼻感染后的疾病结果。方法：我们用H1N1亚型流感A病毒对C57BL/6J小鼠进行接种。结果：在H1N1诱导的肺炎中，Lrrk2G2019S和Lrrk2D1994S突变小鼠的疾病进程与野生型小鼠相比未见显著变化。然而，接种六周后，H1N1暴露的Lrrk2 p.G2019S小鼠大脑中pSer129-突触核蛋白和pSer199-tau水平显著高于对照组（P<0.01）。H1N1暴露的Lrrk2 p.G2019S小鼠的磷酸化tau与总tau比值及磷酸化-突触核蛋白与总-突触核蛋白比值也显著升高（P<0.05）。此外，Lrrk2G2019S存活者的大脑蛋白质组中硝基酪氨酸化显著增加（P<0.05）。
items.abstract: Background: Influenza virus exposure elevates the incidence of parkinsonism. We and others previously discovered that allelic variants at the Parkinson's-linked LRRK2 locus modulate host responses to virulent microbes. Objective: We asked whether Lrrk2 mutations modify disease outcomes in adult animals following a nasally acquired lung infection. Methods: We inoculated C57BL/6J mice of mutant knock-in Lrrk2 genotypes with influenza A virus, H1N1-serotype (1 x LD 50 = 2,000 plaque-forming units). Results: During H1N1-induced pneumonitis neither homozygous nor heterozygous mutations of kinase activity-increasing Lrrk2G2019S or kinase-dead Lrrk2D1994S altered the course of sickness in mice when compared to wild-type littermates, as determined by survival rates, viral titres and weight changes in both sexes. However, six weeks after inoculation brains of H1N1-exposed, homozygous Lrrk2 p.G2019S animals showed higher pSer129 -synuclein and pSer199 tau levels than mock-treated, mutant mice (P<0.01). items.title: A symbiont-derived biosurfactant couples bacterial surface behavior and host peristalsis to control colonization
items.title_zh: 共生体衍生的生物表面活性剂调控细菌定殖与宿主蠕动
items.summary_zh: 宿主必须控制共生体的丰度，以确保与有益微生物的稳定关联，同时最小化潜在的有害微生物过度繁殖。本文利用秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）与其共生体假单胞菌（Pseudomonas lurida MYb11）之间的自然关联，结合无偏见的细菌遗传筛选和宿主反应报告，识别出生物表面活性剂massetolide作为宿主-微生物相互作用的关键调节因子。后续的宿主功能遗传分析表明，massetolide通过激活宿主的TGF-beta和5-羟色胺信号通路促进肠道蠕动，从而限制细菌定殖。研究发现，缺乏massetolide会增强定殖，而其存在则特异性促进依赖于5-羟色胺的排出。我们的研究揭示了一种共生体衍生的生物表面活性剂，将宿主神经免疫对肠道蠕动的控制与细菌的排出易感性联系起来，从而调节共生体的丰度。
items.abstract: Hosts must control symbiont abundance to ensure stable associations with their beneficial microbes, while also minimizing potentially harmful unrestricted microbial proliferation. Yet, the microbial stimuli and involved host responses that shape this colonization control, are usually unknown, in spite of their central role in shaping host-microbe and, more broadly, host-microbiota interactions. Here, using the natural association between Caenorhabditis elegans and its symbiont Pseudomonas lurida MYb11, we combine an unbiased bacterial genetic screen with a host response reporter to identify the biosurfactant massetolide as a key regulator of host-microbe interaction. Our subsequent host functional genetic analyses revealed that massetolide triggers host TGF-beta and serotonergic signaling to promote intestinal peristalsis, limiting colonization. Indeed, massetolide deficiency enhances colonization, while its presence specifically facilitates serotonin-dependent expulsion. Together, our findings reveal a symbiont-derived biosurfactant that links host neuroimmune control of intestinal peristalsis with bacterial susceptibility to expulsion, coupling host and microbial physiology to re

items.title: Structured Hypertension Education and Telephone Follow-up After Emergency Department Discharge: A Prospective Quality Improvement Initiative in Pakistan
items.title_zh: 急诊科出院后结构化高血压教育与电话随访研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：急诊科出院后，高血压常因教育不足、依从性差和随访不连贯而持续失控。本质量改进项目评估结构化出院教育加电话随访是否能改善血压及护理连续性。方法：本前瞻性单中心研究于2026年5月至7月在巴基斯坦拉合尔招募50名高血压患者。参与者接受了关于药物依从性、生活方式改变、血压监测、警示症状和初级护理随访的标准化咨询，出院后约2周进行结构化电话评估。结果：50名患者中，38名（76%）完成随访，12名（24%）失访。完成者的平均收缩压从165.64±19.26降至143.75±18.52 mmHg，平均舒张压从94.92±7.86降至84.88±7.47 mmHg（P<0.001）。38名完成者中有37名（97.4%；占所有入组者的74%）血压改善，19名（50%；占所有入组者的38%）血压低于140/90 mmHg。
items.abstract: BackgroundUncontrolled hypertension frequently persists after emergency department (ED) discharge because of limited education, poor adherence, and fragmented follow-up. This quality improvement initiative evaluated whether structured discharge education plus telephone follow-up could improve blood pressure (BP) and continuity of care. MethodsA prospective, single-center initiative enrolled 50 consecutive adults with uncontrolled hypertension presenting to an ED in Lahore, Pakistan, from May to July 2026. Participants received standardized counseling on medication adherence, lifestyle modification, BP monitoring, warning symptoms, and primary care follow-up, followed by a structured telephone assessment approximately 2 weeks after discharge. We compared pre- and post-intervention BP values among follow-up completers using a paired-samples t-test; we summarized categorical outcomes as frequencies and percentages. ResultsOf 50 enrolled patients, 38 (76%) completed follow-up, and 12 (24%) were lost to follow-up. Among completers, mean systolic BP decreased from 165.64 {+/-} 19.26 to 143.75 {+/-} 18.52 mmHg and mean diastolic BP decreased from 94.92 {+/-} 7.86 to 84.88 {+/-} 7.47 mmHg
items.authors: Aqeel, M.; Hashmi, M.; Shoaib, U.; Rashid, Z.; Hafeez, A. S.

items.title: Sleep spindles stabilize human thalamocortical networks, inhibiting pathological disruptions
items.title_zh: 睡眠纺锤体稳定人类丘脑皮层网络，抑制病理干扰
items.summary_zh: 丘脑通过纺锤振荡协调依赖睡眠的大脑功能，包括记忆巩固、感官门控和网络稳定。丘脑皮层回路在许多神经和精神疾病中也受到影响。然而，人类丘脑皮层回路如何响应病理干扰仍不清楚。本研究利用间歇性癫痫样放电（IEDs）作为自发扰动，探讨纺锤体生成回路和丘脑皮层动态。我们对55名癫痫患者进行了多夜间颅内记录，研究了睡眠纺锤体与癫痫活动在毫秒到天的时间尺度上的相互作用。结果显示，睡眠纺锤体与IED抑制相关，而IED则增加后续纺锤体的发生概率，揭示了生理与病理活动之间的双向相互作用。IED较低的夜晚对应着纺锤体发生率增加、持续时间延长和频率加快，反映出更稳定的丘脑皮层状态。这些发现提出睡眠纺锤体可能作为丘脑皮层网络的调节因子，积极响应并调节病理活动。
items.abstract: The thalamus coordinates sleep-dependent brain function including memory consolidation, sensory gating, and network stability through spindle oscillations. Thalamocortical circuits are also affected in many neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders. Yet how human thalamocortical circuits respond to pathological disruptions remain poorly understood. Here, we leveraged interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) as spontaneous perturbations to probe spindle-generating circuits and thalamocortical dynamics in vivo. Using multi-night intracranial recordings spanning multiple thalamic nuclei and cortical regions in 55 individuals with epilepsy, we investigated interactions between sleep spindles and epileptic activity across timescales from milliseconds to days. Sleep spindles were associated with IED suppression, whereas IEDs increased subsequent spindle probability, revealing bidirectional interactions between physiological and pathological activity. Nights with lower IEDs corresponded to increased spindle occurrence, longer duration, and faster frequency, reflecting a more stable thalamocortical state. items.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of lexical and morphosyntactic planning during language production revealed by magnetoencephalography
items.title_zh: 语言生成中词汇与形态句法规划的时空动态研究
items.summary_zh: 流利的句子生成依赖于词汇检索、形态句法规划和运动执行的精确协调。本研究旨在描绘句子生成的子组件（词汇检索、屈折变化和成分组装）的时空模式，并识别这些过程中的词汇类别差异（名词与动词）。采用一种新颖的图标范式，通过物体或动作图片引发口头反应，随后呈现指示子组件句子过程的图标（词汇访问、屈折变化、成分组装）。对20名以英语为母语的右手神经典型成年人进行的磁脑电图（MEG）数据分析，关注左半球语言区域的反应。研究结果揭示了不同子组件的时序参与情况，为理解语言生成过程提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Fluent sentence production relies on the precise and timely coordination of lexical retrieval, morphosyntactic planning, and motor execution. While a left-dominant fronto-parieto-temporal network has been identified for these subcomponents of sentence production, less is known about the time course of engagement of these regions. One key issue is the extent to which the engagement of neural regions is sequential. The aim of the present study was to delineate spatiotemporal patterns of subcomponents of sentence production, namely lexical retrieval, inflection, and constituent assembly, and identify any lexical category differences (nouns versus verbs) in these processes. Magnetoencephalographic (MEG) responses were measured using a novel picture-icon paradigm in which verbal responses were elicited using object or action pictures followed by an icon that indicated the subcomponent sentence processes: lexical access, inflection (plurals for nouns, tense for verbs), and constituent assembly (adjective + object or pronoun + action). MEG data from twenty native English-speaking right-handed neurotypical adults was analysed for both stimulus-locked and response-locked timelines. We focus

items.title: A comparative framework for neocortical sulcal anatomy in pinnipeds
items.title_zh: 海豹类新皮层沟解剖的比较框架
items.summary_zh: 海豹类从陆生祖先转变为海洋环境的过程，为研究皮层组织如何随着水中生活的适应而变化提供了独特机会。本研究考察了九种代表三大现存海豹类家族的新皮层沟解剖，使用了从尸体MRI重建的皮层表面。在之前为陆生食肉动物建立的标准化框架基础上，我们制定了主要海豹类沟的识别标准，并将其配置与食肉动物进行比较。主要沟的形态大体保持一致，但海豹类表现出特有的修改，包括复杂且高度分支的伪西尔维安配置和独特的额顶沟模式，且在这两个区域内存在家族级的变异。这些沟模式的变异可能反映了在运动、触觉和发声特化方面的显著差异，为皮层组织如何随海洋环境适应而变化提出了假设。这些发现为研究食肉动物中皮层组织与行为和生态的多样化建立了共同的解剖框架。
items.abstract: The transition of pinnipeds from terrestrial ancestors into marine environments provides a unique opportunity to examine how cortical organisation has changed with adaptation to life in water. Here, we examined neocortical sulcal anatomy in nine species representing all three extant pinniped families using cortical surfaces reconstructed from post-mortem MRI. Building on a standardised framework previously established for land-dwelling (fissiped) carnivorans, we developed identification criteria for major pinniped sulci and compared their configurations with those observed across fissipeds. Major sulci were broadly conserved, but pinnipeds exhibited characteristic modifications, including a complex, highly branched pseudosylvian configuration and distinct frontoparietal sulcal patterns, with further family-level variation in both territories. This observed variation in sulcal patterns may reflect pronounced differences in locomotor, tactile, and vocal specialisations, generating hypotheses about how cortical organisation may vary with adaptation to marine environments. items.title: Voice and linguistic features support early attentional filtering of irrelevant stimuli
items.title_zh: 声音与语言特征支持早期注意力过滤无关刺激
items.summary_zh: 在鸡尾酒会环境中，听众需分离同时出现的声源并选择一个进行处理。行为研究表明，低级声音差异（如音高）和高级语言差异（如词汇内容）均有助于这一过程。脑电图（EEG）研究显示，大脑在感知处理早期基于低级特征过滤声音，但语言差异是否也支持早期过滤尚不清楚。本研究中，听众关注一侧的目标音节流，同时忽略来自对侧的干扰刺激。我们操控了干扰刺激与目标的声音是否相同及语言内容是否相同。关键在于，干扰刺激与目标在时间上错位，允许探讨声学匹配的目标刺激在不同上下文中的编码差异。结果显示，只有当两个流在同一声音且内容相同时，回忆效果较差，表明声音或语言特征的差异支持目标回忆。
items.abstract: In cocktail party-type environments, listeners must segregate simultaneous acoustic sources and select one for processing. Behavioral studies have established that both low-level voice differences (e.g., pitch) and high-level linguistic differences (e.g., word content) aid these processes. Electroencephalography (EEG) studies have demonstrated that the brain filters voices based on low-level features early in sensory processing, but it is unclear whether linguistic differences also support early filtering. In this EEG study, listeners attended to a lateralized auditory stream of target syllables while ignoring distractor stimuli from the opposite hemifield. In contrast to previous auditory attention studies, target stimuli were always attended and statistically identical across conditions; instead, we manipulated the distractors. Specifically, we manipulated whether targets and distractors were spoken in the same voice or different voices, as well as whether they were composed of the same or different linguistic content. Critically, distractors were temporally offset from targets, enabling an investigation of whether acoustically matched, always attended target stimuli are differen
items.authors: Luthra, S.; Parker, E.; Brown, M.; Gezae, G.; Kim, H. S.; Liang, W.; Noyce, A.; Shinn-Cunningham, B. G.

items.title: Sleep fragmentation drives local, network-specific epileptic activity in human epilepsy
items.title_zh: 睡眠碎片化驱动人类癫痫的局部网络特异性活动
items.summary_zh: 睡眠与癫痫活动之间存在复杂联系，但睡眠不稳定在驱动和调节人脑病理放电中的因果作用尚不完全清楚。本研究通过在癫痫患者中结合立体脑电图和多导睡眠监测，直接考察实验诱导的睡眠觉醒与间歇性癫痫样放电（IEDs）之间的细微时间耦合。结果显示，睡眠觉醒迅速引发IEDs增加，且效果受解剖区域和睡眠阶段的影响。IEDs的增加仅限于新皮层区域，发生在非快速眼动睡眠的第2阶段（N2）和第3阶段（N3），其中N2阶段的效果更为显著。IEDs的增加在发作起始区与周围区域之间没有差异。尽管觉醒提高了IED计数，但并未改变IED的空间传播，表明局部皮层兴奋性在状态依赖下增强，而未招募更广泛的癫痫网络。这些发现确立了睡眠不稳定在细微时空尺度上主动驱动病理活动的因果作用，并强调睡眠稳定化作为减少癫痫负担和保护皮层网络功能的有前景的治疗策略。
items.abstract: Sleep has complex links with epileptic activity, yet the causal role of sleep instability in driving and modulating pathological discharges in the human brain remains incompletely understood. Here we directly examine this by characterising the fine-scale temporal coupling between experimentally induced sleep arousals and interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs), using combined stereo-electroencephalography and polysomnography recordings in patients with epilepsy. Sleep arousals triggered rapid IED increases, with effects gated by anatomical region and sleep stage. Increases were confined to neocortical regions and occurred during both non-rapid eye movement stage 2 (N2) and stage 3 (N3) sleep, with a larger effect observed in N2. IED increases did not differ between the seizure-onset zone and surrounding regions. Despite elevating IED counts, arousals did not alter IED spatial propagation, indicating state-dependent enhancement of local cortical excitability without recruitment of broader epileptic networks. These findings establish a causal role for sleep instability in actively driving pathological activity on fine-grained spatiotemporal scales, and highlight sleep stabilisation
items.authors: Frauscher, B.; Ho, A.; Matouskova, B.; Jaber, K.; Avigdor, T.; Minato, E.; Thomas, J.; Southwell, D. G.; Hall, J.; Carlson, D.; Klimes, P.; Peter-Derex, L.; Hannan, S.

items.title: Specific Sensitivity to Rare and Extreme Events: Quasi-Complete Black Swan Avoidance vs Partial Jackpot Seeking in Rat Decision-Making
items.title_zh: 老鼠决策中的极端事件敏感性：黑天鹅规避与部分大奖追求
items.summary_zh: 大多数动物行为研究关注于概率超过10%的风险。然而，现实决策常需评估极不可能且后果严重的事件。为填补这一空白，我们开发了实验和计算框架，量化老鼠如何检测和适应稀有结果（概率为10个标准差）。在四臂强盗任务中，动物在与概率奖励（糖丸）或惩罚（时间延迟）相关的选项间选择。结果显示，老鼠对稀有和极端惩罚（黑天鹅）表现出系统性规避，同时对稀有和极端收益（大奖）则表现出部分接触。主导行为表型几乎完全抑制了对黑天鹅的接触，而对大奖的接触则保持在中等水平。这种不对称敏感性使得这些动物接受较小的频繁收益和较大的频繁损失，以避免灾难性结果。为解释这些行为，我们实施了增强型强化学习模型。
items.abstract: Most behavioral studies in animals investigate risk using outcome probabilities larger than 10%. However, real-world Decision-Making often requires evaluating events that are both extremely unlikely and highly consequential. To address this gap, we developed an experimental and computational framework to quantify how rats detect and adapt to rare (probability 10 standard deviations) outcomes (REE). Using a four-armed bandit task, animals chose between options associated with probabilistic rewards (sugar pellets) or punishments (time-out delays). Depending on the animals choice, REE can occur or not, allowing us to probe how rats integrate information across both common and fat-tailed event distributions. Across subjects, behavior showed restricted diversification (typically two out of four options) and clear sensitivity to REE, expressed as a systematic avoidance of rare and extreme punishments (Black Swans) combined with partial exposure to rare and extreme gains (Jackpots). The dominant behavioral phenotype displayed a near-complete suppression of exposure to Black Swans, whereas exposure to Jackpots remained only moderate.
