items.authors: Degoulet, M.; Willem, L.-M.; Baunez, C.; Luchini, S.; Pintus, P.

items.title: Discovery and Structure Activity Relationship Optimization of a Novel Rv1625c Agonist Chemotype with Antitubercular Activity
items.title_zh: 新型Rv1625c激动剂化合物的发现及其抗结核活性优化
items.summary_zh: Rv1625c/Cya已成为开发结核病治疗缩短疗程的有前景靶点。通过筛选Enamine化合物库，发现sBQQ004作为初始命中化合物，快速优化后得到化合物1，确认其为Rv1625c/Cya激动剂。结构活性关系研究确定了具有强效活性的领先化合物25，在胆固醇依赖的生长条件下对结核分枝杆菌H37Rv的最小抑菌浓度为0.27 μM，并显示出强大的巨噬细胞内活性（EC50 = 0.079 μM）。化合物1和25在小鼠中的口服生物利用度分别为84.5%和51.9%。化合物1的重复双次给药导致系统暴露量随剂量和时间的增加而减少。尽管存在药代动力学限制，但该化合物的效力和整体特征促使继续优化。
items.abstract: Rv1625c/Cya has emerged as a promising target for the development of treatment-shortening therapies for tuberculosis. Screening of an Enamine compound library identified sBQQ004 as an initial hit, and rapid hit optimization led to compound 1, which was subsequently confirmed as an Rv1625c/Cya agonist. Structure activity relationship studies identified lead compound 25 with potent activity against Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv under cholesterol-dependent growth conditions (MIC = 0.27 uM) and strong intramacrophage activity (EC50 = 0.079 uM). Compounds 1 and 25 showed oral bioavailabilities of 84.5% and 51.9% in mice, respectively. Repeat BID dosing of compound 1 resulted in a dose- and time-dependent decrease in systemic exposure. Despite this pharmacokinetic limitation, the potency and overall profile of this chemotype encouraged continued optimization.
items.authors: Xie, H.; Sukheja, P.; Tolentino, K.; Webb, J.; Woods, A.; Chi, V.; Kathayat, D.; Montague, C. R.; VanderVen, B. C.; Winneroski, L.; Durst, G.; Mendel, D.; Hipskind, P.; Henry, K.; McNamara, C. W.; Yan

items.title: First for RNA therapy: man with rare motor-neuron disease improves after treatment
items.title_zh: 首例RNA疗法：罕见运动神经元病患者治疗后改善
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月18日，《自然》在线发表了一项研究，报道了一名罕见运动神经元病患者在接受RNA疗法后症状显著改善。研究表明，基因靶向治疗可能为其他罕见类型的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者提供新的治疗选择。该疗法通过特定的RNA分子靶向致病基因，促进神经元的功能恢复。研究结果为RNA疗法在神经退行性疾病中的应用提供了重要的临床证据，显示出其潜在的广泛应用前景。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 18 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02945-z Gene-targeting treatments could be used to treat other people with rare forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
items.authors: Rachel Fieldhouse

items.title: [Comment] Beyond rescue: building a resilient health system after Nepal's 2026 flood
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔2026年洪灾后重建韧性卫生系统的思考
items.summary_zh: 尼泊尔的政府卫生系统在地方、省级和联邦政府层面运作，地方设施侧重于基本卫生服务，而省级和联邦医院提供专业服务。尼泊尔已承诺实现全民健康覆盖，但资源限制、低效的健康保险系统以及农村地区的地理不可达性，阻碍了政府向所有人提供基本和专业卫生服务的能力。2019年，全民健康覆盖有效覆盖指数仅为47.3%。
items.abstract: Nepal's government health system operates on local as well as provincial and federal government levels, with local facilities focusing on basic health services, while provincial and federal hospitals provide specialised services.1 Nepal has endorsed universal health coverage; however, resource limitation, an ineffective health insurance system, and geographical inaccessibility in rural areas have hindered government capacity to provide basic and specialised health services to all people. The universal health coverage effective coverage index was only 47·3% in 2019.
items.authors: Abhilasha Karkey, Sudeep Adhikari, Buddha Basnyat

items.title: DGKα and ζ deficiency causes regulatory T-cell dysregulation, destabilization, and conversion to pathogenic T-follicular helper cells to trigger IgG1-predominant autoimmunity
items.title_zh: DGKα和ζ缺失导致调节性T细胞失调及转化为致病性T辅助细胞
items.summary_zh: 调节性T细胞（Tregs）在免疫抑制中发挥重要作用，以防止自身免疫疾病，但也抑制抗肿瘤免疫。我们发现二酰基甘油激酶（DGK）α和ζ对Tregs的稳态、抑制促炎程序和稳定性至关重要。Treg特异性缺失DGKα和ζ会干扰Tregs的信号传导、代谢和转录程序，导致表型和功能特性失调，并促使其转化为致病性外周Tregs，特别是外周Treg-T辅助细胞2（Tfh2），引发效应T细胞分化失控、胚中心B细胞反应失调及以IgG1/IgE为主的抗体/自体抗体产生，最终导致多脏器自身免疫疾病。我们的数据不仅阐明了DGKs在维持Tregs自我耐受中的关键作用，还揭示了一个受DGKs抑制的Treg转化为自反应致病性外周Tfh细胞的程序，该程序在自身免疫疾病中可能发挥广泛的致病作用。
items.abstract: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) actively engage in immune suppression to prevent autoimmune diseases, but also inhibit anti-tumor immunity. Although Tregs express a TCR repertoire with relatively high affinities to self, they are normally quite stable, and their inflammatory programs are intrinsically suppressed. We report here that diacylglycerol kinases (DGK) α and ζ are crucial for homeostasis, suppression of proinflammatory programs, and stability of Tregs, and for enforcing their dependence on CD28 costimulatory signal. Treg-specific deficiency of both DGKα and ζ derails signaling, metabolic, and transcriptional programs in Tregs to cause dysregulated phenotypic and functional properties and to unleash conversion to pathogenic exTregs, especially exTreg-T follicular helper (Tfh) 2 cells, leading to uncontrolled effector T cell differentiation, deregulated germinal center B-cell responses, and IgG1/IgE predominant antibodies/autoantibodies, and multiorgan autoimmune diseases. items.title: Defective neuronal differentiation in Lowe syndrome is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired cilia-related Sonic Hedgehog signaling
items.title_zh: 洛韦综合征中神经元分化缺陷与线粒体功能障碍及纤毛相关的Sonic Hedgehog信号通路受损相关
items.summary_zh: 洛韦综合征（LS）是一种隐性X连锁疾病，表现为近端肾小管病、先天性白内障、青光眼和神经发育延迟。本研究使用患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）神经元、Ocrl基因敲除小鼠模型和独立的缺乏OCRL的斑马鱼模型，发现线粒体功能障碍是OCRL缺失的保守表型。结果显示，OCRL缺失导致线粒体活性降低、mtDNA水平下降、线粒体含量减少（TOM20）及氧化应激增加。此外，OCRL缺失的神经细胞表现出神经元与星形胶质细胞分化平衡的改变，而非神经发生缺陷。同时，观察到Sonic Hedgehog（Shh）信号通路和纤毛稳态受损。因此，研究结果支持OCRL缺失与线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激增加、神经谱系平衡改变及Hedgehog通路活性降低相关的模型，为理解这些相互关联的表型提供了框架。
items.abstract: Human brain development requires tight coordination of metabolic and signaling pathways. Lowe syndrome (LS) is a recessive X-linked disorder characterized by proximal tubular renal disease, congenital cataracts, glaucoma, and neurodevelopmental delays. While LS results from mutations in the OCRL gene, which encodes an inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase, the cellular mechanisms driving neuronal dysfunction remain poorly understood. In this study, using patient-derived iPSC neurons, an Ocrl knockout mouse model, and an independent zebrafish OCRL-deficient model, we identified mitochondrial dysfunction as a conserved phenotype of OCRL loss across species. Collectively, our findings showed that OCRL deficiency leads to reduced mitochondrial activity, decreased mtDNA levels, reduced mitochondrial content (TOM20), and increased oxidative stress. We further showed that OCRL-deficient neural cells exhibited an altered balance of neuronal versus astrocytic differentiation, rather than a defect in neurogenesis. items.title: High-Flow Nasal Cannula in Adult Acute Care: Physiological Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Persistent Misconceptions
items.title_zh: 成人急性护理中的高流量鼻导管氧疗：机制、证据与误解
items.summary_zh: 高流量鼻导管（HFNC）氧疗广泛应用于急救、重症监护、围手术期及操作环境，但常被误解为非侵入性正压通气（NIPPV）。这种理解在生理上是错误的。HFNC是一种开放式高流量氧气系统，其主要效果来源于死腔清洗、吸入氧分数（FiO₂）稳定性提高、加热湿化、患者舒适度，以及仅有的适度流量依赖性正压。HFNC的开放接口还便于进食、饮水、说话和分泌物清除。临床证据支持HFNC主要用于急性低氧性呼吸衰竭的特定患者，与常规氧疗相比可减少插管。然而，在高碳酸血症呼吸衰竭、心源性肺水肿、免疫抑制患者、肥胖及需要较大压力支持或通气卸载的环境中，证据则较为异质。当治疗中心为控制正压、肺泡招募或通气辅助时，NIPPV或持续正压通气仍更为优选。因此，HFNC应被视为优化的高流量氧疗，而非“通过鼻导管的非侵入性通气”。认识到这一区别可能改善患者选择和治疗方案的调整。
items.abstract: High-flow nasal cannula (HFNC) oxygen therapy is widely used in emergency, inten-sive care, perioperative, and procedural settings, but it is often conceptually assimilated to non-invasive positive pressure ventilation (NIPPV). This interpretation is physio-logically misleading. HFNC is an open high-flow oxygen system whose main effects derive from dead-space washout, improved stability of inspired oxygen fraction (FiO₂), heated humidification, patient comfort, and only modest flow-dependent positive airway pressure. Its open interface also facilitates eating, drinking, speaking, and se-cretion clearance. Clinical evidence supports HFNC mainly in selected patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, where it may reduce intubation compared with conventional oxygen therapy. However, evidence is more heterogeneous in hypercap-nic respiratory failure, cardiogenic pulmonary edema, immunocompromised patients, obesity, and settings requiring substantial pressure support or ventilatory unloading. NIPPV or continuous positive airway pressure remain preferable when controlled positive pressure, alveolar recruitment, or ventilatory assistance are central to treat-ment. HFNC should there
items.authors: Daniele Orso, Francesco Meroi, Alessandro Brussa, Miriam Ladu, Ornella Spagnolello, Irene Comisso

items.title: Machine Learning Analysis of Ligand Datasets for GPCR Receptors Involved in Immune Cell Trafficking and Inflammation
items.title_zh: 机器学习分析免疫细胞迁移相关GPCR配体数据集
items.summary_zh: 免疫细胞从淋巴器官迁移至炎症组织的过程受环境变化敏感的细胞表面受体调控。参与免疫细胞迁移的G蛋白偶联受体用于抗炎药物的设计，提供了大量活性化合物数据集，如ChEMBL。本文评估了这些数据集在机器学习（ML）中用于化合物活性预测的适用性。基于序列同源性选择的混合受体数据集用于训练深度神经网络（DNNs）和梯度提升机（GBMs），以开发针对ChEMBL中配体数据稀疏的受体（如CCR6、CCR7、CCR8、CCR9、CCR10、CXCR5和CCRL2）的准确ML分类器。将这种基于配体的方法与基于结构的虚拟筛选（SBVS）进行了比较，后者使用了最近在GPCRVS中实施的免疫细胞迁移受体的精细结构模型。本文描述了DNNs、GBMs和SBVS在不同数据方案适用性方面的优缺点，提出了一种基于公开可获取库的综合多层次方法，以促进免疫调节药物设计。
items.abstract: Immune cell migration from lymphoid organs to inflamed tissues is regulated by cell-surface receptors sensitive to environmental changes. G protein-coupled receptors involved in immune cell trafficking have been used in the design of anti-inflammatory drugs providing large datasets of active compounds deposited in e.g. ChEMBL. Here, we evaluated these datasets in terms of their applicability to machine learning (ML) aimed at compound activity prediction. Mixed-receptor datasets selected based on sequence homology were used in training of deep neural networks (DNNs) and gradient boosting machines (GBMs) to develop accurate ML classifiers for receptors with sparse ligand datasets in ChEMBL such as CCR6, CCR7, CCR8, CCR9, CCR10, CXCR5, and CCRL2. This ligand-based approach to drug design was compared with structure-based virtual screening (SBVS) using refined, ready-for-VS, structural models of immune cell trafficking receptors recently implemented in GPCRVS. The strengths and weaknesses of DNNs, GBMs, and SBVS were described in terms of applicability of various data schemes. As a result, a comprehensive, multi-level approach based on publicly accessible repositories has been proposed
items.authors: Paulina Dragan, Dorota Latek

items.title: Fungal Cell Factories: Yeasts and Filamentous Fungi in Industrial Production of Ethanol, Biofuels, Citric Acid, and β-Lactam Antibiotics
items.title_zh: 真菌细胞工厂：酵母与丝状真菌在工业生产中的应用
items.summary_zh: 真菌细胞工厂在工业生物技术中发挥了核心作用，酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）和丝状真菌如黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger）、青霉（Penicillium chrysogenum）及克雷伯氏菌（Acremonium chrysogenum）是生产燃料、有机酸和药物的成熟平台。本文回顾了这些真菌生产系统的发展，从传统发酵和经验性菌株改良到代谢工程、基因组规模分析和靶向基因组修改。重点讨论了S. cerevisiae的乙醇和先进生物燃料生产、A. niger的柠檬酸生产，以及P. chrysogenum和A. chrysogenum的β-内酰胺抗生素生产。尽管在途径工程、转运体操控、耐逆境能力、比较基因组学和基因组编辑方面取得了进展，但底物利用、产品毒性、代谢负担、遗传稳定性和菌株特异性调控要求等限制仍然制约着工业应用。文章还考虑了使用转基因真菌的监管影响，特别关注欧洲食品安全局（EFSA）对食品链中微生物安全评估的框架。
items.abstract: Fungal cell factories have played a central role in industrial biotechnology, with Saccharomyces cerevisiae and filamentous fungi such as Aspergillus niger, Penicillium chrysogenum and Acremonium chrysogenum serving as established platforms for the production of fuels, organic acids and pharmaceuticals. This review examines the development of these fungal production systems from conventional fermentation and empirical strain improvement towards metabolic engineering, genome-scale analysis and targeted genome modification. Particular emphasis is placed on ethanol and advanced biofuel production by S. cerevisiae, citric acid production by A. niger, and β-lactam antibiotic production by P. chrysogenum and A. chrysogenum. Recent advances in pathway engineering, transporter manipulation, stress tolerance, comparative genomics and genome editing have substantially expanded the capacity to optimise fungal cell factories. However, limitations including substrate utilisation, product toxicity, metabolic burden, genetic stability and strain-specific regulatory requirements continue to constrain industrial implementation. items.authors: Matthaios Giotas

items.title: Mexican Oregano Infusion and Carvacrol Modulate Cytokine Production, Induce Apoptosis, and Regulate Antioxidant Enzyme Expression and Function in Breast Cancer Cell Lines: Implications for Bioactive Molecule-Based Therapeutics
items.title_zh: 墨西哥牛至浸剂与香芹酚对乳腺癌细胞的影响
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：乳腺癌（BC），尤其是三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC），因治疗耐药和毒性而成为临床挑战。本研究评估了墨西哥牛至（Lippia graveolens）浸剂（MoI）及其活性成分香芹酚（Cv）在不同BC细胞系（MCF-7、HCC-1954和MDA-MB-231）中的抗肿瘤潜力。方法：通过量化细胞凋亡、分析细胞因子（IL-4、IL-6、IL-10）及抗氧化酶（CAT、SOD2、GPX1）的基因表达和酶活性来评估细胞反应。结果：Cv表现出强大的独立于亚型的促凋亡活性，而MoI在非肿瘤HaCaT细胞中显示出显著疗效和更好的安全性。两种处理均调节细胞因子信号，抑制肿瘤促进因子IL-4、IL-6和IL-10，尤其在高度侵袭性的MDA-MB-231细胞中最为明显。结论：研究表明MoI和Cv通过诱导凋亡、免疫调节和氧化还原失衡的协调途径发挥抗肿瘤作用。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Breast cancer (BC), particularly aggressive subtypes such as triple-negative TNBC, remains a significant clinical challenge due to treatment resistance and therapeutic toxicity. This study evaluated the antitumor potential of Mexican Oregano (Lippia graveolens) infusion (MoI) and its bioactive constituent, carvacrol (Cv), in diverse BC cell lines (MCF-7, HCC-1954, and MDA-MB-231). Methods: Cellular responses were assessed by quantifying apoptosis, profiling cytokines (IL-4, IL-6, IL-10), and analyzing the gene expression of antioxidant enzymes (CAT, SOD2, GPX1) and their enzymatic activities. Results: Cv exhibited potent, subtype-independent pro-apoptotic activity, while MoI demonstrated significant efficacy with a more favorable safety profile in non-tumoral HaCaT cells. Both treatments mediated complex modulation of cytokine signaling, characterized by suppression of tumor-promoting IL-4, IL-6, and IL-10, an effect most pronounced in the highly aggressive MDA-MB-231 cell line. Transcriptional and functional analyses further revealed that these agents alter the expression and activity of antioxidant enzymes., thereby promoting pro-oxidant environments conduc
items.authors: Brian Enrique Rojo-Ruvalcaba, Montserrat Maldonado-González, Bertha Ruiz-Madrigal, Erika Martínez-López, Rocío García-Becerra, Pedro Ernesto Sánchez-Hernández

items.title: Fulfilment of Fibromyalgia Criteria and Concomitant Pain-Related Diagnoses in Patients Referred for or Labelled as Having Fibromyalgia: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Pilot Study
items.title_zh: 纤维肌痛症标准满足情况及相关疼痛诊断的回顾性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：纤维肌痛症（FM）通过症状标准进行诊断，临床医生的标签可能与标准化分类框架不一致。FM可能与其他疼痛性肌肉骨骼疾病共存。本研究旨在确定被怀疑或已诊断为FM的患者中，满足2019年ACTTION-美国疼痛学会疼痛分类（AAPT）标准的比例，并比较其伴随疼痛相关诊断和症状严重性。方法：本回顾性单中心横断面研究纳入在三级疼痛单位评估的连续成人门诊患者。通过审查临床记录，确定AAPT 2019标准的满足情况，识别伴随疼痛相关诊断，并使用FIQR、Zung SAS/SDS、DN4和NRS评估症状严重性。结果：在76名患者中（96.1%为女性），28名满足AAPT标准（36.8%；95% CI, 26.9–48.1）。其中25名（89.3%；95% CI, 72.8–96.3）有至少一个伴随疼痛相关诊断，而未满足标准的患者中为26/48（54.2%）（OR, 7.05；95% CI, 1.87–26.54；p = 0.002）。探索性分析显示，AAPT满足组的FIQR、SAS、SDS和DN4评分较高。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Fibromyalgia (FM) is diagnosed using symptom-based criteria, and clinician-assigned labels may diverge from standardized classification frameworks. FM may also coexist with other pain-generating musculoskeletal disorders. We determined the proportion of patients referred for suspected or previously diagnosed FM who fulfilled the 2019 ACTTION-American Pain Society Pain Taxonomy (AAPT) criteria after specialist record-based adjudication and compared documented concomitant pain-related diagnoses and symptom severity according to AAPT status. Methods: This retrospective, single-center cross-sectional pilot study included consecutive adult outpatients evaluated in a tertiary pain unit for suspected or previously diagnosed FM. Routinely collected clinical records were reviewed to determine fulfilment of the AAPT 2019 criteria, identify documented concomitant pain-related diagnoses, and assess symptom severity using FIQR, Zung SAS/SDS, DN4, and NRS measures. Results: Among 76 patients (96.1% female), 28 fulfilled the AAPT criteria (36.8%; 95% CI, 26.9–48.1). items.title: Personalized Treatment of Sexual Dysfunction in Gynecological Cancer Survivors: From Symptom Assessment to Multidisciplinary Oncosexual Rehabilitation
items.title_zh: 妇科癌症幸存者性功能障碍的个性化治疗
items.summary_zh: 背景：性功能障碍是妇科癌症治疗后常见但常被忽视的后果，可能持续影响幸存者，涉及阴道症状、性交疼痛、盆底功能障碍、激素变化、心理困扰、身体形象改变及人际关系困难。尽管对生活质量影响显著，性健康在常规随访中仍未得到一致关注。目的：本叙述性综述评估妇科癌症幸存者性功能障碍的现代治疗策略，并提出个性化的多学科肿瘤性康复框架。方法：在PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Google Scholar中进行文献检索，重点关注2016年1月至2026年9月的出版物，纳入随机对照试验、观察性和定性研究、系统评价、荟萃分析、临床指南及相关叙述性综述。结果：当前证据支持多维度的治疗方法，管理应从结构化评估性症状、癌症及治疗历史、阴道和激素状态、盆底功能、心理健康、身体形象、关系及患者定义的目标开始。
items.abstract: Background: Sexual dysfunction is a common but frequently underrecognized consequence of gynecological cancer treatment. It may persist throughout survivorship and involve vaginal symptoms, dyspareunia, pelvic-floor dysfunction, hormonal changes, psychological distress, altered body image, and relationship difficulties. Despite its substantial impact on quality of life, sexual health is still inconsistently addressed in routine follow-up care. Objective: This narrative review evaluates contemporary treatment strategies for sexual dysfunction in gynecological cancer survivors and proposes a personalized framework for multidisciplinary oncosexual rehabilitation. Methods: A narrative literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Google Scholar, focusing primarily on publications from January 2016 to September 2026. Randomized controlled trials, observational and qualitative studies, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, clinical guidelines, consensus statements, and relevant narrative reviews were considered. items.authors: Zlatko Kirovakov

items.title: International Delphi Consensus on antibiotic management in radical cystectomy with orthotopic ileal neobladders
items.title_zh: 国际德尔菲共识：根治性膀胱切除术抗生素管理
items.summary_zh: 背景：根治性膀胱切除术（RC）结合尿路改道被认为是肌肉侵袭性及部分高风险非肌肉侵袭性膀胱癌的标准治疗。该手术复杂，感染并发症风险高，尤其是正位回肠新膀胱（IN）相比肠道导管更易发生感染并发症和再入院。关于该特殊患者群体的抗生素管理，包括围手术期预防和无症状菌尿（ASB）治疗的证据仍然有限，且缺乏国际共识以支持加强抗生素使用的临床风险因素，导致实践差异和抗微生物管理的担忧。目的：本德尔菲共识研究旨在确定最佳抗生素管理方案，包括围手术期预防及ASB治疗，并定义在RC和IN患者中需要加强抗生素使用的程序性、患者相关和微生物风险因素，建立基于证据的最佳实践建议。方法：将根据DELPHISTAR指南进行修改的三轮德尔菲过程，邀请30-40名国际泌尿科、传染病、微生物学及抗微生物管理领域的专家参与。
items.abstract: Background: Radical cystectomy (RC) with urinary diversion is considered the standard treatment for muscle-invasive and selected cases of high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. As a complex procedure it carries a high risk for complications, especially infectious ones. Orthotopic ileal neobladders (IN) have the highest risk of infectious complications and hospital readmission in comparison to ileal conduits. Unfortunately, the evidence for antibiotic management, including periprocedural prophylaxis and treatment of asymptomatic bacteriuria (ASB) in this special patient cohort is still limited. Furthermore, there is no international consensus on the clinical risk factors that justify intensified antibiotic use, leading to wide practice variability and concerns regarding antimicrobial stewardship.Objective: This Delphi consensus study aims to identify the best antibiotic management, including periprocedural prophylaxis as well as treatment of ASB, and define procedural, patient-related and microbiological risk factors that warrant antibiotic intensified usage in patients with RC and IN and to establish evidence-informed best practice recommendations.Methods: A modified three-r
items.authors: Jennifer Kranz, Florian M. E. Wagenlehner, Laila Schneidewind

items.title: Real-World Renal Effects of Dapagliflozin in Bulgarian Patients with Glomerular Diseases: A Two-Year Comparative Cohort Study with Historical Controls
items.title_zh: 布尔加利亚肾小管疾病患者达格列净的真实世界肾脏效果研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂在慢性肾病中已被确立，但在肾小管疾病中的证据有限，且随机试验中排除了接受强化免疫抑制的患者。本研究评估了达格列净对该人群中蛋白尿和肾功能的影响。方法：单中心回顾性队列研究，使用历史对照。比较了2021至2025年间接受达格列净治疗的147名患者与2014至2021年间的170名患者（大多数为活检证实的肾小管疾病）。在0、12和24个月评估蛋白尿和估计肾小管滤过率（eGFR），并进行基线调整的协方差分析。结果：达格列净组蛋白尿下降51.9%，历史对照组下降22.2%；调整后的几何均值比为0.684（95% CI 0.534–0.877；p = 0.003）。第二年，达格列净组eGFR下降速度比对照组慢4.61 mL/min/1.73 m²（95% CI 1.83–7.40；p = 0.001），eGFR低于15 mL/min/1.73 m²的患者比例为0.7%，对照组为11.8%。在接受强化免疫抑制的患者中，添加达格列净后蛋白尿下降67.5%，而同样治疗组仅下降4.6%。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Sodium–glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are established in chronic kidney disease, but evidence in glomerular disease is limited and patients on intensified immunosuppression have been excluded from the randomised trials. We examined the effect of dapagliflozin on proteinuria and kidney function over two years in such a population. Methods: Single-centre retrospective cohort study with historical controls. 147 patients treated with dapagliflozin between 2021 and 2025 were compared with 170 patients seen between 2014 and 2021, most with biopsy-proven glomerular diseases. Proteinuria and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) were assessed at months 0, 12 and 24, and comparisons used analysis of covariance adjusted for baseline. Subgroups on intensified immunosuppression at entry were prespecified. Results: Proteinuria fell by 51.9% under dapagliflozin and by 22.2% in the historical cohort; the adjusted geometric mean ratio (GMR) was 0.684 (95% CI 0.534–0.877; p = 0.003). items.title: Environmental temperature is a strong driver of subspecies competition in the Drosophila microbiome
items.title_zh: 环境温度是果蝇微生物组亚种竞争的重要驱动因素
items.summary_zh: 大多数微生物组研究集中在物种水平的分类组成上，忽视了种内多样性。为填补这一知识空白，我们利用果蝇简单且可培养的微生物组进行研究。首先，我们记录到自然种群中的D. simulans携带三种分化的Lactiplantibacillus plantarum类群，这是一种关键的营养共生菌。通过在实验室中将果蝇及其本土微生物组暴露于两种温度条件下，我们研究了这三种类群的不同生态角色。在超过10年的时间里，我们追踪了这三种类群在完整果蝇微生物组中的动态变化，发现其对选择条件的反应显著不同。通过体外生长测量和体内单一共生实验，我们确认了这三种类群的功能差异。我们的研究强调环境选择在亚种水平上的作用，因此得出结论，微生物组的功能多样化只有在考虑种内和种间多样性时才能得到理解。
items.abstract: Most microbiome research focuses on the taxonomic composition at the species level to understand the impact of environmental factors, but intraspecific diversity has largely been ignored. To address this significant knowledge gap, we took advantage of the simple, culturable microbiome of Drosophila . First, we documented that natural populations of D. simulans harbor three diverged clades of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum , a key nutritional symbiont. We studied the distinct ecological roles of these three clades by exposing flies with their native microbiome to two temperature regimes in the laboratory. Tracking the three clades within the complete Drosophila microbiome over a period of more than 10 years at two temperatures, we identified strikingly distinct dynamics in response to the selection regime. We confirmed the functional differentiation of the three clades using in vitro growth measurements and in vivo mono-association assays. Our results highlight that environmental selection operates at the subspecies level. Therefore, we conclude that the functional diversification of the microbiome can only be understood when intra- and interspecific diversity is considered.

items.title: Characterization of Extracellular Vesicle Cargo in the Experimental Rat Model of Pulmonary Hypertension
items.title_zh: 实验性肺动脉高压大鼠模型中细胞外囊泡成分特征研究
items.summary_zh: 细胞外囊泡（EVs）由细胞释放，携带多种分子成分，包括蛋白质、脂质、核酸和线粒体。在肺动脉高压（PH）中，循环EV水平升高，可能改变受体细胞的功能，但EV是否传递功能性线粒体及其蛋白质成分的组成尚不清楚。本研究在Sugen5416（SU）和低氧（10% O₂）诱导的PH大鼠模型中，分析了EV的成分。通过定量质谱蛋白组学和流式细胞术从SU/低氧（SU/Hx）和SU/常氧（SU/Nx）大鼠的左心室血液中分离EV。结果显示，EV中含有参与凝血、补体和免疫信号、代谢、受体信号及细胞骨架组织的蛋白质。尽管SU/Hx大鼠的EV整体蛋白丰度降低，但与细胞骨架结构、代谢、免疫信号和细胞粘附相关的特定蛋白质则显著富集。
items.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) released by cells carry a diverse molecular cargo, including proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and mitochondria. In addition, EVs carry antioxidants and free radical producing enzymes like NADPH oxidases or other oxidases. Growing evidence suggests that EV cargo plays a critical role in intercellular communication and disease pathogenesis. In pulmonary hypertension (PH), circulating EV levels are elevated and can alter the function of recipient cells; however, whether EVs transmit functional mitochondria and the composition of their protein cargo remain poorly understood. To address this knowledge gap, we characterized the cargo of EVs in a rat model of Sugen5416 (SU; 20 mg/kg, i.p.)- and hypoxia (10% O₂)-induced PH. EVs were isolated from blood collected from the left ventricles of SU/hypoxia (SU/Hx) and SU/normoxia (SU/Nx) rats and analyzed using quantitative mass spectrometry–based proteomics and flow cytometry. Proteomic profiling revealed that EVs contain proteins involved in coagulation, complement and immune signaling, metabolism, receptor signaling, and cytoskeletal organization. items.title: A Rare Cause of Cardiofaciocutaneous Síndrome, KRAS p.Pro34Arg: Clinical Delineation, Diagnostic Challenges, and Implications for RASopathy Classification
items.title_zh: KRAS p.Pro34Arg导致的罕见心面皮综合征病例研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：心面皮综合征（CFC）是一种罕见的RAS病，特征为颅面畸形、皮肤异常、先天性心脏病和神经发育障碍。与Noonan综合征和Costello综合征的临床重叠常使诊断复杂，因此分子确认至关重要。病例介绍：我们报告了一名一岁男孩，表现为进行性大头症、轴向肌张力低下、胃食管反流、皮肤异常和肥厚型心肌病。脑部磁共振成像显示有脑室扩大、导水管增大和脑室周围胶质增生，符合进行性脑积水。超声心动图显示左心室同心性肥厚，收缩功能保存。靶向下一代测序发现一处杂合性新发KRAS c.101C>G（p.Pro34Arg）变异，此致病变异在CFC中仅报告过一次。讨论：患者的表型，包括显著的神经系统受累和早发性心脏肥厚，与KRAS相关的CFC高度一致。由于表现重叠，与其他RAS病的鉴别诊断在临床上具有挑战性。
items.abstract: Background: Cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (CFC) is a rare RASopathy characterized by craniofacial dysmorphism, cutaneous abnormalities, congenital heart disease, and neurodevelopmental impairment. Clinical overlap with Noonan and Costello syndromes often complicates diagnosis, making molecular confirmation essential. Case Presentation: We report a one-year-old boy presenting with progressive macrocephaly, axial hypotonia, gastroesophageal reflux, dermatologic abnormalities, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Brain magnetic resonance imaging revealed supratentorial ventriculomegaly, aqueductal enlargement, and periventricular gliosis, consistent with evolving hydrocephalus. Echocardiography demonstrated concentric left ventricular hypertrophy with preserved systolic function. Targeted next-generation sequencing identified a heterozygous de novo KRAS c.101C gt;G (p.Pro34Arg) variant. This pathogenic variant has been reported only once previously in association with CFC. Other substitutions affecting the same residue further support the functional importance of codon 34 in KRAS. items.title: Congenital Syphilis in South Africa: A Narrative Review of Epidemiology, Health System Drivers, Prevention, and the Path to Elimination
items.title_zh: 南非先天性梅毒的流行病学与消除路径综述
items.summary_zh: 先天性梅毒（CS）由梅毒螺旋体的垂直传播引起，仍是全球可预防的胎儿和新生儿发病率及死亡率的重要原因。尽管南非已建立产前筛查项目并提供有效的苄星青霉素G（BPG）治疗，但该国的母婴梅毒负担仍然显著，2023年全国病例率约为世界卫生组织消除目标的四倍。本文综述了南非先天性梅毒的相关文献、国家监测报告和国际政策文件，涵盖了微生物学与发病机制、流行病学、临床负担、诊断、卫生系统驱动因素及消除策略。南非先天性梅毒的持续传播受多种因素影响，包括产前预约延迟、筛查机会错失、治疗不完全或延误、伴侣管理不足、艾滋病毒（HIV）共感染、贫困及卫生系统效率低下等。先天性梅毒与不良妊娠结局相关，包括流产、死胎、早产、新生儿死亡及长期残疾。
items.abstract: Congenital syphilis (CS), caused by vertical transmission of Treponema pallidum subsp. pallidum, remains a major but preventable cause of fetal and neonatal morbidity and mortality globally. Despite established antenatal screening programmes and the availability of effective treatment with benzathine penicillin G (BPG), South Africa continues to experience a substantial burden of maternal and congenital syphilis, with a 2023 national case rate approximately four times the World Health Organization (WHO) elimination target. This narrative review synthesises evidence from peer-reviewed literature, national surveillance reports, and international policy documents relating to congenital syphilis in South Africa, covering microbiology and pathogenesis, epidemiology, clinical burden, diagnostics, health system drivers, and elimination strategy. Persistent congenital syphilis transmission in South Africa is driven by an interacting set of factors including delayed antenatal booking, missed screening opportunities, incomplete treatment or delays, inadequate partner management, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) co-infection, poverty, and health system inefficiencies including recurrent ben

items.title: The structural basis of malodorant skatole formation by the glycyl radical enzyme indoleacetate decarboxylase
items.title_zh: 糖氨酸自由基酶诱导的恶臭化合物斯卡托尔形成的结构基础
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了糖氨酸自由基酶（GRE）家族中的一种酶——吲哚乙酸脱羧酶（IAD），其在厌氧环境中催化复杂化学反应的机制。IAD通过C–C键断裂和脱羧反应生成恶臭化合物斯卡托尔。研究采用了结构生物学方法，揭示了IAD的活性位点及其与底物的相互作用，为理解其催化机制提供了重要的结构基础。结果显示，IAD在催化过程中形成了一个关键的中间体，进一步推动了对GRE家族酶的研究，可能为相关生物化学反应的应用提供新的思路。

items.title: OpenAntigens: a structure-aware database for antigen construct design across the human cell-surface and secreted proteome
items.title_zh: OpenAntigens：结构感知的抗原构建设计数据库
items.summary_zh: 在抗体发现、重组试剂生成、结构生物学和计算结合物设计中，选择蛋白质的表达区域仍然缺乏标准化。针对人类细胞表面和分泌蛋白，需要在订购DNA之前协调拓扑、处理、预测和实验结构、修饰、相互作用伙伴、同源物、旁系物及交叉反应风险。OpenAntigens是一个免费的、无需登录的数据库，包含5328个人类分泌、GPI锚定、单跨膜和多跨膜蛋白的构建设计报告。它整合了UniProt拓扑、AlphaFold pLDDT和PAE、PDB先例、InterPro和Pfam域、小鼠和猕猴同源物、旁系物和家族背景、Open Targets疾病关联、伙伴和组装背景以及BLAST搜索。该数据库提供了55305个构建建议，涵盖完整设计区域、PDB支持的边界、注释域、pLDDT/PAE衍生区域和膜表达选项，并提供148722个序列相似性匹配，帮助选择构建并评估交叉反应性。对于具有兼容AlphaFold模型的靶标，交互式设计工具链接序列、结构、pLDDT和PAE，允许用户修订边界并实时导出物种等效序列，同时提供半胱氨酸和修饰警告。OpenAntigens提供可重复的构建建议、比较背景和浏览器体验。
items.abstract: Choosing which region of a protein to express remains poorly standardized in antibody discovery, recombinant reagent generation, structural biology and computational binder design. For human cell-surface and secreted proteins, this requires reconciling topology, processing, predicted and experimental structure, modifications, interaction partners, orthologs, paralogs and cross-reactivity risk before ordering DNA. OpenAntigens is a free, no-login database of construct-design reports for 5328 human secreted, GPI-anchored, single-pass and multipass proteins. It integrates UniProt topology, AlphaFold pLDDT and PAE, PDB precedent, InterPro and Pfam domains, mouse and cynomolgus orthologs, paralog and family context, Open Targets disease associations, partner and assembly context, and BLAST searches. It provides 55 305 construct suggestions spanning full design regions, PDB-backed boundaries, annotated domains, pLDDT/PAE-derived regions and membrane-expression options, plus 148 722 sequence-similarity hits to help choose constructs and assess cross-reactivity. items.authors: Teixeira, A. A. R.; Zhu, H.; Kothiwal, D.; Cao, R.; Mills, A.

items.title: Unsupervised learning of mapping between brain lesions and behavior
items.title_zh: 无监督学习脑损伤与行为之间的映射
items.summary_zh: 人类脑损伤研究是探讨脑区与行为结果关系的重要途径，但在分析脑区与特定行为结果之间的关系时，面临选择合适粒度的挑战。本文展示了一种新颖的数据驱动方法——因果特征学习（Causal Feature Learning, CFL），该方法能够同时学习分析的适当层次及损伤与认知障碍之间的关系。CFL避免了事先指定脑区和特定结果指标，从而发现新的跨领域损伤-行为映射。我们展示了CFL在模拟数据集中稳健地恢复损伤行为映射，而典型相关分析未能提供可解释的结果。随后，我们利用大规模损伤样本数据集，展示CFL成功恢复了已知的语言缺陷和视觉空间处理的损伤-行为映射，并说明CFL如何用于识别损伤与抑郁症状之间的新结果分组。
items.abstract: Human lesion studies offer one of the most direct routes to investigating the relations between brain regions and behavioral outcomes in circumstances where experimental interventions are highly restricted. However, these studies face a major challenge in identifying the right level of granularity at which brain regions and behavioral outcomes should be analyzed to identify the relation between lesions to specific brain regions and specific behavioral outcomes. Here we showcase a novel data-driven approach, Causal Feature Learning (CFL), that learns the appropriate level of analysis and the relation between lesion and cognitive impairment at the same time. The method avoids specifying brain regions and specific outcome measures a priori, allowing for the discovery of new cross-cutting lesion-behavior maps. We show that CFL robustly recovers lesion behavior maps in a simulated dataset where Canonical Correlation Analysis fails to provide interpretable results. We then show that CFL recovers known lesion-behavior maps for language deficits and visuospatial processing using a large dataset of lesion subjects, and we illustrate how CFL can be used to identify new groupings of outcomes
items.authors: Wahle, I. A.; Griffis, J.; Adolphs, R.; Grafman, J.; Tranel, D.; Boes, A.; Eberhardt, F.

items.title: Dynamic Responses to an Inflammatory Challenge Distinguish Metabolic Health Across Lean and Obese Individuals
items.title_zh: 炎症挑战的动态反应区分代谢健康的瘦人和肥胖者
items.summary_zh: 炎症是心脏代谢疾病的关键驱动因素，但尚不清楚系统性炎症标志物是否能区分代谢健康与不健康个体，或捕捉炎症的时间动态。本研究结合系统免疫谱分析与蝉蜕素诱导的外周水泡模型，探讨代谢健康瘦人（MHL）、代谢不健康瘦人（MUL）、代谢健康肥胖者（MHO）和代谢不健康肥胖者（MUO）在动态炎症调节方面的差异。尽管肥胖个体的系统性炎症水平升高，但代谢健康与不健康组之间的差异较小，血浆蛋白组学、循环白细胞表型分析和全血转录组学的区分能力有限。相反，炎症挑战的动态反应在蛋白组学、细胞和转录组学层面显示出显著差异。代谢不健康个体表现出早期先天免疫反应的夸大、炎症解决和组织修复的受损、修复性免疫细胞招募的减少以及持续的T细胞存在。转录组分析进一步显示动态基因调控的减弱和表皮屏障修复的缺陷。这些发现表明，代谢健康在组织水平的炎症动态中得到了更好的反映。
items.abstract: Inflammation is a key driver of cardiometabolic disease, yet it remains unclear whether systemic inflammatory markers can distinguish metabolically healthy from unhealthy individuals or capture the temporal dynamics of inflammation. Here, we combined systemic immune profiling with a cantharidin-induced peripheral blister model to investigate dynamic inflammatory regulation across metabolic phenotypes in metabolically healthy lean (MHL), metabolically unhealthy lean (MUL), metabolically healthy obese (MHO), and metabolically unhealthy obese (MUO) individuals. While systemic inflammation was elevated in obesity, differences between metabolically healthy and unhealthy groups were modest, with limited discrimination by plasma proteomics, circulating leukocyte phenotyping, and whole-blood transcriptomics. In contrast, the dynamic response to inflammatory challenge revealed pronounced differences at proteomic, cellular, and transcriptomic levels. Metabolically unhealthy individuals exhibited exaggerated early innate immune responses, impaired inflammatory resolution and tissue repair, reduced recruitment of reparative immune cells, and sustained T cell presence. items.title: nHOTAIRM1 scaffolds ANXA11-dependent assemblies to drive axonal mRNA localization in human motor neurons
items.title_zh: nHOTAIRM1在人体运动神经元中的轴突mRNA定位研究
items.summary_zh: 长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）在神经元发育和功能中发挥调节作用，但其在轴突运输途径中的整合仍不完全明确。本研究聚焦于人类诱导多能干细胞来源的脊髓运动神经元（spMNs），发现神经特异性HOTAIRM1异构体（nHOTAIRM1）在塑造轴突RNA环境中具有细胞质功能。我们证明nHOTAIRM1与与溶酶体相关的RNA颗粒运动因子Annexin A11（ANXA11）结合，并与特定的运动神经元相关mRNA相互作用。转录组广泛和靶向相互作用实验表明，nHOTAIRM1与参与细胞骨架组织和突触或囊泡功能的mRNA之间存在直接的RNA-RNA配对。功能丧失实验显示，nHOTAIRM1缺失降低了这些mRNA与ANXA11阳性复合物的结合，并减少其在神经元突起中的富集。
items.abstract: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) are well recognized as regulators of neuronal development and function, yet their integration into canonical axonal transport pathways, an essential component of spatial gene regulation in highly polarized cells, remains incompletely defined. It is still unclear to what extent individual lncRNAs confer cargo selectivity and couple discrete mRNA cohorts to established transport machineries. Here we identify a cytoplasmic role for the neuronal isoform of HOTAIRM1 (nHOTAIRM1) in shaping the axonal RNA landscape of human iPSC-derived spinal motor neurons (spMNs). We show that nHOTAIRM1 associates with Annexin A11 (ANXA11), a factor linked to lysosome-coupled movement of RNA granules and engages a defined subset of MN-relevant mRNAs. Transcriptome-wide and targeted interaction assays, together with computational mapping and steric competition, support direct RNA-RNA pairing between nHOTAIRM1 and mRNAs involved in cytoskeletal organization and synaptic or vesicular functions, while spatial analyses place these RNA pairs in close proximity within the soma and neurites. items.title: Cyclin D-CDK4/6 couple proliferation to membrane and mitochondrial protein supply through a DeSI1 phospho-switch
items.title_zh: 细胞周期与膜及线粒体蛋白供给的关联机制研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于细胞周期中的Cyclin D-CDK4/6及其如何协调细胞增殖与膜及细胞器蛋白供给。我们发现DeSI1是Cyclin D-CDK4/6的底物，其在S25位点的磷酸化使其从潜在的同源二聚体转变为活性单体去泛素酶，能够识别具有跨膜结构域和线粒体靶向序列的疏水性蛋白。磷酸化的DeSI1延长了新合成的疏水性蛋白的寿命，支持膜和线粒体的功能。持续激活DeSI1导致代谢供给与蛋白质稳态失衡，影响CTP依赖的磷脂稳态，造成心磷脂耗竭和线粒体功能失调。小鼠实验表明，持续激活DeSI1引起小脑进行性退化，伴随膜蛋白积累和磷脂耗竭。这些发现揭示了细胞周期与膜及线粒体能力之间的后转录调控机制，以及脱钩带来的代谢支持成本。
items.abstract: Cyclin D-CDK4/6 complexes drive cell-cycle entry through an RB-E2F-dependent transcriptional program, but how they coordinate proliferation with the membrane and organelle protein supply required for growth is unclear. We identify DeSI1 as a cyclin D-CDK4/6 substrate whose phosphorylation at S25 converts a latent homodimer into an active monomeric deubiquitylase that recognizes hydrophobic proteins such as those bearing transmembrane domains and mitochondrial targeting sequences. Phosphorylated DeSI1 extends the lifetime of newly synthesized hydrophobic proteins that support membrane and mitochondrial capacity. Constitutive DeSI1 activation uncouples this proteostatic program from metabolic supply, creating a cytidine-nucleotide supply-demand imbalance associated with impaired CTP-dependent phospholipid homeostasis, cardiolipin depletion, and mitochondrial decompensation - defects that cytidine reverses. In mice, constitutive DeSI1 activation causes progressive cerebellar degeneration with membrane-protein accumulation, respiratory-chain loss, and phospholipid depletion. items.title: TOPBP1-Dependent DNA Damage Processing Promotes Centromere Loss in an Inviable Xenopus Hybrid
items.title_zh: TOPBP1依赖的DNA损伤处理促进不可存活的蛙类杂交体的着丝粒丧失
items.summary_zh: 杂交不兼容与染色体不稳定、DNA损伤和胚胎致死相关，但细胞如何应对杂交体中的基因组不稳定尚不清楚。在通过用非洲爪蟾（Xenopus laevis）精子受精非洲爪蟾（Xenopus tropicalis）卵子生成的不可存活杂交体中，父源染色体上的CENP-A丧失，导致两个染色体臂的消失。通过杂交蛙类卵提取物反应，我们发现CENP-A通过与DNA损伤相关的RNA聚合酶II依赖性过程从X. laevis染色体中去除。拓扑异构酶II结合蛋白1（TOPBP1）在中期定位于受损的无心染色体，其去除会影响染色体排列，增加DNA损伤，并阻止CENP-A的去除。抑制DNA聚合酶θ增加了DNA损伤，同时促进CENP-A的保留，表明DNA损伤处理而非损伤本身促进CENP-A的丧失。我们的研究揭示了TOPBP1在染色体组织和着丝粒不稳定中的可分离作用，显示了保护性基因组监测通路如何在不可存活的杂交体中驱动染色体不稳定。
items.abstract: Hybrid incompatibility is associated with chromosome instability, DNA damage, and embryonic lethality, yet how cells respond to genome instability in hybrids is unclear. In inviable hybrids generated by fertilizing Xenopus tropicalis eggs with Xenopus laevis sperm, CENP-A is lost from paternal chromosomes, leading to elimination of two chromosome arms. Using hybrid Xenopus egg extract reactions, we show that CENP-A is removed from X. laevis chromosomes exposed to X. tropicalis cytoplasm through an RNA polymerase II-dependent process associated with DNA damage. Topoisomerase II Binding Protein 1 (TOPBP1) localized to damaged acentric chromosomes during metaphase, and its depletion impaired chromosome alignment, increased DNA damage, and blocked CENP-A removal. Inhibition of DNA polymerase theta increased DNA damage while promoting CENP-A retention, indicating that DNA damage processing rather than damage itself promotes CENP-A loss. Together, our findings reveal separable roles for TOPBP1 in chromosome organization and centromere destabilization, showing how a protective genome surveillance pathway can instead drive chromosome instability in an inviable hybrid.
items.authors: Clark, C.; Terui, R.; Chistol, G.; Heald, R.

items.title: Elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor treatment is associated with epigenetic age deceleration in cystic fibrosis
items.title_zh: Elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor治疗与囊性纤维化表观遗传年龄减缓相关
items.summary_zh: 背景：囊性纤维化（CF）与慢性炎症和进行性多系统疾病相关，可能导致生物学加速衰老。Elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor（ETI）显著改善CF患者的临床结果，但其对表观遗传衰老的影响及与炎症的关系尚不明确。方法：我们对8名未接受调节剂治疗的CF患者进行了纵向研究。在ETI治疗前和治疗1年后对血液DNA甲基化进行了分析。调整年龄和血细胞组成后计算DNAmGrimAge2年龄加速。通过重复测量相关性评估与炎症生物标志物和临床指标的关联。结果：DNAmGrimAge2在基线和随访时与实际年龄强相关。ETI治疗后，DNAmGrimAge2年龄加速从治疗前的中位数1.92年降至1年后的-1.70年（p=0.008）。更大的年龄加速与更高的IL-6、IL-1β和钙保护素浓度相关。更高的FEV1pp与较低的年龄加速相关，而更高的汗氯化物则与更大的年龄加速相关。结论：ETI治疗后DNAmGrimAge2年龄加速降低，并与先天性和中性粒细胞炎症及CF疾病标志物相关。
items.abstract: Background: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is associated with chronic inflammation and progressive multisystem disease, which may contribute to accelerated biological aging. Elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI) substantially improves clinical outcomes in people with CF (pwCF), but its effects on epigenetic aging and their relationship with inflammation remain poorly understood. Methods: We performed a pilot longitudinal study of 8 modulator-naive pwCF. Blood DNA methylation was profiled before ETI initiation and after 1 year of treatment. DNAmGrimAge2 age acceleration was calculated adjusting for chronological age and blood cell composition. Associations with inflammatory biomarkers and clinical measures were assessed using repeated measures correlation. Results: DNAmGrimAge2 was strongly correlated with chronological age at baseline and follow-up. DNAmGrimAge2 age acceleration decreased after ETI treatment, from a median of 1.92 years before treatment to -1.70 years after 1 year (p=0.008). Greater age acceleration was associated with higher IL-6, IL-1{beta}, and calprotectin concentrations. Higher FEV1pp was associated with lower age acceleration, whereas higher sweat chloride was associa

items.title: Dietary Intake During Breast Cancer Treatment and Its Association with Changes in Cardiometabolic Risk Markers and Psychological Outcomes in Women with Breast Cancer: A Prospective Cohort Study Protocol
items.title_zh: 乳腺癌治疗期间饮食摄入与心代谢风险及心理结果的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：系统性治疗是乳腺癌管理的基础，但常导致心代谢、体型及心理问题。尽管治疗期间的饮食摄入可能影响这些并发症，但缺乏严谨的前瞻性队列研究。目的：本研究旨在探讨乳腺癌患者在治疗期间的饮食摄入与内脏脂肪指数（VAI）变化的纵向关联。方法：在伊朗德黑兰招募100名组织学确诊的乳腺癌患者，随访六个月。研究对象接受标准化化疗方案，包括HER2靶向治疗。研究将评估患者在治疗期间的饮食摄入及其对心代谢标志物、身体成分、心理困扰和健康相关生活质量的影响。
items.abstract: Background: Active systemic therapy, including chemotherapy alone or combined with HER2-directed targeted therapy, is a cornerstone of breast cancer management, yet it frequently precipitates adverse cardiometabolic, anthropometric, and psychological disturbances. Although dietary intake during active treatment may modulate these complications, rigorous prospective cohort evidence utilizing repeated dietary assessments and standardized clinical endpoints remains limited. Objective: The primary objective of this prospective cohort study is to investigate the longitudinal association between dietary intake during active cancer treatment and changes in the visceral adiposity index (VAI), serving as the primary cardiometabolic endpoint, among women with breast cancer. Secondary objectives are to examine associations between dietary exposures and individual cardiometabolic markers, body composition, psychological distress, and health-related quality of life. Methods: A prospective cohort of 100 women with histologically confirmed primary breast cancer is recruited at the initiation of systemic therapy and followed prospectively for six months in Tehran, Iran. The cohort encompasses pati

items.title: Shared and unique chromatin accessibility and 3D functional interactions of substance use disorder loci implicate cell types beyond the brain
items.title_zh: 物质使用障碍位点的染色质可及性与3D功能相互作用研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：近期的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）揭示了多种物质使用障碍（SUD）位点，表明这些性状在遗传病因上存在重叠。然而，SUD的因果变异、效应基因及细胞背景的程度尚不明确。我们旨在绘制四种SUD的细胞类型特异性遗传结构，并测试观察到的代谢富集是否反映与2型糖尿病（T2D）的共享因果生物学。方法：我们整合了来自59种人类细胞类型的3D基因组数据集（高分辨率启动子聚焦的Capture-C/Hi-C、ATAC-seq、RNA-seq）与近期的酒精（AUD）、烟草（TUD）、阿片类（OUD）和大麻使用障碍（CanUD）的GWAS汇总统计，使用分层LD回归（S-LDSC）。我们进行了SUD与T2D之间的局部遗传相关性分析（LAVA）、共享位点的基因表达与染色质可及性的多变量整合（DIABLO），以及后续的双向两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）以测试T2D与每种SUD之间的因果关系。结果：经过每个性状的假发现率（FDR）校正后，T...
items.abstract: Objective: Recent genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have revealed multiple loci for substance use disorders (SUDs), including evidence that the traits overlap in genetic etiology. However, the extent of underlying SUD causal variants, effector genes, and cellular contexts, remains unclear. Recent clinical trials of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists have shown promising effects on alcohol and tobacco consumption, raising the question of whether SUD genetic risk resides in metabolic as well as neural cell types. We sought to map the cell-type-specific genetic architecture of four SUDs and to test whether the observed metabolic enrichment reflects shared causal biology with type 2 diabetes (T2D). Methods: We integrated our 3D genomic datasets (high-resolution promoter-focused Capture-C/Hi-C, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq) from 59 diverse human cell types with recent GWAS summary statistics for alcohol (AUD), tobacco (TUD), opioid (OUD), and cannabis use disorder (CanUD), using Stratified LD regression (S-LDSC). items.title: No evidence of increased gaming-related problems with long-term use of a video game therapeutic: Exploratory endpoint findings from a randomized controlled trial
items.title_zh: 长期使用视频游戏治疗对游戏相关问题无明显影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨长期使用视频游戏治疗Meliora是否与游戏相关问题的变化有关。参与者为确诊为重度抑郁症的成年人，基线时无显著的游戏或赌博问题。随机对照试验共纳入1,001名参与者，平均年龄33.4岁，64%为女性。在干预前后（第12周），Meliora组的游戏成瘾量表（GAS-7）得分显著下降（平均变化-0.63分，95% CI：-0.91至-0.34，p < 0.001），而对照组未见变化（平均变化-0.02分，95% CI：-0.25至0.28，p = 0.900）。组间分析显示，Meliora组的GAS-7变化更为显著（调整后的平均差-0.19分，95% CI：-0.30至-0.08，p = 0.001），表明该治疗在降低游戏相关问题方面具有潜在优势。
items.abstract: Digital therapeutics for mental health often face low patient engagement, which limits their clinical impact. Interventions that deliver treatment using a video game medium may improve engagement and therapeutic efficacy, but the potential emergence of gaming-related problems remains a safety question and a concern among clinical stakeholders. We examined whether long-term adjunctive use of the video game therapeutic Meliora was associated with changes in gaming-related problems in a three-arm randomized controlled trial. Participants were adults with interview-confirmed major depressive disorder without significant gaming or gambling problems at baseline. The intention-to-treat cohort (n = 1,001) had a mean age of 33.4 years (SD 9.3), and 64% were female. From baseline to post-intervention (week 12), Game Addiction Scale (GAS-7) scores decreased in the Meliora group (mean change, -0.63 points; 95% CI, -0.91 to -0.34; dz = -0.24; Holm-adjusted p < 0.001), whereas no change was observed in the Sham group, which used a highly similar video game therapeutic (mean change, -0.02 points; 95% CI, -0.25 to 0.28; dz = -0.01; Holm-adjusted p = 0.900). items.title: Population-scale burden analysis of rare damaging coding variants identifies novel risk genes for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias and Parkinson's disease and related disorders
items.title_zh: 罕见有害编码变异对阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病的影响分析
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）和帕金森病及相关疾病（PDRD）具有显著的遗传贡献，但罕见有害编码变异在群体规模上的作用尚未完全阐明。我们在生物样本库和疾病聚焦测序队列中，对功能丧失和有害错义变异进行了基因负担测试，采用校准的代理表型和确诊病例敏感性分析以提高晚发疾病的研究能力。在研究显著性水平下，我们确认了已知ADRD基因（如TREM2、ABCA7等）和PDRD基因（如GBA1、LRRK2）的罕见变异负担。此外，我们在IMPA2发现了新的ADRD负担关联，在ANKRD27和CCL7发现了新的PDRD关联。ANKRD27的信号最强，有害变异集中在与Rab GTP酶和回收体成分相互作用的结构域内。我们的结果展示了群体规模测序在识别神经退行性疾病罕见编码风险基因中的价值。
items.abstract: Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) and Parkinson's disease and related disorders (PDRD) have substantial genetic contributions, yet the role of rare damaging coding variants remains incompletely characterized at population scale. We performed gene-burden testing of loss-of-function and deleterious missense variants in biobanks and disease-focused sequencing cohorts, using calibrated proxy-phenotypes and diagnosed-case sensitivity analyses to increase power for late-onset disease. At study-wide significance, we confirmed rare-variant burden in established ADRD genes (TREM2, ABCA7, SORL1, PSEN1, GRN, ATP8B4, ABCA1, ADAM10) and PDRD genes (GBA1, LRRK2). We also identified a novel ADRD burden association at IMPA2, and novel PDRD associations at ANKRD27, and CCL7. The strongest signal was observed for ANKRD27, where damaging variants clustered within domains mediating interactions with Rab GTPases and retromer components. Our results demonstrate the value of population-scale sequencing to identify rare coding risk genes for neurodegenerative diseases.
items.authors: Le Guen, Y.; Pena-Tauber, A.; Catoia Pulgrossi, R.; Park, J.; Orias, H.; Greicius, M. D.

items.title: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Trustworthy Large Language Models, Agentic AI, and Multimodal Systems
items.title_zh: 可信大型语言模型与多模态系统的统一评估框架
items.summary_zh: 仅凭基准分数无法全面评估现代人工智能系统的可信性。大型语言模型（LLMs）、代理系统和多模态模型（MLLMs）需要不同的评估形式，但其评估证据必须可解释，以便于开发和监督。我们提出了一个统一框架，通过八个可信性维度（能力、稳健性、安全性、公平性、透明性、治理、监督和效率）连接输出级、轨迹级和跨模态评估。该框架保留系统特定指标，同时将原生测量映射到通用性能区间，并附有不确定性估计和可追溯证据。元评估层检查评估本身的有效性、可靠性和可重复性。多维度分析揭示优势和劣势，而安全关键的覆盖措施防止总分掩盖关键失误。与治理框架、国际标准和欧盟监管要求的映射将技术评估与监督需求相连接。该框架为评估系统性能及其支持证据的可信性提供了结构化基础，实证验证在部署背景下仍是重要的下一步。
items.abstract: Benchmark scores alone provide an incomplete basis for assessing the trustworthiness of modern artificial intelligence systems. Large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, and multimodal models (MLLMs) require different forms of assessment, yet their evaluation evidence must remain interpretable for development and oversight. We propose a unified framework that connects output-level, trajectory-level, and cross-modal assessment through eight trustworthiness dimensions: capability, robustness, safety, fairness, transparency, governance, oversight, and efficiency. The framework preserves system-specific metrics while mapping native measurements to common performance bands, accompanied by uncertainty estimates and traceable evidence. A meta-evaluation layer examines the validity, reliability, and reproducibility of the evaluation itself. Multidimensional profiles expose strengths and weaknesses, while safety-critical overrides prevent aggregate scores from masking critical failures. Mappings to governance frameworks, international standards, and European Union regulatory requirements connect technical assessment with oversight needs. The framework provides a structured basis for as
items.authors: Shaina Raza, Ahmed Y. Radwan, Imran Liaquat, Kathryn Hume

items.title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
items.title_zh: 可重复性与构念效度：LLM在机构沟通中的测量
items.summary_zh: 高注释可重复性并不意味着LLM推断的测量能够捕捉其意图测量的构念。我们使用来自欧洲委员会AI法案咨询的数据集进行测试，将结构化调查响应与相同利益相关者的自由文本咨询提交相链接。LLM对咨询提交的注释高度可重复（类内相关系数 > 0.99），但与调查报告的名义构念测量的收敛性有限。调查与LLM推断的文本基础测量之间的差异在不同利益相关者群体中系统性变化：商业协会在文本基础咨询中对AI风险的关注高于调查响应（{\=g} = +1.0），而公共机构和一些非商业团体则表现出较小或负的差异。分数之间的差异表明欧洲国家之间存在正空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036），表明邻国利益相关者对AI安全问题的文本立场趋向相似。尽管存在差异，调查报告的关注仍与对可解释性的支持在所有差异水平上保持强关联。这些结果表明，LLM注释的可重复性可以与较差的构念对应共存。
items.abstract: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({\=g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. items.authors: Veronika Batzdorfer (KIT), Carlo Romano Marcello Alessandro Santagiustina (ALMAnaCH, m\'edialab, Sciences Po)

items.title: Not All AI Agents Are Equal: Characterizing Resource and Performance Dynamics
items.title_zh: 不同AI代理的资源与性能动态特征研究
items.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AI代理通过迭代推理和工具执行处理用户请求，通常涉及调用远程LLM API和本地工具容器。这种执行模型使得代理服务的优化变得困难，因为延迟、本地资源需求和容器瓶颈在请求间交织。然而，当前的代理生态系统在资源动态方面考虑不足，导致资源浪费。本文分析了AI代理在检索增强问答、网页搜索和软件编码三项代表性任务中的资源交互。我们对多个请求和任务并发处理的资源动态进行了延迟特征化。测量结果表明，代理的行为因任务而异，即使是相同工具的资源动态也存在显著差异。此外，多个请求并发运行暴露了依赖任务的资源动态瓶颈，如CPU、磁盘I/O和内存。我们还发现，快速的LLM响应或更多的CPU核心并不总能加速代理。基于这些观察，我们展示了利用任务资源动态的新优化机会：CPU感知的工具接纳和任务感知的CPU分配。我们的结果显示，延迟得到了显著改善。
items.abstract: LLM-based AI agents process user requests through iterative reasoning and tool execution, often involving the invocation of remote LLM APIs with local tool containers. This execution model can make the optimization of agent serving difficult because latency, local resource demand, and container bottlenecks inter-mix across requests. However, the current agent ecosystem runs without much consideration of resource dynamics, which results in significant waste of the precious resources. This paper analyzes the resource inter-mix of AI agents for three representative tasks: retrieval-augmented question answering, web search, and software coding. To this end, we characterize the latency with respect to the resource dynamics of processing multiple requests and tasks concurrently. Our measurements show that agents have a wide range of behaviors depending on tasks, so that even the same tool can differ substantially in resource dynamics. We also find that running multiple requests concurrently exposes task-dependent bottlenecks in resource dynamics such as CPU, disk I/O, and memory. Furthermore, we uncover that faster LLM responses or more CPU cores do not always accelerate agents. Based on
items.authors: Wonmi Choi, Minuk Park, Zhixiong Niu, Yongqiang Xiong, Chuck Yoo, Gyeongsik Yang

items.title: A Proposal for an Agentic AI Architecture to Support Multi-Domain Decision-Making in the Brazilian Armed Forces
items.title_zh: 支持巴西武装部队多领域决策的自主AI架构提案
items.summary_zh: 随着多领域作战环境（陆地、空天、海洋、网络和电磁频谱）的复杂性增加，指挥控制中心面临的数据量和速度显著提升，给观察-定位-决策-行动（OODA）决策循环带来压力。目前，防御领域使用的人工智能（AI）系统通常是反应性和孤立的工具，仍然依赖人类操作员整合信息、评估情境和制定行动方案。本文提出了一种概念性自主AI架构，旨在支持巴西三军（海军、陆军和空军）的决策过程，能够规划、访问数据源、执行工具并自主行动。讨论了四个应用领域（决策支持、态势分析、可行性研究和对策建议），以及数据和传感器访问要求和在行政、战略、操作和战术环境中负责任使用所需的安全和权限保障。
items.abstract: The growing complexity of multi-domain operational environments (land, aerospace, naval, cyber, and electromagnetic spectrum) has increased the volume and velocity of data reaching command-and-control (C2) centers, straining the observe-orient-decide-act (OODA) decision cycle. Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems currently employed in defense are, in general, reactive and isolated tools that still rely heavily on human operators to integrate information, assess scenarios, and formulate courses of action. This paper proposes a conceptual Agentic AI architecture for AI systems that can plan, access data sources, execute tools, and act autonomously and audibly, aimed at supporting decision-making across the three Brazilian Armed Forces (Navy, Army, and Air Force). Four application fronts are discussed (decision support, situational analysis, feasibility studies, and countermeasure suggestion), as well as the data and sensor access requirements and the security and permission safeguards necessary for responsible employment across administrative, strategic, operational, and tactical contexts.
items.authors: Gioliano de Oliveira Braga, Sidnei Barbieri, \'Agney Lopes Roth Ferraz, Wagner Comin Sonaglio, Henrique Curi de Miranda e Louren\c{c}o Alves Pereira Jr

items.title: AI-Driven Real-Time Relay Optimisation in Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimise Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 基于AI的智能城市NR-V2X网络实时中继优化研究
items.summary_zh: 可靠且低延迟的通信是智能城市服务和工业4.0应用的基本需求，尤其在NR-V2X网络中。然而，有限的路侧单元（RSU）部署和复杂的城市传播条件常导致连接和自动驾驶车辆（CAV）无法维持稳定连接。本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的AI驱动学习优化（L2O）框架，用于NR-V2X系统中的实时多跳中继选择。将车载网络建模为图，节点代表CAV和RSU，边编码无线链路特性。离线混合整数线性规划（MILP）提供的最优中继决策作为训练边缘感知图同构网络（GINE）的监督。大量在真实城市数据集上的实验表明，该方法实现了接近最优的连接性能，连接增益高达11.3%，同时执行时间相比MILP减少了多个数量级（最高可达100倍加速）。该框架支持可扩展的实时网络控制，适用于智能城市和工业4.0部署。
items.abstract: Reliable and low-latency communication is a fundamental requirement for smart city services and Industry 4.0 applications enabled by NR-V2X networks. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) deployment and complex urban propagation conditions often prevent Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable connectivity. This paper proposes an AI-driven Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time multi-hop relay selection in NR-V2X systems. The vehicular network is modelled as a graph, where nodes represent CAVs and RSUs, and edges encode radio-link characteristics. An offline Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulation provides optimal relay decisions used as supervision for training an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge Features (GINE). Extensive experiments on realistic urban datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves near-optimal connectivity performance, recovering up to 11.3% connectivity gain, while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude (up to 100 x speed-up) compared to MILP. The framework enables scalable and real-time network control, making it suitable for smart city and Indu
items.authors: Giambattista Amati, Federica Mangiatordi, Emiliano Pallotti, Simone Angelini

items.title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
items.title_zh: GAVEL：基于图模型的长时间跨度LLM任务规划验证与优化
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）为长时间跨度的机器人规划提供了灵活的接口，但生成的计划常常无法遵循具体实施约束、从规划错误中恢复或在部分可观测性下有效推理。我们提出了GAVEL，一个基于显式图世界模型的长时间跨度LLM规划验证与修复框架。该图模型表示相关的对象关系、动作前提条件和效果，以及对未观察对象位置的概率信念。该模型能够在执行前预测LLM生成动作的后果，检测违规行为，并修复那些直接从世界模型中得出的修正。对于多任务指令，GAVEL通过推理可能对象位置的分布来重新排序剩余子任务，最小化预期搜索成本。我们在BEHAVIOR-1K上评估GAVEL，涵盖100个单一长时间跨度任务和500个多任务指令。使用Qwen3-8B，GAVEL将单任务成功率从41.2%提升至91.8%，多任务成功率从19.9%提升至92.6%。分布式信念推理还将旅行距离减少约5.4%。这些改进表明，显式图世界模型显著提高了长时间跨度任务的可靠性和效率。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel di
items.authors: Ruiyang Wang, Hao-Lun Hsu, Swarajh Mehta, Jiwoo Kim, Zhihao Dou, Miroslav Pajic

items.title: Kinematics-Grounded Agentic AI for Robotic Additive Manufacturing Process Planning
items.title_zh: 基于运动学的自主智能AI在机器人增材制造中的应用
items.summary_zh: 机器人增材制造（AM）将材料挤出打印扩展到超越龙门运动学，但使得过程规划依赖于机器人。切片生成的计划在部件坐标中看似可行，但在操控器上可能变得不可行或不利，因为切片过程决策和部件方向决定了生成路径，而部件方向和工作空间布局影响其运动学实现。现有的AM工具、大型语言模型（LLM）基础的决策支持方法和数字影子系统未能提供这些耦合决策的集成执行前评估。本文提出了自主机器人增材制造（A-RAM），一个将用户意图和部件文件转换为可追踪、执行就绪计划的框架。LLM解释制造目标和约束，识别规定和可搜索的规划变量，并将此推理编码为模式约束请求；确定性规划代理实例化相应的搜索工作流，而领域工具计算切片、放置、逆运动学、轨迹时序、关节6的冲击和挤出等定量证据。该框架通过三个案例研究在六轴机器人手臂AM单元上进行了评估。
items.abstract: Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrus
items.authors: Jingzhan Ge, Ruimin Chen, Azadeh Haghighi, Jiong Tang, Farhad Imani

items.title: SoK: Trading Agents or Market Crashers? Dissecting Robustness and Security Failures in Academic Financial LLM Trading Schemes
items.title_zh: 金融交易代理的鲁棒性与安全性研究
items.summary_zh: 自主大型语言模型（LLM）代理迅速进入高风险领域，但现有的代理人工智能安全研究大多缺乏针对性，忽视了这些环境所带来的独特攻击面。我们通过金融交易代理这一高风险代理安全的代表性案例来探讨这一差距，其中单个被攻陷的代理直接控制真实资本。为此，我们提出了FARSIGHT（金融代理鲁棒性与安全性调查及全球整体测试）框架，对金融LLM代理进行方案级评估，重点关注市场动荡下的鲁棒性（包括闪电崩盘场景）和针对三种攻击类型的安全性：信息源攻击、代理攻击和代理作为攻击者的行为。对15个代表性学术方案的应用结果显示，大多数方案忽视了鲁棒性和现实的对抗威胁：80%至少在一个核心鲁棒性指标上失败，100%存在安全漏洞。这两种失败模式是不可分割的：小的判断失误可能导致市场崩盘，而对手可以以最低成本故意触发同样的崩溃。
items.abstract: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents are moving rapidly into high-stakes domains, yet existing agentic-AI security studies remain largely domain-agnostic and overlook the distinctive, high-consequence attack surface such settings create. We examine this gap through financial trading agents, a representative case of high-stakes agentic security, where a single compromised agent has direct execution authority over real capital in an adversarial, reflexive market. To this end, we present FARSIGHT (Financial Agent Robustness and Security Investigation and Global Holistic Testing), a framework that performs scheme-level evaluation of financial LLM agents on two axes: robustness under market turbulence (including flash-crash-like scenarios), and security against three attack types: attacks on information sources, attacks on agents, and agent-as-attacker behaviors. Applying FARSIGHT to 15 representative academic schemes, we find that most overlook robustness and realistic adversarial threats: 80% fail at least one core robustness metric and 100% exhibit security vulnerabilities. These two failure modes are inseparable: a small misjudgment can cascade into a market-wide crash on it
items.authors: Mengxiao Wang, Nitesh Saxena

items.title: AI Should Facilitate Democratic Deliberation at Scale
items.title_zh: AI应促进大规模民主协商
items.summary_zh: AI系统可以通过解决认知、社会、平台设计和市场驱动的摩擦，增强民主，支持大规模协商，同时保持人类的自主性。与通过投票委托重构代表性的流动民主提案不同，本文认为AI辅助的协商提供了一条更有前景的路径，能够降低有意义参与的障碍，而不以机器判断取代人类选择。基于在线协商平台和实验研究的证据，我们确定了四个指导原则：保持自主性和独立性、鼓励相互尊重、促进平等和包容性，以及增强而非替代积极公民身份。我们还讨论了关键挑战，包括对齐、谄媚、训练偏见和对AI系统的过度依赖。我们呼吁机器学习社区开发以协商为中心的AI系统，评估标准不应仅基于参与指标，而应关注其促进知情、代表性和抗摩擦话语的能力。
items.abstract: AI systems can strengthen democracy by supporting deliberation at scale by addressing cognitive, social, platform-design, and market-driven frictions, while preserving human agency. Unlike proposals such as liquid democracy that restructure representation through vote delegation, in this position paper, we argue that AI-assisted deliberation offers a more promising path by lowering barriers to meaningful engagement without substituting machine judgment for human choice. Drawing on evidence from online deliberation platforms and experimental research, we identify four guiding principles: preserving agency and autonomy, encouraging mutual respect, promoting equality and inclusiveness, and augmenting rather than substituting active citizenship. We also address critical challenges, including alignment, sycophancy, training bias, and over-reliance on AI systems. We call on the machine learning community to develop deliberation-focused AI systems evaluated not on engagement metrics but on their capacity to facilitate informed, representative, and friction-robust discourse.
items.authors: Jos\'e Ram\'on Enr\'iquez, Jiaxin Pei, Alex Pentland

items.title: Designing Against Deskilling: Metacognitive Feedback Reduces Cognitive Offloading to LLM Assistants
items.title_zh: 设计反对技能退化：元认知反馈减少对LLM助手的认知外包
items.summary_zh: 认知外包给人工智能可能减少技能练习的机会，从而导致技能退化。然而，如何在不限制对人工智能访问的情况下防止技能退化仍不明确。本研究设计了两种干预措施以减少外包决策：（1）元认知反馈，使用户明确外包的影响；（2）基于努力的奖励，激励用户减少对LLM的依赖。我们在一项预注册的在线实验中测试了这两种干预（$N = 704$），采用2$\times$2设计和无AI对照组。任务是与基于LLM的助手练习分数运算，该助手仅在明确请求时提供解决方案，随后进行无辅助测试。元认知反馈显著减少了答案外包（OR $= 0.47$）并提高了测试表现（OR $= 1.51$）。我们未发现奖励对结果有影响的证据。结果表明，元认知反馈是减少认知外包的有前景的设计选择。
items.abstract: Cognitive offloading to AI can reduce opportunities to practice skills, creating risks of deskilling. However, it remains unclear how to prevent deskilling without restricting access to AI. Here, we design two interventions to reduce offloading decisions: (1) metacognitive feedback that makes the implications of offloading for users explicit, and (2) an effort-based reward that incentivizes less extensive LLM assistance. We test both in a preregistered online experiment ($N = 704$) with a 2$\times$2 design and a no-AI control. The task was to practice fraction arithmetic with an LLM-based assistant that provided solutions only on explicit request, followed by an unaided test. Metacognitive feedback reduced answer offloading (OR $= 0.47$) and improved test performance (OR $= 1.51$). We found no evidence that the reward affected either outcome. Our results identify metacognitive feedback as a promising design choice to reduce cognitive offloading.
items.authors: Sebastian Maier, Kai Schwabe, Manuel Schneider, Stefan Feuerriegel

items.title: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Cognitive and Resting States Using Electroencephalography Signals
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的脑电信号认知与静息状态分类
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过脑电图（EEG）信号对认知状态与静息状态进行分类，以理解与不同心理状态相关的脑活动波动。EEG提供了一种非侵入性的方法来记录静息和任务导向的认知条件下的脑功能，而深度学习技术则能够自动提取复杂EEG数据中的重要模式。我们提出了一种深度学习框架，结合卷积神经网络（CNN）和门控递归单元（GRU）来提取EEG信号特征。通过时频分析探索信号的显著特征，并利用传统深度学习和机器学习分类器对提取的特征进行评估，包括建议的2D-Net架构。该方法在静息与数学任务分类中准确率达到83.177%，静息与记忆任务分类中76.107%，静息与音乐任务分类中83.432%。研究结果表明，将信号处理与深度学习方法结合在区分静息与认知状态方面具有良好效果。
items.abstract: The categorization of cognitive and resting states derived from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is crucial for comprehending fluctuations in brain activity linked to various mental states. EEG provides a non-intrusive approach for documenting brain function in both resting and task-oriented cognitive conditions, whilst deep learning techniques enable the automatic extraction of significant patterns from intricate EEG data. This study presents a deep learning framework to distinguish between resting and cognitive states through EEG records. The proposed framework integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) stacked with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) for the extraction of features from EEG signals. Time-frequency analysis is conducted to explore the salient aspects of signals, and the derived features are then assessed utilizing conventional deep learning and machine learning classifiers, including the suggested 2D-Net architecture. The proposed approach and feature extraction strategy outperform the evaluated comparative methods, achieving accuracies of 83.177% for resting-versus-mathematical task classification, 76.107% for resting-versus-memory task classification, and 83.4
items.authors: K. A. Januka S. Fernando, Harshit Srivastava

items.title: A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies
items.title_zh: AUV故障恢复的仿真平台：探索基于LLM的诊断策略
items.summary_zh: 自主水下航行器（AUV）在可靠通信之外的操作中必须在无人工干预的情况下恢复故障。我们研究了一种架构，其中传统的确定性分层控制自主性管理正常操作，而可调用的大型语言模型（LLM）在机载异常检测识别出性能超出预期范围时，作为诊断和恢复规划工具。由于语言模型具有随机性，严格评估需要进行集成测试而非单独演示。我们提出了一种闭环仿真架构，将实时C语言车辆软件与更高层次的编排层结合，用于基于物理的故障注入、结构化提示、语言模型交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行和LLM评分。该框架称为SPAR（AUV恢复仿真平台），支持在故障实现、提示结构、推理模型和任务条件下的评估。在480次SPAR试验中，我们针对质量转移故障进行了变化，评估了一个前沿模型和三种现成的本地可部署LLM。模型选择主导诊断：前沿模型在85-90%的试验中将重心转移机制列为前三个假设，而最佳本地模型为60-78%。推理分析表明，本地模型的成功与其推理能力相关。
items.abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier m
items.authors: Khalid Halba, Kylie Cooper, James G. Bellingham

items.title: Large Language Models as Falsifiers for Cyber-Physical Systems
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型在网络物理系统中的反例生成应用
items.summary_zh: 反例生成旨在寻找网络物理系统（CPS）中形式规范的反例。通过使用信号时序逻辑（STL）编写的规范，反例生成可以被表述为一个鲁棒性优化问题，传统上采用黑箱搜索算法解决。与此同时，大型语言模型（LLMs）在结合迭代提示时表现出意外的优化效果。本研究提出LLM-Falsifier，一种基于LLM的方法，通过最小化STL鲁棒性度来生成反例。我们将LLM暴露于自然语言输入、输出名称、输出轨迹及关键时间见证等语义信息，从而实现更智能和样本效率更高的鲁棒性搜索。在ARCH-COMP反例生成基准测试中，LLM-Falsifier在21个规范中有14个的平均模拟次数上超越了基于多种优化范式的现有反例生成工具。
items.abstract: Falsification searches for counterexamples to formal specifications in cyber-physical systems (CPS). With specifications written in Signal Temporal Logic (STL), falsification can be formulated as a robustness optimization problem, traditionally tackled with black-box search algorithms. In parallel, large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as surprisingly effective optimizers when coupled with iterative prompting. In this work, we connect these ideas and introduce LLM-Falsifier, an LLM-based approach that falsifies specifications by minimizing the STL robustness degree. Beyond generic prompt-based optimization, our key idea is to expose the LLM to semantic information that is natural for language models but absent from standard numerical optimizers, including natural-language input and output names, output trajectories, and critical-time witnesses for the minimum robustness value. These additions enable smarter and more sample-efficient robustness search. On the ARCH-COMP falsification benchmarks, LLM-Falsifier is shown to outperform existing falsification tools based on a range of optimization paradigms, from surrogate-based and Bayesian optimization to search-based testi
items.authors: Ali ArjomandBigdeli, Jiawei Zhou, Stanley Bak

items.title: A Neuropsychologically Grounded Evaluation of LLM Cognitive Abilities
items.title_zh: 基于神经心理学的LLM认知能力评估
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在10个基准测试中表现出统一的“通用因子”，但在简单任务上仍然存在困难。现有基准主要关注任务完成，未能探讨基础认知能力。为此，我们引入了NeuroCognition基准，基于三项改编的神经心理学测试，分别针对抽象关系推理（Raven's Progressive Matrices）、目标导向空间更新（Spatial Working Memory）和认知灵活性（Wisconsin Card Sorting Test）。评估结果显示，模型在文本上表现良好，但在图像和复杂性增加时性能下降。与人类基线比较发现，LLMs和人类在同一任务的不同部分表现不佳。此外，复杂推理并不总是有利，而简单的人类策略则能带来部分收益。NeuroCognition与标准通用能力基准呈正相关，同时测量超出这些基准的独特认知能力。总体而言，NeuroCognition强调了当前LLMs与人类智能的对齐之处及其在核心适应性认知上的不足。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display a unified "general factor" of capability across 10 benchmarks (a finding confirmed by our factor analysis of 156 models), yet they still struggle with simple, trivial tasks for humans. This is because current benchmarks focus on task completion, failing to probe the foundational cognitive abilities that highlight these behaviors. We address this by introducing the NeuroCognition benchmark, grounded in three adapted neuropsychological tests targeting distinct foundational cognitive components: Raven's Progressive Matrices (abstract relational reasoning), Spatial Working Memory (goal-directed spatial updating), and the Wisconsin Card Sorting Test (cognitive flexibility). Our evaluation reveals that while models perform strongly on text, their performance degrades for images and with increased complexity. Comparison with a human baseline shows that LLMs and humans fail at different parts of the same tasks. Furthermore, we observe that complex reasoning is not universally beneficial, whereas simple, human-like strategies yield partial gains. We also find that NeuroCognition correlates positively with standard general-capability benchmarks, while sti
items.authors: Faiz Ghifari Haznitrama, Faeyza Rishad Ardi, Alice Oh

items.title: AI Training Manager: Bounded Closed-Loop Control of Adaptive Training Recipes
items.title_zh: AI训练管理器：自适应训练方案的有界闭环控制
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了AI训练管理器，这是一个基于有界大型语言模型（LLM）的元认知监控与控制层，用于机器学习训练。该管理器异步观察活跃训练过程中的结构化遥测数据，评估当前训练方案，并通过受限的、确定性验证的行动接口选择自适应干预。我们在监督学习和强化学习任务上评估了该方法。在监督学习中，我们在TinyStories数据集上训练的GPT-2风格模型中引入了多目标过拟合失败，管理器成功防止了后期验证崩溃，相较于相同的压力方案，最终验证损失降低了54.3%。在强化学习中，我们研究了在对抗多因素压力下的机器人到达任务。在保守方案中，管理器将最终确定性安全成功率从0.413提高到0.705；在激进方案中，安全成功率从0.121提高到0.764。两个方案中使用了相同的管理器指令和行动界面。这些结果表明，有界LLM推理可以为持续学习过程提供实用的元认知控制层。
items.abstract: We present the AI Training Manager, a bounded LLM-based metacognitive monitoring-and-control layer for machine-learning training. The manager asynchronously observes structured telemetry from an active training run, assesses the current training regime, and selects adaptive interventions through a constrained, deterministically verified action interface. We evaluate the approach on supervised and reinforcement-learning tasks. For supervised learning, we induce a multi-objective overfitting failure in a GPT-2-style model trained on TinyStories. The manager prevents the resulting late-run validation collapse, reducing final validation loss by 54.3% relative to the same stressed recipe. For reinforcement learning, we study robotic reaching under opposing multifactor stress regimes. In a conservative regime, the manager raises final deterministic safe success from 0.413 to 0.705. In an aggressive regime, it raises safe success from 0.121 to 0.764. The same manager instructions and action surface are used in both regimes. These results suggest that bounded LLM reasoning can provide a practical metacognitive control layer over ongoing learning processes.
items.authors: Anjali Rao, Nikhil Kamalkumar Advani

items.title: AquiLLM: Evaluating Faithfulness in Open-Weight RAG-LLM Systems for Scientific Research
items.title_zh: AquiLLM：评估开放权重RAG-LLM系统在科学研究中的可信度
items.summary_zh: 科学研究日益依赖于大型异构数据源，促使对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的关注，这些系统为科学知识和研究工作流程提供自然语言访问。研究人员正在探索这些系统作为文档搜索的自然语言接口及生成分析代码和流程组件的可行性。同时，数据隐私和研究基础设施控制的担忧推动了对开放权重模型和在研究机构内部托管的开源部署的兴趣。本文对AquiLLM进行领域专家评估，该平台是一个开放权重的离线RAG-LLM，旨在支持科学研究团队使用和保存隐性与显性知识。我们将可信度定义为生成的响应在多大程度上保持与检索的科学背景相一致，且没有不支持的主张或遗漏。我们报告了一个天文学案例研究的结果，评估了AquiLLM在检索和科学分析任务中的表现。AquiLLM在明确的检索导向问题上表现最为可靠。
items.abstract: Scientific research increasingly relies on large, heterogeneous data sources, motivating interest in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that provide natural language access to scientific knowledge and research workflows. Researchers are exploring the viability of these systems as natural language interfaces for document search and for generating analysis code and pipeline components. At the same time, concerns about data privacy and control over research infrastructure have motivated interest in open-weight models and open-source deployments hosted within research institutions. In astronomy, this development follows a long history of computational infrastructure development, from archival databases and Structured Query Language (SQL)-based systems to large language model (LLM)-assisted research tools. This paper presents a domain-expert evaluation of faithfulness for AquiLLM, an open-weight, offline RAG-LLM platform designed to support scientific research groups in the use and preservation of tacit and formal knowledge. We define faithfulness as the extent to which generated responses remain grounded in retrieved scientific context without unsupported claims or omissions.
items.authors: Bernie Boscoe, Srinath Saikrishnan, Vikram Seenivasan, Jack Stark, Andrew Lizarraga, Morgan Himes, Jonathan Soriano, PJ Allen, Tuan Do

items.title: Communication and Verification in LLM Agents towards Collaboration under Information Asymmetry
items.title_zh: 信息不对称下LLM代理的沟通与验证研究
items.summary_zh: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）代理在任务协作中的表现，特别是在信息不对称的情况下，代理之间存在知识和技能差异，需要共同完成共享任务。我们将经典的爱因斯坦谜题扩展为桌面游戏。在该游戏中，两个LLM代理必须推理、沟通并采取行动，以满足解决谜题所需的空间和关系约束。我们采用了微调加验证器的框架，使LLM代理具备多种沟通策略和来自环境的验证信号。实证结果强调了对齐沟通的重要性，尤其是在代理具备信息获取和提供能力时。尽管没有沟通的代理仍能实现较高的任务表现，但进一步分析显示其缺乏对规则的真正理解，且人类评估者的信任度较低。通过整合基于环境的验证器，我们提升了代理理解任务规则和完成任务的能力，从而促进了更安全的协作。
items.abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents are often approached from the angle of action planning/generation to accomplish a goal (e.g., given by language descriptions), their abilities to collaborate with each other to achieve a joint goal are not well explored. To address this limitation, this paper studies LLM agents in task collaboration, particularly under the condition of information asymmetry, where agents have disparities in their knowledge and skills and need to work together to complete a shared task. We extend Einstein Puzzles, a classical symbolic puzzle, to a table-top game. In this game, two LLM agents must reason, communicate, and act to satisfy spatial and relational constraints required to solve the puzzle. We apply a fine-tuning-plus-verifier framework in which LLM agents are equipped with various communication strategies and verification signals from the environment. Empirical results highlight the critical importance of aligned communication, especially when agents possess both information-seeking and -providing capabilities. items.authors: Run Peng, Ziqiao Ma, Amy Pang, Sikai Li, Zhang Xi-Jia, Yingzhuo Yu, Cristian-Paul Bara, Joyce Chai

items.title: EssentialGIN: a new approach for gene essentiality prediction based on graph isomorphism neural networks
items.title_zh: EssentialGIN：基于图同构神经网络的基因必需性预测新方法
items.summary_zh: 背景：预测必需基因（蛋白质）是一个基本且具有挑战性的问题，但在湿实验中成本高且耗时。仅基于计算方法（引入湿实验候选）使用中心性度量进行的必需基因预测不够准确，导致大量假阳性。因此，近期研究采用更复杂的模型如深度学习，并整合生物信息以识别必需基因。方法：本研究聚焦于图同构网络，将蛋白质嵌入PPI网络作为节点，以保留PPI网络的拓扑特征，并整合基因表达数据、基因同源信息和基因亚细胞定位信息，提出了一种深度架构用于预测必需基因。结果：实验表明，所提方法优于基于中心性的方法以及基于机器学习的方法，如Node2Vec、MLP和图注意力网络（GAT）。结论：本研究观察到，使用整合生物数据（作为节点属性）并保留网络拓扑的图同构网络可以显著提高必需基因预测的准确性。
items.abstract: Background: Prediction of essential genes (proteins), is a basic and challenging problem but at the same time very costly and time-consuming in wet-lab experiments. Predicting essential genes, only based on computational methods (to introduce wet-lab candidates) using centrality measures are not accurate and result in large number of false positives; therefore, more complex models such as deep learning and also integration of biological information are used in recent research to identify essential genes. Methods: In this work we focus on graph isomorphism networks, in order to embed proteins as a node in PPI network to conserve topological features of PPI network, and also integrate biological data such as gene expression data, gene orthology information and gene subcellular localization information, and introduced a deep architecture for predicting essential genes. Graph isomorphism network architecture is modified in this work for embedding node information. Results: Our experiments proved that the proposed method outperforms baseline centrality-based methods and also machine learning based methods such as Node2Vec, MLP, and also graph attention networks (GAT).
