items.title: Extragalactic microlensing through Ultra Diffuse Galaxies
items.title_zh: 通过超弥散星系的星际微透镜研究
items.summary_zh: 恒星微透镜是一种强有力的方法，用于约束紧凑暗物质模型、发现双星和系外行星。在宇宙距离上，{\it 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜}（{\it JWST}）常规检测到在大质量透镜团后方的微透镜巨星。本文首次探讨了通过本地超弥散星系（UDGs）观察的适度红移星系中的微透镜现象。以UDG NGC1052-DF2为概念验证，我们发现通过UDGs检测微透镜事件是可行的。Euclid卫星非常适合识别通过本地星系观察的低红移星形成星系样本，以便进行更深入的后续观测。我们的零阶计算估计，在LSST监测下，预计全天空每年会有$\mathcal{O}(1-10)$事件发生，假设所有UDGs与NGC1052-DF2具有相似的距离和恒星成分。这些测量可以通过提供更偏重于恒星初始质量函数（IMF）低端的恒星质量估计，帮助解决UDG星系的暗物质问题。
items.abstract: Stellar microlensing is a powerful method to constrain compact dark matter models, uncover binary stars, and exoplanets during caustic crossing events. At cosmological distances, {\it James-Webb Space Telescope} ({\it JWST}) is routinely detecting microlensed giant stars in highly magnified galaxies behind massive lensing clusters. Here, we explore for the first time microlensing in modest redshift galaxies commonly seen through local Ultra Diffuse Galaxies (UDGs). Using the UDG NGC1052-DF2 as a proof-of-concept, we find that detecting microlensing events through UDGs is possible. Euclid is ideal for identifying samples of low-redshift star-forming galaxies seen through local galaxies for deeper cadenced follow-up, where our zeroth-order calculation estimates that $\mathcal{O}(1-10)$ events per year are expected over the whole sky under the monitoring of LSST, assuming all UDGs share similar distance and stellar content as NGC1052-DF2. Such measurements can help settle the DM issue for UDG galaxies by providing a stellar mass estimate weighted more by the low end of the stellar initial mass function (IMF) than standard stellar synthesis estimates. Note, lower efficiency is estimate
items.authors: Sung Kei Li, Thomas Broadhurst, Jose M. Diego, Jeremy Lim, Jose M. Palencia, James Nianias, Jiashuo Zhang

items.title: The Sound of the Universe: A Resonant Gravitational Instability Driven by Baryon-Dark Matter Relative Drift
items.title_zh: 宇宙的声音：由重子-暗物质相对漂移驱动的共振引力不稳定性
items.summary_zh: 在早期宇宙中，暗物质和重子在解耦后获得相对速度。重子仅在其简斯尺度以上才会引力不稳定，而冷暗物质（CDM）在所有尺度上均不稳定。我们首次展示了它们的相对漂移触发了一种共振引力不稳定性，驱动重子中的声波。当投影的暗物质漂移为亚声速时，重子的稳定振荡分支与多普勒偏移的暗物质模式共振，产生指数增长的扰动，其增长率超过内在的CDM增长率。该不稳定性在重子简斯尺度以下达到峰值，并在重子主导的环境中，在简斯尺度与共振之间打开了完全稳定的窗口。超声速漂移抑制增长。共振耦合还在物种之间转移动量，产生无粘、无碰撞的拖曳。我们推导了共振增长率的准确解析近似，并显示相关时间尺度在不同环境中从几年到数千万年不等，通常远短于其年龄。在扩展的FLRW宇宙中，该不稳定性增强了不同红移下的重子密度扰动。
items.abstract: Dark matter and baryons acquire a relative velocity after decoupling in the early Universe. Baryons are gravitationally unstable only above their Jeans scale, while cold dark matter (CDM) is unstable on all scales. We show for the first time that their relative drift triggers a resonant gravitational instability that drives sound waves in baryons. When the projected DM drift is subsonic, the stable oscillatory branch of baryons resonates with the Doppler-shifted DM mode, producing exponentially growing perturbations whose growth rates exceed the intrinsic CDM growth rate. The instability peaks below the baryon Jeans scale and, in baryon-dominated environments, opens a window of complete stability between the Jeans scale and the resonance. Supersonic drift suppresses growth, as previously noted. The resonant coupling also transfers momentum between the species, creating a non-viscous, collisionless drag. We derive an accurate analytical approximation for the growth rate at resonance and show that the associated timescales range from years to tens of millions of years across diverse environments -- planets, protoplanetary disks, stars, molecular clouds, galaxies, and galaxy clusters
items.authors: Mohamad Shalaby, Avery Broderick

items.title: Assessing Ultra-Cool Dwarf Contamination in Photometrically Selected High-Redshift Galaxy Samples
items.title_zh: 评估光度选择的高红移星系样本中的超冷矮星污染
items.summary_zh: 超冷矮星（UCDs）在高红移星系搜索中是常见的污染源，因为这两类天体均具有红色特征，且早期形成的星系尺寸即使在空间望远镜下也难以分辨。我们开发了前景污染评估器（FC-ENZO），该代码能够预测特定调查设置和星系选择方法下的UCD污染。FC-ENZO结合了UCD数密度模型、合成光谱库和光度选择标准来估算污染物种群。研究发现，预测的污染量对所采用的UCD光谱模型、恒星金属丰度和银河分布模型敏感，银河分布模型的变化可达数倍。Elf Owl模型预测的污染量高于Bobcat模型，主要是因为其覆盖了更广泛的T型和Y型矮星光谱。主要污染物为晚L型到早Y型UCDs，最常被误分类为$z \sim 8$的星系。对于相似面积的调查，不同空间望远镜的宽带观测在给定红移下产生的污染物数量相当，但污染物集中在调查的限制星等附近。
items.abstract: Ultra-cool dwarf stars (UCDs) are a common source of contamination in high-redshift galaxy searches because both populations have red colors and these early-forming galaxies can have sizes that are difficult to resolve even with space telescopes. We develop \textbf{F}oreground \textbf{C}ontamination \textbf{E}valuator of \textbf{N}earby dwarf stars in high-\textbf{Z} photometrically selected \textbf{O}bjects (FC-ENZO), a code that predicts magnitude-dependent UCD contamination for a given survey setup and galaxy selection method. FC-ENZO combines UCD number-density models, synthetic spectral libraries, and photometric selection criteria to estimate contaminant populations. We find that the predicted contamination is sensitive to the adopted UCD spectral model, stellar metallicity, and Galactic distribution models, with the Galactic distribution model producing variations of up to several factors. The Elf Owl models predict higher contamination than the Bobcat models, primarily because of their broader coverage of T and Y dwarf spectra. The dominant contaminants are late L to early Y-type UCDs, which are most commonly misclassified as galaxies at $z \sim 8$. For surveys with similar
items.authors: Onnalin Innala, Nicha Leethochawalit, Takahiro Morishita, Michele Trenti

items.title: Enhanced Emission and Two-Photon Interference of Lead-Vacancy Centers in Diamond Solid Immersion Lenses
items.title_zh: 铅空位中心在金刚石固体浸没透镜中的增强发射与双光子干涉
items.summary_zh: 负电荷铅空位（PbV-）中心是金刚石中的一种新型量子系统，因其较大的基态能级分裂，可在高于4 K的温度下操作。为了揭示PbV-中心的量子特性，荧光强度的增强是关键问题。本文展示了通过在高温退火（超过2000℃）后在粗糙金刚石表面制备的固体浸没透镜（SILs）实现的PbV-中心发射增强，增强因子约为10。共振激发显示出接近变换极限线宽的窄发射。此外，我们还展示了在SIL中使用单个PbV-中心的双光子干涉。这种增强发射和不可区分性将推动PbV-中心在量子网络节点应用方面的进一步发展。
items.abstract: A negatively charged lead-vacancy (PbV-) center in diamond is a novel quantum system which can be operated at a high temperature above 4 K owing to its large ground state splitting. To unlock the quantum properties of the PbV- center, the enhancement of the fluorescence intensity is a key issue. Here, we demonstrate enhanced emission from PbV- centers by a factor of approximately 10 using solid immersion lenses (SILs) fabricated on rough diamond surface caused by high-temperature anneal over 2000{\deg}C. Resonant excitation reveals the narrow emission close to the transform-limited linewidth. Furthermore, we demonstrate two-photon interference using one single PbV- center in an SIL. This enhanced emission and indistinguishability will lead to further development of the PbV- center towards quantum network node applications.
items.authors: Koyo Hirai, Eiki Ota, Yiyang Chen, Ren Kato, Peng Wang, Toshiharu Makino, Takashi Taniguchi, Masashi Miyakawa, Shinobu Onoda, Mutsuko Hatano, Takayuki Iwasaki

items.title: A Square-Root Barrier to Quantum Gate Speed under Linear Coupling
items.title_zh: 量子门速度的平方根障碍与线性耦合
items.summary_zh: 更快的量子门可以抑制计算过程中积累的去相干，但在超导处理器中，强微波脉冲也可能增加泄漏、非共振激发、杂散场误差和串扰。这形成了能量-速度-误差的权衡：量子态工程能否在不成比例增加驱动能量的情况下使门的参数速度加快？我们通过将驱动脉冲视为量子玻色场而非经典波形来探讨这一问题。对于与该场线性耦合的有限维系统，我们证明在耦合和动态的均匀性条件下，固定保真度的门跃迁速率至多以脉冲能量的平方根增长。该界限允许任意脉冲态，包括压缩态和非高斯态，以及驱动-系统纠缠和反馈作用；相干高斯脉冲达到了其能量指数。因此，仅靠压缩或其他态工程无法替代传统线性驱动的平方根能量法则。实现这一改进需要改变交互类别，并使用合适的非经典脉冲，从而确定交互非线性是放宽实际门速度误差权衡的重要资源。
items.abstract: Faster quantum gates can suppress the decoherence accumulated during a computation, but in superconducting processors stronger microwave pulses can also increase leakage, off-resonant excitation, stray-field errors, and crosstalk. This creates a central energy--speed--error tradeoff: can quantum state engineering make a gate parametrically faster without paying proportionally more drive energy? We address this question by treating the driving pulse as a quantum bosonic field rather than a classical waveform. For a finite-dimensional system coupled linearly to that field, we prove that fixed-fidelity gate transition rates grow at most as the square root of the pulse energy, under stated uniformity conditions on the coupling and accepted dynamics. The bound permits arbitrary pulse states, including squeezed and non-Gaussian states, as well as drive--system entanglement and back action; coherent Gaussian pulses attain its energy exponent. Thus squeezing or other state engineering alone cannot replace the square-root energy law of a conventional linear drive by the linear scaling allowed by general quantum speed limits. Achieving that improvement requires changing the interaction class
items.authors: Pablo Restrepo Gaviria, Mischa P. Woods

items.title: Temporal information processing on a 4,500-qubit quantum annealer
items.title_zh: 基于4500量子比特的量子退火器的时间信息处理
items.summary_zh: 量子机器学习有潜力揭示超越经典模型的统计结构，但需要足够大且具有表现力的量子模型。我们在可编程超导量子退火器上实现了一个量子机器学习模型，使用最多4500个量子比特处理大规模时间数据，这是迄今为止最大规模的量子机器学习实验。该模型遵循量子水库计算范式，利用反向退火生成的未训练的多体动力学直接处理时间数据。我们证明了退火过程中产生的相互作用是不可或缺的，非相互作用的水库无法保留输入的记忆。通过在标准记忆基准上进行实验评估，我们展示了该模型能够成功预测混沌时间序列。这些结果确立了量子退火器作为大规模量子机器学习的可扩展平台。
items.abstract: Quantum machine learning could uncover statistical structure beyond the reach of classical models, but this requires quantum models large and expressive enough to be useful and cheap enough to read out. Most approaches optimize many quantum parameters and are thus limited by expensive training loops. Here we report a quantum machine-learning model implemented on a programmable superconducting quantum annealer that processes temporal data at large scale using up to 4,500 qubits-the largest quantum machine-learning experiment performed to date. Following the quantum reservoir computing paradigm, the untrained native many-body dynamics generated by reverse annealing is directly used to process temporal data. We prove that the interactions produced during annealing are indispensable-a non-interacting reservoir retains no memory of its input. We evaluate our model experimentally on standard memory benchmarks and demonstrate that it can successfully forecast chaotic time series. These results establish quantum annealers as a scalable platform for large-scale quantum machine learning.
items.authors: Antonio Sannia, Roberto Menta, Pratik Sathe, Dario De Santis, Vittorio Giovannetti, Luis Pedro Garc\'ia-Pintos, Davide Venturelli, Gian Luca Giorgi, Roberta Zambrini, Francesco Caravelli

items.title: Normalizing Flow-Based Bayesian Parameter Estimation for Noisy Quantum States
items.title_zh: 基于归一化流的噪声量子态贝叶斯参数估计
items.summary_zh: 为了提取实验噪声量子态的完整信息及不同物理参数之间的关联，我们开发了一种高效的机器学习辅助框架，采用基于归一化流的贝叶斯参数估计（BPE）。通过将物理可解释的参数向量 ${s}$ 嵌入量子态假设 $\rho({s})$ 中，基于可用实验数据 $D$ 诱导出相应的参数分布 $p({s}|D)$。BPE 使我们能够进行参数相关性分析，深入了解实验参数及相关噪声源如何影响系统的量子特性。以光学猫态实验为例，我们展示了框架的灵活性，其中将噪声单光子态添加到不纯压缩态中。通过分析 Wigner 函数的负值、光子添加比例、噪声比例和泵浦功率之间的关联，我们的框架为生成噪声非高斯态的复杂实验机制提供了解释。利用基于归一化流的神经网络和贝叶斯不确定性估计，结合自然融入的物理和实验约束，后验学习中推断出的有价值信息为实验者提供了指导。
items.abstract: To extract complete information about experimental noisy quantum states, as well as correlations among different physical parameters, we develop an efficient machine learning-assisted framework with the normalizing flow based Bayesian parameter estimation (BPE). By embedding a physically interpretable parameter vector, ${s}$, into the quantum state ansatzes, $\rho({s})$, the corresponding parameter distribution $p({s}|D)$ is induced from BPE, based on the available experimental data $D$. The BPE allows us to perform parameter correlation analyses, providing powerful insights about how experimental parameters and related noise sources affect quantum features of the system. As an example, the flexibility of our framework is demonstrated using two different physical ansatzes on the optical cat state experiments, where a noisy single-photon state is added to impure squeezed state. With correlations among the Wigner function negativity, photon-addition fraction, noisy fraction, and pump powers, our framework gives interpretations for complicated experimental mechanisms in generating noisy non-Gaussian states. By leveraging normalizing flow-based neural networks and Bayesian uncertainty
items.authors: Hsien-Yi Hsieh, Yuan-Ting Liu, Juan Camilo Rodr{\i}guez, Yang-Yi Lee, Po-Hang Wang, Ole Steuernagel, Chien-Ming Wu, Ray-Kuang Lee

items.title: Experimental certification of the nonlocal advantages of quantum imaginarity
items.title_zh: 量子虚数非局部优势的实验认证
items.summary_zh: 量子虚数是量子信息理论中的一种独特资源，但其非局部特性尚未得到充分探索。本研究报告了量子虚数非局部优势（NAQI）的实验研究，局部测量可以使另一子系统的条件态平均虚数超出相应的经典界限。采用$l_1$-范数虚数不等式作为实验可获取的见证。我们开发了一种结合遗传算法与序列二次规划的混合优化算法，以避免局部最优并加速最佳测量设置的搜索。利用偏振编码的光子量子比特，我们制备了两类两量子比特贝尔对角态，并实验表征了局部测量后的条件态虚数。观察到明显违反$l_1$-范数虚数不等式，提供了NAQI的实验认证。进一步研究了NAQI、量子相干性非局部优势（NAQC）与贝尔非局部性之间的关系。对于本文考虑的两量子比特维尔状态，违反各自标准的状态区域满足$\mathcal{D}_{\rm NAQC}\subset\mathcal{D}_{\rm NAQI}\subset\mathcal{D}_{\rm BN}$。
items.abstract: Quantum imaginarity is a distinct resource in quantum information theory, yet its nonlocal properties have not been fully explored. Here, we report an experimental study of the nonlocal advantage of quantum imaginarity (NAQI), in which local measurements on one subsystem can steer the average imaginarity of the conditional states of the other subsystem beyond the corresponding classical bound. The $l_1$-norm of imaginarity inequality is adopted as an experimentally accessible witness. A hybrid optimization algorithm that combines a genetic algorithm with sequential quadratic programming is developed to avoid local optima and accelerate the search for optimal measurement settings. Using polarization-encoded photonic qubits, we prepare two classes of two-qubit Bell-diagonal states and experimentally characterize the imaginarity of the conditional states following local measurements. Clear violations of the $l_1$-norm of imaginarity inequality are observed, providing an experimental certification of NAQI. We further investigate the relationship among NAQI, the nonlocal advantage of quantum coherence (NAQC), and Bell nonlocality based on their respective inequality criteria. For the tw
items.authors: Jian-Hao Wu, Kai-Yu Yuan, Yun-Xiang Tian, Hao-Ran Tan, Yan-Xin Rong, Zhen Shang, Yong-Jian Gu, Ya Xiao

items.title: Transduction-Enabled Superconducting Quantum Repeater: Toward Deterministic Entanglement Distribution with High-Fidelity Gates
items.title_zh: 基于转导的超导量子中继：实现高保真门的确定性纠缠分发
items.summary_zh: 长距离纠缠分发受到光纤中的光子损失和不可克隆定理的限制。光学量子中继协议依赖于贝尔态测量（BSM），其固有地受限于概率性光子操作，失败率高达50%。我们提出了一种混合方法，结合了光纤中光子量子比特的高传输速度与超导电路的高保真量子处理能力。转导启用的超导量子中继（TESQR）架构消除了对概率性BSM的需求，允许确定性处理操作。TESQR框架在远程节点始终产生最终状态，而不是因光子损失而中止，展现了在特定参数范围内的确定性纠缠分发。我们通过评估输出状态的保真度和纠缠分发的成功概率来评估性能，并使用现实噪声模型进行分析。此外，我们集成了纠缠净化方案，并通过QuTiP环境中的数值模拟评估性能。结果显示，在纠缠交换中，所提方案的纠缠分发速率平均提高了63%，最高可达159%，与仅光子架构相比。
items.abstract: Long-distance entanglement distribution is hindered by photon loss in optical fibers and the nocloning theorem. Optical quantum repeater (QR) protocols rely on Bell state measurements (BSMs), they are intrinsically limited to probabilistic photon operations and fail 50% of the time. We propose a hybrid approach to building quantum repeaters that combines the high transmission speed of photonic qubits in optical fiber with the high-fidelity quantum processing capabilities enabled by superconducting circuits. The transduction-enabled superconducting QR (TESQR) architecture eliminates the need for probabilistic BSMs and allows deterministic processing operations. The TESQR framework always yields a final state at the remote nodes rather than aborting on photon loss, manifesting deterministic entanglement distribution within certain parameter regimes. We evaluate the performance by assessing output-state fidelities and success probabilities of entanglement distribution using realistic noise models. Additionally, we integrate an entanglement purification scheme and evaluate the performance through numerical simulations in QuTiP environment. Our results show that, for entanglement swappi
items.authors: Francesco Fiorini, Jing Wu, Andrew Cameron, Changqing Wang, Doga M. Kurkcuoglu, Rosario G. Garroppo, Michele Pagano, Silvia Zorzetti

items.title: Semiclassical scaling of eigenstate thermalization in single-particle chaotic systems
items.title_zh: 单粒子混沌系统的特征态热化的半经典尺度研究
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了时间反演不变的单粒子混沌系统中实空间可观测量的非对角矩阵元素。通过分析基于贝里猜想推导的非对角方差的半经典表达式，我们展示了可观测量矩阵的带状结构自然出现。对于局部可观测量，我们识别出与粒子速度成反比的晚期时间尺度相关的特征带宽。进一步地，我们表明，对于具有陡壁约束的系统，预测的幅度遵循特征态热化假设（ETH）的熵尺度，并乘以一个与动能相关的额外因子，该因子与空间维度无关，且传统多体ETH无法捕捉。我们通过量子台球的案例研究说明这些结果，并在广义四分之一西奈台球中数值验证了半经典尺度。我们的结果阐明了贝里猜想的动态含义，并比较了单粒子特征态热化与多体ETH。
items.abstract: We study the off-diagonal matrix elements of real-space observables in time-reversal-invariant single-particle chaotic systems. By analyzing the semiclassical expression for the off-diagonal variance derived from Berry's conjecture, we show that the banded structure of the observable matrix emerges naturally. For local observables, we identify a characteristic bandwidth associated with a late-time timescale inversely proportional to the particle velocity. We further show that, for systems with steep-wall confinement, the predicted magnitude follows the entropy scaling of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH), multiplied by an additional kinetic-energy-dependent factor that is independent of spatial dimension and is not captured by conventional many-body ETH. We illustrate these results through a case study of quantum billiards and verify the semiclassical scaling numerically in a generalized quarter-Sinai billiard. Our results elucidate the dynamical implications of Berry's conjecture and provide a comparison between single-particle eigenstate thermalization and many-body ETH.
items.authors: Yaoqi Ye, Xiao Wang

items.title: Rydberg quantum antennas for chip-interfaced single-photon source array
items.title_zh: 基于Rydberg量子天线的芯片接口单光子源阵列
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种Rydberg量子天线，由一维链状中性原子构成，这些原子被困在驻波光镊中，作为芯片接口的单光子源。Rydberg阻塞效应在原子链中诱导单一集体激发，而其有序几何形状将光子发射成定向束，从而实现每次严格发射一个光子的量子天线。通过数值模拟，我们展示了在高数值孔径透镜下，单光子收集效率超过70%，且多重激发概率可忽略。这些性能对驻波偶极陷阱中原子的概率加载具有鲁棒性，仅需十个原子，表明实验的可行性。因此，Rydberg量子天线为与光子芯片接口的高效率、高纯度和相同单光子源的可扩展阵列提供了一条独特的途径，解决了光子量子信息技术中的关键挑战。
items.abstract: We propose a Rydberg quantum antenna, consisting of a one-dimensional chain of neutral atoms trapped in a standing-wave optical tweezer, as a chip-interfaced single-photon source. Rydberg blockade induces a single collective excitation in the atomic chain, while its ordered geometry shapes the photon emission into a directional beam, thereby realizing a quantum antenna that emits strictly one photon at a time. Through numerical simulations, we demonstrate single-photon collection efficiencies into a waveguide exceeding 70\% through a high-NA lens with a negligible multiple excitation probability. These performance are robust against probabilistic atom loading in the standing-wave dipole traps, requiring only ten atoms, indicating experimental feasibility. The Rydberg quantum antenna thus offers a unique route toward scalable arrays of high-efficiency, high-purity, and identical single-photon sources interfaced with a photonic chip, addressing key challenges in photonic quantum information technology.
items.authors: Yan-Lei Zhang, Dong-Qi Ma, Guang-Jie Chen, Qing-Xuan Jie, Liang Chen, Ya-Dong Hu, Zhu-Bo Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Chang-Ling Zou

items.title: Bandwidth-Tunable Quantum Light Source at 1.5 $\mu$m
items.title_zh: 可调带宽的1.5 $\mu$m量子光源
items.summary_zh: 量子光源是构建量子网络的重要物理资源。尽管近期取得了显著进展，但在固定波导参数下对量子光源带宽可调性的系统研究仍然不足。本研究展示了一种在1.5 $\mu$m波段的宽带量子光源，通过改变周期性极化铌酸锂波导的温度实现带宽调节。在实验中，量子光源的带宽在1 $^\circ$C的温度变化下从78.3 nm调节至96.2 nm。在不同带宽下，相关光子对的产生率超过6.3 MHz，巧合与偶然比率始终不低于608。通过Franson干涉测量能量-时间纠缠特性，双光子干涉可见度超过99.06%。我们的结果为开发具有可调带宽的量子光源提供了有效方法，具有构建大规模量子网络的巨大潜力。
items.abstract: Quantum light sources constitute a crucial physical resource for the construction of quantum networks. Despite remarkable recent progress, there remains a lack of systematic investigation into the bandwidth tunability of quantum light sources under fixed waveguide parameters. In this work, we demonstrate a broadband quantum light source in the 1.5 $\mu$m band with tunable bandwidth by changing the temperature of a piece of periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide. In our demonstration, the bandwidth of the quantum light source is tuned from 78.3 nm to 96.2 nm with a temperature change of 1 $^\circ$C . Under different bandwidths, the generation rates of correlated photon pairs are greater than 6.3 MHz with coincidence-to-accidental ratios consistently being no less than 608. The energy-time entanglement properties are measured by using the Franson interference with two-photon interference visibilities larger than 99.06%. Our results provide an effective method for developing the quantum light sources with tunable bandwidth which has great potential for building the large-scale quantum networks.
items.authors: Wei Wu, Yun-Ru Fan, Ri-Yao Song, Si Shen, Zi-Chang Zhang, Hai-Zhi Song, Hao Li, Li-Xing You, Ping-He Wang, Yan-Yu Wei, Kai Guo, Guang-Can Guo, Qiang Zhou

items.title: Multiparameter sensing of axion dark matter with superconducting-qubit networks
items.title_zh: 超导量子比特网络的多参数轴子暗物质传感
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种量子传感器网络，用于直接探测量子色动力学（QCD）轴子暗物质，利用纠缠的超导量子比特。在静态磁场的作用下，振荡的轴子场引起了量子比特的相干旋转，其编码角与轴子-光子耦合及未知的暗物质相位成正比。将相位视为额外的未知参数，使得轴子探测转化为一个双参数量子估计问题。我们在笛卡尔坐标系中对这些信号进行公式化，从而避免了弱信号区域出现的奇点，并建立了多参数量子估计的常规框架。利用该框架，我们优化了量子传感器网络，并结合贝叶斯推断重建轴子-光子耦合。优化后的协议在质量范围$m_a\in[0.1,10]~\mu{\rm eV}$内准确恢复了KSVZ和DFSZ基准耦合，能够推广到之前未见的质量，并对现实中的超导量子比特退相干和门错误保持鲁棒性。
items.abstract: We propose a quantum sensor network for direct detection of quantum chromodynamics (QCD) axion dark matter using entangled superconducting qubits. In the presence of a static magnetic field, the oscillating axion field induces a coherent qubit rotation described by an encoding angle proportional to the axion-photon coupling and an unknown dark-matter phase. Treating the phase as an additional unknown parameter turns axion detection into a two-parameter quantum estimation problem. We formulate these signals in Cartesian coordinates, thereby avoiding the singularity that arises in the weak-signal regime and establishing a regular framework for multiparameter quantum estimation. Using this framework, we optimize the quantum sensor network and combine it with Bayesian inference to reconstruct the axion-photon coupling. The optimized protocol accurately recovers the KSVZ and DFSZ benchmark couplings over the mass range $m_a\in[0.1,10]~\mu{\rm eV}$, generalizes to previously unseen masses, and remains robust against realistic superconducting-qubit decoherence and gate errors.
items.authors: Le Bin Ho

items.title: Observation of multiphoton entanglement in resonance fluoresce
items.title_zh: 共振荧光中的多光子纠缠观察
items.summary_zh: 共振荧光是单个两能级量子发射体与近共振相干光相互作用的过程，是量子光学的基石。尽管已有研究涉及一光子和二光子过程，但单个两能级原子与更高光子数的相互作用尚未在实验中探讨。本文实验揭示了共振荧光的多光子散射特性，内在地导致多光子纠缠。通过访问腔量子电动力学系统中发射的量子波动，我们解析了来自单个两能级原子的三阶和四阶光子散射事件。在三光子组分中，散射光子被证明是真正的能量-时间纠缠，且通过违反Svetlichny不等式得以验证。作为应用示范，利用该纠缠光源实现了量子秘密共享协议（QSS）。我们的研究完善了共振荧光的描述框架，拓宽了其研究范围，并为量子信息处理和量子计量提供了生成多光子纠缠态的简单途径。
items.abstract: Resonance fluorescence, the process in which a single two-level quantum emitter interacts with a near-resonant coherent light, is a cornerstone of quantum optics as a paradigmatic light-matter interaction. Quantum phenomena in resonance fluorescence have been accounted for in terms of one- and two-photon processes; however, the physical processes arising from the interaction of a single two-level atom with higher photon numbers remain unexplored experimentally. Here we experimentally reveal the multiphoton scattering nature of resonance fluorescence, which intrinsically gives rise to multiphoton entanglement. By accessing quantum fluctuations in the field emitted from a cavity-quantum electrodynamics system, we resolve third- and fourth-order photon scattering events from a single two-level atom. In the three-photon component, the scattered photons are shown to be genuinely energy-time entangled, as verified by a violation of Svetlichny's inequality. As a demonstration of an application, a quantum secret sharing protocol (QSS) is implemented using this entangled photon source. Our study refines the descriptive framework of resonance fluorescence and broadens the scope of its invest
items.authors: Xiao-Long Zhou, Jian Wang, Ze-Min Shen, Dong-Yu Huang, Si-Jian He, Qi-Yang Huang, Yi-Jia Liu, Yu-Shu Chen, Quan Jiang, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo

items.title: Particle Physics Driven by Quantum Technology - Quantum Simulations and Quantum Sensing
items.title_zh: 量子技术驱动的粒子物理学：量子模拟与量子传感
items.summary_zh: 我们回顾了量子技术快速进展所推动的粒子物理学的最新进展。量子计算的持续发展朝着大规模、容错系统的方向迈进，有潜力解决经典计算方法面临的极具挑战性的动态问题，为研究非微扰动态过程开辟了新途径。台式探测器和量子增强技术达到了前所未有的灵敏度，使得对超轻粒子、引力波及其他超越标准模型的物理现象的探索成为可能，这些参数范围在传统仪器下是无法达到的。综合来看，这些进展突显了一个快速演变的格局，量子技术开始重塑基础物理学。我们旨在综合近期进展，并阐明它们在未来几年推动粒子物理学发展的机会。
items.abstract: We review recent advances in particle physics enabled and motivated by the rapid progress of quantum technologies. The continued development of quantum computing toward large-scale, fault-tolerant systems has the potential to address dynamical problems that remain extremely challenging for classical computational approaches, opening new avenues for studying nonperturbative dynamical processes. Tabletop detectors and quantum-enhanced technologies have reached unprecedented sensitivities, enabling novel searches for ultralight particles, gravitational waves, and other physics beyond the Standard Model in parameter regimes previously inaccessible to conventional instrumentation. Taken together, these developments highlight a rapidly evolving landscape in which quantum technologies are beginning to reshape fundamental physics. We aim to synthesize recent progress and illuminate the opportunities they present for advancing particle physics in the coming years.
items.authors: Itay M. Bloch, Marcela Carena, Yifan Chen, Xinran Li, Ying-Ying Li, Jing Shu

items.title: Microwave-to-Optical Quantum Transduction of Photons for Quantum Interconnects
items.title_zh: 微波到光子量子转导及其在量子互连中的应用
items.summary_zh: 量子转导，即量子频率转换，对于实现量子网络、分布式量子计算和量子中继至关重要。微波到光子的量子转导在超导量子计算领域尤为重要，因为连接稀释制冷机被认为是实现具有容错能力的大规模量子计算机的必然步骤。本文回顾了微波与光子之间量子转导的最新理论和实验研究，描述了基于输入-输出形式主义的通用理论，推导出转导效率、附加噪声和转导带宽等关键量。我们重点回顾了通过光机械效应、电光效应、磁光效应和原子集群等主要转导方法的实验验证。此外，还简要回顾了从超导量子比特到光子量子转导的最新实验进展，这是实现远程超导量子比特通过光纤互连的量子态传输的重要一步。
items.abstract: The quantum transduction, or equivalently quantum frequency conversion, is vital for the realization of, e.g., quantum networks, distributed quantum computing, and quantum repeaters. The microwave-to-optical quantum transduction is of particular interest in the field of superconducting quantum computing, since interconnecting dilution refrigerators is considered inevitable for realizing large-scale quantum computers with fault-tolerance. In this review, we overview recent theoretical and experimental studies on the quantum transduction between microwave and optical photons. We describe a generic theory for the quantum transduction employing the input-output formalism, from which the essential quantities characterizing the transduction, i.e., the expressions for the transduction efficiency, the added noise, and the transduction bandwidth are derived. We review the major transduction methods that have been experimentally demonstrated, focusing on the transduction via the optomechanical effect, the electro-optic effect, the magneto-optic effect, and the atomic ensembles. We also briefly review the recent experimental progress on the quantum transduction from superconducting qubit to o
items.authors: Akihiko Sekine, Ryo Murakami, Yoshiyasu Doi

items.title: Curvature-Flux Representation of Local Dirac-Node Topology from Non-Hermitian Zeeman Quantum Geometry
items.title_zh: 非厄米Zeeman量子几何中的局部Dirac节点拓扑曲率-通量表述
items.summary_zh: 局部Dirac节点拓扑通常通过绕数或Berry相位描述，而曲率-通量表述通常与全球能带拓扑相关。本文展示了非厄米Zeeman量子几何张量（QGT）提供了局部$\pi_1$拓扑的曲率-通量表述。与传统的厄米QGT不同，Zeeman QGT必须根据指标交换的对称性进行分解，产生正常和异常的度量-曲率部分。正常部分与传统厄米QGT具有相同的度量-曲率结构，而异常部分则包含两个在传统QGT中不存在的成分：一个虚对称的度量类张量和一个实反对称的曲率类张量。在二维Dirac系统中，异常Zeeman曲率形成一个径向通量场，与Dirac节点的切向绕行场Hodge对偶，从而将局部绕行不变量转化为高斯型通量不变量。我们进一步表明，四个Zeeman几何部分一一对应于频率和对称性解析的旋光导电通道，互惠的动量磁电响应提供了补充探测。这些结果确立了非厄米Zeeman量子几何的基础。
items.abstract: Local Dirac-node topology is usually described by a winding number or Berry phase, whereas curvature-flux formulations are commonly associated with global band topology. Here we show that the non-Hermitian Zeeman quantum geometric tensor (QGT) provides a curvature-flux representation of local $\pi_1$ topology. Unlike the conventional Hermitian QGT, whose metric and Berry curvature are fixed respectively by its real symmetric and imaginary antisymmetric parts, the Zeeman QGT must be decomposed according to symmetry under index exchange. This decomposition yields normal and anomalous metric-curvature sectors. The normal sector has the same metric-curvature structure as the conventional Hermitian QGT. The anomalous sector, by contrast, contains two components absent in the conventional QGT: an imaginary symmetric metric-like tensor and a real antisymmetric curvature-like tensor. In a two-dimensional Dirac system, the anomalous Zeeman curvature forms a radial flux field Hodge-dual to the tangential winding field of the Dirac node, thereby converting the local winding invariant into a Gauss-type flux invariant. We further show that the four Zeeman-geometric sectors map one-to-one onto f
items.authors: Rongjie Cui, Longjun Xiang, Fuming Xu, Jian Wang

items.title: Photon-efficient quantum repeater chains via hyperentanglement-assisted purification
items.title_zh: 基于超纠缠辅助净化的光子高效量子中继链
items.summary_zh: 线性量子中继链基于Werner态净化（BBPSSW协议）和纠缠交换（BDCZ方案）是量子网络中纠缠分发的基础。然而，它们在操作可靠性阈值下运行，并依赖于资源密集的递归净化轮次，每轮消耗两个纠缠对以概率性地产生一个。文献中提出超纠缠利用多个自由度（DOF），如偏振和空间模式，在单个光子对中编码独立的纠缠态。我们定义了DAEPP（自由度辅助纠缠净化协议），并建议将其与BDCZ方案结合，形成我们称之为DAHR（自由度辅助超纠缠中继）的链协议。DAEPP步骤通过消耗其他自由度来提纯DOF的保真度。本文提出并分析了一种DAHR变体，在端到端路径的每个段中集成DAEPP，并推导出嵌入单段DAEPP的BDCZ方案的闭合形式的端到端保真度递归，为任何利用BBPSSW净化的BDCZ基线提供严格的资源下限，以匹配DAHR的每段有效保真度。在一个由先前实验提供的信息的代表性非对称操作点上，我们通过数值方法展示了匹配的结果。
items.abstract: Linear quantum repeater chains based on Werner-state purification (the BBPSSW protocol) and entanglement swapping (the BDCZ scheme) are fundamental to entanglement distribution in quantum networks. However, they operate under a stringent operation reliability threshold and rely on resource-intensive recurrence purification rounds, each consuming two entangled pairs to probabilistically produce one. In the literature, hyperentanglement has been proposed to exploit multiple degrees of freedom (DOF), such as polarisation and spatial modes, to encode independent entangled states within a single photon pair. This has led to the definition of DAEPP (DOF-Assisted Entanglement Purification Protocol), which we propose to integrate with the BDCZ scheme, resulting in a chain protocol that we call DAHR (DOF-Assisted Hyperentanglement Repeater). The DAEPP step distils the fidelity of a DOF by consuming other(s). In this work, we propose and analyse a DAHR variant which integrates DAEPP at every segment of an end-to-end path combined with BDCZ. We derive a closed-form end-to-end fidelity recursion that embeds single-segment DAEPP into the BDCZ scheme and give a strict resource lower bound for an
items.authors: Vinay Kumar, Krishan Joshi, Claudio Cicconetti

items.title: Near-Optimal Separations of Certificate Complexity from Randomized and Quantum Query Complexity
items.title_zh: 证书复杂度与随机及量子查询复杂度的近最优分离
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了总布尔函数的证书复杂度 ${C}(f)$ 相对于其随机查询复杂度和量子查询复杂度的关系。构造了一个总布尔函数 $f$，其随机查询复杂度在单边错误下满足 ${R}_1(f) = \Theta(\sqrt{{C}(f)})$。即使允许双边错误，这一分离也是最优的。基于此构造，我们得到另一个总布尔函数 $F$，其有界错误量子查询复杂度为 ${Q}(F) = \widetilde O({C}(F)^{1/4})$，达到了一般四次界限，且只差多对数因子。对于同一函数，其精确和零错误量子查询复杂度均为 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{{C}(F)})$。我们还证明了这两个度量在 $F$ 上的匹配下界。
items.abstract: We study how large the certificate complexity ${C}(f)$ of a total Boolean function can be relative to its randomized and quantum query complexities. We construct a total Boolean function $f$ whose randomized query complexity with one-sided error satisfies ${R}_1(f) = \Theta(\sqrt{{C}(f)})$. This separation is optimal even when two-sided error is allowed. From this construction, we obtain another total Boolean function $F$ with bounded-error quantum query complexity ${Q}(F) = \widetilde O({C}(F)^{1/4})$, attaining the general quartic bound up to polylogarithmic factors. For the same function, both exact and zero-error quantum query complexities are $\widetilde O(\sqrt{{C}(F)})$. We also prove matching lower bounds for these two measures on $F$.
items.authors: Andris Ambainis, J\=anis Iraids, Martins Kokainis

items.title: Exact exponents for smoothing the max-relative entropy and quantum information decoupling in von Neumann algebras
items.title_zh: 在冯·诺依曼代数中平滑最大相对熵的精确指数
items.summary_zh: 我们建立了在任意冯·诺依曼代数上平滑最大相对熵的精确指数。证明首先在半有限设置中发展所需的大偏差和平滑估计，然后通过Haagerup-Junge-Xu约简推广到一般的冯·诺依曼代数。接下来，我们研究当参考系统由任意冯·诺依曼代数描述时的催化量子信息解耦。一个关键成分是适用于任意冯·诺依曼代数的算子层蛋糕公式。该公式为具有一般冯·诺依曼代数参考系统的正常态提供了一个凸分裂估计。结合这一估计与平滑指数结果，我们获得了催化解耦可靠性函数的上下界。这些界限在相应的临界速率以下重合，从而在该范围内得到了精确的解耦可靠性函数。
items.abstract: We establish the exact exponent for smoothing the max-relative entropy on arbitrary von Neumann algebras. The proof first develops the required large-deviation and smoothing estimates in the semifinite setting and then passes to general von Neumann algebras through Haagerup-Junge-Xu reduction. We next study catalytic quantum information decoupling when the reference system is described by an arbitrary von Neumann algebra. A key ingredient is an operator layer-cake formula valid on arbitrary von Neumann algebras. This formula leads to a convex-split estimate for normal states with a general von Neumann algebraic reference system. Combining this estimate with the smoothing exponent result, we obtain lower and upper bounds on the catalytic-decoupling reliability function. These bounds coincide below the corresponding critical rate, yielding the exact decoupling reliability function in that regime.
items.authors: Zhiwen Lin, Hongsen Qiu, Xinyu Zhang

items.title: Harmonised benchmarking of foundation models for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveals context-dependent generalisation
items.title_zh: 基础模型在单细胞与空间转录组学中的统一基准测试
items.summary_zh: 单细胞和空间基础模型承诺可转移的生物学表征，但其通用性在不同模态、生物领域和分析任务中的表现尚未得到充分验证。我们使用统一框架对六个代表性模型（Nicheformer、CellPLM、scGPT-spatial、GenePT、scELMo和Novae）进行了基准测试，涵盖了scRNA-seq、空间转录组学和Perturb-seq。我们评估了零-shot和持续预训练的聚类、监督注释、标记基因一致性和干扰预测。模型性能高度依赖于条件：表达训练的细胞级变换器在许多细胞身份任务中表现最佳，空间和图形感知模型更好地保留了组织结构，而语言衍生的基因嵌入在特定的干扰响应指标中具有竞争力。没有模型在所有任务中占据主导地位，排名随着模态、预处理、分词、生物先验、领域转移和指标选择而变化。该基准为模型选择提供了实用指导，并认为未来模型应根据生物通用性、可解释性和基于干扰的有效性进行评估，而不仅仅是规模或排行榜表现。
items.abstract: Single-cell and spatial foundation models promise transferable biological representations, yet their generality remains largely untested across modalities, biological domains and analytical tasks. We benchmarked six representative models, Nicheformer, CellPLM, scGPT-spatial, GenePT, scELMo and Novae, using a harmonised framework spanning scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics and Perturb-seq. We evaluated zero-shot and continually pretrained clustering, supervised annotation, marker-gene concordance and perturbation prediction. Model performance was strongly conditional: expression-trained cell-level transformers best resolved many cell-identity tasks, spatial and graph-aware models better preserved tissue architecture, and language-derived gene embeddings were competitive for selected perturbation-response metrics. No model dominated across tasks, and rankings shifted with modality, preprocessing, tokenisation, biological prior, domain shift and metric choice. This benchmark provides practical guidance for model selection and argues that future models should be judged by biological generalisation, interpretability and perturbation-grounded validity, not by scale or leaderboard perform

items.title: A robust, scalable K-statistic for quantifying immune cell clustering in spatial proteomics data
items.title_zh: 一种稳健可扩展的K统计量用于量化免疫细胞在空间蛋白组学数据中的聚集
items.summary_zh: 基于点过程理论的空间总结统计量广泛用于量化单细胞空间蛋白组学数据中细胞群体的空间组织。Ripley的K是评估细胞是否空间聚集或随机分散的常用指标。然而，空间均匀性的关键假设在空间蛋白组学数据中常常被违反，导致细胞聚集和共定位的高估。为此，我们提出了一种新方法KAMP（通过置换分布的解析矩进行K调整），用于量化空间蛋白组学样本中细胞的空间组织。KAMP利用每个样本中的背景细胞，并结合Ripley的K的置换零分布的一阶和二阶矩的新闭式表示。我们的方法对非均匀性具有稳健性，在大数据集中计算效率高，并提供近似p值以测试空间聚集和共定位。该方法的开发受到卵巢癌女性的空间蛋白组学研究的启发；在具有足够B细胞和巨噬细胞的子集中，KAMP提供了探索性、特定尺度的证据，关联B细胞-巨噬细胞共定位与患者整体生存率。值得注意的是，我们还发现未校正样本非均匀性使用K可能会偏倚风险比。
items.abstract: Spatial summary statistics based on point process theory are widely used to quantify the spatial organization of cell populations in single-cell spatial proteomics data. Among these, Ripley's K is a popular metric for assessing whether cells are spatially clustered or are randomly dispersed. However, the key assumption of spatial homogeneity is frequently violated in spatial proteomics data, leading to overestimates of cell clustering and colocalization. To address this, we propose a novel method, termed KAMP (K adjustment by Analytical Moments of the Permutation distribution), for quantifying the spatial organization of cells in spatial proteomics samples. KAMP leverages background cells in each sample along with a new closed-form representation of the first and second moments of the permutation null distribution of Ripley's K. Our method is robust to inhomogeneity, computationally efficient even in large datasets, and provides approximate p-values to test spatial clustering and colocalization. Methodological developments are motivated by a spatial proteomics study of women with ovarian cancer; in the subset with sufficient B cells and macrophages, KAMP provides exploratory, scale
items.authors: Julia Wrobel, Hoseung Song

items.title: A Group Analogue of the Ghurye--Olkin--Ibragimov Theorem
items.title_zh: Ghurye--Olkin--Ibragimov定理的群体类比
items.summary_zh: 根据经典的Skitovich--Darmois定理，实数线上的高斯分布由有限个独立随机变量$\xi_j$的两个线性形式的独立性来表征。该定理已在多个方向上得到扩展。特别地，S.G. Ghurye和I. Olkin为$n$维独立随机向量$\xi_j$的情况建立了类似结果，线性形式的系数为可逆的$n\times n$矩阵。随后，A.A. Zinger和I.A. Ibragimov研究了无限序列的$n$维独立随机向量的线性形式。本文首次研究了在第二可数局部紧阿贝尔群$X$中取值的独立随机变量序列的线性形式，条件为：$X$不包含非平凡紧子群，或$X$不包含与圆群拓扑同构的子群且具有有限的拓扑自同构群。此外，我们还研究了独立随机变量取值于$\mathbf{a}$-adic螺旋体$\Sigma_{\mathbf{a}}$的情况。在所有这些设置中，线性形式的系数为相应群的拓扑自同构。
items.abstract: According to the classical Skitovich--Darmois theorem, the Gaussian distribution on the real line is characterized by the independence of two linear forms of a finite number of independent random variables $\xi_j$. This theorem has been extended in various directions. In particular, S.G. Ghurye and I. Olkin established an analogous result for the case where $\xi_j$ are $n$-dimensional independent random vectors and the coefficients of the linear forms are invertible $n\times n$ matrices. Subsequently, A.A. Zinger and later I.A. Ibragimov investigated linear forms of an infinite sequence of $n$-dimensional independent random vectors. In the present paper, we investigate, for the first time, linear forms of a sequence of independent random variables taking values in a second-countable locally compact Abelian group $X$ under either of the following conditions: $X$ contains no nontrivial compact subgroups, or $X$ contains no subgroups topologically isomorphic to the circle group and has a finite topological automorphism group. Furthermore, we investigate the case where the independent random variables take values in an $\mathbf{a}$-adic solenoid $\Sigma_{\mathbf{a}}$. In all these sett
items.authors: Gennadiy Feldman

items.title: Almost-Uniform Bayesian Convergence to the Truth Is Not Characterized by Countable Additivity on Conditional Hitting Times
items.title_zh: 几乎均匀贝叶斯收敛真理的条件与可数可加性无关
items.summary_zh: 本文重新审视了Nielsen（2021）关于有限可加性下贝叶斯收敛真理的分析。其主要定理证明，当且仅当概率函数具备近似性质和条件击中时间的可数可加性时，其后验概率几乎均匀收敛于真理。我们证明这两个性质是必要但不充分的，因此该定理是错误的，并指出其已发表证明中的错误。我们构造了一个仅有限可加的概率函数，具备这两个性质，其后验概率几乎必然收敛于真理但不几乎均匀。论文中剩余的四个定理中的三个及其推论也失去了已发表的证明。我们重新证明了四个结果中的两个，另一个结果未决；最后一个推论未被反例否定，我们为包含反例的一个家族建立了该推论，并在一般情况下保持开放。我们还展示了每个事件的后验概率几乎必然收敛于真理并不表征可数可加性。最后，我们讨论了修正后的几乎均匀收敛的特征需要补充的内容。
items.abstract: We revisit the analysis of Bayesian convergence to the truth under finite additivity in a recent paper by Nielsen (J. Philos. Logic, 2021, doi:10.1007/s10992-020-09569-2) Its principal theorem proves that the posteriors of a probability function converge to the truth almost uniformly if and only if the function has two properties: an approximation property, and so-called countable additivity on conditional hitting times. We show that the two properties are necessary but not sufficient, so that the theorem is false, and we locate the error in its published proof. We construct a merely finitely additive probability function that has both properties and whose posteriors converge to the truth almost surely but not almost uniformly. Three of the paper's four remaining theorems, and its corollary, lose their published proofs as well, two with the failed implication and two to a separate defect that we also identify. Two of the four results we reprove and one we leave undecided; the last is the corollary, which our counterexample does not refute, and which we establish for a family including the counterexample and leave open in general. We also show that almost-sure convergence of posteri
items.authors: M. Ali Khan, Arthur Paul Pedersen, Maxwell B. Stinchcombe

items.title: Maximum Entropy Probability Distributions on Spheres with Fixed Mean Busemann Function and Holomorphic-Information-Geometric Model of Cognition
items.title_zh: 固定均值Busemann函数的最大熵概率分布研究
items.summary_zh: 本文前半部分重新探讨了球面上的最大熵（MaxEnt）概率分布问题。我们推导了在实向量空间和复向量空间中，固定期望Busemann函数（能量）的MaxEnt分布族。作为特例，我们得出了在规范能量水平下的子家族，其中逆温度等于球的维度。后半部分我们关注于复向量空间中球面上规范MaxEnt分布的信息流形。该流形同构于Bergman球。我们在此流形上引入再生核，并利用再生希尔伯特空间（RKHS）理论阐述认知模型。特别地，我们提出了RKHS中的最小认知努力原则，并展示了其与球面边界上MaxEnt概率分布原则的对偶关系。
items.abstract: In the first half of the paper we revisit the question regarding MaxEnt probability distributions on spheres. We derive families of MaxEnt distributions on spheres in real and complex vector spaces with fixed expected Busemann function (energy). As a particular case, we deduce sub-families on canonical energy levels where inverse temperature equals the dimension of the sphere. In the second part we focus on the information manifold of canonical MaxEnt distributions on the sphere in the complex vector space. This manifold is isomorphic to the Bergman ball. We introduce the reproducing kernel on this manifold and use the RKHS theory to elaborate the model of cognition. In particular, we state the principle of minimal cognitive effort in RKHS and demonstrate its dual relationship with the MaxEnt principle for probability distributions on the boundary sphere.
items.authors: Vladimir Jacimovic

items.title: Existence of strong initial traces for stochastic conservation laws
items.title_zh: 随机守恒律的强初始迹的存在性
items.summary_zh: 我们证明了每个有界动量解的随机标量守恒律的强初始迹的存在性和唯一性，尽管没有规定初始值，也没有对通量施加非退化条件。证明的核心是路径依赖的。在固定一个实现后，重缩的随机项和动量测度在爆炸极限中消失，因此可以应用Panov的紧致性论证；退化通量区间通过递归维度减少来处理。随机环境带来了额外的困难。鞅恒等式必须在整个简化过程中在一个共同的全概率集上保持有效，这需要参数化的随机-富比尼构造。此外，路径依赖的迹并不自动可测，因为其例外集可能依赖于实现。确定性时间平均和过滤的右连续性产生了一个联合可测的初始迹，在本质时间上具有局部强收敛性，几乎必然和均值上均成立。
items.abstract: We prove existence and uniqueness of a strong initial trace for every bounded kinetic solution of a stochastic scalar conservation law, although no initial value is prescribed and no nondegeneracy condition is imposed on the flux. The core of the proof is pathwise. After fixing a realization, the rescaled stochastic terms and kinetic measure vanish in the blow-up limit, so Panov's compactness argument applies; degenerate flux intervals are handled by recursive dimension reduction. The stochastic setting creates several additional difficulties. The martingale identities must remain valid on one common full-probability set throughout the reductions, which requires a parameterized stochastic-Fubini construction. Moreover, the pathwise trace is not automatically measurable because its exceptional sets may depend on the realization. Deterministic time averages and right-continuity of the filtration yield a jointly measurable initial trace, with local strong convergence along essential times, both almost surely and in mean.
items.authors: Marko Erceg, Nikola Konatar, Kenneth Karlsen, Darko Mitrovic

items.title: Counterexamples to the Mao-Wu-Xu spectral conjecture and a three-scale boundary for spherical random graphs
items.title_zh: 对毛-吴-徐谱猜想的反例及球面随机图的三尺度边界
items.summary_zh: 随机几何图检测研究从 $S^{d-1}$ 上生成的 $n$ 个独立均匀点构成的图是否能仅通过其邻接矩阵与相同边密度的Erdos-Renyi图区分。毛、吴和徐猜测标准化核的三次迹决定检测边界：$n^3(\mathrm{tr}\,K^3)^2$ 趋向于零或无穷大应分别意味着不可能性或强检测。我们构造了反例，并证明了均匀结果，适用于均匀有界度的球面多项式核，且平均边密度远离零和一。当 $n/n_* \to 0$ 时，几何模型与独立边模型之间的总变差距离趋向于零；当 $n/n_* \to \infty$ 时，趋向于一。三种尺度对应于三角形、四循环和整体几何。纯四度球面调和核仅有正的非零特征值，但其检测尺度为 $n \asymp d^5$。在 $d^5 \ll n \ll d^{16/3}$ 的范围内，三角形和四循环信号及每个固定度的标准化多项式。
items.abstract: Random geometric graph detection asks whether a graph generated from $n$ independent uniform points on $S^{d-1}$, with edge probabilities depending on inner products, can be distinguished from an Erdos-Renyi graph of the same edge density using only its adjacency matrix. Mao, Wu, and Xu conjectured that the cubic trace of the standardized kernel determines the detection boundary: $n^3(\mathrm{tr}\,K^3)^2$ tending to zero or infinity should imply impossibility or strong detection, respectively. We construct counterexamples and prove a uniform result for spherical polynomial kernels of uniformly bounded degree with mean edge density bounded away from zero and one. For the integral operator $K$ of the standardized centered kernel, define \[ n_* = \min\left\{ \frac{1}{|\mathrm{tr}\,K^3|^{2/3}},\quad \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}\,K^4}},\quad \frac{d}{\mathrm{tr}\,K^2} \right\}, \] with zero denominators interpreted as infinity. The total variation distance between the geometric and independent-edge models tends to zero if $n/n_* \to 0$ and to one if $n/n_* \to \infty$. The three scales correspond to triangles, four-cycles, and global geometry. The pure degree-four spherical harmonic kerne
items.authors: Congyi Luo

items.title: Rogers--Ramanujan identities from the geometry of $X^a=Y^b$
items.title_zh: 几何视角下的Rogers-Ramanujan恒等式研究
items.summary_zh: 我们证明了Huang、Jiang和Oblomkov（HJO）的猜想，为每个互质的torus-knot奇点$X^a=Y^b$（$1<a<b$）提供了Rogers-Ramanujan和Andrews-Gordon恒等式的几何扩展。对于素数幂$q$，设$\mathcal{NC}_n^{a,b}(\mathbb F_q)$表示满足$A^a=B^b$的可交换nilpotent $n\times n$矩阵对$(A,B)$的集合。我们建立了它们的归一化计数、HJO $q$-级数$Z_{a,b}$和显式无限积$P_{a,b}$之间的三重等式。我们的主要结果是一个更强的有限恒等式：秩$N$的HJO和等于$(q;q)_N$乘以平衡圆柱分区的生成函数。取$N\to\infty$可得HJO猜想。证明结合了Bergeron-Garsia-Leven-Xin和Mellit的组合有理洗牌定理、斜率算子的可乘性定理以及有界圆柱分区的行列式模型，这些通过共同的$q$-差分方程相连。
items.abstract: We prove the conjecture of Huang, Jiang, and Oblomkov (HJO) giving a geometric extension of the Rogers--Ramanujan and Andrews--Gordon identities for every torus-knot singularity $X^a=Y^b$ with coprime $1<a<b.$ For a prime power $q$, let $\mathcal{NC}_n^{a,b}(\mathbb F_q)$ denote the set of pairs of commuting nilpotent $n\times n$ matrices $(A,B)$ over $\mathbb F_q$ satisfying $A^a=B^b$. We establish the threefold equality between their normalized counts, the HJO $q$-series $Z_{a,b}$, and the explicit infinite product $P_{a,b}$: \[ \underbrace{\vphantom{\Bigg|} \prod_{m\geq1}(1-q^{-m}) \Biggl(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{\lvert\mathcal{NC}_n^{a,b}(\mathbb F_q)\rvert} {\lvert\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbb F_q)\rvert}\Biggr) }_{\text{point count}} = \underbrace{\vphantom{\Bigg|}Z_{a,b}(q^{-1}) }_{\text{\(q\)-series}} = \underbrace{\vphantom{\Bigg|}P_{a,b}(q^{-1}) }_{\text{infinite product}}. \] Our main result is a stronger finite identity: the rank $N$ HJO sum equals $(q;q)_N$ times the generating function for balanced cylindric partitions with entries bounded by $N$. Taking $N\to\infty$ yields the HJO conjecture. The proof combines the compositional rational shuffle theorem of Bergeron--G
items.authors: Yifeng Huang, Kenny Lau, Ken Ono

items.title: Binning-Independent Bayesian Analysis of Time-Dependent Perturbed Angular Distribution data
items.title_zh: 无分箱贝叶斯分析时间依赖扰动角分布数据
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新的分析时间依赖扰动角分布数据的方法。在该方法中，通过单事件的条件概率构建似然函数，避免了时间数据的分箱处理。该似然函数在贝叶斯框架下用于计算感兴趣的$g$因子的后验概率密度函数。我们通过分析模拟数据集，将这种方法与传统的分箱数据分析方法进行了比较。在许多情况下，得到的后验概率密度呈现多模态，因此结果通常无法用单一高斯近似来总结。我们发现，新方法在低统计数据集上的结果更为可靠。
items.abstract: We propose a new approach for analyzing Time-Dependent Perturbed Angular Distribution data. In this, a likelihood is constructed with the help of conditional probabilities of single events and binning of time data is avoided. This likelihood is used in a Bayesian framework to calculate the posterior probability density function for the $g$ factor of interest. This approach is compared to more traditional approaches that use binned data by analyzing simulated datasets. In many cases the resulting posterior probability densities are observed to be multimodal and the results can thus often not be summarized with a single Gaussian approximation. We find that results from the new approach are more reliable for low-statistics datasets.
items.authors: Franziskus von Spee

items.title: Bayesian Sample Size Determination: Sampling Distribution Estimation or Exploration?
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯样本量确定：估计还是探索采样分布？
items.summary_zh: 在许多贝叶斯研究中，样本量的选择旨在达到足够的检验力以拒绝零假设，或使区间估计足够狭窄。对于复杂模型的研究，确定合适的最小样本量通常需要大量的蒙特卡洛模拟。一种基于模拟的策略是估计不同样本量下后验总结的采样分布，如后验概率或区间估计长度。另一种策略则通过随机根查找在样本量空间中探索这些采样分布，而不在任何给定样本量下估计后验总结的整个采样分布。我们通过对重复实施的样本量推荐的蒙特卡洛采样分布进行评估，比较这两种方法的性能。本文理论推导了各种贝叶斯样本量确定方法的蒙特卡洛采样分布，并通过广泛的数值研究评估了这些方法的偏差、精度及对调参的敏感性。
items.abstract: To design many Bayesian studies, the sample size is chosen to attain sufficient power to reject a null hypothesis or a desired probability that an interval estimate is sufficiently narrow. Determining the minimum suitable sample size for studies with complex models typically requires intensive Monte Carlo simulation. One simulation-based strategy to consider the sample-size space involves estimating sampling distributions of posterior summaries, such as posterior probabilities or interval estimate lengths, at various sample sizes. Another strategy instead explores these sampling distributions via stochastic root finding over the sample-size space, where the entire sampling distribution of posterior summaries is not estimated at any given sample size. The performance of these competing approaches can be assessed using their Monte Carlo sampling distributions of sample size recommendations across repeated implementations. In this paper, we theoretically derive these Monte Carlo sampling distributions for various Bayesian sample size determination approaches. To promote best practices for Bayesian sample size determination, we conduct extensive numerical studies to estimate these Mont
items.authors: Luke Hagar, Paul Gustafson

items.title: Hankel-Christoffel-Nevai Screening of Posterior Relevance in Bayesian Inverse Problems
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯逆问题中后验相关候选的Hankel-Christoffel-Nevai筛选
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种Hankel-Christoffel-Nevai框架，用于筛选贝叶斯逆问题中的后验相关候选。通过似然加权矩阵记录贝叶斯更新如何改变先验几何，Christoffel和Nevai构造将这些信息转化为低成本的相关性评分。Christoffel比率捕捉相对局部矩量质量，而Nevai评分提供稳定的多项式局部化似然近似。矩阵可通过确定性似然值、有界无偏标记、后验样本或二元无偏似然观测进行估计。该构造通过嵌套特征映射扩展到函数值未知数，诱导的条件似然具有精确的贝叶斯解释。我们建立了一致性和误差界限，区分特征分辨率、多项式局部化和初步估计。相同的学习几何也可用于重新排序精确的随机似然块，减少预期工作而不改变后验目标。针对非线性、基于PDE和函数空间的逆问题的数值实验表明了有效的后验质量筛选和计算节省。
items.abstract: We introduce a Hankel--Christoffel--Nevai framework for screening posterior-relevant candidates in Bayesian inverse problems. A likelihood-weighted moment matrix records how Bayesian updating changes the geometry of the prior, and Christoffel and Nevai constructions convert this information into inexpensive relevance scores. The Christoffel ratio captures relative local moment mass, whereas the Nevai score provides a stable polynomially localized approximation of the likelihood. The moment matrix can be estimated from deterministic likelihood values, bounded unbiased marks, posterior samples, or binary unbiased likelihood observations. The construction extends to function-valued unknowns through nested feature maps, where the induced conditional likelihood has an exact Bayesian interpretation. We establish consistency and error bounds that separate feature resolution, polynomial localization, and pilot estimation. The same learned geometry can also be used to reorder exact stochastic likelihood blocks, reducing expected work without altering the posterior target. Numerical experiments on nonlinear, PDE-based, and function-space inverse problems demonstrate effective posterior-mass
items.authors: Zhiliang Deng, Xiaomei Yang

items.title: Robust Bayesian Inference for Unnormalized Models with Mixed-Domain Data
items.title_zh: 针对混合领域数据的无规范模型的稳健贝叶斯推断
items.summary_zh: 许多统计模型涉及依赖参数的规范化常数，这些常数在计算上难以处理，给标准贝叶斯推断带来了重大障碍。尽管现有的基于似然的算法通常可以规避这些常数，但在模型误设定下，它们的不确定性量化可能表现不佳。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SME-BETEL，这是一种半参数贝叶斯框架，结合了得分匹配估计方程与贝叶斯指数倾斜经验似然。所得到的后验避免了规范化常数的评估，并且不需要学习率校准。在此框架的基础上，我们为混合领域数据开发了一种新的得分匹配标准，扩展了SME-BETEL到观察值来自不同样本空间的模型。该构造实现了对混合领域双重难以处理模型的稳健贝叶斯推断。我们建立了得分匹配估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，并证明了SME-BETEL后验的Bernstein-von Mises定理。这些结果表明，SME-BETEL的可信区间在渐近上与得分匹配估计量的采样变异性校准一致，在模型误设定下提供有效的频率覆盖。模拟研究表明，SME-BETEL在正确设定下仍具竞争力。
items.abstract: Many statistical models involve parameter-dependent normalizing constants that are computationally intractable, creating substantial obstacles to standard Bayesian inference. Although existing likelihood-based algorithms can often circumvent these constants, their uncertainty quantification may be poorly calibrated under model misspecification. To address these challenges, we propose SME-BETEL, a semiparametric Bayesian framework that combines score matching estimating equations with Bayesian exponentially tilted empirical likelihood. The resulting posterior avoids evaluation of normalizing constants and does not require learning-rate calibration. Building on this framework, we develop a new score matching criterion for mixed-domain data, extending SME-BETEL to models whose observations combine components from different sample spaces. This construction enables robust Bayesian inference for mixed-domain doubly-intractable models. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the score matching estimator, and prove a Bernstein-von Mises theorem for the SME-BETEL posterior. These results show that SME-BETEL credible sets are asymptotically calibrated to the sampling variability
items.authors: Jiongran Wang, Debdeep Pati, Anirban Bhattacharya

items.title: Molecular Geometry Understanding Has Unintendedly Emerged in Frontier Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 前沿大型语言模型意外展现分子几何理解能力
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在解决自然语言表达的复杂化学问题方面表现出强大的能力。然而，化学家进行的许多任务需要理解化合物的三维结构并进行推理，这些能力并非LLM开发者的初衷，也未在现有模型中进行测试。我们在现代LLMs上测试了27种小有机分子的810个几何结构和DFT能量。结果显示，2025年7月之前发布的模型在按稳定性对构象进行排名时表现不佳，而许多近期前沿模型（如GPT-5.6 Sol、Kimi K3和Gemini 3.6 Flash）则达到了竞争性准确性，超越了通用力场。GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5接近现代GFN-FF力场。模型对排名的解释分析表明，它们在具有明确分子内相互作用（如氢键）的分子上表现最佳，而在由松散定义的概念（如环应变）主导的分子上则表现不佳，表明力场在此类情况下更具优势。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have already shown strong capabilities in solving complex chemical problems expressed in natural language. Yet, many tasks performed by chemists require understanding of 3D structures of chemical compounds and reasoning about them -- abilities, which, to the best of our knowledge, were neither intended by LLM developers nor tested in contemporary models. Such understanding is essential for autonomous molecular discovery and drug development, which is one of the Holy Grails of AI application to chemistry. We tested this capability in modern LLMs on 810 geometries and DFT energies of 27 small organic molecules. Strikingly, while models released before July 2025 struggled to rank conformers by stability, many recent frontier models, including GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3, and Gemini 3.6 Flash achieved competitive accuracy, outperforming the Universal Force Field, and GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 came very close to a modern GFN-FF force field. items.title: Pressure-dependent melting and crystallization of B2-NiAl from neural-network molecular dynamics
items.title_zh: 基于神经网络分子动力学的B2-NiAl压力依赖熔化与结晶研究
items.summary_zh: 我们利用神经网络分子动力学和深度势原子模型研究了有序B2-NiAl的压力依赖熔化。通过在广泛压力范围内进行两相固液共存模拟，确定了熔化温度，从而得到了熔化曲线$T_m(P)$。与现有实验和之前的分子动力学结果相比，本研究预测在高压下熔化温度随压力的增加更为显著。为评估计算熔化线的热力学一致性，我们评估了熔化过程中的焓和体积变化，并将Clapeyron斜率与拟合的$T_m(P)$曲线的导数进行比较。两者在大部分研究压力范围内一致，支持了共存结果的内部一致性。通过层分辨的成分分析，我们发现共存液体在所有研究压力下基本保持等原子比，铝的比例偏离化学计量值不超过$5\times10^{-3}$，这为B2-NiAl的熔化过程在当前模型下保持一致性提供了直接原子级证据。这些结果建立了B2-NiAl的热力学一致的压力依赖熔化描述。
items.abstract: We investigate pressure-dependent melting of ordered B2-NiAl using neural-network molecular dynamics with a Deep Potential interatomic model. Melting temperatures are determined from two-phase solid-liquid coexistence simulations over a broad pressure range, yielding the melting curve $T_m(P)$. Relative to available experimental and previous molecular-dynamics results, the present calculations predict a stronger increase of the melting temperature with pressure at elevated compression. To assess the thermodynamic consistency of the calculated melting line, we evaluate the enthalpy and volume changes upon melting and compare the Clapeyron slope with the derivative of the fitted $T_m(P)$ curve. The two estimates are in good agreement over most of the investigated pressure range, supporting the internal consistency of the coexistence results. To probe the character of melting, we perform a layer-resolved composition analysis of the coexistence configurations and find that the coexisting liquid remains essentially equiatomic at all studied pressures, with deviations of the aluminum fraction from the stoichiometric value not exceeding $5\times10^{-3}$. items.authors: A. S. Onegin, P. R. Levashov, N. M. Chtchelkatchev

items.title: Divergent Solid-state Conversion Pathways in Evaporated All-perovskite Tandem Solar Cells
items.title_zh: 蒸发全钙钛矿串联太阳能电池的固态转化路径研究
items.summary_zh: 顺序热蒸发（sTE）作为一种无溶剂的方法，正在成为高质量中带隙钙钛矿的制备途径，但其在混合卤化物宽带隙（WBG）和锡铅窄带隙（NBG）吸收体中的应用仍受限于对固态转化机制的不完全理解。通过时间切片的外部分析，我们揭示了顺序蒸发的WBG和NBG前驱体堆的不同固态转化机制。在WBG堆中，含有甲脒（FA）的物质渗透无机模板，溴/碘的重分布在三维钙钛矿形成之前发生。而在NBG堆中，早期形成富铅钙钛矿相限制了FA进一步渗透到埋藏的SnI$_2$前驱体中。后续的退火促进了晶格的快速重组，留下了垂直成分梯度。基于这些发现，我们开发了带隙范围为1.26-1.96 eV的sTE吸收体，并成功展示了首个蒸发全钙钛矿串联太阳能电池，达到19.2%的光电转换效率。封装的串联电池平均保持80%的初始效率。
items.abstract: Sequential thermal evaporation (sTE) is emerging as a solvent-free route to high-quality mid-bandgap perovskites, but its extension to mixed-halide wide-bandgap (WBG) and Sn-Pb narrow-bandgap (NBG) absorbers for all-perovskite tandem solar cells (TSCs) remains limited by an incomplete understanding of solid-state conversion. Here, using time-sliced ex situ analysis, we reveal divergent solid-state conversion mechanisms in sequentially evaporated WBG and NBG precursor stacks. In WBG stacks, formamidinium (FA)-containing species penetrate the inorganic template and Br/I redistribution precedes substantial three-dimensional perovskite formation. The photoactive phase then crystallizes from a chemically mixed reservoir, and absolute PbBr$_2$ thickness, rather than nominal PbBr$_2$/PbI$_2$ ratio, determines the final bandgap. In NBG stacks, by contrast, an early Pb-rich perovskite phase forms upon formamidinium iodide deposition, restricting further FA penetration into the buried SnI$_2$ precursor. Subsequent annealing promotes rapid lattice reorganization faster than Sn/Pb interdiffusion, leaving vertical compositional gradients. Guided by these insights, we develop sTE absorbers with

items.title: Si- and C-Induced Modifications in Vapor-Solid-Grown InGaAs Nanowires: From Crystal Structure to Carrier Dynamics
items.title_zh: 硅和碳掺杂对气相固相生长InGaAs纳米线的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了硅（Si）和碳（C）掺杂对无催化剂选择性区域生长的InGaAs纳米线的结构、形态和光学特性的影响。通过扫描电子显微镜观察到，与未掺杂纳米线相比，C掺杂使纳米线的长宽比增加超过100%，同时平面缺陷密度降低，表明C掺杂提高了晶体质量。尽管C掺杂纳米线具有优越的晶体质量，但其光致发光强度降低，原因在于点缺陷和表面复合速率增加。时间分辨光致发光光谱进一步支持了这一点，显示C掺杂纳米线中非辐射复合加速。最后，研究了这些纳米结构中的热载流子效应，尽管在Si和C掺杂纳米线中强度降低，但其特征仍然可观察到。该研究建立了掺杂参数与材料特性及载流子动力学之间的明确关联。
items.abstract: Determining the impact of dopants in ternary III-V nanowires (NWs) is crucial for their applications in next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices; however, the interplay between dopant species, crystal structure, and carrier dynamics in vapor-solid-grown InGaAs NWs remains underexplored. In this study, the influence of silicon (Si) and carbon (C) doping on the structural, morphological, and optical properties of catalyst-free, selective-area grown InGaAs NWs fabricated by molecular beam epitaxy is investigated. Scanning electron microscopy demonstrates that C-doping increases the NW aspect ratio by over 100% compared to undoped NWs, while a concomitant decrease in their planar defect density is observed, indicating enhanced crystal quality with C-doping. Despite their superior crystal quality, the C-doped NWs present a diminished photoluminescence intensity, due to point defects and increased surface recombination velocity. This is further supported by time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy, revealing accelerated non-radiative recombination in the C-doped NWs. Lastly, hot-carrier effects in these nanostructures are studied, and their signatures remain observable, al
items.authors: Hamidreza Esmaielpour, Leopold Rothmayer, Thomas Trinkl, Laura Niermann, Tore Niermann, Michael Lehmann, Jonathan J. Finley, Gregor Koblm\"uller

items.title: Polymorphic crystallites model for monolayer amorphous materials
items.title_zh: 多晶体模型用于单层无定形材料研究
items.summary_zh: 建立无定形材料的原子模型仍然是材料科学中的一个核心挑战。本文研究了三种代表性的多组分单层系统，采用基于第一性原理的机器学习势（MLPs）和能量引导的蒙特卡洛结构搜索工作流程。对于单层无定形氮化硼（maBN），独立的密度泛函理论（DFT）单点计算确认，MLP驱动搜索生成的集合在能量上平均低于扩展Tersoff生成的集合。通过局部环分类和严格的连通域分析，识别出h-BN样、o-B$_2$N$_2$样和o-B$_4$N$_4$样的晶体域及混合中程有序。只有包含至少两种不同相纯晶体域类型的样本被分类为多晶体。在单层无定形LiCl中发现共存的六角形和四方形域，在单层无定形BCN中则发现石墨烯样、h-BN样、硼烯样及混合有序区域。300 K下的五纳秒MLP分子动力学轨迹显示候选结构在模拟时间尺度上动态持久。这些结果支持所选模型系统的多晶体描述。
items.abstract: Establishing atomistic models of amorphous materials remains a central challenge in materials science. Here, we examine three representative multicomponent monolayer systems using first-principles-trained machine-learning potentials (MLPs) and an energy-guided Monte Carlo structural-search workflow. For monolayer amorphous boron nitride (maBN), independent density-functional-theory (DFT) single-point calculations confirm that the ensemble generated by the MLP-driven search is lower in energy on average than an extended-Tersoff-generated ensemble. Across the sampled maBN structures, local-ring classification combined with strict connected-domain analysis identifies h-BN-like, o-B$_2$N$_2$-like, and o-B$_4$N$_4$-like crystallite domains together with mixed medium-range order. Only individual samples containing at least two distinct phase-pure crystallite-domain types are classified as polymorphic crystallites. The same analysis finds coexisting hexagonal and tetragonal domains in monolayer amorphous LiCl and graphene-like, h-BN-like, borophene-like, and mixed-order regions in monolayer amorphous BCN. items.authors: Le-Ye Zhu, Xi Zhang, Yun-Peng Wang, Jieheng Shi, Junwei Zhang, Shixuan Du, Yu-Yang Zhang

items.title: Universal scaling of electrochemical information transfer at solid-liquid interfaces
items.title_zh: 固液界面电化学信息传递的普适尺度
items.summary_zh: 固液界面的电化学势决定了多种化学和能量转换过程；然而，其电化学影响在固体内部的延伸程度尚不清楚。本文展示了最大可获取电化学信息由一个无量纲筛选参数$u$主导，该参数定义为界面与探针之间有效电静距离与固体中电静传播长度的比值。最大Fisher信息与该参数呈普适的反平方关系。这一关系表明电静筛选是固液界面信息传递的基本限制，并为界面电化学传感提供了定量设计原则。
items.abstract: Electrochemical potentials at solid-liquid interfaces govern diverse chemical and energy conversion processes; however, the extent to which their electrochemical influence extends into the solid remains unclear. Here, we show that the maximum accessible electrochemical information is governed by a single dimensionless screening parameter $u$, defined as the ratio of the effective electrostatic separation between the interface and probe to the electrostatic propagation length in the solid. The maximum Fisher information follows a universal inverse-square scaling with this parameter. This relation identifies electrostatic screening as a fundamental constraint on information transfer across solid-liquid interfaces and provides quantitative design principles for interfacial electrochemical sensing.
items.authors: Eikichi Kimura, Ashutosh Rathi, Saki Tsuchiya, El Mustapha Mansouri, Sara Mandi\'{c}, Kristi Kanya Saikia, Keisuke Oshimi, Masazumi Fujiwara, Keigo Arai

items.title: Spatiotemporal Analysis for Frequency-Magnitude Distribution of Earthquakes Across Mainland China: Comparing Classical and b-positive b-values Across Tectonic Regimes
items.title_zh: 我国大陆地震频率-震级分布的时空分析：经典与b-positive b值比较
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了我国大陆主要构造区（如四川-云南、华北和西北地区）b值的时空演变。通过分析超过50年的地震记录，我们系统地研究了主要震源区的b值变化，以评估其作为中强度地震前兆的有效性。结果表明，b-positive估计值在检测能力变化和短期余震不完整性方面的影响较小。四川-云南地区呈现出高低b值的复杂“马赛克”，反映了流体驱动过程和局部锁定，而华北平原和西北地区则显示出持续较低的b值，表明高背景应力和刚性地壳完整性。此外，我们发现多个中到大地震的破裂区与局部化现象相吻合。
items.abstract: The Gutenberg-Richter power-law relationship essentially governs the frequency-magnitude distribution (FMD) of seismic activity. The b-value, as the slope of this distribution, is widely recognized not only as a quantifier of the relative proportion of small to large events but also as a diagnostic precursor of crustal differential stress and potential big to huge earthquakes. This study investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of b-values across major tectonic regions in mainland China, for instance, the Sichuan-Yunnan, North China, and Northwest regions. Our analysis of over 50 years of seismic records systematically examines b-value variations across major seismogenic zones in mainland China to evaluate their utility as precursors for moderate-to-strong earthquakes. Moreover, our comparison suggests that the b-positive estimator is less affected by changes in detection capability and short-term aftershock incompleteness than the classical b-value estimator in the cases examined. items.authors: Yuxin Zhou, Huai Zhang, S. Mostafa Mousavi

items.title: Agentic Workflow for High-Throughput Synthesis Campaigns: Mapping the Persistent Phosphor Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+
items.title_zh: 高通量合成中的自主工作流程：持久磷光体Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对高通量合成活动中结构和光谱数据的记录，提出了一种自主工作流程。该流程利用语言模型代理操作基于开源DARA引擎的自动Rietveld相搜索管道Crystalyze Match，并对相位、光谱和合成元数据进行解读。我们在48个样品的合成活动中应用该工作流程，研究了持久磷光体Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+（掺锌硬石膏），作为SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+的水稳定替代品。该流程映射了两个分解路径，验证了两步合成方法，并发现每个掺杂样品中均存在一种先前手动分析未能识别的稀土掺杂物：硅酸盐氧磷灰石Ca2(Eu,Nd)8(SiO4)6O2。尽管稀土掺杂物最终似乎进入氧磷灰石相，但发射强度随着Eu含量单调增加。
items.abstract: The structural and spectroscopic record of a high-throughput synthesis campaign exceeds what experimenters can closely and accurately analyze with conventional tools alone. We report a workflow built for this problem: a language model agent operates an automated Rietveld phasesearch pipeline, Crystalyze Match, built on the open-source DARA engine, and then interprets the phases, optical spectra, and synthesis metadata. We demonstrate this workflow on a 48 sample campaign for the persistent phosphor Ca 2 ZnSi 2 O 7 :Eu 2+ ,Nd 3+ (doped hardystonite), a water-stable candidate alternative to SrAl 2 O 4 :Eu 2+ ,Dy 3+ for luminescent road markings. Within the campaign’s lifetime, the workflow mapped two decomposition pathways, incomplete reaction and zinc volatilization, that validate the two-step synthetic approach. The workflow also identified the fate of the rare-earth dopants: a silicate oxyapatite, Ca 2 (Eu,Nd) 8 (SiO 4 ) 6 O 2 , missed by prior manual analysis, is present in every doped sample. items.authors: Ziyang Jiang, Eric Riesel, Ian Naccarella, Taylor D. Sparks

items.title: Enhancing Aromatics Production in Zeolite-Catalyzed Lignin Pyrolysis by Establishing Structure-Acidity-Performance Relationships
items.title_zh: 通过建立结构-酸性-性能关系提高沸石催化木质素热解芳烃产量
items.summary_zh: 木质素选择性热解为芳烃面临高氧含量和结构复杂性等挑战。固体酸催化剂如沸石在热解过程中表现出良好催化性能，但酸位密度和强度对芳烃产量的影响尚不明确。本研究系统评估了三种不同酸性特征的沸石框架拓扑（FAU、MFI和BEA）在木质素热解中的表现。结果显示，框架拓扑依赖的酸位强度对芳烃产量的影响显著高于酸位密度。热重分析表明，初级木质素降解并未导致产物分布变化，而是氧化木质素片段与酸位的二次反应决定了去氧化性能。H-ZSM-5的芳烃产量最高（100–132 mg g-1木质素），其次为H-Beta（35–52 mg g-1木质素）和H-Y（8–22 mg g-1木质素），这些值对应于理论最大BTXs环利用效率的4%至16%。
items.abstract: Selective pyrolysis of lignin into aromatics remains a major challenge due to its high oxygen content and structural complexity. Solid acid catalysts, like zeolites, are well known as effective catalysts for pyrolysis processes. However, the role of acid site density and strength in controlling aromatic yields in lignin pyrolysis remains insufficiently understood. Here, three zeolite framework topologies, namely FAU, MFI, and BEA, with distinct acidity profiles were systematically evaluated for lignin pyrolysis to disentangle zeolite framework topology and acidity effects. Significant variations in bio-oil and non-oxygenated aromatics (benzene, toluene, xylene (BTXs), and napthalenes) yields demonstrated that framework topology-dependent acid site strength plays a more dominant role than acid site density (bulk/external) in enhancing aromatics yield. Thermogravimetric analysis revealed that primary lignin depolymerization is not responsible for the product distribution variations observed. Instead, secondary reactions of oxygenated lignin fragments with acid sites dictate the overall deoxygenation performance. H-ZSM-5 exhibited the highest aromatics yields (100–132 mg g-1lignin), f
items.authors: Devanshu Sajwan, Lucas Dorazio, Nils Bottke, Andrei N. Parvulescu, Matteo Monai, Bert M. Weckhuysen

items.title: Coverages and Configurations of CO* and H* on Pt(111) under Realistic Reaction Conditions
items.title_zh: Pt(111)上CO*与H*在反应条件下的覆盖与配置研究
items.summary_zh: 共吸附物种之间的侧向相互作用会导致非随机的空间组织，影响催化行为相关的反应性位点。本文研究了在Pt(111)上共吸附的CO*和H*的组织方式，结合了密度泛函理论、簇扩展和广义经典蒙特卡洛模拟。结果表明，在中性Pt(111)上，CO*与H*的最近邻相互作用为强排斥（0.42 eV），CO*与CO*的相互作用为中等排斥（0.12 eV），而H*与H*的相互作用相对较弱。这些相互作用导致CO*形成岛屿并随着覆盖率增加而合并，而H*则优先占据CO*富集区域之外。因此，CO*与H*的最近邻配置数量随着CO*覆盖率呈非单调变化，在中等覆盖率时达到最大值，随后随着CO*岛屿的增长而减少。正表面电荷增强了CO*的吸附。
items.abstract: Lateral interactions between co–adsorbed species can produce non-random spatial organization that governs the availability of reactive motifs relevant to catalytic behavior. For CO* and H* co–adsorbed on Pt(111), these interactions determine how the two species distribute across the surface and therefore which local CO*–H* configurations are available under reaction conditions. In this work, we combine density functional theory, cluster expansions, and grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations to determine how CO* and H* organize on Pt(111), and subsequently use electronic surface charge as a controlled perturbation to examine how this organization responds to changes in the underlying energetics. On neutral Pt(111), CO*–H* first-nearest-neighbor interactions are strongly repulsive (0.42 eV), CO*–CO* first-nearest-neighbor interactions are moderately repulsive (0.12 eV), and H*–H* interactions are comparatively weak. These interactions cause CO* to nucleate into islands that grow and coalesce with increasing CO* coverage, while H* preferentially occupies regions outside CO*-rich domains.
