items.authors: Sifat Hossain, Venkata Rohit Punyapu, Phillip Christopher, Rachel B. Getman

items.title: ElastoGraph: An Open-Source Algorithmic Framework for the Topological Assessment of Molecular Stiffness Applied to Polysaccharide Networks
items.title_zh: ElastoGraph：用于多糖网络分子刚度拓扑评估的开源算法框架
items.summary_zh: 分子尺度机械性质的预测依赖于基于矩阵的方法，如弹性网络模型（ENMs）中的大海森矩阵对角化或分子动力学（MD）模拟。这些方法的计算复杂度为O(N³)，通过数值运算将分子连接性映射到宏观刚度，但未明确解决载荷传递路径。本文提出了ElastoGraph，一个开源Python框架，重点转向弹性路径的拓扑映射，即机械力在终端顶点之间传递的具体路线。该算法实现了三个目标：（i）通过切点分析识别并修剪机械无关子图（r = 0），孤立出对载荷传递有贡献的弹性路径；（ii）基于图距离和顶点连通性，使用k-d子图排名对这些路径进行分层分类，提供化学功能化的优先拓扑目标图；（iii）通过递归边缘简化在O(N)时间内计算系列并联结构的有效弹性常数，同时为非系列并联网络建立严格的拓扑界限。该框架应用于纤维素和β-壳聚糖的承载骨架，揭示了其机械特性。
items.abstract: The prediction of mechanical properties at the molecular scale relies on matrix-based approaches, such as the diagonalization of large Hessian matrices in elastic network models (ENMs) or molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. These methods exhibit O(N3) computational complexity and map molecular connectivity to macroscopic stiffness through numerical operations that do not explicitly resolve load-transmission pathways. Here, we present 2 ElastoGraph, an open-source Python framework that shifts the analytical focus from numerical prediction to the topological mapping of elastic paths—the specific routes through which mechanical force is transmitted between terminal vertices. The algorithm achieves three objectives: (i) it identifies and prunes mechanically irrelevant subgraphs (r = 0) via cut-vertex analysis, isolating the subset of elastic paths that contribute to load transmission; (ii) it hierarchically classifies these paths using a k–d subgraph ranking based on graph distance and vertex-connectivity, providing a prioritized map of topological targets for chemical functionalization; and (iii) it computes effective elastic constants for series-parallel architectures through recurs
items.authors: Martina Canet, Yamila García, Yamila Garcia-Martinez

items.title: Accurate modeling of ion-protein binding in solution: molecular mechanics force field innovation and validation on Mg2+
items.title_zh: 溶液中离子-蛋白质结合的精确建模：分子力学力场创新与验证
items.summary_zh: 多价离子通过与蛋白质结合来调控许多生物过程。分子模拟可以有效补充实验以揭示潜在机制，但在描述凝聚相中的离子-蛋白质结合时存在可靠性和可行性问题。本文提出了一种基于分子力学的通用解决方案，以二价镁离子（Mg²⁺）为模型，展示了我们的方法在描述其与蛋白质结合方面的前所未有的准确性——与高水平量子力学相比，局部相互作用能的平均误差为0.5%，结合模式和结合自由能与实验结果相符。研究表明，达到这种准确性需要在离子附近短距离内大排斥力和吸引力之间保持微妙平衡，显式建模极化是关键。总体而言，我们的工作为未来离子的分子模拟方法发展奠定了基础，并为定量研究数百种酶和蛋白质中的镁依赖机制开辟了新途径。
items.abstract: Multivalent ions bind to proteins to control many biological processes. Molecular simulations can effectively supplement experiments to resolve underlying mechanisms, but suffer from reliability and feasibility issues in describing ion-protein binding in the condensed phase. Here we present a molecular mechanics based generalizable solution to this long-standing challenge. Using the divalent Mg 2+ as a model, we demonstrate that our approach yields unprecedented accuracy in describing its binding to proteins in solution – compared to high level quantum mechanics, the mean error in local interaction energies is 0.5%, and the binding modes and binding free energies match experiment. Our study also shows that key to achieving this accuracy requires a delicate balance between the large repulsive and attractive forces at short distances near ions for which explicit modeling of polarization is essential. Overall, our work lays foundation for future development of molecular simulation methods for ions and opens the way to quantitatively study Mg-dependent mechanisms in hundreds of enzymes and proteins.
items.authors: Giorgio Schillaci, Julian Mélendez Delgado, Matthew Saunders, Irene Arias Gutierrez, Péter R. Nagy, Sameer Varma

items.title: Polymer-Assisted One-Dimensional Dissolution in N‑Methylformamide Unlocks Highly Ordered Hybrid Bragg-Stack Clay-Poly(Ethylene Glycol) Oxygen Barriers
items.title_zh: 聚合物辅助的一维溶解实现高有序混合Bragg堆叠粘土-聚乙烯醇氧气屏障
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在N-甲基甲酰胺（NMF）中，聚乙烯醇（PEG）辅助合成氟膨润土（NaHec）的协同剥离过程。该过程通过PEG作为复合材料的聚合物基体和剥离驱动剂，促使层状材料自发分散为高长宽比的纳米片。喷涂后，聚合物被直接纳入高有序的混合Bragg堆叠纳米复合材料中。通过氧气透过率测量，研究了不同分子量（200、400、1500、10000 g mol-1）的PEG链长对气体屏障性能的影响。随着分子量的增加，氧气渗透率显著降低（23°C，75%相对湿度），最低可达0.029 cm³ µm m⁻² d⁻¹ bar⁻¹，展示了非水相制备NaHec-PEG混合Bragg堆叠纳米复合材料的潜力。
items.abstract: One-dimensional (1D) dissolution is a gentle and thermodynamically driven process that enables the spontaneous and utter delamination of layered materials into nematic suspensions of individual high aspect ratio nanosheets. This process is primarily known and extensively explored for aqueous systems. Examples of 1D dissolution in organic solvents are scarce and require selected organocations or complexation of the interlayer cation. This work demonstrates synergistic delamination of synthetic sodium fluorohectorite (NaHec; Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct Si4 tet O10F2) in N-methylformamide (NMF) using poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG), which concomitantly acts as a complexing agent driving delamination and as the polymer matrix for a composite. Upon spray coating, the polymer is directly incorporated into a highly ordered hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposite. The performance as a gas barrier was investigated for a range of PEG chain lengths [MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1] using O2‑transmission rate measurements. With increasing MW, substantially reduced oxygen permeabilities (23°C, 75% r.h.) were observed, reaching values as low as 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1, demonstrating the power of non-
items.authors: Max Stevenson, Alexandra Jourdain, Felix Uhlig, Sabine Rosenfeldt, Meike Kuhn, Eva M. Herzig

items.title: A Molecular Generation–Validation Workflow Combining Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning and Semi-empirical Quantum Chemistry: A Case Study on Molecular Solar Thermal Fuels
items.title_zh: 结合可逆连接树强化学习与半经验量子化学的分子生成验证工作流程
items.summary_zh: 分子生成模型能够快速探索化学空间，但传统指标无法确定所提结构是否具备应用相关的物理性质。为解决这一局限，我们开发了一个集成的生成-验证框架，将可逆连接树强化学习（RJT-RL）与自动化密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）评估相结合。以基于偶氮苯的分子太阳热燃料为案例研究，RJT-RL在最大Tanimoto相似度的指导下进行，参考分子和生成分子在相同的DFTB计算条件下进行评估，以获得顺式和反式异构体之间的能量差（∆E_iso）和S_0 → S_1激发能（∆E_ex）。随着训练的进行，∆E_iso分布向更高值扩展，而∆E_ex值则集中在可见光窗口内，产生了符合选定联合筛选区域的候选分子，尽管这两个描述符未包含在奖励中。这些结果表明，自动化的半经验后生成验证能够识别具有目标性质组合的候选分子，并揭示超越传统分子生成指标的信息。
items.abstract: Molecular generative models can rapidly explore chemical space, but conventional metrics alone do not establish whether proposed structures possess application-relevant physical properties. To address this limitation, we developed an integrated generationvalidation framework coupling Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning (RJT- RL) with automated density-functional tight-binding (DFTB) evaluation. Azobenzenebased molecular solar thermal fuels served as a representative case study. RJT-RL was guided by maximum Tanimoto similarity to a reference dataset, while reference and generated molecules were evaluated under identical DFTB calculation conditions to obtain the energy difference between the cis and trans isomers (∆ E iso ) and the S 0 → S 1 excitation energy (∆ E ex ). As training progressed, the ∆ E iso distribution extended toward higher values, while ∆ E ex values were more concentrated within the visible-light window, yielding candidates within the selected joint screening region, although neither descriptor was included in the reward. These results show that automated semi-empirical post-generation validation can identify candidates with targeted property combinatio
items.authors: Qingyu Zhu, Ryan Lingg, Reuben Szabo, Tim Kowalczyk, Daisuke Yokogawa

items.title: Nanovehicles Equipped with Triptycene-Fused Unidirectional Light-Driven Molecular Motors
items.title_zh: 配备三苯并环单向光驱动分子马达的纳米载体
items.summary_zh: 本研究报告了一种模块化合成平台，用于基于三苯并环融合过度烯烃分子马达的马达化纳米载体，采用正交轴、基于三甲基阿达曼烷的轮子和可选的鞭状附肢。通过收敛合成策略组装了三种结构复杂度逐渐增加的纳米载体架构。利用核磁共振和紫外-可见光光谱研究了母体分子马达的光化学和热行为，并通过X射线晶体学和密度泛函理论计算进行了支持，显示其经过单向四阶段旋转循环。重要的是，马达嵌入纳米载体框架后，特征性的光异构化和热螺旋反转过程得以保留。此外，选定的纳米载体在金表面上固定，差异紫外-可见光光谱表明在溶液中观察到的光化学和热响应得以保持。这些结果表明，三甲基阿达曼烷轮有效地将马达单元与金属基底解耦。
items.abstract: The integration of molecular motors into increasingly complex functional architectures while preserving their dynamic behavior represents an important challenge in the development of molecular machinery. Herein, we report a modular synthetic platform for motorized nanovehicles based on a triptycene-fused overcrowded alkene molecular motor, orthogonal axles, trimethyladamantane-based wheels, and an optional flagellum-like appendage. Three nanovehicle architectures of increasing structural complexity were assembled using a convergent synthetic strategy. The photochemical and thermal behavior of the parent molecular motor was investigated by NMR and UV–vis spectroscopy, supported by X-ray crystallography and density functional theory calculations, and shown to proceed through a unidirectional four-stage rotary cycle. Importantly, the characteristic photoisomerization and thermal helix inversion processes were retained after incorporation of the motor into the nanovehicle framework. Furthermore, selected nanovehicle was immobilized on gold surfaces, where differential UV–vis spectroscopy demonstrated preservation of the photochemical and thermal responses observed in solution. The clos
items.authors: Guillaume Bastien, Kateřina Bezděková, Katarina Majerová Varga, Eva Kaletová, Lukáš Severa, Jakub Sochor

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Screening for Accelerated Mechanistic Analysis
items.title_zh: 动态参数筛选加速机理分析研究
items.summary_zh: 机理研究对化学科学的持续发展至关重要，但传统方法仍然繁琐且耗材。图形反应分析技术如RPKA和VTNA显著减轻了这一负担，但全面研究日益复杂的反应所需的时间和资源仍然较高。为进一步简化数据获取，开发了中高通量的批量和流动动力学方法，但其广泛应用受限于对专用设备或专业知识的需求。本文介绍了动态参数筛选（DPS），通过在单一批量反应中持续监测，同时使用顺序试剂和催化剂添加来探测多种物质的动力学影响。以钯催化的Kumada–Tamao–Corriu交叉偶联反应为模型系统，我们将DPS与传统的单因素逐次法进行了比较。结果表明，DPS在定性和定量（动力学建模）结论上基本一致，除了XPhos Pd G2系统，该系统显示出多种动力学状态，传统方法揭示了试剂浓度的全球影响，而DPS则提供了更高分辨率的试剂效应洞察。
items.abstract: Mechanistic studies are essential for the continued advancement of the chemical sciences however; classical approaches remain laborious and material intensive. Graphical reaction analysis techniques such as RPKA and VTNA have substantially reduced this burden, yet the time and resources required to comprehensively study increasingly complex reactions remain high. Medium- and high-throughput batch and flow kinetic methods have been developed to further streamline data acquisition, but their widespread adoption is limited by the need for specialized equipment or expertise. Here we introduce dynamic parameter screening (DPS), in which a single batch reaction is monitored continuously while sequential reagent and catalyst additions are used to probe kinetic impacts of multiple species within one experimental setup. Using the palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling as a model system, we compared DPS with traditional one-factor-at-a-time approach across three catalytic systems (PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2, PEPPSI-iPr, and XPhos Pd G2). DPS afforded essentially identical qualitative and quantitative (kinetic modeling) conclusions except for the case of XPhos Pd G2. This latter syste
items.authors: Dylan J. Pyle, Finn Bork, Wesley McNutt, Ekaterina Trushina, Joshua S. Derasp, Sara M. Guzman

items.title: Enzymatic routes to site-specific protein-nucleic acid conjugates
items.title_zh: 酶促合成特定位点蛋白-核酸结合物的途径
items.summary_zh: 自然界中，核酸与蛋白质的共价结合极为罕见，但合成的蛋白-核酸结合物在纳米技术和治疗学等领域具有广泛应用，这些应用需要或受益于已知几何形状的稳定一对一连接。本文评估了实现此类结合物的生化途径，依据四个理想标准：酶促键合、双方的可寻址性、对目标蛋白的最小工程改造，以及与未修饰核酸的无痕连接。现有方法主要分为两种架构：在顺式中，酶本身成为产物的一部分，允许在未修饰核酸上进行本征化学反应，但通常需要在末端进行折叠融合；在反式中，独立酶修饰目标蛋白并留下短序列，但通常会将负担转移到核酸上，后者必须携带反应性基团。目前没有任何方法能满足所有四个理想标准，权衡主要反映了键合酶所识别的底物类别。核酸识别因子提供了无痕、完全酶促结合的最直接途径，但其对大融合的需求限制了蛋白侧的可寻址性。小分子识别因子则反转了这一特征，允许紧凑标签和更大的放置灵活性。
items.abstract: Nature rarely joins nucleic acids to proteins covalently, yet synthetic protein-nucleic acid conjugates enable diverse applications from nanotechnology to therapeutics, which require or benefit from defined, stable, one-to-one linkages of known geometry. Here I evaluate biochemical routes to such conjugates against four ideals: enzymatic bond formation, addressability on both partners, minimal engineering of the protein of interest, and scarless linkage to unmodified nucleic acid. With an eye on biochemical mechanisms, I cover both established tools and natural systems that might become one. The available methods fall into two broad architectures. In cis, the enzyme itself becomes part of the product, allowing native chemistry on unmodified nucleic acid but requiring a folded fusion, usually at a terminus. In trans, a separate enzyme modifies the target protein and leaves a short motif, but the burden often shifts to the nucleic acid, which must carry a reactive group. No current method satisfies all four ideals, and the trade-offs largely reflect the substrate class recognized by the bond-forming enzyme. Nucleic-acid readers offer the most direct route to scarless, fully enzymatic
items.authors: Maximilian J.L.J. Fürst

items.title: Evolving Cell with evolving science
items.title_zh: 进化中的《Cell》与科学的演变
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了《Cell》期刊的特点及其发表标准。作者指出，尽管《Cell》发表的论文通常较长、机制性强且内容“完整”，但其核心价值在于所提供的深刻生物学见解和激动人心的研究成果。作者强调，期刊的目标是发布那些能够引起读者兴趣、带来启发的研究，而不仅仅是因为论文的长度或复杂性。通过这些研究，读者能够获得有益的知识和洞见。
items.abstract: I know what you think about papers in Cell. They are long. Mechanistic. “Complete.” They report deep biological insights. I know this because I hear it a lot from researchers. There is truth to it. Cell has published thousands of papers that fit these descriptors, and we will continue to. They have incredible value. But we don’t publish papers in Cell because they are long and mechanistic. We publish them because they are exciting. Cool. Awe-inspiring. We publish them because we think they provide something that our readers will want to learn about and will benefit from.
items.authors: John W. Pham

items.title: scBaseCount: An AI agent-curated, standardized, auto-updated single-cell data repository
items.title_zh: scBaseCount：AI代理策划的标准化单细胞数据仓库
items.summary_zh: scBaseCount是目前最大的公共单细胞RNA测序数据仓库，包含超过5.02亿个细胞，涵盖27种生物和75种组织。该平台通过AI代理自主发现、注释并统一处理所有10× Genomics数据集，创建了一个和谐且持续更新的资源，旨在研究细胞生物学的多样性及训练AI模型。
items.abstract: scBaseCount is presently the largest public single-cell RNA-seq repository, containing over 502 million cells across 27 organisms and 75 tissues. An AI agent autonomously discovers, annotates, and uniformly reprocesses all 10× Genomics datasets in the SRA, creating a harmonized, continually updated resource for studying the diversity of cell biology and training AI models.
items.authors: Nicholas D. Youngblut, Christopher Carpenter, Arshia Nayebnazar, Abhinav Adduri, Rohan Shah, Chiara Ricci-Tam, Jaanak Prashar, Rajesh Ilango, Noam Teyssier, Silvana Konermann, Patrick D. Hsu, Alexande

items.title: Tahoe-100M: Mapping drug-induced molecular phenotypes at single-cell resolution
items.title_zh: Tahoe-100M：以单细胞分辨率绘制药物诱导的分子表型
items.summary_zh: Tahoe-100M是一个包含1亿个单细胞转录组的图谱，记录了50种癌细胞系对约1100种药物剂量处理的反应。通过大规模的单细胞转录组分析，该资源将药物机制与细胞反应联系起来，并提供了一个公开可用的平台，用于训练细胞行为的预测模型。
items.abstract: Tahoe-100M is an atlas of 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, capturing how 50 cancer cell lines respond to ∼1,100 drug-dose treatments. By pairing single-cell and molecular phenotypes at scale, the resource links drug mechanisms to cellular responses and provides an openly available substrate for training predictive models of cell behavior.
items.authors: Jesse Zhang, Airol A. Ubas, Valentine Svensson, Nicole Thomas, Vishvak Subramanyam, Christopher Carpenter, Aidan Winters, Richard de Borja, Noam Teyssier, Neha Thakar, Umair Khan, Pooja V. Akella, Har

items.title: Take a risk or play it safe? Neuronal tug-of-war helps the brain decide
items.title_zh: 冒险还是保守？神经拉锯战助力大脑决策
items.summary_zh: 研究人员使用一款涉及炸弹和宝箱的视频游戏，探讨大脑在面临复杂决策时的神经活动。研究发现，当大脑评估风险时，前额叶皮层的两个区域之间的神经活动会交替闪烁。这种神经拉锯战反映了大脑在权衡冒险与安全选择时的动态过程。该研究揭示了大脑如何在面对不确定性时做出决策，为理解决策机制提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02911-9 Using a video game involving bombs and treasure chests, researchers show how neural activity flickers between two regions of the frontal cortex when the brain weighs up a tricky decision.
items.authors: Miryam Naddaf

items.title: A world model of the virtual cell
items.title_zh: 虚拟细胞的世界模型
items.summary_zh: 虚拟细胞被设想为一个多模态、多尺度和有状态的世界模型，能够模拟、扰动并最终编程细胞系统。本文阐述了这一范式如何将细胞生物学从实验的试错过程转变为以模拟驱动的发现、反事实探索和合理干预设计。通过构建这一模型，研究者能够更深入地理解细胞行为，并在此基础上进行更有效的生物学研究和应用。
items.abstract: The virtual cell is envisioned as a multi-modal, multi-scale, and stateful world model that can simulate, perturb, and ultimately program cellular systems. This perspective outlines how this paradigm could transform cell biology from experimental trial-and-error toward simulation-driven discovery, counterfactual exploration, and rational intervention design.
items.authors: Eric P. Xing, Le Song

items.title: Changing minds: How AI is transforming the life sciences
items.title_zh: 人工智能如何变革生命科学研究
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变生物医学研究的方式，使得整合多种生物数据成为可能，并能够解决以往难以处理的问题。同时，AI的广泛应用也引发了关于数据质量、可靠性、可解释性以及如何将计算预测与生物知识和实验验证相结合的重要问题。在这篇文章中，来自不同学科的研究人员分享了他们对AI如何推动各自领域发展的看法，并强调了将塑造生命科学未来的变革性机遇和关键挑战。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way biomedical research is conducted by making it possible to integrate diverse types of biological data and tackle questions that were previously difficult to address. At the same time, its growing use also raises important questions about data quality, reliability, interpretability, and how computational predictions should be combined with biological knowledge and experimental validation. In this Voices piece, researchers from diverse disciplines share their perspectives on how AI is advancing their respective fields and highlight both the transformative opportunities and the key challenges that will shape the future of the life sciences.
items.authors: Daphne Koller, Peilong Lu, Laura Cantini, Yuri Pritykin, Jean Yee Hwa Yang, Kanaka Rajan, Martin Steinegger, Mihaela van der Schaar

items.title: Author Correction: Genomic deletion of malic enzyme 2 confers collateral lethality in pancreatic cancer
items.title_zh: 作者更正：苹果酸酶2基因缺失在胰腺癌中导致附带致死性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了苹果酸酶2（ME2）基因缺失对胰腺癌细胞的影响。通过基因组删除实验，发现ME2缺失会导致胰腺癌细胞的生长抑制和细胞死亡。关键数据表明，ME2缺失与代谢重编程相关，影响细胞的能量代谢和抗氧化能力。研究结果表明，ME2可能是胰腺癌治疗的新靶点，针对ME2的治疗策略可能会提高癌症患者的生存率。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11134-x Author Correction: Genomic deletion of malic enzyme 2 confers collateral lethality in pancreatic cancer
items.authors: Prasenjit Dey

items.title: World models for biomedicine
items.title_zh: 生物医学的世界模型研究
items.summary_zh: 生物过程会持续根据干预进行适应。与静态预测模型不同，生物医学世界模型支持基于行动的模拟，以进行反事实推理、干预设计和顺序规划。本文定义了生物医学世界模型的关键特性，并讨论了在生物和临床尺度上构建这些模型所需的数据、建模和评估挑战。
items.abstract: Biological processes continuously adapt in response to intervention. Unlike static predictive models, biomedical world models support action-conditioned simulations for counterfactual reasoning, intervention design, and sequential planning. This perspective defines the key properties of biomedical world models and discusses the data, modeling, and evaluation challenges required to build them across biological and clinical scales.
items.authors: Ayush Noori, Nic Fishman, Ada Fang, Lukas Fesser, Marinka Zitnik

items.title: Synergistic inhibition of Notch signaling and forced cell cycle re-entry drive Müller glia reprogramming in uninjured mouse retina
items.title_zh: Notch信号抑制与细胞周期重启促进小鼠视网膜Müller胶质细胞重编程
items.summary_zh: 在再生物种如硬骨鱼中，Müller胶质细胞（MG）在受伤后能够自主重新进入细胞周期并产生功能性视网膜神经元。然而，哺乳动物视网膜神经元的丧失是不可逆的，MG的增殖和再生能力有限。我们发现MG后代保持高水平的Notch信号，这可能限制其神经发生潜力。条件性删除Notch的中心转录效应因子Rbpj在成熟MG中诱导了有限的MG向神经元转化，而未引起增殖。结合过表达Ccnd1和抑制Cdkn1b以强制MG增殖的Rbpj删除显著促进了MG去分化及在未受伤小鼠视网膜中MG后代细胞中异常表达神经元标记物Otx2。Notch抑制与MG细胞周期重启的结合不仅增加了从MG生成的双极和无长突细胞的数量，还促进了向ON-锥体、OFF-锥体和杆状双极亚型的进一步分化。单细胞核RNA和ATAC测序数据表明，Notch抑制促进了MG来源的祖细胞样细胞的形成，而MG增殖则增加了染色质的可及性。
items.abstract: In regenerative species, such as teleost fish, Müller glia (MG) autonomously re-enter the cell cycle after injury and give rise to functional retinal neurons. In contrast, the loss of retinal neurons in mammals is irreversible due to the limited proliferative and regenerative ability of MG. Various strategies have been developed to induce proliferation of mature mouse MG with or without injury, yet most MG daughter cells retain glial cell fate. Here, we found that MG progenies maintain high Notch signaling, which may constrain their neurogenic potential. Conditional deletion of Rbpj , the central transcriptional effector of Notch, induced limited MG-to-neuron conversion in mature MG without proliferation. However, Rbpj deletion, combined with forced MG proliferation by overexpressing Ccnd1 and suppressing Cdkn1b , significantly promoted MG dedifferentiation and ectopic expression of the neuronal marker Otx2 in MG daughter cells in uninjured mouse retina. Combining Notch inhibition with MG cell cycle re-activation not only increased the numbers of bipolar- and amacrine-like cells generated from MG but also promoted the further differentiation toward ON-cone, OFF-cone, and rod-bipola

items.title: Multi-Channel Postoperative MRI and Deep Transfer Learning to Distinguish Glioblastoma Recurrence from Pseudo-Progression: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.title_zh: 多通道术后MRI与深度迁移学习区分胶质母细胞瘤复发与伪进展的概念验证研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：术后及化疗放疗后的胶质母细胞瘤监测面临挑战，因为肿瘤复发的MRI表现可能与伪进展、治疗相关效应及术后组织变化重叠。方法：我们开发了一种七通道术后MRI框架，利用深度学习迁移方法支持非侵入性胶质母细胞瘤治疗效果评估。模型使用124名术后胶质母细胞瘤患者（164个MRI时间点）的T1增强、FLAIR、T1、RSI-Cell、ADC、T2及脑血流量作为输入。图像通过在588个术后胶质瘤样本上预训练的3D ResNet18编码器进行处理，并使用特定任务的分类头进行微调。该队列包括124名患者，所有MRI时间点均在单一厂商的3T扫描仪上获取。性能通过患者级别的嵌套五折交叉验证进行评估。由于部分临床标签不完整，不同任务的可评估时间点数量不同（复发与伪进展164个；MGMT 99个；短期生存139个）。整个过程在三个独立随机种子下重复。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Glioblastoma surveillance after surgery and chemoradiation remains challenging because MRI findings of tumor recurrence can overlap with pseudo-progression, treatment-related effects, and postoperative tissue changes. Methods: We developed a seven-channel postoperative MRI framework using a deep learning transfer method to support non-invasive glioblastoma treatment-effect assessment. The model used T1 contrast-enhanced, FLAIR, T1, RSI-Cell, ADC, T2, and cerebral blood flow volumes from 124 postoperative glioblastoma patients (164 MRI timepoints) as input. Images were processed using a 3D ResNet18 encoder pretrained on 588 postoperative glioma samples and fine-tuned using task-specific classification heads. The cohort comprised 124 patients contributing 164 postoperative MRI timepoints, all acquired at 3T on scanners from a single vendor. Performance was evaluated with nested five-fold cross-validation stratified and assigned at the patient level, so that all timepoints from a given patient fell in one-fold and the training epoch was selected on an inner split rather than on the fold being reported. items.title: Spike Protein at the Crossroads of Long-COVID and Vaccine-Induced Immune Thrombotic Thrombocytopenia Syndromes: A Cardio-Hematological Perspective
items.title_zh: 刺突蛋白在长期新冠与疫苗诱导免疫性血栓性血小板减少症中的作用
items.summary_zh: 严重急性呼吸综合症冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）刺突（S）蛋白在病毒感染性、宿主-病原相互作用及免疫识别中起核心作用。研究表明，刺突蛋白可能通过内皮、心血管、血液、神经和免疫途径产生多重生物效应。自然感染时，这些效应发生在活跃的病毒复制和全身炎症背景下，而疫苗接种则导致对预融合稳定的刺突抗原的短暂暴露。本文批判性地审视了SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白的分子及临床病理特性，以及感染源与疫苗源刺突暴露之间的生物学差异。重点讨论了内皮功能障碍、血小板和补体激活、免疫性血栓形成、长期新冠中的持续病毒抗原及组织储存，以及疫苗诱导免疫性血栓性血小板减少症（VITT）的独特病理生理机制。新证据表明，持续或失调的刺突相关抗原暴露可能导致部分个体在感染后出现慢性多系统表现。
items.abstract: The severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spike (S) protein is central to viral infectivity, host–pathogen interactions, and immune recognition. Beyond its indispensable role in viral entry, accumulating experimental and clinical evidence indicates that spike protein may exert pleiotropic biological effects involving endothelial, cardiovascular, hematological, neurological, and immunological pathways. During natural infection, these effects occur in the context of active viral replication, additional viral antigens, and systemic inflammation, whereas vaccination induces a fundamentally different, transient exposure to a prefusion-stabilized spike antigen without viral propagation. In this review, we critically examine the molecular and clinicopathological properties of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein and the biological differences between infection-derived and vaccine-derived spike exposure. items.authors: Elifcan Aladag, Ugur Nadir Karakulak, Ibrahim Celalettin Haznedaroglu

items.title: Speckle Tracking Analysis of the Left and Right Heart in Type 1 Diabetes Patients with End-Stage Renal Disease Awaiting Simultaneous Pancreas-Kidney Transplantation
items.title_zh: 1型糖尿病合并终末期肾病患者心脏超声斑点追踪分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：糖尿病性心肌病是1型糖尿病（T1DM）的一种未被充分认识的并发症，常与糖尿病肾病共存。本研究探讨T1DM合并终末期肾病（ESRD）患者在接受同时胰腺-肾脏移植（SPKT）前是否存在心肌病的超声心动图表现，并分析心脏变化更可能归因于糖尿病本身还是慢性肾病。方法：我们回顾性分析了16例T1DM和ESRD患者的术前超声心动图数据，采用二维斑点追踪评估应变。数据与匹配的对照组进行比较：无糖尿病的ESRD患者（n=20）和健康对照（n=48）。分析了左心和右心的功能及结构，包括二维斑点追踪分析。采用混合效应模型调整年龄、性别、冠心病和高血压的影响。结果：SPKT患者左心结构发生显著变化，包括左心室质量和左心房体积指数增加，同时全球纵向应变（GLS）、全球径向应变（GRS）和全球周向应变（GCS）降低，且GRS和GCS在SPKT组显著低于无糖尿病的ESRD组。左心房应变和应变数据也显示出相应变化。
items.abstract: Background: Diabetic cardiomyopathy is an under-recognized complication of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), often co-existing with diabetic nephropathy. This study investigates whether patients with T1DM and end-stage renal disease (ESRD) undergoing simultaneous pancreas-kidney transplantation (SPKT) show echocardiographic signs of cardiomyopathy prior to surgery and explores whether cardiac changes are more attributable to diabetes itself or to chronic kidney disease. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed preoperative echocardiographic data of 16 SPKT patients with T1DM and ESRD, using 2D speckle tracking for strain assessment. Data were compared to individually matched control groups: (1) ESRD patients without diabetes (n=20) and (2) healthy controls (n=48). Left and right ventricular/atrial function and structure were analyzed, including 2D speckle-tracking analysis. A mixed-effects model adjusted for age, sex, coronary artery disease, and hypertension. items.title: Spectrum of Hereditary Ataxia in Omani Children
items.title_zh: 阿曼儿童遗传性共济失调谱系研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：遗传性共济失调是一组在基因和表型上具有异质性的神经退行性疾病，常面临诊断挑战。本研究旨在描述我们机构中遇到的遗传性共济失调谱系，并识别可能促进早期识别和诊断的表型模式。方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入2012年1月至2022年1月在苏丹卡布斯大学医院就诊的18岁以下共济失调患者。回顾医疗记录，收集人口统计、临床、分子遗传学和神经影像学数据。共济失调分为获得性和遗传性，遗传性病例根据临床特征和家族史识别，并进一步分为基因确认和非基因确认。评估选定临床变量对遗传性共济失调诊断收益的影响。数据分析使用SPSS版本29，显著性水平设定为p<0.05。结果：共识别132例共济失调患者，其中70例符合遗传性共济失调的诊断标准。在70例患者中，46例（65.7%）为常染色体隐性共济失调，9例（12.9%）为明显散发性共济失调，4例（5.7%）为常染色体显性共济失调。共济失调性毛细血管扩张症为最常见类型。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Hereditary ataxias are a genetically and phenotypically heterogeneous group of neurodegenerative disorders that often pose diagnostic challenges. This study characterized the spectrum of hereditary ataxias encountered at our institution and identified phenotypic patterns that may facilitate early recognition and diagnosis. Methods: A retrospective cohort study included patients younger than 18 years presenting with ataxia at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital between January 2012 and January 2022. Medical records were reviewed for demographic, clinical, molecular genetics, and neuroimaging data. Ataxia was classified as acquired or hereditary. Hereditary cases were identified based on clinical features and family history and further divided into genetically confirmed and non-genetically confirmed. Selected clinical variables were evaluated for their impact on the diagnostic yield of hereditary ataxia. Data analysis was performed using SPSS version 29, with a significance level set at p 0.05. items.authors: Amal Al-Habsi, Khalid Al-Thihli, Eiman Al-Ajmi, Amna Al-Futaisi, Abdullah Al-Badi, Fatema Al-Amrani

items.title: Toward Clinically Trustworthy Pathology Foundation Models for Microsatellite Instability Prescreening in Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: 肠癌微卫星不稳定性预筛查的可信病理基础模型研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对结直肠癌中的微卫星不稳定性高（MSI-H）预测，评估了九种冻结编码器的性能，包括五种病理特定模型（CONCH、CONCH v1.5、UNI、Virchow2、Phikon）和四种传统视觉骨干（ResNet18、ResNet50、ViT-B/16、ConvNeXt-Tiny）。我们在患者级别框架下，使用TCGA-COAD/READ作为开发队列，CPTAC-COAD作为独立外部队列，对每种编码器进行评估。HE切片在不进行微调的情况下嵌入，并通过相同的逻辑回归线性探针进行评估。主要开发基准为206名患者（82名MSI-H，124名MSS），同时进行标签来源审计，发现7.3%的患者存在跨源MSI来源不一致。次要敏感性分析报告了191名一致标签患者（68名MSI-H，123名MSS）。
items.abstract: Pathology foundation models have recently emerged as powerful pretrained representations for computational pathology, yet whether complex downstream modeling is still necessary once frozen representations are evaluated under a common downstream framework remains insufficiently understood. We address this question for microsatellite-instability-high (MSI-H) prediction in colorectal cancer by benchmarking nine frozen encoders—five pathology-specific (CONCH, CONCH v1.5, UNI, Virchow2, Phikon) and four conventional vision backbones (ResNet18, ResNet50, ViT-B/16, ConvNeXt-Tiny)—for colorectal cancer histopathology under a patient-level framework, using TCGA-COAD/READ as the development cohort and CPTAC-COAD as an independent external cohort. For each encoder, H E tiles were embedded without fine-tuning, mean-pooled to slide and patient representations, and evaluated with the same logistic regression linear probe, alongside nonlinear classifiers and a gated-attention multiple-instance learning (MIL) comparator. items.authors: Nadine Huyen Nguyen, Kim Ngan Ly, Nguyen Quoc Khanh Le

items.title: Pan-Genome-Scale Metabolic Reconstruction Reveals Conserved Metabolic Functions in Candida albicans
items.title_zh: 酵母菌白色念珠菌的全基因组代谢重建及其保守代谢功能研究
items.summary_zh: 白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）是人类粘膜和侵袭性真菌感染的主要病因，但其种内基因组多样性与代谢变异之间的关系尚不清楚。本研究整合了80个公共C. albicans基因组组装、已发表的真菌基因组规模代谢模型（GEMs）、公共反应数据库及正交组关联的基因-蛋白-反应（GPR）证据，构建了物种级别的C. albicans全基因组代谢模型（pan-GEM），并通过基因组投影推导出80个特定菌株的代谢模型（ssGEMs）。全基因组包含10,308个正交组，其中4215个为核心组，5947个为附属组，146个为单例组。最终的pan-GEM包含1986个反应、1777种代谢物和865个基因。所有80个ssGEMs在可行性救援后均满足预测生长的可行性标准。通过营养边界模拟发现，增加D-葡萄糖摄取显著提高了79个可行ssGEMs的预测生长。这一框架为比较C. albicans菌株间的保守代谢功能和基因组投影反应差异提供了可重复使用的资源。
items.abstract: Candida albicans is a major cause of human mucosal and invasive fungal infections, but the relationship between its intraspecific genomic diversity and metabolic variation remains poorly understood. Here, we integrated 80 public C. albicans genome assemblies, published fungal genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs), public reaction databases, and orthogroup-linked gene–protein–reaction (GPR) evidence to construct a species-level C. albicans pan-GEM and derived 80 strain-specific GEMs (ssGEMs) through genome projection. The pan-genome comprised 10,308 orthogroups, including 4215 core, 5947 accessory, and 146 singleton orthogroups. The final pan-GEM contained 1986 reactions, 1777 metabolites, and 865 genes. After feasibility rescue, all 80 ssGEMs met the feasibility criterion for predicted growth and passed the closed-uptake energy-generating-cycle test. items.authors: Ya Meng, Yiming Zhang, Lei Zhang

items.title: Laboratory Markers Associated with Deep Neck Infection in Emergency Department Patients with Throat or Neck Symptoms
items.title_zh: 急诊科喉部或颈部症状患者深颈部感染的实验室标志物研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：深颈部感染（DNI）在急诊科评估中可能难以与局部上呼吸道疾病区分。我们评估了在2021年1月至2026年5月期间，1640名出现喉部或颈部症状的成人中常规可用的实验室标志物，并检查这些关联是否在影像学定义的亚组中得到重复。方法：主要结果为通过对比增强颈部CT、内窥镜/纤维镜评估或超声评估（如适用）确认的DNI。在包含人口统计学、症状、症状持续时间和初始生命体征的临床模型中，添加炎症实验室标志物后进行比较。结果：273名患者（16.6%）确认DNI。在1166个完整病例中，临床模型的10倍交叉验证AUC从0.644提高到0.788（ΔAUC，0.144；95% CI，0.109–0.179；似然比p 0.001）。在增强模型中，ANC（每5 × 10^9/L的aOR，1.49；95% CI，1.25–1.79）和CRP的相关性显著。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Deep neck infection (DNI) can be difficult to distinguish from localized upper aerodigestive disease during emergency department (ED) evaluation. We assessed routinely available laboratory markers in adults presenting with throat or neck symptoms and examined whether the associations were reproduced in an imaging-defined subgroup. Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort included 1640 adults with prespecified throat- or neck-related presentations between January 2021 and May 2026. The primary outcome was DNI confirmed using prespecified diagnostic evidence from contrast-enhanced neck CT, endoscopic/fibroscopic evaluation, or ultrasonographic evaluation with aspiration or drainage when applicable. A clinical model incorporating demographics, presenting symptoms, symptom duration, and initial vital signs was compared with the same model after addition of inflammatory laboratory markers. A secondary analysis was restricted to 662 patients who underwent contrast-enhanced neck CT. Results: DNI was confirmed in 273 patients (16.6%). items.title: Emerging Role, Molecular Mechanisms, and Therapeutic Potential of 2-O, 3-O Desulfated Heparin (ODSH) Across Inflammatory and Vascular Diseases
items.title_zh: 2-O、3-O去硫酸肝素在炎症与血管疾病中的新兴作用及治疗潜力
items.summary_zh: 糖胺聚糖（GAGs）是结构多样的多糖，通过特定的硫酸化模式和与阳离子蛋白的相互作用调节炎症、凝血和细胞稳态。2-O、3-O去硫酸肝素（ODSH）是一种化学修饰的肝素衍生物，其抗凝活性显著降低，但对关键炎症介质的亲和力得以保留。本文综述了ODSH的结构-功能关系、分子机制及其在炎症、血管和免疫介导疾病中的治疗应用。ODSH调节多种共同的致病过程，包括HMGB1-RAGE/TLR4信号通路、中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶介导的组织损伤、PF4依赖的血小板激活、选择素介导的粘附及凝血酶诱导的内皮通透性。这些作用源于直接的分子相互作用和对细胞外介质的间接隔离，整体上与细胞因子释放减少、内皮屏障稳定性增强及炎症-凝血交叉反应减弱相关。临床前研究报告了其在急性肺损伤、囊性纤维化、缺血-再灌注损伤、创伤性脑损伤、血小板减少症和转移性癌症中的保护作用。
items.abstract: Glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) are structurally diverse polysaccharides that regulate inflammation, coagulation, and cellular homeostasis through highly specific sulfation patterns and interactions with cationic proteins. Among GAG derivatives, 2-O, 3-O desulfated heparin (ODSH) is a chemically modified heparin derivative characterized by markedly reduced anticoagulant activity yet preserved affinity for key inflammatory mediators. This review summarizes current knowledge on ODSH structure–function relationships, molecular mechanisms, and therapeutic applications across inflammatory, vascular, and immune-mediated diseases. ODSH modulates several convergent pathogenic processes, including HMGB1-RAGE/TLR4 signaling, neutrophil elastase-mediated tissue injury, PF4-dependent platelet activation, selectin-mediated adhesion, and thrombin-induced endothelial permeability. These actions arise from both direct molecular interactions and indirect sequestration of extracellular mediators, collectively associated with reduced cytokine release, enhanced endothelial barrier stability, and attenuation of inflammation–coagulation crosstalk. items.title: Can Diagnostic Delay Amplify Drug Resistance in Tuberculosis? A Critical Integrative Reflection on Bacterial Adaptation, Persistence, Within-Host Evolution, and Heteroresistance
items.title_zh: 诊断延迟是否加剧结核病药物耐药性？
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：结核病中的药物耐药性仍然是全球疾病控制的主要挑战之一。传统上，其出现归因于治疗中断、依从性差和抗微生物药物施加的选择压力。然而，近期在细菌遗传学、宿主内进化、细胞持久性和异质耐药性方面的进展表明，相关生物过程可能在治疗开始前就已发展。本研究旨在探讨诊断延迟是否可能作为结核分枝杆菌药物耐药性相关适应和进化机制的放大因素。方法：在PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar中进行结构化文献检索。初步识别的86篇文献中，依据预设的纳入和排除标准选取了29项研究。通过概念收敛矩阵分析证据，将发现组织为五个分析类别：诊断延迟与程序性决定因素；耐药机制、细菌适应性与临床影响；持久性与药物耐受性；宿主内进化与遗传多样性；以及异质耐药性与耐药亚群体。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Drug resistance in tuberculosis remains one of the major challenges to global disease control. Traditionally, its emergence has been attributed to factors such as treatment interruption, poor adherence, and the selective pressure exerted by antimicrobial agents. However, recent advances in bacterial genetics, within-host evolution, cellular persistence, and heteroresistance suggest that relevant biological processes may develop before treatment initiation. The aim of this critical integrative reflection was to explore the biological plausibility that diagnostic delay may act as an amplifying factor for adaptive and evolutionary mechanisms potentially associated with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Methods: A structured documentary search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Of the 86 documents initially identified, 29 studies were selected using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. The evidence was analysed through a conceptual convergence matrix, which enabled the organisation of findings into five analytical categories: diagnostic delay and programmatic determinants; mechanisms of resistance, ba
items.authors: Ariel Torres, Paloma González, Gisselle Trujillo, Martha Fors

items.title: Platelet-Rich Plasma in Recurrent Pregnancy Loss: Toward a Precision Medicine Framework for Biologically Guided Patient Selection
items.title_zh: 富血小板血浆在复发性流产中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 复发性流产（RPL）是一种多因素的生殖医学疾病，影响约1-3%的夫妇。越来越多的证据表明，子宫内膜功能障碍、免疫失调、血管生成受损和氧化应激在其病理生理中起重要作用，亟需生物靶向治疗策略。在此背景下，富血小板血浆（PRP）作为一种再生治疗方法，可能调节这些潜在机制。本文对PRP作为RPL辅助治疗的生物学基础和当前临床证据进行了批判性评估，并提出了基于生物学的精准医学患者选择框架。文献综合分析集中于研究PRP在RPL及相关生殖疾病（如子宫内膜变薄和复发性植入失败）中的应用。PRP通过血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）介导的途径促进血管生成，刺激基质和上皮细胞增殖以增强子宫内膜再生，并通过促进调节性T细胞活性来调节免疫反应，同时减弱促炎信号。PRP衍生的细胞外囊泡（EVs）和微小RNA可能在转录后和表观遗传调控中发挥作用。
items.abstract: Recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL), a multifactorial condition in reproductive medicine, affects approximately 1–3% of couples. Increasing evidence implicates endometrial dysfunction, immune dysregulation, impaired angiogenesis, and oxidative stress (OS) in its pathophysiology, highlighting the need for biologically targeted therapeutic strategies. In this context, platelet-rich plasma (PRP) has emerged as a regenerative approach with the potential to modulate these underlying mechanisms. This narrative review critically evaluates the biological rationale and current clinical evidence supporting PRP as an adjunctive treatment for RPL while proposing a precision medicine framework for biologically guided patient selection. A comprehensive narrative synthesis of the literature was performed, focusing on studies investigating PRP in RPL and related reproductive conditions, including thin endometrium and recurrent implantation failure (RIF). Mechanistically, PRP promotes angiogenesis through vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)-mediated pathways, enhances endometrial regeneration by stimulating stromal and epithelial cell proliferation, and modulates immune responses by promoting regu

items.title: Routine Immediate Postoperative Chest Radiography After Minimally Invasive Pulmonary Lobectomy Has a Low Impact on Clinical Management: A Value-Based Imaging Analysis
items.title_zh: 微创肺叶切除术后常规胸片对临床管理影响小的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：尽管微创视频辅助胸腔镜手术（VATS）和术后增强恢复（ERAS）协议得到广泛应用，但在VATS肺叶切除术后，麻醉恢复室（PACU）常规胸片（CXR）仍然普遍。越来越多的证据质疑其在无症状患者中的临床效用。本研究旨在评估VATS肺叶切除术后PACU常规CXR的治疗收益。方法：本单中心回顾性队列研究纳入554例接受择期VATS肺叶切除术的患者（2014-2025年）。主要终点为PACU常规CXR的治疗收益，定义为直接导致术后管理变更的比例。结果：554例常规PACU CXR中，仅有12例（2.2%）导致管理变更；1例需再次手术，5例需重新插入胸管。相比之下，93例术后引流管拔除后的CXR（16.8%）导致变更（p 0.001）。最常见的异常发现为气胸（5.8%）、肺不张（4.5%）和胸腔积液（2.0%）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Despite the widespread adoption of minimally invasive video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) for pulmonary lobectomy and Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols, routine chest X-rays (CXRs) in the Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) after VATS pulmonary lobectomy remain common. Evidence questioning their clinical utility in asymptomatic patients is growing. This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic yield of routine PACU CXRs following VATS lobectomy, in a homogeneous cohort (PACU time point). Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 554 consecutive patients who underwent elective VATS lobectomy (2014–2025). The primary endpoint was the therapeutic yield of routine PACU CXRs, defined as the proportion directly leading to a documented change in postoperative management. Secondary outcomes included the yield of post-drain-removal CXRs, radiographic findings, and the yield in patients with intraoperative complications. Results: Among 554 routine PACU CXRs, only 12 (2.2%; 95% CI: 1.1–3.7) led to a management change; surgical re-intervention was required in 1 patient and chest tube reinsertion in 5 patients. items.title: G2/M Checkpoint Dependency in High-Grade Serous Tubo-Ovarian Carcinoma: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Implications
items.title_zh: 高分级浆液性输卵管卵巢癌的G2/M检查点依赖性及其治疗意义
items.summary_zh: 高分级浆液性癌（HGSC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，亟需新的治疗方案。在分子水平上，HGSC的特征是基因组不稳定性，包括几乎普遍的TP53突变、拷贝数改变和染色体碎裂，这些因素增加了复制压力。这些基本改变导致肿瘤细胞对G2/M检查点的生存依赖，揭示了该检查点作为潜在治疗靶点的可能性。本文讨论了正常细胞周期进程和检查点以及DNA复制的调控，并探讨了HGSC中的复制压力如何导致对G2/M检查点的依赖。我们还介绍了HGSC靶向治疗的现状，包括临床试验和生物标志物在患者选择中的作用。因此，靶向G2/M检查点具有合理的分子基础，可能为HGSC患者带来临床益处，但可能需要仔细选择患者并考虑治疗毒性。
items.abstract: High-grade serous carcinoma (HGSC) of tubo-ovarian origin is an aggressive malignancy in need of new treatment options. At the molecular level, HGSC is characterized by genomic instability, including nearly universal TP53 mutations, copy number alterations, and chromothripsis, which elevate replication stress. These fundamental alterations result in tumor cell dependence on the G2/M checkpoint for survival, thus revealing this checkpoint as a potential therapeutic target. In this review, we discuss the normal cell cycle progression and checkpoints as well as the regulation of DNA replication, and we consider how replication stress in HGSC leads to a dependence on the G2/M checkpoint. We then present information on the current state of targeted therapy development for HGSC including clinical trials and the role of biomarkers in optimal patient selection. Thus, targeting the G2/M checkpoint is driven by sound molecular rationale and may yield clinical benefit in patients with HGSC, but will likely require careful patient selection and consideration of treatment toxicities.
items.authors: Zhiyu Tian, Karen McLean

items.title: Functional Brain Connectivity Changes Following Vestibular Rehabilitation in Persistent Postural-Perceptual Dizziness: A Single-Case Resting-State fMRI Study
items.title_zh: 前庭康复对持续性姿势感知眩晕的功能脑连接影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：持续性姿势感知眩晕（PPPD）是一种慢性功能性前庭障碍，表现为持续性眩晕和不稳。静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）已发现PPPD患者在前庭、视觉、躯体感觉、空间认知和情感网络中的功能障碍。案例：一名37岁女性PPPD患者每6个月经历一次旋转性眩晕，随后出现持续性非旋转性眩晕。评估：基线评估显示其眩晕相关残疾严重（眩晕残疾清单（DHI）得分：66）及抑郁症状（自评抑郁量表（SDS）：40）。姿势图测量显示闭眼时的摇摆增加，而视频头冲击测试未见显著异常。进行了rs-fMRI，并使用SPM12和CONN工具箱进行功能连接分析。结果：经过8周的前庭康复治疗，DHI和SDS得分分别改善至16和27，姿势测量指标也有所改善。
items.abstract: Background: Persistent postural-perceptual dizziness (PPPD) is a chronic functional vestibular disorder characterized by persistent dizziness, and unsteadiness. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has identified dysfunction in vestibular, visual, somatosensory, spatial cognitive, and emotional networks in PPPD. Although vestibular rehabilitation has demonstrated efficacy in PPPD, its effects on these dysfunctional neural networks remain unclear. Case: A 37-year-old woman with PPPD had experienced recurrent rotational vertigo approximately every 6 months followed by persistent non-spinning dizziness. Assessment: Baseline assessment showed severe dizziness-related disability (Dizziness Handicap Inventory (DHI) score: 66) and depressive symptoms (Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS): 40). Posturography demonstrated increased sway with eyes-closed, whereas video head impulse testing revealed no significant abnormalities. Rs-fMRI was also performed, and functional connectivity was analyzed using SPM12 and the CONN toolbox with a region-of-interest-to-region-of-interest approach. items.authors: Katsuhiro Adachi, Satoshi Tanaka, Naoto Sakai

items.title: Delayed Imaging Response After Chemoradiotherapy in a Patient with Unresectable Brainstem Pilocytic Astrocytoma
items.title_zh: 化疗放疗后脑干毛细胞星形胶质瘤患者影像学反应延迟
items.summary_zh: 成人脑干胶质瘤（BSGs）是一种罕见的恶性中枢神经系统肿瘤，难以通过手术完全切除，因此化疗放疗（CRT）是主要治疗方式。然而，BSGs患者对CRT的反应存在显著个体差异。本文报告了一例41岁男性患者，因右侧肢体无力持续3个月就诊。脑MRI显示脑干内有一固体-囊性肿块，涉及延髓和颈髓，病理诊断为毛细胞星形胶质瘤，CNS WHO 1级。由于脑干内的固体-囊性肿块无法切除，患者接受了同步CRT，并随后进行替莫唑胺（TMZ）维持化疗。同步CRT后未观察到肿瘤大小的显著变化。值得注意的是，在放疗后15个月（自初次诊断起19个月），肿瘤大小显著减小。至最新随访时，患者维持部分缓解状态。
items.abstract: Adult brainstem gliomas (BSGs) are rare malignant tumors of the central nervous system (CNS) that are difficult to resect completely via surgery, so chemoradiotherapy (CRT) is the primary treatment modality. However, there is substantial interpatient variability in therapeutic response to CRT among patients with BSGs. Here we present a case of a 41-year-old man who had experienced right limb weakness for 3 months. Brain MRI showed a solid-cystic mass in the brainstem, involving the medulla oblongata and the cervical spinal cord. The pathological diagnosis was pilocytic astrocytoma, CNS WHO Grade 1. Since the solid-cystic mass in the brainstem was unresectable, the patient received concurrent CRT followed by temozolomide (TMZ) maintenance chemotherapy. No significant change in tumor size was observed after concurrent CRT. Notably, 15 months after radiotherapy (19 months since the initial diagnosis), the tumor size decreased significantly. Up to the latest follow-up, the patient has maintained sustained partial remission.
items.authors: Yan Shen, Chao Li, Fengbo Huang, Wei Qian, Bicheng Zhang, Ting Zhang

items.title: Virologic, Lipid, Renal and Hepatic Laboratory Outcomes After Switching to Doravirine/Lamivudine/Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate in Treatment-Experienced People with HIV: Real-World Evidence from the SHINe-SHIC Cohort
items.title_zh: HIV治疗经验者换用多拉韦/拉米夫定/替诺福韦的实验结果
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：多拉韦/拉米夫定/替诺福韦二吡呋酯（DOR/3TC/TDF）作为治疗经验者的换药方案，特别适用于需要简化治疗、改善脂质或避免药物相互作用的患者。本研究评估了在常规护理中，切换至DOR/3TC/TDF后48周的病毒学效果及实验室变化。方法：本多中心回顾性研究纳入了在意大利七个HIV中心的成人患者，他们在撒丁岛HIV网络-西西里HIV队列（SHINe-SHIC）中切换至固定剂量的DOR/3TC/TDF。切换访问作为基线；在24周和48周提取随访数据。主要终点为48周时HIV RNA 50拷贝/mL的比例。次要终点为脂质及其衍生参数、肾功能和肝脏实验室标志物的变化。结果：共纳入98名参与者，其中75名（76.5%）为男性，中位年龄为52.4岁。48周时，72/81名参与者（88.9%）的HIV RNA低于50拷贝/mL，78/81名（96.3%）低于200拷贝/mL。总胆固醇从199降至165 mg/dL（中位变化−22 mg/dL；p < 0.001），低密度脂蛋白胆固醇从118降至106.5 mg/dL（−13.5 mg/dL；p = 0.001），甘油三酯从112.5降至94 mg/dL（−10.5 mg/dL；p = 0.021）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Doravirine/lamivudine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (DOR/3TC/TDF) is used as a switch regimen in treatment-experienced people with HIV (PWH), particularly when simplification, lipid improvement, or avoidance of interaction-prone regimens is needed. We evaluated 48-week virologic effectiveness and laboratory changes after switching to DOR/3TC/TDF in routine care. Methods: This multicenter retrospective study included adults with HIV who switched to fixed-dose DOR/3TC/TDF at seven Italian HIV centers within the Sardinian HIV Network-Sicilian HIV Cohort (SHINe-SHIC) network. The switch visit served as baseline; follow-up data were extracted at 24 and 48 weeks. The primary endpoint was HIV RNA 50 copies/mL at 48 weeks in an observed analysis. Secondary endpoints were changes in lipid and lipid-derived parameters, renal function, and hepatic laboratory markers. Results: Ninety-eight participants were included; 75 (76.5%) were male, and the median age was 52.4 years. At 48 weeks, 72/81 participants (88.9%) had HIV RNA 50 copies/mL and 78/81 (96.3%) had HIV RNA 200 copies/mL. items.title: Incidental/Misdiagnosed Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma and Combined Hepatocellular-Cholangiocarcinoma in Patients Undergoing Living Donor Liver Transplantation
items.title_zh: 肝移植患者意外/误诊的肝内胆管癌与混合肝细胞-胆管癌研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：混合肝细胞-胆管癌和肝内胆管癌在肝硬化患者中越来越常见，传统上这些肿瘤类型并不被视为肝移植的适应症。本研究旨在呈现我们中心在肝移植后发现的意外肝内胆管癌的经验。方法：在985例活体肝移植中，261例最初被诊断为肝细胞癌。我们回顾性分析了人口学数据、术前影像学结果、病理结果及术后结果。根据Goodman分类对肿瘤进行分类。结果：在18例患者的切除标本病理中发现胆管癌。根据Goodman分类，5例（27%）为1型肿瘤；8例（44.4%）为2型肿瘤；5例（27.8%）为单纯胆管癌病变。6例患者（33.3%）出现肿瘤复发。平均生存时间为61.6 ± 12个月，平均无病生存期为10.67 ± 5.7个月。Goodman 1型、2型和单纯胆管癌的无病生存期分别为14.00 ± 5.57、8 ± 5.66和6.00 ± 0.00个月。1年和5年生存率分别为88%和55%。4例患者因胆管癌死亡，其余死亡原因包括脓毒症、COVID-19、肌萎缩侧索硬化症等。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Mixed hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) are increasingly reported in patients with cirrhosis. Traditionally, these tumor types have not been considered indications for liver transplantation. We aimed to present our single-center experience for incidental CCA following liver transplantation. Methods: Among the 985 living donor liver transplantations, 261 cases were initially diagnosed as hepatocellular carcinoma. We retrospectively reviewed demographic data, preoperative radiological findings, pathology results, and postoperative outcomes. We classified tumors according to the Goodman classification. Results: Cholangiocarcinoma was identified in the explant pathology of 18 patients. According to the Goodman classification, five patients (27%) had type 1 tumors; eight (44.4%) had type 2 tumors; and five (27.8%) had sole CCA lesions. Tumor recurrence occurred in six patients (33.3%). The mean survival time was 61.6 ± 12 months. The mean disease-free survival was 10.67 ± 5.7 months. items.title: Elevated White Blood Cell Counts Despite Normal C-Reactive Protein Independently Predict Metabolic Syndrome and Myocardial Infarction: Evidence for Genetic Susceptibility and Dietary Modification in a Prospective Cohort
items.title_zh: 正常C反应蛋白下白细胞增高独立预测代谢综合征与心肌梗死
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：白细胞（WBC）计数和C反应蛋白（CRP）是与心脏代谢疾病相关的炎症标志物。本研究旨在探讨在CRP正常情况下，WBC增高是否能预测代谢综合征（MetS）和心肌梗死（MI），并研究其遗传基础和饮食可调性。方法：本前瞻性队列研究纳入54,744名韩国成年人，平均随访五年。参与者根据基线WBC和CRP水平分为WBC仅增高组（WOE）和正常组（低风险）。采用Cox比例风险模型评估MetS和MI的发生风险。全基因组关联研究（GWAS）识别与WOE相关的遗传变异，并在英国生物库中进行复制。结果：与低风险组相比，WOE独立与MetS（HR = 1.82, 95% CI: 1.57–2.11）和MI（HR = 1.60, 95% CI: 1.25–2.04; 均p < 0.001）风险增加相关。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Elevated white blood cell (WBC) counts and C-reactive protein (CRP) are established inflammatory markers associated with cardiometabolic disease. However, whether elevated WBC remains prognostically important without CRP elevation is unclear. This study aimed to examine whether elevated WBC despite normal CRP would predict incident metabolic syndrome (MetS) and myocardial infarction (MI), and to investigate its genetic basis and dietary modifiability. Methods: This prospective cohort study included 54,744 Korean adults with a mean follow-up of five years. Participants were classified as WBC-Only Elevated (WOE; WBC ≥ 6.2 × 109/L and CRP 1.0 mg/dL) or normal WBC and CRP (Low Risk) at baseline. Cox proportional hazards models estimated risks of incident MetS and MI. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) identified genetic variants associated with WOE, from which weighted genetic risk scores (GRS) were constructed and replicated in the UK Biobank (n = 352,394). GRS–diet interactions were evaluated using a validated 106-item semi-quantitative food frequency questionnaire and 24 h dietary recalls. items.title: Clinical and Radiological Characteristics of Pediatric Skull Fractures and Their Association with Neurosurgical Intervention: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 儿童颅骨骨折的临床与影像学特征及其与神经外科干预的关系
items.summary_zh: 背景：创伤性脑损伤是儿童发病率的主要原因。本研究评估急诊科儿童颅骨骨折患者，以确定与神经外科干预相关的独立因素。方法：本单中心回顾性研究纳入了经确认的颅骨骨折病例。记录了人口统计学、创伤机制、神经状态、骨折特征及颅内损伤。使用Firth惩罚逻辑回归分析与手术相关的因素。结果：平均年龄为4.47岁，跌倒是最常见的创伤机制（63.9%）。气脑和颅内出血各占24.8%。共有12名患者（9.0%）需要神经外科干预。在单变量分析中，凹陷骨折、粉碎性骨折、气脑和颅内出血与干预显著相关。在多变量模型中，年龄、颅内出血和凹陷骨折保持统计学显著性（p = 0.017, p = 0.022, p = 0.013）。结论：颅内出血与神经外科干预的独立统计关联最强。尽管凹陷骨折、粉碎性骨折和气脑在单变量分析中与手术相关，但其...
items.abstract: Background: Traumatic brain injury is a major cause of morbidity in children. This study evaluates pediatric patients with skull fractures in the emergency department to determine independent factors associated with neurosurgical intervention. Methods: This single-center retrospective study included 133 patients under 18 years old with CT-confirmed skull fractures following head trauma. Demographics, trauma mechanisms, neurological status, fracture characteristics, and intracranial injuries were recorded. Firth penalized logistic regression examined factors associated with surgery. Results: The mean age was 4.47 years, and falls were the most common trauma mechanism (63.9%). Pneumocephalus and intracranial hemorrhage were each present in 24.8% of patients. In total, 12 patients (9.0%) required neurosurgical intervention. In univariate analyses, depressed fractures, comminuted fractures, pneumocephalus, and intracranial hemorrhage were strongly associated with intervention. In the multivariable model, age, intracranial hemorrhage and depressed fracture were the factors retaining statistical significance (p = 0.017, p = 0.022, p = 0.013). items.title: Machine Learning-Based Investigation of Factors Influencing Recurrence of Colorectal Adenomatous Polyps: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的结直肠腺瘤复发影响因素研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：结直肠腺瘤是结直肠癌的公认前驱病变。接受内镜下息肉切除术的患者仍面临高复发风险，个体化风险分层在临床实践中仍具挑战性。研究旨在识别腺瘤复发的独立风险因素，并比较八种机器学习预测模型的性能。方法：本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入769名接受结肠镜息肉切除术并完成至少一次随访结肠镜检查的患者。采用非随机分组法构建训练队列（n=539）和独立内部测试队列（n=230）。通过单变量和多变量Cox比例风险回归分析识别复发的独立预测因子。构建八种机器学习模型并综合评估其区分性能、校准度和临床净收益。结果：异常高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL-C）、较高的基线息肉数量和较大的总息肉体积是独立风险因素。
items.abstract: Objectives: Colorectal adenomatous polyps are well-recognized precancerous lesions of colorectal cancer. Patients who undergo endoscopic polypectomy still face a high risk of polyp recurrence, and individualized risk stratification remains challenging in routine clinical practice. Dyslipidemia has been implicated in adenoma development, but its role in recurrence and the predictive value of machine learning tools are understudied in Chinese populations. This study aimed to identify independent risk factors for adenoma recurrence and compare the performance of eight machine learning prediction models. Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 769 patients who underwent colonoscopic polypectomy and completed at least one surveillance colonoscopy. A non-random site-based split was used to derive a training cohort (n = 539, Endoscopy Center) and an independent internal test cohort (n = 230, Colorectal Center). Univariate and multivariate Cox proportional hazards regression were applied to identify independent predictors of recurrence. items.title: Biomarkers in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma: From Biological Association to Clinical Decision-Making
items.title_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌中的生物标志物：从生物关联到临床决策
items.summary_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）的治疗选择迅速增加，包括辅助性帕博利珠单抗、HIF-2α靶向治疗以及多种有效的一线联合疗法。然而，治疗选择仍主要依赖于临床病理特征。本文评估了三个临床决策点的生物标志物：不确定肾肿块的特征化；肾切除术后复发风险评估及辅助治疗选择；以及转移性ccRCC的一线方案选择。DNA甲基化分类器和碳酸酐酶IX靶向的[89Zr]Zr-girentuximab PET/CT可以改善特定肾肿瘤的特征化，但在常规实践中无法替代组织病理学。肾切除术后，升高的血浆肾损伤分子-1（KIM-1）和可检测的循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）可识别高复发风险患者；然而，肿瘤释放量低限制了ctDNA的灵敏度，因此阴性结果并不能排除分子残留病或证明辅助治疗的减量；这两种生物标志物均未得到验证以指导监测、辅助治疗或治疗升级。在转移性ccRCC中，PD-L1表达、肿瘤突变负担和个体基因组改变并不能可靠地区分应接受双重免疫检查点抑制的患者与应接受免疫检查点抑制剂加V的患者。
items.abstract: Therapeutic options in renal cell carcinoma (RCC) have expanded rapidly, including adjuvant pembrolizumab, HIF-2α-directed therapy, and multiple effective first-line combinations for metastatic clear-cell RCC (ccRCC), yet treatment selection remains largely clinicopathologic. This review evaluates biomarkers at three clinical decision points: characterization of an indeterminate renal mass; recurrence-risk assessment and adjuvant treatment selection after nephrectomy; and first-line regimen selection in metastatic ccRCC. DNA-methylation classifiers and carbonic anhydrase IX-targeted [89Zr]Zr-girentuximab PET/CT can improve characterization of selected renal tumors, but neither replaces histopathology in routine practice. After nephrectomy, elevated plasma kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1) and detectable circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) identify patients at higher risk of recurrence; however, low tumor shedding limits ctDNA sensitivity, so a negative result does not exclude molecular residual disease or justify adjuvant de-escalation; neither biomarker is validated to direct surveillance, adjuvant therapy, or treatment escalation. items.title: Association Between Acute-Phase Occupational Therapy and Quality of Life at Hospital Discharge and 90 Days After Discharge
items.title_zh: 急性期职业治疗与出院及90天后生活质量的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：早期康复在重症患者中与改善身体结果相关。然而，职业治疗与生活质量（QOL）之间的关联证据仍有限。本研究探讨急性期职业治疗与生活质量的关系。方法：数据来源于多中心前瞻性EMPICS研究，纳入在重症监护病房（ICU）住院至少48小时的患者。使用EuroQol 5维度5级（EQ-5D-5L）评估出院时及出院后90天的生活质量。采用逆概率治疗加权分析职业治疗与EQ-5D-5L结果的关联。结果：共纳入178名患者（物理治疗组，n = 138；物理加职业治疗组，n = 40）。职业治疗与出院时更有利的EQ-5D-5L指数评分独立相关（B = 0.13，95% CI：0.02–0.24；p = 0.02）。在ICU期间开始职业治疗的患者出院时的EQ-5D-5L指数评分显著优于出院后开始治疗的患者（B = 0.22，95% CI：0.07–0.36；p < 0.01）。结论：急性期职业治疗，特别是在ICU期间开始的治疗，与出院时的生活质量改善相关，但在90天后未见明显关联。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Early rehabilitation in critically ill patients has been associated with improved physical outcomes. However, evidence regarding the association between occupational therapy and quality of life (QOL) remains limited. This study examined the association between acute-phase occupational therapy and QOL. Methods: Data were obtained from the multicenter prospective EMPICS study. Patients who remained in the intensive care unit (ICU) for at least 48 h were included. QOL was assessed using the EuroQol 5-Dimensions 5-Levels (EQ-5D-5L) at hospital discharge and 90 days after discharge. Inverse probability of treatment weighting analyses examined the associations between occupational therapy and EQ-5D-5L outcomes. Results: A total of 178 patients were included (physical therapy group, n = 138; physical plus occupational therapy group, n = 40). Occupational therapy was independently associated with a more favorable EQ-5D-5L index score at hospital discharge (B = 0.13, 95% CI: 0.02–0.24; p = 0.02). items.title: Lipids regulate export of lysosomal enzymes from the endoplasmic reticulum
items.title_zh: 脂质调控溶酶体酶从内质网的输出
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了脂质在细胞内蛋白质运输中的作用，特别是溶酶体酶的输出。我们发现，抑制脂肪酸合成会干扰溶酶体酶的正常转运，影响细胞内稳态。通过实验，我们观察到在脂肪酸合成被抑制的情况下，溶酶体酶的分泌显著减少。这一发现揭示了细胞代谢如何调控内质网与溶酶体之间的蛋白质运输，为理解细胞内蛋白质运输机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: How a team of AIs discovered a promising lung-cancer drug
items.title_zh: 一组人工智能发现有前景的肺癌药物
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月17日，研究人员开发了一个由多达37,000个智能体组成的“虚拟生物技术”，这些智能体向一位“首席科学家”汇报。该团队通过模拟和分析大量化合物，筛选出具有潜力的肺癌药物。研究表明，这种方法能够显著加速药物发现过程，并提高候选药物的成功率。这一创新的虚拟平台为未来的药物研发提供了新的思路，可能会改变传统的药物发现模式。

items.title: Longitudinal Anti-HBs Monitoring and Seroprotection Patterns in Rituximab-Treated Patients with Pemphigus Vulgaris: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 利妥昔单抗治疗大疱性皮肤病患者抗HBs监测研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究回顾性分析了2010至2026年间84名接受利妥昔单抗治疗的大疱性皮肤病患者的抗HBs水平及其保护性抗体变化。研究发现，基线抗HBs中位水平为49.7 IU/L，34名患者（40.5%）抗HBs水平低于10 IU/L。通过线性混合效应模型分析，时间与抗HBs水平显著相关（p = 0.002），在第6个月、第9个月和第18个月的抗HBs水平均低于基线（几何均值比[GMR]分别为0.61、0.64和0.50）。然而，时间与抗HBs≥10 IU/L的几率无显著关联（全球p = 0.490）。本研究提示利妥昔单抗可能影响大疱性皮肤病患者的抗HBs水平，需进一步关注其长期免疫保护。
items.abstract: Rituximab induces prolonged B-cell depletion and may alter protective antibody levels, but longitudinal antibody to hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs) patterns in pemphigus vulgaris remain poorly characterized. This study evaluated anti-HBs levels and seroprotection after rituximab and explored associated factors. Methods: This retrospective cohort included 84 patients with pemphigus vulgaris treated with rituximab between 2010 and 2026 who had baseline and post-treatment anti-HBs measurements. Longitudinal changes in log-transformed anti-HBs levels were analyzed using a linear mixed-effects model with categorical time and a patient-specific random intercept. The probability of anti-HBs 10 IU/L was assessed using a binomial generalized estimating equation model. Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were performed as sensitivity analyses. Results: The median baseline anti-HBs level was 49.7 IU/L, and 34 patients (40.5%) had levels 10 IU/L. Time was associated with longitudinal anti-HBs levels overall (p = 0.002). items.title: Quantitative Navigated Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Motor Mapping and nTMS-Guided Corticospinal Tractography in Healthy Individuals and Patients with Motor-Eloquent Brain Tumors
items.title_zh: 定量导航经颅磁刺激运动定位及其在脑肿瘤患者中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：导航经颅磁刺激（nTMS）用于术前运动定位，nTMS引导的扩散张量成像（DTI）描绘皮质脊髓束（CST）。本研究比较健康个体与运动功能相关脑肿瘤患者之间的皮层和束成像指标。方法：20名健康志愿者和18名患者在110%静息运动阈值（rMT）下进行第一背侧间肌（FDI）定位。分析运动图谱指标、最大FDI运动诱发电位（MEP）幅度及nTMS引导的CST指标；在共同空间评估热点和重心（CoG）分散。DTI指标在13名健康志愿者和13名患者中可用。结果：与以往nTMS文献一致，患者表现出运动功能受损和超阈值皮质脊髓输出，握力、最大FDI MEP幅度及图谱体积均低于对照组。rMT无显著差异，表明尽管运动系统功能障碍，阈值兴奋性可能并不显著。值得注意的是，对侧患者半球在握力、最大FDI MEP幅度、重建的CST纤维长度和平均轴向扩散率上也与对照组存在差异，而同侧和对侧患者半球之间这些指标无显著差异。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Navigated transcranial magnetic stimulation (nTMS) enables presurgical motor mapping, while nTMS-seeded diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) delineates the corticospinal tract (CST). We compared cortical and tractography measures between healthy individuals and patients with motor-eloquent brain tumors and between patient hemispheres. Methods: Twenty healthy volunteers and 18 patients underwent first dorsal interosseous (FDI) mapping at 110% resting motor threshold (rMT). Motor map metrics, maximum FDI motor-evoked potential (MEP) amplitude, and nTMS-seeded CST measures were analyzed; hotspot and center-of-gravity (CoG) dispersion were assessed in common space. DTI metrics were available for 13 healthy volunteers and 13 patients. Results: Consistent with previous nTMS literature, patients showed impaired motor performance and suprathreshold corticospinal output, with lower grip strength, maximum FDI MEP amplitude, and map volume than controls. rMT did not differ significantly, indicating that threshold excitability may be unrevealing despite motor system dysfunction. items.title: Prime Editing for Precision Genetic Medicine: A Systematic Review of Technologies, Delivery, and Therapeutic Applications
items.title_zh: 精准基因医学中的Prime Editing技术系统评述
items.summary_zh: 背景：Prime editing作为一种基于CRISPR的“搜索与替换”方法，迅速发展为多样化的基因组编辑技术。本文系统评述了prime editing的技术演变，重点关注编辑器架构、引导RNA工程、传递方式、治疗应用、计算方法及新兴能力。方法：通过PubMed和Web of Science系统检索prime editing相关的实验、技术、计算、传递或治疗研究。经去重和筛选后，候选研究根据预设的合格标准进行手动复审。排除了综述、修正、植物和细菌研究、无实质性prime editing成分的常规CRISPR或碱基编辑研究及其他不相关记录。最终纳入294项研究。由于编辑器架构、靶点、实验模型、结果和报告的显著异质性，文献采用系统映射和定性主题分析进行综合，而非元分析。结果：证据表明，从原始的Cas9 nickase–逆转录酶–prime editing引导RNA架构迅速多样化。
items.abstract: Background: Prime editing has rapidly evolved from a CRISPR-based “search-and-replace” approach for precise sequence modification into a diverse family of genome editing technologies. This systematic review maps the technological evolution of prime editing, with emphasis on editor architecture, guide RNA engineering, delivery, therapeutic applications, computational approaches, and emerging capabilities. Methods: PubMed and Web of Science were systematically searched for studies in which prime editing constituted a substantive experimental, technological, computational, delivery, or therapeutic component. After deduplication and screening, candidate studies underwent manual re-screening against prespecified eligibility criteria. Reviews, corrections, plant and bacterial studies, conventional CRISPR or base editing studies without a substantive prime editing component, and other non-relevant records were excluded. A total of 294 studies were included in the final systematic evidence synthesis. items.title: Non-Systemic Oral Cellulose-Based Superabsorbent Hydrogels for Weight Management: Potential Drug-Device Interactions Estimated by a Simplified In Vitro Assay
items.title_zh: 非系统性口服纤维素基超吸水水凝胶在体重管理中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：近期开发了一种非系统性口服纤维素基超吸水水凝胶（CB-SAHs）技术平台，作为治疗肥胖的新型疗法。进一步临床应用需评估其对共同给药药物吸收的潜在影响。方法：本研究开发了一种简化的体外检测方法，以评估CB-SAHs与共同给药药物的相互作用程度。选择了两种不同的CB-SAHs，并在模拟胃肠道条件下与多种溶解药物接触进行测试。共选择23种药物，主要用于治疗与超重相关的常见疾病（如2型糖尿病）或满足常见治疗需求（如止痛）。通过紫外-可见光光谱法量化模拟肠道介质中的最终药物回收率（FDR），以评估药物-水凝胶相互作用。结果：大多数药物在两种水凝胶中平均FDR超过80%，但六种化合物在至少一种CB-SAH中FDR较低（约68-78%），表明存在更强的特定药物-水凝胶相互作用。值得注意的是，二甲双胍在两种CB-SAH中的FDR约为94%，与之前的临床研究结果一致，表明二甲双胍与CB-SAH的相互作用微乎其微。结论：本研究为CB-SAHs在体重管理中的应用提供了初步的药物相互作用评估。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: A technological platform of non-systemic oral cellulose-based superabsorbent hydrogels (CB-SAHs) has been recently developed as novel therapeutics for treating obesity. Further clinical advancement of CB-SAH candidates from this platform requires evaluating their potential impact on the absorption of co-administered drugs. Methods: In this work, we developed a simplified in vitro assay to assess whether and to what extent given CB-SAHs may interact with co-administered drugs. We selected two different CB-SAHs and tested them in contact with various solubilized drug substances under simulated gastrointestinal conditions. A total of 23 drugs were chosen among those that could be used to treat frequent conditions associated with excess weight (e.g., type 2 diabetes) or to deal with common therapeutic needs (e.g., pain relief). Final drug recovery (FDR) in the simulated intestinal medium was quantified using UV-Vis spectroscopy to assess drug–hydrogel interactions. items.title: Retzius-Sparing Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy: Analysis of Functional and Oncological Outcomes
items.title_zh: 保留Retzius结构的机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：保留Retzius结构的机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术（RS-RARP）作为一种新兴的手术方法，旨在保护与尿失禁相关的盆腔解剖结构。本研究旨在评估RS-RARP在临床局限性前列腺癌患者中的围手术期、病理、功能及早期术后肿瘤学结果。材料与方法：本回顾性单队列研究纳入2017年1月至2020年2月在单一机构接受RS-RARP的132例连续患者，回顾性收集人口统计学、围手术期、病理、功能及术后肿瘤学数据。主要功能结果为术后尿失禁恢复情况。病理结果包括最终ISUP分级和阳性切缘状态，同时评估术后前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）测量及相关肿瘤学随访数据。结果：中位手术时间为170分钟（四分位数范围160-200），中位估计失血量为100毫升（四分位数范围70-150）。1例患者（0.8%）需要输血，未观察到Clavien-Dindo等级≥III的并发症。最终病理检查显示64.9%的患者为ISUP分级2疾病，整体阳性切缘率...
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Retzius-sparing robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RS-RARP) has emerged as an alternative surgical approach designed to preserve pelvic anatomical structures involved in urinary continence. This study aimed to evaluate the perioperative, pathological, functional, and early postoperative oncological findings of RS-RARP in patients with clinically localized prostate cancer. Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-cohort study included 132 consecutive patients who underwent RS-RARP at a single institution between January 2017 and February 2020. Demographic, perioperative, pathological, functional, and postoperative oncological data were retrospectively collected. The primary functional outcome was postoperative urinary continence recovery. Pathological outcomes included final ISUP Grade Group and positive surgical margin status, while postoperative prostate-specific antigen (PSA) measurements and treatment-related oncological follow-up data were evaluated where available. items.title: SuboptimalDietaryPatterns and Estimated Cardiovascular Disease Mortality Burden in China: A Repeated Cross-Sectional Comparative Risk Assessment
items.title_zh: 亚最佳饮食模式与中国心血管疾病死亡负担研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：亚最佳饮食是中国心血管疾病（CVD）死亡的重要可修改因素，省际饮食质量差异可能导致CVD负担的地理差异。本研究旨在量化浙江省因亚最佳饮食因素导致的CVD死亡的时间趋势，并评估在反事实的江南饮食模式下，河南省CVD死亡的潜在减少。方法：本重复横断面研究使用了2008至2024年间浙江省多轮基于人群的营养监测数据，并结合2015年河南省的比较数据，共纳入56,018名成年人。通过3天24小时饮食回顾和家庭调料称重评估饮食摄入，评估了包括水果、蔬菜、水产品、坚果、全谷物、红肉、加工肉、含糖饮料、调料盐和Omega-3脂肪酸在内的十个饮食因素。根据城乡人口分布标准化亚最佳饮食暴露的流行率，估算与个别及组合饮食因素相关的CVD死亡的群体归因分数（PAFs）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Suboptimal diet is a major modifiable contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality in China, and provincial disparities in dietary quality may contribute to geographic variation in CVD burden. This study aimed to quantify temporal trends in CVD mortality attributable to suboptimal dietary factors in Zhejiang Province and evaluate the potential reduction in CVD deaths in Henan Province under a counterfactual Jiangnan dietary pattern. Methods: This repeated cross-sectional study used data from multiple rounds of population-based nutrition surveillance conducted in Zhejiang Province between 2008 and 2024, with additional comparative data from Henan Province in 2015. A total of 56,018 adults were included. Dietary intake was assessed using 3-day 24-h dietary recalls combined with household condiment weighing. Ten dietary factors were evaluated, including fruits, vegetables, aquatic products, nuts, whole grains, red meat, processed meat, sugar-sweetened beverages, condiment salt, and omega-3 fatty acids. items.title: Temporal Trends and Epidemiological Patterns of Clinically Relevant Microorganisms in a Burn Unit: An 11-Year Retrospective Study from a Tertiary Hospital in Southern Brazil
items.title_zh: 烧伤病房临床相关微生物的时间趋势与流行病学模式研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：烧伤患者因皮肤屏障破坏、住院时间长、免疫失衡及频繁侵入性操作而易受微生物定植和医疗相关微生物影响。本研究旨在描述2014年至2024年间，巴西一家三级医院烧伤病房患者分离的临床相关微生物的流行病学特征和时间趋势。方法：本回顾性观察研究分析了烧伤患者的微生物记录，仅包括每位患者的首次分离物、临床事件和标本类型。微生物按分类、组别和标本来源进行分类。使用基于回归的计数模型和非参数检验评估时间趋势，采用流行病学排名、帕累托分布和热图分析识别主导分类和分布变化。结果：共分析了6769个临床相关微生物分离物。革兰氏阴性菌占主导（60.6%），其次为革兰氏阳性菌（28.9%）和真菌（10.5%）。最常见的分类为不动杆菌属（17.3%）、凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌（13.7%）和假单胞菌属（12.6%）。八个分类占所有分离物的79.5%，显示出高度集中化的微生物特征。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Burn patients are particularly vulnerable to microbial colonization and healthcare-associated microorganisms due to extensive skin barrier disruption, prolonged hospitalization, immune imbalance, and frequent invasive procedures. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological profile and temporal trends of clinically relevant microorganisms isolated from patients admitted to a burn unit over an 11-year period. Methods: This retrospective observational study analyzed microbiological records from burn patients at a Brazilian tertiary hospital (2014–2024), including only the first isolate per patient, clinical episode, and specimen type. Microorganisms were categorized by taxon, group, and specimen sources. Temporal trends were evaluated using regression-based count models and nonparametric tests, while dominant taxa and distribution shifts were identified via epidemiological ranking, Pareto distribution, and heatmap analyses. Results: A total of 6769 clinically relevant microbial isolates were analyzed. Gram-negative bacteria predominated (60.6%), followed by Gram-positive bacteria (28.9%) and fungi (10.5%). items.title: Mitochondrial Modulation as a Therapeutic Entry Point in Neurodegeneration
items.title_zh: 线粒体调节在神经退行性疾病中的治疗潜力
items.summary_zh: 线粒体功能障碍是神经退行性疾病的一个反复出现但依赖于具体情境的特征，其在致病级联中的位置在不同疾病间存在根本差异。本文综述认为，这种异质性而非线粒体生物学本身决定了治疗的可行性。我们综合了线粒体对神经元发育、细胞器质量控制、氧化还原信号传导和神经炎症的调节证据；探讨了临床应用受限于疾病特异性不足、方法学异质性和纵向验证不足的氧化生物标志物；以及从抗氧化剂和NAD+增强到线粒体基因组工程、靶向递送和细胞器转移的治疗策略。在这些领域中出现了一种一致的模式：广泛作用的干预在散发性疾病中反复失败，而最强的转化信号则出现在线粒体功能障碍与遗传因素紧密相关的情况下。因此，线粒体调节不太可能提供普遍的疾病修饰策略，但对于通过遗传或特定生物标志物识别的患者群体仍然是有用的、经过仔细针对的补充。
items.abstract: Mitochondrial dysfunction is a recurrent but context-dependent feature of neurodegenerative disease, and its position in the pathogenic cascade differs fundamentally between disorders. This narrative review argues that this heterogeneity, rather than mitochondrial biology itself, determines therapeutic tractability. We synthesize evidence on mitochondrial regulation of neuronal development, organelle quality control, redox signaling and neuroinflammation; on oxidative biomarkers, whose clinical use remains constrained by limited disease specificity, methodological heterogeneity and insufficient longitudinal validation; and on therapeutic strategies ranging from antioxidants and NAD+ augmentation to mitochondrial genome engineering, targeted delivery and organelle transfer. A consistent pattern emerges across these domains: broadly acting interventions have repeatedly failed in sporadic disease, whereas the strongest translational signals arise where mitochondrial dysfunction is genetically anchored and pathway-proximal. items.authors: Mateusz Mamala, Izabela Skowron, Karolina Marczuk, Arkadiusz Bujas, Jolanta Harasiuk, Julita Kulbacka

items.title: Application of Shear Wave Elastography in Assessing Peripheral Neuropathy in Parkinson’s Disease
items.title_zh: 剪切波弹性成像在帕金森病外周神经病变评估中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：帕金森病（PD）是一种常见的神经退行性疾病，其合并的外周神经病变（PN）严重影响患者预后。神经电生理检查作为诊断金标准存在侵入性等重要局限。本研究旨在探讨高频超声结合剪切波弹性成像（SWE）在PD相关PN中的诊断价值。方法：在30名PD患者中验证了超声参数（横截面积[CSA]、剪切波速度[SWV]）的观察者内外 reproducibility。对40名PD患者（通过电生理金标准分为PD单独组和PD-PN组）和40名健康对照进行病例对照研究。通过相关分析、逻辑回归和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析评估诊断效能。结果：所有测量参数显示良好的重现性（组内相关系数[ICC] 0.855）。经年龄调整后，控制组、PD单独组和PD-PN组的正中神经纵向SWV和腓总神经SWV逐渐增加（p 0.001），并与正中神经运动传导潜伏期呈弱到中等的统计显著相关。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder, and its comorbid peripheral neuropathy (PN) severely worsens patient prognosis. The diagnostic gold standard, nerve electrophysiological examination, has critical limitations, including invasiveness. This study aimed to explore the diagnostic value of high-frequency ultrasound combined with shear wave elastography (SWE) for PD-associated PN. Methods: Intra- and inter-observer reproducibility of ultrasound parameters (cross-sectional area [CSA], shear wave velocity [SWV]) of the median and common peroneal nerves was validated in 30 PD patients. A case–control study was conducted in 40 PD patients (stratified into PD-alone and PD-PN groups via the electrophysiological gold standard) and 40 healthy controls. Correlation analysis, logistic regression, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis were performed to assess diagnostic efficacy. Results: All measured parameters showed good reproducibility (intraclass correlation coefficient [ICC] 0.855). items.title: Phragmites Communis (Lu Gen) Alleviates Hyperuricemia via Xanthine Oxidase Inhibition and Gut-Microbiota-Mediated Metabolite Urate Transporter Regulation
items.title_zh: 芦苇根通过抑制黄嘌呤氧化酶缓解高尿酸血症
items.summary_zh: 背景：高尿酸血症（HU）由尿酸（UA）过量产生或排泄障碍引起，常与痛风和肾功能障碍相关。肠道微生物失调可能影响肠道UA排泄，破坏肠道屏障并促进炎症。传统中医药（TCM）可能为HU提供治疗策略。本研究探讨了清热利尿的中药芦苇根是否通过抑制黄嘌呤氧化酶（XOD）和调节尿酸转运体表达来缓解HU。方法：采用体外和体内模型，结合分子分析、16S rRNA测序和代谢组学分析。结果：芦苇根显著降低血清尿酸（SUA）水平，抑制XOD，改善肾脏和肠道尿酸排泄，伴随肾脏SLC2A9表达降低和肠道ABCG2表达增强，恢复肠道屏障完整性，抑制炎症。微生物分析显示Ligilactobacillus、Prevotella和Dubosiella的富集。粪便代谢组学识别了马尿酸。
items.abstract: Background: Hyperuricemia (HU) results from excessive uric acid (UA) production/impaired excretion and is associated with gout and renal dysfunction. Gut microbiota dysbiosis may impair intestinal UA excretion, disrupt the gut barrier, and promote inflammation. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), with multitarget and microbiota-modulating effects, may offer a therapeutic strategy for HU. In this study, the rhizome of Phragmites communis, a TCM used for clearing heat and promoting diuresis, was investigated. Specifically, we evaluated whether P. communis could alleviate HU by suppressing xanthine oxidase (XOD) and modulating urate transporter expression, thereby reducing UA production while promoting its excretion. Method: The effects of a crude extract of P. communis were investigated with in vitro and in vivo models using molecular, 16S rRNA sequencing, and metabolomic analyses. Results: P. communis significantly decreased serum uric acid (SUA) levels by inhibiting XOD and improving renal and intestinal urate excretion, accompanied by decreased renal and increased intestinal solute carrier family 2 member 9 (SLC2A9) and enhanced ATP-binding cassette subfamily G member 2 (ABCG2) ex
items.authors: Aamir Saleem, Bushra Walayat, Qidi Xue, Immad Ansari, Xiaoqing Wei, Ming Li

items.title: Avoiding common failures in AI for health and medicine
items.title_zh: 避免医疗健康领域人工智能的常见失误
items.summary_zh: Salaudeen等人回顾了医疗保健领域预测性和生成性人工智能中的常见可靠性失误，包括错误的模型输出、临床上不合理的性能差异以及部署时的性能下降。他们分析了现有技术解决方案的不足之处，并主张在评估过程中应关注生命周期、进行持续监测以及加强机构治理。
items.abstract: Salaudeen et al. review common reliability failures in predictive and generative AI for healthcare, including erroneous model outputs, clinically unjustified performance differences, and deployment-time degradation. They examine why existing technical solutions fall short and argue for lifecycle-aware evaluation, continuous monitoring, and institutional governance.
items.authors: Olawale Salaudeen, Haoran Zhang, Eileen Kim, Karandeep Singh, Marzyeh Ghassemi

items.title: An open benchmark and language models for AI in aging biology
items.title_zh: 老龄生物学中的AI开放基准与语言模型
items.summary_zh: LongevityBench、Longevity-LLMs和Longevity Claw评估了当前最先进的人工智能系统在推动老龄研究方面的准备情况。研究对象为老龄生物学领域的AI应用，采用开放基准测试方法，旨在衡量AI系统在相关任务中的表现。通过对比不同模型的性能，研究发现现有AI系统在处理老龄相关数据和任务时仍存在一定的局限性。结论指出，尽管AI技术在老龄生物学研究中展现出潜力，但仍需进一步优化和调整，以更好地支持该领域的研究进展。
items.abstract: LongevityBench, Longevity-LLMs, and Longevity Claw evaluate the readiness of the state-of-the-art AI systems for spearheading aging research.
items.authors: Alex Zhavoronkov, Vladimir Naumov, Denis Sidorenko, Alex Aliper, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Ramin Hasani, Alexander Amini, Katerina Nasto, Mathieu Reymond, Rim Shayakhmetov, Zulfat Miftakhutdinov, Vadim N.

items.title: Gene conversion is a key driver of diversity hotspots in M. tuberculosis antigens and virulence-associated loci
items.title_zh: 基因转换驱动结核分枝杆菌抗原多样性热点
items.summary_zh: 尽管结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）长期以来被视为遗传上保守的病原体，但许多基因组区域因序列同源性高和重复内容而解析不清。我们利用151个全球代表性临床分离株的长读长测序生成的完整基因组组装，全面分析了Mtb基因组的遗传多样性和进化模式。分析发现，基因转换导致同源基因之间的重复区域内存在显著的多样性热点，这些热点的遗传多样性比Mtb基因组其他部分高出一个数量级以上。该区域的突变表现出聚集的替代模式、过量的同源匹配变异和与持续基因转换一致的突变谱。我们识别出300多个基因转换事件，主要分布在与毒力和宿主-病原体相互作用相关的基因家族中，包括PE、PPE和ESX家族。多个显著的多样性热点出现在编码于同源区域的抗原中，其中疫苗候选者PPE18包含已验证表位的突变。
items.abstract: Despite the long-held view of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) as a genetically conserved pathogen, many genomic regions remain poorly resolved due to high sequence homology and repetitive content. Using complete genome assemblies generated from long-read sequencing of 151 globally representative clinical isolates, we comprehensively analyzed genome-wide patterns of genetic diversity and evolution across the Mtb genome. Our analysis uncovers pronounced diversity hotspots within paralogous regions generated by recurrent gene conversion between homologous genes. In many cases, these hotspots exhibit more than an order of magnitude greater genetic diversity than the rest of the Mtb genome, which is otherwise characterized by remarkably low variation. Mutations within these regions display clustered substitution patterns, excess paralog-matching variants, and distinct mutational spectra consistent with ongoing gene conversion. Our analysis identifies over 300 individual gene conversion events distributed throughout the Mtb phylogeny. items.title: CDK4 or CDK6 upregulation induces DNA replication stress and genomic instability to cause EGFR targeted therapy resistance in lung cancer
items.title_zh: CDK4或CDK6上调导致肺癌EGFR靶向治疗耐药
items.summary_zh: 表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变的肺腺癌（LUAD）具有复杂的遗传共变异和潜在的致癌相互作用。其中，细胞周期调控基因CDK4和CDK6的重复扩增与EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKIs）耐药性相关。研究表明，CDK4或CDK6过表达限制了EGFR抑制剂诱导的增殖停滞，促进细胞周期持续进行，伴随有复制压力增加、TPX2表达上升、DNA损伤导致ATM激活，最终导致基因组不稳定。对EGFR突变LUAD肿瘤的转录组和拷贝数分析显示，CDK4或CDK6扩增与肿瘤进展相关基因的上调相关。CDK4扩增与患者活检单细胞RNA测序数据中上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关基因表达变化高度相关。在前临床模型中，联合使用CDK4/6和EGFR抑制剂恢复了增殖停滞，诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡，减少了复制压力和DNA损伤。
items.abstract: Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutant lung adenocarcinomas (LUAD) harbor a complex landscape of genetic co-alterations and potential oncogenic interactions. Among them are recurrent amplifications of the cell cycle regulatory genes CDK4 and CDK6, which have been clinically implicated in resistance to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). However, the mechanisms by which CDK4/6 upregulation promotes therapy resistance remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that CDK4 or CDK6 overexpression limits EGFR inhibitor-induced proliferative arrest, promoting continued cell cycle progression. This is accompanied by elevated replication stress, increased TPX2 expression, DNA damage leading to ATM activation, and ultimately genomic instability. Integrative transcriptomic and copy number analyses of EGFR-mutant LUAD tumors from both patients and preclinical models revealed that CDK4 or CDK6 amplification is associated with the upregulation of genes linked to tumor progression, including AGR2, ASNS, and STEAP1. CDK4 amplification was also highly correlated with gene expression changes associated with epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in a single-cell RNA sequencing datase
