items.title: Cellular source and circuit context organize functional specificity in the Drosophila NPF system
items.title_zh: 果蝇NPF系统中细胞来源与电路背景组织功能特异性
items.summary_zh: 神经肽调节多种功能，但单一肽如何实现功能特异性仍不清楚。果蝇神经肽F（NPF）通过单一受体发挥作用，成为测试细胞来源是否组织特异性的模型。通过全脑连接组，我们定义了四种成年NPF细胞类型，它们没有共享的第一序列突触伙伴，且各自网络独立。这些细胞类型在强化、进食、交配和能量储存方面做出了不同且部分对立的贡献。大多数依赖肽的效应在NPF减少后无法检测，表明全球性扰动可能掩盖来源特异性功能。在同一细胞中改变神经元活动和减少NPF产生了不同的、甚至对立的表型，因此神经元激活不能等同于肽的作用。因此，细胞来源和电路背景共同生成功能特异性，而群体水平的扰动则掩盖了这一点。
items.abstract: Neuropeptides regulate diverse and sometimes opposing functions, yet how a single peptide achieves functional specificity remains unclear. Receptor diversity can provide specificity, but not in systems with only one receptor. Drosophila neuropeptide F (NPF) acts through a single receptor, providing a model to test whether specificity is organized by the peptide's cellular source. Using the whole-brain connectome, we defined four adult NPF cell types with no shared first-order synaptic partners and separate networks. These cell types made distinct and partly opposing contributions to reinforcement, feeding, mating, and energy storage. Most peptide-dependent effects were undetectable after population-level NPF reduction, showing that global perturbation can obscure source-specific functions. Changing neuronal activity and reducing NPF in the same cells produced different, sometimes opposing, phenotypes, so neuronal activation cannot be equated with peptide action. Thus, cellular source and circuit context generate functional specificity that population-level perturbation conceals.
items.authors: Endres, M. N.; Dadyala, T. S.; Christie, K. W.; Sinakevitch, I. T.; Shao, L.

items.title: Rhomboid protease Rhbdl2 regulates macrophage recruitment and wound regeneration in zebrafish
items.title_zh: 菱形蛋白酶Rhbdl2调节斑马鱼巨噬细胞招募与创伤再生
items.summary_zh: 组织再生需要对免疫细胞行为的严格控制，但抑制免疫驱动再生反应的机制仍不明确。本研究鉴定了菱形膜内丝氨酸蛋白酶Rhbdl2作为斑马鱼再生的关键调节因子。通过CRISPR Cas9技术生成rhbdl2突变体，发现其不影响正常发育，但在受伤后触发增强的再生生长，伴随伤口部位巨噬细胞的增加，以及早期凋亡和增殖的增加。蛋白质组学分析显示rhbdl2突变体中Rac2蛋白水平升高，表明免疫信号失调。功能性实验中，Rac2反义寡核苷酸在rhbdl2突变体幼虫中介导的敲低抑制了巨噬细胞招募的增加和增强的组织再生表型。这些发现揭示了Rhbdl2作为一个免疫检查点，限制巨噬细胞驱动的增强再生，对炎症疾病、纤维化和肿瘤免疫相互作用具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Tissue regeneration requires tight control of immune cell behavior, yet the mechanisms that restrain immune-driven regenerative responses remain poorly defined. Here, we identify the rhomboid intramembrane serine protease Rhbdl2 as a critical regulator of regeneration in zebrafish. We generated rhbdl2 mutants by CRISPR Cas9 and found that it does not affect normal development, but triggers enhanced regenerative growth following injury, accompanied by increased macrophage accumulation at the wound site, which is accompanied by increased early apoptosis and proliferation. Proteomic analyses reveal increased Rac2 protein levels in rhbdl2 mutants, indicating dysregulated immune signaling. Functionally, Rac2 morpholino oligonucleotides mediated knockdown in rhbdl2 mutant larvae suppresses the elevated macrophage recruitment and enhanced tissue regenerative phenotype. Together, these findings uncover Rhbdl2 as an immune checkpoint that constrains macrophage driven enhanced regeneration, with vast implications for inflammatory disease, fibrosis, and tumor immune interactions.
items.authors: Gourkanti, S.; Ramakrishnan, G.; Cheung, J.; Schoen, T. J.; Munoz, Y.; Chavez, R. M.; Dohnalek, J.; Martin, K.; Lovett-Barron, M. E.; Whisenant, T.; Strisovsky, K.; Neal, S. E.

items.title: Waking the sleepers: lincRNA overexpression compromises DHX36 activity and global protein synthesis
items.title_zh: 唤醒沉睡者：lincRNA过表达影响DHX36活性与蛋白质合成
items.summary_zh: 转座元件衍生的长间隔非编码RNA（lincRNA）被越来越多地认为是基因表达的上下文依赖性调节因子；然而，它们在体细胞中异位激活的功能后果仍不清楚。我们之前发现U7小核RNA抑制一部分LTR12相关的lincRNA，包括在体细胞中表达极少的lnc-ARRDC4-1和lnc-ADCYAP1-2。本文研究了它们在体细胞中表达增加的后果。结果显示，任一lincRNA的过表达导致共同的转录组和蛋白质组变化、迁移受损、粘附和增殖改变，以及约50%的蛋白质合成减少。此外，我们确定lnc-ARRDC4-1为lnc-ADCYAP1-2转录的上游调节因子。lnc-ADCYAP1-2与RNA解旋酶DHX36相互作用，DHX36是G-四链体含量mRNA的调节因子。lnc-ADCYAP1-2的激活降低了DHX36蛋白水平，并伴随DHX36 mRNA靶标的蛋白输出减少。这些效应与细胞功能障碍和全球翻译改变相关。我们的结果表明，lnc-ARRDC4-1:lnc-ADCYAP1-2:DHX36调控级联将LTR12含量的lincRNA去抑制与蛋白质合成减少及细胞过程改变联系起来。
items.abstract: Transposable element-derived long intergenic noncoding RNAs (lincRNAs) are increasingly recognized as context-dependent regulators of gene expression; however, the functional consequences of their ectopic activation in somatic cells remain poorly understood. We previously showed that U7 snRNA represses a subset of LTR12-associated lincRNAs, including lnc-ARRDC4-1 and lnc-ADCYAP1-2, two testis-enriched lincRNAs with minimal expression in somatic cells. Here, we examined the consequences of their increased expression in somatic cells. We showed that overexpression of either lincRNA led to common transcriptomic changes, proteomic changes, impaired migration, altered adhesion and proliferation, and a ~50% reduction in protein synthesis. Furthermore, we identified lnc-ARRDC4-1 as an upstream regulator of lnc-ADCYAP1-2 transcription. Downstream of this event, lnc-ADCYAP1-2 interacts with the RNA helicase DHX36, a regulator of G-quadruplex-containing mRNAs. lnc-ADCYAP1-2 activation reduces DHX36 protein levels, which is accompanied by decreased protein output from a subset of DHX36 mRNA targets. items.title: Predictive control of human pancreatic cell fate using a digital model of in vitro differentiation
items.title_zh: 数字模型预测人胰腺细胞命运的控制研究
items.summary_zh: 成熟干细胞衍生胰岛（SC-islets）的可控生成仍是可扩展糖尿病细胞治疗的障碍。本文开发了一种预测数字模型，定义了在人类SC-islet分化过程中控制命运特异性细胞状态的调控逻辑。我们整合了来自9个原始单细胞多组学数据集的400,603个细胞，以及52个公共单细胞RNA-seq和ATAC-seq数据集，涵盖4个细胞系和7个分化方案。该模型解析了转录动态和染色质可及性，同时实现了时间分辨推断和细胞状态特异性基因调控网络的计算干扰。我们识别了从内胚层祖细胞到胰腺外分泌和内分泌谱系的调控因子，并提名了新的候选调控因子。验证结果显示，STAT1作为外分泌驱动因子的角色和ZEB1作为早期内分泌特异性及后期非靶向血清素胰岛细胞命运的动态调控因子的作用。这项工作提供了一个实验支持的预测框架和一个包含1,116个模拟的互动资源，以优先考虑转录因子和干预窗口，从而优化SC-islet分化。
items.abstract: The controlled generation of mature stem cell-derived islets (SC-islets) remains a barrier to scalable cell therapy for diabetes. Here, we develop a predictive digital model defining the cell-state-specific regulatory logic governing fate specification during human SC-islet differentiation. We integrate 400,603 cells from 9 original single-cell multiomic datasets and 52 public single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq datasets across 4 cell lines and 7 differentiation protocols. This model resolves transcriptional and chromatin accessibility dynamics while enabling time-resolved inference and in silico perturbation of cell-state-specific gene regulatory networks. We identify regulators across trajectories from endoderm progenitors to pancreatic exocrine and endocrine lineages, nominating new candidate regulators. Among these candidates, we validate previously unreported roles for STAT1 as an exocrine driver and ZEB1 as a dynamic regulator of early endocrine specification and later off-target serotonergic islet cell fate. This work provides an experimentally supported predictive framework and an interactive resource comprising 1,116 simulations to prioritize transcription factors and interve

items.title: Locat: Joint enrichment and depletion testing identifies localized marker genes in single-cell transcriptomics
items.title_zh: Locat：联合富集与耗竭测试识别单细胞转录组中的局部标记基因
items.summary_zh: 多种方法用于识别单细胞转录组数据中划分细胞群体的标记基因，但大多数方法强调候选群体内的富集，而未测试其他区域的表达是否显著降低。我们提出了Locat框架，通过测试基因表达是否集中在细胞嵌入的紧凑区域内并在外部减少，从而识别高度特异的局部基因。Locat为每个基因拟合加权高斯混合模型，计算浓度和耗竭统计量，并将其整合为统一的定位评分。在合成基准测试中，Locat能够检测单峰、多峰和稀疏的局部模式，当表达与背景结构不可区分时，显著性降低。在发育、扰动和分化数据集中，Locat识别出紧凑的标记集，捕捉谱系组织、特定条件程序和时间动态。这些标记集通常小于高度变异的基因选择，而基于这些基因构建的嵌入在多个案例中保留了主要细胞群体和发育程序。在小鼠真皮、干扰素处理的PBMC和视黄酸诱导的胚胎干细胞分化中，局部基因恢复了分化轨迹和刺激响应。
items.abstract: Several methods identify marker genes that delineate cell populations in single-cell transcriptomic data, yet most emphasize enrichment within candidate populations without testing whether expression is significantly reduced elsewhere. We present Locat, a framework for identifying highly specific localized genes by testing whether expression is concentrated within compact regions of a cellular embedding and depleted outside them. For each gene, Locat fits weighted Gaussian mixture models to gene-specific and background densities, computes concentration and depletion statistics, and integrates them into a unified localization score. Across synthetic benchmarks with controlled ground truth, Locat detects uni-modal, multi-modal, and sparse localized patterns and loses significance when expression becomes indistinguishable from background structure. In developmental, perturbation, and differentiation datasets, Locat identifies compact marker sets that capture lineage organization, condition-specific programs, and temporal dynamics. These sets are often smaller than highly variable gene selections, while embeddings built from them preserve major cell populations and developmental progra
items.authors: Lewis, W. R.; Aizenbud, Y.; Strino, F.; Kluger, Y.; Parisi, F.

items.title: Coupling cell growth to protein secretion enables pooled screening at single-cell resolution in bioreactors
items.title_zh: 细胞生长与蛋白质分泌耦合实现单细胞分辨率筛选
items.summary_zh: 在高通量筛选中，保持基因型-表型的关联性至关重要，尤其是在筛选重组蛋白分泌的混合文库时，蛋白质扩散会破坏这种关联。现有方法对筛选细胞的环境有显著限制。本文提出了一种基于生长的筛选策略AutoGrowth，通过单细胞生物传感器将生长速率与分泌相连接。我们展示了分泌对生长速率的比例调节，并在五种模型蛋白上验证了该方法。作为概念验证，我们在生物反应器中筛选了信号肽文库，以提高单链可变片段的分泌效率，并结合深度测序进行研究。此外，通过掺入实验，我们表明AutoGrowth能够在三天内识别稀释至数亿分之一的有利变体。我们的基于生长的策略提供了前所未有的通量潜力，确保选择具有优越分泌和适应能力的遗传变体。
items.abstract: Preserving the genotype-phenotype linkage is critical in high-throughput screens exploring large parameter spaces. Screening pooled libraries for recombinant protein secretion is therefore particularly difficult, since protein diffusion into the medium disrupts this linkage. Existing methods impose significant restrictions on the environment of the screened cells. Here, we present AutoGrowth, a growth-based screening strategy linking growth rate to secretion via a single-cell biosensor. We demonstrated the proportional modulation of growth rate by secretion and validated the approach on five model proteins. As proof of concept, we screened a signal peptide library in bioreactors for improved secretion of a single-chain variable fragment by coupling AutoGrowth with deep sequencing. Additionally, through spike-in experiments, we showed that AutoGrowth can identify favorable variants diluted at ratios as low as one in hundreds of millions in three days. Our growth-based strategy provides unprecedented throughput potential and ensures selection of genetic variants presenting advantageous secretion and fitness capabilities.
items.authors: Galez, H.; Franja Da Silva, A.; Capela, C.; Napolitano, S.; Batt, G.

items.title: Building dynamical models of multi-step state transitions from single cell gene expression trajectories
items.title_zh: 基于单细胞基因表达轨迹构建多步状态转变动态模型
items.summary_zh: 多步细胞状态转变在生物过程中普遍存在，如发育和疾病进展，但其背后的基因调控机制尚不明确。我们提出了NetDes，这是一种计算系统生物学方法，能够从单细胞基因表达轨迹中推断核心转录因子（TF）调控网络，并构建基于常微分方程（ODE）的动态模型。在合成轨迹和BEELINE scRNA-seq数据集的基准测试中，NetDes与现有方法竞争性地识别调控相互作用，并重建了模拟的细胞命运电路。我们将其应用于iPSC向确定性内胚层分化、上皮-间质转化、红细胞生成和树突状细胞分化的时间序列scRNA-seq数据。NetDes在重建一个能够再现观察到的表达动态并捕捉顺序状态转变的最小网络方面优于现有方法。网络模拟预测了驱动每个转变的TF及其组合，恢复了已知的主调控因子，同时网络粗粒化揭示了iPSC向DE分化的电路逻辑。NetDes为复杂细胞状态转变的机制建模提供了一个通用框架。
items.abstract: Multi-step cell state transitions occur across biological processes, such as development and disease progression, yet the underlying gene regulation remains unclear. We introduce NetDes, a computational systems-biology method that infers core transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks and builds ODE-based dynamical models from single-cell gene expression trajectories. In benchmarks on synthetic trajectories with decoys and BEELINE scRNA-seq datasets, NetDes identifies regulatory interactions competitively with existing methods, and reconstructs a simulated cell-fate circuit. We applied it to time-series scRNA-seq data of iPSC-to-definitive-endoderm differentiation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, erythropoiesis, and dendritic cell differentiation. NetDes has advantages over existing approaches in reconstructing a minimal network with a single model that reproduces observed expression dynamics and captures sequential state transitions. Network simulations predict TFs and their combinations driving each transition, recovering known master regulators, while network coarse-graining reveals the circuit logic of iPSC-to-DE differentiation. items.title: A Drug-Specific, Half-Life-Adjusted Framework for Classifying CNS-Active Systemic Therapy Exposure During and After Radiotherapy
items.title_zh: 放疗期间及后期中枢神经系统活性药物暴露分类框架
items.summary_zh: 临床肿瘤学数据集通常将系统治疗记录为带有开始和结束日期的方案标签。尽管这些记录在临床上可识别，但在研究患者是否在放疗期间接触到同时使用的中枢神经系统活性药物（cCNS-aD）或辅助中枢神经系统活性药物（aCNS-aD）时，可能存在分析上的不完整性。本文提出了一种通用框架，将原始系统治疗记录转换为可重复的cCNS-aD和aCNS-aD变量，便于临床研究的亚组分析。该框架基于三种临床证据组件构建透明的CNS评分模型：颅内客观反应率、共识CNS支持和鞘内给药途径。它将药代动力学暴露代理定义为记录的结束日期加上五个半衰期。通过与放疗时间段的重叠来分类同时暴露，通过与预设的放疗后归因窗口的重叠来分类放疗后暴露。该框架还分别识别放疗后的药代动力学持续性和治疗启动，使研究者能够区分持续暴露与治疗启动。
items.abstract: Clinical oncology datasets often store systemic therapy as a regimen label with a start date and an end date. Those records are clinically recognizable but can be analytically incomplete when the research question concerns whether a patient was exposed to a concurrent CNS-active drug (cCNS-aD) or an adjuvant CNS-active drug (aCNS-aD) around radiotherapy. Contemporary CNS-oncology studies usually define CNS activity by empiric drug lists and define concurrency by fixed calendar windows, although the literature shows substantial heterogeneity across both concepts. This paper proposes a generalizable framework for converting raw systemic therapy records into reproducible cCNS-aD and aCNS-aD variables, useful in subgrouping for clinical studies. The framework uses a transparent CNS scoring model based on three clinical evidence components: intracranial objective response rate, consensus CNS endorsement, and intrathecal route of administration. It then defines a pharmacokinetic exposure proxy as the recorded end date plus five half-lives. items.title: Prediction Modeling of Missed Appointments in Safety-Net Physiatry: Visit Characteristics Outperform Patient Risk Scores
items.title_zh: 安全网物理医学中缺席预约预测模型研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：识别公共安全网医院门诊物理医学与康复（PM&R）诊所中与缺席（未到）就诊相关的预约级和患者级因素，测试电子健康记录（EHR）综合风险评分及邻里社会脆弱性是否在调度特征之外提供额外的预测价值，并从常规调度数据中开发和内部验证缺席预测模型。方法：对2022年2月15日至2026年2月12日期间为2,409名成年人安排的8,927个门诊PM&R预约进行回顾性队列研究，开发并进行内部（交叉验证和时间）验证预测模型。结果：缺席率为13.1%（1,171/8,927）；29.0%的预约被取消。10%的患者占据了50%的缺席。总体而言，调度特征在预测缺席方面优于患者风险评分。
items.abstract: Objective. To identify appointment-level and patient-level factors associated with missed (no-show) visits in an outpatient physical medicine and rehabilitation (PM&R) clinic at a public safety-net hospital, to test whether electronic health record (EHR) composite risk scores and neighborhood social vulnerability add predictive value beyond scheduling characteristics, and to develop and internally validate a no-show prediction model from routinely available scheduling data. Design. Retrospective cohort study of all scheduled outpatient PM&R appointments, with development and internal (cross-validated and temporal) validation of a prediction model. Setting. Outpatient PM&R clinic, Arrowhead Regional Medical Center, a county safety-net hospital in the Inland Empire region of Southern California. Participants. 8,927 appointments scheduled for 2,409 adults between February 15, 2022 and February 12, 2026; 6,594 appointments for 1,369 patients were linked to age, EPIC General Risk Score, EPIC Preventive Care Gap Score, and ZIP-code Social Vulnerability Index (SVI). items.title: Antihypertensive Medication Class and Incident Alzheimers Disease and Related Dementias: External Replication Across Two Independent Healthcare Data Sources-the Vanderbilt EHR Synthetic Derivative and US Medicare Claims
items.title_zh: 抗高血压药物类别与阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 重要性：高血压是阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）最重要的可改变风险因素之一，但不同抗高血压药物类别是否对认知风险有不同影响尚不明确。本研究旨在通过两个独立的医疗数据源进行外部验证，评估主要使用刺激或抑制血管紧张素II类型2和类型4受体信号的抗高血压药物与ADRD发生风险的关系。方法：采用回顾性新用户、主动比较的队列研究，使用倾向评分匹配，数据来源为范德比尔特大学医学中心合成衍生数据和Merative MarketScan Medicare数据库。研究对象为65岁及以上的高血压成年人，需有至少365天的抗高血压药物使用记录。结果显示，主要使用不同类别的抗高血压药物与ADRD风险存在关联。
items.abstract: Importance. Hypertension is among the most important modifiable risk factors for Alzheimers disease and related dementias (ADRD), but whether different antihypertensive drug classes confer different cognitive risk, particularly through differential modulation of angiotensin II receptor signaling, remains uncertain. Prior pharmacoepidemiologic evidence is based largely on a single Medicare cohort, and external validation across distinct healthcare data environments is needed. Objective. To externally replicate and extend prior findings across two structurally independent healthcare data sources, evaluating whether predominant use of antihypertensive medications that stimulate versus inhibit angiotensin II type 2 and type 4 receptor signaling is associated with risk of incident ADRD. Design, Setting, and Participants. Retrospective new user, active comparator cohort study with propensity score matching, conducted in parallel across two independent data sources: the Vanderbilt University Medical Center Synthetic Derivative (VUMC SD; deidentified academic medical center electronic health record through February 2025) and the Merative MarketScan Medicare Database (2015 to 2023). Adults

items.title: Clinical and mechanistic responses to a music-based intervention for pain in adults with irritable bowel syndrome: Protocol for a single-arm pilot study
items.title_zh: 基于音乐的干预对肠易激综合征成人疼痛的临床与机制反应研究
items.summary_zh: 肠易激综合征（IBS）是一种常见的脑肠互动障碍，表现为反复腹痛和排便习惯改变。尽管基于音乐的干预（MBIs）在缓解疼痛和压力方面显示出益处，但与IBS疼痛相关的MBI机制尚不清楚。本研究为一项单臂初步机制试验，旨在评估成人IBS患者对MBI的临床和多模态机制反应，并探讨将生理监测从实验室扩展到家庭环境的可行性。将招募36名年龄在18-50岁之间、经医生确认的IBS患者，预计约30人完成干预后的实验室访问。参与者将在认证音乐治疗师的指导下进行实验室课程，并在家中自我管理为期四周的标准化20分钟MBI练习，每周至少五天。评估将包括患者报告的疼痛、压力和IBS症状，定量感官测试，肠道微生物组分析，以及神经、自主和肌肉活动的多模态生理记录。
items.abstract: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common disorder of brain-gut interaction characterized by recurrent abdominal pain and altered bowel habits. Although music-based interventions (MBIs) have shown benefits on pain and stress, the mechanisms associated with MBI-related changes in IBS pain remain poorly understood, and the feasibility of capturing these responses using multimodal wearable monitoring in everyday settings has not been established. This protocol describes a single-arm pilot mechanistic trial examining clinical and multimodal mechanistic responses to an MBI in adults with IBS and the feasibility of extending physiological monitoring from the laboratory to home settings. Thirty-six adults aged 18-50 years with provider-confirmed IBS will be enrolled, with approximately 30 expected to complete the post-intervention laboratory visit. Participants will receive board-certified music therapist-guided laboratory sessions and complete four weeks of self-administered home practice using a standardized 20-minute MBI protocol at least five days per week. items.title: Weight Loss With Microdose Tirzepatide: Real-World Outcomes in Patients Initiating Treatment Below 2.5 mg Weekly
items.title_zh: 微剂量Tirzepatide减重：低于每周2.5mg患者的真实世界结果
items.summary_zh: 背景：Tirzepatide通常以每周2.5mg开始治疗，并逐步调整至批准的维持剂量。关于低于每周2.5mg起始剂量的体重变化证据有限。方法：我们进行了一项回顾性单中心观察研究，纳入基线体重指数（BMI）≥27 kg/m²的新GLP-1治疗成人，使用每周1或2mg的微剂量Tirzepatide。分析了基线有效性、既往治疗、体重一致性和治疗暴露。主要描述性分析选择了每位患者在14-35、36-59和60-89天观察窗口内的最新合格测量，排除超过2mg/周的观察。共纳入93个合格测量。结果：60名患者提供了93个合格的随访测量，其中84个用于患者窗口总结。平均年龄47.3岁，81.7%为女性，平均基线BMI为33.3 kg/m²。在14-35天窗口内，平均体重减轻2.18%（95% CI 1.61-2.76；n=57），在36-59天窗口内减轻3.58%（95% CI 2.43-4.72；n=19）。
items.abstract: Background: Tirzepatide is conventionally initiated at 2.5 mg weekly and titrated to approved maintenance doses. Evidence describing weight change at injectable starting doses below 2.5 mg/week is limited. Methods: We conducted a retrospective, single-organization observational study of adults documented as new GLP-1 starts, with baseline body mass index (BMI) [ ]27 kg/m2, who initiated compounded injectable tirzepatide at a microdose of 1 or 2 mg/week (below the standard 2.5 mg/week starting dose). Source records were reviewed for baseline validity, prior treatment, weight consistency, and treatment exposure. The main descriptive analysis selected the latest eligible measurement per patient within observation windows of 14-35, 36-59, and 60-89 days of adjudicated treatment exposure, excluding observations after escalation above 2 mg/week. All 93 eligible measurements were included in a supporting random-intercept model. Analyses were retrospective and hypothesis-generating; no formal sample-size calculation was performed. items.title: Implementation strategies for integrating TB treatment into community pharmacies for people with TB/HIV in Uganda using human-centered design methodology
items.title_zh: 乌干达社区药房整合结核病治疗的实施策略研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：社区药房作为一种新型的差异化服务交付模式，为人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）感染者提供抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART），并可支持结核病（TB）药物续药。方法：采用以人为本的设计（HCD）方法，我们在乌干达坎帕拉开发了将TB治疗整合进药房的实施策略。我们实施了HCD方法的灵感和构思阶段。在灵感阶段，识别了整合TB治疗的障碍和促进因素，并观察了社区药房中TB/HIV患者的护理路径。我们将定性发现转化为洞察陈述、设计机会和“我们如何能...”问题。在构思阶段，进行了头脑风暴和共同设计研讨会，生成和完善解决方案，测试了低保真原型，并使用系统可用性量表评估高保真原型的可用性。参与者包括TB/HIV患者、TB和HIV重点人员、卫生部DSD模型专家及药房医疗提供者。结果：26个低保真原型中，有四个实施策略被确定。
items.abstract: Background Community pharmacies (private retail drug shops/pharmacies) have emerged as a novel differentiated service delivery (DSD) model for delivering antiretroviral therapy (ART) to people with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and could support integrated tuberculosis (TB) medication refills. Using a Human-Centered Design (HCD) methodology, we developed an implementation strategy for integrating TB treatment into pharmacies targeting people with TB/HIV in Kampala, Uganda. Methods We implemented the inspiration and ideation phases of the HCD methodology. During the inspiration phase, we identified themes describing barriers and facilitators to integrating TB treatment into community pharmacies and conducted observations at community pharmacies to understand the care pathway of people with TB/HIV. We translated these qualitative findings into insight statements, design opportunities, and How Might We (HMW) questions. During the ideation phase, we conducted brainstorming and co-design workshops to generate and refine solutions, tested low-fidelity prototypes using ranked scores, and assessed the usability of high-fidelity prototypes using the System Usability Scale. items.title: Antihypertensive Pharmacotherapy Gaps in Nigeria: A Predictive Machine Learning Analysis of Treatment Uptake Amid Macroeconomic Shock, Using NDHS 2023-24
items.title_zh: 尼日利亚抗高血压药物治疗缺口的机器学习分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：高血压是全球最重要的可改变心血管风险因素，撒哈拉以南非洲的发病率正在上升。2023-24年尼日利亚人口与健康调查（NDHS）首次提供了利用机器学习框架探索全国范围内抗高血压治疗未接受情况的机会。目的：识别尼日利亚已诊断成人中抗高血压治疗未接受的相关因素；检验在宏观经济冲击期间调查进行的时间是否影响未接受情况；比较四种预测算法。方法：使用2023-24年NDHS数据（2,975名女性和529名男性高血压患者，年龄15-49岁），分别按性别拟合加权逻辑回归模型，并在单一模型中评估性别与预测变量的交互作用。结果：访谈时间对女性是显著风险因素（OR=1.14每月；95% CI: 1.06-1.22；p<0.001）。
items.abstract: Background: Hypertension is the most important modifiable cardiovascular risk factor worldwide, and the prevalence is increasing in sub-Saharan Africa. Nigeria's newly released 2023-24 Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS) provides the first opportunity to explore national-level non-uptake of antihypertensive treatment using a machine-learning cascade framework, although survey fieldwork was conducted amid the unprecedented shock of fuel subsidy removal and currency devaluation in Nigeria. Objectives: To identify correlates of antihypertensive treatment non-uptake (Gap 2) among the diagnosed adults in Nigeria; test if the non-uptake varied based on when the survey was conducted during this macroeconomic shock; and compare four predictive algorithms. Methods: We used the 2023-24 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS) data (2,975 women diagnosed with hypertension and 529 men diagnosed with hypertension aged 15-49) to fit survey-weighted logistic regression models separately by sex and evaluated sex-by-predictor interactions in a single pooled model. We then compared the survey-weighted logistic regression model with the elastic net, random forest, and gradient boosting (XGBoost)

items.title: Defining the Genetic and Phenotypic Landscape of Primary Immune Regulatory Disorders Using the ClinGen Validation Framework
items.title_zh: 利用ClinGen验证框架界定原发性免疫调节障碍的遗传与表型特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：原发性免疫调节障碍（PIRDs）是一组快速增长的先天免疫缺陷病，特征包括感染易感性、自身免疫、炎症和淋巴增生。由于现有数据的局限性，这些疾病的基因-疾病关系核心特征常常不明确。ClinGen是一个国际合作项目，旨在通过标准化框架解决PIRDs及其他单基因疾病的这一挑战。目的：系统评估PIRD基因-疾病关系的证据，并识别这些异质性疾病中的保守表型特征。方法：ClinGen PIRD基因审查专家小组（GCEP）使用标准化框架识别主要由免疫失调特征的单基因疾病的潜在基因-疾病关系，并整理相关证据，分类这些关系的证据强度，并通过人类表型本体（HPO）进行标准化表型评估。结果：截至2026年4月，PIRD-GCEP已整理出46个相关基因。
items.abstract: Background: Primary immune regulatory disorders (PIRDs) represent a rapidly growing group of inborn errors of immunity (IEIs) characterized by infection susceptibility, autoimmunity, inflammation, and lymphoproliferation. However, the core features of the gene-disease relationships underlying these conditions are often obscured by limitations in available published data. The Clinical Genome Resource (ClinGen) is an international collaborative effort that seeks to address this challenge for PIRDs and other monogenic diseases through a standardized framework for classifying the strength of gene-disease relationships. Objective: We sought to systematically evaluate the evidence for proposed PIRD gene-disease relationships and identify conserved phenotypic features across this heterogeneous group of disorders. Methods: Using the standardized ClinGen framework, the ClinGen PIRD Gene Curation Expert Panel (GCEP) identified potential gene-disease relationships for monogenic conditions characterized predominantly by immune dysregulation. items.title: Factors Associated with Adherence to Anti-Hypertensive Medication Among Patients Attending a Primary Health Centre in Ndola, Zambia: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.title_zh: 赞比亚Ndola地区高血压患者抗高血压药物依从性相关因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：高血压是全球心血管疾病和过早死亡的主要可改变风险因素。尽管有有效的药物治疗，但抗高血压药物的依从性差仍是控制血压的主要障碍，撒哈拉以南非洲地区的非依从率高达45-65%。在赞比亚，未控制的高血压显著影响住院率和死亡率，但关于依从性障碍的具体数据仍然有限。本研究评估了在赞比亚Ndola地区铁路外科城市卫生中心就诊的高血压患者的抗高血压药物依从性相关因素。方法：对237名高血压患者进行横断面研究，使用结构化问卷评估社会人口特征、临床因素和依从性。数据采用描述性统计、卡方检验和多变量逻辑回归分析。结果：总体依从率为41.4%，58.6%的参与者被归类为非依从者。平均依从性得分为19.8（SD=4.6），最常见的非依从原因包括药物用尽（平均=2.6）、外出（平均=2.5）等。
items.abstract: Background: Hypertension is a leading modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease and premature death worldwide. Despite effective pharmacological therapy, poor adherence to anti-hypertensive medication remains the primary barrier to achieving blood pressure control, with non-adherence rates reaching 45-65% in sub-Saharan African settings. In Zambia, uncontrolled hypertension contributes substantially to hospital morbidity and mortality, yet context-specific data on adherence barriers remain limited. This study assessed factors associated with adherence to anti-hypertensive medication among patients attending Railway Surgery Urban Health Centre in Ndola, Zambia. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 237 hypertensive patients attending Railway Surgery Urban Health Centre in Ndola. A structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire assessed socio-demographic characteristics, clinical factors, and medication adherence using the modified Hill-Bone Compliance Scale. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, and multivariable logistic regression (p<0.05). items.title: Determinants of Antibiotic Prescribing for Acute Respiratory Infections in Primary Care: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study at the Eduardo Mondlane University Health Center, Maputo, Mozambique
items.title_zh: 莫桑比克急性呼吸道感染抗生素处方影响因素研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在识别2024年4月至8月在莫桑比克爱德华多·蒙达内大学健康中心就诊的急性呼吸道感染（ARI）患者中与抗生素处方相关的临床因素。采用观察性、描述性、横断面回顾性研究方法，分析196份ARI患者的临床记录，收集人口学、临床及处方医师相关变量。结果显示，抗生素处方的流行率为69.4%（136/196），显著高于世界卫生组织推荐的20-26.8%范围。其中，阿莫西林是最常处方的抗生素，占45.4%。研究结果表明，急性呼吸道感染患者的抗生素处方存在过度使用现象，需加强合理用药的干预措施。
items.abstract: IntroductionAcute respiratory infections (ARIs) constitute one of the leading reasons for primary care consultations and, despite being frequently viral in etiology, continue to be inappropriately treated with antibiotics, contributing to the rise of antimicrobial resistance. In Mozambique, evidence on the clinical factors associated with antibiotic prescribing in patients with ARIs remains scarce, particularly in studies conducted in the general population. ObjectiveTo identify the clinical factors associated with antibiotic prescribing in patients with ARIs attended at the Eduardo Mondlane University Health Center (CS-UEM) between April and August 2024. MethodsAn observational, descriptive, cross-sectional, retrospective study with a quantitative approach, based on a convenience sample of 196 clinical records of patients with ARIs. Demographic, clinical, and prescriber-related variables were collected. Bivariate associations were assessed using chi-square ({chi}2) tests and Cramers V. items.title: Integrating Causal Inference into Pharmacovigilance: Target Trial Emulations for Proactive Signal Detection of Atorvastatin Initiation in Medicare Beneficiaries
items.title_zh: 将因果推断融入药物监测：针对美国家医保受益者的阿托伐他汀信号检测
items.summary_zh: 重要性：老年人不良药物事件对公共健康构成重大负担，然而自发报告系统因报告不足和缺乏明确人群而难以有效检测。老年人在临床试验中代表性不足，且因多重用药、共病和与年龄相关的药物代谢变化而面临更高风险。目的：开发并应用基于索赔的主动药物监测框架，通过顺序目标试验模拟检测老年人不良药物事件信号，以阿托伐他汀为初步应用。方法：利用2017-2019年美国家医保的费用索赔数据，研究65岁及以上在心肌或脑梗死后未使用他汀类药物的受益者。模拟出最多14个每日顺序试验，将患者分类为开始使用阿托伐他汀（A1）、开始使用其他药物（A2）或无新药物（A0）；主要对比为A1与A2。每个试验中，事件结果被确定并根据临床分类软件精细分类为552种结果。使用Fine-Gray回归模型估计在6个月随访期内的协议效应，考虑死亡作为竞争风险。
items.abstract: Importance: Adverse drug events in older adults are a substantial public health burden, yet spontaneous reporting systems detect them poorly owing to underreporting and the lack of a defined population. These limitations are of particular concern for older adults, who are underrepresented in pre-approval trials yet at elevated risk owing to polypharmacy, multimorbidity, and age-related changes in drug metabolism. Objective: To develop and apply an active, claims-based pharmacovigilance framework using sequential target trial emulation to detect adverse drug event signals in older adults, with atorvastatin as the initial application. Methods: Using Medicare fee-for-service claims (2017-2019), we studied statin-naive beneficiaries aged 65 years or older following myocardial or cerebral infarction. We emulated up to 14 daily sequential trials from the discharge date, classifying patients as initiating atorvastatin (A1), initiating a different medication (A2), or no new medication (A0); the primary contrast was A1 versus A2. items.title: Pre-illness Clonal Hematopoiesis of Indeterminate Potential is Associated with Increased Morbidity and Mortality in Sepsis
items.title_zh: 前疾病克隆性造血与脓毒症患者的发病率和死亡率相关
items.summary_zh: 目的：脓毒症是一种危及生命的综合症，尤其在老年人中导致显著的发病率和死亡率。前疾病克隆性造血（CHIP）是一种与年龄相关的状态，与慢性疾病和全因死亡率相关。本研究评估了前疾病CHIP与脓毒症患者在ICU入院时的死亡率和发病率的关联。方法：我们进行了一项回顾性研究，使用与DNA生物库关联的去标识电子健康记录。我们识别了在ICU入院前收集DNA的脓毒症成年患者。我们测试了通过全基因组测序确定的CHIP状态与ICU死亡率、无器官支持生存天数和长期生存的关联，调整了年龄、性别、种族和入院时的序贯器官衰竭评估（SOFA）评分。结果：研究队列包括220名有前疾病CHIP的患者和3,010名没有的患者。前疾病CHIP与脓毒症死亡率增加相关（OR = 1.54, 95% CI 1.13至2.07, P = 0.005），并且在调整年龄、性别、种族和SOFA评分后，器官支持生存天数减少（-1.7天, 95% CI -3.2至-0.2, P = 0.028）。在脓毒症幸存者中，CHIP也与出院后的长期死亡率增加相关（HR 1.40, 95% CI 1.01至1.93, P = 0.041）。结论：前疾病CHIP与脓毒症患者的发病率和死亡率独立相关。
items.abstract: Purpose: Sepsis is a life-threatening syndrome causing significant morbidity and mortality, especially in older adults. Clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) is an age-related condition linked to chronic illness and all-cause mortality. Here, we evaluated the association of pre-illness CHIP with mortality and morbidity in patients admitted to the ICU with sepsis. Methods: We performed a retrospective study using a de-identified electronic health record linked with a DNA biorepository. We identified adult patients with sepsis who had DNA collected prior to ICU admission. We tested the association between CHIP status determined from whole-genome sequencing, and ICU mortality, organ support-free days, and long-term survival adjusting for age, sex, race and Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score on ICU admission. Results: The cohort comprised 220 patients with pre-illness CHIP and 3,010 patients without. Pre-illness CHIP was associated with increased sepsis mortality (OR = 1.54, 95% CI 1.13 to 2.07, P = 0.005) and fewer days alive and free of organ support (-1.7 days, 95% CI -3.2 to -0.2, P = 0.028) after adjusting for age, sex, race, and SOFA score. items.title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
items.title_zh: EvolveTrade：基于经验的自我进化LLM交易代理策略优化
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）交易代理能够结合市场数据、新闻和可执行分析，但其行为通常受限于在部署前固定的手写工具使用策略。这限制了它们在变化的市场环境中适应证据收集、工具调用、信号验证和风险管理的能力。我们提出了EvolveTrade，一个自我进化框架，将工具使用交易代理的系统提示视为文本参数化策略。在每个更新间隔后，策略代理利用累积的决策轨迹和实际投资组合反馈修订该策略，同时保持基础LLM不变。更新后的策略用于下一批交易决策，使代理能够随着时间的推移优化信息获取和投资组合构建过程。多种市场环境和两种LLM基础模型的实验表明，EvolveTrade通常能提高夏普比率和累计收益率，在大多数评估设置中实现了改进。这些结果表明，适应可重用程序的治理能够显著提升交易表现。
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. items.authors: Sehee Kim, Yumin Choi, Minki Kang, Sung Ju Hwang

items.title: When to Call an LLM: A Confidence-Gated Hybrid for Cost-Effective Emotion Recognition in Conversational AI
items.title_zh: 基于信心门控的混合模型在对话AI中实现高效情感识别
items.summary_zh: 对话中的情感识别（ERC）是联系中心即服务（CCaaS）平台中代理辅助提示、升级路由和通话后分析的核心能力，成本和延迟与准确性同样重要。我们比较了三种对话上下文ERC的部署选项：低成本堆叠集成（句子嵌入、窗口上下文、随机森林/XGBoost/逻辑回归堆叠）、现成的LLM提示（GPT-4o-mini；零-shot、少-shot、思维链）以及一种信心门控混合模型，该模型仅将集成模型中信心最低的预测升级到LLM，模拟了生产联系中心中IVA到人类代理的升级策略。在IEMOCAP数据集上，集成模型显著优于所有LLM配置（0.595对0.460-0.536加权F1，p < 0.0001），且成本仅为其一小部分，延迟低于10毫秒；在MELD和CMU-MOSI上，排名则相反，显示出单一系统并非安全默认。信心门控混合模型在所有三个数据集上都优于这两种纯系统（加权F1分别为0.620、0.643、0.824），同时将大部分流量通过近零成本的集成模型处理，成本约为每百万次发言10-85美元，而LLM仅管道则为99-170美元。
items.abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) is a production capability behind agent-assist prompts, escalation routing, and post-call analytics in contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platforms, where cost and latency constraints matter as much as accuracy. We report a systems-level comparison of three deployment options for dialogue-contextual ERC: a low-cost stacked ensemble (sentence embeddings, windowed context, RandomForest/XGBoost/logistic-regression stacking), off-the-shelf LLM prompting (GPT-4o-mini; zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought), and a confidence-gated hybrid that escalates only the ensemble's least-confident predictions to the LLM - modeled on IVA-to-human-agent escalation policies used in production contact centers. On IEMOCAP, the ensemble significantly outperforms every LLM configuration (0.595 vs. 0.460-0.536 weighted F1, p < 0.0001) at a fraction of the cost and sub-10ms latency; on MELD and CMU-MOSI the ranking reverses, showing neither pure system is a safe default. The confidence-gated hybrid resolves this by Pareto-dominating both pure systems on all three datasets (0.620, 0.643, 0.824 weighted F1) while routing the majority of traffic through the near-zero
items.authors: Sai Babu Udayagiri, Arjun Chouhan, Ravisekhar Kanagala, Trishala Pavagada

items.title: TuiML: Machine Learning for AI Agents
items.title_zh: TuiML：为AI代理设计的机器学习库
items.summary_zh: TuiML是一个为AI代理构建的自包含机器学习库，提供监督、无监督、时间序列、数据处理、调优和评估等任务的原生算法。每个组件通过机器可读的元数据和参数模式自我描述，使代理能够搜索库、检查组件、组合经过验证的工作流，并注册新的组件。所有调用都经过验证、种子化和追踪，实验会话导出为可运行的笔记本，确保实验的可重复性。TuiML的设计优先考虑代理，使其能够自主读取、扩展和操作机器学习。基准测试显示TuiML在预测性能上与scikit-learn和Weka具有竞争力。TuiML是开源的，文档可在https://tuiml.ai获取。
items.abstract: Machine-learning libraries such as Weka and scikit-learn were designed for human programmers. Language-model agents now use these same libraries by recalling APIs from memory and writing code, an approach that hides what a library offers, delays errors until runtime, and loses experimental state between turns. We present TuiML, a self-contained machine-learning library built for AI agents, with native algorithms across supervised, unsupervised, time-series, data handling, tuning, and evaluation tasks. Every component describes itself through machine-readable metadata and parameter schemas, so an agent can search the library, inspect components, compose validated workflows, and register new ones that become discoverable in turn. Every call is validated, seeded, and traced, and sessions export as runnable notebooks, making experiments reproducible by construction. One specification layer drives the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-framework adapters, a Python API, a CLI, and local model serving, while data and models never leave the machine. Benchmarks show TuiML remains predictively competitive with scikit-learn and Weka. While looking like a conventional library to a human user,

items.title: Teaching AI, Robotics, & Community: A Hubs-Based K-12 Education Framework for Reaching Rural Schools
items.title_zh: 基于中心的K-12人工智能与机器人教育框架
items.summary_zh: K-12阶段的机器人和人工智能教育在农村地区难以推广，尤其是缺乏持续的技术指导。我们提出了人工智能、机器人与社区（ARC）框架，通过高校培训本科生导师并为附近的K-12团队举办工作坊。成熟的学校项目可成为支持其他学校的次级中心，形成自我强化的教育循环。我们在一所大学进行了ARC的试点部署，创建了三个农村机器人团队。调查显示，K-12编程知识、资源获取和实践机会的平均提升分别为2.00、2.25和1.25分。本科生在教授技术概念、调整解释、管理团队及享受指导方面的信心分别提高了1.29、1.14、1.00和1.14分。此外，我们建立了ARC增长的空间马尔可夫模型，并以印第安纳州为测试平台进行模拟。在适度条件下，ARC预计在40年内覆盖印第安纳州74%的1925所公立K-12学校，并产生992个机器人项目。
items.abstract: K-12 robotics and AI education remains difficult to scale, especially in rural regions lacking sustained technical mentorship. Programs like FIRST provide competition pathways and instructional opportunities, but they do not eliminate the need for local programming and robotics expertise. We introduce AI, Robotics, & Community (ARC), a hubs-based framework where colleges train undergraduate mentors and host workshops for nearby K-12 teams. Mature school programs can become secondary hubs that support additional schools, creating a self-reinforcing education loop where mentorship reach propagates geographically and can even grow super-linearly. We first evaluate ARC through a trial deployment at one university. The trial created three rural robotics teams. On five-point Likert surveys, mean increases in K-12 programming knowledge, resource access, and practice opportunities were 2.00, 2.25, and 1.25 points. Likewise, undergraduate confidence teaching technical concepts, adapting explanations, managing groups, and finding mentoring enjoyable and meaningful increased by 1.29, 1.14, 1.00, and 1.14 points. items.authors: Maxwell J. Jacobson, Gustavo Rodriguez-Rivera, Petros Drineas, Yexiang Xue

items.title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
items.title_zh: 基于合同的LLM代理符号时间监督方法
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过工具增强，能够自动化复杂的多步骤任务，如网页导航、代码生成和工作流编排。然而，LLM中的幻觉、分布不稳定性和对抗性操控，以及某些工具调用的不可逆后果可能导致有害结果。现有的安全措施要么事后用随机LLM评判记录轨迹，要么逐个阻止不安全的操作，缺乏同时支持这两种角色的确定性工具。我们提出了ContrAgent，一个基于合同的LLM代理符号时间监督框架。ContrAgent将代理的行为捕捉为工具调用序列，并将其形式化为固定可检查谓词的轨迹。然后，它使用线性时序逻辑中的假设-保证合同（LTLf）来指定所需行为。每个合同被编译为一个确定性有限自动机（DFA），用于在线控制代理动作和离线评估记录轨迹。合同库作为可重用知识库，独立于代理模型维护，并可在同一任务领域的不同代理中应用。我们在四个基准测试中展示了我们方法的有效性，ContrAgent在这两种角色上表现出色。
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe actions one call at a time, and no single deterministic artifact supports both roles. We present ContrAgent, a contract-based framework for symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents. ContrAgent captures an agent's behavior as a sequence of tool calls and formalizes it as a trace over a fixed set of checkable predicates. It then specifies required behaviors using assume-guarantee contracts in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTLf). Each contract is compiled to a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) that serves two roles: gating agent actions online and evaluating recorded traces offline. A contract library, acting as a reusable knowledge base, is maintained independently of the agent'
items.authors: Yifeng Xiao, Pierluigi Nuzzo

items.title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
items.title_zh: 铁路应用中建立人工智能信任的必要性
items.summary_zh: 由于铁路行业严格的标准和法规，人工智能（AI）目前仅应用于非安全关键的领域。本文提出审视增强数据科学和AI算法信任所需的三个主要领域：鲁棒性、操作设计域（ODD）和可解释性。鲁棒性是指AI系统在任何情况下维持其性能水平的能力（ISO24029）。ODD允许明确界定系统预期操作的条件，依据最近发布的DIN DKE SPEC 99004。可解释性是AI系统以人类可理解的方式表达影响结果的重要因素的能力。这三个研究领域已被非铁路行业充分研究，现有算法和方法可用于铁路应用。需要系统视角以确保所有可信要求在安全的MLOps环境中持续互动，从而促进监管者、运营商和公众的接受。我们旨在展示，培养对AI的深度信任将释放其全部潜力，并加速在关键任务领域的应用。
items.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. Those 3 domains of research are already well investigated by nonrailway actors, with algorithms and methods ready to use for railway applications. A system view is necessary to ensure all trustworthy requirements interact continuously in a safe MLOps environment thereby fostering acceptance from regulators, operators and the public. items.authors: Lefebvre Renard Cl\'ement, L\'eb\'e Vincent, Da Silva Ribeiro Pereira Ricardo, Sundell Johan, Jaoul Arnaud Saiah Kenza, Mijatov\'ic Nenad

items.title: Where Should Agents Live? Energy-Memory Characterization of Agentic AI for the Edge-Cloud Continuum
items.title_zh: 代理人工智能在边缘云连续体中的能量-记忆特征研究
items.summary_zh: 随着电信网络向自主5G-Advanced和6G运营演进，代理人工智能（AI）工作流程逐渐嵌入边缘云连续体。这些工作流程涉及大型语言模型（LLMs）执行多步骤推理、调用诊断工具、检索领域知识及协调代理团队。尽管生物大脑在约20W的低功耗下实现复杂认知，当前的LLMs却极为耗能且内存密集，因而可持续生命周期管理成为关键运营优先事项。现有的AI生命周期指标仅评估孤立的单模型推理或完全忽视多代理执行图，导致网络运营商缺乏基础模型来判断分布式代理通信是否产生显著能量成本，以及代理团队应在边缘云层级的何处物理驻留。为填补这一空白，我们提出了代理eCAL，将AI生命周期的能量成本（eCAL）指标推广至定向多代理工作流程，结合了闭式两速单调用能量模型与7层OSI数据传输。基于数百个NVIDIA A100和H100的GPU基准配置、16个开放权重模型和8种编排拓扑，我们验证了各组件。
items.abstract: As telecommunication networks evolve toward autonomous 5G-Advanced and 6G operations, agentic artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, where large language models (LLMs) execute multi-step reasoning, invoke diagnostic tools, retrieve domain knowledge, and coordinate across agent teams, are increasingly embedded across the edge-cloud continuum. While the biological brain accomplishes complex cognition on an exceptionally modest metabolic power budget of approximately 20W contemporary LLMs are profoundly energy- and memory-intensive, making sustainable lifecycle orchestration a critical operational priority. However, existing AI lifecycle metrics evaluate only isolated, single-model inferences or overlook multi-agent execution graphs entirely. Consequently, network operators lack foundational models to determine whether distributed agent communication incurs meaningful energy costs and where across edge-cloud tiers agent teams should physically reside. items.authors: Carolina Fortuna, Vid Han\v{z}el, Tim Strnad, Bla\v{z} Bertalani\v{c}

items.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
items.title_zh: 忠实但共谋：链式思维监测无法检测LLM定价代理的共谋行为
items.summary_zh: 部署为自主定价代理的大型语言模型（LLM）可能通过默契协调维持超竞争性价格。我们开发了一种因果图差异框架，分别测量LLM定价代理在伯特兰竞争中的结构忠实性和意图忠实性。在双头垄断和三头垄断条件下的九个LLM中，共谋行为与链式思维（CoT）忠实性在这两个维度上表现出分离：最具共谋性的模型准确报告合作意图，但在结构上不忠实，而最具结构忠实性的模型在两种市场结构下维持超纳什定价。这些发现表明，仅依靠CoT监测无法作为防范算法共谋的独立保障。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLM) deployed as autonomous pricing agents may sustain supracompetitive prices through tacit coordination. We develop a causal graph divergence framework that separately measures structural faithfulness and intent faithfulness of LLM pricing agents in Bertrand competition. Across nine LLMs under duopoly and triopoly conditions, collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions: the most collusive model accurately reports cooperative intent yet reasons structurally unfaithfully, while the most structurally faithful model sustains supra-Nash pricing under both market structures. These findings establish that CoT monitoring alone cannot serve as a standalone safeguard against algorithmic collusion.
items.authors: Dohun Lee, Hyunwoo Park

items.title: Cultural Competence in Context: A Large Language Model Passes the Turing Test in Finland
items.title_zh: 芬兰语图灵测试中的文化能力：大型语言模型的表现
items.summary_zh: 我们报告了在芬兰进行的芬兰语图灵测试结果。由于语言和文化背景在大型语言模型（LLM）训练数据中的代表性不均，我们预期模型（ChatGPT 5.2）在芬兰语图灵测试中的表现会逊色于之前研究的英语环境。然而，出乎我们的意料，LLM成功通过了芬兰图灵测试。参与者在判断人类作者时过于依赖语言线索，尤其是口语芬兰语，成为主要错误来源。我们将图灵测试重新定义为一种比较方法，用于检验AI系统是否能够在特定社会环境中展现可信的成员资格。该方法反映了模型能力、提示身份、人类参与者的内行能力及其AI素养，为跨领域的人机边界提供了有用的探测手段。
items.abstract: We report the results of a Turing Test conducted in Finland in the Finnish language. Because languages and cultural contexts are unevenly represented in LLM training data, we expected the model (ChatGPT 5.2) to perform worse in a Finnish-language Turing Test than in previously studied English-language US contexts. We also present model-generated role prompting as a replicable technique for conducting comparative LLM-based Turing Tests designed to improve construct validity. Contrary to our expectations, the LLM passed the Finnish Turing Test. A prominent source of error was participants' reliance on linguistic cues, particularly colloquial Finnish, as markers of human authorship. We reframe the Turing Test from a test of intelligence to a comparative method for examining whether an AI system can display credible membership in a particular social world. Because its outcome reflects model capabilities, prompted identity, insider competence among human participants, and their AI literacy, the method provides a useful probe of the human-machine boundary across domains.
items.authors: Otto Segersven, Pentti Henttonen

items.title: HPOQuest: A Rare-Disease Diagnostic Agent Using Active Phenotype Acquisition
items.title_zh: HPOQuest：基于主动表型获取的罕见疾病诊断工具
items.summary_zh: 全球超过3亿人受到7000多种已知罕见疾病的影响，但由于患者最初表现出不完整和异质的表型，诊断仍然困难。我们提出了HPOQuest，这是一种用于罕见疾病诊断的无训练框架，能够进行序列表型获取。HPOQuest从一小组观察到的患者表型开始，维持概率性疾病排名，并迭代选择信息丰富的后续问题以支持临床医生在患者评估中的工作。确认的表型会更新疾病排名，而所有响应则更新候选问题集。在四个基准队列中，HPOQuest显著改善了从稀疏初始表型进行的诊断，Recall@1提升了最多30个百分点，Recall@5提升了最多45个百分点。这些结果表明，序列表型获取可以显著改善基于有限初始临床证据的罕见疾病诊断。
items.abstract: More than 300 million people worldwide are affected by one of over 7,000 known rare diseases, yet diagnosis remains difficult because patients initially present with incomplete and heterogeneous phenotypes. We present HPOQuest, a training-free framework for sequential phenotype acquisition in rare-disease diagnosis. Starting from a small set of observed patient phenotypes, HPOQuest maintains a probabilistic disease ranking and iteratively selects informative follow-up questions to support clinicians during patient assessment. Confirmed phenotypes update the disease ranking, while all responses update the candidate question set. Across four benchmark cohorts, HPOQuest substantially improves diagnosis from sparse initial phenotypes, with gains of up to 30% points at Recall@1 and 45% points at Recall@5. These results demonstrate that sequential phenotype acquisition can substantially improve rare-disease diagnosis from limited initial clinical evidence.
items.authors: Kamilia Zaripova, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad, Annalisa Marsico

items.title: WetRobo: A Reproducible Robot Kit for Coding Agents in Biological Laboratories
items.title_zh: WetRobo：可重复使用的生物实验室编码机器人套件
items.summary_zh: 自动化生物研究需要通用、可重复的机器人系统，使得个体湿实验室研究人员能够委派机器人任务，而无需进行远程操作或神经网络训练。我们构建了WetRobo，一个能够在不同实验室间轻松转移的机器人套件。它包括一个机器人手臂、实验室设备（如培养箱、带盖的试剂瓶和培养皿）、现有的手臂移动代码、我们记录的每个任务的远程操作演示，以及一个通用的AGENTS.md技能文件。生物实验者可以提供自然语言任务，而无需收集本地远程操作训练数据或训练神经网络。编码代理观察本地实验室并编写和执行程序，必要时使用外部工具进行适应。我们展示了WetRobo在三个成功任务中的应用：打开培养皿盖、取下瓶盖和打开培养箱门，均在真实实验室中完成。编码代理在实验室X和实验室Y均成功完成瓶盖任务，而在实验室X微调的VLA在实验室X成功，但未能转移到实验室Y。这些结果为实验室机器人提供了实用的解决方案。
items.abstract: Automating biological research requires general-purpose, reproducible robot systems that allow individual wet-lab researchers to delegate robot tasks without performing teleoperation or neural-network training. Vision-language-action policies have been proposed for general-purpose arms, but can lose performance when their operating environment changes. We therefore built WetRobo, a robot kit that can readily transfer between laboratories. It consists of one robot arm, laboratory equipment (an incubator, a reagent bottle with a cap, and a Petri dish), the existing code that moves the arm, teleoperation demonstrations of each task that we recorded, and a general AGENTS.md skill file. A biological experimentalist provides natural-language tasks without collecting local teleoperation training data or training a neural network. The coding agent observes the local laboratory and writes and executes programs, using external tools as needed for adaptation. We demonstrate use of WetRobo with OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) on three successful tasks: lifting a Petri dish lid, removing a bottle cap, and opening the incubator door, all in real-world laboratories. The coding agent achieved the cap t
items.authors: Yuna Oikawa, Kei Endo, Takanori Uzawa, Yunzhe Zhang, Manan Anjaria, Lerrel Pinto, Sherry Yang, Koji Tsuda

items.title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning for Differential Diagnosis on Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 超曲面图表示学习在生物医学知识图中的应用
items.summary_zh: 生物医学知识图结合了本体派生的层次结构与异构实体（如表型、疾病、基因、蛋白质和患者）之间的横向关联。本文探讨了超曲面嵌入在超越纯层次图的情况下是否仍然有效。我们对患者整合的生物医学图进行了孟德尔疾病的差异诊断的初步研究。实验结果表明，超曲面模型在显著低维度下的表现优于欧几里得基线。随后，我们在一个链接预测任务中评估了这些模型，该任务为每位患者排名候选疾病。结果表明，超曲面嵌入能够利用生物医学的层次结构，同时支持对异构患者级图的诊断推理。
items.abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs combine ontology-derived hierarchies with transversal associations among heterogeneous entities such as phenotypes, diseases, genes, proteins, and patients. This hybrid structure raises the question of whether hyperbolic embeddings, which naturally capture tree-like organization, remain useful beyond purely hierarchical graphs. We present a preliminary study of hyperbolic graph representation learning for Mendelian-disease differential diagnosis on a patient-integrated biomedical graph. Experiments on isolated ontology subgraphs show that hyperbolic models achieve strong performance in substantially lower dimensions than Euclidean baselines. We then evaluate the models on a link-prediction task that ranks candidate diseases for each patient. Results suggest that hyperbolic embeddings can exploit biomedical hierarchical structure while supporting diagnostic reasoning over heterogeneous patient-level graphs.
items.authors: Pietro Miotto, Lucia Mellini, Tommaso Marzi, Cesare Alippi, Elena Casiraghi, Alberto Paccanaro, Giorgio Valentini, Mauricio Soto-Gomez

items.title: The Uneven Impact of Generative AI on Student Learning: Examining the Roles of Reliance, Evaluation Literacy, and Course Policy in AI-related Courses
items.title_zh: 生成性人工智能对学生学习的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生成性人工智能（GenAI）对学生学习的影响，重点分析了课程背景、认知依赖、评估素养和早期依赖等因素。我们通过对118名学生在12门AI相关课程中的调查反馈进行分析，识别出四类用户群体：高使用者报告了许多好处，轻度使用者则报告了较少的依赖和好处，另外两个中度使用群体则表现出不同的收益水平。研究发现，免费版与付费版用户、单一工具与多工具用户之间存在显著差异。多变量回归模型显示，学术收益与早期依赖和学术任务支持相关；积极影响与认知依赖、学术任务支持、对GenAI可靠性的信心及教师政策相关；而负面影响则与早期依赖和态度变化相关。随着评估素养的提高，早期依赖与负面影响之间的关联变得更强。总体来看，GenAI增强学习的感知反映了认知、表现和自我效能的好处，而对压力和批判性思维下降的担忧则与较低的学习收益感知相关。
items.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is changing how students learn, yet the roles of course context, cognitive reliance, evaluation literacy, and early reliance remain underexplored. Using survey responses from 118 students across 12 AI-related courses at our institution, we examined differences in GenAI use and perceived learning experiences. We identified four user clusters: high-use students reporting many benefits, light users reporting less reliance and fewer benefits, and two moderate-use groups reporting different levels of benefit. We also found significant differences between free- and premium-version users, single- and multiple-tool users, and students experiencing different instructor policies. In multivariable regression models, academic benefit was associated with early reliance and academic task support; positive impact was associated with cognitive reliance, academic task support, confidence in GenAI reliability, and instructor policy; and negative impact was associated with early reliance and attitudinal change. items.authors: Lydia Manikonda, Mei Si, Sirajam Munira, Oshani Seneviratne, Kristin Bennett

items.title: WARD: Runtime Workload-Adaptive Vision TRansformer Framework for Dependable Edge AI
items.title_zh: WARD：适应运行时负载的可靠边缘AI视觉变换器框架
items.summary_zh: 边缘部署的AI在动态变化的功耗预算、可靠性要求和输入分布下运行，需要持续适应。这种情况出现在长期运行的边缘AI应用中，如自主系统、工业监测和卫星智能。现有的容错方法假设操作条件静态，而持续学习技术在在线适应过程中忽视了并发硬件故障。此外，运行时自适应可靠性框架在可编程AI加速器上的实际部署尚未得到充分探索。本文提出了WARD，一个运行时自适应的视觉变换器框架，结合了通道级子网络划分、可靠性感知的持续学习和动态操作模式调度，以根据运行时条件共同优化性能、容错和适应性。两个物理隔离的子网络在四种操作模式下执行（即全精度模式、低功耗模式、高可靠性模式和自适应模式），动态调整计算成本和可靠性，同时确保实时需求下的不间断推理。为了验证该框架的实际可部署性，WARD在一个轻量级FPGA加速器上实现，并扩展了运行时硬件支持以进行模式调度和资源管理。
items.abstract: Edge-deployed AI operate under dynamically changing power budgets, reliability requirements, and input distributions, requiring continuous adaptation. Such conditions arise in long-running edge AI applications, including autonomous systems, industrial monitoring, and satellite onboard intelligence. Existing fault-tolerant methods assume static operating conditions, whereas continual learning techniques neglect concurrent hardware faults during online adaptation. Moreover, the practical deployment of runtime-adaptive reliability frameworks on programmable AI accelerators remains largely unexplored. This paper presents WARD, a runtime-adaptive Vision Transformer framework that combines channel-wise subnetwork partitioning, reliability-aware continual learning, and dynamic operating-mode scheduling to jointly optimize performance, fault tolerance, and adaptation according to runtime conditions. Two physically isolated subnetworks execute under four operating modes (i.e. Full-Precision Mode, Low-Power Mode, High-Reliability Mode, and Adaptive Mode) that dynamically adjust computational cost and reliability while ensuring uninterrupted inference for real-time requirements. items.authors: Mahdi Taheri, Pramit Kumar Bhaduri, Mohammad Masoumi, Ali Mahani

items.title: QiT: Quantum-Inspired Transformer for Visual Recognition Task
items.title_zh: QiT：用于视觉识别任务的量子启发变换器
items.summary_zh: 量子机器学习提供了一种引人注目的表示视角：角度编码状态栖息于希尔伯特空间中，自然表达周期性相似性和交互。然而，将这一视角应用于视觉识别仍然困难，因为现有的量子神经网络受限于有限的量子比特数量、昂贵的电路模拟和测量、噪声以及在噪声中间规模量子设备上的不稳定优化。我们探讨了是否可以将量子模型中的有用结构思想转化为可扩展的经典变换器操作。我们提出了QiT，一种用于视觉任务的量子启发变换器，包含三个组件：（i）角度启发编码，将图像标记映射到类似于量子旋转状态编码的学习三角函数希尔伯特空间特征；（ii）对这些周期性特征的自注意力，诱导出经典余弦核，近似于量子保真核；（iii）门控乘法仿真，作为变分电路中交互项的可训练经典替代。所有组件均为可微分张量操作，因此QiT不声称具备量子计算或量子加速，并保持标准视觉变换器的$\mathcal{O}(N^2D)$注意力复杂度。在图像分类基准测试中，QiT与匹配的经典变换器具有竞争力。
items.abstract: Quantum machine learning offers a compelling representational perspective: angle-encoded states inhabit Hilbert spaces in which periodic similarities and interactions can be expressed naturally. Realizing this perspective for visual recognition remains difficult, however, because present quantum neural networks are constrained by limited qubit counts, costly circuit simulation and measurement, noise, and unstable optimization on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. We investigate whether useful structural ideas from quantum models can instead be realized as scalable classical Transformer operations. We introduce QiT, a Quantum-inspired Transformer for vision tasks with three components: (i) angle-inspired encoding that maps image tokens to learned trigonometric Hilbert-space features analogous to quantum rotation-based state encoding; (ii) self-attention over these periodic features, inducing a classical cosine kernel approximated to quantum fidelity kernels; and (iii) gated multiplicative emulation, a trainable classical surrogate for interaction terms found in variational circuits. All components are differentiable tensor operations, so QiT claims neither quantum computation
items.authors: Badri N. Patro, Vijay Agneeswaran

items.title: Does AI Assistance Leave a Temporal Fingerprint? Detecting Overreliance in AI-Assisted Writing and Programming
items.title_zh: AI辅助写作与编程的时间特征分析
items.summary_zh: 随着生成性人工智能的快速普及，最终成果已不再可靠地反映学生学习情况，单纯依赖成品的AI检测器存在不准确和伦理争议。本文探讨AI辅助是否具有时间特征，是否能从写作推广到编程，以及是否能区分普通协作与完全委托。我们分析了三个公共语料库：CoAuthor（1,447次击键级别的协作写作）、RealHumanEval（243名程序员的编辑遥测）和一个人类基线的CS1语料库（510万击键），比较了最小AI工作、协作AI使用和模拟完全委托。研究发现：AI贡献在两种媒介中均以突发形式出现，且在写作中93%的AI插入字符保留至最终文档，而编程中仅14%的代码建议完整保留。使用可观察的时间特征的分类器几乎完美地区分模拟委托与真实工作，而普通协作与无辅助工作之间的区分仍然困难。
items.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative AI has made final artifacts unreliable evidence of student learning, and AI detectors that examine only the finished product are inaccurate and ethically contentious. Process data offers an alternative, but prior work covers only English essay writing. We ask whether AI assistance carries a temporal signature, whether it generalizes from writing to programming, and whether it distinguishes ordinary collaboration from wholesale delegation. We analyze three public corpora: CoAuthor (1,447 keystroke-level co-writing sessions), RealHumanEval (editor telemetry from 243 programmer records), and a pre-LLM CS1 corpus (5.1 million keystrokes) as a human-only baseline, comparing minimal-AI work, collaborative AI use, and simulated wholesale delegation. Three findings emerge. First, the signature generalizes: AI contributions arrive in bursts far outside the author's own baseline in both mediums (paired d_z = 1.13 and 3.54). Second, engagement diverges by medium: 93% of AI-inserted characters survived to writers' final documents, while only 14% of accepted code suggestions survived intact. items.authors: Eduardo Davalos, Yike Zhang

items.title: Whom Do AI Agents Work For? Role Assignment Induces Sponsorship Bias in LLM Recommenders
items.title_zh: AI代理的服务对象：角色分配引发的赞助偏见
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）作为购物助手在广告销售平台上运作，面临职责冲突。它们为依赖其判断的消费者提供建议，但又受益于选择赞助列表的平台。赞助披露本应让消费者惩罚付费展示，但现在却传递给了AI代理，且代理对其的评估对消费者是隐蔽的。基于受托人职责冲突的概念，我们认为代理对赞助列表的评估不应依赖于其部署方。在受控选择实验中，我们通过系统提示中的角色分配，分别将旅行者或预订平台指定为代理的委托方。平台委托显著减弱了代理对赞助列表的惩罚，并削弱了披露在其推理过程中的怀疑。我们在不同的LLMs和推理深度中重复了这一发现。第二项研究分解了披露标签，结果显示，当付费展示归因于平台时，两者之间的差异显著扩大。更严格的术语（“赞助”而非“推广”）降低了付费列表的选择，但在提及平台时并未缩小这一差距。研究结果表明，披露要求存在偏见。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as conversational shopping assistants on platforms that also sell advertising. These AI agents face a conflict of duty. They advise consumers who rely on their judgment, yet are deployed by platforms that benefit when sponsored listings are chosen. Sponsorship disclosures, designed to allow consumers to penalize paid placements, now reach the AI agent rather than the consumer, and the agent's evaluation of them is hidden from the consumer. Drawing on the fiduciary concept of conflict of duty, we argue that an agent's evaluation of a sponsored listing should not depend on which party deployed it. In controlled choice experiments, we manipulate assigned roles in the system prompt to name either a traveler or a booking platform as the agent's principal. Platform delegation significantly attenuates the penalty that agents apply to sponsored listings and weakens the skepticism that disclosure triggers in their reasoning traces. We replicate out findings across LLMs and reasoning depths. A second study decomposes the disclosure label and shows that the divergence between the two delegates widens significantly when the paid placement is attributed to
items.authors: Davood Wadi, Yu Ma

items.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cost-Efficient Large Language Models on Algorithmic Programming Tasks
items.title_zh: 对成本效益大型语言模型在算法编程任务中的实证评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究实证评估了成本效益大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成符合书面规范的企业代码方面的可靠性。研究中使用了三种模型（Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini 和 Claude Haiku 4.5），要求其解决992个算法问题，生成符合特定签名和数据传输对象规范的Java Spring Boot服务方法。通过四种模型和代理编码工具组合及两种提示变体，形成八种配置，禁止迭代和硬编码答案。研究中保留了八个问题陈述，以探讨模型对缺失输入的反应。结果生成的7593个方法被分类为八类结果分类，执行后共测得7936个请求。结构符合率接近上限，但38.4%的方法未计算返回值，仅12.9%的返回答案正确。结果表明，响应的可靠性与正确性呈负相关，真正计算的方法回答最少且正确率为19.3%。研究的局限性包括每种配置仅进行单次生成、部分覆盖、单次计时、语法分类及可能的语料污染。
items.abstract: This study empirically evaluates whether cost-efficient Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trusted to generate enterprise code to a written specification. Three models (Gemini Flash 3, GPT-5.4 mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) were asked to solve 992 algorithmic problems as Java Spring Boot service methods conforming to a mandated signature and data-transfer-object specification, crossing four model and agentic coding tool combinations with two prompt variants to yield eight configurations, with iteration forbidden and hardcoded answers explicitly prohibited. Eight problem statements were withheld to probe how models respond to missing input. The 7,593 resulting methods were classified by an eight-class outcome taxonomy describing what each does about producing an answer, then deployed and executed, giving 7,936 measured requests joined to that classification. Structural conformance approached ceiling, yet 38.4% of methods do not compute the value they returned and only 12.9% of returned answers were correct. Conditioning on outcome class shows that response reliability and correctness are inversely related, whereas genuinely computing methods answered least often and were correct 19.3%.
items.authors: Chandimal Adikari, Nandika Herath

items.title: A Comprehensive Review of Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence
items.title_zh: 生成物理人工智能的综合评述
items.summary_zh: 大规模基础模型与物理实体的结合推动了机器人技术的重大进展，称为生成物理人工智能（GPAI）。这些自主智能系统能够在复杂的现实环境中感知、推理和行动。本文全面分析了GPAI系统，重点关注其架构基础、当前应用及主要限制。我们提出了五种不同的方法分类：跨平台技能转移的机器人基础模型（RFM）；端到端多模态感知与控制的视觉-语言行动（VLA）模型；类人运动生成的大行为模型（LBM）；基于扩散模型的时间一致行动生成的扩散政策模型（DPM）；以及符合物理规律的模拟与数据生成的世界基础模型（WFM）。我们探讨了这些方法之间的互补关系，并通过自主车辆、工业自动化、医疗机器人和类人系统的实例，识别出显著的性能提升，并总结了在数据高效学习、模拟到现实转移、边缘兼容架构和安全框架等方面的有前景的研究方向。
items.abstract: The integration of large-scale foundation models with physical embodiments has led to significant advancements in robotics known as Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence (GPAI). These agentic AI systems autonomously perceive, reason, and act in complex real-world situations. This survey comprehensively analyzes GPAI systems, focusing on their architectural foundations, current applications, and key limitations. We introduce a taxonomy of five distinct approaches: Robot Foundation Models (RFMs) for cross-platform skill transfer; Vision-Language Action (VLA) models for end-to-end multi-modal perception and control; Large Behavior Models (LBMs) for human-like movement generation; Diffusion Policy Models (DPMs) for diffusion model-based temporally coherent action generation; and World Foundation Models (WFMs) for physics-compliant simulation and data generation. We examine how these approaches complement each other: WFMs generate training data for VLAs and DPMs, RFMs enable cross-platform deployment of learned policies, while LBMs provide motion priors for natural behavior. Through examples across autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, healthcare robotics, and humanoid syste
items.authors: Satyam Gaba, Krutiksinh Rana, Siva Sai, Vinay Chamola, Dusit Niyato

items.title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
items.title_zh: 重新思考健康人工智能方法进展的评估方式
items.summary_zh: 电子健康记录（EHR）中人工智能（AI）方法的进展依赖于我们判断哪些算法在何种条件下表现更佳。然而，重现性差和临床意义评估任务定义困难被认为是阻碍进展的因素。我们通过在共享评估框架内重新实现12个历史和近期算法，并在两个临床数据集（MIMIC-IV和NWICU）上进行评估，实证研究这些障碍。我们比较了两类互补任务：专家编写的临床意义任务和从随机抽样事件代码及预测时间范围生成的任务。结果显示，聚合的成对比较在评估设置间强烈转移，包括从随机生成任务到临床意义任务及跨数据集。同时，临床意义任务表现出更大的任务-方法交互，初步证据表明任务属性可以帮助解释特定建模选择的优势。最后，新算法并未始终优于早期算法。
items.abstract: Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method i
items.authors: Florent Pollet, Matthew McDermott

items.title: Beyond Accuracy: How Procedural Traces Shift the Decision Criterion of LLM Overseers
items.title_zh: 超越准确性：程序性痕迹如何影响大型语言模型监督者的决策标准
items.summary_zh: 组织越来越多地使用监督循环，其中一个大型语言模型（LLM）审计另一个模型的输出，并结合所声称步骤的程序性痕迹。关于这种LLM作为评判者的流程，普遍担忧详细的痕迹会使监督者变得轻信。我们使用信号检测理论，对五个LLM监督者在19个合规任务中进行审计（分析了4,551个判断），仅改变痕迹细节和证据标记。在始终可见的反驳证据下，错误检测保持在接近上限。相反，复杂的痕迹将决策标准向拒绝倾斜，导致易受影响的监督者增加误报。没有选项标签时，人为验证的理由编码显示约60%的误报引用无法将证据与选项联系起来。标签消除了这一表述原因，但在这些监督者中，正确工作的残余拒绝仍然存在，并随着痕迹细节的增加而上升。因此，程序性痕迹作为治理工具影响监督决策。AI审计员应根据其决策标准和误报行为进行评估，而不仅仅是准确性。
items.abstract: Organizations increasingly use oversight loops where one large language model (LLM) audits another's outputs alongside procedural traces of claimed steps. A common concern about such LLM-as-a-judge pipelines is that detailed traces make overseers gullible. Using signal detection theory, we audit five LLM overseers on 19 compliance tasks (4,551 analyzed judgments), varying only trace detail and evidence labeling. With disconfirming evidence always visible, error detection remains near ceiling. Instead, elaborate traces shift the decision criterion toward rejection, increasing false alarms in susceptible overseers. Without option labels, human-validated reason coding shows about 60% of false alarms cite an inability to tie evidence to its option. Labels eliminate this stated reason, yet residual rejection of correct work persists in those overseers and rises with trace detail. Procedural traces thus act as governance artifacts that shape oversight decisions. AI auditors should be evaluated by their decision criterion and false-alarm behavior, alongside accuracy.
items.authors: Zihan Chen, Di Zhu, Lei Zheng, Weiling Li

items.title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
items.title_zh: 轻量级CNN集成紧凑卷积变换器用于乳腺癌影像检测与分类
items.summary_zh: 近年来，卷积神经网络（CNN）在医学影像的癌症检测与分类中表现出强大的能力。然而，基于CNN的模型在捕捉长距离上下文依赖方面常常面临挑战。本文提出在CCT层后集成紧凑卷积变换器（CCT）架构，使得CNN提取的特征能够通过CCT标记器重塑为紧凑的补丁标记，并添加位置嵌入以保留空间结构。通过5折交叉验证，模型在3组乳腺癌乳腺摄影数据集上测试，参数仅为250,435，准确率达到99%-100%，显示出良好的泛化能力。模型中集成了解释性人工智能（XAI），以增强临床信任。结果表明，所提出的框架适用于计算机辅助诊断系统，尤其是在资源受限的临床环境中。该模型通过将卷积标记化与基于变换器的学习相结合，克服了CNN在最后几层的梯度衰减限制。
items.abstract: Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. items.authors: Md Taimur Ahad (Department of Management North South University, Dhaka, Bangladesh), Ainuddin Ahmed (Department of Management North South University, Dhaka, Bangladesh)

items.title: I code or AI code: A comparative evaluation of AI-rated scores in classroom observations
items.title_zh: AI评分与人工评分：课堂观察的比较评估
items.summary_zh: 课堂观察被广泛认为是评估教育质量和指导教学改进的重要工具，但其资源消耗大且依赖训练有素的观察者。本研究评估了使用大型语言模型（GPT-5）对香港30所幼儿园38个班级的87段视频观察进行评分的可行性，并与人工评分进行了对比。研究采用了课堂评估评分系统（CLASS）框架，分析了AI评分与人类评分在CLASS领域和维度的相关性及均值差异。结果显示，AI与评分者在情感支持领域，特别是在反馈质量维度上有较高的一致性，而在课堂组织和教学支持领域的程序性或情境依赖互动中则存在较大差异。这些发现表明，基于转录的AI评分能够捕捉教师与儿童互动的相对变化，但尚无法在整个CLASS框架中一致地再现经过校准的人类判断。
items.abstract: Classroom observations are widely recognized as a key tool for establishing benchmarks of education quality and guiding pedagogical improvement, yet they remain resource-intensive and dependent on trained observers. This study evaluated the feasibility of using a LLM (GPT-5 model) to score teacher-child interactions in early childhood classrooms, benchmarked against human raters. The study analyzed 87 video-recorded observations from 38 classrooms across 30 kindergartens in Hong Kong. Using observation transcripts, the AI model was configured to apply the full Classroom Assessment Scoring System (CLASS) framework. AI-rated scores were then compared with human ratings by examining correlations and differences in mean scores of the CLASS domains and dimensions. The results showed greater convergence between AI and raters for the Emotional Support domain and, in particular, the Quality of Feedback dimension, which captures how teachers use feedback to extend children's learning. Greater divergence emerged for interactions that were more procedural or context-dependent, particularly within the Classroom Organization and Instructional Support domains. items.authors: Y. Fong, J. Xiang, T. Y. D. Chan, K. Lee, E. Y. H. Lau

items.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
items.title_zh: PACT：企业AI助手在压力下的可信度研究
items.summary_zh: 随着企业AI的不断普及，企业级大语言模型（LLM）代理被应用于招聘、医疗和金融等敏感领域。在这些领域，遵守代理系统上下文中规定的规则是首要的法律问题。目前尚无系统评估框架来测量哪些LLM模型在压力下（如持续用户、匆忙管理者或便利情况下）倾向于违反合规规则。我们提出了PACT（压力下合规测试），这是一个针对AI助手在十二个受监管企业领域和四十八种场景中遵循规则的基准测试。每个基准项目将现有规则与违反规则的捷径进行对比，并在不同措辞和系统提示模式下施加压力。我们在严格的LLM审计下逐步构建PACT，以确保样本明确、不可操控且足够真实，避免引发评估意识行为。PACT用于评估LLM在压力下的合规性，涵盖六个互补指标，全面反映AI助手在多轮对话中的稳健性、透明性及正确识别规则适用性的能力。
items.abstract: As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. items.authors: Mika Okamoto, Ansel Kaplan Erol

items.title: NeuroECG: ECGFounder-Based Deep ECG Representation for EEG-Free Neurological Prognostication After Cardiac Arrest
items.title_zh: NeuroECG：基于ECGFounder的深度ECG表示用于心脏骤停后的神经预后
items.summary_zh: 心脏骤停后的神经预后通常依赖于脑电图（EEG），但EEG需要高临床资源。床边心电图（ECG）标准且成本低，但其在预测神经结果方面的价值尚未充分探索。本研究提出NeuroECG，一种基于ECGFounder的深度表示框架，用于无EEG辅助预后。NeuroECG通过任务特定的微调适应预训练的ECG基础模型。我们在单通道床边监测ECG上实施逐步解冻策略。每位患者的多个ECG片段被编码为片段级深度特征。这些嵌入通过分位数池化（$q = 0.24$）聚合，并使用主成分分析（PCA）压缩。对来自多中心I-CARE数据库的412名ECG可用患者的实验表明，适应的ECGFounder骨干在ECG单一骨干基线中表现最佳，测试AUROC为0.7333。进一步将学习到的深度ECG表示与静态临床协变量结合，NeuroECG模型的测试AUROC达到0.8077，AUPRC为0.8970。这些结果支持深度床边ECG表示作为有用的辅助预后信息来源，其与静态临床协变量的结合在无EEG环境中提高了预测能力。源代码可在h获取。
items.abstract: Neurological prognostication after cardiac arrest commonly relies on electroencephalography (EEG). However, EEG demands high clinical resources. Bedside electrocardiography (ECG) is standard and low-cost. Yet, its value for predicting neurological outcomes remains underexplored. In this study, we propose NeuroECG, an ECGFounder-based deep representation framework for EEG-free auxiliary prognostication. NeuroECG adapts a pretrained ECG foundation model via task-specific fine-tuning. We implement a gradual unfreezing strategy on single-channel bedside monitoring ECG. Multiple ECG segments per patient are encoded into segment-level deep features. These embeddings are aggregated via quantile pooling ($q = 0.24$) and compressed using principal component analysis (PCA). Experiments on 412 ECG-available patients from the multicenter I-CARE database show that the adapted ECGFounder backbone achieves the best performance among ECG-only backbone baselines, with a test AUROC of 0.7333. We further combine the learned deep ECG representation with static clinical covariates. The proposed NeuroECG model achieves a test AUROC of 0.8077 and an AUPRC of 0.8970. These results support deep bedside ECG
items.authors: Jiaju Gao, Yi Zhao, Chenyang Xu, Yuxi Zhou, Hao Wang

items.title: Automated Dental Caries Segmentation in Panoramic Radiographs Using Dual-Stage Deep Learning
items.title_zh: 基于双阶段深度学习的全景X光自动龋齿分割
items.summary_zh: 早期龋齿检测面临传统诊断方法的局限，尤其是后牙的邻接病变。深度学习模型在自动龋齿检测中展现出潜力，但因需大量专家标注的训练数据而面临可扩展性限制。本研究提出了一种双阶段深度学习框架，结合Faster R-CNN进行牙齿定位，使用U-Net进行全景X光的像素级龋齿分割。我们开发了系统转换管道，将大规模多边形标注数据集转换为高分辨率二值分割掩膜，实现像素级监督学习。该框架使用专家验证的数据集和来自3000张全景图像的算法处理标签进行训练。我们的方案表现出色，IoU为0.9013，Dice系数为0.9482，召回率为0.9433，精确率为0.9774，显示出比现有方法更高的准确性，同时显著降低了假阳性率。双阶段框架有效解决了牙科AI应用中的数据标注瓶颈，展示了可扩展的自动龋齿检测系统的潜力，有助于提高诊断一致性并支持临床决策。
items.abstract: Early detection of dental caries remains challenging due to limitations in traditional diagnostic methods, particularly for proximal lesions in posterior teeth. Deep learning models show promise for automated caries detection but face scalability constraints due to requirements for large volumes of expertly annotated training data. This study presents a dual-stage deep learning framework combining Faster R-CNN for tooth localization with U-Net for pixel-wise caries segmentation in panoramic radiographs. We developed a systematic transformation pipeline to convert large-scale polygon-annotated datasets into high-resolution binary segmentation masks, enabling pixel-wise supervised learning. The framework was trained using both expert-verified datasets and algorithmically processed labels from 3,000 panoramic images. Our approach achieved robust performance with an IoU of 0.9013, Dice coefficient of 0.9482, Recall of 0.9433, and Precision of 0.9774, demonstrating superior accuracy compared to existing methods while significantly reducing false-positive rates.
