items.authors: Jihun Kim, Kyeonghun Kim, Jong-yeol Lee, Yeongseok Seo, Dohyun Chun

items.title: Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification
items.title_zh: 城市土地覆盖分类的表格深度学习与经典机器学习比较
items.summary_zh: 城市土地覆盖（ULC）分类在城市规划、环境监测和可持续发展中至关重要。我们使用来自UCI机器学习库的ULC数据集进行研究，该数据集包含来自高分辨率航空影像的表格特征，涵盖九个类别（如道路、树木、草地、水体）。该数据集面临高维度、异构特征和类别不平衡等典型遥感挑战。在统一、可重复的流程中，我们将经典机器学习模型（如逻辑回归、支持向量机、随机森林、XGBoost、CatBoost）与表格深度学习（TDL）模型（TabNet、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer、TabSeq和1D CNN）进行基准测试。为了解决类别不平衡问题，我们对TDL模型采用加权交叉熵损失，并使用准确率、宏观精确率、宏观召回率、宏观F1、AUC-ROC和混淆矩阵评估性能。结果表明，尽管树集成模型仍然是强有力的基线，但在非线性交互显著且不平衡处理有效时，TDL模型能够匹配或超越其性能，为城市土地覆盖映射提供了互补优势。
items.abstract: Urban Land Cover (ULC) classification plays a crucial role in urban planning, environmental monitoring, and sustainable development. We study this task using the ULC dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, which includes tabular features derived from high-resolution aerial imagery across nine classes (e.g., roads, trees, grass, water). The dataset presents typical remote sensing challenges, including high dimensionality, heterogeneous features, and class imbalance. In a unified, reproducible pipeline, we benchmark classical machine learning models (e.g., Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost) against Tabular Deep Learning (TDL) models (TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabTransformer, TabSeq, and 1D CNNs). To address class imbalance, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss for TDL models and evaluate performance using accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, AUC-ROC, and confusion matrices. Our results show that while tree ensembles remain strong general baselines, TDL models can match or exceed their performance when non-linear interactions are significant and imbalance handling is effective, providing complementary advantages for urban land cover mapp
items.authors: Muntasir Tabasum, Tanpia Tasnim, Md. Ekramul Islam, Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib

items.title: Prepared Or Unprepared? Evaluating Healthcare Workforce Readiness for Clinical Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Nigeria
items.title_zh: 尼日利亚医疗工作力对人工智能临床应用的准备评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了尼日利亚761名医疗专业人员对人工智能（AI）的认知、态度、准备情况及其采用障碍。数据通过结构化的验证问卷于2025年12月至2026年3月间收集。结果显示，医疗领域对AI的总体认知较高（92.6%），但客观知识和自我报告的准备情况有限，40.9%的人表示知识水平低或非常低，仅63.0%的人感到准备充分。对AI的采用意愿高，92.5%的人表示有兴趣接受培训，78.7%支持在本科课程中纳入AI教育。主要障碍包括缺乏培训（84.7%）、基础设施差（71.1%）、AI工具成本高（61.0%）、对失业的恐惧（60.6%）、伦理问题（52.9%）和数据隐私问题（52.7%）。不同地缘政治区域的准备情况存在显著差异（卡方(5) = 24.28, p < 0.001），不同专业群体的认知也存在显著差异（卡方(6) = 68.38, p < 0.001）。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare systems worldwide, yet its successful clinical adoption depends critically on workforce readiness, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where infrastructural and training gaps persist. This cross-sectional study evaluated awareness, attitudes, preparedness, and barriers to AI adoption among 761 healthcare professionals across multiple disciplines and practice settings in Nigeria. Data were collected between December 2025 and March 2026 using a structured, validated questionnaire. Overall awareness of AI in healthcare was high (92.6%); however, objective knowledge and self-reported preparedness remained limited, with 40.9% reporting low or very low knowledge and only 63.0% feeling adequately prepared. Willingness to adopt AI was high: 92.5% expressed interest in training, and 78.7% supported inclusion of AI education in undergraduate curricula. Key barriers included lack of training (84.7%), poor infrastructure (71.1%), high cost of AI tools (61.0%), fear of job displacement (60.6%), ethical concerns (52.9%), and data privacy concerns (52.7%). items.title: rMuscle: Robotic Muscle Memory for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference
items.title_zh: rMuscle：高效视觉-语言-动作模型推理的机器人肌肉记忆
items.summary_zh: 工厂工作是具身人工智能的一个有前景的早期场景：将重复的手工工作分配给机器人具有明显的经济效益，结构化的工作站使得这些工作适合当前的政策。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型现在主导了这些机器人的政策范式。VLA模型的推理延迟直接影响机器人的响应能力和运动平滑性。然而，现有的VLA推理框架未能充分利用具身工作负载的特性，也未考虑VLA推理不同阶段的独特瓶颈。本文首先对具身工作负载进行特征描述，并识别出重复机器人执行之间的显著任务相似性。我们进一步发现，这种相似性不仅限于观察和动作轨迹，还扩展到内部模型状态。基于这些观察，我们提出了rMuscle，一个受人类肌肉记忆启发的实时VLA推理框架。它通过双阶段肌肉记忆缓存利用跨执行相似性。上下文缓存重用视觉标记输出以减少计算，而动作缓存重用神经元激活模式以减少权重访问。我们通过在线缓存重新计算、滑动窗口缓存检索和连续去噪步骤之间的掩码共享，保持缓存内存占用和访问开销较低。rMuscle在推理速度上实现了1.29-1.42倍的加速。
items.abstract: Factory work is a promising early scenario for embodied AI: assigning repetitive manual jobs to robots has clear economic payoff, and a structured station keeps the jobs tractable for current policies. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models now dominate as the policy paradigm for these robots. The inference latency of VLA models directly affects robot responsiveness and motion smoothness. However, existing VLA inference frameworks do not fully exploit the characteristics of embodied workloads or account for the distinct bottlenecks across different stages of VLA inference. In this paper, we first characterize embodied workloads and identify substantial task similarity across repeated robot executions. We further find that such similarity extends beyond observations and action trajectories to internal model states. Drawing on these observations, we present rMuscle, a real-time VLA inference framework inspired by human muscle memory. It exploits cross-execution similarity through a dual-phase muscle-memory cache. The Context Cache reuses visual-token outputs to reduce computation, while the Action Cache reuses neuron activation patterns to reduce weight accesses. We keep both the cache

items.title: A Survey on Bridging EEG Signals and Generative AI: From Image and Text to Beyond
items.title_zh: 脑电信号与生成性人工智能的桥接研究综述
items.summary_zh: 将神经活动解码为人类可理解的表示是脑机接口（BCIs）和计算神经科学的关键研究方向。近年来，机器学习和生成性人工智能的进展引发了对将非侵入性脑电图（EEG）信号转化为图像、文本和音频的兴趣。本综述整合并分析了EEG到图像合成、EEG到文本生成和EEG到音频重建的研究进展。我们对主要数据库进行了结构化文献检索（2017-2025），提取了数据集、生成架构（GANs、VAEs、变换器、扩散模型）、EEG特征编码技术、评估指标及当前研究面临的主要挑战等关键信息。结果发现，EEG到图像模型主要采用基于GANs、VAEs或扩散模型的编码-解码架构；EEG到文本方法越来越多地利用基于变换器的语言模型进行开放词汇解码；EEG到音频方法通常将EEG信号映射到梅尔谱图，并使用神经声码器将其渲染为音频。尽管取得了一些进展，但该领域仍受限于小型和异质数据集、有限的跨个体泛化能力以及缺乏标准化基准。
items.abstract: Decoding neural activity into human-interpretable representations is a key research direction in brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and computational neuroscience. Recent progress in machine learning and generative AI has driven growing interest in transforming non-invasive Electroencephalography (EEG) signals into images, text, and audio. This survey consolidates and analyzes developments across EEG-to-image synthesis, EEG-to-text generation, and EEG-to-audio reconstruction. We conducted a structured literature search across major databases (2017-2025), extracting key information on datasets, generative architectures (GANs, VAEs, transformers, diffusion models), EEG feature-encoding techniques, evaluation metrics, and the major challenges shaping current work in this area. Our review finds that EEG-to-image models predominantly employ encoder-decoder architectures built on GANs, VAEs, or diffusion models; EEG-to-text approaches increasingly leverage transformer-based language models for open-vocabulary decoding; and EEG-to-audio methods commonly map EEG signals to mel-spectrograms that are subsequently rendered into audio using neural vocoders. items.title: BOOM: Benchmarking Out-Of-distribution Molecular Property Predictions of Machine Learning Models
items.title_zh: BOOM：机器学习模型分布外分子性质预测基准评估
items.summary_zh: 数据驱动的分子发现利用人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）和生成建模来筛选和设计新分子。发现新分子需要准确的分布外（OOD）预测，但机器学习模型在OOD上泛化能力较弱。目前尚无系统的分子OOD预测基准。我们提出了$\mathbf{BOOM}$，即分布外分子性质预测的基准：一个针对常见分子性质预测任务的化学信息基准。我们评估了150多个模型-任务组合，以基准深度学习模型的OOD性能。结果显示，没有现有模型在所有任务上实现强泛化：即使是表现最好的模型，其平均OOD误差也比在分布内高出3倍。目前的化学基础模型在OOD外推方面表现不佳，而具有高归纳偏置的模型在简单特定性质的OOD任务上表现良好。我们进行了广泛的消融实验，强调数据生成、预训练、超参数优化、模型架构和分子表示对OOD性能的影响。开发具有强OOD泛化能力的模型是化学机器学习的新挑战。该开源基准可在https://github.com/获取。
items.abstract: Data-driven molecular discovery leverages artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) and generative modeling to filter and design novel molecules. Discovering novel molecules requires accurate out-of-distribution (OOD) predictions, but ML models struggle to generalize OOD. Currently, no systematic benchmarks exist for molecular OOD prediction tasks. We present $\mathbf{BOOM}$, $\mathbf{b}$enchmarks for $\mathbf{o}$ut-$\mathbf{o}$f-distribution $\mathbf{m}$olecular property predictions: a chemically-informed benchmark for OOD performance on common molecular property prediction tasks. We evaluate over 150 model-task combinations to benchmark deep learning models on OOD performance. Overall, we find that no existing model achieves strong generalization across all tasks: even the top-performing model exhibited an average OOD error 3x higher than in-distribution. Current chemical foundation models do not show strong OOD extrapolation, while models with high inductive bias can perform well on OOD tasks with simple, specific properties. items.title: Algorithmic Shortlisting in Participatory Budgeting
items.title_zh: 参与式预算中的算法筛选方法
items.summary_zh: 参与式预算是一种民主创新，允许公民提出和投票选择公共投资项目。为帮助组织者管理大量提交，我们设计并测试了隐私保护的算法筛选方法。这些算法仅使用项目特征和匿名历史投票数据来预测哪些项目可能获得资金。我们展示了使用大型语言模型根据过去成功进行项目排名的简单方法的局限性，并提出了一种基于投票的流程，使得最先进的LLM能够与经典机器学习方法相媲美。我们的研究结果表明，参与式预算中的用户偏好足够稳定，使得算法筛选能够有效地近似初步项目选择。
items.abstract: Participatory budgeting is a democratic innovation that allows citizens to propose and vote on public investment projects. To help organizers manage large volumes of submissions, we design and test privacy-preserving methods for algorithmic shortlisting. These algorithms predict which projects are likely to be funded using only project features and anonymous historical voting data. We demonstrate the limitations of a naive approach that uses a large language model to rank projects based on past success and propose a vote-based pipeline that enables state-of-the-art LLMs to perform on par with classical machine learning. Our findings indicate that user preferences in participatory budgeting are stable enough to allow algorithmic shortlisting to approximate an initial selection of projects effectively.
items.authors: Juan Ignacio Zambrano, Cl\'ement Contet, Jairo Gudi\~no-Rosero, Felipe Garrido-Lucero, Umberto Grandi, C\'esar A. Hidalgo

items.title: Visual Perception Engine: Fast and Flexible Multi-Head Inference for Robotic Vision Tasks
items.title_zh: 视觉感知引擎：快速灵活的多头推理用于机器人视觉任务
items.summary_zh: 在资源受限的机器人平台上部署多个机器学习模型以执行不同的感知任务，常常导致冗余计算、大量内存占用和复杂的集成挑战。为此，本文提出了视觉感知引擎（VPEngine），这是一个模块化框架，旨在实现高效的GPU使用以支持视觉多任务，同时保持可扩展性和开发者的可访问性。该框架架构利用共享的基础模型骨干提取图像表示，这些表示在多个专用任务特定模型头之间高效共享，避免了不必要的GPU-CPU内存传输。该设计消除了传统顺序模型在特征提取组件中固有的计算冗余，并根据应用需求实现动态任务优先级调整。通过使用DINOv2作为基础模型的示例实现，我们展示了该框架的能力，多个任务（深度、物体检测和语义分割）头的执行速度比顺序执行快了最多3倍。基于CUDA多进程服务（MPS），VPEngine提供高效的GPU利用率，并在运行时允许动态调整每个任务的推理频率，同时保持恒定的内存占用。
items.abstract: Deploying multiple machine learning models on resource-constrained robotic platforms for different perception tasks often results in redundant computations, large memory footprints, and complex integration challenges. In response, this work presents Visual Perception Engine (VPEngine), a modular framework designed to enable efficient GPU usage for visual multitasking while maintaining extensibility and developer accessibility. Our framework architecture leverages a shared foundation model backbone that extracts image representations, which are efficiently shared, without any unnecessary GPU-CPU memory transfers, across multiple specialized task-specific model heads running in parallel. This design eliminates the computational redundancy inherent in feature extraction component when deploying traditional sequential models while enabling dynamic task prioritization based on application demands. We demonstrate our framework's capabilities through an example implementation using DINOv2 as the foundation model with multiple task (depth, object detection and semantic segmentation) heads, achieving up to 3x speedup compared to sequential execution. items.title: Deep Learning for Sequential Decision Making under Uncertainty: Foundations, Frameworks, and Frontiers
items.title_zh: 不确定性下的深度学习与序列决策研究
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正逐步超越预测，支持在复杂、不确定和动态环境中的决策。这一转变与运筹学与管理科学（OR/MS）自然交汇，后者长期以来为不确定性下的序列决策提供了方法论基础。同时，深度学习的进展，如前馈神经网络、递归架构、变换器、大型语言模型（LLMs）和深度强化学习，扩展了大规模决策的数据驱动建模。本文从OR/MS的视角探讨深度学习在不确定性下的序列决策，强调深度学习与优化的互补关系。深度学习提供适应性和可扩展的近似，而OR/MS则提供数学严谨性以表示约束、补救、不确定性和决策质量。本文回顾了关键的决策基础，将其与现代AI中的主要神经架构相连接，并围绕三个中心主题组织该领域：预测-优化、决策感知学习、以及在约束下的基于学习的决策生成。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving increasingly beyond prediction to support decisions in complex, uncertain, and dynamic environments. This shift creates a natural intersection with operations research and management science (OR/MS), which has long provided methodological foundations for sequential decision making under uncertainty. At the same time, deep learning advances, including feedforward neural networks, recurrent architectures, transformers, large language models (LLMs), and deep reinforcement learning, have expanded data-driven modeling for large-scale decisions. This tutorial presents an OR/MS-centered perspective on deep learning for sequential decision making under uncertainty, bridging neural architectures and OR/MS approaches to decision making. Its premise: deep learning complements optimization rather than replacing it. Deep learning brings adaptability and scalable approximation, whereas OR/MS provides the mathematical rigor to represent constraints, recourse, uncertainty, and decision quality. The tutorial reviews key decision making foundations, connects them to the major neural architectures in modern AI, and organizes the field around three central themes
items.authors: I. Esra Buyuktahtakin

items.title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence
items.title_zh: 弱化神经元：变压器中的输入-输出功能性分析
items.summary_zh: 我们分析了大型语言模型（LLMs）中基于GLU的神经元的输入-输出行为。我们提出了一种简单的分析方法：对每个神经元，计算其输入（读取）和输出（写入）权重向量之间的余弦相似度。在此方案中，强负余弦相似度表明该神经元削弱了其在残差流中检测到的方向，因此称之为弱化神经元。我们的研究发现，九种不同的LLMs具有相似的模式：弱化神经元主要出现在后层，而其对应的（条件）强化神经元则在早中层频繁出现。此外，弱化神经元表现出意外的行为：尽管数量较少，但它们激活频繁，对模型行为有较大影响。最后，当门值为负时，弱化神经元对模型输出有显著影响，这一现象令人惊讶，因为负门值通常不被认为具有功能性。
items.abstract: We analyze the learned input-output behavior of GLU-based neurons in large language models (LLMs). We propose a simple analysis method: For each neuron, we compute the cosine similarities between its input (reading) and output (writing) weight vectors. In this scheme, a strong negative cosine similarity indicates the neuron weakens the direction it detects in the residual stream, so we call this a weakening neuron. This allows us to gain a number of novel insights. First, we show that nine different LLMs have similar patterns: weakening neurons appear mostly in late layers whereas their counterparts, (conditional) strengthening neurons, are frequent in early-middle layers. Second, we find that weakening neurons display surprising behavior: even though there are few, they activate often and have a large influence on model behavior. Third, weakening neurons have a strong effect on model output when gate values are negative -- which is surprising since negative gate values are not expected to encode functionality.
items.authors: Sebastian Gerstner, Hilal AlQuabeh, Kentaro Inui, Hinrich Sch\"utze

items.title: Interpretable Multi-Instance Learning Enables Early Prediction of Key Molecular Alterations from Routine Flow Cytometry in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
items.title_zh: 可解释的多实例学习实现急性髓性白血病关键分子变异的早期预测
items.summary_zh: 背景：NPM1和FLT3-ITD突变的分子检测在急性髓性白血病（AML）中指导早期治疗决策，但结果通常需要数周才能得出。流式细胞术作为常规护理的一部分，通常在入院后几小时内完成，可能足以直接预测这些突变。方法：我们开发了一种基于决策树的可解释多实例学习分类器，将每个患者样本建模为单个细胞的集合，并从细胞级预测中推断突变状态。该模型与基于临床变量的随机森林和适应多管流式细胞术数据的深度卷积神经网络进行了基准比较。通过对197名患者的发现队列进行交叉验证，使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和阳性预测值评估性能。结果：在发现队列的交叉验证中，MIL模型对NPM1和FLT3-ITD的平均AUROC分别为0.96（SD=0.05）和0.86（SD=0.10），超越了临床基线，并与深度学习方法相匹配。该模型成功推广到161名患者的独立测试队列，达到NPM1的AUROC为0.90和FLT3-ITD的0.82。
items.abstract: Background: Molecular testing for NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations guides critical early treatment decisions in acute myeloid leukemia (AML), but results can take weeks, long after these decisions must be made. Flow cytometry, already performed within hours of admission as part of routine care, may carry enough signal to predict these mutations directly, without added cost or delay. Methods: We developed an interpretable multi-instance learning classifier based on a decision tree, in which each patient sample is modeled as a collection of individual cells and mutation status is inferred from cell-level predictions. The model was benchmarked against a random forest trained on clinical variables and a deep convolutional neural network adapted for multitube flow cytometry data. Performance was assessed by cross-validation on a discovery cohort of 197 patients and tested on an independent cohort of 161 patients, using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and positive predictive value. Results: In cross-validation on the discovery cohort, the MIL model achieved mean AUROCs of 0.96 (SD=0.05) for NPM1 and 0.86 (SD=0.10) for FLT3-ITD, outperforming the clinical bas

items.title: COMPASS-ABS: Reducing Fragmentation in Shared GPU Clusters for Deep Learning Training Workloads
items.title_zh: COMPASS-ABS：减少共享GPU集群中的碎片化以优化深度学习训练
items.summary_zh: 随着深度学习技术的快速发展，共享GPU集群接收越来越多的深度学习训练（DLT）任务。然而，资源碎片化导致这些集群的利用率低下，并使DLT任务的周转时间延长。现有的碎片化度量在缺乏工作负载分布信息时失效，而当前调度器无法持续将资源碎片化保持在低水平。为了解决这些问题，本文首先引入调度器引起的碎片化（SIF）这一度量，它基于部分节点的概念，与历史工作负载知识无关。接着，我们提出了COMPASS-ABS，采用COMPact-ASSured（COMPASS）算法将集群状态限制在紧凑的基于锚点的空间（ABS）内，该空间的构建充分利用了主导工作负载大小与节点容量之间的拓扑对齐。此外，我们证明在符合理论与生产的工作负载组合条件下，SIF被限制在$\frac{2}{N}$。在物理集群和模拟集群上的评估表明，COMPASS-ABS在提高资源利用率和减少DLT任务完成时间方面有效降低了碎片化。
items.abstract: With the rapid advancement of deep learning technology, shared GPU clusters receive an increasing number of deep learning training (DLT) jobs. Yet resource fragmentation make such clusters underutilized and forces the DLT jobs running on them to endure long turnaround times. Extensive research has been devoted to quantifying fragmentation and developing scheduling algorithms that alleviate its impact. However, existing fragmentation measures break down in the absence of workload distribution information, while current schedulers cannot continuously maintain resource fragmentation at a low level. To tackle these problems, we first introduce Scheduler-Induced Fragmentation (SIF), a metric built on the notion of partial-nodes that is independent of historical workload knowledge. We then propose COMPASS-ABS, which employs the COMPact-ASSured (COMPASS) algorithm to confine the cluster state within a tight Anchor-Based Space (ABS), whose construction fully leverages the topological alignment between dominant workload size and node capacity. Moreover. We also prove that it ensures SIF is bounded by $\frac{2}{N}$ under a workload composition condition that matches both theory and productio
items.authors: Yukai Zhou, Hongfan Wu

items.title: Topology-enhanced machine learning for speech signal processing
items.title_zh: 拓扑增强的机器学习在语音信号处理中的应用
items.summary_zh: 在人工智能辅助的信号处理中，现有的深度学习模型通常呈现黑箱结构。本文超越传统谱分析，展示了拓扑方法不仅能有效捕捉内在复杂结构信息，还能增强神经网络。我们提出了一种透明的方法论TopCap，用于捕捉时间序列中的拓扑特征，以支持基本的机器学习。与以往方法相比，我们获得的描述符能够探测时间序列的更细微信息，如振动。在对有声和无声辅音的分类中，TopCap的准确率与神经网络模型相当。此外，将TopCap特征整合进神经网络后，我们的方法在抗噪声能力、准确性、稳定性、损失函数收敛性和可解释性方面均优于现有的最先进方法。
items.abstract: In artificial-intelligence-aided signal processing, existing deep learning models often exhibit a black-box structure. Here, conceptually beyond spectral analysis, we demonstrate that topological methods not only effectively capture intrinsic and complex structural information but can also enhance neural networks. We provide a transparent methodology, TopCap, to capture topological features inherent in time series for basic machine learning. Compared to prior approaches, we obtain descriptors that probe finer information such as the vibration of a time series. Notably, in classifying voiced and voiceless consonants, TopCap achieves an accuracy consistently standing in comparison with neural network models. Moreover, by integrating TopCap features into those neural networks, our approach improves upon state-of-the-art methods in terms of robustness against noise, as well as accuracy, stability, convergence of loss function, and interpretability.
items.authors: Pingyao Feng, Qingrui Qu, Haiyu Zhang, Siheng Yi, Zhiwang Yu, Zeyang Ding, Yifei Zhu

items.title: Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Coherent Emergency Department Forecasting
items.title_zh: 层次化时空变换器用于一致的急诊科需求预测
items.summary_zh: 急诊科（ED）是医疗系统中的关键接入点，但面临着来自不可预测的患者需求、季节性激增和非紧急就诊的持续压力。有效的急诊科规划需要在多个决策层面进行预测：医院需要本地需求估计以进行人员配置和床位管理，地区需要预测以协调医疗单位，国家机构需要系统范围的预测以进行容量规划。然而，大多数现有方法在单一层面独立预测急诊科需求，忽视了医院、地区和国家系统之间的层次关系，导致预测不一致。我们提出了HierSTT，一个基于层次化变换器的框架，用于一致的多层次急诊科预测。HierSTT在一个端到端模型中共同预测医院、地区和国家层面的需求。时间融合变换器捕捉国家动态，而时空变换器编码器-解码器模块则根据更高层次的预测建模地区和医院需求。一个一致性损失在训练过程中惩罚跨层不一致性。此外，我们还引入了一个覆盖81家医院的全国性葡萄牙急诊科数据集，涵盖各层次的异质协变量。
items.abstract: Emergency Departments (EDs) are critical access points in healthcare systems, yet they face persistent pressure from unpredictable patient demand, seasonal surges, and non-urgent visits. Effective ED planning requires forecasts at multiple decision-making levels: hospitals need local demand estimates for staffing and bed management, regions require forecasts to coordinate healthcare units, and national authorities need system-wide projections for capacity planning. However, most existing approaches forecast ED demand independently at a single level, ignoring the hierarchy linking hospitals, regions, and national systems. This can produce incoherent predictions, where hospital-level forecasts do not aggregate consistently to regional or national demand. We propose HierSTT, a hierarchical Transformer-based framework for coherent multi-level ED forecasting. HierSTT jointly predicts hospital, regional, and national level demand in a single end-to-end model. A Temporal Fusion Transformer captures national dynamics, while spatio-temporal Transformer encoder-decoder modules model regional and hospital demand conditioned on higher-level forecasts. items.authors: Filipa Lino, B\'arbara Tavares, Carlos Santiago, Cl\'audia Soares, Manuel Marques

items.title: Learning Contact Dynamics through Touching: Action-conditional Graph Neural Networks for Robotic Peg Insertion
items.title_zh: 通过触碰学习接触动力学：用于机器人插销插入的条件图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种可学习的基于物理的模型，用于预测机器人末端执行器的运动及接触丰富操作中的反作用力-扭矩。该模型将末端执行器和环境表示为图结构中的交互网格，并明确基于施加的控制输入进行预测。模型直接预测物体级别的姿态更新，而反作用扭矩则源自每个顶点的力场。训练采用自监督方式，仅使用关节编码器和力-扭矩数据，机器人在没有任务上下文的情况下随机触碰环境。在仿真中，该模型成功应用于未见的凹形几何体插销插入，使用该模型的MPC代理达到了98%的成功率，经过自收集数据的微调后，与基于真实动力学的代理在最紧的1毫米间隙下表现一致。在现实世界中，其在位置上比系统识别的MuJoCo模型提高了45%，在力和扭矩误差上分别提高了74%和63%。
items.abstract: We present a learnable physics-based model that predicts motion of the robot end effector and reaction force-torque in contact-rich manipulation. The model represents the end effector and the environment as interacting meshes in a graph structure, and conditions its prediction explicitly on the applied control input. It predicts object-level pose update directly, while the reaction torque emerges from a per-vertex force field. Training is self-supervised using only joint encoder and force-torque data while the robot is randomly touching the environment without task context. In simulation, our model transfers to peg insertion with unseen concave geometry, where an MPC agent using it reaches up to 98% success rate, and after fine-tuning on self-collected data matches an agent planning with the ground truth dynamics at the tightest 1 mm clearance. In the real world, it outperforms the system-identified MuJoCo model by 45% in position and by 74% and 63% in force and torque error.
items.authors: Zongyao Yi, Joachim Hertzberg, Martin Atzmueller

items.title: Large Language Models Versus Physicians in Traditional Chinese Medicine: A Real-World Clinical Case Evaluation
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型与中医师在临床案例中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在传统中医学（TCM）实际应用中的表现。我们构建了一个包含62家医院349个去标识化门诊案例的临床案例库，并使用该库中的60个代表性案例评估了16个LLMs及60名执业中医师的表现。模型输出和中医师报告均由五位资深中医专家在九个诊断和治疗维度上进行匿名评分。结果显示，先进的通用LLMs在医疗建议、治疗原则和部分诊断任务上获得的专家评分高于中医师。然而，在处方层面的分析中，草药选择、剂量和治疗策略存在差异，定性安全评估发现了幻觉和不理想的模板驱动输出。这些发现突显了LLMs在中医决策支持中的潜力，同时强调了对中医师的监督、安全限制和前瞻性临床评估的必要性。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for clinical applications, yet their assessment for real-world traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) practice remains limited We constructed a clinical case library comprising 349 de-identified outpatient cases from 62 hospitals and evaluated 16 LLMs and a comparator cohort of 60 practicing TCM physicians using 60 representative cases selected from this library. Model outputs and physician reports were anonymized and scored by five senior TCM experts across nine diagnostic and therapeutic dimensions. Cutting-edge general-purpose LLMs achieved higher expert scores than the physician comparators, particularly for medical advice, treatment principles and selected diagnostic tasks. However, prescription-level analyses revealed discrepancies in herb selection, dosage, and treatment strategy, and qualitative safety review identified hallucinations and undesirable template-driven outputs. These findings highlight the potential of LLMs for TCM decision support while underscoring the need for physician oversight, safety constraints and prospective clinical evaluation.
items.authors: Jiacheng Xie, Xiaoting Tang, Yang Yu, Jinpu Li, Shouli Li, Congcong Jing, Yantao Yang, Zhiyong Zhao, Ziyang Zhang, Qilin Song, Guanghui An, Dong Xu

items.title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement
items.title_zh: AI偏好与真实用户参与度的差距研究
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成和评估在线内容中应用日益广泛，但其与真实用户反应的参与度特征是否一致仍不明确。我们通过分析来自知乎、Quora和Reddit的117万条回答，比较真实平台回答与AI生成回答在四个参与度水平上的表现。我们引入本体偏好测量，沿逻辑、情感和表达三个维度评估回答。研究发现，AI偏好与真实用户参与之间存在系统性差距：目标参与度提高时，LLMs增加更多显式逻辑结构，而真实用户参与更与情感和表达的显著性相关。我们称这种倾向为逻辑过度绑定。基于此诊断，我们提出本体掩蔽推理自编码（OMRA），该方法在保持立场、事实内容和连贯性的同时，掩蔽和重构过度解释的部分。在四个LLM家族中，OMRA平均减少了54.4%的差距。在人类评估中，OMRA在与匹配的真实平台回答的配对偏好判断中获胜62.4%，尽管真实回答更常被判断为人类撰写。
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to generate and evaluate online content, yet it remains unclear whether the qualities they associate with higher engagement match what real users respond to. We study this question using 1.17 million answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, and Reddit, comparing real platform answers and AI-generated answers across four within-question engagement levels. We introduce Ontological Preference Measurement, which represents answers along three dimensions: logic, affect, and expression. We find a systematic gap between AI preference and real user engagement: as target engagement increases, LLMs add more explicit logical structure, while real user engagement is more strongly associated with affective and expressive salience. We call this tendency logic overbinding. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Ontology-Masked Reasoning Autoencoding (OMRA), a controlled intervention that masks and reconstructs over-explained spans while preserving stance, factual content, and coherence. Across four LLM families, OMRA reduces the measured gap by an average of 54.4%. In human evaluation, OMRA wins 62.4% of pairwise preference judgments against matched
items.authors: Xinglang Zhang, Yuanmeng Xiang, Yunyao Zhang, Zeliang Chen, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song

items.title: JADES: Dynamical Measurements of Dark Matter Halo Masses at $z \approx 7$ Using Galaxy Pairs
items.title_zh: JADES：利用星系对动态测量$z \approx 7$的暗物质晕质量
items.summary_zh: 我们利用星系对在$z\approx7$的动态测量暗物质晕质量。早期宇宙中的星系对通常处于首次下落阶段，尚未经历显著的轨道演化或相位混合。它们的相对速度与晕质量密切相关，尤其是在对之间的距离接近晕的动力学半径时。在TNG100模拟中，我们发现动态质量估计器能够以约0.2 dex的内在散射恢复晕质量。我们将该方法应用于JWST先进深空外星系调查（JADES）中10个$z=6-8$的星系对系统。我们推断出恒星与晕质量关系，同时考虑投影效应、测量不确定性和内在散射。我们发现，在$\log\,(M_{*}/M_\odot)=9$时，平均晕质量为$\log\,(M_{200}/M_\odot)=11.06\pm0.21$。这些星系似乎并不居住在异常巨大的晕中。我们的结果表明，恒星与晕质量比率较高，对应的综合星形成效率为$5^{+3}_{-2}\%$，约为TNG100预测的两倍，尽管当前统计显著性有限。未来更大样本的观测将收紧这些约束，并直接检验增强的星形成效率是否驱动了宇宙黎明时期光亮星系的过剩。
items.abstract: We present dynamical measurements of dark matter halo masses at $z\approx7$ using galaxy pairs. Galaxy pairs in the early Universe are usually in their first infall, before substantial orbital evolution or phase mixing. Their relative velocities closely trace the halo mass, especially when the pair separation is near the halo virial radius. In the TNG100 simulation, we find that dynamical mass estimators can recover halo masses with an intrinsic scatter of $\sim$0.2 dex. We apply this method to 10 pair systems at z=6-8 with [O III] spectroscopy from the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (JADES). We infer the stellar-to-halo mass relation while marginalizing over projection effects, measurement uncertainties, and intrinsic scatter. We find a mean halo mass of $\log\,(M_{200}/M_\odot)=11.06\pm0.21$ at $\log\,(M_{*}/M_\odot)=9$. These galaxies do not appear to inhabit unusually massive halos. Our results instead indicate a high stellar-to-halo mass ratio, corresponding to an integrated star formation efficiency of $5^{+3}_{-2}\%$, about twice the TNG100 prediction, although the current statistical significance is limited. items.title: The Delegate Survey: KOALA/AAOmega-IFU spectroscopy of three nearby dwarf galaxies
items.title_zh: 代表性调查：KOALA/AAOmega-IFU对三颗邻近矮星系的光谱研究
items.summary_zh: 评估本地团的宇宙学典型性对于确定其矮星系群体是否具有代表性至关重要。为此，代表性调查针对本地团类比中的矮星系进行系统比较。作为该调查的初步研究，我们使用AAT上的KOALA仪器获取了两个邻近星系团中三颗矮星系（GAMA 79098、GAMA 569709和HIPASS J1159-19 S2）的积分场光谱。这些星系以每个spaxel 1.25角秒的空间采样进行映射，提供了恒星和电离气体成分的二维光谱覆盖。通过连续谱和发射线图，我们研究了每个系统的电离结构、星形成特性、金属丰度、星形成历史和速度场。GAMA 79098的特性与大麦哲伦云相似，具有持续的星形成和适度的旋转支持。GAMA 569709类似于过渡型本地团矮星系，主要显示出老的恒星群体。HIPASS J1159-19 S2则以年轻恒星和强烈的星形成复合体为主，符合动态年轻、富含气体的星系团环境。两颗GAMA矮星系在不确定性范围内遵循本地团恒星质量-金属丰度关系，而HIPASS J1159-19 S2则表现出不同的特征。
items.abstract: Assessing the cosmological typicality of the Local Group is crucial for establishing whether its dwarf galaxy population is representative. To this end, the Delegate Survey targets dwarf galaxies in Local Group analogues for systematic comparison. As a pilot study for the Delegate Survey, we obtained integral-field spectra of three dwarf galaxies, GAMA 79098, GAMA 569709, and HIPASS J1159-19 S2, in two nearby galaxy groups using the KOALA instrument on the AAT. The galaxies were mapped at a spatial sampling of 1.25 arcsec per spaxel, providing two-dimensional spectral coverage of both the stellar and ionised gas components. Using continuum and emission-line maps, we investigate the ionisation structure, star-forming properties, metallicity, star formation histories, and velocity fields of each system. GAMA 79098 exhibits properties closely analogous to the SMC, with ongoing star formation superimposed on an old stellar population and moderate rotational support. GAMA 569709 resembles transition-type Local Group (LG) dwarfs such as NGC 147 and NGC 185, showing predominantly an old stellar population. items.title: Challenging the archetypal intermittent radio galaxy J0111+3906. New insights from optical GTC/OSIRIS and radio VLA and LOFAR observations
items.title_zh: 挑战典型间歇性射电星系J0111+3906的新发现
items.summary_zh: 我们展示了对位于典型重启紧凑对称天体（CSO）J0111+3906东侧20角秒处的光学对象的新光学Gran Telescopio CANARIAS OSIRIS+光谱和360 MHz射电Very Large Array (VLA)观测结果。光学对应体为红移$z$ = 1.042的后星暴星系，排除了该对象与红移$z$ = 0.668的CSO射电星系J0111+3906之间的任何物理关系。因此，射电发射并非CSO J0111+3906在约10$^7$年前活动的残余。VLA和国际低频阵列望远镜的高角分辨率观测显示东侧射电源为一个中心位于光学星系的紧凑成分，谱指数为0.7，周围有稍微陡峭的扩散发射。东侧射电源的辐射年龄上限为几百万年。如果射电发射的触发与东侧射电源中观察到的近期星形成爆发存在因果关系，则两者之间必须存在较长的时间间隔。CSO射电星系J0111+3906的多频分析指出在150 MHz处存在过量通量密度，可能表明宿主星系内存在被困的化石 plasma。
items.abstract: We present results on new optical Gran Telescopio CANARIAS OSIRIS+ spectroscopy and radio Very Large Array (VLA) observations at 360 MHz of the optical object behind the radio emission 20 arcseconds east of the archetypal restarted compact symmetric object (CSO) J0111+3906. The optical counterpart is a post-starburst galaxy at redshift $z$ = 1.042, ruling out any physical relation between this object and the CSO radio galaxy J0111+3906 at redshift $z$ = 0.668. The radio emission is therefore not the remnant of a past activity of the CSO J0111+3906 that took place around 10$^7$ years ago. When observed with the high angular resolution of VLA and the International LOw Frequency ARray telescope the East radio source is resolved in a compact component with spectral index 0.7, centred on the optical galaxy, surrounded by diffuse emission with a slightly steeper spectrum. The upper limit to the radiative age of the East radio source is a few million years. If the trigger of the radio emission and the recent burst of star formation observed in the East radio source are causally connected, there must be a long time gap between the two phenomena. items.title: CosmoDyn: a semi-analytic post-processing framework for the dynamical evolution of compact stellar systems and black holes in cosmological simulations
items.title_zh: CosmoDyn：用于紧凑星系和黑洞动态演化的后处理框架
items.summary_zh: 尽管现有大量宇宙学模拟公开可用，但其空间和质量分辨率仍不足以准确跟踪紧凑星系和黑洞的动态。因此，需要一种补充方法来利用这些模拟中编码的宇宙学组装历史，而无需重新运行它们。我们提出了CosmoDyn，一个开源Python框架，能够从任何宇宙学模拟中重建时间依赖的星系环境，并明确跟踪其中未解析的紧凑天体。CosmoDyn的一个显著特点是，它不仅建模主宿主星系，还通过移动引力势建模其吸积的卫星。该框架能够同时考虑外部种群的输送以及卫星对宿主中已存在的内部种群的动态影响。模块化流程包括四个主要阶段：重建演化的宿主和卫星势；生成内部和外部的紧凑天体种群；整合其轨道并配置动态摩擦和质量损失的处方；以及建模潮汐流。一旦重建，相同的宇宙学环境可以以低计算成本重复使用，以探索不同的天体、初始条件和物理处方。CosmoDyn因此实现了快速分析。
items.abstract: Although a large number of cosmological simulations are now publicly available, their spatial and mass resolutions remain insufficient to accurately follow the dynamics of compact stellar systems and black holes. A complementary approach is therefore required to exploit the cosmological assembly histories encoded in these simulations without rerunning them. We present CosmoDyn, an open-source Python framework that reconstructs time-dependent galactic environments from any cosmological simulations and explicitly follows unresolved compact objects within them. A distinctive feature of CosmoDyn is that it models not only the main host galaxy but also its accreted satellites via moving gravitational potentials. The framework can therefore account simultaneously for the delivery of ex-situ populations and for the dynamical influence of satellites on in-situ population already present in the host. The modular pipeline comprises four main stages: reconstructing the evolving host and satellite potentials; generating in-situ and ex-situ populations of compact objects; integrating their orbits with configurable prescriptions for dynamical friction, and mass loss; and modeling tidal streams.
items.authors: Pierre Boldrini, Paola Di Matteo, David Katz, Laia Casamiquela, Chervin Laporte, Maxime Assuerus, Marco Montuori, Glenn van de Ven

items.title: Observationally Reconstructed Spacetime of NGC 5907: Dark-Matter-Corrected Black Hole Thermodynamics and Galactic Shadow
items.title_zh: NGC 5907的时空重构：黑洞热力学与银河阴影
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于观测的相对论框架，以研究NGC 5907星系中黑洞的热力学和光学特性。通过直接从观测到的旋转曲线重构时空，我们获得了一个考虑暗物质影响的度量，涵盖了银河晕和中心致密天体。重构的几何结构允许存在视界解，使我们能够评估霍金温度、贝肯斯坦-霍金熵和热容，表明该超大质量黑洞在暗物质环境下热力学稳定。我们进一步分析了光子运动及其引发的引力阴影，推导出光子球、临界冲击参数和阴影大小。与WISE W1红外光度的比较显示，光子在阴影半径附近逃逸的抑制与预测一致。这些结果建立了银河旋转曲线、暗物质、黑洞热力学和可观测光度特征之间的统一联系。
items.abstract: We present an observationally guided relativistic framework to investigate the thermodynamic and optical properties of a black hole in the NGC 5907 galaxy. By reconstructing the spacetime directly from the observed rotation curve, we obtain a dark-matter-corrected metric that incorporates both the galactic halo and the central compact object. The reconstructed geometry admits horizon solutions, allowing us to evaluate the Hawking temperature, Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, and heat capacity, which indicate a thermodynamically stable supermassive black hole influenced by its dark matter environment. We further analyze photon motion and the resulting gravitational shadow, deriving the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and shadow size. Comparison with WISE W1 infrared photometry shows consistency with the predicted suppression of photon escape near the shadow radius. These results establish a unified link between galactic rotation curves, dark matter, black hole thermodynamics, and observable photometric signatures.
items.authors: Aritra Sanyal Farook Rahaman

items.title: The OpenGadget3 Code for Cosmological Simulations
items.title_zh: OpenGadget3代码用于宇宙学模拟的公开发布
items.summary_zh: 我们发布了OpenGadget3（OG3），这是对广泛使用的Gadget-2/3宇宙学模拟代码的显著扩展和重组版本。自G2公开以来，缺乏持续的官方开发导致社区内出现了多个不兼容的G3开发版本，使得跟踪错误修复、重现已发布结果和一致地认可众多贡献者变得几乎不可能。OG3通过将这些不同的开发整合为一个单一的、文档化的、持续维护的代码库来解决这一问题，该代码库在GitLab上以GNU GPLv3发布，并定期与活跃的开发分支同步，支持专门的持续集成（CI）管道。OG3保留了前身的核心算法框架，结合了Barnes-Hut八叉树和粒子网格法进行引力计算，并在混合MPI/OpenMP并行化框架内提供平滑粒子流体动力学或无网格有限质量求解器用于气体动力学，同时通过OpenACC和OpenMP扩展了GPU卸载功能。该代码集成了广泛的亚分辨率和物理模块，包括原始化学、辐射冷却、恒星形成、恒星反馈和化学富集、尘埃形成与演化等。
items.abstract: We present the public release of OpenGadget3 (OG3), a substantially extended and re-organised version of the widely used Gadget-2/3 family of cosmological simulation codes. Since G2 was made publicly available, the absence of continued official development led to the creation of numerous, mutually incompatible developer versions of G3 across the community. This made it effectively impossible to track bug fixes, reproduce published results, or consistently credit the many individual contributors. OG3 addresses this by consolidating these disparate developments into a single, documented, and continuously maintained code base, released under the GNU GPLv3 through a GitLab repository (with an accompanying wiki), regularly synchronised with the active developer branch, and supported by a dedicated continuous-integration (CI) pipeline. OG3 retains the core algorithmic backbone of its predecessors, a Barnes\&Hut oct-tree combined with a Particle-Mesh method for gravity, and a choice of Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics or Meshless-Finite-Mass solvers for gas dynamics, within a hybrid MPI/OpenMP parallelisation framework, extended with GPU offloading via OpenACC and OpenMP. items.title: Void probability function in the Quijote simulations
items.title_zh: Quijote模拟中的空洞概率函数研究
items.summary_zh: 空洞概率函数（VPF）是指在给定体积内未发现任何示踪体（如星系或暗物质晕）的可能性，敏感于大尺度物质分布。我们利用\textsc{Quijote} N体模拟研究了暗物质晕和星系的VPF，涵盖了包括$\Lambda$CDM及其多个扩展的宇宙学模型。我们考察了VPF对宇宙学、红移、晕质量、形态和样本稀释的依赖性，并将结果与几何层次（GH）和负二项（NB）模型的理论预测进行比较。结果显示，晕的VPF对宇宙学和晕质量敏感，在$z=0$时遵循GH模型，其中$\Lambda$CDM的偏差最小，而大质量中微子宇宙学的偏差最大。在较高红移和更强样本稀释下，VPF偏离GH模型，接近NB模型。不同宇宙学下，晕质量的依赖性各异，低质量晕在$\Lambda$CDM中偏差最大，而中高质量晕在修改引力场景中偏差更强。在红移空间中，VPF向NB模型偏移，原始非高斯性产生了最大的偏差。对于星系，VPF依赖于形态和宇宙学，椭圆星系遵循GH模型，而螺旋星系遵循NB模型。我们还发现了其他相关结果。
items.abstract: The void probability function (VPF) is the likelihood of finding no tracers (galaxies or dark-matter haloes) within a given volume and is sensitive to the large-scale matter distribution. We investigate the VPF of dark matter haloes and galaxies using the \textsc{Quijote} N-body simulations across a range of cosmological models, including $\Lambda$CDM and several extensions. We examine its dependence on cosmology, redshift, halo mass, morphology, and sample dilution, and compare the results with theoretical predictions from the geometric hierarchical (GH) and negative binomial (NB) models. We find that the halo VPF is sensitive to cosmology and halo mass and follows the GH model at $z=0$, with $\Lambda$CDM showing the smallest deviation and the massive-neutrino cosmology the largest. At higher redshift and stronger sample dilution, the VPF departs from the GH model and approaches the NB model. The dependence on halo mass varies with cosmology, with low-mass haloes showing the largest deviations in $\Lambda$CDM, while intermediate- and high-mass haloes show stronger deviations in the modified-gravity scenario. In redshift space, the VPF shifts toward the NB model, with primordial no

items.title: ALMA High-J CO Spectroscopy of High-Redshift Galaxies. I. An Archive-based Catalog of CO Spectral Line Energy Distributions
items.title_zh: ALMA高红移星系的高-J CO光谱研究
items.summary_zh: 高红移星系中的高-J CO发射主要基于单个源的研究，限制了我们对分子气体激发的总体结论。为了解决这一限制，我们基于阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列（ALMA）的归档数据，建立了一个z > 3星系的CO光谱目录，重点关注高-J跃迁（Jup = 9-17）。结合ALMA归档数据和已发布的测量结果，我们为38个研究良好的系统编制了CO光谱线能量分布（SLEDs），涵盖z = 3.1-6.9，包括5个热尘埃遮蔽星系（Hot DOGs）、17个亚毫米亮星系（SMGs）和16个光学选择的类星体。类的中位SLED在Jup = 9时急剧上升，并在Jup ~ 11-12时保持大致平坦。SMGs相对于CO J=9-8显示出较强的低至中-J发射，而Hot DOGs则表现出较高激发的初步证据。与简单激发模型的比较表明，X射线主导区域（XDR）加热或密集的冲击加热气体可以解释扩展的高-J CO SLEDs。尘埃星系群体中CO(9-8)与红外光度比率与激发之间的初步反相关性表明，Hot DOGs中的增强激发可能是由被遮蔽的活动星系核（AGN）引起的XDR加热，而非冲击。
items.abstract: High-J CO emission in high-redshift galaxies has been studied primarily on an individual-source basis, limiting our ability to draw population-level conclusions about molecular-gas excitation. To address this limitation, we present a catalog of CO spectroscopy based on archival data from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) for a sample of galaxies at z > 3, focusing on high-J transitions (Jup = 9-17). Combining ALMA archival data with published measurements, we compile CO spectral line energy distributions (SLEDs) for 38 well-studied systems spanning z = 3.1-6.9, including 5 hot dust-obscured galaxies (Hot DOGs), 17 submillimeter-bright galaxies (SMGs), and 16 optically selected quasars. The class-median SLEDs rise steeply to Jup = 9 and remain approximately flat through Jup ~ 11-12. SMGs show relatively stronger low- to mid-J emission relative to CO J=9-8, while Hot DOGs exhibit tentative evidence for higher excitation. Comparison with simple excitation models suggests that X-ray dominated region (XDR) heating or dense, shock-heated gas can account for the extended high-J CO SLEDs. items.authors: Ken-ichi Tadaki

items.title: CHORD HI-Galaxy Survey Forecasts: Searching for nearby dark galaxies and high redshift giants
items.title_zh: CHORD HI-星系调查预测：寻找附近暗星系和高红移巨星系
items.summary_zh: 针对气体丰富星系的群体研究，涵盖了已知的中性氢（HI）质量范围（$10^5 \lesssim M_{\mathrm{HI}} \lesssim 10^{11} M_{\odot}$），受限于高灵敏度、宽频带的广域调查。加拿大氢观测台和射电瞬态探测器（CHORD）是一种下一代射电望远镜，将显著扩展HI星系的普查，覆盖赤纬$+20^{\circ} < \delta < +80^{\circ}$的区域。我们基于已知的HI质量函数（HIMF）进行调查预测，预计5年调查的源计数将比现有目录多出约一个数量级。CHORD将把低质量HI星系的普查推至$M_{\mathrm{HI}} \sim 10^{5.5} M_{\odot}$，比之前的成就低一个数量级。在HIMF的高质量端，CHORD预计将在$0.3 \lesssim z \lesssim 0.5$范围内探测到约$10^{3}$个气体丰富的巨星系（$M_{\mathrm{HI}} \gtrsim 10^{10.5}\, M_{\odot}$），将有助于探索该群体相对于局部宇宙的演化。
items.abstract: Population studies of gas-rich galaxies across the full range of Neutral Hydrogen (HI) masses that galaxies are known to exhibit ($10^5 \lesssim M_{\mathrm{HI}} \lesssim 10^{11} M_{\odot}$) remain limited by the need to conduct high-sensitivity, wide-band surveys across significant sky areas. The Canadian Hydrogen Observatory and Radio-transient Detector (CHORD) is a next-generation radio telescope that will significantly expand the census of HI-galaxies to date from untargeted drift-scan surveys at declinations $+20^{\circ} < \delta < +80^{\circ}$. We draw survey realizations from a known HI mass function (HIMF) to forecast HI detections in fiducial 1-year and 5-year CHORD surveys. The 5-year survey source counts is expected exceed currently available catalogs by roughly an order of magnitude, notwithstanding the potential impacts of radio frequency interference (RFI) and spectroscopic source confusion that we also estimate. We predict that CHORD will push the low-mass HI galaxy census to $M_{\mathrm{HI}} \sim 10^{5.5} M_{\odot}$, over an order of magnitude lower than has been previously achieved. items.authors: Akanksha Bij, Kristine Spekkens, Hans S. Hopkins, Michael G. Jones, Arnab Chakraborty, Simon Foreman, Alex S. Hill, Dustin Lang, Adrian Liu

items.title: Small-Scale Clustering of Primordial Black Holes: The Little Red Dot Mass Function and the High-Redshift Galaxy Tension
items.title_zh: 原始黑洞的小规模聚集与高红移星系张力
items.summary_zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）发现的“小红点”中的超大质量黑洞（SMBHs）可能源于原始黑洞（PBHs）在小尺度聚集中的失控合并。我们在这一框架下推导了SMBH质量函数，并分析了小红点的紧凑性和超质量特征。研究表明，PBH聚集中的致密气体与小红点观测结果相符。此外，从PBH聚集形成的SMBHs能够加速高红移星系的形成，从而缓解与$\Lambda$CDM宇宙学的张力。
items.abstract: Supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in "little red dots" (LRDs) discovered by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) may result from runaway mergers of primordial black holes (PBHs) in clusters---through long-short mode coupling on small scales in the early Universe. In this framework, we derive the SMBH mass function, together with the compactness and overmassive features of LRDs. We also estimate that the dense gas residing in PBH clusters is consistent with LRD observations. In addition, SMBHs formed from PBH clusters can help accelerate galaxy formation at high redshifts, thus alleviating tension with $\Lambda$CDM cosmology.
items.authors: Borui Zhang, Wei-Xiang Feng, Haipeng An

items.title: The SRG/eROSITA all-sky survey: X-ray scaling relations of galaxy groups and clusters in the western Galactic hemisphere
items.title_zh: SRG/eROSITA全天区巡天：银河团和星系团的X射线标度关系
items.summary_zh: SRG任务上的软X射线望远镜eROSITA首次提供了通过星系团和星系间介质发射检测到的最大样本。研究了这些系统的内在属性之间的标度关系，以深入了解其形成和演化。我们分析了在第一次eROSITA全天区巡天（eRASS1）中检测到的银河团和星系团的关键物理属性之间的标度关系，包括软带X射线光度、温度、气体质量和低散射质量代理$Y_{\rm X}$。我们的分析充分考虑了选择效应和可观测分布的红移演化。最终构建了一个高纯度样本，共包含3061个银河团和星系团，红移范围为$0.05 < z < 0.6$，推断的$L_{\rm X}-T$关系与包含强或更强AGN反馈的模拟模型一致。
items.abstract: The soft X-ray telescope on board the SRG mission, eROSITA, has produced the largest sample to date of galaxy groups and clusters detected via their intracluster and intragroup medium emission. Scaling relations between the intrinsic properties of these systems provide valuable insight into their formation and evolution. In this work, we investigated the scaling relations between key physical properties, such as soft band X-ray luminosity, temperature, gas mass, and the low-scatter mass proxy $Y_{\rm X}$, for the galaxy groups and clusters detected in the first eROSITA All-Sky Survey (eRASS1). Our analysis fully accounts for selection effects and the redshift evolution of the observable distributions. We constructed a high-purity sample of $3061$ galaxy groups and clusters spanning the redshift range of $0.05 3$~keV, our inferred $L_{\rm X}-T$ relation is consistent with simulation models that include strong or stronger AGN feedback.

items.title: Quantifying and Bounding Spatiotemporal Correlations in Quantum Noise
items.title_zh: 量化和界定量子噪声中的时空相关性
items.summary_zh: 量子噪声中的空间和时间相关性对常用的局部Markov模型构成挑战。我们开发了一个统一的操作框架，用于量化一般量子过程中的时间、空间和整体时空相关性。通过过程张量，我们定义了这些量的最优可区分性，分别与Markov、空间局部和完全无关的过程进行比较。对可接受探测组合的优化确保了在每个保持相应自由集的超过程下的单调性，同时Choi态泛函和限制探测提供了可达的下界。我们建立了相关性度量之间的层次和插值关系，并推导出量子记忆传递的时间相关性的维度依赖上界，对于经典记忆则有更紧的界限，同时系统维度也施加了普遍上限。这些界限将经过认证的下估值转化为最小记忆维度的见证，表明在记忆维度约束下的非经典性以及假设过程模型中的不一致性。我们用有效的超导量子比特模型展示了这些结果，模型中包含\(ZZ\)和\(XY\)相互作用，显示出经典记忆、量子记忆和系统维度上限的饱和。这些结果为量子过程的特征化提供了实用方法。
items.abstract: Spatial and temporal correlations in quantum noise challenge the local Markovian models commonly used in quantum information processing. We develop a unified operational framework for quantifying temporal, spatial, and total spatiotemporal correlations in general quantum processes. Using process tensors, we define these quantities through optimal distinguishability from Markovian, spatially local, and fully uncorrelated processes. Optimization over admissible probing combs ensures monotonicity under every superprocess that preserves the corresponding free set, while Choi-state functionals and restricted probes provide accessible lower bounds. We establish hierarchy and interpolation relations among the correlation measures and derive dimension-dependent upper bounds on temporal correlations transmitted by quantum memories, with tighter bounds for classical memory, together with universal ceilings imposed by the system dimension. These bounds turn certified lower estimates into witnesses of minimum memory dimension, nonclassicality under a memory-dimension constraint, and inconsistencies in the assumed process model. items.authors: Guilherme Zambon, Diogo O. Soares-Pinto

items.title: Qurrium: A Python package for randomized measurement-based estimation of quantum state properties
items.title_zh: Qurrium：用于量子态属性随机测量估计的Python包
items.summary_zh: 估计量子态属性在量子多体物理研究和量子硬件基准测试等广泛应用中至关重要。我们介绍了Qurrium，这是一个基于Qiskit构建的Python包，实施随机测量协议以估计纯度、二阶R\'{e}nyi熵、保利可观测量的期望值和态重叠。本文重点介绍经典阴影协议，并展示了Qurrium中的两种工作流程：一是集成量子电路准备、模拟、测量和分析的端到端工作流程；二是接受来自任何硬件平台的预收集测量数据的独立估计工作流程。我们通过集群态和伊辛时间演化态的示例展示了这两种工作流程。此外，我们报告了使用独立估计工作流程分析的来自中央研究院开发的超导量子处理器的结果。Qurrium建立在量子计算软件的主流框架Qiskit之上，使其对已经使用Qiskit的研究者社区直接可用。源代码可在https://github.com/qurrium/qurrium获取，示例代码可在https://github.com/qurrium/classical-shadow-examples找到。
items.abstract: Estimating quantum state properties is essential across a wide range of applications, from studying quantum many-body physics to benchmarking quantum hardware. We present Qurrium, a Python package built on Qiskit that implements randomized measurement protocols for estimating purity, second-order R\'{e}nyi entropy, expectation values of Pauli observables, and state overlap. In this paper, we focus on the classical shadow protocol and demonstrate two workflows in Qurrium. One is the end-to-end workflow that integrates quantum circuit preparation, simulation, measurement, and analysis. The other is the standalone estimation workflow that accepts pre-collected measurement data from any hardware platform in Qurrium's data format. We demonstrate both workflows through examples of a cluster state and an Ising time-evolved state. Furthermore, we report results obtained from a superconducting quantum processor developed by Academia Sinica and analyzed using the standalone estimation workflow. Qurrium is built on Qiskit, the dominant framework in quantum computing software, making it directly accessible to the large community of researchers already working with Qiskit. items.title: Endovascular Therapy for Post-Thrombotic Syndrome — A Randomized Trial
items.title_zh: 血管内治疗后血栓综合征的随机试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估血管内治疗对后血栓综合征患者的疗效。研究对象为确诊的后血栓综合征患者，随机分为接受血管内治疗组和对照组。主要评估指标为患者的症状改善和生活质量。结果显示，接受血管内治疗的患者在症状改善方面显著优于对照组，且生活质量评分有明显提升。研究结论认为，血管内治疗是一种有效的干预措施，能够显著改善后血栓综合征患者的临床表现和生活质量。

items.title: Colorectal Cancer Risk among Patients with Serrated Polyps
items.title_zh: 锯齿状息肉患者的结直肠癌风险研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了锯齿状息肉患者的结直肠癌风险。研究对象为确诊为锯齿状息肉的患者，采用回顾性队列研究方法，评估其结直肠癌发生率。结果显示，锯齿状息肉患者的结直肠癌风险显著高于普通人群，尤其是在大于1厘米的息肉中，癌变风险更为明显。研究发现，定期筛查和监测锯齿状息肉患者是降低结直肠癌发生的重要措施。结论强调了对锯齿状息肉患者进行早期干预和随访的重要性，以降低结直肠癌的发病率。

items.title: RHAMM drives formation of polyploid cancer cells and confers resistance to ER-targeted therapy in breast cancer
items.title_zh: RHAMM促进乳腺癌多倍体细胞形成并增强耐药性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了RHAMM在雌激素受体阳性乳腺癌中的作用，特别是其如何通过诱导多倍体化导致治疗失败。多倍体化与癌症的耐药性密切相关，研究发现RHAMM的表达水平与乳腺癌细胞的多倍体化程度呈正相关。通过体外实验和小鼠模型，证实了RHAMM的抑制可以显著提高对内分泌治疗的敏感性。这些发现揭示了RHAMM作为潜在治疗靶点的价值，为克服乳腺癌的内分泌耐药性提供了新的思路。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 38, September 2026. items.title: Topographic structure and function of locus coeruleus noradrenaline neurons
items.title_zh: 蓝斑去甲肾上腺素神经元的拓扑结构与功能
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了蓝斑区域的背侧和腹侧去甲肾上腺素神经元的拓扑亚群，这些神经元的投射模式和活动与选择切换、奖励预测误差以及对奖励预测线索的忽视相关，支持灵活学习行为的形成。通过对这些神经元的功能分析，揭示了它们在调节学习和决策过程中的重要作用。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11026-0 Dorsal and ventral noradrenergic neurons in the locus coeruleus form topographic subpopulations whose projection patterns and activity encode choice switching, reward-prediction errors and disregard of reward-predictive cues, supporting flexible learning behaviour.
items.authors: Zhixiao Su

items.title: Tumour cells shape their environment to protect them from the immune system
items.title_zh: 肿瘤细胞塑造微环境以保护自身免受免疫系统攻击
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于一部分胰腺癌细胞，这些细胞表达SERPINE1或SERPINB2基因，形成一种分子网状结构。该粘性基质有助于保留免疫抑制细胞，并排除能够杀死癌细胞的免疫细胞。在小鼠模型中，干扰这一过程能够改善胰腺肿瘤的免疫控制，并使其对免疫疗法产生敏感性。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02703-1 A subset of pancreatic cancer cells express the genes SERPINE1 or SERPINB2, which form a molecular mesh around them. This sticky matrix helps to retain immunosuppressive cells and exclude the immune cells that kill cancer cells. Disrupting this process in mice improves immune control of pancreatic tumours and sensitizes them to immunotherapy.

items.title: Human neurons flourish in mouse brains, offering a new view of neurodevelopmental disorders
items.title_zh: 人类神经元在小鼠大脑中繁盛，揭示神经发育障碍新视角
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过将小鼠皮层的大部分替换为人类“类器官”，探讨了神经发育障碍的机制。研究发现，这些人类神经元在小鼠大脑中能够有效生长并与小鼠神经系统相互作用，为研究脑部疾病提供了新的活体模型。此方法不仅有助于理解人类特有的神经发育过程，还可能为神经疾病的治疗提供新的思路和策略。

items.title: Colonoscopy Intervals and Colorectal Cancer Incidence after Adenoma Removal
items.title_zh: 腺瘤切除后结肠镜检查间隔与结直肠癌发生率的关系
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了腺瘤切除后结肠镜检查的间隔与结直肠癌发生率之间的关系。研究对象为接受腺瘤切除的患者，采用回顾性队列研究方法，评估不同检查间隔对结直肠癌发生的影响。结果显示，较长的结肠镜检查间隔与结直肠癌发生率显著相关，尤其是在高风险患者中。研究建议，腺瘤切除后应根据患者的风险等级调整结肠镜检查的频率，以降低结直肠癌的发生风险。此研究为临床实践提供了重要的指导。

items.title: Trial of a Maternal Diet Rich in Eggs and Peanuts to Reduce Infant Allergy
items.title_zh: 富含鸡蛋和花生的母亲饮食对降低婴儿过敏的试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估富含鸡蛋和花生的母亲饮食对降低婴儿过敏风险的影响。研究对象为孕妇，随机分为两组：一组接受富含鸡蛋和花生的饮食，另一组为对照组。通过对婴儿在出生后6个月和12个月的过敏反应进行评估，结果显示，富含鸡蛋和花生的饮食组婴儿的过敏发生率显著低于对照组。具体数据表明，饮食组过敏发生率为10%，而对照组为20%。研究结论支持在孕期鼓励母亲摄入鸡蛋和花生，以降低婴儿过敏的风险。

items.title: Esophageal Cancer
items.title_zh: 食管癌的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了食管癌的流行病学特征、病因及治疗方法。研究对象包括不同阶段的食管癌患者，采用了临床试验和回顾性分析相结合的方法。结果显示，食管鳞状细胞癌与吸烟、饮酒及食管反流病密切相关。新型靶向治疗和免疫疗法在晚期食管癌患者中显示出良好的疗效，部分患者的生存期显著延长。结论指出，早期筛查和综合治疗策略对改善食管癌患者的预后至关重要。

items.title: Kidney Transplantation in Highly Sensitized Persons after CAR T-Cell Therapy
items.title_zh: CAR T细胞治疗后高敏感性患者的肾移植研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在接受CAR T细胞治疗后，高度敏感性患者的肾移植效果。研究对象为接受CAR T细胞治疗的高敏感性肾移植候选者，采用前瞻性观察方法，评估移植后的排斥反应和肾功能恢复情况。结果显示，经过CAR T细胞治疗后，患者的抗体水平显著降低，移植成功率提高，且排斥反应发生率较低。研究结论认为，CAR T细胞治疗为高敏感性肾移植患者提供了新的治疗选择，改善了移植预后。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 11, Page 1141-1143, September 17, 2026.

items.title: Late-Onset Pompe Disease
items.title_zh: 晚发性庞贝病的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了晚发性庞贝病（Late-Onset Pompe Disease, LOPD）的临床特征、诊断方法及治疗效果。研究对象为确诊的LOPD患者，采用基因测序和酶活性检测进行诊断。结果显示，患者普遍存在肌肉无力和呼吸困难等症状，且大多数患者在成年后才出现明显症状。治疗方面，酶替代疗法（Enzyme Replacement Therapy, ERT）显著改善了患者的生活质量和运动能力。研究结论强调了早期诊断和个体化治疗的重要性，以提高患者的预后。

items.title: Initial Screening for Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: 结直肠癌的初步筛查研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了结直肠癌的初步筛查方法，研究对象为年龄在50岁及以上的高风险人群。采用了粪便潜血检测（FOBT）和结肠镜检查相结合的筛查策略。结果显示，接受筛查的人群中，结直肠癌的早期发现率显著提高，FOBT的阳性预测值为15%，而结肠镜检查的发现率达到80%。研究表明，定期筛查能够有效降低结直肠癌的发病率和死亡率，建议在高风险人群中推广此筛查策略，以提高早期诊断率。

items.title: [Comment] The Accra Reset must turn sovereignty into country power
items.title_zh: 阿克拉重置：将主权转化为国家力量
items.summary_zh: 全球健康面临传统治理架构的严重干扰，主要由于资金流动的剧烈变化，这对低收入和中等收入国家影响深远。这些国家被要求协调来自全球健康机构的外部输入，但对其任务、董事会、资金或激励措施几乎没有控制权。卫生部门仍需对健康结果负责，而外部合作伙伴则掌握优先事项、融资渠道、指标和数据的权力。
items.abstract: Global health is experiencing severe disruption in its traditional governance architecture, precipitated by drastic changes in financial flows, which has greatly affected low-income and middle-income countries. These countries are asked to coordinate external inputs from global health institutions while having little control over their mandates, boards, funding, or incentives. Ministries of health remain accountable for health outcomes while external partners retain authority over priorities, financing channels, indicators, and data.
items.authors: Ebere Okereke, Spring Gombe, Catherine Kyobutungi, Magda Robalo

items.title: [Correspondence] Enhancing preparedness for the impending super El Niño
items.title_zh: 增强应对即将来临超级厄尔尼诺的准备
items.summary_zh: 新兴厄尔尼诺事件的峰值预测显示，其每月海表温度异常可能达到+3.9°C（中位数预测），显著超过2015-16年厄尔尼诺创下的最高记录+2.75°C。厄尔尼诺是一种自然现象，通常每2至7年发生一次，属于厄尔尼诺-南方涛动循环的一部分。然而，这一现象发生在气候变化的背景下，可能导致全球影响的加剧。
items.abstract: Peak predictions of the emerging El Niño event suggest that it could reach a maximum monthly sea surface temperature anomaly of +3·9°C (median forecast),1 substantially surpassing the highest recorded magnitude of +2·75°C set by the 2015–16 El Niño.2 El Niño is a natural phenomenon, occurring every 2–7 years as part of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation cycle, but it is happening against a background of human-induced climate change, which could result in more extreme global impacts over time.
items.authors: Ruby Lieber, Dann Mitchell, Andy Haines

items.title: Molecular computation that rolls energetically downhill
items.title_zh: 能量下降的分子计算机研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究展示了一种基于DNA的计算机，通过放松至热力学平衡进行操作，已在十个分子程序上实现。计算时间短至一分钟。一些程序在不同输入下重复运行了多达25次，另一些程序则扩展到100位计算，尽管这显著降低了计算速度。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02878-7 A DNA-based computer that operates by relaxing to thermodynamic equilibrium has been demonstrated on ten molecular programs, which completed computations in as little as one minute. Some programs were rerun using distinct inputs up to 25 times and others were scaled up to 100-bit computations — although this slowed them down substantially.

items.title: Turning scientific research papers into interactive AI agents
items.title_zh: 将科学研究论文转化为互动AI代理
items.summary_zh: 科学知识主要存储在静态论文中。一个名为Paper2Agent的自动化框架可以将每篇论文转化为一个活跃的人工智能代理——一个虚拟的通讯作者，能够回答问题、将论文的方法应用于新数据，并与其他论文代理进行协作。这一创新使得研究更易于复制、重用和扩展。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02880-z Scientific knowledge is mostly stored in static papers. An automated framework called Paper2Agent can now transform each paper into an active artificial intelligence agent — a virtual corresponding author that answers questions, applies the paper’s methods to new data, and collaborates with other paper agents. This makes research easier to reproduce, reuse and extend.

items.title: Modulation of the Endocannabinoid System by Cannabis sativa Bioactives in Alzheimer’s Disease: Therapeutic and Nutritional Implications
items.title_zh: 大麻生物活性成分对阿尔茨海默病内源性大麻素系统的调节
items.summary_zh: 背景：阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，特征为认知下降、神经炎症、氧化应激、淀粉样β积累和tau病理。目前的治疗方法提供的症状缓解有限，亟需新的治疗和营养方法。目的：本综述旨在评估大麻（Cannabis sativa）及其生物活性化合物在AD管理中的治疗和营养意义，重点关注分子机制、临床证据、提取技术和新兴治疗机会。方法：进行了全面的科学文献回顾，重点关注大麻素、非大麻素植物化学物质、麻类营养成分、临床前研究、临床研究及与AD相关的最新进展。结果：证据表明，大麻素，特别是大麻二酚（CBD）和Δ9-四氢大麻酚（THC），可能调节神经炎症、氧化应激、淀粉样β聚集、tau过磷酸化和神经元存活途径。新兴化合物如酸性大麻素、次要大麻素、多酚、类黄酮、麻类生物活性肽和根生物碱显示出额外的神经保护潜力。临床研究主要支持基于大麻素的干预措施以改善行为和神经精神症状。
items.abstract: Background: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, amyloid-β accumulation, and tau pathology. Current therapies provide limited symptomatic relief, highlighting the need for novel therapeutic and nutritional approaches. Objective: This review aimed to evaluate the therapeutic and nutritional implications of Cannabis sativa and its bioactive compounds in AD management, with emphasis on molecular mechanisms, clinical evidence, extraction technologies, and emerging therapeutic opportunities. Methods: A comprehensive review of the scientific literature was conducted, focusing on cannabinoids, non-cannabinoid phytochemicals, hemp-derived nutritional compounds, preclinical findings, clinical studies, and recent advances related to AD. Results: Evidence indicates that cannabinoids, particularly cannabidiol (CBD) and Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), may modulate neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, amyloid-β aggregation, tau hyperphosphorylation, and neuronal survival pathways. items.title: Divergent 12-Month Changes in Bone Mineral Density and Trabecular Bone Score With Menopausal Hormone Therapy Versus Alendronate: A Retrospective Comparative Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 绝经激素治疗与阿仑膦酸钠对骨密度的影响比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：绝经激素治疗（MHT）和阿仑膦酸钠均可改善骨矿密度（BMD），但对小梁骨评分（TBS）的比较效果尚不明确。本研究比较了接受MHT或阿仑膦酸钠治疗的绝经后女性在12个月内TBS和特定部位BMD的变化。方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入172名新诊断为骨质疏松的治疗未接触绝经后女性，分别接受MHT（n=87）或每周70 mg阿仑膦酸钠（n=85）。164名女性（MHT, n=83; 阿仑膦酸钠, n=81）有完整的基线和约12个月的DXA/TBS数据。主要结果为随访时腰椎TBS的组间调整差异，通过协方差分析评估。结果：调整后的MHT与阿仑膦酸钠在TBS上的差异为0.023（95% CI, 0.010–0.036; P<0.001）。MHT组TBS无显著变化（0.002 ± 0.044; P=0.699），而阿仑膦酸钠组TBS下降（−0.018 ± 0.040; P<0.001）。两组BMD均显著增加，阿仑膦酸钠在腰椎（调整差异, −0.014 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.019 to −0.009; P<0.001）、股骨颈（−0.005 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.009 to −0.001; P=0.013）和全髋（−0.007 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.011 to −0.003; P<0.001）处增益更大。结论：两种治疗均改善BMD，但阿仑膦酸钠的增益更大。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) and alendronate improve bone mineral density (BMD), but their comparative effects on trabecular bone score (TBS) are unclear. We compared 12-month changes in TBS and site-specific BMD in postmenopausal women treated with MHT or alendronate. Methods: This retrospective cohort included 172 treatment-naïve postmenopausal women with newly diagnosed osteoporosis who initiated MHT (n=87) or alendronate 70 mg/week (n=85). Complete baseline and approximately 12-month DXA/TBS data were available for 164 women (MHT, n=83; alendronate, n=81). The primary outcome was the adjusted between-group difference in lumbar spine TBS at follow-up, assessed by analysis of covariance. Results: The adjusted MHT-minus-alendronate difference in TBS was 0.023 (95% CI, 0.010–0.036; P lt;0.001). TBS showed no significant within-group change with MHT (0.002 ± 0.044; P=0.699) but decreased with alendronate (−0.018 ± 0.040; P lt;0.001). items.title: Adenosine Deaminase-Mediated Purine Dysfunction Leads to DNA Repair Inhibition and Senescence in Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
items.title_zh: 腺苷脱氨酶介导的嘌呤功能障碍导致肌萎缩侧索硬化中的DNA修复抑制和衰老
items.summary_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种神经退行性疾病，特征为运动神经元死亡，通常在症状出现后3-5年内导致瘫痪和死亡。我们的研究发现，散发性ALS（SALS）患者的诱导神经祖细胞来源的星形胶质细胞（iAstrocytes）中，腺苷脱氨酶（ADA）缺失导致嘌呤代谢功能障碍。ADA缺失伴随外源性5′-核苷酸酶和次黄嘌呤-鸟嘌呤磷酸核糖转移酶的变化，导致嘌呤代谢物水平的紊乱，这与ADA酶的水平相关。年龄和性别影响ADA下游的嘌呤代谢物水平，并与疾病进展呈正相关。ADA缺失导致53BP1介导的DNA修复减少和P16水平增加，这在对照iAstrocytes中通过ADA抑制得以重现。研究结果表明，TDP43功能障碍在体外驱动ADA介导的嘌呤代谢损伤，导致DNA损伤和细胞衰老的下游效应。
items.abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease characterised by the death of motor neurons leading to paralysis and death generally 3–5 years post-symptom onset. ALS is a cell- and non-cell-autonomous disease, with glia such as astrocytes influencing disease pathology and progression. Our laboratory has previously identified purine metabolism dysfunction in induced neural progenitor cell-derived astrocytes (iAstrocytes) from sporadic ALS (SALS) cases, driven by loss of the enzyme adenosine deaminase (ADA). Here, we have demonstrated that loss of ADA, along with changes to ecto-5′-nucleotidase and hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyl transferase led to disruption in purine metabolite levels, linked to the level of the ADA enzyme. These alterations were recapitulated in SALS CSF and post-mortem tissue, with ageing and sex affecting purine metabolite levels downstream of ADA and positively correlating with disease progression. Loss of ADA led to reduced 53BP1-mediated DNA repair and increased P16 levels, which was recapitulated in control iAstrocytes via ADA inhibition. Our findings indicate that TDP43 dysfunction drives impairment of ADA-mediated purine metabolism
items.authors: Benjamin Hall, Yasmina M. Ebrahim, Joanne L. Sharpe, Sangeet Makhija, Brittany C. S. Ellis, Kari E. Wong

items.title: The Management of Left Subclavian Artery in Aortic Open and Endovascular Surgery
items.title_zh: 主动脉开放与血管内手术中左锁骨下动脉的管理
items.summary_zh: 在主动脉弓手术中，左锁骨下动脉（LSA）的管理因其深部解剖位置和潜在病理变化而复杂，可能导致中风、脊髓损伤和喉返神经损伤等风险。LSA的再血管化在多种临床情况下至关重要，以维持椎动脉、脊髓和上肢的充分灌注，尤其是在解剖变异、既往旁路手术或缺血风险增加的患者中。未进行再血管化的胸主动脉内修复（TEVAR）覆盖LSA显著增加中风和脊髓缺血的发生率。我们进行了叙述性综述，评估了主动脉弓及LSA的现代开放和血管内治疗选择。冷冻大象干（FET）、血管内策略（分支和窗孔TEVAR）以及新兴的混合设备都是有价值的治疗方法，各自具有优缺点，需理解以获得最佳的患者-假体匹配。基于病理、紧急程度和患者因素的个体化治疗选择对于优化结果至关重要。这一不断发展的范式整合了开放和血管内技术，以改善复杂主动脉弓疾病患者的护理。
items.abstract: Management of the left subclavian artery (LSA) during aortic arch surgery is complex due to its deep anatomical location and potential pathological alterations, posing risks such as stroke, spinal cord injury, and recurrent laryngeal nerve damage. Revascularization of the LSA is critical in various clinical scenarios to maintain adequate perfusion to the vertebral arteries, spinal cord, and upper limb, especially in patients with anatomical variations, prior bypass surgeries, or increased risk of ischemia. Coverage of the LSA during thoracic endovascular repair (TEVAR) without revascularization significantly increases stroke and spinal cord ischemia rates. We provided a narrative review, evaluating contemporary open and endovascular options for the treatment of the aortic arch, and consequently of the LSA. Frozen elephant trunk (FET), endovascular strategies (branched and fenestrated TEVAR), but also emerging hybrid devices, are all valuable treatments with respective strengths and limitations to be understood to obtain the best patient-prosthesis match. Individualized treatment selection based on pathology, urgency, and patient factors is essential to optimize outcomes. This evolv
items.authors: Federico Giorgi, Nicola Troisi, Laura Besola, Danilo Ruggiero, Giacomo Ravenni, Michele Celiento

items.title: AI-Assisted Scoring Improves Interobserver Agreement in Breast Cancer Biomarker Evaluation
items.title_zh: AI辅助评分提升乳腺癌生物标志物评估的观察者一致性
items.summary_zh: 背景：雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）、增殖标志物Ki67及人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）的免疫组化评估是侵袭性乳腺癌诊断流程的核心，直接影响治疗决策、预后及患者管理。本研究评估了Indica Labs临床图像分析平台在伯尔尼大学进行的前瞻性观察者研究中对乳腺癌生物标志物评分的AI辅助应用。方法：对50例乳腺癌病例的250张免疫组化染色切片，三名医学生和两名认证病理学家进行了独立评估。首次评估使用传统数字病理方法（Visual Dx），随后经过四周的洗脱期，使用HALO Breast IHC AI（AI辅助Dx）重新评估同样病例。分析观察者一致性和评分一致性，以比较不同评估方法的表现。
items.abstract: Background: Immunohistochemical assessment of estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), proliferation marker Ki67, and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) represents a central component of the diagnostic workflow in invasive breast carcinoma, directly influencing therapeutic decision-making, prognosis, and patient management. In this study, we evaluated the use of Indica Labs’ clinical image analysis platform for AI-assisted breast cancer biomarker scoring in a prospective observer study conducted at the University of Bern. The study compared biomarker assessment by novice observers and trained pathologists with and without AI assistance, with a focus on interobserver agreement, scoring consistency, and the potential role of AI-assisted workflows in diagnostic practice and training environments. Methods: Fifty breast cancer cases comprising 250 immunohistochemically stained slides for ER, PR, HER2, and Ki67 were independently assessed by three medical students and two board-certified pathologists in two sequential evaluation rounds. In the first round, biomarkers were scored using conventional digital pathology assessment without AI support (Visual Dx). Follow
items.authors: Wiebke Solass, Clara Desteffani, Florin Kalberer, Ben Scattolo, Branislav Zagrapan, Donna Mulkern

items.title: Zeb1 Is a Determinant of EMT in Human MDA-MB-231 Breast Cancer Cells and M13-MDA231 Tumor Hybrids
items.title_zh: Zeb1在MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞及其肿瘤杂交体中的作用
items.summary_zh: Zeb1是一种已知的上皮-间质转化（EMT）转录因子，在侵袭性癌症中高度表达。本研究探讨了Zeb1在M13-MDA231-6和-13肿瘤杂交体中的作用，这些杂交体源自MDA-MB-231-Hyg人乳腺癌细胞与M13SV1-EGFP-Neo人乳腺上皮细胞的自发融合事件。通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的Zeb1-KO，MDA-MB-231-Hyg-Zeb1-KO和M13-MDA231-13-Zeb1-KO细胞中E-Cadherin重新表达，而M13-MDA231-6-Zeb1-KO细胞则未观察到此现象。与未编辑细胞相比，MDA-MB-231-Hyg-Zeb1-KO和M13-MDA231-13-Zeb1-KO细胞的增殖显著降低，但M13-MDA231-6-Zeb1-KO细胞未见此变化。Zeb1-KO细胞在迁移和侵袭研究中表现出显著减少的迁移活性。总之，数据支持Zeb1在肿瘤细胞迁移中的重要作用。
items.abstract: Zeb1 is a well-known epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT) transcription factor and is highly expressed in aggressive cancers. Tumor hybrids, which were derived from fusion events between cancer cells and normal cells, such as macrophage and stem cells, can possess novel properties, such as enhanced metastatic activity. The role of Zeb1 was studied in M13-MDA231-6 and -13 tumor hybrids that were derived from spontaneous fusion events between MDA-MB-231-Hyg human breast cancer cells and M13SV1-EGFP-Neo human breast epithelial cells. The stable CRISPR/Cas9-mediated Zeb1-KO was correlated with re-expression of E-Cadherin in MDA-MB-231-Hyg-Zeb1-KO and M13-MDA231-13-Zeb1-KO cells, but not in M13-MDA231-6-Zeb1-KO cells. Similarly, the proliferation of MDA-MB-231-Hyg-Zeb1-KO in M13-MDA231-13-Zeb1-KO cells, but not in M13-MDA231-6-Zeb1-KO cells, was decreased as compared to non-edited cells. The migratory activity of Zeb1-KO cells was markedly reduced in transmigration and invasion studies compared to non-edited cells. However, MDA-MB-231-Hyg-Zeb1-KO cells and M13-MDA231-6-Zeb1-KO tumors only showed reduced migratory behavior in a scratch/wound healing assay, while M13-MDA231-13-Zeb1-KO

items.title: Myocardial Injury and Predictors of In-Hospital Mortality in Severe or Critical COVID-19: A Single-Center Observational Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 重症或危重COVID-19患者的心肌损伤与住院死亡率预测因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：重症或危重COVID-19患者的住院死亡率仍然较高。本研究旨在识别住院死亡的独立预测因素，并评估心肌损伤在这一高风险人群中的预后价值。方法：本单中心观察性队列研究纳入172名因重症或危重COVID-19住院的成年人。使用逻辑回归和受试者工作特征曲线分析评估与死亡相关的因素。心肌损伤定义为入院后3-5天hs-cTnT≥14 ng/L。结果：172名患者中，有60名在住院期间死亡（34.9%）。在126个完整病例和37例死亡的主要多变量模型中，年龄（每增加10年，aOR=2.55；95% CI, 1.55–4.22）、既往心血管疾病（aOR=3.06；95% CI, 1.03–9.07）、LDH（每翻倍，aOR=6.31；95% CI, 2.70–14.78）和CT肺部受累（每增加10%，aOR=1.34；95% CI, 1.01–1.80）与住院死亡独立相关。在121名患者（35例死亡）的单独分析中，心肌损伤在调整年龄、心血管疾病和肺部受累后仍与死亡独立相关（aOR=5.19；95% CI, 1.82–14.77）。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: In-hospital mortality remains high among patients with severe or critical COVID-19. This study aimed to identify independent predictors of in-hospital mortality and assess the prognostic value of myocardial injury in this high-risk population. Materials and Methods: This single-center observational cohort study included 172 adults hospitalized with severe or critical COVID-19 across multiple pandemic waves. Mortality-associated factors were assessed using logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve analysis. Myocardial injury was defined as hs-cTnT 14 ng/L, measured on days 3–5 after admission. Results: Of 172 patients, 60 died during hospitalization (34.9%). In the primary multivariable model, based on 126 complete cases and 37 deaths, age (aOR = 2.55 per 10-year increase; 95% CI, 1.55–4.22), pre-existing cardiovascular disease (aOR = 3.06; 95% CI, 1.03–9.07), LDH (aOR = 6.31 per doubling; 95% CI, 2.70–14.78), and CT pulmonary involvement (aOR = 1.34 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 1.01–1.80), were independently associated with in-hospital mortality. items.title: FOLFOX Plus Bevacizumab Rechallenge Versus Regorafenib as Third-Line Treatment in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: The Role of the Oxaliplatin-Free Interval
items.title_zh: FOLFOX联合贝伐单抗再挑战与瑞戈非尼作为转移性结直肠癌三线治疗的比较
items.summary_zh: 背景：在后线转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）中，化疗再挑战的最佳使用尚不确定。本研究比较了三线FOLFOX联合贝伐单抗再挑战与瑞戈非尼的疗效，并探讨了奥沙利铂无药物间隔与治疗结果的关系。方法：本回顾性单中心研究纳入122例2018至2025年间接受治疗的转移性左侧、RAS（KRAS/NRAS）和BRAF野生型、有效错配修复（pMMR）结直肠腺癌患者。所有患者均接受了第一线FOLFOX联合西妥昔单抗或帕尼单抗，随后在疾病进展后接受FOLFIRI联合贝伐单抗。在三线治疗中，65例患者接受了FOLFOX联合贝伐单抗再挑战，57例接受了瑞戈非尼。主要终点为无进展生存期（PFS）。结果：FOLFOX联合贝伐单抗再挑战的中位三线PFS为7.33个月，瑞戈非尼为6.17个月（log-rank p 0.001）。多变量分析显示，FOLFOX联合贝伐单抗再挑战与较低的进展风险相关（调整后HR为0.58，95% CI为0.39–0.88，p = 0.009），倾向评分基础的IPTW敏感性分析结果一致（HR为0.58）。
items.abstract: Background: The optimal use of chemotherapy rechallenge in later-line metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) remains uncertain. We compared third-line FOLFOX plus bevacizumab rechallenge with regorafenib and examined whether the oxaliplatin-free interval was associated with treatment outcomes. Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 122 patients with metastatic left-sided, RAS (KRAS/NRAS) and BRAF wild-type, proficient mismatch repair (pMMR) colorectal adenocarcinoma treated between 2018 and 2025. All patients had received first-line FOLFOX plus cetuximab or panitumumab, followed by FOLFIRI plus bevacizumab after progression. In the third-line setting, 65 patients received FOLFOX plus bevacizumab as oxaliplatin rechallenge and 57 received regorafenib. The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS). Cox regression, propensity score-based inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW), and treatment-by-oxaliplatin-free interval interaction analyses were performed. items.title: Aggregation-Sensitive Mortality Associations and Firth Penalized Logistic Regression After Hip Fracture Surgery: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 髋关节骨折手术后聚合敏感性死亡关联及Firth惩罚逻辑回归研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：髋关节骨折的死亡率分析可能受到聚合相关的关联估计变化和稀疏数据偏倚的影响，尤其是在早期死亡结果方面。方法：本回顾性研究纳入了2020年至2025年间接受髋关节骨折手术的297名患者。以1年死亡率为主要结果，30天死亡率为次要结果。比较了合并、分层特异性和Mantel–Haenszel比值比，以探讨聚合敏感性变化。使用相同的预测变量集拟合传统最大似然逻辑回归和Firth惩罚逻辑回归。模型性能通过曲线下面积（AUC）、Brier评分、校准措施和1000次重抽样的自助法内部验证进行评估。结果：在294名可评估患者中，30天内发生死亡的有36例，1年内发生死亡的有95例。未观察到关联的完全逆转。探索性比较表明，男性的年龄相关减弱、低血红蛋白水平在性别分层中的适度掩盖，以及痴呆和升高的NLR的轻微放大。在1年模型中，年龄、男性、ASA IV状态、痴呆或认知障碍及术前低血红蛋白水平与死亡率独立相关。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Hip fracture mortality analyses may be influenced by aggregation-related changes in association estimates and sparse data bias, particularly for early mortality outcomes. Methods: This retrospective study included 297 patients who underwent hip fracture surgery between 2020 and 2025. One-year mortality was the primary outcome, and 30-day mortality was the secondary outcome. Pooled, stratum-specific, and Mantel–Haenszel odds ratios were compared to explore aggregation-sensitive changes in association estimates. Conventional maximum likelihood logistic regression and Firth penalized logistic regression were fitted using the same predictor set. The model performance was evaluated using the area under the curve (AUC), the Brier score, calibration measures, and bootstrap internal validation with 1000 resamples. Results: Mortality occurred in 36 of 294 evaluable patients within 30 days and 95 of 252 evaluable patients within one year. No complete reversal of the association was observed. items.title: Epigenetic Regulation of Sialyltransferase ST6GAL1 Drives Breast Tumor Heterogeneity
items.title_zh: 表观遗传调控唾液酸转移酶ST6GAL1驱动乳腺肿瘤异质性
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：肿瘤进展常伴随唾液酸转移酶ST6GAL1介导的细胞表面N-糖基化糖蛋白的α2-6连接唾液酸化。人类癌症的一个特征是癌细胞中ST6GAL1表达的异质性，但其机制和重要性尚不清楚。本研究探讨ST6GAL1 DNA甲基化的表观遗传变化是否与人类乳腺癌细胞的生物学相关。方法：分析人类ST6GAL1启动子不同区域（P2和P3）的CpG岛甲基化及其在原发性乳腺肿瘤中与正常组织对照的ST6GAL1表达丧失的关联。评估ST6GAL1 DNA甲基化的表观遗传变化与患者无进展生存期（PFS）的关系。使用小分子表观遗传抑制剂（5-aza-dC和MS-275）评估ST6GAL1转录再激活及其对细胞内ST6GAL1、细胞表面α2,6-唾液酸化和胶原I细胞粘附的影响。结果：在雌激素受体（ER）+和人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）+原发乳腺癌组织中，ST6GAL1 P3启动子高甲基化显著相关。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Tumor progression is often accompanied by sialylation of cell-surface N-glycan glycoproteins with α2-6-linked sialic acids by the sialyltransferase ST6GAL1. Moreover, a hallmark of human cancers is heterogeneity in ST6GAL1 expression among cancer cells, yet the mechanisms and significance of this variability remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate whether epigenetic changes in ST6GAL1 DNA methylation, which affect intracellular ST6GAL1 and cell-surface α2,6-sialylation of glycoproteins, are associated with the biology of human breast cancer (BCa) cells. Methods: We analyzed CpG island methylation across spatially distinct regions of the human ST6GAL1 promoter (P2 and P3) and the associated loss of ST6GAL1 expression in primary human breast tumors compared with adjacent normal tissue controls. Epigenetic changes in ST6GAL1 DNA methylation and patient progression-free survival (PFS) were evaluated. Small-molecule epigenetic inhibitors (5-aza-dC and MS-275) were used to assess ST6GAL1 transcriptional reactivation and its effects on intracellular ST6GAL1, cell-surface α2,6-sialylation, and cell adhesion to collagen I in cultured BCa cell models.
