items.title: A Mini Review of Functional Hydrogels for the Treatment of Oral Diseases: Opportunities and Future Prospects
items.title_zh: 功能性水凝胶在口腔疾病治疗中的应用前景综述
items.summary_zh: 口腔健康是全身健康的重要基础。由于饮食结构和生活习惯的多样性，几乎每个人都受到口腔疾病的影响，如口腔溃疡、牙齿变色和龋齿等。然而，传统口腔生物材料的固有特性限制了现有临床治疗的可靠性和稳定性，导致临床需求未能得到满足。近年来，功能性水凝胶因其良好的生物相容性、生物降解性和可调机械性能，在生物医学领域引起广泛关注，展现出在口腔疾病治疗中的应用潜力。本文回顾了功能性水凝胶在口腔疾病治疗中的最新进展，重点讨论其作用机制和治疗效果。最后，文章还批判性地讨论了功能性水凝胶在口腔临床应用中的当前挑战和未来机遇。此研究旨在为口腔疾病创新治疗策略的设计与开发提供有价值的指导。
items.abstract: Oral health represents a cornerstone of systemic health. Driven by diverse dietary structures and lifestyle habits, nearly everyone is affected by common oral diseases, including oral ulcers, tooth discoloration, and dental caries, etc. However, limited by the inherent properties of conventional oral biomaterials, existing clinical treatments still suffer from insufficient reliability and stability, leaving substantial clinical demands unmet. In recent years, functional hydrogels have aroused widespread interest in the biomedical field owing to their favorable biocompatibility, biodegradability, and tunable mechanical properties, exhibiting promising application potential in oral disease treatment. This paper reviews the recent progress of functional hydrogels in the treatment of oral diseases, with emphasis on their working mechanisms and therapeutic outcomes. Lastly, the current challenges and future opportunities of functional hydrogels in oral clinical applications are also critically discussed. This work is expected to provide valuable guidance for the design and development of innovative therapeutic strategies for oral diseases.
items.authors: Huixu Li, Xinru Feng, Pingping Bao, Jing Shen, Ding Zhang

items.title: Proteomic Profiling Reveals Intracellular Regulatory Network Disturbance Induced by QseB Deletion in Glaesserella parasuis
items.title_zh: QseB缺失引起Glaesserella parasuis细胞内调控网络紊乱的蛋白质组学分析
items.summary_zh: Glaesserella parasuis中的高度保守的QseB/QseC双组分系统（TCS）调控基因表达，其中QseC为组氨酸激酶，QseB为响应调节因子。本研究采用数据独立获取（DIA）定量蛋白质组学方法，探讨qseB缺失对细菌形态、蛋白质组和分子调控的影响。电子显微镜观察显示，ΔqseB突变体表现出超微结构损伤，包括细胞收缩、膜损伤、细胞壁分离和原生质体溶解，表明qseB缺失导致细胞结构完整性严重受损。通过DIA定量蛋白质组学共鉴定出1493种蛋白质，其中55种蛋白质在ΔqseB突变体与野生型菌株SC1401之间表现出差异表达，24种上调，31种下调。上调蛋白主要为热休克蛋白和分子伴侣，参与应激反应和蛋白质折叠；下调蛋白则与TCS、群体感应和转运功能相关。
items.abstract: The highly conserved QseB/QseC two-component system (TCS) in Glaesserella parasuis (G. parasuis) regulates gene expression, with QseC as a histidine kinase and QseB as a response regulator. This study employed data-independent acquisition (DIA) quantitative proteomics to investigate the effects of qseB deletion on bacterial morphology, proteome, and molecular regulation. Electron microscopy revealed that the ΔqseB mutant exhibited ultrastructural damage, including cell shrinkage, membrane impairment, cell wall separation, and protoplast dissolution, indicating that the loss of qseB resulted in severe compromise of cellular structural integrity. A total of 1493 proteins were identified by DIA quantitative proteomics. Fifty-five proteins were differentially expressed between the ΔqseB mutant and the wild-type strain SC1401. Among them, 24 were upregulated and 31 were downregulated. Upregulated proteins were mainly heat shock proteins (DnaK, HslV/U, ClpB), molecular chaperones (GroL, HtpG, HslO), and co-chaperone GroES, along with translation inhibitors RaiA and RsfS. These proteins participate in stress response, protein folding, and proteostasis maintenance. The downregulated protei
items.authors: Xuefeng Yan, Congwei Gu, Mingde Zhao, Lvqin He

items.title: Practical Insights from Operationalizing a Remote Symptom Monitoring Program Using a Commercial Platform in a Canadian Community Cancer Clinic: A Post-Implementation Qualitative Evaluation
items.title_zh: 加拿大社区癌症诊所远程症状监测项目的实践经验
items.summary_zh: 远程症状监测通过电子患者报告结果减少了肿瘤学中的症状负担和急救使用，但大多数项目在学术中心或资助试验中建立，使用专门软件。我们研究了REmote Symptom and Patient mONitoring System（RESPONSe）如何在加拿大社区癌症诊所实施并作为重复临床服务获得资金，使用配置的商业平台、患者自有设备且没有正式的机构授权。我们在不列颠哥伦比亚省的里士满癌症诊所进行了定性后实施过程评估，按照《定性研究报告的综合标准》进行报告。邀请了八名工作人员参与访谈，涵盖一名肿瘤科医生、三名护士、两名虚拟健康工作人员和两名管理员。访谈采用演绎-归纳主题分析法进行分析，识别出三个主题：为临床适配定制技术；围绕患者和临床用户设计护理，以专职症状管理护士为中心；以及向操作化管理的推进。使用可定制的商业平台实现操作化是可行的，但依赖于迭代技术适应、专职临床责任、不断发展的护理工作流程和可持续性。
items.abstract: Remote symptom monitoring using electronic patient-reported outcomes reduces symptom burden and acute care use in oncology, but most programs have been established in academic centers or funded trials using purpose-built software. We examined how the REmote Symptom and Patient mONitoring System (RESPONSe) was implemented and subsequently funded as a recurrent clinical service at a Canadian community cancer clinic using a configured commercial platform, patients’ own devices, and no formal institutional mandate. We conducted a qualitative post-implementation process evaluation at Richmond Cancer Clinic, British Columbia, reported following the Consolidated Criteria for Reporting Qualitative Research. Eight staff, purposively sampled by role and phase of involvement, were invited and participated, which consisted of one oncologist, three nurses, two virtual health staff, and two administrators. Interviews were analyzed using deductive–inductive thematic analysis. Three themes were identified: tailoring technology for clinical fit; designing care around patient and clinician users, centered on a dedicated symptom management nurse; and managing up towards operationalization. items.authors: Melissa J. Chao, Eric Liow, Nasia A. Sheikh, Jeremy Ho

items.title: Expression Analysis of Selected miRNAs in COVID-19 Patients
items.title_zh: COVID-19患者中选定miRNA的表达分析
items.summary_zh: 微小RNA（miRNA）表达的变化可能通过调节靶蛋白影响疾病发生和生物过程。本研究旨在比较COVID-19患者与健康对照者血清中miRNA水平（miR-19a-3p、miR-19b-3p、miR-21、miR-26a-5p、miR-146a、let-7b-3p、miR-155、miR-16、miR-590、miR-1307-3p）的差异，以探讨其临床意义和对疾病发生的贡献。我们从70名COVID-19患者和30名健康个体中采集血样，患者根据疾病严重程度分为轻型、中型和重型。通过实时PCR定量miRNA表达水平，采用Livak ΔΔCT法进行相对定量分析。结果显示，COVID-19患者中miR-1307-3p、miR-146、miR-26a-5p、miR-21、miR-19b-3p和let-7b-3p的表达水平存在统计学显著差异（p < 0.05），而miR-16则呈现非显著的下降趋势。不同患者组的miRNA表达谱存在变异。我们认为miRNA在COVID-19的复杂发病机制中具有重要的潜在治疗靶点和关键调节作用。
items.abstract: Modulations in microRNA (miRNA) expression can contribute to disease pathogenesis and biological processes by regulating target proteins. We aimed to compare serum miRNA levels (miR-19a-3p, miR-19b-3p, miR-21, miR-26a-5p, miR-146a, let-7b-3p, miR-155, miR-16, miR-590, miR-1307-3p) between COVID-19 patients and healthy controls to investigate their clinical significance and contribution to disease pathogenesis. Blood samples were obtained from 70 patients diagnosed with COVID-19 and from 30 healthy individuals as a control group for comparison. The patients were stratified into three categories based on disease severity: mild, moderate, and severe. miRNA expression levels were quantified via real-time PCR, with relative quantification performed using the Livak ΔΔCT method by calculating the 2(−ΔΔCT) fold change values. In patients with COVID-19, the expression levels of miR-1307-3p, miR-146, miR-26a-5p, miR-21, miR-19b-3p, and let-7b-3p demonstrated statistically significant differences (p 0.05). items.title: Guanidinoacetic Acid and Cysteamine Hydrochloride Improve Beef Cattle Growth and Antioxidant Capacity via Fecal Microbiome and Serum Metabolome
items.title_zh: 胍基乙酸与氨基乙烯基盐酸盐改善肉牛生长与抗氧化能力
items.summary_zh: 平衡肌肉生长与抗氧化/抗炎稳态是现代肉牛生产的核心要求。本研究探讨了氨基乙烯基盐酸盐（CSH）与胍基乙酸（GAA）共同补充是否通过调节粪便微生物组和血清代谢组来增强西门塔尔肉牛的生长和抗氧化状态。试验持续60天，将45头10个月大的肉牛随机分为对照组（CON）、GAA补充组和GAA + CSH补充组（每组15头）。结果显示，GAA和GAA + CSH组的生长表现均优于对照组（p < 0.05），但补充组之间无显著差异。然而，GAA + CSH组独特地提高了抗氧化酶水平并降低了丙二醛（p < 0.05）。该处理与Adlercreutzia、Anaerofustis和Monoglobus的丰度增加相关，同时提高了吲哚-3-丙酸和水杨酸硫酸盐的水平。相反，GAA降低了苯乙酰-L-谷氨酰胺和吲哚-3-乙酸。iCAMP分析显示，GAA + CSH缓解了均匀选择，同时增强了异质选择，促进了有益类群的定殖。GAA主要增强氮的利用，而CSH则丰富了有益微生物群和抗氧化代谢物。这些发现表明，联合补充有助于肉牛的生长和抗氧化能力。
items.abstract: Balancing muscle growth and antioxidant/anti-inflammatory homeostasis is a core requirement for modern beef production. This study investigated whether cysteamine hydrochloride (CSH) co-supplementation with guanidinoacetic acid (GAA) enhances growth and antioxidant status through fecal microbiome and serum metabolome modulation in Simmental beef cattle. A 60-day trial randomly assigned 45 10-month-old cattle to control (CON), GAA-supplemented, and GAA + CSH-supplemented groups (n = 15 per group). Growth performance was recorded throughout the trial. Fecal samples were collected for 16S rRNA sequencing, and serum samples for non-targeted metabolomics. Both GAA and GAA + CSH (GCSH) improved growth performance versus CON (p 0.05), with no differences between supplemented groups. However, GCSH uniquely elevated antioxidant enzymes and reduced malondialdehyde (p 0.05). GCSH treatment was associated with higher abundance of Adlercreutzia, Anaerofustis, and Monoglobus, alongside elevated indole-3-propionic acid and salicylsulfuric acid. items.authors: Baoshan Feng, Hongwei Zhang, Jianjun Guo, Meishu Tan, Sen Mao, Bin Yu

items.title: Transplanted human brain-tissue takes root in mice without a cortex
items.title_zh: 移植人脑组织在无皮层小鼠中生根
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了移植的人脑组织在缺乏皮层的小鼠中如何实现细胞整合。研究发现，移植的脑组织能够与宿主神经系统有效整合，形成复杂的细胞网络。这一过程可能为新疗法的体内测试提供了平台。研究还利用人工智能工具，将论文转化为“虚拟通讯作者”，以促进科学交流和合作。结果表明，移植的脑组织不仅存活，还能在缺乏皮层的环境中发挥功能，为未来的神经再生研究提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02927-1 Extensive cellular integration might provide platform for in vivo testing of new therapies — plus, the AI tool that turns papers into ‘virtual corresponding authors’.
items.authors: Benjamin Thompson

items.title: Targeted genomic integration and rearrangement using prime assembly
items.title_zh: 利用引导组装实现靶向基因组整合与重排
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了引导组装技术在人体细胞中实现中到大规模DNA序列整合的能力。该方法无需双链断裂或细胞周期进程，支持外显子重编码、转基因插入及百万碱基规模的重排。研究表明，引导组装能够有效地在基因组中进行靶向整合，为基因编辑和合成生物学提供了新的工具和思路。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11024-2 Prime assembly enables RNA-guided integration of medium-to-large DNA sequences in human cells without requiring double-strand breaks or cell cycle progression, and supports exon recoding, transgene insertion and megabase-scale rearrangements.
items.authors: Sébastien Levesque

items.title: The chromokinesin Kid (KIF22) forms a homodimer, moves processively along microtubules, and transports double-stranded DNA
items.title_zh: 染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）形成同源二聚体并沿微管有序移动
items.summary_zh: 在有丝分裂的前中期，染色体被推向纺锤体赤道。染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）在前中期沿纺锤微管移动。长期以来，Kid被认为是单体且非有序的马达，与典型的动力蛋白不同。本研究表明，全长Kid形成同源二聚体并沿微管有序移动。Kid的茎区内一个保守的螺旋-螺旋结构域足以促成二聚体形成，并且对Kid的有序性至关重要。此外，Kid的颈部连接器和螺旋-螺旋结构域可以为KIF1A的马达域增加有序活性，表明Kid具备功能性的颈部连接器和二聚化能力，这是动力蛋白马达域有序性的前提。全长Kid含有螺旋-发夹-螺旋结构域，能够在体外沿微管运输双链DNA。AlphaFold3预测表明，Kid的二聚化稳定了与DNA的结合。这些发现共同表明，Kid应重新分类为一种有序且二聚的马达，能够沿微管运输DNA。
items.abstract: During prometaphase in mitosis, chromosomes are pushed toward the spindle equator. The chromokinesin Kid, also known as KIF22, moves chromosomes along spindle microtubules during prometaphase. Kid has long been considered a monomeric and nonprocessive motor, different from typical kinesins. In this study, we demonstrate that the full-length Kid forms a homodimer and moves processively along microtubules. A conserved coiled-coil domain within the stalk region of Kid is sufficient for homodimer formation and is required for the processivity of Kid. Furthermore, the neck linker and coiled-coil domains of Kid could add processive activity to the motor domain of KIF1A, suggesting that Kid contains a functional neck linker and dimerization capability, a prerequisite for the processivity of kinesin motor domains. The full-length Kid, containing a helix–hairpin–helix domain, can transport double-stranded DNA along microtubules in vitro. AlphaFold3 prediction suggests that the dimerization of Kid stabilizes the association with DNA. These findings collectively suggest the reclassification of Kid as a processive and dimeric motor that transports DNA along microtubules.

items.title: Beyond Traditional Risk Scores: Artificial Intelligence in Coronary Plaque Characterization and Personalized Atherosclerosis Management
items.title_zh: 超越传统风险评分：人工智能在冠状动脉斑块特征化与个性化动脉粥样硬化管理中的应用
items.summary_zh: 动脉粥样硬化是全球心血管疾病发病率和死亡率的主要原因，其隐匿的进展和复杂的病因常导致临床识别延迟。传统风险分层工具因依赖有限变量和静态线性假设而受到限制，常常错误分类高风险个体。本文回顾了人工智能（AI），特别是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）在动脉粥样硬化管理中的变革性作用。首先，探讨AI驱动的预测模型如何整合基因组学、影像学和实时可穿戴数据，实现优于传统评分的心血管风险分层。其次，详细说明AI在先进影像分析中自动化和增强斑块特征化的能力，能够定量评估人类读者难以察觉的负担、成分和脆弱性标志。最后，研究AI驱动的临床决策支持系统、数字双胞胎和强化学习方法，促进针对每位患者的动态个性化治疗规划。
items.abstract: Atherosclerosis remains a leading global cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, yet its insidious progression and multifaceted etiology, spanning genetic, metabolic, and environmental determinants, often delay clinical recognition until adverse events occur. Traditional risk stratification tools, while foundational in preventive cardiology, are constrained by their reliance on limited variables and static linear assumptions, frequently misclassifying individuals at the extremes of risk. This review critically examines the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), in redefining atherosclerosis management across three interconnected domains. First, we explore how AI-driven predictive models integrate high-dimensional data, from genomics and imaging to real-time wearable metrics, to achieve superior cardiovascular risk stratification compared with conventional scores. Second, we detail AI’s capacity to automate and enhance plaque characterization through advanced imaging analysis, enabling reproducible quantification of burden, composition, and vulnerability markers that are imperceptible to human readers.
items.authors: Rassulbek Aipov, Timur Saliev, Baurzhan Aipov, Zulfiya Kachiyeva, Aksoltan Oradova, Ildar Fakhradiyev

items.title: The NSDHL/c-Myc/PKM2 Axis Drives Glycolytic Reprogramming and Tumor Growth in Multiple Myeloma
items.title_zh: NSDHL/c-Myc/PKM2轴驱动多发性骨髓瘤的糖酵解重编程与肿瘤生长
items.summary_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤（MM）因其复杂的生物学特性和频繁的疾病复发而难以治愈。代谢重编程被认为是MM进展的重要因素。NAD(P)-依赖的类固醇脱氢酶样蛋白（NSDHL）在浆细胞瘤中被认为是一个不利的代谢相关预后基因，但其功能意义和代谢作用尚不明确。通过分析公开的MM转录组数据集和MMRF-CoMMpass队列，评估了NSDHL的表达及其临床相关性。使用CCK-8法评估细胞增殖，同时测量葡萄糖消耗、乳酸产生和细胞外酸化速率以评估糖酵解活性。NSDHL敲低后进行了RNA测序。结果显示，NSDHL在MM中上调，与疾病晚期和较差的总体生存率相关。NSDHL敲低抑制了MM细胞增殖和糖酵解活性。机制上，NSDHL降低了c-Myc在T58位点的磷酸化，同时促进了S62位点的磷酸化，从而抑制了c-Myc的蛋白酶体依赖性降解，稳定了该蛋白。稳定的c-Myc进一步增强了丙酮酸激酶M2（PKM2）的转录表达，导致糖酵解增加。我们的数据揭示了一个新的NSDHL/c-Myc/PKM2调控轴，驱动糖酵解重编程。
items.abstract: Multiple myeloma (MM) remains largely incurable because of its complex biology and frequent disease relapse. Metabolic reprogramming is increasingly recognized as a critical contributor to MM progression. NAD (P)-dependent steroid dehydrogenase-like protein (NSDHL) has been highlighted as an unfavorable metabolism-related prognostic gene in plasma cell myeloma, but its functional significance and metabolic role in MM remain unclear. Publicly available MM transcriptomic datasets and the MMRF-CoMMpass cohort were analyzed to evaluate NSDHL expression and its clinical relevance. Cell proliferation was assessed using CCK-8 assays, while glucose consumption, lactate production, and extracellular acidification rate were measured to evaluate glycolytic activity. RNA sequencing was performed following NSDHL knockdown. NSDHL was upregulated in MM and associated with advanced disease stage and poor overall survival. NSDHL knockdown suppressed MM cell proliferation and glycolytic activity. Mechanistically, NSDHL reduced c-Myc phosphorylation at T58 while promoting phosphorylation at S62, thereby inhibiting proteasome-dependent degradation of c-Myc and stabilizing the protein. items.authors: Can Yue, Bei-Hui Huang, Lin Qi, Xing-Ding Zhang, Juan Li

items.title: Evolution and heterogeneity of lethal metastatic bladder cancer subtypes
items.title_zh: 致命转移性膀胱癌亚型的演变与异质性
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对转移性膀胱癌的侵袭性组织学亚型及其治疗耐药性进行了深入分析。通过快速尸检项目，研究团队获得了宝贵的资源，能够对这些亚型的时间演变进行详细的分子和遗传学分析。研究发现，不同亚型在生物学特性和对治疗的反应上存在显著差异，这为理解膀胱癌的异质性及其临床管理提供了重要见解。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11035-z A rapid autopsy programme provides valuable resources to enable detailed molecular and genetic analyses of the temporal evolution of aggressive histological subtypes and therapy resistance in metastatic bladder cancer.
items.authors: Pushpa Itagi

items.title: Overmassive black holes and little red dots naturally form in simulations
items.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞与小红点在模拟中自然形成
items.summary_zh: 来自詹姆斯·韦布太空望远镜（JWST）的观测揭示了早期宇宙中意外丰富的小红点和超大质量黑洞的存在。这一现象通过全面的宇宙学辐射-流体动力学模拟得到了验证。研究表明，这些小红点和超大质量黑洞的形成过程与宇宙早期的环境密切相关，提供了对宇宙演化的重要见解。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10985-8 Observations from the JWST reveal an unexpectedly abundant population of little red dots and overmassive black holes in the early Universe, which are confirmed by their formation in fully cosmological radiation-hydrodynamic simulations.
items.authors: Sunmyon Chon

items.title: Heterogeneous photonic integration of single-crystalline nanomembranes
items.title_zh: 单晶纳米膜的异质光子集成研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究采用先进的外延生长和层剥离技术，构建了一个框架，通过异质光子集成单晶纳米膜，将所需功能注入硅和氮化硅光子学中。研究表明，该方法实现了超高效的电光和磁光调制，展示了其在光子器件中的潜在应用价值。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11000-w A framework consisting of advanced epitaxy and layer lift-off techniques uses heterogeneous photonic integration of single-crystalline nanomembranes to infuse desired functionalities into silicon and silicon nitride photonics, demonstrating ultraefficient electro-optical and magneto-optical modulation.
items.authors: Yuan Meng

items.title: Molecular-level observation of the self-assembly of a virus-like particle
items.title_zh: 分子级观察病毒样颗粒的自组装
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用质量光谱法结合单分子捕获技术，实现了对单个病毒样颗粒组装过程的实时监测，具有分子分辨率。这一方法使得我们能够观察和量化其自组装路径及动态变化。研究结果揭示了病毒样颗粒在组装过程中的关键步骤和动力学特征，为理解病毒组装机制提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10948-z Using mass photometry combined with a single-molecule trapping method allows real-time monitoring of the assembly of individual virus-like particles with molecular resolution, enabling observation and quantification of their self-assembly pathways and dynamics.
items.authors: Roi Asor

items.title: Identification of broadly tumour-reactive γδ TCRs from multiple myeloma
items.title_zh: 从多发性骨髓瘤中识别广泛肿瘤反应的γδ TCRs
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种机器学习算法PreGame，用于从单细胞CITE测序数据中识别肿瘤反应的γδ T细胞。通过扩展这一细胞群体，可以作为治疗反应的生物标志物。研究结果表明，该算法能够有效识别与多发性骨髓瘤相关的肿瘤反应性T细胞，为个性化治疗提供了新的潜在工具。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11055-9 A machine-learning algorithm, PreGame, is developed to identify tumour-reactive γδ T cells from single-cell CITE sequencing data, and expansion of this cell population can be used as a biomarker of therapeutic response.
items.authors: Michael St. Paul

items.title: A systematic interactome of Saccharomyces cerevisiae SET1C expands its functional landscape and identifies candidate regulatory connections
items.title_zh: 酿酒酵母SET1C系统互作组扩展功能景观及候选调控连接
items.summary_zh: Set1是SET1C或COMPASS的催化亚单位，负责甲基化组蛋白H3K4，并作为七个紧密结合多肽的支架。我们采用酵母双杂交筛选确定了Set1及其各亚单位的互作组，为探索该复合体的已知和新角色提供了独特资源。筛选结果识别出多种潜在互作因子，涉及染色质调控、DNA复制、减数分裂断裂和Ty转位等过程，这些均与SET1C相关。结果显示，Set1作为RNA结合蛋白，SET1C与RNA生物发生的多个方面相关，包括前mRNA剪接和聚腺苷酸化。此外，我们发现多个进口蛋白和含RGG基序的蛋白是Set1的候选互作因子，揭示了Set1在细胞质和细胞核之间移动的机制。重组的SET1C与染色质重塑因子Snf2的AT-hook结构域相互作用，并对该结构域内的多个精氨酸进行甲基化。在体内，我们报告ARTSTRGR AT-hook基序以Set1依赖的方式被甲基化，揭示了赖氨酸和精氨酸甲基化之间的新相互作用。
items.abstract: Set1 is the catalytic subunit of SET1C or COMPASS, which methylates histone H3K4 and serves as a scaffold for the association of seven tightly bound polypeptides. We have employed yeast two-hybrid screenings to determine the interactome of Set1 and each subunit, providing a unique resource for exploring known and novel roles of the complex. Our screenings identified a multitude of potential interactors involved in chromatin regulation, DNA replication, meiotic breaks, and Ty transposition, processes previously associated with SET1C. Consistent with Set1 being an RNA-binding protein, the screens link SET1C to multiple aspects of RNA biogenesis, including pre-mRNA splicing and polyadenylation. The results reveal that several importins are candidate interactors of Set1, along with RGG motif-containing proteins, providing insights into the mechanisms by which Set1 moves between cytoplasmic and nuclear compartments. We further reveal that reconstituted SET1C interacts with the AT-hook domain of the chromatin remodeler Snf2 and methylates multiple arginines within this domain. items.title: Oncohistone inhibition reshapes tumor-microenvironment communication in Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG)
items.title_zh: 肿瘤组蛋白抑制重塑弥漫性中线胶质瘤的肿瘤微环境通信
items.summary_zh: 背景：弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMG）是一种致命的儿童脑肿瘤，由H3K27M肿瘤组蛋白驱动，破坏表观遗传调控并促进肿瘤增殖。尽管先前研究表明H3K27M对肿瘤启动至关重要，但其在已建立肿瘤、肿瘤微环境（TME）调控及治疗反应中的作用尚不明确。方法：我们开发了可诱导和可逆的H3.3K27M和H3.1K27M细胞及小鼠模型，以研究肿瘤生长、复发及免疫/基质微环境的组蛋白依赖性效应。结果：在缺失细胞中重新表达H3K27M诱导形态变化并抑制星形胶质细胞标记物。染色质可及性分析显示ON、OFF和OFF-ON之间的位点特异性差异，包括与免疫调控和肿瘤-微环境相互作用相关的位点变化。单细胞RNA测序表明肿瘤组蛋白重塑了TME，H3K27M表达促进肿瘤-神经元相互作用，增强神经元兴奋性，导致兴奋/抑制失衡及支持肿瘤增殖的突触连接。
items.abstract: Background: Diffuse midline glioma (DMG) is a lethal pediatric brain tumor driven by the H3K27M oncohistone, which disrupts epigenetic regulation and promotes tumor proliferation. While prior studies show that H3K27M is essential for tumor initiation, its role in established tumors, tumor microenvironment (TME) regulation, and therapeutic response remain unclear. Methods: Here, we developed inducible and reversible H3.3K27M and H3.1K27M cell and mouse models to study oncohistone-dependent effects on tumor growth, recurrence, and the immune/stromal microenvironment. We generated a tetracycline-inducible PiggyBac-based oncohistone expression cassette in patient- and murine-derived models and validated inducible and reversible H3K27M expression. Results: Re[ndash]expression of H3K27M in knockout cells induced morphological changes and suppressed astrocytic markers. Chromatin accessibility profiling revealed locus[ndash]specific differences between ON, OFF, and OFF[ndash]ON, including changes at loci associated with immune regulation and tumor[ndash]microenvironment interactions. items.title: Juvenile social isolation induces gene expression alterations and histone modification dysregulations in nucleus accumbens (NAc) neurons of female mice
items.title_zh: 青少年社会隔离引发小鼠伏隔核神经元基因表达变化及组蛋白修饰失调
items.summary_zh: 缺乏社会互动导致啮齿动物出现多种行为异常，包括焦虑水平增加、社交能力改变和认知能力受损。我们研究了青少年社会隔离（jSI）对小鼠伏隔核（NAc）神经元的影响。通过RNA测序，我们发现与神经功能相关的基因及其转录和表观遗传调控发生了变化。差异表达基因（DEGs）的蛋白质相互作用分析显示，下调基因中的关键节点包括膜受体（Ntrk2、Grin3a和Grik1）和凋亡调节因子（Bcl2）。进一步通过CUT&Tag技术分析四种组蛋白修饰（H3K4me1、H3K4me3、H3K27ac和H3K27me3），结果表明表观遗传变化可能在神经功能和转录调控中发挥作用。对先前关于组蛋白修饰相关因子（如Kdm6b、Brd4和Setd1a）操控的RNA-seq数据的重新分析提示这些酶是潜在的候选者。
items.abstract: Lack of social interaction results in various behavioral abnormalities in rodents, including increased anxiety levels, altered sociability, and impaired cognitive ability. Epigenetic factors regulate gene expression, however, how they are involved in juvenile social isolation (jSI)-induced behavioral alterations remains largely unknown. Here, we focused on the nucleus accumbens (NAc), a critical brain region of the reward system that regulates motivation-related behaviors. We first performed RNA-seq on neuronal nuclei and found alterations in genes related to neuronal function, as well as in transcriptional and epigenetic regulation. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) showed that top key nodes among down-regulated genes include membrane receptors (Ntrk2, Grin3a, and Grik1) and an apoptosis regulator (Bcl2). To further investigate the association between jSI-induced gene expression alterations and histone modifications, we next performed CUT&Tag for four histone modifications (H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K27ac, and H3K27me3), and the results implied that epigenetic alterations may also play a role in neuronal function as well as transcription

items.title: Transcriptome-wide mapping reveals a non-canonical RNA-dependent mechanism of platinum cancer drugs
items.title_zh: 转录组范围内的铂类抗癌药物非经典RNA依赖机制研究
items.summary_zh: 脱靶相互作用常常影响抗癌药物的临床效用，导致剂量限制性毒性和治疗耐药性。尽管RNA被预测为众多FDA批准药物的脱靶，但抗癌小分子中RNA脱靶的程度和功能意义仍不清楚。通过系统的药物结合筛选，我们发现顺铂作为一种主要的RNA结合剂，尽管其经典作用机制是通过DNA加成反应。我们采用顺铂作为模型化合物，利用PlatRNA-seq平台对顺铂-RNA相互作用进行转录组范围的映射。基因组和功能分析显示，顺铂优先积累在5'转录末端附近的RNA G-四链体（rG4）结构，诱导R环形成。关键的是，我们证明顺铂的细胞毒性部分通过RNA结合介导，揭示了一种非经典的作用机制。这些发现展示了RNA-小分子脱靶的功能后果，并为研究小分子-RNA相互作用提供了可推广的框架，开启了治疗创新的新途径。
items.abstract: Off-target interactions frequently compromise the clinical utility of anticancer agents by driving dose-limiting toxicity and therapeutic resistance. Although RNA has been predicted to be an off-target for numerous FDA-approved drugs, the extent and functional significance of RNA off-targeting among anticancer small molecules remain poorly understood. Using a systematic drug-binding screen, we identified cisplatin, a frontline chemotherapeutic that acts canonically through DNA adduct formation, as a prominent RNA binder. We employed cisplatin as a model compound to characterize the mechanistic basis and functional impact of RNA-small molecule off-targeting. To map transcriptome-wide cisplatin-RNA interactions, we developed PlatRNA-seq, a click-chemistry-enabled RNA-binding profiling platform. Genomic and functional analyses reveal that cisplatin preferentially accumulates at RNA G-quadruplex (rG4) structures near 5' transcript ends, inducing R-loop formation. Critically, we demonstrate that cisplatin cytotoxicity is partially mediated through RNA binding, revealing a noncanonical mechanism of action. items.title: TEX15 safeguards neuronal diversity in the mouse olfactory system
items.title_zh: TEX15保护小鼠嗅觉系统中的神经元多样性
items.summary_zh: 动物通过数百种化学感受器蛋白检测多样化的化学物质。在许多生物中，感觉化学受体遵循每个细胞一种受体类型的规则，这有助于组织感觉神经元收集的信息。本文研究发现，小鼠中多样的气味受体（OR）表达依赖于睾丸表达基因15（Tex15）。Tex15调控神经前体细胞中的OR表达。在缺失Tex15的（Tex15-/-）小鼠中，前体细胞中的OR转录本水平增加，少数早期转录的OR基因异常高表达，导致这些OR主导嗅觉感知神经元群体。这导致OR基因选择的多样性显著降低，并且嗅上皮的空间模式受到干扰，但未打破每个细胞一种受体类型的规则。Tex15编码转录抑制因子，Tex15-/-小鼠的OR基因上H3K9me3的异染色质相关性降低。因此，我们提出Tex15通过异染色质基础的转录抑制机制，防止不均匀的转录启动影响OR选择，从而保护广泛调谐的化学感知所需的细胞多样性。
items.abstract: Animals detect diverse chemicals using hundreds of chemoreceptor proteins. In many organisms, sensory chemoreceptors obey a one-receptor-type-per-cell rule, which organizes information gathered by sensory neurons. A key question remains how receptor expression gets diversified so that hundreds of chemoreceptors get expressed across the population of sensory neurons. Here we show that diverse odorant receptor (OR) expression in mice requires testis expressed gene 15 (Tex15). We find that Tex15 regulates OR expression in neuronal precursor cells. In Tex15 deficient (Tex15-/-) mice, OR transcript levels are increased in precursors, a handful of early-transcribed OR genes get expressed at abnormally high levels, and these ORs come to dominate the olfactory sensory neuron population. This results in a profound reduction in the diversity of OR gene choice as well as disrupted spatial patterning of the olfactory epithelium, without disrupting the one-receptor-type-per-cell rule. Tex15 encodes a transcriptional repressor, and we show that Tex15-/- mice have reduced heterochromatin-associated H3K9me3 on OR genes. items.title: Spatially resolved gene expression and tumour-microenvironment interactions across malignant transformation in IDH-mutant glioma
items.title_zh: IDH突变胶质瘤恶性转化中的基因表达与肿瘤微环境相互作用
items.summary_zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）突变胶质瘤是年轻人中大多数低级别弥漫性胶质瘤的代表。尽管IDH突变胶质瘤相较于IDH野生型胶质瘤起初表现为良性，但它们不可避免地经历恶性转化。我们分析了两例IDH突变弥漫性胶质瘤患者的独特纵向队列，分别匹配WHO 2、3和4级肿瘤。采用空间转录组学（NanoString GeoMx和10X Visium），结合差异表达、空间变异基因分析和基因本体富集，定义了进展背后的转录程序。意外发现，两位患者的高级别肿瘤在浸润边缘的增殖（以Ki67测量）反而减少。空间转录组分析显示，随着肿瘤级别的增加，侵袭相关基因富集。在一个独立的批量RNA-seq队列中，这一空间衍生程序的表达未能优于仅基于级别的无进展生存期或总生存期分析。这些观察强调了需要开发新的度量标准，以考虑在进展过程中发生的空间演变，而这些变化在批量分析中未能被检测到，并为优先研究迁移、细胞骨架和应激相关程序提供了依据。
items.abstract: Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH)-mutant gliomas represent most lower-grade diffuse gliomas in young adults. Although IDH-mutant gliomas initially behave indolently relative to IDH-wildtype counterparts, they undergo inevitable malignant transformation. The mechanisms driving this progression remain poorly defined. We analyzed a unique longitudinal cohort of two patients with IDH-mutant diffuse gliomas, each with matched WHO grade 2, 3, and 4 tumours. Spatial transcriptomics (NanoString GeoMx and 10X Visium), combined with differential expression, spatially variable gene analysis, and gene ontology enrichment, were used to define transcriptional programs underlying progression. Unexpectedly, across both patients, higher-grade tumours demonstrated reduced proliferation at the infiltrative margin as measured by Ki67. Spatial transcriptomic analysis identified an enrichment of invasion-associated genes associated with increasing tumour grade. In an independent bulk RNA-seq cohort, expression of this spatially derived program did not outperform grade-only PFS or OS analysis. items.title: Comparison of cell-cycle gene expression dynamics and mRNA kinetics across mouse and human pluripotent systems
items.title_zh: 小鼠与人类多能系统细胞周期基因表达动态比较
items.summary_zh: 细胞周期重塑对多能性和谱系承诺至关重要，但其转录和后转录结构在不同物种和发育状态下是否保守尚未解决。本文介绍了Ciclopes，一个基于生物学的深度学习框架，能够直接从单细胞RNA测序中解析连续的细胞周期阶段及阶段依赖的mRNA转录和降解。通过在六种涵盖初始和预备状态的小鼠和人类多能干细胞系统中应用Ciclopes，我们发现转录复杂性和振荡控制存在显著差异：小鼠系统维持核心细胞周期调控因子的高基线表达，而人类系统则以更大的振荡幅度交换更高的基线表达。值得注意的是，mRNA降解时机在不同系统中比转录时机更为保守，揭示了后转录调控作为稳定的进化支柱。随着人类iPSC向确定性内胚层分化，细胞逐渐退出细胞周期，细胞周期相关基因网络收缩，存活的调控因子以更大的幅度振荡。Ciclopes为解析多能细胞在进化和发育转变中如何调节增殖提供了通用框架。
items.abstract: Cell-cycle remodeling is fundamental to pluripotency and lineage commitment, yet whether its transcriptional and post-transcriptional architecture is conserved across species and developmental states has remained unresolved. Here we introduce Ciclopes, a biology-informed deep-learning framework that resolves continuous cell-cycle phase and phase-dependent mRNA transcription and degradation directly from single-cell RNA sequencing. Applying Ciclopes across six mouse and human pluripotent stem-cell systems spanning naive and primed states, we uncover striking divergence in transcriptional complexity and oscillatory control: mouse systems sustain elevated baseline expression of core cell-cycle regulators, while human systems trade higher baseline expression for larger oscillatory amplitude. Strikingly, mRNA degradation timing remain far more conserved across systems than transcription timing, exposing post-transcriptional regulation as a stable evolutionary backbone. As human iPSCs differentiate into definitive endoderm, cells progressively exit the cell cycle, cell-cycle-coupled gene networks contract, and surviving regulators oscillate with larger amplitude. items.title: mTOR disrupts cerebrovascular RNA regulatory networks in Alzheimers disease
items.title_zh: mTOR在阿尔茨海默病中破坏脑血管RNA调控网络
items.summary_zh: 脑血管功能障碍被越来越多地认为是阿尔茨海默病（AD）发病和进展的核心因素。哺乳动物/机械性雷帕霉素靶点（mTOR）通路已成为AD相关血管功能障碍的关键驱动因子。本研究评估了在6至12个月龄的hAPP(J20)小鼠中，雷帕霉素对脑血管RNA调控蛋白水平的影响。结果显示，雷帕霉素部分恢复了疾病抑制的异质核核糖核蛋白（hnRNP）家族成员，包括hnRNP D1（AUF1）和hnRNP E1（PCBP1）。雷帕霉素介导的hnRNP恢复在PS19（P301S）tau病小鼠的脑血管中也得到了验证，表明mTOR依赖的hnRNP抑制在淀粉样蛋白和tau驱动的AD模型中是共享的。此外，hnRNP E1和hnRNP L在AD患者大脑中与Braak分期呈显著负相关，hnRNP R和hnRNP M则显示出类似但不显著的趋势。这些结果表明，脑血管RNA调控网络的破坏可能与AD的进展相关。
items.abstract: Cerebrovascular dysfunction is increasingly recognized as a central contributor to the initiation and progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD). The mammalian/mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway has emerged as a key driver of AD-related vascular dysfunction. Consistent with this role, attenuation of mTOR signaling restores multiple aspects of cerebrovascular function in AD models, including vascular density, cerebral blood flow, vascular reactivity, and neurovascular coupling. However, the molecular mechanisms linking mTOR dysregulation to cerebrovascular dysfunction in AD remain poorly understood we assessed cerebrovascular levels of RNA-regulatory proteins in hAPP(J20) mice treated with rapamycin from 6 to 12 months of age. Rapamycin partially restored disease-suppressed heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein (hnRNP) family members, including hnRNP D1 (AUF1) and hnRNP E1 (PCBP1). Rapamycin-mediated restoration of hnRNP extended to the cerebrovasculature of PS19 (P301S) tauopathy mice, indicating that mTOR-dependent hnRNP suppression is shared across amyloid- and tau-driven models of AD. items.title: The Search for a Diagnostic Indicator of Cochlear Deafferentation: Predicting Age from Auditory Evoked Potential Measures
items.title_zh: 寻找耳蜗去神经化的诊断指标：基于听觉诱发电位预测年龄
items.summary_zh: 目的：耳蜗突触病是一种与年龄相关的耳蜗去神经化，预计在人类中普遍存在，并对听觉感知产生负面影响。目前尚无活体人类耳蜗去神经化的诊断手段。听觉脑干反应（ABR）波I幅度和随后的包络反应（EFR）被提出作为潜在的非侵入性指标，但可能受到外毛细胞（OHC）功能障碍和内耳电位（EP）变化的影响，导致解释困难。本研究的目标是评估结合计算模型（CMAP）的听觉诱发电位在预测耳蜗去神经化风险因素年龄方面的能力。在轻度感音神经性听力损失人群中，使用CMAP与贝叶斯回归预测个体的耳蜗去神经化程度，并探讨EP变化对预测的影响。
items.abstract: Objectives: Cochlear synaptopathy, a type of cochlear deafferentation that occurs with aging, is expected to be common in humans and to have negative impacts on auditory perception. However, there is currently no means for diagnosing cochlear deafferentation in living humans. Auditory brainstem response (ABR) wave I amplitude and the envelope following response (EFR) are auditory evoked potentials that have been proposed as potential non-invasive indicators of cochlear deafferentation. However, these measures may be impacted by outer hair cell (OHC) dysfunction and changes in endocochlear potential (EP), making them difficult to interpret. One potential method for estimating the degree of deafferentation in individual patients is to combine evoked potential and distortion product otoacoustic emission (DPOAE) measurements with a computational model of the auditory periphery (CMAP). The goal of this study was to evaluate the ability of auditory evoked potentials, with and without the CMAP, to predict age, a risk factor for cochlear deafferentation. items.title: LLM Inference in a Flash!
items.title_zh: 闪电般的LLM推理！
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理任务中展现了卓越的能力，LLM推理已成为支持下游应用的重要工作负载。随着请求向更长序列和更重推理转变，LLM推理的服务需求日益严峻，尤其是在检索增强生成、推理时计算扩展和长上下文应用的推动下。此外，硬件趋势使得内存容量和通信带宽的增长速度无法跟上工作负载复杂性的增加。计算闪存（Compute-in-Flash）是一种有前景的解决方案，通过将计算靠近内存来应对内存带宽限制，并利用SSD技术的大容量。然而，由于缺乏对高精度浮点运算的支持以及有限的写入耐久性，在这些系统上部署LLM面临挑战。我们的研究旨在通过设计推理算法，使LLM能够在闪存计算内存设备上进行推理。我们提出了一种端到端的仅整数量化方法，以消除昂贵的浮点计算，并设计了一种基于稀疏字典编码的字典KV缓存压缩策略，以应对有限的写入耐久性。
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across a range of natural language processing tasks, and LLM inference has emerged as a critical workload for enabling downstream applications. The demands of serving LLM inference are becoming increasingly challenging as requests shift toward longer sequences and heavier inference, driven by retrieval-augmented generation, inference-time compute scaling, and long-context applications. Additionally, these challenges are compounded by hardware trends, as memory capacity and communication bandwidth are not scaling as fast as increases in workload complexity. Compute-in-Flash is a promising solution to address memory bandwidth limitations by moving computation close to memory, and to exploit the large capacity of SSD technologies. However, it is challenging to deploy LLMs on these systems as they lack support for high-precision floating point operations and have limited write endurance. In our work, we aim to address these challenges by designing inference algorithms to enable LLM inference on Flash compute-in-memory devices. We present an end-to-end integer-only quantization approach to eliminate expensive floating-point
items.authors: Sebastian Zhao, Minseo Kim, Coleman Hooper, Luca Manolache, Michael W. Mahoney, Yakun Sophia Shao, Kurt Keutzer, Amir Gholami

items.title: Agentic Search Spaces for Tabular Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 基于代理的表格机器学习搜索空间研究
items.summary_zh: 尽管基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理在规划、代码生成和调试方面取得了快速进展，但其在表格机器学习中的实际价值仍未得到充分探索。本文研究了一个具体用例：最先进的代理人工智能系统是否能够设计出超越模型作者提供的标准搜索空间的扩展超参数优化（HPO）搜索空间。我们将每个表格模型表示为一个涵盖预处理、嵌入、架构、训练和推理的模块化管道。然后，我们让代理为每个模块提出候选代码实现，并使用经典的HPO算法共同优化这些候选项和模型的默认超参数。与基础HPO空间相比，扩展的搜索空间在45个数据集的测试中几乎提升了每个模型系列的性能，平均相对增益为0.6%，在小到中型回归数据集上增至2.0%。值得注意的是，这些增益在没有额外调优成本的情况下实现：在相同的调优和集成预算下，扩展空间的表现优于基础空间。
items.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of LLM-based agents for planning, code generation, and debugging, their practical value for tabular machine learning remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate a concrete use case: whether state-of-the-art agentic AI systems can design extended HPO search spaces for established tabular models that outperform the standard search spaces provided by the model authors. Specifically, we represent each tabular model as a modular pipeline covering preprocessing, embeddings, architecture, training, and inference. We then task the agent to propose candidate code implementations for each module and use a classical HPO algorithm to jointly optimize over these candidates and the model's default hyperparameters. Compared with the base HPO spaces, the expanded search spaces improve the performance of nearly every model family across a suite of 45 datasets, with average relative gains of 0.6%, rising to 2.0% on small-to-medium regression datasets. Notably, these gains come at no extra tuning cost: the enlarged spaces outperform the base under the same tuning and ensembling budgets. items.authors: Renat Sergazinov, Artem Chistyakov, Sergey Pankevich, Artem Babenko

items.title: Interpreting and Steering LLM Agents for Social Simulations
items.title_zh: 解读与引导大型语言模型代理的社会模拟
items.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的模拟在理解人类行为方面表现出强大能力，成为社会科学工具箱的重要补充。然而，LLMs作为深度神经网络的黑箱特性限制了其在社会科学中的价值，主要体现在缺乏可解释性和可引导性。本文展示了如何打开这一黑箱，以丰富LLM基础的模拟。我们比较了三种方法：基于提示的操控、基于SAE的特征引导和基于探针的方向引导，并考察其在社会科学模拟中的效用。通过对人类行为的两个基础组成部分（偏好和能力）进行解读与引导，结果表明，SAE和探针技术在引导LLM代理方面通常优于基本的基于提示的方法，尽管这种优势依赖于具体的提示策略。
items.abstract: Simulations based on large language models (LLMs) have proven to be powerful for understanding human behavior, making them valuable additions to the social scientific toolkit. However, LLMs are ultimately black boxes based on deep neural networks which limits their value for social science. This is because of a lack of (i) interpretability: i.e. the ability to assign clear mechanisms driving observed behavior; and a lack of (ii) steerability: i.e. the ability to mute or amplify specific theoretically meaningful mechanisms of action to drive specific model behavior. Here, we demonstrate how the black box could be opened up to further enrich LLM-based simulations. Specifically, we compare three types of methods: (1) prompt-based manipulation, (2) SAE-derived feature steering, and (3) probe-based direction steering and examine their utility for LLM-based social scientific simulations. We do so by interpreting and steering two foundational components of human behaviors, namely preferences (risk attitudes, altruism) and capabilities (divergent creativity, product innovation), operationalized using four classic economic and creative tasks implemented as natural-language interactions. Ove
items.authors: Jiayue Gaveal Fan, Arul Murugan, Shreyas Krishnan, Abhishek Nagaraj

items.title: Continuous-Time Machine Learning: A Unified Mathematical Perspective
items.title_zh: 连续时间机器学习：统一的数学视角
items.summary_zh: 连续时间（CT）机器学习作为一种建模时间动态的原则性框架，特别适用于在任意时间点采样或跨越长时间范围的观察。然而，CT机器学习的主要分支在不同的研究社区中发展，导致其数学关系和设计权衡尚未充分表征。本文通过分类法对主要CT机器学习分支进行统一的概念驱动视角的探讨，依据其基础数学公式组织相关家族。我们提出了一种典型的数学公式，通过向量场参数化、随机性、记忆机制和离散化的不同架构选择将这些家族联系起来。我们比较了训练算法、优化策略和失败模式，突出了各家族之间的权衡。此外，我们还提供了理论计算复杂度的比较分析，并对每个家族的代表性架构进行了架构控制的基准分析。最后，我们识别了在近似理论、训练稳定性、硬件高效实现、基准测试、基础模型和科学机器学习等方面的开放挑战。
items.abstract: Continuous-time (CT) machine learning has emerged as a principled framework for modeling temporal dynamics as a continuous process, particularly when observations are sampled at arbitrary time points or span long-range horizons. However, major branches of CT machine learning have matured in separate research communities, leaving their mathematical relationships and design trade-offs insufficiently characterized. In this survey, we develop a unified, concept-driven view of major CT machine learning branches through a taxonomy that organizes families according to their underlying base mathematical formulations. We present a canonical mathematical formulation that relates these families through different architectural choices of vector-field parameterization, stochasticity, memory mechanisms, and discretization. We compare training algorithms, optimization strategies, and failure modes, highlighting the trade-offs across families. We further provide a comparative analysis of theoretical computational complexity alongside an illustrative architecture-controlled benchmark analysis on representative architectures from each family. items.authors: Waleed Razzaq, Yun-Sheng Zhao, Yun-Bo Zhao

items.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback
items.title_zh: 耦合校准与学习：无目标领域奖励反馈的LLM蒸馏教师偏差缓解
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）蒸馏旨在将强大教师的能力转移到较小的学生模型。然而，直接模仿可能会传递教师的系统性偏差和错误。在协变量转移的情况下，教师在目标问题上的可靠性不确定，且缺乏目标领域的奖励反馈。我们提出了耦合校准与学习（CCL）算法，通过令牌级分支将教师校准与学生更新耦合，仅在源问题上使用奖励反馈。每次迭代使用源反馈校准教师，然后利用校准后的教师在目标问题上训练学生。更新后的学生反过来为后续校准提供信息。在自回归策略框架下，我们证明了输出学生的期望平均Kullback-Leibler散度以多项式速率收敛于零。我们的分析量化了投影学生梯度更新的进展，同时控制教师校准的误差。
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) distillation aims to transfer the capabilities of a powerful teacher to a smaller student. Direct imitation, however, can also transfer the teacher's systematic bias and errors. This challenge is particularly pronounced under covariate shift, when the teacher's reliability on target questions is uncertain and target-domain reward feedback is unavailable. We propose Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL), an LLM distillation algorithm that couples teacher calibration with student updates through token-level branching, using reward feedback only on source questions. Each iteration calibrates the teacher using source feedback and then uses the calibrated teacher to train the student on target questions. The updated student, in turn, informs subsequent calibration. In an autoregressive policy framework, we prove that the output student's expected average Kullback-Leibler divergence to the oracle student converges to zero at a polynomial rate in the number of iterations. The oracle maximizes the true reference-regularized target reward within the student class, which need not represent the unrestricted optimal policy. Our analysis quantifies the progress of pr
items.authors: Haichen Hu, Yuheng Zhang, David Simchi-Levi

items.title: Molecular representation shapes the balance between target fidelity and exploration in flow based polymer generation
items.title_zh: 分子表征影响流动聚合物生成中的目标精度与探索平衡
items.summary_zh: 设计具有特定性质的聚合物需要在有限标记数据中探索广泛的化学空间。本文提出了PolyLatentFlow框架，该框架基于潜在空间中的连续时间流匹配，支持无条件和有条件的聚合物生成，并结合了LlamaUni，这是一种结合聚合物序列和三维结构信息的多模态表征。在无条件生成中，PolyLatentFlow与LlamaUni结合产生了相较于PolyInfo评估的无条件生成器中有效候选的最大产量，同时保持了高多样性。在$T_g$条件下，生成的性质分布在200°C目标范围内系统性地发生了变化。在多性质任务中，分子表征显示出相似的替代目标精度，但在有效性、训练集重放和与标记聚合物的结构接近性上存在显著差异。PolyLatentFlow与LlamaUni的结合始终实现了高有效性与低重放，并在CO$_2$/N$_2$条件下达到了每次尝试非重放目标命中的最大产量。这些结果展示了潜在空间流匹配在聚合物逆设计中的应用，并确定了分子表征作为目标控制与探索的重要决定因素。
items.abstract: Designing polymers with targeted properties requires navigating vast chemical spaces from limited labeled data. Here we introduce PolyLatentFlow, a framework based on continuous-time flow matching in latent space for unconditional and conditional polymer generation, together with LlamaUni, a multimodal representation combining polymer sequence and 3D structural information. In unconditional generation, PolyLatentFlow with LlamaUni produced the largest yield of valid candidates novel relative to PolyInfo among the evaluated unconditional generators while maintaining high diversity. For $T_g$ conditioning, generated property distributions shifted systematically across a 200 {\deg}C target range. In multi-property tasks, molecular representations showed similar surrogate target fidelity but differed markedly in validity, training-set replay, and structural proximity to labeled polymers. PolyLatentFlow with LlamaUni consistently combined high validity with low replay and achieved the largest per-attempt yield of nonreplayed target hits for CO$_2$/N$_2$ conditioning. items.authors: Tianren Zhang

items.title: The AI-Enabled Scientific Frontier
items.title_zh: 人工智能驱动的科学前沿研究
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能能力的提升，它越来越被视为一种通用科学方法。本文通过分析2000年至2025年初间的论文，汇总了2507个AI与其他科学分析技术的对比案例，涵盖27个科学学科。研究发现，AI相较于传统统计方法通常表现更好，但计算成本显著更高。然而，近四分之一的案例中，AI的表现不仅较差且成本更高，这一比例在过去十年中保持稳定。相较于科学计算，AI的表现通常较差，但计算成本较低。自2020年以来，AI在科学计算中的表现显著提升，现已在超过一半的对比中胜出。这些模式表明，AI并不是现有方法的普遍替代，而是新兴的AI驱动科学前沿中一个有价值且不断改善的部分。
items.abstract: As artificial intelligence's capabilities improve, it is increasingly viewed as a general scientific method. But how true are these claims? Does AI outperform all techniques, or only some, and how is this changing? To assess the claims, we assemble a corpus of 2,507 head-to-head comparisons between AI and other scientific analysis techniques across 27 scientific disciplines from papers published between 2000 and early 2025. We find a profound dichotomy. Relative to traditional statistics, AI often outperforms, but at a significantly higher computational cost. But there are also nearly a quarter of cases where AI is both more expensive and performs worse than traditional statistical techniques and this fraction has been stable for a decade. Relative to scientific computing, AI often underperforms, but at lower computational cost. This has begun to change: since 2020, AI's performance against scientific computing has notably strengthened and it now outperforms on more than half of comparisons. These patterns suggest that AI is therefore not a universal replacement for existing methods, but rather a valuable -- and improving -- part of a new AI-enabled scientific frontier.
items.authors: Gabriel Manso, Emma Fu, Neil Thompson

items.title: Physics Informed Random Feature Neural Networks for Solving PDEs
items.title_zh: 物理信息随机特征神经网络用于求解偏微分方程
items.summary_zh: 基于机器学习的偏微分方程（PDEs）求解器近年来受到广泛关注。该领域的进展主要依赖于深度神经网络，如物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和核方法（如物理信息高斯过程）。我们提出了一种物理信息随机特征方法，以应对PINN求解器在某类PDEs中面临的谱偏差问题。随机特征方法最初用于近似大规模核机器，可视为一种专门的随机化神经网络。与其他需要大量配点的最先进PINN求解器相比，我们的方法降低了计算复杂性。本文开发了严格的近似误差分析，并推导了$H^1$范数的高概率误差界限。我们进行了广泛的数值测试，以验证理论保证的误差衰减率，并进行了多项比较测试，以展示我们在对抗深度学习方法中的谱偏差方面的能力。
items.abstract: Machine learning-based partial differential equations (PDEs) solvers have attracted significant attention in recent years. Most progress in this area has been driven by deep neural networks such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and kernel method (such as physics-informed Gaussian Processes). We introduce a physics-informed random feature method for countering part of the spectral bias which PINN-based solvers are facing for a certain class of PDEs. Random feature method was originally proposed to approximate large-scale kernel machines and can be viewed as a specialized randomized neural network. Compared to other state-of-the-art PINN-based solvers which require a large number of collocation points, our proposed method reduces the computational complexity. In this paper, we develop a rigorous approximation error analysis and derive high-probability error bounds on the $H^1$ norm. We provide extensive numerical tests for verifying our theoretical guarantees on error decay rates, as well as several comparison tests to showcase our claimed capability for combating spectral bias in these deep learning based methods.
items.authors: Chi-An Chen, Chunyang Liao, Ming Zhong

items.title: On the disintegration of the stochastic majority vote: From PAC-Bayesian bounds to a self-bounding algorithm
items.title_zh: 随机多数投票的解构：从PAC-Bayesian界限到自约束算法
items.summary_zh: 加权多数投票是许多成功集成方法的核心。PAC-Bayesian理论通过分析随机分类器的期望风险，为此类模型提供了紧凑的泛化保证，而对确定性多数投票风险的分析依赖于替代界限。为避免这些替代界限，Zantedeschi等（2021）为随机多数投票引入了保证，但所得模型仍然是随机的。本文提出了一种随机多数投票的去随机化框架。我们将最新的解构PAC-Bayesian理论直接应用于多数投票权重向量空间，将随机保证转化为单一确定性多数投票的证书。我们推导出两类高概率泛化界限，涵盖了数据无关和数据相关的集成构造，进而自然导出一种优化确定性多数投票保证的自约束学习算法。
items.abstract: Weighted majority votes are central to many successful ensemble methods. PAC-Bayesian theory provides tight generalization guarantees for such models by analyzing the expected risk of stochastic classifiers, while analyzing the risk of deterministic majority votes relies on surrogate bounds. To avoid these surrogates, Zantedeschi et al. ( 2021) introduced guarantees for stochastic majority votes, but the resulting models remain randomized. In this paper, we propose a derandomization framework for stochastic majority votes. To do so, we apply recent advances in disintegrated PAC-Bayesian theory directly to the space of majority vote weight vectors, transforming stochastic guarantees into certificates for a single deterministic majority vote. We derive two families of high-probability generalization bounds, covering both data-independent and data-dependent constructions of the ensemble, which naturally lead to a self-bounding learning algorithm optimizing deterministic majority vote guarantees.
items.authors: Julien Bastian (LabHC), Benjamin Leblanc (LabHC, UJM, MALICE), Pascal Germain (LabHC, UJM, MALICE), Amaury Habrard (LabHC, UJM, MALICE), Guillaume Metzler (ERIC), Emilie Morvant (LabHC), Paul Viallard

items.title: Tail-Shape Estimation in LLM Evaluation Is Fragile: A Protocol for Diagnosing False Positives
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型评估中的尾部形状估计脆弱性研究
items.summary_zh: 近期研究推动将大型语言模型（LLM）评估从基于均值的指标转向关注尾部的指标，包括条件风险价值和奖励模型误差的尾部指数估计。我们探讨经典极值理论中的尾部指数参数是否能提供超越均值和标准尾部大小统计的判别信息。我们预注册了一项协议，涵盖任何正尾部形状声明的可接受性、拟合优度、阈值稳定性和效应大小要求。该协议是本文的贡献；下面的实证研究展示了其筛选的结果。在两个结构不同的评分者家族下应用于标准LLM毒性评估设置，该协议捕捉到三种明显的假阳性模式，而简单分析可能会发布这些结果，并在两个评分者上拒绝了主要的尾部形状声明。我们得出结论，所研究的LLM毒性评估设置中的尾部形状估计比近期文献所建议的更为脆弱，并推荐该协议作为类似设置中尾部指数声明的起点。
items.abstract: Recent work motivates moving large language model (LLM) evaluation from mean-based to tail-aware metrics, including conditional value-at-risk and tail-index estimates of reward-model error. We ask whether the canonical extreme-value-theory tail-index parameter, which isolates how heavy a tail is from how large the tail mass is, adds discriminative information beyond the mean and a standard tail-magnitude statistic in LLM evaluation. We pre-register a protocol covering admissibility, goodness-of-fit, threshold-stability, and effect-size requirements for any positive tail-shape claim. The protocol is the contribution of this paper; the empirical study below is a demonstration of what its gates catch. Applied to a standard LLM toxicity-evaluation setup under two structurally different scorer families, the protocol catches three distinct modes of false positives that a naive analysis would have published, and rejects the headline tail-shape claim on both scorers. We conclude that tail-shape estimation in the LLM toxicity-evaluation setups we examined is more fragile than the recent literature suggests, and recommend the protocol as a starting point for tail-index claims in similar setu
items.authors: Luca Zhou

items.title: Forward-Free LLM Depth Pruning via Weight Redundancy
items.title_zh: 基于权重冗余的无前向深度剪枝方法
items.summary_zh: 深度剪枝通过移除完整的Transformer块来降低大型语言模型（LLM）的推理成本。现有的基于激活的方法通过在校准数据上进行前向传播来收集隐藏状态，而现有的无前向方法则单独对每个Transformer块进行评分，而不测量块之间的相似性。我们提出了一种无前向深度剪枝方法——权重冗余剪枝（WRP），该方法通过检查点权重估计层间冗余，从而在不需要校准数据或模型前向传播的情况下选择块。WRP比较各层的注意力输出和MLP下投影权重，并结合它们的成对相似性与相对投影规模信息。最终生成的全对相似性矩阵指导层的分组和块的选择。在多个剪枝设置、模型系列和下游任务中，WRP始终优于现有的无前向幅度剪枝方法，并接近基于激活的方法的性能。
items.abstract: Depth pruning reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost by removing complete Transformer blocks. Activation-based methods collect hidden states through forward passes on calibration data, while existing forward-free methods score each Transformer block separately without measuring similarity between blocks. We propose Weight-Redundancy Pruning (WRP), a forward-free depth-pruning method that estimates inter-layer redundancy from checkpoint weights to select blocks without calibration data or model forward passes. WRP compares attention output and MLP down-projection weights across layers and combines their pairwise similarities with relative projection-scale information. The resulting all-pairs similarity matrix guides layer grouping and block selection. Across multiple pruning settings, model families, and downstream tasks, WRP consistently outperforms existing forward-free magnitude pruning and approaches the performance of activation-based methods.
items.authors: Vincent-Daniel Yun, Woosang Lim

items.title: From Protocols to Evidence: Bounded Claims for AI in Service of the Common Good
items.title_zh: 从协议到证据：人工智能服务于公共利益的有限主张
items.summary_zh: 人工智能系统声称能够改善决策、扩大访问、减少危害或赋权用户，但这些主张往往超出评估所能证明的范围。仅凭预测性能无法确保安全，监督的存在也无法确保有效控制，而更快的任务完成并不意味着理解或选择。评估必须考虑不可靠的输出和不均匀的性能，以及过度依赖、减弱的救济和人类专业知识的转移。更难的问题在于证据所支持的内容、未被审视的权力关系以及测量的界限。评估改进需要考察机构的价值观和人工智能所需解决的条件。人工智能既是揭示也是干预，其使用可以揭示未满足的人类需求和关于重要性的假设。我们提出了一种断裂测试，评估部署与明确的人类和非人工智能基准的对比。通过研究教皇利奥十四世的《人性之伟大》，我们探讨了尊严和公共利益，以及谁拥有人工智能基础设施和控制其使用的问题。这些承诺影响对改进的判断，证据本身无法建立道德或政治的合法性。我们区分了证据有限的部署，限制主张在已评估的范围内。
items.abstract: Claims that Artificial Intelligence systems improve decisions, broaden access, reduce harm, or empower users can exceed what their evaluation establishes. Predictive performance alone does not establish safety, the presence of oversight does not establish meaningful control, and faster task completion does not establish understanding or choice. Evaluation must account for unreliable outputs and uneven performance, but also for overreliance, weakened recourse, and displaced human expertise. The harder questions are what the evidence warrants, which relations of power remain unexamined, and where measurement must stop. Assessing improvement requires examining what institutions value and the conditions AI is asked to address. AI is both revelation and intervention. Its use can reveal unmet human needs and assumptions about what matters. Once deployed, it can repair, compound, substitute for, or conceal existing failures. We develop a rupture test that evaluates deployment against explicit human and non-AI baselines. items.title: Generating Individual Travel Diaries Using Large Language Models Informed by Census and Land-Use Data
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型生成个体旅行日记的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种大语言模型（LLM）方案，用于生成基于代理的交通模型中的旅行日记关键属性，包括目的、出行方式和距离，以评估LLM在活动生成任务中的潜在可行性。与传统方法依赖大量专有家庭旅行调查不同，我们的方法从开放源代码的美国社区调查（ACS）和智能位置数据库（SLD）数据中随机生成角色，然后通过直接提示合成日记。研究中引入了一种新颖的群体现实评分，结合四个指标（旅行次数评分、时间间隔评分、目的评分和出行方式评分），并与康涅狄格州交通研究（CSTS）日记进行验证。通过Jensen-Shannon散度测量生成日记与真实日记之间的分布相似性。与基于经典方法生成的日记相比（负二项式用于旅行生成；多项式逻辑用于出行方式/目的），LLM生成的日记在整体现实性上表现相当（LLM均值：0.692 vs. 0.628），在确定旅行目的方面表现优异，出行方式预测的一致性更高。
items.abstract: This study introduces a Large Language Model (LLM) scheme for generating key attributes of travel diaries in agent-based transportation models, including purpose, mode and distance, to assess the underlying viability of LLMs for activity generation tasks. While traditional approaches rely on large quantities of proprietary household travel surveys, our method generates personas stochastically from open-source American Community Survey (ACS) and Smart Location Database (SLD) data, then synthesizes diaries through direct prompting. Our study features a novel one-to-cohort realism score: a composite of four metrics (Trip Count Score, Interval Score, Purpose Score, and Mode Score) validated against the Connecticut Statewide Transportation Study (CSTS) diaries, matched across demographic variables. Our validation utilizes Jensen-Shannon Divergence to measure distributional similarities between generated and real diaries. When compared to diaries generated with classical methods (Negative Binomial for trip generation; Multinomial Logit for mode/purpose) calibrated on the validation set, LLM generated diaries achieve comparable overall realism (LLM mean: 0.692 vs. 0.628). items.authors: Sepehr Golrokh Amin, Devin Rhoads, Fatemeh Fakhrmoosavi, Nicholas E. Lownes, John N. Ivan

items.title: TARC: Time-Adaptive Robotic Control
items.title_zh: TARC：时间自适应机器人控制
items.summary_zh: 大多数机器人系统依赖固定频率的离散时间控制器，这在低频控制的效率与高频反馈的响应性之间形成了权衡。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了时间自适应机器人控制（TARC），这是一种强化学习框架，策略同时预测控制动作及其应用持续时间。TARC通过优化任务性能，在控制切换次数的软或硬约束下学习时间扩展的动作，从而实现控制频率的自适应调节。我们在两个机器人硬件平台上评估了TARC：高速遥控车和Unitree Go1四足机器人，以及在模拟中使用视觉-语言动作模型的情况。在所有设置中，TARC的性能与高频离散时间控制器相当，但其控制频率不到后者的一半。与固定频率控制器不同，TARC在线调整控制频率，仅在需要时分配高频反馈。
items.abstract: Most robotic systems rely on fixed-frequency discrete-time controllers, creating a trade-off between the efficiency of low-frequency control and the responsiveness of high-frequency feedback. As a result, systems typically default to high control rates for robustness, at the cost of wasted inference and unnecessary actuation. Addressing this, we introduce Time-Adaptive Robotic Control (TARC), a reinforcement learning framework in which the policy jointly predicts a control action and its duration of application. TARC learns temporally extended actions by optimizing task performance under soft or hard constraints on the number of control switches, enabling adaptive modulation of control rates. We evaluate TARC on two robotic hardware platforms: a high-speed RC car and the Unitree Go1 quadruped, and on a vision-language action model in simulation, where each query incurs a costly transformer forward pass. Across all settings, TARC matches the performance of high-frequency discrete-time controllers while operating at less than half their control frequency. Unlike fixed-rate controllers, TARC adapts its control frequency online, allocating high-frequency feedback only when required.
items.authors: Arnav Sukhija, Lenart Treven, Jin Cheng, Florian D\"orfler, Stelian Coros, Andreas Krause

items.title: Shuttling Compiler for Trapped-Ion Quantum Computers Based on Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 基于微调大型语言模型的陷阱离子量子计算机调度编译器
items.summary_zh: 在陷阱离子量子计算机中，量子比特需要在不同段之间移动以进行交互。每种新陷阱架构的调度逻辑通常需手动编写。本文提出了基于五种大型语言模型（LLMs）的调度编译器，针对线性和分支一维陷阱架构的调度进行了微调。研究表明，微调后的LLMs在训练架构上生成有效调度的能力与量子比特数量相关，最多可处理16个量子比特。在12%的编译中，十次运行中最佳结果的操作次数比启发式基线减少了多达21%。此外，某个微调后的LLM成功生成了一个未见过的四路分支架构的有效调度。这表明跨架构泛化的初步证据，但在其他两个未见架构中未能生成有效调度。因此，LLM学习的调度编译是可行的，且当前的有效性范围已被展示。
items.abstract: In trapped-ion quantum computers, qubits must be shuttled between segments to interact. The routing logic that schedules these movements is written by hand for every new trap architecture. We present shuttling compilers based on five large language models (LLMs). Each LLM is fine-tuned on shuttling schedules produced by hand-coded heuristics for linear and branched one-dimensional trap architectures. We investigate how the shuttling operation counts of their schedules compare with those of the heuristics and how far they generalize to unseen architectures. For circuits of up to 16 qubits, the fine-tuned LLMs generate valid schedules on both training architectures, more often the fewer qubits a circuit has. In 12% of the compilations yielding a schedule, the best of ten runs needs up to 21% fewer operations than the heuristic baselines, after a rule-based post-processing step. A single run of one fine-tuned LLM produces a valid shuttling schedule for a previously unseen four-way branched architecture. This is preliminary evidence of cross-architecture generalization. On two other unseen architectures no LLM produces a valid schedule. Thus, LLM-learned shuttling compilation is feasib
items.authors: Fabian Kreppel, Reza Salkhordeh, Ferdinand Schmidt-Kaler, Andr\'e Brinkmann

items.title: Equivalence of approximation by networks of single- and multi-spike neurons
items.title_zh: 单脉冲与多脉冲神经元网络的近似等价性
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了脉冲神经网络中每个神经元是否只需最多发射一次脉冲的问题。尽管已有研究为脉冲神经网络推导了近似界限，但这些结果仅适用于最多发射一次脉冲的神经元，通常被认为是一个重要限制。我们证明，对于包括常用的带减法重置的漏积分发放模型在内的大多数脉冲神经元模型，存在一个等价的单脉冲神经网络集合，其神经元数量仅线性增加（或减少），且该近似界限依然成立。反向同样适用，表明在一般机器学习任务的近似能力方面，单脉冲和多脉冲神经网络是等价的。因此，文献中关于单脉冲神经网络的许多近似结果同样适用于多脉冲情况。
items.abstract: In a spiking neural network, is it enough for each neuron to spike at most once? In recent work, approximation bounds for spiking neural networks have been derived, quantifying how well they can fit target functions. However, these results are only valid for neurons that spike at most once, which is commonly thought to be a strong limitation. Here, we show that the opposite is true for a large class of spiking neuron models, including the commonly used leaky integrate-and-fire model with subtractive reset: for every approximation bound that is valid for a set of multi-spike neural networks, there is an equivalent set of single-spike neural networks with only linearly more (or less) neurons, in the maximum number of spikes, for which the bound holds. The same is true for the reverse direction too, showing that regarding their approximation capabilities in general machine learning tasks, single-spike and multi-spike neural networks are equivalent. Consequently, many approximation results in the literature for single-spike neural networks also hold for the multi-spike case.
items.authors: Dominik Dold, Philipp Christian Petersen

items.title: Optimal Model Activation Policies for Inference Networks of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型推理网络的最佳模型激活策略
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的进步，它们在自然语言处理（NLP）任务中变得不可或缺，但高昂的推理成本促使研究成本与性能的权衡。实际应用中，多个专家LLM通常协同工作，但缺乏有效的使用策略。我们提出了一种基于图的推理网络框架，节点表示不同的LLM，边表示条件模型激活。我们从一系列具有不同成本和专业水平的LLM专家的基本拓扑出发，提出了优化激活模型的问题，以在满足目标性能约束的前提下最小化预期推理成本。我们证明了最佳激活策略具有阈值结构：首先查询最低成本的LLM，然后调用更昂贵的LLM。
items.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have rendered them necessary for Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, and their high inference cost motivates the study of cost-performance trade-offs. In practice, several expert LLMs are used in synergy for inference, either in an ensemble mode or in series, yet without a principled approach on how to best use the available models. An adaptive approach can route simple queries to cheaper LLMs and complex ones to more capable, costly models. However, a clear understanding on how to best leverage available expert models is missing. We introduce inference networks, a graph-based framework, where nodes denote different LLMs, and links denote conditional model activations. The inference network design problem is to determine the best topology, namely the best way to use the models that best addresses the cost-performance trade-off. We start from the basic topology of a series of LLM experts, each of which has a different cost and a different level of expertise, which is captured via model confidence. We formulate the problem of optimal activation of these models so as to minimize the expected inference cost subject to a target perfor
items.authors: Foivos Charalampakos, Md Ibrahim Ibne Alam, Iordanis Koutsopoulos, Koushik Kar

items.title: Quantifying Organizational Environmental Action from Web Data and Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 量化组织环境行动的网络数据与大语言模型研究
items.summary_zh: 量化组织的环境行动仍然是一个具有挑战性的环境数据科学问题，因为相关信息分散在多个网页上，主要通过非结构化文本传达。本文提出了一种可扩展的计算框架，将组织的网络内容转化为结构化的环境行动指标，并以美国的犹太教会为例进行演示。我们整合了多个地理空间、知识库、目录和人工审核来源，构建了一个包含4,964个教会的国家数据库。其中2,657个教会拥有活跃的网站，成功爬取了154,454个网页。我们比较了三种检测环境行动的方法：关键词检索加大语言模型（LLM）分类、语义向量检索加LLM分类，以及不经过初步检索的直接LLM分类。与专家评审的一致性在关键词检索中最低（$\kappa$ = 0.26），语义向量检索较高（$\kappa$ = 0.42），直接LLM分类相似（$\kappa$ = 0.40）。尽管语义检索的一致性最高，但其检索召回率为0.87，表明在分类前丢失了相关内容。
items.abstract: Quantifying organizational environmental action from publicly available web content remains a challenging environmental data science problem because relevant information can be dispersed across multiple webpages and is primarily communicated through unstructured text. We present a scalable computational framework for transforming organizational web content into structured measures of environmental action and demonstrate the approach using Jewish congregations in the United States. We constructed a national database of 4,964 congregations by integrating multiple geospatial, knowledge-base, directory, and manually reviewed sources. Of these, 2,657 had active websites that were successfully crawled, producing a corpus of 154,454 webpages. We compared three approaches for detecting environmental actions: keyword retrieval followed by large language model (LLM) classification, semantic vector retrieval followed by LLM classification, and direct LLM classification classification without preliminary retrieval. Agreement with an expert human reviewer was lowest for keyword retrieval ($\kappa$ = 0.26), higher for semantic vector retrieval ($\kappa$ = 0.42), and similar for direct LLM classi
items.authors: Quinn Reynolds, Daniel Shore, Vianey Leos Barajas, Tanhum Yoreh, Meredith Franklin

items.title: Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation: A Conversational Benchmark for Safe Stroke Care in Japanese Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 日本中风大语言模型评估：安全中风护理的对话基准
items.summary_zh: 背景：大语言模型（LLMs）在多项选择医学知识考试中表现出与医生相当的能力，但其在临床病史采集、紧急评估和安全性方面的能力尚未充分评估。我们提出了日本中风大语言模型评估，这是一个针对中风护理的多轮对话基准，并在实践导向条件下评估了LLM的表现和安全性。方法：我们创建了10个中风及相关疾病案例，并在多轮日语对话中评估LLM。LLM充当医生，经过认证的神经外科医生充当模拟患者和评估者。每个案例包括病史采集和行动阶段，使用预先指定的标准进行评分。直接威胁生命的错误被定义为关键错误。安全阈值为总体至少80%且无关键错误。结果：Claude Fable 5以87.4%的最高分和零关键错误领先，其次是Claude Opus 4.7（80.3%）和GLM-5.2（75.6%）。两者达到了安全阈值。11个模型出现了17个关键错误，包括未确认实验室结果或血糖、在气道稳定前进行手术、遗漏颈部血管评估以及在适应症外使用t-PA。
items.abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved physician-comparable performance on multiple-choice medical knowledge examinations, but their capabilities in clinical history taking, urgency assessment, and safety remain insufficiently evaluated. We proposed Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation, a multi-turn conversational benchmark for stroke care in Japanese, and evaluated LLM performance and safety under practice-oriented conditions. Methods: We created 10 stroke and related-condition cases and evaluated LLMs in multi-turn Japanese conversations. The LLM acted as physician, while a board-certified neurosurgeon acted as simulated patient and evaluator. Each case comprised history-taking and action phases scored using pre-specified criteria. Errors that could directly threaten life were defined as critical mistakes. The safety threshold was at least 80% overall with zero critical mistakes. Eighteen models were evaluated in October 2025 and June 2026. Results: Claude Fable 5 achieved the highest score (87.4%) with zero critical mistakes, followed by Claude Opus 4.7 (80.3%) and GLM-5.2 (75.6%). Two leaders met the safety threshold. items.authors: Keisuke Masuda, Kazutaka Yatsushiro, Hirohumi Iwamoto, Hirofumi Hirano, Ryosuke Hanaya

items.title: Universal Defenses for Tool-Integrated LLM Agents Against Adversarial Attacks
items.title_zh: 针对工具集成LLM代理的通用防御策略研究
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在多领域展现了卓越能力，尤其是在与外部工具集成完成多步骤任务时。然而，它们对各种对抗性攻击（如直接提示注入、间接提示注入、记忆中毒和后门攻击）日益脆弱。本研究探讨了针对这四种攻击类型的实用且可推广的防御策略，提出了两种通用的工具基础防御：攻击者工具过滤（利用异常检测识别并移除可疑工具）和正常工具恢复（在规划前恢复代理的原始工具集）。此外，还结合了基于提示的防御策略，如链式思维提示和自我反思技术，以增强推理能力并缓解攻击。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著降低了攻击成功率（ASR），在许多设置中实现了0% ASR，同时保持或改善了原始任务成功率。这些发现凸显了简单有效防御策略的潜力。
items.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a variety of domains, particularly when integrated with external tools for multi-step task completion. However, they are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and backdoor attacks, which exploit the model's openness to prompt injection and tool manipulation. In this work, we explore practical and generalizable defense strategies within a unified framework across these four attack types. We introduce two universal tool-based defenses: Attacker Tool Filtering, which uses anomaly detection (e.g., Isolation Forest) to identify and remove suspicious tools, and Normal Tool Recalling, a white-box method that restores the agent's original toolset prior to planning. Additionally, we incorporate prompt-based defenses: Chain-of-Thought prompting and self-reflection techniques to enhance reasoning and task paraphrasing to mitigate attacks. Experimental results across both four open-source LLMs (Gemma2-9B, Qwen2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and LLaMA3.1-8B) and three proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-5) show that our methods signi
items.authors: Xiaoyan Li, Yunli Wang

items.title: Toward Robust LLM-Based Judges: Taxonomic Bias Evaluation and Debiasing Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向稳健的基于LLM的评判者：偏见评估与去偏优化
items.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的评判者广泛应用于自动评估和奖励建模，但其判断常受到偏见的影响。准确评估这些偏见对于确保LLM评判者的可靠性至关重要。现有研究通常在单一评判形式下调查有限的偏见，缺乏全面评估。为此，我们提出JudgeBiasBench，一个系统量化LLM评判者偏见的基准。JudgeBiasBench定义了四个维度的判断偏见分类，并通过控制偏见注入管道构建了增强偏见的评估实例，涵盖12种代表性偏见类型。我们在生成型和判别型评判者上进行了广泛实验，发现当前评判者表现出显著且多样的偏见模式，常常影响自动评估的可靠性。为减轻判断偏见，我们提出了偏见感知训练，明确将偏见相关属性纳入训练过程，鼓励评判者将任务相关质量与偏见相关线索分离。通过对生成型评判者采用强化学习，对判别型评判者采用对比学习，我们的方法有效减少了判断偏见，同时在很大程度上保持了总体评估能力。
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based judges are widely adopted for automated evaluation and reward modeling, yet their judgments are often affected by judgment biases. Accurately evaluating these biases is essential for ensuring the reliability of LLM-based judges. However, existing studies typically investigate limited biases under a single judge formulation, either generative or discriminative, lacking a comprehensive evaluation. To bridge this gap, we propose JudgeBiasBench, a benchmark for systematically quantifying biases in LLM-based judges. JudgeBiasBench defines a taxonomy of judgment biases across 4 dimensions, and constructs bias-augmented evaluation instances through a controlled bias injection pipeline, covering 12 representative bias types. We conduct extensive experiments across both generative and discriminative judges, revealing that current judges exhibit significant and diverse bias patterns that often compromise the reliability of automated evaluation. To mitigate judgment bias, we propose bias-aware training that explicitly incorporates bias-related attributes into the training process, encouraging judges to disentangle task-relevant quality from bias-correlated cue
items.authors: Hongli Zhou, Hui Huang, Rui Zhang, Kehai Chen, Bing Xu, Conghui Zhu, Tiejun Zhao, Muyun Yang

items.title: YFPO: Yoked Feature Preference Optimization with Neuron-Guided Rewards
items.title_zh: YFPO：基于神经元引导奖励的耦合特征偏好优化
items.summary_zh: 偏好优化已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的广泛应用后训练范式。现有方法通常依赖外部行为监督，主要关注偏好和不偏好响应，而忽视了模型内部表示中编码的能力相关信号。本研究探讨了这些内部信号是否能为数学推理提供有用的辅助监督。我们提出了YFPO（耦合特征偏好优化），一种将响应级偏好学习与神经元级奖励相结合的框架。YFPO首先使用AttnLRP识别与数学相关的内部特征，然后根据这些神经元在偏好和不偏好响应之间的激活边际推导出辅助奖励。该奖励与标准偏好优化目标结合，鼓励模型将外部偏好与内部数学相关特征对齐。在GSM8K上进行的小规模实验表明，神经元引导奖励能够影响偏好优化动态，并在多个设置中带来可测量的改进，表明内部表示可以作为轻量且可解释的推理导向后训练信号。
items.abstract: Preference optimization has become a widely used post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. Existing methods typically learn from preferred and dispreferred responses as external behavioral supervision, while largely ignoring capability-related signals encoded in the model's internal representations. In this work, we study whether such internal signals can provide useful auxiliary supervision for mathematical reasoning. We introduce YFPO (Yoked Feature Preference Optimization), a neuron-guided preference optimization framework that couples response-level preference learning with neuron-level rewards. YFPO first uses AttnLRP to identify math-associated internal features, and then derives an auxiliary reward from the activation margin of these neurons between preferred and dispreferred responses. This reward is combined with the standard preference optimization objective, encouraging the model to align external preferences with internal math-related features. We conduct small-scale experiments on GSM8K with a compact language model. Results show that neuron-guided rewards can influence preference optimization dynamics and yield measurable i
items.authors: Yifan Le

items.title: Measuring Human Contribution in AI-Assisted Content Generation
items.title_zh: 测量人类在AI辅助内容生成中的贡献
items.summary_zh: 随着生成性人工智能（AI）的日益普及，越来越多的内容不再仅由人类生成，而是由生成性AI模型在人的指导下生成。这一转变给原创性的界定带来了显著挑战，因为AI辅助作品中人类贡献的程度各不相同。本研究提出了一个测量人类在AI辅助内容生成中贡献的框架，基于信息理论，通过计算人类输入与AI辅助输出之间的互信息，相对于AI辅助输出的自信息，量化人类在内容生成中的信息贡献比例。实验结果表明，所提度量方法能够有效区分多个创意领域中人类贡献的不同程度。我们希望这项工作为在生成性AI时代测量人类在AI辅助内容生成中的贡献奠定基础。
items.abstract: With the growing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (AI), an increasing amount of content is no longer exclusively generated by humans but by generative AI models with human guidance. This shift presents notable challenges for the delineation of originality due to the varying degrees of human contribution in AI-assisted works. This study raises the research question of measuring human contribution in AI-assisted content generation and introduces a framework to address this question that is grounded in information theory. By calculating mutual information between human input and AI-assisted output relative to self-information of AI-assisted output, we quantify the proportional information contribution of humans in content generation. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed measure effectively discriminates between varying degrees of human contribution across multiple creative domains. We hope that this work lays a foundation for measuring human contributions in AI-assisted content generation in the era of generative AI.
items.authors: Yueqi Xie, Tao Qi, Jingwei Yi, Xiyuan Yang, Ryan Whalen, Junming Huang, Qian Ding, Yu Xie, Xing Xie, Fangzhao Wu

items.title: Forged in Quenching: Morphological Transformation across Star-forming and Quiescent Galaxies in EAGLE
items.title_zh: 急冷过程中的形态转变：EAGLE中星形成与静止星系的研究
items.summary_zh: 中心星系的形态与急冷之间的关系已得到广泛认可，但其物理起源仍存在争议。我们通过追踪EAGLE宇宙学模拟中$z=0$星形成和静止中心星系的主要祖先分支，从$z\gtrsim4$开始进行研究。发现它们的盘面与总质量比和三轴性轨迹在$z\approx 1$-$2$之前是不可区分的，随后随着急冷的开始而同时分化，而大小和超大质量黑洞（SMBH）质量的差异则较早建立。我们识别出四个物理上不同的通道将星系形态与急冷联系起来：合并导致大小增长、旋转抑制、三轴性增加和SMBH增长，积累的SMBH质量随后导致星系的急冷；在控制合并历史的情况下，星系形态在星形成阶段调节SMBH增长；在固定的恒星质量和SMBH质量下，紧凑性进一步促进星系的急冷；盘的不稳定性将紧凑的扁平盘转变为长轴系统，伴随显著的大小增长和旋转抑制，但恒星质量增长微乎其微。
items.abstract: The connection between morphology and quenching in central galaxies is well established, but its physical origin remains widely debated. We address this by tracing the main progenitor branches of $z=0$ star-forming and quiescent central galaxies in the EAGLE cosmological simulation from $z\gtrsim4$. Their disc-to-total ratio and triaxiality tracks are indistinguishable until $z\approx 1$-$2$, when both diverge concurrently with the onset of quenching, whereas the size and supermassive black hole (SMBH) mass differences are established earlier. We identify four physically distinct channels linking galaxy morphology and quenching. First, mergers cause size growth, rotation suppression, triaxiality increase, and SMBH growth, with the accumulated SMBH mass subsequently causes the quenching of galaxies. Second, with merger history controlled, galaxy morphology modulates SMBH growth throughout the star-forming phase: compact, dispersion-dominated galaxies grow their SMBHs faster and are preferentially quenched, producing the size and morphology differences between star-forming and quiescent galaxies. Third, at fixed stellar mass and SMBH mass, compactness further facilitates the quenchin
