items.title: Gravitational Wave Bias in IllustrisTNG300 from Machine-Learned Population-Synthesis Calibrated Merger Rates
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的IllustrisTNG300引力波偏差研究
items.summary_zh: 引力波（GW）源的大规模聚集为宇宙学和紧凑双星天体物理学提供了独立的探测手段。为了理解未来的GW聚集测量，我们开发了一个基于模拟的框架来建模双黑洞（BBH）合并的聚集性，并估计相应的GW偏差。我们使用在GALAXYRATE数据集上训练的机器学习模拟器，为IllustrisTNG300填充GW源，提供与星系形成历史相关的合并率。这使得我们能够生成物理上合理的模拟GW目录，BBH合并率依赖于恒星质量、星形成率、金属丰度和红shift。与仅依赖恒星质量的简单现象学模型相比，该框架显示GW源的偏差更强，反映出BBH合并更倾向于发生在更大质量和更强聚集的晕中。此外，机器学习模型显示GW偏差的尺度依赖性强于仅基于恒星质量的加权，表明其他宿主属性也影响GW聚集。我们还发现金属丰度与GW和星系偏差呈正相关。这些结果强调了研究GW源聚集的重要性。
items.abstract: The large scale clustering of gravitational wave (GW) sources offers an independent probe of cosmology and compact-binary astrophysics. Interpreting future GW clustering measurements requires understanding how merger rates depend on host-galaxy properties and environment. We develop a simulation-based framework to model the clustering of binary black hole (BBH) mergers and estimate the corresponding GW bias. We populate IllustrisTNG300 with GW sources using a machine-learning emulator trained on the GALAXYRATE data set, which provides population-synthesis calibrated merger rates linked to galaxy formation histories. This enables physically motivated mock GW catalogs with galaxy-specific BBH merger rates that depend on stellar mass, star formation rate, metallicity, and redshift. We compare this framework to a simpler phenomenological model in which the merger rate depends only on stellar mass. In both approaches, GW sources are more strongly biased than the overall galaxy population, reflecting the preference for BBH mergers to occur in more massive, more strongly clustered halos. The machine-learned model also produces stronger scale dependence in the GW bias than stellar-mass wei
items.authors: Dorsa Sadat Hosseini, Taisiia Karasova, Nikshay Chugh, Alex Krolewski, Ghazal Geshnizjani

items.title: Lower central dark matter densities in nearby galaxies than predicted by simulations
items.title_zh: 附近星系中心暗物质密度低于模拟预测
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对136个附近星系，测量其从中心到20-50 kpc半径范围内的暗物质分布，涵盖了星系质量范围为$10^9$至$10^{11.5}\,M_{\odot}$。结果显示，相较于$\Lambda$CDM模拟预期，这些星系的中心区域暗物质密度较低，且这种低密度区域的范围随着星系质量的增加而扩大，从约10 kpc增长至超过50 kpc。尽管其物理起源尚不明确，但数据清晰地指示了这些低暗物质区域的存在。我们的研究为未来探索替代暗物质模型和反馈过程的水动力学模拟提供了重要的观测基准。
items.abstract: Baryonic feedback in hydrodynamical simulations is typically invoked to alleviate the core--cusp problem in dwarf galaxies. Yet baryonic processes also induce adiabatic contraction of dark matter, producing overly steep density profiles and excessively high dark matter fractions in the inner regions of massive galaxies. The dark matter distribution of galaxies across a wide stellar-mass range is therefore a critical test for such simulations, but a comprehensive benchmark has remained absent. Here, we consistently measure the dark matter distribution from galaxy centres out to radii of 20--50 kpc for 136 nearby galaxies that together span the local mass--size relation over the stellar mass interval $10^9$--$10^{11.5}\,M_{\odot}$. We identify central regions with lower dark matter densities relative to $\Lambda$CDM simulation expectations---whose extent grows from about 10 kpc to $>50$ kpc as stellar mass increases from $10^{10} M_{\odot}$ to $10^{11.5} M_{\odot}$. Although their physical origin remains unclear, these low--dark matter regions are clearly indicated by the data. Our results provide an important observational benchmark for future hydrodynamical simulations that explore
items.authors: Yu Lei, Ling Zhu, Meng Yang, Giulia Despali, Zheng Zheng, Ran Li, Dandan Xu, Niankun Yu, Jes\'us Falc\'on-Barroso, Fangzhou Jiang, Glenn van de Ven, Jie Wang

items.title: Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves by galaxy clusters
items.title_zh: 星系团对引力波的引力透镜效应研究
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了星系团对双黑洞引力波（GWs）的引力透镜效应，重点分析了时间延迟和放大比率的分布，以及微透镜效应的系统性。结果显示，星系团透镜的中位时间延迟约为76天，而星系透镜为6.9天。在LVK O4灵敏度下，信噪比阈值为$\rho>8$时，星系团样本的中位时间延迟为15.4天，星系样本为0.24天。检测到的星系团样本保留了长延迟尾部，9.1%的图像对延迟超过365天，3.3%超过1000天，表明基于星系的时间延迟先验可能会抑制星系团透镜对。尽管星系团成员星系扩展了放大比率的分布，但在O4灵敏度下，检测到的星系团和星系透镜样本非常相似，暗示候选选择中偏差较小。
items.abstract: Strongly lensed gravitational waves (GWs) are commonly searched for using population priors, including time-delay and magnification-ratio distributions, to suppress false alarms. Current LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA (LVK) searches mainly adopt priors calibrated with galaxy-scale lenses; however, these may penalize the longer time delays produced by galaxy clusters, which could contribute 10%--20% of lensed events. Cluster member galaxies may also perturb the macro-lens potential and alter image magnifications. We investigate the time-delay and magnification-ratio distributions of binary black hole GWs lensed by galaxy clusters, together with microlensing systematics. In the full lensed sample, the median time delay is about 76 days for cluster lenses, compared with 6.9 days for galaxy lenses. After imposing an SNR threshold of $\rho>8$ at LVK O4 sensitivity, the medians are 15.4 and 0.24 days. The detected cluster sample retains a long-delay tail, with 9.1% of image pairs delayed by more than 365 days and 3.3% by more than 1000 days, so galaxy-based time-delay priors can suppress cluster-lensed pairs. By contrast, although cluster member galaxies broaden the magnification-ratio distribut
items.authors: Xikai Shan, Yi-Fan Wang, Shude Mao, Huan Yang, Miguel Zumalac\'arregui

items.title: The UV-to-FIR environments of nearby Type Ia supernovae with the DustPedia Galaxy Catalogue -- I. Local versus global host properties
items.title_zh: 利用DustPedia星系目录研究邻近Ia型超新星的环境特征
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了Ia型超新星（SNe Ia）作为标准化烛光的使用，强调了其标准化亮度与宿主星系特性之间的关系需要额外修正。目前，该修正主要基于宿主的恒星质量，通常通过光学光谱能量分布（SED）拟合获得，但近期分析表明，这可能未能充分反映环境特性。我们使用DustPedia星系中的90颗邻近SNe Ia样本，通过\texttt{CIGALE} SED拟合，比较了超新星附近的局部环境与宿主的全球特性。DustPedia的紫外到远红外覆盖提高了尘埃约束，帮助打破了光学研究中的年龄-尘埃退化问题。结果显示，局部的恒星质量和尘埃质量较低，但局部的颜色、特异星形成率（sSFR）和尘埃衰减值与宿主平均值存在显著差异，尘埃衰减的差异最为明显（$p=6.3\times10^{-5}$）。只有质量加权年龄在局部和全球上是一致的。
items.abstract: The ongoing use of Type Ia Supernovae (SNe Ia) as standardisable candles relies on an additional correction for the relationship between their standardised brightnesses and host galaxy properties. Currently, this correction is built on host stellar mass, typically derived from optical-only SED fitting, which recent analyses suggest may not fully capture the underlying environmental properties. This relationship is stronger when considering the regions closest to the SNe, rather than the galaxies as a whole. I use a sample of SNe Ia in DustPedia galaxies and \texttt{CIGALE} SED fitting to compare the local environments of 90 nearby SNe Ia against the global properties of their hosts. The UV-to-FIR coverage of DustPedia enables improved dust constraints, and helps break the age-dust degeneracy that limits optical-only studies; to my knowledge this coverage has not been previously applied to the sub-galactic regions around SNe Ia. Stellar mass and dust mass are lower locally simply because the aperture encloses less of the galaxy; however, for colour, sSFR, and dust attenuation, local values differ from the host average by more than measurement uncertainty alone allows, with attenuati
items.authors: Lisa Kelsey

items.title: Pushing HST to the limit: Detection completeness and morphology robustness of faint galaxies in the EGS field
items.title_zh: 推动HST极限：EGS领域微弱星系的检测完整性与形态稳健性
items.summary_zh: 可靠的微弱星系目录对于星系演化的统计研究至关重要。然而，微弱星系的检测和结构测量仍然具有挑战性。我们利用模拟图像及HST和JWST的观测数据，评估了CANDELS/EGS领域微弱星系的检测完整性和结构参数不确定性。该框架同样适用于包括Euclid、即将推出的CSST和南希·格雷斯·罗曼空间望远镜在内的大型高红移调查。我们在EGS F160W马赛克中使用1.5σ阈值检测源，并通过现实的模拟图像量化检测完整性和误检率。模拟星系对测试评估了混叠效应对源检测和Sersic拟合的结构测量的影响。此外，结合CEERS观测，我们提出了一个经验标准，以利用HST光度法区分真实微弱星系与假检测。我们在CANDELS/EGS领域识别了72,467个源，其中57,444个在F160W中亮度低于25等。对于亮度超过25等的天体，检测完整性超过95%，但在25<mH<27等时，Sersic指数的系统偏差达到Δn≈5-70%。
items.abstract: Reliable catalogs at the faint limit are essential for statistical studies of galaxy evolution. However, detection and structural measurements of faint galaxies remain challenging. We evaluate detection completeness and structural parameter uncertainties of faint galaxies in the CANDELS/EGS field using mock images and observations from the HST and JWST. The framework is also applicable to large high-redshift surveys, including Euclid, the upcoming CSST, and the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. We detect sources in the EGS F160W mosaic using a 1.5\sigma threshold and quantify detection completeness and false-detection rates with realistic mock images. Mock galaxy-pair tests assess blending effects on both source detection and structural measurements in sersic fitting. In addition, the overlap with CEERS observations is used to derive an empirical criterion for separating true faint galaxies from fake detections using HST photometry. We identify 72,467 sources in the CANDELS/EGS field, including 57,444 fainter than 25 mag in F160W. Detection completeness exceeds 95% for objects brighter than 25 mag but declines to 50%). items.authors: Limin Lai, Zhao-Yu Li, Chao Ma, Yang Anpin Li, Luis C. Ho, Mingyang Zhuang

items.title: DeepDive: Simultaneous Formation of Massive Quiescent Galaxies in High-Redshift Galaxy Overdensities
items.title_zh: DeepDive：高红移星系过密区内大质量静止星系的同时形成
items.summary_zh: 我们利用JWST/NIRSpec对早期宇宙中大质量静止星系（QGs）过密区域进行了光谱确认。基于DeepDive NIRSpec项目的数据和Dawn JWST档案的归档数据，我们确认了在$z=3.71$的Jekyll & Hyde附近的三个QGs，以及在$z=4.01$的SXDS-27434周围的两个QGs。通过光度红移分析，Jekyll & Hyde（SXDS-27434）位于一个过密区域，星系数密度分别是COSMOS（SXDS）场平均值的三倍（四倍）。SED拟合表明，大多数QGs具有相似的星形成历史和一致的形成及熄灭时期。JWST光谱显示SXDS-27434有宽H$\alpha$发射线，其他三个QGs则有微弱的发射线，基于发射线比率被识别为AGN驱动。Illustris TNG300模拟在$z=3.71$时也重现了这一过密区，成员QGs具有相似的熄灭时期。这些结果与大规模环境在QGs形成中的重要作用相一致。
items.abstract: We report on the spectroscopic confirmation of overdense regions of massive quiescent galaxies (QGs) in the early Universe with JWST/NIRSpec. Based on data from the DeepDive NIRSpec program and archival data from the Dawn JWST Archive, we confirm three QGs in the vicinity of Jekyll & Hyde, a pair of massive QG and a dusty star-forming galaxy, at $z=3.71$ and two QGs around SXDS-27434 at $z=4.01$. According to the analysis of galaxy number density with photometric redshifts, Jekyll & Hyde (SXDS-27434) are in an overdense region, where the number density of galaxies is three (four) times higher than the average in the COSMOS (SXDS) field. SED fitting suggests that most of the QGs follow similar star formation histories and have consistent formation and quenching epochs. The same trend is observed in other proto-clusters hosting QGs that were already identified by ground-based telescopes, indicating that the large-scale environment plays an important role in the formation of QGs. In addition, JWST spectra reveal a broad H$\alpha$ emission line from SXDS-27434 and faint emission lines from other three QGs, which are identified as AGN-driven based on their emission line ratios. items.title: Optically Selected Superthin Galaxies Remain Thin in the Near-infrared
items.title_zh: 光学选取的超薄星系在近红外中依然保持超薄特征
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在光学图像中被识别为超薄的星系是否在近红外（NIR）中依然保持超薄特征，以及其极端盘状形态与环境的关系。从一个邻近的体积限制样本中，我们通过对SDSS $r$波段图像的二维隆起/盘分解选取了210个超薄星系，要求盘组件的短轴与长轴比 $b/a<1/9$。我们测量了从SDSS $griz$到UKIDSS $JHK$波段的盘形状。结果显示，光学到近红外的主要和次要轴尺度均减小，达到其$r$波段值的$\sim0.6$，但盘轴比几乎保持不变。因此，光学选取的超薄星系在近红外中依然超薄，表明如果存在NIR主导的厚组件，其影响不足以改变拟合的盘形状。对样本及之前超薄样本的重新分析表明，早期报告的NIR增厚主要是由于一维拟合中的幅度和波段依赖偏差。我们进一步通过投影交叉相关、重建局部过密度和大尺度结构分类比较了它们的环境。超薄星系在$\sim0.1$--$1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$尺度上显示出较低的聚集性和在$1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$处的较低过密度，但大尺度聚集性相似且没有明显的残余。
items.abstract: We investigate whether galaxies identified as superthin in optical images remain superthin in the near-infrared (NIR), and how their extreme disk morphology is related to environment. From a nearby volume-limited sample, we select 210 superthin galaxies using two-dimensional bulge/disk decomposition of SDSS $r$-band images, requiring the disk component to have a minor-to-major axis ratio $b/a<1/9$. We measure disk shapes from SDSS $griz$ to UKIDSS $JHK$ bands. Both the major- and minor-axis scales decrease from the optical to the NIR, reaching $\sim0.6$ of their $r$-band values in the $K$ band, but the disk axis ratio remains nearly unchanged. Thus, optically selected superthin galaxies remain superthin in the NIR, suggesting that any NIR-dominant thick component, if present, is not prominent enough to alter the fitted disk shape. Reanalysis of our sample and a previous superthin sample shows that earlier reported NIR thickening is mainly due to a magnitude- and band-dependent bias in one-dimensional fitting. We further compare their environments with matched control samples using projected cross-correlations, reconstructed local overdensities, and large-scale-structure classificat

items.title: Active galactic nucleus activity in brightest cluster galaxies at intermediate redshifts in Sunyaev-Zel'dovich--selected clusters
items.title_zh: 中等红移星系团中最亮星系的活动性研究
items.summary_zh: 研究对象为中等红移（$0.3 < z < 0.8$）的最亮星系（BCGs）中的活跃星系核（AGNs），通过分析171个BCGs，结合南非大望远镜光谱、WISE中红外光度和快速ASKAP连续调查的射电数据，采用X-CIGALE建模来推导恒星质量、星形成率和爱丁顿比例。结果显示，38个BCGs（22%）宿主射电强的AGNs，其中仅有2个（约5%）为高激发射电星系，其余为低激发系统。大多数AGNs具有低爱丁顿比率，表明其辐射效率低。随着红移的增加，吸积效率提升，但与星系团质量和动力状态的相关性较弱。BCGs中的射电强AGNs与场中射电AGNs的射电功率相似。
items.abstract: Context. Brightest cluster galaxies (BCGs) host powerful active galactic nuclei (AGNs) and help regulate the heating--cooling balance of the intracluster medium. While radio-mode feedback is well established locally, its prevalence at intermediate redshifts remains poorly constrained. Aims. We investigate the incidence, accretion state, and host-galaxy properties of AGNs in BCGs in Sunyaev--Zel'dovich (SZ)-selected clusters at $0.3 < z < 0.8$, testing dependences on cosmic epoch, cluster mass, and dynamical state. Methods. We analyse 171 BCGs from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope SZ catalogue, combining Southern African Large Telescope spectroscopy, WISE mid-infrared photometry, and Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey radio data with X-CIGALE modelling to derive stellar masses, star formation rates, and Eddington-scaled accretion rates. Results. Thirty-eight BCGs (22%) host radio-loud AGNs. Only two ($\sim$5%) are high-excitation radio galaxies; the remainder are low-excitation systems. Most AGNs have low Eddington ratios ($-3 \lesssim \log_{10}\lambda_{\mathrm{Edd}} \lesssim -1$), consistent with radiatively inefficient accretion. items.title: Large-scale quantum simulations of dissipative spin-1/2 Heisenberg chains
items.title_zh: 大规模量子模拟耗散自旋-1/2海森堡链
items.summary_zh: 量子多体系统与环境耦合后会放松到一种无平衡稳态，该稳态能够维持无平衡对应的有序状态。计算这种稳态比封闭系统的动力学更为复杂，因为密度矩阵问题使希尔伯特空间维度平方增长，且没有自由能选择稳态。耗散自旋-1/2海森堡链是无平衡稳态物理的基准例子；尽管已有多种方法计算其相图，但结果不一致，且在大系统规模下的受控确定仍然难以实现。本文在超导处理器ibm_kingston上模拟了最多50个格点的链的Lindblad动力学，利用Stinespring扩展实现耗散。系统的耗散演化是一种自我纠正机制，有效地消除错误，因此硬件噪声仅作为弱竞争耗散体进入。我们测量了静态结构因子，解析了铁磁、反铁磁、自旋密度波和顺磁稳态，绘制了$J_x$--$J_y$平面的相图，共获得117个量子硬件数据点。我们揭示了一个丰富的无平衡相图，显示出有序相仅保留均场有序的残余，并且尖锐的相变让位于一维中预期的交叉现象。
items.abstract: A quantum many-body system coupled to an environment relaxes to a nonequilibrium steady state that can sustain order with no equilibrium counterpart. Computing such steady states is harder than closed-system dynamics as the density matrix problem squares the Hilbert-space dimension, and no free energy selects the steady state. The dissipative spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain is a benchmark example for nonequilibrium steady state physics; various methods have each calculated its phase diagram but do not agree, and a controlled determination at large system size has remained out of reach. Here we simulate the Lindblad dynamics of chains of up to 50 sites on the superconducting processor ibm_kingston -- 100 simultaneously active qubits at up to 1700 entangling-gate depths -- realizing the dissipation via Stinespring dilation. The system's dissipative evolution is a self-correcting mechanism that effectively erases errors, so hardware noise enters only as a weak competing dissipator. We measure static structure factors and resolve ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, spin-density-wave, and paramagnetic steady states, mapping the phase diagram with 117 quantum hardware data points across the $J_x
items.authors: Jo\~ao C. Getelina, Andrew Cox, Muhammad Asaduzzaman, Omar Alsheikh, Ryan S. Bennink, James K. Freericks, Alexander F. Kemper

items.title: Coupling Structure Determines Communication Regimes in Discrete Quantum Convolutional Channels
items.title_zh: 耦合结构决定离散量子卷积通道的通信模式
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了离散变量量子系统的量子卷积理论。根据耦合矩阵的不同元素消失情况，我们对由可逆$2\times2$耦合矩阵和固定环境态生成的离散量子卷积通道进行了分类。在保持角色不变的基变换下，所有四个元素均非零的矩阵形成$d-2$个典型交叉比类，而恰好有一个元素消失的矩阵则分为四个不等价的分支。我们确定了所有四个单元素消失分支的优化一次性Holevo信息以及经典、量子和私有容量。如果对角元素消失，该通道为纠缠破坏的测量-准备轨道通道，其经典容量等于环境态的相对熵相干性，而量子和私有容量则为零。如果非对角元素消失，该通道为可降解的广义去相干通道：可以无误差地传输一个完整的正交基，而量子和私有容量由去相干后环境态的熵缺失决定。因此，单个消失元素的位置选择了两种质的不同通信模式。当所有四个元素均非零时，这些通道是不可约的Weyl协变的。
items.abstract: We study the recently developed theory of quantum convolution for discrete-variable quantum systems. We classify the discrete quantum convolutional channels generated by an invertible $2\times2$ coupling matrix and a fixed environmental state according to which entries of the coupling ma- trix vanish. Under role-preserving basis relabelings, matrices with all four entries nonzero form $d-2$ canonical cross-ratio classes, whereas matrices with exactly one vanishing entry split into four inequivalent branches. We determine the optimized one-shot Holevo information and the classical, quantum, and private capacities for all four one-entry-vanishing branches. If a diago- nal entry vanishes, the channel is an entanglement-breaking measure-and-prepare orbit channel: its classical capacity equals a relative entropy coherence of the environmental state, whereas its quantum and private capacities vanish. If an off-diagonal entry vanishes, the channel is a degradable generalized-dephasing channel: one complete orthonormal basis is transmitted without error, whereas the quantum and private capacities are determined by the entropy deficit of the environ-ental state after dephasing in the conjug
items.authors: Chunhe Xiong

items.title: Strong converse for the quantum capacity of the pure-loss bosonic channel
items.title_zh: 纯损耗玻色信道的量子容量强对偶性研究
items.summary_zh: 本文证明了纯损耗玻色信道的无约束量子容量的强对偶性。在每个固定的超出容量的速率下，任意编码的每个码的纠缠生成保真度都被一个常数与信道使用次数的倒数相乘所界定。该界限在没有能量约束的情况下适用，并且适用于任意编码状态，包括在所有输入模式间相关的状态以及任意联合解码器。证明结合了量子切比雪夫不等式和曲棍球棒测试不等式，以及针对平衡纯损耗信道的统一相对熵方差界限，传输率为$\eta=1/2$。方差界限通过将平衡光束分 splitter 表达为明暗模式得出：暗模式完全处于真空状态，任何与该真空正交的状态至少包含一个暗光子。对于一般传输率，扩展衰减器将问题简化为这一平衡信道设置，并通过产生已知量子容量阈值的因子精确界定解码器测试。最终论证确立了每个纯损耗玻色信道的无约束量子容量的强对偶性。
items.abstract: This paper reports the proof of a strong converse for the unconstrained quantum capacity of the pure-loss bosonic channel. At every fixed rate above capacity, the entanglement-generation fidelity of every code is bounded by a constant times the reciprocal of the number of channel uses. The bound holds without an energy constraint and for arbitrary encoded states, including states correlated across all input modes, and arbitrary joint decoders. The proof combines quantum Chebyshev and hockey-stick testing inequalities with a uniform relative-entropy-variance bound for the balanced pure-loss channel, corresponding to transmissivity $\eta=1/2$. The variance bound follows by expressing the balanced beam splitter in bright and dark modes: the dark modes are exactly in vacuum, and any state orthogonal to that vacuum contains at least one dark photon. For general transmissivity, dilating the degrading attenuator reduces the problem to this balanced-channel setting and bounds the decoder test by precisely the factor that produces the known quantum-capacity threshold. The resulting argument establishes the strong converse at the unconstrained quantum capacity for every pure-loss bosonic cha
items.authors: Mark M. Wilde

items.title: Quantum Simulation of Two-Dimensional Free Dirac Hamiltonian in Multimode Circuit QED
items.title_zh: 多模电路量子电动力学中的二维自由狄拉克哈密顿量量子模拟
items.summary_zh: 二维重狄拉克系统具有能隙的狄拉克锥色散，涉及凝聚态物理和拓扑物理中的广泛现象。尽管量子模拟已展示了一维狄拉克动力学和二维无质量韦尔动力学，但可编程的二维重狄拉克动力学尚未在实验中探索。本文实现了在电路量子电动力学中可编程的二维自由狄拉克哈密顿量，利用一个与多模腔的两个模式耦合的单个拉比驱动量子比特，独立调节自旋-动量耦合和质量。我们观察到二维重狄拉克粒子的旋转Zitterbewegung及其对有效质量的依赖。结合测量的去相干、超越旋转波近似（RWA）的修正和超调的时间依赖主方程模拟再现了观察到的动力学。我们的结果确立了多模电路量子电动力学作为高维相对论量子动力学的紧凑可编程平台，为探索重狄拉克系统中的动力学和拓扑现象奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Two-dimensional massive Dirac systems feature a gapped Dirac-cone dispersion central to a broad range of phenomena in condensed-matter and topological physics. While quantum simulations have demonstrated one-dimensional Dirac dynamics and two-dimensional massless Weyl dynamics, programmable simulation of massive two-dimensional Dirac dynamics remains experimentally unexplored. Here, we realize a programmable two-dimensional free Dirac Hamiltonian in circuit QED, with independently tunable spin-momentum couplings and mass, using a single Rabi-driven qubit coupled to two modes of a multimode cavity. Using this Hamiltonian, we observe rotational Zitterbewegung of a two-dimensional massive Dirac particle and its dependence on the effective mass. Time-dependent master-equation simulations incorporating measured decoherence, corrections beyond the rotating-wave approximation (RWA), and anharmonicity of the transmon reproduce the observed dynamics. Our results establish multimode circuit QED as a compact, programmable platform for higher-dimensional relativistic quantum dynamics and provide a foundation for exploring dynamical and topological phenomena in gapped Dirac systems.
items.authors: Jiwon Kang, Jiuk Lee, Eliya Blumenthal, Shay Hacohen-Gourgy, Eunseong Kim

items.title: Classical Communication Protocol based on Joint Classical-Quantum Coding
items.title_zh: 基于联合经典-量子编码的经典通信协议
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种稳健的量子通信协议，结合了经典错误控制编码、纠缠分发和超密编码。通过确定量子比特传输的位置并保护通过超密编码嵌入的数据，经典错误纠正码用于减轻暗计数和光子损失。我们推导了在有限错误频率模型下，所用编码的成功错误纠正条件。此外，推导了经典错误纠正保护的传统超密编码性能的上限。在相同的错误频率约束下，所提协议的适当编码配置在数据传输速率和能量效率方面均可超越这些上限。最后，我们基于光纤衰减、探测器效率、暗计数和时间槽持续时间开发了物理错误模型，并用其评估不同错误纠正编码配置的有效性能。该方法主要适用于短距离量子链路，如量子局域网（QLAN），能够在通信过程中直接集成纠缠分发并提供高通信吞吐量。
items.abstract: We introduce a robust quantum communication protocol that integrates classical error-control coding, entanglement distribution, and superdense coding. Classical error-correcting codes are used to mitigate dark counts and photon losses by determining the positions of qubit transmissions and protecting the data embedded through superdense coding. We derive conditions on the employed codes that guarantee successful error correction under a bounded error-frequency model. Moreover, upper bounds are derived on the performance of conventional superdense coding protected by classical error correction. It is shown that, under the same constraints on error frequency, suitable code configurations of the proposed protocol can exceed those upper bounds both in terms of data rate and energy efficiency. Finally, we develop a physical error model based on fiber attenuation, detector efficiency, dark counts, and time-slot duration, and use it to evaluate the effective performance of different configurations of error-correcting codes. The proposed approach is primarily suited for short-distance quantum links, as in Quantum Local Area Network (QLAN) where it can provide high communication throughput
items.authors: Kristian Skafte Jensen, Ren\'e B{\o}dker Christensen, \v{C}edomir Stefanovi\'c, Petar Popovski

items.title: Phase-stable voltage bias for Josephson photonics devices
items.title_zh: 相位稳定的电压偏置用于约瑟夫森光子学器件
items.summary_zh: 参数相互作用是超导量子技术的基础，但传统的微波驱动泵浦引入了寄生的Kerr非线性和高次谐波，限制了器件性能。约瑟夫森光子学（JP）通过利用直流偏置结避免了这些寄生效应，但仍受到高相位噪声和缺乏稳定相位参考的限制。本文通过集成约瑟夫森电压标准（JVS）克服了这一限制，建立了抗噪声的相位参考，并展示了该参考通过超导序参量被有效传递到非弹性库珀对隧道放大器（ICTA）。所得到的低相位噪声架构实现了14 dB的增益提升和更好的量子极限噪声性能。关键是，相位参考使得在直流偏置放大器中首次观察到相位敏感增益和压缩。通过将干净的无Kerr非线性与相位相干驱动结合，我们的架构为超导电路中的高纯度参数过程建立了稳健的平台。
items.abstract: Parametric interactions are foundational to superconducting quantum technologies, yet conventional microwave-driven pumping introduces parasitic Kerr nonlinearities and higher-order harmonics that limit device performance. Josephson Photonics (JP) avoids these parasitics by utilizing dc-biased junctions but has remained constrained by high phase noise and the absence of a stable phase reference. Here, we overcome this limitation by integrating a Josephson voltage standard (JVS) to establish a noise-tolerant phase reference, and demonstrate that this reference is coherently transferred to an inelastic Cooper-pair tunneling amplifier (ICTA) via the superconducting order parameter.The resulting low-phase-noise architecture yields a 14-dB enhancement in averaged gain and better quantum-limited noise performance. Critically, the phase reference enables the first observation of phase-sensitive gain and sqeezing in a dc-biased amplifier. By reconciling clean, Kerr-free nonlinearities with phase-coherent drive, our architecture establishes a robust platform for high-purity parametric processes in superconducting circuits.
items.authors: Amir Hosein Esmaeili, Naveen Nehra, Alexandre Paquette, Mona Arabmohammadi, Baptiste Monge, Alexandre Rogalle, Francois Cyrenne-Bergeron, Yannick Lapointe, Nicolas Lavoie, Nicolas Bourlet, Max Hofhein

items.title: Evolution of quantum imaginarity in black hole quantum atmosphere
items.title_zh: 黑洞量子气氛中量子虚数的演化研究
items.summary_zh: 量子虚数作为量化量子态中内在非实相干性的关键资源度量，在弯曲时空背景下表现出非平凡的演化行为。本研究聚焦于静态施瓦茨希尔德黑洞的双体Dirac场约化态，旨在探讨霍金热辐射对三种主流虚数度量的调制。我们发现，相对熵虚数、几何虚数和虚数的稳健性在完全可达态中呈现出谷状径向分布，而交叉耦合和完全不可达态则呈现出相反的峰状趋势。进一步分析表明，哈特尔-霍金常数显著增强了虚数在两个区域的重分布效应，而事件视界半径的增加则削弱了这种重分布并平坦化了极值特征。这些发现为解码黑洞量子气氛的信息结构及霍金辐射的内在量子性质提供了新视角。
items.abstract: Quantum imaginarity, as a critical resource metric for quantifying intrinsic nonreal coherence encoded in quantum states, exhibits nontrivial evolutionary behaviors in curved spacetime backgrounds. This work focuses on bipartite Dirac field reduced states in the quantum atmosphere of a static Schwarzschild black hole, aiming to explore the modulation of three mainstream imaginarity measures by Hawking thermal radiation. We reveal that the relative-entropy imaginarity, the geometric imaginarity and robustness of imaginarity, the fully accessible state presents a valley-shaped radial profile with a local minimum inside the quantum atmosphere, while the cross-coupling and fully inaccessible states follow opposite peak-shaped trends. Further analysis demonstrates that the Hartle-Hawking constant significantly strengthens the redistribution effect of imaginarity across both regions, whereas an increase in the event horizon radius weakens such redistribution and flattens the extremum features. These findings offer a new perspective for decoding the information structure of black hole quantum atmospheres and the intrinsic quantum nature of Hawking radiation.
items.authors: Ruopu Sun, Xiaofen Huang

items.title: Adaptive Relational Learning on Multi-instance Quantum Data with Photonic Processors
items.title_zh: 多实例量子数据的自适应关系学习与光子处理器
items.summary_zh: 将多个量子态并行加载到量子机器学习（QML）模型中，可以解锁关键在于态之间的\emph{关系}而非单个态的信息的学习任务。我们提出了一种自适应关系学习框架，能够访问成对及高阶关系。该模型结合了通过SWAP或CYCLE测试进行的全局测量，以评估$n$态Bargmann不变量，并对每个输入态应用浅层可训练变换。我们在连续变量（CV）光子系统中演示了该方法，该系统自然提供对量子数据和必要计算操作的访问。我们解决了涉及隐藏关系检测、几何相位分类和在未知共享干扰下的传感任务。我们将自适应模型与基于连续变量经典阴影的非自适应“先测量”方法进行了基准测试，结果显示阴影估计的成本随着$n$的增加迅速增长，而我们的模型避免了这种依赖。对于$n=2$，我们在500次推理中实现了完美的测试准确率$A=1.0$，并在每个数据点上使用了100倍更少的测量次数，平均测试准确率比基于阴影的方法提高了$\Delta A=0.15$。我们的工作为自适应量子数据应用和传感开辟了新路径。
items.abstract: Loading multiple quantum states in parallel into a quantum machine learning (QML) model can unlock learning tasks where key information resides in the \emph{relations} between states rather than in individual states. We introduce an adaptive relational learning framework for such multi-instance quantum data that accesses pairwise and higher-order relations. Our model combines global measurements via SWAP or CYCLE tests for evaluating an $n$-state Bargmann invariant with shallow trainable transformations applied locally to each input state. We demonstrate the approach for continuous-variable (CV) photonic systems, which naturally provide access to quantum data and necessary computing operations. We solve tasks involving hidden relationship detection, geometric phase classification, and sensing in the presence of an unknown shared nuisance interaction. We benchmark the adaptive model against a non-adaptive ``measure-first'' approach based on continuous-variable classical shadows, and show that the cost of shadow estimation grows rapidly with $n$, while our model avoids this dependence. Already for $n=2$, we achieve perfect test accuracy $A=1.0$ with $500$ inference shots, improving a
items.authors: Marcin Jastrzebski, Shang Yu, Raj B. Patel, Oleksandr Kyriienko

items.title: Quantum Compiler Design for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: 容错量子计算的量子编译器设计
items.summary_zh: 可扩展的量子计算预计依赖于容错量子计算（FTQC），其中量子误差校正（QEC）足够抑制物理错误以支持可靠的逻辑操作。这要求量子编译超越通用电路优化，朝向编码感知和协议结构化的编译，涵盖整个容错量子计算机的堆栈。FTQC编译器必须将算法级操作降低到所选编码支持的逻辑门集，协调编码数据和辅助资源，在硬件约束下实现逻辑操作及重复的综合提取，并将结果测量流提供给实时解码。本文综述了QEC保护量子计算的编译器设计的全栈视角，组织现有工作为三个相互作用的层次：逻辑级QEC编译、物理级QEC实现和解码器运行时集成。我们回顾了表面码晶格手术编译器、超越表面码的代码手术框架及非Clifford操作的编译支持。
items.abstract: Scalable quantum computation is expected to rely on fault-tolerant quantum computation (FTQC), in which quantum error correction (QEC) suppresses physical errors sufficiently to support reliable logical operations. This requires quantum compilation to move beyond general-purpose circuit optimization toward encoding-aware and protocol-structured compilation across the full stack of fault-tolerant quantum computers. Beyond circuit synthesis and hardware mapping, an FTQC compiler must lower algorithm-level operations into the logical gate set supported by the chosen code, coordinate encoded data and ancilla resources, realize logical operations together with repeated syndrome extraction under hardware constraints, and provide the resulting measurement stream to real-time decoding. This survey presents a full-stack view of compiler design for QEC-protected quantum computation. We organize existing work into three interacting layers: logical-level QEC compilation, physical-level QEC realization, and decoder runtime integration. At the logical level, we review surface-code lattice-surgery compilers, beyond-surface-code code-surgery frameworks including emerging qLDPC approaches, and comp
items.authors: Chenghong Zhu, Jiahan Chen, Keming He, Hongshun Yao, Zhaohui Yang, Jin-Guo Liu, Anbang Wu, Xiaotong Ni, Xingsheng Luan, Zhuo Fu, Shenggen Zheng, Xin Wang

items.title: Regularized barycentric R\'enyi divergences
items.title_zh: 正则化重心R\'enyi散度研究
items.summary_zh: 重心R\'enyi散度在文献中被提出，作为定义多变量量子R\'enyi散度的标准Kubo-Ando构造的替代方法。它们通过变分表达式定义，并依赖于有限集合的量子相对熵$D^{q_x}$。当所有相对熵在CPTP映射下是单调时，相应的重心R\'enyi散度也是单调的；当所有相对熵是可加时，相应的重心R\'enyi散度在张量积下是次可加的。此前仅在所有$D^{q_x}$选择为Umegaki相对熵的情况下建立了可加性，这也是重心R\'enyi散度（称为最小散度）具有显式表达的唯一情况。本文通过证明对于任何选择的可加和单调量子相对熵，正则化重心R\'enyi散度在严格正输入下与最小重心R\'enyi散度相同，从而解决了可加性问题。这进一步表明，唯一的可加重心R\'enyi散度是最小散度。
items.abstract: Barycentric R\'enyi divergences were introduced in [Mosonyi, Bunth, Vrana, Linear Algebra and its Applications, 2024] as an alternative to standard Kubo-Ando constructions to define multivariate quantum R\'enyi divergences. They are defined via a variational expression and depend on a finite collection of quantum relative entropies $D^{q_x}$. When all the relative entropies are monotone under CPTP maps then so are the corresponding barycentric R\'enyi divergences, and when all the relative entropies are additive then the corresponding barycentric R\'enyi divergences are subadditive under tensor product. Additivity has only been established before for the case where all $D^{q_x}$ are chosen to be the Umegaki relative entropy, which is also the only case where the barycentric R\'enyi divergence (called the minimal one) admits an explicit expression. Here we settle the problem of additivity by showing that for any choice of additive and monotone quantum relative entropies, the regularized barycentric R\'enyi divergence coincides with the minimal barycentric R\'enyi divergence on strictly positive inputs. This in turn implies that the only additive barycentric R\'enyi divergence is the
items.authors: Mil\'an Mosonyi

items.title: Spectral Chaos from a Fluctuating Quantum Horizon
items.title_zh: 量子视界波动引发的谱混沌
items.summary_zh: 黑洞被推测为最大混沌系统，其量子谱预计展现普遍的随机矩阵相关性。然而，这一预期主要基于全息描述或引入随机性的多体模型，而非源于视界微观自由度的推导。在视界矩阵模型中，模糊球体支持高度简并的部分子态，其多重性解释了黑洞熵。我们表明，视界几何的量子波动提升了这种简并性，并生成一组单部分子的哈密顿量。该集合的算符结构和秩相关协方差由微观模型决定，而非由固定的冷却耦合决定。尽管存在结构化的协方差，结果谱展现出由反酉对称性类别决定的GOE、GUE和GSE统计，且相邻间隙统计随着矩阵大小的增加而趋于自平均。该模型实现了普遍的Pandey--Mehta正交到酉的交叉，交叉尺度由微观几何协方差决定。秩分辨方差分析显示，波动强度在微观截止之前广泛分布于张量秩，提供了观察到的Wigner--Dyson普遍性的微观基础。
items.abstract: Black holes are conjectured to be maximally chaotic, with their quantum spectra expected to exhibit universal random-matrix correlations. This expectation, however, has so far rested largely on holographic descriptions or on many-body models in which randomness is introduced rather than derived from the microscopic degrees of freedom of the horizon itself. In the horizon matrix model, the fuzzy sphere supports highly degenerate parton states whose multiplicity accounts for the black-hole entropy. We show that quantum fluctuations of the horizon geometry lift this degeneracy and generate an ensemble of one-parton Hamiltonians. Both the operator structure and the rank-dependent covariance of this ensemble are determined by the microscopic model, rather than fixed by quenched couplings. Despite this structured covariance, the resulting spectra exhibit GOE, GUE, and GSE statistics dictated by their antiunitary symmetry classes, with the adjacent-gap statistic becoming increasingly self-averaging with matrix size. The model also realizes the universal Pandey--Mehta orthogonal-to-unitary crossover, with the crossover scale determined by the microscopic geometric covariance. A rank-resolv
items.authors: Chong-Sun Chu

items.title: Critical quantum metrology in the output of an optical parametric oscillator
items.title_zh: 光学参量振荡器输出中的关键量子计量学
items.summary_zh: 许多量子传感器从连续发射的场中推断参数，但在存在未监测损失的情况下，难以确定可获取输出中存活的关键增强程度。本研究计算了用于腔体失谐估计的静态真空种子光学参量振荡器的全频率分辨输出量子费舍尔信息（QFI）。我们表明，对于任何固定的非零未监测损失，相关边带对的QFI在阈值附近随平均腔内光子数的平方增长，但仅在一个与该数成反比缩小的频谱窗口内；因此，频谱积分输出QFI速率渐近地仅线性缩放。我们识别出一个远失谐、近阈值的区域，在该区域中，单独监测的输出渐近地接近由损失施加的联合腔体-输出QFI的上限。我们进一步确定了最大化每个腔内光子输出QFI速率的操作点，并引入了一种频率分辨的同相策略，以最大化从单次记录中获得的费舍尔信息。我们的结果建立了关键增强与输出场中可获取的计量信息之间的操作联系，同时为耗散参量传感器的设计和读出提供了具体指导。
items.abstract: Many quantum sensors infer parameters from continuously emitted fields, yet in the presence of unmonitored loss, it is difficult to determine how much critical enhancement survives in the accessible output. In this work, we calculate the full frequency-resolved output quantum Fisher information (QFI) of a stationary vacuum-seeded optical parametric oscillator for cavity-detuning estimation. We show that, for any fixed nonzero unmonitored loss, the QFI of correlated sideband pairs grows quadratically with the mean intracavity photon number near threshold, but only within a spectral window that narrows inversely with that number; consequently, the spectrum-integrated output QFI rate scales asymptotically only linearly. We identify a far-detuned, near-threshold regime in which the monitored output alone asymptotically approaches the loss-imposed upper bound on the joint cavity-output QFI. We further determine the operating points that maximize the output QFI rate per intracavity photon and introduce a frequency-resolved homodyne strategy that maximizes the Fisher information obtainable from a single record. Our results establish an operational connection between critical enhancement a
items.authors: Polina Blinova, Kai Wang

items.title: Tailored coupled cluster method with sample-based quantum diagonalization: Application to titanium-based metallocene catalytic reactions for 1-hexene production
items.title_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化的定制耦合簇方法：应用于钛基茂金属催化反应生产1-己烯
items.summary_zh: 样本基础量子对角化（SQD）是一种用于电子结构计算的混合量子-经典方法。我们将SQD应用于钛基茂金属催化剂系统以生产1-己烯，在此过程中，必须在1 kcal/mol内预测自由能差以准确确定产物选择性。然而，目前量子计算机上可访问的活跃空间大小有限，导致显著的动态相关效应未被纳入活跃空间。为了解决这一挑战，我们将SQD与定制耦合簇（TCC）理论相结合。在SQD-TCC框架中，静态相关由SQD处理，而动态相关通过CCSD及其微扰三重扩展TCC(T)纳入。我们计算了控制1-己烯选择性的两个过渡态的相对能量。尽管单独使用SQD未能在可访问的活跃空间内收敛相对能量，但SQD-TCC和SQD-TCC(T)提供了合理收敛的结果。重要的是，SQD-TCC(T)获得的相对能量与相应的CCSD(T)结果相差超过1 kcal/mol，显示了该系统中静态相关的重要性及其对预测选择性的影响。虽然基于CASCI的TCC(T)计算对于小活跃空间是可行的，但当前系统需要显著更大的活跃空间。
items.abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) is a hybrid quantum-classical method for electronic-structure calculations. We applied SQD to a titanium-based metallocene catalyst system for 1-hexene production, where free-energy differences must be predicted within 1 kcal/mol to accurately determine product selectivity. However, currently accessible active spaces on quantum computers are limited in size, leaving significant dynamical correlation effects outside the active space. To address this challenge, we combined SQD with Tailored Coupled Cluster (TCC) theory. In this SQD-TCC framework, static correlation is treated by SQD, while dynamical correlation is incorporated through CCSD and its perturbative triples extension, TCC(T). We calculated the relative energies of two transition states governing 1-hexene selectivity. While SQD alone did not yield converged relative energies within practically accessible active spaces, SQD-TCC and SQD-TCC(T) provided reasonably converged results. Importantly, the relative energy obtained from SQD-TCC(T) differed by more than 1 kcal/mol from the corresponding CCSD(T) result, demonstrating the significance of static correlation in this system and its
items.authors: Tzu-Wei Lin, Hirotoshi Hirai, Kuan-Chieh Huang, Zih-Chao Hong, Hui-Zhong Zhuang, Tsung-Hui Li

items.title: In-Situ Quantum Optical Measurement for Colloidal Quantum Dots Confined in an Optical Trap
items.title_zh: 光学陷阱中胶体量子点的原位量子光学测量
items.summary_zh: 尽管原子阵列的光学操控已达到高精度和可扩展性，但基于溶液的人工原子如胶体量子点（CQDs）的稳定光学约束仍受限于弱捕获力和热波动。高强度捕获往往会损害这些发射体的量子特性，导致机械稳定性与光学完整性之间的显著权衡。为此，我们提出将CQDs封装在透明聚合物基体中，从而在不改变发射体本身的情况下增加有效相互作用体积和光学恢复力。该策略在标准实验条件下实现了稳定的空间约束，通过光致发光成像和轨迹追踪直接分辨位置波动。位置波动平均值低于20纳米，内在发射光谱和光致发光衰减动力学基本不受影响，光子相关测量确认了单光子发射的完全保留。这些发现为胶体量子发射体的受控约束和未来人工原子的量子光学操控提供了可靠的方法。
items.abstract: While optical manipulation of atomic arrays has reached a high degree of precision and scalability, the stable optical confinement of solution-based artificial atoms like colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) remains hindered by weak trapping forces and thermal fluctuations. High-intensity trapping often compromises the quantum properties of these emitters, creating a significant trade-off between mechanical stability and optical integrity. To overcome this, we propose encapsulating CQDs within a transparent polymer matrix, thereby increasing the effective interaction volume and optical restoring force without altering the emitters themselves. This strategy allows for stable spatial confinement under standard experimental conditions, as evidenced by the direct resolution of positional fluctuations through photoluminescence imaging and trajectory tracking. With averaged position fluctuations below 20 nm, the intrinsic emission spectra and photoluminescence decay dynamics remain largely unaffected, and photon-correlation measurements confirm the full preservation of single-photon emission. These findings establish a robust method for the controlled confinement of colloidal quantum emitters a
items.authors: Zhi-Bo Ni, Jiong-Zhao Li, Jia-Wang Yu, Xiao-Tian Cheng, Yun-Ran Wang, Dai-Bao Hou, Yan-Hua Liu, Wei Fang, Xing Lin, Chao-Yuan Jin

items.title: Quantum Brownian motion in a temperature gradient
items.title_zh: 温度梯度下的量子布朗运动
items.summary_zh: 当经典布朗粒子处于温度梯度时，会发生热泳现象，即粒子向环境的冷区迁移，这对非平衡自组织具有重要影响。本文研究了温度梯度对量子布朗运动的影响。我们采用了一种最近提出的广义系统-热库模型，假设存在连续的热浴场。我们的主要结果是，在费曼-弗农路径积分方法下获得了量子影响泛函。为了验证收敛性，我们推导了量子波包质心的有效朗之万方程，并表明在高温下与经典朗之万方程一致。无论是完全量子（低温）还是半经典（高温）极限，量子布朗运动中均显示出量子热泳的特征，这是一个尚未探索的效应。
items.abstract: When a classical Brownian particle is subjected to a temperature gradient it can undergo thermophoresis, i.e., the particle gets transported towards the colder regions of the environment, which bears relevant consequences to nonequilibrium self-organization. Here, we investigate how the quantum Brownian motion is affected by a temperature gradient. We employ a recently proposed generalized system-plus-reservoir model, where one assumes a continuum field of thermal baths. As our main result, we obtain the quantum influence functional, within the Feynmann-Vernon path integral approach. To test convergence, we derive an effective Langevin equation for the center of mass of the quantum wavepacket, and show that it coincides with the classical Langevin equation at high temperatures. Both the fully quantum (low temperatures) and the semiclassical (high temperature) limits show signatures of quantum thermophoresis in the quantum Brownian motion, a so far unexplored effect.
items.authors: Ricardo J. S. Afonso, Pedro V. Paraguass\'u, Thiago Werlang, Daniel Valente

items.title: Quantum Metrology via Adiabatic Control of Topological Edge States
items.title_zh: 通过绝热控制拓扑边缘态的量子测量
items.summary_zh: 基于临界性的量子传感利用系统参数在相变点附近的超灵敏响应。本研究揭示了拓扑相变在探测器准备为拓扑边缘态时所提供的两项测量优势。首先，发现拓扑带接触的阶数决定了测量灵敏度如何随系统大小缩放。因此，建议工程化具有高阶带接触的拓扑相变，其相关的量子费舍尔信息缩放为 $ \mathcal{F}_Q \sim L^{2p}$，其中 $L$ 为一维晶格大小，$p$ 为带接触的阶数。其次，在容纳简并边缘模态（如多个零模）的拓扑晶格中，准备一个 $N$ 粒子纠缠态并绝热调节系统至相变点，可以将量子纠缠扩展至宏观规模，得到 $\mathcal{F}_Q \sim N^2 L^{2p}$。因此，本研究为利用纠缠、大晶格尺寸和高阶带接触进行量子测量提供了基于拓扑相变的可能途径。
items.abstract: Criticality-based quantum sensing exploits hypersensitive response to system parameters near phase transition points. This work uncovers two metrological advantages offered by topological phase transitions when the probe is prepared as topological edge states. Firstly, the order of topological band touching is found to determine how the metrology sensitivity scales with the system size. Engineering a topological phase transition with higher-order band touching is hence advocated, with the associated quantum Fisher information scaling as $ \mathcal{F}_Q \sim L^{2p}$, with $L$ the lattice size in one dimension, and $p$ the order of band touching. Secondly, with a topological lattice accommodating degenerate edge modes (such as multiple zero modes), preparing an $N$-particle entangled state at the edge and then adiabatically tuning the system to the phase transition point grows quantum entanglement to macroscopic sizes, yielding $\mathcal{F}_Q \sim N^2 L^{2p}$. This work hence paves a possible topological phase transition-based route to harness entanglement, large lattice size, and high-order band touching for quantum metrology.
items.authors: Xingjian He, Aoqian Shi, Jianjun Liu, Jiangbin Gong

items.title: Long-lived local quantum coherences from hydrodynamic large deviations
items.title_zh: 来自流体动力学大偏差的长寿命局部量子相干性
items.summary_zh: 我们建立了一个框架，描述在一般的守恒电荷动力学下，不同电荷区间之间的量子相干性如何演化。该框架捕捉了量子相干性与流体动力学大偏差之间的非微扰相互作用，即低电荷熵的稀有“空洞”。在存活的条件下，量子相干性及其周围的空洞形成一个集体极化子样的物体。在一维情况下，即使在无限温度下，我们也表明相干性的寿命因其与空洞结合而呈参数增强。我们利用该框架探讨了关于守恒电荷的一般量子动力学的两个基本问题。首先，我们认为在弱噪声极限下，即使在不包含流体动力学慢模式的算符空间区间中，间隙Ruelle-Pollicott共振是缺失的；相反，所有区间的谱间隙在噪声强度下非微扰性地消失。其次，我们计算了动态单粒子格林函数的时空渐近行为，既在弱噪声区间也在无噪声情况下。在无噪声的情况下，我们发现空洞-相干极化子经历亚扩散，并计算了其指数。我们通过随机守恒电荷电路的微观推导以及张量网络模拟的数值证据支持了我们的普遍论点。
items.abstract: We develop a framework to describe how quantum coherences between distinct charge sectors evolve under generic charge-conserving dynamics. Our framework captures the nonperturbative interactions between quantum coherences and hydrodynamic large deviations---i.e., rare ``voids'' of low charge entropy. Conditional on surviving, the quantum coherence and its surrounding void form a collective polaron-like object. In one dimension, even at infinite temperature, we show that the lifetime of coherences is parametrically enhanced because they bind to voids. We use our framework to address two fundamental questions about generic quantum dynamics with a conserved charge. First, we argue that gapped Ruelle-Pollicott resonances are absent in the weak-noise limit, even in sectors of operator space that contain no hydrodynamic slow modes: instead, the spectral gap in all sectors vanishes nonperturbatively in the noise strength. Second, we compute the spacetime asymptotics of the dynamical single-particle Green's function, both in the weak-noise regime and in the absence of noise. In the noiseless case, we find that the void--coherence polaron undergoes subdiffusion, with an exponent we calculat
items.authors: Ewan McCulloch, J. Alexander Jacoby, Sarang Gopalakrishnan

items.title: Classical Active-Space Hybrid Quantum Subspace Expansion (CASH-QSE): Quantum Corrections without Remeasuring the Classically Calculable Energy
items.title_zh: 经典主动空间混合量子子空间扩展方法（CASH-QSE）
items.summary_zh: 变分量子特征求解器（VQE）准备的波函数可能包含大量经典可处理成分，但其能量贡献是在量子设备上采样的。通过将波函数表示为经典参考和单独准备的量子态的组合，可以在不进行量子采样的情况下评估参考能量。然而，这些成分之间的近线性依赖可能会放大测量误差并使能量估计不稳定。我们提出了经典主动空间混合量子子空间扩展（CASH-QSE），该方法在经典上保留完整主动空间自洽场（CASSCF）参考，并利用占据结构构建与参考及彼此正交的量子态。能量来自普通的厄米特特征值问题，无需重叠测量，同时相同的占据约束简化了测量算符。通过全配置相互作用指导成分选择，我们在H$_2$O和N$_2$的键伸展坐标下测试CASH-QSE，涵盖弱相关到强相关的范围。基准测试使用STO--3G基组和限制的cc-pVDZ轨道空间。CASH-QSE在限制最大完整测量电路至几百个全连接逻辑控制-NOT门的情况下，达到了化学精度。
items.abstract: The wave function prepared by a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) can contain a substantial classically tractable component, yet its energy contribution is sampled on the quantum device. Representing the wave function as a combination of a classical reference and separately prepared quantum states allows the reference energy to be evaluated without quantum sampling. However, near-linear dependence among these components can amplify measurement errors and destabilize the resulting energy estimate. We introduce Classical Active-Space Hybrid Quantum Subspace Expansion (CASH-QSE), which retains a complete-active-space self-consistent field (CASSCF) reference classically and uses occupation structure to construct quantum states exactly orthogonal to the reference and to one another. The energy follows from an ordinary Hermitian eigenvalue problem without overlap measurements, while the same occupation constraints simplify the measured operators. Using full configuration interaction to guide component selection, we test CASH-QSE along H$_2$O and N$_2$ bond-stretching coordinates spanning weakly to strongly correlated regimes. The benchmarks use STO--3G for both molecules and a restri
items.authors: Artur F. Izmaylov

items.title: Quantum Correlations of Neutrinos in the Kerr-Newman Space-time
items.title_zh: 克尔-纽曼时空中中微子的量子关联研究
items.summary_zh: 量子相位为引力与量子信息之间提供了联系，开辟了探索时空性质的新途径。本文研究了克尔-纽曼时空中中微子的量子关联（QCs），包括零角动量和非零角动量传播的情况。结果表明，在零角动量传播中，生存概率和QCs的振荡周期随着向内传播距离的增加而逐渐减小；而在向外传播中，增加质量$M$会延长$P_{\nu_e\rightarrow\nu_e}$、纠缠和非局域性的单一性振荡周期，而增加角动量$a$或电荷$Q$则会缩短它们。对于非零角动量传播，度量参数通过额外的双路径干涉项产生局部轮廓调制，而不仅仅是重新缩放振荡周期。此外，尽管变化范围不同，纠缠和相干性在两种传播情况下表现出高度一致的振荡行为。这些发现为基于中微子的相对论量子信息提供了全面理解。
items.abstract: Quantum phases provide a connection between gravitation and quantum information, which proposes a novel avenue to explore the properties of space-time. In this paper, we investigate the quantum correlations (QCs) of neutrinos in the Kerr--Newman space-time for both zero- and nonzero-angular-momentum propagation. The results show that, for zero-angular-momentum propagation, the oscillation periods of the survival probability and QCs progressively decrease with propagation distance in the inward direction. In the outward direction, increasing $M$ lengthens the oscillation periods of $P_{\nu_e\rightarrow\nu_e}$, entanglement, and the monogamy of nonlocality, whereas increasing angular momentum $a$ or charge $Q$ shortens them. For nonzero-angular-momentum propagation, the metric parameters also generate local profile modulations through additional two-path interference terms, rather than merely rescaling the oscillation period. Furthermore, we find that, despite differences in their variation ranges, entanglement and coherence exhibit highly consistent oscillation behaviors in both propagation cases. These findings provide a comprehensive understanding for the neutrino-based relativist
items.authors: Ze-Wen Li, Shu-Jun Rong

items.title: How quantum is quantum geometry?
items.title_zh: 量子几何的量子性探讨
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了量子几何张量——贝里曲率与量子度量的结合——在多个可观测量中的作用，包括异常霍尔效应和平坦带的超流体权重。我们探讨了哪些可观测量实际上需要量子力学。为此，我们研究了一个纯经典系统：一个携带经典磁矩$\boldsymbol{\ell}$的点粒子，在动量依赖的磁场$\mathbf{B}(\mathbf{p})$中进动。在哈密顿经典力学框架下，$\boldsymbol{\ell}$沿场的分量重现了贝里曲率现象，而其进动的横向分量则重现了量子度量现象。粒子获得了位置扩展，其二阶矩为度量，产生了轨道磁矩，并且最引人注目的是，由位置依赖的力生成的惯性质量，使得在名义上无色散的系统中出现了非零的德鲁德权重。
items.abstract: The quantum geometric tensor - the Berry curvature together with the quantum metric - now underlies a long list of observables, from the anomalous Hall effect to the superfluid weight of a flat band. We ask which of these observables actually require quantum mechanics. To answer this question, we study a purely classical system: a point particle carrying a classical magnetic moment $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ that precesses in a momentum-dependent magnetic field $\mathbf{B}(\mathbf{p})$. Within Hamiltonian classical mechanics, the component of $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ along the field reproduces the Berry-curvature phenomena, while its precessing transverse component reproduces the quantum-metric phenomena. The particle acquires a position spread whose second moment is the metric, an orbital magnetic moment, and - most strikingly - an inertial mass generated by a position-dependent force, and with it a nonzero Drude weight in a system that is nominally dispersionless.
items.authors: Ady Stern, Felix von Oppen

items.title: Renyi's Relative Entropy Lyapunov Functional for Convergence to Invariant Measure in Dissipative Stochastic Hamiltonian Systems
items.title_zh: Renyi相对熵Lyapunov泛函在耗散随机哈密顿系统中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本文研究由位置的常微分方程和动量的伊藤随机微分方程支配的多变量随机哈密顿系统。动量动力学涉及保守和非保守力，包括朗之万粘性阻尼和作为随机力的维纳过程。该设置允许旋转自由度、非二次势能函数以及位置依赖的质量、扩散和阻尼矩阵。除了建模受随机力影响的非线性物理动力学外，系统还受到随机优化视角的启发，通过收敛到有利于较小势能值的玻尔兹曼平衡测度来寻找势能的全局最小值。在某些正则性条件下，我们证明了与不变测度相关的$\chi^2$散度或Renyi二阶相对熵具有非正的时间导数，从而为该收敛提供了Lyapunov泛函候选。然而，该导数在某些时刻消失，这与条件于位置的动量概率分布的行为有关，并与一类辅助量子谐振子哈密顿量相关。
items.abstract: This paper is concerned with multivariable stochastic Hamiltonian systems governed by an ordinary differential equation for the position and an Ito stochastic differential equation for the momentum. The momentum dynamics involve both conservative and nonconservative forcing including Langevin viscous damping and the Wiener process as a random force. The setting allows for rotational degrees of freedom, a non-quadratic potential energy function and position-dependent mass, diffusion and damping matrices. In addition to modelling nonlinear physical dynamics subject to random forcing, the system is motivated by a stochastic optimisation viewpoint, where the search for global minima of the potential energy (for example, using the gradient descent) is carried out through convergence to a Boltzmann equilibrium measure which favours smaller values of this function. Under certain regularity conditions, we show that the $\chi^2$-divergence or, equivalently, Renyi's second-order relative entropy with respect to the invariant measure has a nonpositive time derivative and thus provides a Lyapunov functional candidate for this convergence. However, this derivative vanishes at some moments of ti
items.authors: Igor G. Vladimirov

items.title: Polylogarithmic characterizations of the reduced coaction Lie algebra and the double shuffle Lie algebra, and their relation to the Kashiwara--Vergne Lie algebra
items.title_zh: 减少共作用李代数与双洗牌李代数的多对数特征及其与Kashiwara--Vergne李代数的关系
items.summary_zh: 减少共作用李代数 $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ 通过一个反对称条件和涉及减少共作用的代数方程定义，该方程是项链共括的非循环细化。双洗牌李代数 $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ 编码了在研究形式多重ζ值时的正则化双洗牌关系，而Kashiwara--Vergne李代数 $\mathfrak{krv}_2$ 则出现在Kashiwara--Vergne猜想的研究中。我们的主要结果是通过对同一对象的不同强度的消失条件来描述 $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ 和 $\mathfrak{rc}_0$：Drinfeld五边形方程的缺陷；$\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ 由相关的双变量多对数的消失特征化，而 $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ 则由其第二个指标深度为1的多对数的消失特征化。我们还建立了这三个李代数之间的显式关系。首先，$\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ 的反对称元素嵌入到 $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ 中。其次，在额外条件下，我们构造了从 $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ 到 $\mathfrak{krv}_2$ 的单射李代数同态。
items.abstract: The reduced coaction Lie algebra $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ is defined by a skew-symmetric condition together with an algebraic equation involving the reduced coaction, a non-cyclic refinement of the necklace cobracket. The double shuffle Lie algebra $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ encodes the regularized double shuffle relations in the study of formal multiple zeta values, while the Kashiwara--Vergne Lie algebra $\mathfrak{krv}_2$ arose in the study of the Kashiwara--Vergne conjecture. Our main result is the description of $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ and $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ by vanishing conditions of different strengths on the same object: the defect of Drinfeld's pentagon equation; $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ is characterised by the vanishing of the associated two-variable multiple polylogarithms, and $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ by the vanishing of those whose second index has depth $1$. We also establish explicit relations among these three Lie algebras. First, the skew-symmetric elements of $\mathfrak{dmr}_0$ embed into $\mathfrak{rc}_0$. Second, under an additional condition, we construct an injective Lie algebra morphism from $\mathfrak{rc}_0$ to $\mathfrak{krv}_2$.
items.authors: Megan Howarth, Muze Ren

items.title: Coherent and robust Bayesian inference under informative sampling via sample-level weight models
items.title_zh: 基于信息抽样的贝叶斯推断方法研究
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了两种互补的贝叶斯推断方法，以应对信息抽样下的分析推断问题。第一种方法通过建模设计权重在研究变量下的样本级分布，构建一致的似然函数，并利用Sverchkov和Pfeffermann（2004）的恒等式恢复条件包含概率；该方法是最近提出的条件似然估计量的贝叶斯对应，能够在正确指定的样本级联合模型下达到模型效率界限，但在其他情况下可能存在偏差。第二种方法则将相同的权重模型作为输入，应用于设计加权得分的Neyman正交化类，并采用损失-似然自助法；在泊松抽样下，所得到的可信区间渐近正确，后验分布在权重模型错误指定时仍然以真实值为中心，尽管工作模型仍会影响一阶方差。对总体包含概率进行beta回归，诱导beta prime样本级权重分布，作为参数默认。第二种方法的数据自适应实现通过设计加权Gamma/对数链接回归估计有效因子，并在联合一步损失-似然自助法中使用，验证其有效性无需额外假设。
items.abstract: We develop two complementary Bayesian procedures for analytic inference under informative sampling. The first constructs a coherent likelihood by modeling the sample-level distribution of the design weight given the study variable and recovering the conditional inclusion probability through the identity of Sverchkov and Pfeffermann (2004); it is the Bayesian counterpart of a recently proposed conditional-likelihood estimator, attains the model-based efficiency bound under the correctly specified sample-level joint model, and can be biased otherwise. The second uses the same weight model only as input to a Neyman-orthogonalized analog of the design-weighted score and applies the loss-likelihood bootstrap; the resulting credible intervals are asymptotically sandwich-correct under Poisson sampling, and the posterior remains centered at the truth under misspecification of the weight model, although the working model can still affect the first-order variance. A beta regression on the population-level inclusion probability, inducing a beta prime sample-level weight distribution, serves as the parametric default. items.authors: Kosuke Morikawa, Jae Kwang Kim, Won Chang

items.title: A flexible framework for treatment effect inference in longitudinal clinical studies with skewed outcomes
items.title_zh: 适用于偏态结果的纵向临床研究治疗效应推断框架
items.summary_zh: 在临床试验中，纵向连续结果通常使用混合模型重复测量（MMRM）进行分析，假设结果服从正态分布。然而，许多临床结果呈偏态，使得基于均值的治疗效应难以解释，并可能降低统计效率。Box-Cox MMRM（BCMMRM）方法通过逆变换来推断模型基础的中位数差异，适应了偏态分布。然而，BCMMRM通常假设治疗组和时间点之间具有共同的变换参数。当组间分布形状不同或随时间演变时，这一假设可能导致治疗效应偏倚。此外，当治疗不仅影响中心趋势，还影响分布形状或尾部行为时，单一位置摘要（如中位数）可能无法充分表征治疗效应。我们提出了Box-Cox多元回归（BCMVR）框架，适用于具有偏态结果的纵向数据。BCMVR通过允许变换参数在组和时间点之间变化，放宽了这一限制。该框架支持基于可解释摘要的推断，包括中位数差异和基于概率的治疗效应，量化随机选择的患者在一组中比另一组有更好结果的概率。
items.abstract: Longitudinal continuous outcomes in clinical trials are commonly analyzed using mixed models for repeated measures (MMRM) under normality assumptions. However, many clinical outcomes are skewed, making mean-based treatment effects difficult to interpret and potentially reducing statistical efficiency. The Box--Cox MMRM (BCMMRM) approach accommodates skewness by enabling inference on model-based median differences via inverse transformation. However, BCMMRM typically assumes a common transformation parameter across treatment groups and time points. When distributional shapes differ between groups or evolve over time, this assumption may lead to biased treatment effect. Furthermore, when treatment affects not only central tendency but also distributional shape or tail behavior, treatment effects may not be adequately characterized by a single location summary such as the median. We propose the Box--Cox multivariate regression (BCMVR) framework for longitudinal data with skewed outcomes. BCMVR relaxes this restriction by allowing transformation parameters to vary across groups and time points. items.authors: Kazushi Maruo, Ryota Ishii, Yusuke Yamaguchi, Toshio Shimokawa, Tomoyuki Sugimoto, Masahiko Gosho

items.title: Graph-Enabled Efficient Federated Bayesian Modeling
items.title_zh: 图形支持的高效联邦贝叶斯建模
items.summary_zh: 联邦贝叶斯建模需要在分布式数据持有者之间结合证据，同时保持后验不确定性和本地数据的去中心化。我们提出了联邦潜在图MCMC（FLaG-MCMC），这是一个用于顺序后验转移的框架，其中累积的后验信息由一组Monte Carlo样本表示。FLaG-MCMC构建了一个捕捉后验储备几何形状的图，并使用图形支持的提议，其每次迭代的成本与储备大小无关。每个数据持有者使用其本地似然更新继承的后验，并返回更新后的储备以供后续推断。我们在两个健康科学场景中应用FLaG-MCMC。利用GLOBEM的移动和可穿戴设备数据，我们研究了抑郁状态与行为模式之间的关联，同时在参与者之间顺序累积后验信息。FLaG-MCMC准确重建了相应的合并贝叶斯后验，同时紧密跟踪这些关联中不断变化的后验位置和不确定性。我们还进行了一个模拟研究，旨在通过贝叶斯证据综合研究阿片类药物使用障碍的流行率，将来自俄亥俄州的后验信息转移到后续的纽约分析中。
items.abstract: Federated Bayesian modeling requires combining evidence across distributed data holders while preserving posterior uncertainty and keeping local data decentralized. We propose Federated Latent Graph MCMC (FLaG-MCMC), a framework for sequential posterior transfer in which accumulated posterior information is represented by a reservoir of Monte Carlo samples. FLaG-MCMC constructs a graph that captures the geometry of the posterior reservoir and uses graph-enabled proposals whose per-iteration cost is independent of the reservoir size. Each data holder updates the inherited posterior using its local likelihood and returns an updated reservoir for subsequent inference. We apply FLaG-MCMC in two health science settings. Using mobile and wearable device data from GLOBEM, we investigate associations between depression status and behavioral patterns while sequentially accumulating posterior information across participants. FLaG-MCMC accurately reconstructs the corresponding pooled Bayesian posterior while closely tracking evolving posterior location and uncertainty in these associations. items.authors: Chenyang Zhong, Shouxuan Ji, Tian Zheng

items.title: Discovering Kinetically Significant Reaction Mechanisms Beyond Chemical Intuition in Condensed-Phase Radiolysis
items.title_zh: 超越化学直觉的凝聚相辐射解离反应机制发现
items.summary_zh: 许多重要的化学系统涉及复杂的反应机制，难以通过实验表征或化学直觉预测。现有的机制发现计算方法通常仅通过热力学可行性评估路径的重要性，无法提供时间依赖的动力学或指导空间非均匀性的建模。本文描述了一种集成工作流程，能够在不预设反应机制的情况下发现复杂反应机制，并将分子尺度的反应性与时空可观测量连接起来。该工作流程结合了高通量密度泛函理论（DFT）、自动化反应网络构建与化学合理性筛选、随机路径采样以识别可能发生的反应，以及空间分辨的反应-扩散动力学模拟，明确跟踪物种在时间和空间中的变化。我们将该工作流程应用于极紫外（EUV）有机聚合物薄膜光刻胶的辐射化学，展示了其在高复杂性系统中的有效性。
items.abstract: Many important chemical systems, from radiation-driven processes to condensed-phase photochemistry, involve reaction mechanisms that are so complex it is a challenge to characterize them experimentally or predict them from chemical intuition. Existing computational approaches to mechanism discovery typically assess pathway importance through thermodynamic favorability alone, which does not provide time-dependent kinetics or inform how to model spatial inhomogeneities. Here we describe an integrated workflow that discovers complex reaction mechanisms without prescribing them and connects molecular-scale reactivity to spatiotemporal observables. The workflow combines high-throughput DFT, automated reaction network construction with chemical plausibility filtering, stochastic pathway sampling to identify reactions which are likely to occur, and spatially resolved reaction-diffusion kinetics simulations with explicit tracking of species in space and time. To demonstrate the workflow on a system of high complexity, we apply it to radiolytic chemistry in an extreme ultraviolet (EUV) organic polymer thin film photoresist, where a single 92 eV photon initiates cascades of radical ions, fra
items.authors: Nitesh Kumar, Jacob R. Milton, Eric Sivonxay, Brett A. Helms, Frances A. Houle, Samuel M. Blau

items.title: QALPA: Property-guided diffusion modeling for efficient exploration of chemical spaces of flexible molecules
items.title_zh: QALPA：基于性质引导的扩散建模高效探索柔性分子化学空间
items.summary_zh: 柔性分子的化学空间探索仍然面临挑战，原因在于可能的化合物和构象数量庞大，以及3D生成模型在处理更大更复杂分子时的成本增加和泛化能力有限。本文介绍了QALPA（“量子感知学习用于性质空间增强”），一种结合E(3)等变扩散模型、主动学习和高效量子力学方法的性质引导生成框架，能够迭代探索目标量子力学性质流形。通过将生成与基于物理的评估相结合，QALPA提高了在化学空间稀疏区域的分子采样和模型可靠性。结果表明，在涵盖小型（QM7-X）和大型（Aquamarine）类药物化合物的互补量子力学数据集上训练，能够在广泛的尺寸范围内实现准确的分子生成，并提高了复杂性质流形的可迁移性。作为概念验证，QALPA与机器学习增强的紧束缚方法EquiDTB结合，能够高效增强alloQM数据集，该数据集包含6,253个变构药物分子的构象。
items.abstract: Exploring the chemical space of flexible molecules remains challenging because the vast number of possible compounds and conformations, together with the increasing cost and limited generalization of 3D generative models for larger and more complex molecules, restrict access to unexplored chemistry. Here, we introduce QALPA ("Quantum-Aware Learning for Property-space Augmentation"), a property-guided generative framework that combines an E(3)-equivariant diffusion model with active learning and efficient quantum-mechanical (QM) methods to iteratively explore targeted QM property manifolds. By coupling generation with physics-based evaluation, QALPA improves molecular sampling and model reliability in sparsely populated regions of chemical space. Our results show that training on complementary QM datasets spanning both small (QM7-X) and large (Aquamarine) drug-like compounds enables accurate molecular generation across a broad size range, improving transferability beyond the training distribution for complex property manifolds involving both extensive and intensive properties. items.authors: Michael Hanna, Julian Cremer, Zekiye Erarslan, Leonardo Medrano Sandonas

items.title: Local energetic coupling enhances the expressivity of chemical computation
items.title_zh: 局部能量耦合增强化学计算的表现力
items.summary_zh: 活系统通过将环境信号映射到特定的内部化学状态来进行化学计算。尽管分子编程已有所进展，但尚不清楚哪些物理化学特征控制化学系统的计算表现力。本文逆向设计了热力学一致的化学反应网络，其稳态响应环境输入以计算目标非线性函数。通过隐式微分，我们直接训练自由能景观：标准化学势、过渡态能量和热力驱动。通过基本的连接和断裂步骤生成的越来越大网络能够拟合越来越复杂的非单调多项式函数，表现力与网络规模呈对数关系，主要由反应数量预测。训练各个能量参数类别表明，能够打破详细平衡的内部热力驱动主导了可训练性，只有成对的参数类别才能实现相当的性能。这些结果表明，非平衡驱动是化学反应网络中稳态计算表现力最有效的单一资源。
items.abstract: Living systems compute with chemistry by mapping environmental signals onto specific internal chemical states. Despite recent advances in molecular programming, it remains unclear which physicochemical features control the computational expressivity of chemical systems. Here we inverse-design thermodynamically consistent chemical reaction networks whose steady-state response to an environmental input computes a target nonlinear function. Using implicit differentiation we train the free-energy landscape directly: standard chemical potentials, transition-state energies and thermodynamic drives. Increasingly large networks generated by elementary ligation and cleavage steps fit increasingly complex nonmonotonic polynomial functions, with expressivity scaling logarithmically with network size, predicted primarily by the number of reactions. Training individual energetic parameter classes reveals that internal thermodynamic drives, capable of breaking detailed balance, dominate trainability, with comparable performances achieved only by pairs of parameter classes. These results identify nonequilibrium drive as the most effective single resource for steady-state computational expressivit
items.authors: Marco Tuccio, Jason W. Rocks, Joshua E. Goldford

items.title: Electric-Field-Switchable Altermagnetism via Ligand Rotation in a d0 Metal-Organic Framework
items.title_zh: 电场可调的配体旋转引发的交替磁性研究
items.summary_zh: 交替磁性结合了消失的净磁化和动量依赖的自旋分裂。尽管在金属有机框架（MOFs）中已识别出交替磁性特征，但非侵入性可逆控制仍然具有挑战性。本文报告了一种在柔性d0-MOF中实现电场可调交替磁性的方法，其中极性取代基将外部电场与配体旋转耦合。在平面基态下，pz轨道介导180度的配体-金属-配体超交换（J2），稳定反铁磁序。配体的面外旋转激活px/py轨道，增强90度路径（J1），并逆转J1/J2竞争。反铁磁到交替磁性交叉发生在约34度，90度时自旋分裂为84 meV。90度交替磁性状态在电场作用下开启，去除电场后关闭，因受限旋转景观单调减少回0度，实现无能量障碍的反铁磁状态放松和可逆开关操作。300 K下的从头算分子动力学显示，仅靠热波动无法同步配体旋转。极性取代基提供了电场控制所需的耦合；对于氟化取代基，临界电场约为0.22 V/Å，接近场效应器件的水平。此研究确立了配体p轨道在交替磁性中的重要性。
items.abstract: Altermagnetism combines vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting. While altermagnetic signatures have been identified in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), non-invasive reversible control remains challenging. Here we report a route to electric-field-switchable altermagnetism in a flexible d0-MOF, in which polar substituents couple the external field to ligand rotation. In the planar ground state, pz orbitals mediate 180-degree ligand-metal-ligand superexchange (J2), stabilizing antiferromagnetic order. Rotating ligands out of plane activates px/py orbitals, enhances 90-degree pathways (J1), and reverses J1/J2 competition. The antiferromagnetic-to-altermagnetic crossover occurs at approx. 34 degrees, with spin splitting of 84 meV at 90 degrees. The 90-degree altermagnetic state is switched on by the electric field and switched off upon field removal, as the constrained-rotation landscape decreases monotonically back toward 0 degrees, enabling barrierless relaxation to the antiferromagnetic state and reversible on/off operation. items.authors: Hongjing Wang, Xiuling Li, Xiaojun Wu

items.title: A common warming-dependent decline emerges from divergent projections of tropical cyclone frequency
items.title_zh: 热带气旋频率的普遍降温依赖性下降现象
items.summary_zh: 全球热带气旋频率对气候变暖的响应仍不确定，预测结果存在增加和减少的差异。本文利用14个耦合模型比较项目第六阶段（CMIP6）模型，在中等和高排放情景下驱动环境依赖的概率热带气旋模型。最初的全球变化较弱，随着世纪末的临近，出现明显下降，主要由南半球的下降加剧和北半球的增加减弱驱动，且在高排放下更为显著。反事实分解表明，这一更强的下降并非由单一环境预测因子解释，而是由绝对涡度、垂直风切变、相对湿度和潜在强度之间的负非线性相互作用所致。在28个模型情景预测中，频率趋势与全球变暖呈线性关系；在2摄氏度的条件下，95%置信区间从[-20.6%, +9.9%]缩小至[-8.2%, -2.1%]。这些结果通过共同的温暖依赖性下降现象调和了不同的预测。
items.abstract: How global tropical cyclone frequency will respond to climate warming remains uncertain, with projections spanning both increases and decreases. Here we drive an environment-dependent probabilistic tropical cyclone model with 14 Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) models under intermediate- and high-emissions scenarios. Initially weak global changes evolve into a clearer late-century decline, driven by a strengthening Southern Hemisphere decline and a diminishing Northern Hemisphere increase, and stronger under higher emissions. Counterfactual decomposition shows that this stronger decline is not explained by individual environmental predictors, whose contributions largely offset, but by negative nonlinear interactions among absolute vorticity, vertical wind shear, relative humidity and potential intensity. Across 28 model-scenario projections the frequency trend scales linearly with global warming; conditioning on 2 degrees C narrows the 95% confidence interval from [-20.6%, +9.9%] to [-8.2%, -2.1%]. These results reconcile divergent projections through a common warming-dependent decline.
items.authors: Cong Gao, Ning Lin

items.title: Reductive Electrophotocatalysis: Fundamentals, Mechanistic Frameworks, and Synthetic Applications
items.title_zh: 还原性电光催化：基础、机制框架与合成应用
items.summary_zh: 还原性电光催化作为一种强大的合成平台，将电化学与光还原催化结合，能够在温和条件下实现极强的还原电位。通过顺序的电化学还原和光激发，生成高度反应性的激发态自由基离子，能够激活传统催化方法难以处理的底物。因此，该方法开启了一系列以往无法实现的还原转化。本文综述了还原性电光催化的基本原理、催化剂设计策略及机制方面，特别强调了关于底物激活的还原物种身份的争论。文中重点讨论了四种当前文献中提出的机制路径：(i) 直接电子转移自激发光催化剂自由基阴离子，(ii) 光催化剂自由基阴离子与底物的预结合促进底物激活，(iii) 通过溶剂化电子或相关电子池机制的还原，(iv) 催化剂衍生或修饰的光催化物种介导的还原。此外，还介绍了代表性的电光催化剂系统及其在还原反应中的应用。
items.abstract: Reductive electrophotocatalysis has emerged as a powerful synthetic platform that combines electrochemistry and photoredox catalysis to achieve exceptionally strong reduction potentials under mild conditions. Through sequential electrochemical reduction and photoexcitation, highly reactive excited-state radical ions are generated, which can activate challenging substrates that are often difficult to address with conventional catalytic methods. Consequently, this approach has unlocked a broad range of previously unattainable reductive transformations. This review seeks to provide a comprehensive overview of the fundamental principles, catalyst design strategies, and mechanistic aspects of reductive electrophotocatalysis, with particular emphasis on the ongoing debate surrounding the identity of the reducing species responsible for substrate activation. items.title: Rhodium-Catalyzed Stereoselective Access to Polysubstituted Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes Bearing Quaternary Bridge Carbons
items.title_zh: 铑催化的立体选择性多取代双环[1.1.0]丁烷合成研究
items.summary_zh: 双环[1.1.0]丁烷（BCBs）是一类独特的应变碳环，因其独特的反应性而成为合成和药物化学中的重要构建块。尽管在多取代BCBs的制备方面已有所进展，但桥接取代衍生物的立体选择性合成仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在涉及四元立体中心时。本文报道了一种铑催化的[2+1]环加成反应，利用环丙烯和二氮化合物直接合成立体定义的桥接取代BCBs。该反应在广泛的底物范围内实现了完全的非对映体控制，并能够构建具有多达四个立体中心的密集功能化框架。此外，该方法还可扩展至富含对映体的环丙烯，提供具有完全对映特异性的光学活性BCBs。DFT计算结果与立体化学结果一致，所得到的BCBs的合成应用通过转化为融合的三环结构及多取代的环丁烯和环丁烷得以验证。
items.abstract: Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (BCBs) are unique strained carbocycles that have emerged as attractive buildingblocks in synthetic and medicinal chemistry owing to their unique reactivity. Despite recent advances in the preparation of polysubstituted BCBs, the stereoselective synthesis of bridge-substituted derivatives remains a significant challenge, particularly when quaternary stereocenters are involved at these positions. Herein, we report a rhodium-catalyzed [2+1] cycloaddition of cyclopropenes and diazo compounds that provides direct access to stereodefined bridge-substituted BCBs. The reaction proceeds with complete diastereocontrol across a broad range of substrates and enables the construction of densely functionalized frameworks bearing up to four stereocenters. The methodology can also be extended to enantioenriched cyclopropenes, providing optically active BCBs with complete enantiospecificity. DFT calculations are consistent with the stereochemical outcome and the synthetic utility of the resulting BCBs is demonstrated by transformations leading to fused tricyclic architectures and polysubstituted cyclobutenes and cyclobutanes.
items.authors: Guillermo Morales-Ortega, Estíbaliz Merino, R. Martín Romero, Javier Carreras

items.title: The nature of metal-ligand interactions in different metalloporphyrin · · · hydrogen cyanide complexes: Limitations of DFT exchange-correlation functionals.
items.title_zh: 不同金属卟啉与氢氰酸复合物中金属-配体相互作用的性质
items.summary_zh: 本文计算了不同金属卟啉（MP，M = Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn）与氢氰酸复合物的弱分子间相互作用能，采用了多种基于波函数的理论水平（MP2、CCSD和CCSD(T)）。在所有三个理论水平上应用了基于域的局部对自然轨道（DLPNO）方法，并在MP2理论中考虑了自旋分量和自旋相反缩放框架。通过局部能量分解（LED）方法，将分子间相互作用能分解为电静力、交换、色散、非色散和微扰三重项等物理意义明确的成分。比较了使用密度泛函理论（DFT）获得的势能曲线，发现DFT泛函的表现高度异质。在色散主导的Ni、Zn和Mg相互作用中，DFT泛函低估了CCSD和CCSD(T)方法获得的势能曲线，而在色散较小的Fe和Cr情况下，DFT泛函则高估了相应的结果。
items.abstract: The weak intermolecular interaction energies of various metalloporphyrin (MP, M = Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn) and hydrogen cyanide complexes along the axial metal-ligand bond have been computed using different wavefunction-based theoretical level (MP2, CCSD and CCSD(T)). The domain-based local pair natural orbital (DLPNO) method was applied at all three theoretical levels, as well as in the case of the MP2 theory, the spin-component and spin-opposite scaled frameworks were also taken into account. The nature of the interactions was analyzed by decomposing the intermolecular interaction energy into physically meaningful components (Electrostatic, Exchange, Dispersion, Non-dispersion and Perturbative triple) using the local energy decomposition (LED) method in the framework of the CCSD(T) theory. The potential energy curves were also compared with the results obtained using density functional theory ((DFT), considering sets of widely used exchange-correlation (XC) functionals, as well as the r2SCAN functional family. The behavior of DFT functionals is highly heterogeneous. For dispersion-dominant Ni, Zn and Mg cases of the interaction, the functionals underestimate the potential energy curve
items.authors: Alex-Adrian Farcaş, Attila Bende

items.title: Trapacycle: A Chiral Rhombic Macrocycle
items.title_zh: Trapacycle：一种手性菱形大环化合物
items.summary_zh: 大环化合物的新类别的开发是超分子化学中的一个主要问题。本文报道了手性菱形大环寡酰亚胺1（称为trapacycles）的合成、光谱特性和宿主-客体功能。Trapacycle (+)-1可通过9,10-二氢-9,10-乙烯基蒽基四羧酸二酐2与(1S,2S)-环己烷-1,2-二胺D-酒石酸盐的缩合反应合成。其对映体(–)-1则可通过类似的方法从2和(1R,2R)-环己烷-1,2-二胺L-酒石酸盐获得。1的固态晶体结构显示出内在的菱形孔和外在孔，这些孔能够容纳客体溶剂分子。此外，1在固态下吸附了碘蒸气，并在有机溶剂中容纳了萘分子。
items.abstract: The development of a new class of macrocycles is a primary issue in supramolecular chemistry. We here report the synthesis, spectroscopic properties, and host-guest functions of chiral, rhombus-shaped macrocyclic oligoimides 1, denoted as trapacycles. Trapacycle (+)-1 could be readily synthesized by the condensation of 9,10-dihydro-9,10-ethanoanthracenebased tetracarboxylic dianhydride 2 with (1S,2S)-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine D-tartrate. Its enantiomer (–)-1 could be analogously accessed from 2 and (1R,2R)-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine L-tartrate. The solid-state crystalline structures of 1 showed intrinsic rhombic shape pores and extrinsic pores. These pores were found to accommodate guest solvent molecules. Furthermore, 1 adsorbed iodine vapor in the solid state and accommodated naphthalenes in organic solvents.
items.authors: Sei Murayama, Hiroshi Naka

items.title: Towards an Accurate Atomistic Description of Procaine Crystals: Force Field Development and MD Simulation of Solid-to-Liquid Phase Transitions
items.title_zh: 精确描述普鲁卡因晶体的原子级模型：力场开发与相变MD模拟
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过分子动力学（MD）模拟，探讨了普鲁卡因晶体在23至373 K温度范围内的热稳定性、结构演变和熔化机制。考虑了两种不同的计算设置：在周期性边界条件下的块体晶体模型（系统I，600个分子）和真空中的孤立纳米晶体（系统II，1188个分子）。结果显示，两种系统在23至313 K范围内保持良好的长程位置有序性，323至333 K之间出现增强旋转自由度的塑性晶态。在343 K时，发生表面引发的异质相变，形成各向同性熔体，接近普鲁卡因游离碱的实验熔点334-337 K。分析表明，在333-343 K时，熔化动力学极为缓慢，晶体核心在500 ns内持续存在超过300 ns。研究发现，晶格的热崩溃与普鲁卡因分子间氢键三维网络的断裂密切相关。
items.abstract: Rational design of crystalline materials is crucial for material science and pharmaceutical development, requiring molecular modeling as a powerful complementary tool. This study employs molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the thermal stability, structural evolution, and melting mechanisms of crystalline procaine base across a temperature range of 23 to 373 K. To evaluate potential finite-size and boundary effects, two distinct computational setups were considered: a bulk crystal model under periodic boundary conditions (System I, 600 molecules) and an isolated nanocrystal in vacuum (System II, 1188 molecules). Both systems demonstrate well-preserved long-range positional ordering from 23 to 313 K, followed by the appearance of a plastic crystalline state with enhanced rotational freedom between 323 and 333 K. At 343 K, a heterogeneous, surface-initiated phase transition to an isotropic melt occurs, which closely matches the experimental melting point of procaine free-base of 334-337 K.
