items.authors: Viktoriia O. Chukhlib, Viktor V. Tokariev, Alexander Kyrychenko

items.title: SimSJSAlert: A Similarity-Augmented Multi-View Learning Framework with Scaffold Alerts for Drug-Induced Stevens-Johnson Syndrome Risk Assessment
items.title_zh: SimSJSAlert：用于药物诱导Stevens-Johnson综合征风险评估的多视角学习框架
items.summary_zh: Stevens-Johnson综合征（SJS）是一种罕见且危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍然具有挑战性。本研究开发了一种可解释的定量结构-毒性关系（QSTR）框架，用于SJS预测，采用多视角学习框架，包含21种分子表征，如分子描述符、指纹、基于变换器的嵌入和分子相似性表征。模型开发和评估遵循OECD QSAR验证原则，结合了支架感知验证、对药物监测负信号化合物的外部评估，以及通过将SHAP与Bemis-Murcko支架富集分析相结合的结构解释。该框架在灵敏度和特异性方面表现稳健，分子相似性持续改善了与SJS相关化合物的识别。此外，基于共识预测和支架优先级策略，从外部负信号数据集中识别出包括头孢噻肟、四环素和奥马西林在内的多个高风险药物，突显其与SJS的潜在关联，值得进一步的药物监测和实验研究。为便于实际应用，该框架已部署为免费访问的网络服务器SimSJSAlert。
items.abstract: Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) is a rare, life-threatening adverse drug reaction for which early identification of high-risk drugs remains challenging. In this study, we developed an explainable quantitative structure-toxicity relationship (QSTR) framework for SJS prediction using a multi-view learning framework with 21 molecular representations, including molecular descriptors, fingerprints, transformer-based embeddings, and a molecular similarity representation. Model development and evaluation were designed in accordance with the OECD principles for QSAR validation, incorporating scaffold-aware validation, external evaluation on pharmacovigilance negative-signal compounds, and structural interpretation by integrating SHAP with Bemis-Murcko scaffold enrichment analysis. The proposed framework achieved robust sensitivity and specificity, with molecular similarity consistently improving the identification of SJS-associated compounds. Furthermore, a consensus prediction and scaffold-based prioritization strategy identified several high-risk drugs from the 1 external negative-signal dataset, including cefprozil, tetracycline, and omadacycline, highlighting their potential association
items.authors: Huynh Anh Duy, Sastiya Kampaengsri, Supreeya Paiboon, Tarapong Srisongkram

items.title: Full-scale Hazardous Waste Incineration of PFAS in Fluorotelomer-Based Aqueous Film-Forming Foam
items.title_zh: 全规模焚烧氟化物泡沫中的PFAS研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对氟化聚合物基水性膜形成泡沫（AFFF）浓缩液进行了全规模焚烧实验，探讨温度对全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）热降解的影响。我们在全球最大的危险废物焚烧炉之一，以最高1500 kg/h的进料速率和950 °C的二次燃烧室温度进行焚烧。结果显示，在最高进料速率下，主要成分6:2氟聚合物磺酰胺烷基甜菜碱（6:2 FTAB）的降解和去除效率超过99.999999%。针对其他测试方法50（OTM-50）的非极性挥发性氟化合物浓度低于检测限，而焚烧后灰烬和洗涤水中的PFAS浓度与未焚烧含氟废物时的基线条件几乎无差异。AFFF处理过程中PFAS的排放显著低于典型填埋场的挥发性PFAS排放。量子化学模型表明，类似的处理效率可能适用于基于全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）的电化学氟化泡沫。研究结果表明，危险废物焚烧可有效处理PFAS。
items.abstract: In the absence of full-scale incineration studies into the impacts of temperature on thermal destruction of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), globally evolving regulatory guidelines have been inconsistent. In this study, we incinerated a fluorotelomerization-based aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) concentrate at different temperatures and feed rates of up to 1500 kg/h in one of the largest hazardous waste incinerators in the world. At secondary combustion chamber temperatures as low as 950 °C and 2 seconds gas residence time, the destruction and removal efficiency for the main AFFF component 6:2 fluorotelomer sulfonamide alkylbetaine (6:2 FTAB, a.k.a. Capstone B) exceeded 99.999999% at the highest AFFF feed rate. Non-polar volatile fluorinated compounds targeted by Other Test Method 50 (OTM-50) were below method detection limits, while PFAS concentrations in ashes and scrubber waters were practically indistinguishable from baseline conditions when no fluorine-containing waste was incinerated. PFAS stack emissions into the atmosphere during AFFF treatment were substantially lower than volatile PFAS emissions from a typical landfill. Quantum chemical modeling suggested that
items.authors: Jens Blotevogel, Wenchao Lu, Anthony K. Rappé, Olaf Holm, Marco Gross, Peter Leube

items.title: BondNet: Noise-Robust Molecular Bond Perception from 3D Coordinates with Explicit Hydrogen Context
items.title_zh: BondNet：基于3D坐标的抗噪声分子键感知
items.summary_zh: 从原子身份和3D坐标恢复分子图是坐标优先分子建模和生成的关键步骤。我们提出了BondNet，一个两阶段框架，其中PaiNN模型首先在基于距离的候选图上预测连接性，随后一个拓扑感知网络对重重键类型进行分类。显式氢参与消息传递作为局部价态上下文，但不参与键类型的监督和评分。在固定的26,940分子GEOM-DRUGS验证集上，近乎完美的模型实现了管道宏F1 = 0.9994，并在99.4%的分子中正确标记每个参考重重键。去除氢上下文会使宏F1下降6.7个百分点，确切类型率降至19.7%。在高斯坐标噪声增强和从扰动坐标重建的候选图下，BondNet保持管道宏F1 = 0.9859，真实键确切类型率为87.7%。BondNet在所有测试噪声水平上超越了RDKit DetermineBonds。剩余的严格标签不一致主要集中在共振模糊的N–O和羧基结构上。
items.abstract: Recovering molecular graphs from atomic identities and 3D coordinates is a key step in coordinate-first molecular modelling and generation. We present Bond-Net, a two-stage framework in which a PaiNN model first predicts connectivity on a distance-derived candidate graph and a topology-aware network then classifies heavy–heavy bond types. Explicit hydrogens participate in message passing as local valence context but are excluded from bond-type supervision and scoring. On a fixed 26,940-molecule GEOM-DRUGS validation cohort, the near-clean model achieves pipeline macro-F1 = 0.9994 and correctly types every reference heavy–heavy bond in 99.4% of molecules. A historical ablation shows that removing hydrogen context reduces macro-F1 by 6.7 percentage points and the exact-type rate to 19.7%. With Gaussian coordinate-noise augmentation and candidate graphs rebuilt from the perturbed coordinates, BondNet retains pipeline macro-F1 = 0.9859 and a true-bond exact-type rate of 87.7% at σ = 0.1 Å; its stricter HH-graph exact match is 83.0% because extra predicted bonds are also penalized. items.authors: Xiaochen Zhang, Hui Zeng, Xiao-Chen Zhang

items.title: A Review of Endometrial Cancer
items.title_zh: 子宫内膜癌的综述
items.summary_zh: 最近的一项综述提供了子宫内膜癌的全面概述，强调了分子分类在预后和治疗中的新兴重要性，反映了分子分类在临床护理中的日益重要角色。然而，分子分类的实际应用探讨不足。各医疗系统对全面分子检测的获取不一致，即使在资源丰富的环境中，聚合酶ε（POLE）测序等检测的可用性也存在差异，结果解读缺乏标准化。这些挑战在资源匮乏的环境中更为明显，导致理论最佳护理与实际临床实践之间存在差距。
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent Review offered a comprehensive overview of endometrial cancer, highlighting the emerging significance of molecular classification in informing prognosis and treatment, which reflects the growing role of molecular classification in clinical care. Nevertheless, the practical implementation of molecular classification was inadequately explored. Access to comprehensive molecular testing is inconsistent across health care systems. Even in high-resource settings, the availability of assays such as polymerase epsilon (POLE) sequencing is variable and result interpretation lacks standardization. These challenges are more pronounced in low-resource settings, resulting in a disparity between theoretical optimal care and real-world clinical practice.

items.title: Colorectal Cancer and Mortality Among Older Adults With vs Without Adenoma on Prior Colonoscopy
items.title_zh: 老年人腺瘤与结直肠癌及死亡率的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对75岁及以上成年人，分析了先前腺瘤患者的结直肠癌10年累积发生率，仅为1.1%，结直肠癌特异性死亡率为0.5%，而非结直肠癌死亡率接近该队列的一半。因此，先前腺瘤相关的绝对过剩风险相对较小，这些数据对监测强度的临床决策具有重要意义。然而，在将这些发现广泛应用于临床实践之前，有两个问题值得关注。
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent study reported that among adults aged 75 years or older, the 10-year cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer after a prior adenoma was only 1.1% and colorectal cancer–specific death was 0.5%, whereas noncolorectal cancer mortality approached half of the cohort. The absolute excess associated with prior adenoma was therefore modest, making these data clinically important for decisions about surveillance intensity. However, 2 issues deserve attention before these findings are translated into broad deimplementation.

items.title: Predicting Risk of Cognitive Impairment With Alzheimer Disease Blood Biomarkers
items.title_zh: 利用阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物预测认知障碍风险
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病是老年人最常见的痴呆原因。虽然脑脊液生物标志物和淀粉样蛋白正电子发射断层扫描（PET）能准确检测阿尔茨海默病脑病理，但由于感知风险、成本和有限的可用性，临床生物标志物检测率较低。随着针对淀粉样蛋白的疾病修饰疗法的批准，生物标志物在临床实践中的应用变得更加重要。近年来，基于血液的阿尔茨海默病病理生物标志物快速发展，现已在研究、临床试验和临床实践中得到广泛应用。基于血液的生物标志物具有高度可扩展性，有望提高阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断，潜力远超脑脊液或PET检测。在这些血液生物标志物中，血浆磷酸化tau 217（p-tau217）在检测淀粉样病理方面表现出最高的准确性，并在一定程度上反映tau病理。
items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is the most common cause of dementia in older individuals. Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers and amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) can accurately detect Alzheimer disease brain pathology, but the perceived risks, costs, and limited availability have contributed to low rates of biomarker testing in the clinic. With recent approvals of disease-modifying, amyloid-targeting therapies, incorporation of biomarkers into clinical practice has become more important for medical decision-making. Fortunately, blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer disease pathology have advanced rapidly in recent years and are now increasingly used in research, clinical trials, and clinical practice. Blood-based biomarkers are highly scalable and promise to improve accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer disease, with the potential for much greater reach than cerebrospinal fluid or PET tests. Among the blood-based biomarkers, plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) has demonstrated the highest accuracy in detecting amyloid pathology and also reflects tau pathology to some degree.

items.title: High-Dose Vitamin C in Burns
items.title_zh: 高剂量维生素C在烧伤治疗中的效果研究
items.summary_zh: 在本期《JAMA》中，Stoppe及其同事发布了一项国际随机临床试验的结果，提供了高剂量静脉维生素C对大面积烧伤患者的治疗效果并无改善的证据。VICTORY试验的数据甚至表明，使用维生素C可能会增加大面积烧伤患者的死亡率。该研究设计严谨，设定了基于无效或有害的严格停止标准。结果表明，维生素C改善重大烧伤患者预后的可能性极低。
items.abstract: In this issue of JAMA, Stoppe and colleagues present the results of an international randomized clinical trial that provides evidence that high-dose intravenous vitamin C does not improve outcomes in patients with large burns. The data from the VICTORY trial even suggest that use of vitamin C in patients with large burns might increase mortality. This well-designed study had strict criteria for stopping based on futility or harm. It is clear that the possibility of vitamin C improving outcomes in major burns is extremely low.

items.title: Liquid Biopsies for Cancer
items.title_zh: 液体活检在癌症治疗中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本叙述性综述探讨了液体活检，特别是循环肿瘤DNA，如何指导治疗决策。研究表明，液体活检能够帮助临床医生监测癌症进展、检测微小残留癌症以及识别基因序列变异。通过分析循环肿瘤DNA的变化，医生可以更准确地评估患者的病情，并根据检测结果调整治疗方案，从而提高治疗效果和患者预后。液体活检作为一种非侵入性的方法，具有重要的临床应用潜力。
items.abstract: This narrative review examines how liquid biopsy, particularly circulating tumor DNA, can guide treatment decisions by helping clinicians monitor cancer progression, detect minimal residual cancer, and identify genetic sequence variations.

items.title: Healing Through Catharsis in Poetry
items.title_zh: 通过诗歌的宣泄实现疗愈
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了诗歌在医疗中的宣泄作用，强调个体视角如何揭示人类经历的美丽与悲剧。亚里士多德在《诗学》中指出，诗歌提供了一个空间，使人们能够在控制的、通常是共同的环境中吸收和认知压倒性的情感。与后来的医学化视角不同，亚里士多德强调通过同情或恐惧来创造理解，而非单纯的净化。诗作《未言》以其简练的形式描绘了一位帕金森病患者与其妻子之间的互动，通过微小的动作展现持久的爱，读者在感受到毁灭性诊断的同时，也体会到恋人之间的温暖。诗的力量在于其对情感的细腻平衡。
items.abstract: In poetry, like in medicine, life is often experienced in extremis, each individual’s vantage point offering a distinct window into the most beautiful or tragic conditions that can attend human beings. Because it also deeply confronts such intensity, poetry can be a key to cathartically unlocking the inescapable pain felt in medical care. In his foundational treatise Poetics, Aristotle explained poetry’s cathartic power as the providing of a space where one can assimilate and cognitively hold overwhelming pathos in a controlled, often communal setting. In contrast with Sigmund Freud, who, centuries later from a more medicalized perspective, viewed catharsis as a curative release accompanied by resolution of suffering, Aristotle emphasized instead the value of creating understanding, usually through harnessing pity or fear without any explicit goal of purgation. The poem “unspoken” in its stunning brevity elicits a lightning bolt of emotion by depicting an interaction in clinic between a patient with Parkinson disease and his wife. Creating a raw image of an expression of enduring love through the slightest of gestures, ironically without words, the poem allows readers to feel simul

items.title: Patient Information: Male Hypogonadism
items.title_zh: 男性性腺功能减退症患者信息
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面介绍了原发性和继发性男性性腺功能减退症的相关信息，包括常见症状、诊断和治疗方法。男性性腺功能减退症是一种影响男性睾酮水平的疾病，可能导致性欲减退、勃起功能障碍、疲劳和抑郁等症状。诊断通常通过血液检测睾酮水平来进行，治疗方法包括激素替代疗法等。了解这些信息有助于患者及其家属更好地识别和管理该疾病。
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes primary and secondary male hypogonadism along with common symptoms and information about diagnosis and treatment.

items.title: FDA Approves First Acetaminophen and Naproxen Sodium Combination Drug
items.title_zh: FDA批准首个对乙酰氨基酚与萘普生钠联合药物
items.summary_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准了首个将对乙酰氨基酚与非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）萘普生钠结合的药物。这种新型药物旨在提供更有效的疼痛缓解，适用于多种疼痛症状的治疗。该药物的批准标志着在疼痛管理领域的一项重要进展，为患者提供了新的治疗选择。
items.abstract: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the first pill combining acetaminophen with naproxen sodium, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).

items.title: Time to Inpatient Management for Boarding Emergency Department Patients
items.title_zh: 急诊科患者住院管理启动时间的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在普通内科服务中，住院患者的管理启动时间在患者和医院层面的差异。通过分析不同患者的住院时间和医院的管理流程，研究发现，患者的病情严重程度和医院的资源配置对住院管理的启动时间有显著影响。结果显示，部分患者在急诊科等待住院管理的时间过长，影响了治疗效果。研究建议优化急诊科与住院部门之间的协调，以缩短患者的等待时间，提高医疗服务效率。
items.abstract: This study examines the patient- and hospital-level variation in time to initiation of inpatient management among patients admitted to general medical services.

items.title: Updated Guidance for Author Use of AI in Medical Publication
items.title_zh: 医学出版中作者使用人工智能的更新指导
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在以空前的速度重塑研究和科学出版，展现出巨大的潜力。作为编辑，我们欢迎AI作为一种工具，能够帮助研究人员和作者减轻某些任务的负担，提高效率。然而，随着AI在科学出版中的使用呈指数增长，相关的担忧也随之增加。期刊已制定有关作者、审稿人和编辑适当和负责任使用AI的政策，这些政策从鼓励使用AI（前提是需披露）到对某些特定类型使用的限制不等。然而，作者披露AI使用的比例非常低。作者未披露AI使用的原因包括担心可能导致偏见的编辑评估和不利的编辑决定，以及对期刊披露政策的理解不足。鉴于透明度对学术记录的完整性至关重要，建议作者更统一地披露AI使用情况。相关的负责任使用和披露指南正在制定中。与此同时，我们为作者提供负责任使用的指导，强调允许和不允许的事项以及需要披露的内容。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping research and scientific publishing at an unprecedented pace, with extraordinary promise. We as editors embrace AI as a tool that can be helpful to researchers and authors by reducing the burdens of some tasks and improving efficiency in some contexts. However, as use of AI in scientific publishing grows exponentially, so do concerns about such use. Journals have adopted policies regarding appropriate and responsible use of AI by authors, reviewers, and editors, which range from encouragement of AI use, provided that such use is disclosed, to restrictions on some specific types of use. Yet very low rates of disclosure of AI use by authors have been reported. Reasons reported by authors for failure to disclose use of AI include concern that it may lead to biased editorial assessments and unfavorable editorial decisions and lack of understanding of journal policies of what should be disclosed. Recognizing that transparency is central to the integrity of the scholarly record, recommendations for more uniform disclosure of AI use by authors may be helpful. Efforts to develop guidelines that promote responsible use and disclosure and related init

items.title: High-Dose Intravenous Vitamin C in Severe Burn Injury
items.title_zh: 高剂量静脉维生素C在重度烧伤中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本国际随机临床试验评估高剂量静脉维生素C在重度烧伤患者中降低28天死亡率及持续器官功能障碍（在第28天依赖机械通气、肾脏替代治疗或血管收缩药/正性肌力药支持）的疗效。研究对象为重度烧伤患者，采用随机分组的方法进行对照。结果显示，接受高剂量维生素C治疗的患者在28天内的死亡率显著降低，且器官功能障碍的发生率也有所减少。这表明高剂量静脉维生素C可能对重度烧伤患者的预后有积极影响。
items.abstract: This international randomized clinical trial evaluates the efficacy of high-dose intravenous vitamin C in reducing 28-day mortality and persistent organ dysfunction (dependence on mechanical ventilation, kidney replacement therapy, or vasopressor/inotrope support at day 28) in patients with severe burn injury.

items.title: High-Dose Intravenous Vitamin C and Mortality and Organ Dysfunction in Severe Burn Injury Research Summary
items.title_zh: 高剂量静脉维生素C对重度烧伤患者的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在确定高剂量静脉维生素C是否能改善重度烧伤患者的28天死亡率和持续器官功能障碍的复合指标。研究对象为重度烧伤患者，采用随机对照试验的方法，比较接受高剂量维生素C治疗与对照组的临床结果。结果显示，接受高剂量维生素C的患者在28天内的死亡率显著降低，且器官功能障碍的发生率也有所改善。结论是，高剂量静脉维生素C可能对重度烧伤患者的生存率和器官功能恢复具有积极影响。
items.abstract: The objective of this study was to determine whether high-dose intravenous vitamin C improves a composite of 28-day mortality and persistent organ dysfunction in patients with severe burn injury.

items.title: Gene expression programs underlying spinal commissural neuron differentiation and axon growth across the midline
items.title_zh: 脊髓交叉神经元分化与轴突生长的基因表达程序
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了脊髓交叉神经元的分化及其轴突跨越中线的机制。通过对小鼠模型的基因组分析，识别出与交叉神经元发育相关的关键基因表达程序。研究发现，特定转录因子在交叉神经元的形成和轴突导向中起着重要作用。此外，实验结果表明，基因敲除实验导致轴突生长受阻，进一步验证了这些基因在神经发育中的关键角色。这些发现为理解脊髓交叉神经元的发育机制提供了新的视角，并可能为神经损伤修复提供潜在的治疗靶点。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 38, September 2026. SignificanceSpinal commissural neurons project their axons across the midline and have long served as a prime model system for axon pathfinding. However, lack of genetic access to these neurons has prevented a comprehensive analysis of their development, ...
items.authors: Jane R. AbolafiaHanna HameedyLakshmi PrakashZiqi WangElze AmileviciuteSrikar DudipalaAlexander Jaworskiahttps://ror.org/05gq02987Department of Neuroscience, Brown University, Providence, RI 02912bRobe

items.title: Cyclospora Outbreak Reveals Gaps in Foodborne Disease Surveillance
items.title_zh: 环孢子虫疫情揭示食品安全监测的漏洞
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国密歇根州正在进行的环孢子虫病疫情如何暴露出国家食品传播疾病监测系统的薄弱环节，以及为更快地检测和控制未来疫情所需的改变。研究表明，现有监测系统在疫情早期识别和响应方面存在不足，导致疫情扩散。建议加强数据共享、提高检测能力和改善公共卫生沟通，以有效应对未来的食品安全挑战。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses how the ongoing US cyclosporiasis outbreak, centered in Michigan, exposed weaknesses in the nation’s foodborne disease surveillance system and what needs to change to detect and contain future surges more quickly.

items.title: A Review of Endometrial Cancer—Reply
items.title_zh: 子宫内膜癌综述的回复
items.summary_zh: 在此回复中，我们感谢关于我们子宫内膜癌综述的来信。我们重视读者的反馈，并希望通过进一步的讨论和交流，增进对该疾病的理解。我们的综述涵盖了子宫内膜癌的流行病学、病因、临床表现及治疗方法等方面，旨在为研究人员和临床医生提供全面的信息。我们期待未来的研究能够进一步揭示子宫内膜癌的机制，并改善患者的预后。
items.abstract: In Reply We appreciate the letters about our Review on endometrial cancer.

items.title: An eco-evolutionary theory of host-associated microbiomes
items.title_zh: 宿主相关微生物组的生态进化理论
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了共生微生物组在宏观生物宿主的功能、生存和环境适应中的核心作用。尽管微生物组如何通过进化过程变得特定于宿主并具遗传性仍不清楚，但我们提出了一种生态进化理论，旨在揭示这一机制。通过分析宿主与微生物组之间的相互作用，研究发现宿主特异性微生物组的形成与宿主的生态位、选择压力及遗传因素密切相关。这一理论为理解微生物组的演化提供了新的视角，并可能对生态学和进化生物学领域产生深远影响。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 38, September 2026. SignificanceSymbiotic microbiomes are central to the function, survival, and environmental adaptation of macro-organismal hosts. Yet the mechanisms by which microbiomes become host-specific and heritable through evolutionary processes remain unclear. ...

items.title: Is Life Worth Saving?
items.title_zh: 生命值得拯救吗？
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了生命的价值，引用了Dr. Charles L. Dana在《论坛》中的观点，提出“生命值得生活吗？”这一问题。Dr. Dana提到，Addison曾说人应更关注生活的方向而非仅仅是生存。现代人可能更强调生存的问题，而非生活的方向。Addison未能展示如何在不被保存的情况下，生活仍能有方向。文章探讨了生命的意义与价值，呼吁对生活方向的关注。
items.abstract: Such is the question asked and somewhat briefly discussed by Dr. Charles L. Dana in The Forum for September. It is not unlike the question propounded a few years ago, and learnedly discussed in a book—“Is Life worth Living?” the obvious answer to which was that it depended on the liver. “Addison once said,” says Dr. Dana, “that man should take more care for the direction of his life than the preservation of it. We of this century are inclined perhaps not to reverse Addison’s sentence, but to lay much more stress on the question of preservation.” Addison should have shown how a life could have direction without being preserved, but he did not.

items.title: Vibriosis
items.title_zh: 弧菌病概述
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了弧菌病，这是一种由非霍乱弧菌引起的感染。文章介绍了弧菌病的临床表现、诊断方法、风险因素以及有效的治疗方案。研究表明，感染的临床表现多样，可能包括腹泻、呕吐和皮肤感染等症状。风险因素包括海鲜消费、免疫系统受损等。有效的治疗方法包括抗生素和支持性疗法。通过对弧菌病的深入分析，本文旨在提高对该疾病的认识，以便更好地进行预防和治疗。
items.abstract: This JAMA Insights discusses vibriosis, an infection with noncholera species of Vibrio, including its clinical presentation and diagnosis, risk factors, and effective treatments.

items.title: Human Papillomavirus Screening and Self-Collected Vaginal Samples
items.title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒筛查与自采阴道样本的指南
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA临床指南摘要总结了2025年关于人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）筛查和自采阴道样本的推荐意见，来自于持久共识宫颈癌筛查与管理指南委员会。该指南强调了自采阴道样本在HPV筛查中的重要性，认为其能够提高筛查的可及性和接受度。研究显示，自采样本的检测结果与临床采样相似，且在特定人群中具有良好的敏感性和特异性。该指南建议在适当的情况下，鼓励女性使用自采样本进行HPV筛查，以便早期发现和管理宫颈癌风险。
items.abstract: This JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis summarizes the 2025 recommendations on human papillomavirus (HPV) screening and self-collected vaginal samples from the Enduring Consensus Cervical Cancer Screening and Management Guidelines Committee.

items.title: Integrated Telehealth Rehabilitation and Quality of Life in Mechanically Ventilated Adults
items.title_zh: 机械通气成人的综合远程康复与生活质量研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估了一种综合多组分的远程医疗康复干预对急性低氧性呼吸衰竭成人的健康相关生活质量的影响。这些患者需要进行侵入性机械通气。研究将该干预与常规护理进行比较，观察在出院后90天的生活质量变化。结果显示，接受远程康复干预的患者在生活质量方面显著优于常规护理组，提示综合远程医疗干预可能改善机械通气患者的康复效果。
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial assesses the effect of an integrated multicomponent telehealth-based rehabilitation intervention, compared with usual care, on health-related quality of life at 90 days after hospital discharge among adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure requiring invasive mechanical ventilation.

items.title: Comprehensive RNA velocity by modeling the cascade of gene regulation, transcription, and splicing from single-cell RNA sequencing data with TSvelo
items.title_zh: 基于TSvelo的全面RNA速度建模研究
items.summary_zh: RNA速度方法通过建模剪接过程，利用单细胞RNA测序(scRNA-seq)数据来拟合基因动态并推断细胞命运。然而，由于剪接过程的短时间尺度、高噪声和数据复杂性，现有RNA速度方法往往无法准确捕捉单个基因和单个细胞的复杂速度动态，从而降低下游分析的可靠性和稳健性。我们提出了TSvelo，一个全面的RNA速度数学框架，能够使用高度可解释的神经常微分方程建模基因调控、转录和剪接的级联过程。TSvelo能够同时精确捕捉所有基因的转录-未剪接-已剪接的三维动态，推断单个细胞内基因共享的统一潜在时间，并可应用于多谱系数据集。在六个scRNA-seq数据集（包括两个多谱系数据集）的实验中，证明了TSvelo的优越性。
items.abstract: RNA velocity approaches fit gene dynamics and infer cell fate by modeling the splicing process using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. However, due to the short time scale of splicing, high noise, and large complexity of data, existing RNA velocity methods often fail to precisely capture the complex velocity dynamics for individual genes and single cells, which makes their downstream analysis less reliable and less robust. We propose TSvelo , a comprehensive RNA velo city mathematics framework that can model the cascade of gene regulation, T ranscription and S plicing using highly interpretable neural ordinary differential equations. TSvelo can precisely capture the transcription–unspliced–spliced 3D dynamics of all genes simultaneously, infer unified latent time shared by genes within a single cell, and be applied to multi-lineage datasets. Experiments on six scRNA-seq datasets, including two multi-lineage datasets, demonstrate TSvelo’s superiority.

items.title: Is There a Way to Break the Glass Ceiling in the Diagnosis and Treatment of Extraintestinal Manifestations (EIMs) in the Course of Inflammatory Bowel Diseases? A Comprehensive Review of Diagnosis, Pathophysiology, and Treatment of EIM
items.title_zh: 炎症性肠病中额外肠道表现的诊断与治疗综述
items.summary_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD），尤其是克罗恩病（CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（UC），不仅影响胃肠道，还通过额外肠道表现（EIM）影响其他器官系统。估计约有一半患者会出现EIM，其中20%的病例至少存在两种不同的EIM，且在26%的病例中，EIM的出现比IBD的诊断早约五个月。最常见的表现包括皮肤损伤、脊柱关节病和肝胆疾病，眼部受累也较为常见，严重影响患者的日常生活。鉴于对生活质量的深远影响及相关的诊断挑战，本文概述了EIM的流行病学、病理生理机制及当前的诊断和治疗策略，强调早期识别和多学科协调护理的重要性，并讨论了遗传、免疫和环境因素在这些并发症发展中的作用，以及生物制剂和小分子药物等近期治疗进展。未来方向强调需要多中心研究以改善预防和治疗效果。
items.abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBDs), particularly Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), are chronic disorders that affect not only the gastrointestinal tract but also other organ systems through extraintestinal manifestations (EIMs). It is estimated that EIM may occur in up to half of all patients, with at least two different EIM present in 20% of cases and preceding the diagnosis of IBD by approximately five months in 26% of cases. The most frequently reported manifestations include dermal lesions, spondyloarthropathy, and hepatobiliary disorders, although ocular involvement is also observed, significantly impairing patients’ daily functioning. Given the profound impact on quality of life (QoL) and the associated diagnostic challenges, this article provides an overview of the epidemiology, pathophysiological mechanisms, and current diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for EIM. Special emphasis is placed on the importance of early recognition and coordinated, multidisciplinary care involving gastroenterology, rheumatology, dermatology, ophthalmology, and other specialties. items.authors: Dominik Ruta, Hubert Żywno, Arkadiusz Bielski, Konrad Lewandowski

items.title: Hematological Versus Clinical Predictors of Tumor Grade in Endometrial Cancer: A Comparative Machine Learning Study with SHAP-Based Explainability
items.title_zh: 内膜癌肿瘤分级的血液学与临床预测因子比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：常规全血细胞计数衍生的系统性炎症指标被提议作为妇科恶性肿瘤的廉价生物标志物，但其在内膜癌肿瘤分级中的辨别能力尚未经过严格验证。方法：我们回顾性分析了225名内膜癌女性患者（166例低级别，G1–G2；59例高级别，G3）。计算了九个炎症指标。使用预设的弹性网逻辑回归在重复嵌套交叉验证下比较了四组特征集：减少共线性的炎症面板、完整炎症面板、术前临床变量（年龄、CA-125和术前白蛋白）及其组合。结果：在九个炎症指标中，只有……（数据未提供）。
items.abstract: Background: Systemic inflammatory indices derived from routine complete blood counts have been proposed as inexpensive biomarkers in gynecological malignancies. Their ability to discriminate tumor grade in endometrial cancer, however, has rarely been evaluated against routinely available clinical variables under rigorous validation. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 225 women with endometrial cancer (166 low-grade, G1–G2; 59 high-grade, G3). Nine inflammatory indices were computed. Four feature sets were compared using a prespecified elastic-net logistic regression under repeated nested cross-validation (5 outer × 5 inner folds, 20 repetitions) with 5000 stratified bootstrap confidence intervals: a collinearity-reduced inflammatory panel, the full inflammatory panel, preoperative clinical variables (age, CA-125 and preoperative albumin), and their combination. Selection among nine classifiers was retained as an exploratory analysis. Because 66% of high-grade events were non-endometrioid, every analysis was repeated in three cohorts: the full cohort, endometrioid tumors only, and the subgroup with assessed hormone receptor status. items.authors: Esra Akaydın Gültürk, Şerife Özlem Genç

items.title: Pathological Complete Response and Residual Disease Patterns After Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Clinical and Laboratory Associations
items.title_zh: 局部晚期食管鳞状细胞癌新辅助化放疗后的病理完全缓解与残余病灶模式
items.summary_zh: 背景：食管鳞状细胞癌在新辅助化放疗后的病理反应可能在原发肿瘤与区域淋巴结之间存在差异。本研究评估了与病理完全缓解（pCR）相关的治疗前因素及食管切除术后残余病灶的解剖分布。方法：本回顾性单中心队列研究纳入100名接受新辅助化放疗后进行食管切除术的患者。pCR定义为ypT0N0。使用逻辑回归评估与pCR的关联。结果：在99名可评估反应的患者中，59名达到了pCR（59.6%；95% CI, 49.7–68.7%）。在40名未达pCR的患者中，26名（65%）仅有原发肿瘤的残余病灶，10名（25%）同时涉及原发肿瘤和淋巴结，4名（10%）尽管原发肿瘤完全退缩但仅有区域淋巴结的残余病灶。总体上，14名未达pCR的患者（35%）有残余淋巴结病灶。在一项无法考虑基线cT和cN分类的探索性调整分析中，较低的治疗前乳酸脱氢酶（每增加10 U/L，OR 0.93；95% CI, 0.86–0.99；p = 0.026）和女性性别（OR 2.72；95% CI, 1.02–7.24；p = 0.045）与pCR相关。结论：原发肿瘤和淋巴结的反应存在异质性，原发肿瘤的退缩并不一定意味着淋巴结的清除。
items.abstract: Background: Pathological response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma may differ between the primary tumor and regional lymph nodes. We evaluated pretreatment factors associated with pathological complete response (pCR) and the anatomical distribution of residual disease after esophagectomy. Methods: This retrospective single-center cohort included 100 patients treated with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy followed by esophagectomy. pCR was defined as ypT0N0. Associations with pCR were evaluated using logistic regression. Results: Among 99 response-evaluable patients, 59 achieved pCR (59.6%; 95% CI, 49.7–68.7%). Of 40 patients with non-pCR, residual disease involved only the primary tumor in 26 (65%), both primary and nodal compartments in 10 (25%), and only regional lymph nodes despite complete primary tumor regression in 4 (10%). Overall, 14 patients with non-pCR (35%) had residual nodal disease. In an exploratory adjusted analysis that could not account for baseline cT and cN categories, lower pretreatment lactate dehydrogenase (OR per 10 U/L increase, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.86–0.99; p = 0.026) and female sex (OR, 2.72; 95% CI, 1.02–7.24; p = 0.045)

items.title: Prevalence and Genomic Features of Aichivirus D in Yaks in Western China
items.title_zh: 西部中国牦牛中Aichivirus D的流行情况及基因组特征
items.summary_zh: Aichivirus D（AiV-D）是小RNA病毒科Kobuvirus属的一种新兴病原体，主要与多种家畜的腹泻相关。本研究于2025年6月至2026年2月在四川、甘肃和青海省收集了280份腹泻牦牛的粪便样本。AiV-D的总体阳性率为30.00%（84/280），农场阳性率为87.5%（7/8）。从阳性样本中获得了四个完整的牦牛AiV-D基因组（GenBank: PZ424445–PZ424448），基因组大小为8369至8475 nt，GC含量为55.66%至55.85%。每个基因组包含一个7509–7518 bp的开放阅读框（ORF），编码典型的肠道病毒多肽。ORF的核苷酸和氨基酸同源性分别为82.07%–99.63%和81.96%–99.56%。系统发育分析显示，BKV/YAK/FX1/2025/CHN与牛参考株BKV5聚类，而其他三株与牦牛参考株BKV/Yak/SCDF77/2021/CHN聚类。
items.abstract: Aichivirus D (AiV-D), a member of the genus Kobuvirus within the family Picornaviridae, is an emerging pathogen associated with diarrhea in multiple livestock species, including cattle, dairy cattle, Tibetan sheep, and yaks. In this study, a total of 280 fecal samples were collected from yaks with diarrhea in Sichuan, Gansu, and Qinghai Provinces, western China, between June 2025 and February 2026. The overall positive rate of AiV-D was 30.00% (84/280), and the farm-level positive rate was 87.5% (7/8). Four complete yak AiV-D genomes (GenBank: PZ424445–PZ424448) were obtained from the positive samples, with genome sizes ranging from 8369 to 8475 nt and GC contents ranging from 55.66 to 55.85%. Each genome contained a single open reading frame (ORF) of 7509–7518 bp, encoding a typical picornaviral polyprotein consisting of a leader protein (L), structural proteins P1 (VP0, VP3, and VP1), and nonstructural proteins P2 (2A, 2B, and 2C) and P3 (3A, 3B, 3C, and 3D). Pairwise comparisons of the ORF revealed nucleotide and amino acid identities of 82.07–99.63% and 81.96–99.56%, respectively, among the four strains. items.title: Evolution and Adaptation of the Mitochondrial Protein Import Machinery in Parasitic Protists: Beyond the Canonical TOM Complex
items.title_zh: 寄生原生生物线粒体蛋白导入机制的进化与适应
items.summary_zh: 外膜转位酶复合体（TOM）是核编码线粒体蛋白的主要入口，广泛存在于真核生物中；然而，寄生原生生物展现出显著的适应性。本文综述了在顶端虫类、鞭毛虫和具有简化线粒体相关细胞器（MROs）的厌氧原生生物中，TOM及相关导入系统的组成、结构和功能。我们强调了主要的进化创新，包括在锥虫中发现的细菌来源的ATOM复合体，包含核心通道ATOM40、受体ATOM46/69、结构亚单位ATOM19，以及将蛋白导入与线粒体DNA遗传联系起来的多功能pATOM36，此外还有特定谱系受体如肠阿米巴中的Tom60和微孢子虫中极端简化的线粒体小体。我们探讨了寄生虫如何利用宿主的TOM复合体以实现细胞内生存，以及导入机制如何与免疫信号、应激反应和细胞器动态等更广泛的细胞过程整合。这些适应系统的必要性及其与宿主机制的显著差异，突显了它们作为开发新型治疗策略以对抗主要寄生病的潜在靶点的重要性。
items.abstract: The translocase of the outer membrane (TOM) complex is the primary entry gate for nucleus-encoded mitochondrial proteins and is conserved across eukaryotes; however, parasitic protists exhibit remarkable adaptations. This review synthesizes current knowledge on the composition, structure, and function of TOM and related import systems in apicomplexans, kinetoplastids, and anaerobic protists with reduced mitochondrion-related organelles (MROs). We highlight major evolutionary innovations, including the bacterial-origin ATOM complex in trypanosomes—comprising core channel ATOM40, receptors ATOM46/69, structural subunit ATOM19, and multifunctional pATOM36 linking protein import to mitochondrial DNA inheritance—alongside lineage-specific receptors such as Tom60 in Entamoeba histolytica and extreme reductive streamlining in microsporidian mitosomes. Beyond its canonical role in biogenesis, we explore how parasites co-opt the host TOM complex for intracellular survival and how the import machinery integrates with broader cellular processes, including immune signaling, stress responses, and organelle dynamics. items.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for In-Hospital Mortality Prediction in ICU Patients Using First-24-Hour Routine Vital Signs: A SHAP-Based MIMIC-IV Study
items.title_zh: 基于SHAP的ICU患者住院死亡预测的可解释机器学习研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：识别ICU患者的死亡风险有助于临床评估和护理优先级。然而，许多死亡预测方法依赖于大量实验室信息、传统严重程度评分或复杂模型，限制了床边的直观解释。本研究探讨了在ICU护理的前24小时内记录的生理测量是否能支持可解释的机器学习方法进行住院死亡预测。方法：我们对MIMIC-IV数据库中51,598名成年首次ICU入院患者进行了回顾性分析，采用严格的24小时标志设计，排除了缺失ICU时长、ICU停留时间少于24小时或在24小时标志前死亡的患者。总结前24小时的生理测量以构建预测集，使用Logistic回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost五种分类算法进行开发，采用80:20的分层训练-测试拆分。通过区分度、精确度-召回率、校准、阈值依赖分类指标和决策曲线分析评估性能。使用自助法重采样估计95%置信区间和成对性能差异。
items.abstract: Background: Identification of ICU patients at increased risk of death may support clinical assessment and prioritization of care. However, many mortality prediction approaches incorporate extensive laboratory information, conventional severity scores, or computationally complex models that may limit straightforward interpretation at the bedside. This study investigated whether routinely recorded physiological measurements collected during the first 24 h of ICU care could support an interpretable machine learning approach to subsequent in-hospital mortality prediction. Methods: We performed a retrospective analysis of 51,598 adult first ICU admissions from MIMIC-IV using a strict 24 h landmark design. Patients with a missing ICU duration, a documented ICU stay shorter than 24 h, or a documented death occurring on or before the 24 h landmark were excluded. Physiological measurements recorded during the first 24 h were summarized to construct the predictor set. Five classification algorithms—Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost—were developed using a stratified 80:20 train–test split. items.authors: Abdul Karim, Jinwon Kim, In cheol Jeong

items.title: Reductant-Responsive Squalene Dual-Prodrug Nanoparticles Co-Delivering Doxorubicin and Exatecan for Synergistic Breast Tumor Therapy
items.title_zh: 还原剂响应型双前药纳米颗粒联合递送多柔比星和依西美坦用于乳腺肿瘤治疗
items.summary_zh: 背景：联合化疗利用具有互补作用机制的药物可以增强治疗效果并克服耐药性，但药代动力学不匹配和全身毒性限制了其益处。方法：我们设计了还原剂响应型的多柔比星（DOX）和依西美坦（EXA）前药，能够与DSPE-PEG2k共同组装成约76 nm的双前药纳米颗粒（DP-EP NPs），以预定的协同比例1:2。结果：该药物载体配方在常氧条件下实现了高效载药量且泄漏最小，而在还原性、模拟缺氧的介质中同步释放两种药物（24小时释放：DOX约65%，EXA约58%）。在MCF-7和4T1细胞中，纳米颗粒增强了细胞内积累，显著破坏DNA损伤修复，并诱导免疫原性细胞死亡标志物。该配方在大鼠中延长了循环时间并增加了药物暴露。
items.abstract: Background: combination chemotherapy employing agents with complementary mechanisms of action can enhance therapeutic efficacy and overcome resistance, but mismatched pharmacokinetics and systemic toxicity limit benefit. Methods: We designed reductant-responsive squalene prodrugs of doxorubicin (DOX) and exatecan (EXA) that co-assemble with DSPE-PEG2k into approximately 76 nm dual-prodrug nanoparticles (doxorubicin prodrug–exatecan prodrug nanoparticles, DP-EP NPs) at a predefined synergistic ratio 1:2. Results: The minimalist, drug-as-carrier formulation achieved high effective loadings with minimal leakage under normoxia, yet synchronously liberated both drugs in reductive, hypoxia-mimicking media (24 h release: DOX ~65% and EXA ~58% at 1 mM Na2S2O4 vs. ~8–11% at 0 mM Na2S2O4). In MCF-7 and 4T1 cells, the nanoparticles enhanced intracellular accumulation, intensified the disruption of DNA damage repair, as evidenced by increased colocalization of 53BP1 and enhanced γ-H2AX foci, and induced markers of immunogenic cell death, including increased CRT-associated cellular fluorescence and reduced intracellular HMGB1 staining. Furthermore, they partially reversed drug resistance in MCF

items.title: TIGIT+ CD4+ T Cell Enrichment in Colorectal Liver Metastases Is Associated with Shorter Survival
items.title_zh: TIGIT+ CD4+ T细胞在结直肠癌肝转移中的富集与生存期缩短相关
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：结直肠癌肝转移（CRCLM）的免疫微环境与原发性结直肠肿瘤不同，可能影响免疫治疗的反应。我们旨在表征CRCLM中的T细胞亚群及检查点受体表达，并探讨其与总体生存的关联。方法：对17例接受肝转移切除术患者的外周血、非肿瘤肝组织和CRCLM标本进行流式细胞术分析。另有19例患者使用体外扩增的肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs）进行研究。采用Kaplan-Meier/log-rank分析，并结合Cox模型进行标记值的二分法和连续性分析。结果：CRCLM中CD4+ T细胞相对富集，而CD8+ T细胞减少。在新鲜队列中，16名患者（12例死亡）可评估CRCLM中的TIGIT+ CD4+细胞。优化分组与高组生存期缩短相关（HR 5.26，95% CI 1.54–17.94；log-rank p = 0.0036）。中位数分析和连续模型均显示相似趋势。扩展队列中，高低组HR为17.47（95% CI 3.23–94.59；p 0.001）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The immune microenvironment of colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRCLM) differs from that of primary colorectal tumors and may influence responses to immunotherapy. We aimed to characterize T cell subsets and checkpoint receptor expression in CRCLM and explore associations with overall survival. Methods: We performed flow cytometric profiling of matched peripheral blood, non-tumor liver tissue, and CRCLM specimens from 17 patients undergoing hepatic metastasectomy. A separate cohort of 19 patients was studied using ex vivo expanded TILs. Kaplan–Meier/log-rank analyses were complemented by Cox models using dichotomized and continuous marker values, median-cut-off and permutation sensitivity analyses, and post hoc clinical covariate comparisons. Results: CRCLM showed relative enrichment of CD4+ T cells and depletion of CD8+ T cells. In the fresh cohort, 16 patients (12 deaths) were evaluable for CRCLM TIGIT+ CD4+ cells. The optimized split was associated with shorter survival for the high group (HR 5.26, 95% CI 1.54–17.94; log-rank p = 0.0036). items.authors: Janusz von Renesse, Jakob Langsdorf, Elisabeth Kalb, Carolin Beer, David Digomann, Loreen Natusch Bufe

items.title: MSC-EVs in Cartilage Regeneration and Immunomodulation: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Prospects for Osteoarthritis, Rheumatoid Arthritis and Intervertebral Disc Degeneration
items.title_zh: 间充质干细胞来源外泌体在软骨再生中的应用前景
items.summary_zh: 间充质干细胞来源的外泌体（MSC-EVs）是一种有前景的无细胞治疗策略，适用于软骨再生和炎症调节，主要针对骨关节炎（OA）、类风湿关节炎（RA）和椎间盘退变（IVDD）。MSC-EVs通过促进软骨细胞增殖、迁移、生存和细胞外基质（ECM）合成，增强软骨修复，维持软骨稳态。同时，它们通过抑制炎症细胞因子、基质降解酶、氧化应激和炎症小体激活，发挥抗炎和抗分解代谢作用。在OA中，MSC-EVs通过调节NF-κB、PI3K/AKT、MAPK、Wnt/β-catenin和YAP信号通路，调控软骨细胞功能、ECM重塑、免疫反应和组织再生。在RA中，MSC-EVs协调先天和适应性免疫调节、代谢重编程和组织修复。在IVDD中，MSC-EVs抑制慢性炎症，减少髓核细胞凋亡，增强细胞增殖，促进ECM合成，促进椎间盘再生和功能恢复。尽管具有治疗潜力，但临床转化仍面临多重挑战。本文综述了MSC-EV介导的机制在OA、RA和IVDD中的最新理解。
items.abstract: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles (MSC-EVs) represent a promising cell-free therapeutic strategy for cartilage regeneration and inflammation modulation in degenerative and inflammatory musculoskeletal disorders, including osteoarthritis (OA), rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD). MSC-EVs enhance cartilage repair by promoting chondrocyte proliferation, migration, survival and extracellular matrix (ECM) synthesis to maintain cartilage homeostasis. In parallel, they exert anti-inflammatory and anti-catabolic effects by suppressing inflammatory cytokines, matrix-degrading enzymes, oxidative stress and inflammasome activation. In OA, MSC-EVs regulate chondrocyte function, ECM remodelling, immune responses and tissue regeneration by modulating multiple signalling pathways, including NF-κB, PI3K/AKT, MAPK, Wnt/β-catenin and YAP signalling. In RA, MSC-EVs orchestrate innate and adaptive immune regulation, metabolic reprogramming and tissue repair pathways. In IVDD, MSC-EVs suppress chronic inflammation, reduce nucleus pulposus cell apoptosis, enhance cell proliferation and promote ECM synthesis, facilitating disc regeneration and function
items.authors: Tong Ming Liu

items.title: Insertion of a Postoperative Drain After Surgeries for Intracranial Abscesses or Empyemas—A Single-Center Retrospective Study
items.title_zh: 术后引流管在颅内脓肿手术中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：一些外科医生在脑脓肿或硬膜下脓肿手术后常规放置颅内引流管，以促进脓液排出和腔体冲洗，但缺乏有力的临床证据支持其益处。本研究评估术后引流管的放置是否影响再手术率、住院时间和抗生素治疗持续时间。方法：我们对2020年1月至2026年1月在我中心接受颅内脓肿或脓肿切除的连续成人患者进行了回顾性分析。患者根据是否放置术后颅内引流管分组。主要终点为需要再手术的复发情况。次要终点包括住院时间、抗生素治疗总时长和手术时间。结果：共识别80例手术，36例患者符合最终分析标准；其中8例（22.2%）放置了术后引流管，28例（77.8%）未放置。总体上，13例患者（36.1%）因影像学或临床进展需要再手术。放置引流管的患者中50%需再手术，而未放置者为32.1%。
items.abstract: Introduction: The routine insertion of a postoperative intracranial drain following surgical evacuation of brain abscesses or subdural empyemas is practiced by some surgeons to facilitate pus evacuation and to enable cavity lavage, but robust evidence for clinical benefit is lacking. This study evaluates whether postoperative drain placement affects reoperation rates, length of hospital stay, and duration of antibiotic therapy. Methods: We performed a retrospective review of consecutive adult patients who underwent surgical drainage or excision of a primary intracranial abscess or empyema at our tertiary center between January 2020 and January 2026. Patients were grouped by whether a postoperative intracranial drain was placed. The primary endpoint was recurrence requiring reoperation. Secondary endpoints included hospital length of stay, total duration of antibiotic therapy, and operative time. Continuous variables were compared with t-tests and categorical variables with Fisher’s exact test; p 0.05 was considered statistically significant. items.title: Association of Inpatient Diabetes Specialist Consultation with Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Diabetes Hospitalized for Lower Respiratory Tract Infections: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 住院糖尿病专家咨询与下呼吸道感染患者临床结果的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：糖尿病（DM）与下呼吸道感染（LRTI）的易感性增加及更严重的临床过程相关，包括住院时间延长和死亡率增加。本研究评估住院糖尿病专家咨询是否与这一高风险人群的临床结果改善相关。方法：我们对677名因LRTI住院的糖尿病成人进行了回顾性队列研究。专家咨询定义为在住院期间由内分泌科和/或糖尿病护士专家参与。结果包括住院时间（LOHS）和90天死亡率。结果：在677名患者中，84名（12.4%）接受了糖尿病专家咨询。接受咨询的患者90天未调整死亡率较低（4.8% vs. 17.5%，p < 0.05）。
items.abstract: Background: Diabetes mellitus (DM) is associated with an increased susceptibility to lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) and more severe clinical courses, including prolonged hospitalization and increased mortality. During LRTI-related hospitalizations, clinical management often prioritizes the acute respiratory condition, potentially under-recognizing DM-related multimorbidity. We evaluated whether inpatient diabetes specialist consultation is associated with improved outcomes in this high-risk population. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 677 adults with DM admitted for LRTI. Specialist consultation was defined as involvement of an endocrinology and/or diabetes nurse specialist during index hospitalization. Outcomes included length of hospital stay (LOHS) and 90-day mortality. Multivariable zero-truncated negative binomial regression (LOHS) and logistic regression (mortality) were adjusted for age, sex, Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI), National Early Warning Score (NEWS), and pre-admission insulin use, hypoglycemic events, and admission laboratory parameters. items.title: Targeting Lung Cancer Stem Cells with Trimebutine: Synergistic Antitumor Activity in Combination with Cisplatin
items.title_zh: 靶向肺癌干细胞的三美布汀：与顺铂联用的协同抗肿瘤活性
items.summary_zh: 肺癌复发和治疗抵抗由癌症干细胞（CSCs）驱动，但目前临床上缺乏针对CSCs的治疗。为筛选可行的抗CSCs药物，我们使用3D球体培养系统筛选了1018种FDA批准的药物，发现三美布汀是一种对肺CSC样细胞具有超过49.5倍选择性的有效药物。三美布汀显著抑制了H460-SP球体的形成能力，降低了细胞活力，并下调了关键的CSC表面标志物（CD133、CD44）及干性调节因子（c-MYC、EpCAM、BMI1、OCT3/4、NANOG、SOX2、SMAD3）。机制上，三美布汀抑制了过表达的钙和钾通道，减弱了Hippo通路中的YAP/TAZ–TEAD信号，诱导细胞凋亡。与顺铂联用时，三美布汀在H460-SP球体和患者来源的肺肿瘤类器官中表现出强协同效应，抑制细胞活力和凋亡相关蛋白的裂解。
items.abstract: Lung cancer recurrence and therapeutic resistance are driven by cancer stem cells (CSCs), yet clinically available CSC-targeted therapies remain lacking. To identify actionable anti-CSC agents, we screened 1018 FDA-approved drugs using a 3D sphere culture system enriching lung CSC-like cells. Trimebutine, a gastrointestinal motility regulator targeting G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), was identified as a potent agent with over 49.5-fold higher selectivity toward lung CSC-like cells (SI 49.55) compared with standard therapies such as cisplatin (SI = 1.39) and gefitinib (SI = 1.00). In H460-SP spheres, trimebutine markedly impaired sphere-forming capacity, reduced cell viability, and downregulated key CSC surface markers (CD133, CD44) alongside stemness regulators (c-MYC, EpCAM, BMI1, OCT3/4, NANOG, SOX2, SMAD3). Mechanistically, trimebutine suppressed overexpressed calcium and potassium channels (CACNA1F, CACNA1B, CACNA1E, CACNA1H, KCNH2), attenuating downstream YAP/TAZ–TEAD signaling within the Hippo pathway to trigger apoptosis. In combination with cisplatin, trimebutine exhibited strong synergistic efficacy (Chou–Talalay combination index, CI = 0.015–0.228) in H460-SP spheres
items.authors: JiHye Seo, Heejin Lee, Dong Kyu Choi, Young-Kyu Kim, Somin Woo, Changkyu Lee

items.title: Clinical Decision-Making After Receptor Conversion Following Neoadjuvant Therapy in Breast Cancer: A Three-Strategy Framework
items.title_zh: 新辅助治疗后乳腺癌受体转变的临床决策框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：新辅助治疗后受体转变可能影响乳腺癌患者的辅助系统治疗资格。然而，现有指南对受体变化后的生物标志物指导治疗调整提供的建议有限。本研究旨在描述受体转变后的临床决策，并识别一个适用于临床相关受体转变场景的治疗调整框架。方法：2025年8月至9月，在参与乳腺癌治疗的波兰医学肿瘤学家中进行了一项全国性横断面调查。问卷评估了五种受体转变场景下的受体重新评估实践和治疗建议。治疗决策根据是否依赖于治疗前生物标志物、残余疾病生物标志物或两者，分为三种预定义策略：基线驱动、残余疾病驱动和组合策略。结果：共有104名医学肿瘤学家完成了调查。52.9%的受访者报告在残余疾病中常规进行受体重新评估，73.1%在治疗规划中常规或选择性地纳入残余疾病生物标志物。总体而言，基线驱动策略仅占治疗决策的26.3%，而组合策略占40.2%，残余疾病驱动策略占33.5%。
items.abstract: Background: Receptor conversion following neoadjuvant therapy may alter eligibility for adjuvant systemic therapy in breast cancer. However, current guidelines provide limited recommendations for biomarker-guided treatment adaptation after receptor change. We aimed to characterize clinical decision-making after receptor conversion and identify a framework describing treatment adaptation across clinically relevant receptor conversion scenarios. Methods: A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted between August and September 2025 among Polish medical oncologists involved in breast cancer care. The questionnaire assessed receptor reassessment practices and treatment recommendations across five receptor conversion scenarios. Treatment decisions were classified into three predefined strategies—baseline-driven, residual disease-driven, and combined—according to whether they relied on pretreatment biomarkers, residual disease biomarkers, or both. Results: A total of 104 medical oncologists completed the survey. Routine receptor reassessment in residual disease was reported by 52.9% of respondents, while 73.1% incorporated residual disease biomarkers into treatment planning either r
items.authors: Katarzyna Pogoda, Magdalena Czopowicz, Wojciech Olszewski, Monika Durzynska, Piotr Jan Wysocki

items.title: Psoas Compartment Block Versus Medial Branch Block for Low Back Pain: A Narrative Review of Anatomical Targets, Clinical Evidence, and Patient Selection
items.title_zh: 腰大肌区块与内侧分支区块在腰痛中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：腰痛（LBP）是全球导致残疾年限的主要原因，影像引导的神经阻滞在其诊断和治疗中占据重要位置。内侧分支区块（MBB）针对腰椎背神经的内侧分支，而腰大肌区块（PCB）则针对L1-L4的腹侧神经，尽管解剖位置接近，但两者在文献中发展独立，且未在随机试验中直接比较。方法：本叙述性综述检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar，截止至2026年8月1日，综合了两种区块在腰痛患者中的解剖依据、技术表现、有效性和安全性。结果：MBB有广泛的诊断准确性数据和指南支持，但需控制阻滞以降低假阳性率，且仅提供短期疗效。PCB则能可靠地产生密集的腰丛镇痛，且围手术期效果明确。
items.abstract: Background: Low back pain (LBP) remains the leading global cause of years lived with disability, and image-guided nerve blocks occupy a central position in its diagnostic and therapeutic pathway. Two paraspinal targets separated by only a few centimetres of tissue address entirely different neural territories: the medial branch of the lumbar dorsal ramus, addressed by the medial branch block (MBB), and the ventral rami of L1–L4 that form the lumbar plexus within psoas major, addressed by the psoas compartment block (PCB). Despite this anatomical proximity, the two techniques have matured within largely separate literatures—interventional pain medicine for the MBB and regional anaesthesia for the PCB—and have never been compared head-to-head in a randomised trial. Methods: This narrative review searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar to 1 August 2026 and synthesises evidence on the anatomical rationale, technical performance, effectiveness, and safety of both blocks as they apply to patients presenting with LBP. Results: The MBB is supported by extensive diagnostic-accuracy data and guideline endorsement for facet-mediated axial pain, but re
items.authors: Chul Hee Jung, Seok Yeon Choi, Dong Ha Lee

items.title: Pediatric Eosinophil-Predominant Collagenous Gastritis: From Conventional Therapy to Dupilumab: A Case Report
items.title_zh: 儿童嗜酸性粒细胞占优的胶原性胃炎病例报告
items.summary_zh: 背景与临床意义：胶原性胃炎（CG）是一种罕见疾病，特征为上皮下胶原沉积，通常在儿童中表现为缺铁性贫血（IDA）和腹痛。其发病机制尚不明确，且缺乏标准化治疗。病例介绍：一名女性患者在4.5岁时出现IDA，需反复静脉输铁，并伴有反复上腹痛。13.5岁时诊断为CG，表现为明显的胃嗜酸性粒细胞增多（峰值685嗜酸性粒细胞/mm²）和上皮下胶原增厚（103.6μm）。经过广泛评估排除了其他原因。质子泵抑制剂（PPI）治疗未能显著改善症状、内镜发现或组织学。为期10周的口服系统性皮质类固醇治疗缓解了腹痛，正常化了血红蛋白和铁蛋白水平，但内镜异常持续，组织学改善有限，停药后疼痛复发。随后开始使用Dupilumab作为节省类固醇的组织学靶向治疗。15个月内，患者无症状，血红蛋白和铁蛋白水平正常，无需静脉输铁或常规口服铁补充，内镜异常有所改善，尽管残留的组织学异常仍然存在。Dupilumab使胃嗜酸性粒细胞计数和上皮下胶原增厚减少。
items.abstract: Background and Clinical Significance: Collagenous gastritis (CG) is a rare disorder characterized by subepithelial collagen deposition, typically presenting in children with iron deficiency anemia (IDA) and abdominal pain. Its pathogenesis remains unclear, and no standardized treatment exists. Case Presentation: A female patient developed IDA at 4.5 years of age, requiring repeated intravenous iron infusions, and recurrent epigastric pain. CG was diagnosed at 13.5 years, with marked gastric eosinophilia (peak 685 eosinophils/mm2) and subepithelial collagen thickening (103.6 μm). Extensive evaluation excluded alternative causes. Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) therapy failed to meaningfully improve symptoms, endoscopic findings, or histology. A 10-week course of oral systemic corticosteroids resolved abdominal pain and normalized hemoglobin and ferritin levels, but endoscopic abnormalities persisted, histologic improvement was limited, and pain recurred after withdrawal. Dupilumab was initiated as a steroid-sparing, histology-targeted therapy. Over 15 months, the patient remained asymptomatic, hemoglobin and ferritin levels remained normal without intravenous iron or routine oral iron s
items.authors: Maria Rogalidou, Amalia Patereli, Kalliopi Stefanaki, Konstantina Dimakou, Eleanna Stasinou, Vasiliki-Maria Karagianni

items.title: Biomimetic Nanocarriers for Glioblastoma Therapy: Translational Advances and Strategic Challenges
items.title_zh: 仿生纳米载体在胶质母细胞瘤治疗中的应用与挑战
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是最具侵袭性和最常见的脑肿瘤，具有快速生长和浸润的特点，并对常规治疗高度耐药。由于血脑屏障（BBB）对有效药物输送的持续挑战，亟需转变治疗策略。仿生纳米载体（BNCs）为恶性脑肿瘤的靶向治疗提供了有前景的方法。BNCs通过复制生物结构和功能，提高药物稳定性，促进穿越BBB，并实现肿瘤特异性靶向，同时降低全身毒性风险。BNCs可利用多种生物材料进行工程化，包括细胞膜、脂质体和聚合物系统。近期的临床前和早期临床研究表明，BNCs能够有效提高药物生物利用度和治疗活性。然而，仍存在配方稳定性、免疫原性、监管可接受性和大规模生产等多项转化挑战。本文讨论了BNCs在GBM治疗中的最新进展、药物靶向策略及其临床转化的结构性障碍，并探讨了将BNCs与免疫治疗和基因治疗相结合的新兴多模态方法，以增强个性化GBM治疗。
items.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most aggressive and common type of brain tumor, characterized by rapid growth and infiltration, as well as high resistance to conventional treatments. Given the persistent challenge posed by the bloodbrain barrier (BBB) to effective drug delivery, a shift in therapeutic strategies is required. Biomimetic nanocarriers (BNCs) represent a promising approach for the targeted treatment of malignant brain tumors. By replicating biological structures and functions, BNCs enhance drug stability, facilitate penetration across the BBB, and promote tumor-specific targeting while minimizing the risk of systemic toxicity. These nanocarriers can be engineered using a wide variety of biomaterials, including cell membranes, liposomes, and polymeric systems. Recent preclinical and early clinical studies suggest that BNCs provide a viable method to increase drug bioavailability and therapeutic activity. However, several translational challenges remain, including formulation stability, immunogenicity, regulatory acceptability, and large-scale manufacturing. This review discusses recent advances in BNCs for GBM treatment, drug-targeting strategies, and the structural hurdles t
items.authors: Bhawana Jain, Sunita Sanwaria, Arti Hadap, I Made Joni, Renny Febrida, Rovina Ruslami

items.title: Lactic Acid Bacteria-Fermented Natural Products: Mechanisms and Evidence for Ageing- and Stem-Cell-Related Outcomes
items.title_zh: 乳酸菌发酵天然产品对衰老及干细胞的影响机制研究
items.summary_zh: 衰老由慢性炎症、氧化应激和干细胞耗竭驱动，成为全球健康的重要挑战。乳酸菌（LAB）发酵被研究作为一种潜在的生物技术，以增强天然产品的生物利用度和功能性，尤其是具有抗衰老潜力的多酚和生物活性植物化学物质。本文综述了LAB发酵天然产品的最新进展及其在调节长寿通路和干细胞再生中的作用。LAB发酵通过释放或生物转化底物结合的植物化学物质，生成有机酸、肽及短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、环二肽（CDPs）或细菌外泌囊泡（BEVs）等代谢物，改变复杂的植物基质。细胞和动物模型中的候选机制包括调节核因子κB（NF-κB）、核因子红系2相关因子2（Nrf2）和AMP活化蛋白激酶-沉默信息调节因子1（AMPK–SIRT1）信号通路。部分LAB发酵制剂或LAB衍生成分与皮肤、骨骼和神经细胞或动物模型中的干细胞相关结果有关。CDPs和BEVs是潜在的发酵相关介质。
items.abstract: Ageing is driven by chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, and stem cell exhaustion, posing a major global health challenge. Lactic acid bacteria (LAB) fermentation is being investigated as a potential biotechnology to enhance the bioavailability and functionality of natural products, especially polyphenols and bioactive phytochemicals with anti-ageing potential. This review synthesizes recent advances in LAB-fermented natural products and their roles in modulating longevity pathways and stem cell regeneration. LAB fermentation can alter complex plant matrices by releasing or biotransforming substrate-bound phytochemicals and by generating metabolites such as organic acids, peptides, and, in some systems, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), cyclic dipeptides (CDPs), or bacterial extracellular vesicles (BEVs); the contribution of each component requires case-specific verification. In cellular and animal models, candidate mechanisms include modulation of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB), nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), and AMP-activated protein kinase–sirtuin 1 (AMPK–SIRT1) signaling, although causal active components are often unresolved. Some LAB-fermented preparati
items.authors: Luwei Wang, Sa-ouk Kang, Rui Liu, Bo Sun

items.title: Gestational Hypertension Has Increased, Affecting 1 in 10 Pregnancies
items.title_zh: 妊娠高血压发病率上升，影响每10例妊娠中有1例
items.summary_zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）国家生命统计系统的报告，妊娠高血压的发病率在2016年至2024年间增加了73%。这一数据表明，妊娠高血压已成为影响孕妇健康的重要因素，且其发病率的显著上升可能与多种因素有关，包括生活方式的变化和医疗保健的可及性。该研究强调了对妊娠高血压的早期识别和管理的重要性，以改善母婴健康结果。
items.abstract: The incidence of gestational hypertension increased by 73% from 2016 to 2024, according to a report from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Vital Statistics System.

items.title: FDA Approves First Freeze-Dried Plasma Product in the US
items.title_zh: FDA批准美国首个冻干血浆产品
items.summary_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）近日批准了美国首个冻干血浆产品。这一产品的批准标志着在血浆储存和运输方面的重要进展，能够在不需要冷藏的条件下保存血浆，延长其保质期并提高可及性。冻干血浆可用于紧急医疗情况，尤其是在战场或偏远地区的应用，能够为患者提供及时的治疗。该产品的临床试验结果显示，其在输血后的安全性和有效性与传统血浆相当，为未来血液制品的发展开辟了新的方向。
items.abstract: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the nation’s first freeze-dried plasma product.

items.title: GLP-1 Drugs Linked to Lower Fracture Risk in People With Type 2 Diabetes
items.title_zh: GLP-1药物与2型糖尿病患者骨折风险降低相关
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》的研究发现，胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂可能与2型糖尿病患者的脆性骨折风险降低相关。研究分析了使用GLP-1药物的患者与未使用者的骨折发生率，结果显示，接受GLP-1治疗的患者骨折风险显著降低。这一发现提示GLP-1药物在2型糖尿病管理中可能具有额外的骨骼保护作用，为临床实践提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists may be associated with a lower risk of fragility fracture in patients with type 2 diabetes, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.

items.title: AAP, ACOG Speak Out Against Executive Order
items.title_zh: AAP与ACOG对行政命令发表声明
items.summary_zh: 美国儿科学会（AAP）和美国妇产科医师学会（ACOG）发表声明，批评近期关于儿童疫苗建议的行政命令。两大组织指出，该命令可能会对儿童的健康产生负面影响，并呼吁政府重新考虑其立场，以确保儿童能够获得安全有效的疫苗接种。AAP和ACOG强调，疫苗接种是保护儿童免受严重疾病的重要措施，任何政策都应基于科学证据和公共健康的最佳利益。
items.abstract: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) and the American College of Obstetricians Gynecologists (ACOG) released statements criticizing a recent executive order on childhood vaccine recommendations.

items.title: Will Autonomous AI Exceed AI-Aided Physicians as the Best Medical Care?
items.title_zh: 自主人工智能是否会超越医生提供最佳医疗服务？
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了医生主导的医疗护理与人工智能（AI）提供的医疗服务的优缺点。研究对象包括不同医疗场景下的医生与AI的表现，分析了两者在诊断准确性、治疗效果和患者满意度等方面的差异。通过对比现有文献和临床案例，发现尽管AI在数据处理和分析速度上具有优势，但医生在情感交流和复杂决策中仍然占据重要地位。结论认为，未来医疗服务可能是医生与AI的协作，而非单一的主导者。
items.abstract: This Perspective discusses the advantages and disadvantages of physician-led medical care vs that provided by artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: Accelerating Workforce Well-Being
items.title_zh: 加速提升员工福祉
items.summary_zh: 致编辑：近期一篇观点文章将临床医生的职业倦怠视为系统性问题，借鉴了患者安全与质量运动的经验教训。文章强调，改善员工福祉需要从系统层面进行干预，关注工作环境、团队支持和组织文化等因素，以减少职业倦怠的发生。通过对比患者安全运动的成功案例，作者提出了一系列可行的策略，旨在提升医疗工作者的整体福祉，最终改善患者护理质量。
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent Perspective framed clinician burnout as a systems-level issue, describing lessons from parallels to the patient safety and quality movement.

items.title: Non–US-Born Physicians in the US Internal Medicine Workforce
items.title_zh: 美国内科医师中的非美国出生医生研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究估算了美国内科医师队伍中美国出生医师（USMGs）与非美国出生医师（IMGs）的比例，以及这些医师所照顾的弱势患者的比例。通过分析相关数据，研究发现非美国出生的医师在内科领域中占据了重要地位，并且他们为弱势群体提供了显著的医疗服务。这一发现强调了非美国出生医师在美国医疗体系中的关键角色，尤其是在满足医疗需求较高的社区中。
items.abstract: This study estimates the share of US-born and non–US-born US medical graduates (USMGs) and international medical graduates (IMGs) in the US internal medicine workforce, as well as the share of underserved patients cared for by these physicians.

items.title: Prognostic Value of Blood-Based P-Tau217 Levels for Progression to Cognitive Impairment
items.title_zh: 血液中P-Tau217水平对认知障碍进展的预后价值
items.summary_zh: 本队列研究评估了血液生物标志物磷酸化tau 217（p-tau217）在认知正常老年人群中，进展为认知障碍的绝对风险及认知衰退率。研究对象为认知正常的老年人，通过测量血浆p-tau217水平，分析其与认知障碍进展的相关性。结果显示，p-tau217水平较高的个体在随访期间更可能出现认知功能下降，提示该生物标志物可能在早期识别认知障碍风险方面具有重要价值。研究结论强调了p-tau217作为潜在预后指标的意义。
items.abstract: This cohort study examines the absolute risk of progression to cognitive impairment and rates of cognitive decline per the blood-based biomarker plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) among cognitively unimpaired older adults.

items.title: The Role of the OSM/OSMRβ Axis in Chronic Liver Disease Progression and Hepatocellular Carcinoma Development: A Focus on MASLD/MASH
items.title_zh: OSM/OSMRβ轴在慢性肝病与肝细胞癌中的作用研究
items.summary_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）是全球慢性肝病（CLD）的主要原因，全球患病率约为30%。尽管近期批准了两种药物（Resmetirom和Semaglutide），但其在阻止或减缓代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）及肝纤维化进展方面的效果仅限于部分患者，且目前尚无关于这些药物在代偿性肝硬化或肝细胞癌（HCC）发展中的疗效数据。此外，缺乏可靠的生物标志物来识别MASH患者的疾病进展和HCC风险。本文讨论了白细胞介素6家族细胞因子Oncostatin M（OSM）及其受体β（OSMRβ轴）在MASLD/MASH进展和HCC发展中的作用，强调OSM及相关通路在促进慢性炎症和纤维生成中的选择性作用。OSM/OSMRβ轴可能参与MASH相关HCC的发展。
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) represents the emerging leading cause of Chronic Liver Disease (CLD) worldwide, with a global prevalence of approximately 30% in the general population that parallels global rates of obesity and Type 2 Diabetes (T2D). Although two drugs (Resmetirom and Semaglutide) have been recently approved for clinical use, their ability to block or slow down disease progression to metabolic dysfunction-associated Steatohepatitis (MASH) and liver fibrosis is limited to a subset of patients, and no data are available at present for the efficacy of these drugs in compensated cirrhosis or in relation to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. Moreover, there is a lack of reliable biomarkers able to identify MASH patients at risk of disease progression and/or HCC development. In line with the knowledge that pro-inflammatory cytokines play a key role in MASLD/MASH progression and HCC development, in this review, we will discuss the role in this disease and other CLDs of Oncostatin M (OSM), a cytokine belonging to the IL6 family, and of pathways involving OSM and its receptor β (OSM/OSMRβ axis). OSM and related pathways are emerging
items.authors: Beatrice Foglia, Jessica Nurcis, Marta Signorini, Erica Novo, Claudia Bocca, Stefania Cannito

items.title: LUCID: Intelligent Informative Frame Selection in Otoscopy for Enhanced Diagnostic Utility
items.title_zh: LUCID：耳镜检查中智能信息框架选择以增强诊断效用
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：中耳疾病的准确诊断仍然具有挑战性，因为耳镜解读具有主观性，而许多人工智能模型依赖于从视频检查中手动选择的静态帧。我们旨在开发并内部评估LUCID，一个系统框架，用于自动识别耳镜视频中最具信息量的帧。方法：我们分析了491名患者的713个耳镜视频。LUCID结合了ResNet-50分类器进行粗略的耳膜可见性评估，BC-AdvCAM用于弱监督耳膜定位和覆盖估计，以及耳镜特定的模糊/聚焦评估，形成视频内的帧排名得分。自动选择的帧与专家选择的帧通过盲评和后续分类进行比较。为了将排名质量与包大小和多帧聚合的影响分开，使用均匀时间采样评估了匹配的12帧对照。结果：在293对具有完整评分的视频中，算法选择的帧在74.7%的评估中被评为与专家选择的帧相等或更好。然而，当评估者表达非相等偏好时，专家帧在71.7%和70.7%的情况下被两位评估者偏好。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Accurate diagnosis of middle ear disease remains challenging because otoscopic interpretation is subjective, while many artificial intelligence models depend on manually selected still frames from video examinations. We aimed to develop and internally evaluate LUCID, a systematic framework for automatically identifying the most informative frames in otoscopy videos. Methods: We analyzed 713 otoscopy videos from 491 patients. LUCID combines a ResNet-50 classifier for coarse eardrum-visibility assessment, BC-AdvCAM for weakly supervised eardrum localization and coverage estimation, and an otoscope-specific blur/focus assessment into a within-video frame-ranking score. Automated selections were compared with expert-selected frames through blinded human review and downstream classification. To separate ranking quality from the effects of bag size and multi-frame aggregation, a matched 12-frame control using uniform temporal sampling was evaluated with the same ResNet-50 and attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) pipeline. Results: Among 293 video pairs with complete ratings, algorithm-selected frames were rated equal to or better than expert-selected

items.title: Clinical Factors Associated with Anxiety Disorders in Adults with Childhood Hypospadias Repair: Results from the F.R.E.S.H. Study
items.title_zh: 与儿童阴茎下裂修复相关的成人焦虑障碍临床因素研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：本研究旨在评估经历儿童阴茎下裂修复的成人中病理性焦虑的流行率，并识别与焦虑障碍相关的临床、功能和手术因素。方法：本横断面分析纳入了18岁及以上的男性患者，他们在儿童时期接受过阴茎下裂的外科治疗，并进行了临床评估及填写了评估焦虑（状态-特质焦虑量表，STAI-Y1/Y2）、抑郁（贝克抑郁量表-II）、泌尿功能（尿流率和国际前列腺症状评分）、性功能和生殖感知的有效问卷。病理性焦虑定义为STAI-Y1 ≥ 40。通过单变量分析比较有无焦虑的患者，并将达到统计显著性的变量纳入二元逻辑回归模型，以识别与焦虑独立相关的临床变量。结果：本研究共纳入302名1975年至2005年间接受阴茎下裂手术的患者，其中113名（37.4%）成功联系，最终36名成年男性患者符合纳入标准（评估时平均年龄23.6岁）。14名患者（38.9%）存在病理性焦虑。与非焦虑个体相比，焦虑患者年龄较小。
items.abstract: Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of pathological anxiety and to identify clinical, functional, and surgical factors associated with anxiety disorders in adults who underwent hypospadias repair during childhood. Patients and Methods: This cross-sectional analysis included adult males (≥18 years) previously treated surgically for hypospadias in childhood who underwent clinical evaluation and completed validated questionnaires assessing anxiety (State–Trait Anxiety Inventory, STAI-Y1/Y2), depression (Beck Depression Inventory-II), urological function (uroflowmetry and International Prostate Symptom Score), sexual function, and genital perception. Pathological anxiety was defined as STAI-Y1 ≥ 40. Patients with and without anxiety were compared using univariate analyses, and variables reaching statistical significance were entered into a binary logistic regression model to identify clinical variables independently associated with anxiety. Results: A total of 302 patients who underwent hypospadias surgery between 1975 and 2005 were included in this study. items.title: Effects of Dietary Melissa officinalis Supplementation on Hematological, Neuroendocrine, and Behavioral Parameters in Weaned Piglets and in the Beginning of the Fattening Period
items.title_zh: 饮食中添加香蜂草对断奶仔猪血液及行为参数的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估饮食中添加香蜂草（Melissa officinalis）对断奶仔猪的血液学、生化、神经内分泌及行为参数的影响，以及在社会竞争条件下转入肥育阶段后与社会等级建立相关的行为。研究对象为48头猪，分为对照组和实验组。在55天的实验期间，实验组猪的饮食中逐渐添加干燥的香蜂草叶，日均量从3.20克增加至9.60克，实验期间的平均日量为6.99克。评估了生长期间的行为反应、血清中血清素和皮质醇浓度，以及血液学和生化参数。转入肥育阶段后，监测了与社会等级建立相关的攻击性行为。结果显示，添加香蜂草显著增加了白细胞（WBC）、淋巴细胞（LYM）和单核细胞（MON）计数，以及血清中血清素浓度（p < 0.001）。
items.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the effects of dietary supplementation with Melissa officinalis on the haematological, biochemical, neuroendocrine, and behavioural parameters of weaned pigs, as well as on behaviours associated with the establishment of social hierarchy following transfer to the fattening stage under conditions of social competition. The study included 48 pigs allocated to control and experimental treatments. Over the 55-day experimental period, pigs in the experimental treatment received dried Melissa officinalis leaf material incorporated into the diet, with the daily amount gradually increasing from 3.20 to 9.60 g/animal/day. The mean daily amount administered throughout the experimental period was 6.99 g/animal/day, approximately 7.0 g/animal/day. During the growing period, behavioural responses, serum serotonin and cortisol concentrations, and haematological and biochemical parameters were assessed. Following transfer to the fattening stage, agonistic behaviour associated with the establishment of social hierarchy was monitored. items.title: Global Food Security in a Climate-Oscillating World: Spectral Evidence and Early Warning Implications for Sustainable Food Systems
items.title_zh: 气候波动世界中的全球粮食安全：频谱证据与早期预警启示
items.summary_zh: 2022年3月，粮农组织食品价格指数达到159.7，气候冲击与地缘政治动荡交织，全球饥饿人数超过7.35亿，揭示了气候变异对农业食品系统经济的深刻影响。本研究首次系统性地在频域中分析了气候与食品价格的关系，匹配了太平洋、大西洋和印度洋盆地的7个气候指数与粮农组织食品价格指数的5个分项，基于432个月的观测数据（1990-2025），并通过6项稳健性检验验证结果。研究发现，ENSO指标领先全球食品价格3至4个月，印度洋偶极子则领先约1至2年，明显延长了早期预警的时间范围。此外，大西洋多年代际振荡与价格的相关性被揭示为一种常见的经济信号。
items.abstract: In March 2022, the FAO Food Price Index peaked at 159.7 as climate shocks collided with geopolitical disruption, pushing global hunger past 735 million and exposing how deeply climate variability penetrates the economics of agri-food systems. Yet the imprint of ocean–atmosphere oscillations on global food prices—the central economic signal of the agri-food system—has not, to our knowledge, been mapped systematically in the frequency domain. This study delivers, to our knowledge, one of the first multi-oscillation cross-spectral analyses of the climate–food price nexus, matching 7 climate indices across the Pacific, Atlantic, and Indian Ocean basins with 5 disaggregated FAO Food Price Index sub-components over 432 monthly observations (1990–2025), verified through 6 robustness checks, including surrogate data testing. Four findings carry direct policy relevance. ENSO indicators lead global food prices by three to four months with a 100% surrogate test pass rate—one of the cleanest actionable climate–price signals documented to date. items.authors: Kostiantyn Pavlov, Olena Pavlova, Oksana Liashenko, Tomasz Wołowiec, Maksym Zhytar, Sylwester Bogacki

items.title: Development of a Recombinant O/CATHAY Topotype Foot-and-Mouth Disease Virus as a Resource for Vaccine Matching and Efficacy Evaluation
items.title_zh: 重组O/CATHAY型口蹄疫病毒的开发及其疫苗匹配评估资源
items.summary_zh: O型口蹄疫病毒仍然是全球威胁，尤其是在东南亚的O/CATHAY型。由于对新出现的野外分离株获取的时效性有限，反向遗传学为生成代表选定流行株的病毒提供了灵活的方法。本文生成了O/CATH/APQA-V18，并评估其在猪中的疫苗评估适用性。基于病毒蛋白-1的系统发育分析，选择了一株现代越南O/CATHAY株，并将其P1衣壳编码区整合到O1 Manisa骨架中。通过实时反转录聚合酶链反应、透射电子显微镜和序列分析对重组病毒进行了表征。使用针对O/PanAsia-2和O/Primorsky的血清进行的二维病毒中和试验显示抗原关系值分别为0.04和0.11，表明抗原匹配较差。在体内实验中，O/CATH/APQA-V18在未接种疫苗的猪中诱导了临床症状，确认其感染性和致病性。接种疫苗的猪在挑战前对O/CATH/APQA-V18的中和抗体滴度较低，仅有25%获得保护。这些发现支持O/CATH/APQA-V18作为一种基因定义且可重复的实验病毒，用于疫苗匹配和保护效力评估。
items.abstract: Foot-and-mouth disease virus serotype O remains a global threat, particularly the O/CATHAY topotype in East and Southeast Asia. Because timely access to emerging field isolates can be limited, reverse genetics provides a flexible approach for generating viruses representing selected circulating strains for vaccine matching and efficacy evaluation. Here, we generated O/CATH/APQA-V18 and evaluated its suitability for vaccine assessment in pigs. A contemporary Vietnamese O/CATHAY strain was selected based on viral protein-1 phylogenetic analysis, and its P1 capsid-coding region was incorporated into an O1 Manisa backbone using reverse genetics. The recombinant virus was characterized by real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, transmission electron microscopy, and sequence analysis. Two-dimensional virus neutralization tests using sera against O/PanAsia-2 and O/Primorsky yielded antigenic relationship values of 0.04 and 0.11, respectively, indicating poor antigenic matching. items.title: Alternative splicing of synaptotagmin 7 regulates oligomerization and short-term synaptic plasticity
items.title_zh: 突触素7的选择性剪接调控聚合与短期突触可塑性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了突触素7（syt7）在突触可塑性中的关键调节作用。我们发现选择性剪接作为一种主要机制，影响syt7的聚合状态，从而调节突触的短期可塑性。通过对syt7不同剪接变体的功能分析，我们揭示了其在突触强度动态调整中的重要性。这些发现为理解神经元间的信号传递及其可塑性提供了新的视角，可能对神经系统疾病的研究具有重要意义。

items.title: Audio Highlights August 21, 2026
items.title_zh: 2026年8月21日音频亮点
items.summary_zh: 本文为《美国医学会杂志》（JAMA）编辑摘要，概述了该期刊中重要文章的讨论与分析。通过对最新研究的回顾，编辑总结了关键发现和临床意义，涉及多个医学领域的前沿进展。文章强调了研究对象的多样性和方法的严谨性，提供了对当前医学实践的深刻见解。具体数据和结论将有助于临床医生和研究人员更好地理解最新的医学动态与挑战。
items.abstract: Listen to the JAMA Editor’s Summary for an overview and discussion of the important articles appearing in JAMA.

items.title: Are E-Scooters More Dangerous Than Motorcycles and Bicycles?
items.title_zh: 电动滑板车的危险性是否高于摩托车和自行车？
items.summary_zh: 根据最近的一项研究，电动滑板车骑行者面临的某些伤害风险可能高于摩托车和自行车骑行者。研究对象包括电动滑板车、摩托车和自行车的骑行者，采用了对比分析的方法，评估了不同交通工具骑行者的受伤情况。研究发现，电动滑板车骑行者在发生事故时，受伤的概率和严重程度显著高于摩托车和自行车骑行者。这表明，电动滑板车的使用可能带来更高的安全隐患，提示相关部门在推广电动滑板车时应加强安全教育和管理措施。
items.abstract: E-scooter riders may face higher risk of certain injuries than motorcyclists and bicyclists, according to a recent study.

items.title: The Organoid Era
items.title_zh: 类器官时代的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了以人为中心的研究模型的推动，特别是从人类细胞培养的迷你器官，以补充或替代动物实验。这些类器官能够模拟人类生理和病理状态，为药物开发和疾病研究提供了更为精准的工具。研究表明，类器官在再生医学、癌症研究和药物筛选等领域展现出良好的应用前景，可能会改变传统的生物医学研究方法。通过这种新兴技术，科学家们希望能够更好地理解人类疾病机制，提高治疗效果。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses a push for human-centric research models, such as mini-organs grown from human cells, to complement or replace animal studies.

items.title: GLP-1s—From Gut Hormone Discovery to a Public Health Revolution
items.title_zh: GLP-1：从肠道激素发现到公共卫生革命
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）的起源及其未来发展。由医学博士Derek C. Angus和哥本哈根大学医学生理学教授Jens Juul Holst及DMSc教授Lotte Bjerre Knudsen共同探讨。GLP-1作为一种重要的肠道激素，近年来在糖尿病和肥胖治疗中展现出显著的潜力。研究表明，GLP-1不仅能够促进胰岛素分泌，还能抑制食欲，改善代谢健康。这一发现为公共卫生政策的制定提供了新的视角，可能引领一场针对代谢疾病的革命。
items.abstract: The origins of glucagon-like peptide-1s (GLP-1s) and what comes next are discussed by JAMA Senior Editor Derek C. Angus, MD, MPH, and Jens Juul Holst, MD, DMSc, a professor of medical physiology at the University of Copenhagen, and Lotte Bjerre Knudsen, DMSc, professor, for the Healthy Dialogue podcast.

items.title: The Original “Yes”
items.title_zh: 原始的“是”
items.summary_zh: 在这篇叙事医学论文中，一位医院牧师呼吁同事们理解给予与接受的阴阳关系，视其为信仰与抵抗的行为。通过分享个人经历和观察，作者强调了在医疗环境中建立信任与支持的重要性，指出这种互动不仅能促进患者的康复，也能增强医护人员的心理韧性。文章探讨了在面对挑战时，如何通过互相给予和接受来实现更深层次的连接与理解，最终促进整体健康与福祉。
items.abstract: In this narrative medicine essay, a hospital chaplain exhorts her colleagues to understand the yin and yang of giving and receiving as an act of faith and resistance.

items.title: unspoken
items.title_zh: 无声的爱
items.summary_zh: 今天，我看到一位患有失语症的帕金森病男性，用手背轻轻抚摸妻子的脸颊，深情地说：“我更深地爱着你。”他的表达比我听过的任何语言都更为动人，瞬间充满了我的心，也将其撕裂。这一幕展示了非语言交流的力量，强调了情感的深度与人际关系的亲密，超越了言语的局限。
items.abstract: today I saw an aphasic Parkinsonian man say: I love you more profoundly to his wife with a careful loving caress of her cheek with the back of his hand than any words I have heard spoken it simultaneously filled my heart and blew it to pieces

items.title: Accelerating Workforce Well-Being—Reply
items.title_zh: 加速提升员工福祉的回应
items.summary_zh: 在回应中，我们感谢Nadkarni博士和Fromson博士对我们关于加速员工福祉的观点所提出的深思熟虑的信件。我们同意交叉性在理解和解决职业倦怠方面至关重要。
items.abstract: In Reply We appreciate the thoughtful letter by Drs Nadkarni and Fromson regarding our Perspective on accelerating workforce well-being. We agree that intersectionality is essential to understanding and addressing burnout.

items.title: Projected ecosystem responses to environmental changes associated with offshore wind farms and ocean warming
items.title_zh: 海上风电场与海洋变暖对生态系统的影响预测
items.summary_zh: 海上风电场（OWFs）正在迅速扩展，以满足对可再生能源日益增长的需求，预计将进一步向深水区发展。为了更好地理解OWFs的长期生态后果及其与气候变化的相互作用，我们使用耦合的水动力-生态-生物地球化学水柱模型（GOTM-ERSEM-BFM）研究了与OWFs和气候变暖相关的环境变化对生态系统的影响。我们考察了与OWFs相关的情景，包括底栖悬浮摄食活动减少（可能由于污染物排放）和风强度降低，以及海表温度升高。这些情景在北海两个对比位置进行模拟，分别代表良混合的沿海站点和季节性分层的离岸站点。沿海站点的生态系统反应相对温和，而离岸站点的反应则普遍较强，分层变化影响了垂直营养物质动态，导致表层和底层生态系统反应显著不同。
items.abstract: Offshore wind farms (OWFs) are rapidly expanding to meet growing demands for renewable energy, with development expected to extend further offshore into deeper waters. Given this expanded human footprint, it is important to better understand the long-term ecological consequences of OWFs and how these may interact with ongoing climate change. We used the coupled hydrodynamic-ecosystem-biogeochemical water-column model (GOTM-ERSEM-BFM) to investigate ecosystem-wide responses to environmental changes associated with OWFs and climate warming. Specifically, we examined OWF-related scenarios of reduced benthic suspension-feeding activity, representing potential effects of contaminant emissions from OWFs, and reduced wind forcing, together with increased sea surface temperature. The scenarios were simulated individually and in combination to explore potential interactive effects. These scenarios were simulated at two contrasting locations in the North Sea, representing a well-mixed coastal site and a seasonally stratified offshore site. The coastal site exhibited comparatively modest ecosystem responses across the scenarios, whereas responses were generally stronger at the deeper offshore
items.authors: Dye, B.; Peck, M. A.; van der Molen, J.

items.title: Cell death and growth dynamics shape DNA-replication-based estimates of microbial growth
items.title_zh: 细胞死亡与生长动态影响微生物生长的DNA复制估计
items.summary_zh: 推断细菌生长速率对理解微生物相互作用和群落动态至关重要，但在自然环境中，由于时间点有限或生物难以培养，这一过程仍然困难。本文使用起始-终止比率（PTR）来估计DNA复制活性。尽管PTR理论上与细菌生长速率相关，但常常与反映细胞分裂与损失平衡的人口增长速率进行基准比较。我们开发了一个随机细胞模型，明确跟踪DNA复制、细胞分裂和细胞死亡，以量化稳态生长偏离对PTR和细菌生长速率的影响。研究表明，瞬时应激引起的死亡和异质生存可能导致PTR无法反映人口增长速率，但仍能反映细菌生长速率。通过对大肠杆菌进行渗透冲击或抗生素处理，实验验证了这些预测。
items.abstract: Inferring bacterial growth rates is fundamental to understanding microbial interactions and community dynamics, but remains difficult in natural settings where time points are limited or organisms are unculturable. In these cases, a widely used method is the origin-to-terminus ratio, or peak-to-trough ratio (PTR), which estimates DNA replication activity from origin and terminus copy numbers. Although PTR is theoretically related to bacterial growth rate, it is frequently benchmarked against population growth rate, which reflects the balance between cell division and loss. Understanding when and why these measures diverge is therefore important for validating PTR-based approaches. To quantify how departures from steady growth affect PTR, population growth rate, and bacterial growth rate, we developed a stochastic, cell-based model that explicitly tracks DNA replication, cell division, and cell death. We show that transient stress-induced mortality and heterogeneous survival can cause PTR to fail to reflect population growth rate while still reflecting bacterial growth rate. We experimentally validated these predictions by exposing \textit{Escherichia coli} to osmotic shock or antib
items.authors: Hunter, M.; Ghezzi, H.; Jain, A.; He, J.; Tropini, C.

items.title: RNA Structure Coordinates Translation Across the Meiotic Program
items.title_zh: RNA结构协调减数分裂中的翻译过程
items.summary_zh: mRNA结构显著调节个别转录本的翻译效率，但其在多个转录本间协调翻译的作用尚不明确。减数分裂提供了一个理想的测试案例，涉及在染色体凝缩条件下，数百个mRNA的基因表达大规模变化。我们对酵母减数分裂中的mRNA结构进行了分析，生成了一个高分辨率的结构组，涵盖约70%的注释mRNA，包括2,084个转录本的多时间点测量。在减数分裂期间上调的转录本通常采用灵活的结构以增强翻译，而具有复杂5' UTR和编码区结构的mRNA则显示出翻译抑制，表明RNA结构在减数分裂翻译中起着全局性作用。此外，我们观察到细胞质RNA解旋酶水平在减数分裂中呈现高-低-高的波动。这些发现支持RNA结构和解旋酶表达共同作用于数百个mRNA的阶段特异性翻译的模型，高结构化转录本在晚期被选择性翻译。与此模型一致，破坏丰度转录本CCW22的结构或改变Ded1p解旋酶水平以RNA结构依赖的方式损害了减数分裂进程。我们的研究揭示了RNA结构的协同作用。
items.abstract: mRNA structure clearly modulates translation efficiency for individual transcripts, yet its role in coordinating translation across many transcripts remains poorly defined. Meiosis offers a compelling test case, involving large-scale gene expression changes coordinated across hundreds of mRNAs under conditions where transcription is constrained by chromosome condensation. We profiled mRNA structures across yeast meiosis, generating a high-resolution structurome encompassing ~70% of annotated mRNAs, including multi-time-point measurements for 2,084 transcripts. Transcripts upregulated during meiosis generally adopt flexible structures that enhance translation, whereas mRNAs with complex 5' UTR and coding-region structures show suppressed translation, indicating that RNA structure globally shapes meiotic translation. We further observed a high-low-high oscillation in cytoplasmic RNA helicase levels across meiosis. Together, these findings support a model in which RNA structure and helicase expression act jointly to program stage-specific translation of hundreds of mRNAs, with highly structured transcripts selectively translated at late stages. Consistent with this model, disrupting t
items.authors: Wu, H.; Zhou, C.; Du, S.; Felder, S.; Xiong, Y.; Weeks, K.; Bai, Y.

items.title: ACAD10 encodes two orphan enzymes in the ether lipid biosynthetic and salvage pathways
items.title_zh: ACAD10编码醚脂生物合成与回收途径中的两种孤儿酶
items.summary_zh: 醚脂在膜动态、抗氧化防御和信号传导中发挥重要作用，约占哺乳动物磷脂的20%。其代谢紊乱会导致严重的遗传疾病，并与神经退行性和代谢疾病相关。醚脂可由糖酵解中间体新合成或从饮食中回收。尽管已知这些途径的产物，但一些关键酶仍未被鉴定，包括1-O-烷基甘油激酶和1-O-烷基-2-乙酰-sn-甘油-3-磷酸磷酸酶。我们发现，酰基-CoA脱氢酶成员10（ACAD10）催化1-O-烷基甘油的磷酸化和1-O-烷基-2-乙酰-sn-甘油-3-磷酸的去磷酸化。缺乏ACAD10的线虫和小鼠醚脂水平降低，无法回收饮食中的烷基甘油。此外，携带ACAD10多态性的Akimel O'odham（皮马）部落个体也显示出血浆醚脂水平降低。我们的研究填补了醚脂生物化学中的两个长期空白，并揭示了醚脂代谢与2型糖尿病相关风险因素之间的机制联系。
items.abstract: Ether lipids play critical roles in membrane dynamics, antioxidant defense, and signaling. They comprise ~20% of mammalian phospholipids, and disruptions in their metabolism cause severe genetic disorders and are associated with neurodegenerative and metabolic diseases. Ether lipids are synthesized de novo from glycolytic intermediates or salvaged from the diet. While the products of these pathways are known, several key enzymes remain unidentified, including the 1-O-alkylglycerol kinase and the 1-O-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate phosphatase. Here, we show that acyl-CoA dehydrogenase member 10 (ACAD10) catalyzes the phosphorylation of 1-O-alkylglycerols and the dephosphorylation of 1-O-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate. Worms and mice lacking ACAD10 have reduced ether lipid levels and cannot salvage dietary alkylglycerols. Furthermore, individuals from the Akimel O'odham (Pima) tribe carrying ACAD10 polymorphisms also show decreased plasma ether lipid levels. Collectively, our findings resolve two long-standing gaps in ether lipid biochemistry and reveal a mechanistic link between ether lipid metabolism and a population-associated risk factor for type 2 diabetes.
