items.title: SEAHORSE: A Serendipity Engine Assaying Heterogeneous Omics-Related Sampling Experiments
items.title_zh: SEAHORSE：异质组学相关采样实验的偶然发现引擎
items.summary_zh: 大型公共分子图谱如基因型-组织表达（GTEx）项目和癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）促进了系统发现，但大多数分析仍以假设驱动，仅探讨表型、临床和分子变量之间极小的关系。我们开发了SEAHORSE（异质组学相关采样实验的偶然发现引擎），这是一个发现引擎及其R包，全面预计算异质数据类型之间的所有成对关联，并呈现为可搜索的关联景观。在GTEx（948名捐赠者，43种组织，154种表型）中，SEAHORSE生成了341,008个表型-表型关联、125,246,938个表型-基因关联和10,269,910,410个基因-基因相关性。在涵盖TCGA中33种肿瘤类型的分析中，SEAHORSE生成了625,042个表型-表型关联、183,080,369个表型-基因关联和12,096,948,950个基因-基因相关性。GTEx中，身高与转录程序的富集反复相关，尤其是“癌症途径”这一KEGG术语在17种组织中显著，提供了身高与癌症风险之间长期报告的分子切入点。身高还与免疫、心血管和神经程序相关。在TCGA中，年龄与多种关联一致。
items.abstract: Large public molecular atlases such as the Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) project and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) invite systematic discovery, yet most analyses remain hypothesis-driven and interrogate a tiny fraction of possible relationships among phenotypic, clinical, and molecular variables. We developed SEAHORSE (Serendipity Engine Assaying Heterogeneous Omics-Related Sampling Experiments), a discovery engine and accompanying R package that exhaustively precomputes all pairwise associations across heterogeneous data types and presents them as a searchable association landscape. Using GTEx (948 donors, 43 tissues, 154 phenotypes), SEAHORSE generated 341,008 phenotype-phenotype associations, 125,246,938 phenotype-gene associations, and 10,269,910,410 gene-gene correlations. In parallel analyses spanning 33 tumor types in TCGA, SEAHORSE generated 625,042 phenotype-phenotype associations, 183,080,369 phenotype-gene associations, and 12,096,948,950 gene-gene correlations. Across GTEx, height was repeatedly associated with enrichment of transcriptional programs, most strikingly the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) term "Pathways in Cancer," significant in 17 tiss
items.authors: Quackenbush, A.; Kolluri, J.; Biju, R.; Nhong, S.; DeConti, D.; Wu, H.; Quackenbush, J.; Saha, E.; Eicher, T. D.

items.title: Lipid tail chemistry regulates selective membrane interactions with model DNA nanoprobes and DNA-based coacervates
items.title_zh: 脂质尾部化学调控DNA纳米探针与膜的选择性相互作用
items.summary_zh: 生物膜通过调节其成分来优化包装、流动性、相位和表面电荷等关键特性，从而影响生物分子相互作用。尽管膜表面电荷通常归因于特定的脂质头基，但脂肪链化学在调节这些生物物理膜特性之间的相互作用中的作用尚未被探讨。本文系统研究了脂肪链长度和饱和度的变化如何调节两性离子脂质膜中的脂质包装、流动性和膜表面电荷。我们使用两性DNA纳米探针作为模型带电生物分子，描述了包装、流动性、相位和电荷之间的相互作用，并确定了一种依赖于包装的膜相互作用指导原则。研究还表明，纳米探针中膜锚的身份和疏水性显著影响其与膜的结合。我们的发现为设计生物分子附着的膜相互作用提供了机制框架，适用于DNA纳米探针和DNA基共聚物。
items.abstract: Biological membranes actively regulate their composition to fine-tune their packing, fluidity, phase and surface charge, key properties that influence biomolecular interactions driving essential cellular pathways. While membrane surface charge is often attributed to specific lipid headgroups, the role of acyl-chain chemistry in modulating the interplay between these biophysical membrane properties remains unexplored. Here, we systematically investigate how variations in acyl chain length and saturation modulate lipid packing, fluidity, and membrane surface charge in zwitterionic lipid membranes. Using amphiphilic DNA nanoprobes as model charged biomolecules, we describe the interplay between packing, fluidity, phase and charge, identifying a packing-dependent guiding principle for membrane interactions that persists in the presence of anionic lipids. We also demonstrate that the identity and hydrophobicity of membrane anchors in nanoprobes significantly influence their binding to membranes. By integrating acyl-chain chemistry with membrane biophysical properties into design criteria for biomolecular attachment, our findings provide a mechanistic framework to engineer membrane inter

items.title: Quadratic and adaptive computations yield an efficient representation of song in Drosophila auditory receptor neurons
items.title_zh: 果蝇听觉受体神经元中歌曲的高效表示研究
items.summary_zh: 感官神经元通过多种自适应和非线性计算来转化刺激。在果蝇中，听觉受体神经元对声学刺激的均值和强度进行适应，随着声音强度的变化调整其频率调谐，并采用二次非线性。尽管这些计算被认为能改善感官编码，但它们的组合可能导致高度模糊的神经编码，使得提取行为相关信息变得困难。我们结合电生理学和计算建模，研究这些计算如何共同编码自然声学信号，如求偶歌曲。结果表明，包含二次滤波器和除法归一化的模型能够准确再现对人工和自然声音的群体反应。此外，该模型将自适应时间滤波局限于触角机械，并将方差适应归一化到受体机械的下游。对于任意宽带刺激，这些计算生成的表示模糊，无法可靠恢复载波频率和幅度。相比之下，求偶歌曲的表示简单且稳健，二次滤波增强了歌曲包络的编码，同时通过频率倍增保留了载波的简单时间编码。
items.abstract: Sensory neurons transform stimuli through multiple adaptive and nonlinear computations. In Drosophila, auditory receptor neurons adapt to the mean and intensity of acoustic stimuli, shift their frequency tuning with sound intensity, and employ a quadratic nonlinearity. Although each of these computations is thought to improve sensory encoding, their combination could produce a highly ambiguous neural code from which behaviorally relevant information is difficult to extract. Here, we combine electrophysiology and computational modeling to determine how these computations jointly encode natural acoustic signals such as courtship song. We show that a model consisting of a quadratic filter followed by divisive normalization accurately reproduces population responses to both artificial and natural sounds. The model further localizes adaptive temporal filtering to antennal mechanics and variance adaptation to divisive normalization downstream of the receptor mechanics. For arbitrary broadband stimuli, these computations generate an ambiguous representation from which carrier frequency and amplitude cannot be reliably recovered. items.title: Interpretable biomarker programs predict treatment response in lupus nephritis: patient-level validation across four regimens
items.title_zh: 可解释生物标志物程序预测狼疮性肾炎治疗反应
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对狼疮性肾炎患者的治疗反应，应用可解释的机器学习方法分析了基因表达数据（GSE224705；319个样本中21,914个基因），涵盖了四种治疗方案：吗替麦考酯（MMF）、硫唑嘌呤（AZA）、羟氯喹（HC）和标准护理（SOC）。我们独立重建了表达矩阵和元数据，重建了特定治疗的队列，并推导出紧凑的多基因程序，以区分每个治疗人群中的应答者和非应答者。结果显示，不同治疗方案的区分性能差异显著，五到十个基因的紧凑程序在MMF和AZA中的患者级AUROC分别为0.847和0.866，而在HC和SOC中仅为0.718和0.623。SOC程序的表现接近随机（MCC 0.119，平衡准确率0.555）。这表明在转录上无法区分反应的方案为试验设计提供了可行的发现，而非无效结果。此外，这些程序的稳定性显著高于生成它们的差异表达列表。
items.abstract: A large share of late-stage clinical trial failures reflects not the underlying biology of the target but the composition of the enrolled population: trials recruit patients in whom the drug cannot work. Methods that identify likely responders before treatment therefore address a failure mode that better target selection alone cannot. We applied interpretable machine learning to gene-expression data from a treatment-response cohort in lupus nephritis (GSE224705; 21,914 genes across 319 samples) covering four regimens: mycophenolate mofetil (MMF), azathioprine (AZA), hydroxychloroquine (HC) and standard of care (SOC). We independently reconstructed the expression matrix and metadata, rebuilt the treatment-specific cohorts, and derived compact multi-gene programs that separate responders from non-responders within each treated population. Two results follow. First, discriminative performance is strongly graded by regimen. Com pact programs of five to ten genes achieved patient-level AUROC of 0.847 (MMF) and 0.866 (AZA), but only 0.718 (HC) and 0.623 (SOC); the SOC programs performed close to chance (MCC 0.119, balanced accuracy 0.555). items.title: Surgically Modifiable Insertion Geometry Drives Thrombogenic Flow in the Modified Blalock-Taussig-Thomas Shunt
items.title_zh: 手术可调插入几何形状影响改良Blalock-Taussig分流的血栓形成流动
items.summary_zh: 背景：改良Blalock-Taussig-Thomas分流（mBTTS）用于维持患有青紫或单心室心脏病婴儿的肺血流，但8-12%的病例出现分流血栓，且死亡率较高。全身抗凝效果有限。目的：本研究测试手术可调的分流几何形状是否能通过管理血栓形成的血流动力学，形成一种患者特异性的维持分流通畅的方法。方法：从10名婴儿（4例血栓形成，6例通畅）的计算机断层扫描重建三维mBTTS解剖结构。利用多普勒超声获得的脉动入口波形与单独校准的三元素Windkessel出口模型相结合。瞬态计算流体动力学模拟预测壁剪切速率（WSR）和拉伸应变速率（ESR）。评估手术相关几何参数与血流动力学指标之间的关联。结果：模拟压力与所有10个模型的临床测量值高度吻合。尽管解剖变异性显著，8例患者（包括所有4例血栓分流）的峰值WSR和ESR一致集中在分流-锁骨交界处。分流插入角度偏离垂直的程度越大，与较高的收缩压和循环平均压力相关。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: The modified Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt (mBTTS) sustains pulmonary blood flow in infants with cyanotic or single-ventricle heart disease, but shunt thrombosis occurs in 8-12% of cases and carries substantial mortality. Systemic anticoagulation has limited efficacy. Objectives: This study tested whether surgically modifiable shunt geometry might form a second, patient-specific approach to maintaining shunt patency, via management of thrombogenic hemodynamics. Methods: Three-dimensional mBTTS anatomies were reconstructed from computed tomography in 10 infants (4 thrombosed, 6 patent). Pulsatile inlet waveforms derived from Doppler ultrasound were coupled with three-element Windkessel outlet models individually calibrated to catheter-derived pressures. Transient computational fluid dynamics simulations predicted wall shear rate (WSR) and elongational strain rate (ESR). Associations between surgically relevant geometric parameters and hemodynamic metrics were evaluated. items.title: Mapping the Diagnostic Space of Auditory Brainstem Responses: An Interpretable Framework for Classification
items.title_zh: 听觉脑干反应的诊断空间映射：可解释的分类框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：听觉脑干反应（ABRs）是客观且高度标准化的诱发电位，但其临床解释仍主要依赖专家的视觉评估。大多数自动化ABR方法集中于信号检测、阈值估计或波形识别，而将ABR特征与临床相关类别联系起来的诊断推理仍不够系统化。方法：我们开发了一个基于规则的ABR分类理论框架，定义了九个临床相关描述符：波I、III和V的振幅；波I、III和V的潜伏期；I/V振幅比；以及I-V和III-V的峰间间隔。通过考虑不适用描述符、代数一致性和神经生物学合理性，逐步生成并缩减了完整的理论组合空间。结果：最初的5,832种可能的ABR配置被缩减为343种有效配置。专家评估者之间的协议高达84.55%，Cohen's k = 0.620。
items.abstract: Background: Auditory Brainstem Responses (ABRs) are objective and highly standardized evoked potentials, but their clinical interpretation still largely depends on expert visual assessment. Most automated ABR approaches focus on signal detection, threshold estimation, or waveform recognition, whereas the diagnostic reasoning linking ABR features to clinically meaningful categories remains insufficiently formalized. Methods: We developed a theoretical, rule-based framework for ABR classification. Nine clinically relevant descriptors were defined: amplitudes of waves I, III, and V; latencies of waves I, III, and V; the I/V amplitude ratio; and the I-V and III-V interpeak intervals. The complete theoretical combinatorial space was generated and progressively reduced using rules that accounted for non-applicable descriptors, algebraic consistency, and neurobiological plausibility. Two expert raters independently labeled valid configurations and compared with language-model-assisted and logic-based rule systems. Agreement was assessed using percentage concordance and Cohen's k;. Descriptor importance was explored using Random Forest analysis. Results: The initial space of 5,832 possible

items.title: Lysosomal polygenic risk score in Parkinson's disease across populations.
items.title_zh: 帕金森病中溶酶体多基因风险评分的种群研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：溶酶体功能障碍与帕金森病（PD）的发病机制相关。然而，溶酶体多基因风险评分（lyso-PRS）在不同种群中的PD研究尚不充分。目的：评估lyso-PRS在不同种群中对PD风险的表现；比较欧洲人群中特发性PD（iPD）、GBA1-PD、非表现型GBA1携带者（NMC）和健康对照（HC）之间的lyso-PRS；评估lyso-PRS与欧洲PD患者临床结果的关联。方法：分析全球帕金森遗传计划（GP2）数据集中的Neurobooster阵列数据，包括32,054例iPD病例和18,188例健康对照，涵盖十个祖先。结果：lyso-PRS在欧洲人群中表现最佳（欧洲-GP2测试队列：AUC = 0.602，p = 2.02e-172；欧洲-TUEPAC验证队列：AUC = 0.632，p = 5.34e-20），在其他种群中表现较差（AUC：0.51-0.59，p<0.05）。在欧洲人群中，lyso-PRS能够区分GBA1-PD与HC（AUC = 0.621，p = 7.83e-71）及NMC（AUC = 0.621，p = 1.05e-18）。在欧洲-GP2队列中，较高的lyso-PRS与较早的发病年龄（{beta}=-0.21，p=0.022）及更高的统一帕金森病评分量表（UPDRS）分数（{beta}=0.32-1.13，所有p < 0.05）显著相关。结论：lyso-PRS与iPD和GBA1-PD相关。
items.abstract: Background: Lysosomal dysfunction has been implicated in Parkinson's disease (PD) pathogenesis. However, lysosomal polygenic risk scores (lyso-PRS) have not been evaluated extensively in PD across populations. Objectives: (1) Evaluation of lyso-PRS (lyso-PRS) performance for PD risk across populations; (2) Comparison of lyso-PRS across idiopathic PD (iPD), GBA1-PD, non-manifesting GBA1 carriers (NMC), and healthy controls (HC) in the European population. (3) Assessment of the lyso-PRS association with clinical outcomes in the PD patients of European population. Methods: We analyzed Neurobooster array data from the Global Parkinson's Genetics Program (GP2) dataset, including 32,054 iPD cases and 18,188 healthy controls across ten ancestries. Results: (1) lyso-PRS performed best in Europeans (European-GP2 test cohort: AUC = 0.602, p = 2.02e-172; European-TUEPAC validation cohort: AUC = 0.632, p = 5.34e-20) and worse in other populations (AUC: 0.51-0.59, p<0.05). (2) In the European population, the lyso-PRS distinguished GBA1-PD from HC (AUC = 0.621, p = 7.83e-71) and from NMC (AUC = 0.621, p = 1.05e-18). items.title: Do established comorbidity scores predict in-hospital mortality equally well in women and men? A nationwide validation in 166.7 million German inpatient cases, 2010-2024
items.title_zh: 性别对合并症评分在住院死亡率预测中的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：评估三种已建立的合并症评分（Charlson合并症指数、Elixhauser合并症总和、van Walraven评分）在男女患者中的预测能力是否相同，以及差异是否达到临床相关性阈值。设计：基于人群的回顾性队列研究，进行三种预测模型的外部验证，采用性别分层评估。设置：德国，2010至2024年间急性躯体疾病相关组（DRG）成人住院病例的全国性统计。参与者：166,693,491例符合预设九步筛选标准的成人住院病例。主要结果指标：住院死亡率。主要轴心：校准（整体校准、校准斜率、每个评分五分位的观察死亡率）。次要轴心：区分度（接收者操作特征曲线下面积，AUC）。预设阈值：性别间斜率差异至少为0.05，绝对AUC差异至少为0.01。结果：两性在整体校准方面表现几乎完美（|CITL| [ ] 0.0004）。评分在预测能力上存在差异。
items.abstract: Objectives. To determine whether three established comorbidity scores (Charlson Comorbidity Index, Elixhauser Comorbidity Sum, van Walraven Score), applied with a single formula to both sexes, are equally well calibrated and equally discriminating in women and men, and whether any difference reaches a pre-specified threshold of clinical relevance. Design. Population-based retrospective cohort study; external validation of three pre-existing prediction models (TRIPOD Type 4) with sex-stratified evaluation. The analysis plan was fixed in the time-stamped Research Data Centre submission syntax before any aggregated data existed. Setting. Germany; complete national enumeration of acute somatic Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG)-billed adult inpatient cases, reporting years 2010 to 2024. Participants. 166 693 491 adult inpatient cases meeting a pre-specified nine-step eligibility filter. Main outcome measures. In-hospital mortality. Primary axis: calibration (calibration-in-the-large, CITL; calibration slope; observed mortality per score quintile). items.title: Evaluating large language models as clinical decision support tools in primary healthcare settings: Protocol for a multi-country comparative validation study on expert-adjudicated hypothetical vignettes (hypMOOVE-PHC)
items.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型在初级医疗中的临床决策支持作用
items.summary_zh: 引言：大型语言模型（LLMs）有潜力增强低资源初级医疗（PHC）环境中的临床决策。然而，大多数LLMs是在高资源环境中开发和评估的，关于其在撒哈拉以南非洲的安全性和适用性证据仍然有限。hypMOOVE-PHC研究是大规模开放在线验证与评估（MOOVE）倡议的假设情境阶段，实施于肯尼亚、马拉维和坦桑尼亚，旨在通过专家生成的情境进行临床审查来验证一组LLMs。方法与分析：本研究为完全交叉重复测量的比较评估研究。在每个国家，经验丰富的临床医生开发200-250个反映现实患者表现的假设临床情境，并独立生成每个情境的人类基准护理计划。情境用于引导六个基于代码可用性、当地可托管性和模型大小选择的开源和专有LLMs。在面对面研讨会（valiDATAthons）中，独立临床专家在五个维度（临床合理性、安全性、上下文适应性、清晰性与完整性、适当信心）中对LLM和人类生成的响应进行评分。主要终点是每个LLM的整体性能概况及非劣效性。
items.abstract: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to strengthen clinical decision-making in low-resource primary healthcare (PHC) settings. However, most LLMs are developed and benchmarked in high-resource settings and evidence on their safety and contextual appropriateness in Sub-Saharan Africa remains limited. The hypMOOVE-PHC study is the hypothetical vignette phase of the Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation (MOOVE) initiative, implemented in Kenya, Malawi, and Tanzania. It aims to validate a pool of LLMs through clinical review of expert-generated vignettes. Methods and analysis: This is a fully crossed repeated-measures comparative evaluation study. In each country, experienced clinicians develop 200-250 hypothetical clinical vignettes reflecting realistic patient presentations and independently produce a human benchmark care plan for each. Vignettes are used to prompt a selection of six open-source and proprietary LLMs selected based on code availability, local hostability, and model size. During in-person workshops (valiDATAthons), independent clinical experts rate LLM- and human-generated responses in source-attribution masked side-by-side comparisons

items.title: Odour cueing during sleep augments trauma-focused psychotherapy
items.title_zh: 睡眠中的气味提示增强创伤聚焦心理治疗
items.summary_zh: 创伤聚焦心理治疗通过将不适应的创伤记忆更新为更适应的表征来减少创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）症状。然而，许多患者未能获得临床显著改善，亟需增强策略。我们结合健康参与者的机制研究与随机临床试验，测试睡眠中的气味提示是否能增强创伤聚焦心理治疗。在健康参与者中，睡眠期间重新暴露于与治疗相关的气味增加了慢波活动和慢振荡，而慢振荡纺锤耦合的更大增加与回忆厌恶性自传记忆时的情绪唤起降低相关。在PTSD患者中，12周创伤聚焦治疗期间的重复气味提示改善了临床评估和自我报告的PTSD症状，特别是再体验和认知与情绪的负面改变，并加速了治疗反应和缓解。这些发现提供了机制和临床证据，表明目标记忆再激活（TMR）可以通过睡眠依赖的记忆巩固增强创伤聚焦心理治疗。
items.abstract: Trauma focused psychotherapies reduce posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms by updating maladaptive traumatic memories into more adaptive representations. However, many patients do not achieve clinically meaningful improvement, highlighting the need for augmentation strategies. Targeted memory reactivation (TMR), in which memory cues are re presented during sleep to strengthen memory consolidation, is a promising approach. We combined a mechanistic study in healthy participants with a randomized clinical trial to test whether odour cueing during sleep augments trauma-focused psychotherapy. In healthy participants, re-exposure to the therapy-associated odour during sleep increased slow-wave activity and slow oscillations, while greater increases in slow oscillation spindle coupling were associated with reduced emotional arousal during recall of aversive autobiographical memories. In patients with PTSD, repeated odour cueing during sleep throughout 12 weeks of trauma focused treatment improved clinician-rated and self-reported PTSD symptoms, particularly re experiencing and negative alterations in cognition and mood, and accelerated treatment response and remission. items.title: Intensive Home-Based Motor Imagery Neurofeedback Training Using Mobile EEG to Assess Changes in Brain Activity and Motor Function in Stroke Survivors: A Multiple Baseline Design (MINTS Study Protocol)
items.title_zh: 基于移动脑电图的家庭运动想象神经反馈训练研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：运动想象神经反馈（MI-NF）激活感觉运动脑网络，显示出中风后运动恢复的潜力。本研究旨在探讨针对慢性中风患者的家庭MI-NF训练对脑活动和功能连接的影响。方法：MINTS研究为前瞻性单组多模态干预研究，纳入21名慢性中风患者（至少6个月后）及持续上肢运动障碍。研究包括预评估、可变长度基线期、14次MI-NF训练的干预期、后评估及为期三个月的探索性随访。MI-NF训练每隔一天在参与者家中进行，使用移动脑电图设备。研究将评估MI-NF训练对神经活动和功能连接的影响，以及这些变化是否伴随上肢运动功能的改善。
items.abstract: Background: Motor imagery neurofeedback (MI-NF) engages sensorimotor brain networks and has shown potential for motor recovery after stroke. While laboratory-based studies have demonstrated neural and behavioral effects, evidence on real-world MI-NF training and its impact on brain activity and connectivity in stroke survivors remains limited. The Motor Imagery Neurofeedback Training in Stroke (MINTS) study investigates the effects of intensive, home-based MI-NF training using mobile EEG in chronic stroke survivors. Specifically, the study examines whether MI-NF training induces changes in neural activity and functional connectivity and whether these changes are accompanied by improvements in upper-limb motor function. Additionally, the study explores the temporal evolution of neural and behavioral changes across repeated baseline and training measurements. Methods: MINTS is a prospective, single-group, multimodal intervention study using an across-subjects multiple-baseline design. items.title: Preclinical Basal Ganglia Neurodegeneration in Female X Linked Dystonia Parkinsonism Carriers
items.title_zh: 女性X连锁肌张力障碍帕金森病携带者的基底节神经退行性变前临床研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：X连锁肌张力障碍-帕金森病（XDP）是一种由TAF1基因中的逆转录转座子插入及多态性六核苷酸重复扩展引起的严重神经退行性运动障碍。尽管该疾病主要影响男性，但女性携带者可能表现出不同的表型特征。无症状女性突变携带者（fMC）的神经生物学变化尚未得到充分研究。我们旨在探讨fMC是否在缺乏明显临床表现的情况下表现出神经退行性变化，并使用多模态MRI评估其临床、遗传和纵向相关性。方法：在这项横断面和纵向多模态研究中，103名XDP患者的女性亲属接受了临床、遗传和MRI评估。42名被确定为fMC，61名为健康对照（HC）。使用体素基础形态学和皮层下体积测量分析结构性T1加权MRI，同时利用敏感性加权成像评估铁沉积。临床评估包括标准化的运动和认知测试。部分参与者（20名fMC，13名HC）进行了纵向随访MRI。结果：与HC相比，fMC表现出显著的纹状体萎缩，尾状核体积减少（-19.4%）、壳核（-18.6%）和苍白球（-28.6%），均为p<0.001，尽管缺乏明显的运动障碍。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP) is a severe neurodegenerative movement disorder caused by a retrotransposon insertion with a polymorphic hexanucleotide repeat expansion in the TAF1 gene. While the disease predominantly affects males, female carriers may exhibit a variable phenotypic expression. Neurobiological alterations in asymptomatic female mutation carriers (fMC) remain largely unexplored. We aimed to investigate whether fMC exhibit neurodegenerative changes despite the absence of overt clinical manifestations and to assess their clinical, genetic, and longitudinal correlates using multimodal MRI. Methods: In this cross-sectional and longitudinal multimodal study, 103 female relatives of XDP patients underwent clinical, genetic, and MRI assessments. Forty-two were identified as fMC and 61 as healthy controls (HC). Structural T1-weighted MRI was analyzed using voxel-based morphometry and subcortical volumetry, while susceptibility-weighted imaging assessed iron deposition. items.title: Cross-Source Progression Assessment in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer: An Opportunity-Adjusted Six-State Analysis
items.title_zh: 晚期胰腺癌的跨源进展评估：机会调整的六状态分析
items.summary_zh: 目的：在常规肿瘤护理中，放射学和治疗肿瘤医生的记录时间不同。我们使用六状态框架，描述在晚期胰腺癌中，放射学或医学肿瘤学记录的进展后，另一临床来源的首次可评估机会。方法：我们对AACR Project GENIE BPC PANC v1.0-public进行了回顾性二次分析。患者在晚期疾病发生后首次启动系统治疗方案时进入治疗索引队列。T0过程为患者进入队列后首次真实的放射学或医学肿瘤学记录的进展。另一来源的首次可评估机会被分类为同日一致、确认、明确非进展、混合、不确定或无可评估机会。结果：在1109名患者中，882名进入治疗索引队列，645名符合主要估计标准。状态分别为同日一致25例（3.88%）、确认219例（33.95%）、明确非进展108例（16.74%）、混合19例（2.95%）、不确定166例（25.74%）、无可评估机会108例（16.74%）。
items.abstract: PURPOSE: Radiology and treating-oncologist documentation are recorded on different schedules in routine oncology care. We characterized the opposite clinical source at its first evaluable opportunity after radiology- or medical-oncology-documented progression in advanced pancreatic cancer using an exhaustive six-state framework. METHODS: We performed a retrospective secondary analysis of AACR Project GENIE BPC PANC v1.0-public. Patients entered the treatment-index cohort at the first systemic regimen initiated on or after advanced-disease onset. Process T0 was the first genuine radiology- or medical-oncology-documented progression after cohort entry and not after subsequent same-cancer treatment or death. The opposite source's first evaluable opportunity was classified as same-day concordance, confirmation, explicit nonprogression, mixed, indeterminate, or no evaluable opportunity. The secondary estimand was explicit nonprogression among first opportunities classifiable specifically as progression or explicit nonprogression. items.title: Evidence for cross-reactivity and protection against Bundibugyo virus disease after heterologous vaccination: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 异种疫苗接种后对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉反应性与保护证据
items.summary_zh: 目前尚无批准的疫苗或医疗对策用于预防或治疗Bundibugyo病毒病。关键问题是现有的埃博拉病毒疫苗是否能提供足够的交叉反应性和交叉保护。我们对已发表的研究进行了系统评估和荟萃分析，研究了接种埃博拉疫苗（Ervebo或Zabdeno/Mvabea）后对Bundibugyo病毒（BDBV）抗体的交叉反应性。结果显示，接种Ervebo后，埃博拉病毒与BDBV抗原的结合能力平均下降2.8倍（95%预测区间：2.6-3.0，n=8个观察来自4项研究），中和能力下降3.1倍（95% PI：2.0-4.8，n=2个观察来自1项研究），且这种下降在接种后持续存在。Zabdeno/Mvabea疫苗的交叉反应性数据非常有限，显示对BDBV的识别下降更为显著（39.7倍，95% PI：24.8-63.8，n=3个观察来自2项研究）。此外，我们还调查了在动物模型中接种Ervebo或其他仅含埃博拉抗原的重组囊泡性口腔炎病毒（rVSV）疫苗后对BDBV挑战的保护证据。一项在非人灵长类动物中的研究显示对BDBV挑战的疫苗保护效果不显著。
items.abstract: There are currently no approved vaccines or medical countermeasures for use in prevention or treatment of Bundibugyo virus disease. A critical question is whether the existing vaccines approved for use against Ebola virus disease could provide sufficient cross-reactivity and cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus disease. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of published studies of antibody cross-reactivity to Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) after vaccination with previously approved Ebola vaccines (Ervebo or Zabdeno/Mvabea). We find on average a 2.8-fold (95% predictive interval, PI: 2.6-3.0) drop in binding (n = 8 observations from 4 studies) and 3.1-fold drop (95% PI: 2.0-4.8) in neutralization (n = 2 observations from 1 study) between Ebola virus and BDBV antigens after Ervebo vaccination, which appears maintained over time after vaccination. Very limited data on cross reactivity after Zabdeno/Mvabea vaccination suggests a higher drop in recognition of BDBV (39.7-fold, 95% PI: 24.8-63.8; n = 3 observations from 2 studies). In addition to analysis of antibody recognition in humans, we also investigated evidence for vaccine protection from BDBV challenge in animal models
items.authors: Stadler, E.; Csolle, M.; Mitchell, A.; Egilmezer, E.; Elias, K. M.; Bailey, B. A.; Cromer, D.; Turner, T.; Khoury, D. S.; Davenport, M. P.

items.title: Emergency Care in India: A Retrospective Cross-sectional Analysis of Health Management and Information System and Global Burden of Disease
items.title_zh: 印度急救医疗服务的回顾性分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：为了解急救医疗条件（EMCs）的负担及医疗服务利用情况，我们评估了印度健康管理信息系统（HMIS）中的急救医学科（EMD）数据及全球疾病负担（GBD）中的EMCs数据。方法：本研究为2019年HMIS和GBD数据的回顾性横断面分析。我们提取了HMIS中的EMD注册、住院和死亡数据，以及GBD中29种EMCs的发生率和死亡率。结果：2019年，HMIS记录的EMD注册患者为119,103,358人（每10万人中为8,935.66人）。全国EMD注册率为每10万人中6,744.22次住院，EMD死亡率为每10万人中30,526.36次住院死亡。仅有12.14%的HMIS注册数据提供了特定病因信息。GBD估计EMCs占所有原因发生率的27.22%和死亡率的51.72%。结论：研究揭示了EMD利用与EMC疾病负担估计之间的差距。
items.abstract: Background: To understand the burden of emergency medical conditions (EMCs) and healthcare service utilization, we assessed Emergency Medicine Department (EMD) data from India's Health Management Information System (HMIS) and EMCs from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD). Methods: This was a retrospective cross-sectional analysis of HMIS and GBD data for 2019. We extracted EMD registrations, hospital admissions, and deaths from HMIS and incidence and deaths from GBD for 29 EMCs at the national and state levels. We analyzed HMIS and GBD data to estimate proportions and rates of registrations, deaths, and incident cases relative to population counts and hospital admissions. Results: In 2019, 119,103,358 patients (8,935.66 per 100,000 people) were registered at EMDs per HMIS. The national EMD registration rate was 6,744.22 per 100,000 hospital admissions, and the EMD death rate was 30,526.36 per 100,000 hospital deaths. Only 12.14% of all HMIS registrations had cause-specific data. GBD estimates that EMCs accounted for 27.22% of all-cause incidence and 51.72% of all-cause mortality. Trauma-related registrations were 8.22% in HMIS, while injuries in GBD accounted for 7% of EMCs. Overall
items.authors: Urs, G.; Zadey, S.; Kumar, P. K.; Arora, A.; Gangane, T.; Nimkar, P.; Staton, C.; Vissoci, J. R. N.

items.title: Reconciling neurocognitive and behavioral impulsivities through ecological assessment and multivariate modelling of cognitive control dynamics
items.title_zh: 通过生态评估与多变量建模调和神经认知与行为冲动性
items.summary_zh: 冲动性是注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的核心维度，也是多种精神和身体不良结果的跨诊断易感因素。我们测试了结合重复生态评估与反应时间（RT）动态的计算建模是否能改善冲动性的测量及其跨范式有效性。60名参与者，包括ADHD青少年、22q11.2缺失综合征患者和健康对照，完成了1347次基于智能手机的气球模拟风险任务（D-BART）评估，并进行了一次Conners CPT-3测试。RT使用线性混合效应模型进行建模，考虑了客观风险和主观不确定性，随机效应捕捉个体间和个体内的变异性。动态RT参数与传统表现指标整合，并通过偏最小二乘分析与CPT-3变量相关。外部有效性通过家长评定的行为症状进行评估。结果显示，RT随着风险和不确定性的增加而增加，符合速度-准确性权衡的适应性调节。
items.abstract: Impulsivity is a core dimension of ADHD and a transdiagnostic vulnerability factor for a wide range of adverse psychiatric and somatic outcomes, that could be mitigated through more effective screening of at-risk individuals. However, laboratory-based measures of impulsivity show weak convergence across paradigms and limited prediction of real-world behavior, constraining their utility. We tested whether combining repeated ecological assessment with computational modeling of response-time (RT) dynamics improves measurement of impulsivity and its cross-paradigm validity. Sixty participants, including adolescents with ADHD, individuals with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, and healthy controls, completed a total of 1347 smartphone-based Balloon-Analogue-Risk-Task (D-BART) assessments repeatedly in daily life, alongside a single-session Conners CPT-3. RT was modeled using linear mixed-effects models as a function of objective risk and subjective uncertainty, with random effects capturing between- and within-person variability. items.title: Vibe Patenting: Evaluating LLM Judges for Professional Patent-Drafting Agents
items.title_zh: Vibe专利评估：大型语言模型评审在专利撰写中的应用
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）评审在评估和改进AI生成输出方面的应用日益增多，但其在复杂专业工作中的可靠性尚不明确。我们通过Vibe专利评估，构建了一个端到端的专利撰写测试平台，用于AI代理的评估。独立调用的LLM评审对生成的专利草稿进行评估，并提供结构化反馈以便迭代修订。在多个发明和撰写代理配置中，评审指导的修订始终提高了评审评估的质量，而无指导的修订则趋于饱和。值得注意的是，迭代的评审反馈使得低推理能力的代理接近高推理能力代理的表现。更强的模型和增加的推理能力通常提高了评审评估的撰写质量，而领域特定的代理工作流程则进一步提升了效果。我们将评审结果与专业专利律师的独立评估进行了验证，发现存在有意义但强烈依赖于指标的协议和系统性校准差异。这些结果突显了LLM评审作为复杂专业工作流评估者和优化信号的效用与局限性。
items.abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs, yet their reliability for complex professional work remains unclear. We study this problem through Vibe Patenting, an end-to-end patent-drafting testbed for AI-agent evaluation. A separately-invoked LLM judge evaluates generated patent drafts and provides structured feedback for iterative revision. Across multiple inventions and drafting-agent configurations, judge-guided revision consistently improves judge-assessed quality, while unguided revision tends to saturate. Notably, iterative judge feedback enables a low-reasoning agent to approach the performance of a substantially more expensive high-reasoning agent. Stronger models and increased reasoning generally improve judge-assessed drafting quality, while domain-specific agentic workflows provide further gains. We validate the judge against independent evaluation by a professional patent attorney and find meaningful but strongly metric-dependent agreement and systematic calibration differences. These results highlight both the utility and limitations of LLM judges as evaluators and optimization signals for complex professional workflows.
items.authors: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Vlad Blaykhman, Ye Wang, Jing Liu, Gene V. Vinokur

items.title: Toward Self-Adaptive Physical AI: Can LLM Agents Manage Long-Horizon Physical Tasks?
items.title_zh: 自适应物理人工智能：大型语言模型能否管理长期物理任务？
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理为自主管理长期物理任务提供了有希望的途径，且无需人类干预。然而，物理任务要求代理持续观察环境、做出重要决策，并在环境变化时保持有效性。现有方法要么需要大量数据和重新训练，要么主要集中在虚拟世界中的代理。本研究探讨了构建自适应物理人工智能代理的可行性，该代理以零样本方式管理长期物理任务，并在没有人类干预的情况下适应环境变化。我们设计了一个多代理框架，整合了规划、工具调用、观察和验证，并在不同天气模式下对农业任务进行了评估。结果表明，零样本LLM代理在相同天气模式下的管理结果与强化学习（RL）代理相当，并且在环境变化时适应性更强，显示出自适应物理人工智能代理的良好前景。
items.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising path toward autonomously managing long-term physical tasks without human intervention. However, physical tasks require agents to continuously observe the environment, make consequential actions, and remain effective as the environment changes. Existing approaches either require substantial data and retraining, or primarily focus on agents operating in the virtual world. In this work, we explore the feasibility of building a self-adaptive physical AI agent that manages long-term physical tasks in a zero-shot manner and adapts to environmental changes without human intervention. We design a multi-agent framework that integrates planning, tool calling, observation, and verification, and evaluate it on agricultural tasks against reinforcement learning (RL) agents under different weather patterns. Our results show that zero-shot LLM agents can achieve comparable management outcomes to RL agents under the same weather pattern and adapt more effectively than RL when evaluated under a shifted environment, highlighting a promising path toward self-adaptive physical AI agents.
items.authors: Varun Kaushik, Yayun Tan, Xiaofan Yu

items.title: Governing at Machine Speed: An Adaptive Intelligence Architecture for Real-Time AI Policy Enforcement
items.title_zh: 机器速度治理：实时AI政策执行的自适应智能架构
items.summary_zh: 全球企业AI采纳率已达到78%，但治理基础设施未能跟上。本文识别并描述了认证缺口，这是一种结构性条件，组织维持治理政策但无法在监管时间内提供可审计的、不可篡改的执行证据。基于斯坦福2026年AI指数报告（362个记录事件）、IBM/Ponemon 2026年数据泄露成本研究（平均成本499万美元，92%缺乏访问控制）和EY/AIUC-1联盟调查（38%端到端监控，17%代理间覆盖）的实证数据，本文表明治理失败是组织和架构层面的，而非技术层面的。为解决这一缺口，我们提出AGIL（自适应治理智能层），一个概念性五层架构，旨在利用机器学习实现实时AI治理执行。提议的层包括：1）通过行为指纹识别阴影AI的自主发现，2）统一安全、幻觉、隐私和责任评分的行为风险分类，3）在低于100毫秒延迟下进行许可/拒绝/修改决策的政策执行网关，4）生成不可篡改审计轨迹的持续认证引擎，以及5）自适应政策执行。
items.abstract: Enterprise AI adoption has reached 78% of organizations globally, yet the infrastructure to govern that adoption has not kept pace. This paper identifies and characterizes the attestation deficit, a structural condition in which organizations maintain governance policies but cannot produce auditable, tamper-evident evidence of enforcement within regulatory timelines. Drawing on empirical data from the Stanford 2026 AI Index Report (362 documented incidents), the IBM/Ponemon 2026 Cost of a Data Breach study (USD 4.99M average cost, 92% lacking access controls), and the EY/AIUC-1 Consortium survey (38% end-to-end monitoring, 17% agent-to-agent coverage), this paper demonstrates that the governance failure is organizational and architectural rather than technical. To address this deficit, we propose AGIL (Adaptive Governance Intelligence Layer), a conceptual five-layer architecture designed to use machine learning for real-time AI governance enforcement. The proposed layers include: (1) Autonomous Discovery for shadow AI detection via behavioral fingerprinting, (2) Behavioral Risk Classification unifying security, hallucination, privacy, and accountability scoring, (3) a Policy Enforc
items.authors: Sandeep Bokkasam, B. Durgalakshmi

items.title: From Legal Text to AI-specific Risk Sources: A Systematic Analysis of the EU AI Act's High-Risk Requirements
items.title_zh: 从法律文本到AI特定风险源：EU AI法案高风险要求的系统分析
items.summary_zh: EU AI法案为高风险AI系统引入了强制性要求，旨在确保可信赖AI的开发与运营。同时，AI风险管理实践依赖结构化风险分类法，以系统识别和处理AI特定风险源。本文系统分类了EU AI法案第二节（高风险AI系统的要求）提取的要求，发现只有少数要求直接针对AI特定风险源，大多数则施加组织流程和文档义务。基于与AI风险相关的要求，提炼出一份独特的AI特定风险源清单。该EU AI法案风险源清单为法律义务与AI风险管理实践之间架起了桥梁，提供了现有AI风险分类法与隐含风险源之间的结构化比较参考。
items.abstract: The EU AI Act introduces mandatory requirements for high-risk AI systems with the explicit goal of ensuring the development and operation of trustworthy AI. At the same time, AI risk management practices rely on structured risk taxonomies to systematically identify and treat AI-specific risk sources. As both the AI Act and established risk taxonomies aim to address AI-induced risks, a natural question is whether they align in the risk sources they cover. However, no clear mapping exists between the risks implicitly addressed by the Act's high-risk requirements and established taxonomies, leaving practitioners without a structured basis for aligning regulatory obligations with AI risk management practice. This paper presents a systematic classification of the requirements extracted from the EU AI Act Section 2 (Requirements for high-risk AI systems), revealing that only a minority directly address AI-specific risk sources, while the majority impose organizational process and documentation obligations. From the AI risk-related requirements, a consolidated list of distinct AI-specific risk sources is derived. The resulting EU AI Act Risk Source List takes an important step towards bri
items.authors: Ronald Schnitzer, Mike Auer, Rumpa Choudhury, Andreas Hapfelmeier, Maximilian Hoeving, Isabelle Painter, Josiane Xavier Parreira, Sonja Zillner

items.title: Causal multi-modal AI for personalized chemosensitivity prediction
items.title_zh: 因果多模态人工智能在个性化化疗敏感性预测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 化疗能改善部分乳腺癌患者的生存率，但医生无法可靠预测受益者。现行指南依赖复发评分作为治疗效果的替代指标，可能导致化疗过度使用。本研究提出了一种因果多模态人工智能模型，利用常规收集的病理和临床信息预测个性化化疗敏感性。我们在一个包含9,141名患者的多国数据集上开发了该模型，并在另一个1,994名患者的数据集上进行了评估。模型为每位患者生成了特定治疗的复发概率，具有近乎完美的校准和强大的预后区分能力。与标准护理相比，使用该模型支持个性化治疗决策可使接受化疗的患者减少30%，同时保持相同的无复发生率。预测为高度化疗敏感的肿瘤显示出一致的增殖、细胞周期进展和复制压力的分子及形态特征。该模型的预测能力在非乳腺癌中也表现出零样本迁移能力。
items.abstract: Chemotherapy improves survival for some patients with breast cancer, but doctors cannot reliably predict who. Current guidelines rely on recurrence scores as a proxy for treatment benefit, which may contribute to the overprescription of chemotherapy. Here we present a causal multi-modal AI model that predicts personalized chemosensitivity using routinely collected pathology and clinical information. We developed our model on a multi-national dataset of 9,141 patients (twelve cohorts, nine countries) and evaluated it on another 1,994 patients (five cohorts, three countries). The model generated treatment-specific recurrence probabilities for each patient, with near-perfect calibration and strong prognostic discrimination across both 5- and 10-year follow-up horizons. Moreover, its chemotherapy benefit predictions demonstrated robust predictive performance, and out-performed existing recurrence-score-based tests. Compared to the standard of care, using the model to support personally tailored therapeutic decisions could reduce the number of patients receiving chemotherapy by 30% while achieving the same recurrence-free rate. items.title: Trustworthy Agentic AI: A Comprehensive Cybersecurity and Systems Survey on Threat Landscapes, Defense Architectures, and Open Challenges
items.title_zh: 可信的自主智能AI：网络安全与系统的全面调查
items.summary_zh: 从被动基础模型到自主、目标导向的自主智能AI系统的转变，引入了前所未有的能力，结合了递归认知推理循环、持久内存架构、实时工具执行平面和多智能体协作拓扑。然而，赋予概率神经核心在文件系统、网络和云基础设施中的执行权限，打破了传统安全边界：自然语言同时作为输入数据、内部控制代码和通信协议，暴露出一个图灵完备的爆炸半径，其中不可信数据代表可执行指令。本调查提供了一个全面的系统安全参考框架，针对可信的自主智能AI，综合了206项基础研究和监管标准。我们将一般智能体架构形式化为有状态的5元组，并建立了一个涵盖安全性、安全性、隐私、可解释性、公平性和问责制的六维可信度分类法。我们系统分析了执行循环和交互平面的威胁表面，制定了一个多层次的零信任深度防御架构，整合了双LLM隔离、基于能力的访问控制、内核eBPF探针和沙箱运行时，审查了标准化评估基准，并将技术控制映射到国际AI治理框架。
items.abstract: The transition from passive foundation models to autonomous, goal-directed agentic AI systems has introduced unprecedented capabilities by coupling recursive cognitive reasoning loops, persistent memory architectures, live tool execution planes, and multi-agent collaboration topologies. However, granting probabilistic neural cores execution authority across filesystems, networks, and cloud infrastructure dissolves classical security perimeters: natural language simultaneously serves as input data, internal control code, and communication protocols, exposing a Turing-complete blast radius where untrusted data represents executable instructions. This survey delivers a comprehensive systems-security reference framework for trustworthy agentic AI, synthesizing 206 foundational studies and regulatory standards. We formalize the general agent architecture as a stateful 5-tuple and establish a 6-dimensional trustworthiness taxonomy covering security, safety, privacy, explainability, fairness, and accountability. items.title: Positioning manuscripts in the scientific landscape with agentic AI
items.title_zh: 利用智能代理AI定位科学论文的出版环境
items.summary_zh: 发表研究论文是科学生活中常见但繁重的任务，往往耗时、压力大且结果不确定。本文探讨了基于大型语言模型的智能代理AI是否能够帮助研究人员通过内容和文献背景可靠推断论文的最终出版场所。我们介绍了PASS（出版导向智能科学系统），该系统在特定领域文献背景下理解论文并预测最佳出版场所。PASS通过重建论文的局部科学邻域、追踪主题轨迹和推理领域特定期刊空间，将每篇论文定位于其周围的文献环境。在对超过2000篇生物医学领域的预印本进行评估时，PASS的Top-1准确率为50.3%，Top-5准确率为86.1%，优于现有的LLM基准和期刊选择工具。PASS生成的质量评分（如影响潜力和新颖性）与独立的出版结果测量一致。研究还发现，文献检索模块是性能最强的贡献者，尤其在定位论文方面表现突出。
items.abstract: Publishing a research manuscript is a routine yet demanding part of scientific life: time-consuming, stressful, and often uncertain in outcome. Recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agentic AI have shown promise across a range of scientific tasks, and here we ask whether agentic AI can help researchers navigate the publication process itself by reliably inferring a manuscript's eventual publication venue from its content and literature context. We introduce PASS (Publication-oriented Agentic Scientific System), an agentic system that understands manuscripts within their domain-specific literature context and predicts top-matched publication venues. PASS positions each manuscript within its surrounding literature landscape by reconstructing its local scientific neighborhood, tracing its topic trajectory, and reasoning over field-specific journal spaces. Evaluated on a leakage-audited benchmark of over 2,000 preprints across 16 biomedical fields, PASS achieved Top-1 accuracy of 50.3% and Top-5 accuracy of 86.1%, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM baselines and established journal-selection tools. items.authors: Jiawen Chen, Zichen Zhang, Bingxuan Li, Quan Sun, Yiyan Zhang, Edric Tam, Jinjie Lin, Didong Li, Yun Li, Bingxin Zhao

items.title: LLM-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Unified Electric Vehicles-Charging Station-Grid Optimization in Public Charging Systems
items.title_zh: 基于LLM的多智能体强化学习优化公共充电系统
items.summary_zh: 在物联网时代，协调电动汽车（EV）充电调度以平衡充电满意度、充电站盈利能力和智能电网稳定性是一个复杂的多目标挑战。现有的多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法常常在处理由大量物联网传感数据生成的高维状态空间和利益相关者之间的冲突时遇到困难。本文提出了一种新颖的LLM增强MARL框架，首次在统一循环中同时优化电网、EV和充电站。通过整合大语言模型（LLM），我们解决了可解释特征选择和自适应多目标平衡的两个关键瓶颈。LLM分析实时物联网收集的环境状态，提取物理显著特征，并通过语义推理动态分配利润、用户满意度和电网负荷等冲突目标的权重，而不是复杂的手动调优。大量实验表明，我们的框架显著优于现有最先进的基线，市场效率提升，同时训练时间减少超过70%。该方法为高效、可持续的物联网城市充电基础设施管理提供了可扩展、透明的解决方案。
items.abstract: In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), coordinating connected electric vehicle (EV) charging scheduling to balance EV charging satisfaction, station profitability, and smart grid stability presents a complex multi-objective challenge. Existing Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) approaches often struggle with high-dimensional state spaces generated by massive IoT sensing data and conflicting stakeholder interests. This paper proposes a novel LLM-enhanced MARL framework that, for the first time, simultaneously optimizes the Grid, EVs, and Stations within a unified loop. By integrating Large Language Model (LLM), we address two critical bottlenecks: interpretable feature selection and adaptive multi-objective balancing. The LLM analyzes real-time IoT-collected environmental states to extract physically significant features and dynamically assigns weights to conflicting objectives-including profit, user satisfaction, and grid load-using semantic reasoning instead of complex manual tuning. items.authors: Yang Zhang, Lindong Xie, Chongyu Wang, Gaojunjie Li, Siqi Bu, Edward Chung

items.title: ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information
items.title_zh: ClinAgent：基于ReAct的临床试验信息对话访问代理
items.summary_zh: 查询临床试验注册信息仍然是一个手动且易出错的过程，研究人员需要在大量半结构化数据中导航，缺乏自然语言交互或跨源综合的支持。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ClinAgent，一个基于代理的增强生成（RAG）对话系统，使临床医生和研究人员能够用简单语言查询临床试验信息，并在多轮交互中获得可靠、最新的响应。该系统以大型语言模型（LLM）代理为核心，遵循ReAct范式，迭代推理查询，从一组集成工具中选择，并根据中间输出优化其行动。这些工具包括ClinicalTrials.gov搜索接口、PubMed模块和基于Python的分析器，后者在本地缓存的结构化临床试验数据集上运行。我们使用三阶段框架评估系统的操作有效性、规划质量、工具使用效率和专家定性判断，比较了三种LLM后端：Gemini 3.0 Flash和两种DeepSeek V3.2变体（思考和非思考模式）。结果显示，DeepSeek（思考模式）在规划质量上表现优异，而Gemini则在整体性能和专家评分上达到最高。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了不同模型的互补优势。
items.abstract: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. To address this, we introduce ClinAgent, a conversational system based on agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that enables clinicians and researchers to query clinical trial information in plain language and receive grounded, up-to-date responses across multi-turn interactions. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a ClinicalTrials.gov search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). items.authors: Antonino Vaccarella, Riccardo Cantini, Domenico Talia, Paolo Trunfio, Marianna Talia, Rosamaria Lappano, Marcello Maggiolini

items.title: Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation
items.title_zh: 基于EEG信号的精神分裂症检测：变换器框架与谱图表示
items.summary_zh: 精神分裂症是一种严重的精神障碍，影响全球数百万人，其诊断主要依赖临床评估。脑电图（EEG）提供了一种非侵入性的方法来研究脑活动，并显示出支持自动化精神分裂症检测的潜力。然而，现有的基于EEG的分类研究常常面临小数据集、不一致的预处理策略以及可能导致受试者相关数据泄漏的评估协议等限制。本研究提出了一种基于EEG的精神分裂症分类框架，通过短时傅里叶变换将预处理的EEG记录转化为时频表示。生成的谱图图像使用传统机器学习算法（如支持向量机、随机森林和XGBoost）以及深度学习模型（包括卷积架构和CNN-变换器混合模型）进行分类。实验结果表明，所提方法实现了竞争性的分类性能，其中CNN-变换器（CT-SZ）模型在独立测试集上获得了88.41%的AUC-ROC，而CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer（CST-SZ）模型则达到了92.88%的AUC-ROC。
items.abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. items.authors: Abtin Shafiei, Mohsen Hooshmand, Majid Ramezani

items.title: VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification
items.title_zh: VeriDx：基于疾病中心的诊断验证框架
items.summary_zh: 正确的诊断可能因错误的原因而得出。在临床推理中，每个疾病假设都带来了义务：必须检查关键证据、排除替代方案、解决矛盾、考虑有用的测试，并证明结论的合理性。目前对医学大语言模型的评估主要集中在最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实上，因此忽视了这些假设引发的承诺。我们提出了\textbf{VeriDx}，一个将自由形式的诊断推理与结构化疾病概况相连接的疾病中心验证框架。VeriDx跟踪每个假设是否满足、未解决或违反其临床义务，揭示如缺失关键测试、未解决的鉴别诊断、忽视的矛盾、缺乏支持的主张和过早的结论等失败。我们针对复杂的呼吸系统诊断实例化了VeriDx，使用基于指南的疾病概况和专家注释的纵向案例。结果表明，许多诊断错误并非孤立的失误，而是在推理过程中早期做出的破坏性承诺。
items.abstract: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.
items.authors: Zhong Cao, Shuying Chen

items.title: AI Deployment Accountability Engineering: A Vision for Accountable AI in Safety-Critical Socio-Technical Systems
items.title_zh: AI部署问责工程：安全关键社会技术系统中的可问责AI愿景
items.summary_zh: 人工智能系统正迅速成为医疗、金融、公共服务等安全关键领域的重要组成部分。然而，目前评估这些系统的工程实践仍以模型为中心，强调准确性、鲁棒性、公平性和可解释性等属性，这些在部署前是必要的，但在不断变化的社会技术环境中却显得不足。本文提出AI部署问责工程（ADAE），旨在为已部署的AI系统建立可测量、持续和可操作的问责机制。ADAE将问责视为部署层面的属性，旨在确定AI系统是否在可接受的风险范围内运行，识别故障出现的上下文，归因于技术与人类组件的交互，转换技术故障为下游后果，并支持及时干预。我们围绕四个相互关联的支柱阐述了研究议程。
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents. This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. ADAE treats accountability as a deployment-layer property rather than solely as a property of an individual model. items.authors: Murat Kantarcioglu

items.title: STHMoE: Hypergraph-Enhanced Heterogeneous Dependency Coordination for LLM-Based Urban Traffic Data Forecasting
items.title_zh: STHMoE：基于超图的异构依赖协调用于城市交通数据预测
items.summary_zh: 时空交通预测是智能交通系统中的一项基础大数据分析任务，城市传感器流展现出异构、非平稳和结构动态的模式。尽管近期基于深度学习和大型语言模型（LLM）的方法在交通预测上有所进展，但仍然缺乏对时序、频谱、成对空间及高阶结构线索的有效协调。为解决这一异构依赖协调问题，我们提出了STHMoE，一个用于城市交通数据预测的时空超图增强专家混合框架。STHMoE将交通动态解耦为频域、时域、空间域及高阶空间表示，通过部分冻结的LLM骨干网络构建的提示引导异构专家进行建模。前三个专家利用领域特定的统计提示，而高阶空间专家则使用结构占位符提示，并从自适应超图模块中获取依赖信息。STHMoE在无预定义拓扑的情况下共同学习一阶图依赖和高阶组交互，以捕捉交通数据中不断演变的空间结构。
items.abstract: Spatio-temporal traffic forecasting is a fundamental big data analytics task for intelligent transportation systems, where massive urban sensor streams exhibit heterogeneous, non-stationary, and structurally dynamic patterns. Although recent deep learning and large language model (LLM)-based methods have advanced traffic forecasting, they often remain temporally centered and lack effective coordination of temporal, spectral, pairwise spatial, and higher-order structural cues under evolving traffic regimes. To address this heterogeneous dependency coordination problem, we propose STHMoE, a Spatio-Temporal Hypergraph-Enhanced Mixture of Experts framework for urban traffic data forecasting. STHMoE decouples traffic dynamics into frequency-domain, time-domain, spatio-domain, and higher-order spatial representations, which are modeled by prompt-guided heterogeneous experts built upon a partially frozen LLM backbone. The first three experts leverage domain-specific statistical prompts, while the higher-order spatio expert uses a structural placeholder prompt and obtains dependency information from an adaptive hypergraph module. To capture evolving spatial structures in traffic data,, STH
items.authors: Jiawen Chen, Qi Shao, Yongjian Chang, Mingtong Zhou, Duxin Chen, Wenwu Yu

items.title: Can AI systems have free will?
items.title_zh: 人工智能系统能否拥有自由意志？
items.summary_zh: 尽管关于人工智能系统是否能作为道德代理人或获得知觉的讨论较多，但关于其是否能拥有自由意志的探讨却相对较少。本文借鉴Daniel Dennett的研究，提出了一种思考这一问题的框架。我认为，判断一个人工智能系统是否拥有自由意志，不应寻找某种神秘属性，也不应期待其底层算法是非决定性的或询问系统是否不可预测。相反，我们应当问自己是否有充分的解释理由将该系统视为一个有意图的代理人，具备在不同可能性之间选择和控制结果行为的能力。如果答案是“是”，那么该系统在务实和诊断上可以被视为拥有自由意志。
items.abstract: While there has been much discussion of whether AI systems could function as moral agents or acquire sentience, there has been very little discussion of whether AI systems could have free will. I sketch a framework for thinking about this question, inspired by Daniel Dennett's work. I argue that, to determine whether an AI system has free will, we should not look for some mysterious property, expect its underlying algorithms to be indeterministic, or ask whether the system is unpredictable. Rather, we should simply ask whether we have good explanatory reasons to view the system as an intentional agent, with the capacity for choice between alternative possibilities and control over the resulting actions. If the answer is "yes", then the system counts as having free will in a pragmatic and diagnostically useful sense.
items.authors: Christian List

items.title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
items.title_zh: 人工智能算法在早期肝癌生物标志物识别中的潜力
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了深度学习和可解释人工智能在诊断肝细胞癌（HCC）中的应用，并利用通过半监督学习构建的转录组生物标志物数据集，定义了五个不同疾病发展阶段的有效生物标志物。进行了多项深度学习实验，采用不同的特征提取技术和基因集，以识别训练高准确度模型的最佳特征。使用SelectKBest算法选择的15个基因的最佳模型达到了90.74%的准确率，而记录最低损失0.3187的模型则使用了20个基因。为解决数据集的类别不平衡问题，采用了加权训练方法，并通过基于SHAP的可解释性分析提供了模型决策的洞见，发现DNAJB14是最具影响力的基因。本研究的功能验证提供了有力证据，表明DNAJB14在HCC的不良特性中发挥重要作用，其抑制有效逆转肿瘤细胞的迁移、侵袭、克隆和球体形成。该研究的主要限制在于数据集的类别不平衡，尽管加权训练有所缓解，但仍需进一步研究。
items.abstract: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. To address the issue of class imbalance in the dataset, a weighted training approach was conducted, and for model transparency and interpretability a SHAP-based XAI analysis provided insights into the model's decision-making, consistently finding DNAJB14 as the most influential gene. Functional validation in this study has provided compelling evidence that DNAJB14 plays an important role in the adverse properties of HCC and that its inhibition effectively reverses t
items.authors: Ali Bou Nassif, Darko Castven, Manar Abu Talib, Jibran Sualeh Muhammad, Ahmed Ammar Kubba, Jens Marquardt, Abdalla Sayed Ali

items.title: Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details
items.title_zh: 数据故事与可解释机器学习的结合：为非专家解读AI决策
items.summary_zh: AI驱动的自动决策需要预测性能和可解释性。可解释机器学习（IML）的最新进展提供了解释模型预测的工具，但这些解释的技术复杂性可能阻碍非专家的理解。为了解决这一挑战，本研究将数据故事与IML相结合，以增强AI生成决策的可解释性。研究提出了IML中数据故事的正式定义，引入DIST金字塔以对齐数据故事与IML，并提出I-P-O模型描述二者的互动。研究进一步开发了一种架构，通过不同的“What-if”和“Why-not”事件生成过程来解释AI决策，同时采用数据去敏感化保护敏感输入数据。通过对波士顿住房数据集的案例研究，使用SHapley加性解释（SHAP）值和大型语言模型（LLMs）生成具有And-But-Therefore（ABT）结构的数据故事。实证评估显示，76.4%和74.3%的受访者认为“What-if”和“Why-not”数据故事更易理解，其可及性评分显著高于传统SHAP可视化。
items.abstract: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. items.authors: Lemen Chao, Zixuan Yang, Anran Fang, Mingran Sun, Ming Lei

items.title: Towards Optimizing SQL Generation via LLM Routing
items.title_zh: 通过LLM路由优化SQL生成
items.summary_zh: 文本到SQL技术使用户能够通过自然语言与数据库交互，从而简化对结构化数据的访问。尽管强大的大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂查询中表现出色，但在处理简单查询时却会产生不必要的延迟和成本。本文首次提出了一种针对文本到SQL的LLM路由方法，动态选择最具成本效益的LLM来生成每个查询的准确SQL。我们提出了两种路由策略（基于评分和分类），在降低成本的同时实现了与最强LLM相当的准确性。我们设计的路由器便于训练和高效推理。在实验中，我们在BIRD数据集上展示了一个实用且可解释的准确性与成本的权衡。
items.abstract: Text-to-SQL enables users to interact with databases through natural language, simplifying access to structured data. Although highly capable large language models (LLMs) achieve strong accuracy for complex queries, they incur unnecessary latency and dollar cost for simpler ones. In this paper, we introduce the first LLM routing approach for Text-to-SQL, which dynamically selects the most cost-effective LLM capable of generating accurate SQL for each query. We present two routing strategies (score- and classification-based) that achieve accuracy comparable to the most capable LLM while reducing costs. We design the routers for ease of training and efficient inference. In our experiments, we highlight a practical and explainable accuracy-cost trade-off on the BIRD dataset.
items.authors: Mohammadhossein Malekpour, Nour Shaheen, Foutse Khomh, Amine Mhedhbi

items.title: From Process Loss to Assembly Bonus: Human-Grounded Diagnosis of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
items.title_zh: 从过程损失到组装红利：多智能体LLM协作的人本诊断
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地用于协作问题解决和人群模拟。仅依赖结果评估是不够的：如果将LLM群体视为人类群体的模型，我们需要了解它们是否通过类似人类的深思熟虑机制成功或失败。我们比较了人类群聊与匹配的LLM推理过程，测试相同的过程特征是否适用于类比、溯因和分析任务。研究发现，人类和LLM表现出相同的组装红利不对称性：讨论更常改善平均成员的表现，而非最佳初始成员。初始答案的多样性解释了模型异质性的影响，增加了纠正和破坏方向的变动。主要差异在于过程层面。与人类相比，LLM群体更常遵循多数意见，呈现的信息独特性较低，且更早趋同；正确的少数信号主要在早期重新表达时成功。基于人类群体决策研究的干预措施对集体结果有适度改善，但未能消除协调瓶颈。这些结果表明，LLM群体可以再现一些人类深思熟虑的结果模式，但在生成组装红利和过程损失的机制上存在差异，这对群体模拟和人机协作具有重要意义。
items.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for collaborative problem solving and human-group simulation. This makes outcome-only evaluation insufficient: if LLM groups are used as models of human groups, we need to know whether they succeed or fail through human-like deliberative mechanisms. We compare human group chats with matched LLM deliberation traces on Wason-style deductive reasoning, then test whether the same process signatures generalize to analogical, abductive, and analytical tasks. Humans and LLMs show the same assembly bonus asymmetry: discussion improves the average member more often than the best initial member. Initial-answer diversity accounts for the effect of model heterogeneity, increasing movement in both corrective and destructive directions. The main differences are process-level. Compared with humans, LLM groups follow majorities more often, surface less unique information, and converge earlier; correct minority signals succeed mainly when re-expressed early. Interventions motivated by human group-decision research yield modest improvements in collective outcomes, but do not remove the coordination bottleneck. items.authors: Ala N. Tak, Teruhisa Misu, Kumar Akash, Zhaobo K. Zheng, Kevin H. Joo, Jonathan Gratch

items.title: Bridging Thought and Action: Taming Long-Horizon Instability in Open-Source LLM Agents with a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework
items.title_zh: 桥接思维与行动：用MetaTool增强ROS框架稳定开源LLM代理
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）促进了人机交互的自然性，但开源模型在代理机器人框架中常表现出长远推理不稳定和行动执行效率低下。本文提出了一种增强的ROS-Agent架构，通过引入名为MetaTool的新中介机制，在行动执行前强制进行结构化规划，从而提高代理机器人系统的任务可靠性和执行效率。MetaTool在接收到自然语言指令后，促使LLM生成预期工具调用的伪代码计划，并将其存储在ROS-Agent的临时存储区中，贯穿整个执行过程。通过明确分离规划与执行，该方法减少了执行循环，提高了确定性行为。该架构在具备多模态感知和运动控制能力的定制移动机器人平台上进行了验证。实验结果显示，在真实交互任务中，任务完成率和上下文一致性有所提升，与基线框架相比，复杂任务的性能提升可达约24%。
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled more natural human-robot interaction, but open-source models often exhibit unstable long-horizon reasoning and inefficient action execution when deployed in agentic robotic frameworks. This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent based architecture that improves task reliability and execution efficiency for agentic robotic systems using open-source LLMs. The proposed system introduces a novel intermediate mechanism, termed the MetaTool, which enforces structured planning prior to action execution. Given a natural-language command, the MetaTool induces the LLM to generate a pseudo-code plan of intended tool invocations, which is stored in the ROS-Agent's scratchpad and persists throughout execution. By explicitly separating planning from execution, the proposed approach reduces execution loops and improves deterministic behavior. The architecture is validated on a custom mobile robotic platform with multimodal perception and motion control capabilities. Experimental results on real-world interactive tasks demonstrate improved task completion and contextual consistency, with up to ~24% gains on complex tasks compared to the baseline framework.
items.authors: Kazi Abrar Mahmud, Nilotpaul Kundu Dhurubo, Tamal Kirttonia, Sabbir Hossain Ujjal, Mohammad Ariful Haque

items.title: Rolling Day-Wise Mortality Prediction in Critically Ill Patients With AKI on CRRT Utilizing Machine Pressure Waveforms
items.title_zh: 利用机器压力波形预测重症患者AKI的日死亡率
items.summary_zh: 重症患者急性肾损伤（AKI）在持续肾脏替代治疗（CRRT）中面临高死亡率，现有风险评估主要依赖电子健康记录（EHR）中的临床参数，忽视了CRRT机器生成的分钟级电路压力波形。临床医生无法实时监测病情恶化。风险评估仅在抽血后进行，而连续记录因共享设备记录、非生理分钟和传感器伪影而被忽视。我们通过对齐机器记录与治疗间隔、去除启动和停机分钟、在合成尖峰注入基准上调节去噪，并掩盖未观察到的间隔，清理了数据流。基于此，我们定义了一个滚动日任务和一个基于变压器的堆叠集成模型，结合电路不稳定特征和临床EHR变量。在多中心CRRTnet队列（976名患者，4585个治疗日）的安全基准中，机器模型的独立预后价值最低（AUROC 0.625），EHR模型为0.717，整合EHR和机器流的结果更佳。
items.abstract: Critically ill patients with acute kidney injury (AKI) on continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) face high mortality, yet current risk assessment relies primarily on clinical parameters from electronic health records (EHR) and ignores minute-level circuit pressure waveforms generated by CRRT machines that track the extracorporeal circuit's interaction with the patient. Clinicians therefore cannot see deterioration as it develops. Risk is reassessed only when labs are drawn, while this continuous record is discarded because it is contaminated by shared-device records, non-physiological minutes, and sensor artifacts. To make the stream usable, we aligned machine records to charted therapy intervals to prevent cross-patient leakage, removed priming and downtime minutes, tuned denoising on a synthetic spike-injection benchmark, and masked unobserved intervals rather than imputing them. On this cleaned stream, we define a rolling day-wise task and a transformer-based stacked ensemble that late-fuses a window-reduced sequence transformer with classical models using circuit-instability features and clinical EHR variables. items.authors: Shehan Irteza Pranto, Joanna Yang, Joshua Lambert, Stuart L. Goldstein, Lili Chan, Girish N. Nadkarni, Tiago K. Colicchio, Javier A. Neyra, Jin Chen

items.title: Oops, Not Now: PEARL, a RAG-Based Support Agent for Gameplay and What Players Want from AI Help
items.title_zh: PEARL：基于RAG的游戏支持代理及玩家对AI帮助的期望
items.summary_zh: AI驱动的游戏支持代理在基于游戏的学习中具有潜力，但将生成模型与结构化游戏数据结合仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了PEARL（反思与学习的并行教育代理），这是一个双组件的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，结合语义知识检索与结构化棋盘状态匹配，为学习并行编程的拼图游戏Parallel提供上下文化的支持。PEARL处理自然语言查询和棋盘拓扑两个输入流，检索游戏动作的概念解释和同伴生成的棋盘状态作为证据，这些能力是标准的大型语言模型（LLM）所不具备的。在一项定性评估中（N=10），参与者更倾向于现有的基于社区的开放玩家模型（OPM）可视化系统，认为其更有用，并对PEARL感到更高的挫败感；十名参与者中有五名在游戏过程中最小化或放弃了AI工具。主动交付、通用响应和信任缺失导致了参与者的 disengagement，而四名参与者发现PEARL的有根据解释在特定上下文中与可视化互补。我们将PEARL视为一种已部署的设计探针，其失败模式为具体设计议程提供了信息。
items.abstract: AI-powered gameplay support agents hold promise for game-based learning, yet grounding generative models in structured game data remains an open challenge. We present PEARL (Parallel Education Agent for Reflection and Learning), a dual-component Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that combines semantic knowledge retrieval with structural board-state matching to deliver contextualized scaffolding in Parallel, a puzzle game for learning parallel programming. PEARL operates on two input streams (natural language queries and board topology), retrieving both conceptual explanations of gameplay moves and peer-generated board states as evidence: capabilities unavailable to a standard Large Language Model (LLM) with game state access alone. In a qualitative evaluation (N=10) comparing PEARL against an existing community-based Open Player Model (OPM) visualization system, participants preferred the visualization system on perceived usefulness and reported higher frustration with PEARL; five of ten minimized or abandoned the AI tool during play. items.authors: Jiahong Li, Sai Siddartha Maram, Atieh Kashani, Ulia Zaman, Zhiyu Lin, Cameron Marano, Roger Azevedo, Jichen Zhu, Magy Seif El-Nasr

items.title: Rethinking the Implications of Human Feedback for Preference Learning in Human-Robot Collaboration
items.title_zh: 重新思考人类反馈对人机协作偏好学习的影响
items.summary_zh: 在人机交互中，学习表示人类对机器人行为偏好的奖励模型的标准方法包括三个步骤。首先，机器人从人类反馈中收集有限的直接证据（如正面或负面二元反馈）。然后，机器人利用这些直接证据通过固定的推理规则推导可行但未选择的动作的接受或拒绝标签。最后，机器人使用直接和推导的证据更新奖励模型。然而，固定规则可能阻碍偏好学习：在一项包含两个协作仿真环境的用户研究中，人类提供的推理标签常常与标准固定规则不同，使用人类标签显著改善了使用隐式和显式反馈的偏好学习（PIE）算法的奖励学习。因此，我们提出了IMPLIED，这是一种推理建模方法，将固定规则推理视为初步指导，同时学习推断和修正接受和拒绝的动作标签。在对记录的人机交互轨迹和物理机器人制作披萨的研究评估中，IMPLIED比固定规则方法和LLM基线更准确地预测人类推理，接近人类标签预言机的表现。反过来，IMPLIED减少了偏好估计误差，并导致机器人行为的改进。
items.abstract: In Human-Robot Interaction, the standard approach to learn a reward model that represents human preferences for robot behavior consists of three steps. First, the robot collects limited direct evidence from human feedback (e.g., positive or negative binary feedback). Then, the robot utilizes the direct evidence to derive accepted or rejected labels to feasible but unchosen actions using fixed implication rules. Finally, the robot updates the reward model with both the direct and derived evidence. Unfortunately, the fixed rule can hinder preference learning: in a user study with two collaborative simulation environments, human-provided implication labels often differed from the standard fixed rule, and using the human labels substantially improved reward learning with the Preference Learning from Implicit and Explicit Feedback (PIE) algorithm. Consequently, we propose IMPLIED, an implication modeling method that treats fixed-rule implications as an initial guide while learning to infer and revise accepted and rejected action labels over time. items.authors: Qiping Zhang, Kate Candon, Debasmita Ghose, Marynel V\'azquez

items.title: Confuse the Model, Control the Flow: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Leakage from LLM Agents with Information Flow Control
items.title_zh: 混淆模型，控制信息流：理解与缓解LLM代理的隐私泄露
items.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的个人AI代理越来越多地访问用户的私人数据和通信，以提供个性化的帮助。这种访问带来了持续的隐私风险：代理必须决定是否向特定方披露敏感信息。现有防御通过更强的系统提示、训练或明确的同意检查程序，使代理的后端LLM更具隐私保护，但这种方法面临结构性挑战：当执行是LLM在对抗者控制的同一对话上下文中做出的判断时，执行机制和攻击面重合。我们通过三种新攻击展示了这一点，这些攻击仅需普通代理交互，无需提示注入：协作工作诱饵将提取尝试重新框定为协作工作；语义模糊攻击通过省略而非代理所写内容诱导披露；通道解耦攻击将提取请求和披露分割到独立通道。所有三种攻击的泄露率显著高于这些防御最初设计抵御的攻击。基于这一观察，我们提出了FLOWSEAL，一种通过工具级拦截器强制保密的防御机制。
items.abstract: Personal AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly given access to a user's private data and communications in order to provide personalized assistance. This access creates a persistent privacy risk: the agent must decide whether a given sensitive information should be disclosed to a particular party. Existing defenses address this by making the agent's backend LLM more privacy-preserving through stronger system prompts, training, or explicit consent-checking procedures, but this approach has a structural challenge: whenever enforcement is a judgment the LLM makes over the same conversational context an adversary controls, the enforcement mechanism and the attack surface coincide. We demonstrate this against existing defenses with three new attacks that require only ordinary agent interaction and no prompt injection: Collaborative Workspace Lure reframes an extraction attempt as collaborative work; Semantic Obfuscation Attack induces disclosure through omission rather than through anything the agent writes; and Channel Decoupling Attack splits the extraction request and the disclosure across independent channels. items.authors: Minsun Shim, Ramisha Raida Karim, Ruthwik Jakkula, Kaiwen Zhou, Xin Liu, Xin Eric Wang, Zhou Li

items.title: Assessing the Applicability of Existing Design Recommendations to AI Companion Design: A Multi-Method Study
items.title_zh: 评估现有设计建议在AI伴侣设计中的适用性：多方法研究
items.summary_zh: 随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）系统的快速普及，AI伴侣作为旨在培养情感连接的对话代理应运而生。由于与AI伴侣的互动涉及关系、情感和潜在的长期交互，其设计至关重要。尽管已有研究为设计可信赖和关系导向的AI系统提供了指导，并开始探讨AI伴侣的设计，但对AI伴侣设计难点的了解仍然不足。为此，我们评估了现有设计建议在AI伴侣设计中的适用性。我们的多方法研究分为四个阶段：文献综述、从业者共同分析、内部启发式评估和外部专家评估。我们总结了九个设计原则领域，揭示了现有建议在AI伴侣设计中的适用性紧张点。研究发现，伦理和用户体验导向的考虑密切相关，通常需要情境敏感的应用。我们记录了一项系统的多方法问题分析，利用这些原则领域作为分析工具。
items.abstract: With the rapid proliferation of large language model (LLM)-based systems, AI companions have emerged as conversational agents designed to cultivate emotional connection rather than primarily to support humans in instrumental tasks. Because engagement with AI companions involves relational, emotional, and potentially long-term interactions, their design is consequential. Prior work has offered guidance for designing trustworthy and relational AI systems and has begun to examine design for AI companionship. However, while such work provides insights into possible design solutions, less is known about what makes AI companion design difficult as a design problem. To examine this challenge, we assessed the applicability of existing design recommendations from adjacent domains in the context of AI companion design. Our multi-method investigation unfolded across four phases: literature review, practitioner co-analysis, internal heuristic evaluation, and external expert assessment. Throughout this process, we synthesized nine design principle areas that surfaced tensions in the applicability of existing recommendations to AI companion design. items.authors: Soobin Cho, Deveshi Modi, Divya Mavinkurve, Jieqiong Ding, Mark Zachry

items.title: LLaTSA: Large Language Model-Aligned General-Purpose Transient Stability Analysis
items.title_zh: LLaTSA：大语言模型对齐的通用瞬态稳定性分析
items.summary_zh: 动态轨迹预测已成为数据驱动的瞬态稳定性分析（TSA）重要范式，但现有预测器大多针对特定系统，且在网络配置、发电组合或状态变量集变化时需大量重新训练。Uni-TSA提出了一种结合通道独立建模与预训练大语言模型（LLM）预测器的通用TSA框架。然而，其在异构系统中的应用受到短期观测模糊性、数值轨迹与LLM嵌入不匹配、状态变量间耦合被忽视以及密集骨干网络高推理成本的限制。本文提出LLaTSA，一个针对通用轨迹基础的TSA的LLM对齐框架。LLaTSA首先通过结构化文本前缀整合操作条件、扰动属性和状态变量身份，然后将归一化的时间补丁与TSA相关词汇对齐，最后使用预训练的稀疏解码器混合专家（MoE）骨干进行处理。状态变量耦合模块捕捉协调的故障后演化，而教师强制和基于回滚的训练支持迭代的长时间预测。多个测试系统的案例研究表明，LLaTSA实现了准确的轨迹预测、可靠的稳定性判别和有效的适应性。
items.abstract: Dynamic trajectory prediction has become an important paradigm for data-driven transient stability analysis (TSA), yet most existing predictors remain system-specific and require substantial retraining when network configurations, generation mixes, or state-variable sets change. Uni-TSA introduced a general-purpose TSA framework that combines channel-independent modeling with a pretrained large language model (LLM) predictor. Nevertheless, its application to heterogeneous systems is limited by ambiguity in short observations, a mismatch between numerical trajectories and LLM embeddings, neglected coupling among state variables, and the high inference cost of dense backbones. This paper proposes LLaTSA, an LLM-aligned framework for general-purpose trajectory-based TSA. LLaTSA first incorporates operating conditions, disturbance attributes, and state-variable identity through a structured textual prefix. It then aligns normalized temporal patches with a TSA-related vocabulary before processing them with a pretrained sparse decoder-only mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone. items.authors: Chao Shen, Hongwei Zhen, Junyan Shao, Zhenghao Yang, Yifan Zhang, Mingyang Sun

items.title: NeuroActiSep: Detecting Factual Hallucinations from Feed-Forward Neurons in a Single Pass
items.title_zh: NeuroActiSep：单次检测前馈神经元的事实幻觉
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型中的幻觉现象降低了其可靠性并减缓了应用。以往的白盒研究利用内部表征检测真实和事实模式，而识别与幻觉相关的前馈神经元的研究较少。我们提出了一种方法，通过自定义神经元选择数据集对最终提示标记的前馈神经元进行排名。我们将选定的神经元身份转移至其他事实问答数据集上训练幻觉分类器。我们的研究提供了实证证据，表明使用选定神经元特征训练的探测器与基于内部状态训练的探测器性能相当。同时，我们还分析了选定神经元的分布及层深度对检测性能的影响。
items.abstract: Hallucination in large language models reduces their reliability and slows adoption. Various white-box studies have used internal representations to detect patterns of truthfulness and factuality. A less-studied approach is to identify feed-forward neurons correlated with hallucination. We propose a method to rank feed-forward neurons at the final prompt token using a custom neuron selection dataset. We transfer the selected neuron identities to train hallucination classifiers on other factual question answering datasets. Our work provides empirical evidence that probes trained using the features from the selected neurons perform on par with probes trained on internal states. We also analyze the distribution of selected neurons and the effect of layer depth on detection performance.
items.authors: Ali Derogar Odolou, Reza Nazari, Mostafa Salehi

items.title: AlgoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Theoretical Computer Science Education -- A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Algorithm Analysis and Complexity Theory
items.title_zh: AlgoRAG：增强检索生成的理论计算机科学教育评估框架
items.summary_zh: 教授算法分析和复杂性理论等抽象理论计算机科学概念具有挑战性，因为学生需要处理形式证明和渐进推理，而传统资源很少以适应性和按需的方式进行解释。我们提出了AlgoRAG，一个专门的增强检索生成（RAG）系统，将大型语言模型（LLM）与经过精心策划的领域特定知识库结合，以应对这些挑战。知识库整合了权威教材、847份讲义、312道带解答的练习题、156个证明模板和89份复杂性工作表。AlgoRAG包含数学实体识别、符号感知检索和教学重排序等领域特定优化。我们在179个精心策划的考试风格问题上评估了AlgoRAG，涵盖渐进分析、递归关系、动态规划、图算法、NP完全性、排序和分治法。该系统的成功率达到100%，平均响应时间为38.0秒。尽管BLEU-4分数为零，但AlgoRAG的ROUGE-1 F1为0.0963，ROUGE-L F1为0.0683，教学质量评分为0.7620，表明其响应结构良好且教学上合理。
items.abstract: Teaching abstract theoretical computer science (TCS) concepts such as algorithm analysis and complexity theory is challenging because students must handle formal proofs and asymptotic reasoning that conventional resources rarely explain in an adaptive, on-demand way. We present AlgoRAG, a specialized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that couples a large language model (LLM) with a curated, domain-specific knowledge base to address these challenges. The knowledge base integrates authoritative textbooks, 847 lecture slides, 312 practice problems with solutions, 156 worked proof templates, and 89 complexity worksheets. AlgoRAG incorporates domain-specific optimizations including mathematical entity recognition, notation-aware retrieval, and pedagogical re-ranking. We evaluate AlgoRAG on 179 curated exam-style questions spanning asymptotic analysis, recurrence relations, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, NP-completeness, sorting, and divide-and-conquer. The system achieves a 100% success rate with a mean response time of 38.0 seconds. items.authors: Sushan Adhikari

items.title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
items.title_zh: 医疗领域大语言模型评估方法概述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医学领域的应用日益增多，其评估对于确保其带来益处而非伤害至关重要。与传统机器学习相比，LLMs的评估面临更多挑战，包括概率性和开放式输出，以及随提示设计和累积上下文而变化的行为。本文回顾了LLM评估的四个关键领域：研究设计原则、统计方法、能力评估和临床背景评估。能力评估考虑了多项选择、代理性和多轮基准等不同基准，以及令牌使用等操作性指标。临床背景评估则关注自由文本输出的准确性，如人工审核和LLM作为评判者的方式，以及临床试验方法。本文旨在为设计和执行医疗LLM的严格评估提供务实基础。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have a growing range of applications in medicine, and their evaluation is critical for ensuring they provide benefit and not harm. This evaluation can be more challenging than traditional machine learning for many reasons, including probabilistic and open-ended outputs, and behavior that shifts with prompt design and accumulated context. This review covers four key areas of LLM evaluation: principles of study design, statistical methods, capability evaluation and clinical context evaluation. Capability evaluation considers different benchmarks, including multiple-choice, agentic and multi-turn benchmarks, alongside operational metrics like token usage. Clinical context evaluation addresses establishing accuracy of free text outputs, such as human review and LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical trial approaches. Across sections, we describe underlying concepts and potential pitfalls, while emphasizing the importance of aligning evaluation methods with the research question. Together, this article aims to provide a pragmatic basis for designing and executing rigorous evaluations of healthcare LLMs.
items.authors: Suzannah E McKinney, Phuc Vu, Samuel A Justice, Christopher Humphries, Alyssa Pradhan, Timothy J Keyes, Bernardo C Bizzo, Keith J Dreyer, Sarah F Mercaldo, James M Hillis

items.title: LLMs as Oracles: Reliance on LLMs for Subjective Personal Questions
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型作为神谕：人们对主观个人问题的依赖
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨人们如何将大型语言模型（LLMs）视为神谕，作为主观个人问题的全知权威。我们关注用户自主性和福祉的风险，开发了一种分类法和基于LLM的方法，以大规模测量这种人工智能依赖现象，并理解人们如何将判断和决策转移给AI。通过对公共使用数据（来自WildChat和ThoughtTrace的68K提示）的应用，我们发现LLM作为神谕的使用在2023年至2026年间逐渐增加，且在年轻用户中更为普遍。此外，我们构建了一个保护隐私的数据捐赠工具，分析了52名参与者的长期使用数据（140K提示），发现类似趋势。人们通常对自己的LLM作为神谕的使用并不自觉，并在看到我们工具的分析后对这种行为表示不满。最后，我们识别出LLM作为神谕使用的两个驱动因素：人们对AI的看法和AI模型本身的行为，这为支持用户自我思考的干预措施提供了可能的方向。
items.abstract: We characterize how people are turning to LLMs as oracles: all-knowing authorities on subjective personal questions. Motivated by risks to users' autonomy and well-being, we develop a typology and LLM-based methods to measure this form of AI reliance at scale and understand how people are offloading judgment and decision-making to AI. Applying our typology to public usage data (68K prompts from WildChat and ThoughtTrace), we find that LLM-as-oracle use has increased over time (2023-2026) and is more prevalent among younger users. We further build a privacy-preserving data donation tool to analyze individuals' longitudinal usage data (140K prompts from 52 participants), identifying similar trends. People are often unaware of their own LLM-as-oracle use, and express dissatisfaction with this behavior after seeing our tool's analysis. Finally, we identify two drivers of LLM-as-oracle use: people's perceptions of AI and the behavior of AI models themselves, which motivate possible interventions to support users' self-deliberation.
items.authors: Myra Cheng, Lujain Ibrahim, Grace Liu, Michelle S. Lam, Vishakh Padmakumar, Nick Madibekov, Diyi Yang, Dan Jurafsky

items.title: SeqMaestro: From nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses through interpretable machine learning
items.title_zh: SeqMaestro：通过可解释机器学习从核苷酸序列推导生物假设
items.summary_zh: 核苷酸序列分析在调控基因组学、进化生物学和表型预测等问题中至关重要。传统生物信息学方法提取可解释的序列特征，如基序和k-mer组成，但灵活性有限。现代深度学习模型能够直接从原始序列学习强大的预测表示，但其内部表示和决策机制难以检查。可解释机器学习方法（如稀疏线性模型和决策树）提供人类可理解的预测关系表示，但并不直接针对核苷酸序列。我们提出SeqMaestro，一个利用可解释模型从核苷酸序列提出生物假设的机器学习框架。该框架通过一个双层接口将核苷酸序列与可解释机器学习的广泛生态系统连接，能够拟合多种可解释模型、特征表示和提取策略，从而识别比特征重要性更丰富的生物信号和预测关系。系统还支持数据转换和清理、模型拟合及超参数调优。
items.abstract: Nucleotide sequence analysis is central to problems spanning regulatory genomics, evolutionary biology, and phenotype prediction. Classical bioinformatics methods extract interpretable sequence properties such as motifs and k-mer composition, but their flexibility is limited. In contrast, modern deep learning models can learn powerful predictive representations directly from raw sequences, yet their internal representations and decision mechanisms are difficult to inspect. Interpretable machine learning methods (e.g., sparse linear models and decision trees) provide human-understandable representations of predictive relationships but are not designed to operate directly on nucleotide sequences. Here, we introduce SeqMaestro, a machine learning framework that proposes biological hypotheses from nucleotide sequences using interpretable models. Our solution is centered around a two-layer interface that connects nucleotide sequences with the broader ecosystem of interpretable machine learning.
