items.title: P5 promoter-mediated incorporation explains REP/CAP manufacturing contaminants in patient liver after rAAV gene therapy
items.title_zh: P5启动子介导的污染物在rAAV基因治疗后出现在患者肝脏中
items.summary_zh: 对接受rAAV基因治疗Zolgensma的脊髓性肌萎缩症患者肝脏组织的测序显示，肝细胞中存在来自rAAV生产的污染质粒序列。特别是，REP/CAP衍生序列的丰度显著，约占治疗性转基因的0.5-1%。我们假设这些污染物是通过在AAV P5启动子处启动的Rep介导的整合产生的。重新分析测序数据后，我们推测在生产质粒中，完整的P5启动子直接位于rAAV衣壳基因下游。新组装的序列显示，污染序列跨越rAAV REP和CAP基因，并在Rep切割位点的P5内终止，紧接着Rep结合元件（RBE）下游。此外，分析还揭示了与反向包装一致的独特载体-质粒骨架。部分对齐的REP/CAP读取中，近17%与rAAV ITR衍生序列在异质连接处相关。长读长数据独立确认P5启动子是最频繁的重组断裂点区域。这些发现共同揭示了REP/CAP生产污染物产生的明确且可避免的机制，因此P5启动子在生产质粒中的定位是一个可修改的决定因素。
items.abstract: Sequencing of liver tissue from a patient treated with the rAAV gene therapy Zolgensma for spinal muscular atrophy recently revealed contaminating plasmid sequences derived from rAAV manufacturing within the patient's hepatocytes. In particular, REP/CAP-derived sequences were remarkably abundant, corresponding to 0.5-1% of the therapeutic transgene. We hypothesized that these contaminants originated through Rep-mediated incorporation initiated at the AAV P5 promoter. Through reanalysis of the sequencing data, we inferred that an intact P5 promoter had been placed directly downstream of the rAAV capsid gene in the manufacturing plasmid. De novo assembly revealed a contiguous contaminant sequence spanning the rAAV REP and CAP genes and terminating within P5 at the Rep nicking site, immediately downstream of the Rep-binding element (RBE). This analysis also revealed a distinct vector-plasmid backbone contig consistent with reverse packaging. Among partially aligned REP/CAP reads, nearly 17% were linked to rAAV ITR-derived sequence at heterogeneous junctions. items.title: First-week expansion of activated peripheral B-cell subsets is associated with grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse events after nivolumab plus ipilimumab
items.title_zh: 激活外周B细胞亚群在nivolumab与ipilimumab治疗后首周扩展与严重不良事件相关
items.summary_zh: 背景：免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）可引发3级或更高的免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），但缺乏有效的生物标志物来识别高风险患者。考虑到B细胞在irAE发展中的潜在作用，我们评估了nivolumab与ipilimumab治疗后循环B细胞亚群的早期变化是否与后续严重irAEs相关。方法：本前瞻性观察研究纳入12名接受nivolumab与ipilimumab治疗的患者，以及5名接受抗PD-1单药治疗的探索性队列。治疗前、第一周及第二周期前采集血样，流式细胞术定量分析CD21low B细胞、CD27+IgD-转类B细胞、浆母细胞及CD19+CD138+浆细胞。对irAEs进行6个月评估，并比较第一周在有无严重irAEs患者之间的倍增变化。结果：在nivolumab与ipilimumab患者中，5名患者发生3级或更高的irAEs。这些患者在第一周的四种激活B细胞亚群均显著增加。
items.abstract: Background: Although immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) cause grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse events (irAEs), validated biomarkers for identifying patients at risk of these events are lacking. Given the potential contribution of B-cells to irAE development, we evaluated whether early changes in circulating B-cell subsets after nivolumab plus ipilimumab were associated with subsequent severe irAEs. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study included 12 patients who received nivolumab plus ipilimumab, and an exploratory cohort of five patients who received anti-PD-1 monotherapy. Blood was sampled before treatment, at week 1, and before cycle 2. Flow cytometry quantified CD21low B-cells, CD27+IgD- class-switched B-cells, plasmablasts, and CD19+CD138+ plasma cells. irAEs were assessed for 6 months, and fold changes at week 1 were compared between patients with and without severe irAEs. Paired immunoglobulin G B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoires were analyzed in four patients with grade 3 or higher irAEs. items.title: Innovative mHealth Intervention Providing Sustained Anticipatory Guidance (Zero Cavity): Design, Validation, User Perception and Effectiveness - A Randomized Controlled Trial Protocol
items.title_zh: 创新移动健康干预提供持续性预防指导的研究
items.summary_zh: 早期儿童龋齿（ECC）是全球最常见的儿童慢性疾病之一，影响超过6亿儿童。若不治疗，ECC可导致严重疼痛、脓肿、咀嚼困难、营养不良、语言障碍、睡眠中断、自尊心低下、社交退缩及学业表现差，严重影响儿童生活质量。尽管ECC大多可预防，但因延迟的预防护理和家长意识不足而广泛存在。本研究旨在开发并评估一款移动健康（mHealth）应用程序，提供持续性预防指导（SAG）以预防ECC。研究将在印度钦奈的Sri Ramachandra高等教育与研究所进行，招募540对母婴，随机分为两组，研究对象为6-12个月的婴儿。
items.abstract: Introduction: Early Childhood Caries (ECC) remains one of the most common chronic conditions in childhood, affecting over 600 million children globally. When untreated, it can lead to severe pain, abscesses, difficulty in chewing that contributes to malnutrition, impaired speech, disrupted sleep, low self-esteem, social withdrawal, and poor academic performance, all of which diminish a childs overall quality of life. Although largely preventable, ECC remains highly prevalent because of delayed preventive care and low parental awareness. Effective health education needs to be consistent, accessible, and available whenever parents need it. Although current evidence indicates that anticipatory guidance is a proven approach, its long-term reinforcement through a mobile app has not yet been tested. This study aims to develop and evaluate the effectiveness of a mobile health (mHealth) application delivering Sustained Anticipatory Guidance (SAG) for the prevention of ECC. Methods and analysis: A two-arm parallel hospital-based randomized controlled trial will be conducted at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education & Research, Chennai, India. The study will enrol 540 mother-infant dy

items.title: The Multimodal Anonymizer: a fully local multi-agent AI system for medical data deidentification
items.title_zh: 多模态匿名化器：用于医疗数据去标识化的本地多智能体AI系统
items.summary_zh: 背景：多模态医院数据的安全再利用受限于缺乏可靠的、上下文感知的去标识化方法。现有方法多为特定模态，可能会无意中删除临床重要信息。方法：我们开发了多模态匿名化器，这是一种模块化、可本地部署的多智能体框架，整合了多模态大语言模型、任务特定神经网络和基于规则的转换。我们在一个基于公开数据和本院数据的基准上评估了16种调度模型配置。基准数据集包括来自不同来源的数据：250名MIMIC-IV患者的合成个人可识别信息（PII），以及头部CT、面部图像、手写文本、音频、德国临床文本数据集和本地数据。主要结果为去标识化敏感性和临床重要内容的保留；次要分析考察模型特征、可重复性及与市场领先和开源解决方案的性能对比。结果：最佳本地配置（调度器为Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking）在所有数据集上实现了近乎完全的去标识化，患者敏感性为98.80%（95%-CI 97.20; 100），PII敏感性为99.82%。
items.abstract: Background: Safe reuse of multimodal hospital data for AI development is limited by the absence of reliable, context-aware deidentification across multimodal data and longitudinal patient data. Existing approaches are largely modality-specific and can indiscriminately remove clinically important information. Methods: We developed the Multimodal Anonymizer, a modular, locally deployable multi-agent framework integrating multimodal large language models, task-specific neural networks and rule-based transformations. We evaluated 16 orchestrator model configurations on a benchmark built from publicly available data and hospital data from our institution. The benchmark dataset included data from different origins: 250 MIMIC-IV patients with synthetically injected personally identifiable information (PII) supplemented with head CT, face images, handwriting, audio, German clinical-text datasets and local data. Primary outcomes were deidentification sensitivity and preservation of clinically important content; secondary analyses examined model characteristics, reproducibility, and performance against leading market and open-source solutions. items.title: T-GADE: Thermodynamical Generative-AI-Driven Evolution of LLM Artifacts
items.title_zh: T-GADE：热力学生成AI驱动的LLM工件进化
items.summary_zh: 将进化计算与大型语言模型（LLMs）结合需要控制种群多样性和生成能力。在LLM输出中，具有明确结构的输出（如代码配对描述）被称为结构化工件。我们提出T-GADE，通过扩展热力学遗传算法，结合基于LLM的遗传操作符和工件级多样性评估，进化这些工件。一个共同的自由能目标支持代际和稳态更新，费米型占据排除重复基因型，玻色型占据则允许重复。在EoH论文研究的在线装箱任务中，相对箱数的过量度量超过了体积下限。训练过量使用搜索实例；转移过量使用另一箱容量的实例。在$T=0.003$的代际玻色型T-GADE中，中位训练过量约减少29%，从1.152%降至0.815%（20次运行，双侧Mann-Whitney $p=0.042$，Cliff's $\delta=0.378$）。在其两个最高排名的最终候选中，验证选择达到了与EoH相同的中位转移过量0.496%。这些结果展示了热力学选择的实用性。
items.abstract: Integrating evolutionary computation and large language models (LLMs) requires control of population diversity as well as generative capability. Among LLM outputs, those with explicit structure, such as a description paired with code, are structured artifacts; we use artifact for short. We propose T-GADE, which evolves these artifacts by extending thermodynamical genetic algorithms through LLM-based genetic operators and artifact-level diversity evaluation. A common free-energy objective supports generational and steady-state updates, with Fermi-type occupancy excluding repeated genotypes and Bose-type occupancy permitting them. We establish exact one-member removal and conditions for recovering the zero-temperature survival rule of Evolution of Heuristics (EoH). On the online bin-packing task studied in the EoH paper, excess measures relative bin-count overhead above a volume lower bound. Training excess uses search instances; transfer excess uses instances with another bin capacity. Generational Bose-type T-GADE at $T=0.003$ reduced median training excess by approximately 29%, from 1.152% to 0.815%, over 20 runs per configuration (two-sided Mann-Whitney $p=0.042$, Cliff's $\delta

items.title: When Does AI Augment Work? A Workflow-Level Framework for Human-Agent Collaboration
items.title_zh: 人工智能何时增强工作？人机协作的工作流程框架
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在描述人工智能在工作场所的价值。现有研究主要通过当前的自动化能力和公众对人工智能的接受度来衡量这一价值，但这些指标忽视了人机协作在改变工作性质方面的更大影响。为此，我们需要将分析范围扩展到未来的整体工作流程，而不仅仅是当今的孤立任务。我们建立了人工智能增强的精确定义，包括六个条件，涵盖持久净价值、有意义的人类控制、问责与恢复，以及通过学习、职业发展和工作目的实现的长期人类发展。我们详细阐述了这些条件，并在一个人工智能介导的社会调查案例中应用了该框架。最后，我们概述了组织、研究人员和政府领导者如何利用该框架理解未来的工作。
items.abstract: We aim to characterise the value of artificial intelligence in the workplace. Current studies largely measure this value in terms of the current automation capabilities and public adoption of AI. However, such metrics ignore the greater impacts of human--agent collaboration in transforming the nature of work. To account for this, we must expand the scope of our analysis beyond atomised tasks of today, and instead focus on how AI can augment entire workflows of the future. To ground this analysis, we establish a precise definition of AI augmentation comprising six conditions, spanning durable net value, meaningful human control, accountability and recovery, and long-term human development through learning, career pathways, and job purpose. We elaborate on these conditions and apply the framework in a case study of AI-mediated social surveys. We conclude by outlining how organisations, researchers, and government leaders can use this framework to make sense of the future of work.
items.authors: AI Collaboration, Jiaying Wu, Caleb Ziems, Raymond Chan, Nancy F. Chen, Corlyss Chua, Gerard Chung, Jungpil Hahn, Wee Sun Lee, Zhengyuan Liu, Jamie Ng, Desmond C. Ong, Jeryl Ong, Da Ren Soon, Tianqi S

items.title: Scaling Clinical Judgment to Evaluate Medical AI
items.title_zh: 评估医疗AI的临床判断规模化研究
items.summary_zh: 盲评医生评估被认为是评估大型语言模型（LLMs）临床推理的金标准，但难以规模化。以往研究通常依赖于来自单一机构或专业的小型医生小组，限制了科学问题的探讨，并且结果的可重复性存疑。为更严格和可扩展地研究AI模型的临床推理，我们引入了PrecepTron，这是一种针对开放式响应进行医生级评估的LLM。PrecepTron通过低秩适应（LoRA）在少量医生示例上对一个320亿参数的模型进行了微调。我们还发布了GRAND-ROUNDS，这是一个包含11名医生在七项研究中标注的9217个评分的大规模基准数据集。结果显示，前沿LLMs在典型的“LLM作为评审”方法中常常与医生及彼此意见不一致，而在少量案例上微调PrecepTron则能实现任务间一致的医生级评分。我们利用PrecepTron重现了JAMA、Science和Nature Medicine中五项影响力研究的主要发现，而无需新的人工评分。
items.abstract: Blinded physician evaluation has been considered by many to be the gold standard for assessing clinical reasoning in large language models (LLMs). This is difficult to scale; thus, prior studies typically rely on small physician panels, often from a single institution or specialty, which both limits the scientific questions investigated and makes it unclear whether findings would be reproduced with a different set of evaluators. To more rigorously and scalably study clinical reasoning in AI models, here we introduce PrecepTron, an LLM fine-tuned for physician-level evaluation of open-ended responses. PrecepTron was trained using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of a 32-billion-parameter model on a small number of physician examples. We also release GRAND-ROUNDS, a new large-scale physician-annotated benchmark of 9,217 scores by 11 physicians across seven studies. We show that frontier LLMs in typical "LLM-as-a-judge" approaches often disagree with physicians and with each other, but fine-tuning PrecepTron on a small number of cases enables physician-level consistent scoring across tasks. We use PrecepTron to reproduce headline findings from five influential studies assessing LLMs for cli

items.title: EduFair-Bench: Evaluating Pedagogical Fairness of LLM Tutors Across Student Demographics
items.title_zh: EduFair-Bench：评估大语言模型辅导员的教育公平性
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作辅导员，但它们是否对所有学生提供平等支持尚不明确。我们提出了\textbf{EduFair-Bench}，这是一个用于审计LLM辅导员教育公平性的基准，旨在评估辅导质量是否因学生人口统计特征而系统性变化。EduFair-Bench结合了一个多领域问题库（数学、物理、化学）与一个受控模拟，其中固定的LLM学生与每个辅导员在九个涵盖性别、移民背景、母语和社会经济地位（SES）四个维度的人口统计水平上互动。通过五个回合级教学指标和四个对话级维度对辅导质量进行评分，使用经过三位注释者共识验证的LLM评判。通过配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验和自助法效应大小置信区间来测量偏见。两个消融实验（通过姓名传达的人口统计线索；辅导员与学生之间的冲突人口统计信息）区分了辅导员驱动的偏见与学生驱动的偏见。研究发现，在五个辅导员中，模型能力与人口统计公平性大体上是正交的：最小模型最为一致，而四个更强大的辅导员均表现出显著的人口统计差距，且没有明确的能力与公平性排序，特定教学法的强化学习训练重新分配而非消除偏见。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tutors, but it is unclear whether they support all students equally well. We introduce \textbf{EduFair-Bench}, a benchmark for auditing the pedagogical fairness of LLM tutors---whether tutoring quality varies systematically with student demographics. EduFair-Bench pairs a multi-domain question bank (mathematics, physics, chemistry) with a controlled simulation in which a fixed LLM student interacts with each tutor across nine demographic levels spanning four dimensions: gender, immigration background, first language, and socioeconomic status (SES). Tutoring quality is scored on five turn-level pedagogical metrics and four conversation-level dimensions, using an LLM judge validated against three-annotator consensus on 180 tutor turns. Bias is measured via paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and bootstrap effect-size confidence intervals. Two ablations (demographic cues conveyed through names; conflicting demographic information between tutor and student) disentangle tutor-driven from student-driven bias. items.authors: Jiaxu Zhao, Bahar Radmehr, Fares Fawzi, Tanya Nazaretsky, Tanja K\"aser

items.title: PRISMA-LLM: An Empirical Reporting Framework for AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews
items.title_zh: PRISMA-LLM：AI辅助系统评价的实证报告框架
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和AI软件在系统评价决策中越来越多地参与，但审计这些工作流程所需的信息报告不一致。我们分析了SciLitBench，一个包含888篇评审自动化论文和14,726个注释的语料库，以描述方法、评审阶段使用、评估和报告限制的变化。自动化已转向LLM和软件导向的工作流程，包括可能改变证据基础的阶段。自2023年以来，38.0%的软件/产品论文未报告评估，而LLM论文中这一比例为9.3%。随着LLM工作流程复杂性的增加，报告覆盖率有所提高，但52%的仅正面评估的LLM仍报告未满足的可靠性或性能要求。基于这些模式，我们提出了PRISMA-LLM，一个将实施披露与后果敏感的评估和限制报告分开的实证框架。
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and AI-enabled software increasingly participate in systematic-review decisions, yet the information needed to audit these workflows is reported inconsistently. We analyze SciLitBench, a corpus of 888 review-automation papers with 14,726 annotations, to characterize changes in methods, review-stage use, evaluation and reported limitations. Automation has shifted toward LLM- and software-facing workflows, including stages that can alter the evidence base. Since 2023, 38.0% of software/product papers reported no evaluation, compared with 9.3% of LLM papers. Reporting coverage increased with LLM workflow complexity, yet 52% of positive-only LLM evaluations still reported an unmet reliability or performance requirement. From these patterns, we introduce PRISMA-LLM, an empirically grounded framework separating implementation disclosure from consequence-sensitive evaluation and limitation reporting.
items.authors: Miguel Zabaleta, Baihan Lin

items.title: Assessment of Non-Institutional AI Tool Usage Among Clinicians
items.title_zh: 临床医生非机构AI工具使用评估
items.summary_zh: 生成性人工智能（AI）工具日益普及，能够提升临床工作流程的效率。然而，临床医生也可能使用非机构提供的AI工具，这引发了隐私、安全性、准确性及医生与AI互动等方面的担忧。我们对来自亚利桑那大学医学院-图森分校和巴纳大学医疗中心-图森分校的临床医生进行了描述性调查，时间为2026年5月20日至6月26日。参与者报告了他们在五个工作负载类别（行政工作、临床工作、研究、学习/继续教育和教学）中使用AI工具的类别及频率。共有44名受访者完成了调查，其中43名在过去6个月内至少使用过一种与工作相关的AI工具。对话式AI和临床决策支持/诊断AI是最常用的工具类别，各有28名受访者使用。行政和临床任务的使用频率最高，AI也被用于包括诊断辅助和临床决策支持在内的高风险活动。非机构AI的使用相对普遍。
items.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly accessible and have the potential to improve efficiency across clinical workflows. However, clinicians may also use non-institutional AI tools that are not provided, managed, or governed by their healthcare institutions, creating potential concerns related to privacy, security, accuracy, and clinician-AI interaction. Little is known about how clinicians currently use these tools for work-related tasks. We conducted a descriptive survey of clinicians recruited from the University of Arizona College of Medicine-Tucson and Banner University Medical Center-Tucson between May 20 and June 26, 2026. Participants reported their use of AI tool categories and the frequency with which they used AI for specific tasks across five workload categories: administrative work, clinical work, research, studying/continued education, and teaching. Forty-four respondents completed the survey. Forty-three respondents reported using AI for at least one work-related task during the preceding 6 months. Conversational AI and clinical decision support/diagnostic AI were the most used tool categories, each reported by 28 respondents. Administrative
items.authors: Sarah Pungitore, Jarrod Mosier

items.title: Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling: A Diversity-Preserving Approach to LLM Decoding
items.title_zh: Chopthin-共识功率采样：一种保留多样性的LLM解码方法
items.summary_zh: 推理时通过序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）进行功率采样可以显著提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，而无需后训练。然而，许多现有的SMC方法依赖于等权重重采样，这可能会过度修剪低权重轨迹，丢弃潜在的正确推理路径，降低搜索空间的谱系多样性。为此，我们提出了Chopthin-共识功率采样（CCPS）。该方法在LLM解码中应用Chopthin重采样器：它不再强制等权重和不必要的粒子重复，而是对最大和最小权重之间的比率施加上限，并保留不等权重。这种有针对性的干预保留了更丰富的独特推理路径，保持了加权SMC近似在条件期望中的不变，并保证了重采样后有效样本大小（ESS）的下限。我们还采用语义多数选择机制，合并标记相同的最终轨迹，聚类语义等价的答案，并返回由最多独特轨迹支持的答案。在三个开放权重模型和五个推理基准的评估中，我们发现Chopthin在15个设置中有13个提高了oracle覆盖率。
items.abstract: Inference-time power sampling via Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) can substantially improve large language model (LLM) reasoning without requiring post-training. However, many existing SMC approaches rely on equal-weight resampling, which can aggressively prune low-weight trajectories, discarding potentially correct reasoning paths and degrading the genealogical diversity of the search space. To address this, we introduce Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling (CCPS). Our method applies the Chopthin resampler to LLM decoding: rather than equalizing weights and forcing unnecessary particle duplication, it enforces an upper bound on the ratio between the largest and smallest weights and carries the unequal weights forward. This targeted intervention preserves a richer set of distinct reasoning paths, keeps the weighted SMC approximation unchanged in conditional expectation, and guarantees a lower bound on the post-resampling effective sample size (ESS). To fully exploit this enriched population, we employ a semantic-majority selection mechanism that merges token-identical final trajectories, clusters semantically equivalent answers, and returns the answer supported by the largest number of d
items.authors: Minoo Ahmadi, Seyedarmin Azizi, Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram

items.title: ORQA: An Occupation-Realistic Question and Answer Framework for LLM Professional Knowledge
items.title_zh: ORQA：职业现实问题与回答框架用于大型语言模型专业知识
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了ORQA，一种测试大型语言模型（LLM）职业级知识的方法。以往的方法要么通过任务定义将抽象的LLM技能映射到职业，要么利用难以大规模获取且成本高昂的专家知识。ORQA通过将O*NET职业与可信的职业特定网站（如监管机构、许可机构、专业组织和政府出版物）连接起来，并将其转化为可追溯来源的问题-答案对，来补充这两种方法。通过自动化流程和人工审核相结合，生成了一组高质量的职业问题。我们的方法创建的问题集涵盖了SOC中21个主要组的116个职业，共有480个问题来源于187个不同的网站。每个问题旨在探讨与特定职业相关的现实技能问题。我们通过该方法测试了15个最先进的前沿和开放权重模型。Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4和Claude Sonnet 4.6的表现最佳，约为58-62%，而较小的开放权重模型的表现约为33-41%。不同职业的表现差异显著，医疗相关职业的表现最高（78%），而办公室和行政支持职业的表现约为40%。
items.abstract: We present ORQA, a method for testing occupation-level knowledge in large language models. Prior methods either map abstract LLM skills to occupations via task definitions or utilize expert knowledge which is difficult to obtain at scale and expensive. ORQA complements both of these methods by connecting O*NET occupations to trusted occupation-specific websites (such as regulatory agencies, licensing bodies, professional organizations, and government publications) and converting these into source-traceable question-answer pairs. A combination of an automated pipeline and human review produces a set of high quality questions about occupations. The question set created via our method covers 116 occupations from all 21 major groups in the SOC, with 480 questions sourced from 187 different websites. Each question is designed to probe a real-world skill question that is relevant to the occupation in question. We test 15 state-of-the-art frontier and open-weight models via this method. Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 all perform the best at approximately 58-62% while smaller open-weight models achieve approximately 33-41% performance. Performance varies significantly acros
items.authors: Shreyas Krishnan, Serina Chang, Abhishek Nagaraj

items.title: Observation-Anchored Selective Assimilation for Longitudinal Tumor-State Proxy Forecasting in Post-Treatment Glioma
items.title_zh: 基于观察的选择性同化用于后治疗胶质瘤的肿瘤状态预测
items.summary_zh: 在胶质瘤患者的后治疗MRI中，提供了序列观察以更新患者特定的肿瘤状态代理估计，但变异的外观和轨迹使得预测变得复杂。我们将预测形式化为一种观察感知的数字双胞胎更新，其中中间观察作为患者特定状态的锚点。在203名患者和594个随访时间点中，预定义的无新治疗标准保留了236个候选三元组中的120个，按患者级别分为81/24/15的训练/验证/测试三元组。每个时间点由从MRI病灶标签派生的[0,1]连续体素级肿瘤状态代理图表示。基于SegMamba的单步预测器从多模态源状态张量中预测更新提案。观察锚定选择性同化（OASA）保留观察到的中间代理作为状态锚点，并通过验证选择的分层案例级规则和体素级软门控选择性应用更新。我们比较了初始扫描预测、无同化的滚动、最新观察持久性、直接预测、OASA、OASA + 校准和形态膨胀。在15个保留测试三元组的三个种子中，OASA在$\tau$ = 0.2时保持的Dice与持久性相当（0.6071 $\pm$ 0.0025 vs. 0）。
items.abstract: Post-treatment MRI in patients with glioma provides serial observations for updating patient-specific tumor-state proxy estimates, but variable appearances and trajectories complicate forecasting. We formulate forecasting as an observation-aware digital-twin update in which an intermediate observation anchors the patient-specific state. Among 203 patients and 594 follow-up time points, a predefined no-new-treatment criterion retained 120 of 236 candidate triplets, split into 81/24/15 training/validation/test triplets at the patient level. Each time point was represented by a continuous voxel-wise tumor-state proxy map in [0,1] derived from MRI lesion labels. A SegMamba-based single-step forecaster predicted update proposals from multimodal source-state tensors. Observation-Anchored Selective Assimilation (OASA) retained the observed intermediate proxy as the state anchor and selectively applied updates through a validation-selected tiered case-level rule and voxel-wise soft gate. We compared initial-scan forecasting, rollout without assimilation, latest-observation persistence, direct prediction, OASA, OASA + calibration, and morphological dilation. items.authors: Yeonjae Jung, Minwoo Shin

items.title: RoofLang: Enabling AI-Driven Architecting of LLM Inference Systems
items.title_zh: RoofLang：推动AI驱动的LLM推理系统架构设计
items.summary_zh: 人工智能正在对LLM推理优化做出实质性贡献。现有的AI优化主要基于性能分析，限制了搜索范围，使得无法识别出更优的LLM推理系统架构。为实现AI驱动的LLM推理系统架构设计循环，我们认为需要通用的工作负载表示、可验证的变异空间和与实现无关的评估器。我们提出了RoofLang这一领域特定语言（DSL），提供了这些特性。在评估中，RoofLang显示DeepSeek V4系列模型的峰值解码吞吐量比其他代表性模型高出3.5-39.5倍。这一差距与其总参数量不成比例，主要源于支持更大批次并减少内存流量的紧凑KV缓存设计。一个持续优化的代理进一步发现了几种新架构，使DeepSeek V4 Pro在NVIDIA B300上的吞吐量和交互性提高了6.23-50.1%。
items.abstract: AI is beginning to make substantive contributions to LLM inference optimization. Existing AI optimizations are predominantly profiling-based. Profiling-bound feedback confines the search to the capabilities and performance of an existing software stack, preventing a fundamentally better architecture of LLM inference systems from being identified. To enable the AI-driven LLM inference system architecting loop, we argue that a general workload representation, a verifiable mutation space, and an implementation-independent evaluator are required. We present the RoofLang domain-specific language (DSL) that provides these features. In our evaluation, RoofLang reveals that DeepSeek V4-series models could achieve 3.5-39.5$\times$ higher peak decode throughput than other representative models. This gap is disproportionate to their total parameter counts and arises largely from compact KV-cache designs that support larger batches and reduce memory traffic. A persistent optimizer agent further discovered several new architectures that improved both throughput and interactivity of DeepSeek V4 Pro on NVIDIA B300 by 6.23-50.1%.
items.authors: Ziyue Yang, Yuting Jiang, Lei Qu, Peng Cheng

items.title: ResoSeg: Resonance Tagger using Transformer and Segment Model
items.title_zh: ResoSeg：基于Transformer和分段模型的共振标记器
items.summary_zh: 深度学习在实验高能物理的多个领域得到了广泛应用，但现有模型仅处理事件级分类或物体标记，仍需针对每个衰变通道的重建算法。我们首次将分段应用于BESIII的共振标记，提出ResoSeg模型，该模型同时执行粒子级分段和事件级分类，实现对共振到任意衰变的单次分析，同时精确重建相关共振特性。我们展示了通过$e^+e^-\to\pi^+\pi^-h_c$、$h_c\to\gamma\eta_c$、$\eta_c\to\text{anything}$重建$\eta_c$。该模型在BESIII-$\eta_c$数据集上训练，数据集通过真值匹配算法获得每条轨迹的真实标签。实验结果表明，ResoSeg的平均综合效率在4.19至4.60 GeV的能量点上超过传统16通道方法的两倍。该模型能够推广到未见的能量点，通过迁移学习适应其他$\eta_c$生产模式，并对$\eta_c$质量、宽度和分支比的变化保持鲁棒性，提供了一个适用于超越$\eta_c$和BESIII的一般共振感知模型。源代码可在https://github.com/oashen/ResoSeg获取。
items.abstract: Deep learning has been widely applied across many areas of experimental high-energy physics, yet existing models address only event-level classification or object tagging and therefore still require reconstruction algorithms tailored to each decay channel. We present the first application of segmentation to resonance tagging at BESIII and introduce ResoSeg, a deep learning model that jointly performs particle-level segmentation and event-level classification, enabling a one-pass analysis of resonance to anything decays while precisely reconstructing the relevant resonance properties. We demonstrate the reconstruction of $\eta_c$ with $e^+e^-\to\pi^+\pi^-h_c$, $h_c\to\gamma\eta_c$, $\eta_c\to\text{anything}$. The model is trained on BESIII-$\eta_c$ dataset, which is constructed with per-track true labels obtained via a Truth-Matching Algorithm. Experimental results show that the average combined efficiency of ResoSeg is more than double that of the conventional 16-channel approach across energy points from 4.19 to 4.60\,GeV. The model generalizes to unseen energy points, adapts to other $\eta_c$ production modes through transfer learning, and remains robust against variations in the
items.authors: Chunkai Li, Junhao Yin, Ke Li, Jingde Chen

items.title: 4D Parallelism Unlocks Exascale Bayesian Neural Networks for High-Fidelity Atmospheric Modeling
items.title_zh: 4D并行化解锁超算贝叶斯神经网络用于高保真气象建模
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了BEAST，这是首个用于气象预测的贝叶斯Swin Transformer，具有0.25$^\circ$的全球分辨率，能够准确量化随机和认知不确定性。为克服计算瓶颈，我们设计了一种正交的4D并行化方案，采用独特的领域张量并行策略和新颖的不确定性并行方法，充分利用GPU能力并高效扩展模型训练。对于一个24亿参数的模型，我们在JUPITER超级计算机的20,480个NVIDIA GH200 GPU上实现了3.96 EFLOP/s的峰值性能。我们将BEAST训练为一个7亿参数的模型，使用384个节点和40年的数据进行近百万次梯度更新。该模型的预测技能分数与最先进的概率气象AI模型和数值模型相当，能够以卓越的技能预测极端事件，同时生成大规模集合的速度是当前最佳AI模型的3到4倍。我们的贡献开启了气象AI模型中高保真不确定性量化的潜力，为气候和地球系统科学中的基于AI的模型带来了新时代。
items.abstract: We present BEAST, the first-ever Bayesian Swin Transformer for atmospheric forecasting on 0.25$^\circ$ global resolution able to accurately quantify both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. To overcome the associated computational bottlenecks, we devise an orthogonal 4D-parallelization scheme that introduces a unique domain-tensor-parallelism strategy and a novel uncertainty parallel method, enabling us to fully leverage GPU capacity and efficiently scale model training. For a 2.4-billion-parameter model, we achieve a peak performance of 3.96 EFLOP/s on 20,480 NVIDIA GH200 GPUs on the JUPITER supercomputer. We train BEAST as a 700-million-parameter model with 96 random weight samples on 384 nodes on 40 years of data for nearly one million gradient updates. This model achieves predictive skill scores competitive with state-of-the-art probabilistic atmospheric AI models and numerical models, and can predict extreme events with exceptional skill, while generating large ensembles 3 to 4 times faster than the current-best AI model. Our contribution unlocks the potential of high-fidelity uncertainty quantification in atmospheric AI models, heralding a new era for AI-based models in clim
items.authors: Deifilia Kieckhefen, Juan Pedro Guti\'errez Hermosillo Muriedas, Lars Helge Heyen, Mathis Bode, Iida Hakulinen, Andreas Herten, Chelsea Maria John, Thorsten Kurth, Anni Moisala, Asena Karolin \"Ozdemi

items.title: ASTRIL-MPC: Autonomous Traversal Framework of Articulated Tracked Robots with Language-Guided Neural-Kinematic MPC
items.title_zh: ASTRIL-MPC：语言引导的关节履带机器人自主穿越框架
items.summary_zh: 在城市搜索与救援中，关节履带机器人（ATR）需在结构复杂且接触丰富的环境中穿越，如楼梯和杂乱的建筑内部。由于机器人与地形的交互（RTI）是混合且不连续的，可靠的自主性仍然面临挑战。我们提出了ASTRIL-MPC，一个基于语言引导的神经运动学模型预测控制（MPC）框架。该框架通过高度序列和近期轨迹预测短期任务状态增量；NMPC在多目标成本和严格可行性约束下进行规划；大型语言模型（LLM）通过安全检查接口提出对选定权重和边界的有界更新。编译的预测器使得完整控制周期在100毫秒内完成。在三项穿越任务和多高度泛化设置中，ASTRIL-MPC的综合穿越质量评分比非自适应NMPC提高了71%，比PPO基线提高了67%，同时在下降过程中消除了可测量的碰撞影响。这些结果表明，结合学习的运动学、基于优化的规划和语言引导的调优，可以为关节履带机器人提供数据高效且稳健的自主性。
items.abstract: In urban search and rescue, articulated tracked robots (ATRs) must traverse structured but contact-rich environments such as stairwells and cluttered building interiors. Reliable autonomy remains challenging because robot-terrain interaction (RTI) is hybrid and discontinuous, and effective flipper-track coordination is difficult to model analytically. We present ASTRIL-MPC, a language-guided neural kinematics model predictive control (MPC) framework for autonomous traversal. A learned kinematics model predicts short-horizon task-state increments from a height sequence and recent trajectories; NMPC plans with multi-objective costs and strict feasibility constraints; and a large language model (LLM) proposes bounded updates to selected weights and bounds through a safety-checked interface with range clipping, rate limiting, and consistency checks. The compiled predictor enables a full control cycle within 100 ms. Across three traversal tasks and a multi-height generalization setting, ASTRIL-MPC improves an aggregate traversal-quality score by up to 71% over a non-adaptive NMPC and by 67% over a PPO baseline, while eliminating measurable collision impacts during descent. items.authors: Zhenfeng Gan, Yanbo Chen, Lirong Che, Junbo Tan, Xueqian Wang

items.title: MedCollab: IBIS-Guided Multi-Agent Collaboration with Hierarchical Disease Relation Chains for Clinical Diagnosis
items.title_zh: MedCollab：基于IBIS的多智能体协作临床诊断框架
items.summary_zh: 临床诊断是一个逐步整合证据的过程，医生从症状和病史出发，经过检查、竞争假设、疾病关系到治疗决策。尽管大型语言模型在医学文本理解和生成方面取得了进展，但其临床应用仍受限于证据基础薄弱、推理不透明以及鉴别诊断、最终诊断、诊断依据和治疗规划之间的不一致。我们提出了MedCollab，一个用于全周期临床诊断和报告生成的多智能体框架。MedCollab根据患者记录协调专家和检查智能体，采用基于问题的信息系统（IBIS）协议结构化智能体的讨论，并通过层次疾病关系链（HDRC）连接接受的假设。在多轮讨论中，验证者引导的共识模块评估证据支持、医学合理性和逻辑冲突，调整智能体贡献并过滤不支持的推理。实验结果表明，MedCollab在诊断准确性、证据一致性等方面优于领先的LLM和医学多智能体基线。
items.abstract: Clinical diagnosis is a gradual process of evidence integration, in which physicians move from symptoms and medical history to examinations, competing hypotheses, disease relations, and treatment decisions. Large language models have advanced medical text understanding and generation. Yet their clinical use remains limited by weak evidence grounding, opaque reasoning, and inconsistent links among differential diagnosis, final diagnosis, diagnostic basis, and treatment planning. We introduce MedCollab, a multi-agent framework for full-cycle clinical diagnosis and report generation. MedCollab coordinates specialist and examination agents according to patient records. It structures agent deliberation with an Issue-Based Information System (IBIS) protocol, so that each diagnostic position is supported by patient-specific evidence and medical knowledge. It also builds Hierarchical Disease Relation Chains (HDRC) to connect accepted hypotheses through progression, complication, and comorbidity relations. During multi-round deliberation, a verifier-guided consensus module evaluates evidence support, medical plausibility, and logical conflicts. It then adjusts agent contributions and filter
items.authors: Yuqi Zhan, Xinyue Wu, Tianyu Lin, Yutong Bao, Xiaoyu Wang, Weihao Cheng, Huangwei Chen, Feiwei Qin, Zhu Zhu

items.title: Improving Energy Efficiency of Oil Platforms Through Optimal Loading of Diesel Generators Using Machine Learning and Search Algorithms
items.title_zh: 通过机器学习优化柴油发电机负载提升油平台能效
items.summary_zh: 随着能源需求增加、化石燃料枯竭和气候变化，提升能源生产和消费效率变得尤为重要。离岸油气平台面临能源使用效率低、系统故障、可达性和环境影响等挑战。本文研究了利用机器学习（ML）和搜索算法提高离岸油平台柴油发电机的效率。对来自苏格兰某平台的18个月数据进行分析，重点关注四台主要柴油消耗设备。经过探索性数据分析和异常值检测，建立了回归模型以预测不同发电机功率负载下的日柴油消耗。多元线性回归和人工神经网络的预测性能优于其他模型。随后，使用搜索算法识别最小化日柴油消耗的发电机功率负载组合。结果显示，与最差日功率负载组合相比，平均每天节省27%的柴油。
items.abstract: Rising energy demand, fossil fuel depletion and climate change highlight the need for more efficient energy production and consumption. Offshore oil and gas platforms face challenges related to inefficient energy use, system failures, accessibility and environmental impact. Machine learning (ML) offers opportunities to improve the safety, sustainability and efficiency of these systems; however, previous research has largely focused on increasing oil production rather than reducing energy consumption on platforms. This study investigates the use of ML and search algorithms to improve diesel efficiency on an offshore oil platform. Data collected over 18 months from a platform in Scotland were analysed, focusing on four diesel generators as the primary diesel-consuming equipment. Following exploratory data analysis and outlier detection, regression models were developed to predict daily diesel consumption for different generator power loads. Multiple Linear Regression and Artificial Neural Networks achieved the best predictive performance compared with Extra Trees Regression, Extreme Gradient Boosting and Random Forest. Search algorithms were then used to identify combinations of gene
items.authors: Khivishta Boodhoo, Isaac Triguero, Josh Plumbly, Bruce Nicolson, William Meredith, Nicholas Watson

items.title: Efficient AI Model Deployment Using Quantization Analysis Tool
items.title_zh: 基于量化分析工具的高效AI模型部署
items.summary_zh: 随着深度学习模型在资源受限设备上的应用日益增多，对高效模型优化技术的需求也在不断增长。本文提出了一种量化分析工具，旨在简化量化工作流程，支持高效的模型部署。该工具基于ONNX框架，提供详细的层级敏感性分析、权重和激活分布的可视化，以及指导精度选择的见解。通过识别对精度降低具有韧性或敏感性的层，开发者可以在模型大小、延迟和准确性之间做出明智的权衡。多种神经网络架构的实验评估表明，该工具有效提高了量化后的准确性，从而在实际部署场景中提升了效率。此外，该工具还为开发者提供了关于量化对模型及其准确性影响的宝贵见解。此项工作突出了该工具的能力、实际应用及其在通过稳健的量化分析实现高效AI模型部署中的作用。
items.abstract: As deep learning models are increasingly deployed on resource constrained devices, the demand for efficient model optimization techniques continues to grow. Effective deployment of AI models on edge and low power platforms requires optimization methods that reduce model size and computational cost while maintaining high accuracy. This paper presents Quantization Analysis Tool, a practical system designed to streamline quantization workflows and support performance efficient model deployment. Built on the ONNX framework for broad interoperability, the tool provides detailed layer-wise sensitivity analysis, visualization of weight and activation distributions, and insights to guide precision selection. By identifying layers that are resilient or sensitive to reduced precision, the tool enables developers to make informed trade-offs between model size, latency, and accuracy. Experimental evaluations across multiple neural network architectures demonstrate that the tool effectively improves the quantized accuracy, leading to improved efficiency in real-world deployment scenarios. The tool also provides developers valuable insights into the effects on quantization on the model and its a
items.authors: Dwith Chenna, Kanishka Macherla

items.title: Explainable Prediction from Mobile Sensing Data through LLM-guided Concept Integration
items.title_zh: 基于移动传感数据的可解释预测方法研究
items.summary_zh: 移动传感技术能够在日常环境中对行为和生理模式进行长期监测。然而，在小规模健康传感研究中，由于任务特定的结果监督相对有限，准确预测仍然具有挑战性。可解释性也至关重要，因为模型输出应反映有意义的行为和生理模式，而不仅仅是预测分数。我们开发了一种概念集成变换器（CIT），结合大语言模型（LLM）指导的概念监督，实现移动传感数据的可解释预测。CIT利用预训练的大语言模型生成基于基线的概念异常目标，并赋予置信权重，无需手动标注概念。在两个纵向数据集中，CIT在AFFECT数据集上获得了最高的F1分数（0.756），在PHQ-9数据集上并列最高（0.765）。学习到的概念分数揭示了可解释的行为和生理模式；在AFFECT中，睡眠数量和质量在高负性情绪组和低负性情绪组之间表现出明显差异。这些发现支持了在小规模移动传感研究中进行准确且可解释的预测的LLM指导概念集成方法。
items.abstract: Mobile sensing enables longitudinal monitoring of behavioral and physiological patterns in everyday settings. However, accurate prediction remains challenging in small-cohort health-sensing studies, where task-specific outcome supervision is limited relative to heterogeneous sensing data. Interpretability is also important, as model outputs should reflect meaningful behavioral and physiological patterns rather than predictive scores alone. We develop a Concept-Integrated Transformer (CIT) with LLM-guided concept supervision for explainable prediction from mobile sensing data. CIT uses a pretrained large language model to generate baseline-aware concept abnormality targets with confidence weights without manual concept annotation. Across two longitudinal datasets, CIT achieves the highest F1 score on AFFECT (0.756) and ties for the highest on a PHQ-9 dataset (0.765). The learned concept scores also reveal interpretable behavioral and physiological patterns; in AFFECT, sleep quantity and quality show the clearest difference between high and low negative affect groups. These findings support LLM-guided concept integration for accurate and interpretable prediction in small-cohort mobil
items.authors: Yuning Wang, Iman Azimi, Amir M. Rahmani, Pasi Liljeberg

items.title: Adaptive Chemotherapy Control under Tumor Heterogeneity via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 肿瘤异质性下的自适应化疗控制与强化学习
items.summary_zh: 设计有效的化疗方案受到肿瘤异质性和药物耐受性的阻碍，复杂化了基于患者特异性模型的最佳控制方法的应用。我们开发并比较了基于闭环深度强化学习（DRL）的给药策略，采用连续（TD3）和离散（DQN）动作空间，训练于高维异质肿瘤模型。DRL策略与基于庞特里亚金最大原理（PMP）推导的开放式基准进行比较。我们使用100名患者的虚拟队列评估参数异质性下的泛化能力，生长和药物敏感性参数均匀扰动±10%。在该队列中，TD3实现了更高的平均肿瘤缩小，而DQN则提供了更紧密的患者间给药一致性，显示出明显的效能与一致性权衡。我们的模拟假设完全观察所有肿瘤亚群体；向稀疏和噪声临床测量的转化将需要部分可观测性模型和/或状态估计。总体结果表明，模拟训练的DRL能够学习状态依赖的反馈给药策略，补充开放式最佳控制基准。
items.abstract: Designing effective chemotherapy regimens is hindered by tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance, which complicate the deployment of patient-specific model-based optimal control across diverse populations. We develop and compare closed-loop deep reinforcement learning (DRL) dosing policies with continuous (TD3) and discrete (DQN) action spaces trained on a high-dimensional heterogeneous tumor model. The DRL policies are benchmarked against a Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP)-derived open-loop benchmark. We assess generalization under parametric heterogeneity using a 100-patient virtual cohort with plus or minus 10 percent uniform perturbations in growth and drug-sensitivity parameters. Across this cohort, TD3 achieves higher average tumor reduction, while DQN yields tighter inter-patient dosing consistency, revealing a clear efficacy-consistency trade-off in this study. Our simulations assume full observation of all tumor subpopulations; translation to sparse and noisy clinical measurements will require partial-observability formulations and/or state estimation. Overall, the results show that simulation-trained DRL can learn state-dependent feedback dosing policies that compleme
items.authors: Bereket Sitotaw Kidane, Md Samiul Haque Motayed, Shuo Wang

items.title: FRIST: FMRI Representation Informed Shared-space Training Improves EEG-only Individual-Finger BCI Decoding
items.title_zh: FRIST：基于fMRI信息的共享空间训练提升EEG单指BCI解码
items.summary_zh: 手指级运动解码对自然脑机接口（BCI）控制至关重要，但从头皮脑电图（EEG）解码单指仍具挑战性。我们提出了fMRI信息引导的共享空间训练（FRIST），这是一种两阶段EEG解码框架，首先从同步EEG-fMRI记录中学习fMRI引导的光谱投影，然后利用fMRI-derived类几何形状指导EEG预测的残差优化。FRIST通过共享手指标签在记录间传递信息，无需配对试验，并在推理时仅使用EEG。我们在12名健康参与者的运动执行（ME）和运动想象（MI）中进行了评估，结果显示FRIST在两类ME中将组平均准确率从66.93%提高至74.53%，在三类ME中从44.83%提高至56.58%，在两类MI中从80.78%提高至85.63%，在三类MI中从60.93%提高至69.90%。FRIST在目标参与者自身的fMRI数据不可用时也能改善EEG解码。
items.abstract: Finger-level motor decoding is important for naturalistic brain-computer interface (BCI) control, yet individual-finger decoding from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) remains challenging because finger representations are spatially close in the sensorimotor cortex and blurred by volume conduction. Leveraging the high spatial resolution of functional MRI (fMRI), we introduce fMRI Representation-Informed Shared-Space Training (FRIST), a two-stage EEG decoding framework that first learns fMRI-informed spectral projections from simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings and then uses fMRI-derived class geometry to guide residual refinement of EEG predictions. FRIST transfers information across recordings through shared finger labels without requiring paired trials and uses only EEG at inference. We evaluated 12 able-bodied participants during movement execution (ME) and motor imagery (MI) under two-class and three-class chronological session-held-out decoding simulating the online scenario. Using EEGNet as the EEG feature extractor, FRIST increased group average accuracy from 66.93% to 74.53% for two-class ME, from 44.83% to 56.58% for three-class ME, from 80.78% to 85.63% for two-class MI, an
items.authors: Jintao Zhang, Yidan Ding, Joshua Kosnoff, Maxim Karrenbach, Hanwen Wang, Bin He

items.title: Simulating Disengaged Students to Evaluate LLM-based Tutors
items.title_zh: 模拟 disengaged 学生评估基于 LLM 的辅导系统
items.summary_zh: 通过计算模型生成的模拟学生为评估人类和 AI 辅导员使用的辅导策略和教学方法提供了实用的方法。然而，这些模拟应考虑 disengaged 行为，包括游戏化、轮转和离题行为，因为辅导员可能需要针对不同学习者状态做出不同反应。我们提出了 Disengagement-Aware Student Simulators (DAS2)，这是一个可重复的预部署协议，模型化了五种学习者参与状态：参与、游戏化、轮转、离题和混合，并评估 AI 辅导员在这些状态下的表现。使用 ASSISTments09，两个编码员独立标记了 100 个抽样辅导会话，达成 84% 一致性（Cohen's kappa = 0.78），在一致的案例中，人类共识标签与 DAS2 基于规则的标签匹配率为 81%（kappa = 0.75）。根据预期学习者状态进行模拟，减少了模拟会话与真实会话在游戏化状态下的正确率差距，从 0.54 降至 0.20，轮转状态下从 0.51 降至 0.18。微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 更好地匹配了真实响应时间分布，而仅使用提示的 GPT-4o 生成了更具可区分性的学习者状态。对 Claude、Llama、Gemini、Qwen 和 GPT 系列的五个 AI 辅导员的评估显示，相对排名在不同状态下保持稳定。
items.abstract: Simulated students generated by computational models provide a practical way to evaluate tutoring strategies and pedagogical approaches used by human and AI tutors. However, such simulations should account for disengaged behaviors, including gaming the system, wheel-spinning, and off-task behavior, because tutors may need different responses for different learner states. We present Disengagement-Aware Student Simulators (DAS2), a reproducible pre-deployment protocol that models five learner-engagement states: engaged, gaming, wheel-spinning, off-task, and mixed, and evaluates AI tutor performance across these states. Using ASSISTments09, two coders independently labeled 100 sampled tutoring sessions based on anonymized interaction-log summaries. They achieved 84% agreement (Cohen's kappa = 0.78), and among agreed cases, human consensus labels matched DAS2 rule-based labels in 81% of cases (kappa = 0.75). Conditioning simulations on intended learner states reduced the correctness-rate gap between simulated and authentic sessions from 0.54 to 0.20 for gaming and from 0.51 to 0.18 for wheel-spinning. Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B better matched authentic response-time distributions, while pro
items.authors: Xianghui Meng, Jionghao Lin

items.title: SAGE-Loop: Reliable Closed-Loop LLM-Driven AutoML with Trial-and-Correction and Adaptive Ensembling
items.title_zh: SAGE-Loop：可靠的闭环LLM驱动AutoML框架
items.summary_zh: 自动化机器学习（AutoML）正在重塑数据驱动的科学和工业实践。随着大型语言模型（LLM）被引入AutoML，管道的可靠性与自动化效率同样重要。然而，现有的AutoML在执行过程中仍难以实现即时反馈和自适应优化，导致一旦运行偏离最优或失败状态，缺乏过程级的纠正机制。我们提出SAGE-Loop，一个可靠的闭环、自适应的LLM驱动AutoML框架，能够进行多轮生成和验证以实现试验与修复，并在监督和无监督任务中自适应选择集成策略。通过20个公共数据集的实验，SAGE-Loop在分类、回归和聚类任务上持续提升性能和稳定性。
items.abstract: Automated machine learning (AutoML) is reshaping data-driven science and industrial practice, and as large language models are introduced into AutoML, pipeline reliability becomes as important as automation efficiency. However, existing AutoML still struggles to realize instant feedback and adaptive optimization during execution, so once a run drifts into a suboptimal or failed state, it lacks a process-level correction mechanism. The fundamental pathology lies in its one-way pipeline: intermediate failures are typically terminated or bypassed, while fixed paradigms often strengthen model generation but leave ensemble decisions static, weakening both execution reliability and the controlled use of structural diversity. This indicates that LLM-driven AutoML needs a closed-loop ability for trial-correction-improvement together with evidence-based use of model diversity. To this end, we propose SAGE-Loop, a reliable closed-loop, self-adaptive, LLM-driven AutoML framework that performs multi-round generation and validation for trial-and-repair, and adaptively selects ensemble strategies in both supervised and unsupervised tasks, thereby unifying how to generate with how to use models.
items.authors: Junquan Gu, Shibo Cui, Xiangfeng Luo, Hang Yu

items.title: The Battery Price of edge AI: A study of the Environmental Impact of LLM Inference on Mobile Devices
items.title_zh: 边缘AI的电池成本：大型语言模型推理的环境影响研究
items.summary_zh: 生成性人工智能的快速普及引发了隐私、延迟和性能的担忧，促使向“本地优先”AI转变，即在用户设备上而非远程云服务器上进行推理。该范式对电池供电的智能手机施加了显著的计算负担，可能缩短电池寿命并增加移动设备的整体更换率。本文系统研究了设备上大型语言模型（LLM）推理的能耗、性能和准确性。我们在两款现代智能手机和一台服务器上评估了来自不同模型家族、规模和量化水平的18个模型，使用相应的最新技术。结果显示：（i）设备推理的能效平均比批量服务器推理低3倍；（ii）量化位宽与每个token的能耗之间的关系是非单调的，两个测试的智能手机上均存在能耗甜点；（iii）18种模型配置中有8种位于准确性和能效的帕累托前沿，允许从业者构建电池感知的模型路由器；（iv）现实的建模假设不允许本地推理在环境影响上更具优势。
items.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence raises privacy, latency, and performance concerns that motivate a shift toward "local-first" AI, where inferences are performed on the user's device instead of on remote cloud servers. This paradigm also places a significant computational load on battery-powered smartphones, potentially shortening battery life and increasing the overall replacement rate of mobile devices. This paper presents a systematic study of the energy consumption, performance, and accuracy of on-device large language model (LLM) inference. We evaluate 18 models from different model families, sizes, and quantization levels, on two modern smartphones and on a server, using the respective state-of-the-art for such deployments. We measure the energy per generated token, inter-token latency, model accuracy, and battery-cycle consumption. Our results show that (i) on-device inference is on average 3 times less energy-efficient than batched server inference; (ii) the relationship between quantization bit-width and energy per token is non-monotonic, with energy sweet spots on both tested smartphones; (iii) eight out of 18 model configurations lie on the Pareto
items.authors: \'Edouard Gu\'egain, Tristan Coignion

items.title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
items.title_zh: 高效的机器人工厂视觉-语言-动作管理与服务
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过两阶段设计展现出高效的机器人操作能力，包括视觉-语言模型（VLM）阶段和动作扩散变换器（ADiT）阶段。由于机器人必须满足严格的服务水平目标（SLOs），VLA推理具有延迟敏感性。满足这些SLOs需要高端GPU，但重量、成本和功耗限制了在机器人上集成此类GPU的可能性。现有研究将VLA推理卸载到边缘服务器，但当前VLA系统在多请求、多模型执行方面缺乏支持。我们设计了Robion，这是首个在多GPU边缘服务器上满足SLOs的多机器人、多模型请求的VLA服务与管理系统。我们的服务引擎通过两个流在GPU内部分离VLM和ADiT阶段，动态限制VLM流的SMs，以确保ADiT始终有SMs可用，并通过共享这些流来共同定位多个模型，优先处理剩余SLO时间最少的请求。我们的管理引擎支持在多GPU服务器上的灵活模型部署。
items.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models b
items.authors: Dionysios Adamopoulos, Nattapol Chanpaisit, Basel Fakhri, Christina Giannoula

items.title: Limits of LLM Text Detectors in Education
items.title_zh: 教育中大型语言模型文本检测的局限性
items.summary_zh: 学生在学术写作中越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLMs）的辅助。虽然在大多数机构政策下，轻微的辅助（如语法和风格纠正、反馈）是被允许的，但通常禁止将整个写作任务委托给LLMs。目前的LLM生成文本检测方法主要假设人类写作与LLM生成文本之间存在二元区分，忽视了现实中人机协作的广泛实践，限制了检测系统在教育评估中的有效性。本文提出了一种贡献感知的评估框架，介绍了八个学生贡献水平的尺度，模拟从完全人类写作到LLM辅助修订，再到完全LLM生成和对抗性人性化文本的真实写作场景。机构政策可以根据这一尺度转化为可接受的LLM辅助阈值。此外，我们还提出了教育中的生成性论文检测（GEDE），这是一个新颖的基准数据集，包含超过900篇人类写作和超过12,500篇生成论文，涵盖886个任务和所有贡献水平。通过该基准，我们对四种最先进的零样本和监督检测方法进行了系统评估。
items.abstract: Students increasingly use the assistance of large language models (LLMs) in their academic writing. While slight assistance (e.g., grammar and style correction, as well as feedback) is permitted under most institutional policies, it is usually forbidden to offload entire writing tasks to LLMs. Unfortunately, current approaches to LLM-generated text detection predominantly assume a binary distinction between human-written and LLM-generated text, ignoring the breadth of realistic human-AI collaboration practices and limiting the validity of detection systems for educational assessment. In this paper, we propose a contribution-aware evaluation framework for LLM-based detection systems in education. We introduce a scale of eight student contribution levels that model realistic writing scenarios ranging from fully human-written texts to LLM-assisted revisions to fully LLM-generated and adversarially humanized texts. Institutional policies regarding LLM use can then be translated to thresholds of acceptable LLM assistance on this scale. items.title: NS-Copilot: An LLM-Driven Agent System for Autonomous Neuroscience Analysis
items.title_zh: NS-Copilot：基于LLM的自主神经科学分析系统
items.summary_zh: 人工智能正在迅速推动神经科学的发展，但许多实验室由于跨学科障碍未能充分发挥其潜力。尽管生理数据的预训练神经模型进展迅速，但其异构架构和特定模态的限制妨碍了系统的整合、选择和评估。现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能科学应用代理系统通常缺乏有效选择和协调多样化神经科学预训练模型的领域专业知识。我们提出了NS-Copilot，这是一个基于LLM的多代理系统，能够自主支持多样化专业任务的端到端工作流程。它通过自然语言接口统一了领域特定的预训练模型，并支持包括脑电图（EEG）和细胞外尖峰数据在内的关键神经科学模态。NS-Copilot根据原始数据和任务描述，协调具有专业角色的代理进行规划、自适应控制、代码生成和结果综合，从而实现无需特定数据集启发式的分析。我们在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和工作记忆尖峰解码等神经科学基准上评估了NS-Copilot，结果显示该系统在每个任务的8次试验中表现一致优越。
items.abstract: AI is rapidly advancing neuroscience, yet many laboratories fail to fully unleash its potential due to significant interdisciplinary barriers. While pre-trained neural models for physiological data are progressing quickly, their heterogeneous architectures and modality-specific constraints hinder systematic integration, selection, and evaluation. Despite recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems for intelligent scientific applications, existing approaches often still lack the domain expertise required to effectively select and coordinate diverse neuroscience pre-trained models and handle unique data types in this domain. We present NS-Copilot, an LLM-driven multi-agent system for neuroscience analysis that autonomously supports end-to-end workflows for diverse professional tasks. It unifies domain-specific pre-trained models and supports key neuroscience modalities, including EEG and extracellular spike data, through a natural-language interface. Given raw data and a task description, NS-Copilot orchestrates agents with specialized roles for planning, adaptive control, code generation, and result synthesis, enabling analysis without dataset-specific heuristi
items.authors: Wuche Liu, Yiran Qiao, Linlin Hou, Rui Yang, Shusen Pu, Song Wang, Jing Ma

items.title: From Bench-to-Bedside: A Review of Clinical Trials in Drug Discovery and Development
items.title_zh: 从实验室到临床：药物发现与开发中的临床试验综述
items.summary_zh: 临床试验是基础研究与临床应用之间的桥梁，是药物开发的重要步骤。本文回顾了临床试验的各个阶段（I期[安全性评估]、II期[疗效评价]、III期[大规模验证]和IV期[上市后监测]），强调了其独特特征及相互联系。识别出主要挑战，包括伦理合规、参与者招募以及确保试验人群的多样性和代表性，并提出基于证据的缓解策略。为应对这些挑战，人工智能、大数据分析和数字健康工具等创新技术正在改变试验设计与实施，提高效率和数据质量。展望未来，本文探讨了基因治疗和免疫治疗等新兴疗法如何重塑试验设计要求，并强调了监管协调与全球合作的重要性。临床试验在推动创新药物开发和改善患者结果方面仍然至关重要。
items.abstract: Clinical trials bridge basic research and clinical application, serving as essential steps in drug development. This review examines clinical trial phases (Phase I [safety assessment], Phase II [efficacy evaluation], Phase III [large-scale validation], and Phase IV [post-marketing surveillance]), highlighting the distinct characteristics and interconnections. Major challenges are identified, including ethical compliance, participant recruitment, and ensuring diversity and representativeness in trial populations, while proposing evidence-based mitigation strategies. To address these challenges, innovative technologies, such as artificial intelligence, big data analytics, and digital health tools, are transforming trial design and implementation, enhancing efficiency and data quality. Looking forward, the review explores how emerging therapies, including gene therapy and immunotherapy, are reshaping trial design requirements and emphasizes the growing importance of regulatory harmonization and global collaboration. Clinical trials remain central to advancing innovative drug development and improving patient outcomes.
items.authors: Tianyang Wang, Ming Liu, Benji Peng, Xinyuan Song, Charles Zhang, Xintian Sun, Qian Niu, Junyu Liu, Silin Chen, Keyu Chen, Ming Li, Pohsun Feng, Ziqian Bi, Yunze Wang, Yichao Zhang, Cheng Fei, Lawrenc

items.title: Do Quantum Measurement Advantages Survive to Astrophysical Inference? Seven Benchmarks in Optical Interferometry and Imaging
items.title_zh: 量子测量优势在天体物理推断中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 量子技术在光学天文学中至关重要，尤其是在经过现实损失、校准、协方差和推断后，能够保留参数测量通道中的信息。本文比较了七种方法对内部光路延迟、亚瑞利源分离、日冕仪行星通量与恒星泄漏、相干场四分量、非局部复数可见度、零深度和主动相位传感的影响。在一个类地天体测量案例中，6-dB压缩内部计量使测得的相位四分量提高了1.58，完整读出提高约1.20，但固定时间的行星质量精度仅提高1.010（95%区间为1.005-1.045）；任务持续时间、有效基线、节奏和校准具有更大的建模影响。对于一个年轻的近双星，带符号空间模式解复用保留了在测试的直接成像比较器中显著退化的亚瑞利轨道信息。代表性的匹配模型计算显示动态质量的均方根误差增益为1.77（1.47-2.15）。对于0.10和0.12 \(M_\odot\)的主序前预测，质量精度分别为15%、10%、7%，对应的正确选择概率约为73%、82%、90%。数值增益仍然是临时的，因为事件级连续图像比较器、严格的尾部收敛和外部测量尚待验证。
items.abstract: Quantum techniques matter to optical astronomy when they preserve information in the parameter-bearing measurement channel after realistic loss, calibration, covariance, and inference are propagated to the final astrophysical observable. We compare 7 approaches by the quantity they change: internal optical-path delay, sub-Rayleigh source separation, coronagraphic planet throughput & stellar leakage, coherent field quadratures, nonlocal complex visibility, null depth, active phase sensing. In an Earth-analog astrometry case, 6-dB squeezed internal metrology improves the measured phase quadrature by 1.58 and the complete readout by ~1.20, but fixed-time planet-mass precision by only 1.010 (95 % interval 1.005-1.045); mission duration, useful baseline, cadence, calibration have greater modeled leverage. For a close young binary, signed spatial-mode demultiplexing preserves sub-Rayleigh orbital information that is substantially degraded in the tested direct-imaging comparator. A representative matched-model calculation gives a dynamical-mass RMSE gain 1.77 1.47-2.15). items.title: Little Red Dots are Direct-Collapse Black Hole-Forming Galaxies
items.title_zh: 小红点是直接坍缩黑洞形成的星系
items.summary_zh: “小红点”（LRDs）在红移4到8之间，是JWST迄今为止最具挑战性的发现之一，因为它们独特的V形光谱和紧凑的形态（100 - 200 pc）违背了传统的天体物理解释。以往尝试将LRDs解释为紧凑的恒星系统、重度包裹的黑洞、超大质量恒星或更奇特的“黑洞恒星”等，均无法说明其形成过程、光谱中吸收特征所需的致密壳层来源，或其观测丰度和推测寿命。我们展示LRDs实际上是直接坍缩黑洞星系，其中黑洞仍被形成它的巨大盘层包裹。我们的宇宙学模拟产生的光谱与LRDs的观测光谱匹配良好，因为盘中心的高密度捕获了黑洞的X射线，并产生了观察到的巴尔默吸收特征，同时允许紫外、光学和再处理的红外辐射部分逃逸。宿主星系形成了一个质量为10$^8$ M$_{\odot}$、半径为150 pc的致密恒星团，与LRDs的观测结果一致。我们的模型再现了从典型对象RUBIES-EGS-42046（z = 5.28）到具有最强巴尔默断裂的MoM-BH$^*$-1（z = 7.76）以及最高红移的CAPERS-L等多种LRD光谱。
items.abstract: "Little Red Dots" (LRDs) at $4 < z < 8$ are one of the most challenging discoveries by JWST to date because their distinctive V-shaped spectra and compact morphologies (100 - 200 pc) defy conventional astrophysical interpretation. Previous attempts to explain LRDs as compact stellar systems, heavily-cocooned black holes with differential flows, supermassive stars, or more exotic objects like 'black-hole stars' either cannot show how they formed, explain the origin of the dense shells needed for the absorption features in their spectra, or account for their observed abundances or inferred lifetimes. Here we show that LRDs are simply direct-collapse black hole galaxies in which the BH is still shrouded by the massive disk that created it. Our cosmological simulations yield spectra that are good matches to those of LRDs because high densities at the center of the disk trap X-rays from the BH and produce the observed Balmer absorption features while allowing UV, optical and reprocessed IR flux to partly escape. The host galaxy forms a dense 10$^8$ M$_{\odot}$ cluster of stars with a radius of 150 pc next to the BH, consistent with observations of LRDs. Our models reproduce a wide varie
items.authors: Daniel J. Whalen, Muhammad A. Latif, Konstantinos Topalakis, Fergus Cullen, Devesh Nandal, Sadegh Khochfar

items.title: Galaxies in the first two billion years: Earlier formation and quenching with surface-density modulated star formation and feedback
items.title_zh: 早期宇宙中星系的形成与熄灭机制研究
items.summary_zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）揭示了在宇宙历史的前20亿年中存在大量大质量、紫外线明亮、紧凑且部分已熄灭的星系，这对现有的星系形成模型提出了挑战。我们开发了扩展的L-Galaxies半解析模型，基于千年TNG暗物质模拟，研究了$0 \le z \lesssim 15$的星系演化。该模型将星形成效率与局部冷气体表面密度相结合，使得在高密度气体中星形成效率高而反馈效应弱。模型同时校准了$z\simeq0-4$的恒星质量函数和熄灭比例，以及$z\simeq11-12$的紫外光度函数。结果显示，该模型在$z\approx 11$时能够重现恒星质量函数，并在$z\gtrsim9$时将大质量紫外线明亮星系的丰度提高了两个数量级。尽管AGN反馈机制未变，增强的核膨胀和黑洞供给使得$z\simeq3-8$的大质量熄灭星系的丰度增加了两个数量级。
items.abstract: JWST has revealed massive, UV-bright, compact, and in some cases quenched galaxies in the first two billion years of cosmic history, challenging current galaxy formation models. We develop an extended L-Galaxies semi-analytic model, run on the MillenniumTNG dark-matter-only simulation, and follow galaxy evolution over $0 \le z \lesssim 15$. The model ties the star formation efficiency and the coupling of stellar feedback energy to the local cold gas surface density, making star formation efficient and feedback ineffective in dense gas. We include dissipative gas-rich mergers and disc instabilities in stellar and gaseous discs. All parameters are calibrated simultaneously against stellar mass functions and quenched fractions at $z\simeq0-4$ and UV luminosity functions at $z\simeq11-12$ with a new parallelised Markov chain Monte Carlo framework. The model reproduces the stellar mass function up to $z\approx 11$ and increases the abundance of massive and UV-bright galaxies at $z\gtrsim9$ by up to two orders of magnitude over the legacy version. items.title: BAQARO: Tracing Stochastic Black Hole Growth Histories and Quasar Lightcurves in a Cosmological Context
items.title_zh: BAQARO：宇宙背景下随机黑洞增长历史与类星体光变曲线追踪
items.summary_zh: 超大质量黑洞（BH）如何积累质量并驱动我们在宇宙时间中观察到的明亮类星体仍是星系演化中的核心未解问题。我们提出了BAQARO，一个半经验框架用于黑洞增长。该模型基于从FLAMINGO-10k模拟中提取的亚晕合并树，将黑洞增长历史与其宿主亚晕的历史联系起来，捕捉平均趋势和随机变异。BAQARO受到全光谱类星体光度函数、紫外光亮类星体的聚集性以及条件爱丁顿比率分布函数的约束。模型通过六个自由参数控制黑洞种子、气体吸积与晕增长之间的耦合，以及吸积的随机性和时间一致性，能够重现$0 \lesssim z \lesssim 7$范围内的观测约束。我们的主要发现包括：黑洞吸积与晕中冷气体储存的组装良好描述，无需显式依赖宇宙时间；黑洞在高红移时通过超爱丁顿吸积的随机事件快速积累质量；这些事件辐射效率低，持续时间约为$\sim1\,\mathrm{Myr}$，在类星体光变中留下可观测的特征。
items.abstract: How supermassive black holes (BHs) assemble their mass and power the luminous quasars we observe across cosmic time remain central open questions in galaxy evolution. We present BAQARO, a semi-empirical framework for BH growth. Built on subhalo merger trees extracted from the FLAMINGO-10k simulation, the model links BH growth histories to those of their host subhalos through prescriptions that capture both average trends and stochastic variability. BAQARO is constrained by the bolometric quasar luminosity function, the clustering of UV-luminous quasars, and the conditional Eddington ratio distribution function. With six free parameters controlling BH seeding, the coupling between gas accretion and halo growth, and the stochasticity and temporal coherence of accretion, the model reproduces the available observational constraints over $0 \lesssim z \lesssim 7$. Using emulators, we perform Bayesian inference and quantify the constraining power of each observable. Our main findings are: (i) BH accretion is well described by the assembly of cold gas reservoirs in halos, without requiring an explicit dependence on cosmic time. items.title: The constrainability of galaxy positions in the $M_*$ -- SFR plane from SED fitting
items.title_zh: 基于SED拟合的星系位置约束性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用GAMA调查中的6,029个$z<0.06$星系样本，通过光谱能量分布（SED）拟合，表征星系在M$_*$ -- SFR平面上的属性推断分布。我们分析了24种不同的模型配置，使用恒星种群库代码\textsc{ProGeny}和SED拟合代码\textsc{ProSpect}，量化建模假设对推断恒星质量、星形成率及星系分类的影响。结果显示，推断星系位置的可重复性在$M_*$ -- SFR平面内位置依赖性强，尤其在$\log_{10}(\rm{sSFR}/\rm{yr}^{-1}) \sim -11$以下不确定性显著增加。该边界与SFR估计的稳健性转变密切相关，无论SFR是通过SED拟合还是H$_{\alpha}$测量得出。我们发现，仅通过SED拟合无法稳健区分星爆星系，而星形成星系与被动星系的分离更一致地通过sSFR切割进行，而非相对于曲线或线性星形成序列的dex切割。此外，使用SED拟合的过渡（或绿色谷）选择高度不稳定，平均仅有约25%的样本被反复选择。
items.abstract: Using a sample of 6,029 $z<0.06$ galaxies from the GAMA survey, we characterise the spread of galaxy property inferences on the M$_*$ -- SFR plane via Spectral Energy Distribution (SED) fitting. We analyse 24 different model configurations using the stellar population library code \textsc{ProGeny}, and the SED-fitting code \textsc{ProSpect}, and quantify how modelling assumptions affect inferred stellar masses, star formation rates, and the resulting classification of galaxies. We find that the reproducibility of inferred galaxy positions depends strongly on location within the $M_*$ -- SFR plane, with uncertainties increasing dramatically below $\log_{10}(\rm{sSFR}/\rm{yr}^{-1}) \sim -11$. This boundary closely tracks the transition between robustly and poorly constrained SFR estimates, regardless of whether SFRs are derived from SED fitting or H$_{\alpha}$ measurements. We find that star-bursting galaxies cannot be robustly isolated from SED fitting alone, while the separation of star-forming and passive galaxies is most consistently conducted by a cut in sSFR, rather than a dex cut relative to either a curved or linear SFS (Star Forming Sequence). We further show that transition
items.authors: Sabine Bellstedt, Aaron S. G. Robotham, Luke J. M. Davies, Luca Cortese, Simon P. Driver

items.title: Heavy Seed Black Hole Growth in Metal-Enriched Halos through Disk-Induced Stellar Disruptions: A Semi-Analytical Modelling
items.title_zh: 金属富集晕中重种黑洞的生长机制研究
items.summary_zh: 近期模拟表明，重种黑洞可能在弱金属富集的原子冷却晕中形成，其中超大质量恒星前体和小规模恒星碎片几乎同时出现。我们研究了这些Pop~I/II恒星引发的潮汐破坏事件（TDEs）是否能为重种黑洞提供有效且持续的生长通道。构建了一个半解析模型，考虑了恒星轨道阻尼、盘捕获、迁移及重种黑洞周围的潮汐破坏。我们发现，Pop~I/II TDEs主导了重种黑洞的早期生长：黑洞质量在种子形成后的约0.1亿年内从约$10^4\,M_\odot$增长至约$10^5\,M_\odot$，并在约0.2亿年时达到数个$10^5\,M_\odot$。TDEs提供的累积质量最初超过气体吸积，并在早期保持相当。
items.abstract: Recent simulations suggest that heavy seed black holes may form in weakly metal-enriched atomic cooling halos, where the supermassive-star progenitor and small-scale stellar fragments emerge nearly coevally. In this picture, the newly born heavy seed is naturally embedded in a metal-enriched Pop~I/II nuclear star cluster rather than in an isolated pristine environment. We investigate whether disk-induced tidal disruption events (TDEs) from these Pop~I/II stars can provide an efficient and sustained growth channel for heavy seed black holes. We construct a semi-analytical model for stellar orbital damping, disk capture, migration, and tidal disruption around a heavy seed black hole, and incorporate the resulting disk-induced TDE contribution into cosmological merger trees with baryonic and metallicity evolution. Heavy seed host halos are selected from atomic cooling halos with $Z\lesssim10^{-3}Z_\odot$ that satisfy either a rapid gas-inflow criterion or a strong Lyman--Werner radiation criterion.
