items.authors: Zijian Wang, Zhili Wang, Yiqiu Ma, Boyuan Liu, Zheng Cai, Mengye Wang, Qingwen Wu

items.title: High-redshift supermassive black hole population from core-collapse in self-interacting dark matter halos
items.title_zh: 自交互暗物质晕中高红移超大质量黑洞群体研究
items.summary_zh: 自交互暗物质（DM）粒子之间的相互作用促进了暗物质晕中心区域内能量的重新分配。近期对大质量黑洞周围暗物质尖峰的研究，以及低质量暗物质丰富星系旋转曲线的多样性，激发了对自交互截面$\mathcal{O}(10)\,\rm cm^2/gm$的探索。在高散射率下，暗物质可通过晕核心的重力热崩溃形成超大质量黑洞种子。接近宇宙黎明的类星体是检验高红移超大质量黑洞形成情景及其与结构形成关系的重要探针。本文指出了有利的初始宇宙条件，这些条件可能提供导致超大质量黑洞的黑洞种子，介导于自交互暗物质晕中的核心崩溃。通过半解析的核心形成模型和现实的质量吸积及晕合并历史，我们将现有的高红移超大质量黑洞观测与我们核心崩溃框架的预测进行了比较。我们发现速度依赖的自交互暗物质参数空间的中位值为$\sigma/m_{\chi}\sim 56\, \rm cm^2/gm$，以及$\omega=101\,\rm km/s$，假设为爱丁顿吸积率。
items.abstract: Self-interactions between dark matter (DM) particles facilitate the inter-particle redistribution of energy within the central region of DM halos. Recent studies of dark matter spikes around massive black holes, and the diversity in rotation curves of dark matter rich low-mass galaxies motivate the exploration of self-interaction cross-section $\mathcal{O}(10)\,\rm cm^2/gm$. At such high scattering rates, DM can lead to the formation of supermassive black hole seeds, through the gravothermal collapse of halo cores, under certain cosmological conditions. Quasars near cosmic dawn are powerful probes for examining the formation scenario of high redshift supermassive black holes, and their connection to structure formation. In this work we point out the favorable initial cosmological conditions that are likely to provide the black hole seeds resulting in supermassive black holes, mediated by core-collapse in self-interacting dark matter halos. Employing a semi-analytic prescription of core formation, and realistic mass accretion and halo merger histories, we compare the existing observations of high-redshift supermassive black holes with those predicted for our core-collapse framework.
items.authors: Sambo Sarkar, Ujjal Kumar Dey

items.title: Comparing gravitational wave background predictions from cosmological simulations to pulsar timing observations
items.title_zh: 比较宇宙模拟预测的引力波背景与脉冲星测时观测
items.summary_zh: 最近，脉冲星测时阵列（PTAs）探测到的引力波背景（GWB）可能是来自合并超大质量黑洞双星的引力波的首次证据，为低频引力波谱开辟了新窗口。这些逐渐合并的双星预计将主导信号，尽管大多数理论模型预测的幅度似乎低于观测值。我们提出了第一个全面的统计框架，以量化PTA测量与理论预测之间的张力，最大化当前数据的约束能力，并便于未来PTA数据集的应用。我们进一步研究了观测推断中的不同假设，特别是对GWB谱使用幂律模型，如何可能导致张力估计的偏差，并可能夸大与理论的差异。我们将该框架应用于比较FABLE宇宙模拟的预测与NANOGrav 15年数据集。对于我们的基准黑洞群体，我们发现张力值为$1\sigma$-$2.5\sigma$，表明与观测结果没有统计学上显著的分歧。我们还探讨了基于电磁观测和理论不确定性指导的合并黑洞群体的物理动机修正。
items.abstract: The recent detection of a gravitational wave background (GWB) by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) may represent the first evidence of gravitational waves from merging supermassive black hole binaries, opening a new window on the low-frequency end of the gravitational wave spectrum. These inspiralling binaries are expected to dominate the signal, although most theoretical models seem to predict somewhat lower amplitudes than what is observed. We present the first comprehensive statistical framework to quantify the tension between PTA measurements and theoretical predictions, maximising the constraining power of current data and allowing straightforward application to future PTA datasets. We further investigate how different assumptions in the observational inference, particularly the use of a power-law model for the GWB spectrum, can bias tension estimates and potentially overstate discrepancies with theory. We apply our framework to compare predictions from the FABLE cosmological simulation with the NANOGrav 15-year dataset. For our fiducial black hole population, we find tension values of $1\sigma$-$2.5\sigma$, indicating no statistically significant disagreement with the observations.
items.authors: Stephanie Buttigieg, Debora Sijacki, Christopher J. Moore, Martin A. Bourne, Alberto Sesana

items.title: Time-Domain Dust Astrophysics. I. Polarization Flares, Polarization-Angle Reverberation, and Fossil Imprints in Supernova-Illuminated Clouds
items.title_zh: 时域尘埃天体物理学：超新星照亮云中的极化闪光与遗留印记
items.summary_zh: 宇宙瞬变事件可以在天到月的时间尺度上增强局部辐射场。我们使用时域\TransRAT\框架，自洽地模拟颗粒加热、对齐、旋转破坏及对齐轴在磁场（{\bf B}）与辐射方向（{\bf k}）之间的切换，预测了由IIP型超新星照亮的致密云的时间依赖性尘埃极化。我们识别出四个关键特征：首先，对于$D\lesssim1$~pc，出现极化闪光，表现为热尘埃极化和消光-极化效率的急剧增加，随后出现极化下降；其次，消光极化的峰值波长$\lambda_{\rm max}$向蓝移；第三，B-RAT到k-RAT的转变导致极化角的急剧旋转，最多可达$45^{\circ}$；第四，瞬变消退后，返回B-RAT产生由拉莫尔进动主导的极化角回响。在$D>1$~pc时，超新星引起的极化特性在辐射消退后仍可持续存在，这些遗留印记提供了重要信息。
items.abstract: Cosmic transients can enhance the local radiation field on timescales of days to months. Using the time-domain \TransRAT\ framework, which self-consistently follows grain heating, alignment, rotational disruption, and switching of the alignment axis between the magnetic field ({\bf B}) and the radiation direction ({\bf k}), we predict the time-dependent dust polarization of a dense cloud, represented by a homogeneous one-zone model, illuminated by a Type~IIP supernova over a range of source--cloud distances. We identify four key signatures. First, for $D\lesssim1$~pc, a \emph{polarization flare} develops within days to weeks, marked by sharp increases in both thermal dust polarization and extinction-polarization efficiency; this is followed by a \emph{polarization dip} as radiative torque disruption (RAT-D) destroys the large aligned grains. Second, the peak wavelength of extinction polarization, $\lambda_{\rm max}$, shifts blueward as the minimum aligned-grain size decreases. Third, the transition from B-RAT to k-RAT produces an abrupt \emph{polarization-angle rotation} of up to $45^{\circ}$ in our fiducial geometry. Fourth, as the transient fades, the return to B-RAT generates a
items.authors: Thiem Hoang (KASI/UST)

items.title: Benchmarking the computational power of quantum computers
items.title_zh: 量子计算机计算能力的基准测试
items.summary_zh: 量子计算硬件正迅速发展，朝着实用规模机器迈进，以实现科学突破。不同团队采用不同的量子比特技术和逻辑架构，追求这一目标，因此需要严格的基准测试来衡量计算能力。本文展示了一种新的基准，量化机器能够成功执行的最大计算相关量子电路的规模及其执行速度。我们将量子通用操作性能系统（QUOPS）实验性地应用于Quantinuum、Google和IBM的领先处理器，直接在物理量子比特上进行计算。将公认挑战问题的最先进资源需求转化为有效的QUOPS电路规模，显示计算能力必须增长5个数量级，推动容错方法的发展。我们还使用相同的基准评估了在Quantinuum Helios-1上实现的最多八个[[7,1,3]]编码逻辑量子比特的简单容错逻辑量子比特处理器的性能。
items.abstract: Quantum computing hardware is advancing rapidly toward utility-scale machines that will enable scientific breakthroughs. Many teams are pursuing distinct and difficult-to-compare routes to this goal, using different qubit technologies and logical architectures. Tracking progress toward quantum utility therefore requires rigorous benchmarks that measure computational capability relative to utility-scale challenge problems and enable fair comparison across disparate platforms. Here we demonstrate direct, cross-platform measurement of quantum computational capability using a new benchmark that quantifies the size of the largest computationally relevant quantum circuits that a machine can execute successfully and the speed at which it can execute them. We apply this quantum universal operation performance system (QUOPS) experimentally to leading processors from Quantinuum, Google, and IBM, computing directly on physical qubits. Translating state-of-the-art resource requirements for recognized challenge problems that represent useful quantum computation into effective QUOPS circuit sizes shows that computational capability must grow by 5 orders of magnitude, motivating fault-tolerant ap
items.authors: Timothy Proctor, Oliver Hart, Oliver Widzowski Maupin, Matthew Girling, Daniel Hothem, Daniel Mills, Jordan Hines, Karl Mayer, Jacob S. Nelson, Tyler LeBlond, Zohim Chandani, Diego Forlivesi, Piper C.

items.title: Security Implications of Measurement Based Crosstalk on Superconducting Quantum Computers
items.title_zh: 超导量子计算机中基于测量的串扰安全性影响
items.summary_zh: 串扰是超导量子处理器可扩展性的一大问题，但也可能被攻击者利用以故意破坏计算和窃取信息。本文分析了在量子比特测量过程中由于串扰导致的数据泄露。先前研究在IBM量子计算机上对单个量子比特测量的分类准确率达96%。在VTT的超导硬件上，我们使用类似框架实现了71.68%的准确率。扩展框架增加标签后，使用支持向量机（SVM）对单个量子比特测量的分类准确率为76.30%，对两个量子比特测量的准确率为53.37%。实验结果表明，量子比特的测量操作会影响相邻量子比特的测量概率，且对目标量子比特的影响依赖于测量的邻近量子比特数量及测量结果。
items.abstract: Crosstalk is one of the major issues for scalability of superconducting quantum processors. But it can also be used by threat actors to intentionally sabotage computations and steal information. This paper analyzes data leakage due to crosstalk during qubit measurement. Prior research yielded an accuracy of 96% in classifying measurement of one qubit in IBM quantum computers. When evaluated on superconducting hardware from VTT, we achieved an accuracy of 71.68% with similar framework. Our extended framework with additional labels yields an accuracy of 76.30% for classifying measurement of one qubit and 53.37% for measurement of two qubits using Support Vector Machine (SVM). Experimental results indicate that measurement operation on a qubit can affect the probability of measuring adjacent qubits. The impact on the target qubit is dependent on the number of neighboring qubits measured and also the measurement outcome.
items.authors: Subarna Adhikari, Kimmo Halunen

items.title: Factoring six-digit integers with superconducting quantum circuits
items.title_zh: 利用超导量子电路分解六位数整数
items.summary_zh: 整数分解是一个重要的计算问题，在公钥密码学中具有重要应用。本文展示了一种利用超导电路的量子分解协议。通过微波驱动，构建了一个高度可调的有效二能级哈密顿量，其特征值可通过光谱测量。目标整数 \(N\) 及每对候选因子 (\(p\),\(q\)) 被编码为施加微波场的幅度、频率和相位。通过扫描候选对并监测零能量下的光谱响应，我们识别出最多六位数的整数因子对。该协议不需要两量子比特门或量子纠缠。目前性能受限于微波控制的精度和光谱响应的有限线宽。提高控制精度和延长相干时间将扩展可分解整数的范围。
items.abstract: Integer factorization is a central computational problem with important applications in public-key cryptography. Here, we demonstrate a quantum factorization protocol using a superconducting circuit. Microwave drives are used to engineer a highly tunable effective two-level Hamiltonian whose eigenvalues can be measured spectroscopically. The target integer \(N\) and each candidate factor pair (\(p\),\(q\)) are encoded into the amplitudes, frequencies, and phases of the applied microwave fields. By scanning the candidate pairs while monitoring the spectral response at zero energy, we identify the factor pairs of integers up to six digits. The protocol requires neither two-qubit gates nor quantum entanglement. Its performance is currently limited by the precision of microwave control and the finite linewidth of the spectroscopic response. Improved control accuracy and longer coherence times would extend the accessible range of integers.
items.authors: Xi Zhang, Xinsheng Tan, Yang Yu

items.title: Violating a Bell Inequality: What to Do When You Lose Your Quantum System
items.title_zh: 违反贝尔不等式：失去量子系统后的应对策略
items.summary_zh: 检测漏洞是贝尔非局域性中的一个著名漏洞，源于贝尔实验中探测器的低效率。然而，这种低效率在量子网络的光子平台中普遍存在，因为光子容易被周围环境吸收。当量子系统（通常是光子）丢失时，各方应如何输出？最自然的选择是采用确定性策略，使每一方通过其局部输入的函数生成输出。本文研究了如何针对不同效率$\eta$选择此类后备策略，以最大化可能的违反程度。我们数学证明，对于CHSH不等式，存在一种对所有$\eta$最优的后备策略。然而，通常情况下，最优后备策略会随$\eta$变化，有时变化令人惊讶。例如，我们发现一个贝尔不等式的例子，其中在阈值效率附近的最优后备策略并不是无损情况下的最优确定性策略。我们的结果可以降低关闭检测漏洞的效率要求，因此对贝尔不等式违反的应用（如量子心灵感应或设备无关的量子密钥分发）具有重要意义。
items.abstract: The detection loophole is a well-known loophole in Bell nonlocality motivated by the inefficiency of detectors used in Bell experiments. However, this inefficiency is actually a ubiquitous feature of any photonic platform for quantum networks since photons are readily absorbed by the surrounding environment. When the quantum system, usually a photon, is lost, what should the parties output? The most natural choice is to fall back to a deterministic strategy where each party produces an output via a function of her local input. In this paper, we study how to choose such a fallback strategy for general Bell inequalities with respect to different efficiencies $\eta$ to maximize the possible violation. We mathematically prove that for the CHSH inequality, there exists a fallback strategy that is optimal for all $\eta$. However, in general, we find that the optimal fallback strategy can vary with $\eta$, sometimes in surprising ways. For example, we find an example of a Bell inequality where the optimal fallback strategy near the threshold efficiency is not an optimal deterministic strategy in the lossless setting. Our results can reduce the efficiency requirements for closing the detec
items.authors: Xinyu Xu, Yuqing Li, Mingze Xu, Dawei Ding

items.title: Spatial symmetry in few-photon interference and quantum metrology
items.title_zh: 少光子干涉与量子测量中的空间对称性
items.summary_zh: 在之前的研究中，我们建立了一个基于对称性的框架，用于广义的Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉及其在量子测量中的应用。本文将该框架应用于实验可实现的少光子配置，探讨其如何为多种现有结果提供新视角，并提出新的实验思路。我们首先将双光子Mach-Zehnder干涉仪重新解释为广义的Hong-Ou-Mandel实验，展示其光子计数统计和测量性能如何源于有效探测态的空间对称性。接着，我们研究了两个相干泵浦的参数光子对源，推导其完整的输出分布，并将源的不可区分性与空间对称性联系起来。最后，我们将讨论扩展到三模干涉仪，表明相同的对称性原理为三光子干涉在三分器配置中的自然描述提供了支持。
items.abstract: In previous work [Physical Review Letters, 136(6):060807, 2026], we developed a symmetry-based framework for generalized Hong-Ou-Mandel interference and its applications to quantum metrology. Here, we apply this framework to experimentally accessible configurations involving a few photons and explore how it sheds new light on a variety of existing results while suggesting new experimental perspectives. We first reinterpret a two-photon Mach-Zehnder interferometer as a generalized Hong-Ou-Mandel experiment and show how its photon-counting statistics and metrological performance follow from the spatial symmetry of an effective probe state. We then study two coherently pumped parametric photon-pair sources, derive their complete output distribution, and connect source indistinguishability with spatial symmetry. Finally, we extend the discussion to a three-mode interferometer and show that the same symmetry principles provide a natural description of three-photon interference in tritter configurations.
items.authors: \'Eloi Descamps, P\'erola Milman

items.title: Error Correction in a Distributed Quantum Computer
items.title_zh: 分布式量子计算中的错误纠正
items.summary_zh: 构建容错量子计算机需要可扩展的硬件架构和高效利用物理量子比特的纠错码。光子互连解决了这两个挑战，使物理量子比特能够分布在多个处理器上，并提供实现高效资源利用的量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码所需的非局部连接性。实现这一架构的关键要求是能够在远程处理器之间进行稳定子测量，这在实验上尚未得到验证。我们首次实验演示了分布式量子错误检测和纠正。我们在两个独立的捕获离子处理器中生成网络量子比特之间的纠缠，并利用它对数据量子比特进行远程综合测量。我们实现了分布式[[2, 1, 1]]重复码，实时检测跨两个模块编码的逻辑量子比特上的相位翻转错误，并抑制逻辑错误。随后，我们将这些中间电路综合测量与实时前馈结合，主动纠正分布式贝尔态上的任意单量子比特保利错误。这些结果为模块化量子架构中的量子错误纠正提供了实验基础。
items.abstract: Building fault-tolerant quantum computers with large numbers of logical qubits requires both scalable hardware architectures and error-correcting codes that make efficient use of physical qubits. Photonic interconnects address both of these challenges by allowing the physical qubits to be distributed across multiple processors while providing the non-local connectivity necessary to implement resource-efficient codes such as high-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes. A key requirement for realising this architecture is the ability to perform stabiliser measurements between remote processors, which has not previously been demonstrated experimentally. Here we report the first experimental demonstration of distributed quantum error detection and correction. We generate entanglement between network qubits in two separate trapped-ion processors and use it to perform remote syndrome measurements on data qubits. We first realise a distributed [[2, 1, 1]] repetition code, detecting phase-flip errors on a logical qubit encoded across the two modules in real time and suppressing logical errors. We then combine these mid-circuit syndrome measurements with real-time feedforward t
items.authors: E. M. Ainley, A. Agrawal, T. Araki, A. R. Mart\'inez, D. Main, E. Malinowski, J. A. Blackmore, S. Chen, P. Drmota, M. Mallweger, D. P. Nadlinger, R. Srinivas, S. C. Benjamin, G. Araneda, D. M. Lucas

items.title: Mass Dependence of Araki Relative Entropy through Modular Theory
items.title_zh: 通过模态理论研究Araki相对熵的质量依赖性
items.summary_zh: 基于已建立的相干态Araki相对熵的一粒子公式，我们研究其值如何对标量场的质量产生非平凡的依赖性。对于属于一粒子希尔伯特空间标准子空间$H_m$的局部向量$h$，已知的二次型表达为：$S_{H_m}(h)=-\langle h,\log\delta_{H_m}\,h\rangle$。我们的贡献是明确构造一个质量索引的向量族，该向量族位于楔形标准子空间上，并对该表达式进行评估。质量壳映射$h_m=E_mf$组织了关于快速性代表的四个结构条件，并展示了一个完整的快速性波函数，该波函数由双重光锥相位、两个sinc因子和一对高斯函数构成，满足这些条件以及严格的局部化标准。因此，该向量族对于每个$m>0$均属于$H_m(\W_R)$，其Araki相对熵是有限且严格正的，具有明确的谱表示使得正性显而易见。熵在大质量时被强烈抑制，在$1+1$维度的中等质量时达到最大值，并收敛到一个有限值。
items.abstract: Building on the established one-particle formula for the Araki relative entropy of coherent states, we study how its value acquires a nontrivial dependence on the mass of the scalar field. For a localized vector $h$ belonging to the standard subspace $H_m$ of the one-particle Hilbert space, the known quadratic-form expression is: $S_{H_m}(h)=-\langle h,\log\delta_{H_m}\,h\rangle$. Our contribution is to construct explicitly a mass-indexed family of vectors of the wedge standard subspace on which this expression is evaluated. The mass-shell map $h_m=E_mf$ organizes four structural conditions on rapidity representatives---on-shell dependence, a controlled massless boundary value, decay for large real rapidity, and Bisognano--Wichmann strip analyticity---and we exhibit an entire rapidity wave function, built from a doubled light-cone phase, two sinc factors, and a Gaussian pair, that satisfies them together with the sharp localization criterion: Hardy-type $L^2$ control throughout the Bisognano--Wichmann strip and the exact Tomita boundary relation. The family therefore belongs to $H_m(\W_R)$ for every $m>0$, and its Araki relative entropy is finite and strictly positive, with an exac
items.authors: M. S. Guimaraes, I. Roditi, S. P. Sorella

items.title: Density Formalism for Quantum Theory
items.title_zh: 量子理论的密度形式主义
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种量子理论的简单数学扩展。该扩展不仅开启了替代计算方法的可能性，还通过提供外部现实的图景，暗示了对标准理论的新物理解释。新形式主义最初针对单粒子情况进行开发，具有立即推广到量子场论及描述相对论现象（如粒子产生和湮灭）的优势。
items.abstract: A simple mathematical extension of quantum theory is presented. As well as opening the possibility of alternative methods of calculation, the additional formalism implies a new physical interpretation of the standard theory by providing a picture of an external reality. The new formalism, developed first for the single-particle case, has the advantage of generalizing immediately to quantum field theory and to the description of relativistic phenomena such as particle creation and annihilation.
items.authors: Roderick Sutherland

items.title: Floquet engineering in hybrid magnetic quantum systems
items.title_zh: 混合磁量子系统中的Floquet工程
items.summary_zh: 随着磁子学的发展，混合磁系统在量子技术中的应用得到了促进。我们设计了一种由超导环和磁性粒子组成的混合磁格子，作为量子总线在量子网络中传播量子资源。然而，该格子对量子实体施加了去相干效应，影响了其实际性能。通过研究与两个独立混合磁格子耦合的氮-空位中心和磁子模式的非马尔可夫动力学，我们提出了一种通过对量子实体进行周期驱动的Floquet工程方案，以抑制去相干。研究发现，当系统的准能谱中存在Floquet束缚态时，显著的稳态纠缠得以保持。这一结果为混合磁系统的精确操控提供了可能，并有利于其在量子网络中的应用。
items.abstract: The advancement of magnonics has facilitated the utilization of hybrid magnetic systems in quantum technologies. A hybrid magnetic lattice formed by an array of superconducting loops and magnetic particles has been devised as a quantum bus to disseminate quantum resources among magnetic quantum entities serving as nodes of a quantum network. However, the lattice also exerts a decoherence effect on the quantum entities, which impairs its practical performance. By studying the non-Markovian dynamics of nitrogen-vacancy centers and magnon modes coupled to two independent hybrid magnetic lattices, we propose a Floquet-engineering scheme via periodic driving on the quantum entities to suppress decoherence. We find that significant steady-state entanglement is preserved when a Floquet bound state exists in the quasienergy spectrum of the system consisting of each driven quantum entity and its lattice. This result enables a precise manipulation of hybrid magnetic systems and benefits their applications in quantum networks.
items.authors: Feng-Zhou Ji, Si-Yuan Bai, Wan-Li Yang, Chun-Jie Yang, Jun-Hong An

items.title: Ultra-Weak-Pump Microwave-to-Optical Quantum Transduction via a Single Color Center
items.title_zh: 超弱泵浦微波-光学量子转导研究
items.summary_zh: 实现容错量子计算的关键挑战之一是扩大超导量子处理器的规模。基于光子分布架构的可扩展性前景良好，但需要在低温下高效的微波-光学量子转导器。现有方法通常依赖强光泵浦，导致不必要的加热并降低单光子相干性。本文提出了一种基于嵌入在钻石光机械谐振器中的单一颜色中心的微波-光学量子转导器。我们展示了颜色中心与光腔之间的强耦合使得在约10 pW的极弱泵浦功率下实现相干转换。该方案能够以千赫兹级速率生成远程纠缠，保真度超过0.9，展示了基于固态缺陷的超弱泵浦和高效量子转导器的可行路径。
items.abstract: Scaling up superconducting quantum processors remains a central challenge for realizing fault-tolerant quantum computation. Although distributed architectures based on optical photons offer a promising route to scalability, they require an efficient microwave-to-optical quantum transducer that operates at cryogenic temperatures. Existing approaches typically rely on strong optical pumping, which induces undesirable heating and degrades single-photon coherence. Here, we propose a microwave-to-optical quantum transducer based on resonant scattering at a single color center embedded in a diamond optomechanical resonator. We show that strong coupling between the color center and the optical cavity enables coherent conversion at extremely weak pump powers on the order of 10 pW. The proposed scheme enables remote entanglement generation at a kilohertz-scale rate with a fidelity exceeding 0.9, demonstrating a viable pathway toward ultra-weak-pump and high-efficiency quantum transducers based on a solid-state defect.
items.authors: Kyosuke Goto, Hodaka Kurokawa, Hideo Kosaka, Kazuki Koshino

items.title: Secure Medical Data Transmission Using Quantum Key Distribution and Post-Quantum Cryptography in Real-World Fiber Networks
items.title_zh: 基于量子密钥分发和后量子密码学的医疗数据安全传输
items.summary_zh: 量子计算机对经典公钥密码学的威胁促使在医疗、金融和能源等关键基础设施中部署量子安全通信。量子密钥分发（QKD）和后量子密码学（PQC）提供互补的安全保障，信息论密钥交换和抗量子攻击的端到端认证可以在分层架构中结合。本文展示了一个在德国图林根地区的实地部署的量子安全网络，集成了基于纠缠的QKD与140公里光纤上的端到端PQC，连接了一个乡村健康服务亭和大学医院。与依赖专用密钥管理系统的传统部署不同，我们的架构将QKD密钥直接注入相邻节点之间的标准Linux VPN隧道中，而PQC则确保了端到端的通信安全，完全兼容现有基础设施和软件。我们在810 nm和1550 nm处生成了偏振纠缠光子对，电信光子通过已部署的光纤传输。主动偏振稳定和色散补偿保持了纠缠，实现了22天的连续自主运行。
items.abstract: The threat quantum computers pose to classical public-key cryptography motivates the deployment of quantum-safe communication for critical infrastructure such as healthcare, finance, and energy systems. Quantum key distribution (QKD) and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) offer complementary security guarantees, information-theoretic key exchange and quantum-resistant end-to-end authentication that can be combined in a layered architecture. Here, we demonstrate a field-deployed quantum-secure network integrating entanglement-based QKD with end-to-end PQC over 140 km of installed fiber in Thuringia, Germany, connecting a rural health kiosk to a university hospital via a trusted-node architecture comprising heterogeneous underground and aerial fiber links. Unlike conventional deployments that rely on a dedicated key management system to forward keys to applications, our architecture injects QKD keys directly into standard Linux-based VPN tunnels between adjacent nodes, while PQC secures the communication end-to-end, remaining fully compatible with existing infrastructure and software. items.title: Massive quantum divergence on the Cauchy horizon of a black hole
items.title_zh: 黑洞的Cauchy边界上的大规模量子发散
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了带电球对称（Reissner-Nordström）黑洞内部的量子大规模标量场。通过考察黑洞电荷、场质量和耦合常数的不同取值，我们分析了Hartle-Hawking态（代表热平衡黑洞）和Unruh态（代表通过霍金辐射蒸发的黑洞）下的场行为。结果表明，真空极化及量子应力-能量张量的角分量在Cauchy边界上发散，这与无质量场的情况形成鲜明对比。此外，我们在Eddington-Finkelstein坐标系下计算了能量通量，发现Cauchy边界上的通量通常不为零，特别是在常规Kruskal坐标系下，入射通量在Cauchy边界（$V=0$）处发散如$V^{-2}$。这一发散暗示其通过半经典爱因斯坦方程的反馈作用将导致强奇点，而非较弱的经典对应情况。有趣的是，在某些例外情况下，Eddington-Finkelstein坐标下的能量通量会消失：如在极限情况下（黑洞电荷最大）和某些精细调谐的参数空间区域。
items.abstract: We investigate a quantum massive scalar field in the interior of a charged and spherically-symmetric (Reissner-Nordstr\"om) black hole. We examine the behaviour for varying values of the black hole charge, field mass and coupling constant when the field is in two quantum states: Hartle-Hawking (representing a black hole in thermal equilibrium) and Unruh (representing a black hole evaporating via the emission of Hawking radiation). We show that the vacuum polarization as well as the angular components of the quantum stress-energy tensor diverge on the Cauchy horizon, in stark contrast to what happens for massless fields. We also calculate the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates $\{u,v\}$. We show that these fluxes on the Cauchy horizon do not generically vanish. This implies, in particular, that in regular, Kruskal coordinates $\{U,V\}$ the ingoing flux diverges like $V^{-2}$ on the Cauchy horizon (where $V=0$). This divergence suggests that its backreaction via the semiclassical Einstein equations would yield a strong singularity, as opposed to its weaker, classical counterpart. Interestingly, there are exceptions, in which the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein
items.authors: Marc Casals, Lorenzo Pisani, Peter Taylor

items.title: Direction and speed selectivity properties for spatio-temporal receptive fields according to the generalized Gaussian derivative model for visual receptive fields
items.title_zh: 基于广义高斯导数模型的时空感受野方向与速度选择性研究
items.summary_zh: 本文深入分析了简单细胞和复杂细胞的理想化时空感受野的方向和速度选择性特性，基于广义高斯导数模型。根据该理论，感受野被建模为适应不同图像速度和不同拉伸程度的速度调谐仿射高斯导数。通过对这些理想化感受野模型进行不同角频率和图像速度的移动正弦波刺激，本文将计算模型与生物神经元方向和速度选择性特性的表征方法进行比较。与初级视觉皮层生物神经元的神经生理测量结果相比，我们发现理论结果与速度调谐的视觉神经元对特定运动方向和速度的敏感性一致，并且不同视觉神经元在方向和速度选择性特性上表现出更宽或更尖锐的差异。我们的理论结果与运动敏感视觉神经元的神经生理特征结果相一致，支持了先前提出的假设。
items.abstract: This paper gives an in-depth theoretical analysis of the direction and speed selectivity properties of idealized models of the spatio-temporal receptive fields of simple cells and complex cells, based on the generalized Gaussian derivative model for visual receptive fields. According to this theory, the receptive fields are modelled as velocity-adapted affine Gaussian derivatives for different image velocities and different degrees of elongation. By probing such idealized receptive field models of visual neurons to moving sine waves with different angular frequencies and image velocities, we characterize the computational models to a structurally similar probing method as is used for characterizing the direction and speed selective properties of biological neurons. By comparison to results of neurophysiological measurements of direction and speed selectivity for biological neurons in the primary visual cortex, we find that our theoretical results are consistent with (i) velocity-tuned visual neurons that are sensitive to particular motion directions and speeds, and (ii) different visual neurons having broader vs. sharper direction and speed selective properties. Our theoretical res
items.authors: Tony Lindeberg

items.title: Linear Response Theory for Jump-Driven Stochastic Systems: Transient Statistics and Escape Dynamics
items.title_zh: 跳跃驱动随机系统的线性响应理论研究
items.summary_zh: 本文发展了一种针对由跳跃过程驱动的随机微分方程类的线性响应理论。我们从概率密度函数、平均退出时间和逃逸概率三个互补的角度研究系统对小的时间依赖扰动的响应。通过对相应的前向和后向Kolmogorov方程进行扰动分析，我们推导出控制这些统计量的一阶响应方程，并建立了明确的线性响应公式，表征了概率分布演化和系统逃逸行为对其系数变化的敏感性。
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a linear response theory for a class of stochastic differential equations driven by jump processes. We investigate the response of the system to small time-dependent perturbations from three complementary perspectives: probability density functions, mean exit times, and escape probabilities. By performing perturbation analyses of the corresponding forward and backward Kolmogorov equations, we derive the first-order response equations governing these statistical quantities and establish explicit linear response formulas, which characterize the sensitivity of the evolution of the probability distribution and the escape behavior of the system to variations in its coefficients.
items.authors: Qingyan Meng, Jinqiao Duan, Valerio Lucarini

items.title: No free lunch for continuity of stochastic convolutions
items.title_zh: 随机卷积的连续性无免费午餐定理
items.summary_zh: 我们构造了紧致、指数稳定的 $C_0$-半群 $S$，作用于希尔伯特空间 $X$，使得对于每个 $T>0$，随机卷积 $U_g(t)=\int_0^t S(t-s)g(s)\,\mathrm{d}\beta_s$ 在 $[0,T]$ 上以正概率是无界的，其中 $g\in L^\infty(\Omega;L^2(0,T;X))$ 是可预测的，$\beta$ 是实布朗运动。一个例子甚至是解析半群。另一个例子的负生成元 $A$ 具有 $\pi/2$ 的扇形角和有界的 $H^\infty$-微积分。我们的主要工具是一个必要条件：对于指数稳定的半群，$\mathbb R_+$ 上的 $L^2$-最大估计迫使负生成元的下界平方函数估计。我们通过涉及随机卷积、下属泊松半群和停止布朗运动的新恒等式推导出这一含义。结合在条件三角基上的 Schauder 乘子，我们得到了最大估计的反例。最后，能量适应的链式论证在更强条件 $g\in L^2([0,T]; L^\infty(\Omega;X))$ 下给出了任意 $C_0$-半群的连续性和最大估计。
items.abstract: We construct compact, exponentially stable $C_0$-semigroups $S$ on Hilbert spaces $X$ such that, for every $T>0$, the stochastic convolution $U_g(t)=\int_0^t S(t-s)g(s)\,\mathrm{d}\beta_s $ is unbounded on $[0,T]$ with positive probability for some predictable $g\in L^\infty(\Omega;L^2(0,T;X))$, where $\beta$ is a real Brownian motion. One example is even an analytic semigroup. For the other, the negative generator $A$ has sectorial angle $\pi/2$ and a bounded $H^\infty$-calculus. Our main tool is a necessary condition: for exponentially stable semigroups, an $L^2$-maximal estimate on $\mathbb R_+$ forces a lower square-function estimate for the negative generator. We deduce this implication from a new identity involving the stochastic convolution, the subordinated Poisson semigroup, and a stopped Brownian motion. Combining this condition with Schauder multipliers on a conditional trigonometric basis yields counterexamples to the maximal estimate. An extrapolation argument then produces the integrands with unbounded stochastic convolutions. Finally, an energy-adapted chaining argument gives continuity and maximal estimates for arbitrary $C_0$-semigroups under the stronger condition
items.authors: Mark Veraar, Joris van Winden

items.title: Bourgain's Lambda(p) selection theorem: a greedy proof with polynomial failure bounds
items.title_zh: Bourgain的Lambda(p)选择定理：带有多项式失败界限的贪婪证明
items.summary_zh: 我们给出了Bourgain有限$\Lambda(p)$选择定理的自包含证明，并提供了明确的概率界限。对于每个$p>2$和$N\ge2$，在一个概率空间中给定$N$个彼此正交且取值不超过1的函数，均匀选择的子系统（大小为$\lceil N^{\frac{2}{p}}\rceil$）以至少$1-\frac{1}{N}$的概率满足$\Lambda(p)$不等式，常数仅依赖于$p$。该不等式对所有复系数向量同时成立。更一般地，对于每个固定的$A>0$，成功概率至少为$1-\frac{1}{N^A}$，常数仅依赖于$p$和$A$，与$N$无关。证明使用了在$L^r$中的贪婪近似（$r>2$），其潜力在所有近似尺度上逐渐减少。对累积更新次数的单一加权界限控制了离散更新历史的并集界限，增加分配给每个历史的权重可以在不改变基数指数的情况下给出规定的失败指数。
items.abstract: We give a self-contained proof of Bourgain's finite $\Lambda(p)$ selection theorem with an explicit probability bound. For every $p>2$ and $N\ge2$, given $N$ pairwise orthogonal functions bounded by one on a probability space, a uniformly chosen subsystem of cardinality $\lceil N^{\frac{2}{p}}\rceil$ satisfies the $\Lambda(p)$ inequality with probability at least $1-\frac{1}{N}$, with a constant depending only on $p$. The inequality holds simultaneously for all complex coefficient vectors. More generally, for every fixed $A>0$, the success probability is at least $1-\frac{1}{N^A}$ with a constant depending only on $p$ and $A$, and independent of $N$. The proof uses a greedy approximation in $L^r$, with $r>2$, whose potential decreases throughout all approximation scales. A single weighted bound on the cumulative number of updates controls a union bound over discrete update histories, and increasing the weight assigned to each history gives the prescribed failure exponent without changing the cardinality exponent.
items.authors: Will Burstein, Alex Iosevich, Ben Krause

items.title: Infinite Families of Counterexamples to a Conjecture of Liu and Qian and a Refined Inverse Theorem for Restricted Sumsets in $\mathbb{Z}_p$
items.title_zh: 刘和钱猜想的反例无穷家族及限制和集的改进逆定理
items.summary_zh: 设$p$为素数，$A,B$为循环群$\mathbb{Z}_p$的非空子集且$|A|\neq |B|$。Alon-Nathanson-Ruzsa定理给出了下界$|A\rplus B|\ge \min\{p,\,|A|+|B|-2\}$，其中$A\rplus B=\{a+b:a\in A,\ b\in B,\ a\neq b\}$为限制和集。1996年，Alon、Nathanson和Ruzsa提出了逆问题，旨在表征所有达到等式的临界对$(A,B)$，该问题至今未解。最近，刘和钱在至少一个集合为等差数列的假设下解决了该逆问题，并提出了一个一般情况的猜想。本文的主要目的是证明该猜想在边界情况$|A|+|B|=p$下不成立。我们构造了无穷多个非等差临界对$(A,B)$，使得$|A|+|B|=p$且$|A\rplus B|=p-2$，适用于每个素数$p\ge 11$。这些家族表明边界情况与非边界情况在本质上是不同的。基于此，我们在自然假设$|A|+|B|\le p-1$下，制定并证明了一个改进的逆定理，排除了边界情况。
items.abstract: Let $p$ be a prime and let $A,B$ be nonempty subsets of the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_p$ with $|A|\neq |B|$. The Alon--Nathanson--Ruzsa theorem gives the lower bound $|A\rplus B|\ge \min\{p,\,|A|+|B|-2\},$ where $A\rplus B=\{a+b:a\in A,\ b\in B,\ a\neq b\}$ is the restricted sumset. The inverse problem of characterizing all critical pairs $(A,B)$ attaining equality was posed by Alon, Nathanson, and Ruzsa in 1996 and remains open. Recently, Liu and Qian solved the inverse problem under the assumption that at least one of the sets is an arithmetic progression, and proposed a conjecture for the general case. The main purpose of this paper is to show that this conjecture fails in the boundary case $|A|+|B|=p$. More precisely, we construct infinite families of non-arithmetic critical pairs $(A,B)$ with $|A|+|B|=p$ and $|A\rplus B|=p-2$ for every prime $p\ge 11$. These families show that the boundary case is fundamentally different from the non-boundary case. Motivated by this, we formulate and prove a refined inverse theorem under the natural hypothesis $|A|+|B|\le p-1$, which excludes the boundary.
items.authors: Jiantao Li, Xinyi Liang

items.title: Gibbs Sampling for Bayesian Generalized Poisson Matrix Factorization
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯广义泊松矩阵分解的吉布斯抽样方法
items.summary_zh: 广义泊松矩阵分解（GPMF）是一种基于广义泊松分布的计数数据矩阵分解方法，适用于过度离散情况。尽管GPMF通过最大似然估计提供模型参数的点估计，但未能量化估计的不确定性。本文提出了GPMF的贝叶斯扩展，称为贝叶斯GPMF，并开发了用于后验推断的吉布斯抽样器。该方法基于广义泊松分布的复合泊松表示，引入潜在变量，并为所有模型参数提供封闭形式的全条件后验分布。为了高效抽样过度离散参数，我们推导了指数倾斜贝塔（EBeta）分布的无限混合表示，并基于此表示开发了有限近似。模拟研究表明，贝叶斯GPMF的均方误差小于传统GPMF，同时提供的可信区间的经验覆盖概率接近名义水平。此外，所提有限近似在估计精度上可与采样/重要性重抽样（SIR）相媲美，但计算量更小。对足球事件数据的应用进一步展示了贝叶斯GPMF在提取可解释性方面的实用性。
items.abstract: Generalized Poisson matrix factorization (GPMF) is a matrix factorization method for count data with overdispersion based on the generalized Poisson distribution. While GPMF provides point estimates of the model parameters through maximum likelihood estimation, it does not quantify estimation uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a Bayesian extension of GPMF, referred to as Bayesian GPMF, and develop a Gibbs sampler for posterior inference. The proposed method is based on a compound Poisson representation of the generalized Poisson distribution, which introduces latent variables and yields closed-form full conditional posterior distributions for all model parameters. To efficiently sample the overdispersion parameter, we derive an infinite mixture representation of the exponentially tilted beta (EBeta) distribution and develop a finite approximation based on this representation. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian GPMF achieves smaller mean squared errors than the conventional GPMF while providing credible intervals with empirical coverage probabilities close to the nominal level. Furthermore, the proposed finite approximation attains estimation accuracy comp
items.authors: Fumitake Sakaori, Hiroyasu Abe

items.title: Nonparanormal Bayesian Learning of Directed Acyclic Graphs under Gamma and Inverse-Gamma Innovation Priors: Closed-Form Scores and Informed Sampling
items.title_zh: 基于伽马与逆伽马先验的有向无环图贝叶斯学习
items.summary_zh: 有向无环图（DAG）的贝叶斯结构学习是重建生物网络的核心工具，但通常假设数据为联合高斯分布。在蛋白质组学应用中，这一假设常常被偏斜和重尾数据所违反，导致高斯DAG恢复虚假或错误的边。我们开发了一种完全贝叶斯框架，针对非高斯家族的DAG学习，替代高斯性要求为未知严格单调递增的边际变换为联合高斯。我们在潜在精度矩阵的修正Cholesky参数化上，引入了两种创新方差先验：非共轭的正态-伽马先验和共轭的正态-逆伽马先验。我们获得了节点边际似然的封闭形式，允许MCMC采样器移动的评分无需数值积分。通过这些，我们构建了局部平衡的知情采样器，并提出了无贝塞尔的评分方法，能够扩展到数百个节点。在模拟数据上，当数据为高斯时，我们的非高斯采样器与高斯方法相匹配，而在边际偏斜时则显著优于它们。
items.abstract: Bayesian structure learning for directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) is a central tool for reconstructing biological networks, yet it often assumes the data are jointly Gaussian. In motivating proteomic applications, this assumption is routinely violated by skewed and heavy-tailed data, causing Gaussian DAGs to recover spurious or misdirected edges. We develop a fully Bayesian framework for DAG learning in the nonparanormal family, replacing Gaussianity with the weaker requirement that unknown strictly increasing marginal transformations are jointly Gaussian. Working on the modified Cholesky parameterization of the latent precision matrix, we introduce two innovation-variance priors: a non-conjugate Normal-Gamma prior, which decouples coefficient shrinkage from variance regularization, and a conjugate Normal-Inverse-Gamma prior. For both, we obtain the node-wise marginal likelihood in closed form -- through a modified Bessel function of the third kind for the Gamma prior and a Student-$t$ form for the Inverse-Gamma prior -- allowing MCMC sampler moves to be scored without numerical integration. Exploiting these, we build a locally-balanced informed sampler and a Bessel-free score that sc
items.authors: Samaneh Nazari, Mohammad Arashi

items.title: Crystallographic and Electronic Phase Changes in TiTe2 via Atmospheric and Electron Beam Exposure
items.title_zh: TiTe2在气氛和电子束照射下的晶体和电子相变研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了通过化学气相运输（CVT）技术在高压下生长的过渡金属二硫化物TiTe2的表面敏感性，以及样品在暴露于空气和电子束照射下的表面变化。我们使用扫描隧道显微镜/光谱（STM/STS）研究了机械剥离样品表面的局部态密度（LDOS），发现表面发生了金属到半导体的转变。STM分析显示表面粗糙度明显变化，表明样品表面形成了附加层。通过X射线衍射（XRD）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）检查晶体结构，发现从单晶六方相向扭曲的单斜相再到多晶状态的相变。此外，可能存在的超晶格表明暴露层表面存在非化学计量的TixTey。
items.abstract: In this study, we examine the surface sensitivity of a transition metal dichalcogenide (TiTe2) grown using the Chemical Vapor Transport (CVT) technique at high pressure and study the surface changes in the sample upon exposure to air as well as its crystallographic properties upon e-beam exposure. We examine the local density of States (LDOS) of the mechanically exfoliated sample surface before and after exposure using Scanning Tunneling Microscopy/Spectroscopy (STM/STS) and find a metal-to-semiconductor transition at the surface. The STM analysis shows a clear change in surface roughness which indicates the formation of an adlayer on the surface of the sample. The crystal structure was examined using X-ray Diffraction (XRD) and Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), indicating a phase transition from a single-crystalline hexagonal phase to a polycrystalline state via a distorted monoclinic phase. Furthermore, the presence of a possible superlattice suggests non-stoichiometric TixTey at the surface of the exposed layer.
items.authors: Bishal Pokhrel, Joel Quarnstrom, Saraswati Shrestha, Halle Helfrich, Elena Echeverria, David N. McIlroy, Andrew J. Yost

items.title: Quantitative and bond-traceable resonant X-ray optical tensors of organic molecules
items.title_zh: 有机分子的定量与可追踪键的共振X射线光学张量
items.summary_zh: 纳米结构内的局部分子取向和构象对其在器件、量子态和生物过程中的行为至关重要。X射线显微镜和在碳吸收边缘的散射对这些现象具有独特的敏感性，通过与光子能量和极化相关的跃迁偶极矩进行编码。然而，由于缺乏具有键和取向特异性的准确光学模型，定量分析受到限制。我们通过无监督机器学习算法生成了这样的模型，将密度泛函理论计算聚类为主要电子跃迁，并通过角分辨吸收测量进行定量优化。所得到的光学张量能够重现具有不同取向和晶体堆积的样品数据。这一优化方法将光谱特征与化学基团联系起来，并解析了测量无法获取的偶极矩，为分子纳米结构中键的无标记取向分析建立了新范式。
items.abstract: Local molecular orientation and conformation within nanostructures is central to their behavior in devices, emergent quantum states, and biological processes. X-ray microscopy and scattering at the carbon absorption edge is uniquely sensitive to these phenomena, through transition dipole moments encoded with photon energy and polarization. However, quantitative analysis is precluded due to the lack of accurate optical models with bond and orientation specificity. We generate such a model through an unsupervised machine learning algorithm that clusters density functional theory calculations into principle electronic transitions, quantitatively refined with angle-resolved absorbance measurements. The resulting optical tensor reproduces data from samples with domains of different orientation and crystalline packing. This refinement method connects spectral features to chemical moieties and resolves measurement-inaccessible dipole moments, establishing a new paradigm for label-free orientation analyses of bonds within molecular nanostructures.
items.authors: Victor Murcia, Obaid Alqahtani, Harlan Heilman, Brian A. Collins

items.title: Investigating the ‘Water Paradox’: Theoretical Evidence for Electric Field-Mediated Catalysis of Peptide Bond Formation
items.title_zh: 研究“水悖论”：电场介导的肽键形成催化理论证据
items.summary_zh: 生命起源化学中的一个关键问题——“水悖论”——是复杂生物分子如何在水相环境中通过缩合反应形成。肽的形成是一个在水中具有挑战性的反应，因为高自由能障碍和小热力学驱动力阻碍聚合。近期实验表明，肽聚合在气-水界面上更为容易，可能与内在的界面电场有关。本文通过量子力学模拟甘氨酸双离子化的二聚反应，探讨电场催化肽键形成的可行性。结果表明，定向电场将水相中的高能障碍、六步机制简化为四步过程，显著降低反应障碍。此外，模型显示，肽水解反应未被催化，因为定向电场导致反应水与肽键之间的空间分离，使初始水解步骤的可及性降低。这些结果补充了实验发现，提供了支持界面电场在前生物肽合成中发挥核心作用的机制。
items.abstract: A key question in origins of life chemistry – sometimes termed the ‘Water Paradox’ – is how complex biomolecules can form via condensation reactions in aqueous environments. This problem is exemplified by the formation of peptides, which is a challenging reaction in bulk water because high free energy barriers and small thermodynamic driving forces hinder polymerization. Recent experiments suggest that peptide polymerization is more facile at air-water interfaces, possibly due to the presence of intrinsic interfacial electric fields. Here we explore the viability of electric field catalysis of peptide bond formation using quantum mechanical simulations of the dimerization of glycine zwitterions. Our results suggest that oriented electric fields reduce the high barrier, six-step mechanism in bulk water to a simpler four-step process with substantially lower reaction barriers. Furthermore, our modeling indicates that the reverse reaction – peptide hydrolysis – is not catalyzed because the oriented electric field causes a spatial separation between the reacting water and the peptide bond, making the initial hydrolysis step less accessible. These results complement experimental finding
items.authors: Teddy Herriman, Gino A. DiLabio

items.title: Geometry-Dependent Redistribution of Exocytotic Spike-Shape Populations Revealed by Ultrafast Disk and Nanotip Acetylcholine Biosensors
items.title_zh: 几何依赖性外排尖峰形态的重分布研究
items.summary_zh: 通过超快电化学乙酰胆碱（ACh）生物传感器，亚毫秒级的ACh外排测量得以实现。该生物传感器将瞬态的突触前ACh释放事件转化为亚毫秒的安培尖峰，能够在单事件水平上进行分析。尽管盘形和纳米尖电极几何结构已被应用于超快ACh生物传感器，但传感器几何是否影响量子测量及外排尖峰形态的分布尚不明确。对单个胆碱能细胞的安培记录进行分析，采用了包括低尖锐、高尖锐、增加、减少、平台、高尖峰、重叠和奇特事件在内的八种事件类别的尖峰形态分类系统。结果显示，纳米尖生物传感器检测到的高尖锐事件比例显著高于盘形生物传感器，而形态更复杂的完全释放事件和重叠事件的比例则较低。这一复杂完全释放事件的减少并非由单一亚型驱动，而是反映了分布特征。
items.abstract: Measurements of sub-millisecond acetylcholine (ACh) exocytosis have only recently become possible through the development of ultrafast electrochemical ACh biosensors. These biosensors convert transient presynaptic ACh release events into sub-millisecond amperometric spikes that can be analyzed at the single-event level. Although both disk and nanotip electrode geometries have been incorporated into ultrafast ACh biosensors, it remains unclear whether sensor geometry influences quantal measurements and the observed distribution of exocytotic spike shapes. Amperometric recordings were obtained from single cholinergic cells and analyzed using a spike-shape classification system consisting of eight distinct event categories, including low sharp, high sharp, increasing, decreasing, plateau, high spike, overlap, and funky events. Although disk and nanotip biosensors produced comparable estimates of vesicular release content and global spike kinetics, detailed spike-shape classification revealed a geometry-dependent redistribution of the detected exocytotic event populations. Nanotip biosensors detected a significantly higher proportion of high sharp events and lower proportions of morpho
items.authors: Yuanmo Wang, Ajay Pradhan

items.title: SCN4A Channelopathies: From Disease Mechanisms to Variant Interpretation
items.title_zh: SCN4A通道病：从疾病机制到变异解读
items.summary_zh: SCN4A基因编码骨骼肌电压门控钠通道NaV1.4。该基因的致病变异导致不同的疾病机制，包括显性α孔功能获得、显性S4门控孔电流和通道可用性降低，严重的双等位基因功能缺失可引起先天性肌病和胎儿运动不足。这种异质性使得变异解读变得困难，因为正式的变异分类、通道功能障碍的方向和患者级别的疾病归因是密切相关但可区分的结论。本文综述了与SCN4A变异解读相关的临床、遗传、电生理、结构和功能证据，特别关注不确定意义的错义变异。我们探讨了如何在ACMG/AMP框架内整合遗传方式、通道拓扑、表型、种群数据、分离、RNA证据、区域和残基水平背景及机制匹配的功能测定。已发表的致病富集区域、gnomAD区域错义约束和同残基观察可在满足ACMG/AMP标准的情况下为变异解读提供支持；若未针对SCN4A进行特定验证或校准，则最好作为优先考虑额外证据的背景信息。
items.abstract: SCN4A encodes the skeletal-muscle voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.4. Pathogenic variation in this gene produces fundamentally different disease mechanisms, including dominant alpha-pore gain of function, dominant S4 gating-pore currents, and reduced channel availability, with severe biallelic loss of function causing congenital myopathy and fetal hypokinesia. This heterogeneity makes variant interpretation difficult because formal variant classification, the direction of channel dysfunction, and patient-level disease attribution are closely related but distinguishable conclusions. In this review, we synthesize the clinical, genetic, electrophysiological, structural, and functional evidence relevant to SCN4A variant interpretation, with particular attention to missense variants of uncertain significance. We examine how inheritance, channel topology, phenotype, population data, segregation, RNA evidence, regional and residue-level context, and mechanism-matched functional assays can be integrated within the ACMG/AMP framework. Published pathogenic-enriched regions, gnomAD regional missense constraint, and same-residue observations may contribute to variant interpretation when the r
items.authors: Paola D’Ambrosio, Lorenzo Cipriano, Alessia Pugliese, Roberta Petillo, Dario Ricciardi, Francesco Habetswallner

items.title: Construction-Stage Carbon Accounting and Carbon Reduction Performance of Intelligent Construction in Landfill Vertical Barrier Engineering
items.title_zh: 填埋场垂直屏障工程智能施工阶段碳核算与减排绩效研究
items.summary_zh: 尽管对低碳基础设施的需求日益增长，环境修复项目的施工阶段碳排放仍然缺乏量化。本研究基于中国海口的一项全尺度修复项目，建立了填埋场垂直屏障工程的碳核算框架。通过排放因子法量化了与化石燃料消耗、施工材料、电力使用、施工期间水消耗及人员相关活动相关的碳排放，并比较了传统与智能施工场景。结果显示，传统施工场景下化石燃料燃烧占总排放的80.87%，智能施工场景下为66.83%。智能施工使总排放减少了19.34%，柴油消耗减少33.3%，HDPE土工膜消耗减少2.9%，施工周期减少15.5%。设备电气化、自动化施工和智能灌浆被确定为通过提高能源效率和材料利用率实现减碳的主要驱动因素。所提出的框架为低碳施工和可持续填埋场修复提供了实用指导。
items.abstract: Construction-stage carbon emissions from environmental remediation projects remain poorly quantified despite growing demands for low-carbon infrastructure. This study develops a carbon accounting framework for landfill vertical barrier engineering based on a full-scale remediation project in Haikou, China. Carbon emissions associated with fossil fuel consumption, construction materials, electricity use, water consumption during construction, and personnel-related activities were quantified using the emission factor method, and conventional and intelligent construction scenarios were compared. The results show that fossil fuel combustion accounted for 80.87% of total emissions under the conventional construction scenario and 66.83% under the intelligent construction scenario. Intelligent construction reduced total emissions by 19.34%, accompanied by reductions of 33.3% in diesel consumption, 2.9% in HDPE geomembrane consumption, and 15.5% in construction duration. Equipment electrification, automated construction, and intelligent grouting were identified as the primary drivers of carbon reduction through improved energy efficiency and material utilization. items.title: Thoracic Skeletal Muscle Attenuation Predicts Sex-Specific Mortality After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting—Sex-Specific Insights into Risk Stratification and Frailty Assessment
items.title_zh: 胸部骨骼肌衰减预测冠脉旁路手术后的性别特异性死亡率
items.summary_zh: 背景：虚弱和肌肉质量受损是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）不良结果的重要决定因素，但传统风险评分忽视了这一生物学维度。本研究利用常规术前CT扫描获得的Hounsfield单位平均值计算（HUAC）来量化骨骼肌衰减，反映肌内脂肪浸润和代谢储备。方法：在这项回顾性单中心研究中，分析了479名接受孤立CABG的患者（382名男性，97名女性），并测量了第四（TH4）和第十二（TH12）胸椎水平的平均HUAC。生成性别特异性的HUAC四分位数，低四分位数定义为低胸部肌肉衰减，代表肌肉质量受损的放射学表型。通过Kaplan-Meier分析、受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线和性别分层的Cox回归模型评估与1年、3年和5年死亡率的关联。结果：低HUAC患者的预后价值超越EuroSCORE II。
items.abstract: Background: Frailty and impaired muscle quality are strong determinants of adverse outcomes after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), yet conventional risk scores overlook this biological dimension. The Hounsfield Unit Average Calculation (HUAC) obtained from routine preoperative computed tomography (CT) scans quantifies skeletal muscle attenuation, reflecting intramuscular fat infiltration and metabolic reserve. This study evaluated the prognostic value of HUAC measured at two thoracic levels and explored sex-specific differences in its predictive performance. Methods: In this retrospective single-center study, 479 patients (382 men, 97 women) undergoing isolated CABG with available preoperative CT scans were analyzed. Mean HUAC was measured bilaterally at the fourth (TH4) and twelfth (TH12) thoracic vertebral levels. Sex-specific HUAC quartiles were generated, with the lower quartile defining low thoracic muscle attenuation, representing a radiographic phenotype of impaired muscle quality. items.title: Stochastic Foundations of Atmospheric Thermodynamics: Deriving the Laws from Maximum Entropy and Implications for Earth’s Climate
items.title_zh: 大气热力学的随机基础：从最大熵推导定律及其对地球气候的影响
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新的熵的公理基础，克服了经典和信息论熵基础的局限，最终统一了概率熵和物理熵。通过一组新的公设，建立了与最大熵原理一致的基于不确定性的严格熵定义。熵因此成为一个纯粹的随机概念，用于量化不确定性，丰富了Kolmogorov的概率系统。在气体热力学中，该框架重现了经典结果，并推导出热力学定律。在大气应用中，熵最大化导致分子平衡的等温状态。重力不改变等温状态，但使其与宏观空气团的等熵状态区分开来，后者的运动使大气远离平衡。辐射活性气体通过与短波和长波辐射的相互作用，维持大气变量的非平衡垂直分布。结合Stefan-Boltzmann定律，这些机制为观察到的大气行为和气候系统提供了简单、节约且一致的解释。该框架强调热力学是从随机性中涌现的，为分子不确定性、宏观结构的涌现及辐射提供了新的见解。
items.abstract: A novel axiomatic foundation of entropy has recently been proposed, overcoming the limitations of classical and information-theoretic entropy foundations and eventually unifying probabilistic and physical entropy. A new set of postulates leads to a rigorous, uncertainty-based definition of entropy consistent with the principle of maximum entropy. Entropy is thus a purely stochastic concept quantifying uncertainty, thereby enriching Kolmogorov’s probability system. Applied to gas thermodynamics, the new framework reproduces classical results and derives, rather than assumes, the laws of thermodynamics. In atmospheric applications, entropy maximization yields an isothermal state as the molecular equilibrium. Gravitation does not alter the isothermal state but differentiates it from the isentropic one of macroscopic air parcels, whose motion drives the atmosphere away from equilibrium. Radiatively active gases, through interactions with shortwave and longwave radiation, sustain non-equilibrium vertical profiles of the atmospheric variables. Combined with the Stefan–Boltzmann law, these mechanisms provide a simple, parsimonious, and coherent explanation of observed atmospheric behavior
items.authors: Demetris Koutsoyiannis

items.title: CT Imaging Patterns and Clinical Outcomes of Traumatic Brain Injury: Distribution Across Injury Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 创伤性脑损伤的CT影像模式与临床结果研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：本研究旨在评估与创伤相关的脑损伤的影像学模式和临床结果，分析交通事故、跌倒及其他原因导致的脑损伤、面部骨折及其结果的分布。方法：回顾性分析2019年1月至2024年1月间536例患者的脑部CT扫描，收集人口统计学、病因、交通方式（司机、乘客、行人、摩托车骑士、自行车骑士）、格拉斯哥昏迷评分（GCS）、临床结果（重症监护室入院、神经外科干预、死亡率）及CT影像特征。结果：39%的受试者被诊断为脑损伤，其中最常见的病变为脑实质内血肿（24%），其次为硬膜下血肿（23%）。跌倒患者的脑损伤发生率（45%）高于交通事故患者（37%），但在未调整及调整后分析中均未达到统计学显著性（p>0.05）。不同交通方式的CT影像模式存在差异，自行车骑士与脑实质内出血相关。
items.abstract: Background: Our goal was to evaluate the radiological patterns and clinical outcomes of brain injuries related to trauma, offering insight into the distribution of brain injuries, facial fractures and outcomes across road traffic accidents (RTAs), falls and other causes. Methods: Cerebral CT scans of 536 cases obtained between January 2019 and January 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. The collected data included demographics, etiology, transportation groups (driver, car occupant, pedestrian, motorcyclist, bicyclist), GCS (Glasgow Coma Scale), clinical outcome (ICU (intensive care unit) admission, neurosurgical intervention, mortality) and CT imaging features. Images were analyzed independently by two physicians. The findings reflect a selected population of polytrauma patients who underwent cerebral CT at a single emergency hospital. Results: Brain injury was identified in 39% of all subjects, the most frequent type of lesion being intraparenchymal hematoma (24%), followed by subdural hematoma (23%). Brain injury was numerically more frequent among patients with falls (45%) than among those involved in RTAs (37%), although this difference did not reach statistical significance in

items.title: The Causal Artificial Intelligence Clinician for early haemodynamic management of septic shock in ICU
items.title_zh: ICU中早期血流动力学管理的因果人工智能临床医生
items.summary_zh: 背景：由于患者异质性，脓毒性休克的液体和血管收缩剂复苏标准化面临挑战。目的：确定脓毒性休克患者在ICU入院前六小时的最佳静脉液体和血管收缩剂剂量。方法：应用基于专家临床知识的图形因果推断模型，估计异质治疗效果，限制虚假相关带来的偏差。模型在1,706例MIMIC入院数据上训练，并在1,450例eICU入院数据上进行外部验证。主要结果为院内生存率，次要结果为临床改善。结果：研究对象为3,156名参与者（年龄65岁 [IQR 53-75]；42.8%为女性）。血管收缩剂推荐偏离与临床改善失败相关（中位OR 1.26，95% CI 1.21-1.32），且与院内死亡率相关（中位OR 1.16，95% CI 1.10-1.24）。液体偏离的中位OR分别为1.12（1.08-1.18）和1.02（0.96-1.07）。外部验证的AUROC为生存0.72（95% CI 0.67-0.76）和改善0.70（95% CI 0.66-0.73），与预测基线相当。治疗反应因基线生理状态而异。
items.abstract: Rationale: Standardizing fluid and vasopressor resuscitation in septic shock is challeng ing due to patient heterogeneity. Objectives: To identify optimal intravenous fluid and vasopressor doses in first six hours of ICU admission in septic shock. Methods: Graphical causal inference models grounded in expert clinical knowledge were applied to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects, limiting bias from spurious correlations. The model was trained on 1,706 MIMIC admissions and externally validated on 1,450 eICU admissions. The primary outcome was in-hospital survival; clinical improvement was the secondary outcome. Measurements and Main Results: The cohort comprised 3,156 participants (age 65 years [IQR 53-75]; 42.8% female). Deviation from vasopressor recommendations was associ ated with failed clinical improvement (median OR 1.26, 95% CI 1.21-1.32), the most stable association across twelve sensitivity configurations, and with in-hospital mortality (median OR 1.16, 95% CI 1.10-1.24), which was null in five of twelve. items.title: Scalable context-dependent single-cell eQTL mapping reveals disease-relevant regulatory variation beyond static models
items.title_zh: 可扩展的上下文依赖单细胞eQTL映射揭示超越静态模型的疾病相关调控变异
items.summary_zh: 许多与疾病相关的变异被认为通过基因调控发挥作用，但传统的eQTL映射仅解释了部分GWAS位点，可能是因为调控效应在细胞状态和环境中变化。我们提出了CASTIE，一个可扩展的泊松混合模型框架，直接建模稀疏的单细胞读数，能够在不预筛选静态效应的情况下进行全基因组的基因型与上下文交互测试。应用CASTIE于来自982名OneK1K捐赠者的120万外周血单核细胞，识别出3,155个上下文依赖的eQTL关联，其中2,022个e基因没有可检测的静态效应。这些关联在94个性状中产生了374个共定位，代表270个独特位点，其中197个未通过相应的静态eQTL恢复。共定位将性状关联与特定细胞上下文和基因（如GCHFR、RNASET2和ATP1A3）联系起来。在暴露于代谢刺激的脂肪源间充质干细胞中，CASTIE使e基因发现增加了36-92%，并识别出代谢性状位点的刺激依赖性调控效应。因此，建模细胞上下文揭示了超越静态eQTL映射的疾病相关调控变异。
items.abstract: Many disease-associated variants are thought to act through gene regulation, yet conventional eQTL mapping explains only a fraction of GWAS loci, potentially because regulatory effects vary across cellular states and environments. We present CASTIE, a scalable Poisson mixed-model framework that directly models sparse single-cell read counts and enables genome-wide testing of genotype-by-context interactions without pre-screening for static effects. Applying CASTIE to 1.2 million peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 982 OneK1K donors identified 3,155 context-dependent eQTL associations, including 2,022 eGenes without detectable static effects. These associations yielded 374 colocalizations across 94 traits, representing 270 unique loci, of which 197 were not recovered using the corresponding static eQTLs. The colocalizations linked trait associations to specific cellular contexts and genes including GCHFR, RNASET2 and ATP1A3. In adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells exposed to metabolic stimulations, CASTIE increased eGene discovery by 36-92% across cell populations and identified stimulation-dependent regulatory effects at metabolic trait loci. items.title: Diagnostic Value of Large Language Model-Extracted Gross Brain Findings in Neurodegenerative Diseases
items.title_zh: 大语言模型提取的脑部病理发现对神经退行性疾病的诊断价值
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了大语言模型提取的尸检报告中的脑部病理描述在神经退行性疾病中的分类能力。我们分析了1998年至2023年间梅奥诊所脑库收集的5,613例尸检病例，涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、路易体病（LBD）、AD-LBD、额颞叶变性、皮质基底变性、进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）和多系统萎缩（MSA）七个诊断类别。经过微调的大语言模型将叙述性病理描述转化为39个特征的半定量评分，提取准确率为0.95。使用CatBoost分类器和第二个微调的LLM对提取的评分和标准化文本描述进行分类。CatBoost的准确率为0.73，Cohen's kappa为0.65，宏平均ROC曲线下面积为0.92；文本基础的LLM准确率为0.75，kappa为0.68。两个模型的宏平均灵敏度均为0.66。
items.abstract: Gross brain findings help guide differential diagnosis, but their diagnostic value across major neurodegenerative diseases remains incompletely characterized. We evaluated whether gross descriptions in autopsy reports could classify cases by final neuropathologic diagnosis. We analyzed 5,613 autopsy cases from the Mayo Clinic Brain Bank collected between 1998 and 2023, including seven diagnostic categories: Alzheimer disease (AD), Lewy body disease (LBD), combined AD and LBD (AD-LBD), frontotemporal lobar degeneration, corticobasal degeneration, progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), and multiple system atrophy (MSA). A fine-tuned large language model (LLM) converted narrative gross descriptions into semi-quantitative scores for 39 features. Extraction accuracy was 0.95 in 200 manually annotated feature-level test examples. A CatBoost classifier used the extracted scores as input, whereas a second fine-tuned LLM used standardized textual descriptions of the same features. Both classifiers also included age at death, sex, and brain weight. Performance was evaluated in the same held-out test set of 562 cases. items.title: Acceptability of AI-applications in routine clinical care for children and adolescents: perspectives of parents and healthcare professionals
items.title_zh: 儿童青少年临床护理中AI应用的可接受性研究
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）技术的快速发展，越来越多的关注集中在其在儿科医疗中的潜在应用上。了解影响家长和临床工作人员对AI可接受性的因素是促进其在临床常规中整合的重要前提。本研究调查了198名家长（第一组）和79名家长（第二组）以及33名儿科医疗专业人员在不同疾病、诊断或治疗场景下对AI的可接受性。评估了人口统计变量和上下文预测因素（如数据隐私、AI知识和感知疾病严重性）对使用AI意愿的影响。结果显示，更宽松的数据隐私与降低的使用意愿相关（p < .001）；在第二组家长中，感知疾病严重性较高与更高的使用意愿相关（β = .10, p = .013）。当AI与临床医生的建议冲突时，家长在治疗场景中更倾向于选择AI。医疗专业人员表现出类似的模式，但在解决分歧时更重视感知疾病严重性。这些发现强调了关注利益相关者共同体的重要性。
items.abstract: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, growing interest has emerged in its potential application in pediatric healthcare. Understanding the factors influencing AI acceptability among parents and clinical staff is an important prerequisite for facilitating its integration in clinical routine. To date, these factors have not been systematically assessed across different stakeholder groups. Here we investigated AI acceptability among parents (first cohort n = 198; second cohort: n = 79) and pediatric health care professionals (n = 33) across different disease, diagnosis or treatment scenarios. The effects of demographic variables and contextual predictors, such as data privacy, AI knowledge and perceived disease severity, on willingness to use AI were evaluated. More liberal data privacy was associated with reduced willingness to use AI (p = < .001). A higher perceived disease severity was linked to higher willingness to use AI ({beta} = .10, p = .013) in the second parent group. When the recommendations of AI and clinicians conflicted, parents were more likely to choose AI over the judgment of clinicians in treatment compared to diagnosis scenarios.
items.authors: Lin, F.; Bischops, A. C.; Kerth, J.-L.; Meissner, T.; Bruni, T.; Eickhoff, S. B.; Heinrichs, B.; Lahnakoskia, J. M.; Dukart, J.

items.title: Plasma proteomics reveals stage-dependent biological remodelling in Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: 血浆蛋白组学揭示阿尔茨海默病的阶段性生物重塑
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了来自1035名参与者的血浆生物标志物，评估与淀粉样蛋白相关的tau磷酸化（T1）和已确立的tau蛋白病（T2），以近似阿尔茨海默病的阶段。使用220重免疫测定平台，我们将T1/T2生物标志物与淀粉样蛋白和tau正电子发射断层扫描进行比较，并构建了一个五阶段框架。脑源性磷酸化tau 217和内源性切割的微管结合区tau构成了简约的基础。基线阶段排序的临床痴呆评定-总分轨迹显示，个体内阶段的前移与临床恶化加速相关。在197种非tau蛋白中，有34种与阶段相关；T1阳性转变显示出最广泛的蛋白组学变化，后期的重塑则更具选择性。在连续样本中，15种蛋白质纵向变化，13种重现了横断面阶段模式。因此，血浆定义的疾病位置映射到超越T1/T2生物标志物的不同且部分动态的生物状态。
items.abstract: Plasma biomarkers of amyloid-associated tau phosphorylation (T1) and established tau proteinopathy (T2) can approximate Alzheimer's disease stage, but whether plasma-defined stages correspond to broader biological states is unknown. In 1,035 participants from a multicentre Korean cohort, we used a 220-plex immunoassay platform to compare T1/T2 biomarkers against amyloid and tau positron emission tomography anchors and construct a five-stage framework. Brain-derived phosphorylated tau 217 and endogenously cleaved microtubule-binding-region tau formed the parsimonious backbone. Baseline stage ordered Clinical Dementia Rating-Sum of Boxes trajectories, and forward within-person stage movement was associated with faster clinical worsening. Among 197 non-tau proteins, 34 were stage-associated; the T1-positive transition showed the broadest proteomic shift, with more selective remodelling later. In serial samples, 15 proteins changed longitudinally, with 13 recapitulating the cross-sectional stage pattern. Thus, plasma-defined disease position mapped onto distinct, partly dynamic biological states beyond the defining T1/T2 biomarkers.

items.title: Germline Variants Absent from Global Reference Databases in Malawian DLBCL Patients: Implications for Variant Interpretation in African Genomic Medicine
items.title_zh: 马拉维DLBCL患者缺失的生殖系变异及其对解读的影响
items.summary_zh: 背景：非洲人群在全球基因组参考数据库中代表性不足，给临床和研究中的生殖系变异解读带来挑战。我们评估了马拉维弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）患者中缺失于常用全球参考数据库的生殖系变异。方法：分析了来自利隆圭卡穆祖中央医院的55例组织学确诊DLBCL病例的全外显子组测序数据。使用GATK HaplotypeCaller调用生殖系变异，并用Ensembl VEP v110进行注释。将队列等位基因频率与gnomAD v3.1.2、ExAC v1.0和1000基因组项目第3阶段进行比较。缺失于所有三个数据库的变异被称为数据库缺失变异（DAVs）。结果：我们在55个样本中识别出127,456个通过PASS过滤的生殖系变异，其中332个变异（0.26%）缺失于gnomAD、ExAC和1000基因组，分布于289个基因中（中位数，每个基因一个变异；范围，1-8）。
items.abstract: Background: African populations remain underrepresented in global genomic reference databases, complicating germline variant interpretation in clinical and research settings. This concern is particularly relevant in Malawi, where population-matched allele-frequency resources are limited. We assessed germline variants in Malawian patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) that were absent from commonly used global reference databases. Methods: Whole-exome sequencing data from 55 histologically confirmed DLBCL cases recruited at Kamuzu Central Hospital, Lilongwe, were analyzed. Germline variants were called using GATK HaplotypeCaller and annotated with Ensembl VEP v110. Cohort allele frequencies were compared with gnomAD v3.1.2, ExAC v1.0, and the 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 using African (AFR) and European (EUR) reference subsets. Variants absent from all three databases were designated database-absent variants (DAVs); this designation indicates absence from the queried reference panels and does not establish population restriction. items.title: Vascular geometry and network topology reveal vascular remodelling beyond density measures across Chew grades in macular telangiectasia type 2
items.title_zh: 血管几何与网络拓扑揭示黄斑扩张症2型的血管重塑
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：以往的OCTA研究主要集中在黄斑扩张症不同严重程度下的灌注和密度变化。图形派生的网络结构是否提供了补充的严重程度信息尚不明确。因此，我们测试了较低的Chew等级是否已显示出结构异常，尽管整体血管密度相对保存。对象/方法：本横断面研究包括62例黄斑扩张症患者和64例健康对照眼。使用DREAM平台获取的以中心凹为中心的3x3毫米高分辨率扫频光学相干断层成像（OCTA）数据通过OCTAVA进行分析。采用混合效应模型评估整体图像血管长度密度（VLD）、区域血管面积密度（VAD）、周围FAZ灌注、中心凹无血管区（FAZ）几何和网络拓扑，调整了年龄、性别和轴长。结果：0-2级的FAZ非圆形度已显著高于对照组（SCP; +0.132; q<0.001；DCP; +0.073; q=0.034），且SCP分支点密度较低（q=0.022）。随着黄斑扩张症等级的增加，DCP VLD每级下降0.352 mm-1（95% CI -0.583至-0.121；Holm P=0.007），而SCP斜率无显著性（Holm P=0.071；丛集交互作用P=0.160）。DCP中心凹周围VAD每级下降0.593个百分点（95% CI，-0.943至-0.242；q=0.007），而中心凹VAD未见相应下降。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Previous OCTA studies across MacTel severity levels have primarily characterised perfusion- and density-based vascular changes. Whether graph-derived network architecture provides complementary information on severity remains unclear. We therefore tested whether lower Chew grades already show architectural abnormalities despite comparatively preserved global vessel density. Subjects/Methods: This cross-sectional study included 62 MacTel and 64 healthy control eyes. Fovea-centred 3x3-mm high-resolution swept-source OCTA acquired with the DREAM platform was analysed with OCTAVA. Whole-image vessel length density (VLD), regional vessel area density (VAD), peri-FAZ perfusion, foveal avascular zone (FAZ) geometry and network topology were assessed using mixed-effects models adjusted for age, sex and axial length. Results: Grades 0-2 already showed greater FAZ acircularity than controls in the superficial (SCP; +0.132; q<0.001) and deep capillary plexus (DCP; +0.073; q=0.034), with lower SCP branchpoint density (q=0.022). items.title: Juvenile and adult open-angle glaucoma form a single polygenic continuum
items.title_zh: 青少年与成人开角型青光眼为单一多基因连续体
items.summary_zh: 目的：测试青少年开角型青光眼（JOAG）和原发性先天性青光眼（PCG）是否与原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）在多基因上连续。设计：回顾性队列研究。参与者：3,102例开角型青光眼病例，其中2,836例有诊断年龄记录（52例PCG，226例JOAG，2,558例POAG）及999例欧洲血统对照。两个重复队列包括70例JOAG和31例PCG病例及230例对照（马萨诸塞眼耳医院），以及9例PCG和120例POAG病例（青光眼遗传研究）。方法：每个家庭分析一例病例。根据加权SNP计算多基因风险评分（PRS），并调整血统。病例按诊断年龄（PCG=4岁和=40岁）及致病/可能致病变异的存在进行分层。主要结果指标：比较不同青光眼亚型及孟德尔与非孟德尔亚组的PRS百分位值。结果：在第四个十年诊断的病例中，平均PRS最高。在亚组中，非孟德尔JOAG的PRS最高（84.1%），超过对照（53.3%）、孟德尔JOAG（68.9%）和非孟德尔POAG（79.3%）（均P <= 0.003）。
items.abstract: Purpose: To test whether juvenile open-angle glaucoma (JOAG) and primary congenital glaucoma (PCG) are polygenically continuous with primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG), using a multi-trait POAG polygenic risk score (PRS). Design: Retrospective cohort study. Participants: 3,102 open-angle glaucoma index cases, of whom 2,836 had a recorded age at diagnosis (52 PCG, 226 JOAG, and 2,558 POAG) and 999 European-ancestry controls from a glaucoma disease registry and a population-based cohort. Two replication cohorts comprised 70 JOAG and 31 PCG probands with 230 controls (Mass Eye and Ear, MEE), and 9 PCG and 120 POAG cases (Genetics of Glaucoma Study, GOGS). Methods: One index case per family was analysed. PRS were calculated from weighted SNPs and adjusted for ancestry. Cases were stratified by age at diagnosis (PCG =4 and =40 years) and presence of pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants ("Mendelian"). Groups were compared by Kruskal-Wallis test, with logistic regression and area under the curve for per-SD effects. items.title: The information in diagnostic tests
items.title_zh: 诊断测试中的信息量分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了诊断测试所能解决的不确定性，使用敏感性、特异性及起始疾病概率进行测量。通过实例展示了起始概率如何影响预期学习，类似准确度的测试为何能提供不同的信息，以及这种预期与单个结果所提供的证据之间的差异。我们分析了来自210个评审的273个汇总诊断特征，将这一已建立的测量方法置于经验参考尺度上，以便于解读和报告不同测试和阈值的诊断信息。结果显示，在标准化的20%起始概率下，中位特征能够解决29.2%的起始不确定性。
items.abstract: Diagnostic information measures how much uncertainty a test is expected to resolve before its result is known, using sensitivity, specificity, and a stated starting disease probability; worked examples show how starting probability changes expected learning, why tests with similar conventional accuracy can provide different information, and how that expectation differs from the evidence supplied by an individual result; across 273 pooled diagnostic profiles from 210 reviews, we place this established measure on an empirical reference scale for interpreting and reporting diagnostic information across tests and thresholds, with the median profile resolving 29.2% of starting uncertainty at a standardised 20% starting probability.
items.authors: He, S.; Locke, B. W.; Joseph, J. W.; Liebovitz, D. M.; Rohlfsen, C.; Goff, A.; Safari, P.; Kabrhel, C.; Mohamed, A.; Raja, A. S.; Goldstein, J. N.

items.title: Impact of HPV vaccination in Spain: Reductions in vaccine-type genotypes, cytological abnormalities, and the influence of epidemiological factors
items.title_zh: 西班牙HPV疫苗接种影响：疫苗型基因型和细胞学异常的减少
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了西班牙HPV疫苗的影响，特别是在接种与未接种女性中的HPV和细胞学结果。研究对象为2024年4月至2026年1月期间参与西班牙三地区宫颈癌筛查的908名女性（58%接种）。收集了宫颈样本及流行病学和疫苗接种数据。结果显示，HPV阳性率为37%（337/908），高风险HPV为24%（221/908）。未接种女性中高等级细胞病变发生率更高（2.4% vs 0.38%，p=0.011），且HPV 16/18（5.5% vs 0.76%；aOR: 4.9；95% CI: 1.4-17）和HPV31（3.4% vs 1.3%；aOR: 2.7；95% CI: 1.0-6.9）的感染率也较高。接种女性中HPV51和HPV70的发生率较高，但与接种无关，HPV51与性伴侣数量（aOR: 2.6；95% CI: 1.2-5.6）相关，HPV70与吸烟（aOR: 0.36；95% CI: 0.13-0.99）相关。接种女性中HPV 16/18、HPV31及高等级病变的低检测率支持疫苗的有效性和交叉保护，强调了对HPV基因型及流行病学和性行为因素的持续监测的重要性。
items.abstract: Data evaluating human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine impact in Spain remain limited. We aimed to assess HPV and cytology findings among vaccinated and unvaccinated women as an early indicator of its effectiveness. During April 2024-January 2026, a total of 908 women participating in a population-based cervical cancer screening in three regions of Spain were recruited (58% vaccinated). Cervical samples and epidemiological and vaccination data were obtained. HPV was detected in 37% (337/908) and high-risk HPV in 24% (221/908). High-grade cytological lesions (1.2%, 11/907) were more frequent in unvaccinated women (2.4% vs 0.38%, p=0.011) and showed higher prevalence of HPV 16/18 (5.5% vs 0.76%; aOR: 4.9; 95% CI: 1.4-17) and HPV31 (3.4% vs 1.3%; aOR: 2.7; 95% CI: 1.0-6.9) compared with vaccinated women. HPV51 and HPV70 were more frequent among vaccinated women; however, both were associated with factors unrelated to vaccination. HPV51 was linked to a higher number of sexual partners (aOR: 2.6; 95% CI: 1.2-5.6), while HPV70 to smoking (aOR: 0.36; 95% CI: 0.13-0.99). items.title: Favourable discharge after cardiac arrest across APACHE IVa-predicted hospital mortality: a multicentre observational study
items.title_zh: 心脏骤停患者的有利出院与APACHE IVa预测住院死亡率的关系
items.summary_zh: 目的：一般ICU严重性评分预测异质人群的住院死亡率，而非特定诊断下的恢复情况。本研究描述了心脏骤停后在APACHE IVa预测的住院死亡率范围内的有利出院情况，并检验是否有任何床边亚组低于预设基准。方法：观察性队列研究，包含3,641例在161家eICU医院首次入院的心脏骤停患者。暴露因素为APACHE IVa预测的住院死亡率，结果为有利出院（回家或康复）。预设了14个床边亚组，基准要求95%上限低于5%。结果：有利出院发生在1,039例（28.5%），从最低预测死亡率十分位的78.9%降至最高的4.1%。在预测死亡率≥50%的2,139例患者中，301例（14.1%）有利出院；在≥90%的281例中，9例（3.2%）有利出院。无亚组的95%上限低于5%；最低为264例中的8例（3.0%）。在更宽松的10%基准下，有两个亚组符合条件。在1,961例未能遵从指令的患者中，263例（13.4%）有利出院。功能结果与住院死亡的区分能力未显著不同。
items.abstract: Aim: General ICU severity scores predict hospital mortality across heterogeneous populations, not recovery within one diagnosis. We described favourable discharge across the range of APACHE IVa-predicted hospital mortality after cardiac arrest, and tested whether any bedside subgroup fell below a pre-specified benchmark. Methods: Observational cohort of 3,641 first ICU admissions in 161 eICU hospitals with a cardiac-arrest diagnosis documented within 24 hours. The exposure was APACHE IVa-predicted hospital mortality; the outcome was favourable discharge (home or rehabilitation), a functional-outcome proxy. Fourteen bedside subgroups were pre-specified; the benchmark required an upper 95% bound below 5%. Results: Favourable discharge occurred in 1,039 (28.5%), falling from 78.9% in the lowest predicted-mortality decile to 4.1% in the highest (trend z, -27.2; P < 0.001). Among 2,139 patients with predicted mortality at or above 50%, 301 (14.1%; 95% CI, 12.6 to 15.6) had a favourable discharge; among 281 at or above 90%, 9 (3.2%) did. items.title: Mechanistic Assessment of Norepinephrine Therapy versus Angiotensin-II in Septic Shock (MANTRA): Study Protocol for a multicenter randomized trial
items.title_zh: 去甲肾上腺素与血管紧张素-II在脓毒性休克中的机制评估研究方案
items.summary_zh: 背景：去甲肾上腺素是脓毒性休克的一线血管收缩药，但高剂量使用可能导致不良的心血管、肾脏和免疫效应。血管紧张素-II（Ang-II）是一种非儿茶酚胺类的血管收缩药，已获批用于提高血管舒张性休克患者的血压。脓毒性休克中常见的RAAS失调可能是可治疗的特征，但关于早期使用Ang-II对RAAS生物学、宿主反应或临床结果的影响的前瞻性研究较少。因此，我们设计了一项机制性临床试验，假设早期Ang-II治疗能够正常化系统性RAAS异常并调节先天免疫反应。方法：MANTRA试验是一项由研究者发起的前瞻性、多中心、开放标签、随机机制性临床试验。符合Sepsis-3标准的脓毒性休克成人患者，将接受去甲肾上腺素等效剂量（NED）0.10-0.50 mcg/kg/min，随机分为1:1接受Ang-II（最大40 ng/kg/min）或去甲肾上腺素（最大35 mcg/min）治疗，持续48小时。主要结果为基线时两组间血浆肾素轨迹的差异。
items.abstract: Introduction Norepinephrine remains first-line vasopressor therapy for septic shock despite its association at high doses with undesirable cardiovascular, kidney, and immune effects. Angiotensin-II (Ang-II) is a non-catecholamine vasopressor of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) now approved to increase blood pressure in vasodilatory shock. RAAS dysregulation is common in septic shock and may represent a treatable trait. However, few prospective investigations evaluate the effect of early Ang-II use in septic shock on dysfunctional RAAS biology, host-response, or clinical outcomes. Therefore, we designed a mechanistic clinical trial to test the hypothesis that early Ang-II therapy in septic shock normalizes systemic RAAS abnormalities and modulates innate immune responses. Methods and Analysis The Mechanistic Assessment of Norepinephrine TheRapy vs. Angiotensin-II in Septic Shock (MANTRA) trial is an investigator-initiated, prospective, multicenter, open-label, randomized mechanistic clinical trial. items.title: Access Consequences of Restricting Mohs Micrographic Surgery to Fellowship-Trained Surgeons: A National Workforce, Board-Certification, and Drive-Time Simulation Study
items.title_zh: 限制Mohs显微外科仅限于专科医生的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：限制Mohs显微外科（MMS）仅由专科培训（FT）外科医生执行的政策，可能会排除住院医生/实践培训（R/P培训）外科医生。目的：量化限制MMS仅由FT外科医生执行的劳动力、认证、地理和患者获取后果。方法：对所有Medicare MMS账单（2020-2024；n=3,451）进行横断面分析，依据ACMS目录链接将外科医生分类为FT与R/P培训；链接美国皮肤病学委员会微显微外科（MDS）认证记录；县/市场获取类别；模拟R/P培训外科医生排除对CMS网络适宜性标准的影响；乡村替代模型。结果：2024年，R/P培训外科医生占劳动力的45.3%，55.6%持有MDS认证，提供52.1%的非城市MMS量。在223个县（2340万居民）中，他们是唯一的Mohs外科医生。模拟排除使1560万人超出60分钟车程，2310万人不符合CMS皮肤科时间和距离标准，且主要影响农村地区（3.2倍）。
items.abstract: Background: Policies restricting Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS) to only fellowship-trained (FT) surgeons -- through privileging standards, laboratory-director qualifications, or payer credentialing -- would bar residency/practice-trained (R/P-trained) surgeons from MMS. The access consequences have not been quantified. Objective: To quantify the workforce, board-certification, geographic, and patient-access consequences of restricting MMS to only fellowship-trained surgeons. Methods: Cross-sectional analysis of all Medicare MMS billers (2020-2024; n=3,451), classified FT versus R/P-trained by complete ACMS directory linkage (the definition of prior national analyses; audited); linkage to American Board of Dermatology Micrographic Dermatologic Surgery (MDS) certification records; county/market access classes; road-network drive-time simulation of R/P-trained exclusion against CMS network-adequacy standards; fellowship-pipeline replacement modeling. Results: R/P-trained surgeons were 45.3% of the 2024 workforce, 55.6% held MDS certification, and they supplied 52.1% of nonmetropolitan MMS volume. In 223 counties (23.4 million residents) they were the only Mohs surgeons. Simulated exc

items.title: Pathway-specific polygenic risk scores reveal underlying mechanisms of cerebral small vessel disease
items.title_zh: 通路特异性多基因风险评分揭示脑小血管病机制
items.summary_zh: 白质高信号（WMH）是脑小血管病（cSVD）的关键MRI标志，常见于老年人，并与中风和痴呆风险增加相关。最新的WMH全基因组关联研究（GWAS）识别了27个基因位点，涉及细胞外基质、髓鞘形成和膜转运等富集基因。基因预测的WMH与年轻成人的白质微结构变化相关，并对中风和痴呆具有因果效应。然而，WMH的生物通路及其对临床结果的贡献尚不清楚，且缺乏经过验证的WMH多基因风险评分（PRS）。本研究应用全球和通路特异性PRS（ps-PRS）生成稳健的WMH-PRS，并识别影响WMH的生物通路。我们利用最大的欧洲血统WMH-GWAS（N=46,944）和15,320名UK生物库参与者的MRI数据（平均年龄67岁）优化WMH全球PRS，并基于分子特征数据库构建3,794个ps-PRS。最佳WMH全球PRS在UKB-MRI中的预测效果显著，能够在独立队列中预测WMH。
items.abstract: White matter hyperintensities (WMH), a key MRI-marker of cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD), are common in older adults and associated with an increased risk of stroke and dementia. The latest WMH genome-wide association study (GWAS) identified 27 loci involving genes enriched for extracellular matrix, myelination, and membrane transport. Genetically predicted WMH correlates with white matter microstructural alterations in young adults and shows causal effects on stroke and dementia. However, biological pathways underlying WMH and their contribution to clinical outcomes remain unclear, and validated polygenic risk scores (PRS) for WMH are lacking. We applied global and pathway-specific PRS (ps-PRS) to generate robust WMH-PRS and identify biological pathways contributing to WMH across the lifespan. We leveraged the largest European-ancestry WMH-GWAS (N=46,944) and data from 15,320 UK Biobank participants with MRI (UKB-MRI) (mean age=67 (7.7) years) to optimize a WMH global-PRS and construct 3,794 ps-PRS based on canonical pathways from the Molecular Signatures Database (v2023.2). items.title: Ischemic Stroke Detection, Segmentation, and Volume Estimation using Multi-sequence MRI Data with Missing Sequences
items.title_zh: 缺失序列多序列MRI数据的缺血性中风检测与体积估计
items.summary_zh: 缺血性中风是全球致残和死亡的主要原因之一，及时准确的诊断对治疗和改善患者预后至关重要。由于训练有素的临床医生和放射科医师短缺，神经影像学的快速可靠解读受到限制。人工智能（AI）为此挑战提供了有效的解决方案。本文提出了一种集成中风诊断系统（ISDS-MRI），利用图神经网络和序列特征建模进行全面的缺血性中风分析。该框架能够从多序列MRI数据中检测缺血性中风、分割病灶并估计病灶体积，同时适应不完整的MRI序列组合。我们在多个公开MRI数据集上评估了该方法，并引入了新整理的数据集BGD-MRIS，包含来自孟加拉国三家医院的532个MRI扫描。实验结果表明，ISDS-MRI的Dice分数达到0.725。
items.abstract: Stroke remains one of the leading causes of disability and mortality worldwide, where timely and accurate diagnosis is critical for guiding treatment and improving patient outcomes. However, a global shortage of trained clinicians and radiologists continues to limit rapid and reliable interpretation of neuroimaging, particularly in resource-constrained settings. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising solution to this challenge by enabling efficient analysis of medical images. Here we present an Integrated Stroke Diagnosis System for MRI (ISDS-MRI), a unified framework that leverages graph neural networks and sequence-specific feature modeling for comprehensive ischemic stroke analysis. This framework is designed to detect ischemic stroke, segment lesions, and estimate lesion volume from multi-sequence MRI data, while accommodating incomplete combinations of MRI sequences. To ensure generalizability, we evaluate our approach across multiple publicly available MRI datasets and introduce a newly curated dataset, BGD-MRIS, comprising 532 MRI scans from three hospitals in Bangladesh. items.title: Glycovariants of CA-125 in the early detection of ovarian cancer
items.title_zh: CA-125糖异构体在卵巢癌早期检测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 重要性：两项随机试验表明，CA-125筛查对降低卵巢癌死亡率无效，原因是CA-125的变化发生得太晚，无法实现早期疾病的外科治愈。目的：确定CA-125糖异构体是否能在临床诊断前数年检测卵巢癌。设计：对冷冻血样和来自马尔默饮食与癌症队列的人群数据进行病例对照研究。参与者：1991至1996年收集的17,297名年龄在44至73岁女性的血清，以及2007至2012年重新采样的2,168名女性。通过瑞典癌症登记处识别出82名在血样采集后10年内确诊的卵巢癌患者。结果：CA-125-STn与后续卵巢癌相关（p=0.002）。在限制为5年内病例的主要分析中，CA-125-STn的曲线下面积为0.68。
items.abstract: Importance Two randomized trials have shown that screening with CA-125 is not of value for reducing ovarian cancer mortality. This appears to be because changes in CA-125 occur too late in the disease process to allow for surgical cure of early-stage disease. Objective To determine whether glycovariants of CA-125 could detect ovarian cancer years before clinical diagnosis. Design Case-control study of cryopreserved blood samples and data from the population-based Malmo Diet and Cancer cohort. Setting Population-based study in Sweden. Participants Serum was available for 17,297 women aged 44 to 73 collected at baseline in 1991to1996 and from 2,168 women re-sampled in 2007 to 2012. Participants' records were linked to the Swedish cancer registry to identify 82 women with incident ovarian cancer diagnosed up to 10 years after blood draw. Cases were matched 1:3 with controls by age and venipuncture date. Exposure Serum was measured for CA-125 glycovariants Sialyl-Thomsen-nouveau (STn) and Macrophage-Galactose-Lectin (MGL) using GLYVAR Ovarian I and II assays (Uniogen), conventional CA-125 (CanAg CA125 EIA, Fujirebio) and HE4 EIA (Fujirebio). Main outcome measure Ovarian cancer. Results
