items.title: Toward Population-Level Brain AVM Screening: Construction and Evaluation of a Two-Step Genetic Risk Model Incorporating Rare Mendelian Variants and a Novel Polygenic Risk Score
items.title_zh: 针对人群级脑动静脉畸形筛查的遗传风险模型构建与评估
items.summary_zh: 脑动静脉畸形（bAVM）在0.01%的人群中存在，破裂时会导致严重的神经后果。本研究构建并评估了一种新颖的两步遗传风险分层模型，考虑了稀有的孟德尔变异和常见的遗传变异，以识别高遗传风险患者并进行筛查MRI。研究对象为参与宾夕法尼亚医学生物库（PMBB）的个体，包含外显子测序和基因分型数据。参与者分为“孟德尔队列”和“非孟德尔队列”。孟德尔队列包括在已知孟德尔AVM相关基因中具有致病或高概率功能丧失变异的个体，其余为非孟德尔队列。通过电子健康记录（EHR）审核确定bAVM病例，MRI、CTA或血管造影确认的为bAVM病例，影像学阴性及缺乏ICD-10 Q28.2代码的为对照组。
items.abstract: Introduction Brain arteriovenous malformation (bAVM) is present in 0.01% of the population and has devastating neurologic consequences when ruptured. This study reports and evaluates a novel two-step genetic risk stratification model for bAVM, taking into account both rare Mendelian and common genetic variants, to identify patients with high genetic risk who can then receive screening MRI. Methods Participants in the Penn Medicine Biobank (PMBB) with both exome sequencing and imputed (TOPMED) genotyping array data were included in this study. Participants were stratified into a "Mendelian cohort" and a "non-Mendelian cohort." Participants with a pathogenic or high probability loss-of-function variant in any known Mendelian AVM-related gene formed the Mendelian cohort, while the remainder formed the non-Mendelian cohort. To define bAVM cases, chart review was performed for all participants in the Mendelian group and for all other participants with at least one occurrence of the International Classification of Diseases (ICD)-10 code Q28.2 ("Arteriovenous malformation of cerebral vessels") in their EHR. items.title: Evaluating the impact of a policy restricting reimbursement of lidocaine plaster prescribing on opioid and other analgesic prescribing
items.title_zh: 评估限制利多卡因贴剂报销政策对镇痛药处方的影响
items.summary_zh: 背景：在爱尔兰引入利多卡因贴剂的报销限制可能对其他有滥用潜力的镇痛药处方产生了意想不到的影响。本研究评估了该政策对阿片类药物、加巴喷丁类药物及其他镇痛药的使用、治疗强化和启动的影响。方法：本队列研究包括符合爱尔兰公共医疗覆盖的成年人（约占总人口的33%），使用初级医疗处方数据。该政策于2017年12月全面实施，要求对利多卡因贴剂的报销进行个体患者审批。在中断时间序列分析中，我们考察了其他镇痛药处方的水平和趋势变化。在队列分析中，我们比较了政策前利多卡因使用者与其他镇痛药使用者，并评估了政策后3个月内阿片类药物、加巴喷丁类药物及其他镇痛药的治疗强化和启动结果。结果：在165万人中，政策前每月有最多1.4%的人获得利多卡因贴剂。其他镇痛药的总体使用基本保持不变（局部药物除外）。与其他镇痛药使用者相比，利多卡因贴剂使用者在政策后经历阿片类药物治疗强化的可能性显著增加（调整风险比1.47，95%CI 1.38-1.57）。
items.abstract: Background Introducing a reimbursement restriction on lidocaine plaster prescribing in Ireland may have had unintended effects on prescribing of other analgesics with misuse potential. This study evaluates the impact of this policy on use, treatment intensification and initiation of opioids, gabapentinoids, and other analgesics. Methods This cohort study included adults eligible for Ireland's public health cover (approximately 33% of the population), using primary care dispensing data. The policy was fully implemented in December 2017, requiring individual patient approval for coverage of lidocaine plasters. In interrupted time series analysis, we examined change in level and trend of prescribing of other analgesics. In cohort analysis we compared lidocaine users to users of any other analgesic pre-policy and assessed outcomes of treatment intensification and initiation of opioids, gabapentinoids, and other analgesics in the three months post-policy. Results Among 1.65 million individuals, up to 1.4% were dispensed lidocaine plasters monthly pre-policy. items.title: Profile of the digestive and absorptive functions in the intestine of fish with different dietary habits and in response to increased dietary carbohydrate or protein.
items.title_zh: 不同饮食习惯鱼类肠道消化吸收功能特征研究
items.summary_zh: 全球水产养殖显著增长，但未来20年需将供应量翻倍以维持消费水平。本研究对三种重要养殖鱼类（尼罗罗非鱼、鲤鱼和虹鳟鱼）的肠道消化和吸收能力进行了表征。结果显示，尼罗罗非鱼的双糖酶活性（麦芽糖酶、蔗糖酶）和钠依赖性D-葡萄糖吸收能力最高，其次是鲤鱼，虹鳟鱼最低。三种鱼类在肠道不同区域的双糖酶活性和SGLT1表达存在差异。氨肽酶A（APA）和氨肽酶N（APN）活性在尼罗罗非鱼中通常最高。尼罗罗非鱼和鲤鱼的中性氨基酸转运蛋白B0AT1的肠道表达约为虹鳟鱼的两倍。此外，鲤鱼和斑马鱼在高碳水化合物饮食中通过上调消化酶和SGLT1适应，而虹鳟鱼则在高碳水化合物饮食中增加了双糖酶活性，但未增加SGLT1表达。
items.abstract: Global aquaculture has grown significantly, but to maintain current consumption, supply must double over the next 20 years. Here, we characterised the digestive and absorptive capacities in the intestines of three commercially important, farmed fish species with varying natural diets: Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), common carp (Cyprinus carpio ), and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss). Disaccharidase activity (maltase, sucrase) and sodium-dependent D-glucose absorption were highest in Nile tilapia, followed by common carp, and lowest in rainbow trout. We found regional intestinal differences in disaccharidase activity and SGLT1 expression in the three species. Aminopeptidase A (APA) and aminopeptidase N (APN) activities were typically highest in Nile tilapia. Intestinal expression of the neutral amino acid transporter B0AT1 was approx. double in tilapia and carp compared to trout. We also assessed common carp, zebrafish and Rainbow trout's digestion profile when fed low-carbohydrate/high protein and high-carbohydrate/low-protein diets. Common carp and zebrafish adapted to high-carbohydrate diets by up-regulating both digestive enzymes and SGLT1. Common carp increased SGLT1
items.authors: Moran, A. W.; Al-rammahi, M.; Bristow, R. L.; Magee, K.; Shirazi-Beechey, S. P.

items.title: A single-cell view of human tissue aging reveals architectural decline beyond cellular composition
items.title_zh: 单细胞视角下的人体组织衰老揭示超越细胞组成的结构性衰退
items.summary_zh: 衰老在细胞层面重塑人体，但细胞身份、形态及空间组织如何在不同器官和成人生命周期中变化尚不明确。我们将GTEx组织病理档案视为一个涵盖人群规模和生命周期的空间生物学资源，检测到近千名个体的16个人体器官中超过35亿个单细胞。细胞密度普遍下降，但具有器官特异性。视觉-语言表型分析将上皮细胞分为九个亚型，显示出不同的衰老轨迹，包括卵巢颗粒细胞在每十年约减少45%。空间细胞图上的社区检测识别出功能性组织单元，其中超过四分之一随着年龄沿着共享轨迹重塑，从密集的专门单元转向稀疏的基质和免疫富集结构。重要的是，这种结构重塑与细胞组成大体解耦，显示人类组织沿着两个部分独立的轴线衰老：细胞的普遍丧失和它们形成的结构的显著重塑，结构性衰退超出了细胞组成的预测。
items.abstract: Aging reshapes the human body at the cellular level, yet how cell identity, morphology, and spatial organization remodel across organs and the adult lifespan remains poorly mapped, at a scale and lifespan coverage that molecular spatial assays cannot yet reach. Treating the GTEx histopathology archive as a population-scale, lifespan-resolved resource for spatial biology, we detected over 3.5 billion single cells across 16 human organs from nearly one thousand individuals. Cell density declined pervasively but organ-specifically, and vision-language phenotyping resolved epithelial cells into nine subtypes with divergent aging trajectories, including loss of ovarian granulosa cells at ~45% per decade. Community detection on spatial cell graphs identified functional tissue units, over a quarter of which remodeled with age along a shared trajectory from dense, specialized units toward sparser, stromal- and immune-enriched structures. Critically, this architectural remodeling was largely decoupled from cell composition (R2=0.07), showing that human tissues age along two partly independent axes, a pervasive loss of cells and a distinct remodeling of the architecture they form, with struc
items.authors: Abila, E.; Zheng, Y.; Bago-Horvath, Z.; Rendeiro, A. F.

items.title: Genomic evidence for Z-W differentiation in Pacific saury (Cololabis saira) and sex-chromosome diversity in Beloniformes
items.title_zh: 太平洋秋刀鱼性别决定机制及其性染色体多样性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究确认了太平洋秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）的性别决定系统，采用双消化限制位点关联DNA测序（ddRAD-seq）和全基因组池测序（Pool-seq）。DNA序列分析发现多种标记主要或仅在表型雌性中出现，表明存在ZZ/ZW性别决定系统。ddRAD-seq位点的定位显示这些标记集中在17号染色体（Chr17）的3-19 Mb区域内。Pool-seq分析也揭示了该区域内的FST升高、性别特异的测序深度差异和核苷酸多样性，进一步支持了涉及Chr17的ZZ/ZW性别决定系统。开发的女性特异性PCR标记FS1在2025年收集的43个表型雌性中均被检测到，而在50个表型雄性中未发现。在2026年独立样本中，FS1在19个表型雌性和29个表型雄性中检测到1个阳性雄性，表明与表型性别的符合率为97.9%。该FS1阳性雄性可能代表基因型与表型的性别不匹配或反映了FS1与其他基因的重组。
items.abstract: Genetic sex-determination mechanisms evolve rapidly in teleost fishes and are diverse within Beloniformes. In the present study, the sex-determination system of Pacific saury (Cololabis saira) was confirmed using double-digest, restriction-site-associated DNA sequencing (ddRAD-seq) and pooled whole-genome sequencing (Pool-seq), and a DNA marker was developed for inferring genetic sex. DNA sequence analysis detected numerous markers occurring predominantly or exclusively in phenotypic females suggesting a ZZ/ZW sex-determination system. Mapping of ddRAD-seq loci showed that these markers were concentrated within a 3-19 Mb region of chromosome 17 (Chr17). Pool-seq analyses also revealed elevated FST, sex-specific differences in sequencing depth, and nucleotide diversity within this region, supporting a ZZ/ZW sex-determination system involving Chr17. A PCR marker designated female-specific 1 (FS1), developed from a female-associated ddRAD sequence unmapped from the male-derived reference genome, was detected in all 43 phenotypic females and none of the 50 phenotypic males collected in 2025. items.title: Molecular characterization of required for killing-2: a gene required for spore killing by Neurospora Sk-3.
items.title_zh: 神经孢子Sk-3中必需杀菌基因rfk-2的分子特征
items.summary_zh: 神经孢子真菌中的Sk-3自私遗传因子通过孢子杀灭以偏向的方式传递给后代。在Sk-3菌株与孢子杀敏感（Sk-S）菌株的交配中，几乎所有未继承Sk-3的后代都会被杀死。我们发现，导致Sk-3杀菌功能失效的突变rfk-2UV是位于rfk-2基因内的T>G转变突变。rfk-2基因位于第三染色体上，编码的转录本经历了RNA剪接和至少两次RNA编辑事件，其中一次将UAG终止密码子转变为UGG色氨酸密码子，从而产生一个102个氨基酸的蛋白质。我们的研究表明，rfk-2对孢子杀灭是必需的，但不足以单独完成该过程，表明Sk-3的机制比之前预想的更为复杂。
items.abstract: The Sk-3 selfish genetic element in Neurospora fungi is transmitted to offspring in a biased manner through spore killing. In crosses between an Sk-3 strain and a Spore killing-sensitive (Sk-S) strain, nearly all offspring that fail to inherit Sk-3 are killed. Although a mutation called rfk-2UV, which disrupts spore killing by Sk-3, was isolated in an earlier work, its precise location within the Sk-3 element was not identified. Here, we demonstrate that rfk-2UV is a T>G transversion mutation within a protein coding gene called rfk-2. The rfk-2 gene is located on Chromosome III, and it encodes a transcript that undergoes RNA splicing and at least two RNA editing events. One of these editing events changes a UAG stop codon to a UGG tryptophan codon and allows for production of a 102 amino acid protein. Additionally, while our results demonstrate that rfk-2 is required for spore killing, they also show that it is insufficient for the process. Sk-3 is thus more complex than previously anticipated. Rather than using a single gene to produce its killer, Sk-3 requires multiple genes to kill spores and break the rules of Mendelian Inheritance.
items.authors: Sultana, S.; Mahmud, S.; Jazireian, P.; Lohmar, J.; Brown, D.; Hammond, T. M.; Rhoades, N.

items.title: Demography and selection shape gene loss in freshwater sticklebacks - A pangenomic perspective
items.title_zh: 淡水刺鳚基因丢失的种群与选择影响 - 泛基因组视角
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了淡水刺鳚（Pungitius pungitius）基因组组装大小的种内变异及其中中性与适应性过程的相对贡献。我们基于对1,478个个体的全基因组重测序数据，组装了九刺鳚的泛基因组，涵盖47个种群。分析结果显示，发现约234.15 Mb的新序列，并在非参考区域鉴定出11,151个蛋白编码基因，占所有注释泛基因组基因的28.8%，相较于更新的v8参考基因组的27,450个蛋白编码基因扩展了40.6%。有效种群规模较小的淡水种群丢失了更多基因，组装大小也较大海洋种群小。海洋种群较大的基因组大小主要与转座元件含量较高相关。不同基因类别的分子变异模式表明，淡水种群的净化选择较弱，而淡水偏向的PAV基因丢失则提示基因丢失并非完全随机。
items.abstract: The extent of within-species variation in genome assembly size, and the relative contributions of neutral vs. adaptive processes to it, remains poorly understood. We assembled the pangenome for the nine-spined stickleback (Pungitius pungitius) from whole-genome resequencing data obtained from range-wide sampling of 1,478 individuals across 47 populations. Our analysis recovered approximately 234.15 Mb of novel sequence and identified 11,151 protein-coding genes annotated in non-reference-represented regions, which accounted for 28.8% of all annotated pangenomic genes, corresponding to a 40.6% expansion relative to the 27,450 protein-coding genes annotated in the updated v8 reference genome. The identified presence/absence variation (PAV) genes exhibited a higher incidence of deleterious and non-synonymous mutations than core genes. Freshwater populations with smaller effective population sizes had lost more genes and had smaller assembly sizes relative to larger marine populations. Larger genome sizes of marine populations were primarily associated with higher transposable element content. Across gene categories, patterns of molecular variation were consistent with weaker purifying
items.authors: Wang, H.; Zhang, C.; Wang, D.; Reid, K.; Merila, J.

items.title: Live confocal imagining of cellular touch responses upon local quantifiable mechanical stimulation in plant cells
items.title_zh: 植物细胞在局部机械刺激下的活体共聚焦成像研究
items.summary_zh: 植物细胞在不断变化的环境中生长和分化，能够感知、整合并动态响应各种刺激是其适应和生存的基础。植物细胞面临多种机械刺激，如风、触碰、昆虫接触、病原体侵入及组织生长过程中产生的内在机械应力。尽管植物细胞有承重的细胞壁，但仍能对机械刺激作出反应。本文建立了一种系统，能够施加可量化的局部机械应力，同时利用共聚焦成像高时空分辨率捕捉细胞反应。研究表明，该系统可估算局部施加的压力，并提供触碰时完整活体组织中亚细胞事件的时间和空间细节。我们认为，高时空分辨率下观察这些亚细胞事件并将其动态与机械刺激强度关联，可能揭示其分子机制。
items.abstract: Plant cells grow and differentiate in an ever-changing environment characterized by transient signals and stimuli. The ability of plant cells to perceive, integrate, and dynamically respond to these stimuli underpins a plant adaptation and survival. Among the plethora of complex stimuli plant cells are exposed to, several stimuli have a mechanical component, for example, wind, touch, contact with insects, penetration of pathogens, and even intrinsic mechanical stresses arising during tissue growth. Despite the presence of a load-bearing cell wall that separates cells from the environment and fixes their location within a tissue, plant cells are responsive to mechanical stimuli. However, several questions remain unanswered around how mechanical stimuli are perceived and translated into cellular responses. Here we establish a system enabling application of quantifiable localized mechanical stress while simultaneously capturing cellular responses with high spatio-temporal resolution using confocal imaging. We show that this system enables estimation of locally applied pressure and provides access to the temporal and spatial details of subcellular events in intact living tissues upon t
items.authors: Bellandi, A.; Lionnet, C.; Arico, D.; German, N.; Lenz, M. O.; Kirchhelle, C.; Loisy, I.; Hamant, O.

items.title: Agentic-AI-ready genome-wide poxvirus-host interaction screen refined by a protein language model
items.title_zh: 基于蛋白质语言模型的广泛pox病毒-宿主相互作用筛选
items.summary_zh: 近期的mpox疫情突显了理解pox病毒与人类宿主相互作用的必要性。通过RNA干扰在单细胞水平上系统性筛选参与感染的宿主基因可以发现这些相互作用。然而，非特异性效应和实验噪声掩盖了真实的基因-表型关系，阻碍了治疗相关靶点的发现。我们展示了整合来自蛋白质语言模型的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用信息能够提升天花病毒-宿主相互作用的发现。我们提出了ICARus——一种正无标记读出精炼框架，以实现这一目标。我们的方法增强了具有潜在抗病毒功能的人类基因的识别。我们提供了天花病毒宿主因子的全基因组筛选的原始和精炼读出，作为一个支持AI的社区资源。我们的发现为功能筛选中的稳健命中优先级提供了一种可推广的策略，加速了复杂生物系统中的发现。
items.abstract: Recent mpox outbreaks highlight the necessity to understand the interactions between poxviruses and the human host. These can be discovered systematically through screening for host genes involved in infection at the single-cell level using RNA interference. However, off-target effects and assay noise obscure true gene-phenotype relationships, hampering the discovery of therapeutically relevant targets. Here, we show that integrating protein-protein interaction information derived from a protein language model boosts the discovery of vaccinia virus-host interactions. We propose ICARus - a positive-unlabelled read-out refinement framework to achieve this. Our approach enhances the identification of human genes with potential antiviral function. We provide the raw and refined read-outs of a genome-wide screen for vaccinia virus host factors as an agentic-AI-enabled community resource. Our findings provide a generalisable strategy for robust hit prioritisation in functional screens, accelerating discovery across complex biological systems.
items.authors: Anter, J.; Mercer, J.; Yakimovich, A.

items.title: Decision Analysis Modeling Favors Optimal Influenza Vaccination in Late November or Early December
items.title_zh: 决策分析模型支持11月底或12月初接种流感疫苗
items.summary_zh: 背景：疫苗保护力减弱和流行病时间变化导致在流感传播前接种疫苗与在疾病负担最大时保持保护之间存在权衡。现有指导未量化最佳平衡这一权衡的周数。目的：估算考虑流行病时间和疫苗保护不确定性的最佳流感疫苗接种周。设计：基于模拟的概率决策分析。设置：2010/11至2018/19及2023/24至2025/26季节美国50州及哥伦比亚特区的门诊流感监测。参与者：美国接种1剂流感疫苗的人群。干预措施：在疾病控制与预防中心（MMWR）第36至12周接种疫苗。测量：结合流感样疾病（ILI）综合监测和流感特定数据，考虑流行病时间的不确定性、初始疫苗有效性、减弱和免疫反应滞后。结果：主要模型确定最佳接种时间为第47周，第47-48周的效用相似。我们的流感加权门诊分析（ILI+）选择第48周。与第44周相比，接种时间的选择更为合理。
items.abstract: Background: Waning vaccine protection and variable epidemic timing create a tradeoff between vaccinating before influenza circulation and preserving protection when disease burden is greatest. Existing guidance does not quantify the week that best balances this tradeoff. Objective: To estimate the optimal week for influenza vaccination while accounting for uncertainty in epidemic timing and vaccine protection. Design: Simulation-based probabilistic decision analysis. Setting: United States outpatient influenza surveillance from the 50 states and District of Columbia during the 2010/11 through 2018/19 and 2023/24 through 2025/26 seasons. Participants: People in the United States who would receive 1 influenza vaccine dose. Interventions: Vaccination during Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (MMWR) weeks 36 through 12. Measurements: We combined influenza-like illness (ILI) syndromic surveillance and influenza-specific data with uncertainty in epidemic timing, initial vaccine effectiveness, waning, and immune-response lag. For each candidate week, the model estimated direct protection against outpatient surveillance burden. Results: The primary model identified the optimal time to v
items.authors: Meyer, A. G.; Rosales, B. N.; Yang, S.; Santillana, M.

items.title: The impact of an ageing population on pandemic risk in England
items.title_zh: 老龄化人口对英格兰疫情风险的影响
items.summary_zh: 背景：英格兰人口迅速老龄化，预计到2047年，80岁及以上人群将增加85%。老年人面临更高的严重后果风险，并且在某些呼吸道感染中需要不成比例的早期疫苗供应，尽管他们的社交接触较少。方法：我们使用了一个年龄结构的随机SARS-CoV-2传播模型，该模型已根据英格兰七个NHS地区的实时COVID-19疫情进行校准。在2047年ONS主要人口预测下运行该模型，固定所有非药物干预措施，并根据总体人口增长调整疫苗供应。结果：在中央反事实情景下，疫情前两年累计住院人数为674,004，比历史基线增加40.3%，医院死亡人数增加49.4%，与总人口13.9%的增长不成比例。
items.abstract: Background England's population is ageing rapidly, with those aged 80 years and older projected to increase 85% by 2047. Aging populations may change the dynamics of future pandemics, since older individuals face higher risks of severe outcomes and require a disproportionate share of early vaccine supply, for certain respiratory infections, despite having fewer social contacts. The net pandemic-risk implications of these competing effects cannot be resolved without dynamic transmission modelling. Methods We used an age-structured stochastic SARS-CoV-2 transmission model, previously calibrated to the real-time COVID-19 epidemic across seven NHS regions of England. Running the fitted model under the ONS principal population projection for 2047 as a counterfactual, we held all non-pharmaceutical interventions fixed and scaled vaccine supply to overall population growth. Nine counterfactual scenarios spanned three vaccine deployment strategies and three ONS migration assumptions. Findings The basic reproduction number remained largely unchanged by the projected age distribution. items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Efficacy of Partnered Rhythmic Rehabilitation in Prodromal Alzheimer's Disease: A 12-Month Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
items.title_zh: 伴侣节奏康复在前驱阿尔茨海默病中的可行性与安全性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：非药物干预可能增强前驱阿尔茨海默病（pAD）患者的运动-认知整合。伴侣节奏康复（PRR）是一种基于舞蹈的适应性干预，旨在促进运动、认知和社交领域的参与。本研究评估了PRR与团体步行（WALK）在pAD和健忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）成人中的可行性、安全性和初步疗效。方法：在这项单盲随机对照试验中（NCT04029623），68名pAD和aMCI成人被随机分配到PRR或WALK组。可行性标准为流失率≤15%且干预期间无伤害性跌倒。初步疗效通过四方步态测试（FSST）评估。结果：PRR组流失率为15.2%，未显著超过预设阈值（P = .848），且监督期间未报告伤害性跌倒，符合可行性和安全性标准。FSST未观察到显著的组间时间交互作用。
items.abstract: Background: Non-pharmacological interventions may enhance motor-cognitive integration in prodromal Alzheimer's disease (pAD). Partnered Rhythmic Rehabilitation (PRR), an adapted dance-based intervention, is designed to engage the motor, cognitive, and social domains. However, no randomized trial has evaluated its feasibility or efficacy in pAD. This study evaluated the feasibility, safety, and preliminary efficacy of PRR compared to group walking (WALK) in adults with pAD and amnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI). Methods: In this single-blind, randomized controlled pilot trial (NCT04029623), 68 adults with pAD and aMCI were randomized to PRR or WALK. Prespecified feasibility criteria were attrition [ ]15% and no injurious falls during interventions. Preliminary efficacy was examined on the primary outcome, the Four-Square Step Test (FSST). Secondary cognitive, motor, and psychosocial outcomes were also assessed to inform future definitive trials. Several modifications were made to the original protocol to ensure compliance with safety measures associated with the COVID-19 pandemic. Results: Attrition in the PRR group (15.2%) did not significantly exceed the prespecified thresh
items.authors: Rafiei Rezvani, F.; Azimi, D.; Nekouei, A. H.; Kim, H.; Sauer, C. C.; Wharton, W.; Qiu, D.; Goldstein, F.; McKay, J.; Hackney, M. E.

items.title: Hybrid lexical-semantic retrieval over SNOMED CT: combining two retrieval paradigms to facilitate clinical data entry
items.title_zh: SNOMED CT的混合词汇-语义检索：促进临床数据录入
items.summary_zh: 目的：在SNOMED CT等参考术语中检索面临两种本质上相反的检索技术。确定性词汇匹配精确、独立于顺序且基于字符，允许临床医生逐步细化查询，但受限于经过整理的描述的措辞和语言。学习的语义匹配能够桥接同义词和语言，但对缩写和部分输入的表现较差。两者的需求和失败模式差异显著，简单结合可能导致错误的通道影响正确的通道。传统方法是增强词汇通道，但维护额外的本地接口词汇劳动强度大且质量随时间下降。我们探讨这两种对立范式是否可以在SNOMED CT的整理描述中共存，并研究查询解释、排名融合和重新排名设计以确保这种共存的安全性。材料与方法：我们在SNOMED CT国际版上实现了这一架构的可重复实例。
items.abstract: Objectives: Searching a reference terminology such as SNOMED CT confronts two retrieval technologies of fundamentally opposite nature. Deterministic lexical matching is precise, order-independent and character-level, and lets a clinician refine a query incrementally, but it is confined to the wording and language of the curated descriptions. Learned semantic matching bridges paraphrase and language, but poorly represents abbreviations and partial, as-typed input. Their requirements and failure modes are so different that combining them naively can let the channel that is wrong for a given query degrade the one that is right. The conventional way to avoid adding a semantic channel at all has been to strengthen the lexical one (curating an additional local interface vocabulary so that more expressions match by surface form), but such vocabularies are labour-intensive to maintain and their quality degrades over time. We ask whether these two opposite paradigms can instead be made to *coexist* in one retrieval flow (each serving the input regime it is strong at, neither harming the other) over SNOMED CT's own curated descriptions, and study the query interpretation, rank fusion and re-
items.authors: Lopez Osornio, A.; Randorff Hoejen, A.; Kewley, K.

items.title: Determinants of Anticipated Video-Supported Treatment Acceptability in Drug-Susceptible Pulmonary Tuberculosis
items.title_zh: 药物敏感性肺结核患者视频支持治疗接受度的影响因素
items.summary_zh: 研究地点：秘鲁利马大都会五个地理区域的23个城市医疗机构。研究目的：识别药物敏感性肺结核患者对视频支持治疗（VST）接受度的影响因素。研究设计：观察性横断面研究（2025年8月至12月）。接受度评估涵盖两个领域：使用接受度（使用VST的愿望）和遵从意愿（完成VST要求的信心）。使用稳健的Poisson回归估计调整后的流行率比（aPR）及其95%置信区间（95%CI）。结果：在473名参与者中（中位年龄35岁；51.5%为男性），61.3%（95%CI：57.0%-65.9%）报告了使用接受度，42.3%（95%CI 36.2%-49.4%）表示愿意遵从VST。教育程度是两个结果的最强预测因素。能够使用手机录制和发送视频以及技术访问的持续性与使用接受度和遵从意愿相关。糖尿病、非法药物使用和放弃治疗的意图与遵从意愿降低相关。结论：VST的接受度受教育程度、数字能力、结构条件及临床和行为特征的影响。
items.abstract: Setting: Twenty-three urban healthcare facilities across five geographic jurisdictions of Metropolitan Lima, Peru. Objective: To identify determinants of anticipated video-supported treatment (VST) acceptability among persons with drug-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis. Design: Observational, cross-sectional study (August-December 2025). Anticipated acceptability was assessed across two domains: acceptability of use (desire to use VST) and willingness to comply (confidence in fulfilling VST requirements). Adjusted prevalence ratios (aPR) with 95% confidence intervals (95%CI) were estimated using robust Poisson regression with Liang-Zeger cluster-robust standard errors. Results: Among 473 participants (median age 35 years; 51.5% male), 61.3% (95%CI: 57.0%-65.9%) reported acceptability of use and 42.3% (95%CI 36.2%-49.4%) willingness to comply with VST. Educational attainment was the strongest predictor of both outcomes. The ability to record and send videos using a mobile phone and continuity of technology access were associated with acceptability of use and willingness to comply with VST, respectively. items.title: "Mortality Prediction in Heart Failure using Explainable AI: Development and Validation of the EXACT-HF Model in a Nationwide Multi-Ethnic Asian Cohort"
items.title_zh: 心力衰竭死亡预测的可解释人工智能：EXACT-HF模型的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 背景：现有心力衰竭（HF）风险评分主要基于西方人群，假设线性预测效应，且仅提供预后而不指示行动。我们在多民族亚洲HF人群中开发并外部验证了机器学习（ML）模型，用于预测30天和1年死亡率，并与三种已建立的评分进行基准比较，测试其是否能够定位可纠正的指南导向医疗治疗（GDMT）缺口。方法：我们分析了2016年11月至2023年3月在新加坡八家医院住院的9,050名HF成人。采用梯度提升树（XGBoost，主要）和弹性网逻辑回归在三家医院（n=4,034）开发，并在五家独立医院（n=5,016）验证，患者和地点无重叠。比较评分（MAGGIC、新加坡HF评分、OPTIMIZE-HF-Asia）在开发数据上进行了逻辑重新校准。结果：在外部验证中，XGBoost在30天和1年死亡率的AUROC分别为0.862（95% CI 0.833-0.890）和0.749（0.734-0.764），而三种重新校准评分的AUROC为0.711-0.754和0.682-0.699；逻辑回归表现相近（0.864, 0.757），且在1年时校准更好。尽管在时间验证、多重插补和乐观校正下保持优越性，但一旦去除药物，30天的优势与MAGGIC不再可区分。
items.abstract: Background: Established heart-failure (HF) risk scores were developed largely in Western cohorts, assume linear predictor effects, and stop at prognosis without indicating action. We developed and externally validated machine-learning (ML) models for 30-day and 1-year mortality in a multi-ethnic Asian HF population, benchmarked against three established scores, and tested whether they localised correctable guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) gaps. Methods: We analysed 9,050 adults hospitalised with HF across eight Singapore hospitals (November 2016?March 2023). Gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost, primary) and elastic-net logistic regression were developed on three hospitals (n=4,034) and validated on five independent hospitals (n=5,016), without patient or site overlap. Comparators (MAGGIC, Singapore HF Score, OPTIMIZE-HF-Asia) were logistically recalibrated on development data. Results: On external validation XGBoost achieved AUROCs of 0.862 (95% CI 0.833?0.890) for 30-day and 0.749 (0.734?0.764) for 1-year mortality, versus 0.711?0.754 and 0.682?0.699 for the three recalibrated scores; logistic regression performed near-identically (0.864, 0.757) and was better calibrated at 1

items.title: A First-Visit Clinical Score to Distinguish Immunoglobulin Light-Chain from Wild-Type Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis: Derivation and Internal Validation
items.title_zh: 区分免疫球蛋白轻链与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变的首次就诊评分
items.summary_zh: 背景：免疫球蛋白轻链心脏淀粉样变（AL-CA）的延迟诊断会恶化预后，部分原因是AL-CA与野生型转甲状腺素心脏淀粉样变（ATTRwt-CA）在初次心脏病就诊时难以区分。我们开发并验证了一种实用评分以区分AL-CA与ATTRwt-CA。方法：我们回顾性分析了541名心脏淀粉样变患者（91例AL-CA，450例ATTRwt-CA），随机分为开发组（n=378）和验证组（n=163）。候选变量经过LASSO选择，采用Rubin规则进行估计汇总。通过自助法验证、校准和决策曲线分析评估模型性能，并将其转化为简化的积分评分。结果：保留了七个变量：年龄、无房颤、无腕管综合症、低血清白蛋白、蛋白尿（[ ]1+）、低电压及左心室后壁厚度较薄。开发组和验证组的曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.97和0.99；自助法校正后的AUC为0.96。模型在0.01-0.50的阈值概率范围内提供了净收益。风险分层将验证组分类为低（0-5分；AL-CA 0%）、中（6-9分；26%）和高（10-13分）风险。
items.abstract: Background: Delayed diagnosis of immunoglobulin light-chain cardiac amyloidosis (AL-CA) worsens prognosis, partly because AL-CA and wild-type transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTRwt-CA) are difficult to distinguish at the initial cardiology visit. We developed and validated a practical score to triage AL-CA from ATTRwt-CA. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 541 consecutive patients with cardiac amyloidosis (91 AL-CA, 450 ATTRwt-CA) at our institution's amyloidosis center, randomly divided into derivation (n=378) and validation (n=163) cohorts. Candidate first-visit variables underwent LASSO selection after multiple imputation, with estimates pooled by Rubin's rules. Performance was assessed by bootstrap validation, calibration, and decision curve analysis. The model was converted into a simplified point-based score. Results: Seven variables were retained: age, absence of atrial fibrillation, absence of carpal tunnel syndrome, low serum albumin, proteinuria ([ ]1+), low voltage, and thinner left ventricular posterior wall thickness. items.title: Trends in Lyme disease incidence in England, 2013 to 2024
items.title_zh: 2013至2024年英格兰莱姆病发病率趋势研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了2013至2024年英格兰的莱姆病发病率，基于国家参考实验室的实验室确诊病例数据和初级医疗数据。由于患者可通过临床诊断而无需实验室检测，官方数据可能低估了急性病例的真实发病率。研究采用季节性时间序列模型分析数据，并使用PELT或BinSeg方法检查结构性变化，利用泊松回归模型估算年度乘数因子。结果显示，2013至2024年间，实验室确诊的莱姆病例数量没有显著变化，而初级医疗诊断的病例数量在同一时期显著增加。这表明需要更新莱姆病的发病率估算方法。
items.abstract: Official Lyme disease incidence figures for England are based on the number of cases with a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis from the national reference laboratory. However, these figures underestimate the true incidence of acute cases since patients can also be diagnosed clinically without the need for laboratory testing. The use of a multiplication factor has been proposed to estimate total Lyme disease incidence from the number of laboratory-confirmed cases. The current multiplication factor is derived from data spanning 1998 to 2016 and is thought to be outdated, in part due to the introduction of new national Lyme disease management guidance in 2018. The aim of this study was to analyse more recent laboratory and primary care data to identify trends in case numbers and to derive updated estimates of the total annual number of acute Lyme disease cases in England. Data spanning 2013 to 2024 from the national reference laboratory and a primary care data source were analysed using seasonal time series models. items.title: Meningococcal epidemiology in Ethiopia after MenAfriVac: A situational analysis of surveillance gaps and national meningococcal vaccine policy.
items.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚MenAfriVac后脑膜炎球菌流行病学分析
items.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚于2013至2015年间引入MenAfriVac疫苗以控制A群脑膜炎球菌病（MenA）疫情。自此以来未报告MenA疫情。然而，由于缺乏后续策略，仍有两个关键问题未解答：（1）对MenA的保护是否正在减弱，可能导致疫情重新出现？（2）在脑膜炎带其他地区已知会引发疫情的非A群脑膜炎球菌目前是否在埃塞俄比亚传播？本研究通过历史记录、2015年后的监测数据、MenAfriVac活动报告及当前政策环境进行情境分析，评估埃塞俄比亚的脑膜炎球菌流行病学。现有国家数据无法回答这两个问题，疾病报告依赖于三家医院的哨点监测，均位于疫情风险较低的地区，且病例很少经过实验室确认，几乎从未进行血清分型，数据报告不及时。主要的携带率和血清调查研究有限，方法学异质性限制了其对人口政策决策的普遍适用性。
items.abstract: Abstract Ethiopia introduced the MenAfriVac vaccine to control epidemics of serogroup A meningococcal disease (MenA) between 2013 and 2015. Since the campaign, no MenA epidemics have been reported. However, lacking a follow-up strategy, two critical questions remained unanswered: (1) is protection against MenA waning to a point where epidemics could re-emerge and (2) are non-A serogroups, known to cause outbreaks elsewhere in the meningitis belt, currently circulating in Ethiopia? To inform future policy, this situational analysis draws on historical records, post-2015 surveillance data, MenAfriVac campaign reports, and the current policy landscape to assess meningococcal epidemiology in Ethiopia. Available national data cannot answer either question. Disease notification relies on sentinel surveillance at three hospitals; none located in the epidemic risk western regions and none with a defined catchment population. Cases are rarely laboratory-confirmed, almost never serogrouped, and the resulting data are not reported in a timely manner. items.title: Clinical and Decisional Trajectories Preceding Early Postprocedural Death Among Patients with Preexisting Code-Status Limitations
items.title_zh: 既往有代码状态限制患者术后早期死亡的临床与决策轨迹
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发既往有代码状态限制患者术后早期死亡的临床与决策轨迹类型。背景：不进行心肺复苏的患者术后死亡率较高，但早期死亡的临床与决策过程尚不清楚。仅凭死亡率和代码状态无法判断这些死亡是否反映了救治受限、治疗失败、疾病进展或基于重新评估的护理方向调整。方法：我们对2024年3月至2025年6月期间五家学术和社区医院的电子健康记录进行了回顾性定性轨迹分析。符合条件的成年人在接受麻醉的手术前有活跃的代码状态限制，并在手术后3天内去世。通过适应的序列基础复合方法，2名评审员独立重建病例的临床与决策序列，并就重复轨迹家族达成共识；随后生成了示例复合体。第三名评审员在不知情的情况下独立分类病例；使用未加权的Cohen kappa评估一致性。结果：在2833名既往有代码状态限制的患者中，接受了手术。
items.abstract: Objective: To develop a typology of recurrent clinical and decisional trajectories preceding early postprocedural death among patients with preexisting code-status limitations. Background: Patients with do-not-resuscitate orders experience higher postoperative mortality, but the clinical and decisional processes underlying early deaths are poorly understood. Mortality and code status alone cannot determine whether these deaths reflect constrained rescue, unsuccessful treatment, progression of terminal illness, or reassessment-driven redirection of care. Methods: We conducted a retrospective qualitative trajectory analysis of electronic health record documentation across five academic and community hospitals from March 2024 through June 2025. Eligible adults had an active preprocedural code-status limitation and died within 3 calendar days of a procedure requiring anesthesia, before hospital discharge. Using an adapted sequence-based composite approach, 2 reviewers independently reconstructed cases as ordered clinical and decisional sequences and reached consensus on recurrent trajectory families; illustrative composites were then generated. items.title: Continuous Diagnostic Indices from BanffNET Automated Lesion Scores for Kidney Transplant Pathology: Development and Evaluation of a Diagnostic Prediction Model
items.title_zh: 基于BanffNET自动病变评分的肾移植病理连续诊断指标研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：肾移植活检的组织病理学诊断（Banff分类）存在显著的观察者间变异和误解，易导致诊断错误。本文提出基于BanffNET自动病变评分的连续指标，以量化肾移植活检的连续表型谱，补充病理学家的评估。方法：使用BanffNET模型对2544例训练队列、3863例大验证队列和36例多读者队列（67名病理学家评分）进行连续病变评分。采用惩罚回归方法将17个自动病变评分浓缩为四个指标，代表移植物损伤的主要维度：TCMR/TI指数、AMR/MVI指数、活动指数和慢性指数。结果：BanffNET TCMR/TI指数、AMR/MVI指数和活动指数在训练和验证队列中与Banff诊断及组织学指标进行了评估。
items.abstract: Background: Histopathological diagnoses in kidney transplant biopsies, as described by the Banff classification, suffer from substantial inter-observer variability and misinterpretation, making them prone to diagnostic errors. Continuous indices based on BanffNET automated lesion scores are proposed to quantify the continuous phenotypic spectrum of kidney transplant biopsies, complementary to pathologist assessment of biopsies. Methods: The BanffNET model was used to obtain continuous lesion scoring for a training cohort of 2544 biopsies, a large validation cohort of 3863 biopsies, and a multi-reader cohort of 36 biopsies scored by 67 pathologists. A penalized regression approach was used to condense 17 automated lesion scores into four indices, representing the most important dimensions of graft injury: a TCMR/TI Index, an AMR/MVI Index, an Activity Index and a Chronicity Index. The BanffNET Indices were evaluated against Banff diagnoses and histological indices in the training cohort and validation cohort. items.title: Multigenerational machine learning-based genomic prediction for dermo resistance in eastern oyster Crassostrea virginica
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的东海岸牡蛎抗病性多代基因组预测
items.summary_zh: 由原生动物Perkinsus marinus引起的Dermo病对东海岸牡蛎养殖构成重大威胁。我们之前进行了抗Dermo性状的基因组选择，发现其效果优于表型选择。本研究报告了利用三代数据改进的基因组预测。我们评估了九种不同的基因组选择模型，包括三种监督机器学习架构：梯度提升、逻辑回归和随机森林。跨代数据的结合并未显著提高大多数模型的准确性，但增加的样本量提高了稀有等位基因位点的基因分型信心。所有模型的相关性准确度在纳入低频变异和通过全基因组关联研究识别的强效标记后显著提高。梯度提升机器学习模型在所有训练场景中表现优于其他基因组选择模型，显示出更强的学习与Dermo抗性相关的可推广基因组信号的能力。最佳梯度提升模型的峰值相关性准确度达到0.410，较传统模型的0.274有显著提升。我们的结果强调了机器学习在基因组选择中的潜力及稀有变异的重要性。
items.abstract: Dermo disease caused by the protist Perkinsus marinus poses a major threat to Eastern oyster aquaculture. We previously conducted genomic selection for dermo resistance and found increased effectiveness over phenotypic selection. Here, we report improved genomic predictions using combined data from three successive generations. We evaluated nine different genomic selection models, including three supervised machine learning architectures: gradient boosting, logistic regression, and random forest. Combining data across multiple generations did not, by itself, substantially improve the accuracy of most models, but the increased sample size provided genotyping confidence of loci with rare alleles. Correlation accuracy of all models significantly increased with the inclusion of low-frequency variants and strong-effect markers identified through a genome-wide association study. Gradient boosting machine learning models outperformed other genomic selection models across all training scenarios, suggesting enhanced capacity to learn generalizable genomic signals associated with dermo resistance. items.title: Maternal Antibodies to Primary CMV Infection Link to Fetal Transmission
items.title_zh: 母体抗体与初次CMV感染及胎儿传播的关联
items.summary_zh: 背景：人类巨细胞病毒（HCMV）是全球出生缺陷的主要感染原因。尽管其导致终身残疾的普遍性，但尚无获准疫苗预防先天性CMV（cCMV），保护相关机制仍不清楚。方法：从一项筛查超过20万名孕妇的试验中收集母体血浆，399名孕妇被血清学确诊为初次HCMV感染，随机分配接受高免疫球蛋白或安慰剂治疗（NCT01376778），其中78例传播了cCMV。测量了母体血浆中IgG、IgM和IgA对HCMV抗原的结合、 neutralization、抗体依赖性细胞吞噬及细胞相关病毒传播抑制，并与传播结果相关联。结果：在病例对照条件逻辑回归中，IgM对HCMV入侵糖蛋白的结合与cCMV的增加相关，识别出潜在的先天感染生物标志物。相反，IgG对UL16、UL141、前融合样gB、gB抗原域（AD）4+5及gH/gL的结合与cCMV的降低相关。意外的是，IgG对免疫优势gB AD-1区域、pp150及细胞相关gB的结合与cCMV的增加相关。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) is the leading global infectious cause of birth defects. Despite its prevalence as a cause of life-long disabilities, there are no licensed vaccines to prevent congenital CMV (cCMV), and correlates of protection remain poorly understood. To address this, we identified humoral immune responses to primary HCMV infection during early pregnancy associated with odds of vertical transmission. METHODS Maternal plasma was collected from a trial that screened >200,000 and enrolled 399 pregnant women serologically diagnosed with primary HCMV infection prior to randomization for hyperimmunoglobulin or placebo therapy (NCT01376778), where 78 transmitted cCMV. Plasma IgG, IgM, and IgA binding to HCMV antigens, neutralization, antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and inhibition of cell-associated viral spread were measured and related to transmission outcome. RESULTS In a case-control conditional logistic regression, IgM binding to HCMV entry glycoproteins was associated with increased odds of cCMV, identifying potential biomarkers of congenital infection. items.title: Gentamicin-Augmented Intrarenal Irrigation During Percutaneous Nephrolithotomy Reduces 30-Day Infectious Complications and Eliminates Pyelonephritis and Sepsis: A 1:2 Matched Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 增敏庆大霉素肾内灌注降低经皮肾镜取石术感染并发症
items.summary_zh: 目的：评估增敏庆大霉素肾内灌注在经皮肾镜取石术（PCNL）中是否能减少30天内尿路感染并发症。方法：对2020年1月至2026年6月间接受PCNL的成人进行单中心回顾性1:2匹配队列研究。113名接受增敏灌注的患者（每3升0.9%盐水中含80毫克庆大霉素）与226名盐水对照组在年龄、性别、体重指数、Charlson合并症指数、ASA评分、糖尿病及既往肾造口管等方面进行倾向评分匹配。主要终点为30天内合并症状的尿路感染（培养>1000 CFU/mL）、发热性尿路感染、肾盂肾炎或脓毒症。结果：主要合并感染结果在增敏组为3/113（2.7%），对照组为33/226（14.6%），风险差异为-11.9%（95% CI -17.4至-5.6；NNT=8；p=0.001）。发热性尿路感染/肾盂肾炎在增敏组为0%，对照组为6.2%（p=0.006），脓毒症在增敏组为0%，对照组为4.0%（p=0.03）。所有事件均为无发热或器官功能障碍的培养确诊尿路感染。SIRS发生率为31.9%对54.4%（p<0.001），无症状菌尿无显著差异。
items.abstract: Purpose: To evaluate whether gentamicin-augmented intrarenal irrigation during percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL) was associated with fewer 30-day urinary infectious complications. Materials and Methods: Single-center retrospective 1:2 matched cohort study of adults undergoing PCNL between January 2020 and June 2026. One hundred thirteen patients receiving gentamicin-augmented irrigation (80 mg per 3-L bag of 0.9% saline) were propensity-score matched to 226 saline controls on age, sex, body mass index, Charlson Comorbidity Index, ASA score, diabetes, and a pre-existing nephrostomy tube. The primary endpoint was a 30-day composite of symptomatic urinary tract infection with culture >1,000 CFU/mL, febrile UTI or pyelonephritis, or sepsis. A [ ] 100,000 CFU/mL composite was a prespecified sensitivity endpoint and asymptomatic bacteriuria a prespecified negative control. items.title: Functional plasticity of the olfactory network following functional septorhinoplasty in persistent COVID-19-related olfactory dysfunction: an fMRI study
items.title_zh: 功能性鼻中隔整形术后嗅觉网络的功能可塑性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：持续性COVID-19相关嗅觉功能障碍（C19OD）对患者造成显著负担，其病理机制尚不明确。功能性鼻中隔整形术（fSRP）是一种新型干预，旨在恢复气味分子流向嗅觉上皮，并在持续性C19OD患者中显示出临床显著的嗅觉改善。本研究使用任务驱动功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）探讨fSRP前后主要及高阶嗅觉脑网络的功能可塑性。方法：在前瞻性队列研究中，持续性C19OD患者在基线及术后6个月接受心理物理嗅觉测试、鼻气流测量及嗅觉任务fMRI。分析全脑fMRI数据以评估神经激活变化及其与临床参数的相关性。结果：八名参与者完成了术前和术后fMRI评估。基线时，左侧海马体出现去激活，双侧小脑激活增加。任务驱动激活与右侧丘脑及左侧小脑第六小叶的鼻腔体积呈正相关。术后，任务驱动去激活情况有所变化。
items.abstract: Background: Persistent COVID-19-related olfactory dysfunction (C19OD) has a significant disease burden. The underlying pathology is unclear, both at the level of the olfactory epithelium, and the higher neural networks. Functional septorhinoplasty (fSRP) is a novel intervention aimed at restoring odorant airflow to the olfactory epithelium, demonstrating clinically meaningful olfactory improvements in persistent C19OD patients. In the same cohort, we investigated the functional plasticity within the primary and higher-order olfactory brain networks using task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) before and after fSRP. Methods: In a prospective cohort study, patients with persistent C19OD underwent psychophysical olfactory testing, nasal airflow measurements, and olfactory task-based fMRI at baseline and 6 months post-fSRP. Whole-brain fMRI data was analysed to evaluate changes in neural activation and their correlations with clinical parameters. Results were mapped to standardized anatomical and olfactory atlases. items.title: Health workforce preparedness for sepsis care in Bahrain: a cross-sectional survey of guideline knowledge, attitudes, and practices
items.title_zh: 巴林医疗工作者对脓毒症护理的准备情况调查
items.summary_zh: 脓毒症及脓毒性休克仍然是需要及时有效干预的重大医疗紧急情况。本研究评估了巴林医疗专业人员对脓毒症和脓毒性休克管理的知识、态度和实践（KAP）。在310名被接触的医疗工作者中，有260名同意参与，响应率为83.9%。使用结构化的自填问卷收集数据，以确保匿名性和回答的一致性。数据通过IBM SPSS版本29进行描述性和推断性统计分析。大多数参与者对脓毒症有良好的基本知识，90.7%正确识别广谱抗生素为一线治疗。然而，对某些临床工具的认识较低，仅44.6%的人了解qSOFA评分，60%理解毛细血管再充盈时间的使用。男性（77.4%）的知识水平显著高于女性（70.6%，p = 0.043），而拥有高级学位者（p < 0.001）知识水平更高，尤其是博士学位持有者（84.5%）。医生的平均知识得分最高（91.0%），其次是药学博士（82.2%）。82.2%的参与者对早期识别脓毒症持积极态度，尤其是在博士教育背景和21年以上工作经验者中。
items.abstract: Sepsis and septic shock remain critical medical emergencies that require timely and effective interventions. This study evaluates the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of healthcare professionals in Bahrain concerning the management of sepsis and septic shock. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among a sample of 260 healthcare professionals who consented to participate out of 310 approached, yielding a response rate of 83.9%. Data were collected using a structured, self-administered questionnaire designed to ensure anonymity and consistency in responses. Data were analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics via IBM SPSS version 29. Most participants demonstrated sound general knowledge of sepsis, with 90.7% correctly identifying broad-spectrum antibiotics as the first-line treatment. However, awareness of certain clinical tools was lower--only 44.6% recognized the qSOFA score and 60% understood the use of capillary refill time. Knowledge levels were significantly higher among males (77.4%) than females (70.6%, p = 0.043), and among those with advanced degrees (p < 0.001), especially doctorate holders (84.5%). items.title: “Chilling” warning or overreaction? AI bioweapons report divides experts
items.title_zh: “冷酷”警告还是过度反应？AI生物武器报告引发专家分歧
items.summary_zh: Anthropic描述了五个案例，涉及科学家在未具名国家尝试利用其Claude软件进行可能的病毒或毒素相关的恶意工作。这些案例引发了对人工智能在生物武器开发中潜在风险的讨论，专家们对此看法不一。一些专家认为这是对AI技术潜在滥用的合理警告，而另一些则认为这种担忧可能是过度反应。报告强调了对AI技术监管的重要性，以防止其被用于危害公共安全的目的。
items.abstract: Anthropic describes five cases where scientists in unnamed countries tried to use its Claude software for potentially nefarious work on viruses or toxins
items.authors: Jocelyn Kaiser

items.title: Towards reconstruction of the human interactome from positive and negative experimental evidence
items.title_zh: 从实验证据重建人类相互作用组的研究
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）已被检测并报告数百万次，但人类PPI网络的知识仍不完整，存在许多假阳性测量且高度偏倚。为了解决这些问题，需要了解高置信度的正相互作用以及可能不相互作用的蛋白质对。然而，这些信息通常在PPI研究中未被报告。我们开发了一种方法，从现有PPI数据中重建这些知识。我们重建了进行PPI筛选的实验搜索空间，并创建了一个模型，用于评估PPI的真实性。我们认为，负蛋白质对可以帮助我们估计实验和计算筛选的错误率。最后，我们评估了一种简单的机器学习方法用于PPI预测，并提出如何利用负数据进行训练。我们的结果表明，重建实验搜索空间能够从现有PPI数据中恢复被忽视的信息层，有助于指导更准确的PPI预测。
items.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) have been detected and reported in the millions, but while they are used in many different contexts for better understanding cellular processes in health and disease, the knowledge of the human PPI network is far from complete, containing many false positive measurements and being highly biased. Both to chart the extent of those problems and to solve them requires not just a knowledge of high-confidence positive interactions, but also likely non-interacting protein pairs. However, this information is typically not reported in PPI studies. We developed a methodology to reconstruct this knowledge from existing PPI data. We reconstruct the experimental search space in which PPI screens have been performed and then create a model that informs how likely a PPI is real given its testing and observation frequency. We argue that negative protein pairs allow us to estimate the error rates of experimental and computational screens. We show how this knowledge could be incorporated for calibration. items.title: pydreg: a fast Python package for identifying active cis-regulatory elements from nascent transcription
items.title_zh: pydreg：快速识别新生转录活性顺式调控元件的Python包
items.summary_zh: 背景：活性启动子和增强子通过新生RNA测序生成特征性RNA转录模式。dREG是识别基因组中活性顺式调控元件的领先方法，但其参考实现基于R语言，维护和部署日益困难。发现：为提高dREG的可用性，我们开发了pydreg，一个dREG的Python移植版。pydreg保留了dREG的预训练模型和峰值调用程序，同时使用现代数值库进行CPU和GPU计算。与dREG相比，pydreg在运行时间和峰值主机内存上分别减少了4.5倍和5.4倍，同时生成几乎相同的峰值调用。结论：pydreg降低了本地运行dREG的实际障碍，改善了运行时间和内存使用，易于与基于Python的基因组工作流程集成，并为现代计算基础设施提供了可维护的基础。可用性与实现：pydreg在Python 3.11+中实现，遵循GPL-3许可证，免费提供于https://github.com/adamyhe/pydreg和通过pip install pydreg[gpu]从PyPI获取。
items.abstract: Background: Active promoters and enhancers generate characteristic patterns of RNA transcription that can be measured through nascent RNA sequencing. dREG is a leading method that uses these patterns to identify active cis-regulatory elements across the genome, allowing regulatory activity and gene transcription to be profiled in the same experiment. However, its reference implementation was developed around an R-based workflow and a legacy GPU-accelerated support vector machine library that have become increasingly difficult to maintain and deploy. Findings: To improve future usability of dREG, we developed pydreg, a Python port of dREG. pydreg preserves the original pretrained models and peak calling procedure from dREG while using contemporary numerical libraries for CPU and GPU computation. pydreg achieves 4.5 and 5.4-fold reductions in runtime and peak host memory, respectively, compared to dREG while producing near identical peak calls. Conclusions: pydreg reduces practical barriers to running dREG locally, improves runtime and memory usage, integrates readily with Python-based genomics workflows, and provides a maintainable foundation on modern computing infrastructure. items.title: Sex and Life Stage Differences in the Association Between Cognitive Engagement and Cognitive Change
items.title_zh: 性别与生命阶段对认知参与与认知变化关系的影响
items.summary_zh: 引言：认知刺激活动（CSA）与认知健康相关，但其与认知变化的关系是否因生命阶段和性别而异尚不明确。方法：数据来源于Rush队列，参与者为2,614名65岁及以上的成年人（1,965名女性；649名男性）。根据生命阶段的特征，分类儿童期、中年和晚年的CSA。采用线性混合效应模型分析全球认知及五个领域，调整年龄、教育和认知诊断。性别-参与-时间交互作用经过假发现率校正。结果：儿童期参与的关联有限，仅工作记忆的性别-参与-时间交互作用通过校正（β = -0.014, qFDR=.047）。中年期显示出最强的性别依赖关联，全球认知、情景记忆、语义记忆、处理速度和视觉空间能力均有显著交互作用（qFDR < .017）。女性的高参与与更有利的全球和视觉空间轨迹相关，而男性则在多个领域表现出更负面的轨迹。在晚年，只有工作记忆显示出显著的性别交互作用（β = 0.017, qFDR=.018）。儿童期和中年期的高参与后随之而来的低晚年参与与更有利的全球轨迹相关。
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Cognitively stimulating activity (CSA) is associated with cognitive health, but whether associations with cognitive change differ by life stage and sex remains unclear. METHODS: Data were drawn from Rush cohorts. Participants were 2,614 adults aged 65 years and older (1,965 females; 649 males). CSA during childhood, middle adulthood, and late life was classified using stage-specific pooled medians. Linear mixed-effects models examined global cognition and five domains, adjusting for age, education, and cognitive diagnosis. Sex-engagement-time interactions were tested with false discovery rate correction. RESULTS: Childhood engagement showed limited associations; only the working-memory sex-engagement-time interaction survived correction ({beta} = -0.014, qFDR=.047). Middle adulthood showed the strongest sex-dependent associations, with significant interactions for global cognition, episodic memory, semantic memory, processing speed, and visuospatial ability (qFDR [ ].017). items.title: Aortic Haemodynamics Are Independent Longitudinal Determinants of Left Ventricular Function in Repaired Tetralogy of Fallot
items.title_zh: 主动脉血流动力学是修复法洛四联症左心室功能的独立纵向决定因素
items.summary_zh: 背景：左心室射血分数（LVEF）在修复法洛四联症（ToF）中独立预测死亡率，但左心室功能障碍的原因尚不完全清楚。ToF的内源性主动脉病变增加了脉动后负荷，但其是否导致左心室功能障碍尚不明确。本研究旨在确定主动脉尺寸和流动衍生的后负荷是否作为左心室功能障碍的横断面标志、随时间变化的动态贡献者，或两者兼具。方法：对554名修复ToF患者进行回顾性纵向研究（2003-2026年，共1448次心血管磁共振检查）。分析主动脉根部尺寸、总动脉顺应性（TAC）和全身血管阻力（SVR），并使用混合效应模型分离患者间和患者内的LVEF关联。结果：在分析样本中（1053个观察，521名患者），主动脉窦直径在患者内（β = -0.23, p<0.001）和患者间（β = -0.20, p=0.003）均能预测LVEF。该关联在窦管连接处得到重复，但在升主动脉处缺失，表明影响局限于根部。TAC在患者内预测LVEF（β=0.90每mL/mmHg, p=0.014），但在患者间不显著（p=0.62），表明脉动后负荷是动态因素。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) independently predicts mortality in repaired tetralogy of Fallot (ToF), but the causes of LV dysfunction are incompletely understood. The intrinsic aortopathy of ToF increases pulsatile afterload, yet whether this contributes to LV dysfunction is unknown. We sought to determine whether aortic dimensions and flow-derived afterload act as cross-sectional markers of LV dysfunction, dynamic contributors to change in LV function over time, or both. METHODS: Retrospective longitudinal study of 554 patients with repaired ToF (1,448 serial cardiovascular magnetic resonance examinations, 2003-2026). Aortic root dimensions, total arterial compliance (TAC: aortic forward flow volume/pulse pressure), and systemic vascular resistance (SVR) were derived, and a within-between decomposition separated between-patient from within-patient associations with LVEF in mixed-effects models. RESULTS: In the analytic sample (1,053 observations, 521 patients), aortic sinus diameter predicted LVEF at both levels (within:{beta} = -0.23, p<0.001; between: {beta} = -0.20, p=0.003). items.title: ESCRT-I Inhibition Protects against NMDAR Hypofunction and Restores Synaptic Homeostasis in a Cellular Model of Schizophrenia
items.title_zh: 抑制ESCRT-I保护NMDAR功能并恢复精神分裂症模型中的突触稳态
items.summary_zh: N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）功能低下是精神分裂症的核心病理机制，但直接增强NMDAR功能的临床效果有限，可能是因为未能解决受体运输和表面稳定性的问题。内涵体排序复合物（ESCRT）负责内化膜蛋白的溶酶体命运，但其在谷氨酸功能障碍中的突触受体稳态中的作用尚不明确。我们使用非竞争性NMDAR拮抗剂氟环啶（PCP）模型研究NMDAR功能低下及精神分裂症表型。研究表明，亚慢性PCP暴露导致持久的NMDAR功能低下、GABA能传递受损及兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡崩溃。基因抑制ESCRT-I成分TSG101可防止这些缺陷，促进PCP洗脱后的功能恢复，并增加功能性NMDAR和GABAA受体的表面表达。TSG101敲低恢复了抑制性信号、正常化了兴奋性活动并稳定了E/I平衡。
items.abstract: N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) hypofunction is a central pathophysiological mechanism in schizophrenia, yet direct NMDAR potentiation has shown limited clinical benefit, potentially because it fails to address deficits in receptor trafficking and surface stability. The endosomal sorting complexes required for transport (ESCRT) machinery governs the lysosomal fate of internalised membrane proteins, but its role in synaptic receptor homeostasis during glutamatergic dysfunction remains unclear. Phencyclidine (PCP), a non-competitive NMDAR antagonist, is widely used to model NMDAR hypofunction and schizophrenia-like phenotypes. Here, we show that sub-chronic PCP exposure induced persistent NMDAR hypofunction, impaired GABAergic transmission, and collapsed of excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance in primary hippocampal neurons. Genetic inhibition of the ESCRT-I component TSG101 prevented these deficits, enabled functional recovery following PCP washout, and increased surface expression of functional NMDARs and GABAA receptors without altering receptor pharmacology or biophysical properties. items.authors: Shalaby, M.; Prato, V.; Elies, J. G.; Gamper, N.; Mclean, S. L.; Kantamneni, S.

items.title: Competing calcium sensors orchestrate various patterns of synaptic transmission
items.title_zh: 竞争性钙传感器调控突触传递模式
items.summary_zh: 神经递质传递依赖于时机和效能，使神经元能够在毫秒级时间尺度内精确编码信息。突触通常表达多种钙传感器，如突触小体素-1（syt1）和突触小体素-7（syt7），但这些传感器如何定量调节同步释放（SR）和异步释放（AR）的机制尚不明确。我们开发了一个生物物理详细的随机模型，结合syt1和syt7的钙结合动力学，分析它们在突触释放中的作用。研究表明，SR和AR模式受钙通道分布、传感器数量、外部钙浓度和缓冲特性影响。syt1和syt7之间的相互作用，通过其不同的钙亲和力和外排动力学，构成神经传递的核心机制。这些发现确立了钙分配作为驱动syt1和syt7多样释放模式的核心机制，适应更复杂的多传感器环境。
items.abstract: Neurotransmission critically depends on both timing and efficacy, enabling neurons to encode information with highly accuracy in millisecond timescales. While synapses often express multiple calcium sensors, such as synaptotagmin-1 (syt1) and synaptotagmin-7 (syt7), the quantitative mechanisms by which these sensors regulate synchronous release (SR) and asynchronous release (AR) remain unresolved. We develop a biophysically detailed stochastic model of a presynaptic bouton that incorporates the distinct calcium-binding kinetics of syt1 and syt7 to dissect their roles in shaping synaptic release. We demonstrate how a rich repertoire of SR and AR patterns is influenced by calcium channel distribution, sensor quantity, the external calcium concentration and buffer properties. Importantly, the interplay between syt1 and syt7-- through their distinct calcium affinities and exocytotic kinetics -- constitutes a core mechanism for neural transmission. These findings establish calcium partitioning as a core mechanism driving the diverse release patterns of syt1 and syt7, accommodating even more complex multi-sensor environments.
items.authors: Li, Y.; Lallouette, J.; Hepburn, I.; Chen, W.; De Schutter, E.

items.title: Trajectory of Hyper IgE complications
items.title_zh: 高免疫球蛋白E综合征并发症的自然史研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在定义高免疫球蛋白E综合征的自然历史。我们利用USIDNET注册库识别高免疫球蛋白E综合征患者，评估所有患者而不考虑遗传病因。通过提取问题清单或ICD编码中的并发症信息，并记录每个并发症的发生日期，从而估算其发生年龄。结果显示，该队列中许多已知并发症再次出现，但最令人担忧的并发症较为少见，发展迟缓和精神病影响了近五分之一的患者，这是之前未曾报道的。随着高免疫球蛋白E综合征成人患者数量的增加，关注晚发并发症显得尤为重要。曲霉菌感染和气胸的发生率低于其他队列，但精神病的显著发生率将对临床医生构成重大挑战。
items.abstract: Abstract Objective Our objective was to define the natural history of hyper IgE syndrome. Well, there have been a number of large cross-sectional studies. It has been difficult to provide anticipatory care for the growing adult population. Methods The USIDNET registry was used to identify patients with hyper IgE syndrome. We evaluated all patients regardless of genetic etiology. Complications were extracted as text from the problem list or ICD codes, and each complication was date stamped, which allowed us to estimate the age at which the complication arose. Results Many of the complications previously identified were seen in this cohort. The most feared complications were uncommon, however, developmental delay and psychosis affected nearly a fifth of the cohort which has not been previously reported. Conclusions As the number of adults with hyper IgE syndrome increases our awareness of late onset complications is important. Aspergillus and pneumatoceles were less common than seen in some other cohorts. However, the significant rate of psychosis will represent a significant challenge for clinicians.

items.title: Epigenetic Effects of HIV and Childhood Maltreatment in Women
items.title_zh: HIV与儿童虐待对女性表观遗传影响研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：HIV感染者经历不良儿童经历的比例显著高于普通人群，这与长期的身心健康后果相关。DNA甲基化作为一种可遗传、相对稳定且可量化的表观遗传机制，可能有助于理解HIV和儿童创伤如何在生物上嵌入并影响疾病风险。方法：本研究旨在识别与HIV和儿童虐待评分相关的甲基组特征，研究对象为南非女性。对238名女性的血样进行DNA甲基化分析，使用Illumina Infinium EPIC V2试剂盒。对HIV和儿童虐待评分进行区域DNA甲基化分析，并进行加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），以确定相关的共表达模块。最后，对最显著的网络模块进行因果中介分析以澄清关联方向。结果：HIV状态与儿童虐待评分之间的关系尚未完全明确。
items.abstract: Introduction: People with HIV have disproportionately higher rates of adverse childhood experiences compared to the general population. This, in turn, is linked to long-term physical and mental health consequences. DNA methylation - a heritable, reasonably stable and quantifiable epigenetic mechanism implicated in gene silencing - may offer a useful lens that helps understand how HIV and childhood trauma become biologically embedded and affect disease risk profiles. Methods: This study aimed to identify regional and network level methylomic signatures associated with HIV and childhood maltreatment scores in South African women who bear the highest dual burden. DNA methylation profiling using the Illumina Infinium EPIC V2 kit was performed on DNA extracted from blood samples of 238 women with or without HIV with varying levels of childhood maltreatment. Regional DNA methylation analyses, composed of correlation tests on specific CpG sites and on genetic regions, were conducted for each of HIV and childhood maltreatment scores. items.title: ACE2 Polymorphisms rs2285666 and rs147311723 Are Clinically Relevant Variants in SARS-CoV-2 and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Co-infection.
items.title_zh: ACE2多态性rs2285666和rs147311723在SARS-CoV-2与结核共感染中的临床相关性
items.summary_zh: 背景：严重急性呼吸综合症冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）主要通过血管紧张素转化酶2（ACE2）受体进入宿主细胞。ACE2基因的遗传变异可能影响COVID-19期间宿主的炎症反应和临床结果。结核病（TB）则通过干扰素刺激提高ACE2表达水平。本研究旨在探讨ACE2基因中特定单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与SARS-CoV-2和结核分枝杆菌共感染的易感性及严重性之间的关系。方法：本回顾性横断面研究纳入了2020年9月至2023年12月在喀麦隆雅温得四家医院招募的120名有症状个体。参与者分为四组：COVID-19、TB、TB/COVID-19共感染及感染阴性对照。通过RT-PCR和标准微生物学方法确认诊断。定量测定血清生化标志物和细胞因子，并使用TaqMan检测ACE2多态性。结果：统计分析显示ACE2表达与炎症或生化标志物之间存在显著关联，尤其是rs147311723。多个ACE2多态性（rs6632677、rs147311723、rs4646140、rs2285666和rs4646142）显著相关。
items.abstract: Background: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) enters host cells primarily through the angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor. Genetic variation in the ACE2 gene may influence host inflammatory responses and clinical outcomes during COVID-19. Tuberculosis (TB) on the other hand increases the level of ACE2 expression through interferon stimulation. The objective of this study was to investigate the association between specific single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in the ACE2 gene and their impact on susceptibility to and severity of SARS-CoV-2 and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Co-infection. Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 120 symptomatic individuals recruited between September 2020 and December 2023 from four hospitals in Yaounde, Cameroon. Participants were classified into four groups: COVID-19, TB, TB/COVID-19 co-infection, and infection-negative controls. Diagnoses were confirmed using RT-PCR and standard microbiological methods. items.title: Using Routine Ventilator Data to Visualize and Quantify Dynamic Compliance Trends Post-Surfactant Therapy in Preterm Infants: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.title_zh: 利用常规呼吸机数据可视化早产儿表面活性剂治疗后动态顺应性趋势
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用16名患有呼吸窘迫综合征的早产儿的常规呼吸机数据，采用移动中位数滤波器平滑表面活性剂给药后的动态顺应性轨迹，并使用四参数逻辑模型进行特征分析。结果显示，10名婴儿的顺应性呈现S型改善。在接受第二剂表面活性剂的11名婴儿中，有6名显示出后续改善。这表明该方法可以可视化和量化个体的顺应性恢复，作为传统临床指标的补充工具。
items.abstract: Using routinely recorded ventilator data from 16 preterm infants with respiratory distress syndrome, dynamic compliance trajectories after surfactant administration were smoothed with a moving-median filter and characterized with a four-parameter logistic model; 10 infants showed sigmoidal improvement, and among 11 infants who received a second surfactant dose, 6 showed subsequent improvement, suggesting that this approach can visualize and quantify individual compliance recovery as a complementary tool to conventional clinical indicators.
items.authors: Higashiyama, H.

items.title: ACTH-independent hypercortisolism across the cardiometabolic spectrum
items.title_zh: 心血管代谢谱中ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：越来越多的证据表明，心血管代谢风险因素患者中高皮质醇血症的发生率远高于以往认为。本研究旨在评估心血管代谢风险谱中ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症的流行情况。方法：参与者被前瞻性招募为三组，接受肾上腺生理的规范评估：1）正常血压参与者；2）高血压和肥胖但无糖尿病的参与者；3）糖尿病及超重/肥胖参与者。所有参与者（n=216）接受了过夜1 mg地塞米松抑制测试、促肾上腺皮质激素刺激测试和24小时尿游离皮质醇测试。ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症定义为地塞米松后血清皮质醇>1.8 g/dL（50 nmol/L），同时地塞米松后ACTH<10 pg/mL（2.2 pmol/L）。结果：216名参与者中有16名（7.4%）被发现有ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症，其中正常血压组5.6%（4/71），高血压-肥胖组6.2%（5/81），糖尿病-肥胖组10.9%（7/64）。年龄、体重指数、糖化血红蛋白、血压、肾功能、晨间ACTH和24小时尿游离皮质醇在有无ACTH独立性高皮质醇血症者之间相似。
items.abstract: Background: Accumulating evidence suggests that the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with cardiometabolic risk factors is much higher than previously thought. This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of ACTH-independent hypercortisolism across the spectrum of cardiometabolic risk. Methods: Participants were prospectively recruited into three cohorts to undergo protocolized assessment of adrenal physiology:1) normotensive participants; 2) participants with hypertension and obesity, but without diabetes; 3) participants with diabetes and overweight/obesity. All participants (n=216) underwent overnight 1 mg dexamethasone suppression testing followed by cosyntropin stimulation test, and 24-hour urine free cortisol (UFC) testing. ACTH-independent hypercortisolism was defined as post-dexamethasone serum cortisol >1.8 g/dL (50 nmol/L) with a concomitant post-dexamethasone ACTH [ ]10 pg/mL (2.2 pmol/L). Result: 16 of 216 (7.4%) participants were found to have ACTH-independent hypercortisolism, including 5.6% (4/71) in the normotensive cohort, 6.2% (5/81) in the hypertension-obesity cohort and 10.9% (7/64) in the diabetes-obesity cohort. items.title: A De Novo, Intragenic Modifier in Cis Rescues Scn8a-N1768D Epilepsy and Defines a Therapeutic Window Bounded by Gain- and Loss-of-Function
items.title_zh: 新型顺式修饰因子拯救Scn8a-N1768D癫痫并界定治疗窗口
items.summary_zh: SCN8A基因编码NaV1.6，其功能变异导致早发性、耐药性癫痫及发育性脑病。研究表明，NaV1.6的过量或不足均有害，因此降低NaV1.6的治疗需在狭窄窗口内进行。我们对携带Scn8a-N1768D的C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J同系群进行表征，发现一个紧密连锁的顺式修饰因子(L)，将严重表型转变为分级结果。在98.4% C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J背景下的N1768D纯合子中，分离出三种表型：短命(SL)小鼠、长命(LL)小鼠和后肢瘫痪(HP)小鼠。遗传分析显示第二个位点(L)与Scn8a紧密连锁并共分离。海马RNA-seq结果显示Scn8a mRNA呈剂量依赖性减少：SL组无表达，LL组减少30%，HP组减少70%。长读长三重DNA测序发现Scn8a编码外显子15中存在一个新型2-bp移码突变，导致提前终止密码子，预计会触发无义介导降解。
items.abstract: Gain-of-function variants in SCN8A, encoding NaV1.6, cause developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with early-onset, drug-resistant seizures. SCN8A is a Goldilocks gene: both excess and deficit of NaV1.6 are deleterious, so therapies that lower NaV1.6 must operate within a narrow window. Here we characterize a congenic C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J colony carrying Scn8a-N1768D and identify a tightly linked, cis-acting modifier (L) that converts a severe phenotype into graded outcomes. Among N1768D homozygotes on a 98.4% C3H/HeJ.C57BL/6J background, three phenotypes segregate: short-lived (SL) mice with early lethal tonic-clonic seizures (TCS), long-lived (LL) mice with delayed onset and reduced seizure burden, and hindlimb-paralysis (HP) mice with early death. Heterozygotes separate into D/+ SL mice, which develop spontaneous TCS and die of epilepsy, and D/+ LL mice, which lack spontaneous TCS and epilepsy-related death. Genetic analysis places a second locus (L) tightly linked to Scn8a and co-segregating with phenotype. items.title: A transitional senescence program drives inflammatory monocyte state expansion in aging humans
items.title_zh: 衰老人类中炎症单核细胞状态扩展的过渡性衰老程序
items.summary_zh: 功能失调的单核细胞状态与年龄相关的病理和全身炎症有关，但调控这些状态转变的基因调控网络尚不清楚。本研究采用大规模和单细胞多维整合分析，揭示了人类衰老过程中未被表征的单核细胞状态转变。我们发现，源自经典CD14++ CD16-单核细胞的短暂衰老样群体驱动了衰老人类中炎症单核细胞状态的积累。该衰老相关转变由主衰老调控因子AP-1协调，AP-1作用于预先建立的染色质结构，重新连接单核细胞转录因子网络，并激活衰老和年龄相关的炎症转录程序。通过与临床转录组数据集的整合，我们证明衰老样和老年单核细胞在转录上已准备好向败血症相关状态转变。总体而言，本研究提供了单核细胞中衰老样过渡状态的核心基因调控原则，并将AP-1确定为调节衰老和疾病中全身炎症的有吸引力的靶点。
items.abstract: Dysfunctional monocyte states contribute to age-related pathologies and systemic inflammation. However, the gene regulatory networks governing the transition to these states remain unknown. Here we used bulk and single-cell multidimensional integrative profiling to reveal previously uncharacterized monocyte state transitions during human aging. We show that a transient senescent-like population arising from classical CD14++ CD16- monocytes drives the accumulation of an inflammatory monocyte state in aging humans. This senescence-associated transition is orchestrated by the master senescence regulator AP-1, which acts on a pre-established chromatin landscape to rewire the monocyte transcription factor (TF) network and activate both senescence- and age-associated inflammatory transcriptional programs. Through integration with clinical transcriptomic datasets, we demonstrate that senescent-like and aged monocytes are transcriptionally primed toward sepsis-associated states. items.authors: Vasilopoulos, T.; Turano, P. S.; Garza-Martinez, L.; Akbulut, E.; Konda, M.; Herbig, U.; Fitzgerald-Bocarsly, P.; Martinez Zamudio, R. I.

items.title: Capturing Social Prescribing in Primary Care Health Records: A Study of Coding Practices in England
items.title_zh: 初级医疗记录中社会处方的编码实践研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：社会处方在英格兰及国际上迅速发展，但收集一致的数据以监测和评估其影响仍然具有挑战性。方法：本研究使用了来自英格兰临床实践研究数据链接（CPRD）Aurum的常规数据。通过UpSet图描述不同社会处方编码之间的交集，以及社会处方与其他非临床干预之间的关系。在识别潜在问题交集后，采用多层回归模型分析不同全科诊所之间的变异，并理解与潜在编码问题相关的因素。发现：2019年至2025年间，CPRD Aurum记录了约380万次涉及社会处方编码的咨询。社会处方编码大多单独记录（38.1%），但不同编码之间及与相关非临床支持之间存在交集。这些交集反映了社会处方路径中的合理阶段和情境。然而，一些编码模式显得模糊或可能不一致，特别是与社会处方的提供和转诊相关的编码。多层回归模型的结果表明，这些编码的变异中有28.4%-34.6%是由于属性造成的。
items.abstract: Background: Social prescribing has expanded rapidly in England and internationally. However, the collection of consistent data to monitor and evaluate its reach and impact remains to be challenging. Methods: This study used routine data from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum in England. UpSet plots were used to describe intersections among different social prescribing codes, and between social prescribing and other non-clinical interventions. After identifying potential problematic intersections, we fitted multilevel regression models to examine variation between general practices and to understand factors associated with potentially problematic coding. Findings: Between 2019 and 2025, approximately 3.8 million consultations involving social prescribing codes were recorded in CPRD Aurum. Social prescribing codes were most often recorded individually (38.1%), but intersections existed both among different social prescribing codes, and between social prescribing and related non-clinical support. items.authors: Bu, F.; Fancourt, D.

items.title: Magnetic Resonance Elastography of Regional Aortic Mechanics and True- and False-Lumen Stiffness in Aortic Dissection: A Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 主动脉夹层区域机械特性及腔体刚度的磁共振弹性成像研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：区域主动脉机械特性及真腔与假腔的机械环境不能仅通过最大直径表示。本研究评估磁共振弹性成像（MRE）在胸主动脉夹层中提供降主动脉刚度估计及区分真腔与假腔的可行性。方法：在10名健康受试者及2名慢性B型主动脉夹层患者中获取60Hz的降主动脉MRE数据。通过三种运动编码方向和四个时间偏移量生成一阶谐波复合波场。经过方向滤波后，沿主动脉掩膜追踪曲线中心线。局部空间频率沿弧长估计并转换为有效剪切刚度。主要区域结果为每个区域质量排名切片的中心20%-90%路径的平均有效刚度。在夹层中，整个主动脉掩膜和瓣膜在注册的矢状面上定义；血管外科医生分配真腔与假腔，分别手动中心化腔体路径。结果：所有10个区域数据集及56个可用切片均成功处理。10名健康志愿者的平均年龄为26.6±4.6岁。
items.abstract: Objective Regional aortic mechanics and the mechanical environments of the true and false lumens are not represented by maximal diameter alone. We evaluated whether magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) could provide paired descending thoracic and abdominal aorta stiffness estimates and separate true- and false-lumen estimates in thoracic aortic dissection. Methods We acquired 60-Hz descending thoracic and abdominal aortic MRE data in 10 healthy subjects and in 2 patients with chronic type B aortic dissections. Three motion-encoding directions and four temporal offsets were reduced to first-harmonic complex wave fields. After directional filtering, we traced a curved centerline through the aortic mask. Local spatial frequency was estimated along arc length and converted to effective shear stiffness. The primary regional outcome was the mean effective stiffness over the central 20%-90% of the path from the quality-ranked slice in each region. In dissection, the whole-aorta mask and flap were defined on a registered sagittal scout; a vascular surgeon assigned the true and false lumens, and separate, manually centered lumen paths followed one union-mask phase correction and unwrapping
items.authors: Hirad, A. A.; Dong, H.; Nanjappa, M.; Kedwai, B.; Thompson, K.; Kruger, J.; Chen, J.; Kolipaka, A.; Mix, D.

items.title: Altered EEG patterns co-vary with specific improvements in mind health at summer camp
items.title_zh: 夏令营中EEG模式变化与心理健康改善相关
items.summary_zh: 近年来，青少年的心理健康显著下降，主要与日常环境的变化有关。本文研究了30名青少年在为期三周的无设备、自然丰富的夏令营前后的脑电图（EEG）谱和复杂性指标。干预后，参与者表现出更陡的非周期性斜率、增加的DFA标度指数、降低的熵和Lempel-Ziv复杂性，以及减少的α波和β波功率，这表明神经动态向更有结构或更少随机的状态转变，表现出相对更强的抑制影响。这些神经变化与23名参与者的自我报告的心理健康数据相一致，表现为减少的躁动和多动、改善的注意力、睡眠质量及整体心理健康。精确分析进一步确认了这种关系的特异性。
items.abstract: The mental health and wellbeing or `mind health', which we define as the ability to navigate challenges and function productively, of adolescents has declined substantially over the last two decades corresponding with fundamental changes in their daily environments. These include the widespread adoption of smartphones and social media as well as reduced sleep and time spent in nature. Device free, nature-rich summer camps represent a shift in environment that has been shown to have behavioral and mental health benefits. However, neural mechanisms underlying these changes remain unknown. Here we examined EEG spectral and complexity measures in adolescents ( N=30) before and after a three-week device-free, nature-rich residential summer camp. Following the intervention, participants exhibited steeper aperiodic slopes, increased DFA scaling exponents, reduced entropy and Lempel-Ziv complexity, and decreased alpha and beta power, a convergent pattern consistent with a shift toward more structured or less random neural dynamics characterized by relatively greater inhibitory influence. items.authors: Subramaniyam, N.; Brown, R.; Gibbens, E.; Forche, A.; Dirks, C.; Newson, J.; Thiagaraja, T.

items.title: A large language model for risk-of-bias assessment in systematic reviews of prognosis studies in clinical neurology
items.title_zh: 用于神经病学预后研究系统评价偏倚风险评估的大型语言模型
items.summary_zh: 背景：偏倚风险（ROB）评估是系统评价的重要组成部分，但这一任务通常重复性高、耗时且缺乏评审者间一致性。大型语言模型（LLMs）为系统评价的自动化提供了机会，可能加快研究综合的质量和一致性。方法：我们设计了一种基于LLM的管道，作为“预后研究质量评估”（QUIPS）框架的人类评审者的虚拟模拟，采用零样本提示。我们将该管道应用于已发表系统评价中的文章，专注于神经学领域的预后研究。我们研究了（1）LLM与原始人类ROB评估之间的评审者间一致性，以及（2）原始人类ROB评估之间的一致性。结果：纳入了来自15篇综述的298篇文章，涵盖癫痫、创伤性脑损伤和中风三个领域。尽管LLM与人类评审者的一致性有限（Cohen加权kappa=0.22，95% CI，0.12-0.33），我们的数据初步表明，基于小样本（n=5），其可能不劣于人类评审者之间的一致性（Cohen加权kappa=-0.25，95% CI，-1.04-0.54）。Wilcoxon符号秩检验在统计上显著。
items.abstract: Background: Risk-of-bias (ROB) assessments represent an integral component of systematic reviews. However, this task is often highly repetitive, time-consuming, and may lack inter-rater consistency. Large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities for automation in systematic reviews, which may expedite and enhance the quality and consistency of research synthesis. Methods: Using zero-shot prompting, we designed an LLM-based pipeline as a virtual mimic of a human reviewer for the Quality in Prognosis Studies (QUIPS) framework. Then, focusing on prognostic research in a single discipline (neurology), we applied this pipeline to articles included in previously published systematic reviews. We studied inter-rater agreement between both (1) the LLM and the original human ROB assessments and (2) between original human ROB assessments. Results: 298 articles from 15 reviews across three domains (epilepsy, traumatic brain injury, stroke) were included. We demonstrate the feasibility of a tailored, prompt-engineered LLM pipeline for automating ROB assessments with the QUIPS tool. items.authors: Kampman, S. L.; Braun, K. P.; Otte, W. M.

items.title: Priming effects of ketone monoester supplementation on theta-burst stimulation-induced plasticity in the primary motor cortex: a randomized placebo-controlled crossover study
items.title_zh: 酮单酯补充对初级运动皮层塑性的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了酮单酯（KME）补充对经颅磁刺激（TMS）诱导的初级运动皮层（M1）可塑性的影响。44名健康年轻成年人参与了随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的交叉研究，分为两组接受间歇性和连续的θ波刺激（iTBS/cTBS）。参与者在两次实验中分别饮用KME或安慰剂，随后进行TBS刺激。结果显示，KME显著提高了血液中的β-羟基丁酸（BHB）和心率，同时降低了血糖和舒张压。KME未改变静息运动阈值、基线运动诱发电位（MEP）幅度或延迟。因子分析未发现KME对TBS后MEP时间过程的显著影响。
items.abstract: Neurological and cardiovascular disorders frequently coexist, yet targeted dual-system interventions remain underinvestigated. Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), including intermittent and continuous theta-burst stimulation (iTBS/cTBS), non-invasively modulates primary motor cortex (M1) excitability. Concurrently, ketone monoesters (KME) show neuroprotective potential and alter cardiovascular hemodynamics. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover study, 44 healthy young adults were stratified to receive iTBS or cTBS (n = 22/group). Participants completed two sessions separated by 1 week, consuming either a KME or placebo beverage, followed by TBS 1-hour post-ingestion. Motor evoked potentials (MEPs) from the right first dorsal interosseous muscle were tracked for 30 minutes post-stimulation. Blood pressure was measured every 3-5 minutes, heart rate was monitored continuously, and venous blood was sampled for glucose, beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB), pro-BDNF, mature BDNF (mBDNF), and the BDNF rs6265 polymorphism. items.title: Losses outlast gains in Northern Hemisphere tree growth under climate change
items.title_zh: 气候变化下北半球树木生长的损失超过收益
items.summary_zh: 在气候变化的背景下，北半球森林的生长趋势因地区而异，整体方向不明。本文通过分析自1902年以来记录的4110个北半球树木年轮年表，涵盖超过1200万次年轮宽度测量，学习非线性气候与树木生长的关系，并在CMIP6情景下预测其在21世纪的发展。结果显示，预计生长将下降，收益和损失在时间上不对称：一旦出现损失，几乎无法逆转（保留率90%），而收益则会减弱（保留率56%）。这种不对称在每个样本充分的区域均存在，并在更高的强迫下加剧。生长下降主要受气温上升和大气水分需求增加的驱动，其负面影响超过了降水带来的收益。整体来看，北半球的树木生长趋势是持续向下的。
items.abstract: Under climate change, will forests grow more or less? The answer differs from place to place, obscuring the overall direction. Here we trace it by learning nonlinear climate--tree-growth relationships from 4110 Northern Hemisphere tree-ring chronologies recorded since 1902, spanning more than 12 million ring-width measurements, and projecting them through the twenty-first century under CMIP6 scenarios. Projected growth declines, and gains and losses are temporally asymmetric: once losses emerge, they are rarely reversed (90% retained), whereas gains fade (56% retained). This asymmetry holds in every well-sampled region and strengthens under higher forcing. The decline itself is driven by warming and rising atmospheric water demand, whose broadly negative contribution outweighs precipitation-driven gains. Across the Northern Hemisphere, growth does not just move between gains and losses; it is drawn steadily downward.
items.authors: Feuer, E.; Klesse, S.; Amir, G.; Peleg, N.; Mau, Y.

items.title: A new class of inherently efficient SUMOylation substrates
items.title_zh: 一种新型高效SUMO化底物的研究
items.summary_zh: SUMO化是一种重要的真核生物类泛素后转录修饰，参与调控多种核内过程和应激反应。传统上，SUMO化发生在位于内在无序区域或环中的赖氨酸残基上，且与SUMO结合酶UBC9特异性相互作用。然而，许多已检测到的SUMO化位点位于结构域内，如何被UBC9识别仍不清楚。本研究探讨了人类ZBTB38的BTB结构域中位于刚性β-折叠内的赖氨酸43的SUMO化。通过结合X射线晶体学、结构预测及体外UBC9相互作用和SUMO化实验，我们发现ZBTB38BTB具有专门的表面，重现了经典线性共识基序的空间排列。该表面以中微摩尔亲和力结合UBC9，并预测将赖氨酸43定位于其活性位点以实现高效SUMO化。结构模型和序列分析表明，这一特性在脊椎动物ZBTB蛋白家族的五个成员（10%）的BTB结构域中共享，揭示了ZBTBBTB结构域子集的一个新特性。动力学分析显示，在所用反应条件下，ZBTB38BTB的催化效率。
items.abstract: SUMOylation is an essential eukaryotic ubiquitin-like post-translational modification that plays a central role in the regulation of various nuclear processes and stress responses. It canonically occurs at lysine residues within {Psi}KXE consensus motifs that lie in intrinsically disordered regions or loops and interact specifically with the SUMO-conjugating E2 enzyme UBC9. However, many detected SUMOylation sites are found within structured domains, and it remains unclear how these are recognised by UBC9. Here, we investigated the SUMOylation of Lys43 in the BTB domain of human ZBTB38 (ZBTB38BTB), a lysine located within a rigid {beta}-sheet. By combining X-ray crystallography, structural prediction, and in-vitro UBC9 interaction and SUMOylation assays, we show that ZBTB38BTB possesses a dedicated surface that recapitulates the spatial arrangement of residues found in canonical linear consensus motifs. This surface binds UBC9 with mid-micromolar affinity and is predicted to position Lys43 in its active site for efficient SUMOylation. Structural modelling and sequence analyses suggest that this property is shared by BTB domains of five members (10%) of the ZBTB-protein family acros

items.title: PRISM: Phase-Resolved Isotropic Subtraction Mapping for Automated Multi-Phase CT Digital Subtraction Angiography
items.title_zh: PRISM：相位分辨各向同性减法映射用于自动化多相CT数字减影血管造影
items.summary_zh: 多相对比增强计算机断层扫描（CT）是肾细胞癌（RCC）表征的金标准，但临床解读依赖于主观的相位视觉比较。我们提出了PRISM（相位分辨各向同性减法映射），这是一个开源自动化管道，将多相CT采集转换为注册的数字减影血管造影（DSA）体积及其彩色增强图。PRISM集成了六个处理阶段：1）DICOM加载及自动对比相位分类，2）基于深度学习的各向同性插值，3）使用TotalSegmentator v2进行自动肾脏分割，4）基于增强的组织检测，5）使用SimpleITK的三步可变形配准（刚性、仿射、B样条），6）双通道数字减影可视化。我们进行了系统的参数优化研究，涵盖五位患者和五个实验的200次配准。关键发现：我们确定了一种高效的配准配置，结合40 mm B样条网格（在计算成本降低36%的情况下，质量在6%内接近30 mm的最佳质量），5%度量采样（在3.2倍加速下质量相当于25%），以及单层多分辨率金字塔（避免了4,2金字塔的5.4倍开销而无质量收益）。
items.abstract: Multi-phase contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) is the gold standard for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) characterization, yet clinical interpretation relies on subjective visual comparison across phases. We present PRISM (Phase-Resolved Isotropic Subtraction Mapping), an open-source automated pipeline that transforms multi-phase CT acquisitions into registered digital subtraction angiography (DSA) volumes with color-coded enhancement maps. PRISM integrates six sequential processing stages: (1) DICOM loading with automated contrast-phase classification, (2) deep learning-based isotropic interpolation via RIFE, (3) automated kidney segmentation using TotalSegmentator v2, (4) enhancement-based tissue detection, (5) three-step deformable registration (rigid, affine, B-spline) using SimpleITK, and (6) dual-channel digital subtraction visualization. We present a systematic parameter optimization study comprising 200 registrations across five patients and five experiments.
