items.authors: Rodriguez, R.; Ramirez, R.; Rathore, H.

items.title: Lightweight Frequency-Gated Enhancement of nnU-Net Improves Data Efficiency in Nasal Sinus CT Segmentation
items.title_zh: 轻量级频率门控增强的nnU-Net提升鼻窦CT分割的数据效率
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：从CT自动分割鼻腔和鼻窦有助于诊断和手术规划，但该领域的临床数据集仍然较小，影响训练稳定性和评估有效性。本研究探讨自适应频率-空间双流网络（AFS-DSN）的频域机制是否可以以轻量级形式转移到自配置的nnU-Net框架中，以及所产生的性能提升是否经过严格统计验证。我们将AFS-DSN的频率分支和跨域注意机制整合到nnU-Net中，并修正了原设计中的零初始化门控死锁，使用修正后的模型（v2）作为基础。我们评估了三种变体：X1为输入条件的可学习谱门，应用于24个小波子带；X2增加了边界距离训练目标；X3结合了X1和X2。实验使用130个体积的NasalSeg CT数据集，采用完整的91/19/20协议和重建的真实3折交叉验证。结果显示，所有变体在完整协议下均表现出小幅但统计上显著的提升，X3的Dice分数为95.78%，而基线nnU-Net为95.59%。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Automatic segmentation of the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses from CT aids diagnosis and surgical planning, but clinical datasets in this domain remain small, which can affect training stability and evaluation validity. This study investigates whether the frequency-domain mechanisms of the Adaptive Frequency-Spatial Dual-Stream Network (AFS-DSN) can be transferred, in a lightweight form, into the self-configuring nnU-Net framework, and whether the resulting performance improvement survives rigorous statistical validation. We integrated the AFS-DSN frequency branch and cross-domain attention mechanism into nnU-Net, and corrected a zero-initialization gating deadlock in the original design, using the corrected model (v2) as a common base. On this base, we evaluated three variants: X1, an input-conditioned learnable spectral gate applied to 24 wavelet sub-bands; X2, which adds a boundary-distance training objective; and X3, combining X1 and X2. Experiments used the 130-volume NasalSeg CT dataset, under a full 91/19/20 protocol and a rebuilt, genuine 3-fold cross-validation in which the training set for each fold was reduced by approximately 19%, from 91 t
items.authors: Chen, Y.-C.; Wan, S.-Y.

items.title: Motor Module-Guided Human-Machine Interaction Promotes Improvement of Neuromuscular Coordination and Reduction in Motor Impairment in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot Study
items.title_zh: 运动模块引导的人机交互促进慢性中风患者神经肌肉协调改善
items.summary_zh: 背景：中风常导致上肢运动障碍，包括异常的神经肌肉协调（即运动模块），影响独立关节控制和日常生活活动。传统康复主要针对运动缺陷，而非潜在的神经肌肉功能障碍，可能限制训练效果的迁移性。因此，我们提出了一种定制的运动模块引导的锻炼，通过人机交互改善神经肌肉协调并减少运动障碍。方法：五名慢性中风患者参与了为期六周的运动模块引导干预，学习选择性激活健康个体的肌肉群。此外，三名中风患者作为主动对照组完成了力量引导干预。采用标准化临床评估（如上肢Fugl-Meyer评估和动作研究手臂测试）在训练前后及一、三个月后进行评估。通过表面肌电图的非负矩阵分解量化神经肌肉协调，并在动态任务中使用运动捕捉系统评估关节间协调。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Stroke often leads to upper-extremity motor impairments, including abnormal neuromuscular coordination (i.e., motor modules), which reduce independent joint control and impair activities of daily living. Conventional rehabilitation mainly targets the resultant motor deficits (e.g., impaired movement) rather than the underlying neuromuscular dysfunction, potentially limiting transferability of gains beyond trained tasks. Therefore, we propose a customized, motor module-guided exercise facilitated by human-machine interaction to improve neuromuscular coordination and reduce motor impairment. Methods Five chronic stroke survivors with severe-to-mild upper extremity impairment participated in a six-week motor module-guided intervention in which they learned to selectively activate muscle groups identified in healthy individuals. In addition, three stroke survivors completed a force-guided intervention as an active control group. Standardized clinical assessments, including the Upper Extremity Fugl-Meyer Assessment and Action Research Arm Test, were performed before and after training and repeated one and three months later to assess retention. items.title: Integrative Genetic and Single-Cell Analysis Reveals Macrophages as Key Mediators Linking Aging and Osteoporosis
items.title_zh: 整合遗传与单细胞分析揭示巨噬细胞在衰老与骨质疏松中的关键作用
items.summary_zh: 骨质疏松是一种常见的与年龄相关的疾病，越来越多的证据表明其与衰老过程密切相关。本研究采用整合方法系统识别衰老与骨质疏松之间的关系，并揭示了介导这一关联的关键细胞类型和分子调节因子。通过对UK Biobank的表型数据进行观察性分析和孟德尔随机化分析，发现衰老与骨质疏松相互关联，彼此既是原因又是结果。我们通过整合全基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据与骨重塑的单细胞转录组图谱，识别出巨噬细胞作为介导这一关联的关键细胞类型，并发现骨髓中巨噬细胞的比例随年龄增长而减少。此外，利用共享遗传工具和加权共表达网络分析，揭示了调控这一交叉作用的新型分子调节因子。我们确定了TGFB1和新基因HNRNPUL1作为影响巨噬细胞分化和功能的关键调节因子。总之，本研究提供了衰老与骨质疏松之间双向关系的观察性和遗传证据，并揭示了由TGFB1和HNRNPUL1调控的以巨噬细胞为中心的机制，为与年龄相关的骨骼健康提供了新见解。
items.abstract: Osteoporosis is a highly prevalent age-related disorder, and accumulating evidence suggests that it does not arise in isolation but is intrinsically linked to the aging process. Here, we employed integrative methods to systematically identify the relationship between aging and osteoporosis, and uncover the critical cell types and molecular regulators that mediate this association. Observational analysis of phenotypic data from UK Biobank and Mendelian Randomization analysis of summary-level statistics revealed that aging and osteoporosis are interrelated, acting as both causes and effects of each other. We identified macrophages as the key cell types mediating this association by integration of GWAS data with a comprehensively assembled single-cell transcriptomic atlas of bone remodeling. And the percentage of macrophages from bone marrow decreases with age. Additionally, shared genetic tools and weight co-expression network analysis were employed to uncover novel molecular regulators underlying this crosstalk. We identified TGFB1 and a novel gene, HNRNPUL1, as key regulators that influence macrophages differentiation and function. In conclusion, our study provides observational an

items.title: The super El Niño is already wreaking havoc: here’s what’s in store
items.title_zh: 超级厄尔尼诺已造成严重影响：未来展望
items.summary_zh: 2026年的超级厄尔尼诺现象带来了极端天气，其影响可能与以往事件有所不同。研究表明，当前的气候模式和海洋温度异常可能导致更为剧烈的气候变化，影响全球多个地区的降水和气温。通过对历史数据的分析，科学家们发现，超级厄尔尼诺的强度与其引发的极端天气事件之间存在显著关联。预计未来几个月内，全球范围内将出现更多极端气候事件，特别是在热带地区。研究强调了监测和应对气候变化的重要性，以减轻其对生态和人类社会的影响。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 13 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02826-5 The extreme weather of this year’s mega El Niño could look different from past events.

items.title: From Geometry to Hierarchy: Charting the Dominant Modes of Human Cortical Function Through Development
items.title_zh: 从几何到层级：人类皮层功能主导模式的发展图谱
items.summary_zh: 人类皮层功能在宏观信息处理层级上呈现空间模式。该层级沿着感官-联想轴展开，一端为单模态感官区域，另一端为跨模态联想区。脑动力学的生物物理模型表明，该轴应与皮层解剖和几何的主导共振模式对齐，但实际上并不一致。我们使用四个独立的功能性磁共振成像数据集（涵盖0至21岁，共1512名参与者）显示，这种空间偏差源于长程皮层间区域功能耦合的成熟。具体而言，我们发现人类皮层在生命的前三到四年内的主导功能模式与皮层几何的 rostro-caudal 模式相似，随后在4至6岁之间转变为初步的感官-联想模式，并最终在13岁时成熟为典型的感官-联想模式。
items.abstract: Cortical function in the human cortex is spatially patterned along a macroscale information processing hierarchy. This hierarchy tracks a sensory-association axis anchored at one end by unimodal sensory regions and at the other by transmodal association areas. Biophysical models of brain dynamics suggest that this axis should align with the dominant, resonant modes of cortical anatomy and geometry, but they do not. Instead, the dominant anatomical modes correspond to simple spatial gradients extending along rostro-caudal, medio-lateral, and dorso-ventral axes. How does this divergence between anatomical and functional modes of the cortex arise? Here, using four independent functional magnetic resonance imaging datasets spanning infancy to young adulthood (n=1,512, aged 0-21 years), we show that this spatial divergence is attributable to the maturation of long-range cortico-cortical inter-regional functional coupling. Specifically, we find that the dominant functional mode of the human cortex during the first 3 to 4 years of life closely resembles the rostro-caudal mode of cortical geometry, then shifts to a rudimentary sensory-association-like mode between 4 and 6 years of age and

items.title: Delta rhythm and voice familiarity organize neural entrainment in the infant brain
items.title_zh: 婴儿大脑中的δ节律与声音熟悉度对神经同步的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了δ频率带（~0.5-3.5 Hz）在婴儿大脑中的神经同步机制，特别关注刺激的节奏性、频率特异性和声音熟悉度对听觉时间预测的影响。我们使用高密度脑电图（EEG）对30名6个月大的婴儿进行实验，观察他们在听到母亲或陌生人以δ（2 Hz）或θ（4 Hz）速率发出的有节奏音节时的神经同步反应。结果显示，听觉时间规律引发了广泛的额前颞部同步反应。重要的是，δ波段同步在额部和颞部区域表现出频率特异性，右额部的选择性在同步期间逐渐增强，表明该区域积极调整输入的时间模型。声音熟悉度进一步影响同步反应：左颞皮层对母亲的声音表现出选择性同步，而右额部对陌生人的声音则表现出选择性反应。
items.abstract: The delta frequency band (~0.5-3.5 Hz) represents a phylogenetically conserved tempo of biological communication, and neural entrainment to this timescale would be a key mechanism through which the brain might generate temporal predictions. While entrainment at different levels has been characterized in adults, the mechanisms of auditory temporal prediction remain poorly studied across developmental trajectories, particularly regarding the roles of stimulus rhythmicity, frequency specificity, and voice familiarity. Using high-density EEG, we examined neural entrainment in thirty 6-month-old infants exposed to vocally rhythmic syllables produced by their mother or a stranger at delta (2 Hz) or theta (4 Hz) rates, as well as a non-rhythmic control. Auditory temporal regularity elicited a broad frontotemporal entrainment response. Critically, delta-band entrainment was frequency-specific across frontal and temporal clusters, with right-frontal selectivity progressively strengthening throughout the entrainment period as expected if this region actively refines a temporal model of the input rather than passively resonating to it; no significant theta-band specificity was observed. items.title: Polar Geometry of Time-Odd EEG Dynamics
items.title_zh: 时间奇异脑电图动态的极性几何特征
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨多通道脑电图（EEG）是否包含一种在重复记录和较长间隔中仍能区分个体的时间奇异几何结构。我们构建了局部状态导数算子T_ij = corr(m_i, Delta x_j)，并提取其偏斜分量K = 1/2(T - T^T)。通过极分解K = Q_K M_K，我们将交互强度与归一化方向分离。我们还对有符号的虚部相干性Omega = Im(G)进行了相同的分解，提供了一种基于频域的测试。我们在四个公共的纵向EEG数据集中评估了跨会话的个体匹配，包括206名参与者的多特蒙德队列，记录间隔约为五年。结果显示，算子T的偏斜分量主导了其特性，极性方向提高了K在每个主要比较中的纵向可区分性。对于约一个月的RestCog间隔，接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）显著增加。
items.abstract: Abstract Objective. Longitudinal EEG recordings vary across sessions because of electrode reapplication, referencing, recording conditions, and physiological state. We asked whether multichannel EEG contains a time-odd geometric structure that remains subject-discriminative across repeated recordings and extended inter-session intervals. Approach. We constructed a local state-derivative operator T_ij = corr(m_i, Delta x_j) and isolated its exact skew component, K = 1/2(T - T^T). Polar decomposition, K = Q_K M_K, separated interaction magnitude from normalized orientation. We applied the same decomposition to signed imaginary coherency, Omega = Im(G), providing a frequency-domain test based on a separate estimation procedure. We evaluated cross-session subject matching in four public longitudinal EEG datasets, including the Dortmund cohort of 206 participants with recordings separated by approximately five years. Alpha-beta fusion used fixed equal weights without calibration or learned weighting. Main results. items.title: Testing the feasibility of a national respiratory swabbing tool in FluSurvey to support pandemic preparedness in England, 2025-26
items.title_zh: 评估英国流感监测自我采样工具的可行性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景 FluSurvey 是一个参与式监测系统，参与者每周报告呼吸道症状、医疗使用情况和社交接触。为支持快速公共卫生评估，我们开发了呼吸道自我采样功能。我们旨在评估有症状的 FluSurvey 参与者自我采样的可行性。方法 在 2026 年 1 月至 3 月期间，在英格兰部署了 FluSurvey 自我采样。报告近期急性呼吸道感染症状的成年人有资格进行 Covid-19、RSV 和流感的 PCR 检测，样本通过邮寄方式送回实验室。参与者收到可选的反馈调查。我们描述了采样兴趣、及时性和参与者人口统计特征，并评估参与者反馈以改进流程。结果 研究期间共有 234 例符合条件的疾病；45.7%（107/234）请求测试工具，93.5%（100/107）测试工具被归还。其中 97.0%（97/100）结果有效；参与者的中位年龄为 61.74 岁（IQR:47.4-67.4），68.4% 为女性，90.0% 为白人。所有九个地区均有代表。及时性高；从症状出现到样本日期的中位时间为 4.0 天（IQR:3.0-5.0）。完成反馈调查的参与者中，96.7%（59/61）表示愿意再次参与自我采样。结论 我们开发了一种工具来检测个体。
items.abstract: Background FluSurvey is a participatory surveillance system, through which participants report weekly respiratory symptoms, healthcare use and social contacts. To support rapid public health assessment we developed a respiratory self-swabbing feature. We aimed to assess the feasibility of self-swabbing among symptomatic FluSurvey participants. Methods FluSurvey self-swabbing was deployed in England between January-March 2026. Adults reporting recent Acute Respiratory Infection symptoms were eligible for a self-swabbing Covid-19, RSV and Influenza PCR test which was returned to the laboratory by post. Participants were sent optional feedback surveys. We described swabbing interest, timeliness and participant demographics. We evaluated participant feedback to improve the process. Results There were 234 eligible illnesses during the study period; 45.7% (107/234) requested test kits and 93.5%(100/107) test kits were returned. Of these, 97.0%(97/100) had valid results; median participant age was 61.74 years (IQR:47.4-67.4), 68.4% were female and 90.0% were of white ethnicity. All nine regions in England were represented. items.title: PDA Closure Rates and Safety after Repeated Courses of Cyclooxygenase Inhibitors in Preterm Infants: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 早产儿反复使用环氧合酶抑制剂后动脉导管未闭闭合率及安全性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：环氧合酶（COX）抑制剂用于治疗早产儿血流动力学显著的动脉导管未闭（PDA）。若初次治疗后PDA仍显著，则考虑再次使用COX抑制剂或手术干预。本系统评价研究了早产儿反复使用COX抑制剂后的PDA闭合率及安全性。方法：通过Embase、Medline及其他两数据库检索至2026年4月，纳入报告两次或以上使用COX抑制剂后PDA闭合率的研究。使用Joanna Briggs Institute工具评估偏倚风险。采用随机效应模型进行荟萃分析，计算PDA闭合比例，并使用多层次混合效应元回归比较不同治疗课程的闭合率。结果：共纳入33项研究。第一次、第二次和第三次使用COX抑制剂后的PDA闭合率分别为62%（95%置信区间[CI] 57-67%）、46%（95% CI 40-52%；与第一次比较p < 0.001）和38%（95% CI 27-51%；与第一次比较p = 0.001）。在大多数亚组中，反复治疗的闭合率均较低。
items.abstract: Background: Cyclooxygenase (COX) inhibitors have been used to treat hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) in preterm infants. If the PDA remains hemodynamically significant after an initial course, additional courses of COX inhibitors or surgical intervention are considered. This systematic review evaluates PDA closure rates and safety after repeated courses of COX inhibitors in preterm infants. Methods: Embase, Medline, and two other databases were searched through April 2026 (pre-registered in PROSPERO [CRD42023454003]). Studies reporting PDA closure rates after two or more courses of COX inhibitors were included. Risk of bias was assessed using Joanna Briggs Institute tools. Meta-analyses with random-effects models were performed to calculate the proportions of PDA closure. Multilevel mixed-effects meta-regression was used to compare closure rates across treatment courses while accounting for within-study correlations. Results: A total of 33 studies were included. items.title: Psychiatric partner resemblance and its socioeconomic component across the life course
items.title_zh: 伴侣精神疾病相似性及其社会经济成分的生命周期研究
items.summary_zh: 伴侣相似性影响并反映人类群体的社会、遗传和健康结构。我们利用丹麦注册数据分析了787,658对夫妻的伴侣相似性，涉及十种精神疾病和社会经济地位（SES），测量时间为首次生育前一年及整个生命周期。精神疾病伴侣相关性从饮食失调的0.08到精神分裂症的0.36，低于教育（0.63）和收入（0.57）。收入相似性在生命周期中显著下降（降至0.38），而教育相似性保持稳定。精神疾病相似性在不同时间窗口变化不大。调整精神疾病易感性以考虑自身SES降低了伴侣精神疾病相似性，而调整SES以考虑自身精神状态对SES伴侣相似性影响甚微。首次生育前伴侣精神疾病相似性中位数减少约7%，而生命周期内减少约26%，表明诊断和SES在个体内逐渐耦合。因此，伴侣精神疾病相似性所代表的含义取决于测量时间。
items.abstract: Partner resemblance influences and reflects the social, genetic and health structure of human populations. Using Danish registers on 787,658 couples, we quantified partner resemblance for ten psychiatric disorders and socioeconomic status (SES), measured up to a year before first childbirth and across the life course. Psychiatric partner correlations ranged from 0.08 for eating disorders to 0.36 for schizophrenia, below those for education (0.63) and income (0.57). Income resemblance fell substantially across the life course (to 0.38), whereas education resemblance was stable. Psychiatric resemblance changed little across windows. Adjusting psychiatric liability for own SES reduced psychiatric partner resemblance, whereas adjusting SES for own psychiatric status barely affected SES partner resemblance. The reduction in psychiatric partner resemblance had a median of ~7% before first childbirth but ~26% across the life course, as diagnosis and SES became increasingly coupled within individuals. What psychiatric partner resemblance represents therefore depends on when it was measured.
items.authors: Dehkordi, S. R.; Villumsen, M. D.; Helenius, D.; Peyrot, W. J.; Werge, T.; Buil, A.; Abdellaoui, A.

items.title: Adolescent engagement and sentiment toward reproductive-health videos on Chinese social media: a cross-sectional content analysis
items.title_zh: 青少年在中国社交媒体上对生殖健康视频的参与与情感分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：青少年对生殖健康信息的需求在社交媒体上日益增加，但在中国此类内容的范围、可信度和情感反应尚不明确。本研究考察了青少年如何在Bilibili这一视频分享平台上参与生殖健康视频，以识别信息缺口和影响在线讨论的因素。方法：通过18个关键词检索，我们获取了743个2016年9月至2024年6月间发布的Bilibili视频的元数据和用户生成文本。数据集包含4.868亿次观看、1230万次点赞和约76万条文本评论（评论加弹幕）。在去重和中文分词后，我们对参与度指标进行了描述性和Pearson相关分析，并应用大型语言模型（Qwen2.5-32B）对所有评论和弹幕进行三类情感分类。上传者的医学背景经过人工验证以确认其专业资格。结果：观看次数与点赞（r = 0.7）、收藏（r = 0.74）和分享（r = 0.74）之间存在强正相关；收藏和分享几乎呈线性关系（r = 0.9）。较少涉及的话题，如绝育手术（占视频的3.0%）和基于生育意识的方法。
items.abstract: Background Adolescent reproductive health information is increasingly sought on social-media platforms, yet the scope, credibility, and emotional reception of such content remain unclear in China. This study examined how adolescents engage with reproductive-health videos on Bilibili, a video-sharing site with about 341 million monthly users, most of whom are 24 years old or younger, to identify information gaps and factors shaping online discourse. Methods Using an 18-keyword query, we retrieved metadata and user-generated text for 743 Bilibili videos published between September 2016 and June 2024. The dataset contained 486.8 million views, 12.3 million likes, and approximately 760,000 textual entries (comments plus danmaku). After duplicate removal and chinese word segmentation, we conducted descriptive and Pearson-correlation analyses of engagement metrics and applied a three-class sentiment classifier, powered by the large language model (Qwen2.5-32B), to all comments and danmaku. The medical backgrounds of uploaders were manually verified to confirm their professional qualifications. items.title: Assessing and refining a metabolite-based distress score for use in different populations within three US cohorts
items.title_zh: 评估和完善代谢物基础的心理压力评分在不同人群中的应用
items.summary_zh: 引言：心理压力与代谢变化相关，这些变化会导致不同人群中不良的心脏代谢结果。我们之前在主要为白人女性的研究中开发了代谢物基础的心理压力评分（MDS）。由于男性和黑人个体的心脏代谢疾病发生率较高，我们评估了MDS在这些人群中与抑郁的关联，并在黑人个体中推导出多民族MDS（MDS-ME），并在独立样本中进行了验证。方法：数据来自三个美国队列，包括动脉粥样硬化多民族研究（MESA）、女性健康倡议（WHI）和护士健康研究（NHS），分四个阶段进行评估。结果：之前验证的20种代谢物MDS在白人（OR: 1.93, 95% CI: 1.71, 2.19）与黑人（OR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.97, 1.33）中与抑郁的关联更强。
items.abstract: Introduction: Psychological distress is associated with metabolic alterations that contribute to adverse cardiometabolic outcomes across diverse populations. We previously developed a metabolite-based distress score (MDS) in predominantly White women. Because men and Black individuals suffer high rates of cardiometabolic disease, we evaluated whether the MDS is similarly associated with depression in these populations, and derived a multi-ethnic MDS (MDS-ME) among Black individuals with replications in independent samples. Methods: Data were from three U.S. cohorts, the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA), Women's Health Initiative (WHI), and Nurses' Health Study (NHS), evaluated in 4 stages. Stages 1-3 included 2,477 White and 1,625 Black MESA participants with depression status data and plasma metabolomics assessed at baseline. Stage 1: We calculated the MDS and examined its association with depression status. Stage 2: We conducted an agnostic analysis among a 70% random subset of Black participants to identify additional relevant metabolites. Stage 3: We derived an MDS-ME in Black participants. items.title: Resolving the Genomic Context of Clinically Relevant Antibiotic Resistance Genes in Wastewater with Ligation-Mediated PCR
items.title_zh: 废水中临床相关抗生素耐药基因的基因组背景解析
items.summary_zh: 抗微生物耐药性（AMR）是全球公共卫生面临的重大挑战。抗生素耐药基因（ARGs）通过移动遗传元件在细菌群体中传播。进水废水是监测AMR的有前景样本类型，因为它汇集了个体的生物输入。本研究开发了一种连接介导的PCR（LM-PCR）富集策略，能够通过长读长测序定向捕获ARG周围的基因组背景。我们在华盛顿州的13个废水处理厂中应用该方法，研究了四种临床相关ARG（blaCTX-M、blaKPC、blaOXA-48-like和qnrS）的自然基因组背景多样性。LM-PCR在所有时间点识别出与每个ARG相关的不同基因组背景簇家族，包括blaKPC的七个、blaCTX-M的11个、qnrS的24个和blaOXA-48-like的一个。其中，24个qnrS簇中有11个被推测为新颖，与公共数据库中现有序列无匹配。与blaCTX-M和blaKPC相关的基因组背景在簇间相对保守，而qnrS则与更为多样的背景相关。
items.abstract: Abstract Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a pressing global public health challenge. AMR is driven in part by the spread of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) through bacterial communities via mobile genetic elements. Influent wastewater is a promising sample type for monitoring AMR because it pools biological inputs shed by individuals across a population. However, untargeted sequencing approaches, such as metagenomic sequencing, often miss low-abundance targets such as clinically important ARGs. In this work, we develop a ligation-mediated PCR (LM-PCR) enrichment strategy that can directionally capture the genomic context surrounding an ARG using long-read sequencing. We applied this method to study the natural genomic context diversity of four clinically relevant ARGs (blaCTX-M, blaKPC, and blaOXA-48-like, and qnrS) across 13 wastewater treatment plants in Washington state, each sampled at two timepoints. Across all timepoints, LM-PCR identified distinct genomic context cluster families associated with each ARG, including seven for blaKPC, 11 for blaCTX-M, 24 for qnrS, and one for blaOXA-48-like. items.title: Neural tracking of surprisal and semantic distance in naturalistic movie viewing
items.title_zh: 自然电影观看中的惊讶感与语义距离的神经追踪
items.summary_zh: 理解语言需要听众将输入与先前的语言和主题知识结合，以获取意义，这一过程受到预测的极大帮助。惊讶感与相关现象（如下一个词预测）通常与听觉过程中语言区域的广泛激活相关。我们对20名英语母语者在观看电影《500天的夏天》时的fMRI扫描进行了分析，重点关注大脑对惊讶感或语义距离的敏感性。通过实施一系列分层体素编码模型，我们发现，在控制低级听觉和视觉特征后，惊讶感或语义距离的加入提高了双侧上颞回、左侧下额回和右侧小脑的预测能力。关键是，语义距离和惊讶感在双侧大脑区域中解释了独特的变异。
items.abstract: Understanding speech requires listeners to integrate incoming input with prior linguistic and thematic knowledge to access meaning, a task greatly aided by prediction. Surprisal and related phenomena (e.g., next word prediction) tend to be associated with broad activation of language regions during listening. A major challenge for interpreting the neural correlates of surprisal is that lexical expectancies are constrained both by syntactic and semantic information. In contrast, semantic distance yields more of a pure metric of relatedness between one language constituent (e.g., word, phrase, n-gram) and another within a high-dimensional semantic space. We contrasted surprisal and semantic distance in running discourse during naturalistic audiovisual language comprehension. We analyzed fMRI scans from 20 English-speaking adults who viewed the full-length film 500 Days of Summer. Our focus was on brain sensitivity to either surprisal or semantic distance as language unfolded word-by-word. To this end, we implemented a series of hierarchical voxelwise encoding models. items.authors: O'Leary, R. M.; Smith, H. C.; Myers, E. B.; Reilly, J.; Peelle, J. E.

items.title: Reward expectation signals in the superior colliculus during associative learning
items.title_zh: 上丘在联想学习中的奖励预期信号研究
items.summary_zh: 预测未来奖励使得中性感官线索获得动机意义，并指导以最大化奖励获取为目标的行为。这些奖励预测在结果与预期不符时会更新，导致预测误差。中脑多巴胺神经元提供了奖励预测误差信号的经典神经相关性，并向多个脑区广播。这些学习到的奖励预测最终影响神经过程，使动物能够选择、准备和执行针对预期奖励的行为。奖励预期信号已在感官和运动回路中观察到，能够调节感官处理和行为选择及活力。上丘作为中脑中的感官运动区域，受到奖励背景的强烈影响。预期奖励调节视觉和运动前活动，学习到的物体价值塑造感官反应，近期奖励改变小鼠上丘的视觉处理。上丘还向中脑多巴胺神经元提供输入，并能够传递或获取影响多巴胺活性的条件感官反应。
items.abstract: Predicting future rewards allows neutral sensory cues to acquire motivational significance and guide goal-directed actions that maximise reward acquisition. These reward predictions are updated when outcomes differ from expectations resulting in an error in prediction. Midbrain dopamine neurons provide a canonical neural correlate of reward prediction error signal that are broadcast to multiple brain areas. These learned reward predictions ultimately influence neural processes that enable animals to select, prepare and execute actions towards expected rewards. Reward expectation signals have been observed across sensory and motor circuits where they can modulate sensory processing and action selection and vigor. This raises the question of how integrative sensorimotor circuits represent information about reward expectation alongside sensory and motor variables that drive reward-seeking actions. The superior colliculus (SC), a sensorimotor area in the midbrain traditionally associated with orienting and action selection, is strongly influenced by reward context. items.authors: Mutlu, S.; Das, A.; Tripodi, M.

items.title: Ancestree: unified likelihood inference of ancestral alleles under supplied or inferred genealogies
items.title_zh: Ancestree：统一的祖先等位基因似然推断方法
items.summary_zh: 推断祖先状态，即确定每个多态位点的祖先等位基因和衍生等位基因，是许多下游群体遗传分析的基础。然而，现有工具无法统一支持所有相关输入，包括普通变异数据或祖先重组图（ARG），且需兼容多等位基因和重复突变位点。本文介绍了Ancestree，一个基于似然的引擎，将这些输入统一在一个框架内，并返回每个位点四种核苷酸状态的完整后验分布。它有三种运行模式：固定树模式、ARG模式和局部树模式。模拟数据表明，基于谱系的模式（ARG和局部树）更准确且扩展性更好，并在违反固定树假设的外群配置下保持稳健。
items.abstract: Inferring ancestral states--determining, at each polymorphic site, which allele is ancestral and which derived--underpins many downstream population-genetic analyses, from selection scans and the unfolded site-frequency spectrum to demographic inference. However, no existing tool uniformly supports the full range of relevant inputs: plain variant data or ancestral recombination graphs (ARGs), with or without outgroups, while accommodating poly-allelic and recurrently-mutated sites. Here we present Ancestree, a likelihood-based engine that unifies these inputs within a single framework and returns full posteriors over the four nucleotide states at every site. It runs in three modes: a fixed-tree mode that assumes a single topology across sites and co-infers the per-branch substitution rates by maximum likelihood; an ARG mode that reads a different local tree at each site directly from a supplied ancestral recombination graph; and a local-tree mode that instead samples those local trees from the genotype data via a pairwise-coalescent HMM, needing no pre-existing ARG. On simulated data, the genealogy-based modes (ARG and local-tree) are more accurate and scale better, and remain robu
items.authors: Sendrowski, J.; Bataillon, T.

items.title: Cortical high frequency oscillations reflect encoding and retrieval of specific word concepts
items.title_zh: 皮层高频振荡反映特定词概念的编码与提取
items.summary_zh: 高伽马和涟漪频率振荡参与记忆痕迹的编码与回忆。通过对癫痫患者的颅内电极记录，我们检测到在不同任务中观看和记忆相同名词时的高频振荡突发。我们发现视觉感知区域的最低词响应选择性约为40%，而在更前部的联想区域选择性逐渐提高。相同的词组在筛选任务中被识别为优选词，在视觉呈现或自由回忆的另一任务中触发选择性反应，且在同一会话中没有感官刺激，第二天也能重复出现。我们证明了特定概念下大规模神经元集合的持续再激活在人的皮层中以高频振荡突发的形式反映出来。
items.abstract: High gamma and ripple frequency oscillations are engaged in encoding and recall of memory traces. Tracking specific traces with their signature neural activities across time and various tasks remains a major challenge. Using intracranial electrode recordings from epilepsy patients, we detected bursts of high-frequency oscillations in response to viewing and remembering the same common nouns in two different tasks repeated on subsequent days. We found the lowest word response selectivity of approximately 40% in the visual sensory areas and increasingly higher selectivity in the more anterior associational regions. The same word sets identified as preferred in a screening task triggered selective responses in another task during visual presentation or free recall with no sensory stimulation in the same session, and on the following day. We demonstrate that persistent reactivation of large-scale neuronal assemblies underlying particular concepts is reflected in bursts of high-frequency oscillations in the human cortex.
items.authors: Cimbalnik, J.; Prathapagiri, S.; Sarmiento-Rivera, L. F.; Jurkovicova, L.; Kojan, M.; Daniel, P.; Roman, R.; Czyzewski, A.; Brazdil, M.; Kucewicz, M. T.

items.title: An updated roadmap for brain-mental health associations in the UK Biobank
items.title_zh: 英国生物库中脑与心理健康关联的更新路线图
items.summary_zh: 英国生物库提供了一个前所未有的机会，以大规模研究脑成像与心理健康之间的关联，但其强度和可重复性仍不明确。我们在8,415名参与者中，分析了17,580个成像衍生表型与309个心理健康表型的相关性，分为发现和验证子集。结果显示，关联通常较小（中位数|r| = 0.018；前1%为0.108），且重复性差：仅9.0%的显著发现关联在验证中显著。饮食失调表现出最大的影响，但仅在6.0%的案例中重复，而物质使用的重复性最高（14.5%）。加权成像产生了最具可重复性的成像关联。脑与心理健康指标的纵向变化关系较弱。我们提供了一个互动仪表板，返回任何心理健康类别与成像模式组合的效应大小和可重复性基准，支持英国生物库研究中的变量选择和研究设计。
items.abstract: The UK Biobank offers an unprecedented opportunity to examine associations between brain imaging and mental health at scale, but their magnitude and replicability remain unclear. We correlated 17,580 imaging-derived phenotypes across seven MRI modalities with 309 mental health phenotypes in 8,415 participants, split into discovery and validation subsets. Associations were generally small (median |r| = 0.018; top 1% of 0.108), and they replicated poorly: only 9.0% of significant discovery associations were significant in validation. Eating disorders showed the largest effects of any mental disorders but replicated in only 6.0% of cases, whereas substance use showed the highest replication (14.5%). Susceptibility-weighted imaging produced the most replicable imaging associations. Longitudinal changes in brain and mental health measures were weakly related. We provide an interactive dashboard that returns the effect-size and replicability benchmarks for any combination of mental health category and imaging modality, supporting variable selection and study design in UK Biobank research.
items.authors: Li, X.; Khalife, S.; Oestreich, L. K. L.

items.title: Active Bed Microclimate Regulation Modulates Sleep Architecture, Autonomic, and Central Nervous System Activity during Sleep
items.title_zh: 主动床垫微气候调节影响睡眠结构与神经系统活动
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了床垫微气候对睡眠的影响，使用一款智能床具调节温度，研究对象为18名成年人（9名男性，9名女性，平均年龄44.5岁）。参与者在两次过夜多导睡眠监测中，床温通过拉丁方设计在高冷、中冷、低冷、关闭、低热和中热六种设置中轮换。混合效应回归模型评估了温度变化对睡眠与清醒状态及各睡眠阶段（N1、N2、N3、REM）的影响。结果显示，所有五种主动设置均显著加深睡眠，增加慢波睡眠的几率（几率比1.21至3.65，以高冷为最大），并降低轻度非快速眼动睡眠的几率。加热相较于冷却加速了早期睡眠的深化，而心率则随着冷却呈现逐步下降。
items.abstract: Skin temperature and bed microclimate are established modulators of human sleep, but most prior work has relied on passive thermal materials. We used a smart bed capable of heating or cooling the microclimate to investigate how six temperature settings affect sleep architecture, autonomic activity, and electroencephalographic (EEG) activity. Eighteen adults (9 male, 9 female; mean age 44.5 years) completed two overnight polysomnography sessions with bed temperature assigned via Latin-square counterbalancing across three-hour segments of high cooling, medium cooling, low cooling, off, low heating, and medium heating. Mixed-effects regression models evaluated manipulation checks on induced thermal changes, the probability of sleep versus wake, and the probability of each sleep stage (N1, N2, N3, REM), while secondary analyses assessed sleep deepening, heart rate, and EEG spectral power. Temperature manipulations significantly affected sleep and physiological outcomes. All five active settings shifted sleep toward greater depth, increasing the odds of slow-wave sleep (odds ratios 1.21 to 3.65, largest for high cooling) and reducing the odds of light non-rapid eye movement sleep relati
items.authors: Garcia Molina, G. N.; Rao, M. R.; Winger, T.; Chernega, P.; Shcherbakov, Y.; Veneros, E.; Reid, K. J.; Grimaldi, D.; Van Someren, E.; Zee, P.

items.title: DiffDose: Differentiable Programming for Personalized Dose-Regimen Optimal Control
items.title_zh: DiffDose：个性化给药方案的可微编程优化控制
items.summary_zh: 给药方案设计需要选择药物剂量、给药时间以及治疗在不同患者间的变化。机制性药代动力学-药效学（PK/PD）和定量系统药理学（QSP）模型能够预测治疗反应，但优化给药输入依赖于特定模型的灵敏度推导或无导数搜索。本文介绍了DiffDose，一个用于机制性开环给药方案优化的可微编程框架，利用自动微分（AD）处理临床可解释的剂量和给药时间作为可微控制变量。我们在三个场景中评估了该方法：在OptiDose PK/PD基准中的固定时间表剂量幅度优化；在具有状态依赖延迟的化疗诱导中性粒细胞减少症模型中的给药时机优化；以及在QSP虚拟人群中的个性化mosunetuzumab给药。通过这些例子，AD生成的梯度与参考结果一致，减少了模型特定的导数工作，并缩短了基准求解时间。因此，DiffDose将机制性PK/PD和QSP模型从评估预设方案的工具转变为基于梯度的个性化方案设计引擎。
items.abstract: Dose-regimen design requires choosing how much drug to give, when to give it, and how treatment should vary across patients. Mechanistic pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) and quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) models can predict treatment responses, but optimizing dosing inputs depends on model-specific sensitivity derivations or derivative-free search. Here, we introduce DiffDose, a differentiable programming framework for mechanistic open-loop dose-regimen optimization that uses automatic differentiation (AD) to handle clinically interpretable dose amounts and administration times as differentiable controls. We evaluate our method in three settings: fixed-schedule dose-amplitude optimization in OptiDose PK/PD benchmarks; dose-timing optimization in a chemotherapy-induced neutropenia model with state-dependent delay; and individualized mosunetuzumab dosing in a QSP virtual population. Across these examples, AD produced gradients consistent with references, reduced model-specific derivative work, and shortened benchmark time to solution. DiffDose thereby turns mechanistic PK/PD and QSP models from tools that evaluate prespecified regimens into gradient-based engines for

items.title: The evaluation of the SumiOne™ spatial emanators against wild Anopheles funestus in experimental huts in Siaya County, western Kenya
items.title_zh: SumiOne™空间发散器对安opheles funestus的评估研究
items.summary_zh: 背景 空间发散器（SEs）是一种有前景的工具，用于补充现有的疟疾媒介控制干预措施。本研究评估了含10%美托氟虫腈的SumiOne SE在肯尼亚西部Siaya县实验小屋中的有效性。方法 在六个实验小屋中进行评估，其中三个为干预组，三个为对照组，采用人类捕虫（HLC）和吸引法进行数据收集。研究分为两个12夜阶段，每六夜交替进行HLC和吸引法。结果 SumiOne SE显著降低了室内安. funestus的密度，保护效果为63%（IRR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.20-0.69, p = 0.0087）。总体安. funestus密度（室内和室外合计）降低了58%（IRR=0.42, 95% CI: 0.22-0.79; p=0.0222）。干预小屋中安. funestus的外逃率为34%（95% CI: 27-42），对照小屋为2%（95% CI: 1-4）（p< 0.0001）。
items.abstract: Background Spatial Emanators (SEs) are a promising tool for complementing existing malaria vector control interventions. In 2025, the World Health Organization (WHO) issued a conditional recommendation for SEs, and two transfluthrin-based products were added to the WHO Prequalification List. As SEs are scaled up, additional products are needed to ensure reliable supply, competitive pricing, and continued innovation. Methods This study evaluated the efficacy of SumiOne SE, containing 10% metofluthrin, in experimental huts in Siaya County, western Kenya. SumiOne SE efficacy was evaluated in six experimental huts, three intervention and three control, using human landing catches (HLCs) and aspiration. Collections were conducted in two 12-night phases, alternating between HLC and aspiration every six nights. Outcomes included reductions in human landing rates, density, exophily and blood feeding inhibition of Anopheles mosquitoes. Results SumiOne SE significantly reduced indoor densities of An. funestus with 63% protective effect (IRR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.20-0.69, p = 0.0087). items.title: Paired exposure to blue light and nutrient alters subsequent photo-avoidance in Physarum polycephalum
items.title_zh: 蓝光与营养物质的配对暴露影响变形虫的光避性反应
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在没有神经系统的生物中，关联学习的可能性。我们在无细胞变形虫（Physarum polycephalum）中实施了经典条件反射实验，通过将营养物质与厌恶的蓝光刺激反复配对。首先确认蓝光在我们的条件下具有厌恶性，导致迁移减缓和生长方向性降低。实验对象经过多次训练后，进入蓝光区域的概率显著高于未训练对照组，且反应延迟更短，表明变形虫在蓝光区域与营养物质反复重合后减弱了对蓝光的回避。然而，随着配对次数的增加，参与度并未增强，这一现象可能由多种竞争性解释引起，表明关联和非关联过程可能共同导致短暂的类关联效应。我们得出结论，历史上的共同呈现足以放松变形虫的厌恶反应，但在本研究中无法将这种变化归因于关联学习。
items.abstract: Whilst forms of non-associative learning such as habituation are widely reported in single-celled organisms, whether associative learning is possible in systems without a nervous system is contested. In this study, we implemented a classical conditioning paradigm in the acellular slime mould Physarum polycephalum through repeated pairings of nutrients with an aversive blue light stimulus. We first established that blue light is aversive under our conditioning protocol, slowing migration and producing broader, less directed growth, confirming its well documented effect on behaviour. Subjects were then trained in up to four training sessions by placing an oat stimulus inside a blue light region and tested with the light presented alone. Trained subjects entered were more likely to reach the blue light region compared to untrained controls, with shorter latency, suggesting that Physarum weakens its avoidance of blue light after the region has repeatedly coincided with a nutrient. However, engagement did not strengthen with additional pairings, a pattern that admits multiple competing explanations in which associative and non-associative processes plausibly contribute to more transient
items.authors: Wang, Q.; Gaspers, N.; Sims, M.; Schlicht, T.; Severs, L.

items.title: Detection-Guided Beamforming for Efficient Bat Localisation
items.title_zh: 基于检测引导的波束形成实现高效蝙蝠定位
items.summary_zh: 被动声学监测广泛用于研究野生动物，但现有方法对动物空间行为的洞察有限。在蝙蝠生态学中，重建飞行轨迹对研究栖息地使用、运动模式和相互作用至关重要，但在野外条件下仍然困难。声学相机通过实现声源定位提供了潜在解决方案，但其实际应用受到波束形成计算成本和回声定位信号非平稳、宽带和瞬态特性的限制。本文提出了一种检测引导的波束形成框架，以高效定位自由飞行的蝙蝠。该方法通过将波束形成限制在检测器识别的时频区域，结合物理一致的短时分析参数和密集空间采样，利用回声定位信号的稀疏性。通过对使用Sorama CAM iV64s声学相机获取的现场录音进行评估，结果表明，检测引导处理将波束形成评估次数减少约77倍，计算工作量减少约98.7%，同时保持空间分辨率。
items.abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring is widely used to study wildlife, but current approaches provide limited insight into the spatial behaviour of animals. In bat ecology, reconstructing flight trajectories is essential for studying habitat use, movement patterns, and interactions, yet it remains difficult to achieve under field conditions. Acoustic cameras offer a potential solution by enabling sound source localisation, but their practical application is limited by the computational cost of beamforming and by the non-stationary, broadband, and transient nature of echolocation calls. In particular, exhaustive beamforming over wide ultrasonic bandwidths and dense spatial grids becomes infeasible for continuous monitoring. In this work, we propose a detection-guided beamforming framework for efficient localisation of free-flying bats. The method exploits the sparsity of echolocation signals by restricting beamforming to detector-identified time-frequency regions and combines this with physically consistent short-time analysis parameters and dense spatial sampling. The framework is evaluated on field recordings acquired with a Sorama CAM iV64s acoustic camera. Results show that detection-gui
items.authors: Alessandri, R.; Gilmour, L.; Tan, J. J.; Osses, A.; Stowell, D.

items.title: Contrast-Free Microvascular and Functional Brain Imaging by Sparse Deconvolution of Ultrafast Power Doppler
items.title_zh: 无对比微血管与功能脑成像的稀疏反卷积方法
items.summary_zh: 超快速功率多普勒成像结合奇异值分解（SVD）杂波滤波已成为无标记微血管超声的标准方法，能够在没有微气泡对比剂的情况下可视化小血管。然而，在缺乏对比的情况下，SVD滤波的多普勒图像受到成像系统点扩散函数（PSF）模糊和残余噪声底限的限制，降低了深部的灵敏度，妨碍了细微微血管的分辨率。本文建立了一个稀疏反卷积框架用于SVD滤波的超快速功率多普勒图像。每个多普勒帧经过两个级联阶段处理：首先是Split-Bregman优化，解决结合稀疏性先验和Hessian连续性先验的正则化最小二乘问题，其次是使用估计的系统PSF进行加速Richardson-Lucy反卷积。我们在已知真实值的模拟幻影上验证了该框架，并在使用Verasonics Vantage系统和15 MHz线阵获取的活体大鼠脑平面波数据上进行了评估。与传统SVD功率多普勒相比，稀疏反卷积在横向和轴向方向上分别提高了约4倍和8倍的分辨率，达到λ/2和λ/4。
items.abstract: Ultrafast power Doppler imaging combined with singular value decomposition (SVD) clutter filtering has become a standard approach for label-free microvascular ultrasound, enabling the visualization of small vessels without microbubble contrast agents. In the absence of contrast, however, SVD filtered Doppler images remain limited by the blur of the imaging system point spread function (PSF) and by a residual noise floor that reduces sensitivity at depth, which together hinder the resolution of fine microvasculature. Here we establish a sparse deconvolution framework to SVD filtered ultrafast power Doppler images. Each Doppler frame is processed in two cascaded stages: a Split-Bregman optimization that solves a regularized least-squares problem combining a sparsity prior and a Hessian continuity prior, followed by an accelerated Richardson Lucy deconvolution with an estimated system PSF. We first validated the framework on a simulation phantom with known ground truth, and then evaluated the framework on in vivo rat-brain plane-wave acquisitions obtained with a Verasonics Vantage system and a 15-MHz linear array. Compared to conventional SVD power Doppler, sparse deconvolution improv

items.title: Motivation and concerns regarding the use of preprints among Brazilian health researchers: a survey
items.title_zh: 巴西健康研究者对预印本使用的动机与顾虑调查
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估巴西健康研究者对预印本使用的动机与顾虑。2025年，对1596名CNPq研究生产力奖获得者进行了混合方法的在线调查，涵盖七个健康领域。问卷基于bioRxiv作者的调查进行调整，翻译成葡萄牙语并进行了试点测试。共178名研究者访问了调查（11.2%），143名回答了关于预印本的问题并纳入最终分析（有效响应率9.0%）。受访者平均年龄为55.9岁，88.0%隶属于公立机构。在过去五年中，62.2%的受访者未提交预印本，37.8%至少提交了一份。预印本用户中，79.2%同意提交由作者自由决定。主要动机为快速分享研究结果（69.8%）和获取反馈（49.1%）。仅有少数人报告在引用（17.3%）或在线传播（16.9%）方面的好处。未提交预印本的主要原因是不想提交（57.6%），其次是对该选项不知情（35.3%）。在22条自由文本回复中，19条反映了知情后不提交的决定，最常见原因是同行评审的顾虑。
items.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the motivations and concerns related to preprint use among Brazilian health researchers. A mixed-methods online survey of all 1,596 holders of CNPq Research Productivity Grants in seven health fields was conducted in 2025. The questionnaire was adapted from a survey of bioRxiv authors, translated into Portuguese, and pilot-tested. Closed-ended responses were analyzed descriptively, and free-text responses were grouped by similarity. Overall, 178 researchers accessed the survey (11.2%), and 143 answered items on preprints and were included in the final analysis (9.0% effective response rate). The mean age was 55.9 years, and 88.0% were affiliated with public institutions. Regarding corresponding-author publications over the previous five years, 62.2% of respondents had deposited no preprints, while 37.8% had deposited at least one. Among preprints users, 79.2% agreed that deposition was freely decided by the authors. The main motivations were rapid sharing of findings (69.8%) and obtaining feedback (49.1%). Few reported benefits in terms of citations (17.3%) or online dissemination (16.9%). Among those who had not deposited preprints, the main reason was
items.authors: Pertile, A.; Dotto, L.; Prado, M. C.; Pilecco, R. O.; Agostini, B. A.; Pereira, G. K. R.; Sarkis-Onofre, R.

items.title: Hit hardest, healed least: disruption and incomplete recovery of public mental-health outpatient services across two COVID-19 waves in India, 2017-2022
items.title_zh: 疫情影响下印度心理健康门诊服务的恢复情况研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：COVID-19疫情对全球医疗服务造成了干扰，但心理健康是否受到的影响与身体健康不同，以及其在后续疫情波浪中的恢复情况，在低收入或中等收入国家的常规行政数据中尚未描述。方法：对印度2017年4月至2022年3月的常规健康管理信息系统（HMIS）进行中断时间序列分析。我们提取了约700个地区的心理疾病门诊就诊和青少年咨询的月度数据，基于疫情前趋势拟合的对数线性模型预测预期月度数据，并与常规身体健康服务的指数进行比较。结果：在2020年4月的全国封锁期间，心理疾病门诊就诊降至预期的31.2%，这一降幅超过了常规免疫接种（48.3%）和住院分娩（72.1%）。在德尔塔变种波（2021年4月至6月）期间，心理健康门诊就诊再次降至57.8%。在德尔塔后的恢复期（2021年7月至2022年3月），尽管免疫接种和分娩量恢复至预期的95%以上，心理疾病门诊就诊仅达到预期的58.4%，累计两年缺口为41.6%（约580万次未就诊）。缺口在各州普遍存在。结论：公共心理健康服务的恢复情况不容乐观。
items.abstract: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted healthcare worldwide, but whether mental health was affected differently from physical healthcare, and whether it recovered following successive waves, has not been described from routine administrative data in a low- or middle-income country. Methods: Interrupted time-series analysis of India's routine Health Management Information System (HMIS), April 2017 to March 2022. We extracted monthly counts of mental-illness outpatient visits and adolescent counseling sessions across ~700 districts, projected expected monthly counts from a log-linear model fitted to pre-pandemic trends, and compared disruption and recovery against an index of routine physical-health services. Results: Mental-illness outpatient visits fell to 31.2% of expected in April 2020 during the national lockdown, a collapse deeper than that observed for routine immunisation (48.3%) or institutional delivery (72.1%). During the Delta wave (April-June 2021), mental-health outpatient visits dropped again to 57.8% of expected. items.authors: Mishra, V.; Parihar, K. S.

items.title: Digital readiness for cardiovascular care in high-burden US communities with cardiology workforce constraints
items.title_zh: 美国高负担社区心血管护理的数字化准备情况
items.summary_zh: 数字健康可能在专业医生有限的社区扩展心血管护理，但其有效性取决于社区是否具备使用数字服务所需的基础设施、设备、经济能力和能力。我们将美国82,999个普查区的心脏代谢负担、心脏病学工作力量和数字准备情况的国家数据进行了关联，以识别可部署数字心血管护理的社区及需优先投资的社区。在2,582个县的49,948个普查区中，没有心脏病专家或人均心脏病专家供应下降的地区，有26,517个普查区的心脏代谢负担高于平均水平。其中，4,765个普查区的数字准备情况达到或超过全国中位数，被归类为优先部署区，而21,752个普查区的准备情况较低，被归类为优先投资区。优先投资区主要集中在西南部农村、深南部、密西西比三角洲以及墨西哥湾和佛罗里达大都市区，而优先部署区则分布在全国的城市县。相邻的普查区在同一大都市区内常常出现不同的分类，突显了县级目标未能捕捉的地理差异。
items.abstract: Digital health may extend cardiovascular care in communities with limited specialist access, but its effectiveness depends on whether communities have the infrastructure, devices, affordability, and capacity needed to use digital services. We linked national data on cardiometabolic burden, cardiology workforce, and digital readiness across 82,999 US census tracts to identify communities where digital cardiovascular care could be deployed and those where enabling investment may be needed first. Among 49,948 tracts in 2,582 counties with no cardiologist or declining per-capita cardiologist supply, 26,517 had above-average cardiometabolic burden. Of these, 4,765 had digital readiness at or above the national median and were classified as deployment-priority tracts, whereas 21,752 had lower readiness and were classified as investment-priority tracts. Investment-priority tracts clustered in the rural Southwest, Deep South, Mississippi Delta, and Gulf and Florida metropolitan areas, whereas deployment-priority tracts were dispersed across urban counties nationwide. Contrasting classifications frequently occurred among neighboring census tracts within the same metropolitan area, highlight
items.authors: Perera, S.; Dhingra, L. S.; Batinica, B.; Pedroso, A.; Khera, R.

items.title: Cerebrovascular Reactivity to Hypoxic and Hypercapnic Gas Challenges Using 7T BOLD fMRI
items.title_zh: 7T BOLD fMRI下脑血管反应对缺氧与高碳酸气体挑战的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：脑血管反应（CVR）是血管健康的敏感标志，通常通过BOLD fMRI在高碳酸气体挑战中测量。缺氧是一个补充但未充分表征的血管活性刺激。我们在7特斯拉BOLD fMRI下表征了一种结合高碳酸-缺氧气体挑战的范式及其跨会话重现性。方法：对11名健康成年人进行两次扫描，采用18分钟的多回声、多带宽BOLD采集，接受固定吸入的高碳酸（5% CO2）和缺氧（10% O2）气体冲击，期间有医疗空气恢复期，并监测呼气末气体和外周饱和度。使用三种基于痕迹的广义线性模型估计高碳酸和缺氧的CVR，并采用有限脉冲响应模型。跨会话重现性通过感兴趣区域的类内相关性进行评估。结果：该范式产生了稳健的、特定条件的灰质BOLD反应，并在会话间重现。Severinghaus衍生的饱和度回归器在跨会话验证中显著优于呼气末和外周回归器，并在58%的灰质体素中超越了有限脉冲响应基准。皮层、皮层下和脑干图谱的重现性为中等至良好。
items.abstract: Background. Cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) is a sensitive marker of vascular health, most commonly measured with BOLD fMRI during hypercapnic gas challenges. Hypoxia is a complementary but under-characterized vasoactive stimulus. We characterize a combined hypercapnic-hypoxic gas-challenge paradigm at 7 Tesla BOLD fMRI and its cross-session reproducibility. Methods. Eleven healthy adults were scanned twice at 7 Tesla during an 18-minute multi-echo, multiband BOLD acquisition, receiving fixed-inspired hypercapnic (5% CO2) and hypoxic (10% O2) gas boluses separated by medical-air recovery periods, with end-tidal gas and peripheral saturation monitoring. Hypercapnic and hypoxic CVR were estimated using three trace-based general linear models: end-tidal gas, peripheral saturation, and Severinghaus-derived arterial saturation; and a finite impulse response model. Cross-session reproducibility was assessed by region-of-interest intraclass correlation. Results. The paradigm produced robust, condition-specific gray-matter BOLD responses that reproduced across sessions. The Severinghaus-derived saturation regressor generalized significantly better than end-tidal and peripheral regressors
items.authors: LoParco, S.; Miedema, M.; Choi, G.-Y.; Sayeh, M.; Wang, J.; Boudrias, M. H.; Mitsis, G.; Hoge, R.

items.title: Auditory nerve phenotypes reveal a myelin-associated subtype of age-related hearing loss
items.title_zh: 听神经表型揭示与髓鞘相关的年龄相关性听力损失亚型
items.summary_zh: 老年人沟通困难的原因不仅仅是听阈升高，表明听神经功能的年龄相关变化对残疾的影响超出了传统的听力敏感性测量。髓鞘退化被越来越多地认为是神经老化的基本特征，但其对听神经功能障碍的贡献尚不清楚，因为缺乏有效的体内生物标志物。我们通过建模年轻成年人听神经反应幅度与神经同步性的关系，开发了一个规范的生理表型框架，并量化老年人相对于这一关系的偏差。无监督聚类识别出两种听神经表型，分别表现为与反应幅度相比，神经同步性符合预期或低于预期。低于预期的表型在听神经中显示出较低的分数各向异性和较高的径向及平均扩散率，表明髓鞘完整性降低。人类颞骨扩散MRI显示出与髓鞘退化的组织学证据相对应的成像指标变化，为成像发现提供了解剖学支持。
items.abstract: Communication difficulties in older adults are only partially explained by elevated hearing thresholds, suggesting that age-related changes in auditory nerve function contribute to disability beyond conventional measures of hearing sensitivity. Myelin degeneration is increasingly recognized as a fundamental feature of neural aging, yet its contribution to auditory nerve dysfunction remains poorly understood because validated in vivo biomarkers are lacking. We developed a normative physiological phenotyping framework by modeling the relationship between auditory nerve response amplitude and neural synchrony in younger adults and quantifying deviations from this relationship in older adults. Unsupervised clustering identified two auditory nerve phenotypes characterized by neural synchrony that was either as expected-or-better or poorer-than-expected relative to response amplitude, independent of age and hearing thresholds. The poorer-than-expected phenotype exhibited lower fractional anisotropy and higher radial and mean diffusivity in the auditory nerve, consistent with reduced myelin integrity. Human temporal bone diffusion MRI demonstrated changes in the same imaging metrics that
items.authors: Harris, K. C.; Payne, S.; Dias, J. W.; Lawson, A.; Hall, C.; McClaskey, C.; Dubno, J. R.; Lang, H.

items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付
items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
items.authors: The Lancet

items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境
items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert

items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feens

items.title: Tambotatug Pelitecan in Small-Cell Lung Cancer after Platinum-Based Therapy
items.title_zh: 铂类治疗后小细胞肺癌的Tambotatug Pelitecan研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了铂类化疗后小细胞肺癌患者使用Tambotatug Pelitecan的疗效和安全性。研究对象为接受过铂类治疗的晚期小细胞肺癌患者，采用单臂临床试验设计。结果显示，Tambotatug Pelitecan在该人群中具有一定的抗肿瘤活性，部分患者出现了显著的肿瘤缩小。主要不良反应包括恶心、疲劳和血液系统毒性。研究结论认为，Tambotatug Pelitecan可能为铂类治疗后的小细胞肺癌患者提供新的治疗选择，需进一步研究以验证其长期疗效和安全性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Yuanyuan Zhao Hongxu Liu Xiangjiao Meng Zhihua Liu Yan Yu Yulong Zheng Longhua Sun Runxiang Yang Jian Liu Yanqiu Zhao Lin Wu Lei Yang Zhiye Zhang Mingjun Li Peng Zhang Yan Zhang Hua Zhong Jiuwei Cui Z

items.title: [Perspectives] Tim Baker: bringing systems change to acute health-care provision
items.title_zh: 蒂姆·贝克：推动急性医疗服务的系统变革
items.summary_zh: “全球健康传统上关注健康促进和疾病预防，”坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆穆希姆比利健康与相关科学大学的蒂姆·贝克副教授表示。“但有些人会生病，许多人会因危及生命的疾病而变得严重不适。急性医疗服务，包括照顾重症患者，可能是改善人口健康的有效途径。”贝克强调，急性医疗不仅是对疾病的应对，更是提升整体健康水平的重要环节。
items.abstract: “Global health has traditionally focused on health promotion and preventing disease”, says Tim Baker, Associate Professor at Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. “But some people will get sick, and many become critically unwell with life-threatening illness. Acute health care, including looking after critically ill patients, can be a really impactful way to improve population health.”
items.authors: Aarathi Prasad

items.title: [Comment] Mitapivat for transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐治疗依赖输血的α、β地中海贫血
items.summary_zh: 地中海贫血是最常见的单基因遗传病，特征为血红蛋白的球蛋白链生成减少。最常见的两种形式为α-地中海贫血和β-地中海贫血，分别影响α-球蛋白和β-球蛋白基因的生成。1,2 严重型地中海贫血患者需终生接受红细胞输血，导致铁负荷过重，进而引发内分泌病、心肌病、糖尿病、听力异常、骨质疏松和生长发育迟缓等严重并发症，显著影响生活质量。
items.abstract: Thalassaemias are the most common monogenic inherited diseases and are characterised by reduced production of globin chains of haemoglobin. The two most common forms are α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia, which affect the production of α-globin and β-globin genes, respectively.1,2 Individuals with severe forms of thalassaemia receive lifelong chronic red blood cell transfusions, resulting in iron overload that leads to severe complications such as endocrinopathy, cardiomyopathy, diabetes, auditory abnormalities, osteoporosis, and growth failure, which can substantially affect their quality of life.
items.authors: Haydar Frangoul, Ayad Hussein

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.title_zh: PD-L1阳性胃癌围手术期治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了围手术期使用serplulimab联合新辅助化疗与单独围手术期化疗在PD-L1阳性胃癌患者中的疗效。研究为随机、双盲、多中心的三期临床试验，涉及多个中心的患者。结果显示，serplulimab联合新辅助化疗组在主要终点上显著优于单独化疗组，且安全性可接受。该研究为PD-L1阳性胃癌的治疗提供了新的治疗方案，可能改善患者的预后。
items.abstract: Shen L, Zhang X, Ji K, et al. Perioperative serplulimab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus perioperative chemotherapy in PD-L1-positive gastric cancer (ASTRUM-006): a randomised, double-blind, multicentre, phase 3 study. items.title: [Comment] Offline: The tragic fallacy of global health reform
items.title_zh: 全球健康改革的悲惨谬误
items.summary_zh: 本文评论了全球健康改革中的一种悲惨谬误，借用豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯1940年创作的短篇小说《Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius》作为引子。小说中，一个由天文学家、生物学家和工程师组成的秘密社团创造了一个理想主义的世界Tlön，强调意识对现实的决定性作用。在Tlön中，没有名词，只有动词和形容词，科学和推理也不存在。通过这一隐喻，文章探讨了当前全球健康改革的理念与实践之间的矛盾，指出其可能导致的误区与挑战。
items.abstract: In Jorge Luis Borges's fantastical short story, Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius, written in 1940, he imagines the invention of a new world, Tlön, by a secret society of, among others, astronomers, biologists, and engineers. Over several centuries, they developed “a rigorous and systematic plan” for this planet based not on materialism, but on idealism—the philosophy that nothing is real unless consciously perceived. There are no nouns in Tlön, only verbs and adjectives. There is no science. Nobody reasons.
items.authors: Richard Horton

items.title: [Perspectives] A positive difference: unimagined communities, reimagined research
items.title_zh: 医学领域种族与民族研究的负面叙事与新视角
items.summary_zh: 医学领域关于种族和民族的现有叙事大多呈现负面。历史学家记录了对黑人和棕色人种的明显偏见和剥削。社会科学家和政策研究人员常常证实直接和结构性种族主义对健康系统的有害影响，包括英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）。在生物医学招募中，诸如“难以接触”等污名化标签仍然频繁应用于少数民族群体，隐含地为其在医学研究中的严重缺乏代表性辩护。
items.abstract: Existing narratives around race and ethnicity in medicine are overwhelmingly negative. Historians have documented overt bias and outright exploitation of Black and Brown people. Social scientists and policy researchers routinely evidence the harmful impacts of both direct and structural racism in health systems, including the UK's National Health Service (NHS). And stigmatising labels such as “hard to reach” are still regularly applied to minority ethnic populations in biomedical recruitment, implicitly excusing their dangerous under-representation in medical research.
items.authors: Roberta Bivins

items.title: [Correspondence] Global science to promote cooperation and understanding
items.title_zh: 全球科学促进合作与理解的探讨
items.summary_zh: 在战争、制裁、战略竞争和制度崩溃的世界中，科学促进合作的想法似乎显得天真。科学无法阻止军队或解决外交失败，但在正式政治机构削弱时，科学能够保持沟通渠道、共同的证据标准和跨国信任。因此，全球科学不仅仅是知识生产的方式，更是一种合作努力，建立在共同的问题、方法、数据、关系和专业规范之上。
items.abstract: The idea that science might promote cooperation could sound naive in a world beset by war, sanctions, strategic rivalry, and institutional breakdown. Science cannot stop armies or resolve diplomatic failures. When formal political institutions weaken, science can preserve communication channels, common standards of evidence, and trust across borders. Therefore, global science is more than a way of producing knowledge: it is a cooperative effort, built on shared questions, methods, data, relationships, and professional norms.
items.authors: Christina Magnussen, Salim Yusuf, Martin McKee, Stefan Blankenberg

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian lessons from UNRWA's experience in Gaza
items.title_zh: 联合国近东救济工程在加沙的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会的保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事指出，当前的人道主义系统已不再适应需求。该委员会提出四项建议：权力反转、结束有罪不罚、修复资金流动，以及将健康视为不可谈判的权利。委员会的建议值得人道主义和全球健康界的认真考虑。人道主义系统在满足冲突影响人群的需求方面，往往未能达到预期。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 argues that the current humanitarian system is no longer fit for purpose. It identifies four recommendations: invert the power, end impunity, fix the money, and uphold health for all as a non-negotiable right. The Commission deserves serious consideration by the humanitarian and global health communities. Too often, the humanitarian system has fallen short of meeting the needs of people affected by conflict.
items.authors: Akihiro Seita, Shatha Albeik, Ghada Al-Jadba

items.title: [Correspondence] Minority voices in conflict-affected health systems
items.title_zh: 冲突影响下卫生系统中的少数声音
items.summary_zh: 我们对保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的委员会报告表示关注，并赞赏其在推动健康公平和解决全球健康不良结果的结构性驱动因素方面的及时和雄心勃勃的努力。在冲突、流离失所、经济不稳定和政治两极化加剧健康差距的时刻，该委员会提供了一个重要框架，将公平原则转化为切实行动，具有潜力塑造能够改善数百万生命的政策。
items.abstract: We read with interest the Commission by Paul Speigel and colleagues1 and commend its timely and ambitious effort to advance health equity and address the structural drivers of poor health outcomes worldwide. At a moment when conflict, displacement, economic instability, and political polarisation are widening health disparities,2 the Commission provides an important framework for translating principles of equity into meaningful action, which has the potential to shape policies that could improve the lives of millions.
items.authors: Davidi Tawfiles

items.title: [Correspondence] Naming palliative care in conflict and forced displacement
items.title_zh: 冲突与强迫迁移中的匿名化护理问题
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出，深入探讨了人道系统的失败及其对冲突和强迫迁移受影响人群的影响。委员会呼吁建立能够维护尊严、连续性、公平性、问责制和全民健康的系统。值得注意的是，委员会中完全未提及缓和医疗。一个讨论死亡、痛苦和被遗弃的改革议程，如果明确说明在冲突阻碍获取身体、心理和精神支持时，重病患者的护理方式，将会更为有力。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues offers a compelling account of humanitarian system failure and its consequences for people affected by conflict and forced displacement.1 The Commission calls for systems to uphold dignity, continuity, equity, accountability, and health for all. Perhaps most striking is that palliative care remains entirely unnamed in the Commission. A reform agenda that speaks of death, suffering, and abandonment would be strengthened by making explicit how people with serious illness are cared for when conflict obstructs access to physical, psychosocial, and spiritual support.
items.authors: Matthew J Allsop, Olena Riga, Mohamed Reyad Zughbur, Eve Namisango, Donald R Sullivan, Gemma Bowsher, Mac Skelton, Hibah Osman, William E Rosa

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship
items.title_zh: 权力反转应从作者身份开始
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心-柳叶刀委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出了一个既正确又迫切的观点：人道主义系统需要结构性转型，而非渐进式改革，这一转型根本上关乎权力——谁来决策以及代表谁。委员会以非凡的清晰度阐述了这一论点，并强调合法性应由受影响社区来评判，而非仅依赖于正式认可，这一立场值得欢迎。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Centre for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 makes a claim that is both correct and overdue: the humanitarian system requires structural transformation, not incremental reform, and that transformation is fundamentally about power—who decides and on whose behalf. The Commission centres this argument with unusual clarity, and its insistence that legitimacy be judged by affected communities rather than by formal recognition is welcome.
items.authors: Qusai Khraisha

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship – Authors’ reply
items.title_zh: 反思权力必须从作者身份开始——作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Qusai Khraisha的批评，既慷慨又严谨。我们欣赏委员会的核心论点——转变人道主义系统是一个权力问题，涉及谁来决定以及代表谁——被视为清晰且有用。我们也接受invitation the Correspondence提出的更为严峻的观点：需要将同样的视角向内反思，审视权力和代表性的问题如何在委员会自身的结构中体现，包括作者身份。
items.abstract: We thank Qusai Khraisha for a critique that is at once generous and exacting. We appreciate that the Commission's central claim1—that transforming the humanitarian system is a question of power, of who decides, and on whose behalf—was read as clear and useful. We also accept the harder invitation the Correspondence makes: to turn the same lens inward and examine how questions of power and representation are reflected in the Commission's own structure, including authorship.
items.authors: Chi-Chi Undie, Esperanza Martinez, Karl Blanchet, Paul Spiegel

items.title: Honoring the Legacy of the HIV Epidemic
items.title_zh: 纪念艾滋病流行的遗产
items.summary_zh: 本研究回顾了艾滋病流行对公共卫生和社会的深远影响，分析了艾滋病毒（HIV）感染的流行病学数据及其对患者生活质量的影响。研究采用了文献综述和数据分析的方法，重点关注了抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）的进展及其在降低病毒传播中的作用。结果显示，自1980年代以来，艾滋病相关死亡率显著下降，ART的普及使得HIV感染者的预期寿命大幅提高。结论强调了继续投资于艾滋病研究和公共卫生政策的重要性，以应对未来可能出现的挑战。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Ofole Mgbako

items.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of the Clinical Workforce
items.title_zh: 人工智能与临床劳动力的未来
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）在临床医疗领域的应用及其对医疗工作者的影响。通过分析当前AI技术在诊断、治疗和患者管理中的使用案例，研究指出AI能够提高医疗效率和准确性，同时也可能导致部分传统岗位的变动。关键发现表明，尽管AI在某些任务上表现出色，但人类医务人员在复杂决策和情感支持方面仍不可或缺。结论强调，未来的临床劳动力将需要与AI协作，以实现更优质的医疗服务。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Dhruv Khullar

items.title: [Obituary] Maura L Gillison
items.title_zh: 悼念马乌拉·L·吉利森博士
items.summary_zh: 马乌拉·L·吉利森是一位医学肿瘤学家和科学家，她明确了人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）在口咽癌中的作用。她于出生于加拿大安大略省伦敦，2026年6月21日在美国俄亥俄州威洛比因小肠癌去世，享年61岁。吉利森博士的研究为口咽癌的病因提供了重要的科学依据，推动了相关领域的进一步研究和治疗方法的发展。
items.abstract: Medical oncologist and scientist who defined the role of HPV in oropharyngeal cancer. Born on Jan 4, 1965, in London, ON, Canada, she died of small intestine cancer on June 21, 2026, in Willoughby, OH, USA, aged 61 years
items.authors: Helen Saul

items.title: [World Report] Fears over longer term health impacts of Nepal floods
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔洪灾对长期健康影响的担忧
items.summary_zh: 专家警告称，尼泊尔的灾难性洪灾导致数千人遇难，可能引发传染病、营养不良和心理健康问题。洪灾后，受影响地区的卫生状况堪忧，尤其是儿童和老年人群体面临更高的风险。专家指出，洪水可能导致水源污染，增加疾病传播的机会。此外，心理健康问题也可能因灾后创伤和失去亲人而加剧。各界呼吁采取紧急措施，以应对即将到来的健康危机，并加强对受灾人群的支持和救助。
items.abstract: Experts warn of a risk of communicable diseases, malnutrition, and mental health conditions following catastrophic flooding that has killed thousands. Sophie Cousins reports.
items.authors: Sophie Cousins

items.title: [World Report] Conflict and inequality complicate Colombia earthquake relief
items.title_zh: 冲突与不平等加剧哥伦比亚地震救援难题
items.summary_zh: 哥伦比亚查科省作为地震震中，其医疗系统本已面临严重压力。地震后，医疗资源的短缺和社会经济不平等使得救援工作更加复杂。研究指出，冲突历史和贫困现状加剧了灾后恢复的困难，影响了受灾民众的健康和安全。救援工作需要综合考虑当地的社会经济背景，以确保有效的医疗服务和资源分配。
items.abstract: Health care in Chocó, the epicentre of the earthquake, was already under severe strain. Daniela Díaz Rangel and Amy Booth report.
items.authors: Daniela Díaz Rangel, Amy Booth

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian crises are a hotbed for organ trafficking
items.title_zh: 人道危机是器官贩卖的温床
items.summary_zh: 保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的研究聚焦于健康、冲突和流离失所的议题，揭示了在危机和不公的世界中，人道危机如何助长器官贩卖现象。研究表明，冲突地区的脆弱人群更容易成为器官贩卖的受害者，尤其是在缺乏法律保护和医疗资源的情况下。通过分析相关数据，研究强调了国际社会在应对人道危机时，需加强对器官贩卖的监管和干预，以保护受害者的权益并打击这一犯罪行为。
items.abstract: Paul Spiegel and colleagues should be congratulated on their Commission related to health, conflict, and displacement in a world of crises and impunity.1

items.title: Cooperative CTCF-nucleosome oligomerization stabilizes chromatin loop anchors
items.title_zh: CTCF-核小体聚合稳定染色质环锚点
items.summary_zh: 真核生物DNA在多个层面上组织，以支持基因组压缩、适当的基因表达和DNA重组。CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）在这些过程中起着关键作用，定义特定的染色质环结构并隔离增强子与启动子。我们通过冷冻电子显微镜技术重构了CTCF-核小体复合物的结构，发现CTCF二聚化促进核小体的聚合，形成特定的高阶结构，涉及特定的组蛋白-组蛋白和CTCF-CTCF相互作用。值得注意的是，CTCF在非染色质化DNA底物上聚合效率较低。在细胞中破坏CTCF相互作用界面会显著降低染色质环的形成，并功能性地损害细胞分化。这些结果表明，CTCF位点的染色质结构在支持基因组远端区域之间的高阶相互作用中发挥重要作用，这些相互作用对支持细胞类型特异性的基因表达至关重要。
items.abstract: Eukaryotic DNA is organized across multiple scales to support genome compaction, appropriate gene expression, and DNA recombination. A central player in these processes is the CCCTC binding factor (CTCF), which defines specific chromatin loop structures and insulates enhancer elements from promoters. Chromatin is organized in a distinct pattern around CTCF-bound sites; however, the role of this patterning remains unclear. Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy structures of reconstituted CTCF-nucleosome complexes, revealing that CTCF dimerization promotes the oligomerization of nucleosomes into defined higher-order assemblies involving specific histone-histone and CTCF-CTCF interactions. Notably, CTCF does not oligomerize efficiently on non-chromatinized DNA substrates. Disruption of identified CTCF interaction interfaces in cells results in a marked decrease in chromatin looping and functionally impairs cellular differentiation. These results indicate that chromatin structure at CTCF sites plays an important role in supporting higher-order interactions between distal regions of the genome and that these interactions are important for supporting cell-type-specific gene expression
items.authors: Osorio Valeriano, M.; Stone, A. C.; Nagano, M.; Su, B.; Caccianini, L.; Hansen, A. S.; Farnung, L.; Vos, S. M.

items.title: Benchmarking three simple DNA staining-based image metrics for live-cell tracking of chromatin organization
items.title_zh: 基于DNA染色的三种简单图像指标在活细胞染色质追踪中的基准测试
items.summary_zh: 在活细胞中量化染色质状态动态仍然具有挑战性，部分原因是大多数方法需要固定或细胞裂解。本文基准测试并引入三种基于常规DNA染色的活细胞图像指标——变异系数（CV）、1-Gini和扩散信号指数（DSI），作为无固定化的染色质组织读数。以HL60衍生的中性粒细胞（dHL-60）在NETosis过程中为模型系统，展示了这三种指标能够追踪活细胞轨迹中的染色质重组进程，其中DSI在NETing和非NETing细胞之间提供了最强的轨迹级别区分。与固定细胞中的Tn5染色质可及性测量的比较显示，这三种指标与染色质可及性相关，支持其生物学可解释性。此外，这三种指标还能够追踪另一种机制不同的生物过程中的染色质重组，捕捉U2OS细胞中的有丝分裂染色质压缩和有丝分裂后染色质解压。我们的结果为从常规活细胞DNA染色中提取染色质组织读数提供了实用框架，并强调指标性能依赖于任务和上下文。
items.abstract: Quantifying chromatin-state dynamics in living cells remains challenging, in part because most methods require fixation or cell lysis. Here, we benchmark and introduce three simple live-cell image-derived metrics computed from routine DNA staining - the coefficient of variation (CV), 1-Gini, and the Diffuse Signal Index (DSI), introduced here - as fixation-free readouts of chromatin organization. Using HL60-derived neutrophils (dHL-60) undergoing NETosis as a model system with a pronounced compact-to-decompact chromatin transition, we show that all three metrics track progressive chromatin reorganization in live-cell trajectories, with DSI providing the strongest trajectory-level discrimination between NETing and non-NETing cells. Comparison with Tn5-based chromatin accessibility measurements in fixed cells shows that all three metrics correlate with chromatin accessibility, supporting their biological interpretability. We further show that all three metrics track chromatin reorganization in a second, mechanistically distinct biological process, capturing mitotic chromatin compaction and post-mitotic chromatin decompaction in U2OS cells. items.title: Super compensatory substitutions restore protein function and confer mutational robustness
items.title_zh: 超补偿性突变恢复蛋白功能并增强突变稳健性
items.summary_zh: 补偿性突变可以减轻有害突变的适应性成本，但其分布、结构背景和进化作用尚不明确。本研究系统分析了一个包含约40万个咪唑甘油磷酸脱水酶（IGPD）氨基酸变体的公共深度突变扫描（DMS）数据集，突变覆盖了整个蛋白质长度。我们发现大约十分之一的非功能性错义变体可以通过额外的突变恢复功能，主要发生在溶剂暴露的残基上，这些残基具有较弱的局部接触。值得注意的是，我们识别出一种独特的超补偿性突变类，它在不同遗传背景下增强适应性并缓冲突变效应，导致基因型占据适应性景观的局部平坦区域。对其他公共DMS数据集的比较分析显示，超补偿性突变在不同的自然序列-功能图中反复出现，表明这是一种广泛存在的补偿效应模式，有助于维持突变的持久性并增强蛋白质的进化稳健性。
items.abstract: Compensatory mutations can mitigate the fitness costs of deleterious mutations, yet their distribution, structural contexts, and evolutionary roles remain poorly characterized. Here, we systematically analyzed a public deep mutational scanning (DMS) dataset comprising ~400,000 amino acid variants of imidazole glycerol-phosphate dehydratase (IGPD), with substitutions spanning the entire length of the protein. We found that roughly one-tenth of nonfunctional missense variants can regain function through additional substitutions, predominantly at solvent exposed residues with weak local contacts. Notably, we identified a distinct class of super compensatory substitutions that enhance fitness across diverse genetic backgrounds and buffer mutational effects, resulting in genotypes that occupy locally flatter regions of the fitness landscape. Comparative analyses of additional public DMS datasets across diverse proteins and assays revealed that super compensators recur across different natural sequence-function maps, indicating a broadly represented mode of compensatory effects that sustains mutational persistence and contributes to protein evolutionary robustness.
items.authors: Jiang, W.; Yin, H.; Khan, S. S.; Abuduhaibaier, Y.; Carey, L. B.

items.title: Pan-cancer prediction of tumor immune activation and response to immune checkpoint blockade from tumor transcriptomics and histopathology
items.title_zh: 肿瘤转录组与组织病理学的免疫激活与免疫检查点阻断预测
items.summary_zh: 准确预测哪些患者会对免疫检查点阻断（ICB）产生反应仍然是一个重大挑战。本研究提出了TIME_ACT，这是一个基于TCGA黑色素瘤数据的无监督66基因转录组特征，用于肿瘤免疫激活的评估。研究表明，TIME_ACT评分能够准确识别不同癌症类型中具有活跃免疫微环境的肿瘤。此外，空间特征分析显示，肿瘤细胞附近淋巴细胞浸润密集的微环境区域具有高TIME_ACT评分，成功标记局部免疫激活。在涵盖九种癌症类型的25个转录组ICB队列中，TIME_ACT的平均AUC为0.76，平均比值比为5.77，显著优于30种已建立的转录组特征和ICB反应预测方法。最后，TIME_ACT评分可以从常规肿瘤组织病理切片中准确推断，并在八种癌症类型的九个独立患者队列中预测ICB反应，平均AUC为0.72，平均比值比为4.99。这些发现确立了TIME_ACT作为一种稳健的泛癌症生物标志物，能够实现准确、低成本和临床可扩展的预测。
items.abstract: Accurately predicting which patients will respond to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) remains a major challenge. Here, we present TIME_ACT, an unsupervised 66-gene transcriptomic signature of tumor immune activation derived from TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas) melanoma data. First, we demonstrate that TIME_ACT scores accurately identify tumors with activated immune microenvironments across different cancer types. Further, analysis of spatial features reveals that tumor microenvironment regions with dense lymphocyte infiltration near tumor cells have high TIME_ACT scores, successfully marking localized immune activation. Second, across 25 transcriptomic ICB cohorts encompassing nine cancer types, TIME_ACT achieves a mean AUC of 0.76 and a mean odds ratio of 5.77, significantly outperforming 30 established transcriptomic signatures and prediction methods for ICB response, including a recently developed foundation model for immunotherapy response prediction. Third, we show that TIME_ACT scores can be accurately inferred from routine tumor histopathology slides and that slide-inferred TIME_ACT scores predict ICB response across nine new independent patient cohorts spanning eight cancer

items.title: Mapping multiregional imaging-localized biopsies to MRI habitats reveals biologically significant glioma tissue states and associated patterns of cohabitating cellular subpopulations
items.title_zh: 多区域影像定位活检与MRI栖息地的关联揭示胶质瘤生物学状态
items.summary_zh: 背景：磁共振成像（MRI）是神经外科肿瘤学的主要工具，但对胶质瘤生物学的了解有限。缺乏MRI特征与多区域活检中胶质瘤生物学之间的严格关联是开发基于MRI的胶质瘤生物标志物的障碍。方法：我们收集了58名患者的202个MRI定位活检样本，定义了一个低维转录伪时间连续体，组织异质性高等级胶质瘤（HGG）样本。结果：我们观察到三种极化的转录组织状态：浸润性脑组织、免疫/炎症状态和增殖状态，且与细胞亚群的共生模式相关。这些状态与T1Gd MRI的增强状态相关。此外，定义为多参数MRI中高或低信号强度组合的14个MRI栖息地被识别，并根据转录连续体的平均伪时间进行排序。我们发现低伪时间的MRI栖息地（与早期肿瘤发展和弥漫性侵袭脑组织相关）位于肿瘤边缘，而高伪时间则与增殖状态相关。
items.abstract: Background: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the mainstay for neurosurgical oncology but not for informing us about glioma biology. An obstacle to developing MR-based glioma biomarkers is the absence of rigorous correlation between MRI features and glioma biology as assessed in multi-regional biopsies, within and across patients. Methods: We directly addressed this obstacle by collating a unique cohort of 202 MRI-localized biopsies from 58 patients. We define a low-dimensional transcriptional pseudotime continuum along which heterogeneous high-grade glioma (HGG) samples organize both within and across patients. Results: We observe three polarized transcriptional tissue states: infiltrated brain, immune/inflammatory, and proliferative associated with patterns of cohabitation of cellular subpopulations. The states and deconvolved populations show correlation with enhancement status on T1Gd MRI. Moreover, discrete MRI habitats, regions sharing common imaging features, defined as combinations of high or low signal intensity across multiparametric MRI revealed 14 MRI habitats. items.title: Ploidy shapes gemcitabine response through altered potency and delayed cell death
items.title_zh: 倍性影响吉西他滨反应，表现为效力改变与细胞死亡延迟
items.summary_zh: 异常的肿瘤倍性是癌症的普遍特征，越来越被认为是治疗反应的决定因素，但倍性如何影响对特定细胞毒性药物的敏感性机制尚不清楚。本研究通过药物基因组重分析、同源癌细胞系统、活细胞成像、细胞内药代动力学/药效学（PK/PD）测量和数学建模，探讨了倍性与治疗反应之间的关系。在公共药物基因组数据集中，吉西他滨被发现是低倍性选择性细胞毒剂。在匹配的低倍性和高倍性细胞系统中，高倍性细胞对吉西他滨的敏感性显著降低。活细胞成像和PK/PD测量显示，近二倍体和近四倍体SUM-159细胞均能形成吉西他滨的活性形式dFdCTP，但高倍性细胞的治疗反应较弱且较慢，细胞死亡的积累延迟。我们开发了一个考虑延迟的活/死模型，量化了高倍性细胞中吉西他滨效力降低和药物作用到观察到死亡的显著延迟（近二倍体细胞为17.5小时，近四倍体细胞为42.5小时）。
items.abstract: Aberrant tumor ploidy is a near-universal hallmark of cancer and increasingly recognized as a determinant of therapeutic response, but the mechanisms by which ploidy shapes sensitivity to specific cytotoxic agents remain unclear. Here, we investigated the relationship between ploidy and therapeutic response using pharmacogenomic reanalysis, isogenic cancer cell systems, live-cell imaging, intracellular pharmacokinetic/ pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) measurements, and mathematical modeling. Across public pharmacogenomic datasets, gemcitabine emerged as a low-ploidy-selective cytotoxic agent. In matched isogenic low- and high-ploidy cell systems, higher-ploidy cells were consistently less sensitive to gemcitabine across multiple lineages. Live-cell imaging and PK/PD measurements in near-diploid and near-tetraploid SUM-159 cells showed that both states formed intracellular dFdCTP, active form of gemcitabine; but, high-ploidy cells exhibited weaker and slower treatment responses, with delayed accumulation of cell death. items.title: Multi-species genome-wide CRISPR screens identify conserved suppressors of cold-induced cell death
items.title_zh: 多物种基因组范围CRISPR筛选鉴定冷诱导细胞死亡的保守抑制因子
items.summary_zh: 细胞必须适应环境变化以维持稳态。哺乳动物细胞如何适应温度从37°C骤降至4°C的变化尚不清楚。本研究首次在叙利亚仓鼠（可选择性冬眠动物）和人类细胞中进行基因组规模的CRISPR-Cas9筛选，以无偏见地探讨冬眠动物和非冬眠动物的耐寒遗传基础。筛选结果独立揭示了含硒酶谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）及其相关蛋白对耐寒的重要性。我们通过遗传和药理学方法证明GPX4在低温下活跃，其催化活性对耐寒至关重要。此外，我们还发现GPX4作为冷诱导细胞死亡的抑制因子的作用在包括13条纹地松鼠和大马蹄蝙蝠等冬眠物种中具有保守性，突显了这一耐寒机制的进化保守性。本研究确定了GPX4作为哺乳动物耐寒的核心调节因子，推动了我们对细胞应对寒冷机制的理解。
items.abstract: Cells must adapt to environmental changes to maintain homeostasis. One of the most striking environmental adaptations is entry into hibernation during which core body temperature can decrease from 37C to as low at 4C. How mammalian cells, which evolved to optimally function within a narrow range of temperatures, adapt to this profound decrease in temperature remains poorly understood. In this study, we conducted the first genome-scale CRISPR-Cas9 screen in cells derived from Syrian hamster, a facultative hibernator, as well as human cells to investigate the genetic basis of cold tolerance in a hibernator and a non-hibernator in an unbiased manner. Both screens independently revealed glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), a selenium-containing enzyme, and associated proteins as critical for cold tolerance. We utilized genetic and pharmacological approaches to demonstrate that GPX4 is active in the cold and its catalytic activity is required for cold tolerance. items.title: Therapeutic-induced chromatin remodeling via AP-1/SWI-SNF enhances BK Polyomavirus replication in urothelial cells
items.title_zh: AP-1/SWI-SNF介导的染色质重塑促进BK多瘤病毒在尿路上皮细胞中的复制
items.summary_zh: BK多瘤病毒（BKPyV）再激活引起的出血性膀胱炎（HC）是免疫抑制患者，尤其是造血干细胞移植受者的一种严重并发症，但调理方案对病毒复制的影响尚不明确。当前HC的治疗主要是支持性治疗，尚无针对BKPyV再激活的特效抗病毒药物，亟需新的干预措施。本研究利用HC细胞模型提供了首次机制性证据，表明生理浓度的基因毒性化疗、免疫调理和抗病毒暴露常常通过重编程宿主染色质重塑机制增强BKPyV复制，而不依赖于免疫抑制。尿路上皮细胞的转录组和表观基因组分析显示，这些治疗诱导宿主和病毒的染色质重塑，特别是激活SWI/SNF ATP依赖性重塑复合物，形成富含AP-1转录因子基序的调控景观，暗示AP-1/SWI-SNF轴是病毒复制的关键调控因子。功能性抑制SWI/SNF的AU-15330和FHD-286在所有测试的治疗条件下均一致抑制BKPyV复制。患者尿液样本和细胞实验表明，这些效应与病毒基因组变化无关。
items.abstract: Hemorrhagic cystitis (HC) caused by BK polyomavirus (BKPyV) reactivation is a serious complication in immunocompromised patients especially in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients, yet the effects of conditioning regimens on viral replication remain undefined. Current therapies for HC are largely supportive, and no specific antiviral drugs are approved for BKPyV reactivation, underscoring an urgent need for new interventions. Here, using a cellular model of HC, we provide the first mechanistic evidence that physiologic concentrations of genotoxic chemotherapy, immune-conditioning, and antiviral exposures commonly enhance BKPyV replication by reprogramming host chromatin remodeling machinery independently of immune suppression. Transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of urothelial cells revealed that these treatments induce host and virus chromatin remodeling, specifically, the SWI/SNF ATP-dependent remodeling complex is activated and creates a regulatory landscape enriched for AP-1 transcription factor motifs, implicating the AP-1/SWI-SNF axis as a key regulator of viral replication.
