items.title: Cell-composition sensitivity of pooled whole-blood DNA methylation profiling in sepsis using the Infinium MethylationEPIC v2.0 array and SeSAMe
items.title_zh: 脓毒症中全血DNA甲基化特征的细胞组成敏感性研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：利用Infinium Methylation EPIC v2.0平台，描述与脓毒症相关的全基因组DNA甲基化模式，并评估在关键护理队列中进行 pooled 甲基化分析的可行性。设计：单中心试点表观基因组关联研究，使用 pooled 全血基因组DNA及池级生物信息学分析。患者：50名重症成人患者（在疾病发作48小时内入组）和20名健康对照。结果：重症患者需要机械通气和/或血管收缩药支持。根据Sepsis-3标准定义脓毒症。70个样本分为14个计划池，每池5个个体：7个脓毒症池、3个重症非脓毒症池和4个健康对照池。因DNA质量差，排除1个重症非脓毒症池，最终分析13个池。主要比较中，7个脓毒症池与6个非脓毒症池（2个重症非脓毒症和4个健康对照）比较。经SeSAMe质量控制和预处理，保留876,094个CpG位点，初步筛选出170,897个候选差异甲基化区域。经过严格的二次过滤，最终结果显示具有显著性差异的区域。
items.abstract: Objective: To characterize genome-wide DNA methylation patterns associated with sepsis using the Infinium Methylation EPIC v2.0 platform and to evaluate the feasibility of pooled methylation profiling in a pilot critical care cohort. Design: Single-center pilot epigenome-wide association study using pooled whole-blood genomic DNA and pool-level bioinformatic analysis. Setting: Academic medical center. Patients: Fifty critically ill adults enrolled within 48 hours of illness onset and 20 healthy controls. Interventions: None. Measurements and Main Results: Critically ill patients required mechanical ventilation and/or vasopressor support. Sepsis was defined according to Sepsis-3 criteria. Seventy individual samples were organized into 14 intended pools of 5 individuals each: 7 sepsis pools, 3 critically ill non-septic pools, and 4 healthy-control pools. One critically ill non-septic pool was excluded because of poor DNA quality, yielding 13 analyzable pools. For the primary pooled comparison, 7 sepsis pools were compared with 6 non-sepsis comparator pools comprising 2 critically ill non-septic and 4 healthy-control pools. After quality control and preprocessing with SeSAMe, 876,094
items.authors: Janicki, P.; Bonavia, A. S.

items.title: Clinical outcomes with chronic adaptive versus conventional DBS in Parkinson's disease: A pilot randomized crossover trial
items.title_zh: 慢性适应性深脑刺激与常规深脑刺激在帕金森病中的临床结果比较
items.summary_zh: 背景：目前可用的适应性深脑刺激（aDBS）通过实时β波段局部场电位活动调节刺激，可能优于常规深脑刺激（cDBS）。在慢性刺激下的临床证据仍然有限。目的：比较在慢性刺激下aDBS与cDBS在帕金森病（PD）患者中的疗效。方法：本研究为双盲随机交叉试验，涉及九名接受双侧丘脑下核DBS的PD患者。患者在四个月的术后间隔后，经历了为期一个月的cDBS和aDBS连续期。aDBS采用双阈值算法，根据丘脑下核β波段LFP功率调整刺激幅度。主要结果为优化药物下的每日ON/OFF时长和运动障碍时长。使用混合效应ANCOVA估计治疗效果，贝叶斯分析整合先前证据评估临床意义差异的概率。结果：治疗间未出现统计学显著差异。方向性效果各异：ON时长偏向cDBS，而困扰性运动障碍和UPDRS评分偏向aDBS。贝叶斯分析显示这些差异达到临床重要性的概率较低（cDBS在ON时间上的优势概率为29.4%，aDBS在UPDRS第三部分上的优势概率为7.5%）。
items.abstract: Background: Currently available adaptive deep brain stimulation (aDBS) modulates stimulation guided by real-time beta-band local field potential activity, potentially offering advantages over conventional DBS (cDBS). Clinical evidence under chronic stimulation remains limited. Objectives: To compare aDBS versus cDBS efficacy in patients with Parkinson's disease (PD) under chronic stimulation. Methods: This was a double-blind, randomized crossover trial in nine PD patients with bilateral subthalamic nucleus DBS. Patients underwent consecutive one-month periods of cDBS and aDBS after a four-month postoperative interval. aDBS used dual-threshold algorithm adjusting amplitude based on subthalamic beta-band LFP power. Primary outcomes were daily ON/OFF durations and dyskinesia duration under optimized medication. Mixed-effects ANCOVA estimated treatment effects. Bayesian analyses integrated prior evidence to assess probabilities of clinically meaningful differences. Results: No statistically significant differences emerged between treatments. Directional effects varied: ON duration favored cDBS, whereas troublesome dyskinesia and UPDRS scores favored aDBS. Bayesian analyses indicated lo
items.authors: Tanimura, J.; Yako, T.; Hashimoto, T.

items.title: Regional Disparities and Temporal Trends in Rheumatic Heart Disease Burden in Nepal: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔风湿性心脏病负担的区域差异与时间趋势研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：风湿性心脏病仍是低中收入国家可预防的心血管疾病 morbidity 和 mortality 的主要原因。我们进行了系统评价和荟萃分析，以估计风湿性心脏病的流行率，考察时间和地理差异，并评估现有证据的确定性。方法：我们系统回顾了报告风湿性心脏病流行率的观察性研究，提取可用的分子和分母，并确认超声心动图诊断。使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所（JBI）检查表评估质量。采用广义线性混合模型（GLMM）估计合并流行率，进行亚组分析比较加德满都与非加德满都的研究；元回归分析出版年份、样本量对数和地区。证据的确定性使用 GRADE 评估。结果：纳入十项研究（209,815 名参与者和 5,440 例病例）。合并流行率为 3.1%（95% CI 1.6-5.8%），预测区间宽泛（0.3-28.5%），表明尼泊尔的真实流行率可能从非常低到非常高。异质性极大（I^2 = 99.8%）。排除全国性研究后，加德满都的流行率为 1.1%（0.9-1.3%），非加德满都为 7.2%（3.7-13.3%）（p < 0.001）。
items.abstract: Background Rheumatic heart disease remains a major cause of preventable cardiovascular morbidity and mortality in low- and middle-income countries. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to estimate the prevalence of rheumatic heart disease, examine temporal and geographic disparities, and assess the certainty of the available evidence. Methods We systematically reviewed observational studies reporting rheumatic heart disease prevalence with extractable numerators and denominators and echocardiography-confirmed diagnoses. Quality was appraised using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) checklist. Pooled prevalence was estimated using generalized linear mixed models (GLMM) with logit transformation (random effects; back-transformed). Subgroup analyses compared Kathmandu-based studies with non-Kathmandu studies; meta-regression examined publication year, log(sample size), and region. The certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. Results Ten studies (209,815 participants and 5,440 cases) were included. The pooled prevalence was 3.1% (95% CI 1.6-5.8%) with a wide prediction interval of 0.3-28.5%, indicating that the true prevalence in Nepalese settings could plausibly va
items.authors: Pandey, S.; Tiwari, A.; Bhattarai, A.; Timalsina, A.; Pandey, A.; Poudel, A.; Neupane, A.; Subedi, D. J.; Dhaubhadel, S.; Bista, K. B.

items.title: iPlexD2Go Integrates AI-Guided Biomarker Panel Discovery with Decentralized Multiplex Diagnostics
items.title_zh: iPlexD2Go：AI引导的生物标志物面板与去中心化多重诊断整合
items.summary_zh: 许多疾病，尤其是慢性疾病，涉及复杂的生物过程，单一生物标志物无法充分评估。我们开发了一种微型ChromaDot阵列（McDa）平台，以“一标志物一点”的方式进行多重生物标志物测量。该系统通过化学空间信号放大级联，将3D微针阵列的比色信号刻录到2D凝胶中，实现精确的智能手机信号采集与分析。以系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）患者的临床血清为模型，我们量化了五个生物标志物，并结合深度学习建模。经过5折交叉验证的支持向量机（SVM）模型识别出优化的三生物标志物面板，能够以97%的特异性和93%的敏感性区分SLE患者与健康对照，显著优于当前临床标准的抗核抗体（ANA）检测。为实现生物标志物面板分析的去中心化检测，我们进一步设计了一种迷你诊断设备（miniDia）及相关应用程序，能够自动化McDa检测、进行智能手机分析，并提供用户友好的结果读取，无需实验室或专业人员。
items.abstract: Many diseases, particularly chronic diseases, involve complex biological processes that cannot be adequately assessed by a single biomarker. However, identifying a specific biomarker panel and implementing its measurement at point-of-care (PoC) or home testing remain highly challenging. Here, we developed a micro-ChromaDot array (McDa) platform for multiplexed biomarker measurement in a one-biomarker-one-dot fashion. The system engraved colorimetric signals from a 3D microneedle array into a 2D gel via a chem-spatial signal-amplification cascade, enabling precise smartphone-based signal acquisition and analysis. Using clinical sera from systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) patients as a disease model, we quantified five biomarkers and integrated the data with deep-learning-assisted modeling. A support vector machine (SVM) model with 5-fold cross-validation identified an optimized three-biomarker panel that discriminated SLE patients from healthy controls with 97% specificity and 93% sensitivity, substantially outperforming the current clinical standard antinuclear antibody (ANA) test. To translate the biomarker-panel analysis into decentralized testing, we further engineered a mini-d

items.title: Vascular and neurodegenerative contributions to cognitive decline and multidomain progression in de novo Parkinsons disease
items.title_zh: 新发帕金森病中血管与神经退行性因素对认知衰退的影响
items.summary_zh: 引言：帕金森病（PD）中的认知衰退可能反映神经退行性和脑血管过程的相互作用，但其时间贡献尚不明确。方法：纳入PPMI中基线认知正常且至少有三年认知随访的新诊断未治疗PD参与者。采用线性混合效应模型分析纵向萎缩、白质高信号（WMH）和临床轨迹。混合效应模型还考察了基线WMH与相关萎缩模式表达分数与后续多领域临床进展之间的关联。结果：58名参与者经历了认知衰退，292名保持认知稳定。认知转变者在所有认知领域的衰退速度更快，伴随运动、步态、神经精神、睡眠相关和功能症状的加重。转变者的基线WMH负担更高，但未加速累积，同时伴随边缘系统和皮层下萎缩加速。更大的基线WMH负担与转变者在认知、步态和功能独立等十一项临床结果中的差异纵向进展相关（均q<0.05）。基线萎缩模式表达在八个结果中显示出类似的转变者依赖性关联。
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Cognitive decline in Parkinsons disease (PD) may reflect interacting neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular processes, but their distinct temporal contributions remain unclear. METHODS: Newly diagnosed, untreated PD participants from the PPMI who were cognitively normal at baseline and had at least three years of cognitive follow-ups were included. Linear mixed-effects models examined longitudinal atrophy, white matter hyperintensity (WMH), and clinical trajectories. Mixed-effects models also examined the associations between baseline WMHs and a decline-related atrophy pattern expression score with subsequent multidomain clinical progression. RESULTS: 58 participants experienced cognitive decline and 292 remained cognitively stable. Converters showed faster decline across all cognitive domains, accompanied by faster worsening of motor, gait, neuropsychiatric, sleep-related, and functional symptoms. Converters further showed higher baseline WMH burden without accelerated accumulation, alongside accelerated limbic and subcortical atrophy. items.authors: Moqadam, R.; Azizi, H.; Raeesi, S.; Zeighami, Y.; Dadar, M.

items.title: Omega-3 Supplementation with Lipid Biomarker Assessment in Youth with Migraine: A Quasi-Randomized Controlled Feasibility Trial
items.title_zh: 青少年偏头痛患者的Omega-3补充与脂质生物标志物评估的可行性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：Omega-3多不饱和脂肪酸可能调节与偏头痛相关的脂质介导的炎症通路，但针对儿童的生物靶点参与评估的试验方法仍有限。本研究评估了在儿童营养基础的偏头痛干预试验中，整合长期干血点生物标志物收集、验证的患者报告结果、饮食评估和监护人报告的可接受性措施的可行性。方法：在两家学术儿科神经科诊所进行了一项准随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的可行性试验。招募10-17岁偏头痛儿童和青少年，采用顺序交替分配法将其分为每日补充Omega-3（850 mg二十碳五烯酸+二十二碳六烯酸）或匹配的椰子油安慰剂，持续12周。可行性结果包括招募率、参与者保留率、监护人报告的补充剂依从性、干血点生物样本完成率、24小时饮食回顾完成率及通过监护人退出问卷评估的干预可接受性。根据已发布的儿童试验文献，后期设定的可行性基准为：招募率>70%、保留率≥70%、补充剂依从性≥70%（大多数天监护人报告给药）、生物样本完成率≥90%。
items.abstract: Background: Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids may modulate lipid-mediated inflammatory pathways implicated in migraine, yet pediatric trial methodologies evaluating biologic target engagement remain limited. This study evaluated the feasibility of conducting a pediatric nutrition-based migraine intervention trial integrating longitudinal dried blood spot biomarker collection, validated patient-reported outcome measures, dietary assessment, and caregiver-reported acceptability measures. Methods: A quasi-randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled feasibility trial was conducted at two academic pediatric neurology clinics. Children and adolescents aged 10-17 years with migraine were assigned 1:1 using sequential alternating allocation to daily omega-3 supplementation (850 mg eicosapentaenoic acid + docosahexaenoic acid) or matched coconut oil placebo for 12 weeks. Feasibility outcomes included recruitment yield, participant retention, caregiver-reported supplement adherence, dried blood spot biospecimen completion, 24-hour dietary recall completion, and intervention acceptability assessed via caregiver exit questionnaire. Feasibility benchmarks were established post hoc based on p

items.title: Absolute Benefit of Androgen Deprivation Therapy With Radiotherapy for Localized Prostate Cancer
items.title_zh: 局部前列腺癌放疗联合雄激素剥夺治疗的绝对获益
items.summary_zh: 目的：通过整合癌症特异性风险、其他原因死亡（OCM）风险和相对治疗效果，估算对局部前列腺癌男性患者添加和延长雄激素剥夺治疗（ADT）与放射治疗（RT）的绝对获益。方法：通过整合来自验证的分期系统（STAR-CAP）和非癌症死亡模型（OCCAM）的特定原因风险估计，评估个体化风险。然后，使用MARCAP荟萃分析中发布的风险比估计来纳入ADT治疗效果。模型的实用性通过前列腺、肺、结肠和卵巢（PLCO）癌症筛查试验队列（n=5468名具有完整协变量的前列腺癌患者）进行说明。主要结果是添加短期ADT（STADT）或将STADT延长至长期ADT（LTADT）后，估算的10年远处转移（DM）绝对风险降低（ARR）。结果：在PLCO中，模型估计的10年DM风险在<1%至56%之间，OCM风险在3%至80%之间。对于NCCN不良中等风险患者（n=1814），添加STADT到RT使估算的10年DM风险中位数降低4%，但个体ARR估计范围为<1%至近15%。NCCN高风险患者也观察到了类似的变异。
items.abstract: Objectives: To estimate the absolute benefit of adding and prolonging androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) to radiation therapy (RT) for men with localized prostate cancer by integrating cancer-specific risk, other-cause mortality (OCM) risk, and relative treatment efficacy. Subjects and Methods: Individualized risks were estimated by integrating cause-specific hazard estimates from a validated staging system (STAR-CAP) with those from a validated non-cancer mortality model (OCCAM). ADT treatment efficacy was then incorporated using published hazard ratio estimates from the MARCAP meta-analysis. Model utility was illustrated using the Prostate, Lung, Colon, and Ovarian (PLCO) cancer screening trial cohort (n=5468 prostate cancer patients with complete covariates). The primary outcome was the estimated 10-year absolute risk reduction (ARR) in distant metastasis (DM) from adding short-term ADT (STADT) to RT or extending STADT to long term ADT (LTADT). Results: Within PLCO, model estimated risk of DM at 10 years ranged from <1% to 56% under guideline concordant care and OCM risk ranged from 3% to 80% independent of treatment. items.title: Evaluation of AI-assisted summarisation of tertiary clinical genomics reports: results of the QNOMX-VHIR-CPSP-001 Phase 1 study
items.title_zh: 评估AI辅助总结三级临床基因组报告的研究结果
items.summary_zh: 背景：肿瘤学中的综合基因组报告包含复杂的分子信息，需要转化为简明的总结供临床医生使用。手动总结耗时，且支持AI辅助总结系统的证据有限。我们评估了AI生成的总结在忠实呈现三级儿科癌症基因组报告信息方面是否不劣于手动生成的总结。方法：QNOMX-VHIR-CPSP-001 Phase 1是一项在Vall d'Hebron Institut de Recerca进行的单中心非干预临床性能研究。使用评估中的AI辅助系统和标准手动工作流程对去标识化的三级儿科癌症基因组报告进行总结。三名合格评审员在盲法、交叉设计下使用六领域五点质量总结指数（QSI）评估两种总结类型。主要终点为内容和呈现的综合评分。结果：38个计划案例中有37个贡献了74对评估。AI生成和手动总结的平均内容评分相似。
items.abstract: Background. Comprehensive genomic reports in oncology contain complex molecular information that must be translated into concise summaries for treating clinicians. Manual summarisation is time-intensive, and robust evidence supporting AI-assisted summarisation systems remains limited. We evaluated whether AI-generated summaries were non-inferior to manually produced summaries in faithfully representing information from tertiary paediatric cancer genomics reports. Methods. QNOMX-VHIR-CPSP-001 Phase 1 was a single-site, non-interventional clinical performance study conducted at Vall d'Hebron Institut de Recerca under ISO 20916:2019. De-identified tertiary paediatric cancer genomics reports were summarised using both the AI-assisted system under evaluation and the standard manual workflow. Three qualified raters assessed both summary types against the source reports using the six-domain, five-point Quality Summary Index (QSI) in a blinded, counterbalanced crossover design with a minimum fourteen-day washout. Co-primary endpoints were composite content and presentation scores. Non-inferiority was assessed using a pre-specified Bayesian hierarchical model with a margin of 0.5 points and

items.title: Generative model of patient health states and pan-cancer risk stratification
items.title_zh: 患者健康状态生成模型及全癌症风险分层
items.summary_zh: 本研究介绍了GenEHR，一种自回归生成模型，基于数百万患者的电子健康记录（EHR）进行训练，能够在预测未来临床事件时明确表示就诊间隔的不规则时间。我们将基础训练中学习到的通用患者表征与针对全癌症风险分层的高效监督适应相结合。在五个大型EHR队列中，监督适应显著提高了五年内首次癌症诊断的预测性能。我们的回顾性结果支持GenEHR-CancerRisk作为前瞻性临床决策支持工具的评估，以优先考虑高风险筛查的患者，特别是胰腺癌和卵巢癌等侵袭性癌症类型。
items.abstract: While large language models are powerful generators of new text, forecasting disease progression from longitudinal health histories remains a challenging problem. We introduce GenEHR, an autoregressive generative model trained on electronic health records (EHRs) from millions of patients that explicitly represents the irregular time intervals between visits when forecasting future clinical events. We combine the general-purpose patient representation learned during foundational training with parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for the task of pan-cancer risk stratification. In five large EHR cohorts supervised adaptation substantially improved prediction performance of a first cancer diagnosis within a five year horizon window. Our retrospective results support the evaluation of GenEHR-CancerRisk as a prospective clinical decision-support tool for prioritizing patients for risk-based screening for aggressive cancer types, such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.

items.title: Antimalarial Pharmacotherapy Gaps in Nigerian Children Under Five: A Predictive Machine Learning Analysis of Care-Seeking, Testing, and ACT Treatment Using NDHS 2023-24
items.title_zh: 尼日利亚五岁以下儿童抗疟药物治疗缺口分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：尼日利亚的疟疾负担在全球最高，涉及发病率和死亡率。病例管理采用WHO的测试、治疗、追踪（T3）方法，可能在三个阶段（寻求护理、诊断测试和治疗适宜性）出现失败。本研究将这一过程分为两个结果，并比较了四种预测建模方法以识别决定因素。方法：从2023-24年尼日利亚DHS儿童重编码文件中，我们识别出3962名在调查前两周内报告发热的五岁以下儿童。缺口A（获取）定义为：从任何来源寻求护理并接受诊断血液测试。缺口B（质量）限于1776名接受任何抗疟药物的儿童，特别定义为仅接受青蒿素联合疗法（ACT）。我们测试并比较了加权逻辑回归、弹性网回归、随机森林和梯度提升（XGBoost）模型，使用单一保留测试分区和接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估所有四个模型的表现。结果：发热儿童的综合获取比例为16.0%，接受抗疟药物的儿童中有60.2%接受了ACT。
items.abstract: Background: Nigeria's malaria burden is the highest in the world, both in terms of incidence and fatalities. Case management uses the WHO's Test, Treat, Track (T3) approach, where failures can occur at three stages (care-seeking, diagnostic testing, and treatment appropriateness), which are often combined into a single coverage measure. In this study, we split the cascade into two outcomes and compared four predictive modeling approaches to identify determinants. Methods: From the Children's Recode file of the 2023-24 Nigeria DHS, we identified 3,962 children under 5 years of age who reported having a fever in the two weeks before the survey. Gap A (access) was defined as: seeking care from any source and receiving a diagnostic blood test. Gap B (quality) was limited to the 1,776 children who had received any antimalarial, and specifically defined as receipt of an artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) only. items.title: Dynamic Prediction to Predict Virologic Failure in Antiretroviral Treated People Living with HIV: Cohort Analysis of Routine Electronic Health Records Data in the Western Cape, South Africa
items.title_zh: 动态预测模型评估南非HIV患者抗病毒治疗中的病毒学失败
items.summary_zh: 目的：病毒学失败（VF）在HIV护理中仍然是一个主要挑战，尤其是在资源有限的环境中。动态预测模型可以利用纵向生物标志物数据提供个体风险评估。方法：我们开发并内部验证了一个动态预测模型，使用来自南非西开普省122,425名接受抗病毒治疗的HIV患者的常规电子健康记录数据。模型结合了线性混合效应模型和Cox模型，调整了基线年龄组和出生性别。结果：共有12,547名HIV患者（10.2%）经历了病毒学失败。模型在12个月和24个月时显示出中等的区分度（AUC: 0.69和0.73）和良好的校准（Brier分数: 0.033和0.051）。结论：该动态预测模型在常规EHR数据中具有应用潜力。
items.abstract: Objectives Virologic failure (VF) remains a major challenge in HIV care, particularly in resource-limited settings where timely identification is critical. Dynamic prediction models can provide continuously updated, individual-level risk estimates using longitudinal biomarker data. However, their applicability to routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data remains poorly understood. We developed and internally validated a dynamic prediction model for VF using routine EHR data from people with HIV (PWH) receiving antiretroviral therapy in South Africa. Methods A joint model (JM) linking a linear mixed-effects model for longitudinal HIV viral load (HIVVL) to a Cox model for time to first VF, adjusted for baseline age group and sex at birth, was developed using routine National Health Laboratory Service data from 122,425 PWH in the Western Cape, South Africa (SA) (January 2008-September 2018), randomly split into development (n = 91,818; 75%) and validation (n = 30,607; 25%) cohorts. items.title: Effectiveness and safety of a New Standardised TrEatment Protocol based on initial/early therapy with single-pill combinations of blood pressure-lowering drugs for improving blood pressure control (NewSTeP): Rationale, design of a randomized clinical trial and baseline characteristics of the trial participants
items.title_zh: 新标准化治疗方案对高血压控制的有效性与安全性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：高血压是心血管疾病的主要可改变风险因素。尽管有降压治疗，血压控制率仍不理想。组合治疗启动的犹豫和治疗强化的延迟导致控制不佳。早期使用单片组合药物（SPCs）可能改善结果，但印度的证据有限。目的：评估新标准化治疗方案（NewSTeP）中早期使用SPCs的有效性与安全性。方法：NewSTeP试验为一项在印度三级医疗中心进行的多中心随机对照试验。300名未治疗或仅接受一种降压药的高血压成年人将1:1随机分配至新治疗方案或常规护理组，随访6个月。主要有效性指标为随机化至第6个月的家庭测量平均收缩压变化，主要安全性指标为因不良事件停药的比例。
items.abstract: Background Hypertension is the leading modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease (CVD). Despite availability of blood pressure (BP)-lowering therapies, BP control rates remain suboptimal. Reluctance to initiate treatment with combination therapy and delayed treatment intensification contribute to poor control. Early use of single-pill combinations (SPCs) within standardised treatment protocols (STPs) may improve outcomes, but evidence from India is limited. Objective To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of a new STP incorporating initial or early use of SPCs compared with usual care among adults with hypertension. Methods The New Standardised TrEatment Protocol (NewSTeP) trial is a pragmatic, multicentre, randomized, parallel-group, open-label trial conducted in tertiary healthcare centres in India. Adults with hypertension who are untreated or receiving one BP-lowering drug and require treatment initiation or intensification (n = 300) will be randomized 1:1 to either a new STP incorporating early SPC therapy or usual care. items.title: Clinically Accessible Phenotypes Refine Cardiovascular Risk Stratification Beyond Contemporary Clinical Equations
items.title_zh: 临床可及表型优化心血管风险分层超越现有临床方程
items.summary_zh: 背景：现有心血管风险方程指导预防，但风险分布超出高风险群体。基线表型是否能改善风险分层及其是否可简化为临床可及指标尚不确定。目的：评估基线表型是否能超越PREVENT和CHARGE-AF改善心血管风险分层，以及该信息是否可压缩为临床可及的措施。方法：研究266,410名无冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤或中风的UK Biobank参与者，分为训练、验证和保留测试样本。使用PREVENT方程估算冠心病、心力衰竭和中风的10年风险，使用CHARGE-AF估算5年房颤风险。考虑了3,838种基线表型。结果：临床方程识别的最高风险20%占后续事件的44.8%至55.2%。广泛表型优化了风险分层。经过压缩，13至19种疾病特异性临床可及指标保留了部分广泛表型提供的增量区分，IPCW AUC改善幅度为0.013至0.030。
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Contemporary cardiovascular risk equations guide prevention, yet cardiovascular risk remains distributed beyond the highest-risk groups. Whether broader baseline phenotyping can improve risk stratification and whether this information can be reduced to clinically accessible measures is uncertain. OBJECTIVES To assess whether baseline phenotyping improves cardiovascular risk stratification beyond PREVENT and CHARGE-AF and whether this information can be compressed into clinically accessible measures. METHODS We studied 266,410 UK Biobank participants without prevalent CHD, HF, AF, or stroke, divided into training, validation, and held-out test samples. PREVENT equations were used to estimate 10-year risk for CHD, HF, and stroke, and CHARGE-AF to estimate 5-year AF risk. Models considered 3,838 baseline phenotypes. Geographic replication was assessed in Scotland and Wales. RESULTS The highest-risk 20% identified by the clinical equations accounted for 44.8% to 55.2% of subsequent events across the 4 outcomes. items.title: Prevalence and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus (HPV) among adolescent girls and young women in a high HIV burden rural area of South Africa: a cross-sectional survey
items.title_zh: 南非高HIV负担地区青少年女性HPV流行及基因型分布研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是宫颈癌的主要致病因素，HIV感染女性面临更高的HPV感染及相关疾病风险。关于南非农村地区青少年女孩和年轻女性（AGYW）HPV流行及基因型分布的数据仍然有限。本研究估计了南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省高HIV流行区AGYW的HPV流行率、基因型分布及与HPV感染相关的因素。方法：本横断面研究嵌套于Thetha Nami试验的基线调查中，参与者为15至30岁的年轻人。参与者提供干血点进行HIV检测和生殖道拭子进行性传播感染检测。结果：在187名有效HPV结果的AGYW中，90名（48.1%）为HIV阳性。总体HPV流行率为69.1%（95%置信区间（CI）=54.5至80.7%），高风险HPV流行率为57.3%（95%CI=44.1至69.6%）。
items.abstract: Background Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer, with women living with HIV at increased risk of HPV infection and HPV related disease. Data on HPV prevalence and genotype distribution among adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) in rural South African settings remain limited. We estimated HPV prevalence, genotype distribution, and factors associated with HPV infection among AGYW in a high HIV prevalence district of KwaZulu Natal, South Africa. Methods This cross-sectional study was nested within the baseline survey of the Thetha Nami population-based trial among young people aged 15 to 30 years in rural uMkhanyakude District, KwaZulu-Natal. Survey participants were asked to provide dried blood spots for HIV testing and genital swabs for STI testing. For this study, we selected AGYW living with HIV with available vaginal swabs and a frequency-matched sample of AGYW without HIV. HPV genotyping was done using the HPV Direct Flow Chip Kit (Master Diagnostica, Spain). Genotype-specific HPV prevalence was described overall and by HIV status. Logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with HPV infection. Results Among 187 AGYW with valid HP

items.title: Molecular epidemiology of respiratory syncytial virus infections in Arizona, USA during the 2023-24 and 2024-25 seasons.
items.title_zh: 2023-24和2024-25年亚利桑那州呼吸道合胞病毒感染的分子流行病学研究
items.summary_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒感染是婴儿和老年患者住院的常见原因。随着疫苗和治疗性抗体的可用性增加，监测病毒基因组的序列变异对于识别潜在的中和突变至关重要。在2023-24和2024-25年RSV季节，我们从出现流感样症状的患者中收集了未配对的鼻咽拭子样本。通过平铺扩增富集或商业寡核苷酸杂交富集面板及下一代测序，我们获得了RSV及共感染病毒的基因组序列。系统发育分析显示RSV-A菌株属于A.D.1、A.D.2、A.D.3和A.D.5亚克隆，RSV-B基因组属于B.D.4.1、B.D.4.1.1、B.D.E.1、B.D.E.5和B.D.E.7谱系。在两季监测期间，我们在RSV-A基因组中发现9个多态位点，在RSV-B基因组中发现18个多态位点，且在RSV-A和RSV-B基因组中分别识别出7个和8个位于G蛋白保守中心域的多态位点。
items.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus infection is a common cause of hospitalizations in infants and elderly patients. With the increased availability of vaccines and therapeutic antibodies, surveilling the sequence landscape of viral genomes is important to increase awareness of potentially neutralizing mutations. During the 2023-24 and 2024-25 RSV seasons, we collected unpaired nasopharyngeal swab specimens from patients presenting to Arizona healthcare systems with symptoms of influenza-like illness. Using either tiled am-plicon-based enrichment or a commercial oligo hybrid-enrichment panel and next generation sequencing, we obtained genome sequences for RSV and co-infecting viruses. We performed phylogenetic and genomic analyses to classify RSV genomes and detect mutations in the antigenic sites of the F protein and conserved central domain of the G protein. Phylogenetic analysis showed RSV-A strains belonged to the A.D. 1, A.D.2, A.D.3, and A.D. 5 subclades. RSV-B genomes belonged to the B.D.4.1, B.D.4.1.1, B.D.E.1, B.D.E.5, and B.D.E. 7 clades. We found 9 polymorphic sites located in the antigenic sites of the F protein in our RSV-A genomes and 18 polymorphic sites in our RSV-B genomes

items.title: Long-term follow-up in pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2A: survival, symptom course, and disease burden
items.title_zh: 2A型桥小脑发育不良的长期随访研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：2A型桥小脑发育不良（PCH2A）是一种罕见的常染色体隐性遗传疾病，预期寿命较短。临床特征包括严重的发育迟缓、小头畸形和运动障碍。常见的附加症状有喂养困难、呕吐、肌张力障碍发作和癫痫。与正常发育儿童的父母相比，PCH2A儿童的父母健康相关生活质量较低。本研究旨在对生存率、症状及疾病负担进行随访。方法：患者主要通过德国患者组织（PCH-Familie e.V.）招募，需基因确认PCH2A。数据收集时间为2020-2022年，采用家长问卷和医疗报告，疑问通过半结构化电话访谈澄清。统计分析采用定量方法，根据数据分布使用适当的统计检验。结果：65名患者参与，年龄中位数为6.4岁，性别分布均衡。16名患者（25%）在中位年龄5.5岁时去世，10年生存率为71.5%。喂养困难、运动障碍和睡眠障碍为常见且持续的症状。癫痫随年龄增加，而呕吐和肌张力障碍发作随时间减少。
items.abstract: Background Pontocerebellar hypoplasia Type 2A (PCH2A) is a rare, autosomal recessive disorder with reduced life expectancy. Clinical features include profound developmental delay, microcephaly, and a dyskinetic movement disorder. Additional symptoms frequently observed are feeding difficulties, vomiting, dystonic attacks, and seizures. Compared to parents of typically developing children, parents of children with PCH2A experience decreased health-related quality of life. The aim of this study was to provide a follow-up on survival, symptoms, and perceived disease burden. Methods Patients were primarily recruited via the German patients' organization (PCH-Familie e.V.). Inclusion required genetic confirmation of PCH2A. Data were collected from 2020-2022 using parent questionnaires and medical reports; uncertainties were clarified during semi-standardized telephone interviews. Statistical analysis was quantitative, appropriate statistical tests were used, depending on the data distribution. Results Sixty-five patients participated, with a median age of 6.4 years and balanced gender distribution. Sixteen patients (25%) died at a median age of 5.5 years. Ten-year survival rate was 71.5

items.title: Safety and efficiency of the HEART-GP strategy with point-of-care high-sensitivity troponin testing for acute chest pain in out-of-hours primary care: a prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy study
items.title_zh: HEART-GP策略在急性胸痛中的安全性与有效性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：全科医生常是急性胸痛患者的首位评估者，但诊断支持有限。研究旨在评估HEART-GP策略，该策略结合结构化临床评估、指尖血高敏肌钙蛋白I检测和心电图。方法：在四个荷兰的非工作时间初级保健中心进行前瞻性多中心配对诊断准确性研究，招募2023年3月至2025年8月期间的急性非创伤性胸痛患者。全科医生在肌钙蛋白结果前记录管理意图，以便与未经辅助的临床判断进行配对比较。HEART-GP策略建议在高临床怀疑、肌钙蛋白≥4 ng/L或缺血性心电图时紧急转诊。主要结果为6周内重大不良心血管事件（MACE）。结果：1104名患者中，917名被纳入研究，62名（6.8%）发生MACE。
items.abstract: Background: GPs are often the first clinicians to assess acute chest pain in gatekeeper healthcare systems, but usually with limited diagnostic support. They must distinguish conditions that can be managed safely in primary care from those requiring immediate hospital evaluation, particularly acute coronary syndrome (ACS), while avoiding unnecessary over-referral to already pressured emergency departments. We evaluated HEART-GP, a novel GP-led strategy combining structured clinical assessment, fingerstick point-of-care high-sensitivity troponin I testing, and ECG when available. Methods: We performed a prospective, multicentre, paired diagnostic accuracy study in four Dutch out-of-hours primary care centres implementing the HEART-GP strategy. Patients with acute non-traumatic chest pain and possible ACS according to the treating GP were enrolled from March 2023 to August 2025. Before troponin results were available, GPs recorded intended management, allowing paired comparison with unaided clinical judgement. The HEART-GP strategy recommended urgent referral for high clinical suspicion, troponin of >=4 ng/L, or ischaemic ECG. The primary outcome was adjudicated 6-week major adverse

items.title: Inequalities and practice-level predictors of cancer diagnostic activity: longitudinal study in England
items.title_zh: 癌症诊断活动的不平等及实践层面预测因素：英国纵向研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：及时的全科医生（GP）转诊有助于早期癌症检测。然而，GP实践面临压力，尤其是在贫困地区，这可能与诊断不平等相关。目的：研究实践内的访问、劳动力和人口收入贫困变化是否与诊断护理指标相关。设计与设置：对2015-2019年和2022-2023年间6194个实践的回顾性纵向研究。方法：采用面板固定效应回归分析USC转诊率、USC阳性预测值（PPV）、USC敏感性和急诊就诊率。预测因素包括患者报告的访问情况、GP劳动力和实践人口收入贫困。结果：在实践内每增加一个标准差，(i) 更好的预约体验（-1.4%）和较高的GP平均年龄（-3.5%）与较低的USC转诊率相关，而女性GP比例（+1.3%）则与较高的转诊率相关；GP全职当量（FTE）与转诊率呈小幅正相关（+0.7%至+0.8%）。(ii) USC PPV随GP平均年龄增加而上升（+2.2%）。(iii) USC敏感性随GP平均年龄增加而下降（-1.1%）；急诊就诊与访问或劳动力因素的关联有限。为最贫困人群服务的实践急诊就诊率较高（+13.7%）。贫困对访问和劳动力关联的影响证据有限。GP平均年龄是一个例外。
items.abstract: Background: Early cancer detection is aided by timely GP referrals. However, GP practices face pressures, particularly in deprived areas, which may be associated with diagnostic inequalities. Aim: To examine whether within-practice changes in access, workforce, and population income deprivation were associated with diagnostic care indicators. Design and setting: Retrospective longitudinal study of 6,194 practices between 2015-2019 and 2022-2023. Method: Panel fixed-effects regression examined USC referral rates, USC PPV, USC sensitivity, and emergency presentation rates. Predictors were patient-reported access, GP workforce, and practice population income deprivation. Results: Per one SD increase within practices, (i) USC referral rates were lower with better appointment-making experience (-1.4%) and older average GP age (-3.5%), and higher with female GP share (+1.3%); GP FTE showed a small positive association (+0.7% to +0.8%). (ii) USC PPV increased with older average GP age (+2.2%). (iii) USC sensitivity was lower with older average GP age (-1.1%); emergency presentations showed limited association with access or workforce factors. Practices had higher emergency presentation ra

items.title: Polygenic and machine learning analysis of medication response in a prospective pediatric cohort initiating ADHD medication
items.title_zh: 多基因与机器学习分析儿童ADHD药物反应
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨多基因评分（PGS）在预测注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）药物反应中的潜力。我们从瑞典ADHD药物及治疗结果预测研究（ADAPT）中招募了309名6至17岁参与者，并计算其PGS。与参考队列（N=780）相比，ADAPT组的ADHD PGS显著较高（p<2.22e-16），而自闭症（p=0.0051）、教育成就（EA）（p=8e-10）和智力（p=7e-08）的PGS则较低。线性混合效应模型分析显示，ADHD PGS与总体SNAP-IV评分呈正相关（{beta}=0.1419, p=0.0078, FDR=0.0293），但与随访变化无显著关联；而EA PGS则与总体评分呈负相关（{beta}=-0.1161, p=0.0256, FDR=0.0679），并在随访中表现出更小的减少（{beta}=0.0946, p=0.0453, FDR=0.1130）。亚组分析显示，这些效应在青少年（[ ]13岁）和被分类为治疗反应者的个体中更为显著。
items.abstract: While medication for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is effective, predictors of treatment response remain poorly understood. Given the use of polygenic scores (PGS) in psychiatric conditions, we investigate their potential to predict ADHD medication response. In this work, we recruited 309 participants aged 6-17 years from the Swedish ADHD medication and predictors of treatment outcome (ADAPT) study (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02136147; June 2015), and calculated their PGS. Compared with a reference cohort (N=780), ADAPT showed higher PGS for ADHD (p<2.22e-16), and lower PGS for autism (p=0.0051), educational attainment (EA) (p=8e-10), and intelligence (p=7e-08). To assess the association between genetic effects and changes in Swanson, Nolan, and Pelham ADHD Rating Scale-version IV (SNAP-IV) scores, linear mixed-effects models tested the interaction between each PGS and time (baseline, 3-months). PGS for ADHD was associated with higher SNAP-IV scores overall ({beta}=0.1419, p=0.0078, FDR=0.0293) but not with a change at follow-up; whereas, PGS for EA was associated with lower overall scores ({beta}=-0.1161, p=0.0256, FDR=0.0679) and smaller reductions at follow-up ({be

items.title: Therapists' perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.title_zh: 治疗师对使用下肢外骨骼在脑瘫儿童物理治疗中的看法
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：脑瘫儿童通常比神经典型儿童更少活动。动力过地面外骨骼提供稳定的辅助步态，已显示出促进功能性和锻炼相关的参与机会。本研究旨在探讨物理治疗团队在与轻度行走能力受限的脑瘫儿童进行物理治疗时使用下肢外骨骼的经验、感知的益处和挑战。方法：在一项前后可行性试验中进行定性描述研究，涉及10名脑瘫儿童（GMFCS IV级，4至6岁），他们在六周内每周接受两次基于下肢外骨骼的物理治疗。物理治疗师（PT，n=5）和物理治疗助理（PTA，n=4）干预团队在完成外骨骼干预后接受了访谈。通过Zoom进行半结构化访谈，访谈记录的编码后进行了归纳主题分析。结果：共进行了10对PT/PTA的访谈，具体与10名儿童在外骨骼研究中的干预体验相关。形成了三个主题：1）外骨骼基础的治疗提供了额外的运动/粗大运动选项，可能成为传统治疗的有价值补充；2）外骨骼基础的治疗...
items.abstract: Background and objective: Children with cerebral palsy (CP) generally experience more sedentary lifestyles than neurotypical peers. Powered overground exoskeletons offer stable and assisted stepping that have been shown to lead to functional and exercise-linked participation opportunities. Our aim was to explore physiotherapy team experiences, perceived benefits and challenges when using an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions with minimally ambulatory children with CP. Methods: Qualitative descriptive study within a pre/post feasibility trial involving 10 children with CP (GMFCS Level IV, 4 to 6 years) who received lower limb exoskeleton-based physiotherapy twice weekly over six weeks in school or outpatient setting. Physiotherapist (PT, n=5) and physiotherapy assistant (PTA, n=4) intervention team dyads were interviewed following completion of the exoskeleton intervention with their assigned child. Semi-structured interviews were conducted over Zoom. Coding of interview transcripts was followed by inductive thematic analysis. Results: There were 10 PT/PTA dyad interviews linked specifically to 10 children's intervention experiences in the exoskeleton study.

items.title: Evaluation of Urinary Circulating Tumor DNA to Detect Minimal Residual Disease in Patients with High-Risk Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer
items.title_zh: 评估尿液循环肿瘤DNA检测高危非肌肉侵袭性膀胱癌的微小残留病
items.summary_zh: 目的：对某些高危非肌肉侵袭性膀胱癌（NMIBC）患者进行膀胱肿瘤经尿道切除术再分期（reTURBT）是标准治疗，但可能导致并发症，因此需要生物标志物以避免不必要的reTURBT。方法：前瞻性招募接受reTURBT的高危NMIBC患者，采用全外显子组测序和低通量全基因组测序对TURBT样本进行突变谱和拷贝数变异分析。使用最多50个个性化突变和固定的500个热点突变面板检测reTURBT前收集的尿液样本中的变异。通过预设算法，测量微小残留病的肿瘤分数（TF）和拷贝数负担（CNB）评分，并与reTURBT病理结果相关联。结果：共收集72/76个高危NMIBC患者的尿液样本通过质量检测。来自TURBT标本的中位个性化变异为39个。肿瘤分数中位数在有残留肿瘤患者为0.206，无残留肿瘤患者为0.001（p<0.001）。CNB评分也显著升高（7.34 vs. 4.02, p<0.001）。utDNA在预测疾病方面的敏感性为97.8%，特异性为69.2%，曲线下面积（AUC）为0.932。
items.abstract: Purpose Restaging transurethral resection of bladder tumor (reTURBT) is the standard-of-care for some patients with high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). However, it may lead to complications and biomarkers to avoid unnecessary reTURBT are needed. Materials and Methods Patients with high-risk NMIBC undergoing reTURBT were prospectively enrolled. Whole-exome sequencing along with low-pass whole-genome sequencing were performed on index TURBT samples to generate mutational profiles and copy number variation. Up to 50 personalized mutations and a fixed panel of 500 hotspot mutations were used for detecting variants from urine samples collected prior to reTURBT. Using a prespecified algorithm, tumor fraction (TF) and copy number burden (CNB) score were used to measure minimal residual disease and correlated with reTURBT pathology. Results Overall, 72/76 urine samples collected from patients with high-risk NMIBC prior to reTURBT passed quality check. From the indext TURBT specimens, a median of 39 personalized variants from the index TURBT were used for disease tracking. items.title: Drug-Drug Interaction Signals Between Anti-Amyloid-β Antibodies and Antithrombotic Drugs for Amyloid-Related Imaging Abnormalities and Intracranial Hemorrhage: A FAERS Disproportionality Analysis
items.title_zh: 抗淀粉样β抗体与抗凝药物间相互作用信号研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：抗淀粉样β（Aβ）单克隆抗体是早期阿尔茨海默病的疾病修饰治疗，但与淀粉样相关影像异常（ARIA）和颅内出血（ICH）相关。目的：评估抗Aβ抗体与抗凝药物在ARIA和ICH方面的潜在药物间相互作用（DDI）信号。方法：分析1997至2024年FDA不良事件报告系统（FAERS）的报告，评估的抗Aβ抗体包括阿杜卡单抗、利卡单抗和多纳单抗，抗凝药物包括阿司匹林、P2Y12抑制剂、直接口服抗凝药、华法林和组织型纤溶酶原激活剂（tPA）。结果：所有三种抗体在所有结果中均显示出正信号。阿司匹林在三种模型中对任何ARIA、ARIA-E和ARIA-H显示出正DDI信号。利卡单抗-阿司匹林在多个模型中对任何ARIA和ARIA-H也显示信号。对于ICH，tPA在所有四个模型中与利卡单抗均显示信号。
items.abstract: Background: Anti-amyloid-{beta} (A{beta}) monoclonal antibodies are disease-modifying treatments for early Alzheimer's disease but are associated with amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA) and intracranial hemorrhage (ICH). However, the safety of concomitant antithrombotic use remains unclear. Objective: To evaluate potential drug-drug interaction (DDI) signals between anti-A{beta} antibodies and antithrombotic drugs for ARIA and ICH using the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS; JAPIC AERS). Methods: FAERS reports from 1997 to 2024 were analyzed. The anti-A{beta} antibodies evaluated were aducanumab, lecanemab, and donanemab. Antithrombotics were aspirin, P2Y12 inhibitors, direct oral anticoagulants, warfarin, and tissue-type plasminogen activators (tPAs). Outcomes were any ARIA, ARIA with edema or effusion (ARIA-E), ARIA with hemosiderin deposition (ARIA-H), and ICH. Individual-drug signals were assessed using reporting odds ratios and information components; DDIs were evaluated using four complementary models. Results: All three antibodies showed positive signals for all outcomes. When the three antibodies were analyzed together, aspirin showed positive DDI signals

items.title: Data-driven subtypes of Alzheimer's Disease: A multicohort study
items.title_zh: 数据驱动的阿尔茨海默病亚型：多队列研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者在血管变化和神经退行性变的严重程度上表现出显著异质性，因此识别生物学上有意义的亚型对于改善预后和个性化干预至关重要。我们旨在通过磁共振成像（MRI）对AD高风险或已诊断个体进行数据驱动的亚型划分，以识别疾病进展和临床结果的不同轨迹。方法：我们分析了PREVENT-AD、CIMA-Q、ALLFTD和ADNI队列中的基线生物标志物及纵向临床和认知评估数据，共包括1396名参与者。区域萎缩和白质高信号（WMH）负担来自T1加权MRI。应用SuStaIn算法推断个体的亚型和阶段。结果：在所有队列中识别出两种不同的亚型：一种以早期海马旁回和皮层萎缩为特征，另一种则以初期WMH体积升高为特征。两种亚型均表现出异常的tau和淀粉样蛋白水平。
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Individuals with Alzheimer's disease (AD) exhibit substantial heterogeneity in the severity of vascular changes and neurodegeneration, making the identification of biologically meaningful subtypes across the AD spectrum critical for improving prognosis and tailoring interventions. We aimed to determine whether data-driven subtyping of individuals at risk for or diagnosed with AD, based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), can identify distinct trajectories of disease progression and clinical outcomes. METHODS: We analyzed baseline biomarkers and longitudinal clinical and cognitive assessments from the PREVENT-AD, CIMA-Q, ALLFTD, and ADNI cohorts, including 1396 participants. Regional atrophy and White Matter Hyperintensity (WMH) burden were derived from T1-weighted MRI. The SuStaIn algorithm was applied to baseline data to infer individuals' subtypes and stages based on MRI biomarker profiles. The resulting subtypes were compared in terms of baseline molecular biomarker levels and vascular risk factors, longitudinal cognitive decline trajectories, and clinical and neuropathological outcomes. items.title: Immune Profiling after treatment with an Anti-CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cell Therapy in Treatment-Refractory Progressive Multiple Sclerosis
items.title_zh: 抗CD19嵌合抗原受体T细胞治疗难治性进行性多发性硬化的免疫特征分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对两名难治性进行性多发性硬化（MS）患者，采用0.33e8自体抗CD19 CAR T细胞（mivocabtagene autoleucel，miv-cel）进行治疗。患者1（50岁女性，EDSS 6）未出现细胞因子释放综合征（CRS）或免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征（ICANS）；患者2（60岁女性，EDSS 4.5）出现1级CRS，无ICANS。两名患者在第14天的脑脊液中均观察到CAR T细胞扩增，且疾病相关的寡克隆带（OCB）持续消失或IgG指数正常化，尽管外周初始B细胞重建。MRI和临床结果在第48周显示持续稳定。血清学研究显示抗埃比斯坦-巴尔病毒（EBV）血清阳性率下降。单细胞髓系和蛋白质组学特征显示促炎症特征下降。结果表明，低剂量抗CD19 CAR T细胞治疗（miv-cel）在这两名进行性MS患者中是安全的。
items.abstract: Treatment targeting progressive multiple sclerosis (MS) have limited efficacy, as central nervous system (CNS) resident B cells are resistant to peripheral B cell depletion by antiCD20 monoclonal antibodies. CD19 targeted chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)T cells offer the promise to deplete B cells more extensively in both the peripheral and CNS compartments. Two adult participants with treatment-refractory progressive MS were treated with 0.33e8 autologous anti CD19 CAR T cells (mivocabtagene autoleucel, miv-cel) intravenously after a preconditioning regimen. Participant 1 (50's year old female, EDSS 6) had no cytokine release syndrome (CRS) or immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS). Participant 2 (60's year old female, EDSS 4.5) had grade 1 CRS and no ICANS. Expansion of CAR T cells in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) at Day 14 was noted in both participants, remarkably with sustained disappearance of disease-associated oligoclonal band (OCB) or normalization of IgG index despite peripheral naive B cell reconstitution. items.title: Improving Immediate Postpartum Detection of Obstetric Anal Sphincter Injury: Added Diagnostic Value of Impedance Spectroscopy Following Clinical Assessment
items.title_zh: 改善产后立即检测产科肛门括约肌损伤的诊断价值
items.summary_zh: 目的：评估产后立即使用阻抗谱（IS）结合临床评估对产科肛门括约肌损伤（OASI）的附加诊断价值，以三维肛门超声（3D EAUS）作为解剖参考评估。方法：本前瞻性观察队列研究纳入了在阴道分娩后，具有至少一个预定义OASI风险因素或对括约肌损伤存在临床不确定性的女性。参与者接受产后临床评估，包括数字直肠检查和必要时的高级产科重新评估，随后进行产后立即IS。完成3D EAUS的女性被纳入配对诊断分析。结果：151名女性中，有70名完成EAUS并纳入配对分析；其中29/70（41.4%）在EAUS参考评估中为OASI阳性。IS的敏感性为86.2%（95% CI 69.4-94.5），特异性为92.7%（95% CI 80.6-97.5），总体准确性为90.0%（95% CI 80.8-95.1），而临床评估的敏感性、特异性和总体准确性分别为75.9%（95% CI 57.9-87.8）、70.7%（95% CI 55.5-82.4）和72.9%（95% CI 61.5-81.9）。在配对分析中，IS正确而临床评估错误的有17名女性。
items.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the added diagnostic value of immediate postpartum impedance spectroscopy (IS) when used alongside clinical assessment for obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI), using subsequent three-dimensional endoanal ultrasound (3D EAUS) as the anatomical reference assessment. Methods: This prospective observational cohort study included women following vaginal birth with at least one predefined OASI risk factor or clinical uncertainty regarding sphincter injury. Participants underwent postpartum clinical assessment, including digital rectal examination and senior obstetric reassessment when required, followed by immediate postpartum IS. Women who subsequently completed 3D EAUS were included in the paired diagnostic analysis. Diagnostic performance, agreement with EAUS and clinically relevant discordant findings were evaluated. Results: Of 151 women enrolled, 70 completed EAUS and were included in the paired analysis; 29/70 (41.4%) were OASI-positive on the EAUS-based reference assessment. items.title: The Impact of Opioid, Opioid Agonist Therapy, and Cannabis Exposure on Fetal Growth: A Population-Based Cohort Study
items.title_zh: 阿片类药物、阿片激动剂治疗与大麻对胎儿生长的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨阿片类药物及阿片激动剂治疗（OAT）暴露孕妇胎儿生长特征受大麻暴露影响的程度。采用基于人群的队列研究设计，研究对象为安大略省2015年至2019年间的所有活产和死产。研究发现，共纳入959,731例出生，暴露情况包括864,508例（88.0%）无物质暴露、73,815例（7.7%）尼古丁、23,003例（2.4%）大麻、7,694例（0.8%）阿片类药物和5,353例（0.6%）OAT。大麻共暴露在每6例阿片类药物和/或OAT暴露的出生中报告1例。与无物质暴露组相比，物质暴露组中小于胎龄（SGA）和子宫内生长受限（IUGR）的比例约增加了一倍。调整分析显示，仅大麻暴露与胎儿生长受限风险增加84%相关。
items.abstract: Objectives. The primary objective is to determine the extent to which fetal growth profiles in opioid and opioid agonist (OAT) exposed pregnancies are influenced by cannabis exposure. Secondary objectives are to examine differences in fetal and neonatal morbidity and mortality. Design. Population-based cohort study. Setting. Ontario, Canada, in a public healthcare system. Participants. All live/stillborn births between April 1st, 2013, and March 31st, 2021. Exposures. Substance exposure in pregnancy, including opioids, opioid agonist therapy, cannabis, and nicotine. Main Outcome Measures. Primary outcome measures included incidence of small for gestational age (<3rd and <10th percentile for sex) and intrauterine growth restriction. Secondary outcome measures included incidence of stillbirth, severe neonatal morbidity (SNM), neonatal mortality, and neonatal abstinence syndrome (NAS). Results. 959,731 births are included with exposures classified as 864,508 (88.0%) no substance, 73,815 (7.7%) nicotine, 23,003 (2.4%) cannabis, 7,694 (0.8%) opioid, and 5,353 (0.6%) OAT. items.title: Gut microbiome alterations predictive of cancer risk
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物组变化与癌症风险的预测关系
items.summary_zh: 癌症是全球第二大死亡原因。许多癌症死亡与可改变的风险因素有关，如烟草使用和饮食因素，强调了预防的重要性。本文聚焦于通过微生物组变化将个体分为高低癌症风险组，研究对象包括来自不同欧洲国家的两组癌症患者和四组普通人群，总计16,255人，其中3,341例为癌症病例。研究发现，特定癌症类型（肺癌、肾癌和乳腺癌）存在共同的微生物组变化，并在不同癌症患者中均有体现。这些变化在法国、荷兰、芬兰和拉脱维亚均被发现。此外，1,640名在微生物组采样后被诊断为癌症的人，其微生物组变化与已诊断癌症病例相似，但程度较低，表明微生物组可能在癌症诊断前就已向癌症相关状态演变。最后，微生物组变化的程度可用于对已诊断癌症病例的分层。
items.abstract: Cancer is the second leading cause of death worldwide. A large proportion of cancer deaths is associated with modifiable risk factors, such as tobacco use, or dietary factors. This indicates a major role for prevention to reduce cancer deaths. Prevention has two main facets, identifying individuals at risk and mitigating their risk. Here we focus on the first, using microbiome alterations to stratify individuals into groups of higher and lower cancer risk, leveraging two cohorts of cancer patients and four general population cohorts from different European countries, totaling 16,255 individuals and including 3,341 cancer cases. For that, we first establish existence of common microbiome alterations in several specific cancer types (lung, kidney and breast) and show their presence in groups of individuals with different cancers. These alterations are found in France, the Netherlands, Finland and Latvia. items.title: Molecular Diagnosis as a Probability of Necessity
items.title_zh: 作为必要性概率的分子诊断研究
items.summary_zh: 遗传诊断需要将患者的疾病归因于某种变异。我们提出了必要性概率（PN），这是一个反事实估计量，给出了在观察到生殖系变异的情况下，疾病在缺失该变异时不会发生的概率。我们利用这一形式化方法探讨了将疾病归因于遗传变异的逻辑和局限性。研究表明，PN与渗透率脱钩：相同的渗透率在不同的基线疾病流行率下会产生不同的PN。病例选择偏倚影响PN估计，倾向于使用人群规模的队列而非确诊病例系列。随着竞争原因的流行率上升，PN下降，形式化了在因果异质性下必要性与渗透率的差异。我们引入了介导必要性概率（PMN），通过介导生物标志物更新PN。利用英国生物库数据，我们估计了在缺血性心脏病中稀有LDLR变异的PN和PMN，使用高脂血症作为介导因素，并按ClinVar类别和计算致病性评分分层。PN在未分类变异（VUS）类别中超越分类解决了异质性。在帕金森病的GBA1携带者中复制这一结果，尽管渗透率较低，但PN仍然较高。这些结果支持进一步的发展。
items.abstract: Genetic diagnosis requires attributing a patient's disease to a variant. We develop the Probability of Necessity (PN), a counterfactual estimand giving the probability that disease would not have occurred absent a germline variant, given both are observed; and we use this formalism to explore the logic and limitations of attributing a disease to genetic variants. We show PN dissociates from penetrance: identical penetrance yields different PN depending on baseline disease prevalence. Case selection biases PN estimation, favoring population-scale cohorts over ascertained case series. PN falls as competing-cause prevalence rises, formalizing why necessity differs from penetrance under causal heterogeneity. We introduce the Probability of Mediated Necessity (PMN), updating PN using mediator biomarkers proxying a variant's operative pathway. Using UK Biobank data, we estimate PN and PMN for rare LDLR variants in ischemic heart disease (IHD, ICD-10 I25), using hyperlipidemia (E78) as mediator, stratifying by ClinVar class and computational pathogenicity score. PN resolves heterogeneity within the variant of unknown significance (VUS) class beyond classification alone. Replicating in GBA

items.title: Estrogen interactions with breast cancer risk variants in regulatory DNA
items.title_zh: 雌激素与乳腺癌风险变异的调控DNA相互作用
items.summary_zh: 了解基因-环境（GxE）相互作用是研究多基因疾病（如乳腺癌）的主要目标。我们结合大规模平行报告实验（MPRA）、染色质分析和网络分析，识别出雌激素响应的乳腺癌变异。筛选1,604个GWAS识别的乳腺癌变异，发现73个雌激素调节的单核苷酸变异（emSNVs）。染色质可及性建模验证了等位基因特异性效应，识别出破坏先锋因子与染色质结合的变异，以及调节转录因子（TF）招募至预可及增强子的变异。emSNV靶点汇聚在包括线粒体代谢、NF-{kappa}B信号通路和染色质调控等途径。将emSNVs聚合成多基因风险评分（PRSE2）显示与13,026例绝经后BRCA病例和108,265例对照的生殖风险因素存在相互作用，包括初次生育年龄（p=0.0052）；缺乏雌激素响应变异的对照PRS未显示相互作用。该框架连接了分子和流行病学GxE研究，揭示了其疾病关联依赖于环境背景的变异，为理解多基因疾病风险提供了重要启示。
items.abstract: Insight into population-level gene-environment (GxE) interactions is a major goal in understanding polygenic diseases, such as breast cancer. We integrated massively parallel reporter assays (MPRA), chromatin profiling, and network analysis to identify estrogen-responsive breast cancer variants. Screening 1,604 GWAS-identified breast cancer variants identified 73 estrogen-modulated SNVs (emSNVs). Chromatin accessibility modeling validated allele-specific effects, identifying variants that disrupt pioneer factor binding to chromatin and others that modulate transcription factor (TF) recruitment to pre-accessible enhancers. emSNV targets converged on pathways including mitochondrial metabolism, NF-{kappa}B signaling, and chromatin regulation. Aggregating emSNVs into a polygenic risk score (PRSE2) revealed interactions with reproductive risk factors in 13,026 post-menopausal BRCA cases and 108,265 controls, including age at first birth (p=0.0052); a control PRS lacking estrogen-responsive variants showed no interactions. items.title: Temporal EHR Models Detect Rare Disease Years Before Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 时间电子健康记录模型提前发现罕见疾病
items.summary_zh: 背景：罕见疾病全球影响约3亿人，患者在多次就医后平均需等待4-8年才能确诊。电子健康记录（EHR）详细记录了这一预诊过程，但传统方法通常将多年纵向表型信号压缩为单一静态快照；我们的研究直接建模这一时间结构。方法：我们使用梅奥诊所平台的约300万患者的纵向EHR数据进行回顾性队列研究，病例为确诊的10种罕见疾病患者，对照组（每种疾病约5200人）无罕见疾病记录。通过medspaCy NLP管道从临床记录和实验室结果中提取HPO表型术语，ICD编码按三位字符分组。我们开发并训练了两种时间模型GRU-Attn和Conformer，将患者历史编码为最长达30年的季度时间序列，并与三种静态基线模型（CatBoost、XGBoost、逻辑回归）进行比较。模型在诊断前1-10年的预测范围内进行系统评估。结果：在完整的保留队列中...
items.abstract: Background. Rare diseases collectively affect an estimated 300 million people worldwide, yet patients wait an average of 4-8 years for a correct diagnosis after visiting multiple physicians, accumulating unexplained findings, and suffering preventable disease progression before a unifying diagnosis is reached. Electronic health records (EHRs) capture this pre-diagnostic trajectory in rich detail, but conventional methods typically collapse years of longitudinal phenotypic signals into a single static snapshot; our approach instead models this temporal structure directly. Methods. We conducted a retrospective cohort study using longitudinal EHR data from approximately 3 million patients at Mayo Clinic Platform_Accelerate. Cases were patients with confirmed diagnoses of 10 rare diseases; controls (~5,200 per disease) had no record of any rare disease. HPO phenotype terms were extracted from clinical notes and laboratory results using a medspaCy NLP pipeline; ICD codes were grouped at three-character level. items.title: Treatment Adherence and Health-Related Quality of Life Among Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Rajshahi, Bangladesh: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.title_zh: 孟加拉国拉杰沙希2型糖尿病患者的治疗依从性与健康相关生活质量研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：2型糖尿病（T2DM）在孟加拉国迅速增长，2021年约有1310万成年人患病，预计到2045年将增至2230万。治疗依从性差和健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）受损是长期管理T2DM的后果，但来自孟加拉国西北部的数据仍然稀缺。本研究旨在评估拉杰沙希T2DM患者的治疗依从性、HRQoL及其相关因素。方法：我们在2021年1月至12月期间对205名来自两家三级医院的T2DM患者进行横断面研究。使用八项Morisky药物依从性量表（MMAS-8）评估治疗依从性，使用EuroQol-5维度问卷（EQ-5D-5L）测量HRQoL。结果：参与者平均年龄为54.43（±10.75）岁，50.73%为女性。大多数（85.85%）患者的HbA1c≥6.5%，显示出普遍的血糖控制不良。治疗依从性方面，40.98%患者依从性低，26.83%中等，32.19%高。HRQoL方面，仅6.83%处于完美健康状态，52.68%有轻度/中度问题，40.49%有严重/极端问题。
items.abstract: Background Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a rapidly growing public health crisis in Bangladesh, where an estimated 13.1 million adults were living with the condition in 2021, with projections suggesting this figure will nearly 22.3 million by 2045. Poor medication adherence and impaired health-related quality of life (HRQoL) are recognized consequences of long-term T2DM management, yet data from northwestern Bangladesh remain scarce. This study aimed to assess treatment adherence, HRQoL and identify their associated factors among T2DM patients in Rajshahi, Bangladesh. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study between January and December 2021 among 205 T2DM patients from two tertiary-level hospitals in Rajshahi. Treatment adherence was assessed using the eight-item Morisky Medication Adherence Scale (MMAS-8), and HRQoL was measured using the EuroQol-5 Dimensions Questionnaire (EQ-5D-5L). items.title: Healthy vaccinee effect in SARS-CoV-2 vaccinees without documented infection
items.title_zh: SARS-CoV-2疫苗接种者的健康疫苗接种者效应研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估健康疫苗接种者效应（HVE），通过比较接种与未接种个体的全因死亡率、癌症死亡率及外因死亡。采用2021年至2022年8月31日的奥地利国家登记数据，研究对象为2021年1月1日未曾记录SARS-CoV-2感染的成年人口。使用Cox回归分析接种与未接种个体的死亡风险比（HR），调整年龄、性别及奥地利长期护理津贴（ALTCA）接受情况，并按接种剂次（1至4剂）分层。分析涵盖整个观察期、3个月区间及每年COVID-19负担最高和最低的2个月。此外，依据接种日及教育水平匹配新接种者，评估接种后两周的HR。结果显示，接种者的死亡风险显著低于未接种者，提示HVE可能影响疫苗有效性评估。
items.abstract: Importance: Estimates of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine effectiveness (VE) from observational studies may be biased if healthier (healthy vaccinee effect; HVE) or less healthy individuals are preferentially vaccinated. Quantifying HVE is essential for interpreting VE estimates for informed vaccination policy. Objective: To assess the HVE by comparing all-cause mortality, cancer mortality, and deaths from external causes between vaccinated and unvaccinated individuals. Design, Setting, and Participants: This nationwide retrospective cohort study used Austrian national registry data from 2021 to August 31, 2022, and included the entire adult population of Austria with no previously documented SARS-CoV-2 infection on January 1, 2021. Cox regression was used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) for mortality comparing vaccinated with unvaccinated individuals while adjusting for age, sex and Austrian long-term care allowance (ALTCA) recipiency, stratified by vaccinations (1 to 4). Analyses were performed for the whole observation period, 3-month blocks (quarters) and the 2 months with highest and lowest COVID-19 disease burden per year. items.title: Exploring proteins as intermediates between physical activity and cancer in UK biobank
items.title_zh: 探讨蛋白质在身体活动与癌症之间的中介作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨身体活动（PA）与癌症风险之间的生物机制。我们结合观察性研究和孟德尔随机化（MR）方法，分析了来自英国生物银行（UK Biobank）约10万名参与者的加速度计测得的PA数据、约5.3万名参与者的循环蛋白水平（使用Olink Explore 3072面板）以及癌症发生率（乳腺癌、结直肠癌、子宫内膜癌和前列腺癌）。通过回归模型和Cox比例风险模型评估观察性关联，并进行BMI等协变量的调整。结果显示，整体加速度平均值与乳腺癌、结直肠癌和子宫内膜癌的风险呈负相关，但在调整BMI后，子宫内膜癌和结直肠癌的关联减弱，而与前列腺癌呈正相关。MR分析支持较高的PA对乳腺癌、结直肠癌和前列腺癌风险具有保护性因果效应。
items.abstract: Introduction Higher physical activity (PA) is associated with lower risk of several cancers, but the biological mechanisms underlying these associations remain unclear. We integrated observational and Mendelian randomization (MR) approaches to investigate circulating proteins as potential intermediates linking PA to cancer risk. Methods We analysed accelerometer-derived PA measures (~100,000 participants), circulating protein levels (~53,000 participants) derived using the Olink Explore 3072 panel and cancer incidence (breast, colorectal, endometrial, and prostate cancers) via linked registry data among UK Biobank (UKB) participants. Observational associations were assessed using regression models and Cox proportional hazard models adjusting for demographic, lifestyle, and clinical covariates, including body mass index (BMI). Proteins associated with both overall acceleration average and cancer incidence were taken forward in a two-sample and two-step MR analyses using genome-wide association data. items.title: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen PET/CT Complements MRI for Focal Therapy Selection in Prostate Cancer: A Whole-Mount Histopathologic Study
items.title_zh: 前列腺特异性膜抗原PET/CT在前列腺癌局部治疗选择中的应用
items.summary_zh: 背景：前列腺特异性膜抗原（PSMA）PET/CT相较于多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）在前列腺癌局部治疗患者选择中的增值尚不明确。本研究评估PSMA PET/CT、mpMRI及其联合应用在与全切片组织病理学（WMHP）对比时对局部治疗适应性的判断。方法：我们回顾性分析了2017-2024年在UCLA接受根治性前列腺切除术的患者，所有患者均进行了术前PSMA PET/CT和mpMRI检查，且活检分级组（GG）≥3，单侧疾病，术后前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）聚焦。结果：112名患者中，有77名（69%）在WMHP上被判定为不适合治疗，其中19名（17%）在术后GG>3。PET的敏感性和特异性分别为53%和54%，mpMRI为70%和49%。联合成像的敏感性提高至83%（P<0.001 vs PET; P=0.002 vs MRI），但特异性降至26%。每100名患者中，约可正确识别9名额外的不适合患者，同时错误排除约7名真正候选者。mpMRI在外包膜侵犯（EPE）检测上比PET更敏感（77% vs 32%，P<0.001），而PET在特异性上更优（90% vs 58%，P<0.001）。联合成像在多灶性（44% vs 23%，P=0.001）和双侧疾病（45% vs 23%，P=0.002）检测上优于单独mpMRI。结论：将PSMA PET/CT添加至mpMRI可显著提高前列腺癌局部治疗选择的准确性。
items.abstract: Background: The incremental value of PSMA PET/CT over multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) for selecting patients for prostate cancer focal therapy is undefined. Unlike lesion-detection studies, we evaluated whether PSMA PET/CT, mpMRI, and their combination correctly determine focal therapy eligibility when validated against whole-mount histopathology (WMHP). Methods: We retrospectively analyzed patients undergoing radical prostatectomy (RP) at UCLA (2017-2024) with preoperative PSMA PET/CT and mpMRI, biopsy grade group (GG) [ ]3, unilateral disease, and prostate-specific antigen 3 focus at RP. Modalities were compared by McNemar tests. Results: Of 112 patients, 77 (69%) were ineligible on WMHP, including 19 (17%) with a GG>3 focus at RP. Sensitivity and specificity were 53% and 54% for PET and 70% and 49% for mpMRI. Combined imaging improved sensitivity to 83% (P<0.001 vs PET; P=0.002 vs MRI) but reduced specificity to 26%. items.title: Sex-specific efficacy of acetazolamide for acute mountain sickness. A randomised clinical trial.
items.title_zh: 阿莫地喹对急性高山病的性别特异性疗效研究
items.summary_zh: 重要性：急性高山病（AMS）是一种常见的高海拔疾病，部分可以通过阿莫地喹预防，但其性别特异性疗效和耐受性尚未前瞻性评估。目的：检验预设假设，即预防性阿莫地喹在女性低海拔居民中对AMS的相对风险降低（RRR）比男性高20%。设计：随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的平行组试验，参与者、结果评估者和统计学家在分析完成前均处于盲态。设置：基线在比什凯克760米，海拔暴露在吉尔吉斯斯坦库姆托尔高海拔设施（3600米）。参与者：健康的女性和男性低海拔居民（年龄18-44岁，BMI 18-30 kg/m²，居住在2500米以下4周内）。干预：阿莫地喹125毫克或匹配安慰剂每日两次，从上升前24小时开始，持续2天2夜在3600米的停留。主要结果和指标：主要结果为AMS的性别间RRR差异，定义为2018年修订的湖露易斯评分3分或以上，包括头痛。结果：303名随机参与者中（180名女性，123名男性；平均年龄23岁），安慰剂组（n=155）中AMS发生率为34%（女性42% vs 男性23%）。
items.abstract: Importance: Acute mountain sickness (AMS) is a common high-altitude illness partly preventable by acetazolamide, but sex-specific efficacy and tolerability have not been prospectively evaluated. Objective: To test the a priori hypothesis that preventive acetazolamide achieves a 20% greater relative risk reduction (RRR) of AMS in female vs male lowlanders ascending to 3600 m. Design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial conducted from March 2024 to August 2025; participants, outcome assessors, and statistician were blinded until analysis was complete. Setting: Baseline at 760 m in Bishkek and altitude exposure at the Kumtor High Altitude Facility (3600 m), Kyrgyz Republic. Participants: Healthy female and male low-altitude residents (age 18-44 years, BMI 18-30 kg/m2, residence 2500 m within 4 weeks. Intervention: Acetazolamide 125 mg or matching placebo twice daily, from 24 hours before ascent and throughout the 2-day, 2-night stay at 3600 m. Main Outcomes and Measures: Primary outcome was the between-sex difference in RRR of AMS, defined as a 2018 revised Lake Louise Score of 3 or higher including headache. items.title: Amyloid-Independent Elevation of Plasma phosphorylated tau-217 Tracks Neurodegenerative Risk in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex: Implications for mTOR-Targeted Intervention
items.title_zh: 结节性硬化症中血浆磷酸化tau-217与神经退行性风险的关系
items.summary_zh: 背景：结节性硬化症（TSC）是一种罕见的常染色体显性神经发育障碍，因TSC1或TSC2基因功能丧失突变引起，导致mTOR通路的慢性过度激活。TSC患者表现出广泛的认知、行为和精神特征，统称为结节性硬化症相关神经精神障碍（TAND）。此外，这些患者在成年后发展出与阿尔茨海默病（AD）重叠的临床和神经病理特征。方法：本研究比较了63名TSC患者、25名AD患者和116名认知正常（CU）患者的血浆磷酸化tau-217（ptau-217）水平。结果：发现TSC患者在年轻时血浆ptau-217水平升高，且TSC、AD和CU组之间存在相似的年龄相关轨迹。多变量线性回归显示，CU组的log2 ptau-217浓度显著低于TSC组（{β} = -0.21, SE = 0.05, p < 0.0001），但TSC组与AD组之间无显著差异。
items.abstract: Background: Tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) is a rare autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2, resulting in chronic hyperactivation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway. TSC patients experience a wide spectrum of cognitive, behavioral, and psychiatric features collectively termed Tuberous Sclerosis Complex Associated Neuropsychiatric Disorders (TAND). Moreover, these patients develop a clinical trajectory in adulthood with clinical and neuropathological features overlapping those of Alzheimers disease (AD). Prior neuropathological studies have shown accumulation of AD-type mixed 3R/4R tau isoforms in adults with TSC that is amyloid-independent. Methods: To further explore the biological convergence of TSC and AD, this study compared plasma levels of phosphorylated tau-217 (ptau-217), a sensitive and specific marker of early AD pathology, in 63 TSC, 25 AD, and 116 cognitively unimpaired (CU) patients. Results: Findings revealed elevated levels of plasma ptau-217 in individuals with TSC at younger ages with a parallel age-related trajectory between TSC, AD, and CU cohorts. items.title: Processing Speed Accounts for the Discriminative Power of a Smartphone Go/No-Go Task in Multiple Sclerosis
items.title_zh: 智能手机Go/No-Go任务在多发性硬化症中的区分能力研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：识别和长期测量认知衰退仍然具有挑战性，传统评估主要依赖训练有素的考官进行面对面的类比量表评估。智能手机技术提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，能够从连续的传感器和事件流中提取独特的数字生物标志物。本研究评估了一种最终候选模块的临床效用和增量效度：一种等概率（50/50）连续警觉性Go/No-Go范式。方法：我们分析了来自303名参与者的3,270个质量控制试验，主要分析集中在34名健康供体（HD）和213名多发性硬化症（MS）参与者的488个首次试验观察上。从原始事件流中筛选出16个候选指标，并根据其内在心理测量特性保留10个。结果：尽管10个结果中有9个显著区分了HD与MS。
items.abstract: Background: Identifying and longitudinally measuring cognitive decline remains challenging because traditional assessments rely largely on episodic, in-person administration of analog scales by trained examiners. Smartphone technology provides a scalable alternative capable of extracting distinct digital biomarkers from continuous sensor and event streams. Following the integration of several cognitive modules into the self-administered Neurological Functions Test Suite (NeuFun-TS), this study evaluates the clinical utility and incremental validity of a final candidate module: an equiprobable (50/50) continuous vigilance Go/No-Go paradigm. Methods: We analyzed 3,270 quality-controlled trials from 303 participants, focusing primary analyses on 488 first-trial observations across 34 healthy donors (HD) and 213 multiple sclerosis (MS) participants. From the raw event stream, we screened 16 candidate metrics and retained 10 based on their intrinsic psychometric properties. Using these 10 metrics, we evaluated diagnostic group separation, test-retest reliability, correlations with clinical and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) benchmarks, and incremental validity over existing digital mo
items.authors: Kosa, P.; Moghadam Ahmadi, A.; Kanu, M.; Mejia, Y.; Mekasha, E.; Steltzner, C.; Bielekova, B.

items.title: Basket Trials in Gynaecology: A Simulation Study Comparing Novel Designs with Current Practice
items.title_zh: 妇科领域的篮式试验：新设计与现行实践的模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：篮式试验为在单一协议下评估干预措施提供了框架，能够提高效率并减少对小规模、统计能力不足研究的依赖。在妇科疾病中，患者常常表现出不同的症状，尽管治疗方法相似，导致试验规模小且统计能力不足。篮式试验等主协议有潜力通过在多个疾病亚型中评估单一干预措施来减少研究浪费。本文比较了妇科领域篮式试验与典型试验设计和分析方法的使用。方法：我们的模拟研究评估了篮式试验设计在假设妇科环境中的表现和实用性。我们比较了信息共享策略（治疗效应借用TEB和治疗反应借用TRB）与典型妇科试验设计的策略（无借用NB和完全汇总）。
items.abstract: Background Basket trials provide a framework for evaluating an intervention across multiple subtrials within a single protocol. By enabling information sharing, they may improve efficiency and reduce reliance on small, underpowered studies. In gynaecological conditions, we often see patients with the same condition presenting with different symptoms. Although the symptoms are different, treatment is often the same, leading to small and often statistically underpowered trials. Master protocols such as basket trials have the potential to reduce waste in research by allowing the evaluation of a single intervention in multiple disease subtypes. In a hypothetical gynaecological basket trial, this would allow the inclusion of patients with the same underlying condition, but with differing most bothersome symptoms, to be included in the same randomised basket trial. In this article, we compare the use of basket trials in gynaecology to typical approaches to trial design and analysis. Methods Our simulation study evaluates the performance and utility of basket trial designs in hypothetical gynaecological settings. items.authors: Stocking, K.; Wason, J. J.; Kirkham, J. J.; Vail, A.; Wilkinson, J. D.

items.title: Ruling resistance out, and reading the blank: genome-based antimicrobial susceptibility prediction in clinical Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates
items.title_zh: 基于基因组的临床铜绿假单胞菌抗菌药物敏感性预测
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过基因组预测抗菌药物敏感性，以识别抗药性决定因素，并报告可能导致治疗失败的抗生素。我们对来自两个三级医疗中心的5,749个连续临床分离株进行了测序，并获得了与环丙沙星、头孢他啶、美罗培南和托布霉素的表型敏感性测试结果。基因组变异的解读需经过三项调整：变异是相对于种群主要等位基因而非PAO1进行调用的，这样可以去除参考文献的伪标记；系统性捕捉基因功能丧失，因为许多抗药性遗传决定因素通过功能丧失机制发挥作用；引入了特异性比率，通过对同一分离株测试四种抗生素，区分与抗药性机制相关的标记和仅跟踪克隆谱系的标记。此外，还考虑了敏感性标记，如排出泵功能丧失。
items.abstract: Genomic prediction of antimicrobial susceptibility aims to identify resistance determinants and thereby to report those antibiotics for which therapeutic failure is to be expected. We investigated what this approach can achieve in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a species in which resistance often arises through changes in gene expression. For this purpose, 5,749 consecutive clinical isolates from the routine laboratories of two tertiary care centers were sequenced, each with paired phenotypic susceptibility test results for ciprofloxacin, ceftazidime, meropenem, and tobramycin. Genomic variation could be interpreted only after three adaptations. Variants were called against the population-wide major allele rather than against PAO1. This removes markers that are artefacts of the reference. Loss of gene function was captured systematically, as many genetic determinants of resistance act through loss-of-function mechanisms.
