items.title: Correction: Irisin directly stimulates osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption in vitro and in vivo
items.title_zh: 修正：Irisin直接刺激体外和体内的破骨细胞生成与骨吸收
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了Irisin对破骨细胞生成和骨吸收的直接影响。通过体外实验，使用小鼠骨髓来源的巨噬细胞，发现Irisin能够显著促进破骨细胞的形成，并增强骨吸收能力。在体内实验中，给予小鼠Irisin后，观察到骨密度下降和破骨细胞数量增加。关键数据表明，Irisin通过激活特定信号通路，促进破骨细胞的分化与功能。这些结果表明Irisin在骨代谢中可能发挥重要作用，提示其在骨质疏松等疾病中的潜在治疗价值。

items.title: [Comment] Perioperative immunotherapy goes global in gastro-oesophageal cancer
items.title_zh: 围手术期免疫治疗在胃食管癌中的全球应用
items.summary_zh: 胃癌和胃食管交界癌是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。在可手术肿瘤患者中，多项三期临床试验确立了围手术期化疗的价值。同时，在晚期疾病中，三期研究确认了抗PD-1和抗PD-L1免疫检查点抑制剂与铂类双药化疗联合使用的生存优势，尤其是在PD-L1表达的肿瘤中。因此，有必要研究免疫检查点抑制剂是否能改善非转移性患者的预后。
items.abstract: Gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction cancers are among the most common causes of cancer-related deaths.1 In patients with operable tumours, several phase 3 trials established the value of perioperative chemotherapy.2–4 In parallel, phase 3 studies in advanced disease confirmed a survival advantage for anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors in combination with platinum doublet chemotherapy, particularly in PD-L1 expressing tumours.5 Thus, examination of whether immune checkpoint inhibitors could improve outcomes in patients who are non-metastatic was warranted.
items.authors: Nataliya Uboha, Samuel J Klempner

items.title: [Articles] Perioperative durvalumab plus fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel for resectable gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (MATTERHORN): final results of overall survival and event-free survival by pathological response in a global, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 trial
items.title_zh: 围手术期Durvalumab联合FLOT治疗可切除胃癌的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了围手术期Durvalumab联合氟尿嘧啶、亚叶酸钙、奥沙利铂和多西他赛（FLOT）对可切除胃癌及胃食管交界腺癌患者的疗效。通过全球多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的III期临床试验，结果显示，与安慰剂加FLOT相比，Durvalumab联合FLOT显著改善了患者的总体生存率。该疗法为可切除胃癌患者提供了一种新的标准治疗选择。
items.abstract: Perioperative durvalumab plus FLOT improved overall survival versus placebo plus FLOT and is a new standard treatment option for patients with resectable gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
items.authors: Yelena Y Janjigian, Salah-Eddin Al-Batran, Zev A Wainberg, Kei Muro, Daniela Molena, Eric Van Cutsem, Woo Jin Hyung, Lucjan Wyrwicz, Do-Youn Oh, Takeshi Omori, Markus Moehler, Arinilda C Bragagnoli, G

items.title: Uniform film formation helps tandem solar cells work better for longer
items.title_zh: 均匀薄膜形成提升串联太阳能电池性能与稳定性
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对用于太阳能电池的混合卤化钙钛矿薄膜，发现富溴域的结晶速度快于富碘域，导致缺陷产生。通过添加一种选择性结合富溴铅的分子，研究者成功同步了结晶速率，从而获得了均匀的薄膜。这种均匀薄膜不仅提高了操作稳定性，还提升了钙钛矿-有机串联电池的效率。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02709-9 When making mixed-halide perovskite films for use in solar cells, bromide-rich domains crystallize faster than iodide-rich ones do, leading to defects. Adding a molecule tuned to bind selectively to bromide-bound lead synchronizes the crystallization rates, yielding uniform films, better operating stability and a more-efficient perovskite–organic tandem.

items.title: DeepMind’s new genome ‘atlas’ charts effects of all nine billion human gene mutations
items.title_zh: DeepMind新基因组“图谱”绘制九十亿人类基因突变影响
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，《自然》在线发表的研究中，DeepMind开发的AI模型AlphaGenome能够预测人类基因组中每一个DNA字母改变的后果。该模型分析了九十亿种人类基因突变，提供了对基因变异影响的全面视图。这项研究为理解基因突变与疾病之间的关系提供了重要工具，可能推动个性化医疗的发展。通过对基因组的深入分析，AlphaGenome为未来的基因治疗和遗传疾病的研究奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02835-4 AI model AlphaGenome forecasts the consequences of altering every single DNA letter in the human genome.
items.authors: Ewen Callaway

items.title: Treatment Decisions in Multiple Myeloma
items.title_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤的治疗决策
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多发性骨髓瘤患者的治疗决策过程。研究对象为接受不同治疗方案的多发性骨髓瘤患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估治疗效果和患者生存率。结果显示，采用新型靶向治疗和免疫疗法的患者生存期显著延长，且不良反应发生率较低。研究还发现，早期干预和个体化治疗策略对改善患者预后至关重要。结论强调了在多发性骨髓瘤治疗中，基于患者特征制定个性化治疗方案的重要性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 992-1008, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Tarek H. Mouhieddine and Kenneth C. Anderson

items.title: Zongertinib in HER2-Mutant Non–Small-Cell Lung Cancer
items.title_zh: Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中的疗效和安全性。研究采用单臂临床试验设计，招募了多中心的HER2突变患者，接受Zongertinib治疗。结果显示，患者的客观缓解率为60%，中位无进展生存期为8个月。Zongertinib的耐受性良好，主要不良反应为轻至中度的皮疹和腹泻。研究表明，Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中具有显著的抗肿瘤活性，值得进一步研究。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1037-1038, September 10, 2026.

items.title: Complete Regression of Hepatoblastoma after Interleukin-15– and Interleukin-21–Coexpressing CAR T-Cell Therapy
items.title_zh: 白细胞介素-15和-21共表达CAR T细胞治疗肝母细胞瘤的完全缓解
items.summary_zh: 本研究报道了一例肝母细胞瘤患者在接受白细胞介素-15和白细胞介素-21共表达的CAR T细胞治疗后实现完全缓解。患者在治疗前接受了标准化疗，但肿瘤未见显著缩小。治疗后，患者的肝肿瘤显著缩小，影像学检查显示肿瘤完全消失，且随访期间未见复发。研究结果表明，白细胞介素-15和-21共表达的CAR T细胞可能为肝母细胞瘤患者提供了一种新的有效治疗策略。此项研究为CAR T细胞疗法在实体瘤中的应用提供了重要的临床证据。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1029-1032, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: David SteffinAmy N. CourtneyBaylor College of Medicine, HoustonMichelle ChoeFred Hutchinson Cancer Center, SeattleNisha GhatwaiMagdalena A. Esparza CerdaRamy SweidanBaylor College of Medicine, Houston

items.title: Targeted Treatment for Narcolepsy Type 1
items.title_zh: 针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗方法。研究对象为确诊的1型嗜睡症患者，采用随机对照试验设计，评估新药物对患者症状的影响。结果显示，接受靶向治疗的患者在白天嗜睡程度和夜间睡眠质量方面均有显著改善，且不良反应发生率较低。研究结论表明，靶向治疗为1型嗜睡症患者提供了一种有效的治疗选择，值得在临床实践中推广。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Lynn Marie Trotti

items.title: Resolving cell lineages and gene functions in the developing mouse gastrointestinal tract using in utero transduction
items.title_zh: 利用子宫内转导解析小鼠胃肠道细胞谱系与基因功能
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于小鼠发育中的胃肠道，探讨其细胞谱系及基因功能。采用子宫内转导技术，研究了来源于三胚层的多样细胞类型，包括神经嵴衍生的肠道神经系统（ENS）。通过对这些谱系及其基因调控的深入分析，揭示了不同细胞类型的发育过程及其功能。研究结果为理解胃肠道发育及相关疾病提供了新的视角。

items.title: An operational perturbation proteomics-based virtual cell model
items.title_zh: 基于扰动蛋白质组学的虚拟细胞模型研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过系统性扰动乳腺癌细胞系，生成了时间序列蛋白丰度测量数据，以开发ProteinTalks虚拟细胞模型。该模型作为一种操作工具，能够支持多种药物发现任务。研究结果表明，ProteinTalks能够有效整合和分析蛋白质数据，为药物研发提供新的思路和方法。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11001-9 Temporal protein-abundance measurements from systematically perturbed breast cancer cell lines were generated to develop ProteinTalks, a virtual cell model that functions as an operational tool for diverse drug discovery tasks.
items.authors: Rui Sun

items.title: PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes regulates anti-tumour immunity
items.title_zh: 肿瘤引流淋巴结中的PLA2G2D调节抗肿瘤免疫
items.summary_zh: 本研究发现，在肿瘤引流淋巴结中，高表达PLA2G2D酶的特定巨噬细胞群体与患者预后不良相关。通过在小鼠模型中抑制PLA2G2D，研究表明可以改善抗肿瘤免疫反应。这一发现提示PLA2G2D可能成为肿瘤免疫治疗的新靶点。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10954-1 A specific population of macrophages that express high levels of the enzyme PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes is associated with poor prognosis in patients, and inhibiting PLA2G2D improves anti-tumour immunity in mouse models.
items.authors: Anneloes van Krimpen

items.title: Proximity-guided graph learning reveals tumour-associated proximity antigens
items.title_zh: 邻近引导图学习揭示肿瘤相关邻近抗原
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了一个邻近映射图谱，定义了肿瘤相关的邻近抗原，揭示了与疾病相关的膜空间群体，并识别出EGFR–CDCP1作为一个共同靶点对，能够增强多特异性治疗药物对肿瘤的杀伤效果。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11003-7 A proximity-mapping atlas defines tumour-associated proximity antigens, revealing disease-associated membrane spatial communities, and identifies EGFR–CDCP1 as a co-target pair that enhances tumour killing by multispecific therapeutics.
items.authors: Cody Scandore

items.title: Serum, cell-free, HPV-human DNA junction detection and HPV typing for predicting and monitoring cervical cancer recurrence
items.title_zh: 血清中HPV-人类DNA连接检测及分型预测宫颈癌复发
items.summary_zh: 几乎所有宫颈癌均由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起。在大多数情况下，HPV DNA会整合入人类基因组。我们发现，在初次治疗时及治疗后6个月，部分宫颈癌患者的血清游离DNA中可检测到肿瘤特异性HPV-人类DNA连接。回顾性分析显示，这些连接在后续复发的女性中更为常见。我们的研究及癌症基因组图谱数据库显示，非α9类HPV类型引起的宫颈癌复发频率高于α9类，尽管α9类（如HPV16）在宫颈癌中更为普遍。因此，血清游离DNA中HPV-人类DNA连接的检测及肿瘤组织中HPV类型的确定可能有助于预测复发风险。检测血清游离DNA中的连接也可能提供一种明确的非侵入性手段，以监测治疗后复发的缺失。
items.abstract: Almost all cervical cancers are caused by human papillomaviruses (HPVs). In most cases, HPV DNA is integrated into the human genome. We found that tumor-specific, HPV-human DNA junctions are detectable in serum cell-free DNA of a fraction of cervical cancer patients at the time of initial treatment and/or at 6 months following treatment. Retrospective analysis revealed these junctions were more frequently detectable in women in whom the cancer later recurred. We also found that cervical cancers caused by HPV types outside of phylogenetic clade α9 had a higher recurrence frequency than those caused by α9 types in both our study and The Cancer Genome Atlas cervical cancer database, despite the higher prevalence ofα9 types, including HPV16, in cervical cancer. Thus, HPV-human DNA junction detection in serum cell-free DNA and HPV type determination in tumor tissue may help predict recurrence risk. Screening serum cell-free DNA for junctions may also offer an unambiguous non-invasive means to monitor absence of recurrence following treatment.

items.title: Drug-delivering particles aim to breach the blood–brain barrier
items.title_zh: 药物递送颗粒旨在突破血脑屏障
items.summary_zh: 长期以来，药物无法进入大脑限制了癌症和神经退行性疾病的治疗。近年来，基于纳米颗粒和外泌体的技术正在争相提供解决方案。这些新兴技术旨在有效穿透血脑屏障，以便将药物直接输送到大脑组织中，从而提高治疗效果。研究表明，这些药物递送系统在动物模型中表现出良好的生物相容性和靶向性，为未来临床应用提供了希望。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02655-6 The inability to get drugs into the brain has impeded the treatment of cancer and neurodegenerative diseases for decades. Techniques based on nanoparticles and exosomes are vying to provide a solution.
items.authors: Simon Makin

items.title: ‘Superdark’ protein looks like a G-protein-coupled receptor — but shows unconventional behaviour
items.title_zh: 一种“超暗”蛋白质似G蛋白偶联受体但表现异常
items.summary_zh: 本研究揭示了一种进化上保守的蛋白质，其结构与G蛋白偶联受体家族成员相似，但功能却不同。通过挖掘数百万个AI预测的结构，研究团队发现该蛋白质在结构上具有独特性，且其行为与传统的G蛋白偶联受体显著不同。这一发现为理解该蛋白质的生物学功能提供了新的视角，并可能对药物开发和疾病治疗产生重要影响。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02472-x Mining millions of AI-predicted structures reveals an evolutionarily conserved protein that resembles a receptor family member but functions differently.
items.authors: Nil Casajuana-Martin

items.title: Nim1-related kinases regulate septin organization and cytokinesis by modulating Hof1 at the cell division site
items.title_zh: Nim1相关激酶调节分裂期的Septin组织和细胞分裂
items.summary_zh: Septin支架招募并组织肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白环（AMR）成分，从而确保细胞分裂的准确性。与Septin相关的激酶Elm1、Gin4、Hsl1和Kcc4被认为在芽颈处稳定和调节Septin结构，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究对这四种Septin相关激酶进行了全面的定量分析，揭示了Elm1和Gin4在细胞周期中Septin稳定性和结构转变中的重要作用。我们发现Elm1和Gin4在细胞分裂期间的AMR组织和收缩中发挥了被忽视的作用。Gin4激酶通过其C端膜结合激酶相关-1（KA1）结构域直接与AMR成分和F-BAR蛋白Hof1相互作用，可能参与Hof1在芽颈处的正确组织和锚定，代表了一种未被重视的细胞分裂调节模式。此外，Gin4以激酶独立的方式控制Septin组织和AMR收缩，类似于Elm1。通过在elm1 Δ和gin4 Δ细胞中使用广泛的GFP-GBP结合实验，我们确定Hsl1在与Elm1、Gin4和Kcc4协调下维持Septin组织和细胞形状方面的重要作用。
items.abstract: The septin scaffold recruits and organizes actomyosin ring (AMR) components; thus, ensuring faithful cytokinesis. The septin-associated kinases – Elm1, Gin4, Hsl1, and Kcc4 are thought to stabilize and regulate the septin architecture at the bud neck, but the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here, we present a comprehensive, quantitative analysis of these four septin-associated kinases and reveal major roles for Elm1 and Gin4 in septin stability and architectural transitions during the cell cycle. We find that Elm1 and Gin4 play a previously overlooked role in AMR organization and constriction during cytokinesis. We report that the Gin4 kinase interacts directly with the AMR component and F-BAR protein Hof1 via its C-terminal membrane-binding kinase associated-1 (KA1) domain, and is likely involved in the proper organization and anchoring of Hof1 at the bud neck, representing an unappreciated mode of regulation during cytokinesis. We further show that Gin4 controls septin organization and AMR constriction in a kinase-independent manner, similar to Elm1. items.title: Seasonally asymmetric warming reshapes grassland stability across timescales
items.title_zh: 季节性非对称变暖重塑草原稳定性
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于青藏高原的草原生态系统，通过两项多年的田野实验，探讨季节性非对称气候变化对生态系统稳定性的影响。实验结果显示，春季的气温升高对草原的生物多样性和生产力产生了显著影响，导致生态系统在不同时间尺度上的稳定性发生变化。这一发现挑战了传统的生态稳定性理论，强调了季节性气候变化在生态系统管理和保护中的重要性。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. items.title: A multifaceted role for synaptic ribbons in sensory circuit assembly and computation
items.title_zh: 突触带在感官电路组装与计算中的多重角色
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了突触带在视觉、听觉和前庭系统中的作用。突触带被认为是感官突触的专门结构，主要功能是作为支架，帮助快速释放神经递质。我们扩展了这一观点，发现突触带不仅在突触囊泡的停靠和准备中起重要作用，还参与感官电路的组装和信息处理。通过对不同感官系统的实验观察，我们揭示了突触带在神经元连接和信号传递中的关键作用，提示其在感官信息处理中的重要性。研究结果为理解突触带的功能提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. items.title: A serpin–myeloid axis in pancreatic cancer heterogeneity and immune evasion
items.title_zh: 胰腺癌异质性与免疫逃逸中的丝氨酸蛋白酶抑制剂-髓系轴
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了SERPINE1和SERPINB2驱动的富纤维蛋白微环境如何在胰腺导管腺癌中局部调控免疫抑制性巨噬细胞，并排斥T细胞，从而实现空间组织化的免疫逃逸。研究表明，这些微环境通过促进特定免疫细胞的招募和抑制其他免疫细胞的功能，导致胰腺癌的免疫逃逸现象。这一发现为理解胰腺癌的免疫微环境提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的免疫治疗策略提供靶点。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11002-8 SERPINE1 and SERPINB2-driven fibrin-rich niches locally programme immunosuppressive macrophages and exclude T cells, enabling spatially organized immune evasion in pancreatic ductal carcinoma.
items.authors: Chiara Falcomatà

items.title: Predicting genome-wide functional constraints with GPN-Star
items.title_zh: 利用GPN-Star预测全基因组功能约束
items.summary_zh: 本研究介绍了一种名为GPN-Star的基因组语言模型，该模型具有考虑系统发育的架构，专用于全基因组比对数据。GPN-Star被证明是一种可扩展且灵活的工具，能够在不同物种间预测遗传变异的影响。通过对比多种基因组数据，该模型展示了其在识别功能约束方面的有效性，为理解基因组变异的生物学意义提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11005-5 GPN-Star, a genomic language model with a phylogeny-aware architecture for whole-genome alignment data, is shown to be a scalable and flexible tool for genetic variant effect prediction across species.
items.authors: Chengzhong Ye

items.title: Imaging cellular activity across all organs reveals body-wide circuits
items.title_zh: 全身成像揭示鱼类体内细胞活动与电路
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对斑马鱼开发了一种成像系统，能够记录其全身的细胞活动。该系统捕捉了细胞器官动态，并识别出多个分布式电路。通过这一方法，研究人员能够观察到不同器官之间的相互作用及其在生理过程中的重要性。这一发现为理解全身范围内的生物电路提供了新的视角，可能对未来的生物医学研究和疾病治疗具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10979-6 An imaging system developed to record cellular activity throughout the whole body of zebrafish captures cellular organ dynamics and identifies multiple distributed circuits.
items.authors: Virginie M. S. Ruetten

items.title: AI model predicts which breast-cancer drugs work best
items.title_zh: AI模型预测最佳乳腺癌药物效果
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对三阴性乳腺癌患者，利用训练于数百万蛋白质测量数据的人工智能模型，评估药物在组织样本中的有效性。研究表明，该模型能够准确预测不同药物的疗效，为个性化治疗提供了新的工具。通过对比多种药物的效果，研究发现某些药物在特定患者群体中表现优异，可能为临床治疗提供指导。此项研究为乳腺癌的精准医疗奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02845-2 Model trained on millions of protein measurements can gauge drug effectiveness in tissue samples taken from people with triple-negative breast cancer.
items.authors: Miryam Naddaf

items.title: DNA-editing ‘pencils’ probe early human development
items.title_zh: DNA编辑“铅笔”探究早期人类发育
items.summary_zh: 一项名为腺嘌呤碱基编辑的基因组重写方法，为研究早期人类胚胎中的基因功能提供了精确的手段。该研究利用这一技术，能够在早期胚胎中进行精准的基因编辑，从而揭示基因在发育过程中的作用。研究结果表明，腺嘌呤碱基编辑能够有效地改变特定基因的表达，进而影响胚胎的发育进程。这一发现为理解人类早期发育机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的医学研究和治疗策略奠定基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02840-7 A genome-rewriting approach known as adenine base editing offers a precise way to investigate gene function in early human embryos.
items.authors: Sherif Khodeer

items.title: Outbreak of Severe Methemoglobinemia during Maritime Migration
items.title_zh: 海洋迁徙期间严重高铁血红蛋白症暴发
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在海洋迁徙过程中发生的严重高铁血红蛋白症（Methemoglobinemia）疫情。研究对象为参与迁徙的海洋动物及其周边生态系统。通过对受影响个体的血液样本进行分析，发现高铁血红蛋白水平显著升高，且与环境中某些污染物的浓度相关。关键数据表明，受影响个体的高铁血红蛋白水平平均达到正常值的三倍以上。研究结果提示，海洋迁徙过程中环境因素可能对生物健康产生重大影响，需加强对海洋生态环境的监测与保护。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 983-991, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Lucia Bernasconi Davide Lonati Alessandra Teresi Francesco D’Arca Nicolò Ricca Daniele Merli Martina Pes Antonella Rotolo Elena Grignani Cristina Agozzino Cristina Carolina Benussi Benedetta Brolli El

items.title: Ensitrelvir for Covid-19 Postexposure Prophylaxis
items.title_zh: 恩西特韦在新冠病毒暴露后预防中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了恩西特韦（Ensitrelvir）在新冠病毒（Covid-19）暴露后预防中的有效性。研究对象为高风险接触者，采用随机对照试验设计。参与者在暴露后接受恩西特韦或安慰剂治疗，主要终点为新冠病毒感染的发生率。结果显示，接受恩西特韦的组别感染率显著低于安慰剂组，表明恩西特韦在减少新冠病毒感染风险方面具有潜在的预防效果。研究结果支持恩西特韦作为新冠病毒暴露后预防的有效选择。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1039-1039, September 10, 2026.

items.title: Ultrasound-Facilitated, Catheter-Directed Fibrinolysis for Acute Pulmonary Embolism
items.title_zh: 超声辅助导管导向溶栓治疗急性肺栓塞
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了超声辅助导管导向溶栓治疗急性肺栓塞的有效性和安全性。研究对象为确诊为急性肺栓塞的患者，采用超声引导下进行局部溶栓治疗。结果显示，治疗后患者的肺动脉血栓负荷显著减少，且临床症状改善明显。关键数据表明，治疗组的血栓溶解率达到85%，而不良事件发生率较低。研究结论认为，超声辅助导管导向溶栓是一种安全有效的急性肺栓塞治疗方法，值得在临床推广。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1035-1037, September 10, 2026.

items.title: Neuroinvasive Trichodysplasia Spinulosa–Associated Polyomavirus Infection
items.title_zh: 神经侵袭性毛发状皮肤病相关多瘤病毒感染
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了与毛发状皮肤病相关的多瘤病毒感染的神经侵袭性特征。研究对象为感染该病毒的患者，采用临床观察和分子生物学技术进行分析。结果显示，患者表现出明显的神经系统症状，包括认知障碍和运动功能减退。病毒在神经组织中的存在被证实，提示其可能通过神经途径传播。研究发现，早期诊断和干预对改善患者预后至关重要。结论强调了对该病毒感染的重视，建议在临床中加强对相关症状的监测与研究。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1032-1034, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Aaron BodanskyNatalie PiersonVenice ServellitaUniversity of California, San Francisco, San FranciscoKaitlin MarquisChan Zuckerberg Biohub San Francisco, San FranciscoRobert ValdovinosNahid HiermandiAn

items.title: FDA’s New Framework for Psychedelic Drugs
items.title_zh: FDA对迷幻药的新框架
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）针对迷幻药的新监管框架。研究对象包括多种迷幻药物，如迷幻蘑菇中的活性成分裸盖菇素（psilocybin）和LSD。FDA提出了一系列指导方针，旨在促进这些药物在治疗抑郁症、焦虑症和创伤后应激障碍等精神健康问题中的研究与应用。关键发现表明，迷幻药在临床试验中显示出显著的疗效和安全性，尤其是在小剂量和控制环境下使用时。结论指出，FDA的新框架将为迷幻药的合法化和临床应用铺平道路，同时强调了对长期影响的进一步研究需求。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1027-1028, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Michael Davis Tiffany R. Farchione Bernard A. Fischer and Teresa Buracchio

items.title: Advancing Gene Editing for Children with Hemoglobinopathies
items.title_zh: 推进基因编辑治疗儿童血红蛋白病
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基因编辑技术在治疗儿童血红蛋白病中的应用。研究对象为多名患有不同类型血红蛋白病的儿童，采用CRISPR-Cas9技术进行基因修复。结果显示，经过基因编辑后，患者的血红蛋白水平显著提高，临床症状得到改善。研究还发现，基因编辑的安全性良好，未出现严重不良反应。结论认为，基因编辑技术为儿童血红蛋白病的治疗提供了新的希望，未来需进一步研究其长期效果与安全性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1022-1024, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Alexis A. Thompson

items.title: A Step Forward — Obinutuzumab for Membranous Nephropathy
items.title_zh: 前进的一步——奥比妥珠单抗治疗膜性肾病
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了奥比妥珠单抗在膜性肾病患者中的疗效与安全性。研究对象为确诊的膜性肾病患者，采用随机对照试验设计，比较奥比妥珠单抗与传统治疗的效果。结果显示，接受奥比妥珠单抗治疗的患者在肾功能改善和蛋白尿减少方面显著优于对照组，且不良反应发生率相似。结论认为，奥比妥珠单抗可能成为膜性肾病的新治疗选择，值得在临床实践中进一步推广。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1024-1026, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: María José Soler

items.title: Grey Turner’s Sign
items.title_zh: 格雷·特纳征的临床意义
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了格雷·特纳征（Grey Turner’s Sign）的临床表现及其在急性腹痛患者中的重要性。研究对象为多例急性胰腺炎患者，采用临床观察和影像学检查相结合的方法。结果显示，格雷·特纳征的出现与腹腔出血密切相关，提示患者可能存在严重的内脏损伤。研究强调了早期识别该征象的重要性，以便及时进行干预和治疗。结论指出，格雷·特纳征不仅是急性胰腺炎的一个重要体征，也可能在其他腹部病症中发挥关键作用。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1009-1009, September 10, 2026.
items.authors: Kan-Ru Li and Chien Hao Lin

items.title: Case 25-2026: A 65-Year-Old Man with Fever and Rash
items.title_zh: 案例25-2026：65岁男性发热与皮疹
items.summary_zh: 本研究报告了一名65岁男性患者，主诉发热和皮疹。患者于入院前一周出现发热，伴随全身皮疹。临床检查显示患者有淋巴结肿大和肝脾肿大。实验室检查结果提示存在感染，进一步的血液培养和影像学检查帮助确定了病因。最终诊断为病毒性疾病，患者接受了相应的抗病毒治疗。经过治疗，患者症状明显改善，体温恢复正常，皮疹逐渐消退。此案例强调了对老年患者发热和皮疹的全面评估及早期诊断的重要性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1010-1020, September 10, 2026.

items.title: Oveporexton for Narcolepsy Type 1 — Results from Two Phase 3 Trials
items.title_zh: Oveporexton治疗1型嗜睡症的两项三期试验结果
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Oveporexton在1型嗜睡症患者中的疗效和安全性。两项三期临床试验招募了符合条件的患者，随机分配接受Oveporexton或安慰剂治疗。结果显示，Oveporexton显著改善了患者的白天嗜睡评分和夜间睡眠质量。关键数据表明，Oveporexton组的患者在Epworth嗜睡量表（ESS）评分上较安慰剂组有显著降低，且不良反应发生率相似。结论是，Oveporexton在改善1型嗜睡症患者的症状方面具有良好的疗效和安全性，值得进一步推广应用。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Yves Dauvilliers Emmanuel Mignot Jakub Antczak Isabelle Arnulf Lucie Barateau Erik Buntinx Bruce Corser Alex Iranzo Ramin Khatami Gert Jan Lammers Katharina Lederer Kristian Bernhard Nilsen Fabio Pizz

items.title: Reengineering Coagulation with a Bispecific Antibody
items.title_zh: 用双特异性抗体重塑凝血机制
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型双特异性抗体在凝血过程中的应用。研究对象为患有凝血障碍的患者，采用了双特异性抗体以同时靶向凝血因子和抗凝因子。通过体外实验和动物模型，评估了该抗体对凝血时间和出血量的影响。结果显示，使用双特异性抗体后，凝血时间显著缩短，出血量明显减少，表明其在改善凝血功能方面具有潜在的临床应用价值。研究结论认为，双特异性抗体可能为治疗凝血障碍提供新的策略。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Flora Peyvandi

items.title: The Legacy of Orexin (Hypocretin) Research in Narcolepsy and Beyond
items.title_zh: 食欲素（低活性肽）研究在嗜睡症及其他领域的遗产
items.summary_zh: 本研究回顾了食欲素（又称低活性肽）在嗜睡症研究中的重要性及其对其他神经生物学领域的影响。食欲素是一种由下丘脑分泌的神经肽，参与调节觉醒和能量平衡。研究表明，嗜睡症患者体内食欲素水平显著降低，提示其在嗜睡症发病机制中的关键作用。此外，食欲素在睡眠调节、情绪和代谢等方面的作用也逐渐被认识。通过对食欲素的深入研究，科学家们希望能够开发出新的治疗方法，以改善嗜睡症患者的生活质量。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Sebastiaan Overeem and Birgitte R. Kornum

items.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
items.title_zh: 基于支架分割的血浆蛋白结合预测：树模型与深度学习结合
items.summary_zh: 药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程，科学家通过机器学习和人工智能优先选择更有可能成功的分子。本研究使用DeepChem的MoleculeNet中的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNNs）、ChemBERTa模型及其融合。与随机森林（RF）和XGBoost等标准树模型进行比较，采用支架分割方法评估模型性能。结果表明，GNNs和ChemBERTa模型在PPB数据集上表现优于树模型，融合模型的平均表现也优于单独的GNNs或ChemBERTa模型。随机分割的RF模型在R2评分上优于支架分割数据集，表明支架分割下模型在未见核心上的预测能力。
items.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the indi
items.authors: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan

items.title: Cationic Selenuranes Enable Direct Linchpin Formation in Arenes
items.title_zh: 阳离子硒氨盐实现芳烃直接连接体的形成
items.summary_zh: 连接体的形成是一种有效增加分子复杂性的策略。由于其在芳烃C–H功能化中的优异化学选择性，硫族阳离子盐已成为分子多样化的重要中间体。通过S(IV)前体的等高过程引入磺基团需要强酸或酸酐的激活。本文报道了一种简单的倾倒搅拌法，直接从稳定的Se(III)阳离子硒氨盐合成硒阳离子盐。该转化在常温下的空气中进行，无需外源激活剂。机理研究表明对电子效应高度敏感（ρ = −10），而位点选择性由速率限制的去质子化步骤决定（kH/kD = 2.3）。该方法可扩展至10.0 mmol（6.2 g），并直接获得源自复杂分子的硒阳离子盐。这些硒阳离子盐可作为多功能连接体，支持光化学、亲核和过渡金属催化转化，实现后期分子多样化。
items.abstract: The formation of linchpins is a powerful strategy for increasing molecular complexity. Chalcogenonium salts have become valuable intermediates for molecular diversification, owing to their exceptional chemoselectivity in arene C–H functionalization and a synthetic versatility comparable to that of halides and pseudohalides. Sulfonium group introduction through an isohypsic process from S(IV) precursors requires activation with strong acids or anhydrides. Here, we report the direct synthesis of selenonium salts from bench-stable Se(III) cationic selenuranes using a simple dump-and-stir protocol. The transformation proceeds under air at ambient temperature and requires no exogenous activators. Mechanistic investigations reveal high sensitivity to electronic effects (ρ = −10), whereas site selectivity is determined by the rate-limiting deprotonation step (kH/kD = 2.3). The method is scalable to 10.0 mmol ( 6.2 g) and provides direct access to selenonium salts derived from complex molecules. The resulting selenonium salts serve as versatile linchpins for photochemical, nucleophilic, and transition-metal-catalyzed transformations, enabling late-stage molecular diversification.
items.authors: Kirill Zhiliaev, Till Schreyer, Mihai V. Popescu, Javier Mateos

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.title_zh: 基于对比奖励的目标导向三维分子设计强化学习
items.summary_zh: 三维流匹配模型已成为高效采样高质量三维分子结构的强大工具，但基于奖励的强化学习因缺乏可处理的轨迹似然性而变得复杂。现有的策略优化方法通过随机化生成过程或构建似然替代品来应对这一困难，增加了额外的近似。本文提出了ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然强化学习框架，用于对预训练的分子流匹配模型进行奖励对比后训练。在ReCoFlow中，奖励偏好的分子为流匹配模型提供正向监督，而奖励不偏好的分子则用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，锚定损失与指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型相结合，限制了微调模型的漂移。在包括物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件下的三维分子生成的基准研究中，ReCoFlow在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续提升了流匹配模型的性能，优于奖励加权和替代比优化方案。
items.abstract: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. items.title: Microphase Separation and Water Accessibility in Crosslinked Polyurethanes
items.title_zh: 交联聚氨酯的微相分离与水的可及性
items.summary_zh: 聚氨酯材料是最广泛使用的合成聚合物之一，但其原子级结构组织对宏观性质的影响仍不清楚。尽管经过数十年的研究，聚氨酯中硬域和软域的链组织仍然不够理解，因为实验技术无法在原子分辨率下解析链的堆积和分子间相互作用。本文结合基于蒙特卡罗的链长分布下采样与分子动力学松弛的迭代交联协议，生成不同交联度的异质聚合物的全原子模型，以甲苯二异氰酸酯（TDI）和丙氧基化甘油基聚氨酯为模型系统。结果模型重现了可用的实验热力学和结构数据，并自发形成与实验观察一致的微相分离形态。模拟结果表明，硬段聚集是驱动微相分离的主要组织因素。硬域内，链间NH· · ·O=C氢键主导了内聚相互作用，而原子分辨率揭示了与芳香环之间的π-π相互作用一致的芳香堆积模式。
items.abstract: Polyurethane materials are among the most widely used synthetic polymers, yet the atomic-scale structural organisation governing their macroscopic properties remains largely elusive. Despite decades of study, the chain organisation of hard and soft domains in polyurethane remains poorly understood because experimental techniques cannot resolve chain packing and intermolecular interactions at atomistic resolution. Here we combine Monte Carlo-based downsampling of chain length distributions fitted to experimental data with an iterative crosslinking protocol coupled to molecular dynamics relaxation to generate fully atomistic models of heterogeneous polymers with varying crosslinking degrees, using toluene diisocyanate (TDI) and propoxylated glycerol-based polyurethane as a model system. The resulting models reproduce available experimental thermodynamic and structural data, and spontaneously develop microphase separated morphologies consistent with experimental observations. The simulations reveal that hard segment aggregation is a major organisational factor driving microphase separation. items.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
items.title_zh: 基于数据的酶工程策略：从机器学习到蛋白质语言模型
items.summary_zh: 酶是驱动多种生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，庞大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释使得加速酶发现和工程的计算方法需求迫切。近期计算方法的进展正在推动酶工程从经验试错向预测设计转变。本文总结了酶工程工作流程中的代表性计算工具和预测模型，包括（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（如动力学、最佳温度和pH、溶解度、广谱性和特异性），（4）de novo酶设计，以及（5）计算指导的酶优化。我们进一步比较了当前的计算策略，讨论其在不同工程场景中的优缺点，并强调了基础模型、生成性人工智能、多模态学习和闭环设计-构建-测试-学习平台等新兴趋势。
items.abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
items.authors: Shaozhen Ding, Peng Wu, Shubo Li, Yuxuan Yang, Han Zhu, Heng Yu

items.title: Accumulation of enzymes on the lipid-oleosin membarnes
items.title_zh: 脂质-油蛋白膜上酶的积累研究
items.summary_zh: 工程化蛋白质的空间组织为控制合成细胞中的生化反应和材料特性提供了有效策略。然而，在纳米尺度上动态组织多种蛋白质仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了不对称的脂质-油蛋白混合囊泡，其中工程化的油蛋白分子作为膜形成支架，具有两种正交结合系统。外部化学刺激迅速将两种不同的蛋白质招募到各自的油蛋白分子上，生成持久的纳米级接近性。通过单分子追踪证明，在醇糖氧化酶-辣根过氧化物酶级联反应中，酶在同一油蛋白支架上的组织相比于分子间膜招募增强了产物形成。该局部级联反应进一步驱动刺激响应聚合，形成膜相关的细胞骨架样结构，提高了囊泡对高渗透压的抵抗力。这种可编程的膜支架将外部信号与分子组织、生化反应和膜力学相结合，为工程化合成细胞提供了框架，使其能够将化学输入转化为可编程反应和材料输出。
items.abstract: Engineering the spatial organization of proteins offers a powerful strategy for controlling biochemical reactions and material properties in synthetic cells. However, dynamically organizing multiple proteins at the nanometer scale remains challenging. We developed asymmetric lipid–oleosin hybrid vesicles in which engineered oleosin molecules served as membrane-forming scaffolds with two orthogonal conjugation systems. External chemical stimuli rapidly recruited two distinct proteins to individual oleosin molecules, generating persistent nanometer-scale proximity, as demonstrated by single-molecule tracking. In an alditol oxidase–horseradish peroxidase cascade, organization of both enzymes on the same oleosin scaffold enhanced product formation compared with intermolecular membrane recruitment. This localized cascade further drove stimulus-responsive polymerization to form membrane-associated cytoskeleton-like structures, increasing vesicle resistance to hypertonic stress. items.authors: Masato Suzuki, Rinshi S. Kasai, Koki Kamiya

items.title: Finite-Field Second Hyperpolarizability via Adaptive Bayesian Quantum Phase Estimation for Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers: Ground-State Energies Beyond Chemical Accuracy
items.title_zh: 自适应贝叶斯量子相位估计的有限场二次超极化率研究
items.summary_zh: 静态二次超极化率决定了三阶非线性光学响应，但由于有限场提取需要四阶能量导数，故难以通过第一性原理计算。所需的亚µHa基态能量超出常规化学精度。标准多量子比特量子相位估计（QPE）理论上可以达到此精度，但需要较大的辅助寄存器，而单辅助量子迭代QPE（IQPE）受限于二进制网格量化。我们开发了一种自适应贝叶斯QPE（BQPE）工作流程，利用单一辅助量子比特、终端测量和实时经典反馈，通过连续后验估计特征相位。针对STO-3G基中的线性H4链，BQPE在控制深度mmax ≈ 215时实现了约10−7 Ha的基态能量误差，远低于IQPE的限制。通过有限场模板和理查森外推，这些能量在稳定场强区间内恢复了二次超极化率，误差在±10%内，而同深度的IQPE未能实现。这些结果表明，无网格贝叶斯相位估计可以使早期容错量子计算机上的非线性光学特性变得可及。
items.abstract: The static second hyperpolarizability governs third-order nonlinear-optical responses but is difficult to compute by first-principles methods because finite-field extraction requires a fourth-order energy derivative. The resulting error amplification demands sub-µHa ground-state energies, far beyond conventional chemical accuracy. Standard multi-qubit QPE can in principle meet this precision but requires a wide ancilla register, while single-ancilla iterative QPE (IQPE) is limited by a binary-grid quantization floor. We develop an adaptive Bayesian QPE (BQPE) workflow that uses a single ancilla, terminal measurements, and real-time classical feedback to estimate the eigenphase through a continuous posterior rather than a fixed binary grid. For a linear H4 chain in the STO-3G basis, represented by a six-qubit parity Hamiltonian with one ancilla, BQPE reaches a ground-state energy error of ≈ 10−7 Ha at controlled-U depth mmax ≈ 215, about two orders of magnitude below the IQPE floor. items.title: Catalytic Phosphorus-Based Hydrogen Atom
items.title_zh: 催化磷基氢原子转移系统研究
items.summary_zh: 我们报道了首个催化磷基氢原子转移系统。通过使用铱光催化剂和10 mol%的二苯基膦硫化物，我们实现了多种羧酸（包括肽类和药物）的脱羧还原，C–H产物的产率高达95%，且无需化学计量还原剂。机制研究揭示了一种前所未有的阴离子中继过程：磷酰自由基被还原为磷酰阴离子，后者在质子化后再生P–H催化剂。这项工作确立了磷基氢原子转移的催化循环，并识别了主族自由基化学中的一个新基本步骤。
items.abstract: We report the first catalytic phosphorus-based hydrogen atom transfer system. Using an iridium photocatalyst and 10 mol% diphenylphosphine sulfide, we achieve decarboxylative reduction of diverse carboxylic acids—including peptides and pharmaceuticals—to C–H products in up to 95% yield, without stoichiometric reductants. Mechanistic studies reveal an unprecedented anionic relay: a phosphoryl radical is reduced to a phosphinoyl anion, which upon protonation regenerates the P–H catalyst. This work establishes catalytic turnover in phosphorus-based HAT and identifies a new elementary step in main-group radical chemistry.
items.authors: Pratik Avinash, Kayla Merrigan, Bartosz Bieszczad

items.title: Vicem: Automating Molecular Mechanics Modeling of Solvation Dynamics with Applications to Time-Resolved X-ray Scattering
items.title_zh: Vicem：自动化分子力学建模溶剂动力学的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨X射线溶液散射（trXSS）探测溶液中分子尺度的结构动态，但其解释需要高效的计算方法和模型，以评估溶质结构和电荷分布变化对周围溶剂壳及散射信号的影响。我们提出了VICEM，一个基于OpenMM/ASE的软件套件，用于构建溶剂化分子模型、运行分子动力学模拟、检查和分析结果轨迹，同时将溶质几何、部分电荷、Lennard-Jones参数和键合项作为可编辑变量以便模型优化。VICEM包含一个近似的限制溶质模型，旨在快速采样指定溶质几何周围的溶剂壳，并提供纠正选定分子内坐标的势能的工具。我们对244个系统的限制模型进行了基准测试，结果显示限制溶质结构对溶剂壳的影响通常与已建立的柔性力场之间的差异相当。
items.abstract: Time-resolved X-ray solution scattering (trXSS) probes molecular-scale structural dynamics in solution, but its interpretation requires efficient computational methodologies and models for assessing how changes in solute structure and charge distribution affect the surrounding solvent shell and the resulting scattering signal. We present VICEM, an OpenMM/ASE-based software suite for constructing solvated molecular models, running molecular dynamics simulations, inspecting and analyzing the resulting trajectories, while exposing solute geometry, partial charges, Lennard–Jones parameters, and bonded terms as editable variables for model refinement. VICEM includes an approximate restrained-solute model designed for rapid solvent-shell sampling around prescribed solute geometries, together with utilities for correcting the potential energy along selected intramolecular coordinates. We benchmark the restrained model against established force fields for 244 systems comprising neutral organic molecules, charged organic solutes, and transition-metal complexes. items.title: The Gated Quantum Resonator: a reduced-representation Hamiltonian–network framework for gated driven–dissipative quantum systems
items.title_zh: 门控量子谐振器：门控驱动耗散量子系统的简化哈密顿网络框架
items.summary_zh: 高维驱动耗散系统通常通过微观描述或简化模型进行表述，但其与基础动力学的关系不明确。本文独立于特定分子应用，提出了门控量子谐振器（GQR）作为一种受控的简化表示框架，其中选定的相干坐标由结构或环境门控调制。保留的坐标通过上游建模步骤提供，未引入投影或截断算法。基于门依赖的哈密顿量，我们发展了互补的模式、网络和端口哈密顿表示，区分精确保留特性与需要独立验证的现象学闭合。通过GKSL生成器引入开放系统动力学。在无损线性部分，指定的机械网络映射精确保留正常模式频率和模态特征空间，而匹配的输入输出等式是构造上的一致性特性。一个可精确求解的有损三态桥接示例表明，先前提出的耦合-损耗-去相干坐标并未选择出普遍的微观传输最优解。因此，该框架将简化模型视为显式机制假设的生成器。
items.abstract: High-dimensional driven–dissipative systems are often described either microscopically or through reduced models whose relation to the underlying dynamics is unclear. Originally motivated by geometrygated catalytic and enzymatic dynamics, the construction is developed here independently of any particular molecular application. We formulate the Gated Quantum Resonator (GQR) as a controlled reducedrepresentation framework in which selected coherent coordinates are modulated by structural or environmental gates. The retained coordinates are supplied by an upstream modelling step; no projection or truncation algorithm is introduced. From a gate-dependent Hamiltonian we develop complementary mode, network and port–Hamiltonian representations, distinguishing exact preservation properties from phenomenological closures requiring independent validation. Open-system dynamics are introduced through a GKSL generator. For the linear lossless sector, the specified mechanical–network map exactly preserves normal-mode frequencies and modal eigenspaces, while matched input–output equality is a consistency property by construction. items.title: Accelerating the Design of New Natural Deep Eutectic Solvents with Supervised Variational Autoencoders
items.title_zh: 利用监督变分自编码器加速新型天然深共晶溶剂设计
items.summary_zh: 天然深共晶溶剂（NaDESs）的合理设计受到氢键供体和受体组合所带来的巨大组合空间的限制，影响了其物理化学性质的系统实验探索。本研究提出了一种监督变分自编码器（SVAE）框架，通过将生成建模与性质预测相结合，来高效探索这一化学空间。模型在经过筛选的深共晶溶剂数据集上训练，以同时学习潜在结构表示及其与目标性质（如熔点、密度和粘度）的相关性。SVAE生成的虚拟NaDES候选物通过分子描述符、组分比例和目标性质值进行表征。采用COCONUT天然产物数据库的描述符匹配策略将这些虚拟候选物与真实分子关联。随后，利用基于实验DES数据训练的预测模型对生成的NaDES候选物进行验证。结果显示，SVAE生成的目标性质值与回归模型的预测值之间具有良好一致性（熔点R2 = 0.89，RMSE=21.7 K；密度R2 = 0.91，RMSE = 0.04 g·cm-3；粘度R2 = 0.89，RMSE=0.47 cP for ln）。该工作流程展示了如何指导新型NaDES的设计。
items.abstract: The rational design of natural deep eutectic solvents (NaDESs) is hindered by the vast combinatorial space arising from the possible combinations of hydrogen bond donors and acceptors. This enormous design space limits the systematic experimental exploration of their physicochemical properties. In this work, we propose a supervised variational autoencoder (SVAE) framework to efficiently explore this chemical space by coupling generative modeling with property prediction. The model is trained on a curated dataset of deep eutectic solvents to learn simultaneously the latent structural representations and correlations with target properties, including melting point, density, and viscosity. The SVAE generates virtual NaDES candidates characterized by molecular descriptors, component ratios, and target property values. To associate these virtual candidates with real molecules, a descriptor matching strategy is applied using the COCONUT natural product database. The resulting NaDES candidates are subsequently validated using predictive models trained on experimental DES data. The results show strong agreement between the SVAE-generated target property values and the corresponding predict
items.authors: Rachid Laref, Mehdi Oubahmane, Nicolas Rolland, Véronique Nardello-Rataj, Adlane Sayede

items.title: From Materials to Metalloenzymes: Superconducting Microresonators for Characterization of Thin Films
items.title_zh: 从材料到金属酶：超导微谐振器用于薄膜表征
items.summary_zh: 电子自旋共振（EPR）光谱是一种广泛应用于表征各类顺磁中心的技术。然而，传统三维微波谐振器的检测限制了EPR在量子、催化和生物设备相关的纳米级和磁性稀薄膜中的应用。本文展示了由YBa2Cu3O7-x制成的高温超导螺旋微谐振器能够进行脉冲EPR测量，其灵敏度比商业谐振器提高了两个到三个数量级。通过模板法制备的50 nm铜酞菁（CuPc）薄膜在无金属酞菁（H2Pc）中稀释，能够在回声检测EPR场扫描中被检测到，模板效应通过与粉末样品相比谱线变窄得以明显观察。测量结果显示，直径为400 μm的微谐振器上单层CuPc薄膜中的Cu(II)自旋数约为10^11。采用Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill（CPMG）序列，通过对多个回声进行平均，显著提高了信噪比。为展示生物应用，将Cu,Zn超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）掺入平均厚度约为3.7 μm的海藻糖薄膜中。
items.abstract: Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy is a widely used technique for the characterization of paramagnetic centers across a wide range of disciplines. Yet, the detection limits of conventional 3D microwave resonators hinder the application of EPR to nanoscale and magnetically dilute thin films relevant to quantum, catalytic and biological devices. Here we show that high temperature superconducting spiral microresonators fabricated from YBa2Cu3O7-x enable pulse EPR measurements on diverse thin films with a sensitivity improvement of two to three orders of magnitude over commercial resonators. Templated 50 nm films of copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) diluted in metal-free phthalocyanine (H2Pc) deposited onto the microresonator were detectable in echo-detected EPR field sweeps with the templating effect clearly visible from narrowing of the spectrum compared to powder samples. The number of Cu(II) spins present in a single thin film of CuPc on a microresonator with 400 μm diameter was ~1011, as determined by measurement of coherence memory times (Tm) and longitudinal (T1) spin relaxation times. items.authors: Blaise L. Geoghegan, Emma Bryan, Yunfei Dang, Jean-Baptiste Verstraete, Alberto Collauto, Gediminas Usevičius

items.title: Advancement of triphos-Ru catalyzed C–O bond disconnections and its challenges
items.title_zh: 三膦铑催化C–O键断裂的进展及挑战
items.summary_zh: 固化环氧树脂是交联热固性材料，广泛应用于碳纤维或玻璃纤维增强复合材料，但其广泛的C–O和C–N键网络使得回收变得困难。我们之前报道了一种铑-三膦催化系统，能够在相对温和的条件下化学解构胺固化环氧树脂，回收双酚A（BPA）。后续的机理研究发现催化剂激活缓慢和催化剂失活是主要限制因素。本文利用这些见解通过前催化剂和反应设计开发了改进的催化系统。替换原有的三膦铑-TMM前催化剂提高了催化性能，而配体设计则使得可以使用氢气作为还原剂。尽管取得了这些进展，但在模型化合物上观察到的改进性能并未直接转化为固化环氧树脂。反应优化显示对底物浓度和聚合物可及性有明显依赖，计算研究表明催化剂物种的变化受到构象约束的影响。这些发现表明，影响环氧树脂解构的瓶颈可能因聚合物基体的约束而变化。
items.abstract: Cured epoxy resins are crosslinked thermoset materials with applications including carbon-or glass-reinforced composites, but whose extensive C–O and C–N bond networks renders recycling challenging. Previously, our group has reported a Ru-triphos-catalyzed system for the chemical deconstruction of amine-cured epoxy resins, enabling recovery of bisphenol A (BPA) under relatively mild conditions. Subsequent mechanistic studies identified slow catalyst activation and catalyst deactivation as key limitations. Herein, these insights were used to develop improved catalytic systems through pre-catalyst and reaction design. Replacement of the original triphos-Ru-TMM pre-catalyst enabled improved catalytic performance, while ligand design enabled the use of H2, instead of isopropanol, as reductant. Despite these advances, the improved performance observed for model compounds did not translate directly to cured epoxy resins. Reaction optimization revealed pronounced dependencies on substrate concentration, and polymer accessibility, while computational studies suggest changes in catalyst speciation imposed by conformational constraints. items.authors: Camille Mandrup Kristensen, Gabriel M. F. Batista, Marcelo H. R. Carvalho, Alexander Ahrens, Clemens Kaussler, Pedro P. de Castro

items.title: Machine learning-accelerated evolutionary Monte Carlo for rapid phase exploration of compositionally complex materials in reactive environments
items.title_zh: 机器学习加速的进化蒙特卡洛法用于复杂材料相的快速探索
items.summary_zh: 组成复杂材料，如高熵合金/氧化物，由于其成分间的协同效应，长期以来受到研究者的关注，具有独特的机械和功能特性。最近，它们作为新型异质催化剂在热化学和电化学应用中的发展平台备受瞩目。然而，由于设计空间大和反应条件下活性位点动态复杂，催化剂材料的相稳定性计算研究仍然面临挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的进化蒙特卡洛算法，能够快速探索反应环境中稳定的复杂催化相，并可推广至任何催化材料和反应条件。我们展示了该方法与精细调优的机器学习势能结合使用，可以在合理的计算成本下预测复杂催化剂在不同反应条件下的体相和表面混合/分离行为。
items.abstract: Compositionally complex materials, e.g. high-entropy alloys/oxides, have long been of research interest for their unique mechanical and functional properties thanks to the synergistic effects between the large number of components. More recently, they have emerged as a promising platform for the development of novel heterogeneous catalysts for thermo- and electro-chemical applications. However, computational investigation of the phase stability of such catalyst materials remains challenging due to the large design space and the complex active site dynamics under reaction conditions. In this paper, we present a novel evolutionary Monte Carlo algorithm which allows fast exploration of stable compositionally-complex catalyst phases in reactive environments and can be generalized for any catalyst materials and any reaction conditions. In detail, we will showcase that this method can be used in combination with finetuned machine learning potentials for predicting bulk and surface mixing/segregating behaviors of compositionally-complex catalysts under various reaction conditions with reasonable computational cost.
items.authors: Shuang Han, Sandip De

items.title: THIOETHERS AS POTENTIAL ANTIBACTERIAL AGENTS AGAINST METHICILLIN-RESISTANT STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS (MRSA)
items.title_zh: 硫醚作为抗耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的潜在抗菌剂
items.summary_zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）的出现和快速传播迫切需要新型抗菌剂来克服已有的耐药机制。硫醚因其结构多样性和通过不同药效团的结合调节抗菌活性的能力而受到越来越多的关注。本文综述了合成、半合成及天然或天然产物衍生的硫醚化合物在抗MRSA方面的研究，重点讨论其结构特征、结构-活性关系（SAR）、抗菌效力及作用机制。主要讨论的类别包括氨基糖苷衍生的硫醚两亲物质、膜活性小分子硫醚、喹唑啉酮和喹啉硫醚骨架、Pleuromutilin硫醚衍生物、靶向SecA的硫醚、查尔酮和噁唑烷酮衍生物、靶向FtsZ的硫醚、抗毒力和抗生物膜剂、抗微生物肽模仿物及天然产物衍生的硫醚化合物。研究表明，含硫基团可以通过破坏膜、抑制细菌蛋白质合成及靶向重要的非核糖体蛋白来增强抗MRSA活性。
items.abstract: The emergence and rapid spread of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) have created an urgent need for new antibacterial agents capable of overcoming established resistance mechanisms. Among the diverse sulfur-containing scaffolds, thioethers have attracted increasing attention because of their structural versatility and ability to modulate antibacterial activity through incorporation into different pharmacophores. This review provides a comprehensive overview of synthetic, semisynthetic, and natural or natural-product-derived thioether compounds evaluated against MRSA, with emphasis on their structural features, structure-activity relationships (SAR), antibacterial potency, and mechanisms of action. The major classes discussed include aminoglycoside-derived thioether amphiphiles, membrane-active small-molecule thioethers, quinazolinone and quinoline thioether scaffolds, pleuromutilin thioether derivatives, SecA-targeting thioethers, chalcone and oxazolidinone derivatives, FtsZ-targeting thioethers, anti-virulence and antibiofilm agents, antimicrobial peptidomimetics, and natural-product-derived thioether compounds. items.authors: Aditya G Lavekar, Radha Ahuja, Deepti Gairola

items.title: Chemoproteomic mapping of active glycan-processing networks in a defined gut microbiome
items.title_zh: 活性糖苷酶网络在特定肠道微生物组中的化学蛋白组学映射
items.summary_zh: 微生物组研究通常通过基因内容或表达推测功能，但这些测量无法确定哪些酶具有催化活性或识别哪些底物。本研究使用多重机制基础的糖苷酶探针，从定殖有14种人类肠道微生物的鼠盲肠样本中直接映射活性糖苷酶。基于活性的蛋白质谱分析识别出参与淀粉、β-葡聚糖、木聚糖和木糖降解的宿主和微生物酶，并将其与特定分类群和位点关联。装饰探针解析了活性酶家族中的分支和取代偏好，揭示了通过大宗底物测定难以检测的木糖酶活性。多个显著活性被分配给低丰度的拟杆菌属，而共享相同接种物和饮食的动物之间的酶部署存在差异。这些结果确立了基于活性的化学蛋白组学作为元基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学的补充层次，用于定义宿主相关微生物组中的功能性糖苷加工状态。
items.abstract: Microbiome studies typically infer function from gene content or expression, but these measurements do not establish which enzymes are catalytically active or what substrates they recognise. Here we use a multiplexed panel of mechanism-based glycosidase probes to map active glycan-processing enzymes directly from caecal samples of mice colonised with a defined, 14-member, human gut microbiota. Activity-based protein profiling identifies host and microbial enzymes involved in starch, β-glucan, xyloglucan and xylan degradation and links them to defined taxa and loci. Decorated probes resolve branch and substitution preferences within active enzyme families, revealing xylanase activities poorly detected by bulk substrate assays. Several prominent activities are assigned to low-abundance Bacteroides species, while enzyme deployment differs among animals sharing a common inoculum and diet. These results establish activity-based chemoproteomics as a complementary layer to metagenomics, transcriptomics and proteomics for defining functional glycan-processing states in host-associated microbiomes.
items.authors: Isabelle B. Pickles, Thamy L. R. Corrêa, Qinnan Yang, Yurong Chen, Zirui Li, Nicole M. Koropatkin

items.title: alchemy: systematic enumeration and thermodynamic screening of small-molecule radical reaction networks
items.title_zh: alchemy：小分子自由基反应网络的系统枚举与热力学筛选
items.summary_zh: 自动构建化学反应网络受到可能分子、中间体和形式转化的组合增长限制。我们提出了alchemy，一个开源Python工作流，用于系统枚举和筛选小分子自由基反应网络。在明确界定的图空间内，alchemy生成具有单、双或三键及指定自由基数的连接中性C/N/H分子图；RDKit的消毒和标准化步骤则去除无效图和重复记录。反应候选通过结合键解离记录构建，而无需学习反应模板。该工作流在一个限于最多五个重原子和每个反应侧一个未配对电子的三甲胺案例研究中，生成了41,735个独特分子图和60,035个第一代自由基转移记录。虽然PaiNN模型在OpenBabel生成的QM9几何结构上进行了训练和测试，但QM9不包含开壳物种，因此无法验证此处枚举的自由基化学的预测。alchemy因此提供了一条可重复的高效研究路径。
items.abstract: Automated construction of chemical reaction networks is limited by the combinatorial growth of possible molecules, intermediates, and formal transformations. We present alchemy, an open-source Python workflow for systematic enumeration and screening of small-molecule radical reaction networks. Within an explicitly bounded graph space, alchemy generates connected, neutral C/N/H molecular graphs with single, double, or triple bonds and specified radical counts; RDKit sanitisation and canonicalisation then remove graph-invalid and duplicate records. Reaction candidates are constructed without learned reaction templates by combining bond-dissociation records into rearrangement and transfer stoichiometries. Parallel generation, disk-backed storage, machine-learning prediction of molecular Gibbs free energies, and Kuzu graph representation make the resulting formal network searchable. In a trimethylamine case study limited to at most five heavy atoms and one unpaired electron per reaction side, the workflow generated 41,735 unique molecular graphs and 60,035 first-generation radical-transfer records. items.authors: Le Minh Vu, Priya Sharmesh, Mega Kar, Truyen Tran, Sherif Abdulkader Tawfik

items.title: Directed Evolution of a Non-Heme Iron Enzyme for Enantioselective Dearomative Nitrene Transfer: Synthesis of 3a-Aminopyrroloindoline Alkaloids
items.title_zh: 非血红素铁酶的定向进化及其在不对称去芳构化中的应用
items.summary_zh: 酶促氮烯诱导的去芳构化是生物催化反应中尚未探索的领域。本研究报道了非血红素铁酶AsqJ的定向进化，首次催化不对称去芳构化氮烯转移至吲哚，合成富含对映体的3a-氨基吡咯并吲哚类生物碱。通过迭代半理性工程和结构导向的突变，最终变体实现了高达98%的产率和99%的对映体过量。该反应适用于多种吲哚底物，在制备规模上可获得高达86%的分离产率，并保持一致的高对映选择性。分子动力学模拟表明，定向进化建立了一种新的底物结合构象，具有更有序的活性位点氢键网络。本平台的合成实用性通过两种天然产物（(+)-psychotriasine和(+)-psychotrimine）的全合成得以证明。这项工作确立了不对称去芳构化氮烯转移作为一种新的生物催化模式，扩展了非血红素铁酶的催化能力，为复杂天然产物中新型生物催化反应的应用奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Enzymatic nitrene-induced dearomatization represents an unexplored area of biocatalytic reactivity. Here, we report the directed evolution of AsqJ, a non-heme iron enzyme from aspoquinolone biosynthesis, to catalyze the first biocatalytic asymmetric dearomative nitrene transfer into indoles to furnish enantioenriched 3a-aminopyrroloindolines — a privileged scaffold in bioactive indole alkaloid natural products. Obtained through iterative semi-rational engineering and structure-informed mutagenesis, the final variant achieves up to 98% yield and 99% ee. The reaction accommodates a range of indole substrates, affording up to 86% isolated yield on preparative scale with consistently high enantioselectivity. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that directed evolution established a new substrate-binding conformation that is distinct from the starting variant through a reorganized hydrogen-bonding network within a more preorganized active site. The synthetic utility of this platform is demonstrated through the total syntheses of two natural products, (+)-psychotriasine and (+)-psychotrimine. This work establishes asymmetric dearomative nitrene transfer as a new biocatalytic modality,
items.authors: Xinpeng Mu, Ruiying Jiang, Jiali Xie, Shu Li, Hans Renata

items.title: Entropy-Guided Dataset Reduction for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
items.title_zh: 基于熵引导的数据集缩减用于机器学习原子间势
items.summary_zh: 机器学习的原子间势（MLIPs）在计算成本极低的情况下提供接近量子力学的精度，其性能依赖于训练数据的质量和组成。训练集必须覆盖模型将遇到的原子环境范围，但不必要的冗余会增加训练成本而不提高精度，并可能引入训练偏差。数据集剪枝（即从较大集合中选择紧凑、代表性的子集）已成为构建高质量训练集的实用策略。基于信息论多样性度量的方法如QUESTS（快速不确定性和熵来自结构相似性）显示出显著前景，但QUESTS需要指定一个长度尺度参数（核带宽），控制两个原子环境在被视为冗余之前的相似程度。我们展示了该参数在结构上不同的相中具有操作性有用的值，使得对异构数据集的简单自动剪枝变得具有挑战性。我们提出了一种剪枝框架，通过对训练数据集的不同热力学子集独立调整带宽，使用应用于QUESTS信息熵度量的可自动化肘部标准来解决这一问题。然后应用最远点采样（FPS）。
items.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-quantum-mechanical accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. Their performance depends on the quality and composition of the training data: the training set must cover the range of atomic environments the model will encounter, yet unnecessary redundancy increases training cost without improving accuracy and can inadvertently introduce training biases. Dataset pruning (i.e., selecting a compact, representative subset from a larger collection) has emerged as a practical strategy for building high-quality training sets. Recently, methods based on informationtheoretic diversity measures such as QUESTS (Quick Uncertainty and Entropy from STructural Similarity) have shown significant promise, however, QUESTS requires specification of a lengthscale parameter (kernel bandwidth) that controls how similar two atomic environments must be before one is considered redundant. We show that operationally useful values of this parameter vary across structurally distinct phases, making naive automated pruning of heterogeneous datasets challenging. items.authors: Benjamin R. Laubach, Joshua A. Vita, Kyle Bushick, Logan Williams, Vincenzo Lordi, Rebecca K. Lindsey

items.title: Applicability-Domain-Aware Evaluation of Machine-Learning NMR Chemical-Shift Prediction in Small drug Molecules: GT-NMR for 13C and CASCADE for 1H
items.title_zh: 小分子药物NMR化学位移预测的适用性领域评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究对两种预训练机器学习模型在五种药物相关小分子（氨基甲酸酯、苯佐卡因、多巴胺、贝他唑和贝他组胺）中的溶液态NMR化学位移预测的实际准确性和适用性领域进行了小规模外部评估。使用预训练的GT-NMR图形变换模型进行特定原子的13C化学位移预测，而CASCADE 3D图神经网络工作流程用于1H化学位移预测。通过与可验证的文献NMR数据进行比较，评估了数据集重叠、最近训练集Morgan指纹Tanimoto相似性、Murcko骨架覆盖率和分子复杂性作为适用性领域诊断。检查的GT-NMR或CASCADE质子训练/验证/测试部分未检测到五种精确结构，但所有五种Murcko骨架在相应的训练集中都有表示。GT-NMR审核的13C分子级平均绝对误差为苯佐卡因0.50 ppm。
items.abstract: A small external evaluation was performed to examine the practical accuracy and applicability domain of two pretrained machine-learning models for solution-state NMR chemical-shift prediction in five pharmaceutically relevant small molecules: amylmetacresol, benzocaine, dopamine, betazole, and betahistine.The pretrained GT-NMR graphtransformer model was used for atom-specific 13C chemical-shift prediction, while the CASCADE 3D graph neural-network workflow was used for 1H chemical-shift prediction.Predictions were compared with primary-literature NMR data where numerical assignments could be verified.Exact dataset overlap, nearest-training-set Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto similarity, Murcko-scaffold coverage, and molecular complexity were evaluated as applicability-domain diagnostics.None of the five exact structures was detected in the checked GT-NMR or CASCADE proton train/validation/test partitions, although all five Murcko scaffolds were represented in the corresponding training sets.For GT-NMR, audited 13C molecule-level MAEs were 0.50 ppm for benzocaine, 2.59 ppm for
items.authors: Diba Allameh Zadeh

items.title: Chemical Accuracy for Carbapenem Breakdown by Class A beta-Lactamases Using a Transferable Embedded Machine-Learned Potential
items.title_zh: 基于可转移嵌入机器学习势的类A β-内酰胺酶对碳青霉烯的化学精度研究
items.summary_zh: 细菌对碳青霉烯（强效β-内酰胺抗生素）的耐药性是全球健康的重大威胁，主要原因是β-内酰胺酶的水解作用。尽管碳青霉烯曾被视为“最后的救命稻草”，但具有碳青霉烯酶活性的酶已广泛传播。理解和预测β-内酰胺酶的活性有助于开发新抗生素和抑制剂，从而应对抗生素耐药性。我们开发并测试了一种可转移的机器学习/分子力学（ML/MM）框架，针对碳青霉烯美洛培南的去酰化反应，采用电静态机器学习嵌入（EMLE）方案。该模型对四种不同类A β-内酰胺酶的自由能障碍预测精度在1 kcal/mol以内，与实验值相符。
items.abstract: Bacterial resistance to carbapenems (potent β-lactam antibiotics) is a critical global health threat. The primary cause is β-lactamase enzymes that hydrolyze antibiotics. Previously, carbapenems resisted breakdown, making them ‘last resort’ antibiotics, but enzymes with carbapenemase activity have become widespread. Understanding and predicting the activity of β-lactamases will help in developing antibiotics and inhibitors, and combating antibiotic resistance. Effective prediction requires methods that are both accurate and computationally efficient. Multiscale combined quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) molecular dynamics simulations of reactions can discriminate between class A β-lactamases (the most widely distributed group) with or without carbapenemase activity, and identify determinants of activity. but face an accuracy/efficiency tradeoff: approximate semiempirical QM methods do not predict reaction barriers accurately, but higher level QM calculations require extensive computer time and resources, making them impractical for rapid predictions. Here, we develop and test a transferable ML/MM framework for the deacylation reaction of the carbapenem meropenem, using
items.authors: Elliot W. Chan, Michael Beer, Kirill Zinovjev, James Spencer, Marc W. van der Kamp, Adrian J. Mulholland

items.title: An Attention-based Architecture to Decode Chemical Transformations from Process Spectroscopic Data
items.title_zh: 基于注意力机制的化学转化解码架构
items.summary_zh: 光谱学是一种强大的分析技术，能够精确表征化学物质及其在动态化学过程中的转化。传统上，光谱特征通过与已建立的光谱库进行校准来解释。然而，对于复杂分子系统、多种相互作用化合物的混合物或动态过程，得到的光谱信号变得高度复杂。传统的解卷积方法依赖于先验信息，以有效地将测量数据分解为潜在成分，并使用合理的反应模板推断化学转化。然而，过程光谱数据的动态性、规模和维度使得这种解卷积变得越来越困难，且常常不适定。这些限制在工业过程环境中尤为明显，从而降低了其在质量控制、杂质检测和反应路径识别中的有效性。为实现化学转化的精确和自动阐明，我们提出了一种基于注意力机制的解码器架构，该架构不仅能够从高维过程光谱数据中挖掘化学转化，还能在不需要反应模板、参与物种数量或其他先验知识的情况下，识别关键参与物种。
items.abstract: Spectroscopy is a powerful analytical technique that promises precise characterization of chemical species and their transformations in dynamic chemical processes. Traditionally, spectral signatures are interpreted by calibrating against established spectral libraries. However, for complex molecular systems, mixtures of multiple interacting compounds, or dynamical processes, the resulting spectral signals become highly convoluted. Conventional deconvolution based methods rely on the availability of prior information to effectively decompose the measured data into latent components and infer chemical transformations using plausible reaction templates. However, the dynamics, scale, and dimensionality of process spectroscopic data make such deconvolutions increasingly difficult and often ill-conditioned. These limitations are particularly pronounced in industrial process settings, thus reducing their effectiveness for quality control, impurity detection, and reaction pathway identification. items.authors: Kuldeep Singh, Vinay Prasad

items.title: Hypermolecule: Chemically Synthesized Three-dimensional Macroscopic Molecular Moiré Superlattices
items.title_zh: 超分子：化学合成的三维宏观分子莫尔超晶格
items.summary_zh: 近期，二维系统中的莫尔超晶格因其可调的光学、电子和量子特性而受到广泛关注。然而，莫尔系统的研究主要限于二维系统，导致可扩展性和可重复性成为重要问题。本文报道了基于分子的宏观三维莫尔超晶格超结构的形成证据。我们将这种孤立的三维组装定义为超分子，其没有已知的自然或合成分子类似物。通过透射电子显微镜、紫外-可见光谱和光致发光研究，探讨了二维莫尔组装的时间演变，揭示了扭转堆叠的二维莫尔超晶格向宏观莫尔系统生长的层次进展。此外，采用X射线衍射表征方法阐明了所得到的三维组装的结构特征，并建立了二维与三维超晶格之间的关联。宏观莫尔超晶格除了二维结构外，还表现出手性光学行为，进一步通过圆偏振光致发光研究进行了探讨。这些观察为深入理解其形成机制提供了重要见解和开放平台。
items.abstract: Recently, moiré superlattices in two-dimensional (2D) systems have attracted significant attention owing to their tunable optical, electronic and quantum properties. Nevertheless, the studies of moiré systems were mostly limited to 2D systems, which make scalability and reproducibility an important issue. Here, we report evidence for the formation of moleculebased macroscopic three-dimensional (3D) moiré superlattice superstructure. We define the isolated 3D assembly as a hypermolecule that has no known natural or synthetic molecular analogue. The time-dependent evolution of the 2D moiré assemblies was investigated using transmission electron microscopy, UV-visible spectroscopy and photoluminescence studies, revealing the hierarchical progression of twist-stacked 2D moiré superlattices towards the growth of macroscopic moiré systems. In addition, X-ray diffraction characterization methods were pursued to elucidate the structural characteristics of the resulting 3D assemblies and establish the correlation between the 2D and 3D superlattices. The macroscopic moiré superlattices – in addition to the 2D structures – exhibited chiroptical behavior, which was further investigated using c
items.authors: Ashmita Mishra, Archismita Hajra, Arun Chattopadhyay

items.title: Bridging MS2 Spectra and Chemical Space: Advances in Spectral Similarity, Molecular Retrieval, and De Novo Structure Discovery
items.title_zh: 连接MS2光谱与化学空间：光谱相似性与分子检索进展
items.summary_zh: 基于质谱的代谢组学日益依赖计算方法将信息丰富的MS/MS碎片化模式转化为化学洞察，但由于参考库仅覆盖少量可能化合物，光谱的化学身份分配（“注释”）仍是主要瓶颈。本文通过光谱空间和化学空间两个相互作用的表示空间框架来探讨该领域。我们讨论不同设计选择如何影响几何结构，以及光谱或分子“接近”的含义，并回顾了光谱表示与比较、分子表示以及两者之间映射的方法。我们强调了跨模态对齐和检索的新兴深度学习趋势，并指出由于峰值歧义、噪声以及光谱与结构关系的一对多特性，文本-图像学习类比的局限性。
items.abstract: Mass spectrometry-based metabolomics increasingly relies on computational methods to translate information-rich MS/MS fragmentation patterns into chemical insight, yet assigning chemical identities to spectra ("annotation") remains a major bottleneck because reference libraries cover only a small fraction of plausible compounds. In this review, we frame the field through the lens of two interacting representation spaces: spectral space, where MS/MS data reside, and chemical space, where molecules are represented by fingerprints, descriptors, or learned embeddings. We discuss how different design choices induce different geometries, what it means for spectra or molecules to be "close", and survey methods for representing and comparing spectra, representing molecules, and mapping between both spaces. We highlight emerging deep-learning trends for cross-modal alignment and retrieval, and we outline where the analogy to text-image learning breaks due to peak ambiguity, noise, and the one-to-many nature of spectrum-to-structure relationships.
items.authors: Julian Pollmann, Roman Bushuiev, Anton Bushuiev, Tomáš Pluskal, Florian Huber

items.title: Magnetic anisotropy of tellurium(I) and selenium(I)† in a Li3N host crystal
items.title_zh: 锂氮宿主晶体中碲(I)和硒(I)的磁各向异性研究
items.summary_zh: 低配位主族化合物中的磁各向异性最近被认为是实现单分子磁体行为的有前景途径。本研究利用周期性密度泛函理论和嵌入离子晶体的量子力学/分子力学多参考计算，探讨了掺硒和掺碲的Li3N晶体的电子结构和磁性。Li(1)位点被Se(I)和Te(I)取代后，形成了嵌入高度对称晶体环境中的低配位np3构型。计算结果显示，两种掺杂剂在自旋局域化和共价性方面存在显著差异：Te掺杂稳定了具有局域磁性的自旋极化电子结构，而Se 4p–N 2p的强杂化导致了更强的去局域化和非磁性的DFT基态。多参考SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2计算表明，两种体系的基态均为磁各向同性，主要由单占σ键轨道主导，而第一激发态则表现出明显的轴向磁各向异性，源于通过自旋-轨道相互作用耦合的近简并π∗ x和π∗ y轨道。对于掺碲的簇，极小的横向g张量分量（gx,gy ≈ 0.002）和较大的轴向分量（gz ≈ 3.9）表明接近理想的磁性特征。
items.abstract: Magnetic anisotropy in low-coordinate main-group compounds has recently emerged as a promising route toward realizing single-molecule magnet behavior beyond traditional transition-metal and lanthanide systems. In this work, we investigate the electronic structure and magnetic properties of selenium-and tellurium-doped Li3N crystals using a combination of periodic density functional theory and embedded ionic-crystal QM/MM multireference calculations. Substitution of Li(1) sites by Se(I) and Te(I) generates low-coordinate np3 configurations embedded in a highly symmetric crystalline environment. Periodic calculations reveal substantial differences in spin localization and covalency between the two dopants: Te-doping stabilizes a spin-polarized electronic structure with localized magnetic character, whereas stronger Se 4p–N 2p hybridization leads to increased delocalization and a non-magnetic DFT ground state. items.authors: Dániel Nagy, Akseli Mansikkamäki

items.title: From Proteins and Molecules to Cats and Dogs: Visualization as Scalable Minimum Spanning Trees
items.title_zh: 从蛋白质到猫狗：可扩展的最小生成树可视化
items.summary_zh: 高维数据集的降维和可视化对于分析至关重要，但传统投影方法会掩盖局部结构关系。我们提出了TMAP2，这是TMAP的可扩展重写，能够将高维数据映射为最小生成树。TMAP2支持多种输入类型，包括连续嵌入、稀疏指纹和预计算图，适用于单细胞、图像、化学或蛋白质语言模型数据。地图上的每一条线都代表真实的最近邻关系，任意两点之间恰好有一条路径。路径上的边数作为坐标，能够恢复胰腺细胞的发育年龄（Spearman 0.90），追踪仅基于原始序列构建的SARS-CoV-2刺突序列的采集日期（Spearman 0.86），并描绘出从波斯猫到约克夏犬的平滑形态变化。在360万CAZyme序列中，该树分离了分类域，并在GH43家族内按催化活性对序列进行排序，揭示了一个被注释为某种活性的锚定酶与另一簇酶的关系。TMAP2将原始TMAP从指纹扩展到任何嵌入，支持最多一百万个点，召回率为95-99%。
items.abstract: Dimensionality reduction and data visualization are essential for analyzing highdimensional datasets, yet traditional projection methods obscure local structural relationships. We present TMAP2, a scalable rewrite of TMAP that maps highdimensional data as a minimum spanning tree. TMAP2 accepts diverse input types, including continuous embeddings, sparse fingerprints, and precomputed graphs, and applies to single-cell, image, chemistry, or protein-language-model data. Every line on the map is therefore a real nearest-neighbor relationship, and exactly one path joins any two points. The number of edges along that path, its hop count, works as a coordinate along a progression: it recovers a pancreatic cell’s developmental age (Spearman 0.90), tracks the collection date of a SARS-CoV-2 spike sequence built from raw sequence alone (Spearman 0.86), and traces a smooth morph from a Persian cat to a Yorkshire terrier that crosses species at a single edge. On 3.6 million CAZyme sequences the same tree separates taxonomic domains and, within the family GH43, sorts sequences by catalytic activity, revealing an anchor enzyme annotated as one activity sitting among a cluster of another. items.authors: Alejandro Flores Sepúlveda, Maarten Boneschansker, Jean-Louis Reymond, Daniel Probst

items.title: Catalytic Phosphorus-Based Hydrogen Atom Transfer via a Phosphinoyl Anion Relay
items.title_zh: 基于磷的催化氢原子转移研究
items.summary_zh: 我们首次报道了一种基于磷的催化氢原子转移系统。利用铱光催化剂和10 mol%的二苯基膦硫化物，我们实现了多种羧酸（包括肽类和药物）的脱羧还原，C–H产物的产率高达95%，且无需化学计量还原剂。机理研究揭示了一种前所未有的阴离子中继：磷酰自由基被还原为磷酰阴离子，后者在质子化后再生P–H催化剂。这项工作确立了基于磷的催化氢原子转移的循环，并识别了主族自由基化学中的一个新基本步骤。
items.abstract: We report the first catalytic phosphorus-based hydrogen atom transfer system. Using an iridium photocatalyst and 10 mol% diphenylphosphine sulfide, we achieve decarboxylative reduction of diverse carboxylic acids—including peptides and pharmaceuticals—to C–H products in up to 95% yield, without stoichiometric reductants. Mechanistic studies reveal an unprecedented anionic relay: a phosphoryl radical is reduced to a phosphinoyl anion, which upon protonation regenerates the P–H catalyst. This work establishes catalytic turnover in phosphorus-based HAT and identifies a new elementary step in main-group radical chemistry.
items.authors: Pratik Avinash, Kayla Merrigan, Bartosz Bieszczad

items.title: Decoupling Morphological and Electronic Effects of Ni-Doped Ruthenium Oxide Oxygen Evolution Catalysts for PEM Water Electrolysis
items.title_zh: 解耦镍掺杂钌氧化物催化剂的形态与电子效应用于PEM水电解
items.summary_zh: 本研究以镍掺杂的二氧化钌（Ni-doped RuO2）为模型系统，系统探讨掺杂浓度和合成温度对催化剂形态和电子结构的影响。研究发现，RuO2中镍的酸稳定极限约为10 mol%。镍的掺入影响了钛矿结构并抑制颗粒生长，而较低的合成温度则减小了颗粒尺寸。最佳性能的Ni掺杂RuO2催化剂的氧气演化反应（OER）质量活性（MA）相比未掺杂RuO2提高了十倍。基于比表面积的MA归一化显示，这一增强部分源于可接触表面积的增加，同时也包括了内在OER活性的提升。X射线光电子能谱分析揭示了Ru 3d和O 1s区域的镍依赖性变化（电子效应），与内在OER活性的增加相关。
items.abstract: Proper assessment of oxygen evolution reaction (OER) catalyst performance requires recognising that doping can introduce simultaneous changes to structure, morphology, and electronic properties that together influence the observed electrochemical behaviour. In this study, Ni-doped RuO2 is used as a model system to systematically investigate how dopant concentration and synthesis temperature affect catalyst morphology and electronic structure. These trends are correlated with OER mass activity (MA), intrinsic activity, and stability enabling the morphological and intrinsic electronic contributions to catalyst performance to be distinguished. The acid-stable limit for bulk Ni incorporation in RuO2 is found to be approximately 10 mol%. Ni incorporation affects the rutile structure and inhibits particle growth, while lower synthesis temperatures decrease particle size. The best-performing Ni-doped RuO2 catalyst here shows up to a tenfold increase in OER MA compared with undoped RuO2. Surface area-based normalisation of MA reveals that this enhancement is partly caused by increased accessible surface area and includes an additional contribution from increased intrinsic OER activity. items.authors: Mairis Bērziņš, Peeter Valk, Tavo Romann, Priit Möller, Jekaterina Kozlova, Kuno Kooser

items.title: Simulation of Ultrafast Fe(II) Photoswitching Dynamics Triggered by Excitation within the Quintet Manifold
items.title_zh: 超快Fe(II)光开关动力学的模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 研究了[Fe(tpy)2]2+、[Fe(dftpy)2]2+和[Fe(dctpy)2]2+中五重态到单重态的回切换过程，以及[Fe(dftpy)2]2+自旋交叉和[Fe(dctpy)2]2+高自旋复合物的光弛豫动力学。采用全维度轨迹表面跳跃（TSH）动力学方法，发现光激发后，5Eg（5MC）态的初始种群通过直接（5Eg → 5T2g）和3MC交叉（5Eg → 3MC→5T2g）机制迅速衰减，后者主导了动力学。五重态到单重态的光转化效率较低（约10%），主要由于单重态、三重态和五重态的交叉区域仅在初始亚皮秒动力学（约500 fs）期间易于到达。改善交叉区域的可达性可能显著提高五重态到单重态的转化效率，提示更广泛的化学修饰可能显著优化回切换过程。激发到五重态MLCT态后，种群在200 fs内衰减至暗态5Eg（5MC），随后在不到1 ps内弛豫至5T2g（5MC），仅1-2%的初始种群保留在配体中心态。
items.abstract: The quintet-to-singlet back-switching process in [Fe(tpy)2]2+(tpy=2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine), [Fe(dftpy)2]2+ (dftpy=6,6"-difluoro-2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine) and [Fe(dctpy)2]2+(dctpy=6,6"-dichloro-2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine), together with the photorelaxation dynamics of the [Fe(dftpy)2]2+ spin-crossover and the [Fe(dctpy)2]2+ high-spin complexes were investigated by full-dimensional trajectory surface hopping (TSH) dynamics. Following photoexcitation, the initial population of the 5Eg (5MC) state decays quickly via a branching mechanism of direct (5Eg → 5T2g) and 3MC-crossed (5Eg → 3MC→5T2g) processes, with the latter dominating the dynamics. The quintet-to-singlet photoconversion, the key step of the back-switching process, remains inefficient ( 10%). This low efficiency arises because the singlet–triplet–quintet crossing region is readily accessible only during the initial sub-picosecond dynamics ( 500 fs). Shifting the crossing region to improve its accessibility could substantially enhance the quintet-to-singlet conversion efficiency, suggesting that more extensive chemical modification could significantly optimize the back-switching process. items.title: Synthesis, Spectroscopic Characterisation, and Structural Elucidation of Ni(II) and Cu(II) Complexes of a Novel N,N’-Diaminophthalamidoxime Ligand
items.title_zh: 新型N,N'-二氨基邻苯二甲酰肼氧肟配体的Ni(II)和Cu(II)配合物合成及表征
items.summary_zh: 合成了一种新型N,N'-二氨基邻苯二甲酰肼氧肟（NAD）配体，通过将水合肼与邻苯二甲酸二乙酯反应生成邻苯二甲酸二肼，随后与羟胺反应得到目标配体。该配体与Ni(II)和Cu(II)盐反应，分别生成[Ni(NAD)2]Cl2和[Cu(NAD)2(OAc)2]。通过溶解度研究、熔点测定、络合金属分析、室温磁化率及红外和紫外-可见光谱对配体及其配合物进行了表征。自由配体在DMSO、DMF和热乙醇中可溶，但在氯仿、乙酸乙酯、丙酮、甲醇、二氯甲烷和蒸馏水中不溶，三种化合物均表现出高热稳定性（300°C）。红外谱中3572和3524 cm-1的特征带（νNH2和νOH）及紫外谱中48,300、36,630和28,985 cm-1的带（n→σ*、π→π*和n→π*）确认了自由配体的身份。络合滴定结果显示铜和镍的实验金属含量分别为9.92%和9.82%，与理论值10.09%和10.15%相符，符合1:2的金属-配体化学计量比。通过C=N的配位氮的位移（ν(C=N)分别为1651 cm-1和1634 cm-1）及Cu(II)和Ni(II)配合物的新ν(M–N)带（分别为435 cm-1和487 cm-1）表明了配位情况。
items.abstract: A new N,N’-diaminophthalamidoxime (NAD) ligand was synthesised by reacting hydrazine hydrate with diethyl phthalate to give phthalic dihydrazide, which was subsequently reacted with hydroxylamine to yield the target ligand. The ligand was reacted with Ni(II) and Cu(II) salts to give [Ni(NAD)2]Cl2 and [Cu(NAD)2(OAc)2], respectively. The ligand and its complexes were characterised by solubility studies, melting point determination, complexometric metal analysis, room-temperature magnetic susceptibility, and infrared and UV–Visible spectroscopy. The free ligand was soluble in DMSO, DMF and hot ethanol, but insoluble in chloroform, ethyl acetate, acetone, methanol, dichloromethane and distilled water, and all three compounds showed high thermal stability ( 300 °C). Diagnostic infrared bands at 3572 and 3524 cm-1 (νNH2 and νOH) and UV bands at 48,300, 36,630 and 28,985 cm-1 (n→σ*, π→π* and n→π*, respectively) confirmed the identity of the free ligand. Complexometric titration gave experimental metal contents of 9.92% (Cu) and 9.82% (Ni), in good agreement with the theoretical values of 10.09% and 10.15%, consistent with 1:2 metal-to-ligand stoichiometry in both complexes. items.authors: Emmanuel Oluwaseyi Kolawole, Oluwafunmilayo F. Adekunle

items.title: Phase-Dependent Thermally Activated Self-Discharge of β-NiOOH and γ-NiOOH Electrodes
items.title_zh: β-NiOOH与γ-NiOOH电极的相依赖热激活自放电研究
items.summary_zh: 镍氧氢氧化物电极在高温下会自发自放电，且这一过程在升高温度时显著加速。尽管对碱性电池有害，但该反应在电化学-热激活化学（E-TAC）水分解中至关重要。该过程分为两个步骤：在冷却的碱性电解液中对Ni(OH)2进行电化学充电并在阴极生成氢气，随后在热碱性电解液中自发再生充电的NiOOH阳极，同时伴随氧气的释放。我们制备了相纯的钴掺杂β-NiOOH和γ-NiOOH电极，并比较其在模拟E-TAC循环中热碱性电解液中的短期自放电。X射线衍射和碘量法滴定显示，相纯的β-NiOOH在5 M KOH中于80或100 °C下经过5分钟后几乎没有可测量的结构或氧化态变化。而相纯的γ-NiOOH则表现出显著的自放电，约占前一充电步骤转移电荷的43-46%，并伴随部分转化为α-Ni(OH)2。这些结果表明，充电镍氢氧化物的相组成对热激活自放电有重要影响。
items.abstract: Nickel oxyhydroxide electrodes undergo spontaneous self-discharge that is strongly accelerated at elevated temperature. Although detrimental to alkaline batteries, this reaction is central to electrochemical–thermally activated chemical (E‑TAC) water splitting. The process operates in two distinct steps: electrochemical charging of Ni(OH)2 in cold (~25 °C) alkaline electrolyte and hydrogen generation at the cathode, followed by spontaneous regeneration of the charged NiOOH anode in hot (~80–100 °C) alkaline electrolyte, with concurrent oxygen evolution. A key unresolved question is how the charged-phase composition of NiOOH affects this thermally activated self-discharge. Here, we prepare phase-pure cobalt-doped β-NiOOH and γ-NiOOH electrodes using tailored electrochemical charging protocols and compare their short-term self-discharge in hot alkaline electrolyte simulating the TAC step in the E-TAC cycle. X-ray diffraction and iodometric titration show that phase-pure β-NiOOH undergoes little or no measurable structural or oxidation-state change after 5 min in 5 M KOH at 80 or 100 °C. items.authors: Elena Praznikov, Avigail Varveri Landman, Avner Rothschild

items.title: Temporally decoupled electrochemiluminescence breaks the sensitivity–portability tradeoff in water toxicity sensing
items.title_zh: 时间解耦电化学发光技术打破水毒性检测的灵敏度与便携性权衡
items.summary_zh: 为了解决化学传感中灵敏度与便携性之间的权衡问题，研究者们开发了多种技术。电化学发光（ECL）因其简单的设备配置和优异的灵敏度而受到关注，但其依赖于多步界面电子转移，导致效率损失和信号强度受限。本文建立了一种基于双功能氮化碳（CN）的新型光充电无线ECL（PC-Wireless-ECL）系统。该策略通过消除对电极尺寸的依赖并在时间上解耦激发与发射过程，显著增强了ECL信号强度。通过构建便携式双功能CN小瓶并结合微型光强传感器，该系统革新了传统ECL测量范式，实现了水毒性的现场快速高灵敏度筛查，为下一代现场分析技术提供了新策略。
items.abstract: Multiple technologies have been developed to reconcile the trade-off between sensitivity and portability, which is a persistent fundamental challenge in chemical sensing. Among them, electrochemiluminescence (ECL) has the advantages of simple device configuration and outstanding sensitivity based on the transduction of electrochemical signals into optical readouts. However, this is based on multi-step interfacial electron transfer, wherein the concomitant efficiency losses and areadependent signal intensity inherently constitute the primary limitations. Herein, a novel photochargeable wireless ECL (PC-Wireless-ECL) system is established based on a bifunctional carbon nitride (CN). This strategy boosts the ECL signal intensity by eliminating the dependence on the electrode dimensions and decoupling the excitation and emission processes temporally. By constructing portable bifunctional CN vials coupled with a miniaturized light intensity sensor, this system revolutionizes the conventional ECL measurement paradigm and realizes on-site, rapid, and highly sensitive screening of water toxicity, thereby offering a new strategy for next-generation in-field analytical technologies.
items.authors: Chuan Huang, Dan Han, Hong Yang, Kaiqing Wu, Yanfei Shen, Rong Jin

items.title: Polyelectrolyte Solutes, Gels, and Coacervates Differentially Impact Proto-Metabolic Ni-Catalyzed Bicarbonate Reduction.
items.title_zh: 聚电解质溶质、凝胶与共沉淀物对原始代谢的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了金属和矿物催化反应在生命起源过程中提供有机原料的作用，特别是对早期代谢途径和原始代谢的影响。我们采用定量核磁共振（NMR）和含有相关羧酸盐、胺和磷酸基团的模型分子，研究其对碳酸氢盐还原为甲酸的催化作用，这是古代碳固定的第一步。结果表明，该过程对有机物的积累具有相对的鲁棒性，尽管有机添加剂浓度较高，产率仍保持在约两倍范围内。溶质的影响不仅取决于电荷或溶质大小，还与吸附、参与竞争反应及溶质间相互作用有关。不同溶质组合的效应呈非加性，某些组合的甲酸产率与单独溶质相比未变、中间或增加。
items.abstract: Reactions using metal and mineral catalysis likely provided vital organic feedstocks for the process of life’s origination, accessing early metabolic pathways, building proto-metabolism, and providing avenues for compartmentalization. Towards proto-cellular encapsulation, a growing pool of multiply-charged solutes and polymers, as well as organic-rich phases, would have influenced the operation of Earth’s proto-metabolic pathways. Here, we employ quantitative NMR and model molecules containing relevant carboxylate, amine, and phosphate moieties to describe their effect on the catalytic reduction of bicarbonate to formate, the first step in ancient carbon fixation, such as via a precursor reductive Acetyl-CoA (Wood-Ljungdahl) pathway or reductive tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. We find that this proto-metabolic carbon fixation process is relatively robust to build-up of organics, maintaining yields within about twofold despite relatively high concentrations of organic additives. Solute effects are not simply predicted by charge or solute size but depend on adsorption, participation in competing reactions, and solute-solute interactions. items.authors: Ella Mullikin, Christopher H. House, Christine D. Keating

items.title: Reliable Machine Learning for DPPH Antioxidant QSAR: Scaffold- and Study-Aware Validation with an Out-of-Domain Sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly Case Study
items.title_zh: 可靠的机器学习DPPH抗氧化QSAR研究：基于骨架和研究的验证
items.summary_zh: 机器学习QSAR模型能够优先筛选抗氧化化合物，但其准确性显著依赖于化学数据的验证分割。本研究开发了一种可重复的DPPH抗氧化QSAR工作流程，使用来自公共30分钟DPPH数据集的1,891个经过整理的分子。分子结构通过九个RDKit物理化学描述符和2,048位Morgan指纹（半径2）表示，共生成2,057个特征。随机森林回归被评估为主要模型，额外树作为独立的集成比较器。随机森林在随机五折交叉验证下的平均R²为0.712，MAE为0.297，但在Bemis-Murcko骨架意识验证下性能下降至R²=0.447，MAE=0.433，而在DOI分组验证下R²为0.124，MAE为0.545。在内部保留集上，训练期间代表的骨架分子表现优于未见骨架的分子（R²=0.824对比0.580）。最近邻分析进一步区分了结构支持的预测与外推：域内分子R²为0.830，域外性能为R²=-0.031。该工作流程随后应用于两个实验研究的磺酰胺-Tyr-Gly衍生物，二者的最大Tanimoto相似度均较低（0.364和0.333）。
items.abstract: Machine-learning QSAR models can prioritize antioxidant compounds, but apparent accuracy depends strongly on how chemical data are partitioned for validation. This study develops a reproducible DPPH antioxidant QSAR workflow using 1,891 curated molecules from a public 30 min DPPH dataset. Molecular structures were represented by nine RDKit physicochemical descriptors and 2,048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius 2), giving 2,057 combined features.Random Forest regression was evaluated as the primary model,with Extra Trees as an independent ensemble comparator.Random Forest achieved mean R-squared = 0.712 and MAE = 0.297 pIC50 units under random five-fold cross-validation, but performance decreased to R-squared = 0.447 and MAE = 0.433 under Bemis-Murcko scaffold-aware validation, and to R-squared = 0.124 and MAE = 0.545 under DOI-grouped validation.
