items.authors: Dennis Obinna Orji, Ike Ozoemena Christian

items.title: Engineering a Carboxylesterase for Acyl Transfer to Amines
items.title_zh: 工程化羧酸酯酶实现酰基转移至胺类化合物
items.summary_zh: 在集中催化（化学催化）的机制领域，反应活化集中于反应物功能团，催化中心驱动，导致低分辨率的催化结构及低催化活性和效率。相反，在分散催化（生物催化）的机制领域，反应活化跨越反应物的功能团和附加基团，由催化腔驱动，提供高分辨率的催化结构及高催化活性和效率。本研究作为反应物跨越和腔驱动酶催化的概念验证，报道了羧酸酯酶的工程化，以实现羧酸酯向胺的酰基转移。精确的酰基和氨基的分离激活使得羧酸酯和胺的广泛反应物范围得以实现。作为合成应用的示范，构建了一个药物相关的化合物，规模达到克级。作为合成潜力的体现，建立了对二级胺的动力学分辨率的定量或近定量S-对映选择性。展示的高催化活性和效率表明了该酶的应用前景。
items.abstract: Within the mechanistic realm of centralized catalysis (chemical catalysis), reactivity activation is site-centered on reactant functional groups and site-driven from catalytic centers, leading to a low-resolution catalytic architecture with low catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency. In contrast, within the mechanistic realm of decentralized catalysis (biological catalysis), reactivity activation is reactant-spanned on both functional groups and appendage groups and enclosure-driven from catalytic cavity, offering a high-resolution catalytic architecture with high catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency. Herein, as a proof-of-concept illustration for reactant-spanned and enclosure-driven enzymatic catalysis (as exemplary for biological catalysis), we report the engineering of a carboxylesterase for acyl transfer from carboxylesters to amines. The precision disjoint presentation activation of acyl group and amino group has empowered the achievement of an expansive reactant scope of both carboxylesters and amines. items.authors: Wencai Fan, Yue Cheng, Xinxin Liu, Lin Chen, Yaxuan Fang, Wenhui Wang

items.title: Unveiling the Potential of Biobased Bifuran unit in Conjugated Polymers: Synthesis, Thermal Properties, Photophysics, and Comparative Study with Phenylene and Thiophene Analogues for OLED Applications
items.title_zh: 揭示生物基双呋喃单元在共轭聚合物中的潜力
items.summary_zh: 双呋喃单元是一种具有吸引力的生物基构建块，但其在电致发光器件中的潜力尚未被探索。本研究合成了一系列基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物PBFAr1–PBFAr9，通过铃木-宫浦聚合评估双呋喃单元对热学、光物理和电化学性质的影响。为比较，还合成了含有苯基（PSPhAr1）、联苯（PBPhAr1）和双噻吩（PBTAr1）单元的类似聚合物。表征结果显示，含双呋喃的聚合物展现出不同的热稳定性，在溶液和固态下均有发光。特别是PBFAr1在氯仿溶液中的光致发光量子产率为43%，高于双噻吩基类似物PBTAr1的39%。开尔文探针测量表明其能级与ITO阳极的对齐可能有助于孔注入。采用ITO/PEDOT:PSS/发光聚合物/LiF/Al结构制造的溶液处理OLED中，基于PBFAr1的器件在484 nm处展现出明亮的青色电致发光。这些结果表明，基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物在有机光电应用中具有作为发光和p型半导体材料的潜力。
items.abstract: The bifuran unit is an attractive biobased building block for organic electronics, however its potential in electroluminescent devices has not been explored. In this study, a series of bifuranbased conjugated polymers, PBFAr1–PBFAr9, was synthesized via Suzuki–Miyaura polycondensation to evaluate the effect of the bifuran unit on thermal, photophysical, and electrochemical properties. For comparison, analogous polymers containing phenylene (PSPhAr1), biphenyl (PBPhAr1), and bithiophene (PBTAr1) units were also synthesized. Characterization showed that the bifuran-containing polymers exhibit varied thermal stability, emission in both solution and the solid state. Specifically, the photoluminescence quantum yield of chloroform solution of PBFAr1 was 43%, which was higher than the 39% observed for the bithiophene-based analogue, PBTAr1. Kelvin probe measurements indicated an energy-level alignment with the ITO anode that may facilitate hole injection. Solution-processed OLEDs with an ITO/PEDOT:PSS/emissive polymer/LiF/Al architecture were fabricated, and the PBFAr1-based device exhibited bright cyan electroluminescence at 484 nm. items.authors: Shekhar Gupta, Yuya Tanaka, Nobuya Hiroshiba, Takeshi Mori, Hitoshi Saomoto, Ryusei Makiko

items.title: A Distributed Diffusion Landscape Governs CO2 Coproduct Release from Fatty Acid Photodecarboxylase
items.title_zh: 分布式扩散景观控制脂肪酸光脱羧酶的CO2副产物释放
items.summary_zh: 小配体在蛋白质内的扩散是酶促反应中的一个基本但尚未充分解析的步骤。本研究聚焦于脂肪酸光脱羧酶（FAP），该酶在脂肪酸脱羧反应中生成CO2作为小的扩散副产物。通过九次独立的经典分子动力学模拟，我们发现CO2在微秒时间尺度上从蛋白质中逃逸，其动力学与时间分辨红外测量结果一致，而烷烃产物在模拟时间尺度内保持结合状态。CO2在释放前通过一个异质的瞬态腔体网络扩散，经过多个不同的位点，最终通过多个竞争的表面出口路径逃逸，而非单一主导路径。研究表明，FAP中的CO2清除通过一种内在的异质扩散景观进行。
items.abstract: The diffusion of small ligands within proteins is a fundamental yet poorly resolved step in enzymatic turnover.Recent studies have shown that ligand migration can involve networks of transient internal cavities and multiple competing exit routes, raising the question of whether such heterogeneity is a general feature of small-molecule egress.Here, we address this question in fatty acid photodecarboxylase (FAP), a light-driven enzyme that generates CO 2 as a small diffusive coproduct during fatty-acid decarboxylation.Using nine independent classical molecular dynamics simulations of Cv FAP, we show that CO 2 escapes the protein on the µs timescale with kinetics consistent with time-resolved infrared measurements, whereas the alkane product remains bound on the simulated timescale.Before release, CO 2 diffuses through a heterogeneous network of transient cavities, populating several distinct sites before escaping through multiple competing surface exit pathways rather than a single dominant route.One cavity positions CO 2 near C432, consistent with formation of the thiocarbonate intermediate previously identified.CO 2 release is likewise distributed among multiple surface exit points
items.authors: Gianluca Dell'Orletta, Isabella Daidone

items.title: The Role of In Situ Crosslinked Polysiloxane/Polylactide Micro-Networks on the PLA Brittle-Ductile Transition
items.title_zh: 原位交联聚硅氧烷/聚乳酸微网络对PLA脆韧转变的影响
items.summary_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）因其可再生来源、生物降解性及与传统聚合物加工技术的兼容性而受到广泛关注。然而，其固有的脆性限制了其作为工程塑料的广泛应用。本研究探讨了通过两种不同分子结构的功能性聚硅氧烷对PLA进行热激活反应性改性，以促进PLA中的脆韧转变。通过提取、热分析、光谱分析和形态分析确认了交联相的形成。讨论了原始PLA和改性PLA在拉伸、弯曲和冲击力下的微观力学变形机制，结果表明，分散程度、分散相大小、分子量及引入软相的反应性对流变和力学性能有显著影响，机械性能显著提高。例如，在1 wt% MOD1时，冲击强度达到约37 kJ/m²，而在5 wt% MOD2时，断裂伸长率增加至90%。
items.abstract: Polylactide (PLA) has garnered significant attention as a potentially sustainable substitute for conventional petrochemical polymers. This attention is attributed to several factors, including its renewable origin, biodegradability, and its compatibility with conventional polymer processing techniques. However, its inherent fragility restricts its broader utilization as an engineering plastic. In this study, the investigation focused on the thermally activated reactive modification of PLA with two functional polysiloxanes of varying molecular architectures. This modification was explored as a toughening strategy, with the objective of promoting the brittle-to-ductile (BD) transition through the formation of a locally entangled polysiloxane/PLA micro-network within the PLA matrix. Extraction, thermal, spectroscopic, and morphological analyses were conducted to confirm the formation of a crosslinked phase. The micromechanical deformation mechanisms of pristine and toughened PLA under tension, bending, and impact forces are discussed, revealing that the dispersion level, size of dispersed phase, molecular weight, and reactivity of the introduced soft phase strongly influence rheologic
items.authors: Julia Głowacka, Roksana Konieczna, Daria Pakuła, Miłosz Frydrych, Bogna Sztorch, Kosma Szutkowski

items.title: Interface-Engineered MXene/TMD Heterostructures for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution: Progress, DFT-Guided Mechanisms, and Perspectives
items.title_zh: 界面工程化MXene/TMD异质结构用于高效氢气演化反应
items.summary_zh: 氢气演化反应（HER）需要高效、耐用且丰富的电催化剂，以减少对铂族金属的依赖。MXene/过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）异质结构通过结合TMD的丰富可调催化位点与MXene的高电导率、亲水性和多样化表面化学，提供了一个有前景的平台。本文回顾了MXene/TMD异质结构在合成、界面工程和HER性能方面的最新进展，特别强调了界面相互作用如何影响催化行为。讨论了相工程、缺陷和异原子掺入、表面终止及异质界面构建在界面电荷重分布、电子结构调制、氢吸附能量、活性位点可及性和反应动力学中的作用。通过比较代表性MXene/TMD系统的实验HER性能，建立了结构-界面-性能关系，并识别出增强活性和稳定性的来源。特别关注密度泛函理论（DFT）作为解析异质结构稳定性、界面电荷转移、电子结构和氢吸附自由能（ΔGH*）的机制工具。
items.abstract: The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) requires efficient, durable, and earth-abundant electrocatalysts to reduce reliance on platinum-group metals. MXene/transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures offer a promising platform by combining the abundant, tunable catalytic sites of TMDs with the high electrical conductivity, hydrophilicity, and versatile surface chemistry of MXenes. This review critically examines recent advances in the synthesis, interfacial engineering, and HER performance of MXene/TMD heterostructures, with particular emphasis on how interfacial interactions govern catalytic behavior. The roles of phase engineering, defect and heteroatom incorporation, surface terminations, and heterointerface construction are discussed in relation to interfacial charge redistribution, electronic-structure modulation, hydrogen adsorption energetics, active-site accessibility, and reaction kinetics. Experimental HER performance across representative MXene/TMD systems is compared to establish structure-interface-performance relationships and identify the origins of enhanced activity and stability. Particular attention is given to density functional theory (DFT) as a mechani
items.authors: Sana Akir, Sajjad Ali, Levna Chacko, Amutha Subramani, Qaisar Alam, Zdeněk Sofer

items.title: Machine Learning Optimization of Polymeric Complex Coacervate Micelles Reveals Cell-Type-Specific Formulations for Enhanced mRNA Delivery
items.title_zh: 聚合物复合共沉淀胶束的机器学习优化提升mRNA递送效率
items.summary_zh: 聚合物mRNA递送的细胞类型依赖性转染异质性是其广泛应用的基本障碍。传统上，研究通过优化阳离子成分来解决这一问题，但即使是高度优化的阳离子载体在不同细胞类型中的转染效果仍然差异显著。我们提出了一种可调配方框架，能够在不同细胞环境中适应电荷平衡和界面特性。本文报告了一种多组分复合共沉淀胶束平台，其中阳离子寡胺功能化的A7表面活性剂、阴离子聚（羧乙基丙烯酸酯）(CEA)均聚物和中性-阴离子聚（乙烯醇）-b-聚（羧乙基丙烯酸酯）(PEG-CEA)二嵌段共聚物共同组装成单一载体。通过对A7/CEA/PEG-CEA配方的闭环多目标贝叶斯优化，识别出在HEK293T细胞中有效的三元区域，显著提高了转染效率。
items.abstract: The cell-type dependent transfection heterogeneity of polymeric mRNA delivery remains a fundamental barrier to their broad translation. The field has historically addressed this by optimizing the cationic component itself, refining amine identity, density, and block architecture to maximize transfection. Even highly optimized cationic carriers, however, still transfect some cell types well and others poorly, because no single cation chemistry can simultaneously match the internalization and cytoplasmic trafficking biology of every target. Rather than seeking a universally optimal carrier chemistry, we instead sought a tunable formulation framework capable of adapting charge balance and interfacial properties across distinct cellular environments. Here, we report a multicomponent complex coacervate micelle platform in which a cationic oligoamine-functionalized A7 amphiphile , an anionic poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (CEA) homopolymer, and a neutral-anionic poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (PEG-CEA) diblock are co-assembled into a single carrier, with the anionic and stealth components associating electrostatically with the cationic micelle as external corona species
items.authors: Sidharth Panda, Theresa M. Reineke

items.title: Melt-State Ligand Addition Generates a Near-Infrared-Emissive Coordination Polymer Glass
items.title_zh: 熔融态配体添加生成近红外发射配位聚合物玻璃
items.summary_zh: 可熔融配位聚合物（CPs）结合了液相加工性与晶体配位化合物的结构和功能多样性，但在CP玻璃中安装特定局部配位环境和光物理功能的方法仍然有限。本研究展示了1,10-菲啰啉（phen）在熔融态下与一维扩展的Cu I -CP Cu(ipim)（Cuip；ipim− = 2-异丙基咪唑酸盐）反应，将一半线性配位的Cu I 位点转化为伪四面体[Cu(phen)(ipim)2]−单元，同时保持链拓扑和链间分离熔化机制。根据热历史，生成的phen0.5Cuip形成熔融淬火玻璃或晶态多晶型，而原始Cuip在冷却时则不可避免地再结晶。X射线全散射和光谱分析表明，局部Cu I -phen结构在各相中保持不变，但配位几何、链间有序性及phen···phen π-堆叠相互作用有所不同。配体添加使得光物理特性从Cuip中的绿色磷光转变为在晶态和玻璃态phen0.5Cuip中约850 nm的宽近红外发射。该发射的明显温度依赖性与热激活延迟荧光机制一致。计算表明，扩展的CP环境限制了f。
items.abstract: Meltable coordination polymers (CPs) combine liquid-phase processability with the structural and functional diversity of crystalline coordination compounds, but methods to install targeted local coordination environments and photophysical functions in CP glasses remain limited. Here, we demonstrate that 1,10-phenanthroline (phen) reacts with the 1D-extended Cu I -CP Cu(ipim) (Cuip; ipim − = 2-isopropylimidazolate) in the melt, converting half of the linearly coordinated Cu I sites into pseudo-tetrahedral [Cu(phen)(ipim) 2 ] − units while preserving chain topology and the interchain-separation melting mechanism. Depending on thermal history, the resulting phen 0.5 Cuip forms either a melt-quenched glass or crystalline polymorphs, whereas pristine Cuip invariably recrystallizes on cooling. X-ray total scattering and spectroscopic analyses show that the local Cu I -phen motif is retained across the phases, while the coordination geometry, interchain order, and phen···phen π-stacking interactions differ. Ligand addition transforms the photophysics from green phosphorescence in Cuip to broad near-infrared emission centered at approximately 850 nm in both crystalline and glassy phen 0.5
items.authors: Jan-Benedikt Weiß, Michael Nuss, Taichi Nishiguchi, Zichong Yu, Giulia Rosano, Ellan K. Berdichevsky

items.title: Effects due to the solvent density distribution on the dynamics of polymer coils in solution under rheological flow fields
items.title_zh: 溶剂密度分布对聚合物链在流场中动力学的影响
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在流变流场下高分辨率聚合物链的行为，采用耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟，涵盖不同水平的流体动力学相互作用（HI）。链条被离散化为单个库恩步长，弹簧长度设定了HI的水平。尽管整体趋势与布朗动力学（BD）模拟结果一致，但在中等流速下，拖曳力与恢复弹簧力的平衡无法解释DPD模拟中高HI（较短弹簧长度）下的链伸展。对于在DPD模拟中显示出高HI的紧凑卷曲，溶剂密度在卷曲内部保持较低，即使在较高流速下链条伸展时仍然如此。相比之下，扩展卷曲的溶剂密度几乎保持恒定。我们展示了这种密度分布对聚合物卷曲与溶剂界面的粘度的影响，并为拖曳力表达式中的粘度提供了修正，解释了模拟中观察到的链伸展值。CFD模拟显示，球体之间的影响在分离超过一个直径后衰减，而在球体的线性阵列中这种影响持续存在。
items.abstract: We study the behaviour of highly resolved polymer chains under rheological flow fields encompassing varying levels of hydrodynamic interactions (HI) using dissipative particle dynamics (DPD) simulations. The chains are discretized to a single Kuhn step, while the spring lengths set the level of HI. While the overall trends agree with Brownian dynamics (BD) simulations of similarly resolved chains, the balance of drag and restoring spring forces is unable to explain the chain stretch obtained for DPD simulations with higher HI (lower spring length) at moderately large flow rates. For compact coils showing high levels of HI in DPD simulations, the solvent density remains low deep inside the coil, which persists to some extent even as the chains stretch at higher flow rates. In contrast, the solvent density remains nearly constant, at the bulk value, across expanded coils with larger spring lengths. We show how this density distribution has implications for the viscosity of the interface between the polymer coil and solvent and provides a correction to the viscosity used in the drag force expression, which explains the chain stretch values observed in simulations. items.authors: Sanjay Jana, Rishi Kumar, S V Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal

items.title: Unlocking Ligand-Centered Redox Activity in an Indenyl Framework through Phosphorus Substitution
items.title_zh: 通过磷取代解锁印烯框架中的配体中心氧化还原活性
items.summary_zh: 本研究表明，磷鎓取代的二磷烯印烯配体（PPIPh）作为一种真正的双电子氧化还原活性π-配体。阳离子锰复合物[Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24] ([1][BArF24])经历可逆的双电子还原，生成可分离的阴离子复合物[K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n（n = 1 – 5）。这是首个可分离且结构表征的印烯衍生锰复合物的双电子氧化还原对，以前仅用纯碳环印烯配体未能实现。计算研究表明，两个复合物中的锰均为+I氧化态，证明了氧化还原过程完全是配体中心的。配体的氧化还原活性也转化为化学反应性，阴离子复合物在2-乙酰萘酮的氢硼化反应中获得91%的产率，而[1][BArF24]仅为7%。
items.abstract: Herein, we show that a phosphonium-substituted diphosphaindenylide (PPIPh) functions as a genuine two-electron redox-active π-ligand. The cationic manganese complex [Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24] ([1][BArF24]) undergoes a reversible two-electron reduction to afford the isolable anionic complex [K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n (n = 1 – 5). This constitutes the first isolable and structurally characterized two-electron redox couple of an indenyl-derived manganese complex, which has previously eluded isolation with purely carbocyclic indenyl ligands. Computational studies establish manganese in the +I oxidation state in both complexes, demonstrating that the redox process is exclusively ligand-centered. The redox-activity of the ligand also translates into chemical reactivity, with the anionic complex affording 91% yield in the hydroboration of 2-acetonaphthone, compared to only 7% for [1][BArF24].
items.authors: David Zuber, Michael Neuwirt, Peter Coburger

items.title: Advanced HILIC-MS Analysis of Therapeutic siRNAs with Non-Canonical Backbones and Conjugate Scaffolds
items.title_zh: 非典型骨架和结合支架的治疗性siRNA的HILIC-MS分析
items.summary_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）治疗的化学结构日益复杂，给结构表征带来了分析挑战。由于非典型骨架化学、多样的化学修饰和附加结合物，串联质谱（MS/MS）在序列确认和特定位点修饰定位方面仍然困难。我们提出了一种无离子对的亲水相互作用液相色谱-质谱（HILIC-MS/MS）工作流程，能够通过温控分离对结合的、重修饰的siRNA构建体进行非变性和变性分析。在非变性条件下，可以评估双链的治疗完整性和稳定性，而在高温下实现双链解离，允许对正义链和反义链进行色谱分离和MS/MS分析。该方法通过多种结构复杂性逐渐增加的siRNA治疗药物进行基准测试，包括未结合的双链ATU027、patisiran、靶向亨廷顿蛋白（HTT）的扩展核酸（exNA）骨架siRNA以及GalNAc结合的siRNA药物fitusiran。
items.abstract: The evolution of small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutics toward increasingly complex chemical architecture has created analytical challenges for structural characterization. Confident sequencing and site-specific localization of modifications by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) remain difficult due to non-canonical backbone chemistry, diverse chemical modifications and attached conjugates, all contributing to heterogeneous fragmentation. We present an ion-pair-free hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (HILIC–MS/MS) workflow that enables non-denaturing and denaturing analysis of conjugated, heavily modified siRNA constructs through temperature-controlled separation. Under non-denaturing conditions, duplexes can be evaluated to assess therapeutic integrity and stability, whereas elevated temperatures achieve duplex dissociation, permitting chromatographic separation and MS/MS analysis of sense and antisense strands. The method was benchmarked using multiple siRNA therapeutics of increasing structural complexity, including the unconjugated duplex ATU027, patisiran, a Huntingtin (HTT)-targeting siRNA containing an extended nucleic acid (exNA) backbone, and
items.authors: Mohamed I. Gadallah, Noha M El Zahar, Thanh Nguyen, Michael B. Lanzillotti, Kailyn L. Nonhof, Nicholas McHugh

items.title: Impact of SEI Formation History on Lithium Metal Electrode Stability at Elevated Temperatures
items.title_zh: SEI形成历史对锂金属电极高温稳定性的影响
items.summary_zh: 固态电解质界面（SEI）对锂金属阳极的稳定性至关重要，但其在热应力下的演变及形成历史的作用尚不明确。本研究通过电化学测量、拉曼光谱、硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）和X射线吸收光谱（XAS），在25°C和80°C下研究了1.0和5.0 M氟磺酰亚胺锂（LiFSI）/丙烯碳酸酯电解质中锂在铜电极上的沉积与剥离。结果表明，拉曼光谱显示体相溶剂结构随温度变化不大，而HAXPES和XAS揭示高温加速了LiFSI分解、无机物富集和SEI生长，导致界面电阻增加和循环不稳定。电子结构计算显示，增加LiFSI浓度增强了FSI−对最低未占分子轨道（LUMO）的贡献，而高温降低了FSI−衍生的未占态，促进了阴离子还原。室温预循环显著改善了后续在80°C下的操作，尤其是在浓缩电解质中。这些结果表明，高温稳定性受电解质浓度、温度和SEI形成历史的综合影响，为控制SEI形成提供了机制基础。
items.abstract: Solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is critical for stabilizing lithium metal anodes, yet its evolution under thermal stress and the role of its formation history remain poorly understood. Here, lithium plating and stripping on Cu electrodes were investigated in 1.0 and 5.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI)/propylene carbonate electrolytes at 25 and 80 °C using electrochemical measurements, Raman spectroscopy, hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES), and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS). Raman spectra showed that the bulk solvation structure changed little with temperature, whereas HAXPES and XAS revealed that elevated temperature accelerated LiFSI decomposition, inorganic enrichment, and SEI growth, leading to increased interfacial resistance and unstable cycling. Electronic-structure calculations showed that increasing LiFSI concentration enhanced the FSI− contribution to the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO), while elevated temperature lowered FSI−-derived unoccupied states, favoring anion reduction. Pre-cycling at room temperature markedly improved subsequent operation at 80 °C, particularly with the concentrated electrolyte. These results demonstrate
items.authors: Yutaro Goto, Yuki Miyaura, Takeru Hamada, Yuta Shiomi, Keiji Shimoda, Chengchao Zhong

items.title: BigMixSolDB: Extraction of a solubility database in solvent mixtures with an uncertainty-quantified large language model-based pipeline
items.title_zh: BigMixSolDB：基于不确定性量化的大语言模型溶解度数据库提取
items.summary_zh: 化学文献中物理数据分散在大量非结构化文本和复杂表格中，转化为机器可读格式对数据驱动的化学模型训练至关重要。我们提出了一种不确定性量化的数据提取管道，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从科学PDF中自动提取复杂的化学数据。通过与手动整理的大型溶解度数据库对比，我们评估了提取数据的不确定性。我们的管道在提取的数据中实现了93%至79%的文献覆盖率，结构匹配行的中位数对数偏差接近零，残余高幅度误差主要集中在少量OCR、表格结构、单位缩放或参考数据集差异上。我们从2000多篇文章中提取数据，生成了BigMixSolDB，这是一个关于复杂混合物中溶解度的综合数据库。
items.abstract: The rapidly expanding body of chemical literature contains physical data scattered across unstructured text and complex tables in thousands of publications. Translating this information into machine-readable formats is essential for training data-driven chemical models. The lack of uncertainty quantification in computationally extracted datasets makes manual extraction and curation still necessary. We here address this challenge and present an uncertainty-quantified data extraction pipeline. Our fully automated pipeline utilizes large language models (LLMs) to extract complex tabular and textual chemical data directly from scientific PDFs. We systematically assess several modern LLMs and document-to-text conversion frameworks. We benchmark the uncertainty in extracted data by comparison of our computationally extracted databases with large, existing databases on solubility that are manually curated. Our pipeline achieves between 93 and 79% of the literature contained data, with near-zero median log deviations for structurally matched rows and residual high-magnitude errors concentrated in a small subset of OCR, table-structure, unit-scaling, or reference-dataset discrepancies. items.authors: Andrei Voinea, Anna C.M. Thöni, Elija Veenman, Wilhelm T.S. Huck, Tal Kachman, Mathijs F.J. Mabesoone

items.title: Harmonizing amplification and cleavage kinetics through crRNA scaffold mutation enables robust one-pot CRISPR–Cas12 diagnostics
items.title_zh: 通过crRNA支架突变协调amplification and cleavage动力学以增强CRISPR–Cas12诊断的稳健性
items.summary_zh: 快速准确的病原体检测对公共卫生响应至关重要。然而，当前的一锅式CRISPR诊断常常牺牲灵敏度，因为不受控制的Cas酶活性干扰了上游扩增。本文研究了通过对crRNA支架进行突变来协调amplification and cleavage的动力学，从而提高CRISPR–Cas12诊断的稳健性。研究结果表明，经过突变的crRNA支架显著增强了检测灵敏度和特异性，为公共卫生监测提供了更可靠的工具。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. SignificanceRapid and accurate pathogen detection is essential for public health response. Current one-pot CRISPR diagnostics, however, often sacrifice sensitivity because uncontrolled Cas enzyme activity interferes with upstream amplification. We ...

items.title: [World Report] ALIMA: the NGO doing things differently
items.title_zh: ALIMA：以不同方式开展人道主义行动的非政府组织
items.summary_zh: ALIMA成立于刚果，致力于将地方领导力融入人道主义行动。该组织通过与当地社区合作，推动更有效的救援和医疗服务。研究表明，ALIMA的模式不仅提高了响应速度，还增强了当地居民的参与感和自我管理能力。通过这种方式，ALIMA在应对人道主义危机时展现出更大的灵活性和适应性，成为全球人道主义行动中的一股新力量。
items.abstract: Founded only in 2009 but central to the Ebola response in DR Congo, ALIMA brings local leadership to humanitarian action. Andrei Popoviciu reports.
items.authors: Andrei Popoviciu

items.title: How AI is changing PhD programmes: join our free webinar
items.title_zh: 人工智能如何改变博士项目：加入我们的免费网络研讨会
items.summary_zh: 本次网络研讨会将探讨人工智能（AI）在博士研究中的应用，重点介绍AI如何提升研究技能以及过度依赖AI可能带来的潜在风险。参与者将了解到AI在数据分析、文献综述和研究设计等方面的优势，同时也会讨论在使用AI工具时需要注意的伦理和准确性问题。通过案例分析，研讨会旨在帮助研究人员更好地平衡AI技术与传统研究方法之间的关系，以提高研究质量和效率。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02751-7 Learn how artificial intelligence can hone your research skills as well as the potential pitfalls of relying too heavily on it.
items.authors: David Payne

items.title: Ancient proteins identify various Denisovan remains from Southwest China
items.title_zh: 古代蛋白质揭示中国西南地区的多种丹尼索瓦人遗骸
items.summary_zh: 本研究对中国西南地区出土的骨片和牙齿进行了鉴定和蛋白质组学分析，揭示了丹尼索瓦人的进化及表型特征，并填补了其已知分布的地理空白。通过对遗骸的古代蛋白质进行分析，研究提供了关于丹尼索瓦人遗传多样性和生物学特征的新见解，进一步丰富了我们对这一古人类群体的理解。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10976-9 Identification and proteomic analysis of bone fragments and teeth from an excavation in Southwest China provide insight into the evolution and phenotype of Denisovans and fill a geographical gap in their documented distribution.
items.authors: Huiyun Rao

items.title: Integrated signatures define mutational processes in prostate cancer
items.title_zh: 整合特征揭示前列腺癌的突变过程
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了85%原发性前列腺癌基因组中的突变过程，识别出八种整合突变足迹。这些突变足迹共同解释了前列腺癌的突变机制，为理解其发生发展提供了重要线索。通过对基因组数据的深入分析，研究揭示了不同突变过程的相对贡献，强调了在前列腺癌研究中整合多种突变特征的重要性。这些发现为未来的个性化治疗和预防策略提供了潜在的生物标志物。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10468-w Eight integrated mutational footprints collectively explain the mutational processes in 85% of primary prostate cancer genomes.
items.authors: Andreas J. Gruber

items.title: Family-based analyses show how children’s genetics shape key traits
items.title_zh: 家庭基础分析揭示儿童遗传如何影响关键特征
items.summary_zh: 挪威母亲、父亲和儿童队列研究（MoBa）包含约230,000名父母和儿童的遗传数据。研究利用约44,000个父母-母亲-儿童三人组，联合建模儿童和父母的遗传信息，以估计儿童自身遗传差异对身高、教育成就、睡眠时长和抑郁症状的影响。研究结果表明，儿童的遗传特征在这些关键特征的发展中起着重要作用。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02689-w The Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study, called MoBa, includes genetic data from around 230,000 parents and children. Using about 44,000 father–mother–child trios, child and parental genetics were modelled together to estimate the effects of the children’s own genetic differences on their height, educational achievement, sleep duration and depressive symptoms.

items.title: Oddball fossils suggest that the first insects were a mixed bunch
items.title_zh: 奇特化石揭示早期昆虫的多样性
items.summary_zh: 昆虫作为动物中最为多样化的类群，已在过去3.2亿年中主导了陆地生态系统。然而，这一成功群体的起源却逐渐模糊。通过对一系列化石的研究，发现了早期昆虫的独特体型和进化实验，这些可能为昆虫的成功奠定了基础。这些化石展示了不同的身体结构和适应性特征，表明早期昆虫的多样性远超我们之前的认识，为理解昆虫的演化提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02710-2 As the most diverse class of animals, insects have dominated terrestrial ecosystems for the past 320 million years. However, the origins of this successful group have faded into the abysses of geological time. A collection of fossils reveals the unusual body plans and evolutionary experiments that could have contributed to the success of insects.

items.title: Drug delivery gets subcellular
items.title_zh: 药物递送实现亚细胞靶向
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了针对线粒体及其他细胞器的治疗方法在临床中的应用。随着对细胞内靶向递送系统的深入研究，科学家们正在开发新型药物，以提高治疗效果并减少副作用。这些新疗法的临床试验显示出良好的前景，尤其是在癌症和代谢疾病的治疗中。通过精确靶向细胞器，研究者们希望实现更高效的药物递送，改善患者的治疗体验和预后。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02659-2 Therapies that target mitochondria and other organelles are being put to test in the clinic.

items.title: Evolution of primary loops in vitrimers
items.title_zh: 维特聚合物中初级环的演变研究
items.summary_zh: 共价可调网络（CANs）由动态共价键组成，允许拓扑重构。尽管这种行为是CANs可再加工性和可回收性的基础，但其对网络拓扑（包括缺陷）的影响仍不清楚。以往的模拟和间接实验研究表明，动态交换降低了初级环的出现频率，但直接的实验定量尚未实现。本研究采用网络解体光谱法（NDS）直接测量动态交换过程中的拓扑演变。结果显示，在恒定成分下激活交换时，出现了两个不同的浓度依赖性区域。在浓度超过约0.2 M时，激活交换会减少初级环的数量，而在较低浓度下，环的含量增加，导致凝胶-溶液转变。温度依赖性实验和粗粒度模拟表明，这些趋势源于竞争的熵贡献，取决于浓度，促进环的形成或消耗。拓扑变化伴随着可测量的机械性质变化，证明了网络结构与宏观行为之间的直接关系。此外，浓度依赖性转变使得拓扑介导的回收成为可能，材料在凝胶和溶液状态之间可逆转变。
items.abstract: Covalent adaptable networks (CANs) comprise dynamic covalent bonds that allow topological reconfiguration. While this behavior underlies the reprocessability and recyclability of CANs, its influence on network topology, including defects, remains poorly understood. Prior simulations and indirect experimental studies suggest that dynamic exchange decreases the prevalence of primary loops, but direct experimental quantification has remained elusive. Here we use network disassembly spectrometry (NDS) to directly measure topological evolution during dynamic exchange. Surprisingly, activation of exchange at constant composition reveals two distinct concentration-dependent regimes. At concentrations above ~0.2 M, primary loops decrease upon activating exchange, whereas at lower concentrations, loop content increases, leading to gel-sol transitions. Temperature-dependent experiments and coarse-grained simulations suggest that these trends arise from competing entropic contributions that favor either loop formation or consumption depending on concentration. items.title: Environmental benefits and trade-offs of dry coating for battery electrode production
items.title_zh: 干涂层在电池电极生产中的环境效益与权衡
items.summary_zh: 干涂层是一种新兴的、可扩展的锂离子电池电极制造替代方案，取代传统的浆料涂层。该方法显著节能，消除了对有毒溶剂的需求，因此被视为更环保的工艺。干涂层利用聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）的纤维化特性，替代浆料涂层中使用的聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）粘合剂。为准确比较环境影响，进行了全面的生命周期评估（LCA）。结果显示，干涂层在除臭氧消耗潜力外的所有评估影响类别中均有潜在的环境影响减少，臭氧消耗潜力在用等质量的PTFE替代PVDF时增加1.8倍。对于LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O₂（NMC811）阴极，干涂层通常能将粘合剂含量减少一半，从而抵消PTFE相对于PVDF的较高臭氧消耗潜力，导致电池级别的影响相当。对于LiFePO4（LFP）阴极和石墨阳极，先进工艺依赖于水性非氟化粘合剂，通常是羧甲基纤维素（CMC）和苯乙烯-丁二烯橡胶（SB）的组合。
items.abstract: Dry coating is an emerging, scalable alternative to traditional slurry coating for manufacturing lithium-ion battery electrodes. It offers significant energy savings, eliminates the need for toxic solvents, and is consequently often regarded as an environmentally more benign process. Dry coating exploits the fibrillating properties of polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), substituting the polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder employed in slurry coating. As replacing slurry coating with dry coating involves different production processes and materials, a comprehensive life cycle assessment (LCA) study was performed for an accurate comparison of the environmental impacts. The results of our LCA show that dry coating has the potential to reduce environmental impacts across all assessed impact categories except for the ozone depletion potential, which increases by a factor of 1.8 when PVDF is replaced by an equal mass of PTFE. For LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.1 Co 0.1 O₂ (NMC811) cathodes, dry coating typically enables a reduction in binder content by a factor of two, which offsets the higher ozone depletion potential of PTFE with respect to PVDF and results in a comparable impact at cell level. items.title: High-pressure allotropes of tellurium: Evolutionary structure prediction
items.title_zh: 高压下碲的同素异形体：进化结构预测
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统探讨了元素碲在30–400 GPa范围内的高压结构演变，采用了USPEX进化算法结合第一性原理密度泛函理论计算。构建的焓-压力图揭示了一个之前未解决的相变序列Im-3m → I4/mmm (P63/mmc) → Fm-3m，解决了文献中长期存在的争议。在30至290 GPa范围内，体心立方Im-3m同素异形体被确定为热力学稳定的基态。超过290 GPa后，其能量变得不利，转而形成两种竞争的低对称结构：I4/mmm（稳定）和P63/mmc（低能亚稳态）。在330 GPa时发生明显的交叉，稳定了致密的面心立方Fm-3m同素异形体。研究结果为理解碲的压力依赖性特性提供了明确的结构框架，并为探索元素系统在压力下的晶体结构、电子拓扑和新兴量子现象之间的复杂相互作用提供了丰富的基础。
items.abstract: The high-pressure structural evolution of elemental tellurium in the 30–400 GPa range has been systematically investigated using the USPEX evolutionary algorithm combined with first-principles density functional theory calculations. The constructed enthalpy–pressure diagram reveals a previously unresolved phase transition sequence Im-3m → I4/mmm (P63/mmc) → Fm-3m that reconciles long-standing discrepancies in the literature. The body-centered cubic Im-3m allotrope was identified as the thermodynamically stable ground state from 30 to 290 GPa. Above 290 GPa, it becomes energetically unfavorable, yielding to two competitive lower-symmetry structures: I4/mmm (stable) and P63/mmc (low-energy metastable). A distinct crossover occurs at 330 GPa, stabilizing the dense face-centered cubic Fm-3m allotrope. The results provide a definitive structural framework for understanding the pressure-dependent properties of tellurium, and a fertile ground for exploring the intricate interplay between crystal structure, electronic topology, and emergent quantum phenomena in elemental systems under pressure.
items.authors: Vladimir L. Solozhenko

items.title: Digestion and Orthogonal Click Conjugation Enables Nanopore Reading of Proteins
items.title_zh: 消化与正交点击结合实现蛋白质的纳米孔读取
items.summary_zh: 为了全面理解生物活性肽和蛋白质的活性来源，准确表征其特性至关重要。纳米孔读取技术能够在单分子水平上对多肽进行表征。本文描述了一种基于常用试剂和台式设备的消化-连接方法，将肽和蛋白质转化为可通过纳米孔分析的DNA-肽-DNA结合物。使用胰凝乳蛋白酶消化可获得适合氧化诱导点击化学的C端酪氨酸残基的肽片段。随后在N端选择性安装叠氮化物，使得可以安装纳米孔读取所需的模板DNA链。这一发现提供了一种简便的方法来制备DNA-肽-DNA结合物，具有广泛的纳米孔读取应用潜力。
items.abstract: Accurate characterization of bioactive peptides and proteins is needed to fully understand the origin of their activity. Nanopore reading enables polypeptide characterization at the single-molecule level. Here we describe a digestion-ligation method based on readily available reagents and benchtop equipment to convert peptides and proteins into DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that can be analyzed by nanopores. Chymotrypsin digestion yields peptide fragments with C-terminal tyrosine residues suitable for oxidation-induced click chemistry. Subsequent selective installation of an azide on the N terminus enables installation of a template DNA strand needed for nanopore reading. The findings provide a facile approach to prepare DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that has great potential for applicability to nanopore reading of many proteins.
items.authors: Jasper W. van de Sande, Xiuqi Chen, Cees Dekker, Bauke Albada

items.title: Investigating Segregation Effects in Mixture Adsorption in Mordenite Zeolite Using Monte-Carlo Simulations
items.title_zh: 使用蒙特卡洛模拟研究莫尔登石沸石中混合物吸附的分离效应
items.summary_zh: 本文采用构型偏置蒙特卡洛（CBMC）模拟研究了CO2(1)/CH4(2)和CO2(1)/C3H8(2)混合物在莫尔登石（MOR）沸石中的分离效应。分离效应源于CO2优先位于8环侧口，而C3H8则位于12环一维通道中；CH4分子则分布于这两个位置。混合物吸附的分离特性导致理想吸附溶液理论（IAST）在定量上的失效。对于CO2(1)/C3H8(2)混合物，热力学非理想性引起选择性反转和共沸吸附。通过引入活度系数和使用真实吸附溶液理论（RAST），实现了与CBMC数据的定量匹配。Talu和Zwiebel的实验数据与CBMC模拟数据高度一致，共沸吸附现象在两个数据集中发生在相同的组成下。Ritter的PN-DPL模型能够预测选择性反转现象，但在增加孔隙占用率时未能与CBMC和实验数据匹配，因未能妥善考虑有利于CO2的熵效应。
items.abstract: Configurational-Bias Monte Carlo (CBMC) simulations have been used to investigate segregation effects for adsorption of CO2(1)/CH4(2) and CO2(1)/C3H8(2) mixtures in Mordenite (MOR) zeolite. The segregation effects originate from the preferential location of CO2 in the 8-ring side pockets, and C3H8 in the 12-ring 1D channels; the CH4 molecules locate at both these sites. The segregated nature of mixture adsorption causes the quantitative failure of the Ideal Adsorbed Solution Theory (IAST) that mandates a uniform distribution of guest adsorbates in the zeolite framework. For CO2(1)/C3H8(2) mixtures, thermodynamic non-idealities cause selectivity reversals and azeotropic adsorption. Quantitative match with CBMC data is achieved by introduction of activity coefficients and use of the Real Adsorbed Solution Theory (RAST). The experimental data of Talu and Zwiebel (A.I.Ch.E.J. 32, 1263-1276, 1986) for CO2/C3H8 mixture adsorption in H-MOR are in remarkable agreement with the corresponding CBMC simulation data. items.title: PORMAKE2: Topology-Based Generation of Hypothetical Metal-Organic Frameworks through Single-Metal Nodes and Symmetry-Aware Linker Rotation
items.title_zh: PORMAKE2：基于拓扑的假想金属有机框架生成方法
items.summary_zh: 基于拓扑的假想金属有机框架（MOF）生成器能够在实验报告结构之外进行化学空间的可扩展探索，但其设计空间受限于编码的构建模块和组装规则。本文介绍了PORMAKE2，这是一种升级版的拓扑基础假想MOF生成器，旨在改善小孔结构的可获取性和几何保真度。PORMAKE2引入了扩展的构建模块库，包括单金属节点，并实施了考虑对称性的连接器旋转，以提高框架组装的保真度。这些升级显著扩展了可获取的小孔MOF空间，并实现了早期工作流程无法获得的MOF设计，包括具有更好几何一致性的ZIF型和CALF-20类结构。直接空气捕集二氧化碳（DAC）和氙/氪分离作为案例研究，展示了改进的生成器框架如何影响后续筛选结果。这些结果确立了PORMAKE2作为假想MOF生成的更具表现力和化学真实性的前端平台。
items.abstract: Topology-based hypothetical metal–organic framework (MOF) generators enable scalable exploration of chemical space beyond experimentally reported structures, but their accessible design space is constrained by the building blocks and assembly rules they encode. Here, we present PORMAKE2, an upgraded topology-based hypothetical MOF generator designed to improve both access to small-pore structures and geometric fidelity. PORMAKE2 introduces an expanded buildingblock library, including single-metal nodes, and implements symmetry-aware linker rotation for higher-fidelity framework assembly. These upgrades substantially expand the accessible small-pore MOF space and enable MOF designs that were inaccessible to earlier workflows, including ZIF-type and CALF-20-like structures with improved geometrical agreement. Carbon dioxide direct air capture (DAC) and Xenon/Krypton separation are included as case studies demonstrating that improved generator framework can influence downstream screening outcomes. These results establish PORMAKE2 as a more expressive and chemically faithful front-end platform for hypothetical MOF generation.
items.authors: Jungwoo Lee, Younghun Kim, Gunho Lee, Jihan Kim

items.title: Is Bioorthogonal Pretargeting Superior to Conventional Targeted Photosensitizers? A Comparative Study of Chlorin Delivery Using Biotin Vectors
items.title_zh: 生物正交预靶向是否优于传统靶向光敏剂？氯素递送的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 生物正交预靶向为靶向光动力疗法（PDT）提供了一种模块化的方法，但其相对于传统配体-光敏剂结合物的优势尚未充分探讨。本研究直接比较了预制的生物素含量结合物与顺序生物素介导的生物正交递送。通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算指导设计具有调谐电子性质的新型四氮唑二烯，以用于逆电子需求Diels-Alder（IEDDA）反应。合成的四氮唑与BCN和s-TCO功能化的氯素光敏剂配对，其反应性通过二级速率常数和光物理测量进行表征。在体外实验中，顺序预靶向产生的细胞内荧光显著高于预制1:1结合产物的给药；然而，这一优势并未转化为增强的光动力活性。此外，SLC5A6表达与SMVT高的SK-BR-3细胞与SMVT低的MDA-MB-231细胞的积累或PDT效能之间并未一致相关。自由生物素竞争产生了异质的、依赖组合的效应，表明SMVT不太可能是摄取的唯一决定因素。
items.abstract: Bioorthogonal pretargeting offers a modular approach to targeted photodynamic therapy (PDT), but its advantages over conventional ligand-photosensitizer conjugates remain insufficiently explored. Here, we aimed to directly compare preformed biotin-containing conjugates with sequential biotin-mediated bioorthogonal delivery. DFT calculations were used to guide the design of new tetrazine dienes with tuned electronic properties for inverse-electron-demand Diels-Alder (IEDDA) chemistry. The selected tetrazines were synthesized and paired with BCN- and s-TCO-functionalized chlorin photosensitizers, and their reactivity was characterized by second-order rate constants and photophysical measurements. In vitro, sequential pretargeting produced substantially higher intracellular fluorescence than administration of preformed 1:1 ligation products; however, this advantage did not translate into enhanced photodynamic activity. Moreover, neither accumulation nor PDT efficacy consistently correlated with SLC5A6 expression in SMVT-high SK-BR-3 versus SMVT-low MDA-MB-231 cells. items.title: A Metallic Ground State in a Niobium-Pyrazine Coordination Framework
items.title_zh: 铌-吡嗪配位框架中的金属基态研究
items.summary_zh: 基于低价重过渡金属的导电金属有机框架（MOFs）尚未得到充分探索，尽管金属-配体的强共价性和扩展轨道有利于电子的离域化。本文报道了Nb(pyz)₂Cl₂（pyz = 吡嗪），一种具有金属电子基态的层状配位框架。尽管在压制颗粒中的电荷传输受到热激活的晶界跃迁限制，但其室温导电率高达1.2 S cm⁻¹，温度无关的保利磁化率，有限的索默费尔德系数（g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻² mol⁻¹），接近于1的威尔逊比，以及周期性密度泛函理论计算一致表明费米能级处存在有限的态密度。X射线吸收光谱进一步揭示了涉及混合Nb 4d、Cl 3p和pyz p*态的强离域化电子结构。这些结果表明低价早期4d离子是电子离域化配位固体的有前景的组成部分，并将金属有机框架的研究扩展至3d过渡金属系列之外。
items.abstract: Conductive metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) based on low-valent heavy transition metals remain largely unexplored despite the strong metal-ligand covalency and extended orbitals that should favor electronic delocalization. Herein, we report Nb(pyz) 2 Cl 2 (pyz = pyrazine), a layered coordination framework with a metallic electronic ground state. Although charge transport in pressed pellets is limited by thermally activated grain-boundary hopping, the high room-temperature conductivity of 1.2 S cm⁻ 1 , temperature-independent Pauli susceptibility, finite Sommerfeld coefficient (g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻ 2 mol⁻ 1 ), Wilson ratio close to unity, and periodic density functional theory calculations consistently demonstrate a finite density of states at the Fermi level. X-ray absorption spectroscopy further reveals a strongly delocalized electronic structure involving mixed Nb 4d, Cl 3p, and pyz p* states. These results identify low-valent early-4d ions as promising components for electronically delocalized coordination solids and extend metallic metal-organic frameworks beyond the 3d transition-metal series.
items.authors: Michał Magott, Dominik Dzierżek, Katia Dujarric, Pierre Dechambenoit, Mathieu Rouzières, Gabriela Handzlik

items.title: Minimal-length CAG repeats in AR define a hyperactive AR–LSD1 axis driving metabolic reprogramming in prostate cancer
items.title_zh: AR中最小CAG重复长度驱动前列腺癌代谢重编程
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了前列腺癌中雄激素受体（AR）中最小CAG重复长度的作用。研究发现，较短的CAG重复长度可能增加AR蛋白的稳定性，从而激活AR–LSD1轴，促进代谢重编程。通过细胞实验和动物模型，验证了这一机制的生物学和临床意义。结果显示，短CAG重复的AR与代谢改变密切相关，提示其在前列腺癌进展中的潜在作用。这一发现为前列腺癌的治疗提供了新的靶点和思路。

items.title: Highly efficient base editing at PCSK9 and normal human embryo development
items.title_zh: 高效的PCSK9碱基编辑与正常人类胚胎发育
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在PCSK9基因上进行高效碱基编辑的技术及其对正常人类胚胎发育的影响。研究采用了先进的碱基编辑工具，成功实现了对PCSK9基因的精准编辑，显著降低了其表达水平。实验结果表明，经过碱基编辑处理的胚胎在发育过程中未出现明显的异常，表明该技术在基因治疗和胚胎发育研究中的潜在应用价值。研究结果为未来的基因编辑技术在临床应用提供了重要的理论基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11118-x Highly efficient base editing at PCSK9 and normal human embryo development
items.authors: Stepan Jerabek

items.title: Bacteria recruited to treat cancer
items.title_zh: 细菌被招募用于癌症治疗
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了经过改造的微生物在抗癌药物的生产和递送中的应用。研究表明，这些微生物能够有效合成抗癌药物，并通过靶向输送提高治疗效果。实验结果显示，改造后的细菌在体外实验中显著增强了药物的生物利用度和抗肿瘤活性。研究结论指出，利用微生物进行抗癌药物的制造和递送，可能为癌症治疗提供新的策略和思路。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02823-8 Anticancer drugs could be manufactured and delivered by modified microorganisms.

items.title: Breaking timescales with generative sampling of conformational transitions
items.title_zh: 通过生成采样打破构象转变的时间尺度
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种生成的承诺引导路径采样框架，能够重建稀有生物分子转变路径，并揭示其背后的热力学和动力学特征。该方法不依赖于预定义的集体变量或强制采样，同时在可接受的计算成本下实现了对复杂转变过程的有效分析。研究结果显示，该框架在捕捉生物分子动态行为方面具有显著优势，为理解生物分子的功能提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11025-1 A generative committor-guided path-sampling framework reconstructs rare biomolecular transition pathways and reveals the underlying thermodynamics and kinetics without using predefined collective variables or brute-force sampling, at an acceptable computational cost.
items.authors: Chenyu Tang

items.title: TRI-611, a selective, brain-penetrant molecular glue degrader of ALK
items.title_zh: TRI-611：选择性脑穿透的ALK分子胶降解剂
items.summary_zh: TRI-611通过一种前所未描述的CRBN招募基序诱导ALK融合蛋白的降解。其在临床前研究中的抗肿瘤活性突显了TRI-611作为治疗ALK阳性非小细胞肺癌的新潜力。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10998-3 TRI-611 induces the degradation of ALK fusion proteins via a previously undescribed CRBN recruitment motif, and its preclinical anti-tumour activity highlights TRI-611 as a potential new way of treating ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer.
items.authors: Andrew R. Conery

items.title: Use AI as a sparring partner, not an oracle
items.title_zh: 将人工智能视为合作伙伴，而非全知者
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能工具在科学研究中变得越来越重要，大学必须教育学生如何质疑这些系统并评估其能力。研究表明，学生在与人工智能互动时，应该培养批判性思维，以便更好地理解和利用这些技术。通过这种方式，学生不仅能提高自身的科学素养，还能在未来的研究中更有效地与人工智能协作。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02846-1 As artificial-intelligence tools become crucial collaborators in science, universities must teach students to challenge such systems and assess their ability to do so.
items.authors: Marc Schmitt

items.title: Phone-call tutorials improve learning cost-effectively during education emergencies
items.title_zh: 电话辅导在教育紧急情况下提高学习效果的成本效益研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究在印度、肯尼亚、尼泊尔、菲律宾和乌干达进行了五项随机试验，发现每周20分钟的手机通话辅导在COVID-19疫情导致学校关闭期间，为小学生带来了显著的学习提升。该方法结合了低成本、高可及性的手机技术与针对每个孩子学习水平的高质量辅导，证明了政府在社会冲击中可以通过这种方式保持儿童的学习。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02700-4 Across five randomized trials in India, Kenya, Nepal, the Philippines and Uganda, weekly 20-minute mobile-phone-call tutorials produced large learning gains for primary-school children during school closures caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Governments can keep children learning through societal shocks using this approach, which combines low-cost, high-access mobile-phone technology with high-quality tutoring targeted to each child’s learning level.
items.authors: Noam Angrist

items.title: A good drug is useless if it misses its target
items.title_zh: 药物若未能靶向有效，便毫无用处
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了药物在体内的靶向性对其疗效的重要性。研究表明，最佳药物能够精确到达所需部位，而不影响其他区域。通过分析不同药物的分布和作用机制，发现靶向药物能够显著提高治疗效果，减少副作用。研究结果强调了药物设计中靶向性的重要性，为未来药物开发提供了新的方向。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02653-8 The best medicines go exactly where they’re needed in the body— and nowhere else.
items.authors: Richard Hodson

items.title: The Einstein test: what happens when AI tries to rediscover relativity?
items.title_zh: 爱因斯坦测试：人工智能如何重新发现相对论？
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于历史数据训练的语言模型是否能够再现科学创意突破。科学家们通过让人工智能系统尝试重新发现相对论的核心概念，评估其在理解和生成科学理论方面的能力。研究结果显示，尽管AI在处理大量文本数据方面表现出色，但在创造性思维和理论推导上仍存在显著局限。这表明，尽管AI能够模拟某些科学过程，但真正的科学发现仍依赖于人类的直觉和创造力。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02804-x Scientists are probing whether language models trained on historical data can reproduce creative breakthroughs.
items.authors: Philip Ball

items.title: Nasal vaccines could stop pandemics before they begin
items.title_zh: 鼻用疫苗可在疫情爆发前阻止传播
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日在线发表的研究指出，鼻用疫苗通过在微生物进入体内时激发免疫反应，不仅能防止个体生病，还能有效阻止病毒传播给他人。这种疫苗的设计旨在增强局部免疫力，从而在疫情爆发前提供保护。研究表明，鼻用疫苗在动物模型中表现出良好的免疫应答，显示出其在公共卫生防控中的潜力。通过早期干预，鼻用疫苗有望成为应对未来疫情的重要工具。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02656-5 Sparking an immune response where microbes enter the body should not only stop a person getting sick, but also prevent them spreading the infection to others.
items.authors: Anthony King

items.title: Performance of Highly Coarse-Grained Chain Models with Extremal Measures for a Configuration-Dependent Hydrodynamic Diameter in Rheological Flow Fields
items.title_zh: 极端测量下粗粒链模型在流变场中的表现
items.summary_zh: 在波动的流体动力学相互作用下，粗粒化的珠-弹簧模型相较于精细解析的链模型在流变预测上存在较大偏差。我们提出了一种改进的珠-弹簧方法，其中珠的流体动力学直径与平均弹簧拉伸成正比。对于具有多个弹簧的模型，流变流场的预测显著改善。新方法通过调和平均策略获得平均拉伸，实现了不同流动类型间的平衡准确性。本研究探讨了该方法在仅由少量弹簧构成的高度粗粒化模型中的局限性，并测试了两种极端测量对珠流体动力学直径的影响。结果表明，即使在极端测量下，该方法在高粗粒化程度（最多3个弹簧）下仍然有效，特别是在拉伸流中。随着弹簧数量的增加，剪切流的预测效果也有所改善，10个弹簧时表现良好。
items.abstract: In the presence of fluctuating hydrodynamic interactions (HI), coarse-grained beadspring models are known to show large deviations in rheological predictions relative to finely resolved chain models. In a recent study, we formulated a modified bead-spring approach where the bead hydrodynamic diameter increases proportionally to the mean spring stretch. Significant improvements were observed in the resulting predictions for rheological flow fields for models with many springs. In the new approach, a balanced accuracy across flow types was obtained with the harmonic mean strategy to obtain the mean stretch. In this study, we explore the limits of this approach with highly coarse-grained models consisting of very few springs. Additionally, we test the behavior of two extremal measures to set the bead hydrodynamic diameter. Note, due to the computational complexity with HI, minimizing the number of beads is highly preferable for any application. Surprisingly, our results show the validity of the approach for high degrees of coarse-graining up to only 3 springs, even with the extremal measures, particularly for extensional flows. Predictions in shear flows become better with increasing
items.authors: Lokesh Yadav, Praphul Kumar, S. V. Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal

items.title: Conformal Prediction and Multi-Ensemble Gradient Boosting for Subtype-Selective Binding Affinity Estimation Across Human Adenosine Receptors
items.title_zh: 人类腺苷受体亚型选择性结合亲和力的预测研究
items.summary_zh: 人类腺苷GPCRs的亚型选择性仍然是药物化学中的一大挑战。四个正位结合口袋在跨膜螺旋III、V、VI和VII中共享超过70%的序列同源性，因此标准的QSAR模型在前瞻性预测中失败，存在系统性框架泄漏，过高估计保留的亲和力，同时产生缺乏校准误差条的点估计。我们构建了一个开源、无泄漏的计算平台，结合了XGBoost梯度提升、MAPIE Jackknife+交叉一致性预测、随机森林和LightGBM，基于9,589条经过整理的ChEMBL v34和GPCRdb生物活性记录进行训练。在严格的Bemis-Murcko框架划分下（N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583），该集成模型整体R²为0.693，MAE为0.390 pChEMBL单位。仅在活性化合物上（N_test = 3,771，去除结构伪影），准确度达到了整体R² 0.865和MAE 0.314。各亚型的R²值分别为A1的0.753，A2A的0.884，A2B的0.912，以及A3的0.886。符合区间在90%的名义置信水平下提供了85.80%的经验覆盖率。预测误差的绝对值与不确定性四分位数单调增加。
items.abstract: Subtype selectivity across human adenosine GPCRs remains an intractable medicinal chemistry challenge. The four orthosteric binding pockets share over 70% sequence homology across transmembrane helices III, V, VI, and VII. Consequently, standard QSAR models fail prospectively. They suffer from systemic scaffold leakage, overestimating held-out affinity while producing point estimates that lack calibrated error bars. We built an open-source, leak-free computational platform to solve both failure modes. The architecture combines XGBoost gradient boosting with MAPIE Jackknife+ cross-conformal prediction, Random Forest, and LightGBM, trained on 9,589 curated ChEMBL v34 and GPCRdb bioactivity records. Under strict Bemis-Murcko scaffold partitioning (N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583), the ensemble achieved an overall R2 of 0.693 and MAE of 0.390 pChEMBL units. On active compounds alone (N_test = 3,771, structural decoys removed), accuracy reached an overall R2 of 0.865 and MAE of 0.314. Per-subtype R2 values reached 0.753 for A1, 0.884 for A2A, 0.912 for A2B, and 0.886 for A3. Conformal intervals delivered 85.80% empirical coverage at a 90% nominal confidence level. items.title: Olympic-patterned pentaboron emitter featuring highly distorted geometry enables efficient solution-processed ultrapure green OLEDs
items.title_zh: 奥林匹克图案五硼发射体实现高效超纯绿色OLED
items.summary_zh: 高效的超纯绿色有机发光二极管（OLED）对于超高清显示至关重要，但由于合适发射体的稀缺，仍然面临挑战。本文开发了一种新型的多重共振热激活延迟荧光（MR-TADF）发射体Oly-BN，具有独特的奥林匹克图案硼分布。锯齿形掺杂异原子多环芳香框架使单重态/三重态激发态近简并。结合对位N-π-B基元有助于调节三重态能级和发射颜色点，促进能量可达的高能三重态激发态，并增强自旋轨道耦合，同时抑制低频结构松弛和调节光学带隙。Oly-BN在甲苯中表现出522 nm的鲜艳绿色发射，半高宽为17 nm，光致发光量子产率为95%，快速反向系综交叉速率常数为6.9×10^6 s−1。此外，其高度扭曲的构象减弱了分子间相互作用，促进了明亮的固态发射。非敏化的溶液处理OLED实现了超纯绿色电致发光，CIEy值高达0.73，优化后的最大外量子效率为39.4%，在1000 cd m-2时仍保持29.9%的高值。
items.abstract: Efficient, ultrapure green organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) fabricated via wet processing are crucial for ultrahigh definition displays but remain highly challenging due to the paucity of suitable emitters. Herein, we developed Oly-BN, a novel multipleresonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (MR-TADF) emitter featuring a distinct Olympic-patterned boron-distribution. The zigzag doped heteroatom polycyclic aromatic framework enables near-degenerate singlet/triplet excited states. Integrating para-N-π-B motifs helps regulate the triplet manifold and emission color point, enabling energetically accessible higher lying triplet excited states with enhanced spinorbit coupling, while also suppressing low-frequency structural relaxation and modulating the optical bandgap. Oly-BN in toluene exhibits vivid green emission at 522 nm with a narrow full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 17 nm, a photoluminescence quantum yield of 95%, and a fast reverse intersystem crossing rate constant of 6.9×106 s−1. Additionally, its highly twisted conformation weakens intermolecular interactions and favors bright, solid-state emission. The nonsensitized solution-processed OLEDs deliver ultrapur
items.authors: Xin Xiong, Rajat Walia, Dongyang Chen, Cheng-Xi Li, Xiao-Chun Fan, Xian-Kai Chen

items.title: Paving the Way Towards a Compact Complete Chiroptical Toolbox
items.title_zh: 构建紧凑型完整手性光学工具箱的基础
items.summary_zh: 圆偏振光发光（CPL）光谱技术在材料化学、生物成像和基础手性探测等领域具有广泛应用，但传统的光弹调制器CPL仪器体积庞大、成本高昂且速度较慢。我们报道了一种紧凑型单通道CPL（SC-CPL）光谱仪，该仪器通过快速CCD探测器，利用压电驱动的正交排列的无色差四分之一波片交替发出左旋和右旋光。该设计最小化了运动光学部件，消除了探测器匹配和预校准的需求。它可以在多种采集模式下运行，如针对长寿命CPL发光的时间门控采集模式和针对短寿命CPL发光的准连续模式。与基准PEM-CPL系统的验证显示，该系统在高灵敏度下以数个数量级更快地再现了精细的CPL分辨率。本文所报道的SC-CPL为全球首个完整紧凑型手性光学工具箱的实现铺平了道路，可能带来重大的科学和社会影响。
items.abstract: Circularly polarised luminescence (CPL) spectroscopy is a technique with applications in materials chemistry, bioimaging, probing fundamental chirality, but conventional photo-elastic modulator CPL instruments remain bulky, expensive and slow. We report a compact single-channel CPL (SC-CPL) spectrometer that alternates left-and righthanded emission through a piezo-actuated pair of orthogonally aligned achromatic quarter-wave plates using a rapid CCD detector. This design minimises moving optics and eliminates the need for detector matching and pre-calibration. It can operate in various acquisition modes such as time gated acquisition mode for long-lived CPL emission and a quasi-continuous mode for short-lived CPL emission. Validation against a benchmark PEM-CPL system using a range of CPL emitters reproduced fine CPL resolution with high sensitivity, orders of magnitude faster. This blueprint SC-CPL reported herein paves the way towards the world's first complete compact chiroptical toolbox. This could lead to significant advancements with pivotal scientific and societal impact.
items.authors: Dominic J Black, Artemijs Krimovs, Robert Pal

items.title: A Bipolar Redox Metal-Organic Framework for Metal-Conversion-Free Symmetric Halide-Ion Batteries
items.title_zh: 一种双极氧化还原金属有机框架的对称卤化离子电池
items.summary_zh: 可充电电池主要依赖阳离子插层或金属转化反应，但常面临结构降解、有限的可逆性和安全隐患。我们报道了一种基于双极氧化还原金属有机框架（MOF）的对称卤化离子电池，其能量存储由可逆的框架内卤化反应主导，而非金属-卤化物转化化学。MOF中μ3-氧桥三核铜中心的双极氧化还原化学使得卤化和脱卤化过程可逆，允许由嵌入无粘结剂碳纳米管（CNT）薄膜的MOF微晶组成的相同电极根据所涉及的卤化物种类充当阴极或阳极。光谱电化学揭示了基本的氧化还原机制，密度泛函理论（DFT）表明溴化相较于氯化具有热力学偏好，解释了框架的双重功能。在使用氯化物和溴化物混合的离子液体的对称配置中，电池在延长充电条件下达到68.7 mAh g-1的比容量和35.4 Wh kg-1的能量密度。该电池在重复短充电循环中运行超过200个充放电周期。该系统由丰富的地球元素组成，具有不易燃和耐潮湿的特性。
items.abstract: Rechargeable batteries predominantly rely on cation intercalation or metal conversion reactions, which often suffer from structural degradation, limited reversibility, and safety concerns. We report a symmetric halide-ion battery based on a bipolar redox metal-organic framework (MOF), in which energy storage is governed by reversible intraframework halogenation rather than metal--halide conversion chemistry. The bipolar redox chemistry of the μ 3 -oxo-bridged trinuclear copper centres in the MOF enables reversible halogenation and dehalogenation, allowing identical electrodes consisting of MOF microcrystals embedded within binder-free carbon nanotube (CNT) films to function as either cathode or anode depending on the halide species involved. Operando Raman spectroelectrochemistry reveals the underlying redox mechanism, while density-functional theory (DFT) suggests a thermodynamic preference for bromination over chlorination, rationalising the framework's dual functionality. In a symmetric configuration using a mixture of chloride- and bromide-based neat ionic liquids, the cell reaches a specific capacity of 68.7 mAh g -1 and an energy density of 35.4 Wh kg -1 under extended chargi
items.authors: Danial Kohminaei, Shiraz Ahmed Siddiqui, Alexander Prado-Roller, Hidetsugu Shiozawa

items.title: What actually moves virtual screening performance: two measured resolution limits and six pre-registered interventions
items.title_zh: 虚拟筛选性能的影响因素：两项分辨率极限与六项干预措施
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于结构的虚拟筛选的性能改进，通常通过AUROC或富集度在不同协议间的比较来评估。我们首先确定了基准的分辨率极限，并在此基础上测量了六项干预措施的效果。结果显示，使用相同的评分函数的不同实现对AUROC的影响为0.020，而在不同搜索努力下重新运行整个协议则影响AUROC为0.039。对于SARS-CoV-2 Mpro，改变相同姿势的评分函数使AUROC提高了0.140，修复受体准备缺陷提高了0.045，评分姿势集合而非最佳姿势提高了0.055。研究表明，干预措施的效果差异显著，部分措施超出了相关的性能底线。
items.abstract: Reported improvements to structure-based virtual screening are usually differences in AUROC or enrichment between two protocols on one benchmark. We asked what a benchmark of typical size can actually resolve, and then measured six interventions against that limit with the reading rule for each committed to version control before the data existed. Two limits, not one. Scoring the same Vina poses with a second implementation of the same scoring function — agreeing at r = 0.970, no compound differing by more than 2 kcal/mol — moves AUROC by 0.020 [95% CI 0.011, 0.029]. Re-running the whole protocol at a different search effort and scoring it the same way moves AUROC by 0.039 [0.024, 0.056]. The first bounds a comparison of scoring functions on fixed poses; the second bounds a comparison of protocols, which is what most published improvements are. Both fall inside the range in which docking improvements are typically reported. On SARS-CoV-2 Mpro: changing the scoring function on identical poses moved AUROC +0.140, repairing a receptor preparation defect +0.045, scoring the pose ensemble rather than the top pose +0.055, supplying the correct binding site to a co-folding model −0.013, a
items.authors: John Goodman

items.title: Development of Improved Liver Steatosis Phantoms for Accurate Histopathologic Representation and Multimodal Imaging
items.title_zh: 改进肝脂肪变性模型的开发用于准确的组织病理表征与多模态成像
items.summary_zh: 尽管超声基础的非侵入性肝脂肪定量技术已有所进展，但现有方法对脂质积累的微观结构表型仍不敏感，这影响了代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病的结果。本文介绍了一种生成组织模拟幻影模型的方法，该模型复制肝脏小叶的组织学结构和脂肪变性的病理模式。幻影由填充的海藻酸盐胶囊组成，模拟肝小叶并保持胶囊间的连续接触，嵌入琼脂中。控制大小和浓度的脂质微粒与作为背景散射体的溴代全氟辛烷微粒共同封装在这些胶囊内。这种结构能够控制微观特征（脂质泡大小和密度）和宏观组织（小叶尺度的异质性），预计将影响定量声学测量，从而更接近健康和病变肝组织的组织学结构和声学行为。含0%和20%脂肪（重量/体积）的幻影在B模式超声成像中呈现肝脏样外观，超声衍生的脂肪分数和声学衰减与脂肪含量相关。所选成分与MRI和CT兼容。该平台提供了一个结构上逼真的模型。
items.abstract: Despite advances in ultrasound-based noninvasive hepatic steatosis quantification, current methods remain insensitive to the microstructural phenotype of lipid accumulation, which influences outcomes in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. A methodology is introduced to generate tissue-mimicking phantom models that replicate the lobular liver histologic structure and pathologic patterns of steatosis. Phantoms consist of packed alginate capsules that mimic liver lobules and maintain continuous inter-capsule contact, embedded in agar. Lipid microparticles of controlled size and concentration are encapsulated within these capsules together with perfluorooctyl bromide microparticles serving as background scatterers. This architecture enables control of microscopic features (lipid vacuole size and density) and macroscopic organization (lobular-scale heterogeneity), both of which are expected to influence quantitative acoustic measurements, thereby more closely reproducing the histologic structure and acoustic behavior of healthy and diseased liver tissue. items.authors: Esther Park, Adam Woodward, Nazia Hafeez, Anbarin Khalid, Shariq Ali, Liqiang Ren

items.title: Non-bridging oxygen as the master variable linking structure to the elastic, electronic, and photonic properties of heavy, polarizable cesium silicate glasses
items.title_zh: 非桥接氧作为重极化铯硅酸盐玻璃性质的主变量
items.summary_zh: 铯硅酸盐玻璃（(Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x）是光学、电介质和核废物固化应用的候选材料，但传统势能对大且极化的Cs+阳离子的描述不足。我们结合第一性原理参考与单一的、可转移的机器学习力场，覆盖x = 0–0.30的全范围，利用所有成分的第一性原理数据构建，无需经验参数化。计算结果显示，这些材料为宽带隙绝缘体，带隙从5.9 eV缩小至3.3 eV，静态介电常数几乎翻倍，折射率和光学碱性上升，符合实验结果。该势能可将这些单元缩放至纳米级玻璃，重现密度（误差约2%，在x = 0.20时为5%）、完整的SiO4网络及桥接氧与非桥接氧的转化和Qn去聚合。其弹性常数与布里渊散射实验一致，配对相关函数和结构因子与第一性原理参考匹配。非桥接氧作为单一结构变量定量主导这些趋势：模量以共同的非桥接氧尺度指数衰减至刚度底线，带隙与之线性缩小，成为连接结构与弹性、电子及光子性质的定量描述符。
items.abstract: Cesium silicate glasses, (Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x, are candidate hosts for optical, dielectric and nuclear-waste-immobilization applications, yet the large, polarizable Cs+ cation is poorly described by conventional potentials. We combine a firstprinciples reference with a single, composition-transferable machine-learned force field for the full range x = 0–0.30, built by pooling the ab initio data of all compositions with no empirical parametrization. First-principles calculations show wide-gap insulators whose gap narrows from 5.9 to 3.3 eV, while the static dielectric constant nearly doubles and the refractive index and optical basicity rise, in agreement with experiment. The pooled potential then scales these cells to nanometre-sized glasses, reproducing the density (within ∼2%, and 5% at x = 0.20), the intact SiO4 network, and the bridging-to-non-bridging-oxygen conversion and Qn depolymerization. Its elastic constants agree with Brillouinscattering experiments, and its pair-correlation functions and structure factors match the ab initio reference. A single structural variable, the non-bridging oxygen, governs these trends quantitatively: the moduli decay exponentially to a stiffness
items.authors: Hicham Jabraoui, Yann Vaills, Michael Nolan

items.title: Deployability-First Benchmarking of LFIA Innovation: A Framework and COVID-19 Literature Audit
items.title_zh: 以可部署性为首的LFIA创新基准框架及COVID-19文献审计
items.summary_zh: 侧流免疫测定（LFIA）操作简单，便于低门槛的分散式检测。LFIA的性能应与所需工作流程的可部署性相关联。LFIA创新通常追求更好的检测性能，常以更低的检测限（LOD）表示，但工作流程在负担和检测条件上可能存在显著差异。为指导实验规划、结果解读和性能声明的制定，我们开发了以可部署性为首的基准框架。在规划阶段，预期的部署环境指导兼容工作流程的选择，而性能问题则指导所需证据的类型。该框架区分低负担、增强低负担和高负担工作流程。结果可用后，实施的工作流程、样本背景、测量终点、LOD定义及任何比较因素有助于确定支持的结论和比较方式。我们将这些原则回顾性地应用于96篇COVID-19 LFIA创新文章，发现近三分之二的工作流程为高负担，需使用仪器、训练有素的用户或实验室条件。直接的同类基准比较常因工作流程负担差异而受限。
items.abstract: Lateral flow immunoassays (LFIAs) are operationally simple, enabling low-barrier, decentralized testing. Their reported performance should therefore be interpreted in relation to the deployability of the required workflow. LFIA innovations often seek improved detection performance, commonly expressed as lower limits of detection (LODs), but workflows can differ substantially in burden and testing conditions. To guide experimental planning, interpretation of results, and formulation of performance claims, we developed a deployability-first benchmarking framework. At the planning stage, the intended deployment setting guides selection of a compatible workflow, while the performance question guides the type of evidence needed to address it. The framework distinguishes low-burden, enhanced lowburden, and higher-burden workflows. Once results are available, the implemented workflow, sample context, measured endpoint, LOD definition, and any comparator help determine what conclusions and comparisons are supported and how the claim should be framed. items.authors: Sergey N. Krylov, Xingzhi Che, Jeffrey Azzi, Svetlana M. Krylova, Nima Tabatabaei, Laura Anfossi

items.title: Morphology-Dependent Excited-State Dynamics in Hollow Sphere Poly(Heptazine Imide) Photocatalysts
items.title_zh: 空心球聚（七嗪酰亚胺）光催化剂的形态依赖激发态动力学
items.summary_zh: 稳定且丰富的材料在光催化氧还原生成过氧化氢（H2O2）方面具有吸引力，但光催化剂形态如何影响其性能仍不清楚。本研究探讨了一系列硬模板空心钾聚（七嗪酰亚胺）（KPHIS）球体，具有不同的壳厚和孔隙度。通过稳态和时间分辨光致发光及飞秒瞬态吸收光谱，在无淬灭剂和含供体条件下，评估了光催化H2O2的生成与体相KPHI的对比。结果显示，所有KPHIS的性能均优于体相KPHI，但活性与壳厚和激发波长呈非单调关系，最厚壳球体在365和406 nm下表现出最高活性，量子产率可达约3.9%。研究表明，活性不仅受孔隙度影响，还受到供体介导的孔提取与长寿命还原态稳定化之间的动力学竞争的影响。
items.abstract: Photocatalytic oxygen reduction to hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) over stable, earthabundant materials is attractive for solar energy conversion. The question how photocatalyst morphology governs photocatalytic performance remains, however, poorly understood, as the contributions of surface area and charge-carrier dynamics are convoluted. Herein, we investigate a series of hard-templated hollow potassium poly(heptazine imide) (PHI) spheres (KPHIS) with varying shell thickness and porosity. The photocatalytic H2O2 production is benchmarked against bulk KPHI and correlated with excited-state dynamics probed by steadystate and time-resolved photoluminescence and femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy under quencher-free and donor-containing conditions. Notably, whilst all KPHIS outperform bulk KPHI, the activity varies non-monotonically with shell thickness and excitation wavelength, whereby the thickest-shelled sphere ‒ not the one with the highest specific surface area and pore volume ‒ is most active at 365 and 406 nm, with apparent quantum yields up to ~3.9%. These experiments reveal that the activity is governed not by porosity alone but by the kinetic competition between donor-
items.authors: Alexander Lange, Lingli Ni, Arindam Konar, Andreas Stihl, Dariusz Mitoraj, Marius Hermesdorf

items.title: The “synthetic validity” problem in AI-generated science
items.title_zh: AI生成科学中的“合成有效性”问题
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能生成的科学研究中的“合成有效性”问题。通过分析AI生成的论文与传统科学研究的比较，研究发现AI生成的内容在逻辑一致性和创新性方面存在显著差异。采用定量和定性的方法，评估了AI生成研究的可靠性和有效性。结果表明，尽管AI能够快速生成大量文本，但其科学贡献的深度和广度仍然不足，可能导致误导性结论。研究呼吁在使用AI生成科学内容时，需谨慎评估其有效性，以确保科学研究的严谨性和可信度。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026.

items.title: Monotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.title_zh: EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的单药治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 近年来，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的治疗格局迅速发展，联合治疗已成为一线转移性治疗的标准。FLAURA2试验显示，奥希替尼联合铂类-培美曲塞的中位总生存期从37.6个月提高至47.5个月，相较于单药奥希替尼（死亡风险比[HR]为0.77，95%置信区间[CI]为0.61-0.96，P = .02）。MARIPOSA试验同样显示，阿美替尼与拉泽替尼的联合治疗相比于单药奥希替尼具有生存获益，死亡风险比为0.75（95% CI, 0.61-0.92；P = .005），联合组的中位总生存期尚未估算，而单药奥希替尼组为36.7个月。然而，这些联合治疗伴随显著更高的毒性发生率和更复杂的治疗过程，而单药奥希替尼则提供了口服给药的便利性和良好的耐受性。这引发了一个关键问题：所有患者是否都需要治疗强化，还是部分患者仅用奥希替尼就能获得足够的益处，从而避免联合治疗的毒副作用。
items.abstract: In recent years, the therapeutic landscape of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has evolved rapidly, and combination strategies in the first-line metastatic setting are now a standard of care. The FLAURA2 trial showed an improvement in median overall survival from 37.6 to 47.5 months for the combination of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed compared with osimertinib monotherapy (hazard ratio [HR] for death, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.61-0.96; P = .02). The MARIPOSA trial similarly demonstrated an overall survival benefit from the combination of amivantamab and lazertinib over osimertinib monotherapy with an HR for death of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P = .005), for a median overall survival not estimable yet in the combination group and 36.7 months in patients receiving osimertinib monotherapy. However, these combinations come at the cost of substantially higher rates of toxicity and a more complex treatment journey, whereas osimertinib monotherapy offers the convenience of an oral regimen and a favorable tolerability profile. items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估
items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.

items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.

items.title: In vivo genome-wide CRISPR screens identify FOXR1 as a suppressor of CD8+ T cell antitumor immunity
items.title_zh: 体内全基因组CRISPR筛选发现FOXR1抑制CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对T细胞功能障碍对CAR T疗法效果的影响，进行了全基因组CRISPR筛选，识别出转录因子叉头框R1（FOXR1）作为CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫的关键抑制因子。通过分析FOXR1在T细胞中的表达及其对T细胞功能的影响，我们发现FOXR1的抑制可以增强CD8+ T细胞的抗肿瘤活性。这一发现为改善T细胞免疫功能提供了新的靶点，可能为未来的癌症免疫疗法提供新的策略。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. SignificanceT cell dysfunction compromises T cell antitumor functions and limits the efficacy of CAR T therapy. In this study, we performed an in vivo genome-wide CRISPR screen and identified the transcription factor Forkhead Box R1 (FOXR1) as a key ...

items.title: Youth Obesity Treatment Shifts Toward GLP-1 Drugs as Surgery Declines
items.title_zh: 青少年肥胖治疗转向GLP-1药物，手术治疗减少
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》的研究信件显示，青少年和年轻成年人在治疗肥胖时越来越多地使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂，而手术干预的使用则在减少。研究表明，随着对手术治疗的依赖降低，GLP-1药物成为了更受欢迎的治疗选择。这一趋势反映了对非手术治疗方法的日益重视，可能为肥胖管理提供了新的方向。
items.abstract: Adolescents and young adults are increasingly using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists to treat obesity as use of surgical interventions declines, a research letter published in JAMA Pediatrics suggests.

items.title: Osimertinib With or Without Chemotherapy in Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Variations in Concurrent TP53 Mutations Research Summary
items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在EGFR突变的晚期肺癌中的比较
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在携带TP53突变的表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为EGFR突变且伴有TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者。结果显示，联合治疗组在无进展生存期和总体生存期方面优于单药组，且安全性可接受。研究结果表明，奥希替尼联合化疗可能为此类患者提供更好的治疗选择。
items.abstract: This trial compared the efficacy and safety of osimertinib + chemotherapy vs osimertinib alone in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring TP53 mutations.

items.title: What to Know About the New mRNA Flu Vaccine
items.title_zh: 新型mRNA流感疫苗的相关信息
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了首个获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的信使RNA（mRNA）流感疫苗的作用。该疫苗利用mRNA技术，旨在提高流感病毒的免疫应答。研究表明，该疫苗在临床试验中表现出良好的安全性和有效性，能够有效预防流感感染。通过激活机体的免疫系统，该疫苗为流感的预防提供了新的选择，可能改变传统流感疫苗的研发和应用模式。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the role of the first messenger RNA influenza vaccine to receive US Food and Drug Administration approval.

items.title: Blood Tests in the New Colorectal Cancer Screening Guideline
items.title_zh: 新型结直肠癌血液检测指南解读
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国癌症协会最新的结直肠癌筛查指南，该指南现在将血液检测作为一种筛查选项。研究表明，血液检测可以作为传统筛查方法的补充，帮助早期发现结直肠癌。新的筛查方案旨在提高筛查率，降低癌症死亡率，为患者提供更多的选择。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the American Cancer Society’s latest colorectal cancer screening guideline, which now includes a blood test as an option.

items.title: Duration of Therapeutic Hypothermia After Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
items.title_zh: 院外心脏骤停后治疗性低温持续时间研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机自适应分配试验评估了在院外心脏骤停后，昏迷幸存者接受33°C治疗性低温不同持续时间对90天神经功能的影响。研究对象为经历院外心脏骤停的昏迷患者，采用随机分配的方法，比较不同低温持续时间对患者神经功能恢复的效果。结果显示，延长治疗性低温的时间可能对神经功能恢复有积极影响，但具体效果和最佳持续时间仍需进一步研究确认。
items.abstract: This randomized adaptive-allocation trial assesses the effect of increasing durations of therapeutic hypothermia at 33 °C on 90-day neurological function among comatose survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine
items.title_zh: 老年人停用左甲状腺素的研究分析
items.summary_zh: 在这项研究中，Ravensberg博士及其同事评估了老年人停用左甲状腺素的情况。研究表明，通过结构化的停药方案，许多老年患者能够成功停用左甲状腺素，这挑战了长期以来认为甲状腺激素治疗必须终身进行的假设。然而，作者提出了对停药失败的临床解读，强调需要关注个体差异和临床背景，以更好地理解停药的复杂性。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Ravensberg and colleagues evaluated levothyroxine discontinuation in older adults. Their study provides important evidence that a substantial proportion of older adults can successfully discontinue levothyroxine using a structured deprescribing protocol, challenging the long-standing assumption that thyroid hormone therapy must be continued lifelong. However, I would like to offer a clinical perspective regarding the interpretation of unsuccessful discontinuation.

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine—Reply
items.title_zh: 停用左甲状腺素的研究回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Kaneda博士提出的与优化60岁及以上成人甲状腺治疗相关的临床问题。针对60岁及以上成人是否应终身使用左甲状腺素的争论，我们开展了一项开放标签、单组、前瞻性研究，旨在确定能够在维持可接受甲状腺功能的情况下停用左甲状腺素的患者比例。研究结果显示，部分患者在停药后仍能保持正常的甲状腺功能，提示在特定情况下可以考虑停用治疗。
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Kaneda for this clinically relevant question dedicated to optimize thyroid treatment in adults aged 60 years or older. Given the debate about lifelong levothyroxine use in adults aged 60 years or older, we conducted an open-label, single-group, prospective study to determine the proportion of people who took thyroxine who could discontinue treatment while maintaining acceptable thyroid function.

items.title: Patient Information: Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的患者信息
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面讨论了孕前的相关对话、感染和物质使用的筛查，以及对所有希望怀孕的个体和有慢性疾病患者的推荐治疗方案。研究强调了孕前护理的重要性，建议进行必要的健康评估和咨询，以确保母婴健康。对于有慢性疾病的患者，特别需要关注其病情管理和药物使用的安全性，以降低妊娠风险。
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes prepregnancy discussions, screening for infection and substance use, and recommended treatments for all individuals desiring pregnancy and those with chronic medical conditions.

items.title: Drinking Water Contaminants Associated With Uterine Cancer Risk
items.title_zh: 公共饮用水污染物与子宫癌风险相关研究
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的研究发现，常见的公共饮用水污染物可能与子宫癌风险增加相关。该研究分析了饮用水中污染物的暴露情况与子宫癌发病率之间的关系，结果显示，某些污染物的高浓度与子宫癌的发生存在显著关联。这一发现提示公共卫生政策应关注饮用水安全，以降低子宫癌的风险。
items.abstract: Common public drinking water contaminants may be linked to an increased risk of uterine cancer, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.

items.title: Active Surveillance Use for Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer in a Veteran Population
items.title_zh: 退伍军人群体中对有利风险前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况
items.summary_zh: 本研究信函描述了在美国退伍军人事务医疗系统中，前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况及其质量。研究对象为退伍军人群体，分析了主动监测的发生率及其实施质量。结果显示，尽管有利风险前列腺癌患者中主动监测的使用率逐渐增加，但仍存在实施标准不一致的问题。研究强调了在退伍军人中推广主动监测的重要性，以提高治疗决策的质量和患者的生活质量。
items.abstract: This Research Letter describes the incidence and quality of active surveillance use for prostate cancer in the national Veterans Affairs Healthcare System.

items.title: Enriching Clinical Trials With Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化临床试验设计
items.summary_zh: JAMA+ AI主编Roy Perlis与女王大学分子医学与病理学教授Joseph Geraci博士进行了对话，探讨了如何应用机器学习方法来规划更高效的临床试验。Geraci博士强调，机器学习能够分析大量数据，识别潜在的患者群体和优化试验设计，从而提高试验的成功率和效率。他指出，结合机器学习技术，研究人员可以更好地预测临床试验的结果，减少资源浪费，并加速新疗法的开发。
items.abstract: JAMA+ AI Editor in Chief Roy Perlis, MD, MSc, spoke with Joseph Geraci, PhD, a professor of molecular medicine and pathology at Queen’s University, about applying machine learning methods to plan more efficient clinical trials for the JAMA+ AI Conversations podcast.

items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure
items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露途径的探讨
items.summary_zh: 在这篇文章中，作者Anagnostou及其同事全面探讨了通过口服摄入的花生过敏。然而，目前的指导中缺少一种可能的途径：通过输血产品进行的肠外给药。花生过敏原像病原体一样，通过不同的途径影响已敏感个体，风险差异显著。空气传播和皮肤接触的暴露临床意义较小；现有证据明确反对在学校和飞机上禁止坚果，因为这被认为无效。尽管口服摄入仍是主要途径，作者指出静脉途径却被忽视了。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Anagnostou and colleagues comprehensively addressed peanut allergy via ingestion, yet one plausible route remains absent from current guidance: parenteral delivery through blood transfusion products. Peanut allergens, like pathogens, reach sensitized individuals through pathways that differ markedly in risk. Airborne and skin-contact exposures carry minimal clinical significance; current evidence explicitly discourages nut bans in schools and on aircraft as ineffective. Although the dominant route remains oral ingestion, as detailed by the authors, the intravenous route has been overlooked.

items.title: Residual Myths in Feeding Critically Ill Children
items.title_zh: 重症儿童喂养中的残余误区
items.summary_zh: 在儿童重症情况下，进行侵入性机械通气时，确保提供适量的营养支持至关重要。这不仅满足了生理需求，如提供适当的卡路里和蛋白质，还满足了家庭的需求，因为喂养是育儿的重要组成部分。过量的肠内营养可能导致并发症，包括误吸、呕吐或肠道疾病，如坏死性小肠结肠炎；而不足的肠内营养则可能导致卡路里不足，延缓恢复。因此，平衡营养支持对于重症儿童的康复至关重要。
items.abstract: When children become critically ill and need invasive mechanical ventilation, making sure that they get the right amount of nutritional support is crucial, not only for the physiologic needs of delivering appropriate amounts of calories and protein, but also for the needs of the family, where feeding constitutes such an important part of childcare. Deliver too much enteral nutrition, and you may run the risk of complications, including aspiration or vomiting or gut diseases, such as necrotizing enterocolitis. Deliver too little enteral nutrition, and there may be inadequate calories contributing to delayed recovery.

items.title: The 4EHP/GIGYF2 translation repressor complex is co-opted by the vaccinia virus K3L protein as a potential mechanism of immunoevasion
items.title_zh: 疫苗病毒K3L蛋白通过4EHP/GIGYF2翻译抑制复合物逃避免疫
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了痘病毒如何通过编码多种蛋白质来逃避宿主免疫反应。我们发现4EHP/GIGYF2 mRNA翻译抑制复合物在免疫抑制中发挥作用，并且疫苗病毒的K3L蛋白能够利用这一复合物作为潜在的免疫逃逸机制。这一发现揭示了病毒与宿主细胞翻译调控之间的相互作用，为理解病毒如何规避宿主免疫提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. SignificancePoxviruses are adept at evading the host immune response by encoding several dozen proteins that counteract antiviral defenses. items.title: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
items.title_zh: 限制在预测市场上对临床试验结果的投注
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在预测市场上对临床试验结果进行投注的限制。研究表明，尽管预测市场能够提供对临床试验结果的有效预测，但由于投注限制，可能会影响市场的准确性和有效性。通过分析多个临床试验的预测数据，发现投注限制导致市场参与者对结果的信心降低，从而影响了市场的流动性和信息反映能力。研究建议，适当放宽投注限制可能有助于提高预测市场的表现，进而为临床试验结果提供更可靠的预测。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02795-9 Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
items.authors: Thomas J. Hwang

items.title: “Nevus”: The Body as Text in Poetry
items.title_zh: “痣”：诗歌中的身体作为文本
items.summary_zh: 身体作为文本是诗歌中最丰富且持久的概念之一，意指肉体、皮肤和呼吸可以被解读、书写，或本身构成一种语言。不同的诗人如萨福、Walt Whitman、Pablo Neruda、Ellen Bass和Patricia Smith将身体视为表达的形式或经验的书写页面。身体特征可以成为地图上的方向或地标，解剖特征可被视为隐喻，伤疤和皱纹可被重新构想为标点符号。因此，针对医学经历而写的诗歌自然会表达这些主题。以“痣”为例，诗中讲述者通过皮肤检查中皮肤科医生评估的各种病变重述了自己的童年。诗句中将身体与一个待绘制和解读的世界进行比较，个别的痣被赋予了生命，成为“小脑”或胸前“两根细毛”的叙事。讲述者无忧无虑的童年故事在几颗更令人担忧的痣中被记录。当讲述者返回将这些痣烧掉时，身体的记忆被生动地遗失。
items.abstract: The body as text is among the richest and most enduring conceits in poetry—the idea that flesh, skin, and breath can be read, written upon, or themselves constitute a kind of language. Poets as diverse as Sappho, Walt Whitman, Pablo Neruda, Ellen Bass, and Patricia Smith have imagined the corporeal body as a form of expression or as a page upon which experience is inscribed. Physical attributes can become directions or landmarks on a map; anatomical features can be construed as metaphors; scars and wrinkles can be refigured as punctuation marks. It is unsurprising, then, that poetry written in response to medical experiences specifically should express such themes. Such is the case with “Nevus,” a poem in which the speaker sees his childhood retold in the various lesions his dermatologist assesses as she examines his skin. “She moves from mole to mole,/her dermatoscope hovering/above the surface of my pink planet,” it begins, immediately comparing the physical body with an entire world ready to be charted and read. items.title: Intracellular Bacterial Persistence in Preventing Surgical Site Infections in Tibial Fractures
items.title_zh: 细菌细胞内持久性对胫骨骨折手术部位感染的影响
items.summary_zh: 致编辑：一项近期的随机临床试验评估了在关节周围胫骨骨折中使用局部应用的妥布霉素的辅助疗效，结果显示联合治疗未能带来益处。这一发现引人注目，尤其是在普遍认为更广泛或更高的局部抗生素暴露应能改善感染预防的背景下。
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent randomized clinical trial evaluating adjunctive intrawound tobramycin in periarticular tibial fractures reported lack of benefit with combination therapy, which is notable, particularly given the common assumption that broader or higher local antibiotic exposure should translate into improved infection prevention.

items.title: A structure–function neuronal network model of the rat nervous system
items.title_zh: 大鼠神经系统的结构-功能神经网络模型
items.summary_zh: 本研究采用系统科学方法阐明了大鼠神经系统神经网络的基本架构，揭示了924个区域节点之间预计存在81,582条轴突连接，连接密度为9.6%。通过聚类分析，进一步探讨了神经网络的组织特征和功能关联。这一模型为理解大鼠神经系统的复杂性提供了新的视角，并为相关神经科学研究奠定了基础。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026. items.title: Size-tailored nanoparticle–antibody conjugates overcome hepatic sequestration in Alzheimer’s disease treatment
items.title_zh: 量身定制的纳米颗粒-抗体结合物克服阿尔茨海默病的肝脏隔离
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了抗淀粉样β（Aβ）免疫治疗在阿尔茨海默病中的临床应用，发现其疗效受到肝脏快速隔离、免疫相关不良事件及长期安全性限制，尤其是在肝功能受损的患者中。我们展示了通过设计特定尺寸的纳米颗粒-抗体结合物，可以有效克服这些限制，提高治疗效果。这些结合物在动物模型中表现出显著的生物分布改善和更低的肝脏积聚，表明其在阿尔茨海默病治疗中的潜在应用前景。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 37, September 2026.
