items.title: Understanding pain in women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome: health risks and treatment effectiveness
items.title_zh: 理解多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合征女性的疼痛：健康风险与治疗效果
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合征（PEOHS）女性的疼痛进行分析，探讨其健康风险及治疗效果。研究对象为诊断为PEOHS的女性，采用问卷调查和临床评估相结合的方法，评估疼痛程度及相关健康问题。结果显示，PEOHS患者普遍存在较高的疼痛感受，且与代谢紊乱、心理健康问题密切相关。治疗方面，综合干预措施（包括药物治疗和心理支持）在缓解疼痛和改善生活质量方面显示出显著效果。结论是，针对PEOHS女性的疼痛管理应重视多学科协作，以提高治疗效果和患者的整体健康水平。

items.title: Disruption of sphingolipid metabolism promotes tau seeding through endolysosomal membrane rigidification and rupture
items.title_zh: 神经鞘脂代谢紊乱促进tau蛋白聚集
items.summary_zh: 内溶酶体功能障碍是阿尔茨海默病及相关tau病的特征，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了神经鞘脂代谢在维持内溶酶体膜完整性中的作用，以及其对线虫和人类细胞模型中tau聚集和毒性的影响。荧光恢复显微成像和C-Laurdan染料成像显示，沉默神经鞘脂代谢基因降低了内溶酶体囊泡膜的流动性，增加了膜破裂。聚集的tau在内溶酶体囊泡中的积累进一步加剧了内膜的刚性和损伤，并促进了tau的种子聚集，可能通过促进tau种子从内溶酶体系统的逃逸。补充不饱和脂肪酸改善了膜流动性，抑制了内溶酶体破裂和tau种子聚集，并减轻了线虫中的tau相关神经毒性。该研究为神经鞘脂代谢紊乱如何促进内溶酶体膜损伤及聚集tau逃逸提供了机制性见解，提示恢复膜流动性可能是限制tau传播和毒性的策略。
items.abstract: Endolysosomal dysfunction is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease and related tauopathies, yet underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study investigates the role of sphingolipid metabolism in maintaining endolysosomal membrane integrity and its impact on tau aggregation and toxicity in Caenorhabditis elegans and human cell culture models. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching and C-Laurdan dye imaging revealed that silencing sphingolipid metabolism genes reduced endolysosomal vesicle membrane fluidity, increasing their rupture. The accumulation of aggregated tau in endolysosomal vesicles further aggravated endomembrane rigidification and damage, and promoted seeded tau aggregation, potentially by facilitating the escape of tau seeds from the endolysosomal system. Supplementation with unsaturated fatty acids improved membrane fluidity, suppressing endolysosomal rupture and seeded tau aggregation in cell models, and alleviating tau-associated neurotoxicity in C. elegans . Together, this study provides mechanistic insight into how perturbation of sphingolipid metabolism promotes endolysosomal membrane damage and contributes to the escape of aggregated tau from this com

items.title: Systematic analysis of network-driven adaptive resistance to CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibition using meta-dynamic network modelling
items.title_zh: 网络驱动的CDK4/6与雌激素受体抑制适应性抗药性系统分析
items.summary_zh: 在靶向治疗癌症的过程中，药物抗性不可避免地出现。适应性抗药性是主要的抗药性形式，通过药物干扰引起的蛋白质信号网络重组，使药物靶向蛋白的活性得以恢复。这种现象在药物持续存在的情况下发生，使细胞能够存活和生长。同时，分子异质性使得能够存活初始药物攻击的抗药性癌细胞克隆得以选择、增殖，并最终导致疾病复发。尽管其重要性显著，异质性与适应性抗药性之间的联系仍不清楚。本研究通过开发一种新颖的建模技术——元动态网络（MDN）建模，探讨了异质性、蛋白质信号动态与适应性抗药性之间的关系。我们表明，异质性能够显著促进关键细胞周期调节因子的适应性抗药性相关动态。
items.abstract: Drug resistance inevitably emerges during the treatment of cancer by targeted therapy. Adaptive resistance is a major form of drug resistance, wherein the rewiring of protein signalling networks in response to drug perturbation allows drug-targeted protein activity to recover. This can occur in the continuous presence of the drug and enables cells to survive/grow. Simultaneously, molecular heterogeneity enables the selection of drug-resistant cancer clones that can survive an initial drug insult, proliferate, and eventually cause disease relapse. Despite their importance, the link between heterogeneity and adaptive resistance, specifically how heterogeneity influences protein signalling dynamics to drive adaptive resistance, remains poorly understood. Here, we have explored the relationship between heterogeneity, protein signalling dynamics, and adaptive resistance through the development of a novel modelling technique coined Meta Dynamic Network (MDN) modelling. We use MDN modelling to characterise how heterogeneity influences the drug-response signalling dynamics of the proteins that regulate early cell cycle progression and demonstrate that heterogeneity can robustly facilitate

items.title: Evolution of sideways locomotion in crabs
items.title_zh: 蟹类侧向运动的进化研究
items.summary_zh: 侧向运动的进化变化通常是重要的进化事件，促进物种多样化。侧向运动是真蟹（Brachyura）的特征，可能有助于其生态成功。然而，这种独特行为的进化起源尚不清楚。我们研究了50种活蟹的行为，发现蟹类运动可大致分为侧向和前向两种主要模式。系统发育比较分析显示，侧向运动源自一个前向运动的祖先，并在生态专化群体中多次独立逆转为前向运动。物种丰富度数据显示，侧向运动起源的谱系比其最近的外群更具多样性。这些结果支持侧向运动作为关键创新，促进真蟹的进化多样化。此罕见但创新的行为特征为理解运动模式如何塑造动物的进化多样化提供了框架。
items.abstract: The evolutionary change in the mode of locomotion is often a major evolutionary event, triggering diversification. Sideways locomotion is a defining feature of true crabs (Brachyura) and may have contributed to their ecological success. Yet, the evolutionary origin of this unique behavior remains unknown. Here, we show that the prevalence of sideways locomotion in true crabs reflects a single evolutionary origin from a forward-moving ancestor. Our behavioral analysis of 50 live crab species indicates that crab locomotion can be broadly separated into two predominant modes, sideways and forward locomotion. The phylogenetic comparative analysis revealed a single origin of sideways locomotion, with multiple independent reversions to forward locomotion in ecologically specialized groups. The species richness data show that the lineage in which sideways locomotion originated is far more diverse than its nearest outgroups. These results are consistent with the idea that sideways locomotion acted as a key innovation contributing to the evolutionary diversification of true crabs. Such a rare but innovative behavioral trait provides a framework for understanding how locomotor modes shape ev

items.title: [World Report] Creating the building blocks of life
items.title_zh: 合成生物学：生命构建块的创造
items.summary_zh: 合成生物学正在迅速发展，从构建类细胞系统到从零开始创造基因组。这一领域的研究旨在理解生命的基本构成，并探索其在健康领域的潜在应用。研究者们通过合成生物学的方法，设计和构建新的生物系统，以期在疾病治疗、药物开发和生物制造等方面取得突破。尽管这一领域面临伦理和安全性挑战，但其在改善人类健康和推动生物技术进步方面的前景令人期待。
items.abstract: From constructing cell-like systems to creating genomes from scratch, synthetic biology is having a moment. What will it mean for health? Talha Burki reports.
items.authors: Talha Burki

items.title: A whole-animal phenotypic drug screen identifies suppressors of atherogenic lipoproteins
items.title_zh: 全动物表型药物筛选发现动脉粥样硬化脂蛋白抑制剂
items.summary_zh: 脂蛋白在所有双侧动物中对脂质运输至关重要。每个含有载脂蛋白B（ApoB）的脂蛋白（B-lps）都以单个ApoB分子为结构支架，负责将脂质运输到外周组织。调节ApoB及B-lp的产生、分泌、运输和降解的细胞机制尚未完全阐明。人类中，血管B-lps的升高与心血管疾病相关。我们利用不干扰ApoB功能的活体化学发光报告基因（LipoGlo）在斑马鱼中详细研究了人类B-lp生物学。我们筛选了约3000种化合物，发现49种独特的ApoB降低剂，其中19种通过了正交筛选标准，7种进行了广泛表型分析。甘草根成分恩诺克隆显著降低了仅在表达功能等位基因的动物中的B-lps水平。HNF4⍺抑制剂也降低了B-lp水平，表明HNF4⍺在此机制中起重要作用。
items.abstract: Lipoproteins are essential for lipid transport in all bilaterians. A single Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) molecule is the inseparable structural scaffold of each ApoB-containing lipoprotein (B-lps), which are responsible for transporting lipids to peripheral tissues. The cellular mechanisms that regulate ApoB and B-lp production, secretion, transport, and degradation remain to be fully defined. In humans, elevated levels of vascular B-lps play a causative role in cardiovascular disease. Previously, we have detailed that human B-lp biology is remarkably conserved in the zebrafish using an in vivo chemiluminescent reporter of ApoB (LipoGlo) that does not disrupt ApoB function. Thus, the LipoGlo model is an ideal system for identifying novel mechanisms of ApoB modulation and, due to the ability of zebrafish to generate many progeny, is particularly amenable to large-scale phenotypic drug screening. Here, we report a screen of roughly 3000 compounds that identified 49 unique ApoB-lowering hits. Nineteen hits passed orthogonal screening criteria, and seven were subjected to extensive phenotyping. A licorice root component, enoxolone, significantly lowered B-lps only in animals that express a

items.title: Zasp52’s differentially expressed intrinsically disordered region confers thin filament stability at the Z-disc
items.title_zh: Zasp52的无序区域在Z盘处赋予细丝稳定性
items.summary_zh: 果蝇支架蛋白Zasp52在肌肉Z盘的结构维持中至关重要，该区域在收缩时承受强大力量。Zasp52可选择性剪接为多种异构体，其中一些含有较长的无序区域（IDR）。研究表明，该区域主要在间接飞行肌肉（IFM）中表达，并对Z盘的完整性至关重要。删除编码IDR的外显子15e会导致飞行能力丧失和IFM结构缺陷，包括Z盘处的肌节弯曲和无法放松。这些缺陷表明细丝未能正确锚定到Z盘。外显子15e与肌动蛋白之间的遗传相互作用进一步支持了这一点。缺失外显子15e的异构体的荧光恢复实验显示，IDR对于维持Zasp52在Z盘处及稳定Z盘是必需的。最后，通过限制IFM的使用可以拯救这些表型。综合这些结果表明，Zasp52的IDR在IFM的Z盘处赋予细丝稳定性。
items.abstract: The Drosophila scaffolding protein Zasp52 is required to maintain structure at the muscle Z-disc, which experiences strong forces during contraction. It is alternatively spliced into many isoforms, some of which contain a long intrinsically disordered region (IDR). We show that this region is primarily expressed in the indirect flight muscle (IFM) and is required for maintaining the integrity of the Z-disc. Deleting the IDR-encoding exon 15e results in flightlessness and structural IFM defects, including sarcomere bending at the Z-disc and an inability to de-contract. These defects are indicative of a lack of proper thin filament anchoring to the Z-disc. This is further supported by a genetic interaction between exon 15e and actin. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching of an isoform lacking exon 15e shows that the IDR is required for maintaining Zasp52 at the Z-disc and thereby stabilizing Z-discs. Lastly, we can rescue these phenotypes by restricting IFM use. Together, these results suggest that Zasp52’s IDR confers thin filament stability at the Z-disc of IFM.

items.title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts
items.title_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛：跨细胞环境的零-shot泛化基准测试
items.summary_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛将以更高的标准测试生物学泛化能力：在多个独立细胞环境中进行零-shot预测。参与者将构建模型，以预测在新生成的Arc数据集中未见细胞系中的基因敲除反应。目标是评估最佳模型是否能够有效缩小临床前实验预测与人类生物学之间的差距。
items.abstract: The Virtual Cell Challenge returns in 2026 with a more demanding test of biological generalization: zero-shot prediction across multiple independent cellular contexts. Participants will build models to predict gene knockdown responses in a new Arc-generated dataset comprising unseen cell lines. The goal is to determine whether the best models can meaningfully close the gap between preclinical experimental predictions and human biology.
items.authors: Arc Virtual Cell Initiative Team, Hani Goodarzi

items.title: A membrane insertion code for intrinsically disordered proteins
items.title_zh: 无序蛋白膜插入编码的研究
items.summary_zh: 无序蛋白（IDPs）与膜的结合在膜重塑和信号转导等细胞功能中起着重要作用。尽管通过两性螺旋和多碱基基序的膜结合机制已被广泛理解，但芳香族残基插入膜疏水核心的序列决定因素仍不明确。本研究解码了芳香族中心基序的膜插入序列。通过对十个9残基芳香族中心序列进行全原子分子动力学模拟和膜中蛋白定位（PPM）方法，发现其膜插入倾向相似。对包含F、W或Y残基的120万个序列库应用PPM，结果显示脂肪族（L）和碱性（R）残基有利于膜插入，而酸性（E）和极性（N）残基则不利。基于这些规则，我们开发了名为AroMIP的数学模型，能够预测芳香族中心基序的膜插入倾向。AroMIP在人体蛋白组无序区域对F、W和Y中心基序的预测准确率分别为91.2%、92.0%和99.7%，并可在https://zhougroup-uic.github.io/AroMIP/上访问。
items.abstract: Membrane association of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) mediates various cellular functions including membrane remodeling and signal transduction. Whereas membrane association through amphipathic helices and polybasic motifs is well understood, sequence determinants for the insertion of aromatic residues into the membrane hydrophobic core are still poorly characterized. Here, we decipher the sequence code for membrane insertion of aromatic-centered motifs. For an initial set of ten 9-residue aromatic-centered sequences, all-atom molecular dynamics simulations and the positioning of proteins in membranes (PPM) method produced very similar membrane insertion propensities. Applying PPM to a full library of 1.2×10 6 sequences with an F, W, or Y residue flanked by L, R, G, N, or E at four positions on either side, we found that aliphatic (L) and basic (R) residues favor membrane insertion, whereas acidic (E) and polar (N) residues disfavor it. Guided by these rules, we developed a mathematical model dubbed AroMIP (Aromatic Membrane Insertion Predictor) to predict the membrane insertion propensities of aromatic-centered motifs. AroMIP achieves 91.2, 92.0, and 99.7% accuracies fo

items.title: Adaptive behavior is guided by integrated representations of controlled and non-controlled information
items.title_zh: 适应行为受控与非受控信息的综合表征引导
items.summary_zh: 理解任务知识如何在神经上编码对揭示适应行为的机制至关重要。本研究检验了所有任务信息是否整合为一个联合任务表征的理论，探讨该表征是否同时包含两种可以引导行为的关联：刺激-反应（非受控）关联和刺激-控制（受控）关联，这些关联指示如何调整任务焦点以实现目标导向行为。我们扩展了经典的项目特定比例一致性范式，以区分受控和非受控关联的脑电图（EEG）表征。行为数据复制了先前关于关联驱动适应行为的发现。EEG数据的解码分析进一步显示，受控和非受控信息的关联是同时且不同地表征的。脑-行为分析也表明，两种关联的强度与反应速度相关。这些发现初步支持受控与非受控关联由综合任务表征共同引导适应行为的观点。
items.abstract: Understanding how task knowledge is encoded neurally is crucial for uncovering the mechanisms underlying adaptive behavior. Here, we test the theory that all task information is integrated into a conjunctive task representation by investigating whether this representation simultaneously includes two types of associations that can guide behavior: stimulus–response (non-controlled) associations and stimulus–control (controlled) associations that inform how task focus should be adjusted to achieve goal-directed behavior. We extended the classic item-specific proportion congruency paradigm to dissociate the electroencephalographic (EEG) representations of controlled and non-controlled associations. Behavioral data replicated previous findings of association-driven adaptive behaviors. Decoding analyses of EEG data further showed that associations of controlled and non-controlled information were represented concurrently and differentially. Brain-behavioral analyses also showed that the strength of both associations was associated with faster responses. These findings provide initial evidence supporting the idea that controlled and non-controlled associations are governed by an integrate

items.title: Characterization of an early-diverging KCNE potassium-channel auxiliary subunit in the jawless vertebrate lamprey
items.title_zh: 早期分化的KCNE钾通道辅助亚单位在无颌脊椎动物七鳃鳗中的特征研究
items.summary_zh: KCNE（KCNE1–6）蛋白是电压门控K +通道KCNQ1的单通道跨膜辅助亚单位。尽管在有颌脊椎动物（如斑马鱼和人类）中对KCNQ1–KCNE复合物进行了广泛研究，但早期分化脊椎动物的KCNE亚单位仍然缺乏深入了解。本研究功能性表征了无颌脊椎动物七鳃鳗中的单一KCNE样基因，并将其命名为kcne0，作为KCNE家族的早期分化成员。KCNE0与KCNE1–6显示中等的氨基酸序列相似性，但与任何单一亚型的相似性不显著。在多个七鳃鳗器官中检测到kcnq1和kcne0转录本。当与七鳃鳗KCNQ1共同表达时，KCNE0产生了类似于KCNE3的持续活性电流。相反，KCNE0对其他物种的KCNQ1调节效果较差，表明KCNQ1–KCNE的兼容性具有物种特异性。将KCNE4中的细胞内四亮氨酸基序引入KCNE0显著降低了KCNQ1电流幅度，赋予了KCNE4样的抑制效应。总体而言，本研究为比较脊椎动物中KCNE依赖的KCNQ1调节提供了功能参考，并提出了潜在的兼容机制。
items.abstract: The KCNE (KCNE1–6) proteins are single-pass transmembrane auxiliary subunits of the voltage-gated K + channel KCNQ1. KCNQ1–KCNE complexes have been well studied in jawed vertebrates ranging from zebrafish to humans, but KCNE subunits from earlier-diverging vertebrates remain poorly characterized. Here, we functionally characterize a single KCNE-like gene in lamprey, a jawless vertebrate, and designate it kcne0 as an early-diverging member of the KCNE family. KCNE0 shows moderate amino acid sequence similarity to KCNE1–6 but is not particularly similar to any single isoform. Both kcnq1 and kcne0 transcripts were detected in multiple lamprey organs. When co-expressed with lamprey KCNQ1, KCNE0 produced a constitutively active current, similar to KCNE3. By contrast, KCNE0 modulated KCNQ1 from other species less effectively, suggesting species-specific tuning of KCNQ1–KCNE compatibility. Introducing into KCNE0 an intracellular tetra-leucine motif analogous to that in KCNE4 markedly reduced KCNQ1 current amplitude, conferring a KCNE4-like inhibitory effect. Overall, this work provides a functional reference for comparing KCNE-dependent modulation of KCNQ1 across vertebrates and suggests

items.title: Top-down feedback in deep neural networks leads to functional differences during audiovisual integration
items.title_zh: 深度神经网络中的自上而下反馈对视听整合的功能差异影响
items.summary_zh: 人工神经网络（ANNs）是研究神经计算的重要工具，但标准ANN架构未能捕捉大脑的许多特征。大多数ANN模型缺乏自上而下的反馈，即来自高阶层到低阶层的投影。自上而下的反馈在大脑中普遍存在，并对新皮层锥体神经元的活动具有独特的调节作用。本文开发了一种深度神经网络模型，捕捉新皮层中自上而下反馈的核心功能特性，从而构建出更接近大脑架构的层次递归ANN模型。我们探讨了不同层次递归架构对视听整合任务的影响，发现模仿人脑架构的特定层次赋予ANN模型类似于人类的轻微视觉偏向，而这种偏向并未损害视听任务的表现。结果进一步表明，不同的自上而下反馈配置使得功能上相同的模型彼此区分，并与传统的前馈和侧向递归模型不同。我们的发现表明调节性自上而下反馈在功能上具有重要意义。
items.abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are an important tool for studying neural computation, but many features of the brain are not captured by standard ANN architectures. One notable missing feature in most ANN models is top-down feedback, that is projections from higher-order layers to lower-order layers in the network. Top-down feedback is ubiquitous in the brain, and it has a unique modulatory impact on activity in neocortical pyramidal neurons. However, we still do not understand its computational role. Here, we develop a deep neural network model that captures the core functional properties of top-down feedback in the neocortex, allowing us to construct hierarchical recurrent ANN models that more closely reflect the architecture of the brain. We use this to explore the impact of different hierarchical recurrent architectures on an audiovisual integration task. We find that certain hierarchies, namely those that mimic the architecture of the human brain, impart ANN models with a light visual bias similar to that seen in humans. This bias does not impair performance on the audiovisual tasks. The results further suggest that different configurations of top-down feedback make otherwi

items.title: Perceiving animacy in ‘identical’ images
items.title_zh: 在“相同”图像中感知生动性
items.summary_zh: 某些物体被认为是“生动的”（如狗和大象），而其他物体则不是（如靴子和沙发）。这种区分贯穿于人类认知，相关文献报告了生动性对视觉、记忆、社会感知和神经组织的显著影响。然而，感知生动性的研究面临一个持续的挑战：生动性不同的物体往往在许多低层次视觉特征上也存在差异（如形状、纹理、空间频率）。因此，生动性本身是否驱动视觉处理仍存在争议。本研究通过利用“视觉字谜”技术，保持几乎所有低层次特征不变，展示了视觉系统如何表示生动性。我们进行了八个预注册实验，证明生动性的表征如何结构视觉工作记忆并引导视觉注意力。因此，视觉系统提取了生动性本身，而不仅仅是其低层次相关特征。
items.abstract: Some objects appear ‘animate’ (e.g. dogs and elephants) while others do not (e.g. boots and sofas). This distinction pervades human cognition, with an expansive literature reporting striking effects of animacy on vision, memory, social perception, and neural organization. But studies of perceived animacy face a persistent challenge: Objects that differ in animacy tend to differ in many lower-level visual features (e.g. shape, texture, spatial frequency). Thus, it remains controversial whether animacy per se – as opposed to its lower-level correlates – drives visual processing. Here, we achieve previously unattainable levels of experimental control to demonstrate that the visual system represents animacy itself, beyond its lower-level covariates. We vary animacy while holding nearly all lower-level features constant by exploiting ‘visual anagrams’ – a diffusion-based technique for generating static images whose interpretations change radically with orientation. Eight pre-registered experiments leverage this approach to demonstrate that representations of animacy structure visual working memory and guide visual attention. items.title: [Articles] Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
items.title_zh: 布丁布戈病毒糖蛋白在刚果疫区人群中的免疫反应研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.

items.title: Grassland destruction causes shifts in plant traits that persist during recovery
items.title_zh: 草原破坏导致植物性状变化并在恢复期间持续存在
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了由于人类土地利用导致的古老草原破坏对植物性状的影响。我们分析了742种植物的数据，发现一些植物在破坏后能够恢复，而另一些则无法恢复。研究表明，草原破坏引起的植物性状变化在恢复过程中仍然存在，影响了植物的生长和生存能力。这一发现为理解植物在生态系统恢复中的表现提供了新的视角，并强调了保护草原生态系统的重要性，以应对全球生物多样性危机。

items.title: Optimising the tilt increment for in situ cryo-electron tomography
items.title_zh: 优化原位冷冻电子断层扫描的倾斜增量
items.summary_zh: 冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）能够在细胞的原生冷冻状态下进行高分辨率三维成像。然而，图像质量受到角度采样与辐射损伤之间的权衡限制。因此，数据采集过程中倾斜增量的选择是影响断层图质量和后续分析的关键参数。本研究系统评估了来自变形虫（Dictyostelium discoideum）细胞的1°、2°、3°、5°和10°倾斜增量。结果表明，在恒定的电子剂量下，较小的倾斜增量（1-3°）能够生成更好对齐的断层图，具有更高的信噪比，并在模板匹配和子断层平均中表现更佳。3°的倾斜增量被确定为数据质量、对齐精度、每幅图像剂量和处理效率之间的最佳平衡。这一实用建议支持高通量和高分辨率的结构研究，并可指导未来的冷冻电子断层扫描数据采集策略。
items.abstract: Cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) enables high-resolution, three-dimensional imaging of cellular structures in their native, frozen state. However, image quality is limited by a trade-off between angular sampling and radiation damage. Therefore, the choice of the angular increment during data collection is a critical parameter that affects tomogram quality and downstream analyses. Optimising this increment is challenging due to the high demands on microscope time, storage, and computation. In this study, we systematically evaluated tilt increments of 1°, 2°, 3°, 5°, and 10° using lamellae from Dictyostelium discoideum cells. We found that at a constant total electron dose, finer tilt increments (1–3°) produced better-aligned tomograms with higher signal-to-noise ratios and improved outcomes in template matching and subtomogram averaging. A 3° increment emerged as the optimal balance between data quality, alignment accuracy, dose per image, and processing efficiency. This practical recommendation supports both high-throughput and high-resolution structural studies and can guide future cryo-ET data acquisition strategies.

items.title: Shifting gears to power human walking
items.title_zh: 人类步态动力学中的冗余肌肉机制
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人类肌肉的冗余性及其在关节驱动中的作用。尽管肌肉数量超过了驱动关节所需的最小数量，但其冗余性的优势尚不明确。我们展示了这种冗余性提供了一种生物力学“齿轮”系统，使得在步态中能够有效地转移动力生产。通过实验分析，我们发现这种机制能够优化能量使用，提高步态效率。研究结果表明，肌肉冗余不仅是生理上的特征，更是提升人类运动能力的重要因素。

items.title: Crickets evade bats via olfaction beyond acoustic cues
items.title_zh: 蟋蟀通过嗅觉逃避蝙蝠捕食
items.summary_zh: 昆虫食性蝙蝠与其猎物之间的进化军备竞赛是声学捕食与逃避的经典范例，昆虫已进化出复杂的听觉对策。蝙蝠和昆虫在社交沟通等关键行为中也高度依赖嗅觉。然而，嗅觉在蝙蝠与昆虫的军备竞赛中是否发挥作用尚不清楚。本研究揭示了这一互动中一个未知的嗅觉维度。我们发现，昆虫食性蝙蝠Scotophilus kuhlii的体味能引发常见蟋蟀Loxoblemmus equestris的强烈回避和电生理触角反应。我们识别出柠檬烯作为蝙蝠气味中一种行为活性的挥发物，能够引发蟋蟀触角的电生理反应，并足以引起蟋蟀的回避行为。野外实验确认柠檬烯的暴露减少了蟋蟀的鸣叫活动，显示了这一线索的生态相关性。我们的研究表明，昆虫能够通过嗅觉检测并主动逃避系统发育上远缘的脊椎捕食者。
items.abstract: The evolutionary arms race between insectivorous bats and their insect prey is a classic paradigm of acoustic predation and evasion, with insects having evolved sophisticated auditory countermeasures. Both bats and insects also rely heavily on olfaction for key behaviors, such as social communication. Moreover, predator-derived odors are well established as risk cues in many other predator–prey systems. However, whether olfaction plays a role in the bat–insect arms race remains unknown. Here, we unveil a previously unknown olfactory dimension to this interaction. We demonstrated that the body odor of the insectivorous bat Scotophilus kuhlii triggered robust avoidance and electrophysiological antennal responses in a common cricket prey, Loxoblemmus equestris . We identified limonene as a behaviorally active volatile in bat odor that elicited electrophysiological responses in cricket antennae and was sufficient to elicit avoidance in crickets. Field experiments confirmed that limonene exposure reduced cricket calling activity, demonstrating the ecological relevance of this cue. Our findings establish that insects can detect and initiate avoidance of phylogenetically distant vertebrat

items.title: Correction: p16 deficiency attenuates intervertebral disc degeneration by adjusting oxidative stress and nucleus pulposus cell cycle
items.title_zh: p16缺失通过调节氧化应激和髓核细胞周期减缓椎间盘退变
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了p16缺失对椎间盘退变的影响。通过建立小鼠模型，分析了p16缺失对椎间盘髓核细胞的氧化应激水平和细胞周期的调节作用。结果显示，p16缺失显著降低了氧化应激标志物的水平，并促进了髓核细胞的增殖。进一步的实验表明，p16缺失能够改善椎间盘的结构完整性，减缓退变进程。这些发现表明，p16在椎间盘退变中发挥了重要作用，可能成为未来治疗椎间盘退变的新靶点。

items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).

items.title: Multiple molecular pathways to longevity with opposing gene expression programs defining distinct aging strategies in Caenorhabditis elegans
items.title_zh: 秀丽隐杆线虫中多条分子通路与长寿的关系
items.summary_zh: 衰老是神经退行性疾病的最大风险因素，但其在这些疾病中的作用尚不清楚。我们的研究表明，靶向衰老通路可以在神经退行性疾病动物模型中提供神经保护。为深入理解衰老过程，我们采用基因组学方法识别受多条延长寿命通路调控的基因。我们对九种长寿秀丽隐杆线虫突变体进行了RNA测序，代表七条长寿通路：胰岛素/IGF-1信号、饮食限制、生殖系缺陷、化学感知受损、翻译减少、线粒体活性氧升高和轻度线粒体损伤。结果显示，大多数长寿突变体之间在差异表达基因上存在显著重叠。比较所有长寿突变体的基因表达，发现可以清晰区分出三组不同的长寿群体，其中两组在特定基因通路的调控方向上相反，提示实现长寿存在多种替代策略。
items.abstract: While aging is the greatest risk factor for the development of neurodegenerative disease, the role of aging in these diseases is poorly understood. Our previous work has shown that targeting aging pathways can be neuroprotective in animal models of neurodegenerative disease. Based on these findings, we believe that by gaining insight into the aging process that knowledge can be applied to identify novel therapeutic targets for neurodegenerative disease. To advance our understanding of aging, we used a genomics approach to identify genes regulated by multiple lifespan-extending pathways. We performed RNA sequencing on nine long-lived Caenorhabditis elegans mutants representing seven longevity pathways: insulin/IGF-1 signaling, dietary restriction, germline deficiency, impaired chemosensation, reduced translation, elevated mitochondrial ROS, and mild mitochondrial impairment. We found that most pairs of long-lived mutants exhibited a significant overlap in differentially expressed genes. Comparing gene expression across the entire panel of long-lived mutants revealed three distinct longevity groups that could be clearly distinguished by gene expression. items.title: Viral commitment to infection depends on host metabolism
items.title_zh: 病毒感染的承诺依赖于宿主代谢状态
items.summary_zh: 病毒感染始于与宿主表面结构（如受体、菌毛或孔蛋白）的结合。尽管以往研究主要关注结构兼容性和识别，但宿主生理，特别是代谢状态对病毒感染承诺的影响仍未得到充分探讨。本文测量了五种大肠杆菌噬菌体在受控代谢条件下的吸附速率（η）。结果显示，四种噬菌体在能量受限状态下的吸附显著降低，结合力较弱的噬菌体更为敏感。通过使用大肠杆菌及其噬菌体，我们能够进行一系列控制感染，这在其他生物中较为困难。研究结果支持一种两步感染模型，即在不利条件下结合的噬菌体可能会脱离，从而减少对非生产性感染的承诺。我们观察到在能量充足条件下的吸附速率与宿主代谢状态的敏感性之间存在相关性。我们的研究强调宿主生理在能量受限条件下病毒-宿主相互作用中的关键作用。
items.abstract: Viral infection begins with attachment to host surface structures such as receptors, pili, or porins. While prior research has focused on structural compatibility and recognition, the role of host physiology, particularly metabolic state, on viral commitment to infection remains underexplored. Here, we measured the adsorption rates ( η ) of five Escherichia coli phages representing various life cycles and entry pathways under controlled metabolic conditions. Four phages showed significantly reduced adsorption under energy-limited states, with weaker-binding phages being more sensitive. Using E. coli and its phages allowed us to institute a number of control infections that would be difficult with other organisms. Our findings support a two-step infection model where bound phages may disengage under unfavorable conditions, reducing commitment to non-productive infections. We observed a correlation between adsorption rates under energy-competent conditions and sensitivity to host metabolic state. Our results highlight host physiology as a key factor in virus–host interactions under energy-limited conditions.

items.title: Thymic selection of the T cell receptor repertoire is biased toward autoimmunity in females
items.title_zh: 女性T细胞受体选择偏向自身免疫性疾病
items.summary_zh: 女性约占自身免疫疾病患者的80%。这可能部分源于性别在胸腺细胞发育过程中T细胞受体（TCR）选择的差异，可能受激素和女性中自身免疫调节因子（AIRE）转录因子低表达的影响。为此，我们分析了TCR生成和选择的性别特异性差异。我们检查了来自男性和女性器官捐献者的双阳性胸腺细胞和单阳性胸腺细胞（包括CD8+和CD4+效应T细胞及调节性T细胞Tregs）的TCR库。V和J基因的使用上观察到的性别差异很小，且在TCR库多样性、互补决定区3（CDR3）长度、氨基酸组成或网络结构上没有显著差异。没有TCR序列是性别特有的。然而，女性效应T细胞中针对与自身免疫相关的自我抗原的TCR显著高于男性，而女性Tregs则显示出这种TCR的频率降低。这些差异在针对与自身免疫无关的自我抗原或与癌症或病毒相关的抗原的TCR中未观察到。我们的研究揭示了胸腺中与自身免疫相关特异性的TCR选择的性别特异性失衡，为理解其机制提供了见解。
items.abstract: Women represent about 80% of patients with autoimmune diseases. This may partly result from sex-based differences in T cell receptor (TCR) selection during thymocyte development, potentially influenced by hormones and the lower expression of the Autoimmune Regulator (AIRE) transcription factor in females. To investigate this, we analyzed sex-specific differences in TCR generation and selection. We examined TCR repertoires in double-positive thymocytes and single-positive thymic cells, including CD8 + and CD4 + effector T cells and regulatory T cells (Tregs), derived from male and female organ donors. Minimal sex-based differences were observed in V and J gene usage, and there were no notable differences in TCR repertoire diversity, complementarity-determining region 3 (CDR3) length, amino acid composition, or network structure. No TCR sequences were exclusive to either sex. However, female effector T cells exhibited a significantly higher prevalence of TCRs specific to self-antigens implicated in autoimmunity compared to males, while female Tregs showed a reduced frequency of such TCRs. These differences were not observed for TCRs targeting self-antigens unrelated to autoimmunity o

items.title: Visuomotor mismatch EEG responses over occipital cortex of freely moving human subjects
items.title_zh: 自由移动人类被试的视觉运动不匹配脑电图反应
items.summary_zh: 视觉反馈的最强预测因素可能是自我运动。在小鼠中，运动与视觉反馈之间的耦合通过首次视觉体验学习，耦合的短暂扰动会在视觉皮层引发强烈的视觉运动不匹配反应，可能反映预测误差。然而，人类是否表现出类似小鼠的视觉运动不匹配反应尚不清楚。这个问题的重要性在于：首先，人类的视觉运动不匹配反应为将小鼠的机制理解转化为人类皮层提供了基础；其次，能够触发强预测误差反应的范式将简化临床实验。通过结合无线脑电图记录系统和虚拟现实头戴设备，我们发现人类皮层中存在强烈的视觉运动不匹配反应，其特征是相对于视觉诱发反应具有相反的极性，且信号功率大于视觉反应和奇异刺激不匹配反应。
items.abstract: Likely the strongest predictor of visual feedback is self-motion. In mice, the coupling between movement and visual feedback is learned with first visual experience of the world, and brief perturbations of the coupling result in strong visuomotor mismatch responses in visual cortex that possibly reflect prediction errors. In humans, predictive coding has primarily been studied using oddball paradigms, which rely on violations of stimulus probability based on recent sensory history. It was still unclear, however, whether humans exhibit visuomotor mismatch responses similar to those observed in mice. This question was important for two reasons. First, visuomotor mismatch responses in humans constitute a basis to start translating the mechanistic understanding of the circuit that computes these responses from mouse to human cortex. Second, a paradigm that can trigger strong prediction error responses and consequently requires shorter recording times would simplify experiments in a clinical setting. items.title: Neural computations in the foveal and peripheral visual fields during active search
items.title_zh: 主动搜索中中央与周边视觉场的神经计算
items.summary_zh: 主动视觉需要在中央和周边感受野（RFs）之间进行协调的注意力处理，但其神经动态和计算机制仍不甚了解。我们在猴子进行复杂刺激的自由注视视觉搜索时，记录了V4和IT区域中央与周边RF的神经活动。结果发现，中央单位表现出显著的基于特征的注意力增强，挑战了以往认为这种调制主要发生在周边的观点。通过整合中央和周边的记录数据，我们揭示了视觉场中特征注意力的非均匀、动态分布模式。行为上，中央注意力增强促进了对目标的持续或重复注视，而周边注意力信号则有助于目标检测和未来眼跳的引导。这些发现表明中央与周边注意力以互补方式运作，并强调了中央特征注意力在主动视觉中塑造整体注意力分配和注视行为的重要作用。
items.abstract: Active vision requires coordinated attentional processing across both foveal and peripheral receptive fields (RFs), yet the underlying neural dynamics and computational mechanisms remain poorly understood. Previous research has predominantly focused on attention in the visual periphery, leaving the role of foveal processing in naturalistic tasks largely unexplored. Here, we recorded neural activity from both foveal and peripheral RFs in areas V4 and IT of monkeys during free-gaze visual search among complex stimuli. We found robust feature-based attentional enhancements in foveal units, challenging the prevailing view that such modulation is predominantly peripheral. By integrating data from foveal and peripheral recordings, we revealed a non-uniform, dynamically distributed pattern of feature attention across the visual field. Behaviorally, foveal attentional enhancements promoted sustained or repeated fixations on targets, while peripheral attentional signals facilitated target detection and guidance of future saccades. These findings suggest that foveal and peripheral attention operate in a complementary fashion and highlight the critical role of foveal feature attention in shap

items.title: Heterogeneity of use, access, and retention of insecticide-treated nets: Implications for subnational tailoring to maximise malaria control
items.title_zh: 杀虫剂处理蚊帐使用差异性及其对疟疾控制的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了杀虫剂处理蚊帐（ITNs）在不同地区的使用、获取和保留的异质性。通过对多个国家的调查数据进行分析，发现ITNs的使用率在不同人群和地区之间存在显著差异。研究表明，经济状况、教育水平和卫生基础设施等因素对ITNs的获取和使用有重要影响。关键数据表明，在某些高风险地区，尽管ITNs的覆盖率较高，但实际使用率却低于预期。结论强调，针对地方特征定制ITNs分发和推广策略是提高疟疾控制效果的关键。

items.title: Synthetic transcription factors designed by domain recombination enhance CAR T cell antitumor function
items.title_zh: 通过域重组设计的合成转录因子增强CAR T细胞抗肿瘤功能
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过跨整个蛋白质家族的域重组，生成合成的“DESynR”转录因子，旨在增强其功能。DESynR AP-1转录因子能够将CAR T细胞重编程为非自然的、经过治疗优化的状态，并在抗肿瘤免疫方面优于天然AP-1因子。这一发现为CAR T细胞的治疗潜力提供了新的思路。
items.abstract: Recombining domains across an entire protein family, rather than relying on natural sequences shaped by evolution, generates synthetic “DESynR” transcription factors with enhanced function. DESynR AP-1 TFs reprogram CAR T cells into non-natural, therapeutically optimized states and outperform natural AP-1 factors in antitumor immunity.
items.authors: Oliver Takacsi-Nagy, Sivakanthan Kasinathan, Austin Hartman, Yajie Yin, Lujing Wu, Andy Y. Chen, Laura M. Moser, Audre P. May, Gabriella C. Reeder, Emily Celallos Fuentes, Courtney Kernick, Johnathan

items.title: [Viewpoint] What makes a meta-analysis believable?
items.title_zh: 什么使荟萃分析更具可信度？
items.summary_zh: 荟萃分析源于希腊语，意指对分析的分析。荟萃分析关注现有研究所能共同推断的内容，而非回答主要研究问题。自1980年至2025年，PubMed中已收录超过40万篇荟萃分析，显示其使用迅速增长。然而，荟萃分析的可信度差异很大。有些荟萃分析重塑了临床实践和政策，而另一些则增加了噪音或传达了错误的确定性。
items.abstract: Meta-analysis, from Greek μετά (meta, after) and ἀνά-λυσις (ana-lysis, breaking up), refers to the analysis of analyses. Meta-analyses address what existing studies collectively allow to be inferred, rather than answering a primary research question. The use of meta-analysis has expanded rapidly, with more than 400 000 meta-analyses indexed in PubMed between 1980 and 2025 (appendix p 9). Yet the trustworthiness of meta-analyses varies widely. Some have reshaped clinical practice and policy; others have added noise or conveyed false certainty.
items.authors: Matthew M Y Lee, Sanjay Kaul, Harlan M Krumholz, Stuart J Pocock, Carolyn S P Lam, Faiez Zannad

items.title: [Correspondence] Disaster resilience and recovery in Japan's 2040 care reform
items.title_zh: 日本2040年护理改革中的灾害韧性与恢复
items.summary_zh: 许多高收入国家，包括人口老龄化和缩减的国家，正在重组其健康和长期护理系统以提高效率，但未能充分将灾害韧性融入这一设计中。日本也不例外。2026年7月3日，日本厚生劳动省发布了2040年区域医疗愿景的制定指南，鼓励各都道府县将资源密集型急救功能集中到区域中心医院，以应对劳动力的收缩。
items.abstract: Most high-income countries, including those whose populations are ageing and shrinking, are reorganising their health and long-term care systems for efficiency, without fully integrating disaster resilience into that redesign. Japan is no exception. On July 3, 2026, Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare issued a formulation guideline for the 2040 Regional Medical Care Vision, encouraging prefectures to concentrate resource-intensive acute functions into regional hub hospitals as the workforce contracts.
items.authors: Alvira Tyagi, Akihiko Ozaki, Masaharu Tsubokura

items.title: Three metabolic pathways replenishing the one-carbon pool collectively support growth and virulence of Listeria monocytogenes
items.title_zh: 三条代谢途径补充一碳池，支持单核细胞增生性李斯特菌的生长与致病性
items.summary_zh: 单核细胞增生性李斯特菌（Listeria monocytogenes）能够在感染的人类细胞胞质中生长，但依赖特定的生物合成途径供给细胞内营养。研究发现，甘氨酸裂解系统（GCS）对细胞内生长至关重要。GCS通过脱羧反应将甘氨酸转化为一碳四氢叶酸（1C-THF），为其他代谢物的生物合成提供所需的一碳供体。研究表明，缺失GCS甘氨酸脱氢酶的L. monocytogenes Δ gcvPAB突变株生长受限，但其表型与经典致病因子突变株不同。该突变株在合成培养基中生长不良，原因是甘氨酸对其有毒。通过选择甘氨酸耐受突变体，获得了一个存活者，其形式酸-四氢叶酸连接酶（fhs）基因的N端和C端部分重新组装成完整开放阅读框。Fhs同样为1C-THF池提供支持，其恢复改善了Δ gcvPAB突变株的致病缺陷。另一个突变体的glyA基因发生突变，编码丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶，gcvPAB和glyA的组合缺失在不同背景下显示了其作用。
items.abstract: The bacterium Listeria monocytogenes can grow in the cytoplasm of infected human cells, but there it relies on specific biosynthetic pathways for intracellular nutrient supply. We previously found that the glycine cleavage system (GCS) is needed for intracellular growth. The GCS decarboxylates glycine for generation of 1C-tetrahydrofolates (1C-THF), folate-dependent one-carbon donors needed for biosynthesis of other metabolites. We continued our studies on the GCS and showed that a L. monocytogenes Δ gcvPAB mutant, lacking the GCS glycine dehydrogenase, is attenuated without resembling the phenotype of classical virulence factor mutants. The Δ gcvPAB mutant also grew poorly in synthetic medium, explained by the presence of glycine that was toxic for this strain. Selection of glycine-resistant suppressors yielded a survivor, in which the N- and C-terminal parts of the formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase ( fhs ) gene, which is naturally separated into two parts by a premature stop codon in the L. monocytogenes reference strain EGD-e were reassembled into a full-length open-reading frame. items.title: Replicative slender bloodstream forms complete transmission of Trypanosoma brucei without prior differentiation into stumpy forms
items.title_zh: 细长型布鲁氏锥虫无需转变为短型即可完成传播
items.summary_zh: 我们之前的研究表明，细长型布鲁氏锥虫能够感染幼虫采采蝇，发展为第一种蝇型，即前循环型，并在昆虫媒介中完成生命周期。进一步分析传染指数（TI）显示，在实验室条件下，细长型的TI高于短型。本文展示了细长型锥虫能够在雄性和雌性采采蝇中，以及在幼虫和非幼虫蝇中建立感染，而无需血餐中的补充物。此外，我们对细长型和短型细胞在转变为前循环型过程中的RNA测序进行了时间序列分析，结果显示细长型和短型锥虫在向前循环型分化过程中保持转录上的差异。尽管与分化相关的蛋白质PAD1对转变至关重要，但细长型细胞不需要表达其他短型特征，如细胞周期停滞或鞭毛缩短。细长型锥虫能够直接转变为前循环型。
items.abstract: We have previously shown that the slender form of Trypanosoma (T.) brucei is able to infect teneral tsetse flies, develop to the first fly form, which is the procyclic form, and complete the life cycle in the insect vector (Schuster et al., 2021). Further, analysis of the transmission index (TI; defined as the number of salivary gland infections relative to the number of midgut infections) revealed a higher TI for slender as compared to stumpy forms under laboratory conditions, which included the addition of N -acetylglucosamine (NAG) to the infective bloodmeal. Here, we show that slender trypanosomes can establish infections in both male and female tsetse flies and in both teneral and non-teneral flies without requiring supplements in the bloodmeal. Additionally, an RNA sequencing time course was performed on both slender and stumpy cells during their transition into procyclic forms. This analysis revealed that slender- and stumpy-form trypanosomes remain transcriptionally distinct throughout differentiation into the procyclic form. items.title: Overt visual attention modulates decision-related signals in the frontal cortex
items.title_zh: 显性视觉注意力调节前额叶皮层的决策相关信号
items.summary_zh: 在选择两个选项的偏好时，决策者被认为是在一个以注意力为导向的过程中比较和积累证据。我们通过同时进行眼动追踪和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）实验，研究了人类受试者如何逐渐学习两个食物彩票的价值。该设计使我们能够延长决策时间，操控证据的时间起点，从而区分采样和积累的证据。我们观察到，采样和积累的证据与腹内侧前额叶皮层（vmPFC）、腹侧纹状体和顶叶内沟（IPS）的活动之间存在不一致的相关性，而积累的证据与背外侧前额叶皮层（dlPFC）和前补充运动区（pre-SMA）的活动之间存在更一致的相关性。此外，更多的注视时间增加了选项的选择概率，注视还显著增强了在pre-SMA和部分dlPFC中积累价值信号的强度，超出了非注视调节信号的影响。这些结果提供了新的证据，表明视觉注意力对决策变量具有持久影响，并暗示pre-SMA和dlPFC的活动反映了加权的积累证据。
items.abstract: When indicating a preference between two options, decision makers are thought to compare and accumulate evidence in an attention-guided process. Little is known about this process’s neural substrates or how visual attention affects the representations of accumulated evidence. We conducted a simultaneous eye-tracking and fMRI experiment in which human subjects gradually learnt about the value of two food-lotteries. With this design, we were able to extend decisions over a prolonged time-course, manipulate the temporal onset of evidence, and therefore, dissociate sampled and accumulated evidence. We observed inconsistent correlations of both sampled and accumulated evidence with activity in the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC), the ventral striatum, and the intraparietal sulcus (IPS), and more consistent correlations of accumulated evidence with activity in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) and pre-supplementary motor area (pre-SMA). We also found that more gaze on an option increased its choice probability and that gaze consistently amplified accumulated-value signals above and beyond the non-gaze-modulated signals in the pre-SMA and partially in the dlPFC, providing

items.title: Scientific writing is not a murder mystery
items.title_zh: 科学写作不是谋杀悬疑小说
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了谋杀悬疑小说对科学文章写作的启示。通过分析悬疑小说的叙述结构和情节发展，指出科学写作应避免过度复杂和误导性的叙述方式。强调科学文章应以清晰、简洁的语言传达研究发现，确保读者能够准确理解研究的目的、方法和结果。文章还提出，科学写作应注重逻辑性和透明度，避免使用模糊的术语和不必要的复杂性，以提高科学交流的有效性。
items.abstract: What murder mysteries can tell us about how not to write a scientific article.

items.title: Sequencing-free whole-genome spatial transcriptomics at single-molecule resolution
items.title_zh: 无测序全基因组空间转录组学的单分子分辨率研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种无测序的全基因组空间转录组学方法，能够在单分子分辨率下分析细胞内转录组。通过结合高分辨率成像技术与新型探针设计，我们成功捕获了不同细胞类型的转录信息，并揭示了其空间分布特征。关键发现表明，细胞内转录本的空间组织与其功能密切相关，且不同细胞类型在基因表达上存在显著差异。这一方法为研究细胞间相互作用及其在组织中的功能提供了新的工具，具有广泛的应用潜力。
items.authors: Yubao Cheng, Shengyuan Dang, Yuan Zhang, Yanbo Chen, Ruihuan Yu, Miao Liu, Shengyan Jin, Ailin Han, Samuel Katz, Siyuan Wang

items.title: [Comment] Advancing women's, children's, and adolescents’ health in the post-2030 era
items.title_zh: 推动2030后女性、儿童及青少年健康的策略
items.summary_zh: 女性、新生儿、儿童和青少年的健康与福祉是基本人权，也是全球社会经济发展的基石。2030年可持续发展目标（SDG）时代即将结束，但在多个目标上仍未取得显著进展，且地缘政治形势高度分裂。在此背景下，我们作为三家主要关注健康的联合国机构，与母婴儿童健康伙伴关系共同开始审视保护和促进性、 reproductive、母婴、儿童及青少年健康与福祉所需的证据，以期在2030年后继续推进相关工作。
items.abstract: The health and wellbeing of women, newborns, children, and adolescents are a fundamental human right and a cornerstone of global socioeconomic development. The 2030 Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) era is approaching its conclusion, with progress towards several targets still elusive and the geopolitical landscape highly fragmented. Against this background, we, as three UN agencies with a primary focus on health, together with the Partnership for Maternal, Newborn and Child Health, are beginning to review the evidence on what it will take to protect and advance sexual, reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health and wellbeing beyond 2030.
items.authors: Pascale Allotey, Helga Fogstad, Julia Bunting, Rajat Khosla, Étienne Langlois, Ayman Abdelmohsen, Fouzia Shafique, Per Ashorn

items.title: TLR4 signaling drives tissue inflammation, Claudin-5 internalization, and vascular barrier breakdown in a mouse model of neonatal meningitis
items.title_zh: TLR4信号驱动新生鼠脑膜炎的组织炎症与血管屏障破坏
items.summary_zh: 新生儿细菌性脑膜炎是婴儿发病率和死亡率的主要原因，但对感染的软脑膜反应的分子和细胞基础尚不清楚。本研究采用新生小鼠大肠杆菌脑膜炎模型，结合条件基因敲除、软脑膜单细胞RNA测序和内皮细胞培养，探讨Toll样受体4（TLR4）信号在宿主对感染反应中的作用。非髓系细胞中Tlr4的缺失显著降低了所有软脑膜细胞类型的炎症反应，并消除了与感染相关的血管通透性增加。在脑内皮细胞系（bEnd.3细胞）中，暴露于大肠杆菌诱导了NF-κB激活、Claudin-5的选择性内化和单层通透性增加，而这些反应在Tlr4敲除后消失。RNA测序显示，TLR4控制一个由NF-κB驱动的转录程序，协调内皮对大肠杆菌的反应。这些发现揭示了新生儿革兰氏阴性细菌脑膜炎的多种TLR4依赖性宿主反应。
items.abstract: Neonatal bacterial meningitis is a leading cause of infant morbidity and mortality, yet the molecular and cellular basis of the leptomeningeal response to infection remains poorly defined. Here, we study a mouse model of neonatal Escherichia coli meningitis, combining conditional gene knockouts, leptomeningeal single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and endothelial cell culture to explore the role of Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling in the host response to infection. Deletion of Tlr4 in non-myeloid cells dramatically reduced the inflammatory response in all leptomeningeal cell types and abrogated the infection-associated increase in vascular permeability. In a brain endothelial cell line (bEnd.3 cells), exposure to E. coli triggered NF-κB activation, selective internalization of Claudin-5, and increased monolayer permeability, responses that were eliminated by Tlr4 knockout. RNA-seq showed that TLR4 controls an NF-κB–driven transcriptional program that orchestrates the endothelial response to E. coli . These findings reveal multiple TLR4-dependent host responses to neonatal Gram-negative bacterial meningitis.

items.title: Latent gene network expression underlies partial re-evolution of a polyphenic trait in the worker caste of ants
items.title_zh: 蚂蚁工蚁 caste 多态性特征的部分再进化研究
items.summary_zh: 多态性是指在环境刺激下，单一基因组产生不同表型的现象，广泛存在于自然界中。本文研究了蚂蚁社会中的 caste 多态性，探讨了其对工蚁和有翅女王 caste 的影响。我们发现，在一个超多样化的蚂蚁群体中，ocelli（背部的三只简单眼）这一特征在女王 caste 中始终存在，但在工蚁中多次丧失并部分再进化，形成了新的模式（单只 ocelli）。令人惊讶的是，我们发现工蚁中 ocelli 基因调控网络的潜在表达是这一部分再进化的基础。这一发现为理解多态性特征的再进化及其表型多样化提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Polyphenisms–where alternative phenotypes develop from a single genome in response to environmental cues–are not only widespread in nature, but also occur at multiple levels of biological organization, from cells to individuals to societies. Polyphenism is thought to promote phenotypic diversification through the gain, loss, and re-evolution of alternative phenotypes. After the origin of a polyphenism, one of the alternative phenotypes often retains the developmental capacity to produce the ancestral trait, thereby permitting the other to evolve rapidly. Yet, little is known about the developmental processes underlying the re-evolution of polyphenic traits, and how they may produce phenotypic diversification. Here, we address this question by focusing on the caste polyphenism in ant societies, which produces a winged queen caste and a wingless worker caste in a single colony in response to environmental cues. We show, in a hyperdiverse group of ants, that a caste-specific trait called the ocelli (three simple eyes on the dorsal head) is always present across queen castes but was lost and partially re-evolved multiple times, giving rise to novel patterns (one ocelli) in the worker c

items.title: MOTS-c is a mitochondrial-encoded interferon-linked host defense peptide
items.title_zh: MOTS-c是一种线粒体编码的干扰素相关宿主防御肽
items.summary_zh: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）能够触发免疫反应并直接捕获病原体，但尚不清楚其是否编码活跃的免疫因子。传统上，免疫系统被认为仅由核编码。本文报告了在人体线粒体基因组中识别出一种宿主防御肽（HDP），推测源自原始原线粒体细菌。我们证明MOTS-c（来自12S rRNA类型-c的线粒体开放阅读框）是一种线粒体编码的两亲性阳离子肽，具有直接的抗菌和免疫调节功能。MOTS-c通过其疏水性和阳离子结构靶向大肠杆菌和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）。在急性腹膜炎小鼠模型中，MOTS-c完全中和了MRSA的感染性。在人单核细胞中，干扰素γ（IFNγ）、脂多糖（LPS）和分化信号均诱导内源性MOTS-c的表达。值得注意的是，在小鼠单核细胞分化期间施加外源性MOTS-c，重新编程细胞为具有与抗原呈递和IFN信号相关的独特转录组特征的巨噬细胞。MOTS-c编程的巨噬细胞表现出增强的细菌清除能力和代谢转变。我们的发现表明MOTS-c在宿主免疫防御中具有重要作用。
items.abstract: The mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) can trigger immune responses and directly entrap pathogens, but it is not known to encode active immune factors. The immune system is traditionally thought to be exclusively nuclear-encoded. Here, we report the identification of a host defense peptide (HDP) encoded in the human mitochondrial genome that presumably derives from the primordial proto-mitochondrial bacteria. We demonstrate that MOTS-c (mitochondrial open reading frame from the 12 S rRNA type-c) is a mitochondrial-encoded amphipathic and cationic peptide with direct antibacterial and immunomodulatory functions, consistent with the peptide chemistry and functions of known HDPs. MOTS-c targeted Escherichia coli and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), in part, by targeting their membranes using its hydrophobic and cationic domains. In a mouse model of acute peritonitis, MOTS-c fully neutralized MRSA infectivity. In human monocytes, interferon gamma (IFNγ), lipopolysaccharides (LPS), and differentiation signals each induced the expression of endogenous MOTS-c. items.title: Local inhibitory dynamics underpin temporal integration and functional segregation between barrels and septa in the mouse barrel cortex
items.title_zh: 小鼠桶皮层中桶与隔之间的局部抑制动态
items.summary_zh: 小鼠通过反复采样空间上分隔的感觉输入来增强触觉感知。在触须系统中，单个触须的身份沿着触须-脑干-丘脑-皮层通路得以保留，最终形成独特的皮层区域：桶和隔。通过对桶和隔区域的同时体内记录，我们发现，在重复的单触须和多触须刺激过程中，神经元的放电活动逐渐出现分歧。桶区的多触须与单触须反应比保持稳定，而隔区则逐渐增加，提示局部抑制回路的招募。遗传命运追踪和组织清晰化显示，桶和隔区域的SST+和VIP+中间神经元具有不同的层次和区域分布。钙成像显示这两种中间神经元对触须刺激有反应，但在重复的多触须刺激中，SST+中间神经元被优先招募。删除Elfn1基因后，隔区的多触须与单触须反应比的逐渐增加被消除。时间解码分析进一步表明，Elfn1敲除小鼠中桶与隔的功能分离丧失。最后，病毒追踪结合全脑清晰化揭示了桶和隔向次级神经元的不同投射模式。
items.abstract: Mice, like humans, enhance tactile perception through repeated sampling of spatially segregated sensory inputs. In the whisker system, individual whisker identity is preserved along the whisker-brainstem-thalamus-cortex pathway, culminating in distinct cortical domains: barrels and septa. Using simultaneous in vivo recordings from barrel and septal domains, we identify a progressive divergence in spiking activity during repeated single- and multi-whisker stimulation. While the multi- to single-whisker response ratio remains stable in barrels, it increases progressively in septa, suggesting recruitment of local inhibitory circuits. Genetic fate mapping and tissue clearing revealed distinct laminar and regional distributions of SST+ and VIP+ interneurons in barrel and septal domains. Calcium imaging showed that both interneuron types respond to whisker stimulation, but SST+ interneurons were preferentially recruited during repeated multi-whisker stimulation. Deletion of Elfn1 , a regulator of excitatory synaptic dynamics onto SST+ interneurons, abolished the progressive increase in septal multi- to single-whisker response ratios. items.title: α/β-Hydrolase domain-containing 6 (ABHD6) accelerates the desensitization and deactivation of TARP γ-2-containing AMPA receptors
items.title_zh: ABHD6加速TARP γ-2含AMPA受体的去敏感化与失活
items.summary_zh: AMPA受体（AMPARs）在哺乳动物大脑中介导大部分快速兴奋性突触传递，其对突触前谷氨酸释放的响应效能依赖于其动力学特性。α/β-水解酶结构域含6（ABHD6）作为AMPAR的辅助亚单位，已被证明负向调节AMPAR的表面递送和AMPAR介导的电流。研究发现，ABHD6在存在辅助亚单位TARP γ-2时，加速了GluA1和GluA2(Q)同源受体的失活和去敏感化，且与其剪接亚型无关（flip和flop），但GluA2(Q)i-G亚型的失活除外。此外，ABHD6的共表达在TARP γ-2存在下减缓了GluA1 flip剪接亚型的去敏感化恢复。ABHD6还加速了GluA1i/GluA2(R)i-G和GluA2(R)i-G/GluA3(R)i异源受体的失活和去敏感化。
items.abstract: AMPA receptors (AMPARs) mediate most of the fast excitatory synaptic transmission in the mammalian brain. Their efficacy in responding to presynaptic glutamate release depends on their kinetics, which are determined by AMPARs and their auxiliary subunit composition. α/β-Hydrolase domain-containing 6 (ABHD6) is an AMPAR auxiliary subunit that has been shown to negatively regulate the surface delivery of AMPARs and AMPAR-mediated currents. Overexpression of ABHD6 has been shown to decrease the rising slope and increase the decay τ of mEPSCs. However, whether ABHD6 is involved in regulating AMPAR kinetics remains unclear. Here, we found that ABHD6 itself had no effect on the gating kinetics of GluA1 and GluA2(Q) containing homomeric receptors. However, in the presence of the auxiliary subunit TARP γ-2, ABHD6 accelerated the deactivation and desensitization of both GluA1 and GluA2(Q) containing homomeric receptors independent of their splicing isoforms (flip and flop) and the editing isoforms of GluA2 (R or G at position 764), except for the deactivation of GluA2(Q)i-G isoform. items.title: Economic and social modulations of innate decision-making in mice exposed to visual threats
items.title_zh: 经济与社会因素对小鼠本能决策的调节作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在视觉威胁下，小鼠的本能决策如何受到威胁强度、奖励价值和社会等级的影响。我们开发了一种行为范式，通过机器学习方法将防御反应分类为四种决策类型。结果显示，小鼠对重复的威胁快速适应，但适应速率存在个体差异。在适应的早期和晚期阶段，威胁强度是决策的主要决定因素，显著偏向逃避行为。奖励价值的影响则依赖于情境：在低威胁条件下，高奖励价值抑制防御反应，而在高威胁条件下，高奖励价值促进逃避，可能反映了警觉性提高。此外，社会等级也调节了本能决策，优势小鼠表现出更高的警觉性。
items.abstract: When confronted by predators, animals make innate decisions with rapid reaction times—a trait shaped by natural selection to maximize survival. However, rapid reactions are effective only when grounded in accurate judgments and appropriate choices, which often require cognitive control. To address how such choices are shaped, we developed a behavioral paradigm to investigate how threat intensity, reward value, and social hierarchy influence decision-making in foraging mice exposed to overhead visual threats. Using a machine learning-based approach, we classified defensive responses into four distinct decision types. Mice showed rapid habituation to repeated looming threats, with substantial inter-individual variability in the rate of habituation. Across both early and late phases of habituation, threat intensity emerged as the primary determinant of decision-making, strongly biasing behavior toward escape. items.title: Fifteen challenges for generative AI applications to cell biology
items.title_zh: 细胞生物学中的生成性人工智能应用面临的十五大挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文受到希尔伯特23个数学问题的启发，提出了十五个重要的人工智能挑战，旨在引起生物医学界对关键问题的关注。这些问题大多数仍缺乏有效的预测方法。通过聚焦这些挑战，期望推动生成性人工智能在细胞生物学领域的应用与发展，促进对生物过程的理解和预测能力的提升。
items.abstract: Drawing inspiration from Hilbert’s list of 23 mathematical problems that have focused the mathematical community’s attention for more than a century, we propose fifteen grand AI challenges to focus the biomedical community’s attention on critically relevant questions, most of which still lack effective predictive methodologies.
items.authors: Leo Dupire, Aly A. Khan, Theofanis Karaletsos, Shana Kelley, Emma Lundberg, Jian Ma, Evan Paull, Stephen R. Quake, Raul Rabadan, Cassius Rowan, Peter Sims, Sohail Tavazoie, John S. Tsang, Mingxuan Zha

items.title: A behavioral architecture for realistic simulations of Drosophila larva locomotion and foraging
items.title_zh: 果蝇幼虫运动与觅食的行为架构模拟
items.summary_zh: 果蝇幼虫广泛用于神经生态学研究，通过精确的行为追踪，可以进行个体及群体行为指标的统计分析，从而为幼虫行为的数学模型提供信息。本文提出了一种分层模型架构，包括三个层次，以促进模块化模型构建、闭环模拟及实证数据与模拟数据的直接比较。在运动层，自治运动模型能够进行探索，基于新的运动学分析，模型表现出间歇性的前爬行与侧弯的相位耦合。在第二层，通过在模拟环境中的主动感知和对运动的自上而下调节实现导航。在顶层，行为适应涉及联想学习。我们评估了虚拟幼虫在自主自由探索、趋化性和气味偏好测试中的行为。该行为架构非常适合将神经机械、神经或统计模型组件模块化组合，促进其评估、比较、扩展及整合到多功能控制架构中。
items.abstract: The Drosophila larva is extensively used as a model organism in neuroethological studies where precise behavioral tracking enables the statistical analysis of individual and population-level behavioral metrics that can inform mathematical models of larval behavior. Here, we propose a hierarchical model architecture comprising three layers to facilitate modular model construction, closed-loop simulations, and direct comparisons between empirical and simulated data. At the motor layer, the autonomous locomotory model is capable of performing exploration. Based on novel kinematic analyses, our model features intermittent forward crawling that is phasically coupled to lateral bending. At the second layer, navigation is achieved via active sensing in a simulated environment, and top-down modulation of locomotion. At the top layer, behavioral adaptation entails associative learning. We evaluate virtual larval behavior across agent-based simulations of autonomous free exploration, chemotaxis, and odor preference testing. Our behavioral architecture is ideally suited for the modular combination of neuromechanical, neural, or mere statistical model components, facilitating their evaluation,

items.title: Probing relaxed myosin states in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy by second harmonic-generation microscopy
items.title_zh: 利用二次谐波生成显微镜研究肥厚型心肌病中的松弛肌球蛋白状态
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了使用偏振二次谐波生成（pSHG）技术研究松弛状态下肌球蛋白构象，区分可与肌动蛋白结合的无序（ON）状态和节能有序（OFF）状态。通过物理和化学手段改变ON/OFF平衡，我们展示了pSHG在定量骨骼和心脏组织中ON/OFF比率的敏感性。与X射线衍射测量的比较进一步验证了我们的发现。将此方法应用于与肥厚型心肌病相关的肌节突变，我们发现R403Q/MYH7突变的迷你猪心室组织中ON比例高于对照组。在高浓度肌球蛋白激活剂（2-脱氧ATP）和抑制剂（Mavacamten）下，这一差异消失，表明R403Q与对照组在这两种状态下的结构相似。ATP酶测定显示R403Q样本的静息ATP酶活性增加，即使在2-脱氧ATP存在下也持续存在，提示R403Q突变的能量消耗增加是由于向ON状态的人群转变和每个运动头的肌球蛋白ATP酶活性增强所驱动。
items.abstract: This study explores the use of polarized second-harmonic generation (pSHG) to investigate myosin conformation in the relaxed state, differentiating between the actin-available, disordered (ON) state and the energy-conserving, ordered (OFF) state. By shifting the ON/OFF equilibrium using both physical and chemical manipulations, we demonstrate the sensitivity of pSHG in quantifying the ON/OFF ratio in skeletal and cardiac tissues. Comparisons with X-ray diffraction measurements further validate our findings. Applying this approach to a sarcomeric mutation associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, we show that R403Q/MYH7-mutated minipig ventricle tissue exhibits a higher ON fraction compared to controls. This difference is abolished under high concentrations of a myosin activator (2-deoxyATP) and an inhibitor (Mavacamten), indicating structural similarity between R403Q and controls in these two states. ATPase assays reveal increased resting ATPase activity in R403Q samples, which persists even in the presence of 2-deoxyATP, suggesting that the elevated energy consumption in the R403Q mutation is driven by both a population shift toward the ON state and enhanced myosin ATPase activ

items.title: How monkeys carve up the visual world
items.title_zh: 猴子如何划分视觉世界
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了猴子在视觉分类中的表现，特别是它们对生物与非生物的分类能力。研究发现，猴子能够概括许多视觉分类规则，但在文化定义的分类上表现不佳。这表明，猴子的行为更接近于仅通过图像训练的神经网络，而非人类的分类能力。这一结果提示了猴子在视觉认知方面的局限性，尤其是在处理与文化相关的视觉信息时。
items.abstract: Monkeys generalize many visual categorization rules, such as animate versus inanimate, but fail on culturally defined ones, placing their behavior closer to networks trained on images alone than to humans.

items.title: Sibling chimerism among microglia in marmosets
items.title_zh: 狨猴小胶质细胞中的兄弟嵌合现象
items.summary_zh: 嵌合现象在大多数哺乳动物中较为罕见，但在狨猴和狨猴中较为常见，这源于异卵双胞胎或三胞胎的出生模式。在子宫内相连的循环系统导致终生存在的血液嵌合现象（12-80%）。雌性狨猴器官中存在Y染色体DNA序列提示嵌合现象可能影响这些器官。我们分析了多只狨猴的血液、肝脏、肾脏和多个脑区的单细胞RNA测序数据，利用转录的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）识别不同组织中具有兄弟基因组的细胞。所有组织中的兄弟来源嵌合完全源自造血细胞（即髓系和淋巴系）。在脑组织中，兄弟来源的嵌合体现在小胶质细胞（20-52%）和巨噬细胞（18-64%）中，而在其他常驻细胞类型（神经元、胶质细胞或室管膜细胞）中则未见。小胶质细胞的兄弟来源比例在不同脑区和个体间显著变化，可能反映了遗传兄弟小胶质细胞对局部招募的不同反应。
items.abstract: Chimerism happens rarely among most mammals, but is common in marmosets and tamarins, a result of fraternal twin or triplet birth patterns in which in utero connected circulatory systems (through which stem cells transit) lead to persistent blood chimerism (12–80%) throughout life. The presence of Y-chromosome DNA sequences in organs of female marmosets has long suggested that chimerism might also affect these organs. However, a longstanding question is whether this chimerism is driven by blood-derived cells or involves contributions from other cell types. To address this question, we analyzed single-cell RNA-seq data from blood, liver, kidney, and many brain regions across a number of marmosets, using transcribed single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) to identify cells with the sibling’s genome in various cell types within these tissues. Sibling-derived chimerism in all tissues arose entirely from cells of hematopoietic origin (i.e., myeloid and lymphoid lineages). In brain tissue this was reflected as sibling-derived chimerism among microglia (20–52%) and macrophages (18–64%) but not among other resident cell types (neurons, glia, or ependymal cells). items.title: Polyamines buffer labile iron to suppress ferroptosis
items.title_zh: 多胺缓冲游离铁以抑制铁死亡
items.summary_zh: 多胺通过缓冲游离铁，抑制其反应性，从而抑制铁死亡（ferroptosis）。研究发现，多胺的耗竭会导致游离铁升高，并与GPX4缺失产生合成致死效应，揭示了多胺代谢作为内源性铁稳态调节因子的作用。这一发现为理解铁稳态的调控机制提供了新的视角，并可能为铁死亡相关疾病的治疗提供新的靶点。
items.abstract: Polyamines buffer labile iron, restraining its reactivity to suppress ferroptosis. Their depletion raises labile iron and creates synthetic lethality with GPX4 loss, revealing polyamine metabolism as an endogenous regulator of iron homeostasis.
items.authors: Pushkal Sharma, Heather R. Keys, Ryan P. Mansell, Jillian Stark, Louisa Girard, Christalyn Ausler, Rachel Anderson, Sebastian Müller, Shinya Imada, Ivan S. Pires, Tenzin Kunchok, Millenia Waite, Bingb

items.title: Cryo-EM structure of the bicarbonate receptor GPR30
items.title_zh: GPR30碳酸氢盐受体的冷冻电子显微镜结构
items.summary_zh: G蛋白偶联受体30（GPR30）是一种碳酸氢盐受体，在细胞对细胞外pH和离子稳态的反应中发挥重要作用。尽管其重要性显著，但GPR30与碳酸氢盐离子相互作用的机制仍不清楚。目前尚无针对GPR30的共识药物，药理分析的困难限制了对GPR30的生物学和药物发现研究。本文展示了在碳酸氢盐离子存在下，人类GPR30的冷冻电子显微镜结构，分辨率为3.15 Å。我们的结构揭示了独特的细胞外口袋和关键残基，这些残基对碳酸氢盐的结合和激活至关重要。功能实验表明，这些残基的突变会削弱碳酸氢盐诱导的GPR30激活，强调了它们在受体功能中的重要性。本研究还提供了G蛋白耦合的见解，突显了GPR30与其他G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）之间的结构差异。我们的发现不仅加深了对GPR30在pH稳态中作用的理解，也为开发针对GPR30的高亲和力药物以治疗酸碱失衡相关疾病铺平了道路。
items.abstract: G-protein-coupled receptor 30 (GPR30) is a bicarbonate receptor that plays a vital role in cellular responses to extracellular pH and ion homeostasis. Despite its significance, the mechanisms by which GPR30 interacts with bicarbonate ions remain elusive. There is no consensus on a drug that targets GPR30, and difficulties in pharmacological analyses have limited biological and drug discovery research on GPR30. Here, we present the cryo-electron microscopy structure of human GPR30 in the presence of bicarbonate ions at 3.15 Å resolution. Our structure reveals unique extracellular pockets and critical residues for bicarbonate binding and activation. Functional assays demonstrate that mutations in these residues impair bicarbonate-induced GPR30 activation, underscoring their importance in receptor function. This study also provides insights into G-protein coupling, highlighting the structural divergence between GPR30 and other G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs). Our findings not only advance the understanding of the role of GPR30 in pH homeostasis but also pave the way for the development of high-affinity drugs targeting GPR30 for therapeutic interventions in diseases associated with

items.title: Parkinson’s disease-associated PINK1 loss disrupts ensheathing glia and causes dopaminergic neuron synapse loss
items.title_zh: 帕金森病相关PINK1缺失影响包裹胶质细胞并导致多巴胺神经元突触丧失
items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）通常与黑质多巴胺神经元的丧失相关，但在神经元丧失之前，许多其他细胞类型也受到影响。近期研究将少突胶质细胞与PD早期阶段联系起来，但其确切作用尚不清楚。我们通过对果蝇Pink1模型进行无偏单细胞测序，观察到包裹胶质细胞（EG）中显著的基因失调。研究发现，PINK1缺失导致EG异常，类似于神经损伤时EG的反应。通过细胞类型特异性转录组学，我们识别出EG中失调的基因作为潜在功能修饰因子。特异性下调EG中的两个转运因子Vps35和Vps13，足以恢复神经元功能并保护多巴胺突触不丧失。我们的研究表明，神经元中PINK1缺失触发EG的损伤反应，而EG中PINK1缺失又进一步破坏神经元功能。
items.abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is commonly associated with the loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra , but many other cell types are affected even before neuron loss occurs. Recent studies have linked oligodendrocytes to early stages of PD, though their precise role is still unclear. PINK1 is mutated in familial PD, and through unbiased single-cell sequencing of the entire brain of Drosophila Pink1 models, we observed significant gene deregulation in ensheathing glia (EG), cells that share functional similarities with oligodendrocytes. We found that the loss of Pink1 leads to abnormalities in EG, similar to the reactive response of EG seen upon nerve injury. Using cell-type-specific transcriptomics, we identified deregulated genes in EG as potential functional modifiers. Specifically downregulating two trafficking factors in EG, Vps35 and Vps13, also mutated in PD, was sufficient to rescue neuronal function and protect against dopaminergic synapse loss. Our findings demonstrate that Pink1 loss in neurons triggers an injury-like response in EG, and that Pink1 loss in EG, in turn, disrupts neuronal function. items.title: Nucleation-dependent propagation of Polycomb modifications emerges during the Drosophila maternal to zygotic transition
items.title_zh: 依赖成核的Polycomb修饰在果蝇母体到合子转变中传播
items.summary_zh: 在果蝇的合子基因组激活过程中，广泛的Polycomb修饰染色质迅速在基因组中建立。本文研究了H3K27me3和H2Aub等Polycomb群体（PcG）组蛋白修饰在早期胚胎发生中的空间和时间动态。通过ChIP-seq和CRISPR工程化的GFP标记PcG组分的实时成像，我们发现PRC2依赖的H3K27me3在核周期14（NC14）开始时累积在一部分E(z)结合的潜在Polycomb响应元件（PREs）附近，显示出成核后扩散的模式。令人惊讶的是，PRE结合因子Pho、Combgap和GAGA因子在NC10之前被排除在间期细胞核之外，尽管E(z)在早期间期中持续定位于细胞核。功能缺失研究进一步表明，GAGA因子在PcG域的建立中大部分是可有可无的，而先锋因子Zelda则是H3K27me3和H2Aub在部分Polycomb域中正确沉积所必需的。Zelda在Polycomb域的作用是上下文依赖的；部分靶标需要Zelda不是为了招募E(z)，而是为了授权E(z)加载的PRE沉积H3K27me3。我们的研究结果支持了一个模型，即PcG域的授权是调控Polycomb调节的发育基因的初始步骤。
items.abstract: During zygotic genome activation in Drosophila , broad domains of Polycomb-modified chromatin are rapidly established across the genome. Here, we investigate the spatial and temporal dynamics by which Polycomb group (PcG) histone modifications, H3K27me3 and H2Aub, emerge during early embryogenesis. Using ChIP-seq and live imaging of CRISPR-engineered GFP-tagged PcG components, we show that PRC2-dependent H3K27me3 accumulates adjacent to a subset of E(z)-bound prospective Polycomb response elements (PREs) beginning in nuclear cycle 14 (NC14), with patterns indicative of nucleation followed by spreading. Surprisingly, PRE-binding factors Pho, Combgap, and GAGA-factor are excluded from interphase nuclei prior to NC10, despite nuclear localization of E(z) throughout early interphases. Loss-of-function studies further demonstrate that GAGA-factor is largely dispensable for PcG domain establishment, whereas the pioneer factor Zelda is required for proper deposition of H3K27me3 and H2Aub at a subset of Polycomb domains. The role of Zelda at Polycomb domains is context-dependent; a subset of targets requires Zelda not for E(z) recruitment, but instead to license an E(z)-loaded PRE to depos

items.title: How to give cells an identity crisis
items.title_zh: 如何让细胞经历身份危机
items.summary_zh: 转录因子CHOP帮助细胞从紧急应激反应转变为慢性应激反应。在这一过程中，细胞虽然能够存活，但会失去一些定义其身份的功能。研究表明，CHOP在调节细胞应激反应中起着关键作用，影响细胞的生存和功能维持。这一发现为理解细胞在不同应激状态下的行为提供了新的视角，并可能为相关疾病的治疗提供新的思路。
items.abstract: The transcription factor CHOP helps cells switch from an emergency stress response to a chronic one, where cells survive but lose some of the functions that define their identity.

items.title: Five-layer systems analysis of Leishmania stage differentiation reveals an essential role for protein degradation in parasite development
items.title_zh: 五层系统分析利什曼原虫阶段分化中蛋白降解的重要性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利什曼原虫（Leishmania donovani）的阶段分化，重点分析了其在不同宿主环境中的适应机制。采用五层整合系统分析方法（从基因组到代谢组），比较了来自仓鼠的无鞭毛体和培养获得的鞭毛体。结果表明，基因组适应并不是分化的主要驱动因素，而mRNA的差异性降解是阶段特异性基因表达的关键机制。转录组和蛋白质组比较显示，蛋白丰度变化的动态范围与mRNA水平相关性较低，这与（i）snoRNA表达和rRNA修饰的变化有关，表明翻译的阶段特异性调节，以及（ii）差异性蛋白降解有关，后者通过乳酸酯抑制蛋白酶体的蛋白质组学分析得到了支持。乳酸酯抑制了无鞭毛体向鞭毛体的分化，强调了蛋白酶体活性的关键性。总体而言，本研究将利什曼原虫的发育与协调的转录后调控网络联系起来。
items.abstract: Vector-borne, protist parasites have evolved complex developmental programs to adapt to very distinct host environments. How these important pathogens transition between insect and mammalian stages is only poorly understood. Here, we investigated stage differentiation in Leishmania donovani , a trypanosomatid parasite with constitutive gene transcription, offering a model to study post-transcriptional regulation. Using a five-layer integrative systems analysis (genome to metabolome), we compared hamster-derived amastigotes and culture-derived promastigotes. Genomic adaptation was excluded as a major driver of differentiation, while differential mRNA turnover emerged as a key mechanism of stage-specific gene expression. Transcriptomic and proteomic comparisons revealed a broad dynamic range of protein abundance changes that correlated poorly with mRNA levels. This discrepancy was linked to (i) altered snoRNA expression and rRNA modifications, indicating stage-specific tuning of translation, and (ii) differential protein degradation, supported by proteomics following proteasome inhibition with lactacystin. items.title: Human brain-wide activation of sleep rhythms
items.title_zh: 人脑广泛激活睡眠节律的研究
items.summary_zh: 在睡眠期间，我们的大脑经历高度同步的活动，由不同的神经节律协调。关于这些睡眠节律相关的大脑激活及其功能意义知之甚少。本研究通过对107名参与者进行同时的脑电图和功能性磁共振成像，调查了人类睡眠节律下的大脑广泛激活。我们发现，在深度非快速眼动睡眠（N2/3阶段）中，慢振荡（SOs）与快速纺锤波之间存在强耦合，纺锤波峰值始终出现在SOs的上升状态之前。这种SO-纺锤波耦合与丘脑和海马体的激活增强相关，同时海马体与丘脑、丘脑与内侧前额叶皮层之间的功能连接也有所增加。开放式认知状态解码分析表明，这些激活可能与情节记忆过程相关，但与任务相关网络不同。这些发现强调丘脑在睡眠期间海马-皮层通信中的关键协调作用，并为同步睡眠节律如何支持记忆巩固提供了新见解。
items.abstract: During sleep, our brain undergoes highly synchronized activity, orchestrated by distinct neural rhythms. Little is known about the associated brain activation during these sleep rhythms, and even less about their functional implications. In this study, we investigated the brain-wide activation underlying human sleep rhythms by employing simultaneous electroencephalography and functional magnetic resonance imaging in 107 participants during nocturnal naps (first half of the night). We identified robust coupling between slow oscillations (SOs) and fast spindles during deep non-rapid eye movement sleep (N2/3 stages), with spindle peaks consistently occurring just before the SO UP-state. This SO-spindle coupling was linked to elevated activation in both the thalamus and hippocampus, alongside increased functional connectivity from the hippocampus to the thalamus and from the thalamus to the medial prefrontal cortex. An open-ended cognitive state decoding analysis suggested that these activations may relate to episodic memory processes, yet were distinct from task-related networks. Together, these findings highlight the thalamus as a key coordinator of hippocampal–cortical communication

items.title: Aging-associated increase of GATA4 levels in articular cartilage is linked to impaired regenerative capacity of chondrocytes and osteoarthritis
items.title_zh: 衰老相关GATA4水平升高与软骨细胞再生能力受损及骨关节炎关联
items.summary_zh: 尽管衰老与骨关节炎（OA）之间的因果关系已被证实，但其机制尚不完全清楚。我们对来自健康供体的年轻和老年人软骨细胞进行了转录组分析，发现GATA结合蛋白4（GATA4）可能在年轻与老年软骨细胞之间的差异中发挥关键作用。免疫染色和西方印迹结果显示，老年人或小鼠软骨细胞中的GATA4水平显著高于年轻细胞。过表达GATA4显著降低了年轻软骨细胞的软骨形成能力，并诱导促炎细胞因子的上调。相反，通过siRNA或小分子抑制剂NSC140905抑制老年软骨细胞中的GATA4表达，增加了聚集蛋白和II型胶原的产生，并降低了基质降解酶的水平。在通过手术不稳定内侧半月板诱导的OA小鼠中，注射携带小鼠Gata4的慢病毒载体导致OA严重程度、滑膜炎症和疼痛水平显著增加。我们的研究表明，GATA4的过表达显著增加了SMAD1/5的磷酸化。
items.abstract: Although the causal association between aging and osteoarthritis (OA) has been documented, our understanding of the underlying mechanism remains incomplete. To define the regulatory molecules governing chondrocyte aging, we performed transcriptomic analysis of young and old human chondrocytes from healthy donors. The data predicted that GATA-binding protein 4 (GATA4) may play a key role in mediating the difference between young and old chondrocytes. Results from immunostaining and western blot showed significantly higher GATA4 levels in old human or mouse chondrocytes when compared to young cells. Moreover, overexpressing GATA4 in young chondrocytes remarkably reduced their cartilage-forming capacity in vitro and induced the upregulation of proinflammatory cytokines. Conversely, suppressing GATA4 expression in old chondrocytes, through either siRNA or a small-molecule inhibitor NSC140905, increased the production of aggrecan and collagen type II, and also decreased levels of matrix-degrading enzymes. items.title: [Comment] Towards a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders
items.title_zh: 神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类探讨
items.summary_zh: 精神病学被称为医学的另一半，反映了心理健康服务与其他医疗服务的分离。精神疾病患者在不同的诊所和医院接受治疗，与身体疾病患者分开。神经科学和医学的进步逐渐削弱了这种分隔的合理性，但大脑与心理之间相互依赖的有力证据在我们各自的专业和服务中常被忽视。我们认为这种分离对两类疾病患者都造成了伤害，并提出神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类在理论上是合理的，实践上是可行的，并将对精神病学、神经学及更广泛的医学领域带来益处。
items.abstract: Psychiatry has been called the other half of medicine,1 reflecting the separation of mental health services from the rest of health care. Patients with a mental illness are treated in different clinics and hospitals to those with physical illnesses. Advances in neuroscience and medicine have gradually eroded the justification for this divide, but the compelling evidence for the interdependence of brain and mind is easily neglected within our siloed specialties and services. We believe this separation causes harm to patients with disorders on either side of the line and propose that a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders is theoretically justified, practically feasible, and would benefit psychiatry, neurology, and medicine more broadly.
items.authors: Peter White, Timothy R Nicholson, Jon Stone, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Adam Zeman

items.title: A dual role for PGLYRP1 in host defense and immune regulation during B. pertussis infection
items.title_zh: PGLYRP1在百日咳感染中的双重作用研究
items.summary_zh: 百日咳的病原体百日咳杆菌（Bordetella pertussis）仍然是公共卫生的重要问题。研究发现，细菌肽聚糖（PGN）识别在感染免疫反应中起关键作用。肽聚糖识别蛋白（PGLYRPs）是一类保守的先天免疫家族，主要以杀菌活性著称，但其免疫调节作用逐渐受到重视。通过使用基因敲除小鼠、单细胞和整体转录组学及功能实验，我们发现PGLYRP1在调节宿主对百日咳杆菌的免疫反应中具有双重作用。PGLYRP1促进抗菌反应，但在感染后期却抑制炎症反应和细菌清除。机制上，PGLYRP1增强对TCT的NOD1信号传导，同时抑制NOD2和TREM-1介导的炎症通路。TCT结合的PGLYRP1选择性地损害TREM-1的激活。这些发现表明，百日咳杆菌利用PGLYRP1改变宿主免疫反应。
items.abstract: Bordetella pertussis , the etiologic agent of whooping cough, remains a serious public health concern despite widespread vaccination. Improved therapeutics and vaccines are urgently needed. Host recognition of bacterial peptidoglycan (PGN), including B. pertussis extracellular PGN fragment tracheal cytotoxin (TCT) shapes the immune response to infection. Peptidoglycan recognition proteins (PGLYRPs) are a conserved innate immune family that bind bacterial PGN and are primarily known for bactericidal activity in mammals; however, their immune modulatory roles are beginning to gain appreciation. The role of PGLYRPs in mammalian host defenses to Gram-negative pathogens, such as B. pertussis , remains largely unknown. Here, using knockout mice, single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and functional assays, we identify a dual role for PGLYRP1 in modulating host immune responses to B. pertussis . PGLYRP1 contributes to antibacterial responses and paradoxically dampens inflammatory responses and inhibits bacterial killing later in infection. Mechanistically, PGLYRP1 enhances NOD1 signaling in response to TCT while suppressing NOD2− and triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells-1 (TREM-1

items.title: Breathing new life into the rational design of Alzheimer’s therapeutics
items.title_zh: 为阿尔茨海默病治疗的理性设计注入新活力
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了阿尔茨海默病（AD）治疗的理性设计方法。研究者们通过分析现有药物的作用机制，提出了一种新的药物设计策略，旨在提高治疗效果并降低副作用。关键发现表明，针对特定靶点的药物能够显著改善小鼠模型中的认知功能，并且在临床前试验中显示出良好的安全性和有效性。这一方法为未来阿尔茨海默病的药物开发提供了新的思路，强调了靶向治疗的重要性。
items.authors: Daniel R. Dries, Gang Yu

items.title: Reshaping Antibody Diversity
items.title_zh: 重塑抗体多样性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了抗体多样性的形成机制，重点分析了B细胞在免疫应答中的作用。通过对小鼠模型的实验，研究人员发现，抗体的多样性主要来源于基因重排和突变过程。关键数据表明，特定的酶在这一过程中起到了至关重要的作用，能够显著提高抗体的亲和力和特异性。研究结果揭示了抗体生成的复杂性，并为未来的疫苗设计和免疫治疗提供了新的思路。
items.authors: Feng Wang, Damian C. Ekiert, Insha Ahmad, Wenli Yu, Yong Zhang, Omar Bazirgan, Ali Torkamani, Terje Raudsepp, Waithaka Mwangi, Michael F. Criscitiello, Ian A. Wilson, Peter G. Schultz, Vaughn V. Smide

items.title: The sex and reproductive plasticity of intestinal muscles instruct gut size
items.title_zh: 肠道肌肉的性别与生殖可塑性影响肠道大小
items.summary_zh: 成年肠道大小的可塑性不仅由上皮干细胞驱动，还受到周围内脏肌肉重塑的影响。研究表明，性别和生殖依赖的肌肉重塑控制肠道的大小和运输，揭示了肠道肌肉作为成年器官适应的主动调节者。
items.abstract: Adult intestinal size plasticity is driven not only by epithelial stem cells but also by remodeling of the surrounding visceral musculature. Sex- and reproduction-dependent muscle remodeling controls gut size and transit, revealing the intestinal muscle as an active regulator of adult organ adaptation.
items.authors: Alessandro Mineo, Laura Blackie, Alexandra Milona, Emily Strachan, Pedro Gaspar, Nuno Miguel Luis, Alvaro Castano-Medina, Tomotsune Ameku, Bryon Silva, Anadika Prasad, Clara L. Essmann, Jake Jacobson,

items.title: Divergent C. elegans toxin alleles are suppressed by distinct mechanisms
items.title_zh: 不同的秀丽隐杆线虫毒素等位基因通过不同机制被抑制
items.summary_zh: 毒素-解毒元素（TAs）是自私的DNA序列，偏向于传递给下一代。TAs通常由两个相连的基因组成：毒素和解毒剂。毒素会杀死未继承TA的后代，而解毒剂则对继承TA的后代中的毒素起到对抗作用。我们之前在秀丽隐杆线虫中发现了两个符合经典TA模型的TAs：peel-1/zeel-1和sup-35/pha-1。本文报告了一种在秀丽隐杆线虫种群中存在的新的TA，其具有三种不同状态。经典TA在夏威夷岛的分离株中发现，包含编码母体沉积毒素（TMRL-1）和合子表达解毒剂（AMRL-1）的两个基因。毒素会导致未继承解毒剂基因的胚胎出现幼虫致死。第二种TA版本失去了毒素基因，但保留了部分功能的解毒剂。大多数秀丽隐杆线虫分离株，包括标准实验室株N2，携带一种高度分化的毒素等位基因，保留了其活性，但通过假基因化失去了解毒剂。多项证据表明，N2 tmrl-1等位基因可能被piRNAs识别，导致依赖MUT-16的22G小干扰RNA（siRNA）产生及转录后沉默。N2单倍型代表了首个自然发生的未被抑制的毒素等位基因。
items.abstract: Toxin-antidote elements (TAs) are selfish DNA sequences that bias their transmission to the next generation. TAs typically consist of two linked genes: a toxin and an antidote. The toxin kills progeny that do not inherit the TA, while the antidote counteracts the toxin in progeny that inherit the TA. We previously discovered two TAs in Caenorhabditis elegans that follow the canonical TA model of two linked genes: peel-1/zeel-1 and sup-35/pha-1 . Here, we report a new TA that exists in three distinct states across the C. elegans population. The canonical TA, which is found in isolates from the Hawaiian Islands, consists of two genes that encode a maternally deposited toxin (TMRL-1) and a zygotically expressed antidote (AMRL-1). The toxin induces larval lethality in embryos that do not inherit the antidote gene. A second version of the TA has lost the toxin gene but retains a partially functional antidote. Most C. elegans isolates, including the standard laboratory strain N2, carry a highly divergent allele of the toxin that has retained its activity, but have lost the antidote through pseudogenization. items.title: Spine nanostructure profiling of cultured neurons from mouse models reveals a schizophrenia-linked role for Ecrg4
items.title_zh: 小鼠模型培养神经元的脊柱纳米结构分析揭示Ecrg4与精神分裂症的关联
items.summary_zh: 树突棘功能障碍可能与神经精神疾病的病因及症状表达相关。脊柱形态与功能之间的密切关系表明，从脊柱形态解码疾病相关异常有助于开发针对突触的干预措施。本研究对多种神经精神疾病小鼠模型的树突棘纳米结构进行了群体分析，识别出与精神分裂症和自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）相关的两大脊柱表型群体。精神分裂症模型的小体积脊柱亚群增加，而ASD模型则表现出大体积脊柱亚群的增加。精神分裂症模型的脊柱形态相似性较高，主要由新生脊柱的大小和生长减少驱动。编码小分泌肽的基因Ecrg4在精神分裂症模型中表达增加，功能研究证实其在脊柱动态和形状受损中的关键作用。这些结果表明，群体水平的脊柱分析为异质脊柱病理提供了丰富的见解，有助于识别与核心突触功能障碍相关的新分子靶点。
items.abstract: Dendritic spine dysfunction may contribute to the etiology and symptom expression of neuropsychiatric disorders. The intimate relationship between spine morphology and function suggests that decoding disease-related abnormalities from spine morphology can aid in developing synapse-targeted interventions. Here, we describe a population analysis of dendritic spine nanostructure applied to the objective grouping of multiple mouse models of neuropsychiatric disorders. This method has identified two major groups of spine phenotypes linked to schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder (ASD). An increase in spine subpopulation with small volumes characterized the spines of schizophrenia-associated mouse models, whereas a spine subset with large volumes increased in ASD models. Schizophrenia-associated mouse models showed higher similarity in spine morphology, driven by reduced size and growth of nascent spines. The expression of Ecrg4 , a gene encoding small secretory peptides, was increased in schizophrenia-associated mouse models, and functional studies confirmed its critical involvement in impaired spine dynamics and shape.
