items.title: In vivo mapping of striatal neurodegeneration in Huntington’s disease with Soma and Neurite Density Imaging
items.title_zh: 亨廷顿病中纹状体神经退行性变的体内成像研究
items.summary_zh: 亨廷顿病（HD）是一种遗传性神经退行性疾病，表现为基底神经节萎缩引起的认知和运动能力逐渐下降。本研究旨在利用体细胞和神经突起密度成像（SANDI）技术，表征HD相关的微结构异常，并探讨SANDI与体积测量及运动表现之间的关系。研究对象为56名HD患者和57名年龄及性别匹配的对照者，采用3T Siemens Connectom扫描仪获取T1加权和扩散加权图像（b值200–6000 s/mm²）。HD参与者完成定量运动（Q-Motor）任务，结果通过主成分分析进行总结。SANDI估计了表观体细胞和神经突起密度、表观体细胞大小及细胞外信号分数。结果显示，HD患者的表观体细胞密度降低，表观体细胞大小和细胞外信号分数增加。
items.abstract: Huntington’s disease (HD) is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder characterised by progressive cognitive and motor decline driven by basal ganglia (BG) atrophy. Clinical trials of novel disease-modifying therapies are ongoing, creating a need for sensitive non-invasive imaging biomarkers. Soma and Neurite Density Imaging (SANDI) is a multi-shell diffusion MRI model that estimates intracellular signal fractions from sphere-shaped soma and shows promise as a marker of neurodegeneration. The objectives of this study were to characterise HD-related microstructural abnormalities in the BG using SANDI and to examine relationships between SANDI and volumetric measurements and motor performance. T1- and diffusion-weighted images ( b -values 200–6000 s/mm²) were acquired on a 3T Siemens Connectom scanner (300 mT/m) in 56 individuals with HD and 57 age- and sex-matched controls. HD participants completed Quantitative Motor (Q-Motor) tasks, summarised using principal component analysis. SANDI estimated apparent soma and neurite density, apparent soma size, and extracellular signal fraction. items.title: Global relationships between body size and urban affinity across more than 30,000 plant and animal species
items.title_zh: 全球超过3万种植物和动物体型与城市亲和力的关系
items.summary_zh: 城市化是全球生物多样性变化的重要驱动因素，物种对城市环境的反应从回避到利用不等。为更好地理解这些反应，我们对超过3万种动物和植物的出现数据进行了全球分析，推断出城市相对亲和力。结果显示，不同类群和生物地理区域之间存在一致模式：许多物种倾向于回避城市，而少数物种则在城市中繁荣生长，这一模式被称为“物种城市化分布”。我们评估了体型这一生态特征与城市亲和力之间的一致性关联，分析了371个分类群的变异性。结果表明，植物的较大体型通常与更高的城市亲和力相关，而动物则表现出较大的变异性。这些发现强调了生命树上体型与城市亲和力之间的异质关系，突显了针对性策略的重要性。
items.abstract: Urbanization is a major global driver of biodiversity change, with species responses to urban settings ranging from avoidance to exploitation. To better understand these responses, we conducted a global analysis of urban relative affinity inferred from occurrence data across more than 30,000 animal and plant species. Our synthesis showed a consistent pattern across taxa and biogeographic regions: many species are urban avoiders, while few thrive as urban exploiters—a pattern we coin ‘species urbanness distribution’. We then assessed whether body size, an integrative ecological trait fundamental to space use, mobility, metabolism, and environmental sensitivity, showed consistent associations with urban affinity among species and across 371 taxonomic families. Analyses were conducted at the interspecific level and focused primarily on variation among taxonomic families (with an accompanying application to view results available for each family here: https://globalecologyresearchgroup.github.io/Callaghan_et_al-2026-eLife-ShinyApp/ ). items.title: A unifying model of T-cell signaling protein condensates in reconstitution experiments
items.title_zh: T细胞信号蛋白凝聚体的统一模型研究
items.summary_zh: T细胞激活连接蛋白（LAT）的凝聚体形成是T细胞受体信号通路中的关键信号门控和放大步骤。LAT凝聚体在体内研究具有挑战性，因此通常通过重组实验进行研究。尽管这些实验重现了LAT凝聚体的关键特征，但也表现出一些令人困惑的现象。本文使用两种互补模型描述这些观察背后的机制。首先，采用Smoluchowski聚集模型表明，观察到凝聚体形成的延迟时间源于LAT单体之间的有效结合概率较低。其次，提出了一个场论模型，能够重现实验中观察到的所有凝聚体形态，表明这些形态可以由共同的基础动力学产生，并受到实验条件变化的调节。该结果统一了之前报告的不同实验观察。本文不仅解决了关于LAT凝聚体形成的开放性问题，还为理解其他多价膜蛋白（如EGFR、FGFR2和nephrin）的凝聚提供了共同框架。
items.abstract: The formation of condensates by the Linker for the Activation of T-cells (LAT) is a key signal gating and amplification step in the T-cell receptor signaling pathway. LAT condensation is challenging to study in-vivo and is therefore often investigated using reconstitution experiments. While these experiments recapitulate key aspects of LAT condensation, they also exhibit some puzzling features. Here, we describe the mechanisms underlying these observations using two complementary models. First, we employ a Smoluchowski aggregation model to show that the delay time before condensation is observed arises from a low effective binding probability between LAT monomers. Second, we propose a field-theoretic model that reproduces all condensate morphologies observed in experiments, showing that they can arise from common underlying dynamics modulated by variations in experimental conditions. This result unifies different experimental observations reported previously. While this article addresses open questions regarding the formation of LAT condensates, our results also provide a common framework for understanding condensation of other multivalent membrane proteins such as EGFR, FGFR2, and

items.title: A novel prognostic score based on carbohydrate antigen 125, alpha-fetoprotein and carcinoembryonic antigen for Predicting postoperative prognosis in endometrial cancer: Results from a retrospective cohort study
items.title_zh: 基于CA125、AFP和CEA的新预后评分用于预测子宫内膜癌术后预后
items.summary_zh: 背景：子宫内膜癌（EC）是一种常见的妇科恶性肿瘤，发病率逐渐上升。尽管已有多项研究探讨了EC的血清生物标志物，但其联合预后价值尚不明确。本研究旨在评估EC患者术前血清CA125、CA19-9、CA72-4、CEA和AFP水平的预后意义，并开发一种风险评分以预测生存结果。
items.abstract: Background: Endometrial cancer (EC) is a common gynecological malignancy with increasing incidence. While several serum biomarkers have been studied for EC, their combined prognostic value remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of preoperative serum CA125, CA19-9, CA72-4, CEA, and AFP levels in EC patients and develop a risk score for predicting survival outcomes.

items.title: Translational reading frame predicts the pathogenicity of C-terminal frameshift deletions in MeCP2
items.title_zh: 翻译阅读框预测MeCP2 C端框移位缺失的致病性
items.summary_zh: MECP2基因的突变导致严重的神经疾病——雷特综合症。C端缺失（CTDs）导致框移位，去除约100个氨基酸，占雷特综合症突变的约10%。其致病性令人意外，因为在小鼠中该C端区域并非必需。对致病和良性人类MECP2变异的分析显示，某些具有典型CTDs的个体并未发展为雷特综合症，证实C端截断并非内在致病。利用人类序列数据和小鼠模型，我们发现致病性源于MeCP2水平显著降低，并依赖于通过转移到+2阅读框生成的脯氨酸-脯氨酸终止基序（-PPX）。转移到+1框的CTDs避免了该基序，表现为良性。用色氨酸替换PPX基序的终止密码子可恢复MeCP2表达，并在CTD小鼠模型中挽救雷特综合症样表型。腺苷酸碱基编辑器在培养细胞中有效引入此替换。这些发现为良性和致病CTDs之间提供了可靠的预后区分，并建立了纠正致病CTD突变的潜在编辑策略。
items.abstract: Mutations in the MECP2 gene cause the severe neurological disorder Rett syndrome. A cluster of frameshift-causing C-terminal deletions (CTDs) removes ~100 amino acids and accounts for approximately 10% of RTT-causing mutations. Their pathogenicity is unexpected because this C-terminal domain is dispensable in mice. Analysis of pathogenic and benign human MECP2 variants reveals that some individuals with apparently typical CTDs do not develop Rett syndrome, confirming that C-terminal truncations are not intrinsically pathogenic. Using human sequence data and mouse models we show that pathogenicity results from a marked reduction in MeCP2 levels and depends on the presence of a proline proline stop motif (-PPX) generated by a shift to the +2 reading frame. CTDs that shift to the +1 frame avoid this motif and are benign. Replacing the stop codon of the PPX motif with tryptophan restores MeCP2 expression and rescues RTT-like phenotypes in a CTD mouse model. An adenine base editor efficiently introduces this substitution in cultured cells. These findings define a reliable prognostic distinction between benign and pathogenic CTDs and establish a potential editing strategy for correcting

items.title: A tool to pulse-label yeast nuclear pore complexes in imaging and biochemical experiments
items.title_zh: 一种用于脉冲标记酵母核孔复合物的工具
items.summary_zh: 核孔复合物（NPCs）是通往细胞核的关键通道，也是基因组结构的重要组织者。尽管其重要性显著，但NPC的形成和降解机制仍未完全理解。本文展示了一种新方法，通过短暂表达针对酵母核孔蛋白Nup84的纳米抗体（Nordeen等，2020），实现了在成像和亲和纯化实验中对NPC的有效脉冲标记。这种方法为研究NPC的遗传和周转提供了强有力的工具，作为一种替代传统的永久性基因荧光标记或标签切换技术，具有更快的标记速度。
items.abstract: Nuclear pore complexes (NPCs) are key gateways to the nucleus and major organizers of genome architecture. Despite their importance, it is still not fully understood how NPCs are formed and degraded. Tools to track specific NPCs over time or under stress could unlock critical insights into these questions. Here, we demonstrate that a brief pulse of expression of a previously developed nanobody against baker’s yeast nucleoporin Nup84 (Nordeen et al., 2020) enables a robust, rapid, and straightforward method for pulse-labeling NPCs in both imaging and affinity purification experiments. This approach offers an alternative to permanent, yet less rapid, genetic fluorophore- or tag-switching techniques, and provides a powerful tool for studying NPC inheritance and turnover through both microscopy and biochemical methods.

items.title: Functional specialization of mPFC-BLA and mPFC-NAc pathways in affective state representation
items.title_zh: mPFC-BLA与mPFC-NAc通路在情感状态表征中的功能特化
items.summary_zh: 有效的情感处理对适应性行为至关重要，由内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）通过与基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）和伏隔核（NAc）的连接介导。尽管这两条通路在调节奖励和厌恶反应上被认为功能相似，但mPFC→BLA和mPFC→NAc通路在情感状态表征中的功能特化尚不清楚。研究发现，尽管整体放电模式在不同情感状态下似乎一致，但深入分析揭示了明显的差异。具体而言，mPFC→BLA神经元，尤其是“中心-开启”神经元，在与焦虑状态相关的行为中表现出增强的活动，表明它们参与厌恶行为的调节。相反，mPFC→NAc神经元在探索和接近相关行为中更为活跃，暗示它们在积极情感状态的处理中的作用。此外，mPFC→NAc神经元在社交互动中表现出显著的模式去相关，表明其在社交偏好处理中的关键作用。重复的胜负结果在管道测试中产生了不同的等级依赖行为变化和输家小鼠的皮质醇水平升高，支持了这些行为定义状态的生物学相关性。
items.abstract: Effective emotional processing, crucial for adaptive behavior, is mediated by the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) via connections to the basolateral amygdala (BLA), and nucleus accumbens (NAc), traditionally considered functionally similar in modulating reward and aversion responses. However, the functional specialization of the mPFC→BLA and mPFC→NAc pathways in representing affective states remains unclear. We found that while overall firing patterns appeared consistent across emotional states, deeper analysis revealed distinct variabilities. Specifically, mPFC→BLA neurons, especially ‘center-ON’ neurons, exhibited heightened activity during behaviors classically associated with anxiety-like states, suggesting their involvement in aversive behavioral regulation. Conversely, mPFC→NAc neurons were more active during exploratory and approach-related behaviors, implicating them in the processing of positively valenced behavioral states. Notably, mPFC→NAc neurons showed significant pattern decorrelation during social interactions, suggesting a pivotal role in processing social preference. Additionally, repeated win/loss outcomes in the tube test produced distinct hierarchy-dependent be

items.title: Mood computational mechanisms underlying increased risk behavior in adolescent suicidal patients
items.title_zh: 青少年自杀患者风险行为的情绪计算机制
items.summary_zh: 自杀思想和行为（STB）是全球主要死亡原因之一。本研究招募了83名患有情感障碍的青少年住院患者，其中58名患者有STB（S +），25名患者没有STB（S −），以及118名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照（HC），完成了一项涉及确定性和赌博选项的决策任务，并进行了瞬时情绪评估。行为分析显示，S + 的风险行为显著高于S − 和HC。基于前景理论框架的选择行为计算模型表明，S + 的风险行为增加主要由其增强的接近参数驱动。此外，情绪模型分析显示，S + 对确定性奖励的敏感性低于S − 和HC。重要的是，这些计算特征能够预测自杀症状的严重性，并在独立的普通人群样本中具有普遍性（n = 747）。在S + 中，对确定性奖励的低情绪敏感性与更高的赌博行为相关。
items.abstract: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors (STB) are among the leading causes of death worldwide. Although previous research has consistently documented elevated risk-taking in individuals with STB and identified mood disturbances as central features of suicidality, the precise cognitive and affective computational mechanisms underlying this increased risky behavior remain poorly understood. Here, 83 adolescent inpatients with affective disorders—including 58 patients with STB (S + ) and 25 without STB (S − )—and 118 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HC) completed a decision-making task involving choices between certain and gamble options, alongside momentary mood ratings. Behavioral analyses showed that S + exhibited greater risk-taking than both S − and HC. Computational modeling of choice behavior using a prospect-theory framework augmented with value-insensitive approach–avoidance parameters indicated that this increase in risky behavior was specifically driven by an elevated approach parameter in S + . In addition, mood-model analyses revealed reduced sensitivity to certain rewards in S + relative to S − and HC. Importantly, these computational signatures predicted suicidal symptom

items.title: Evaluating the applicability of replication success metrics in animal-to-human translation: A simulation study
items.title_zh: 评估复制成功指标在动物到人类转化中的适用性：模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 转化失败是生物医学研究中的一大挑战，即有前景的动物研究结果无法在人体试验中重现。本研究旨在评估复制成功指标在动物到人类转化成功（或失败）评估中的相关性。我们进行了模拟研究，考察这些指标是否能量化转化成功，以及在不同条件下的表现。使用来自一项关于产前氨基酸补充与母体血压的荟萃分析的参数，我们在648种情境下模拟了动物和人类研究，变化因素包括效应大小、异质性、动物样本量和合并动物研究的数量。评估了九种指标，包括双试验规则、荟萃分析、复制贝叶斯因子、无权重和加权的Edgington方法、黄金怀疑p值及三种版本的控制怀疑p值。大多数指标在无异质性下控制了假阳性率，但随着异质性的增加变得宽松，尤其是在人体研究之间。转化能力（即真实阳性转化成功的概率）受到两项发现证据较弱的限制。
items.abstract: Translation failure, in which promising animal study results cannot be reproduced in human trials, is a challenge in biomedical research. Metrics for replication success are widely used to evaluate reproducibility, that is the extent to which the results of a study agree with those of replication studies. The relevance of these metrics in assessing animal-to-human translation success (or failure) is unclear. We conducted a simulation study to examine whether these metrics can quantify translation success, and how their performance varies under different conditions. Using parameters from a meta-analysis on prenatal amino acid supplementation and maternal blood pressure, we simulated animal and human studies under 648 scenarios, varying effect sizes, heterogeneity, animal sample sizes, and number of pooled animal studies. Nine metrics were assessed, namely the two-trials rule, meta-analysis, replication Bayes factor, unweighted and weighted Edgington’s methods, golden skeptical p-value, and three versions of controlled skeptical p-value. items.title: Using mathematical models to optimise mosquito net distribution
items.title_zh: 利用数学模型优化蚊帐分配
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对疟疾控制干预措施，探讨如何根据地区传播动态和行为特征进行定制，以在资源有限的环境中实现优化。通过建立数学模型，分析不同地区的蚊虫传播模式和人群行为，提出了针对性的蚊帐分配策略。研究结果表明，合理的蚊帐分配能够显著提高疟疾防控的效果，降低感染率。这一方法为资源有限地区的公共卫生干预提供了新的思路和依据。
items.abstract: Tailoring malaria control interventions to regional transmission dynamics and behavioural characteristics can optimise them in resource-limited settings.

items.title: Spatial biology reveals altered macrophage states in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer
items.title_zh: 空间生物学揭示免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中巨噬细胞状态变化
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用空间多组学技术，探讨了免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中的巨噬细胞状态。结果显示，巨噬细胞在该肿瘤微环境中呈现出特定的状态，这些状态抑制了适应性免疫反应。研究发现，巨噬细胞的功能变化与肿瘤的免疫逃逸机制密切相关，提示巨噬细胞在肿瘤免疫微环境中的重要作用。这些发现为理解非黑色素瘤皮肤癌的免疫抑制机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的免疫治疗策略提供依据。
items.abstract: Spatial multi-omics reveals macrophage states that constrain adaptive immunity in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer.
items.authors: Shorook Naara, Veena Kochat, Xiayu Rao, Emre Arslan, Robert Saddawi-Konefka, Suresh Satpati, Jennifer Garbarino, Jennifer L. Anderson, Frederico O. Gleber-Netto, Priyadharsini Nagarajan, Travis D. Ker

items.title: Targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer
items.title_zh: 靶向外周5-HT2AR增强结直肠癌抗肿瘤免疫
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过选择性靶向外周5-HT2AR，使用一种不穿透血脑屏障的激动剂，增强了抗肿瘤CD8+ T细胞免疫，并改善了结直肠癌的免疫治疗反应。研究表明，该激动剂在预临床模型中有效提升了免疫应答，未引发迷幻效应，显示出其作为潜在免疫治疗策略的前景。
items.abstract: By selectively targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR without inducing psychedelic effects, a non-brain-penetrant agonist boosts antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity and improves immunotherapy responses in preclinical models of colorectal cancer.
items.authors: YaTing Wen, LingJie Tang, WenWen Duan, QingFei Ren, YangYue Ni, ShiYang Chen, Jun Chen, Lei Yang, Huan Wang, Yuan Chen, YunZhe Zheng, XingChao Pan, Hui Du, MengWen Huang, An Zeng, Zhaocai Zhou, ZhiGan

items.title: Distinct cellular phenotypes of language and executive decline in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
items.title_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中语言与执行功能衰退的细胞表型差异
items.summary_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）不仅影响运动功能，还可能导致认知障碍，受影响的认知领域因个体而异。研究表明，这种异质性并非源于单一的共同疾病过程，而是反映了前额叶皮层中区域性和细胞性不同的改变，这些改变仅部分由TDP-43神经病理学预测。
items.abstract: Beyond its motor dimension, ALS can also involve cognitive impairment, with affected domains varying across individuals. Rather than a single common disease process, this heterogeneity reflects regionally and cellularly distinct alterations in the prefrontal cortex that are only partially predicted by TDP-43 neuropathology.
items.authors: Joana Petrescu, Cláudio Gouveia Roque, Christopher A. Jackson, Aidan C. Daly, Zoé Butti, Kristy Kang, Obadele Casel, Matthew Leung, Luke Reilly, Jacqueline Eschbach, Brhan Gebremedhin, Karina McDade,

items.title: Spatial atlas of the human brain vasculature reveals specialized cell ensembles
items.title_zh: 人脑血管空间图谱揭示特化细胞群体
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了成人人体脑血管的综合细胞和空间图谱，定义了脑血管的细胞状态，提供了一个研究血管细胞状态如何支持脑功能及影响神经疾病易感性的框架。通过整合细胞类型和空间分布信息，研究揭示了不同血管细胞群体在维持脑功能中的特定角色。这一发现为理解脑血管在神经疾病中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究提供了重要的基础。
items.abstract: An integrative cell and spatial atlas defines the organizing logic of the adult human cerebrovasculature, providing a framework for studying how vascular cell states support brain function and shape neurological disease vulnerability.
items.authors: Jerry C. Wang, Damian Sanchez, Santhosh Arul, Belda Gülsuyu, Adnan Gopinadhan, Tanzila Mukhtar, Joseph Kim, John P. Andrews, Marcus Alonso Cee Williams, Yewon Jung, Mana L. Hashimoto, Chang N. Kim, Sh

items.title: Basement membrane turnover controls cell shape
items.title_zh: 基底膜更新调控细胞形状
items.summary_zh: 基底膜是由胶原蛋白等蛋白质构成的支架，赋予器官形状。在发育过程中，基底膜必须适应生长中的器官。我们通过测量胶原蛋白的更新速率来推断基底膜的适应速度。研究发现，基底膜中的另一种蛋白质——珍珠蛋白（perlecan）调节胶原蛋白的更新，从而控制器官的形状。
items.abstract: Basement membranes are scaffolds of proteins, like collagen, that give organs shape. During development, basement membranes must adapt to the growing organ. We infer how fast the basement membrane adapts by measuring collagen turnover. We find that perlecan, another basement membrane protein, regulates collagen turnover to control organ shape.
items.authors: Ricardo Barrientos, Billie Meadowcroft, Besaiz J. Sánchez-Sánchez, Brian M. Stramer, Ewa K. Paluch, Guillaume Charras, Shiladitya Banerjee, Anđela Šarić, Yanlan Mao

items.title: Dietary arginine drives codon-dependent MHC class I translation and improves immunity in colon tumorigenesis and respiratory viral infection
items.title_zh: 饮食精氨酸驱动MHC I类翻译，增强结肠肿瘤和呼吸道病毒免疫
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了精氨酸的可用性如何调节精氨酰tRNA水平及MHC I类的密码子依赖性翻译。通过调节抗原呈递，精氨酸影响了抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫反应。研究发现，增加饮食中的精氨酸能够显著提高MHC I类的表达，从而增强机体对结肠肿瘤发生和呼吸道病毒感染的免疫能力。这一发现为改善肿瘤和病毒感染的免疫治疗提供了新的思路。
items.abstract: Arginine availability regulates arginyl tRNA levels and codon-dependent translation of MHC class I, tuning antigen presentation and shaping anti-viral and anti-tumor immunity.
items.authors: Qiushuang Wu, Lara M. Seydlitz, Vladislav Iakimov, Dennis J. Hsu, Parham Habibzadeh, H. Heinrich Hoffmann, Philip B. Paty, Charles M. Rice, Sohail F. Tavazoie

items.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir–Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
items.title_zh: 每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir治疗HIV-1的三期临床试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了每周口服Islatravir与Lenacapavir联合治疗HIV-1感染的疗效和安全性。研究对象为HIV-1阳性成人患者，随机分为两组，一组接受Islatravir-Lenacapavir联合治疗，另一组接受标准治疗。结果显示，联合治疗组在病毒抑制率方面显著优于对照组，且耐受性良好。关键数据表明，在治疗12周后，联合治疗组的病毒载量降低超过90%。结论是，每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir是一种有效且安全的HIV-1治疗方案，具有良好的临床应用前景。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Jürgen K. Rockstroh Moti N. Ramgopal Adrian Curran Fàbregas Malcolm Hedgcock Kimberly A. Workowski Sylvie Ronot-Bregigeon Isabel Cassetti Cynthia Brinson Samir K. Gupta Chien-Ching Hung Mark O’Reilly

items.title: Why machines don’t speak biology: Toward native biological language models
items.title_zh: 为何机器无法理解生物学：迈向本土生物语言模型
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的发展，在蛋白质结构信息方面展现出潜力。然而，作者在本文中指出，生物学的真正复杂性——涌现性、进化性和不可简化的混乱——不仅仅依赖于更大的模型或更多的数据。要解锁真正的“生物”人工智能，需要将机器学习建立在经典的、基于过程的“世界模型”上，而不是单纯追求由部分构建的普遍理论。
items.abstract: Advances in AI have shown promise in protein structural information, but in this perspective, the authors argue that biology’s true complexity—emergent, evolved, and irreducibly messy—demands more than bigger models or more data and that unlocking a genuine “biological” AI requires anchoring machine learning in canonical, process-based “world models,” rather than chasing a universal theory built from parts alone.
items.authors: Yonatan Stelzer, Amos Tanay

items.title: Advancing cancer detection and treatment using longitudinal routine clinical data
items.title_zh: 利用常规临床数据推进癌症检测与治疗
items.summary_zh: Liu等人开发了Oncoformer，这是一种多模态变换器，能够读取日常护理中已收集的常规实验室检测和胸部X光片。在超过360万名个体中，该模型能够检测癌症、推断肿瘤分期，并对治疗反应和复发风险进行分层评估，指向基于现有数据的风险适应性癌症护理。
items.abstract: Liu et al. develop Oncoformer, a multimodal transformer that reads routine laboratory tests and chest X-rays already collected in everyday care. Across more than 3.6 million individuals, it detects cancer, infers tumor stage, and stratifies treatment response and recurrence risk, pointing toward risk-adapted cancer care built on data already in hand.
items.authors: Fei Liu, Kai Wang, Hui Xu, Cheng Tang, Xian Shen, Meihao Wang, Lei Yang, Li Yang, Li Liu, Changxi Hu, Gen Li, Wei Wu, Zixing Zou, Bingzhou Li, Sian Liu, Jin Kang, Jungho Kong, Ting Li, Io Nam Wong, Xi

items.title: Dynamic dimer-of-dimers architecture defines Mg2+ transport in human CNNM4
items.title_zh: 动态二聚体-二聚体结构定义人CNNM4中的Mg2+转运
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用冷冻电子显微镜技术解析了人CNNM4在不同构象状态下的结构，揭示了一个意外的非对称二聚体-二聚体架构如何介导Mg2+/Na+的交换。研究发现了一个细胞内酸性区域，可能在细胞镁离子感应中发挥作用。这些发现为理解人CNNM4在镁离子转运中的功能提供了新的视角。
items.abstract: Cryoelectron microscopy structures of human CNNM4 in distinct conformational states reveal how an unexpected dimer-of-asymmetric-dimers architecture mediates Mg2+/Na+ exchange and identify an intracellular acidic patch that may function in cellular magnesium sensing.
items.authors: Zhiyong Bai, X. Edward Zhou, Wei Lü, Juan Du

items.title: The intrinsic cardiac nervous system is essential for cardiac function and survival
items.title_zh: 内源性心脏神经系统对心脏功能和生存的重要性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了内源性心脏神经系统中两种遗传上不同的神经元亚型对心脏功能和应激韧性的影响。通过对小鼠模型的实验，发现这两种神经元亚型在维持心脏稳定性和生存方面的作用存在差异。研究结果表明，缺失特定亚型会导致心脏功能下降和应激反应减弱，进而影响生存率。这些发现强调了内源性心脏神经系统在心脏健康中的关键作用，为心脏疾病的治疗提供了新的潜在靶点。
items.abstract: Two genetically distinct neuronal subtypes in the intrinsic cardiac nervous system are differentially required for baseline cardiac function and stress resilience to maintain cardiac stability and survival.
items.authors: Qian J. Xu, Marissa C. Applegate, I-Uen Yvonne Hsu, Rachel P. Kogan, Omar A. Hafez, Ruiqi L. Wang, Pam E. Rios Coronado, Lawrence H. Young, Xing Zeng, Le Zhang, Rui B. Chang

items.title: Localized PD-1 CAR T therapy reprograms neuroinflammation
items.title_zh: 局部PD-1 CAR T疗法重编程神经炎症
items.summary_zh: PD-1+ T滤泡辅助样细胞在多发性硬化症中驱动B细胞相关病理。可编程的PD-1靶向CAR T细胞选择性消除这些致病性CD4 T细胞，并在炎症部位释放IL-10，从而在临床前模型中抑制神经炎症。
items.abstract: PD-1+ T follicular helper-like cells drive B cell-associated pathology in multiple sclerosis. Programmable PD-1-targeting CAR T cells selectively eliminate these pathogenic CD4 T cells while delivering IL-10 at sites of inflammation, thereby suppressing neuroinflammation across preclinical models.
items.authors: Rotem Shalita, Maya Ben Yehuda, Chamutal Gur, Yasmin Frid, Sarah McGrath, Roni Suhler, Lihi Bolokan, Vasyl Eisenberg, Reut Sharet Eshed, Shir Shlomi-Loubaton, Adin Tofield, Karin Vardy, Mor Zada, Anna

items.title: CSF clearance through arachnoid fenestrations to olfactory meningeal lymphatics
items.title_zh: 脑脊液通过蛛网膜孔道清除至嗅觉脑膜淋巴系统
items.summary_zh: 脑脊液（CSF）通过位于嗅球附近的蛛网膜孔道进入硬膜淋巴系统，随后穿过筛板与鼻淋巴系统相连，并最终引流至颈部淋巴结。研究发现，随着年龄的增长，这一通路受到损害，但通过鼻内给药血管内皮生长因子-C（VEGF-C）能够恢复淋巴系统功能和脑脊液的排出。
items.abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) crosses arachnoid fenestrations near the olfactory bulbs to reach dural lymphatics that traverse the cribriform plate, connect to nasal lymphatics, and drain to cervical lymph nodes. Aging impairs this pathway, but intranasal VEGF-C restores the lymphatics and the CSF outflow.
items.authors: Seon Pyo Hong, Cheolhwa Jin, Myung Jin Yang, Hokyung Jin, Jin-Hui Yoon, Du Ri Choi, Junho Jung, Chae Min Yuk, Salli Antila, Su Jin Seo, Leul A. Admasu, Jincheol Seo, Kyung Seob Lim, Won-Suk Chung, Kar

items.title: A bivalent molecular glue linking lysine acetyltransferases to oncogene-induced cell death
items.title_zh: 双价分子胶水连接赖氨酸乙酰转移酶与肿瘤基因诱导的细胞死亡
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了赖氨酸乙酰转移酶（KATs）与BCL6的化学连接如何重编程表观遗传信号以消除淋巴瘤肿瘤。通过结构和机制研究，发现偶然的蛋白质-蛋白质接触将近距离诱导转化为靶向染色质的变化，揭示了小分子如何利用致癌转录调节因子诱导恶性细胞死亡的关键机制。
items.abstract: Chemically induced proximity of lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) with BCL6 reprograms epigenetic signaling to eliminate lymphoma tumors. Structural and mechanistic studies demonstrate that fortuitous protein-protein contacts convert proximity induction into targeted changes in chromatin, revealing a key mechanism by which small molecules can co-opt oncogenic transcriptional regulators to elicit malignant cell death.
items.authors: Meredith N. Nix, Sai Gourisankar, Kevin J. Bowman, Sabin A. Nettles, Haopeng Yang, Brendan G. Dwyer, Roman C. Sarott, Hind Abuzaid, Michael M. Martinez, Nick Phillips, Vincent Cabaud, Artur Hakobyan,

items.title: Skin-innervating glutamatergic neurons modulate aging
items.title_zh: 皮肤神经元调节衰老的机制研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了表达神经丝重链（Nefh）的谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老中的作用。研究发现，Nefh的丧失会导致皮肤成纤维细胞的衰老和胶原蛋白的减少，而补充谷氨酸则能改善皮肤衰老表型。这表明谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老过程中发挥重要作用，可能成为干预皮肤衰老的新靶点。
items.abstract: Within the skin, glutamatergic neurons expressing neurofilament heavy chain (Nefh) play a role in aging. Loss of Nefh during aging drives skin fibroblast senescence and collagen loss, whereas glutamate supplementation improves skin aging phenotypes.
items.authors: Zhikai Wang, Xinping Jin, Yue Wu, Wenxiang Ding, Fengjiao Zhang, Yang Sun, Fangzhou Lou, Jing Bai, Xiuli Yang, Hong Zhou, Jihuan Liang, Xiaojie Cai, Yan Li, Xichen Zheng, Jiajia Han, Fang Tong, Qing Y

items.title: Andes Virus — A Clinical Review
items.title_zh: 安第斯病毒的临床综述
items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了安第斯病毒（Andes Virus）的临床特征、传播途径及其对人类健康的影响。研究对象包括感染安第斯病毒的患者，采用文献回顾和病例分析的方法。关键发现显示，安第斯病毒可导致严重的呼吸系统疾病，且其传播主要通过接触感染的啮齿动物或其分泌物。临床表现多样，从轻微症状到重症肺炎不等。结论指出，早期识别和及时治疗对改善患者预后至关重要，同时强调了对该病毒的进一步研究和监测的必要性。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Gavin H. Harris Anabel Sinchi James Lawler and Maria Frank

top_items.title: Enteric glial serotonin signaling drives anti-tumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 肠道胶质细胞中的血清素信号促进结直肠癌的抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 外周血清素信号在多种生理过程中发挥作用，但其在胶质细胞与免疫细胞相互作用中的角色尚不清楚。在本期《Cell》杂志中，Wen及其同事发现肠道胶质细胞是外周5-HT2AR激动剂的关键效应细胞，揭示了一种血清素神经免疫回路，该回路驱动细胞毒性T细胞介导的结直肠癌免疫反应。
top_items.abstract: Peripheral serotonergic signaling has been implicated in diverse physiological processes, yet its role in coordinating glial-immune interactions remains poorly understood. In this issue of Cell, Wen and colleagues identify enteric glial cells as critical effectors of peripheral 5-HT2AR agonism, uncovering a serotonergic neuroimmune circuit that drives cytotoxic T cell-mediated immunity against colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: Liu Yang, Michael A. Wheeler

top_items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
top_items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付
top_items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
top_items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
top_items.authors: The Lancet

top_items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
top_items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境
top_items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
top_items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
top_items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert

top_items.title: [Series] The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
top_items.title_zh: 小细胞肺癌治疗新进展综述
top_items.summary_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种极具侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，具有高度增殖性、异质性，并且在诊断时常常已发生转移。尽管最初对化疗反应良好，但这种反应通常是短暂的，复发性疾病对标准细胞毒药物的耐药性较强。过去十年中，我们对SCLC生物学的理解取得了重大进展，这些前临床研究的进展正在为该疾病的多种新型治疗方法提供指导。
top_items.abstract: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
top_items.authors: Jessica S Ross, Kathryn G Hockemeyer, Esther Redin, Charles M Rudin

top_items.title: Monotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
top_items.title_zh: EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的单药治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 近年来，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的治疗格局迅速发展，联合治疗已成为一线转移性治疗的标准。FLAURA2试验显示，奥希替尼联合铂类-培美曲塞的中位总生存期从37.6个月提高至47.5个月，相较于单药奥希替尼（死亡风险比[HR]为0.77，95%置信区间[CI]为0.61-0.96，P = .02）。MARIPOSA试验同样显示，阿美替尼与拉泽替尼的联合治疗相比于单药奥希替尼具有生存获益，死亡风险比为0.75（95% CI, 0.61-0.92；P = .005），联合组的中位总生存期尚未估算，而单药奥希替尼组为36.7个月。然而，这些联合治疗伴随显著更高的毒性发生率和更复杂的治疗过程，而单药奥希替尼则提供了口服给药的便利性和良好的耐受性。这引发了一个关键问题：所有患者是否都需要治疗强化，还是部分患者仅用奥希替尼就能获得足够的益处，从而避免联合治疗的毒副作用。
top_items.abstract: In recent years, the therapeutic landscape of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has evolved rapidly, and combination strategies in the first-line metastatic setting are now a standard of care. The FLAURA2 trial showed an improvement in median overall survival from 37.6 to 47.5 months for the combination of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed compared with osimertinib monotherapy (hazard ratio [HR] for death, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.61-0.96; P = .02). The MARIPOSA trial similarly demonstrated an overall survival benefit from the combination of amivantamab and lazertinib over osimertinib monotherapy with an HR for death of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P = .005), for a median overall survival not estimable yet in the combination group and 36.7 months in patients receiving osimertinib monotherapy. However, these combinations come at the cost of substantially higher rates of toxicity and a more complex treatment journey, whereas osimertinib monotherapy offers the convenience of an oral regimen and a favorable tolerability profile. This raises the critical question of whether all patients truly require treatment intensification or whether some may st

top_items.title: A Review of Endometrial Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 子宫内膜癌的综述
top_items.summary_zh: 最近的一项综述提供了子宫内膜癌的全面概述，强调了分子分类在预后和治疗中的新兴重要性，反映了分子分类在临床护理中的日益重要角色。然而，分子分类的实际应用探讨不足。各医疗系统对全面分子检测的获取不一致，即使在资源丰富的环境中，聚合酶ε（POLE）测序等检测的可用性也存在差异，结果解读缺乏标准化。这些挑战在资源匮乏的环境中更为明显，导致理论最佳护理与实际临床实践之间存在差距。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor A recent Review offered a comprehensive overview of endometrial cancer, highlighting the emerging significance of molecular classification in informing prognosis and treatment, which reflects the growing role of molecular classification in clinical care. Nevertheless, the practical implementation of molecular classification was inadequately explored. Access to comprehensive molecular testing is inconsistent across health care systems. Even in high-resource settings, the availability of assays such as polymerase epsilon (POLE) sequencing is variable and result interpretation lacks standardization. These challenges are more pronounced in low-resource settings, resulting in a disparity between theoretical optimal care and real-world clinical practice.

top_items.title: Colorectal Cancer and Mortality Among Older Adults With vs Without Adenoma on Prior Colonoscopy
top_items.title_zh: 老年人腺瘤与结直肠癌及死亡率的关系研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对75岁及以上成年人，分析了先前腺瘤患者的结直肠癌10年累积发生率，仅为1.1%，结直肠癌特异性死亡率为0.5%，而非结直肠癌死亡率接近该队列的一半。因此，先前腺瘤相关的绝对过剩风险相对较小，这些数据对监测强度的临床决策具有重要意义。然而，在将这些发现广泛应用于临床实践之前，有两个问题值得关注。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor A recent study reported that among adults aged 75 years or older, the 10-year cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer after a prior adenoma was only 1.1% and colorectal cancer–specific death was 0.5%, whereas noncolorectal cancer mortality approached half of the cohort. The absolute excess associated with prior adenoma was therefore modest, making these data clinically important for decisions about surveillance intensity. However, 2 issues deserve attention before these findings are translated into broad deimplementation.

top_items.title: Predicting Risk of Cognitive Impairment With Alzheimer Disease Blood Biomarkers
top_items.title_zh: 利用阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物预测认知障碍风险
top_items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病是老年人最常见的痴呆原因。虽然脑脊液生物标志物和淀粉样蛋白正电子发射断层扫描（PET）能准确检测阿尔茨海默病脑病理，但由于感知风险、成本和有限的可用性，临床生物标志物检测率较低。随着针对淀粉样蛋白的疾病修饰疗法的批准，生物标志物在临床实践中的应用变得更加重要。近年来，基于血液的阿尔茨海默病病理生物标志物快速发展，现已在研究、临床试验和临床实践中得到广泛应用。基于血液的生物标志物具有高度可扩展性，有望提高阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断，潜力远超脑脊液或PET检测。在这些血液生物标志物中，血浆磷酸化tau 217（p-tau217）在检测淀粉样病理方面表现出最高的准确性，并在一定程度上反映tau病理。
top_items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is the most common cause of dementia in older individuals. Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers and amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) can accurately detect Alzheimer disease brain pathology, but the perceived risks, costs, and limited availability have contributed to low rates of biomarker testing in the clinic. With recent approvals of disease-modifying, amyloid-targeting therapies, incorporation of biomarkers into clinical practice has become more important for medical decision-making. Fortunately, blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer disease pathology have advanced rapidly in recent years and are now increasingly used in research, clinical trials, and clinical practice. Blood-based biomarkers are highly scalable and promise to improve accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer disease, with the potential for much greater reach than cerebrospinal fluid or PET tests. Among the blood-based biomarkers, plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) has demonstrated the highest accuracy in detecting amyloid pathology and also reflects tau pathology to some degree.

top_items.title: [Comment] Perioperative immunotherapy goes global in gastro-oesophageal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 围手术期免疫治疗在胃食管癌中的全球应用
top_items.summary_zh: 胃癌和胃食管交界癌是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。在可手术肿瘤患者中，多项三期临床试验确立了围手术期化疗的价值。同时，在晚期疾病中，三期研究确认了抗PD-1和抗PD-L1免疫检查点抑制剂与铂类双药化疗联合使用的生存优势，尤其是在PD-L1表达的肿瘤中。因此，有必要研究免疫检查点抑制剂是否能改善非转移性患者的预后。
top_items.abstract: Gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction cancers are among the most common causes of cancer-related deaths.1 In patients with operable tumours, several phase 3 trials established the value of perioperative chemotherapy.2–4 In parallel, phase 3 studies in advanced disease confirmed a survival advantage for anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors in combination with platinum doublet chemotherapy, particularly in PD-L1 expressing tumours.5 Thus, examination of whether immune checkpoint inhibitors could improve outcomes in patients who are non-metastatic was warranted.
top_items.authors: Nataliya Uboha, Samuel J Klempner

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care – Authors’ reply
top_items.title_zh: 揭示卵巢癌护理中的不平等：作者回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Rui Wu及其同事对《柳叶刀卵巢癌委员会》目标的深思熟虑的评论。作者提供了有关女性在急诊室首次诊断卵巢癌的比例的数据（在某些地区高达50%），以及这种表现的预后影响。吴及其同事提出了重要发现：这些患者往往年龄较大、身体虚弱，并且在获得稳定医疗服务方面存在不平等（由于各国复杂原因不同），因此可能被排除在优化的诊断路径（包括遗传学和分子分析）、外科干预、新疗法的获取以及优化生存计划之外。
top_items.abstract: We thank Rui Wu and colleagues for their thoughtful commentary on the outlined objectives for the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer.1 The authors have provided intriguing data regarding the percentage of women who are first diagnosed in emergency room settings (up to 50% in some jurisdictions) and the associated prognostic implications of this presentation. Wu and colleagues raise important findings: these patients are far more likely to be older, frailer, and to have inequities in access to stable health care (for a variety of complex reasons that vary by country) and thus might be excluded from optimised diagnostic pathways (inclusive of genetics and molecular profiling), surgical intervention, access to novel therapeutics, and optimised survivorship plans.
top_items.authors: Kathleen Nadine Moore, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, the Lancet Ovarian Cancer Commission

top_items.title: Clarifications in JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis
top_items.title_zh: JAMA临床指南摘要中的澄清说明
top_items.summary_zh: 在2026年6月30日在线发布的JAMA临床指南摘要《轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗》中，多个要点进行了澄清。在证据基础部分的第三段中，第二句修订为“由于严重或致命毒性风险，nirmatrelvir-ritonavir与某些药物的联合使用是禁忌的（例如，胺碘酮、他汀类药物[尤其是辛伐他汀和洛伐他汀]、磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂[例如，西地那非]、α-阻滞剂[例如，坦索罗辛]或苯二氮卓类药物[例如，三唑仑、咪达唑仑]）或强CYP3A诱导剂（例如，利福平、卡马西平、圣约翰草）。”在证据基础部分的第五段中，最后一句修订为“能够怀孕的患者在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天应使用避孕措施；如果其伴侣未使用molnupiravir，则应如此。与使用molnupiravir的男性伴侣的个体在最后一次剂量后应有效避孕3个月。哺乳期患者应考虑在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天中断哺乳，改为泵奶并丢弃母乳。”在讨论部分的第二段中，增加了一句关于molnupiravir的补充说明：“目前在美国仅有此药物可用。”
top_items.abstract: In the JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis titled “Antiviral Therapies for Adults With Mild to Moderate COVID-19 Infection,” published online June 30, 2026, several points were rewritten for clarification. In the third paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the second sentence was revised to “Coadministration of nirmatrelvir-ritonavir is contraindicated with certain medications due to risk of serious or fatal toxicity (eg, amiodarone, statins [especially simvastatin and lovastatin], phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors [eg, sildenafil], α-blockers [eg, tamsulosin], or benzodiazepines [eg, triazolam, midazolam]) or strong CYP3A inducers (eg, rifampin, carbamazepine, St John’s wort).” In the fifth paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the last sentence was revised to “Patients who can become pregnant should use contraception during molnupiravir use and for 4 days following the last dose if their partner did not also use molnupiravir. Individuals with a male partner who used molnupiravir should use effective contraception for 3 months after the last dose. top_items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline
top_items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化研究
top_items.summary_zh: 致编辑，Patel博士及其同事报告称，988自杀与危机热线的全国启动与青少年及年轻人自杀死亡率减少11%相关（比预期少4372例）。这些发现表明，基于电话的开放式危机服务实现了传统医疗系统少有的人口层面死亡率降低。作者讨论中缺乏自杀与物质使用障碍，特别是阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）之间的密切联系。OUD中的自杀意念普遍存在（25%-40%），阿片类药物相关的风险行为与自杀倾向之间的界限往往临床上模糊。在经历非致命阿片类药物过量的急诊就诊后一年，幸存者的自杀死亡率比人口匹配的普通人群高出282例每10万人，风险增加18倍。国家卫生统计中心数据显示，Patel及其同事研究的年龄组中，非故意药物过量死亡人数超过自杀死亡人数。作者的结果定义排除了非故意和意图不明的药物中毒（国际疾病分类第十版[ICD-10]代码X40-X44和Y10-Y14），这可能包括许多未被识别的自杀死亡（在一项研究中超过20%）。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Patel and colleagues reported that the national launch of the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline was associated with an 11% reduction in adolescent and young adult suicide deaths (4372 fewer than expected). These findings suggest that a phone-based open-access crisis service achieved what the traditional health care system seldom does—population-level reductions in mortality. Missing from the authors’ discussion is the close connection between suicide and substance use disorders, particularly opioid use disorder (OUD). Suicidal ideation is highly prevalent (25%-40%) in OUD, and the distinction between opioid-related risk-taking and suicidality is often clinically ambiguous. In the year after an emergency department visit for nonfatal opioid overdose, survivors experienced 282 excess suicide deaths per 100 000 persons vs a demographically matched general population—an 18-fold increase in risk. National Center for Health Statistics data show that unintentional drug overdose deaths outnumber suicide deaths in the age cohort studied by Patel and colleagues. top_items.title: Optimizing the Therapeutic Ratio in Prostate Radiation Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 优化前列腺放射治疗的治疗比率
top_items.summary_zh: 前列腺癌长期以来是癌症治疗创新的重要领域。与许多其他恶性肿瘤相比，局部前列腺癌具有独特的临床特征。尽管新诊断病例的发生率较高，但前列腺癌通常呈现出缓慢的自然病程，导致前列腺癌特异性死亡风险较低。同时，存在多种管理策略，包括手术、放射治疗和积极监测，这些策略在适当选择的男性中提供类似的疾病结果。因此，局部疾病的治疗决策必须考虑肿瘤学结果以及尿液、肠道和性功能的保护。在过去几十年中，影像学、风险分层（包括基因组学）和治疗实施的进展不断重塑前列腺癌护理，目标是：在接受局部治疗的早期疾病男性中，临床医生和研究人员必须努力优化治疗比率，保持高癌症控制率，同时最小化治疗相关的发病率。
top_items.abstract: Prostate cancer has long served as a fertile ground for innovation in cancer therapy. Compared with many other malignancies, localized prostate cancer occupies a unique clinical space. Although the incidence of new diagnoses is high, prostate cancer often follows an indolent natural history, resulting in a low risk of prostate cancer–specific mortality. Meanwhile, multiple management strategies exist, including surgery, radiation therapy, and active surveillance, which provide similar disease outcomes in appropriately selected men. As a result, treatment decisions for localized disease must account for not only oncologic outcomes but also preservation of urinary, bowel, and sexual function. Over the past several decades, advances in imaging, risk stratification (including genomics), and treatment delivery have steadily reshaped prostate cancer care with a common goal: in men with early-stage disease who receive local therapy, clinicians and investigators must attempt to optimize the therapeutic ratio by maintaining high rates of cancer control, while minimizing treatment-related morbidity.

top_items.title: Ceperognastat in Alzheimer Disease
top_items.title_zh: Ceperognastat在阿尔茨海默病中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病的特征是细胞外淀粉样β斑块和由过度磷酸化的tau蛋白组成的神经纤维缠结的积累。多年来，药物开发主要集中在淀粉样β斑块上，最近批准的淀粉样靶向单克隆抗体lecanemab和donanemab用于早期阿尔茨海默病的治疗。同时，针对tau缠结的治疗开发也引起了广泛关注，tau缠结是阿尔茨海默病的第二种特征性病变。
top_items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is defined by the accumulation of extracellular amyloid-β plaques and intraneuronal neurofibrillary tangles composed of hyperphosphorylated tau. For many years, drug development efforts have focused on amyloid-β plaques, culminating in the recent approval of the amyloid-targeting monoclonal antibodies lecanemab and donanemab for the treatment of early-stage Alzheimer disease. In parallel, there has been considerable interest in developing treatments directed at tau tangles, the second pathognomonic lesion of Alzheimer disease.

top_items.title: [Comment] Late-onset seizures as a sentinel of Alzheimer's disease progression in Down syndrome
top_items.title_zh: 唐氏综合症患者晚发性癫痫与阿尔茨海默病进展的关系
top_items.summary_zh: 癫痫是老年唐氏综合症患者常见的共病，且常与阿尔茨海默病相关的认知下降相伴随。晚发性肌阵挛癫痫（LOMEDS）在唐氏综合症中表现为肌阵挛或强直-阵挛发作，可能既是潜在阿尔茨海默病病理的表现，也是加速疾病进展的因素。然而，唐氏综合症成人癫痫发作的时间与阿尔茨海默病症状及进展之间的关系尚不明确，这使得对认知下降的解读和临床管理变得复杂。
top_items.abstract: Epilepsy is a common co-occurring condition in older adults with Down syndrome and frequently associated with the emergence of Alzheimer's disease-related cognitive decline.1 Likely to be under-recognised and often untreated in the earlier stages, late-onset myoclonic epilepsy in Down syndrome (LOMEDS) presents as myoclonic or tonic–clonic seizures and can be both a manifestation of underlying Alzheimer's disease pathology and an accelerator of disease progression.2 How seizure onset timing in adults with Down syndrome relates to Alzheimer's disease symptoms and progression remains unclear, complicating interpretation of decline and clinical management.
top_items.authors: Zinayida Schlachetzki, Michael S Rafii

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B
top_items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配的研究进展
top_items.summary_zh: WILLOW试验的Cohort B结果区分了狼疮试验中常混淆的两个问题：药物是否改变了疾病生物学，以及所选的复合终点是否能够检测到这种改变。尽管enpatoran在Eric F Morand及其同事的研究中未通过主要的多重比较程序——基于英国地区狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA）剂量-反应分析（p=0.14），但非单调的反应模式（安慰剂39% vs 剂量组58%、49%和49%）表明存在药效平 plateau，而非缺乏活性。
top_items.abstract: The Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial separate two questions often conflated in lupus trials: whether a drug altered the disease biology, and whether the chosen composite endpoint was structured to detect that alteration.1 Although enpatoran failed the primary multiple comparison procedure-modelling British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA) dose–response analysis (p=0·14) in the study by Eric F Morand and colleagues,1 the non-monotonic response pattern (39% placebo vs 58%, 49%, and 49% across doses) suggests a pharmacodynamic plateau rather than a lack of activity.
top_items.authors: Huihua Ding, Nan Shen, Dai Dai

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Gold standard vaccine policy as a global health signal
top_items.title_zh: 黄金标准疫苗政策作为全球健康信号
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年8月10日，美国发布的行政命令建立了“黄金标准儿童疫苗推荐”，这一政策不仅是国内政策的变化，也可能成为全球健康信号。该政策通过重新定义应常规推荐的儿童疫苗，鼓励将麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗分开接种，并提倡为不同儿童免疫接种安排单独的就医访问，存在将家长选择与基于证据的疫苗接种优化混淆的风险。
top_items.abstract: The US Executive Order of Aug 10, 2026, establishing “Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations”,1 should be considered not only a domestic policy change but also a potential global health signal. By redefining what childhood vaccines should be routinely recommended, encouraging separation of the combined measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine, and advocating separate medical visits for different childhood immunisations, the policy risks conflating parental choice with the optimisation of evidence-based vaccination delivery.
top_items.authors: Mauer Alexandre da Ascensão Gonçalves, Aguinaldo Filipe de Morais, Capela António Pascoal, Carlos Victor Montefusco-Pereira, Howard Lopes Ribeiro Junior

top_items.title: High-Dose Vitamin C in Burns
top_items.title_zh: 高剂量维生素C在烧伤治疗中的效果研究
top_items.summary_zh: 在本期《JAMA》中，Stoppe及其同事发布了一项国际随机临床试验的结果，提供了高剂量静脉维生素C对大面积烧伤患者的治疗效果并无改善的证据。VICTORY试验的数据甚至表明，使用维生素C可能会增加大面积烧伤患者的死亡率。该研究设计严谨，设定了基于无效或有害的严格停止标准。结果表明，维生素C改善重大烧伤患者预后的可能性极低。
top_items.abstract: In this issue of JAMA, Stoppe and colleagues present the results of an international randomized clinical trial that provides evidence that high-dose intravenous vitamin C does not improve outcomes in patients with large burns. The data from the VICTORY trial even suggest that use of vitamin C in patients with large burns might increase mortality. This well-designed study had strict criteria for stopping based on futility or harm. It is clear that the possibility of vitamin C improving outcomes in major burns is extremely low.

top_items.title: Evolving Cell with evolving science
top_items.title_zh: 进化中的《Cell》与科学的演变
top_items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了《Cell》期刊的特点及其发表标准。作者指出，尽管《Cell》发表的论文通常较长、机制性强且内容“完整”，但其核心价值在于所提供的深刻生物学见解和激动人心的研究成果。作者强调，期刊的目标是发布那些能够引起读者兴趣、带来启发的研究，而不仅仅是因为论文的长度或复杂性。通过这些研究，读者能够获得有益的知识和洞见。
top_items.abstract: I know what you think about papers in Cell. They are long. Mechanistic. “Complete.” They report deep biological insights. I know this because I hear it a lot from researchers. There is truth to it. Cell has published thousands of papers that fit these descriptors, and we will continue to. They have incredible value. But we don’t publish papers in Cell because they are long and mechanistic. We publish them because they are exciting. Cool. Awe-inspiring. We publish them because we think they provide something that our readers will want to learn about and will benefit from.
top_items.authors: John W. Pham

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Patient organisations are key implementation partners
top_items.title_zh: 患者组织是实施健康政策的关键合作伙伴
top_items.summary_zh: 作为墨西哥患者组织Mario Robles Ossio基金会的主席，我强烈支持Tonelli及其同事在健康政策中对实施的关注。墨西哥是全球肾病负担最重的国家之一。2025年3月，慢性肾病被纳入国家医疗护理协议。然而，正如论文所强调的，真正的挑战在于政策采纳后的实施：将这些承诺转化为能够影响人们日常生活的行动。
top_items.abstract: As President of the Mario Robles Ossio Foundation, a Mexican patient organisation, I strongly support the focus on implementation in the Health Policy by Tonelli and colleagues.1 Mexico has one of the highest burdens of kidney disease worldwide. In March, 2025, chronic kidney disease was included within the National Medical Care Protocols.2 However, as the paper highlights, the real challenge begins after policy adoption: translating those commitments into actions that reach people in their daily lives.
top_items.authors: Marisol Robles

top_items.title: [Comment] Closing the preparedness gap: moving beyond emergency response to sustain the medical countermeasure ecosystem
top_items.title_zh: 填补应对准备差距：超越紧急响应以维持医疗对策生态系统
top_items.summary_zh: 在危机间被忽视的传染病疫情。刚果民主共和国正在进行的由Bundibugyo病毒（Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV）引发的埃博拉病毒病疫情，期间出现了跨境传播至乌干达的情况，促使各国政府、区域和多边组织、制造商、研究机构及融资伙伴共同合作。这些参与者加速了医疗对策（MCMs）的开发、评估和部署，包括诊断工具、疫苗、治疗药物和个人防护装备（PPE）。
top_items.abstract: Infectious disease outbreaks expose weaknesses that are overlooked between crises. The ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during which there has been cross-border transmission into Uganda, has brought together governments, regional and multilateral organisations, manufacturers, research institutions, and financing partners. These actors are accelerating the development, evaluation, and deployment of medical countermeasures (MCMs), including diagnostics, vaccines, therapeutics, and personal protective equipment (PPE).
top_items.authors: Victor J Dzau, Jean Kaseya, Benedict Oramah, John-Arne Røttingen, Jane Halton, Elizabeth E Cameron, Oluwatosin Akande

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96
top_items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的KEYNOTE-B96试验结果分析
top_items.summary_zh: 我们祝贺Nicoletta Colombo及其同事在铂耐药卵巢癌领域的ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96试验中取得的具有实践意义的结果。该研究报告显示，在接受不超过两种系统治疗的铂耐药卵巢癌患者中，使用帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（可选择性添加贝伐单抗）显著改善了无进展生存期，并在总体生存期上也有临床意义的改善。这些发现对于历史上预后较差的患者群体具有重要意义。
top_items.abstract: We congratulate Nicoletta Colombo and colleagues for the practice changing results of the ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 trial in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Their study reports clinically significant improvement in progression-free survival and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival with pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in patients who had received no more than two previous lines of systemic therapies (for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer).1 These findings are notable in a setting of historically poor prognosis.
top_items.authors: Stanislas Quesada, Manuel Rodrigues, Anne-Claire Hardy, Benoît You, Alexandra Leary, Isabelle Ray-Coquard

top_items.title: [Perspectives] Teresa Lambe: making vaccines, saving lives
top_items.title_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝：研发疫苗，拯救生命
top_items.summary_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝是英国牛津大学疫苗免疫学主任，兼任疫苗学与免疫学的研究者。她自我描述为制造疫苗的免疫学家，致力于将疫苗从概念推向许可阶段。目前，她主要关注于刚果民主共和国的Bundibugyo埃博拉病毒疫情，表现出对这一领域的极大热情与专注。
top_items.abstract: Teresa Lambe, the Calleva Head of Vaccine Immunology and Professor of Vaccinology and Immunology at the University of Oxford, UK, is one of those academics who wears many different hats. She describes herself in different ways depending on to whom she is speaking: “either a manufacturer, an immunologist, or a vaccinologist. But really, I am an immunologist who makes vaccines and tries to get them all the way through from concept to licensure”. Where is she channelling these various identities and energies at the moment? “Pretty much solely focused on and obsessed with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo”, she says.
top_items.authors: Faith McLellan

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B – Authors' reply
top_items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配：作者回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢丁辉华及其同事对系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）WILLOW试验B组结果的深思熟虑的评论。在本研究中，所有剂量的Toll样受体7和8（TLR7/8）抑制剂enpatoran均与复合结果指标的更高达成率相关，即基于英国群岛狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA），但预先设定的主要结果未能显示该终点的剂量-反应关系。
top_items.abstract: We thank Huihua Ding and colleagues for their thoughtful comments regarding the Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).1 In this study, all doses of the Toll-like receptor 7 and 8 (TLR7/8) inhibitor enpatoran were associated with higher attainment of the composite outcome measure—ie, British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA)—but the prespecified primary outcome of showing a dose–response with this endpoint was not reached.1
top_items.authors: Eric F Morand, Ruth Fernandez-Ruiz, Lena Klopp-Schulze, Richard Furie

top_items.title: Metabolite buffering of labile iron governs ferroptosis
top_items.title_zh: 代谢物缓冲可溶性铁调控铁死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 铁的丰度并不能单独决定铁死亡的敏感性。在本期《细胞》杂志中，Sharma及其同事发现多胺作为内源性代谢缓冲剂，能够降低可溶性铁的化学可及性。这一发现揭示了细胞中最丰富的代谢物类别之一的意外功能，同时也提出了关于细胞内铁代谢组织的新问题。
top_items.abstract: Iron abundance alone does not determine ferroptosis sensitivity. In this issue of Cell, Sharma and colleagues identify polyamines as endogenous metabolic buffers that reduce the chemical accessibility of labile iron, revealing an unexpected function for one of the cell’s most abundant metabolite classes while raising new questions about the organization of intracellular iron metabolism.
top_items.authors: Amalia H. Megarioti, James A. Olzmann

top_items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
top_items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
top_items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feens

top_items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估
top_items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
top_items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.

top_items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
top_items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.

top_items.title: Liquid Biopsies for Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 液体活检在癌症治疗中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 本叙述性综述探讨了液体活检，特别是循环肿瘤DNA，如何指导治疗决策。研究表明，液体活检能够帮助临床医生监测癌症进展、检测微小残留癌症以及识别基因序列变异。通过分析循环肿瘤DNA的变化，医生可以更准确地评估患者的病情，并根据检测结果调整治疗方案，从而提高治疗效果和患者预后。液体活检作为一种非侵入性的方法，具有重要的临床应用潜力。
top_items.abstract: This narrative review examines how liquid biopsy, particularly circulating tumor DNA, can guide treatment decisions by helping clinicians monitor cancer progression, detect minimal residual cancer, and identify genetic sequence variations.

top_items.title: In vivo genome-wide CRISPR screens identify FOXR1 as a suppressor of CD8+ T cell antitumor immunity
top_items.title_zh: 体内全基因组CRISPR筛选发现FOXR1抑制CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对T细胞功能障碍对CAR T疗法效果的影响，进行了全基因组CRISPR筛选，识别出转录因子叉头框R1（FOXR1）作为CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫的关键抑制因子。通过分析FOXR1在T细胞中的表达及其对T细胞功能的影响，我们发现FOXR1的抑制可以增强CD8+ T细胞的抗肿瘤活性。这一发现为改善T细胞免疫功能提供了新的靶点，可能为未来的癌症免疫疗法提供新的策略。

SignificanceT cell dysfunction compromises T cell antitumor functions and limits the efficacy of CAR T therapy. In this study, we performed an in vivo genome-wide CRISPR screen and identified the transcription factor Forkhead Box R1 (FOXR1) as a key ...

top_items.title: scBaseCount: An AI agent-curated, standardized, auto-updated single-cell data repository
top_items.title_zh: scBaseCount：AI代理策划的标准化单细胞数据仓库
top_items.summary_zh: scBaseCount是目前最大的公共单细胞RNA测序数据仓库，包含超过5.02亿个细胞，涵盖27种生物和75种组织。该平台通过AI代理自主发现、注释并统一处理所有10× Genomics数据集，创建了一个和谐且持续更新的资源，旨在研究细胞生物学的多样性及训练AI模型。
top_items.abstract: scBaseCount is presently the largest public single-cell RNA-seq repository, containing over 502 million cells across 27 organisms and 75 tissues. An AI agent autonomously discovers, annotates, and uniformly reprocesses all 10× Genomics datasets in the SRA, creating a harmonized, continually updated resource for studying the diversity of cell biology and training AI models.
top_items.authors: Nicholas D. Youngblut, Christopher Carpenter, Arshia Nayebnazar, Abhinav Adduri, Rohan Shah, Chiara Ricci-Tam, Jaanak Prashar, Rajesh Ilango, Noam Teyssier, Silvana Konermann, Patrick D. Hsu, Alexande

top_items.title: Tahoe-100M: Mapping drug-induced molecular phenotypes at single-cell resolution
top_items.title_zh: Tahoe-100M：以单细胞分辨率绘制药物诱导的分子表型
top_items.summary_zh: Tahoe-100M是一个包含1亿个单细胞转录组的图谱，记录了50种癌细胞系对约1100种药物剂量处理的反应。通过大规模的单细胞转录组分析，该资源将药物机制与细胞反应联系起来，并提供了一个公开可用的平台，用于训练细胞行为的预测模型。
top_items.abstract: Tahoe-100M is an atlas of 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, capturing how 50 cancer cell lines respond to ∼1,100 drug-dose treatments. By pairing single-cell and molecular phenotypes at scale, the resource links drug mechanisms to cellular responses and provides an openly available substrate for training predictive models of cell behavior.
top_items.authors: Jesse Zhang, Airol A. Ubas, Valentine Svensson, Nicole Thomas, Vishvak Subramanyam, Christopher Carpenter, Aidan Winters, Richard de Borja, Noam Teyssier, Neha Thakar, Umair Khan, Pooja V. Akella, Har

top_items.title: A Cure Out of Most Patients’ Reach — Sickle Cell Disease in the Gene-Therapy Era
top_items.title_zh: 大多数患者难以获得的治疗——基因疗法时代的镰状细胞病
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了镰状细胞病（SCD）在基因疗法时代的治疗现状与挑战。研究对象为接受基因疗法的SCD患者，采用临床试验数据分析方法。结果显示，尽管基因疗法在部分患者中取得了显著的疗效，但由于高昂的治疗费用和复杂的治疗过程，绝大多数患者仍难以获得这种治疗。研究指出，需加强对基因疗法的可及性和经济性的评估，以便为更多患者提供有效的治疗选择。结论强调了在推进基因疗法的同时，必须关注其公平性和可及性问题。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Naif I. AlJohani and Sultan Almutairi

top_items.title: “The Hole”: Poetry Like a Gunshot Wound
top_items.title_zh: “伤口”：如枪伤般的诗歌
top_items.summary_zh: 医学训练临床医生在一种特定的沉默中。通过诊断，我们将痛苦的原因医学化——挫伤、撕裂、出血——仿佛重新命名痛苦就能将其控制，防止其从病历中溢出，影响我们的生活。手术室和病房在压抑的语言中变得流利。然而，惨遭重创的身体却坚持要求诗歌。在医学测量与人类体验之间的裂缝中，诗歌成为一种必要，而非装饰。在《伤口》中，诗歌并未解决这一裂缝，或修复伤口（在此案例中是患者头部的枪伤），而是深入不可言说的痛苦，不是通过医学术语翻译，而是揭示抵抗翻译的暴力。伤口的血腥从不同角度展现：艺术的（“毕加索”）、奇异怀旧的（“肉丸”，“樱桃酱”）和临床的（“补丁”，“挖掘”，“评估”）。然而，所有的解释和描述都显得不足，而在这种不足中，奇异而持久的亲密感产生。诗中矛盾的核心句子“这个洞很大/却不比一个眼睛大”，展现了深刻的创伤；最后的句子“它不会被梦/或诗歌，我的手或纱布填满”似乎真的在流血。
top_items.abstract: Medicine trains clinicians in a particular silence. Through diagnosis, we medicalize the causes of suffering—contusion, laceration, hemorrhage—as though renaming anguish might contain it, keeping it from spilling out of charts and into our own lives. Operating room and ward become, ironically, fluent in the language of suppression. Yet the horrifically wounded body insists on poetry. It is precisely here, in the rupture between what medicine measures and what human beings experience, that the poem becomes not decoration but necessity. In “The Hole,” poetry does not resolve this rupture or even fix the wound, in this case a gunshot to the patient’s head, another in an epidemic of harm. Instead, it plumbs the unspeakable, not by translating it into medical terminology but exposing the violence of what resists translation. The wound’s gore is first shown from various perspectives: artful (“Picasso”), oddly nostalgic (“meatballs,” “cherry jam”), and clinical (“patch,” “excavate,” “evaluate”).
