top_items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke
top_items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后使用动脉内阿替普酶的研究
top_items.summary_zh: Renú博士及其同事报告称，在成功进行取栓后，辅助使用动脉内阿替普酶“可能改善大血管闭塞性中风的功能恢复”。该随机临床试验为一种合理的再灌注策略提供了重要的验证，但报告中存在一个关键问题未得到解决——临床恢复的发现基于在试验过程中更改的主要结果。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Renú and colleagues reported that adjunctive intra-arterial alteplase after successful thrombectomy “may improve functional recovery” in large vessel occlusion stroke. The randomized clinical trial provides an important test of a plausible reperfusion strategy, but the report leaves a key issue unresolved—the clinical recovery finding rests on a primary outcome that was changed during the trial.

top_items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后动脉内阿替普酶的应用—回复
top_items.summary_zh: 在回复中，我们提到原报告中主要结果在第12个月进行了修订，以提高临床相关性和可解释性，考虑到新出现的随机证据和盲法mRS评分评估的既定使用。该修订于2025年2月10日实施，时已招募283名患者，其中214名完成或符合90天随访的条件。未进行中期分析，修订时没有按治疗组提供的结果数据，因此该变更并未受到累积试验结果的影响。
top_items.abstract: In Reply As described in the original report, the primary outcome was amended at month 12 to improve clinical relevance and interpretability, considering emerging randomized evidence and the established use of the blinded mRS score assessment. The amendment was implemented on February 10, 2025, after enrollment of 283 patients, of whom 214 had completed or were eligible for 90-day follow-up. No interim analyses had been conducted, and no outcome data by treatment group were available at the time of the amendment; therefore, the change was not informed by accumulating trial results.

top_items.title: Exclusion of HIV-Positive Patients From Sickle Cell Gene Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 排除HIV阳性患者参与镰状细胞基因治疗的影响
top_items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在镰状细胞病基因治疗中排除HIV阳性患者的伦理、科学、临床和制造方面的影响。研究指出，尽管基因治疗在治疗镰状细胞病方面展现出潜力，但对HIV阳性患者的排除可能导致伦理争议和临床实践的挑战。此外，制造过程中的安全性和有效性问题也需考虑，以确保所有患者的权益和健康。通过分析现有文献和临床数据，作者呼吁在制定治疗标准时应综合考虑这些因素，以实现更广泛的患者受益。
top_items.abstract: This Perspective discusses the ethical, scientific, clinical, and manufacturing implications of excluding patients living with HIV from gene therapies for sickle cell disease.

top_items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化的回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Herring博士和Purtle博士的深思熟虑的评论。我们的研究发现，在988热线全国启动后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率有所下降，尤其是在988热线使用率显著增加的州，下降幅度最大。此外，这些模式经过预设的虚假检验测试，结果显示在988热线无法影响的结果或时期中并未出现相同的下降，这表明我们的结果具有可信性。
top_items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Herring and Dr Purtle for their thoughtful comments. Our study found that suicide mortality among adolescents and young adults decreased after the national launch of the 988 Lifeline, that declines were largest in states where the 988 Lifeline uptake increased most, and that these patterns withstood prespecified falsification testing—analyses checking whether the same decline appeared in outcomes or periods that the 988 Lifeline could not have affected, which would have signaled a spurious result.

top_items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Prostate Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗对前列腺癌的比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估立体定向体部放疗在患者报告的尿路刺激/梗阻和肠道生活质量以及无病生存期方面是否优于中等分次调强放疗。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者。试验结果显示，立体定向体部放疗在改善尿路和肠道生活质量方面具有一定优势，同时在无病生存期上也表现出积极的趋势。这些发现为前列腺癌的放疗选择提供了重要的临床依据。
top_items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial assesses whether stereotactic body radiotherapy is superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy in terms of patient-reported urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

top_items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer Research Summary
top_items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）是否优于中等分次调强放疗（MH-IMRT），在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中对尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存期的影响。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机对照试验的方法进行比较。结果显示，SBRT在尿路和肠道生活质量方面表现出一定优势，同时在无病生存期方面，两种治疗方法的效果相似。结论是，SBRT可能在改善生活质量方面优于MH-IMRT，但两者在无病生存期上无显著差异。
top_items.abstract: The objective of this study was to assess whether stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) was superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy (MH-IMRT) for urinary and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

top_items.title: [Articles] Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
top_items.title_zh: 布丁布戈病毒糖蛋白在刚果疫区人群中的免疫反应研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
top_items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.
top_items.authors: Megan Halbrook, Sydney Merritt, Nicole A Hoff, Patrick Mukadi, Jean Paul Kompany, Kamy Musene, Michael Beya, Handdy Kalengi, Merly Tambu, J Daniel Kelly, Aquena H Ball, Albert To, Tracy MacGill, Rober

top_items.title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts
top_items.title_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛：跨细胞环境的零-shot泛化基准测试
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛将以更高的标准测试生物学泛化能力：在多个独立细胞环境中进行零-shot预测。参与者将构建模型，以预测在新生成的Arc数据集中未见细胞系中的基因敲除反应。目标是评估最佳模型是否能够有效缩小临床前实验预测与人类生物学之间的差距。
top_items.abstract: The Virtual Cell Challenge returns in 2026 with a more demanding test of biological generalization: zero-shot prediction across multiple independent cellular contexts. Participants will build models to predict gene knockdown responses in a new Arc-generated dataset comprising unseen cell lines. The goal is to determine whether the best models can meaningfully close the gap between preclinical experimental predictions and human biology.
top_items.authors: Arc Virtual Cell Initiative Team, Hani Goodarzi

top_items.title: [Comment] Cardiac resynchronisation therapy: 30 years of progress
top_items.title_zh: 心脏再同步治疗：30年的进展
top_items.summary_zh: 双室起搏的心脏再同步治疗（BiV-CRT）彻底改变了左束支传导阻滞（LBBB）患者心力衰竭的治疗方法。研究发现，LBBB会导致心脏功能受损，随后发现将导线植入左心室自由壁与右心室导线结合，可以显著改善LBBB患者的急性心脏功能。专用导线的发展促进了BiV-CRT的完全经静脉方法，通过冠状窦的心室分支靶向左心室自由壁。
top_items.abstract: Cardiac resynchronisation therapy with biventricular pacing (BiV-CRT) revolutionised the treatment of heart failure in patients with left bundle-branch block (LBBB). Its development, founded upon observations that LBBB leads to cardiac impairment,1 progressed to finding that combining a lead implanted on the left ventricular free wall with a lead in the right ventricle could provide drastic improvements in acute cardiac function in patients with LBBB.2 The development of dedicated leads facilitated the fully transvenous approach to BiV-CRT, with the left ventricular free wall targeted by using a ventricular branch of the coronary sinus.
top_items.authors: Matthew Shun-Shin, Zachary Whinnett

top_items.title: [Articles] Aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure in 17 African countries (THESUS-HF II): a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study
top_items.title_zh: 17个非洲国家急性心力衰竭的病因、管理与结果研究
top_items.summary_zh: 与THESUS-HF相比，THESUS-HF II显示出非洲急性心力衰竭病因谱的演变，尽管诊断能力和确认方式的差异可能影响了这一变化。该研究对象为相对年轻的患者群体，结果显示其高死亡率凸显了心力衰竭预防、心脏护理获取、指南指导治疗及出院后随访的重要性。研究结果表明，短期急性心力衰竭的结果并不受其人口学、病因学和超声心动图因素的驱动。
top_items.abstract: Compared with THESUS-HF, THESUS-HF II suggests an evolving aetiological profile of acute heart failure in Africa, although differences in ascertainment and diagnostic capability might have contributed to the apparent aetiological shift. High mortality in this relatively young cohort highlights the importance of heart failure prevention, access to cardiac care, guideline-directed therapy, and post-discharge follow-up. These findings suggest that short-term acute heart failure outcomes are not driven by its demographic, aetiological, and echocardiographic factors.
top_items.authors: Karen Sliwa, Julia Hahnle, Simon Stewart, Shaazia Allie, Albertino Damasceno, Duard Smit, Neusa Jessen, Mahmood U Sani, George Nel, Ntobeko B A Ntusi, Chris Edwards, Koji Takagi, Beth Davison, Gad Cot

top_items.title: [Articles] Discontinuation of β-blockers in stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, and no heart failure: a pooled analysis of individual patient data
top_items.title_zh: 稳定性心肌梗死患者停用β-阻滞剂的分析
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对稳定性心肌梗死患者，左心室射血分数≥40%，无心力衰竭且未接受其他β-阻滞剂治疗的个体数据进行汇总分析。结果显示，停用β-阻滞剂在主要和关键次要终点上满足非劣效性标准。然而，主要终点的解读受到住院率高和试验依赖性组成的限制。
top_items.abstract: In stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%, no heart failure, and no other indication for β-blocker therapy, discontinuation met the non-inferiority criteria for the primary and key secondary endpoints. Interpretation of the primary endpoint is limited by its hospitalisation-heavy and trial-dependent composition.
top_items.authors: Johanne Silvain, Ki Hong Choi, Victorien Monguillon, Danbee Kang, Guillaume Cayla, Weon Kim, Emile Ferrari, Young Bin Song, Grégoire Range, Etienne Puymirat, Joon-Hyung Doh, Nicolas Delarche, Juhan Ki

top_items.title: [Comment] Acute heart failure in Africa: new causes, unchanged outcomes
top_items.title_zh: 非洲急性心力衰竭：新原因与不变的结局
top_items.summary_zh: 15年前，原始的撒哈拉以南非洲心力衰竭调查（THESUS-HF）首次前瞻性、多国描述了撒哈拉以南非洲的急性心力衰竭。研究发现，撒哈拉以南非洲的急性心力衰竭患者普遍年轻，男女发病率几乎相等，且发病主要由非缺血性疾病引起，尤其是高血压和风湿性心脏病，短期预后较差。该研究将非洲的心力衰竭重新定义为一个独特的临床实体，而非高收入人群的附注。
top_items.abstract: More than 15 years ago, the original Sub-Saharan Africa Survey of Heart Failure (THESUS-HF) provided one of the first prospective, multinational descriptions of acute heart failure in sub-Saharan Africa.1 THESUS-HF found that patients with acute heart failure in sub-Saharan Africa were young, with near-equal incidence in men and women, that incidence was driven overwhelmingly by non-ischaemic disease, especially hypertensive and rheumatic heart diseases, and that short-term prognosis was poor.1 The study reframed heart failure in Africa as a distinct clinical entity rather than a footnote to high-income cohorts.
top_items.authors: Bamba Gaye, Antonio Luiz Pinho Ribeiro, Eloi Marijon

top_items.title: Targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 靶向外周5-HT2AR增强结直肠癌抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究通过选择性靶向外周5-HT2AR，使用一种不穿透血脑屏障的激动剂，增强了抗肿瘤CD8+ T细胞免疫，并改善了结直肠癌的免疫治疗反应。研究表明，该激动剂在预临床模型中有效提升了免疫应答，未引发迷幻效应，显示出其作为潜在免疫治疗策略的前景。
top_items.abstract: By selectively targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR without inducing psychedelic effects, a non-brain-penetrant agonist boosts antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity and improves immunotherapy responses in preclinical models of colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: YaTing Wen, LingJie Tang, WenWen Duan, QingFei Ren, YangYue Ni, ShiYang Chen, Jun Chen, Lei Yang, Huan Wang, Yuan Chen, YunZhe Zheng, XingChao Pan, Hui Du, MengWen Huang, An Zeng, Zhaocai Zhou, ZhiGan

top_items.title: Clopidogrel or Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in High-Ischemic-Risk Patients
top_items.title_zh: 高缺血风险患者的氯吡格雷或双抗血小板治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在比较氯吡格雷单药治疗与双抗血小板治疗在高缺血风险患者中的效果。研究对象为接受冠状动脉介入治疗的高风险患者，随机分为氯吡格雷组和双抗组。结果显示，双抗组在主要不良心血管事件发生率上显著低于氯吡格雷组，且出血事件发生率相似。研究结论认为，在高缺血风险患者中，双抗血小板治疗优于单一氯吡格雷治疗，能够更有效地降低心血管事件风险。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Seung-Jun Lee Yong-Joon Lee Kyounghoon Lee Deok-Kyu Cho Yun-Hyeong Cho Sung Gyun Ahn Kyeong Ho Yun Ji-Yong Jang Seunghwan Kim Yong Hoon Kim Yong Hwan Park Sung Uk Kwon Seung-Ho Hur Tae Soo Kang Eun-Se

top_items.title: [Comment] Rethinking success after atrial fibrillation ablation: when sham is more than a placebo
top_items.title_zh: 重新思考心房颤动消融后的成功：假手术的意义
top_items.summary_zh: 导管消融技术彻底改变了心房颤动的管理。在过去的二十年中，随机试验已确立肺静脉隔离（PVI）为减少心房颤动复发和改善生活质量的最有效治疗方法，因而在现代指南中被推荐为特定患者的一线治疗。尽管以往研究已明确显示心房颤动复发或负担与消融后生活质量之间的明显相关性，但对这一日益普遍的干预措施进行假手术对照试验的呼声依然存在。
top_items.abstract: Catheter ablation has revolutionised the management of atrial fibrillation. Over the past two decades, randomised trials have established pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the most effective treatment for reducing atrial fibrillation recurrence and improving quality of life,1,2 leading to its recommendation as first-line therapy for selected patients in contemporary guidelines.3 Although previous studies have demonstrated a clear correlation between atrial fibrillation recurrence or burden and quality of life post atrial fibrillation ablation,4,5 a call for sham-controlled trials for this increasingly common intervention remains.
top_items.authors: Louise Segan, Peter M Kistler

top_items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
top_items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
top_items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).
top_items.authors: Efstathios Pettas, Arash Mostaghimi, Sook-Bin Woo

top_items.title: Synthetic transcription factors designed by domain recombination enhance CAR T cell antitumor function
top_items.title_zh: 通过域重组设计的合成转录因子增强CAR T细胞抗肿瘤功能
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究通过跨整个蛋白质家族的域重组，生成合成的“DESynR”转录因子，旨在增强其功能。DESynR AP-1转录因子能够将CAR T细胞重编程为非自然的、经过治疗优化的状态，并在抗肿瘤免疫方面优于天然AP-1因子。这一发现为CAR T细胞的治疗潜力提供了新的思路。
top_items.abstract: Recombining domains across an entire protein family, rather than relying on natural sequences shaped by evolution, generates synthetic “DESynR” transcription factors with enhanced function. DESynR AP-1 TFs reprogram CAR T cells into non-natural, therapeutically optimized states and outperform natural AP-1 factors in antitumor immunity.
top_items.authors: Oliver Takacsi-Nagy, Sivakanthan Kasinathan, Austin Hartman, Yajie Yin, Lujing Wu, Andy Y. Chen, Laura M. Moser, Audre P. May, Gabriella C. Reeder, Emily Celallos Fuentes, Courtney Kernick, Johnathan

top_items.title: [Comment] Stopping β-blockers long after myocardial infarction
top_items.title_zh: 心肌梗死后长期停用β-阻滞剂的探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 心血管药物治疗中，心肌梗死后β-阻滞剂的使用变化显著。过去几十年，β-阻滞剂在心肌梗死后被常规且往往无限期使用，这一做法基于1980年代早期的试验结果，显示其能降低死亡率和复发事件。然而，这些试验是在常规再灌注、侵入性治疗、他汀类药物和双重抗血小板治疗普及之前进行的，因此其对现代心肌梗死患者的适用性尚不明确。
top_items.abstract: Few areas of cardiovascular pharmacotherapy have changed as much as β-blocker use after myocardial infarction. For decades, β-blockers were prescribed routinely and often indefinitely after myocardial infarction, a practice based on trials from the early 1980s showing reductions in mortality and recurrent events.1 However, those trials preceded routine reperfusion, invasive management, statins, and dual antiplatelet therapy; therefore, their relevance to contemporary post-myocardial infarction patients is uncertain.
top_items.authors: Borja Ibanez

top_items.title: [Comment] Towards a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders
top_items.title_zh: 神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 精神病学被称为医学的另一半，反映了心理健康服务与其他医疗服务的分离。精神疾病患者在不同的诊所和医院接受治疗，与身体疾病患者分开。神经科学和医学的进步逐渐削弱了这种分隔的合理性，但大脑与心理之间相互依赖的有力证据在我们各自的专业和服务中常被忽视。我们认为这种分离对两类疾病患者都造成了伤害，并提出神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类在理论上是合理的，实践上是可行的，并将对精神病学、神经学及更广泛的医学领域带来益处。
top_items.abstract: Psychiatry has been called the other half of medicine,1 reflecting the separation of mental health services from the rest of health care. Patients with a mental illness are treated in different clinics and hospitals to those with physical illnesses. Advances in neuroscience and medicine have gradually eroded the justification for this divide, but the compelling evidence for the interdependence of brain and mind is easily neglected within our siloed specialties and services. We believe this separation causes harm to patients with disorders on either side of the line and propose that a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders is theoretically justified, practically feasible, and would benefit psychiatry, neurology, and medicine more broadly.
top_items.authors: Peter White, Timothy R Nicholson, Jon Stone, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Adam Zeman

top_items.title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State
top_items.title_zh: 跨多种情境预测细胞对扰动的反应
top_items.summary_zh: 建模大规模单细胞群体的扰动效应需要灵活性以捕捉异质性。通过在共享嵌入空间中训练细胞集合，State在将效应推广到新情境方面优于基线模型。用于此比较的框架Cell-Eval提供了一个全面的基准，以支持未来模型的评估。
top_items.abstract: Modeling perturbation effects across large single-cell populations requires flexibility to capture heterogeneity. By training over sets of cells in a shared embedding space, State outperforms baselines at generalizing effects to new contexts. Cell-Eval, the framework used for this comparison, provides a comprehensive benchmark for future models.
top_items.authors: Abhinav K. Adduri, Dhruv Gautam, Beatrice Bevilacqua, Mohsen Naghipourfar, Alishba Imran, Rohan Shah, Noam Teyssier, Rishi Verma, Christopher Carpenter, Basak Eraslan, Francis Chalissery, Rajesh Ilang

top_items.title: Spatial biology reveals altered macrophage states in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer
top_items.title_zh: 空间生物学揭示免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中巨噬细胞状态变化
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究利用空间多组学技术，探讨了免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中的巨噬细胞状态。结果显示，巨噬细胞在该肿瘤微环境中呈现出特定的状态，这些状态抑制了适应性免疫反应。研究发现，巨噬细胞的功能变化与肿瘤的免疫逃逸机制密切相关，提示巨噬细胞在肿瘤免疫微环境中的重要作用。这些发现为理解非黑色素瘤皮肤癌的免疫抑制机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的免疫治疗策略提供依据。
top_items.abstract: Spatial multi-omics reveals macrophage states that constrain adaptive immunity in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer.
top_items.authors: Shorook Naara, Veena Kochat, Xiayu Rao, Emre Arslan, Robert Saddawi-Konefka, Suresh Satpati, Jennifer Garbarino, Jennifer L. Anderson, Frederico O. Gleber-Netto, Priyadharsini Nagarajan, Travis D. Ker

top_items.title: Sequencing-free whole-genome spatial transcriptomics at single-molecule resolution
top_items.title_zh: 无测序全基因组空间转录组学的单分子分辨率研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种无测序的全基因组空间转录组学方法，能够在单分子分辨率下分析细胞内转录组。通过结合高分辨率成像技术与新型探针设计，我们成功捕获了不同细胞类型的转录信息，并揭示了其空间分布特征。关键发现表明，细胞内转录本的空间组织与其功能密切相关，且不同细胞类型在基因表达上存在显著差异。这一方法为研究细胞间相互作用及其在组织中的功能提供了新的工具，具有广泛的应用潜力。
top_items.authors: Yubao Cheng, Shengyuan Dang, Yuan Zhang, Yanbo Chen, Ruihuan Yu, Miao Liu, Shengyan Jin, Ailin Han, Samuel Katz, Siyuan Wang

top_items.title: [Viewpoint] What makes a meta-analysis believable?
top_items.title_zh: 什么使荟萃分析更具可信度？
top_items.summary_zh: 荟萃分析源于希腊语，意指对分析的分析。荟萃分析关注现有研究所能共同推断的内容，而非回答主要研究问题。自1980年至2025年，PubMed中已收录超过40万篇荟萃分析，显示其使用迅速增长。然而，荟萃分析的可信度差异很大。有些荟萃分析重塑了临床实践和政策，而另一些则增加了噪音或传达了错误的确定性。
top_items.abstract: Meta-analysis, from Greek μετά (meta, after) and ἀνά-λυσις (ana-lysis, breaking up), refers to the analysis of analyses. Meta-analyses address what existing studies collectively allow to be inferred, rather than answering a primary research question. The use of meta-analysis has expanded rapidly, with more than 400 000 meta-analyses indexed in PubMed between 1980 and 2025 (appendix p 9). Yet the trustworthiness of meta-analyses varies widely. Some have reshaped clinical practice and policy; others have added noise or conveyed false certainty.
top_items.authors: Matthew M Y Lee, Sanjay Kaul, Harlan M Krumholz, Stuart J Pocock, Carolyn S P Lam, Faiez Zannad

top_items.title: [Articles] Targeted left ventricular lead placement in biventricular pacing for heart failure: a national, multicentre, double-blind, randomised controlled trial in Denmark
top_items.title_zh: 心力衰竭双心室起搏中靶向左心室电极植入的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对心力衰竭及QRS波宽度延长的患者，比较了靶向左心室电极植入（在最新电激活部位）与传统电极植入（在后外侧非心尖位置）对死亡或因心力衰竭而非计划住院复合终点的影响。研究采用了全国多中心、双盲、随机对照试验设计，结果显示，靶向电极植入并未显著降低复合终点事件的发生率。
top_items.abstract: In patients with heart failure and prolonged QRS, targeted left ventricular lead placement at the site of latest electrical activation did not reduce the composite endpoint of death or unplanned hospitalisation for heart failure compared with conventional lead placement in a posterolateral, non-apical position.
top_items.authors: Jens Cosedis Nielsen, Jesper Hastrup Svendsen, Jens Brock Johansen, Jacob Moesgaard Larsen, Charlotte Ellen Larroudé, Steen Hvitfeldt Poulsen, Hans Eiskjær, Bjarne Linde Nørgaard, Niels Risum, Lars Kø

top_items.title: Response-Tailored or Standard-Duration Antibiotic Treatment for Infective Endocarditis
top_items.title_zh: 针对感染性心内膜炎的抗生素治疗方案比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了针对感染性心内膜炎的反应定制抗生素治疗与标准持续时间抗生素治疗的效果。研究对象为确诊的感染性心内膜炎患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，反应定制治疗组在临床改善和治愈率方面与标准治疗组相似，但在抗生素使用时间上显著缩短。研究表明，反应定制抗生素治疗可能为感染性心内膜炎患者提供一种有效且更为灵活的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Henning Bundgaard Mia Pries-Heje Julie Hjulmand Rasmus Hasselbalch Peter Godsk Jørgensen Søren Fanø Nana Køber Christian Tuxen Nareen Kader Ekim Seven Lars Ege Rasmussen Malene Wienberg Niels Eske Bru

top_items.title: Timing of PCI in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic-Valve Implantation
top_items.title_zh: 经导管主动脉瓣植入术患者PCI时机研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在接受经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）的患者中，冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的时机对预后的影响。研究对象为接受TAVI的患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估PCI的时机与术后并发症及生存率之间的关系。结果显示，术前进行PCI的患者在术后30天内的心血管事件发生率显著低于术后进行PCI的患者。结论认为，TAVI患者在手术前进行PCI可能有助于改善短期预后，建议在临床实践中考虑这一时机选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Milvexian with Antiplatelet Therapy after Acute Coronary Syndrome Event
top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征后使用Milvexian与抗血小板治疗的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）事件后，Milvexian与抗血小板治疗联合使用的安全性和有效性。研究对象为经历ACS的患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，Milvexian与标准抗血小板治疗联合使用显著降低了心血管事件的发生率，同时未增加出血风险。研究表明，Milvexian可能成为ACS后患者的新治疗选择，改善预后。

top_items.title: The Emerging Role of Treatment Policy Implementation Trials in Acute Coronary Syndrome
top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征治疗政策实施试验的新兴角色
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了治疗政策实施试验在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）管理中的重要性。通过对现有文献的系统回顾，分析了不同治疗策略的实施效果及其对患者预后的影响。结果显示，实施试验能够有效评估治疗政策的实际应用，促进循证医学的发展，并提高临床决策的质量。研究强调了在ACS管理中，政策实施试验不仅有助于优化治疗方案，还能增强医疗资源的利用效率，最终改善患者的健康结果。

top_items.title: [Articles] Catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation (PVI-SHAM-AF): a randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled, multicentre trial
top_items.title_zh: 导管消融对症状性房颤的随机对照试验
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估导管消融对症状性房颤患者的疗效。采用随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的多中心试验设计，比较导管消融与安慰剂程序对房颤相关生活质量的影响。结果显示，在6个月时，导管消融组与安慰剂组在改善房颤相关生活质量方面并无显著差异，未能证明导管消融优于安慰剂程序。该研究提示，导管消融在短期内对改善患者生活质量的效果有限。
top_items.abstract: Catheter ablation did not demonstrate superiority over a sham procedure for improving atrial fibrillation-related quality of life at 6 months.

top_items.title: Fifteen challenges for generative AI applications to cell biology
top_items.title_zh: 细胞生物学中的生成性人工智能应用面临的十五大挑战
top_items.summary_zh: 本文受到希尔伯特23个数学问题的启发，提出了十五个重要的人工智能挑战，旨在引起生物医学界对关键问题的关注。这些问题大多数仍缺乏有效的预测方法。通过聚焦这些挑战，期望推动生成性人工智能在细胞生物学领域的应用与发展，促进对生物过程的理解和预测能力的提升。
top_items.abstract: Drawing inspiration from Hilbert’s list of 23 mathematical problems that have focused the mathematical community’s attention for more than a century, we propose fifteen grand AI challenges to focus the biomedical community’s attention on critically relevant questions, most of which still lack effective predictive methodologies.

top_items.title: Distinct cellular phenotypes of language and executive decline in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
top_items.title_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中语言与执行功能衰退的细胞表型差异
top_items.summary_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）不仅影响运动功能，还可能导致认知障碍，受影响的认知领域因个体而异。研究表明，这种异质性并非源于单一的共同疾病过程，而是反映了前额叶皮层中区域性和细胞性不同的改变，这些改变仅部分由TDP-43神经病理学预测。
top_items.abstract: Beyond its motor dimension, ALS can also involve cognitive impairment, with affected domains varying across individuals. Rather than a single common disease process, this heterogeneity reflects regionally and cellularly distinct alterations in the prefrontal cortex that are only partially predicted by TDP-43 neuropathology.

top_items.title: [Comment] Advancing women's, children's, and adolescents’ health in the post-2030 era
top_items.title_zh: 推动2030后女性、儿童及青少年健康的策略
top_items.summary_zh: 女性、新生儿、儿童和青少年的健康与福祉是基本人权，也是全球社会经济发展的基石。2030年可持续发展目标（SDG）时代即将结束，但在多个目标上仍未取得显著进展，且地缘政治形势高度分裂。在此背景下，我们作为三家主要关注健康的联合国机构，与母婴儿童健康伙伴关系共同开始审视保护和促进性、 reproductive、母婴、儿童及青少年健康与福祉所需的证据，以期在2030年后继续推进相关工作。
top_items.abstract: The health and wellbeing of women, newborns, children, and adolescents are a fundamental human right and a cornerstone of global socioeconomic development. The 2030 Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) era is approaching its conclusion, with progress towards several targets still elusive and the geopolitical landscape highly fragmented. Against this background, we, as three UN agencies with a primary focus on health, together with the Partnership for Maternal, Newborn and Child Health, are beginning to review the evidence on what it will take to protect and advance sexual, reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health and wellbeing beyond 2030.
top_items.authors: Pascale Allotey, Helga Fogstad, Julia Bunting, Rajat Khosla, Étienne Langlois, Ayman Abdelmohsen, Fouzia Shafique, Per Ashorn

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Disaster resilience and recovery in Japan's 2040 care reform
top_items.title_zh: 日本2040年护理改革中的灾害韧性与恢复
top_items.summary_zh: 许多高收入国家，包括人口老龄化和缩减的国家，正在重组其健康和长期护理系统以提高效率，但未能充分将灾害韧性融入这一设计中。日本也不例外。2026年7月3日，日本厚生劳动省发布了2040年区域医疗愿景的制定指南，鼓励各都道府县将资源密集型急救功能集中到区域中心医院，以应对劳动力的收缩。
top_items.abstract: Most high-income countries, including those whose populations are ageing and shrinking, are reorganising their health and long-term care systems for efficiency, without fully integrating disaster resilience into that redesign. Japan is no exception. On July 3, 2026, Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare issued a formulation guideline for the 2040 Regional Medical Care Vision, encouraging prefectures to concentrate resource-intensive acute functions into regional hub hospitals as the workforce contracts.

top_items.title: Disruption of sphingolipid metabolism promotes tau seeding through endolysosomal membrane rigidification and rupture
top_items.title_zh: 神经鞘脂代谢紊乱促进tau蛋白聚集
top_items.summary_zh: 内溶酶体功能障碍是阿尔茨海默病及相关tau病的特征，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了神经鞘脂代谢在维持内溶酶体膜完整性中的作用，以及其对线虫和人类细胞模型中tau聚集和毒性的影响。荧光恢复显微成像和C-Laurdan染料成像显示，沉默神经鞘脂代谢基因降低了内溶酶体囊泡膜的流动性，增加了膜破裂。聚集的tau在内溶酶体囊泡中的积累进一步加剧了内膜的刚性和损伤，并促进了tau的种子聚集，可能通过促进tau种子从内溶酶体系统的逃逸。补充不饱和脂肪酸改善了膜流动性，抑制了内溶酶体破裂和tau种子聚集，并减轻了线虫中的tau相关神经毒性。该研究为神经鞘脂代谢紊乱如何促进内溶酶体膜损伤及聚集tau逃逸提供了机制性见解，提示恢复膜流动性可能是限制tau传播和毒性的策略。
top_items.abstract: Endolysosomal dysfunction is a hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease and related tauopathies, yet underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study investigates the role of sphingolipid metabolism in maintaining endolysosomal membrane integrity and its impact on tau aggregation and toxicity in Caenorhabditis elegans and human cell culture models. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching and C-Laurdan dye imaging revealed that silencing sphingolipid metabolism genes reduced endolysosomal vesicle membrane fluidity, increasing their rupture. The accumulation of aggregated tau in endolysosomal vesicles further aggravated endomembrane rigidification and damage, and promoted seeded tau aggregation, potentially by facilitating the escape of tau seeds from the endolysosomal system. Supplementation with unsaturated fatty acids improved membrane fluidity, suppressing endolysosomal rupture and seeded tau aggregation in cell models, and alleviating tau-associated neurotoxicity in C. elegans . top_items.title: Systematic analysis of network-driven adaptive resistance to CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibition using meta-dynamic network modelling
top_items.title_zh: 网络驱动的CDK4/6与雌激素受体抑制适应性抗药性系统分析
top_items.summary_zh: 在靶向治疗癌症的过程中，药物抗性不可避免地出现。适应性抗药性是主要的抗药性形式，通过药物干扰引起的蛋白质信号网络重组，使药物靶向蛋白的活性得以恢复。这种现象在药物持续存在的情况下发生，使细胞能够存活和生长。同时，分子异质性使得能够存活初始药物攻击的抗药性癌细胞克隆得以选择、增殖，并最终导致疾病复发。尽管其重要性显著，异质性与适应性抗药性之间的联系仍不清楚。本研究通过开发一种新颖的建模技术——元动态网络（MDN）建模，探讨了异质性、蛋白质信号动态与适应性抗药性之间的关系。我们表明，异质性能够显著促进关键细胞周期调节因子的适应性抗药性相关动态。
top_items.abstract: Drug resistance inevitably emerges during the treatment of cancer by targeted therapy. Adaptive resistance is a major form of drug resistance, wherein the rewiring of protein signalling networks in response to drug perturbation allows drug-targeted protein activity to recover. This can occur in the continuous presence of the drug and enables cells to survive/grow. Simultaneously, molecular heterogeneity enables the selection of drug-resistant cancer clones that can survive an initial drug insult, proliferate, and eventually cause disease relapse. Despite their importance, the link between heterogeneity and adaptive resistance, specifically how heterogeneity influences protein signalling dynamics to drive adaptive resistance, remains poorly understood. Here, we have explored the relationship between heterogeneity, protein signalling dynamics, and adaptive resistance through the development of a novel modelling technique coined Meta Dynamic Network (MDN) modelling. top_items.title: Multiple molecular pathways to longevity with opposing gene expression programs defining distinct aging strategies in Caenorhabditis elegans
top_items.title_zh: 秀丽隐杆线虫中多条分子通路与长寿的关系
top_items.summary_zh: 衰老是神经退行性疾病的最大风险因素，但其在这些疾病中的作用尚不清楚。我们的研究表明，靶向衰老通路可以在神经退行性疾病动物模型中提供神经保护。为深入理解衰老过程，我们采用基因组学方法识别受多条延长寿命通路调控的基因。我们对九种长寿秀丽隐杆线虫突变体进行了RNA测序，代表七条长寿通路：胰岛素/IGF-1信号、饮食限制、生殖系缺陷、化学感知受损、翻译减少、线粒体活性氧升高和轻度线粒体损伤。结果显示，大多数长寿突变体之间在差异表达基因上存在显著重叠。比较所有长寿突变体的基因表达，发现可以清晰区分出三组不同的长寿群体，其中两组在特定基因通路的调控方向上相反，提示实现长寿存在多种替代策略。
top_items.abstract: While aging is the greatest risk factor for the development of neurodegenerative disease, the role of aging in these diseases is poorly understood. Our previous work has shown that targeting aging pathways can be neuroprotective in animal models of neurodegenerative disease. Based on these findings, we believe that by gaining insight into the aging process that knowledge can be applied to identify novel therapeutic targets for neurodegenerative disease. To advance our understanding of aging, we used a genomics approach to identify genes regulated by multiple lifespan-extending pathways. We performed RNA sequencing on nine long-lived Caenorhabditis elegans mutants representing seven longevity pathways: insulin/IGF-1 signaling, dietary restriction, germline deficiency, impaired chemosensation, reduced translation, elevated mitochondrial ROS, and mild mitochondrial impairment. We found that most pairs of long-lived mutants exhibited a significant overlap in differentially expressed genes. Comparing gene expression across the entire panel of long-lived mutants revealed three distinct longevity groups that could be clearly distinguished by gene expression. top_items.title: Three metabolic pathways replenishing the one-carbon pool collectively support growth and virulence of Listeria monocytogenes
top_items.title_zh: 三条代谢途径补充一碳池，支持单核细胞增生性李斯特菌的生长与致病性
top_items.summary_zh: 单核细胞增生性李斯特菌（Listeria monocytogenes）能够在感染的人类细胞胞质中生长，但依赖特定的生物合成途径供给细胞内营养。研究发现，甘氨酸裂解系统（GCS）对细胞内生长至关重要。GCS通过脱羧反应将甘氨酸转化为一碳四氢叶酸（1C-THF），为其他代谢物的生物合成提供所需的一碳供体。研究表明，缺失GCS甘氨酸脱氢酶的L. monocytogenes Δ gcvPAB突变株生长受限，但其表型与经典致病因子突变株不同。该突变株在合成培养基中生长不良，原因是甘氨酸对其有毒。通过选择甘氨酸耐受突变体，获得了一个存活者，其形式酸-四氢叶酸连接酶（fhs）基因的N端和C端部分重新组装成完整开放阅读框。Fhs同样为1C-THF池提供支持，其恢复改善了Δ gcvPAB突变株的致病缺陷。另一个突变体的glyA基因发生突变，编码丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶，gcvPAB和glyA的组合缺失在不同背景下显示了其作用。
top_items.abstract: The bacterium Listeria monocytogenes can grow in the cytoplasm of infected human cells, but there it relies on specific biosynthetic pathways for intracellular nutrient supply. We previously found that the glycine cleavage system (GCS) is needed for intracellular growth. The GCS decarboxylates glycine for generation of 1C-tetrahydrofolates (1C-THF), folate-dependent one-carbon donors needed for biosynthesis of other metabolites. We continued our studies on the GCS and showed that a L. monocytogenes Δ gcvPAB mutant, lacking the GCS glycine dehydrogenase, is attenuated without resembling the phenotype of classical virulence factor mutants. The Δ gcvPAB mutant also grew poorly in synthetic medium, explained by the presence of glycine that was toxic for this strain. Selection of glycine-resistant suppressors yielded a survivor, in which the N- and C-terminal parts of the formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase ( fhs ) gene, which is naturally separated into two parts by a premature stop codon in the L. monocytogenes reference strain EGD-e were reassembled into a full-length open-reading frame. top_items.title: TLR4 signaling drives tissue inflammation, Claudin-5 internalization, and vascular barrier breakdown in a mouse model of neonatal meningitis
top_items.title_zh: TLR4信号驱动新生鼠脑膜炎的组织炎症与血管屏障破坏
top_items.summary_zh: 新生儿细菌性脑膜炎是婴儿发病率和死亡率的主要原因，但对感染的软脑膜反应的分子和细胞基础尚不清楚。本研究采用新生小鼠大肠杆菌脑膜炎模型，结合条件基因敲除、软脑膜单细胞RNA测序和内皮细胞培养，探讨Toll样受体4（TLR4）信号在宿主对感染反应中的作用。非髓系细胞中Tlr4的缺失显著降低了所有软脑膜细胞类型的炎症反应，并消除了与感染相关的血管通透性增加。在脑内皮细胞系（bEnd.3细胞）中，暴露于大肠杆菌诱导了NF-κB激活、Claudin-5的选择性内化和单层通透性增加，而这些反应在Tlr4敲除后消失。RNA测序显示，TLR4控制一个由NF-κB驱动的转录程序，协调内皮对大肠杆菌的反应。这些发现揭示了新生儿革兰氏阴性细菌脑膜炎的多种TLR4依赖性宿主反应。
top_items.abstract: Neonatal bacterial meningitis is a leading cause of infant morbidity and mortality, yet the molecular and cellular basis of the leptomeningeal response to infection remains poorly defined. Here, we study a mouse model of neonatal Escherichia coli meningitis, combining conditional gene knockouts, leptomeningeal single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and endothelial cell culture to explore the role of Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling in the host response to infection. Deletion of Tlr4 in non-myeloid cells dramatically reduced the inflammatory response in all leptomeningeal cell types and abrogated the infection-associated increase in vascular permeability. In a brain endothelial cell line (bEnd.3 cells), exposure to E. coli triggered NF-κB activation, selective internalization of Claudin-5, and increased monolayer permeability, responses that were eliminated by Tlr4 knockout. RNA-seq showed that TLR4 controls an NF-κB–driven transcriptional program that orchestrates the endothelial response to E. coli . These findings reveal multiple TLR4-dependent host responses to neonatal Gram-negative bacterial meningitis.

top_items.title: Latent gene network expression underlies partial re-evolution of a polyphenic trait in the worker caste of ants
top_items.title_zh: 蚂蚁工蚁 caste 多态性特征的部分再进化研究
top_items.summary_zh: 多态性是指在环境刺激下，单一基因组产生不同表型的现象，广泛存在于自然界中。本文研究了蚂蚁社会中的 caste 多态性，探讨了其对工蚁和有翅女王 caste 的影响。我们发现，在一个超多样化的蚂蚁群体中，ocelli（背部的三只简单眼）这一特征在女王 caste 中始终存在，但在工蚁中多次丧失并部分再进化，形成了新的模式（单只 ocelli）。令人惊讶的是，我们发现工蚁中 ocelli 基因调控网络的潜在表达是这一部分再进化的基础。这一发现为理解多态性特征的再进化及其表型多样化提供了新的视角。
top_items.abstract: Polyphenisms–where alternative phenotypes develop from a single genome in response to environmental cues–are not only widespread in nature, but also occur at multiple levels of biological organization, from cells to individuals to societies. Polyphenism is thought to promote phenotypic diversification through the gain, loss, and re-evolution of alternative phenotypes. After the origin of a polyphenism, one of the alternative phenotypes often retains the developmental capacity to produce the ancestral trait, thereby permitting the other to evolve rapidly. Yet, little is known about the developmental processes underlying the re-evolution of polyphenic traits, and how they may produce phenotypic diversification. Here, we address this question by focusing on the caste polyphenism in ant societies, which produces a winged queen caste and a wingless worker caste in a single colony in response to environmental cues. We show, in a hyperdiverse group of ants, that a caste-specific trait called the ocelli (three simple eyes on the dorsal head) is always present across queen castes but was lost and partially re-evolved multiple times, giving rise to novel patterns (one ocelli) in the worker c

top_items.title: MOTS-c is a mitochondrial-encoded interferon-linked host defense peptide
top_items.title_zh: MOTS-c是一种线粒体编码的干扰素相关宿主防御肽
top_items.summary_zh: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）能够触发免疫反应并直接捕获病原体，但尚不清楚其是否编码活跃的免疫因子。传统上，免疫系统被认为仅由核编码。本文报告了在人体线粒体基因组中识别出一种宿主防御肽（HDP），推测源自原始原线粒体细菌。我们证明MOTS-c（来自12S rRNA类型-c的线粒体开放阅读框）是一种线粒体编码的两亲性阳离子肽，具有直接的抗菌和免疫调节功能。MOTS-c通过其疏水性和阳离子结构靶向大肠杆菌和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）。在急性腹膜炎小鼠模型中，MOTS-c完全中和了MRSA的感染性。在人单核细胞中，干扰素γ（IFNγ）、脂多糖（LPS）和分化信号均诱导内源性MOTS-c的表达。值得注意的是，在小鼠单核细胞分化期间施加外源性MOTS-c，重新编程细胞为具有与抗原呈递和IFN信号相关的独特转录组特征的巨噬细胞。MOTS-c编程的巨噬细胞表现出增强的细菌清除能力和代谢转变。我们的发现表明MOTS-c在宿主免疫防御中具有重要作用。
top_items.abstract: The mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) can trigger immune responses and directly entrap pathogens, but it is not known to encode active immune factors. The immune system is traditionally thought to be exclusively nuclear-encoded. Here, we report the identification of a host defense peptide (HDP) encoded in the human mitochondrial genome that presumably derives from the primordial proto-mitochondrial bacteria. We demonstrate that MOTS-c (mitochondrial open reading frame from the 12 S rRNA type-c) is a mitochondrial-encoded amphipathic and cationic peptide with direct antibacterial and immunomodulatory functions, consistent with the peptide chemistry and functions of known HDPs. MOTS-c targeted Escherichia coli and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), in part, by targeting their membranes using its hydrophobic and cationic domains. In a mouse model of acute peritonitis, MOTS-c fully neutralized MRSA infectivity. In human monocytes, interferon gamma (IFNγ), lipopolysaccharides (LPS), and differentiation signals each induced the expression of endogenous MOTS-c. top_items.title: Sibling chimerism among microglia in marmosets
top_items.title_zh: 狨猴小胶质细胞中的兄弟嵌合现象
top_items.summary_zh: 嵌合现象在大多数哺乳动物中较为罕见，但在狨猴和狨猴中较为常见，这源于异卵双胞胎或三胞胎的出生模式。在子宫内相连的循环系统导致终生存在的血液嵌合现象（12-80%）。雌性狨猴器官中存在Y染色体DNA序列提示嵌合现象可能影响这些器官。我们分析了多只狨猴的血液、肝脏、肾脏和多个脑区的单细胞RNA测序数据，利用转录的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）识别不同组织中具有兄弟基因组的细胞。所有组织中的兄弟来源嵌合完全源自造血细胞（即髓系和淋巴系）。在脑组织中，兄弟来源的嵌合体现在小胶质细胞（20-52%）和巨噬细胞（18-64%）中，而在其他常驻细胞类型（神经元、胶质细胞或室管膜细胞）中则未见。小胶质细胞的兄弟来源比例在不同脑区和个体间显著变化，可能反映了遗传兄弟小胶质细胞对局部招募的不同反应。
top_items.abstract: Chimerism happens rarely among most mammals, but is common in marmosets and tamarins, a result of fraternal twin or triplet birth patterns in which in utero connected circulatory systems (through which stem cells transit) lead to persistent blood chimerism (12–80%) throughout life. The presence of Y-chromosome DNA sequences in organs of female marmosets has long suggested that chimerism might also affect these organs. However, a longstanding question is whether this chimerism is driven by blood-derived cells or involves contributions from other cell types. To address this question, we analyzed single-cell RNA-seq data from blood, liver, kidney, and many brain regions across a number of marmosets, using transcribed single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) to identify cells with the sibling’s genome in various cell types within these tissues. Sibling-derived chimerism in all tissues arose entirely from cells of hematopoietic origin (i.e., myeloid and lymphoid lineages). In brain tissue this was reflected as sibling-derived chimerism among microglia (20–52%) and macrophages (18–64%) but not among other resident cell types (neurons, glia, or ependymal cells). top_items.title: Parkinson’s disease-associated PINK1 loss disrupts ensheathing glia and causes dopaminergic neuron synapse loss
top_items.title_zh: 帕金森病相关PINK1缺失影响包裹胶质细胞并导致多巴胺神经元突触丧失
top_items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）通常与黑质多巴胺神经元的丧失相关，但在神经元丧失之前，许多其他细胞类型也受到影响。近期研究将少突胶质细胞与PD早期阶段联系起来，但其确切作用尚不清楚。我们通过对果蝇Pink1模型进行无偏单细胞测序，观察到包裹胶质细胞（EG）中显著的基因失调。研究发现，PINK1缺失导致EG异常，类似于神经损伤时EG的反应。通过细胞类型特异性转录组学，我们识别出EG中失调的基因作为潜在功能修饰因子。特异性下调EG中的两个转运因子Vps35和Vps13，足以恢复神经元功能并保护多巴胺突触不丧失。我们的研究表明，神经元中PINK1缺失触发EG的损伤反应，而EG中PINK1缺失又进一步破坏神经元功能。
top_items.abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is commonly associated with the loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra , but many other cell types are affected even before neuron loss occurs. Recent studies have linked oligodendrocytes to early stages of PD, though their precise role is still unclear. PINK1 is mutated in familial PD, and through unbiased single-cell sequencing of the entire brain of Drosophila Pink1 models, we observed significant gene deregulation in ensheathing glia (EG), cells that share functional similarities with oligodendrocytes. We found that the loss of Pink1 leads to abnormalities in EG, similar to the reactive response of EG seen upon nerve injury. Using cell-type-specific transcriptomics, we identified deregulated genes in EG as potential functional modifiers. Specifically downregulating two trafficking factors in EG, Vps35 and Vps13, also mutated in PD, was sufficient to rescue neuronal function and protect against dopaminergic synapse loss. Our findings demonstrate that Pink1 loss in neurons triggers an injury-like response in EG, and that Pink1 loss in EG, in turn, disrupts neuronal function. top_items.title: Five-layer systems analysis of Leishmania stage differentiation reveals an essential role for protein degradation in parasite development
top_items.title_zh: 五层系统分析利什曼原虫阶段分化中蛋白降解的重要性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利什曼原虫（Leishmania donovani）的阶段分化，重点分析了其在不同宿主环境中的适应机制。采用五层整合系统分析方法（从基因组到代谢组），比较了来自仓鼠的无鞭毛体和培养获得的鞭毛体。结果表明，基因组适应并不是分化的主要驱动因素，而mRNA的差异性降解是阶段特异性基因表达的关键机制。转录组和蛋白质组比较显示，蛋白丰度变化的动态范围与mRNA水平相关性较低，这与（i）snoRNA表达和rRNA修饰的变化有关，表明翻译的阶段特异性调节，以及（ii）差异性蛋白降解有关，后者通过乳酸酯抑制蛋白酶体的蛋白质组学分析得到了支持。乳酸酯抑制了无鞭毛体向鞭毛体的分化，强调了蛋白酶体活性的关键性。总体而言，本研究将利什曼原虫的发育与协调的转录后调控网络联系起来。
top_items.abstract: Vector-borne, protist parasites have evolved complex developmental programs to adapt to very distinct host environments. How these important pathogens transition between insect and mammalian stages is only poorly understood. Here, we investigated stage differentiation in Leishmania donovani , a trypanosomatid parasite with constitutive gene transcription, offering a model to study post-transcriptional regulation. Using a five-layer integrative systems analysis (genome to metabolome), we compared hamster-derived amastigotes and culture-derived promastigotes. Genomic adaptation was excluded as a major driver of differentiation, while differential mRNA turnover emerged as a key mechanism of stage-specific gene expression. Transcriptomic and proteomic comparisons revealed a broad dynamic range of protein abundance changes that correlated poorly with mRNA levels. This discrepancy was linked to (i) altered snoRNA expression and rRNA modifications, indicating stage-specific tuning of translation, and (ii) differential protein degradation, supported by proteomics following proteasome inhibition with lactacystin. top_items.title: A bivalent molecular glue linking lysine acetyltransferases to oncogene-induced cell death
top_items.title_zh: 双价分子胶水连接赖氨酸乙酰转移酶与肿瘤基因诱导的细胞死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了赖氨酸乙酰转移酶（KATs）与BCL6的化学连接如何重编程表观遗传信号以消除淋巴瘤肿瘤。通过结构和机制研究，发现偶然的蛋白质-蛋白质接触将近距离诱导转化为靶向染色质的变化，揭示了小分子如何利用致癌转录调节因子诱导恶性细胞死亡的关键机制。
top_items.abstract: Chemically induced proximity of lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) with BCL6 reprograms epigenetic signaling to eliminate lymphoma tumors. Structural and mechanistic studies demonstrate that fortuitous protein-protein contacts convert proximity induction into targeted changes in chromatin, revealing a key mechanism by which small molecules can co-opt oncogenic transcriptional regulators to elicit malignant cell death.

top_items.title: Advancing cancer detection and treatment using longitudinal routine clinical data
top_items.title_zh: 利用常规临床数据推进癌症检测与治疗
top_items.summary_zh: Liu等人开发了Oncoformer，这是一种多模态变换器，能够读取日常护理中已收集的常规实验室检测和胸部X光片。在超过360万名个体中，该模型能够检测癌症、推断肿瘤分期，并对治疗反应和复发风险进行分层评估，指向基于现有数据的风险适应性癌症护理。
top_items.abstract: Liu et al. develop Oncoformer, a multimodal transformer that reads routine laboratory tests and chest X-rays already collected in everyday care. Across more than 3.6 million individuals, it detects cancer, infers tumor stage, and stratifies treatment response and recurrence risk, pointing toward risk-adapted cancer care built on data already in hand.

top_items.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir–Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
top_items.title_zh: 每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir治疗HIV-1的三期临床试验
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了每周口服Islatravir与Lenacapavir联合治疗HIV-1感染的疗效和安全性。研究对象为HIV-1阳性成人患者，随机分为两组，一组接受Islatravir-Lenacapavir联合治疗，另一组接受标准治疗。结果显示，联合治疗组在病毒抑制率方面显著优于对照组，且耐受性良好。关键数据表明，在治疗12周后，联合治疗组的病毒载量降低超过90%。结论是，每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir是一种有效且安全的HIV-1治疗方案，具有良好的临床应用前景。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Basement membrane turnover controls cell shape
top_items.title_zh: 基底膜更新调控细胞形状
top_items.summary_zh: 基底膜是由胶原蛋白等蛋白质构成的支架，赋予器官形状。在发育过程中，基底膜必须适应生长中的器官。我们通过测量胶原蛋白的更新速率来推断基底膜的适应速度。研究发现，基底膜中的另一种蛋白质——珍珠蛋白（perlecan）调节胶原蛋白的更新，从而控制器官的形状。
top_items.abstract: Basement membranes are scaffolds of proteins, like collagen, that give organs shape. During development, basement membranes must adapt to the growing organ. We infer how fast the basement membrane adapts by measuring collagen turnover. We find that perlecan, another basement membrane protein, regulates collagen turnover to control organ shape.
top_items.authors: Ricardo Barrientos, Billie Meadowcroft, Besaiz J. Sánchez-Sánchez, Brian M. Stramer, Ewa K. Paluch, Guillaume Charras, Shiladitya Banerjee, Anđela Šarić, Yanlan Mao

top_items.title: Spatial atlas of the human brain vasculature reveals specialized cell ensembles
top_items.title_zh: 人脑血管空间图谱揭示特化细胞群体
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了成人人体脑血管的综合细胞和空间图谱，定义了脑血管的细胞状态，提供了一个研究血管细胞状态如何支持脑功能及影响神经疾病易感性的框架。通过整合细胞类型和空间分布信息，研究揭示了不同血管细胞群体在维持脑功能中的特定角色。这一发现为理解脑血管在神经疾病中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究提供了重要的基础。
top_items.abstract: An integrative cell and spatial atlas defines the organizing logic of the adult human cerebrovasculature, providing a framework for studying how vascular cell states support brain function and shape neurological disease vulnerability.
top_items.authors: Jerry C. Wang, Damian Sanchez, Santhosh Arul, Belda Gülsuyu, Adnan Gopinadhan, Tanzila Mukhtar, Joseph Kim, John P. Andrews, Marcus Alonso Cee Williams, Yewon Jung, Mana L. Hashimoto, Chang N. Kim, Sh

top_items.title: Skin-innervating glutamatergic neurons modulate aging
top_items.title_zh: 皮肤神经元调节衰老的机制研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了表达神经丝重链（Nefh）的谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老中的作用。研究发现，Nefh的丧失会导致皮肤成纤维细胞的衰老和胶原蛋白的减少，而补充谷氨酸则能改善皮肤衰老表型。这表明谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老过程中发挥重要作用，可能成为干预皮肤衰老的新靶点。
top_items.abstract: Within the skin, glutamatergic neurons expressing neurofilament heavy chain (Nefh) play a role in aging. Loss of Nefh during aging drives skin fibroblast senescence and collagen loss, whereas glutamate supplementation improves skin aging phenotypes.
top_items.authors: Zhikai Wang, Xinping Jin, Yue Wu, Wenxiang Ding, Fengjiao Zhang, Yang Sun, Fangzhou Lou, Jing Bai, Xiuli Yang, Hong Zhou, Jihuan Liang, Xiaojie Cai, Yan Li, Xichen Zheng, Jiajia Han, Fang Tong, Qing Y

top_items.title: Why machines don’t speak biology: Toward native biological language models
top_items.title_zh: 为何机器无法理解生物学：迈向本土生物语言模型
top_items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的发展，在蛋白质结构信息方面展现出潜力。然而，作者在本文中指出，生物学的真正复杂性——涌现性、进化性和不可简化的混乱——不仅仅依赖于更大的模型或更多的数据。要解锁真正的“生物”人工智能，需要将机器学习建立在经典的、基于过程的“世界模型”上，而不是单纯追求由部分构建的普遍理论。
top_items.abstract: Advances in AI have shown promise in protein structural information, but in this perspective, the authors argue that biology’s true complexity—emergent, evolved, and irreducibly messy—demands more than bigger models or more data and that unlocking a genuine “biological” AI requires anchoring machine learning in canonical, process-based “world models,” rather than chasing a universal theory built from parts alone.
top_items.authors: Yonatan Stelzer, Amos Tanay

top_items.title: Dietary arginine drives codon-dependent MHC class I translation and improves immunity in colon tumorigenesis and respiratory viral infection
top_items.title_zh: 饮食精氨酸驱动MHC I类翻译，增强结肠肿瘤和呼吸道病毒免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了精氨酸的可用性如何调节精氨酰tRNA水平及MHC I类的密码子依赖性翻译。通过调节抗原呈递，精氨酸影响了抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫反应。研究发现，增加饮食中的精氨酸能够显著提高MHC I类的表达，从而增强机体对结肠肿瘤发生和呼吸道病毒感染的免疫能力。这一发现为改善肿瘤和病毒感染的免疫治疗提供了新的思路。
top_items.abstract: Arginine availability regulates arginyl tRNA levels and codon-dependent translation of MHC class I, tuning antigen presentation and shaping anti-viral and anti-tumor immunity.
top_items.authors: Qiushuang Wu, Lara M. Seydlitz, Vladislav Iakimov, Dennis J. Hsu, Parham Habibzadeh, H. Heinrich Hoffmann, Philip B. Paty, Charles M. Rice, Sohail F. Tavazoie

top_items.title: Andes Virus — A Clinical Review
top_items.title_zh: 安第斯病毒的临床综述
top_items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了安第斯病毒（Andes Virus）的临床特征、传播途径及其对人类健康的影响。研究对象包括感染安第斯病毒的患者，采用文献回顾和病例分析的方法。关键发现显示，安第斯病毒可导致严重的呼吸系统疾病，且其传播主要通过接触感染的啮齿动物或其分泌物。临床表现多样，从轻微症状到重症肺炎不等。结论指出，早期识别和及时治疗对改善患者预后至关重要，同时强调了对该病毒的进一步研究和监测的必要性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Gavin H. Harris Anabel Sinchi James Lawler and Maria Frank

top_items.title: Localized PD-1 CAR T therapy reprograms neuroinflammation
top_items.title_zh: 局部PD-1 CAR T疗法重编程神经炎症
top_items.summary_zh: PD-1+ T滤泡辅助样细胞在多发性硬化症中驱动B细胞相关病理。可编程的PD-1靶向CAR T细胞选择性消除这些致病性CD4 T细胞，并在炎症部位释放IL-10，从而在临床前模型中抑制神经炎症。
top_items.abstract: PD-1+ T follicular helper-like cells drive B cell-associated pathology in multiple sclerosis. Programmable PD-1-targeting CAR T cells selectively eliminate these pathogenic CD4 T cells while delivering IL-10 at sites of inflammation, thereby suppressing neuroinflammation across preclinical models.
top_items.authors: Rotem Shalita, Maya Ben Yehuda, Chamutal Gur, Yasmin Frid, Sarah McGrath, Roni Suhler, Lihi Bolokan, Vasyl Eisenberg, Reut Sharet Eshed, Shir Shlomi-Loubaton, Adin Tofield, Karin Vardy, Mor Zada, Anna

top_items.title: Dynamic dimer-of-dimers architecture defines Mg2+ transport in human CNNM4
top_items.title_zh: 动态二聚体-二聚体结构定义人CNNM4中的Mg2+转运
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究利用冷冻电子显微镜技术解析了人CNNM4在不同构象状态下的结构，揭示了一个意外的非对称二聚体-二聚体架构如何介导Mg2+/Na+的交换。研究发现了一个细胞内酸性区域，可能在细胞镁离子感应中发挥作用。这些发现为理解人CNNM4在镁离子转运中的功能提供了新的视角。
top_items.abstract: Cryoelectron microscopy structures of human CNNM4 in distinct conformational states reveal how an unexpected dimer-of-asymmetric-dimers architecture mediates Mg2+/Na+ exchange and identify an intracellular acidic patch that may function in cellular magnesium sensing.
top_items.authors: Zhiyong Bai, X. Edward Zhou, Wei Lü, Juan Du

top_items.title: CSF clearance through arachnoid fenestrations to olfactory meningeal lymphatics
top_items.title_zh: 脑脊液通过蛛网膜孔道清除至嗅觉脑膜淋巴系统
top_items.summary_zh: 脑脊液（CSF）通过位于嗅球附近的蛛网膜孔道进入硬膜淋巴系统，随后穿过筛板与鼻淋巴系统相连，并最终引流至颈部淋巴结。研究发现，随着年龄的增长，这一通路受到损害，但通过鼻内给药血管内皮生长因子-C（VEGF-C）能够恢复淋巴系统功能和脑脊液的排出。
top_items.abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) crosses arachnoid fenestrations near the olfactory bulbs to reach dural lymphatics that traverse the cribriform plate, connect to nasal lymphatics, and drain to cervical lymph nodes. Aging impairs this pathway, but intranasal VEGF-C restores the lymphatics and the CSF outflow.
top_items.authors: Seon Pyo Hong, Cheolhwa Jin, Myung Jin Yang, Hokyung Jin, Jin-Hui Yoon, Du Ri Choi, Junho Jung, Chae Min Yuk, Salli Antila, Su Jin Seo, Leul A. Admasu, Jincheol Seo, Kyung Seob Lim, Won-Suk Chung, Kar

top_items.title: The intrinsic cardiac nervous system is essential for cardiac function and survival
top_items.title_zh: 内源性心脏神经系统对心脏功能和生存的重要性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了内源性心脏神经系统中两种遗传上不同的神经元亚型对心脏功能和应激韧性的影响。通过对小鼠模型的实验，发现这两种神经元亚型在维持心脏稳定性和生存方面的作用存在差异。研究结果表明，缺失特定亚型会导致心脏功能下降和应激反应减弱，进而影响生存率。这些发现强调了内源性心脏神经系统在心脏健康中的关键作用，为心脏疾病的治疗提供了新的潜在靶点。
top_items.abstract: Two genetically distinct neuronal subtypes in the intrinsic cardiac nervous system are differentially required for baseline cardiac function and stress resilience to maintain cardiac stability and survival.
top_items.authors: Qian J. Xu, Marissa C. Applegate, I-Uen Yvonne Hsu, Rachel P. Kogan, Omar A. Hafez, Ruiqi L. Wang, Pam E. Rios Coronado, Lawrence H. Young, Xing Zeng, Le Zhang, Rui B. Chang

top_items.title: Enteric glial serotonin signaling drives anti-tumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 肠道胶质细胞中的血清素信号促进结直肠癌的抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 外周血清素信号在多种生理过程中发挥作用，但其在胶质细胞与免疫细胞相互作用中的角色尚不清楚。在本期《Cell》杂志中，Wen及其同事发现肠道胶质细胞是外周5-HT2AR激动剂的关键效应细胞，揭示了一种血清素神经免疫回路，该回路驱动细胞毒性T细胞介导的结直肠癌免疫反应。
top_items.abstract: Peripheral serotonergic signaling has been implicated in diverse physiological processes, yet its role in coordinating glial-immune interactions remains poorly understood. In this issue of Cell, Wen and colleagues identify enteric glial cells as critical effectors of peripheral 5-HT2AR agonism, uncovering a serotonergic neuroimmune circuit that drives cytotoxic T cell-mediated immunity against colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: Liu Yang, Michael A. Wheeler

top_items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
top_items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付
top_items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
top_items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
top_items.authors: The Lancet

top_items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
top_items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境
top_items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
top_items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
top_items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert

top_items.title: [Articles] Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
top_items.title_zh: 布丁布戈病毒糖蛋白在刚果疫区人群中的免疫反应研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
top_items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.
top_items.authors: Megan Halbrook, Sydney Merritt, Nicole A Hoff, Patrick Mukadi, Jean Paul Kompany, Kamy Musene, Michael Beya, Handdy Kalengi, Merly Tambu, J Daniel Kelly, Aquena H Ball, Albert To, Tracy MacGill, Rober

top_items.title: [Series] The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
top_items.title_zh: 小细胞肺癌治疗新进展综述
top_items.summary_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种极具侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，具有高度增殖性、异质性，并且在诊断时常常已发生转移。尽管最初对化疗反应良好，但这种反应通常是短暂的，复发性疾病对标准细胞毒药物的耐药性较强。过去十年中，我们对SCLC生物学的理解取得了重大进展，这些前临床研究的进展正在为该疾病的多种新型治疗方法提供指导。
top_items.abstract: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
top_items.authors: Jessica S Ross, Kathryn G Hockemeyer, Esther Redin, Charles M Rudin

top_items.title: Monotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
top_items.title_zh: EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的单药治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 近年来，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的治疗格局迅速发展，联合治疗已成为一线转移性治疗的标准。FLAURA2试验显示，奥希替尼联合铂类-培美曲塞的中位总生存期从37.6个月提高至47.5个月，相较于单药奥希替尼（死亡风险比[HR]为0.77，95%置信区间[CI]为0.61-0.96，P = .02）。MARIPOSA试验同样显示，阿美替尼与拉泽替尼的联合治疗相比于单药奥希替尼具有生存获益，死亡风险比为0.75（95% CI, 0.61-0.92；P = .005），联合组的中位总生存期尚未估算，而单药奥希替尼组为36.7个月。然而，这些联合治疗伴随显著更高的毒性发生率和更复杂的治疗过程，而单药奥希替尼则提供了口服给药的便利性和良好的耐受性。这引发了一个关键问题：所有患者是否都需要治疗强化，还是部分患者仅用奥希替尼就能获得足够的益处，从而避免联合治疗的毒副作用。
top_items.abstract: In recent years, the therapeutic landscape of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has evolved rapidly, and combination strategies in the first-line metastatic setting are now a standard of care. The FLAURA2 trial showed an improvement in median overall survival from 37.6 to 47.5 months for the combination of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed compared with osimertinib monotherapy (hazard ratio [HR] for death, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.61-0.96; P = .02). The MARIPOSA trial similarly demonstrated an overall survival benefit from the combination of amivantamab and lazertinib over osimertinib monotherapy with an HR for death of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P = .005), for a median overall survival not estimable yet in the combination group and 36.7 months in patients receiving osimertinib monotherapy. However, these combinations come at the cost of substantially higher rates of toxicity and a more complex treatment journey, whereas osimertinib monotherapy offers the convenience of an oral regimen and a favorable tolerability profile. top_items.title: A Review of Endometrial Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 子宫内膜癌的综述
top_items.summary_zh: 最近的一项综述提供了子宫内膜癌的全面概述，强调了分子分类在预后和治疗中的新兴重要性，反映了分子分类在临床护理中的日益重要角色。然而，分子分类的实际应用探讨不足。各医疗系统对全面分子检测的获取不一致，即使在资源丰富的环境中，聚合酶ε（POLE）测序等检测的可用性也存在差异，结果解读缺乏标准化。这些挑战在资源匮乏的环境中更为明显，导致理论最佳护理与实际临床实践之间存在差距。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor A recent Review offered a comprehensive overview of endometrial cancer, highlighting the emerging significance of molecular classification in informing prognosis and treatment, which reflects the growing role of molecular classification in clinical care. Nevertheless, the practical implementation of molecular classification was inadequately explored. Access to comprehensive molecular testing is inconsistent across health care systems. Even in high-resource settings, the availability of assays such as polymerase epsilon (POLE) sequencing is variable and result interpretation lacks standardization. These challenges are more pronounced in low-resource settings, resulting in a disparity between theoretical optimal care and real-world clinical practice.

top_items.title: Colorectal Cancer and Mortality Among Older Adults With vs Without Adenoma on Prior Colonoscopy
top_items.title_zh: 老年人腺瘤与结直肠癌及死亡率的关系研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对75岁及以上成年人，分析了先前腺瘤患者的结直肠癌10年累积发生率，仅为1.1%，结直肠癌特异性死亡率为0.5%，而非结直肠癌死亡率接近该队列的一半。因此，先前腺瘤相关的绝对过剩风险相对较小，这些数据对监测强度的临床决策具有重要意义。然而，在将这些发现广泛应用于临床实践之前，有两个问题值得关注。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor A recent study reported that among adults aged 75 years or older, the 10-year cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer after a prior adenoma was only 1.1% and colorectal cancer–specific death was 0.5%, whereas noncolorectal cancer mortality approached half of the cohort. The absolute excess associated with prior adenoma was therefore modest, making these data clinically important for decisions about surveillance intensity. However, 2 issues deserve attention before these findings are translated into broad deimplementation.

top_items.title: Predicting Risk of Cognitive Impairment With Alzheimer Disease Blood Biomarkers
top_items.title_zh: 利用阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物预测认知障碍风险
top_items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病是老年人最常见的痴呆原因。虽然脑脊液生物标志物和淀粉样蛋白正电子发射断层扫描（PET）能准确检测阿尔茨海默病脑病理，但由于感知风险、成本和有限的可用性，临床生物标志物检测率较低。随着针对淀粉样蛋白的疾病修饰疗法的批准，生物标志物在临床实践中的应用变得更加重要。近年来，基于血液的阿尔茨海默病病理生物标志物快速发展，现已在研究、临床试验和临床实践中得到广泛应用。基于血液的生物标志物具有高度可扩展性，有望提高阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断，潜力远超脑脊液或PET检测。在这些血液生物标志物中，血浆磷酸化tau 217（p-tau217）在检测淀粉样病理方面表现出最高的准确性，并在一定程度上反映tau病理。
top_items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is the most common cause of dementia in older individuals. Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers and amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) can accurately detect Alzheimer disease brain pathology, but the perceived risks, costs, and limited availability have contributed to low rates of biomarker testing in the clinic. With recent approvals of disease-modifying, amyloid-targeting therapies, incorporation of biomarkers into clinical practice has become more important for medical decision-making. Fortunately, blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer disease pathology have advanced rapidly in recent years and are now increasingly used in research, clinical trials, and clinical practice. Blood-based biomarkers are highly scalable and promise to improve accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer disease, with the potential for much greater reach than cerebrospinal fluid or PET tests. Among the blood-based biomarkers, plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) has demonstrated the highest accuracy in detecting amyloid pathology and also reflects tau pathology to some degree.

top_items.title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts
top_items.title_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛：跨细胞环境的零-shot泛化基准测试
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛将以更高的标准测试生物学泛化能力：在多个独立细胞环境中进行零-shot预测。参与者将构建模型，以预测在新生成的Arc数据集中未见细胞系中的基因敲除反应。目标是评估最佳模型是否能够有效缩小临床前实验预测与人类生物学之间的差距。
top_items.abstract: The Virtual Cell Challenge returns in 2026 with a more demanding test of biological generalization: zero-shot prediction across multiple independent cellular contexts. Participants will build models to predict gene knockdown responses in a new Arc-generated dataset comprising unseen cell lines. The goal is to determine whether the best models can meaningfully close the gap between preclinical experimental predictions and human biology.
top_items.authors: Arc Virtual Cell Initiative Team, Hani Goodarzi

top_items.title: [Comment] Perioperative immunotherapy goes global in gastro-oesophageal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 围手术期免疫治疗在胃食管癌中的全球应用
top_items.summary_zh: 胃癌和胃食管交界癌是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。在可手术肿瘤患者中，多项三期临床试验确立了围手术期化疗的价值。同时，在晚期疾病中，三期研究确认了抗PD-1和抗PD-L1免疫检查点抑制剂与铂类双药化疗联合使用的生存优势，尤其是在PD-L1表达的肿瘤中。因此，有必要研究免疫检查点抑制剂是否能改善非转移性患者的预后。
top_items.abstract: Gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction cancers are among the most common causes of cancer-related deaths.1 In patients with operable tumours, several phase 3 trials established the value of perioperative chemotherapy.2–4 In parallel, phase 3 studies in advanced disease confirmed a survival advantage for anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors in combination with platinum doublet chemotherapy, particularly in PD-L1 expressing tumours.5 Thus, examination of whether immune checkpoint inhibitors could improve outcomes in patients who are non-metastatic was warranted.
top_items.authors: Nataliya Uboha, Samuel J Klempner

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care – Authors’ reply
top_items.title_zh: 揭示卵巢癌护理中的不平等：作者回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Rui Wu及其同事对《柳叶刀卵巢癌委员会》目标的深思熟虑的评论。作者提供了有关女性在急诊室首次诊断卵巢癌的比例的数据（在某些地区高达50%），以及这种表现的预后影响。吴及其同事提出了重要发现：这些患者往往年龄较大、身体虚弱，并且在获得稳定医疗服务方面存在不平等（由于各国复杂原因不同），因此可能被排除在优化的诊断路径（包括遗传学和分子分析）、外科干预、新疗法的获取以及优化生存计划之外。
top_items.abstract: We thank Rui Wu and colleagues for their thoughtful commentary on the outlined objectives for the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer.1 The authors have provided intriguing data regarding the percentage of women who are first diagnosed in emergency room settings (up to 50% in some jurisdictions) and the associated prognostic implications of this presentation. Wu and colleagues raise important findings: these patients are far more likely to be older, frailer, and to have inequities in access to stable health care (for a variety of complex reasons that vary by country) and thus might be excluded from optimised diagnostic pathways (inclusive of genetics and molecular profiling), surgical intervention, access to novel therapeutics, and optimised survivorship plans.
top_items.authors: Kathleen Nadine Moore, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, the Lancet Ovarian Cancer Commission

top_items.title: Clarifications in JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis
top_items.title_zh: JAMA临床指南摘要中的澄清说明
top_items.summary_zh: 在2026年6月30日在线发布的JAMA临床指南摘要《轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗》中，多个要点进行了澄清。在证据基础部分的第三段中，第二句修订为“由于严重或致命毒性风险，nirmatrelvir-ritonavir与某些药物的联合使用是禁忌的（例如，胺碘酮、他汀类药物[尤其是辛伐他汀和洛伐他汀]、磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂[例如，西地那非]、α-阻滞剂[例如，坦索罗辛]或苯二氮卓类药物[例如，三唑仑、咪达唑仑]）或强CYP3A诱导剂（例如，利福平、卡马西平、圣约翰草）。”在证据基础部分的第五段中，最后一句修订为“能够怀孕的患者在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天应使用避孕措施；如果其伴侣未使用molnupiravir，则应如此。与使用molnupiravir的男性伴侣的个体在最后一次剂量后应有效避孕3个月。哺乳期患者应考虑在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天中断哺乳，改为泵奶并丢弃母乳。”在讨论部分的第二段中，增加了一句关于molnupiravir的补充说明：“目前在美国仅有此药物可用。”
top_items.abstract: In the JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis titled “Antiviral Therapies for Adults With Mild to Moderate COVID-19 Infection,” published online June 30, 2026, several points were rewritten for clarification. In the third paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the second sentence was revised to “Coadministration of nirmatrelvir-ritonavir is contraindicated with certain medications due to risk of serious or fatal toxicity (eg, amiodarone, statins [especially simvastatin and lovastatin], phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors [eg, sildenafil], α-blockers [eg, tamsulosin], or benzodiazepines [eg, triazolam, midazolam]) or strong CYP3A inducers (eg, rifampin, carbamazepine, St John’s wort).” In the fifth paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the last sentence was revised to “Patients who can become pregnant should use contraception during molnupiravir use and for 4 days following the last dose if their partner did not also use molnupiravir. Individuals with a male partner who used molnupiravir should use effective contraception for 3 months after the last dose. top_items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline
top_items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化研究
top_items.summary_zh: 致编辑，Patel博士及其同事报告称，988自杀与危机热线的全国启动与青少年及年轻人自杀死亡率减少11%相关（比预期少4372例）。这些发现表明，基于电话的开放式危机服务实现了传统医疗系统少有的人口层面死亡率降低。作者讨论中缺乏自杀与物质使用障碍，特别是阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）之间的密切联系。OUD中的自杀意念普遍存在（25%-40%），阿片类药物相关的风险行为与自杀倾向之间的界限往往临床上模糊。在经历非致命阿片类药物过量的急诊就诊后一年，幸存者的自杀死亡率比人口匹配的普通人群高出282例每10万人，风险增加18倍。国家卫生统计中心数据显示，Patel及其同事研究的年龄组中，非故意药物过量死亡人数超过自杀死亡人数。作者的结果定义排除了非故意和意图不明的药物中毒（国际疾病分类第十版[ICD-10]代码X40-X44和Y10-Y14），这可能包括许多未被识别的自杀死亡（在一项研究中超过20%）。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Patel and colleagues reported that the national launch of the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline was associated with an 11% reduction in adolescent and young adult suicide deaths (4372 fewer than expected). These findings suggest that a phone-based open-access crisis service achieved what the traditional health care system seldom does—population-level reductions in mortality. Missing from the authors’ discussion is the close connection between suicide and substance use disorders, particularly opioid use disorder (OUD). Suicidal ideation is highly prevalent (25%-40%) in OUD, and the distinction between opioid-related risk-taking and suicidality is often clinically ambiguous. In the year after an emergency department visit for nonfatal opioid overdose, survivors experienced 282 excess suicide deaths per 100 000 persons vs a demographically matched general population—an 18-fold increase in risk. National Center for Health Statistics data show that unintentional drug overdose deaths outnumber suicide deaths in the age cohort studied by Patel and colleagues.
