top_items.title: Optimizing the Therapeutic Ratio in Prostate Radiation Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 优化前列腺放射治疗的治疗比率
top_items.summary_zh: 前列腺癌长期以来是癌症治疗创新的重要领域。与许多其他恶性肿瘤相比，局部前列腺癌具有独特的临床特征。尽管新诊断病例的发生率较高，但前列腺癌通常呈现出缓慢的自然病程，导致前列腺癌特异性死亡风险较低。同时，存在多种管理策略，包括手术、放射治疗和积极监测，这些策略在适当选择的男性中提供类似的疾病结果。因此，局部疾病的治疗决策必须考虑肿瘤学结果以及尿液、肠道和性功能的保护。在过去几十年中，影像学、风险分层（包括基因组学）和治疗实施的进展不断重塑前列腺癌护理，目标是：在接受局部治疗的早期疾病男性中，临床医生和研究人员必须努力优化治疗比率，保持高癌症控制率，同时最小化治疗相关的发病率。
top_items.abstract: Prostate cancer has long served as a fertile ground for innovation in cancer therapy. Compared with many other malignancies, localized prostate cancer occupies a unique clinical space. Although the incidence of new diagnoses is high, prostate cancer often follows an indolent natural history, resulting in a low risk of prostate cancer–specific mortality. Meanwhile, multiple management strategies exist, including surgery, radiation therapy, and active surveillance, which provide similar disease outcomes in appropriately selected men. As a result, treatment decisions for localized disease must account for not only oncologic outcomes but also preservation of urinary, bowel, and sexual function. Over the past several decades, advances in imaging, risk stratification (including genomics), and treatment delivery have steadily reshaped prostate cancer care with a common goal: in men with early-stage disease who receive local therapy, clinicians and investigators must attempt to optimize the therapeutic ratio by maintaining high rates of cancer control, while minimizing treatment-related morbidity.

top_items.title: Ceperognastat in Alzheimer Disease
top_items.title_zh: Ceperognastat在阿尔茨海默病中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病的特征是细胞外淀粉样β斑块和由过度磷酸化的tau蛋白组成的神经纤维缠结的积累。多年来，药物开发主要集中在淀粉样β斑块上，最近批准的淀粉样靶向单克隆抗体lecanemab和donanemab用于早期阿尔茨海默病的治疗。同时，针对tau缠结的治疗开发也引起了广泛关注，tau缠结是阿尔茨海默病的第二种特征性病变。
top_items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is defined by the accumulation of extracellular amyloid-β plaques and intraneuronal neurofibrillary tangles composed of hyperphosphorylated tau. For many years, drug development efforts have focused on amyloid-β plaques, culminating in the recent approval of the amyloid-targeting monoclonal antibodies lecanemab and donanemab for the treatment of early-stage Alzheimer disease. In parallel, there has been considerable interest in developing treatments directed at tau tangles, the second pathognomonic lesion of Alzheimer disease.

top_items.title: [Comment] Cardiac resynchronisation therapy: 30 years of progress
top_items.title_zh: 心脏再同步治疗：30年的进展
top_items.summary_zh: 双室起搏的心脏再同步治疗（BiV-CRT）彻底改变了左束支传导阻滞（LBBB）患者心力衰竭的治疗方法。研究发现，LBBB会导致心脏功能受损，随后发现将导线植入左心室自由壁与右心室导线结合，可以显著改善LBBB患者的急性心脏功能。专用导线的发展促进了BiV-CRT的完全经静脉方法，通过冠状窦的心室分支靶向左心室自由壁。
top_items.abstract: Cardiac resynchronisation therapy with biventricular pacing (BiV-CRT) revolutionised the treatment of heart failure in patients with left bundle-branch block (LBBB). Its development, founded upon observations that LBBB leads to cardiac impairment,1 progressed to finding that combining a lead implanted on the left ventricular free wall with a lead in the right ventricle could provide drastic improvements in acute cardiac function in patients with LBBB.2 The development of dedicated leads facilitated the fully transvenous approach to BiV-CRT, with the left ventricular free wall targeted by using a ventricular branch of the coronary sinus.
top_items.authors: Matthew Shun-Shin, Zachary Whinnett

top_items.title: [Comment] Late-onset seizures as a sentinel of Alzheimer's disease progression in Down syndrome
top_items.title_zh: 唐氏综合症患者晚发性癫痫与阿尔茨海默病进展的关系
top_items.summary_zh: 癫痫是老年唐氏综合症患者常见的共病，且常与阿尔茨海默病相关的认知下降相伴随。晚发性肌阵挛癫痫（LOMEDS）在唐氏综合症中表现为肌阵挛或强直-阵挛发作，可能既是潜在阿尔茨海默病病理的表现，也是加速疾病进展的因素。然而，唐氏综合症成人癫痫发作的时间与阿尔茨海默病症状及进展之间的关系尚不明确，这使得对认知下降的解读和临床管理变得复杂。
top_items.abstract: Epilepsy is a common co-occurring condition in older adults with Down syndrome and frequently associated with the emergence of Alzheimer's disease-related cognitive decline.1 Likely to be under-recognised and often untreated in the earlier stages, late-onset myoclonic epilepsy in Down syndrome (LOMEDS) presents as myoclonic or tonic–clonic seizures and can be both a manifestation of underlying Alzheimer's disease pathology and an accelerator of disease progression.2 How seizure onset timing in adults with Down syndrome relates to Alzheimer's disease symptoms and progression remains unclear, complicating interpretation of decline and clinical management.
top_items.authors: Zinayida Schlachetzki, Michael S Rafii

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B
top_items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配的研究进展
top_items.summary_zh: WILLOW试验的Cohort B结果区分了狼疮试验中常混淆的两个问题：药物是否改变了疾病生物学，以及所选的复合终点是否能够检测到这种改变。尽管enpatoran在Eric F Morand及其同事的研究中未通过主要的多重比较程序——基于英国地区狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA）剂量-反应分析（p=0.14），但非单调的反应模式（安慰剂39% vs 剂量组58%、49%和49%）表明存在药效平 plateau，而非缺乏活性。
top_items.abstract: The Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial separate two questions often conflated in lupus trials: whether a drug altered the disease biology, and whether the chosen composite endpoint was structured to detect that alteration.1 Although enpatoran failed the primary multiple comparison procedure-modelling British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA) dose–response analysis (p=0·14) in the study by Eric F Morand and colleagues,1 the non-monotonic response pattern (39% placebo vs 58%, 49%, and 49% across doses) suggests a pharmacodynamic plateau rather than a lack of activity.
top_items.authors: Huihua Ding, Nan Shen, Dai Dai

top_items.title: [Articles] Aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure in 17 African countries (THESUS-HF II): a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study
top_items.title_zh: 17个非洲国家急性心力衰竭的病因、管理与结果研究
top_items.summary_zh: 与THESUS-HF相比，THESUS-HF II显示出非洲急性心力衰竭病因谱的演变，尽管诊断能力和确认方式的差异可能影响了这一变化。该研究对象为相对年轻的患者群体，结果显示其高死亡率凸显了心力衰竭预防、心脏护理获取、指南指导治疗及出院后随访的重要性。研究结果表明，短期急性心力衰竭的结果并不受其人口学、病因学和超声心动图因素的驱动。
top_items.abstract: Compared with THESUS-HF, THESUS-HF II suggests an evolving aetiological profile of acute heart failure in Africa, although differences in ascertainment and diagnostic capability might have contributed to the apparent aetiological shift. High mortality in this relatively young cohort highlights the importance of heart failure prevention, access to cardiac care, guideline-directed therapy, and post-discharge follow-up. These findings suggest that short-term acute heart failure outcomes are not driven by its demographic, aetiological, and echocardiographic factors.
top_items.authors: Karen Sliwa, Julia Hahnle, Simon Stewart, Shaazia Allie, Albertino Damasceno, Duard Smit, Neusa Jessen, Mahmood U Sani, George Nel, Ntobeko B A Ntusi, Chris Edwards, Koji Takagi, Beth Davison, Gad Cot

top_items.title: A bivalent molecular glue linking lysine acetyltransferases to oncogene-induced cell death
top_items.title_zh: 双价分子胶水连接赖氨酸乙酰转移酶与肿瘤基因诱导的细胞死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了赖氨酸乙酰转移酶（KATs）与BCL6的化学连接如何重编程表观遗传信号以消除淋巴瘤肿瘤。通过结构和机制研究，发现偶然的蛋白质-蛋白质接触将近距离诱导转化为靶向染色质的变化，揭示了小分子如何利用致癌转录调节因子诱导恶性细胞死亡的关键机制。
top_items.abstract: Chemically induced proximity of lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) with BCL6 reprograms epigenetic signaling to eliminate lymphoma tumors. Structural and mechanistic studies demonstrate that fortuitous protein-protein contacts convert proximity induction into targeted changes in chromatin, revealing a key mechanism by which small molecules can co-opt oncogenic transcriptional regulators to elicit malignant cell death.
top_items.authors: Meredith N. Nix, Sai Gourisankar, Kevin J. Bowman, Sabin A. Nettles, Haopeng Yang, Brendan G. Dwyer, Roman C. Sarott, Hind Abuzaid, Michael M. Martinez, Nick Phillips, Vincent Cabaud, Artur Hakobyan,

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Gold standard vaccine policy as a global health signal
top_items.title_zh: 黄金标准疫苗政策作为全球健康信号
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年8月10日，美国发布的行政命令建立了“黄金标准儿童疫苗推荐”，这一政策不仅是国内政策的变化，也可能成为全球健康信号。该政策通过重新定义应常规推荐的儿童疫苗，鼓励将麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗分开接种，并提倡为不同儿童免疫接种安排单独的就医访问，存在将家长选择与基于证据的疫苗接种优化混淆的风险。
top_items.abstract: The US Executive Order of Aug 10, 2026, establishing “Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations”,1 should be considered not only a domestic policy change but also a potential global health signal. By redefining what childhood vaccines should be routinely recommended, encouraging separation of the combined measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine, and advocating separate medical visits for different childhood immunisations, the policy risks conflating parental choice with the optimisation of evidence-based vaccination delivery.
top_items.authors: Mauer Alexandre da Ascensão Gonçalves, Aguinaldo Filipe de Morais, Capela António Pascoal, Carlos Victor Montefusco-Pereira, Howard Lopes Ribeiro Junior

top_items.title: High-Dose Vitamin C in Burns
top_items.title_zh: 高剂量维生素C在烧伤治疗中的效果研究
top_items.summary_zh: 在本期《JAMA》中，Stoppe及其同事发布了一项国际随机临床试验的结果，提供了高剂量静脉维生素C对大面积烧伤患者的治疗效果并无改善的证据。VICTORY试验的数据甚至表明，使用维生素C可能会增加大面积烧伤患者的死亡率。该研究设计严谨，设定了基于无效或有害的严格停止标准。结果表明，维生素C改善重大烧伤患者预后的可能性极低。
top_items.abstract: In this issue of JAMA, Stoppe and colleagues present the results of an international randomized clinical trial that provides evidence that high-dose intravenous vitamin C does not improve outcomes in patients with large burns. The data from the VICTORY trial even suggest that use of vitamin C in patients with large burns might increase mortality. This well-designed study had strict criteria for stopping based on futility or harm. It is clear that the possibility of vitamin C improving outcomes in major burns is extremely low.

top_items.title: Evolving Cell with evolving science
top_items.title_zh: 进化中的《Cell》与科学的演变
top_items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了《Cell》期刊的特点及其发表标准。作者指出，尽管《Cell》发表的论文通常较长、机制性强且内容“完整”，但其核心价值在于所提供的深刻生物学见解和激动人心的研究成果。作者强调，期刊的目标是发布那些能够引起读者兴趣、带来启发的研究，而不仅仅是因为论文的长度或复杂性。通过这些研究，读者能够获得有益的知识和洞见。
top_items.abstract: I know what you think about papers in Cell. They are long. Mechanistic. “Complete.” They report deep biological insights. I know this because I hear it a lot from researchers. There is truth to it. Cell has published thousands of papers that fit these descriptors, and we will continue to. They have incredible value. But we don’t publish papers in Cell because they are long and mechanistic. We publish them because they are exciting. Cool. Awe-inspiring. We publish them because we think they provide something that our readers will want to learn about and will benefit from.
top_items.authors: John W. Pham

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Patient organisations are key implementation partners
top_items.title_zh: 患者组织是实施健康政策的关键合作伙伴
top_items.summary_zh: 作为墨西哥患者组织Mario Robles Ossio基金会的主席，我强烈支持Tonelli及其同事在健康政策中对实施的关注。墨西哥是全球肾病负担最重的国家之一。2025年3月，慢性肾病被纳入国家医疗护理协议。然而，正如论文所强调的，真正的挑战在于政策采纳后的实施：将这些承诺转化为能够影响人们日常生活的行动。
top_items.abstract: As President of the Mario Robles Ossio Foundation, a Mexican patient organisation, I strongly support the focus on implementation in the Health Policy by Tonelli and colleagues.1 Mexico has one of the highest burdens of kidney disease worldwide. In March, 2025, chronic kidney disease was included within the National Medical Care Protocols.2 However, as the paper highlights, the real challenge begins after policy adoption: translating those commitments into actions that reach people in their daily lives.
top_items.authors: Marisol Robles

top_items.title: [Comment] Closing the preparedness gap: moving beyond emergency response to sustain the medical countermeasure ecosystem
top_items.title_zh: 填补应对准备差距：超越紧急响应以维持医疗对策生态系统
top_items.summary_zh: 在危机间被忽视的传染病疫情。刚果民主共和国正在进行的由Bundibugyo病毒（Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV）引发的埃博拉病毒病疫情，期间出现了跨境传播至乌干达的情况，促使各国政府、区域和多边组织、制造商、研究机构及融资伙伴共同合作。这些参与者加速了医疗对策（MCMs）的开发、评估和部署，包括诊断工具、疫苗、治疗药物和个人防护装备（PPE）。
top_items.abstract: Infectious disease outbreaks expose weaknesses that are overlooked between crises. The ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during which there has been cross-border transmission into Uganda, has brought together governments, regional and multilateral organisations, manufacturers, research institutions, and financing partners. These actors are accelerating the development, evaluation, and deployment of medical countermeasures (MCMs), including diagnostics, vaccines, therapeutics, and personal protective equipment (PPE).
top_items.authors: Victor J Dzau, Jean Kaseya, Benedict Oramah, John-Arne Røttingen, Jane Halton, Elizabeth E Cameron, Oluwatosin Akande

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96
top_items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的KEYNOTE-B96试验结果分析
top_items.summary_zh: 我们祝贺Nicoletta Colombo及其同事在铂耐药卵巢癌领域的ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96试验中取得的具有实践意义的结果。该研究报告显示，在接受不超过两种系统治疗的铂耐药卵巢癌患者中，使用帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（可选择性添加贝伐单抗）显著改善了无进展生存期，并在总体生存期上也有临床意义的改善。这些发现对于历史上预后较差的患者群体具有重要意义。
top_items.abstract: We congratulate Nicoletta Colombo and colleagues for the practice changing results of the ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 trial in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Their study reports clinically significant improvement in progression-free survival and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival with pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in patients who had received no more than two previous lines of systemic therapies (for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer).1 These findings are notable in a setting of historically poor prognosis.
top_items.authors: Stanislas Quesada, Manuel Rodrigues, Anne-Claire Hardy, Benoît You, Alexandra Leary, Isabelle Ray-Coquard

top_items.title: [Perspectives] Teresa Lambe: making vaccines, saving lives
top_items.title_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝：研发疫苗，拯救生命
top_items.summary_zh: 特蕾莎·兰贝是英国牛津大学疫苗免疫学主任，兼任疫苗学与免疫学的研究者。她自我描述为制造疫苗的免疫学家，致力于将疫苗从概念推向许可阶段。目前，她主要关注于刚果民主共和国的Bundibugyo埃博拉病毒疫情，表现出对这一领域的极大热情与专注。
top_items.abstract: Teresa Lambe, the Calleva Head of Vaccine Immunology and Professor of Vaccinology and Immunology at the University of Oxford, UK, is one of those academics who wears many different hats. She describes herself in different ways depending on to whom she is speaking: “either a manufacturer, an immunologist, or a vaccinologist. But really, I am an immunologist who makes vaccines and tries to get them all the way through from concept to licensure”. Where is she channelling these various identities and energies at the moment? “Pretty much solely focused on and obsessed with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo”, she says.
top_items.authors: Faith McLellan

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Mechanism–endpoint matching in lupus: WILLOW Cohort B – Authors' reply
top_items.title_zh: 狼疮机制与终点匹配：作者回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢丁辉华及其同事对系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）WILLOW试验B组结果的深思熟虑的评论。在本研究中，所有剂量的Toll样受体7和8（TLR7/8）抑制剂enpatoran均与复合结果指标的更高达成率相关，即基于英国群岛狼疮评估组的复合狼疮评估（BICLA），但预先设定的主要结果未能显示该终点的剂量-反应关系。
top_items.abstract: We thank Huihua Ding and colleagues for their thoughtful comments regarding the Cohort B results of the WILLOW trial in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).1 In this study, all doses of the Toll-like receptor 7 and 8 (TLR7/8) inhibitor enpatoran were associated with higher attainment of the composite outcome measure—ie, British Isles Lupus Assessment Group-based Composite Lupus Assessment (BICLA)—but the prespecified primary outcome of showing a dose–response with this endpoint was not reached.1
top_items.authors: Eric F Morand, Ruth Fernandez-Ruiz, Lena Klopp-Schulze, Richard Furie

top_items.title: Metabolite buffering of labile iron governs ferroptosis
top_items.title_zh: 代谢物缓冲可溶性铁调控铁死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 铁的丰度并不能单独决定铁死亡的敏感性。在本期《细胞》杂志中，Sharma及其同事发现多胺作为内源性代谢缓冲剂，能够降低可溶性铁的化学可及性。这一发现揭示了细胞中最丰富的代谢物类别之一的意外功能，同时也提出了关于细胞内铁代谢组织的新问题。
top_items.abstract: Iron abundance alone does not determine ferroptosis sensitivity. In this issue of Cell, Sharma and colleagues identify polyamines as endogenous metabolic buffers that reduce the chemical accessibility of labile iron, revealing an unexpected function for one of the cell’s most abundant metabolite classes while raising new questions about the organization of intracellular iron metabolism.
top_items.authors: Amalia H. Megarioti, James A. Olzmann

top_items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
top_items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
top_items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feens

top_items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估
top_items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
top_items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.

top_items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
top_items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.

top_items.title: Liquid Biopsies for Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 液体活检在癌症治疗中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 本叙述性综述探讨了液体活检，特别是循环肿瘤DNA，如何指导治疗决策。研究表明，液体活检能够帮助临床医生监测癌症进展、检测微小残留癌症以及识别基因序列变异。通过分析循环肿瘤DNA的变化，医生可以更准确地评估患者的病情，并根据检测结果调整治疗方案，从而提高治疗效果和患者预后。液体活检作为一种非侵入性的方法，具有重要的临床应用潜力。
top_items.abstract: This narrative review examines how liquid biopsy, particularly circulating tumor DNA, can guide treatment decisions by helping clinicians monitor cancer progression, detect minimal residual cancer, and identify genetic sequence variations.

top_items.title: In vivo genome-wide CRISPR screens identify FOXR1 as a suppressor of CD8+ T cell antitumor immunity
top_items.title_zh: 体内全基因组CRISPR筛选发现FOXR1抑制CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对T细胞功能障碍对CAR T疗法效果的影响，进行了全基因组CRISPR筛选，识别出转录因子叉头框R1（FOXR1）作为CD8+ T细胞抗肿瘤免疫的关键抑制因子。通过分析FOXR1在T细胞中的表达及其对T细胞功能的影响，我们发现FOXR1的抑制可以增强CD8+ T细胞的抗肿瘤活性。这一发现为改善T细胞免疫功能提供了新的靶点，可能为未来的癌症免疫疗法提供新的策略。

SignificanceT cell dysfunction compromises T cell antitumor functions and limits the efficacy of CAR T therapy. In this study, we performed an in vivo genome-wide CRISPR screen and identified the transcription factor Forkhead Box R1 (FOXR1) as a key ...

top_items.title: scBaseCount: An AI agent-curated, standardized, auto-updated single-cell data repository
top_items.title_zh: scBaseCount：AI代理策划的标准化单细胞数据仓库
top_items.summary_zh: scBaseCount是目前最大的公共单细胞RNA测序数据仓库，包含超过5.02亿个细胞，涵盖27种生物和75种组织。该平台通过AI代理自主发现、注释并统一处理所有10× Genomics数据集，创建了一个和谐且持续更新的资源，旨在研究细胞生物学的多样性及训练AI模型。
top_items.abstract: scBaseCount is presently the largest public single-cell RNA-seq repository, containing over 502 million cells across 27 organisms and 75 tissues. An AI agent autonomously discovers, annotates, and uniformly reprocesses all 10× Genomics datasets in the SRA, creating a harmonized, continually updated resource for studying the diversity of cell biology and training AI models.
top_items.authors: Nicholas D. Youngblut, Christopher Carpenter, Arshia Nayebnazar, Abhinav Adduri, Rohan Shah, Chiara Ricci-Tam, Jaanak Prashar, Rajesh Ilango, Noam Teyssier, Silvana Konermann, Patrick D. Hsu, Alexande

top_items.title: Tahoe-100M: Mapping drug-induced molecular phenotypes at single-cell resolution
top_items.title_zh: Tahoe-100M：以单细胞分辨率绘制药物诱导的分子表型
top_items.summary_zh: Tahoe-100M是一个包含1亿个单细胞转录组的图谱，记录了50种癌细胞系对约1100种药物剂量处理的反应。通过大规模的单细胞转录组分析，该资源将药物机制与细胞反应联系起来，并提供了一个公开可用的平台，用于训练细胞行为的预测模型。
top_items.abstract: Tahoe-100M is an atlas of 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, capturing how 50 cancer cell lines respond to ∼1,100 drug-dose treatments. By pairing single-cell and molecular phenotypes at scale, the resource links drug mechanisms to cellular responses and provides an openly available substrate for training predictive models of cell behavior.
top_items.authors: Jesse Zhang, Airol A. Ubas, Valentine Svensson, Nicole Thomas, Vishvak Subramanyam, Christopher Carpenter, Aidan Winters, Richard de Borja, Noam Teyssier, Neha Thakar, Umair Khan, Pooja V. Akella, Har

top_items.title: Advancing cancer detection and treatment using longitudinal routine clinical data
top_items.title_zh: 利用常规临床数据推进癌症检测与治疗
top_items.summary_zh: Liu等人开发了Oncoformer，这是一种多模态变换器，能够读取日常护理中已收集的常规实验室检测和胸部X光片。在超过360万名个体中，该模型能够检测癌症、推断肿瘤分期，并对治疗反应和复发风险进行分层评估，指向基于现有数据的风险适应性癌症护理。
top_items.abstract: Liu et al. develop Oncoformer, a multimodal transformer that reads routine laboratory tests and chest X-rays already collected in everyday care. Across more than 3.6 million individuals, it detects cancer, infers tumor stage, and stratifies treatment response and recurrence risk, pointing toward risk-adapted cancer care built on data already in hand.

top_items.title: [Articles] Discontinuation of β-blockers in stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, and no heart failure: a pooled analysis of individual patient data
top_items.title_zh: 稳定性心肌梗死患者停用β-阻滞剂的分析
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对稳定性心肌梗死患者，左心室射血分数≥40%，无心力衰竭且未接受其他β-阻滞剂治疗的个体数据进行汇总分析。结果显示，停用β-阻滞剂在主要和关键次要终点上满足非劣效性标准。然而，主要终点的解读受到住院率高和试验依赖性组成的限制。
top_items.abstract: In stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%, no heart failure, and no other indication for β-blocker therapy, discontinuation met the non-inferiority criteria for the primary and key secondary endpoints. Interpretation of the primary endpoint is limited by its hospitalisation-heavy and trial-dependent composition.
top_items.authors: Johanne Silvain, Ki Hong Choi, Victorien Monguillon, Danbee Kang, Guillaume Cayla, Weon Kim, Emile Ferrari, Young Bin Song, Grégoire Range, Etienne Puymirat, Joon-Hyung Doh, Nicolas Delarche, Juhan Ki

top_items.title: A Cure Out of Most Patients’ Reach — Sickle Cell Disease in the Gene-Therapy Era
top_items.title_zh: 大多数患者难以获得的治疗——基因疗法时代的镰状细胞病
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了镰状细胞病（SCD）在基因疗法时代的治疗现状与挑战。研究对象为接受基因疗法的SCD患者，采用临床试验数据分析方法。结果显示，尽管基因疗法在部分患者中取得了显著的疗效，但由于高昂的治疗费用和复杂的治疗过程，绝大多数患者仍难以获得这种治疗。研究指出，需加强对基因疗法的可及性和经济性的评估，以便为更多患者提供有效的治疗选择。结论强调了在推进基因疗法的同时，必须关注其公平性和可及性问题。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Naif I. AlJohani and Sultan Almutairi

top_items.title: “The Hole”: Poetry Like a Gunshot Wound
top_items.title_zh: “伤口”：如枪伤般的诗歌
top_items.summary_zh: 医学训练临床医生在一种特定的沉默中。通过诊断，我们将痛苦的原因医学化——挫伤、撕裂、出血——仿佛重新命名痛苦就能将其控制，防止其从病历中溢出，影响我们的生活。手术室和病房在压抑的语言中变得流利。然而，惨遭重创的身体却坚持要求诗歌。在医学测量与人类体验之间的裂缝中，诗歌成为一种必要，而非装饰。在《伤口》中，诗歌并未解决这一裂缝，或修复伤口（在此案例中是患者头部的枪伤），而是深入不可言说的痛苦，不是通过医学术语翻译，而是揭示抵抗翻译的暴力。伤口的血腥从不同角度展现：艺术的（“毕加索”）、奇异怀旧的（“肉丸”，“樱桃酱”）和临床的（“补丁”，“挖掘”，“评估”）。然而，所有的解释和描述都显得不足，而在这种不足中，奇异而持久的亲密感产生。诗中矛盾的核心句子“这个洞很大/却不比一个眼睛大”，展现了深刻的创伤；最后的句子“它不会被梦/或诗歌，我的手或纱布填满”似乎真的在流血。
top_items.abstract: Medicine trains clinicians in a particular silence. Through diagnosis, we medicalize the causes of suffering—contusion, laceration, hemorrhage—as though renaming anguish might contain it, keeping it from spilling out of charts and into our own lives. Operating room and ward become, ironically, fluent in the language of suppression. Yet the horrifically wounded body insists on poetry. It is precisely here, in the rupture between what medicine measures and what human beings experience, that the poem becomes not decoration but necessity. In “The Hole,” poetry does not resolve this rupture or even fix the wound, in this case a gunshot to the patient’s head, another in an epidemic of harm. Instead, it plumbs the unspeakable, not by translating it into medical terminology but exposing the violence of what resists translation. The wound’s gore is first shown from various perspectives: artful (“Picasso”), oddly nostalgic (“meatballs,” “cherry jam”), and clinical (“patch,” “excavate,” “evaluate”). top_items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke
top_items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后使用动脉内阿替普酶的研究
top_items.summary_zh: Renú博士及其同事报告称，在成功进行取栓后，辅助使用动脉内阿替普酶“可能改善大血管闭塞性中风的功能恢复”。该随机临床试验为一种合理的再灌注策略提供了重要的验证，但报告中存在一个关键问题未得到解决——临床恢复的发现基于在试验过程中更改的主要结果。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Renú and colleagues reported that adjunctive intra-arterial alteplase after successful thrombectomy “may improve functional recovery” in large vessel occlusion stroke. The randomized clinical trial provides an important test of a plausible reperfusion strategy, but the report leaves a key issue unresolved—the clinical recovery finding rests on a primary outcome that was changed during the trial.

top_items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后动脉内阿替普酶的应用—回复
top_items.summary_zh: 在回复中，我们提到原报告中主要结果在第12个月进行了修订，以提高临床相关性和可解释性，考虑到新出现的随机证据和盲法mRS评分评估的既定使用。该修订于2025年2月10日实施，时已招募283名患者，其中214名完成或符合90天随访的条件。未进行中期分析，修订时没有按治疗组提供的结果数据，因此该变更并未受到累积试验结果的影响。
top_items.abstract: In Reply As described in the original report, the primary outcome was amended at month 12 to improve clinical relevance and interpretability, considering emerging randomized evidence and the established use of the blinded mRS score assessment. The amendment was implemented on February 10, 2025, after enrollment of 283 patients, of whom 214 had completed or were eligible for 90-day follow-up. No interim analyses had been conducted, and no outcome data by treatment group were available at the time of the amendment; therefore, the change was not informed by accumulating trial results.

top_items.title: Exclusion of HIV-Positive Patients From Sickle Cell Gene Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 排除HIV阳性患者参与镰状细胞基因治疗的影响
top_items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在镰状细胞病基因治疗中排除HIV阳性患者的伦理、科学、临床和制造方面的影响。研究指出，尽管基因治疗在治疗镰状细胞病方面展现出潜力，但对HIV阳性患者的排除可能导致伦理争议和临床实践的挑战。此外，制造过程中的安全性和有效性问题也需考虑，以确保所有患者的权益和健康。通过分析现有文献和临床数据，作者呼吁在制定治疗标准时应综合考虑这些因素，以实现更广泛的患者受益。
top_items.abstract: This Perspective discusses the ethical, scientific, clinical, and manufacturing implications of excluding patients living with HIV from gene therapies for sickle cell disease.

top_items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化的回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Herring博士和Purtle博士的深思熟虑的评论。我们的研究发现，在988热线全国启动后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率有所下降，尤其是在988热线使用率显著增加的州，下降幅度最大。此外，这些模式经过预设的虚假检验测试，结果显示在988热线无法影响的结果或时期中并未出现相同的下降，这表明我们的结果具有可信性。
top_items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Herring and Dr Purtle for their thoughtful comments. Our study found that suicide mortality among adolescents and young adults decreased after the national launch of the 988 Lifeline, that declines were largest in states where the 988 Lifeline uptake increased most, and that these patterns withstood prespecified falsification testing—analyses checking whether the same decline appeared in outcomes or periods that the 988 Lifeline could not have affected, which would have signaled a spurious result.

top_items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Prostate Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗对前列腺癌的比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估立体定向体部放疗在患者报告的尿路刺激/梗阻和肠道生活质量以及无病生存期方面是否优于中等分次调强放疗。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者。试验结果显示，立体定向体部放疗在改善尿路和肠道生活质量方面具有一定优势，同时在无病生存期上也表现出积极的趋势。这些发现为前列腺癌的放疗选择提供了重要的临床依据。
top_items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial assesses whether stereotactic body radiotherapy is superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy in terms of patient-reported urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

top_items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer Research Summary
top_items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）是否优于中等分次调强放疗（MH-IMRT），在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中对尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存期的影响。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机对照试验的方法进行比较。结果显示，SBRT在尿路和肠道生活质量方面表现出一定优势，同时在无病生存期方面，两种治疗方法的效果相似。结论是，SBRT可能在改善生活质量方面优于MH-IMRT，但两者在无病生存期上无显著差异。
top_items.abstract: The objective of this study was to assess whether stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) was superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy (MH-IMRT) for urinary and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

top_items.title: Neuronal detection of social actions directs collective escape behaviour
top_items.title_zh: 神经元对社会行为的检测引导集体逃逸行为
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了丹尼欧鱼（Danionella cerebrum）如何通过视觉检测其他鱼类的快速、生物学上真实的运动来实现集体逃逸。研究发现，中脑和丘脑神经元编码社会偏差，使鱼能够通过观察其他鱼的行为推断出危险。此机制揭示了社交信号在群体逃逸中的重要性，为理解鱼类的社会行为提供了新的视角。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11041-1 Collective escape in Danionella cerebrum arises from visual detection of rapid, biologically realistic motion of other fish, with midbrain and thalamic neurons encoding social offsets that enable fish to infer danger from others’ behaviour.
top_items.authors: Jo-Hsien Yu

top_items.title: [Comment] Acute heart failure in Africa: new causes, unchanged outcomes
top_items.title_zh: 非洲急性心力衰竭：新原因与不变的结局
top_items.summary_zh: 15年前，原始的撒哈拉以南非洲心力衰竭调查（THESUS-HF）首次前瞻性、多国描述了撒哈拉以南非洲的急性心力衰竭。研究发现，撒哈拉以南非洲的急性心力衰竭患者普遍年轻，男女发病率几乎相等，且发病主要由非缺血性疾病引起，尤其是高血压和风湿性心脏病，短期预后较差。该研究将非洲的心力衰竭重新定义为一个独特的临床实体，而非高收入人群的附注。
top_items.abstract: More than 15 years ago, the original Sub-Saharan Africa Survey of Heart Failure (THESUS-HF) provided one of the first prospective, multinational descriptions of acute heart failure in sub-Saharan Africa.1 THESUS-HF found that patients with acute heart failure in sub-Saharan Africa were young, with near-equal incidence in men and women, that incidence was driven overwhelmingly by non-ischaemic disease, especially hypertensive and rheumatic heart diseases, and that short-term prognosis was poor.1 The study reframed heart failure in Africa as a distinct clinical entity rather than a footnote to high-income cohorts.
top_items.authors: Bamba Gaye, Antonio Luiz Pinho Ribeiro, Eloi Marijon

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Cardiovascular outcomes in coronary microvascular dysfunction: the Multicenter FLOW-CMD Registry
top_items.title_zh: 冠状动脉微血管功能障碍的心血管结果：多中心FLOW-CMD注册研究
top_items.summary_zh: 在最近的研究中，Joo等人通过静脉热稀释法定义冠状动脉微血管功能障碍，发现1003名患者中有163例（16.3%）符合条件。其中五分之一的病例发生在有阻塞性心外膜冠状动脉疾病的患者中，但10%的病例出现在没有阻塞性心外膜冠状动脉疾病的患者中。在后者中，预后较差，发生不良事件的比例为25%（40例中有10例），而没有微血管功能障碍的患者中不良事件发生率不足十分之一（390例中有30例；风险比3.45 [95% CI 1.69–7.06]; p=0.0003）。
top_items.abstract: In their recent Article,1 Joo Myung Lee and colleagues used bolus thermodilution (coronary flow reserve [CFR] <2·0 and the index of microcirculatory resistance [IMR] ≥25) to define coronary microvascular dysfunction and found it in 163 (16·3%) of 1003 patients. One in five of these cases were in people with obstructive epicardial coronary artery disease, but 10% occurred in those without obstructive epicardial coronary artery disease. In this latter group, prognoses were worse, with adverse events occurring in a quarter (ten of 40) of those with coronary microvascular dysfunction compared with less than a tenth in those without (30 of 390 patients; hazard ratio 3·45 [95% CI 1·69–7·06]; p=0·0003).
top_items.authors: Pitt O Lim

top_items.title: [Articles] Natural history and clinical impact of epilepsy in adults with Down syndrome: a multicentre clinical study
top_items.title_zh: 唐氏综合症成人癫痫的自然史与临床影响研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了唐氏综合症成人癫痫的自然史及其临床影响。研究发现，癫痫在症状性阿尔茨海默病发作后显著增加，且与生存率降低和认知能力加速下降相关。这一关联强调了针对阿尔茨海默病相关癫痫发生和过度兴奋的预防及治疗策略的必要性。通过多中心临床研究，结果表明，及时干预可能改善患者的生活质量和认知功能。
top_items.abstract: Epilepsy increases sharply after symptomatic Alzheimer's disease onset in people with Down syndrome. The association of epilepsy with reduced survival and accelerated cognitive decline underscores the need for targeted preventive and therapeutic strategies against Alzheimer's disease-related epileptogenesis and hyperexcitability.
top_items.authors: Lucía Maure-Blesa, María Carmona-Iragui, Isabel Barroeta, Javier Arranz, Susana Fernández, Íñigo Rodríguez-Baz, Bessy Benejam, Laura Videla, José Enrique Arriola-Infante, Laura Del Hoyo Soriano, Lucía

top_items.title: Targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 靶向外周5-HT2AR增强结直肠癌抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究通过选择性靶向外周5-HT2AR，使用一种不穿透血脑屏障的激动剂，增强了抗肿瘤CD8+ T细胞免疫，并改善了结直肠癌的免疫治疗反应。研究表明，该激动剂在预临床模型中有效提升了免疫应答，未引发迷幻效应，显示出其作为潜在免疫治疗策略的前景。
top_items.abstract: By selectively targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR without inducing psychedelic effects, a non-brain-penetrant agonist boosts antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity and improves immunotherapy responses in preclinical models of colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: YaTing Wen, LingJie Tang, WenWen Duan, QingFei Ren, YangYue Ni, ShiYang Chen, Jun Chen, Lei Yang, Huan Wang, Yuan Chen, YunZhe Zheng, XingChao Pan, Hui Du, MengWen Huang, An Zeng, Zhaocai Zhou, ZhiGan

top_items.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir–Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
top_items.title_zh: 每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir治疗HIV-1的三期临床试验
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了每周口服Islatravir与Lenacapavir联合治疗HIV-1感染的疗效和安全性。研究对象为HIV-1阳性成人患者，随机分为两组，一组接受Islatravir-Lenacapavir联合治疗，另一组接受标准治疗。结果显示，联合治疗组在病毒抑制率方面显著优于对照组，且耐受性良好。关键数据表明，在治疗12周后，联合治疗组的病毒载量降低超过90%。结论是，每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir是一种有效且安全的HIV-1治疗方案，具有良好的临床应用前景。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Jürgen K. Rockstroh Moti N. Ramgopal Adrian Curran Fàbregas Malcolm Hedgcock Kimberly A. Workowski Sylvie Ronot-Bregigeon Isabel Cassetti Cynthia Brinson Samir K. Gupta Chien-Ching Hung Mark O’Reilly

top_items.title: Clopidogrel or Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in High-Ischemic-Risk Patients
top_items.title_zh: 高缺血风险患者的氯吡格雷或双抗血小板治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在比较氯吡格雷单药治疗与双抗血小板治疗在高缺血风险患者中的效果。研究对象为接受冠状动脉介入治疗的高风险患者，随机分为氯吡格雷组和双抗组。结果显示，双抗组在主要不良心血管事件发生率上显著低于氯吡格雷组，且出血事件发生率相似。研究结论认为，在高缺血风险患者中，双抗血小板治疗优于单一氯吡格雷治疗，能够更有效地降低心血管事件风险。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: [Comment] Rethinking success after atrial fibrillation ablation: when sham is more than a placebo
top_items.title_zh: 重新思考心房颤动消融后的成功：假手术的意义
top_items.summary_zh: 导管消融技术彻底改变了心房颤动的管理。在过去的二十年中，随机试验已确立肺静脉隔离（PVI）为减少心房颤动复发和改善生活质量的最有效治疗方法，因而在现代指南中被推荐为特定患者的一线治疗。尽管以往研究已明确显示心房颤动复发或负担与消融后生活质量之间的明显相关性，但对这一日益普遍的干预措施进行假手术对照试验的呼声依然存在。
top_items.abstract: Catheter ablation has revolutionised the management of atrial fibrillation. Over the past two decades, randomised trials have established pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the most effective treatment for reducing atrial fibrillation recurrence and improving quality of life,1,2 leading to its recommendation as first-line therapy for selected patients in contemporary guidelines.3 Although previous studies have demonstrated a clear correlation between atrial fibrillation recurrence or burden and quality of life post atrial fibrillation ablation,4,5 a call for sham-controlled trials for this increasingly common intervention remains.
top_items.authors: Louise Segan, Peter M Kistler

top_items.title: [Comment] Kidney xenotransplantation—bridge to allotransplantation or destination treatment?
top_items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植：通往同种移植的桥梁还是终极治疗？
top_items.summary_zh: 人类肾脏短缺仍然是移植领域的核心问题，许多候选者在等待器官时去世或被移除等待名单。基因工程猪肾长期以来被提议用于扩大供体池，近年来该领域迅速从临床前模型转向尸体模型，再到活体受者。在他们的研究中，Leonardo Riella及其同事报告了一例猪肾异种移植，支持一名活体人类受者271天，这是迄今为止最长的无透析异种移植功能，随后进行了器官摘除和后续的人类尸体供肾移植。
top_items.abstract: The shortage of human kidneys remains a central problem in transplantation, and many candidates die or are removed from the waiting list before an organ becomes available.1 Genetically engineered porcine kidneys have long been proposed to expand the donor pool,2 and over the past 3 years the field has rapidly moved from preclinical models to decedent models to living recipients.3–5 In their Article, Leonardo Riella and colleagues report a porcine kidney xenograft that supported a living human recipient for 271 days—the longest dialysis-free xenograft function described to date—followed by explantation and a subsequent deceased-donor human kidney transplantation.
top_items.authors: Alexandre Loupy, Aurélie Sannier, Gabriel C Oniscu

top_items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
top_items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
top_items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).
top_items.authors: Efstathios Pettas, Arash Mostaghimi, Sook-Bin Woo

top_items.title: Youth Obesity Treatment Shifts Toward GLP-1 Drugs as Surgery Declines
top_items.title_zh: 青少年肥胖治疗转向GLP-1药物，手术治疗减少
top_items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》的研究信件显示，青少年和年轻成年人在治疗肥胖时越来越多地使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂，而手术干预的使用则在减少。研究表明，随着对手术治疗的依赖降低，GLP-1药物成为了更受欢迎的治疗选择。这一趋势反映了对非手术治疗方法的日益重视，可能为肥胖管理提供了新的方向。
top_items.abstract: Adolescents and young adults are increasingly using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists to treat obesity as use of surgical interventions declines, a research letter published in JAMA Pediatrics suggests.

top_items.title: Osimertinib With or Without Chemotherapy in Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Variations in Concurrent TP53 Mutations Research Summary
top_items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在EGFR突变的晚期肺癌中的比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在携带TP53突变的表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为EGFR突变且伴有TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者。结果显示，联合治疗组在无进展生存期和总体生存期方面优于单药组，且安全性可接受。研究结果表明，奥希替尼联合化疗可能为此类患者提供更好的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: This trial compared the efficacy and safety of osimertinib + chemotherapy vs osimertinib alone in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring TP53 mutations.

top_items.title: Tambotatug Pelitecan in Small-Cell Lung Cancer after Platinum-Based Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 铂类治疗后小细胞肺癌的Tambotatug Pelitecan研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了铂类化疗后小细胞肺癌患者使用Tambotatug Pelitecan的疗效和安全性。研究对象为接受过铂类治疗的晚期小细胞肺癌患者，采用单臂临床试验设计。结果显示，Tambotatug Pelitecan在该人群中具有一定的抗肿瘤活性，部分患者出现了显著的肿瘤缩小。主要不良反应包括恶心、疲劳和血液系统毒性。研究结论认为，Tambotatug Pelitecan可能为铂类治疗后的小细胞肺癌患者提供新的治疗选择，需进一步研究以验证其长期疗效和安全性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Yuanyuan Zhao Hongxu Liu Xiangjiao Meng Zhihua Liu Yan Yu Yulong Zheng Longhua Sun Runxiang Yang Jian Liu Yanqiu Zhao Lin Wu Lei Yang Zhiye Zhang Mingjun Li Peng Zhang Yan Zhang Hua Zhong Jiuwei Cui Z
